descriptionByLocale.de:
Bauen wir gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft! Durch die Kombination unserer einzigartigen Stärken definieren wir die Gesundheitsversorgung durch nachhaltiges Handeln und Innovationen. Sehen Sie sich dieses Video an, um zu sehen, wie wir bei Roche eine personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung zur Realität machen. Die mySugr GmbH wurde 2017 von Roche übernommen und unser Büro in Wien gehört zu den weltweiten Standorten von Roche. Sie befinden sich hier im Herzen von Wien, egal ob Sie an einem mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® oder einer anderen Roche-Produkt oder Lösung arbeiten. Lesen Sie hier mehr über die Geschichte von mySugr & Roche . Hier ist, was wir suchen: Roche nutzt ein einheitliches Design-System, um die Benutzeroberflächen seiner digitalen Produkte zu optimieren und für unsere Kunden ein einheitliches, harmonisiertes Nutzererlebnis zu bieten. Das One Design System umfasst alle Web- und mobilen Anwendungen, die bei Roche Diagnostics entwickelt wurden. Unser Engineering-Team ist auf der Suche nach einem Android-Experten in der Lage, die Entwicklung von Android-Mobile-Komponenten zu führen, um die korrekte Gestaltung und Implementierung von hochmodernen Benutzeroberflächen für Android-Mobilanwendungen zu gewährleisten. Sie sind in der Lage, UX- und Kundenanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und umgekehrt, und Sie werden die Entwicklung solcher Komponenten führen. Sie befinden sich entweder in Wien oder in Sant Cugat (bei Barcelona). Ihre kommende Mission: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Ausführung:
• Architekt, entwickeln, pflegen die Design-System-Komponenten und Interaktionsmuster für mobile, im Einklang mit Plattformstrategien, Governance-Politik und Standards.
• Schreiben Sie und überprüfen Sie saubere, testbare, skalierbare Code mit besten Praktiken und Design-Muster.
• Erhalten Sie die Codequalität durch automatisierte Tests, Code-Reviews und kontinuierliche Integrationspipelines.
• Technische Bewertung der Entwicklung der Konstruktionskomponenten im mobilen Bereich, um sicherzustellen, dass der Ansatz von Qualität ist, ist es kundenzentriert, zukünftiges Denken und einfach zu bedienen.
• Nehmen Sie aktiv an der Schaffung der Architektur für mobile Anwendungen teil, die mit Plattformstrategien, Governance-Politik und Standards vereinbar ist. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
• Zusammenarbeit mit Design & Entwicklung Teams, um Ziele, Umfang und Geschäftsergebnisse auszurichten.
• Stellen Sie die Dokumentation zu mobilen Komponenten sicher und unterstützen Sie die mobile Entwicklungsgemeinschaft bei Adoption, Umsetzung, Tests und Wartung.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Roche-Kunden (Projektleiter, Architekten, Designer, Front-End-Entwickler) zusammen, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und ihre Zweifel zu lösen.
• Champion die Einführung des Design Systems zusammen mit dem Kunden und den Usability Engineers über Roche. Kreative / strategische Aktivitäten:
• Verbesserungen der Brainstorm und innovative Lösungen zur Verbesserung des Community Engagements.
• Neue Technologien, Muster und Rahmen für eine mögliche Adoption bewerten.
• Tragen Sie auf Design-Review, Prototypen und mobile Benutzererfahrungsstandards bei. KI powered design system:
• Erstellung von Dokumentationen für AI-Agenten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Benutzer des Design-Systems mit der Bibliothek
• Erstellen Sie Testanwendungen mit Vibe-Codierung, um die Kompatibilität der Bibliothek mit AI zu gewährleisten
• Dokumentieren Sie alle Komponenten in Fiigma-Code-Verbindung Wesentliche Fähigkeiten für Ihre Mission:
• Android Developer für mindestens 5 Jahre
• Experte in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose und Git
• Erfahrung mit Material Design 3 für Jetpack Compose und Design Systems im Allgemeinen
• Starke Erfahrung zum Aufbau von wiederverwendbaren, testbaren, kompilierbaren UI-Komponenten
• Proficiency zu schreiben Einheitstests, Screenshot-Tests, Compose UI Tests
• Tiefe Kenntnisse über die Umsetzung der besten Praktiken der Zugänglichkeit (A11y) in Jetpack Compose
• RTL Wissen Bonusfähigkeiten:
• Vivid Interesse an modernen Technologietrends und Best Practices
• Curiosität in Domains außerhalb von Android: iOS-Entwicklung, Cross-Plattform-Lösungen Wissen.
• Innersourcen-Produkte Erfahrung
• Engagement in dev-Communities, Community-Management, aktiver Beitrag zur Öffnung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain, ensemble! En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé par une action durable et l'innovation. Pour un regard en coulisses, regardez cette vidéo pour voir comment nous, à Roche, faisons des soins de santé personnalisés une réalité. La mySugr GmbH a été acquise par Roche en 2017 et notre bureau de Vienne est l'un des sites mondiaux de Roche. Vous serez situé ici, au cœur de Vienne, peu importe si vous travaillez sur un mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® ou tout autre produit ou solution Roche. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur l'histoire de mySugr & Roche ici. Voici ce que nous recherchons : Roche utilise un système de conception unifié pour rationaliser les interfaces utilisateur de ses produits numériques et offrir une expérience utilisateur cohérente et harmonisée à nos clients. Le système One Design englobe toutes les applications web et mobiles développées chez Roche Diagnostics. Notre équipe d'ingénierie est à la recherche d'un expert Android capable de diriger le développement de composants mobiles Android assurant la conception et la mise en œuvre correctes d'interfaces utilisateur de pointe pour les applications mobiles Android. Vous êtes en mesure de traduire les exigences de UX et de clients en solutions techniques et vice versa, et vous dirigerez le développement de ces composants. Vous serez situé soit à Vienne, soit à Sant Cugat (près de Barcelone). Votre prochaine mission: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:
• Architecte, développe, maintient les composants du système de conception et les modèles d'interaction pour mobile, en conformité avec les stratégies de plate-forme, la politique de gouvernance, et les normes.
• Écrire et commenter un code propre, testable, évolutif aligné sur les meilleures pratiques et les modèles de conception.
• Maintenir la qualité du code au moyen d'essais automatisés, d'examens de code et de pipelines d'intégration continue.
• Fournir une évaluation technique du développement des composants de conception dans le mobile, en veillant à ce que l'approche soit de qualité, qu'elle soit centrée sur le client, la pensée future et facile à utiliser.
• Participer activement à la création de l'architecture pour les applications mobiles, conformément aux stratégies des plateformes, aux politiques de gouvernance et aux normes. Collaboration des intervenants et interfonctions :
• Collaborer avec les équipes de conception et de développement pour s'aligner sur les objectifs, la portée et les résultats opérationnels.
• Assurer la documentation sur les composants mobiles et aider la communauté du développement mobile à adopter, mettre en œuvre, tester et entretenir.
• Travailler avec les clients Roche (chefs de projet, architectes, concepteurs, développeurs de front) pour établir la collaboration, comprendre leurs besoins et résoudre leurs doutes.
• Championne de l'adoption du système de conception avec le client et les ingénieurs d'utilisation de Roche. Activités créatives/stratégiques:
• Améliorations de brainstorm et propositions de solutions innovantes pour améliorer l'engagement communautaire.
• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies, modèles et cadres en vue de leur adoption éventuelle.
• Contribuer à l'examen de la conception, des prototypes et des normes d'expérience des utilisateurs mobiles. Système de conception alimenté par l'IA :
• Créer une documentation pour les agents de l'IA pour s'assurer que les utilisateurs du système de conception peuvent vibrer le code avec la bibliothèque
• Créer des applications de test en utilisant le codage par vibration pour assurer la compatibilité de la bibliothèque avec l'IA
• Documenter tous les composants du code Fiigma connecter Compétences essentielles pour votre mission :
• Développeur Android depuis au moins 5 ans
• Expert en Kotlin, Jetpack Compose et Git
• Expérience avec la conception de matériaux 3 pour Jetpack Compose et les systèmes de conception en général
• Forte expérience pour construire des composants d'interface réutilisables, testables et composables
• Compétence pour écrire des tests unitaires, des tests de capture d'écran, des tests d'interface Compose
• Connaissance approfondie de la mise en oeuvre des meilleures pratiques d'accessibilité (A11y) dans Jetpack Compose
• Compétences en bonus de connaissances RTL :
• Intérêt vif pour les tendances et les meilleures pratiques technologiques modernes
• Curiosité dans les domaines en dehors d'Android : développement iOS, connaissances sur les solutions multiplates.
• L'expérience des produits de sources internes
• L'engagement dans les communautés de développement, la gestion communautaire, la contribution active à l'ouverture

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。
Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.
2、 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。
Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.
3、 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。
Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.
4、 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。
Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.

titleByLocale.en: Customer Support Center - Medical Laboratory Diagnostics (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Wir freuen uns auf Unterstützung und Deine Ideen im Teams des Regional Customer Support Centers in Mannheim. Wir sind verantwortlich für den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice: vom technischen Produktmanagement über Trainings zur Bedienung von Analysegeräten bis zur telefonischen Hotline. Während Deines Praktikums arbeitest Du zusammen mit unseren Spezialisten im Bereich der Laborsysteme zur medizinischen Diagnostik. Hier sammelst Du Erfahrungen direkt an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik, IT, Naturwissenschaft und Medizin und lernst unsere teils internationalen Kunden aus Labor und Krankenhaus in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Belgien, der Niederlande, Griechenland und der Türkei kennen.

Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt und koordinierst applikative und technische Serviceprojekte

• Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Wissensmanagement-Tools

• Du unterstützt bei der Trainings- und Hotlineplanung sowie der Reklamationsbearbeitung

• Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung und Bearbeitung von Prozessbeschreibungen mit

• Du erstellst Analysen und Reports für Controlling-Zwecke

Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem Masterstudium der Fachrichtung Biologie, Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Chemie, Medizin oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung eingeschrieben

• Du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrungen in Projektmanagement gesammelt

• Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem MS / Google-Office-Paket, insbesondere Excel und Powerpoint beherrschst du sehr gut

• Du überzeugst mit einer analytischen Herangehensweise, hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster und verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Koordinationsfähigkeit

• Arbeiten im Team ist für dich selbstverständlich, speziell auch im internationalen Kontext

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und Anschreiben online hoch.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key Responsibilities
Sales and Market Strategy

• Responsible for planning and executing business plans to achieve sales targets for the Mass Spec product line.

• Formulate and execute customized sales strategies for key customers.

• Coordinate sales activities in conjunction with clinical chemistry/immunoassay equipment and pioneer new markets for TDM, Vitamin D, and High Medical Value Assays.

• Deliver differentiated value by achieving customer retention, expansion, and new acquisition through opportunity identification, solution proposal, and execution.

Customer Management

• Build relationships and establish long-term business connections with key decision-makers and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).

• Maximize the value of integrated solutions and customer satisfaction through KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilize specialized knowledge to resolve technical inquiries and provide professional customer support.

• Provide necessary support and solutions to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with various organizations such as Marketing, Application Specialist, Service Engineer, and Medical Affairs.

Collaboration and Accountability

• Drive business success through close cooperation with relevant departments (Marketing, Finance, Service, etc.).

• Enhance overall diagnostic business performance through collaboration with other business units, including the Digital Business Unit, Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit, and Automation-related departments.

• Responsible for sales forecasting, contract management, and sales reporting.

Competency Development

• Practice continuous learning and internal sharing of Mass Spec technology, market trends, and competitor information.

• Strengthen expertise in automation systems, LC-MS/MS analysis principles, and Total laboratory automation integration technology.

• Continuously develop sales competencies (negotiation, strategic thinking, communication).

Who You Are

Education and Experience

• Major in a related field such as Life Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Clinical Chemistry

• 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, biotech, life science instruments, or analytical equipment sectors

Required and Preferred Experience

• Sales experience with LC-MS/MS or Mass Spec equipment portfolio

• Experience with LC-MS/MS reagent application (overall operation)

• Experience and understanding of clinical application of High Medical Value Assays, Vitamin D, Immunosuppressants, etc

• Understanding of the central laboratory operating environment, including Clinical Laboratory Automation Workflow, Laboratory Information System/Total laboratory automation, Clinical Chemistry/Immunoassay, or CBC

• Essential in English for technical communication and information sharing with Global/APAC teams

• Native-level proficiency in Korean is required

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are

jobs.title: QA Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Product Release & Batch Documentation Management

• Batch Record Review: Lead the comprehensive review and approval of all Batch Production Records (BPR) and Batch Control Records (BCR) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and strict adherence to cGMP standards.

• Release Decision & Certification: Facilitate the efficient and timely release of products by verifying all testing results against specifications and issuing Certificates of Analysis (CoA) for final batch disposition.

• Aseptic Oversight: Oversee the local batch release process specifically for aseptic filling and packaging operations, ensuring that sterility assurance and environmental monitoring data support the release.

Materials Management & Supplier Quality

• Material Disposition: Manage the quality oversight of raw materials, consumables, and primary packaging materials, ensuring they are sampled, tested, and released on-time to support production schedules.

• Perform thorough risk assessments to identify potential quality risks, develop and implement risk mitigation strategies

• Supplier Lifecycle Management: Lead the quality evaluation and qualification of material suppliers based on risk-based quality criteria and international regulatory requirements.

Service Provider & Third-Party Oversight

• External Service Governance: Manage the quality oversight of third-party service providers and external laboratories, ensuring that outsourced testing and GMP-related services (e.g., calibration, validation) meet internal quality standards.

• Quality Agreements: Drive the establishment and maintenance of Quality Agreements with service providers and third-party labs to clearly define compliance responsibilities.

• Audit & Inspection Readiness: Collaborate and lead during internal/external audits and Health Authority (HA) inspections, representing the quality status of supplier and service provider management systems.
Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) & Quality Trend Analysis

• APQR Compilation & Coordination: Lead the end-to-end preparation, coordination, and compilation of the Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) to evaluate the consistency of existing manufacturing processes and the appropriateness of current specifications.

• Data Synthesis & Statistical Analysis: Systematically review and analyze critical data, including batch records, out-of-specification (OOS) results, deviations, changes, and stability data, utilizing statistical tools to identify any adverse trends.

• Compliance Assessment: Evaluate the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and previous year’s recommendations to ensure continuous improvement in product quality and process robustness.

• Regulatory Reporting: Ensure the timely completion and archival of APQR reports in compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., NMPA, FDA, EMA), and present key findings during Quality Management Reviews or health authority inspections.

• Responsible for ensuring that product quality issues are correctly investigated, and that appropriate corrective and preventative actions are implemented. Review deviation/exception/ investigation reports.

• Support and represent QA during audits and inspections; may directly interact with regulatory agencies during on-site inspections.

• Maintain project timelines associated with initiatives to support the evolving business.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the

jobs.title: QA Specialist, BIologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Quality and Technical Guidance

• Oversee programs to support Visual Inspection Operations at the Drug Product facility.

• Execute daily operations, including, but limited to:

• Providing Quality Oversight and guidance during on-the-floor manufacturing

• Executing daily on-the-floor duties to ensure facilities, equipment, materials, and documentation comply with SOPs and safety standards.

• Performing Quarantine and Segregation of material.

• Performing line clearances activities.

• Perform Acceptable Quality Level (AQL).

• Review procedures, documents and records, including but not limited to Batch Production Records, and Protocols.

• Ensure that EBR/Batch Records are complete, accurate, and documented according to the written procedure. Quality support in electronic batch record creation, review, and approval.

• Author/Review/ Quality documents, such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Risk Assessment (RA), training materials, training documents, protocols and reports.

• Support and represent QA during audits and inspections; may directly interact with regulatory agencies during on-site inspections.

• Identification and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities within our processes and systems and contribute to the continuous improvement culture.

• Maintain project timelines associated with initiatives to support the evolving business.

• Responsible for ensuring that product quality issues are correctly investigated, and that appropriate corrective and preventative actions are implemented. Review deviation/exception/ investigation reports.

• Supports management to implement and maintain the following programs, Annual Product Quality Review (APQR), Compliance Alerts, Market Actions and Roche Global document assessments required to be performed at the site level.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Support the compliance, regulatory and training activities as required

Education/Qualifications

• The candidate should have at least a Degree in pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences, biology, biotechnology chemistry, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

Job Required Competencies

• A minimum experience of 3 years in pharmaceutical or biotechnology in quality assurance, GMP compliance, operations or validation, ideally in a multinational company.

• Aseptic Filling experience is required.

• Ability to apply a phase appropriate, risk-based approach to QA operational decisions.

• Experience supporting cGMP manufacturing operations through administration and enforcement of the Quality Management System.

• Ability to work well independently and within a team.

• Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent oral and written communication skills in English with technical writing experience required.

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: (Sr.) Country Medical Manager (GI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

titleByLocale.it: Business Analysis Manager (Sistema IT di produzione)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'analyse des activités (système informatique de fabrication)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsible for business management, process management, and user management of manufacturing IT systems.
负责生产IT系统的业务管理、流程管理和用户管理。
1. Business Requirement Analysis: Communicate with production business departments to gather and analyze their needs, ensuring IT systems meet business requirements, support and enhance business efficiency, and comply with GxP regulations.
业务需求分析： 与生产业务部门沟通，收集和分析其需求，确保IT系统满足业务需求、支持和提升业务效率且符合GxP法规。
2. System Evaluation: Assess the performance of existing production IT systems, propose improvements and new system requirements based on business needs, and assist in selecting suitable technical solutions.
系统评估： 评估现有生产IT系统的表现，结合业务需求提出改进建议和新的系统需求，并协助选择合适的技术解决方案。
3. Process Optimization: Analyze current business processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement optimization plans.
流程优化： 分析当前业务流程，识别改进点，制定并实施优化方案。
4. Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analysis tools to generate insights reports, supporting business decisions and process optimization.
数据驱动决策： 利用数据分析工具，生成洞察报告，支持业务决策和流程优化。
5. User Access Control: Manage user permissions to ensure only authorized personnel can access corresponding data and functions.
用户权限控制： 管理用户权限，确保只有获得授权的人员才能访问权限相应的数据和功能。
6. Business Continuity Planning (BCP): Develop and maintain business continuity plans to ensure production and business activities can continue in emergencies.
业务持续计划（BCP）： 制定和维护业务持续性计划，以确保在紧急情况下生产和业务活动能够持续进行。
7. Audit Trail Review: Participate in periodical audit trail review to ensure data and operational traceability, complying with GxP regulations.
审计追踪审查： 参与定期的审计追踪审查，确保数据和操作的可追溯性，符合GxP法规的要求。
8. User Support and Training: Support IT system training for production and business teams, assisting them in effectively utilizing IT system features.
用户支持与培训： 支持对生产业务团队的IT系统培训，协助他们能够高效利用IT系统的功能。
9. Problem Solving: Assist in identifying and resolving IT system issues in business applications, providing continuous support and improvement suggestions.
问题解决：协助发现和解决IT系统在业务应用中的问题，提供持续的支持和改进建议。
10. Project Management: Lead or participate in projects related to production IT systems to ensure business goals are met.
项目管理： 领导或参与与生产IT系统相关的项目，确保达到业务目标。
11. Other tasks assigned by the line manager.
其他直线经理安排的任务。

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or related fields
工业工程、信息技术、生物技术、制药工程或相关领域的学士或硕士学位
Leadership Competencies 领导者胜任力
Models Integrity倡导诚信
Focus on value and customer 价值与客户导向
Align for success 协力成功
Deliver results 结果导向
Learn for the future 不断学习
Teamwork and collaboration团队协作配合
Strategic agility战略灵活性
Change Management变革管理
Excellent and proven interpersonal and influencing skills出色且可靠的人际交往能力和影响力
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
Work Experience: At least 5 years of business analysis or related experience in production IT systems. Preference for candidates with experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
工作经验： 至少5年生产IT系统的业务分析或相关工作经验，有制药行业经验者优先。
Business Analysis Skills: Proficient in business requirement analysis and process optimization methods and tools. Project management experience is preferred.
业务分析技能： 熟练掌握业务需求分析和流程优化的方法和工具，有项目管理经验者优先。
Technical Understanding: Knowledge of production management soft

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Lifecycle Management team focuses on supporting ELM processes and provides customer service and advisory support to managers, employees, People & Culture and business partners on global P&C systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.
As a Employee Lifecycle Management Subject Matter Expert, you are responsible for coordinating complex P&C requests and being the internal escalation point for the ELM Specialists and Senior Specialist. In this role, you will be delivering training on systems, tools and processes, ensuring quality data maintenance by regular checks and assisting implementing corrective actions. In this position you will ensure that all relevant process documentation is up to date. The ELM SME also focuses on projects, system testing and continuous improvement initiatives.

You will be :

• Service Delivery : Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced. Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement. Align service delivery and quality with overarching objectives of the global People Support Solutions organization. Manage service quality expectations and address customer concerns . Ensure end to end ownership of resolution . Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs. Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations. Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.

• Coordination of Complex HR Requests : Provide customer service on HR related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting for end to end customer experience.
Execute system data maintenance and business process activities in support of P&C business processes ( onboarding, movement, off boarding etc. ) Act as SPOC for internal escalations (Tier 2). In team assigned, support appropriate process execution, Servicing regulatory compliance / Audit readiness . Support P&C chapters in system maintenance activities . Support operations in troubleshooting and in escalations to Tier 3 (IT/P&C)

• Training Delivery and Ensure Data Quality : Advise and train stakeholders on process and system. Deliver solution and process training. Acts as a point of contact for all training related topics. Identify training needs and propose training activities (internal and external). Attend community meetings and cascade information to the appropriate levels. Delivers New Hire Orientation process/system training for newcomers

• Process Documentation Correctness : Collaborate with other P&C chapters keep training materials and process documentation up to date. Follow the system and process updates and embed new knowledge in the existing community. Ensure process and systems documentation is up to date through coordinating the update of SWIs and local SOP documentation

• Projects Delivery, System Testing and Continuous Improvement ; Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives. Participates in HR Support Solution systems and business process innovation projects, including system. Leads project streams or small projects or initiatives within the respective area. Work with Operations Teams, BPAs, IWS, and CoE and IT, etc.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support So

jobs.title: Biomarker Group Leader (Principal Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we create transformative medicines to tackle some of the world's toughest unmet healthcare needs for patients. At CICoR, we aspire to serve patients by leveraging China's life science ecosystem to accelerate scientific innovation and develop breakthrough medicines. Together, we cultivate a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility—one where our talented people are empowered and inspired to deliver extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

The mission of our biomarker team is to accelerate early-phase clinical development, through effective patient selection and enrichment, and generation and analysis of clinical biomarker data. These efforts enable proof-of-mechanism (PoM) demonstration and deeper disease understanding, supporting faster and more confident decision-making. In addition, we provide biomarker expertise to discovery projects to elucidate the molecular pathways that drive disease.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the biomarker team. In this role, you will strategize and deliver rigorous biomarker support across multiple disease areas—including Oncology, Immunology, Neurology, Cardiovascular & Metabolism, and Ophthalmology, etc.—to advance translational science in China. You will ensure strong contributions to programs in both early- and late-stage clinical development by collaborating with cross-functional teams in China and globally, as well as with key TAEs and CROs in China.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of biomarker experts while also serving as an hands-on individual contributor.

• Define and drive the China biomarker strategy for early and late-phase clinical development programs, including providing program-specific feasibility assessments and execution plans.

• Serve as the biomarker subject matter expert on clinical development project teams, advising on disease biology and biomarker science.

• Support the generation and review of critical clinical development documents (e.g., protocols, ICFs) to ensure alignment with biomarker strategies.

• Partner with global biomarker and project teams to lead the execution of biomarker studies, including data analysis, interpretation, and reporting.

• Integrate preclinical, clinical, and real-world data to guide indication selection and develop patient enrichment strategies to increase the probability of clinical success for CICoR programs.

• Design and lead forward and reverse translational research studies in collaboration with internal and external partners to support the preclinical and clinical portfolio.

• Stay abreast of novel biomarker modalities and technologies to drive the prioritization and harmonization of biomarker platforms across the portfolio.

• Lead biomarker assay outsourcing efforts, including overseeing assay development, transfer, validation, and execution at CROs for both non-clinical and clinical studies.

• Ensure data integrity through critical review and validation of CRO-generated results.

• Identify, select, and manage external vendors and institutional collaborators to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data .

Qualification

• PhD or MD in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Oncology, Immunology, etc.).

• Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in Translational Medicine, Clinical Development, or Biology research, with a strong preference for candidates possessing a background in biomarker research or clinical

• Define and drive the China biomarker strategy for early and late-phase clinical development programs, including providing program-specific feasibility assessments and execution plans.
• Serve as the biomarker subject matter expert on clinical development project teams, advising on disease biology and biomarker science.
• Support the generation and review of critical clinical development documents (e.g., protocols, ICFs) to ensure alignment with biomarker strategies.
• Partner with global biomarker and project teams to lead the execution of biomarker studies, including data analysis, interpretation, and reporting.
• Integrate preclinical, clinical, and real-world data to guide indication selection and develop patient enrichment strategies to increase the probability of clinical success for CICoR programs.
• Design and lead forward and reverse translational research studies in collaboration with internal and external partners to support the preclinical and clinical portfolio.
• Stay abreast of novel biomarker modalities and technologies to drive the prioritization and harmonization of biomarker platforms across the portfolio.
• Lead biomarker assay outsourcing efforts, including overseeing assay development, transfer, validation, and execution at CROs for both non-clinical and clinical studies.
• Ensure data integrity through critical review and validation of CRO-generated results.
• Identify, select, and manage external vendors and institutional collaborators to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data . Qualification
• PhD or MD in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Oncology, Immunology, etc.).
• Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in Translational Medicine, Clinical Development, or Biology research, with a strong preference for candidates possessing a background in biomarker research or clinical

At Roche, we create transformative medicines to tackle some of the world's toughest unmet healthcare needs for patients. At CICoR, we aspire to serve patients by leveraging China's life science ecosystem to accelerate scientific innovation and develop breakthrough medicines. In addition, we provide biomarker expertise to discovery projects to elucidate the molecular pathways that drive disease.

We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the biomarker team. In this role, you will strategize and deliver rigorous biomarker support across multiple disease areas—including Oncology, Immunology, Neurology, Cardiovascular & Metabolism, and Ophthalmology, etc.—to advance translational science in China. You will ensure strong contributions to programs in both early- and late-stage clinical development by collaborating with cross-functional teams in China and globally, as well as with key TAEs and CROs in China.

• Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of biomarker experts while also serving as an hands-on individual contributor.

• Design and lead forward and reverse translational research studies in collaboration with internal and external partners to support the preclinical and clinical portfolio.

• Stay abreast of novel biomarker modalities and technologies to drive the prioritization and harmonization of biomarker platforms across the portfolio.

• Lead biomarker assay outsourcing efforts, including overseeing assay development, transfer, validation, and execution at CROs for both non-clinical and clinical studies.

• Ensure data integrity through critical review and validation of CRO-generated results.

• Identify, select, and manage external vendors and institutional collaborators to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data .

Qualification

• PhD or MD in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Oncology, Immunology, etc.).

• Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in Translational Medicine, Clinical Development, or Biology research, with a strong preference for candidates possessing a background in biomarker research or clinical

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai and we are looking for Lab Support & ASAT SME, for who takes responsibility for equipment/systems qualification and validation, sample and testing material management and other lab supporting processes. Also provides support during the project, operation readiness and start-up phase and liaises across the design, construction, qualification of the QC area, ensuring they meet the intended standard and regulation requirements.
Strong skill and experience are required to cover two areas: Greenfield project and Routine Operation management.

• The role supports on the equipment/system qualification and validation, sample/material management and QC operation readiness and start up.

• Work independently and with a level of autonomy and authority in efficient execution to ensure on-going compliance against approved global/local procedure documents, current Good Manufacturing Practices, and CN/EU Annex-1 during the product lifecycle.

• Enable and self-motivate, and demonstrate leadership behavior and mindset

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the qualification, validation, calibration and maintenance activities for relevant equipment with Roche’s QMS and regulatory guidelines.

• Set up master data according to business requirements and ensure data integrity.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Lab Support to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors. Accomplish sample and testing materials management(eg account management, DI assessment), to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time. Report the abnormal status, deviations to supervisors with initiative.

• By identifying abnormal status and unexpected results during routine operation by detailed data, support to alert supervisors to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Equipment qualification and validation: Support and execute the equipment qualification and validation for the aseptic product.

• Sample and material management: Execute GMP sample management; Execute material inventory management.

• Digital system deployment: Support and ensure on time delivery for QC digital system(eg.LIMS).

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new system startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future dri

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Quantitative Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche Diagnostics has built a new strategic area – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) - charged with creating a modern portfolio of decision support software products and generating insights that change the way patients are cared for. Our challenge is to bring together complex diagnostic and treatment data from medical devices and IT systems and intelligently process and present this data to clinicians, researchers, and caregivers to improve research outcomes and patient care by offering a suite of Clinical Decision Support (CDS) solutions. We also work with clinical care solutions that are tailored to be used by the patient directly and empower them with the tools to manage their health.

As a Principal Quantitative Scientist , you will act as a scientific leader for Real-World Data (RWD), driving evidence generation that fundamentally shapes the development and adoption of our digital health, IVD, and medical device products. This is a high-impact, independent role requiring deep expertise and the ability to influence critical business and regulatory decisions. Your work will involve strategically shaping analyses involving diverse data types (including EHR, claims, omics, and digital health data) in close alignment with data scientists and biostatisticians .

Your upcoming mission:

RWD Strategy & Execution (End-to-End Leadership):

• Drive the conceptualization, planning, execution, and reporting of advanced RWD studies using various research and commercial healthcare databases.

• Develop rigorous RWD study protocols and lead complex analyses to support the evidence needs of the IVD, medical device, and digital health portfolio.

• Ensure the design, execution, and presentation of RWE adhere to the highest scientific and methodological standards.

Strategic Influence & Adoption

• Act as a RWD leader, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders such as Product Leads, Medical Affairs, and Clinical Development to ensure RWD projects directly support commercial, market access, and regulatory needs.

• Champion RWD's use to supplement clinical evidence and actively identify opportunities where RWD can serve as the primary evidence mechanism to achieve regulatory and reimbursement objectives.

• Collaborate with external partners (KOLs, academic institutions, healthcare authorities) on study design and foster strong relationships to explore new data assets and analytical methodologies

Expertise & Mentorship:

• Leverage and expand expertise in RWD sources, epidemiology, and state-of-the-art causal inference methodologies.

• Promote innovation by enhancing ways of working (processes, methods, technology) and proactively sharing learnings with peers.

• Mentor junior colleagues and act as an influential subject matter expert to the team.

Essential Skills for your mission:

• You hold a PhD (preferred) OR Master’s Degree in a Quantitative science field (e.g. Pharmacoepidemiology, Epidemiology, RWD Biostatistics, Pharmacoeconomics, Health Economic and Outcomes Research)

• And 7+ years of directly related (industry, consulting, or other relevant) experience.

• Proven track record of utilizing RWD to support regulatory submissions.

• Solid expertise in epidemiology and causal inference methodologies is required.

• Strong experience in using diverse RWD sources to generate insights and evidence .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme! Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l'azione sostenibile e l'innovazione. Per uno sguardo dietro le quinte, controllare questo video per vedere come siamo a Roche stanno rendendo l'assistenza sanitaria personalizzata una realtà. La mySugr GmbH è stata acquisita da Roche nel 2017 e il nostro ufficio di Vienna è uno dei siti globali di Roche. Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui . Ecco cosa stiamo cercando: Roche Diagnostics ha costruito una nuova area strategica – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) - incaricato di creare un moderno portafoglio di prodotti software di supporto decisionale e di generare intuizioni che cambiano il modo in cui i pazienti sono curati. La nostra sfida è quella di riunire dati diagnostici e di trattamento complessi da dispositivi medici e sistemi informatici e di elaborare in modo intelligente questi dati a medici, ricercatori e caregiver per migliorare i risultati della ricerca e la cura del paziente offrendo una suite di soluzioni CDS (CDS). Lavoriamo anche con soluzioni di assistenza clinica su misura per essere utilizzate direttamente dal paziente e confermiamo loro gli strumenti per gestire la loro salute. Come principale scienziato quantitativo , si agirà come leader scientifico per Real-World Data (RWD), la generazione di prove che modella fondamentalmente lo sviluppo e l'adozione dei nostri prodotti per la salute digitale, IVD e dispositivi medici. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto, indipendente che richiede competenze profonde e la capacità di influenzare le decisioni aziendali e regolamentari critiche. Il vostro lavoro coinvolgerà analisi strategicamente che coinvolgono diversi tipi di dati (tra cui EHR, reclami, omics e dati di salute digitale) in stretta allineamento con gli scienziati di dati e biostatistici. La vostra prossima missione: RWD Strategy & Execution (End-to-End Leadership):

• Assicurare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la presentazione di RWE aderiscono ai più elevati standard scientifici e metodologici. Influenza strategica e adozione
• Agire come leader RWD, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interfunzionali come i Lead del prodotto, gli Affari medici e lo sviluppo clinico per garantire che i progetti RWD supportino direttamente le esigenze commerciali, di accesso al mercato e di regolamentazione.
• L'uso del campione RWD per integrare le prove cliniche e identificare attivamente le opportunità in cui RWD può servire come meccanismo di prova principale per raggiungere gli obiettivi di regolazione e rimborso.
• Collaborare con partner esterni (KOL, istituzioni accademiche, autorità sanitarie) sulla progettazione di studi e promuovere relazioni forti per esplorare nuovi asset di dati e metodologie analitiche Expertise & Mentorship:

• Promuovere l'innovazione migliorando le modalità di lavoro (processi, metodi, tecnologia) e condividendo attivamente gli insegnamenti con i pari.
• Mentor junior colleghi e agire come un esperto di materia influente per la squadra. Competenze essenziali per la vostra missione:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche Diagnostics has built a new strategic area – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) - charged with creating a modern portfolio of decision support software products and generating insights that change the way patients are cared for. Our challenge is to bring together complex diagnostic and treatment data from medical devices and IT systems and intelligently process and present this data to clinicians, researchers, and caregivers to improve research outcomes and patient care by offering a suite of Clinical Decision Support (CDS) solutions. We also work with clinical care solutions that are tailored to be used by the patient directly and empower them with the tools to manage their health.

As a Principal Quantitative Scientist , you will act as a scientific leader for Real-World Data (RWD), driving evidence generation that fundamentally shapes the development and adoption of our digital health, IVD, and medical device products. This is a high-impact, independent role requiring deep expertise and the ability to influence critical business and regulatory decisions. Your work will involve strategically shaping analyses involving diverse data types (including EHR, claims, omics, and digital health data) in close alignment with data scientists and biostatisticians .

Your upcoming mission:

RWD Strategy & Execution (End-to-End Leadership):

• Drive the conceptualization, planning, execution, and reporting of advanced RWD studies using various research and commercial healthcare databases.

• Develop rigorous RWD study protocols and lead complex analyses to support the evidence needs of the IVD, medical device, and digital health portfolio.

• Ensure the design, execution, and presentation of RWE adhere to the highest scientific and methodological standards.

Strategic Influence & Adoption

• Act as a RWD leader, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders such as Product Leads, Medical Affairs, and Clinical Development to ensure RWD projects directly support commercial, market access, and regulatory needs.

• Champion RWD's use to supplement clinical evidence and actively identify opportunities where RWD can serve as the primary evidence mechanism to achieve regulatory and reimbursement objectives.

• Collaborate with external partners (KOLs, academic institutions, healthcare authorities) on study design and foster strong relationships to explore new data assets and analytical methodologies

Expertise & Mentorship:

• Leverage and expand expertise in RWD sources, epidemiology, and state-of-the-art causal inference methodologies.

• Promote innovation by enhancing ways of working (processes, methods, technology) and proactively sharing learnings with peers.

• Mentor junior colleagues and act as an influential subject matter expert to the team.

Essential Skills for your mission:

• You hold a PhD (preferred) OR Master’s Degree in a Quantitative science field (e.g. Pharmacoepidemiology, Epidemiology, RWD Biostatistics, Pharmacoeconomics, Health Economic and Outcomes Research)

• And 7+ years of directly related (industry, consulting, or other relevant) experience.

• Proven track record of utilizing RWD to support regulatory submissions.

• Solid expertise in epidemiology and causal inference methodologies is required.

• Strong experience in using diverse RWD sources to generate insights and evidence .

• Experience in the

Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain, ensemble! En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé par une action durable et l'innovation. Pour un regard en coulisses, regardez cette vidéo pour voir comment nous, à Roche, faisons des soins de santé personnalisés une réalité. La mySugr GmbH a été acquise par Roche en 2017 et notre bureau de Vienne est l'un des sites mondiaux de Roche. Vous serez situé ici, au cœur de Vienne, peu importe si vous travaillez sur un mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® ou tout autre produit ou solution Roche. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur l'histoire de mySugr & Roche ici. Voici ce que nous cherchons: Roche Diagnostics a construit un nouveau domaine stratégique – Roche Information Solutions (RIS) – chargé de créer un portefeuille moderne de logiciels de soutien à la décision et de générer des idées qui changent la façon dont les patients sont pris en charge. Notre défi est de rassembler des données complexes de diagnostic et de traitement des dispositifs médicaux et des systèmes informatiques et de les traiter intelligemment et de les présenter aux cliniciens, aux chercheurs et aux soignants afin d'améliorer les résultats de la recherche et les soins aux patients en offrant une série de solutions de soutien à la décision clinique. Nous travaillons également avec des solutions de soins cliniques qui sont adaptées pour être utilisées directement par le patient et leur donner les outils pour gérer leur santé. En tant que principal scientifique quantitatif, vous agirez comme un chef de file scientifique pour les données du monde réel (RWD), la génération de preuves qui façonne fondamentalement le développement et l'adoption de nos produits de santé numérique, de DIV et d'instruments médicaux. Il s'agit d'un rôle indépendant et à impact élevé qui exige une expertise approfondie et la capacité d'influencer les décisions commerciales et réglementaires essentielles. Votre travail comprendra l'élaboration stratégique d'analyses faisant appel à divers types de données (y compris les DSE, les allégations, les omiques et les données numériques sur la santé) en étroite harmonie avec les scientifiques en données et les biostaticiens. Votre prochaine mission : RWD Stratégie et exécution ( Leadership de bout en bout) :
• Diriger la conceptualisation, la planification, l'exécution et l'établissement de rapports sur les études avancées de la MDR à l'aide de diverses bases de données de recherche et de soins de santé commerciaux.
• Mettre au point des protocoles d'étude rigoureux et mener des analyses complexes pour répondre aux besoins de la DIV, des dispositifs médicaux et de la santé numérique.
• Veiller à ce que la conception, l'exécution et la présentation de RWE respectent les normes scientifiques et méthodologiques les plus élevées. Influence stratégique et adoption
• Agir en tant que chef de file du RWD, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes interfonctionnelles telles que les chefs de produit, les affaires médicales et le développement clinique, afin de garantir que les projets de RWD soutiennent directement les besoins commerciaux, l'accès aux marchés et la réglementation.
• L'utilisation de Champion RWD pour compléter les preuves cliniques et identifier activement les occasions où RWD peut servir de principal mécanisme de preuve pour atteindre les objectifs de réglementation et de remboursement.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires extérieurs (KOL, établissements universitaires, autorités sanitaires) à la conception d'études et favoriser des relations solides pour explorer de nouveaux éléments de données et des méthodes d'analyse Expertise et mentorat :
• Tirer parti et développer l'expertise en matière de sources de MDR, d'épidémiologie et de méthodes d'inférence causale de pointe.
• Promouvoir l'innovation en améliorant les méthodes de travail (processus, méthodes, technologie) et en partageant activement les enseignements avec les pairs.
• Mentor junior collègues et agir comme un expert en matière d'influence pour l'équipe. Compétences essentielles pour votre mission :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat (préféré) OU d'une maîtrise en sciences quantitatives (p. ex. pharmacoépidémiologie, épidémiologie, biostatistique RWD, pharmacoéconomie, recherche sur l'économie de la santé et les résultats)
• Et plus de 7 ans d'expérience directement liée (industrie, conseil ou autre)
• Expérience éprouvée de l'utilisation de la MDR pour appuyer les présentations réglementaires.
• Une solide expertise en épidémiologie et en méthodes d'inférence causale est nécessaire.
• Forte expérience de l'utilisation de diverses sources RWD pour générer des informations et des preuves .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 依据抗感染市场策略、行业发展及数据分析，结合内外部资源与全国NKA总部的全年策略，制定区域重点分部和龙头客户发展策略，并与重点客户达成长期战略合作，完成业务目标
− 结合抗感染市场策略、零售药店行业发展趋势，制定重点客户发展策略，与多家全国性连锁重点分部或区域龙头连锁达成战略合作
− 深入洞察客户发展策略及方向，分析与我司的切入点和双方特点，进行区域框架协议谈判、战略合作评估、销售目标制定、投资计划制定等
− 同客户共建业务跟进管理机制，实施中不断优化，最大化投入产出比，推动业务持续向前发展

2、制定速福达在重点客户的联合发展计划，作为重点客户全国合作的全面对接人，整合内外部资源，将联合发展计划落实
− 与重点客户全国总部共同制定联合发展计划，结合客户特点，设计以推动业务为目的的合作项目
− 结合总部推动和重点分部共同合作的方式，推动项目高质量落地
− 协助重点客户进行关键分子公司和旗舰门店的推广管理

3、与内部相关团队及生态圈内跨团队建立良好的沟通与联动合作机制，最大化公司业务目标
− 积极配合市场部和连锁总部负责人执行公司在零售端的品牌策略，扩大目标产品在患者的端知晓度
− 执行区域市场活动，并利用线下药师教育和数字化手段进行潜力患者触达活动
− 保持与医院销售相关团队的密切合作，探索院内外联动机制，推动业务增长
− 同经销商管理团队及供应链等团队保持沟通，确保药品目标终端快速可及和便利性

4、其他相关工作
− 收集市场多方反馈，协助上级主管进行策略迭代，探索建立和优化以患者为中心的生态圈
− 不断提升自身业务能力，追求高绩效
− 上级指派的其他临时性任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
大学本科及以上
医学、药学、市场营销或相关专业优先

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力
政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力
结果导向、具有典型成长思维，较强的执行力
客户谈判、沟通与管理能力

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
1) 5年以上零售重点连锁销售管理经验（OTC或处方药），有季节性品类管理经验优先
2）对医药零售行业政策及发展趋势有较为深度的认知和判断，熟悉连锁关键决策人
3）热爱销售工作，负有责任心，敢于创新，熟悉新零售渠道创新模式
4）良好的沟通和语言表达能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: (Associate) Gestionnaire, Soutien de laboratoire et ASAT, Produits biologiques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

Equipment and System Support:

• Act as the QC equipment SME to contribute to project design, construction, and qualification. This includes participating in equipment selection, URS (User Requirement Specification) review, and IOPQ (Installation, Operation, and Performance Qualification) to ensure successful project delivery.

• Support the establishment and development of the QC operation system in alignment with Roche standards. This involves creating a maintenance management system, and an automation strategy(eg. LIMS, Empower, SAP) and implementation to support robust operational readiness.

• Lead the setup of sample and material management processes for QC operations and ensure all necessary processes, documentation (SOPs), and tracking systems are in place for the management of samples and testing materials from day one.

• Support all QC activities during regulatory inspections and audits and participate in the response to regulatory and global quality audits.

• As the experienced SME, proactive drive the continuous improvement in Lab support team by leading the taskforce to identify and implement new technologies to improve the compliance and efficiency in routine QC operations.

Routine Operation:

Safety Management:

• Be the QC SHE SPOC and to maintain strict adherence to Roche's SHE (Safety, Health, Environment) standards and all regulatory guidelines.

• Actively promote a safety-first culture within the team and report any incidents or deviations promptly.

Equipment and Method Lifecycle Management:

• Be responsible for the operation and maintenance of relevant equipment with Roche‘s QMS standards and regulatory guidelines.

• Develop and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs to maximize equipment availability and optimize life-cycle costs.

• Ensure all computerized systems are maintained in a validated state throughout their operational life.

• Drive operational excellence through the implementation of digital solutions and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support the integration of new technologies and digital tools to enhance lab efficiency and data management.

• Support the lifecycle management of analytical methods, including implementation, transfer, and periodic review, to ensure compliance with cGMP and Roche standards.

Data Integrity Assurance:

• Ensure the QC data flow generated by lab equipment and maintenance activities are compliance to DI requirements.

• Ensure all data is maintained in accordance with cGMP and company standards for data integrity.

Sample and Material Management:

• Ensure the proper receipt, logging, storage, and traceability of all samples according to established SOPs.

• Conduct Stability，retention sample management with compliance to cGMP.

QC Compliance Assurance:

• Ensure audit readiness by complying with effective standards, regulatory/statutory, and cGMP requirements

• Provide technical support on all lab-related topics during internal and external audits.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences and Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

• Strong knowledge of QC operation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

A Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a technically-qualified person (expert) who strives to achieve business goals through web presence and digital platforms by supporting stakeholders with providing hands-on delivery coordination and consultative advisory to local markets and global teams. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is responsible for consulting and partnering with Roche Divisions and/or affiliates in executing the digital strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a skilled expert in all aspects of digital project management, content management, and tool development across different platforms, and can build out reporting metrics that support the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of Enterprise Web Product (Adobe Experience Manager) requests in line with business objectives

• Advise stakeholders on the effective use of Enterprise Web Product functionalities and best practices

• Act as the main liaison between BPOs, internal requestors, IT/technical teams, and external partners

• Act as an internal consultant and bridge between business teams and IT, overseeing the process from strategy development to implementation and hypercare

• Share specialist knowledge and building expertise by training stakeholders, mentoring colleagues, and promoting innovative digital practices

• Drive process improvements and governance through process optimization, documentation, and occasional handling of incidents and service requests

Who you are:

• You have 7+ years in IT systems, digital operations, and website management within agencies or large organizations (including healthcare or tech), plus proven success leading large-scale or global digital projects.

• You are skilled in developing digital strategies and action plans, managing agencies and stakeholders, and providing expert consultancy to global business teams.

• You have excellent project management, analytical, and technical skills; effective communicator in English with the ability to engage senior leaders and work in global, cross-functional teams.

• You are quick learner, detail-oriented, passionate about technologies, comfortable working under pressure, and dedicated to continuous improvement.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,
