jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

Core Competencies

• Emergency Response & On-Call Availability: Demonstrated capability to respond effectively to critical safety, facilities, or security incidents (chemical spills, power outages, facility emergencies) with flexibility for after-hours and weekend availability as needed; track record of minimizing business disruption during safety events

• Self-Direction & Organization: Highly sel

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di definire la direzione per i team di ingegneria e di servizio per costruire prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfino le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni, pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con i relativi standard del settore. • Gestire il ciclo di vita completo: Prendere la responsabilità per l'intero viaggio del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino alla scalabilità e al pensionamento di soluzioni cloud complesse.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: la strategia "Cloud-First" di Orchestrate Roche ottimizza la velocità e la cadenza di rilascio per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione dei prodotti Enterprise e R&D.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigare un ampio ecosistema di team interni, fornitori esterni di SaaS e partner accademici per garantire l'integrazione della piattaforma senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione delle API.
• Assicurare Compliance ed Eccellenza: L'innovazione di equilibrio con una rigorosa adesione agli standard del settore, tra cui GxP, integrando al contempo le capacità AI per mantenere un vantaggio competitivo. Chi sei:
• Leader del prodotto esperto: porti 10+ anni nella gestione del prodotto o nell'analisi aziendale con una comprovata storia di lancio e gestione di prodotti tecnologici complessi.
• Esperto del settore: hai 2 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata.
• Proven People Manager: Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza leader, mentoring e sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti e multidisciplinari.
• Tecnicamente Proficiente: Lei possiede una laurea universitaria e ha una profonda conoscenza dell'architettura moderna del software, di Cloud Hyperscalers e di Container come Servizio (CaaS).
• Normativa e Data Savvy: Lei è ben diversificato nei principi di dati GxP, FAIR e nelle normative sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR per garantire fondazioni sicure e conformi. Pronto a portare le vostre qualità uniche a Roche e fare un impatto? Applicare ora e unirsi a noi nella nostra missione per plasmare il futuro della salute. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con la nostra medicina

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef de produit HI Enterprise Cloud (chef de produit principal) est responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vie du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à l'échelle et au retrait éventuel d'un produit complexe. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de définir l'orientation des équipes d'ingénierie et de service pour construire des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Vos principales responsabilités :
• Conduire la vision du produit: Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route globales pour le portefeuille Enterprise Cloud afin d'accélérer la livraison de diagnostics changeant la vie.
• Gérer le cycle de vie complet : Rendre compte de l'ensemble du parcours du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'à la mise à niveau et à la retraite de solutions cloud complexes.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestre Roches Stratégie «Cloud-First» en optimisant la vitesse et la cadence de sortie pour répondre aux exigences changeantes des produits Enterprise et R&D.
• Favoriser la collaboration stratégique : Naviguez dans un vaste écosystème d'équipes internes, de fournisseurs externes SaaS et de partenaires universitaires afin d'assurer l'intégration des plateformes et la gestion des API.
• Assurer la conformité et l'excellence : équilibrer l'innovation avec le strict respect des normes de l'industrie, y compris GxP, tout en intégrant les capacités d'IA pour maintenir un avantage concurrentiel. Qui vous êtes :
• Chef de produit expérimenté: Vous apportez 10 ans et plus en gestion de produits ou en analyse commerciale avec une histoire éprouvée de lancement et de gestion de produits technologiques complexes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des technologies de santé réglementées.
• Proven People Manager: Vous possédez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en leadership, en mentorat et en développement d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires à haut rendement.
• Techniquement compétent: Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire et avez une connaissance approfondie de l'architecture logicielle moderne, Cloud Hyperscalers et Container as a Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: Vous êtes bien orienté dans GxP, principes de données FAIR, et les règles de confidentialité des données telles que le RGPD pour assurer des fondations sûres et conformes. Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et faire un impact? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Madrid. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec notre médicament

The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most.

As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation.

Key areas of accountability include:

• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives

• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation

• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong track record in Analytics, Procurement, and account management within complex, matrixed organizations. You bring both strategic vision and hands-on expertise, along with the ability to influence at the highest levels.

• Fluency in English

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department.

The Opportunity:

• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.

The Opportunity
As a TDL, you will lead Technical Development Teams (TDTs) to develop and drive Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (CMC) strategies for clinical drug candidates from early human trials through product launch ensuring technical integrity and proactive risk mitigation.

• You are a recognized thought leader in CMC/product development with a proven ability to lead complex, high-stakes pharmaceutical projects.

• Technical Expertise: Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, including a strong background in biologics process development and CMC team leadership.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) ist die Organisation, die Roches bahnbrechende Therapien auf 127 Millionen Patienten weltweit produziert und liefert. PT beteiligt sich an der Produktion jeder Roche-Medikament – vom Entwicklungsprozess über klinische Studien – und an der Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Produktion von Roche-Medizinen in allen Krankheitsgebieten und Dosierungsformen. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) ist integraler Bestandteil der Mission von Roche, innovative und transformative sinnvolle Arzneimittel für Patienten zu entwickeln, indem sie führende technische Expertise für die Entwicklung, Entwicklung, Versorgung und Registrierung von klinischen Stage-Produkten weltweit anwenden. Die Chance Als TDL führen Sie technische Entwicklungsteams (TDTs) dazu, Chemie, Fertigung und Control (CMC) Strategien für klinische Arzneimittelkandidaten aus frühen humanen Studien zu entwickeln und zu treiben, indem Sie die technische Integrität und proaktive Risikominderung gewährleisten.
• Führung: Führen Sie technische Teams während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der präklinischen Entwicklung bis zum Produktstart, um die wissenschaftliche Integrität der CMC-Strategie zu gewährleisten.
• Strategy & Execution: Entwirft und implementiert vielseitige technische Strategien, die Fertigungsprozesse, Produkt- und Gerätekonfigurationen und globale Lieferketten umfassen, um eine nahtlose regulatorische Genehmigung und kommerziellen Erfolg zu gewährleisten.
• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Bietet Unternehmensperspektiven, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferungen geduldig und kundenorientiert bleiben; dient als primäre Verbindung zu Asset-Teams, Senior Management- und Governance-Komitees und liefert transparente Updates, die die fundierte Entscheidungsfindung erleichtern.
• Operationelle Exzellenz: Übersieht die end-to-end CMC-Entwicklung, einschließlich finanzieller Stewardship, Ressourcenprognose und Meilensteinverfolgung, um eine einwandfreie Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Risiko- und Entscheidungsmanagement: treibt fundierte Entscheidungsfindung für CMC-Investitionen und Risikominderungen an, entwickelt robuste Notfallpläne und kommuniziert potenzielle Auswirkungen auf relevante Führungs- und Leitungsorgane proaktiv. Wer bist du?
• Sie sind ein anerkannter Denkführer in der CMC/Produktentwicklung mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, komplexe, hochverdiente pharmazeutische Projekte zu führen.
• Ausbildung: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemie, Pharmazeutika, Chemische Technik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Technische Expertise: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, einschließlich eines starken Hintergrunds in der Prozessentwicklung der Biologik und CMC-Team-Führung.
• Strategisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittenes Verständnis des gesamten Drogenentwicklungsprozesses mit einer Geschichte erfolgreicher Innovation. Business acumen ist ein Plus
• Program Management: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Programme zu handhaben, während strategisch und proaktiv denken.
• Kommunikation & Einfluss: Außergewöhnliche Verhandlungs- und mündliche/schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einem Überblick über die Einflussnahme von Führungskräften und Dritten. . Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam über 100’000 Mitarbeiter

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Position Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à 127 millions de patients dans le monde. PT participe à la production de tous les médicaments Roche – du processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques – et continue à atteindre la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de la mission de Roches de développer des médicaments innovants et transformatifs significatifs pour les patients en appliquant une expertise technique de premier plan pour concevoir, développer, fournir et enregistrer des produits de stade clinique dans le monde entier. L'opportunité En tant que TDL, vous dirigerez des équipes de développement technique (TDT) afin d'élaborer et de piloter des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour les candidats aux médicaments cliniques, depuis les premiers essais humains jusqu'au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité technique et l'atténuation proactive des risques.
• Leadership : Diriger les équipes techniques tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, du développement préclinique au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité scientifique de la stratégie CMC.
• Stratégie et exécution : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies techniques multiformes - englobant les procédés de fabrication, les configurations de produits et d'appareils pharmaceutiques et les chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales - pour assurer une approbation réglementaire et un succès commercial sans faille.
• Alignement et gouvernance de l'entreprise : offre des perspectives à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour s'assurer que les produits livrables restent axés sur le patient et le client; assure la liaison principale avec les équipes d'actifs, les cadres supérieurs et les comités de gouvernance, en fournissant des mises à jour transparentes qui facilitent la prise de décisions éclairées.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Supervise le développement de bout en bout du MCC, y compris la gérance financière, la prévision des ressources et le suivi des étapes pour assurer une exécution parfaite.
• Gestion des risques et des décisions : favorise la prise de décisions éclairées pour les investissements du MCC et l'atténuation des risques, l'élaboration de plans d'urgence robustes et la communication proactive des impacts potentiels aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un chef de file reconnu dans le développement de CMC/produit avec une capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets pharmaceutiques complexes et à fort débit.
• Éducation: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. en chimie, pharmacie, génie chimique, ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Expertise technique : vaste expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris une solide expérience dans le développement de procédés biologiques et le leadership de l'équipe du CMC.
• Pensée stratégique et critique: compréhension avancée du processus de développement complet des médicaments avec une histoire d'innovation réussie. Le sens des affaires est un atout
• Gestion des programmes : Capacité démontrée de gérer des programmes interfonctionnels complexes tout en pensant de façon stratégique et proactive.
• Communication & influence: compétences exceptionnelles en négociation et en communication verbale/écrite, avec une expérience d'influence sur la haute direction et les tiers. . Êtes-vous prêt à faire une différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et devenez partie intégrante de notre voyage! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle pourrait être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents en matière de rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.en: 治疗领域经理 - 眼科治疗领域（兰州）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
您是谁
您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

您的机会:
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts

• Hanno una profonda conoscenza della sintesi chimica, delle tecnologie di processo chimico e della produzione in un ambiente cGMP.
• Come esperto tecnico, si capisce motivare i team in un'organizzazione matrice e creare una forte coesione per avere successo insieme.
• I loro punti di forza sono in cooperazione: mantengono eccellenti relazioni con gli stakeholder e navigano abilmente attraverso negoziati e progetti interfunzionali.
• Sono un impulso attivo per il cambiamento, creando una cultura flessibile e aperta per nuove opportunità.
• Sono una forza trainante per un miglioramento continuo e incontrano nuove sfide con passione.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029.

The Opportunity

• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting

• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.

• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.

• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.

• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.

• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.

• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.

• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.

• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

jobs.title: Digital Content Strategist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope.

Your Opportunity
In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:

• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain

• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem

• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively

• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value

• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies

• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments

• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners

Who you are
You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:

• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience

• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)

• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges

• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill

• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities

• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave f

jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.

Your Opportunity:
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.
In this position you will be focusing on:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver l

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de Service et Maintenance - Bretagne (d/f/m)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Bretagne.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes.
You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.

• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau

• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.

• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel

• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows

• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.

• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management.

Who You Are
You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator.
Qualifications & Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.

• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

jobs.title: Facilities Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping complex operations running smoothly? Roche is seeking a Facilities Specialist to serve as a key contributor to our facilities management team. You'll coordinate maintenance, manage SAP systems, supervise contractors, and be the trusted liaison between our internal customers and facilities services. If you have SAP Plant Maintenance expertise, strong customer service skills, and thrive in regulated environments, this role offers the perfect blend of technical and interpersonal challenge.

The Opportunity
Essential Job Functions & Major Contributions

• Coordinates facility repair and maintenance frequently involving the supervision of contractors. Inspects completed work for quality, compliance with local procedures and documentation for final approval. Primary liaison between internal customers and facilities management for unscheduled maintenance and projects, local personnel and equipment relocations, and small projects.

• Coordinates and supervises various contracted maintenance services that includes but is not limited to mechanical, plumbing and electrical equipment and systems. Assesses service provider performance at least annually.

• Primary or back-up SAP Plant Maintenance coordinator, adding equipment master records, functional locations, setting up maintenance plans and general equipment task lists, generating and tracking PM and maintenance orders, documenting order completion, and auditing of maintenance records and reports to ensure regulatory compliance of the maintenance program. Generates CMMS reports based on gathered metrics.

• Assist with delegating repair/service tickets to the Facilities Team

• Assists with handles invoices for review, approval, payment, and filing. Acts as the primary liaison GenMark Facilities group, service providers and Accounts Payable.

• Responsible for collection and prompt reporting of any customer service-related issues directly to the Facilities Manager or Director. Responsibilities may include preparing, tabulating, and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys related to any or all of the wide array of service provided by the group through ServiceNow.

• Support O&M technical leads, which may include periodically performing daily rounds and on-call services

• Maintains GMP SOPs and non-GMP Facilities documents

• Trained to input SOP Change Requests

• Other tasks delegated to by the Manager

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, etc.

• Minimum 2 years working experience with SAP Plant Maintenance Module software and knowledge of Archibus

• Minimum 4 years’ experience working in a customer service intensive role and /or facilities maintenance planning

• Exceptional customer service skills

• Experience working in an ISO and FDA regulated environment.

• Advanced computer skills - e.g., MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Workspace

Preferred:

• Technical/trade school specializing in electrical, plumbing or mechanical systems.

• Thorough expertise using SAP Plant Maintenance Module software, Archibus, and ServiceNow

• 6 or more years’ experience working in a relevant Facilities Management and Planning position

• Experience working with Monday.com

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $66,900 - $124,200 USD Annual. Act

The Position
Praktikum im Project Portfolio Management mit Schwerpunkt IT-Architektur & KI-Anwendungen (m/w/d)

Möchten Sie die Zukunft des Project Portfolio Managements mitgestalten und innovative KI-Lösungen entwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Wer wir sind:
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg (DOZ) ist der zweitgrößte Produktionsstandort innerhalb Roche Global Operations und Rohstofflieferant für die gesamte Diagnostics Division. Als führender Hersteller für biologische und chemische Einsatzstoffe ist DOZ ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt im weltweiten Roche Netzwerk.

Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n Praktikanten/in, die/der unser Team im Bereich Project Portfolio Management (PPM) verstärkt. In dieser spannenden Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Architektur und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz, um unsere Projektmanagementprozesse zu optimieren und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Wenn Sie begeistert vom Projektmanagement und der Steuerung eines großen Projektportfolios sind, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung einer zukunftsweisenden IT-Architektur für das Project Portfolio Management: Sie helfen uns dabei, eine skalierbare und effiziente Architektur zu konzipieren, die den Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Projektlandschaft gerecht wird.

• Identifizierung und Evaluierung von Potenzialen für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen im PPM: Sie recherchieren und bewerten innovative KI-Lösungen, die zur Verbesserung von Prognosen, Ressourcenplanung, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung im Projektportfolio eingesetzt werden können.

• Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) für ausgewählte KI-Anwendungen: Sie sind aktiv an der Umsetzung erster Prototypen beteiligt, um die Machbarkeit und den Mehrwert von KI-basierten Lösungen zu demonstrieren.

• Analyse von Projektmanagement-Daten zur Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen: Sie unterstützen uns bei der Datenanalyse, um Engpässe und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in unseren bestehenden PPM-Prozessen zu identifizieren.

• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Architekturen und Best Practices: Sie tragen zur Erstellung und Pflege relevanter Dokumentationen bei, um Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft des Project Portfolio Managements: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die täglichen Abläufe und unterstützen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Ihr Profil:

• Immatrikulierte/r Student/in der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.

• Hohe Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung .

• Begeisterung für Projektmanagement oder erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt- oder Portfoliomanagement.

• Interesse an IT-Architektur und Faszination für KI sowie Bereitschaft, sich in neue Technologien

• Analytische, problemlösungsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, Herausforderungen aktiv anzunehmen .

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Kommunikation und Teamgeist.

• Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. • Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
