Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you someone who finds satisfaction in the details? Do you enjoy the process of systematically checking software to ensure it works perfectly with physical hardware? In our cross functional and cross Site team, we are looking for a Test Technician with a strong interest in Instrument testing focusing on Software Testing to join our team in Sant Cugat. While you will be working with physical medical instruments, your primary focus will be on the software that drives them—executing test cases, documenting defects, and ensuring the system is reliable for patient use. Your Role In this position, you aren't just "clicking buttons"—you are the guardian of software quality. You will be responsible for the consistent execution of test protocols that bridge the gap between digital code and mechanical movement. Key Responsibilities:
• Software-Centric medical device testing:
• Execute manual test cases focusing on software functionality, with a customer mindset on a medical device.
• Lifecycle Maintenance:
• Create, refine, and update software test cases over the entire life cycle of the medical device.
• Methodical Execution:
• Perform repetitive test cycles with high consistency to ensure software stability across different versions.
• Technical Documentation:
• Document every step of your process. You will record defects and test results with high precision to meet medical regulatory standards. Your Profile We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for technology. If you love troubleshooting, have a high affinity for software, and prefer hands-on execution over theoretical concepts, this is the role for you. Formación Profesional (Grado Medio/Superior), no university degree is required—we value your practical skills, technical curiosity, and drive to learn Background: Completed apprenticeship or solid job experience in a technical environment, laboratory, or IT-support setting. E.g. Técnico/a de Pruebas, Tester de Software y Hardware, Técnico de Verificación y Validación (V&V), Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma, Grado en Ingeniería Informática or similar The "Tester" Mindset: You are naturally conscientious and thorough. You enjoy a routine-oriented environment and take pride in performing repetitive tasks with 100% accuracy every time. Software Affinity: You have a keen interest in how software operates and a desire to build a career in instrument/system testing (no programming skills needed). Quality First: You understand that documenting a test is just as important as performing it. Soft skills: Ability to actively contribute to team collaboration, inclusion, sharing ideas and good team spirit, as well as mutual trust and respect (project team and sub chapter level) Languages skills: Expert Spanish (C1 or better) and expert English (C1 or better) language skills. The project language is English. Local team language is Spanish Bonus skills:
• Basic understanding of customer workflows in the area of diagnostic instruments (e.g. in coagulation or serum work area)
• Basic skills with testing tools e.g. Retina
• Initial experience with software testing on instrument level What you can expect from us: Teamwork with ambitious and passionate people building high-quality products meeting customer’s needs An agile working environment allowing for collaboration and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams Fostered collaboration within the project and chapter to build and maintain a tr

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist - Cincinnati, OH
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live south west of Cincinnati around the 71/75 corridor)
Travel: 100% in assigned territory.

This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative
diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Ba

The Position The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. The Opportunity
• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.
• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.
• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.
• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.
• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.
• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.
• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction. This is a field-based role that requires 60%-70% daily travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in the Winston-Salem, NC and Surrounding areas which include Greensboro, NC / Kernersville, NC / Clemmons, NC / Salisbury, NC / Charlotte, NC and will include travel to South Carolina and Virginia. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who You Are
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience
• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering
• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking
• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy
• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required Preferred Requirements
• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of North Carolina is $71,100- $132,000 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are A healthier future drives

jobs.title: (Sr.) Specialist, LS & ASAT, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai and we are looking for Lab Support & ASAT SME, for who takes responsibility for equipment/systems qualification and validation, sample and testing material management and other lab supporting processes. Also provides support during the project, operation readiness and start-up phase and liaises across the design, construction, qualification of the QC area, ensuring they meet the intended standard and regulation requirements.
Strong skill and experience are required to cover two areas: Greenfield project and Routine Operation management.

• The role supports on the equipment/system qualification and validation, sample/material management and QC operation readiness and start up.

• Work independently and with a level of autonomy and authority in efficient execution to ensure on-going compliance against approved global/local procedure documents, current Good Manufacturing Practices, and CN/EU Annex-1 during the product lifecycle.

• Enable and self-motivate, and demonstrate leadership behavior and mindset

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the qualification, validation, calibration and maintenance activities for relevant equipment with Roche’s QMS and regulatory guidelines.

• Set up master data according to business requirements and ensure data integrity.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Lab Support to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors. Accomplish sample and testing materials management(eg account management, DI assessment), to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time. Report the abnormal status, deviations to supervisors with initiative.

• By identifying abnormal status and unexpected results during routine operation by detailed data, support to alert supervisors to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Equipment qualification and validation: Support and execute the equipment qualification and validation for the aseptic product.

• Sample and material management: Execute GMP sample management; Execute material inventory management.

• Digital system deployment: Support and ensure on time delivery for QC digital system(eg.LIMS).

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new system startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist, Obesity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Required:

• Lead multidisciplinary drug discovery project teams from target identification through preclinical candidate selection. Proactively 'invent' future medicines by identifying high-value targets in the obesity and cardiometabolic diseases space.

• Proven expertise in building disease-relevant cellular assays for metabolic disorders using immortalized and/or primary human and animal cells, including co-cultures and/or organoid culture systems

• Capable in design and execution of in vivo studies to characterize the pharmacology of novel targets. Extensive familiarity with in vivo workflows, including experimental design, surgical/dosing techniques, and interpretation of metabolic phenotypic data. This includes evaluating regulation of body weight/composition, glucose and lipid utilization and total energy balance.

• Partner with colleagues in molecular pharmacology, chemistry, and in vivo biology to perform biochemical and molecular assessments on ex vivo samples, ensuring an integral understanding of drug action.

• Requirement for accurate record keeping, independent data analysis, and reporting of data in written and oral formats. Exceptional attention to details with excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate complex concepts at all levels of the organization.

Desired:

• Deep expertise in the biology of energy balance regulation and the pathophysiology of adipose tissue (white, brown, and beige fat).

• Hands-on experience with functional metabolic assays, including insulin sensitivity and glucose/lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function and cellular respiration (e.g., Seahorse assays), assessment of body composition (e.g., EchoMRI or DEXA).

• Specific experience studying the interplay between adipose tissue and neural biology (e.g., sympathetic innervation of fat or central control of metabolism) is a plus.

Qualifications

• PhD and/or postdoctoral training with a focus on metabolism, physiology, biology or related field with well recognized peer-reviewed publications in metabolic research.

• Proven experience leading drug discovery projects in metabolism discovery within a pharmaceutical or biotechnology setting is highly desired.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.
In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities.

Project People Leader

• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.

• Responsible for performance management of employees.

• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to colleagues for an assigned area of technical regulatory responsibility.

• Work closely with the Portfolio Leader to coordinate resources and priorities at a Portfolio level.

• Regularly follow up and check in the progress of every specific project in the team, enlighten the team to work out submission strategies for different applications and identify regulatory risks and develop migration plans.

• Build and maintain a healthy relationships with internal & external key stakeholders, like NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Quality and compliance, PDR China and PTR global,

• Collaborate with internal key stakeholders for development and alignment of technical strategy, maximizing and balancing regulatory and supply needs in China.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education
Master’s Degree in life science disciplines is preferred; Post Graduate Degree is a plus.

Experience

• 8 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry and CMC, quality, regulatory or related experience.

• Previous People management o

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza
• 8 o più anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o relativo settore e CMC, qualità, normazione o relativa esperienza.
• Gestione delle persone precedenti

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt darin, die Teammitglieder zu leiten und zu trainieren, um den Drogenzugriff und die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten zu beschleunigen, indem die richtigen Erstanträge an chinesische Gesundheitsbehörden und effektive Interaktionen mit der Gesundheitsbehörde sichergestellt werden. Zusammenarbeit mit Management in führenden Kommunikationen mit HA über Projekte und Initiativen großer Komplexität. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Gestione della filiale di sicurezza EMEA-LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role:

The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates.

We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field.

Your Responsibilities:

• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.

• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.

• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.

• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.

• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.

• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.

• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.

• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.

• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.

• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.

• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers.

Your Experience & Skills:

• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.

• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.

• Commercial mindset.

• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.

• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.

• Highly influential relationship builder.

• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.

• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.

• EU residence/citizenship preferred.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

The Opportunity

• Vendor & Stakeholder engagement – Vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and ensure adherence to SLAs.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Infine, TSO fornisce supporto tecnico per sistemi che offrono strumenti per la formazione di modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e per la creazione di agenti autonomi, oltre a garantire che gli utenti siano effettivamente abilitati a sfruttare questi sistemi avanzati, dalle piattaforme di formazione LLM agli strumenti di costruzione di agenti autonomi. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità
• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Sviluppare e implementare piani strategici allineati a obiettivi organizzativi, integrando servizi gestiti, operazioni on-premise e iniziative cloud, sfruttando l'IA come acceleratore chiave.
• L'impegno del venditore & Stakeholder – le relazioni del venditore, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'adesione a SLAs.
• Eccellenza operativa & Change Management – Applicare i principi di ingegneria del software alle operazioni per scalare e mantenere sistemi di produzione altamente affidabili, bilanciando il rapido rilascio di nuove funzionalità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for variou

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

What your key responsibilities will be:

• Vendor creation/maintenance in SAP

• Bank maintenance in SAP

• Vendor Request validation and approval

• Participation in data cleansing activities

• Replication monitoring

What you should bring to our company:

• Ongoing Hungarian University studies

• Able to work at least 30 hours per week

• Fluent English

• Knowledge of MS Office

• SAP knowledge is a plus

Why you should join us:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Free language courses

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte des données/de l'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Cerchiamo un visionario Data/Information Architect all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione strategica e l'implementazione delle nostre soluzioni Master Data Management (MDM) basate sull'intelligenza artificiale. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto principale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nel nostro ecosistema MDM, trasformando i record anagrafici relazionali legacy in asset di dati intelligenti, sensibili al contesto e pronti per l'intelligenza artificiale. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architetturale si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di dati master degli operatori sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia attraverso domini di dati master alternativi nelle ondate future. Un obiettivo determinante della progettazione dell'architettura sarà colmare il divario tra le piattaforme MDM tradizionali e i livelli semantici aziendali avanzati, trasformando senza soluzione di continuità i set di dati master in grafici della conoscenza unificati che alimentano applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale generativa all'avanguardia. L'area Data Management e Data Quality Platforms funge da motore di intelligence fondamentale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è quella di scalare un quadro di dati master armonizzato e conforme a FAIR che si integri fortemente con un livello semantico automatizzato e abilitato all'intelligenza artificiale. Inserendo significato contestuale, standard ontologici e grafici relazionali nei dati master grezzi, forniamo all'azienda una visione unica, altamente attendibile e rilevabile della nostra rete. Unirsi a quest’area significa assumere un ruolo di primo piano nel garantire che i modelli di dati specifici del settore sanitario rimangano contestualmente accurati, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standard normativi globali e completamente ottimizzati per l’implementazione del machine learning all’avanguardia. L'opportunità:
• Architettura MDM abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale: architettura, progettazione e guida dell'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei sistemi di gestione dei dati master aziendali integrando funzionalità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle entità e l'arricchimento dei dati.
• Leadership nei programmi HCP e HCO: agire come architetto tecnico primario per le iniziative di base dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/fornitori, garantendo modellazione ad alta fedeltà e scalabilità per i domini successivi.
• Integrazione del livello semantico: definire i modelli e le regole di mappatura necessarie per connettere i dati master transazionali con livelli semantici unificati, ontologie e grafici della conoscenza aziendale.
• Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'intelligenza artificiale: garantisce che i modelli di dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati in modo esplicito

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Wir suchen einen visionären Daten-/Informationsarchitekten innerhalb der RDT Data Platforms-Funktion, der das strategische Design und die Implementierung unserer KI-gesteuerten Master Data Management (MDM)-Lösungen leitet. In dieser Rolle sind Sie der Hauptarchitekt, der künstliche Intelligenz in unserem gesamten MDM-Ökosystem ermöglicht und ältere relationale Stammdatensätze in intelligente, kontextbezogene und KI-fähige Datenbestände umwandelt. Die erste Hauptpriorität dieser Architektur-Roadmap wird sich auf die Modernisierung der Stammdatenprogramme von Healthcare Professional (HCP) und Healthcare Organization (HCO) konzentrieren, mit einer breiteren Skalierungsstrategie über alternative Stammdatendomänen in zukünftigen Wellen. Ein entscheidender Schwerpunkt Ihres Architekturentwurfs wird darin bestehen, die Lücke zwischen traditionellen MDM-Plattformen und fortschrittlichen semantischen Unternehmensebenen zu schließen und Stammdatensätze nahtlos in einheitliche Wissensgraphen umzuwandeln, die hochmoderne generative KI-Anwendungen vorantreiben. Der Bereich Datenmanagement- und Datenqualitätsplattformen dient als grundlegender Intelligenzmotor unseres globalen digitalen Unternehmens. Unsere Mission ist es, ein harmonisiertes, FAIR-konformes Stammdaten-Framework zu skalieren, das sich stark in eine automatisierte, KI-gestützte semantische Schicht integrieren lässt. Indem wir kontextuelle Bedeutung, Ontologiestandards und Beziehungsdiagramme in Rohstammdaten einfügen, bieten wir dem Unternehmen eine einzige, äußerst vertrauenswürdige und auffindbare Ansicht unseres Netzwerks. Der Beitritt zu diesem Bereich bedeutet, eine führende Rolle dabei zu übernehmen, sicherzustellen, dass gesundheitsspezifische Datenmodelle kontextgenau, hochsicher, mit globalen Regulierungsstandards konform und vollständig für den Einsatz modernster maschineller Lernmethoden optimiert sind. Die Chance:
• KI-gestützte MDM-Architektur: Entwerfen, entwerfen und leiten Sie die technische Ausführung der Modernisierung von Stammdatenverwaltungssystemen für Unternehmen durch die Integration von KI/ML-Funktionen für den Datenabgleich, die Entitätsauflösung und die Datenanreicherung.
• HCP- und HCO-Programmleitung: Fungieren Sie als primärer technischer Architekt für die grundlegenden Stammdateninitiativen für medizinisches Fachpersonal (HCP), Gesundheitsorganisation (HCO) und Geschäftspartner/Anbieter und stellen Sie eine hochpräzise Modellierung und Skalierbarkeit für nachfolgende Bereiche sicher.
