jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in

The Position As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms. Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software. Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator . You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement. The Opportunity:
• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).
• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.
• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.
• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.
• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data
• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required. Who you are:
• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.
• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions
• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues
• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.
• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) What you get:
• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;
• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);
• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available
• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity

jobs.title: 区域生态圈负责人_乳腺治疗领域

titleByLocale.en: 区域生态圈负责人_乳腺治疗领域
titleByLocale.de: 区域生态圈负责人 乳腺治疗领埶

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position 生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。 A. 目标与计划管理
• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性
• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划 B. 客户管理与区域合作
• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动
• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益
• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。 C. 团队管理
• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划
• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展
• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景 D. 财务和合规管理
• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标
• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境 我们期待这样的您加入：
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先
• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者
• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质
• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维
• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养
• 业务及资源规划能力
• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力 教育程度/所获资格证书 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

The Position The Opportunity Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are
• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders Who you are
• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.
• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.
• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.
• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).
• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.
• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments. Work Environment The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment. While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag#LI-DNI

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Personalized Healthcare (PHC) Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable des soins de santé personnalisés

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Scope

I. Team Leadership and People Development

• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.

• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent

II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results

• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.

• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.

• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.

• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.

• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance

• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth

III. Customer Experience Excellence

• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.

• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey.

IV. Compliance and Integrity

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Requirements

Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:

• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.

• > 2 year

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Scope I. Team Leadership and People Development
• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.
• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.
• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results
• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.
• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.
• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.
• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.
• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance
• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth III. Customer Experience Excellence
• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.
• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey. IV. Compliance and Integrity
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity. Requirements Qualifications:
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years Education:
• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred. Working Experience:
• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.
• > 2 year

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. L'opportunità
• Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. Eccellenza: Autore storie utente precise e attuabili, epici e criteri di accettazione; partner con UX per creare wireframe e prototipi, filtrare senza scrupoli richieste basate sul valore, e mantenere una specifica di prodotto vivente tracciabile alle esigenze dell'utente.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Agire come traduttore tecnico convertendo complessi flussi di lavoro clinici in requisiti strutturati, sfruttando una forte alfabetizzazione in architettura, modellazione dei dati e API per collaborare con gli ingegneri sui rischi tecnici, dipendenze e soluzioni.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner con architetti, ingegneri senior e QA porta in tutto il ciclo di costruzione dello sviluppo per garantire scalabilità e qualità delle funzionalità, supportando al contempo la progettazione e l'esecuzione UAT per soddisfare gli standard di intenti scientifici e di usabilità.
• Leadership Agile & Delivery: consegna iterativa di guida, feedback rapido e sviluppo basato su ipotesi; proprio e sposo un backl prodotto pronto sprint

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrie und klinische Beweise Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Durchschnitt zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Der Principal Business Analyst ist eine hochwirksame Rolle, die an der Kreuzung der klinischen Wissenschaft, Produktstrategie und Technologielieferung sitzt. Während sie als Business Analyst positioniert ist, arbeitet diese Rolle mit der Breite, Tiefe und strategischem Einfluss eines erfahrenen Analysten, der die Vision, Innovationspipeline besitzt, und der Feature-Lieferung des Study Designer, einem Flagship-Produkt, das klinische Testteams ermöglicht, intelligentere, schnellere und effektvollere Studien zu entwickeln. Dieses Individuum bringt eine seltene Kombination aus tiefen wissenschaftlichen Glaubwürdigkeit, Produktführerschaft und technischer Glaubwürdigkeit - in der Lage, das Vertrauen der Klinischen Wissenschaftler in einem Treffen zu verdienen und einen Engineering-Sprint im nächsten zu treiben. Sie sind unermüdlich neugierig, innovationsgetrieben und leidenschaftlich über die Anwendung von Technologie, um zu transformieren, wie klinische Studien konzipiert und durchgeführt werden - letztendlich beschleunigen Therapien für Patienten. Die Chance
• Klinische und wissenschaftliche Zusammenarbeit: Akt als primäre Verbindung zwischen klinischen/wissenschaftlichen Teams und Produkttechnik, Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen und Erleichterung von Entdeckungsworkshops mit medizinischen Experten, um das Testdesign zu verstehen und die Stimme des klinischen Benutzers zu repräsentieren.
• Produkt-Feature Innovation: Definieren und besitzen Sie die Funktion Roadmap durch den Ausgleich von Geschäfts-, wissenschaftlichen und technischen Bedürfnissen; fördern Sie Innovation durch Design Thinking Sprints, um neue Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, überzeugende Geschäftsfälle zu schaffen, und verfolgen Sie die Funktion Erfolg Metriken/KPIs post-Release.
• Feature Design & Anforderungen Exzellenz: Autor präzise, aktivierbare Benutzergeschichten, Epische und Akzeptanzkriterien; Partner mit UX, um Drahtrahmen und Prototypen zu erstellen, Filteranfragen auf Basis des Wertes lückenlos zu filtern und eine lebende Produktspezifikation zu erhalten, die auf die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer zurückzuführen ist.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act als technischer Übersetzer, indem komplexe klinische Workflows in strukturierte Anforderungen umgewandelt werden und starke Alphabetisierung in Architektur, Datenmodellierung und APIs nutzen, um mit Ingenieuren auf technische Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Lösungen zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner mit Architekten, Senior Engineers und QA führt während des gesamten Entwicklungs-Bauzyklus, um die Funktion Skalierbarkeit und Qualität zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt UAT Design und Ausführung, um wissenschaftliche Absichts- und Usability Standards zu erfüllen.
• Agile Führung & Lieferung: Fahren Sie iterative Lieferung, schnelles Feedback und Hypothese-getriebene Entwicklung; eigene und pflegen Sie ein sprint-ready Produkt Backl
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste des affaires TI - DDT Biométrie et preuves cliniques Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'analyste principal des affaires joue un rôle de premier plan à fort impact qui se situe au carrefour des sciences cliniques, de la stratégie des produits et de la prestation de la technologie. Tout en étant un analyste d'affaires, ce rôle fonctionne avec l'étendue, la profondeur et l'influence stratégique d'un analyste chevronné possédant la vision, le pipeline d'innovation et la prestation de fonctions du concepteur d'études, un produit phare permettant aux équipes d'essais cliniques de concevoir des études plus intelligentes, plus rapides et plus pertinentes. Cette personne apporte une rare combinaison de crédibilité scientifique profonde, de leadership de produit et de compétence technique - capable de gagner la confiance des scientifiques cliniques dans une réunion et conduire un sprint d'ingénierie dans la prochaine. Ils sont inlassablement curieux, motivés par l'innovation et passionnés par l'utilisation de la technologie pour transformer la façon dont les essais cliniques sont conçus et exécutés - en fin de compte, accélérer les traitements aux patients. L'opportunité
• Collaboration clinique et scientifique : agir comme premier lien entre les équipes cliniques/scientifiques et l'ingénierie des produits, établir des relations à long terme et faciliter des ateliers de découverte avec des experts médicaux pour bien comprendre la conception des essais et représenter la voix de l'utilisateur clinique.
• Caractéristiques du produit Innovation: Définir et posséder la feuille de route des caractéristiques en conciliant les besoins commerciaux, scientifiques et techniques; encourager l'innovation par des sprints de réflexion de conception pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités, créer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et suivre les caractéristiques de réussite métriques/KPI après la sortie.
• Conception des caractéristiques et exigences Excellence : Auteur d'histoires d'utilisateurs précises, exploitables, épopées et critères d'acceptation ; partenaire avec UX pour créer des trames filaires et des prototypes, filtrer impitoyablement les requêtes en fonction de la valeur et maintenir une spécification de produit vivante traçable aux besoins de l'utilisateur.
• Partenariat technologique et ingénierie : agir en tant que traducteur technique en convertissant des flux de travail cliniques complexes en exigences structurées, en tirant parti d'une solide connaissance de l'architecture, de la modélisation des données et des API pour collaborer avec les ingénieurs sur les risques techniques, les dépendances et les solutions.
• Assurance qualité et soutien de l'UAT: Partenaire avec les architectes, les ingénieurs seniors et l'AQ mène tout au long du cycle de construction de développement pour assurer l'évolutivité et la qualité des fonctionnalités, tout en soutenant la conception et l'exécution de l'UAT pour répondre aux objectifs scientifiques et aux normes d'utilisation.
• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Diriger la livraison itérative, la rétroaction rapide et le développement basé sur l'hypothèse; propre et préparer un produit prêt au sprint backl

jobs.title: Medical Enabler, APAC Rare Diseases
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Where

• Agire come esperto scientifico per le nostre medicine e soluzioni durante i loro cicli di vita del prodotto.

• Costruire programmi di istruzione medica continua ad alto valore per gli stakeholder esterni.
• Fornire una rassegna medica strategica e l'approvazione per materiali e comunicazioni.
• Liaise a stretto contatto con colleghi e team medici globali per garantire il coordinamento e la coerenza alla diffusione dei dati Chi sei: Sei un appassionato professionista medico pronto a fare un impatto significativo sulla salute delle malattie rare in tutta l'Asia. Come esperto di materia con il potenziale per i ruoli di leadership futuri avete uno spirito imprenditoriale, identificare le opportunità, sono confortevoli con ambiguità e sfidare lo status quo. Hai...
• Esperienza rilevante in un ruolo di Affari medici all'interno di settori farmaceutici, diagnostici, scienze della salute, biotecnologie o correlati.
• L'esperienza di lavorare nelle malattie rare sarebbe molto auspicabile.
• Forte comprensione dei dati, valutazione critica, sintesi e capacità di consegna.
• Una mentalità "System Thinker", in grado di costruire forti collaborazioni interne/esterne per guidare il cambiamento.
• approccio Customer-Centric, soluzioni di co-creazione per soddisfare le esigenze e trasformare la pratica clinica.
• Una cultura dell'umanità, della curiosità e della responsabilità, che prospera in un ambiente di lavoro potenziato, dinamico e agile.
• Provato track record di costruzione, leader, e contribuendo a team di alta qualità, diversi, agili / matrice.
• Laurea in scienze, biologia, immunologia, neuroscienze, o equivalente preferito. L'esperienza clinica nelle malattie rare è un vantaggio. Questa è un'incredibile opportunità di sviluppo per applicare le tue competenze scientifiche, collaborare con colleghi e clienti da tutto il mondo, e contribuire all'innovazione che influenzerà le famiglie che vivono con malattie rare in tutta l'Asia e oltre. Dove

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Roche Pharma Bei Roche sind wir von einer dringenden Verpflichtung, heute medizinische Lösungen zu liefern, während wir für morgen innovieren. Unser mutiges neues A2-Betriebsmodell nutzt die kollektiven Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen, um schnelle, schlagkräftige Lösungen für Patienten weltweit zu schaffen. Wir glauben an personalisierte, nachhaltige Gesundheitsversorgung und sind einzigartig positioniert, um Pharmazeutika, Diagnostik, digitale Gesundheit und Big Data zu integrieren. Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen Medical Enabler, um unserem dynamischen APAC Rare Diseases Team beizutreten. Diese dauerhafte, Vollzeit-Rolle ist eine über-Lande-Pool-Ressource-Position, die eine 80-100% FTE über Land Engagement in unserem Netzwerk erfordert. Idealerweise suchen wir jemanden, der über langjährige Erfahrung in der Arbeitsmedizin in ganz Asien verfügt und sich in Hongkong oder Taiwan befindet, aber diese Rolle bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, sich auf grenzüberschreitende Arbeitspakete und -ermöglichung zu konzentrieren, die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen regionalen und globalen Netzwerken, um einen sinnvollen Wandel zu fördern. An was du arbeitest: Als medizinischer Enabler (APAC) Seltene Krankheiten, werden Sie:
• Strategische Input- und operative Unterstützung für späteste Entwicklungs-/Near-Launch-Therapien in seltenen Krankheiten.
• Handeln Sie als wissenschaftlicher Experte für unsere Medikamente und Lösungen während ihrer gesamten Produktlebenszyklen.
• Arbeiten in virtuellen, grenzüberschreitenden, grenzübergreifenden Teams, um Länder, regionale und globale Ergebnisse zu realisieren und zu skalieren.
• Foster aussagekräftige wissenschaftliche Kooperationen und wertbasierte Partnerschaften mit Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), Gesundheitsexperten, Patientenorganisationen in verschiedenen Gesundheitssystemen.
• Um Datenlücken zu verstehen und Datengenerierungspläne zu unterstützen (z.B. Phase IV-Studien, Register).
• Aufbau hochwertiger Weiterbildungsprogramme für externe Akteure.
• Strategische medizinische Überprüfung und Genehmigung für Materialien und Kommunikation.
• Liaise eng mit globalen medizinischen Kollegen und Teams zusammen, um die Koordination und Konsistenz unserer Datenverbreitung zu gewährleisten Wer du bist: Sie sind ein leidenschaftlicher Arzt, der bereit ist, einen erheblichen Einfluss auf die Gesundheit von seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien zu machen. Als Thema Experte mit dem Potenzial für zukünftige Führungsrollen haben Sie einen Unternehmergeist, identifizieren Chancen, sind komfortabel mit Mehrdeutigkeit und fordern den Status quo. Sie haben:
• Relevante Erfahrung in einer medizinischen Rolle in der Pharma-, Diagnostik-, Gesundheits-, Biotechnologie- oder verwandten Bereichen.
• Die Erfahrung der Arbeit in seltenen Krankheiten wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Starkes Datenverständnis, kritische Beurteilungs-, Synthese- und Lieferfähigkeiten.
• Ein "System Thinker" Mindset, in der Lage, starke interne/externe Kollaborationen zu bauen, um Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Customer-Centric-Ansatz, Co-Creating-Lösungen, um Bedürfnisse zu lösen und klinische Praxis zu transformieren.
• Eine Kultur der Menschlichkeit, Neugier und Verantwortung, die in einem bestärkten, dynamischen und agilen Arbeitsumfeld blüht.
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von Gebäuden, Führungen und Beiträgen zu hochperformierenden, vielfältigen, agilen / Matrix-Teams.
• MD-Abschluss; PhD oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biologie, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften oder gleichwertig bevorzugt. Klinische Erfahrung in seltenen Krankheiten ist ein Plus. Dies ist eine unglaubliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeit, um Ihr wissenschaftliches Know-how anzuwenden, mit Kollegen und Kunden aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten und zu Innovationen beizutragen, die Familien mit seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien und darüber hinaus beeinflussen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Nous cherchons un activateur médical passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique APAC maladies rares. Ce rôle permanent à temps plein est un poste de ressource commun au-dessus du pays, exigeant un engagement de 80 à 100% ETP au-dessus du pays au sein de notre réseau. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Graphic Design Intern assists in creating visually compelling designs while gaining hands-on experience in a professional design environment. Working closely with senior designers and team members, they contribute to various creative projects across print, digital, and social media platforms.

In this role, the intern supports the team to design scalable Showpad pages, build automated template workflows, explore new Ai key features, and enforce governance across global Roche design assets. This role ensures 100% compatibility with Figma/Illustrator. They have the opportunity to enhance their creative skills, and learn how to create lovable marketing assets for customers using ABX approach.
This internship is ideal for students or recent graduates looking to build their portfolio, work on real-world projects, and collaborate within a dynamic design team.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

• Vector-First Production: Design, build, and migrate Showpad pages and UI assets strictly within Figma and Illustrator, ensuring all global assets are lightweight, editable, and scalable.

• Template Engineering: Turn standard layouts into robust, modular Figma components and design systems so that "simple design tasks" can be executed instantly or self-sourced by affiliates.

• Asset Optimization: Ensure all imagery and graphics comply with Roche UI guidelines

• Assist in designing marketing materials such as brochures, social media graphics, presentations, banners, and other visual assets.

• Support the team in maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs.

• Work closely with senior designers and other team members to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.

• Edit and refine design elements based on feedback and brand guidelines.

• Explore AI page creation and section templates in Showpad to scale approach

• Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.

• Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.

• Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Who you are

You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field at a Hungarian University.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in protein chemistry: Novel antibody-based formats for in-vitro diagnostics (m/f/d)

Suchst Du ein Praktikum, in dem Du dich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen jemanden, der uns bei unseren vielfältigen Aufgaben unterstützt. Dies gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die verschiedenen Einheiten innerhalb unserer Abteilung kennenzulernen und einen Überblick über die unterschiedlichen Aktivitäten zu gewinnen.

Die Abteilung

Sie werden in der Abteilung „Proteinchemie“ arbeiten, die zur Einheit „Reagent Research and Design“ von Roche Centralized and Point of Care Solutions gehört und sich auf die Entwicklung von protein basierten Reagenzien für immunologische Diagnostik Tests konzentriert.
Hier entwickeln, realisieren und bewerten wir innovative Lösungen für Diagnostik Systemkonzepte basierend auf dem Roche Cobas e-Analyzer zur zielgerichteten und hochsensitiven Quantifizierung von menschlichen Körperflüssigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie werden aktiv an Forschungsprojekten teilnehmen, um die Entwicklung von Antikörper basierten Reagenzien für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologien zu optimieren.

• Sie werden verschiedene Techniken zur Antikörperreinigung durchführen.

• Sie werden Antikörper mit sowohl ortsspezifischen als auch unspezifischen Markierungsstrategien konjugieren und anschließend reinigen.

• Sie werden die Leistungsfähigkeit dieser Reagenzien auf Cobas e-Analyzer evaluieren.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit mehreren Teams zusammen, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Chemie, Proteinchemie, Antikörperentwicklung und Enzymtechnologie).

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemischer Biologie oder einem
verwandten Bereich oder in einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang oder befinden sich in einem Gap
Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Ihre Stärken

• Sie haben Kenntnisse in organischer Chemie und Proteinbiochemie, erste Erfahrungen sind

• von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in instrumenteller Analytik (z.B. UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Grundkenntnisse in Immunologie sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam im Team Konzepte zu entwickeln.

• Sie sind kreativ und setzen Ihre Ideen gerne in die Praxis um.

• Sie können sich selbstständig organisieren und Ihren Arbeitsalltag strukturieren.

• Sie besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37.5 Std./Woche)

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf online hoch.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit
eingeschrieben sind oder sich in einem Gap Year befinden (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum: Ab Oktober 2026 oder früher für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Bitte beachten, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.
