The Position
Internship in protein chemistry: Novel antibody-based formats for in-vitro diagnostics (m/f/d)

Suchst Du ein Praktikum, in dem Du dich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen jemanden, der uns bei unseren vielfältigen Aufgaben unterstützt. Dies gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die verschiedenen Einheiten innerhalb unserer Abteilung kennenzulernen und einen Überblick über die unterschiedlichen Aktivitäten zu gewinnen.

Die Abteilung

Sie werden in der Abteilung „Proteinchemie“ arbeiten, die zur Einheit „Reagent Research and Design“ von Roche Centralized and Point of Care Solutions gehört und sich auf die Entwicklung von protein basierten Reagenzien für immunologische Diagnostik Tests konzentriert.
Hier entwickeln, realisieren und bewerten wir innovative Lösungen für Diagnostik Systemkonzepte basierend auf dem Roche Cobas e-Analyzer zur zielgerichteten und hochsensitiven Quantifizierung von menschlichen Körperflüssigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie werden aktiv an Forschungsprojekten teilnehmen, um die Entwicklung von Antikörper basierten Reagenzien für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologien zu optimieren.

• Sie werden verschiedene Techniken zur Antikörperreinigung durchführen.

• Sie werden Antikörper mit sowohl ortsspezifischen als auch unspezifischen Markierungsstrategien konjugieren und anschließend reinigen.

• Sie werden die Leistungsfähigkeit dieser Reagenzien auf Cobas e-Analyzer evaluieren.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit mehreren Teams zusammen, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Chemie, Proteinchemie, Antikörperentwicklung und Enzymtechnologie).

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemischer Biologie oder einem
verwandten Bereich oder in einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang oder befinden sich in einem Gap
Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Ihre Stärken

• Sie haben Kenntnisse in organischer Chemie und Proteinbiochemie, erste Erfahrungen sind

• von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in instrumenteller Analytik (z.B. UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Grundkenntnisse in Immunologie sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam im Team Konzepte zu entwickeln.

• Sie sind kreativ und setzen Ihre Ideen gerne in die Praxis um.

• Sie können sich selbstständig organisieren und Ihren Arbeitsalltag strukturieren.

• Sie besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37.5 Std./Woche)

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf online hoch.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit
eingeschrieben sind oder sich in einem Gap Year befinden (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum: Ab Oktober 2026 oder früher für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Bitte beachten, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário(a) de Estratégia e Soluções Integradas, você terá a oportunidade de entender a jornada do paciente e envolver-se na cocriação e implementação de projetos e soluções. Esta vaga oferece uma trilha de desenvolvimento clara, onde você expandirá o seu impacto e responsabilidades ao longo do programa de estágio.

A Oportunidade
No seu dia a dia, você participa em melhorias de processos internos com foco na agilidade para o cliente e auxilia na implementação de eventos, campanhas e materiais. A sua jornada será estruturada da seguinte forma:

No 1º ano de estágio:

• Você realiza a imersão nas políticas internas e implementa processos end-to-end, como gestão de contratos, cadastro de speakers (PF e PJ) e parceiros de negócios, atuando como ponto focal de pagamentos.

• Você gerencia a abertura de eventos no SalesForce, realiza o upload de materiais no PromoMats para aprovação (de acordo com RDC 96 e PAMDE) e faz o preenchimento do GSD.

• Você colabora com a organização de repositórios nos iHubs, faz a interface direta com fornecedores e instituições patrocinadas, e modera as cerimónias do chapter de ESI.

No 2º ano de estágio:

• Você implementa, de ponta a ponta, projetos e eventos de média complexidade e participa, junto ao analista e coordenador, no desenvolvimento de projetos de alta complexidade.

• Você modera as syncs dos iHubs, atua na governança do guia de processos ESI e faz a interface com estratégias omnichannel.

• Você cria materiais e briefings para parceiros de negócios e realiza a revisão de materiais segundo as normas (RDC 96 e PAMDE).

Quem é você

• Você cursa graduação em áreas relacionadas a Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou na área da Saúde (Farmácia, Enfermagem, Biomedicina, etc.).

• Você tem disponibilidade para cumprir um contrato de estágio de, no mínimo, 1 ano e meio (formatura a partir de Dez de 2027).

• Você possui um nível intermediário do idioma Inglês.

• Você tem conhecimentos básicos nas ferramentas Excel e PowerPoint.

Diferenciais

• Você possui noções e interesse em gestão de projetos.

• Você tem conhecimento de metodologias ágeis.

*Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

L'Oportunità Nel quotidiano, parteciperete a finali di processi interni con focus sull'agilità per il cliente e aiutaete nell'implementazione di eventi, campagne e materiali. Anno 2 di Stage - Implementerete, da ponta a ponta, e eventi di media complessità e parteciperete, insieme all'analista e al coordinatore, nel sviluppo di progetti di complessità alta. - Modorerete le sync dei iHubs, agire nella governanza del guida di processi ESI e farete l'interfaccia con strategie omnichannel. - Creerete materiali e briefings per partner di business e realizza la revisione di materiali secondo le norme (RDC 96 e PAMDE). Chi è la persona giusta - Cursate la laurea in aree correlate a Marketing, Amministrazione, Comunicazione, Ingegneria di Bioprocessi o nell'area della Salute (Farmacia, Ingegneria, Biomedicina, ecc.). - adempiere a un contratto di stage di, almeno, 1 anno e mezzo (formatura a partire da Dicembre 2027). - Possedete un livello intermedio del linguaggio inglese. - conoscenze basilari nelle ferramenta Excel e PowerPoint. Differenziali - Possedete nozioni e interessanti in gestione di progetti. - Avete conoscenza di metodi agili. *Benefici di relocalizzazione non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso ai servizi sanitari oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Abbiamo il potere di decidere a esplorare nuove possibilità, di favorire la creatività e di mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni di saluto che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik-Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team
Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Francisco peninsula, East Bay & South Bay areas, or within the Vacaville/Fairfield area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $81,700 and $151,700 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Hai una comprensione dei cambiamenti ambientali esterni, dei precedenti, per navigare situazioni complesse e influenzare strategie e processi decisionali. Hai la capacità di interpretare e applicare la comprensione del pensiero dei regolatori ai progetti e applicare strategie alle diverse esigenze delle diverse regioni senza una guida significativa. Proattivamente crei strategie di regolazione uniche/innovative e influenza gli approcci per evitare ostacoli normativi e accelerare le approvazioni mondiali. - Lei collabora efficacemente con gli stakeholder di influenza finale per capire e fornire le migliori soluzioni. Si prende l'iniziativa di affrontare problemi o opportunità e coinvolgere collaboratori per le migliori soluzioni. Si sviluppano relazioni che influenzano significativamente la direzione attuale e futura per Roche e i nostri prodotti. - Hai il coraggio di prendere decisioni anche al di fuori del campo di applicazione / zona di sforzo e avviare proattivamente attività indipendentemente. Abbraccia i buoni principi decisionali. - Modelli la leadership VAAC e l'agilità. Identifichi le opportunità per sviluppare la competenza VACC. Agite con impegno di integrità, coraggio, passione e onore e contribuite a un ambiente inclusivo che supporta tutte le dimensioni della diversità. - Siete in grado di riunire le persone intorno a un obiettivo comune e cercare di capire e costruire su prospettive diverse per migliorare i risultati. Si affronta e risolve il conflitto creando un'atmosfera di apertura e fiducia. Porti fuori il meglio nelle persone e nelle squadre. Chi sei? - Hai una laurea / Master in Scienze della Vita, Scienza dei dati o soggetto correlato o esperienza equivalente. Grado avanzato preferito. - Hai 3-5 anni di esperienza con dottorato di ricerca, 5-7 con master e 6-8 anni con laurea in t

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Market Insights Leader is responsible for operationalizing industry-leading methodologies in primary and secondary market research to guide strategic decisions. In this role, you will lead innovative projects and workstreams that pioneer new methodologies, apply new technologies and create analyses that shape development and commercial strategy. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams to drive engagement, embed enhancements, and realize the full value of solutions developed. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• Insights excellence: Elevate the quality and impact of EI deliverables by advancing research practices across primary and secondary sources. You will ensure our research remains best-in-class by implementing high-impact methodologies and tools that allow insights to directly inform and accelerate strategic business decisions.

• Future-ready roadmap: Design and execute a multi-year roadmap to evolve Primary Market Research and secondary insights capabilities. You will lead pilots for innovative research engines and scale successful methodologies globally, ensuring our insights infrastructure is agile, scalable, and ahead of industry trends.

• Cross-portfolio insights: Lead the generation of strategic insights on themes with multi-TA impact, such as Digital Health, Drug Delivery, and next-generation commercialization models. You will connect the dots across the portfolio to unlock business value

• Upskilling and training: Define the gold standard for Market Research within EI. You will design and deliver a comprehensive curriculum to ensure our capabilities remain industry-leading and future proof

• Strategic vendor & compliance oversight

Focus areas and responsibilities

• Insights excellence: Elevate the quality and impact of EI deliverables by advancing research practices across primary and secondary sources. You will ensure our research remains best-in-class by implementing high-impact methodologies and tools that allow insights to directly inform and accelerate strategic business decisions.

• Future-ready roadmap: Design and execute a multi-year roadmap to evolve Primary Market Research and secondary insights capabilities. You will lead pilots for innovative research engines and scale successful methodologies globally, ensuring our insights infrastructure is agile, scalable, and ahead of industry trends.

• Cross-portfolio insights: Lead the generation of strategic insights on themes with multi-TA impact, such as Digital Health, Drug Delivery, and next-generation commercialization models. You will connect the dots across the portfolio to unlock business value

• Upskilling and training: Define the gold standard for Market Research within EI. You will design and deliver a comprehensive curriculum to ensure our capabilities remain industry-leading and future proof

• Strategic vendor & compliance oversight

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file de l'Espace Thérapeutique (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Au-delà de l'AT Market Insights Leader est chargé de rendre opérationnelles les méthodes de pointe de l'industrie dans les études de marché primaires et secondaires pour guider les décisions stratégiques. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Mansioni - Insights excellence: Accroître la qualité et l'impact des produits livrables de l'AE en faisant progresser les pratiques de recherche dans les sources primaires et secondaires. Vous veillerez à ce que nos recherches demeurent les meilleures en classe en mettant en oeuvre des méthodologies et des outils à impact élevé qui permettent d'éclairer et d'accélérer directement les décisions stratégiques. - Feuille de route prête pour l'avenir : Concevoir et exécuter une feuille de route pluriannuelle pour faire évoluer la recherche sur les marchés primaires et les capacités secondaires de connaissances. Vous dirigerez des projets pilotes pour des moteurs de recherche innovants et des méthodologies efficaces à l'échelle mondiale, en veillant à ce que notre infrastructure d'information soit agile, évolutive et devant les tendances de l'industrie. - Perspectives transversales : Diriger la production de perspectives stratégiques sur des thèmes ayant un impact multi-TA, tels que la santé numérique, la prestation de médicaments et les modèles de commercialisation de la prochaine génération. Vous connecterez les points à travers le portefeuille pour débloquer la valeur de l'entreprise - Améliorer les compétences et la formation : Définir la norme d'or pour les études de marché au sein de l'IE. Vous allez concevoir et fournir un programme d'études complet pour assurer que nos capacités restent leader de l'industrie et la preuve future - Surveillance stratégique des fournisseurs et de la conformité Contatto (Non fornito)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader is responsible for harnessing next-gen AI and digital solutions in Primary Market Research, secondary data sources, and forecasting to deliver superior quality insights with increased speed and cost-efficiency. In this role, you will lead innovative projects and workstreams that pioneer new methodologies, apply new technologies and create analyses that shape development and commercial strategy. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams including ABBI to drive engagement, embed enhancements, and realize the full value of solutions developed. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• AI capability building: Establish the framework for integrating Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics into the core of Primary Market Research, secondary insights, and forecasting. You will put in place tech-augmented approaches that unlock insights and create a distinct competitive advantage for our TAs

• Process optimization: Streamline insights workflows through technology solutions. You will enable the team to pivot from data analysis to strategic advisory, ensuring focus on the highest-value business challenges

• Solution integration: Identify, pilot, deploy, and manage a suite of internal and external technology solutions. You will partner with AABI to curate the Ecosystem Tool Stack, including GenAI and synthesis platforms, to deliver high quality insights faster and more cost-effectively

• Workflow: Drive the successful adoption of new technologies by bridging the gap between technical capabilities and daily research workflows. You will ensure that AI and digital tools are not just deployed, but deeply integrat

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader è responsabile dell'imbragatura di soluzioni AI e digitali di prossima generazione in Primary Market Research, fonti di dati secondarie e della previsione per fornire informazioni di qualità superiori con maggiore velocità e efficienza dei costi. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti innovativi e flussi di lavoro che pionierizzano nuove metodologie, applichino nuove tecnologie e creeranno analisi che modellano lo sviluppo e la strategia commerciale. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI, tra cui ABBI per guidare il coinvolgimento, incorporare miglioramenti, e realizzare il pieno valore delle soluzioni sviluppate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Aree di messa a fuoco e responsabilità
• Realizzazione delle capacità di AI: Stabilire il quadro per integrare l'Intelligenza Artificiale e l'analisi avanzata nel nucleo della Ricerca di Mercato Primario, intuizioni secondarie e previsioni. Si metterà in atto approcci tecno-agmentati che sbloccano intuizioni e creano un vantaggio competitivo distinta per i nostri TA
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: semplifica i flussi di lavoro attraverso soluzioni tecnologiche. Permetterai al team di ruotare dall'analisi dei dati alla consulenza strategica, garantendo attenzione alle sfide aziendali di maggior valore
• Integrazione della soluzione: Identificare, pilotare, distribuire e gestire una suite di soluzioni tecnologiche interne ed esterne. Potrai collaborare con AABI per curare l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, tra cui GenAI e piattaforme di sintesi, per fornire informazioni di alta qualità più veloce e più conveniente
• Flusso di lavoro: guidare l'adozione di nuove tecnologie, colmare il divario tra capacità tecniche e flussi di lavoro di ricerca giornalieri. Ti assicurerai che l'IA e gli strumenti digitali non siano solo implementati, ma profondamente integrati

L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file en habilitation de produits Beyond Therapeutical Area (TA) Insights pour se joindre à nous dans l'élaboration de la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives de marché, de portefeuille et de clients. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Le responsable de l'activation des produits Beyond TA Insights est chargé d'exploiter les solutions numériques et d'IA next-gen dans les études de marché primaires, les sources de données secondaires et les prévisions afin de fournir des informations de qualité supérieures avec une rapidité et une rentabilité accrues. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec d'autres équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI, dont ABBI, pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Domaines d ' intervention et responsabilités
• Renforcement des capacités en matière d'IA : établir le cadre d'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'analyse avancée au cœur de la recherche de marché primaire, des connaissances secondaires et des prévisions. Vous mettrez en place des approches tech-augmentées qui libèrent les idées et créent un avantage concurrentiel distinct pour nos AT
• Optimisation des processus : Rationaliser les flux de connaissances grâce à des solutions technologiques. Vous permettrez à l'équipe de pivoter de l'analyse de données à l'avis stratégique, en veillant à se concentrer sur les défis commerciaux de la plus haute valeur
• Intégration des solutions: Identifier, piloter, déployer et gérer une série de solutions technologiques internes et externes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec AABI pour la mise en place de l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, y compris les plateformes GenAI et de synthèse, afin de fournir des informations de haute qualité plus rapidement et de manière plus rentable.
• Flux de travail: Conduire l'adoption réussie de nouvelles technologies en comblant l'écart entre les capacités techniques et les flux de recherche quotidiens. Vous vous assurerez que l'IA et les outils numériques ne sont pas simplement déployés, mais profondément intégrés

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur principal / Ingénieur principal principal en logiciels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards.

Who You Are

We are looking for a passionate and collaborative software engineer with a talent for building scalable, reliable platforms. You thrive on engaging with scientific partners to solve comple

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. Unisciti al nostro team Data e Digital Catalyst come Software Engineer, dove svilupperai gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi che sono fondamentali per la nostra ricerca. Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per potenziare i nostri scienziati e promuovere la scienza dei dati attraverso la tecnologia innovativa. L'opportunità
• Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Chi sei Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere software appassionato e collaborativo con un talento per la costruzione di piattaforme scalabili e affidabili. Si prospera sul coinvolgimento di partner scientifici per risolvere la conformità

Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. • Construire et améliorer un écosystème moderne et évolutif d'applications et d'outils pour capturer, déplacer et préparer des données scientifiques à analyser.
• Concevoir et fournir des applications et des pipelines de données complexes et conviviaux qui intègrent divers ensembles de données dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'intelligence artificielle (AI), l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et la recherche en langage naturel.

• Mentor junior développeurs, favorisant leur croissance professionnelle et le maintien de normes d'ingénierie élevées. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Data Engineers, Product Leaders e partner scientifici per progettare e implementare sistemi che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente ad accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti costruendo l'ecosistema moderno che cattura, si muove e prepara i dati scientifici per l'analisi. L'opportunità
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.
• Integra diversi set di dati per alimentare AI/ML, Natural Language Search e strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi a valle.
• Facilitare l'implementazione di modelli AI all'avanguardia che sfruttano i progressi nell'apprendimento automatico.
• Influenza delle decisioni tecniche sui flussi di lavoro dei dati e sullo sviluppo delle applicazioni in collaborazione con partner chiave.
• Imparare e comprendere profondamente il nostro Data Ecosystem per promuovere un miglioramento continuo e un'innovazione. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere appassionato che si preoccupa dell'eccellenza tecnica e del prodotto, con l'obiettivo di costruire soluzioni altamente utilizzabili. Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, sfruttando le pratiche di sviluppo moderne per tradurre sfide complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Una laurea in Informatica o una tecnica simile

Votre travail contribuera directement à accélérer la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients en construisant l'écosystème moderne qui capture, déplace et prépare des données scientifiques à analyser. L'opportunité
• Assurer l'excellence technique en fournissant des flux de données et des pipelines innovants et de qualité supérieure dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Promouvoir l'adoption de tendances et de technologies clés en appliquant une approche Open Source, Cloud First, API First et AI First à la résolution de problèmes.
• Améliorer nos flux de travail de données et l'architecture d'application en tirant parti des modèles standard tels que les microservices et la conception d'événements.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'IA/ML, la recherche en langage naturel et les outils de visualisation et d'analyse en aval.
• Faciliter la mise en œuvre de modèles d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui tirent parti des progrès de l'apprentissage automatique.
• Influencer les décisions techniques sur les flux de données et le développement des applications en collaboration avec les principaux partenaires.
• Apprenez et comprenez profondément notre écosystème de données pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur passionné qui se soucie de l'excellence technique et des produits, avec un moteur pour construire des solutions hautement utilisables. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement collaboratif, en tirant parti des pratiques de développement modernes pour traduire les défis complexes en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Baccalauréat en informatique ou technica similaire

jobs.title: Business Excellence Chapter Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chapitre sur l'excellence en affaires Chef de file

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
The chapter lead of business excellence serves as the core person for bridging high-level corporate strategy with on-the-ground commercial execution. The Chapter Lead translates the company's strategic vision into tangible commercial projects, manages the strategic initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment to deliver measurable business outcomes and drive sustainable revenue growth.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
I. Strategic Planning and development

• Strategy Formulation: Partner with senior leaders to support the annual and long-range company strategy planning process

• Strategic Roadmap: Translate approved corporate and commercial strategies into a defined, prioritized roadmap of projects and initiatives

• Business Case Development: Lead the development of robust business cases for strategic commercial investments, defining expected financial return (ROI), resource requirements, and measurable success criteria.

II. Project Management Office (PMO) Leadership

• Project Execution Oversight: Act as the lead or co-lead for high-priority, complex strategic projects, driving accountability, managing interdependencies, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio dashboard for executive leadership, providing clear, concise status updates on project health, key milestones, budget adherence, and projected impact realization.

III. Commercial Excellence Oversight
A. Channel & Distributor Management:

• Focus on maximizing revenue growth and profitability through the optimization of go-to-market channels and the professional management of distributors and business partners.

• Direct the design, implementation, and governance of sales incentive compensation (IC) plans for the direct sales force and partner reward programs.

• Ensure the implementation of a robust performance review framework and regular commercial compliance audit programs for distributors, reviewing anti-bribery, data privacy, and ethical selling practices.

B. Customer Experience & Operational Processes:

• Lead the function responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing seamless service journeys for clinicians and patients across the product lifecycle.

• Ensure the establishment, documentation, and socialization of robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all critical customer-facing and back-office processes, ensuring compliance and efficiency.

• Manage the governance model for external partners , defining and enforcing strict SLAs and KPIs for third-party vendors (e.g., tech support, specialty pharmacies).

C. Sales Analytics & Performance Management :

• Oversee the entire process of sales target setting and management (annual, quarterly, regional, individual).

• Direct the design and maintenance of optimal sales territory structures to maximize market coverage and ensure fair opportunity distribution.

• Drive the development and dissemination of actionable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and dashboards for sales pipeline health and performance.

• Lead the successful execution of the Objectives and Key Results (OKR) framework within the sales organization, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.

D.Customer Relationship Management & Digital Adoption:

• Assess the business needs in development of customer relationship management and direct strategic framework, implementation, and optimization of the Customer Relationship Man

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• This role is for a temporary one-year contract with the possibility of extension.
• The successful candidate will be employed by a third-party agency on behalf of Roche.

Hlavním cílem a úkolem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní podporu zákazníkům v rámci České republiky ,převážně v regionu Čechy (instalace, pravidelnou údržbu, opravy, softwarové modifikace) analyzátorů a systémů Roche řady cobas, umístěných v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří. Budete úzce spolupracovat s ostatními odděleními Roche Diagnostics při přípravě a implementacích komplexních projektů laboratorních řešení. Preferované bydliště Praha/Střední Čechy

Hlavní odpovědnosti
• ● Provozovat rutinní servisní podporu na analytických přístrojích Roche v úzké spolupráci s centrem zákaznické podpory a dalšími týmy Professional Services.
• To zahrnuje:
• o Instalace přístrojů v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří
• o Provádění periodické údržby přístrojů - opravovat přístroje na základě požadavků zákazníků
• o Provádění výrobcem předepsané modifikace přístrojů
• o Poslední fází veškerých servisních služeb je konečná zkouška příslušného analyzátoru a potvrzení jeho plné funkčnosti.
• ● Provádět příslušnou dokumentaci v digitální formě (dokumentace servisních aktivit, reportování v globálním CRM systému)
• ● Sledovat servisní bulletiny za účelem zajištění co nejlepší přípravy na servisní proces a zajištění kvalitních služeb
• ● Samostatně si plánovat aktivity, zajišťovat objednávky potřebných náhradních dílů ve spolupráci se servisním zázemím
• ● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti
• Vhodný/á kandidát/ka:
• ● Absolvent/ka vysoké školy technického směru (zaměření na elektroniku nebo IT)
• ● Absolvent/ka střední školy se zaměřením na elektroniku a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.
• ● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
• ● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
• ● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
• ● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
• ● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
• ● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50)
• ● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
• ● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
