jobs.title: Regulatory Specialist Diagnostics (Maternity cover)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
As a Regulatory Specialis t you will be responsible to compile documents and deliverables to support planned product registration timelines. You will maintain product registration throughout a product’s lifecycle by applying successful regulatory change control. You will maintain clear agreement with other functions, stakeholders, and external partners (such as health authorities, companies, and notified bodies) to promote success of the registration activities and strategies. Collaborates with other functions in the organization to obtain regulatory approvals for products with defined markets.

• Provides support to currently marketed products, e.g., labeling, product and manufacturing changes and documentation for compliance and for changes requiring regulatory agency approval, as pertains to regulatory requirements. This includes annual reporting and laser reporting in relevant countries.

• Interfaces with internal stakeholders to collect data to prepare, maintain regulatory documentation. This includes internal documentation decisions and review of analytical data report review and authoring of relevant analytical documentation.

• Maintain documentation of the Regulatory Information Management System and create and maintain product information on the Regulatory Information Management System

• Create reports on Regulatory Information Management System

• Responsible for maintenance of product technical files and for ongoing activities related to compliance with Global Regulatory directives and regulations

• Support for documentation management system workflows and support for any appropriate submission activity, including PMA supplements, 30-day notices and certain 510(k)

• Support international regulatory submissions by provision of needed data and documents; answering Health Authority questions on the submissions; keeping our Affiliates informed about new products /projects/ process changes etc.

Who you are:

• Bachelor's/Master's degrees or equivalent experience

• 0-5 years experience, in Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations and/or Clinical

• Equivalent experience" may be satisfied by having completed training as a technician, a laboratory technician, or an equivalent qualification

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

• Proven ability to work autonomously

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

The Opportunity:
As a Regulatory Specialis t you will be responsible to compile documents and deliverables to support planned product registration timelines. • Maintain documentation of the Regulatory Information Management System and create and maintain product information on the Regulatory Information Management System

• Create reports on Regulatory Information Management System

• Responsible for maintenance of product technical files and for ongoing activities related to compliance with Global Regulatory directives and regulations

• Support for documentation management system workflows and support for any appropriate submission activity, including PMA supplements, 30-day notices and certain 510(k)

• Support international regulatory submissions by provision of needed data and documents; answering Health Authority questions on the submissions; keeping our Affiliates informed about new products /projects/ process changes etc.

• 0-5 years experience, in Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations and/or Clinical

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial ope

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Richiesto

• Conoscenza terapeutica all'interno del metabolismo, l'obesità e il diabete con esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica di sperimentazione / sviluppo necessario

• Sfondo accademico / insegnamento è un plus

• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi dei dati, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica

• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito

• Regolazione: Conoscenza degli aspetti medici del GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito

• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea

• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale

Abilità e comportamenti chiave

• Etica: Ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche

• Attenzione al dettaglio: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli

• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia

• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget

• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità

• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta

• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo

• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i consegnabili lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente

• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso mentre bilanciare l'etica e l'efficacia

• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra

DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ:
Strategia e pianificazione CDP

• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate

• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD

• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)

• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD

• Resta al passo con gli sviluppi interni ed esterni, le tendenze e altre dinamiche rilevanti per il lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)

• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione dell'intelligenza competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria

• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione

• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), così come gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, ope commerciale
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
ERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• Akademisch/wissenschaftlich/klinisch:
• M.D. erforderlich

• Therapeutisches Wissen über Stoffwechsel, Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes mit relevanter klinischer, wissenschaftlicher und klinischer Studien- / Entwicklungserfahrung erforderlich

• Akademischer / Lehrhintergrund ist ein Plus

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinischen Relevanz

• Erfahrungen mit der Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einer Peer-Review-Zeitschrift werden bevorzugt

• Regulatory: Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften werden bevorzugt

• Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre postgraduale akademische oder klinische Erfahrung

• Bis zu 30% globale Reisen

Schlüsselkompetenzen und -verhalten

• Ethik: Hat eine tadellose Ethik. Nachweis oder Nachweisfähigkeit von Roche Values

• Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail: Hervorragende Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail

• Business Acumen: Hat Kenntnisse in der Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie, den vielfältigen Funktionen und Rollen, die am Medikamentenentwicklungsprozess beteiligt sind. Führt regelmäßig die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen

• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele pünktlich, zielgenau und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren

• Zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen

• Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Gute Geschäftspräsentationsfähigkeiten; ist komfortabel und effektiv, wenn sie sich intern oder extern anderen präsentieren. Selbstsicher und kompetent im Umgang mit anderen intern und extern: bleibt konzentriert und punktgenau, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen produktiv und reif zu stellen

• Verhandlungsfähigkeiten : Gute Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: weiß, wie man Ergebnisse durch effektive interne und externe Zusammenarbeit mit anderen erledigt

• Entscheidungsfindung: Wissen, wie man Kompromissentscheidungen trifft, während man Ethik und Wirksamkeit in Einklang bringt

• Teamwork: Starke Orientierung an Teamwork

BESONDERE ZÖLLE UND ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN:
CDP Strategie und Planung

• Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugeordnete Moleküle/Indikationen

• Sammelt und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die für die Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Subteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse- / Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)

• Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget- / Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind

• Bleibt auf dem Laufenden über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit der CD relevant sind, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Sicht und Perspektive der internen / externen Einflüsse und / oder Implikationen für die zugewiesenen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereiche zu erhalten

• Gegebenenfalls nimmt er an wettbewerbsrelevanten Informationen und/oder anderen Markt-/Industriebewertungsaktivitäten und -projekten teil.

• Bewahrt die höchsten Standards und Niveaus der wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Kenntnisse in den spezifischen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereich (en) der Zuordnung

• Arbeitet mit einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Partnern und Stakeholdern zusammen, wie klinischen Prüfern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs) sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in den Bereichen PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung und kommerzieller Forschung.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
EXPÉRIENCE ET QUALIFICATIONS:

• Académique, scientifique et clinique :
• M.D. Requis

• Connaissances thérapeutiques au sein du métabolisme, de l'obésité et du diabète avec expérience clinique, scientifique et clinique pertinente

• L'enseignement supérieur est un plus

• Expérience de travail avec les principes et techniques d'analyse des données, d'interprétation et de pertinence clinique

• On préfère publier les résultats d'une étude scientifique dans une revue évaluée par des pairs.

• Réglementation : Connaissance des aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des exigences techniques pour l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres lignes directrices et règlements pertinents est préférable

• Durée de l'expérience: 2 ans ou plus d'expérience universitaire ou clinique postdoctorale

• Jusqu'à 30% de voyages mondiaux

Compétences et comportements clés

• Éthique : A une éthique impeccable. Démontre, ou capacité prouvée de démontrer, Roche Valeurs

• Attention aux détails: Une attention exceptionnelle aux détails

• Œuvre d'affaires : possède une connaissance pratique de l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique, des multiples fonctions et rôles associés au processus de développement des médicaments. Dirige régulièrement l'élaboration de stratégies et de plans de lutte contre la maladie

• Organisation : Peut prioriser plusieurs tâches et objectifs à temps, à la cible et dans les limites du budget

• Compétences interpersonnelles : Bonne communication interpersonnelle, verbale et influence des compétences : peut influencer sans autorité

• Écrit: Fortes compétences en communication écrite

• Compétences en présentation : Bonnes compétences en présentation d'affaires; est confortable et efficace lorsqu'on se présente aux autres, à l'interne ou à l'externe. Confiance et compétence lors de l'interaction avec les autres à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur: reste concentré et sur-le-champ, est capable de soulever des problèmes ou des défis de manière productive et mature

• Compétences en négociation : Bonnes compétences en négociation : sait comment réaliser les produits livrables en travaillant efficacement avec les autres à l'interne et à l'externe

• Prise de décisions : Savoir prendre des décisions de compromis tout en conciliant éthique et efficacité

• Travail d'équipe: Une forte orientation vers le travail d'équipe

DROITS ET RESPONSABILITÉS SPÉCIFIQUES:
Stratégie et planification du PCD

• Participer à l'élaboration du plan CD pour la ou les molécules/indications attribuées

• Rassemble et analyse les données et les informations nécessaires pour créer le plan CD

• Collabore avec d'autres membres du CST et des sous-équipes compétentes pour élaborer des éléments du plan de CD (p. ex., stratégie d'analyse et de données, élaboration de KOL, stratégie de publications, etc.)

• Collabore avec le Comité de la science et de la technologie et d ' autres équipes compétentes pour élaborer et fournir des informations et des données sur les besoins budgétaires et les ressources nécessaires à la mise en œuvre et à l ' exécution du plan de la Conférence du désarmement

• Maintient les normes et les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans les domaines thérapeutiques et de maladies spécifiques

jobs.title: Medical Director - CVM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial ope

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest .
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

Your day to day responsibilities are:
We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Talent Acquisition Intern colleague for our team in Budapest. As a Talent Acquisition Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partners in the recruitment process for open roles.

We are offering an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on work experience and insights into Recruiting as well as wider HR topics during a very dynamic time at Roche. You will be an integral part of our TA team, managing recruiting activities across various client groups. In addition you will lead and support a range of global initiatives enabling our organisation to adapt to new technologies and new ways of working.

As our trusted Intern colleague, you will:

• Candidate sourcing, application screening, requisitions clean up, scheduling and assessment

• Handling of candidate workflow using our e-recruitment system: Workday

• Partnering with Talent Acquisition Partners, Early in Career Partners,, business departments and People & Culture colleagues globally

• Supporting the team with reports and presentations, as well as actively looking for process improvements

• Supporting one or more of our client group’s global transformation programs

• Other activities related to the role and business needs

We are keen to discover talents who are passionate about learning and show high curiosity in discovering new things.

What can you bring to our team:
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. Furthermore:

• y​ou have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• ​y​ou are available at least 30 hours per week

• ​y​ou have a good command of French and English and have outstanding communication skills

• ​y​ou have a customer oriented mind-set and you are creative, enthusiastic, pro-active and​ open to taking over new tasks

• you are open to learn and develop

• you have the passion to find people careers rather than simply jobs

• you are willing to learn and develop and you are open for further career opportunities within Roche.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted usin

jobs.title: Business Strategy Praktikantenstelle (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unser Team

Unser Team ist ein integraler Teil der globalen Sites Networks von Roche und betreut die großen Produktionsstandorte Mannheim und Penzberg (München). Wir gestalten die strategische Ausrichtung und organisatorische Entwicklung dieser Standorte. Mit einer umfangreichen strategischen Agenda treiben wir zahlreiche Initiativen und Projekte im Site Management voran, immer mit dem Ziel, messbaren Fortschritt und Verbesserung zu erreichen. In unserem aufgeschlossenen und ambitionierten Team wirst du in Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen, globalen und Konzernfunktionen standortübergreifend innovative Ideen und Lösungen entwickeln sowie umsetzen.
Deine Rolle
In dieser Schlüsselfunktion bringst du deine eigenen Ideen direkt ein. Durch die enge 1:1 Zusammenarbeit mit dem/der Chief of Staff nimmst du eine aktive Sparringspartner-Rolle ein, um zentrale Managementthemen des Sites Networks erfolgreich mitzugestalten. Als Teil des Stabs der Geschäftsführung unterstützen wir zudem bei allen relevanten Gremien (u.a. Betriebsrat, Wirtschaftsausschuss) und Terminen von Roche Diagnostics.
Deine Aufgaben in unserem Team setzen sich wie folgt zusammen:

• Konzeption und Umsetzung eines Dashboards von Business-relevanten KPIs zur Performancesteuerung im Site Management. Dabei gehört die kontinuierliche Reflektion von Optimierungspotenzialen zu deinen Aufgaben

• Durchführung von verschiedenen Analysen und Auswertungen laufender Initiativen im Site Management, wie beispielsweise Marktanalysen und Stakeholderanalysen

• Analyse der Voraussetzungen und Ausarbeitung eines ganzheitlichen und zielgerichteten Ansatzes für ein unternehmerisches Ökosystem in der Pharmabranche in Deutschland. Hierbei arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen

• Eigenständige, konzeptionelle Vor- und Nachbereitung von Workshops, Meetings, Reportings und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management und Gremiensitzungen

• Mitwirkung bei der Koordination, Konzeption und Umsetzung von strategischen Projekten in direkter Abstimmung mit dem/der Chief of Staff

• Aktive Unterstützung des Managements bei der Weiterentwicklung von Business, Strategie und Innovation

Dein Profil

• Ein Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Relevante praktische Erfahrung durch mindestens zwei Praktika in der Unternehmensberatung, in strategischen Konzernrollen, einem Start-up oder ähnlichen Bereichen, in denen analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick erfolgreich unter Beweis gestellt wurden

• Zusätzliche Auslandserfahrung ist von Vorteil

• Die Mindestvoraussetzung für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau,fließende Englischkenntnisse sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Office-Programmen und Kollaborationstools

• Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten, eine gesunde Portion Neugier sowie ein starkes Gespür für Zahlen und Daten

• Eigenverantwortliches Vorantreiben von Themen, hohe Flexibilität bei der Aufgabenerfüllung und das entsprechende Mindset, in einem weltweit agierenden Pharmaunternehmen zu arbeiten

• Spaß an der Kombination aus Strategie und Innovation, kreativer Arbeit und einem hohen Maß an Verantwortung

​
Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung, Home-Office ist möglich

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/ offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Weiterbildu

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

• Design, build, and scale cloud-native and hybrid data and machine learning platforms (MLOps) tailored to the complex, evolving needs of our established Data Science team.

• Plan, architect, and develop long-term enterprise tooling and infrastructure for internal use to accelerate and streamline ML model research, training, and evaluation.

• Take responsibility for the end-to-end software and data architecture within Data Science initiatives, independently driving the specification, implementation, and testing of complex technical assignments.

• A very good understanding of complete ML workflows and hands-o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Sales Account Manager you will be responsible for achieving regional sales targets for our Near Patient Care (NPC) Roche Diagnostics portfolio. You will manage the full customer lifecycle, from prospecting new clients to maintaining relationships with existing ones through proactive communication.
Key responsibilities include providing demand-driven sales and after-sales support, conducting customer training, and installing NPC products, all while ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends and competitor activity.
Our NPC covers healthcare customers such as physicians (General practitioners, ambulatory specialists - diabetologists, internal medicine doctors, cardiologists, pneumologists) and hospitals. The NPC portfolio consists of various POCT devices, professional/hospital and patient blood glucose meters and CGM.

Preferred location: Southern Moravia, e.g. Brno / Olomouc
Readiness to active business trips is required
Employment contract: initially fixed-term 2 years with a possibility to extend, contract with a vendor of service of Roche

The Opportunity

Customer Relationship & Sales Management:

• Proactively engage customers to identify needs, suggest solutions, and resolve issues, ensuring high satisfaction through exceptional after-sales support

• Drive sales growth by negotiating new business, promoting and installing products (instruments, reagents), and expanding the customer portfolio

• Manage the full sales process, including preparing, presenting, and negotiating quotations using designated tools and processes.

Portfolio Promotion & Training:

• Promote NPC portfolio by conducting customer training seminars and representing the company at key conferences

Market Intelligence & Personal Development:

• Monitor and report on regional competitor behavior and market trends

• Proactively engage in continuous self-learning to maintain expert knowledge of relevant publications and industry information

Compliance & Collaboration:

• Ensure strict compliance with all Complaint Management procedures, including accurate and timely reporting in our CRM and other global systems

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues within the NPC team and other departments to achieve shared goals

Who You Are

• Secondary education as a minimum, Natural or Health Sciences field preferred

• Proven customer-facing within commercial functional area experience (1+ years of experience as a minimum)

• Sales experience in the healthcare field of medical devices or In-vitro diagnostics is desired

• Czech language fluent and English at intermediate level

• Demonstrated communication skills to be able to present complex topics in concise and clear manner

• Negotiation and influencing skills with solution-orientated mindset

• Able to handle conflicting priorities with value-generating outlook

• PC Skills (experience working in Google Workplace, MS Office)

• Team player mindset to challenge colleagues but also support them grow in line with achieving common goals

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high

The Position
Como Tendering & Contract Management Partner , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en nuestra división de Diagnóstica al asegurar nuestra participación efectiva en oportunidades de negocio tanto públicas como privadas. Actuarás como un socio estratégico de back-office , brindando soporte crítico al equipo de ventas durante todo el ciclo de vida del contrato.

La Oportunidad

• Elaboras y consolidas toda la documentación requerida para los procesos de adquisiciones públicas y privadas, garantizando el cumplimiento de las normativas legales y los estándares de la compañía.

• Colaboras estrechamente con el equipo de ventas y áreas transversales para gestionar los procesos comerciales internos de inicio a fin.

• Supervisas la ejecución de los procesos internos de gestión contractual para todos los clientes, asegurando una prestación de servicio sin interrupciones.

• Identificas y alertar sobre posibles riesgos contractuales, desarrollando planes de acción proactivos para mitigar penalidades y mejorar los flujos de trabajo internos.

• Lideras las reuniones de Kick Off de los contratos con clientes públicos, comunicando claramente las responsabilidades contractuales a toda la organización.

• Gestionas adendas, adicionales y reducciones de contratos, asegurando que toda la documentación necesaria sea precisa y esté actualizada.

• Mantienes actualizadas las herramientas comerciales corporativas y los repositorios para garantizar la trazabilidad total e integridad de los datos.

• Gestionas penalidades no imputables a la organización mediante la solicitud de ampliaciones de plazo y exoneraciones para proteger los intereses de la compañía.

Quién eres

• Tú cuentas con un título universitario en Administración, Ingeniería de Negocios, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Tú aportas al menos 3 años de experiencia en compras y contrataciones públicas.

• Tú tienes un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia en servicio al cliente, gestión comercial o gestión de procesos.

• Tú posees un nivel de inglés intermedio, lo que permite tu participación en proyectos y reuniones regionales.

• Tú te caracterizas por una alta atención al detalle, gran capacidad analítica y excelentes habilidades de planificación y organización.

​ Preferible

• Cuentas con un MBA o un postgrado relacionado.

• Tienes experiencia en el desarrollo de presupuestos y un profundo conocimiento de expedientes de licitación pública.

• Demuestras una alta orientación al servicio y capacidad para la toma de decisiones en entornos dinámicos.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: People & Culture OneRoche Trainee
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Esta posición tiene una duración de 6 meses con posibilidad de extensión de hasta 18 meses.

OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO:
Facilitar el camino de transformación de nuestras personas y organización entregando soporte de People & Culture (P&C) a OneRoche a través de la ejecución de diferentes iniciativas de desarrollo, training, performance, comunicaciones, y operaciones que apoyan la agilidad, efectividad y transformación organizacional.
ROLES Y RESPONSABILIDADES:
P&C Operations:

• Simplificar procesos y proponer áreas de mejora y eficiencia para facilitar la transformación organizacional.

• Guiar y prestar apoyo a los People Managers y colaboradores en procesos de Workday, facilitar Workday training on-demand.

• Seguimiento con P&C PSS local y regional, y Workday cuando sea necesario.

• Coordinar nuevos ingresos con equipos locales, IT, y SHE en cuanto a documentación y equipos requeridos.

• Apoyar en actividades de onboarding con la finalidad de que las personas cuenten con todo lo necesario para su efectividad laboral e integración a la organización.

People & Culture Communications:

• Coordinar las comunicaciones de People & Culture de nuevos ingresos, desarrollo de Carrera, transformación, cambios organizacionales, y salidas de OneRoche trabajando en conjunto de la agencia de comunicaciones y stakeholders relevantes.

Training & Development:

• Analizar, identificar, y coordinar soluciones de training enfocadas en las necesidades del business on-demand.

• Preparar, co-facilitar workshops, y dar seguimiento a las acciones de las actividades de training & development.

• Actualizar y administrar participación y coordinación de trainings con proveedores, facilitadores, colaboradores y stakeholders relevantes.

• Apoyar, actualizar, y a dar seguimiento a los procesos de talent (succession plans, talent pools) performance, y development via check-ins y reuniones con people managers y colaboradores, utilizando y actualizando la herramienta de Talent en Workday.

• Participar y trabajar en equipo con el equipo de Calidad en las necesidades de training y auditoria.

REQUERIMIENTOS:
Conocimientos:

• Título Universitario Ingeniería Comercial, Administración de Empresas, Recursos Humanos o carrera afín.

• Experiencia laboral de al menos 2 a 3 años en áreas de Recursos Humanos, Consultoría, o Gestión de Proyectos.

• Nivel de Inglés Avanzado.

Conocimientos específicos (deseable):

• Workday

• Metodologías Ágiles

• Gestión de Proyectos

• Técnicas de facilitación

• Habilidades digitales

• Habilidades de presentación

• Metodologías/técnicas de coaching

• Metodologías/técnicas de feedback

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader is responsible for analyzing the Global Pharma portfolio to evaluate commercial attributes, identify risks/opportunities, anticipate impact of landscape shifts and shape strategic decisions. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams to develop insights and realize the full value of recommendations generated. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• Strategic modeling & analytics: Develop sophisticated analytical frameworks and models used to evaluate the global portfolio and inform long-term planning. You will provide a quantitative commercial foundation for commercialization and R&D strategic decisions, ensuring recommendations are rooted in robust data and contextualized for business impact

• Market trend synthesis: Evaluate diverse data sources to identify emerging trends and shifts in the healthcare landscape. You will lead the development of cohesive "outside-in" perspectives on our internal portfolio that inform how we navigate an evolving competitive environment

• Performance evaluation and risk mitigation: Assess cross-portfolio performance to identify high-potential growth drivers and critical trade-offs. You will highlight potential gaps in the collective strategy and recommend interventions to strengthen our portfolio position

• Decision Support: Act as a specialist consultant for strategy projects, translating complex portfolio analytics into concise, high-impact recommendations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, turning technical complexity into clear, actionable business strategies

• Unified portfolio narrative: Integrate individual Therapeutic Area insights into a single, co

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader è responsabile dell'analisi del portafoglio di Global Pharma per valutare gli attributi commerciali, identificare i rischi / opportunità, anticipare l'impatto dei cambiamenti del paesaggio e modellare le decisioni strategiche. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI per sviluppare intuizioni e realizzare il valore completo delle raccomandazioni generate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Aree di messa a fuoco e responsabilità
• Modellazione strategica e analisi: sviluppare sofisticati framework analitici e modelli utilizzati per valutare il portafoglio globale e informare la pianificazione a lungo termine. Fornirai una base commerciale quantitativa per la commercializzazione e le decisioni strategiche R&D, assicurando che le raccomandazioni siano radicate in dati robusti e contestualizzate per l'impatto aziendale
• Sintesi della tendenza di mercato: Valutare diverse fonti di dati per identificare le tendenze e i cambiamenti emergenti nel panorama sanitario. Potrai condurre lo sviluppo di prospettive coessive "outside-in" che informano come navighiamo un ambiente competitivo in evoluzione
• Valutazione delle prestazioni e mitigazione dei rischi: Valuta le prestazioni cross-portfolio per identificare i driver di crescita ad alto potenziale e i trade-off critici. Si evidenziano potenziali lacune nella strategia collettiva e raccomanda interventi per rafforzare la nostra posizione di portafoglio
• Sostegno alla decisione: agire come consulente specializzato per progetti di strategia, tradurre analisi complesse del portafoglio in raccomandazioni concise e ad alto impatto. Potrai servire come consulente di fiducia per la leadership senior, trasformando la complessità tecnica in strategie aziendali chiare e attuabili
• Una narrazione di portafoglio unificato: Integra le informazioni individuali dell'Area terapeutica in un singolo, coesivo "oltre il TA"

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht einen Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader, der uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharmastrategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse beitritt. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader ist für die Analyse des Global Pharma Portfolios verantwortlich, um kommerzielle Attribute zu bewerten, Risiken/ Chancen zu identifizieren, Auswirkungen von Landschaftsverschiebungen zu antizipieren und strategische Entscheidungen zu formen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um Erkenntnisse zu entwickeln und den vollen Wert der generierten Empfehlungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Schwerpunkte und Zuständigkeiten
• Strategische Modellierung & Analytik: Entwickeln Sie ausgeklügelte analytische Rahmenbedingungen und Modelle, mit denen das globale Portfolio bewertet und die langfristige Planung informiert wird. Sie werden eine quantitative kommerzielle Grundlage für die Kommerzialisierung und strategische Entscheidungen der F & E bieten, um sicherzustellen, dass Empfehlungen in robusten Daten verwurzelt und für Geschäftsauswirkungen kontextualisiert werden
• Markttrend-Synthese: Bewerten Sie verschiedene Datenquellen, um aufkommende Trends und Verschiebungen in der Gesundheitslandschaft zu erkennen. Sie werden die Entwicklung von kohäsiven "outside-in" Perspektiven führen, die informieren, wie wir ein sich entwickelndes Wettbewerbsumfeld navigieren
• Leistungsbeurteilung und Risikominderung: Erfolgt das Cross-Portfolio, um potenzielle Wachstumstreiber und kritische Trade-offs zu identifizieren. Sie werden potenzielle Lücken in der kollektiven Strategie hervorheben und Interventionen empfehlen, um unsere Portfolioposition zu stärken
• Entscheidungsunterstützung: Handeln Sie als spezialisierter Berater für Strategieprojekte und übersetzen komplexe Portfolioanalysen in präzise, wirkungsstarke Empfehlungen. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für leitende Führung dienen und technische Komplexität in klare, handlungsfähige Geschäftsstrategien verwandeln
• Einheitliche Portfolio-Erzählung: Integrieren Sie individuelle Therapeutische Area-Einsichten in eine einzelne, zusammenhängende "Beyond TA"
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file du portefeuille « Beyond Therapeutical Area » (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche au moyen de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Le chef de file du portefeuille Au-delà de l'AT est chargé d'analyser le portefeuille Global Pharma afin d'évaluer les caractéristiques commerciales, de cerner les risques et les possibilités, d'anticiper l'impact des changements de paysage et de façonner les décisions stratégiques. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec d'autres équipes de l'IE et d'autres ISP afin d'élaborer des idées et de réaliser toute la valeur des recommandations générées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Domaines d ' intervention et responsabilités
• Modélisation et analyse stratégiques: Développer des cadres et modèles analytiques sophistiqués utilisés pour évaluer le portefeuille mondial et éclairer la planification à long terme. Vous fournirez une base commerciale quantitative pour la commercialisation et les décisions stratégiques de R-D, en veillant à ce que les recommandations soient fondées sur des données solides et contextualisées en fonction de l'impact de l'entreprise.
• Synthèse des tendances du marché : Évaluer diverses sources de données pour identifier les tendances émergentes et les changements dans le paysage des soins de santé. Vous dirigerez l'élaboration de perspectives cohésives « externes » qui guideront la façon dont nous naviguons dans un environnement concurrentiel en évolution
• Évaluation des performances et atténuation des risques: évaluer les performances inter-portfolio pour identifier les facteurs de croissance à fort potentiel et les compromis critiques. Vous soulignerez les lacunes potentielles de la stratégie collective et recommanderez des interventions pour renforcer notre position de portefeuille
• Appui à la décision : agir en tant que consultant spécialisé pour les projets stratégiques, traduire l'analyse complexe du portefeuille en recommandations concises et à impact élevé. Vous serez un conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs, transformant la complexité technique en stratégies opérationnelles claires et réalisables
• Narratif unifié du portefeuille : Intégrer les points de vue individuels de la zone thérapeutique dans un « Au-delà de l'AT » unique et cohérent

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Domain Architect – Sites & Services

The Domain Architect – Sites & Services is a senior, pivotal role within the SPG (Strategy, Portfolio & Governance) Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This role serves as the critical connector between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the global Sites, SHE & Sustainability function with a focus on the Sites. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Sites leadership team, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of Roche’s global site footprint, corporate real estate, and facility management operations.
Crucially, in our federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Sites architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Sites organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready technology roadmaps.

Description of the Area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural interface for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Sites domain, this involves deeply integrating with product and engineering teams across the core Sites function, Data, Analytics & AI, and the Regional Business Partnering teams (e.g., Switzerland, Germany, US West Coast, US Mid-West and East Coast). This architectural role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and the local operational execution for Roche's physical footprint and smart building initiatives is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity:

• Drive strategic business partnering by acting as the primary architectural liaison between SPG and the Sites function to align real estate priorities with multi-year technology roadmaps.

• Orchestrate the global architecture network across regional sites, empowering embedded domain and solution architects to execute efficiently while adhering to shared enterprise principles.

• Lead architecture governance by defining technology guardrails and non-functional requirements, including IoT network security, physical access control resilience, and operational data privacy.

• Steer critical program delivery for high-impact initiatives such as smart building deployments, connected workplace technologies, and global real estate portfolio rationalization.

• Develop core domain architecture deliverables, including Facility Management capability maps, target-state architectures, and reference blueprints utilizing the ArchiMEDES toolchain.

• Align portfolio investments by embedding architectural insights into funding decisions, maximizing platform reuse, and actively minimizing technical debt across global sites.

• Evaluate emerging technology innovations and vendor solutions (such as digital twins for buildings and advanced IoT facility ecosystems) to ensure alignment with operational needs.

• Foster a collaborative workplace culture that balances enterprise coherence with local agility, transforming complex architectural visions into scalable, real-world value.

Who you are:

• Educated with a Bachelor’s or Master’

jobs.title: Stażysta / Stażystka ds. Logistyki
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech.

Twoja Rola:

• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.

• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).

• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.

• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.

• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki.

O Tobie:

• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).

• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).

• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.

• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​

Oferujemy:

• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.

• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .

• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.

• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi.

Dodatkowe informacje:

• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)

• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo)

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .
​

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Gestión global de proyectos relacionados con la instalación, soporte y mantenimiento del software de gestión integral del Tratamiento Anticoagulante Oral (y otros productos POC). El dispositivo informático facilita la gestión integral descentralizada de los pacientes en tratamiento anticoagulante oral, gracias a una aplicación web ágil y flexible (y otros productos POC como CGM y NaPOC Operations. Asimismo facilita la integración de la información con otros sistemas del Área Sanitaria gracias al uso de estándares de comunicación.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de instalaciones y actualizaciones.

• Formación al cliente final.

• Apoyo al cliente en incidencias, dudas, nuevos proyectos, etc.

• Gestión Documental de los proyectos e instalaciones

• Gestión de las conexiones de instrumentos.

• Soporte a la red de ventas

Perfil requerido:

• Ingeniería Técnica o superior de Informática de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones

• Inglés Nivel Medio

• Conocimientos mínimo técnicos de BBDD

• Conocimientos de sistemas Windows y Linux

• Persona comunicativa

• Disponibilidad para viajar (esporádicamente)

Perfil Deseado:

• Conocimientos técnicos de BBDD (SQL, MysQL y Oracle)

• Conocimientos mensajería HL7 y Motor integración Mirth

• Conocimientos de herramientas de ticketing

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: R&D Business Tools Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.
We are seeking a R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist to join our global support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how —understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools , enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, change requests) for high-accuracy execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

•
• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

• Education a
