jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Quality Lead within our Quality Assurance Process and Affiliate team, you will bring diverse thinking and technical expertise across various quality disciplines to support the Roche/Genentech organisation.

In this pivotal role, you will design and deliver risk-based Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post-approval products, affiliates, and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, guiding cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.

• Design and Implement QA Strategies: Partner with business stakeholders to independently define the QA approach, assessing risks and adapting strategies using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework across GCP, GVP, and Medical Device areas.

• Define and Lead Audits: Determine required audits, leverage data analytics to develop methodologies, and independently manage the end-to-end audit process from preparation to reporting.

• Manage Quality Issues: Independently manage quality issues, tracking systematic findings for process improvement and escalating significant risks to PDQ management.

• Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication: Independently evaluate quality positions to drive compliance action plans. Lead high-level risk presentations and strategic discussions with business stakeholders, Pharma representatives, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs.

• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead preparation, staff training, and the management of major regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA), confidently presenting quality strategies and conclusions.

• Drive PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead compliance projects, and act as a dedicated mentor to develop Quality Leads within the team.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, matrixed environment and is passionate about driving Quality outcomes. You possess strong digital and data literacy, allowing you to turn data into insights, and you are comfortable asking challenging questions to support PDQ outcomes.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Quality Expertise: A strong background in the drug development process and clinical trials, with robust cross-functional experience in GCP, GVP/PV, or Medical Devices/SaMD.

• Inspection Leadership: A proven track record of leading major Health Authority inspections (such as FDA or EMA), including inspection readiness and post-inspection management.

• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving skills with a proactive, risk-based mindset and the ability to utilise data and data visualisation tools to drive decisions.

• Influencing & Communication Skills: Exceptional relationship management skills with a proven ability to negotiate effective solutions and influence senior stakeholders.

• Inclusive Leadership: Experience managing projects in global, multicultural teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others.

• Academic Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred).

Location

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, sviluppiamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), ci sforziamo di fiducia nell'integrità dei nostri dati e processi, agilità e trasparenza senza rivali con autorità sanitarie, pazienti e società. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Quality Lead all'interno del nostro team di Quality Assurance e Affiliazione, avrai diverse competenze tecniche e di pensiero in diverse discipline di qualità per supportare l'organizzazione Roche/Genentech. In questo ruolo fondamentale, progettare e fornire strategie di assicurazione della qualità basate sul rischio, audit e conclusioni per i prodotti post-approvazione, affiliati e processi. Potrai agire come partner affidabile per gli stakeholder aziendali senior, guidando la collaborazione interfunzionale per garantire standard di qualità globali sono soddisfatti durante la navigazione di paesaggi normativi complessi.
• Design e Implement QA Strategie: Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire in modo indipendente l'approccio QA, valutare i rischi e adattare le strategie utilizzando il framework Critical to Quality (CtQ) in aree GCP, GVP e Medical Device.
• Definire e Lead Audits: Determinare gli audit necessari, sfruttare l'analisi dei dati per sviluppare metodologie e gestire in modo indipendente il processo di audit end-to-end dalla preparazione alla reportistica.
• Gestione dei problemi di qualità: gestire in modo indipendente i problemi di qualità, tracciare i risultati sistematici per il miglioramento del processo e aumentare i rischi significativi per la gestione del PDQ.
• Conclusione di qualità e Stakeholder Comunicazione: Valutare in modo indipendente le posizioni di qualità per guidare i piani di azione di conformità. Condurre presentazioni di rischio di alto livello e discussioni strategiche con gli stakeholder aziendali, i rappresentanti di farmaci, gli affari legali e regolamentari.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: preparazione del piombo, formazione del personale, e la gestione di importanti ispezioni normative (ad esempio, FDA, EMA), presentando con fiducia strategie e conclusioni di qualità.
• Guida PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribuisci alla direzione strategica a lungo termine del PDQ, ai progetti di conformità dei lead e funge da mentore dedicato per sviluppare i lead di qualità all'interno del team. Chi sei Sei un proattivo, pensatore strategico che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, matrice ed è appassionato di guidare i risultati di qualità. Possiedi una forte alfabetizzazione digitale e dei dati, permettendoti di trasformare i dati in insight, e sei a tuo agio a porre domande impegnative per supportare i risultati PDQ. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza di qualità estesa: uno sfondo forte nel processo di sviluppo del farmaco e studi clinici, con una solida esperienza interfunzionale in GCP, GVP/PV, o dispositivi medici/SaMD.
• Leadership di ispezione: una comprovata traccia di importanti ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria (come FDA o EMA), compresa la disponibilità di ispezione e la gestione post-ispezione.
• pensiero analitico e critico: competenze avanzate di problem solving con una mentalità proattiva e basata sul rischio e la capacità di utilizzare strumenti di visualizzazione dati e dati per guidare le decisioni.
• Influencing & Communication Skills: competenze di gestione delle relazioni eccezionali con una comprovata capacità di negoziare soluzioni efficaci e influenzare gli stakeholder senior.
• Leadership Inclusive: esperienza nella gestione di progetti in team globali e multiculturali, con la passione per allenare e sostenere gli altri.
• Qualifiche accademiche: diploma di laurea o equivalente in un campo scientifico o di qualità (è preferito un grado avanzato). Location

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche fördern wir die Wissenschaft, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. In der Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) streben wir nach Vertrauen in die Integrität unserer Daten und Prozesse, Agilität und unübertroffene Transparenz mit Gesundheitsbehörden, Patienten und Gesellschaft. Die Chance Als Senior Quality Lead in unserem Quality Assurance Process und Affiliate Team bringen Sie vielfältiges Denken und technisches Know-how in verschiedenen Qualitätsdisziplinen, um die Roche/Genentech-Organisation zu unterstützen. In dieser entscheidenden Rolle entwerfen und liefern Sie risikobasierte Qualitätssicherungsstrategien, Audits und Schlussfolgerungen für Postzulassungsprodukte, Affiliate und Prozesse. Sie fungieren als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für geschäftsführende Stakeholder und führen eine funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, um sicherzustellen, dass globale Qualitätsstandards erfüllt werden und komplexe regulatorische Landschaften navigieren.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von QA-Strategien: Partner mit Geschäftspartnern, um den QA-Ansatz unabhängig zu definieren, Risiken zu bewerten und Strategien mit dem Critical to Quality (CtQ)-Framework in GCP-, GVP- und Medical Device-Bereichen anzupassen.
• Define and Lead Audits: Bestimmen Sie notwendige Audits, nutzen Sie Datenanalysen, um Methoden zu entwickeln und den Abschluss-zu-End-Auditprozess unabhängig von der Vorbereitung bis zur Berichterstattung zu verwalten.
• Qualitätsfragen verwalten: Unabhängige Qualitätsfragen verwalten, systematische Erkenntnisse zur Prozessverbesserung verfolgen und erhebliche Risiken für das PDQ-Management ausgleichen.
• Quality Fazit und Stakeholder Communication: Unabhängige Bewertung von Qualitätspositionen, um Compliance-Aktionspläne zu steuern. Führen Sie hochrangige Risikopräsentationen und strategische Gespräche mit Wirtschaftsteilnehmern, Pharma-Vertretern, Recht und Regulierung.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead Preparation, Personal Training und die Verwaltung von wichtigen Regulierungsinspektionen (z.B. FDA, EMA), zuversichtlich Präsentation von Qualitätsstrategien und Schlussfolgerungen.
• Fahren Sie PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Tragen Sie der langfristigen strategischen Ausrichtung von PDQ bei, führen Sie Compliance-Projekte und fungieren als engagierter Mentor, um Quality Leads innerhalb des Teams zu entwickeln. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein proaktiver, strategischer Denker, der in einer kollaborativen, Matrix-Umgebung lebt und leidenschaftlich am Fahren von Qualitätsergebnissen ist. Sie besitzen eine starke digitale und Datenkompetenz, so dass Sie Daten in Einsichten verwandeln, und Sie sind bequem, anspruchsvolle Fragen zu stellen, um PDQ Ergebnisse zu unterstützen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Umfangreiche Qualitätsexpertise: Ein starker Hintergrund bei der Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln und klinischen Studien, mit robuster funktionsübergreifender Erfahrung in GCP, GVP/PV oder Medical Devices/SaMD.
• Inspektion Leadership: Ein bewährter Track-Recording von führenden Hauptinspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden (z.B. FDA oder EMA), einschließlich Inspektionsbereitschaft und Nachinspektionsmanagement.
• Analytisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittene Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einem proaktiven, risikobasierten Denkansatz und die Fähigkeit, Daten und Datenvisualisierungstools zu nutzen, um Entscheidungen zu leiten.
• Einflussnahme & Kommunikation Fähigkeiten: Außergewöhnliche Beziehung Management Fähigkeiten mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, effektive Lösungen zu verhandeln und Senior Stakeholder zu beeinflussen.
• Inklusive Führung: Erleben Sie Projekte in globalen, multikulturellen Teams, mit einer Leidenschaft für Coaching und Mentoring andere.
• akademische Qualifikationen: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in einem wissenschaftlichen oder qualitätsbezogenen Bereich (ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss ist bevorzugt). Standort

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à une transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. L'opportunité En tant que responsable principal de la qualité au sein de notre équipe de processus d'assurance de la qualité et d'affiliation, vous apporterez une diversité de réflexion et d'expertise technique dans différentes disciplines de qualité pour soutenir l'organisation Roche/Genentech. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous concevrez et fournirez des stratégies, des vérifications et des conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur les risques pour les produits, les filiales et les processus post-approbation. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants commerciaux, en guidant la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiales tout en naviguant dans des paysages réglementaires complexes.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'AQ : établir des partenariats avec les intervenants commerciaux pour définir de façon indépendante l'AQ, évaluer les risques et adapter les stratégies à l'aide du cadre essentiel à la qualité (CtQ) dans l'ensemble des secteurs du GCP, du GVP et des instruments médicaux.
• Définir et diriger les audits : Déterminer les audits requis, tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour élaborer des méthodologies et gérer de manière indépendante le processus d'audit de bout en bout, de la préparation à l'établissement de rapports.
• Gérer les problèmes de qualité : gérer les problèmes de qualité de façon indépendante, suivre les constatations systématiques pour améliorer les processus et augmenter les risques importants pour la gestion des PDQ.
• Conclusion sur la qualité et communication avec les parties prenantes: évaluer de manière indépendante les positions de qualité afin d'orienter les plans d'action en matière de conformité. Diriger des présentations de risques de haut niveau et des discussions stratégiques avec les intervenants commerciaux, les représentants des pharmaciens, les Affaires juridiques et réglementaires.
• Diriger et appuyer les inspections des autorités sanitaires : préparation des responsables, formation du personnel et gestion des principales inspections réglementaires (par exemple, FDA, EMA), présentation confiante de stratégies et de conclusions de qualité.
• Diriger le leadership et le mentorat du PDQ : contribuer à l'orientation stratégique à long terme du PDQ, diriger des projets de conformité et agir comme un mentor dévoué pour développer des responsables de qualité au sein de l'équipe. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE)　本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。

職務内容
弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、Medical Scientific Affairs、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、以下の業務を行っていただきます。

• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチーム、メディカルチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する

• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する

• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行

• ジュニアスタッフの人財育成

求める経験

• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器（プログラム医療機器の経験であれば尚可）の薬事申請業務の経験（3年以上）を有すること。

• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。

求める知識・スキル、マインドセット

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。

• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話以上の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。

• 論理的な思考力、並びに文章構成力（正確性を含む）。

• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるリーダーシップ。

• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。

• 薬事スペシャリストとして、新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。
ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 職務の目的 ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE) 本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。 職務内容 弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、Medical Scientific Affairs、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、以下の業務を行っていただきます。
• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチーム、メディカルチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する
• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する
• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行
• ジュニアスタッフの人財育成 求める経験
• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器（プログラム医療機器の経験であれば尚可）の薬事申請業務の経験（3年以上）を有すること。
• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。 求める知識・スキル、マインドセット
• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。
• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。
• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。
• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話以上の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。
• 論理的な思考力、並びに文章構成力（正確性を含む）。
• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるリーダーシップ。
• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。
• 薬事スペシャリストとして、新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。
• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。 海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。 ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Analyst, you will act as a senior Solution Consultant in China Everyday AI and Core Collaboration&Productivity Suite areas, independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain’s Everyday AI scenarios, related technologies(Google workplace & MS365, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans.
In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You are expected to be a tech champion for Everyday AI toolsets and lifting the business users’ expertise, hands-on with no-code/low-code AI products to rapidly build AI workflows and mockups for business validation. Also, you will lead the M365 migration project, specifically analyzing Google Service specific business scenarios to determine migration paths or alternative solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, e.g. Everyday AI/Google/M365, without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Serve as the Solution Owner for China Everyday AI toolsets, defining the evolution of the China Everyday AI toolkit by orchestrating global AI offerings. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems in collaboration and productivity domain, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals. Interface with business partners to present AI workflow mockups, using rapid prototyping to align expectations and secure buy-in.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies (e.g. Gemini, Copilot, Coze, M365, Google), and their interdependencies. Independently applies to

titleByLocale.it: Partner di Eccellenza e Trasformazione Digitale
titleByLocale.fr: Excellence client et partenaire de transformation numérique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Customer Excellence & Digital Transformation Partner, you will play a key role within our Supply Chain organization, combining operational Customer Service responsibilities with a strong focus on digital transformation and process optimization. This is a hybrid position designed for someone who enjoys both hands-on operational work and contributing to a more automated, efficient, and customer-centric future.
You will manage daily Order-to-Cash activities while also helping identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve customer interactions, and support the transition from manual operations to digital-first solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer end to end order flow: order management, invoicing, pricing discrepancies, operational incidents and collecting activities within SAP and Order-to-Cash workflows

• Provide customer support through phone and email while ensuring high-quality service and timely issue resolution

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Logistics, and Commercial teams to ensure smooth operations

• Identify repetitive manual activities and contribute ideas to improve efficiency through automation, digital tools, and AI solutions

• Support digital transformation initiatives by helping customers adopt online ordering, automated workflows, and more agile ways of working

Who You Are

• Experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Billing, Order Management, or related operational environments

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a customer-oriented mindset

• Analytical and proactive profile with interest in process improvement and operational excellence

• Curious about digital transformation, automation, AI, and new technologies applied to business processes

• Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced environments with an agile and collaborative mindset

Technical & Digital Skills

• SAP or ERP systems experience is highly valued

• Familiarity with CRM tools and Order-to-Cash processes

• Advanced Excel and strong data accuracy mindset

• Interest or experience in automation, digital workflows, or AI-driven solutions

• Understanding of Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices

Languages

• Fluent Spanish

• Professional English

• Catalan is a plus

What We Offer
At Roche, you will join an innovative and collaborative environment where operational excellence and digital transformation go hand in hand. This role offers the opportunity to develop both customer-facing and strategic skills while contributing to projects that improve efficiency, automation, and customer experience within a global healthcare organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end "Order to Cash" journey, ensuring that every interaction adds value to our clinicians and patients. • Responsibilities : -Strategic Order Management: Execute the daily management of customer orders within SAP with precision, acting as the primary point of contact to ensure a seamless experience. -Digital Onboarding & Transformation: Drive the continuous development of the customer journey by migrating clients to automated solutions (EDI, Webshop/Online Ordering, Track and Trace). You will represent the Spanish affiliate in regional forums to align on global digital strategies. -Consultative Logistics: Analyze customer ordering patterns to identify inefficiencies. Act as an Architect to influence and advise clients on better planning, safety stocks, and consolidated ordering to improve operational flow for both the client and Roche. -Agile Collaboration: Work within cross-functional "Squads" to break down silos. Contribute to strategic projects that radically simplify current processes and shorten the "Order to Cash" cycle. -Ownership of Customer Experience: Manage and resolve customer claims and enquiries using CRM tools (Rexis), ensuring high-quality resolution and redirecting non-logistic issues to the appropriate experts. Who You Are : -A Proactive Mindset: You are energized by a fast-paced, demanding environment and possess the "courageous" spirit needed to navigate uncertainty. -Experienced Professional: You have a solid background in Customer Service,Supply Chain, Billing, Accounts Receivable or Pricing Administration (SAP experience is a must). jobs.description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is part of the Integrated Workforce Strategies Chapter within the People & Culture organization. Our purpose is to enable the business to achieve its ambitious goals while anticipating and adapting to a rapidly changing environment. We elevate the way leaders shape our future workforce by providing data-driven, skills-based workforce planning solutions to the business, such as Strategic Workforce Planning. We are also developing Roche-wide innovative frameworks to support closing our gaps (e.g. borrowing skills by leveraging external partners, bridging skill gaps by flowing skills to the most impactful work). Shaping new planning solutions, creating insights and automating processes as well as working with cross-functional partners offers you great learning opportunities.

The Opportunity

As an intern in the Workforce Optimization team for a 6-month period, your main focus will be learning about External Workforce Management at Roche globally and innovative concepts to manage the external workforce lifecycle process, while deploying solutions to support workforce strategies.

You will analyze data, generate reports and insights, prepare presentations and drive data-driven recommendations for decision making related to the External Workforce at Roche. You will also contribute to the automation of our analytics and implement innovative ideas to create efficiencies in our data & insights world.

Who you are

• You are in your Bachelor or Master studies at a Hungarian University in the field of economics, business administration, HR Management, STEM subjects or similar

• Ideally, you already have had (e.g. previous internship) experience in HR, Procurement and/or project management

• You have a passion for conceptual and data-driven working and are detail-oriented when conducting analysis

• You can address complex problems and develop effective solutions

• You think creatively and you enjoy supporting projects (e.g. workshop preparation, creation of effective presentations)

• You have expertise in Office or Google Suite, esp. Excel or GoogleSheets, Data analysis; experience with SQL is a plus

• You are motivated to work independently in a collaborative and dynamic environment and can adapt to different needs

• You have a can-do attitude and growth mindset

• You demonstrate a high level of social competence and are able to communicate efficiently in English

General information

Start date: July 2026
Possible work locations: Budapest (first location)
Workload: at least 30 hours/week
Duration: 6 months

Skills Needed

• Excel or Google Sheet (required)

• PowerPoint or Google Slide (required)

• Data Analysis &interpretation

• Agile

• Creating processes & frameworks

• Creative Thinking

• English language

titleByLocale.fr: Alternant /Stagiaire - Chargé(e) de la Transformation Numérique (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t' impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prend part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Présentation de la mission :
Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire / un(e) alternant dynamique pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Chargé de la transformation numérique via nos nouveaux outils IA.

Dans le cadre de l’accélération numérique de notre entreprise, tu seras chargé de définir et déployer une approche afin d’améliorer la maîtrise et l’efficience des équipes opérationnelles à l'utilisation de leurs outils et systèmes métier, mais aussi d’identifier comment ces équipes peuvent intégrer les outils d'intelligence artificielle à leur disposition dans leurs processus quotidiens.

L’objectif de ta mission : améliorer nos pratiques actuelles pour accompagner nos professionnels de santé partenaires. (Médecins, Pharmaciens, Centres Hospitaliers)

Quel sera ton impact ?
Dans le cadre de ce stage / alternance, nous te proposons de :

• Collaborer avec les équipes de management, et en collaborer avec nos équipes informatiques, conduire des projets visant à identifier comment optimiser et rendre plus efficaces les activités quotidiennes internes grâce aux outils (incluant IA).

• Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l’utilisation de nouvelles solutions numériques et outils métiers, en assurant une adoption fluide et efficace.

• Proposer et mettre en place des programmes de formation destinés aux collaborateurs pour les aider à maîtriser les outils numériques.

Ton ADN :

• Tu prépares une formation supérieure bac+4 ou bac+5 ; avec une spécialisation en informatique, systèmes d’information, intelligence artificielle, ou management des technologies.

• Tu as une forte appétence pour les systèmes de gestion de l’information et les outils d’IA (comme les plateformes de machine learning, les outils d’analyse de données, etc.).

• Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences analytiques, et une capacité à prendre du recul pour comprendre le fonctionnement d’un système

• Tu es rapide, structuré(e), curieux(se) et un bon relationnel,

• On te reconnait une aptitude certaine à vulgariser les outils.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)
Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires / les alternants comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu che

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Providing Medical Expertise

• Providing deep scientific expertise to form differentiation strategy for company’s pipeline and portfolio.

• Acting as a medical expert throughout all stages of the product lifecycle.

• Leadership in medical portion of the integrated strategy and shaping a scientifically sound value story for products.

Customer Engagement and Insight Collection

• Proactive scientific engagement with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and other stakeholders in full alignment with the integrated strategy.

• Establishing and maintaining effective professional peer-to-peer relationships.

• Conducting high-quality non-commercial events to disseminate relevant data and build trust among clinicians.

• Systematic collection and analysis of external scientific and clinical insights to translate them into strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams (Squad).

Evidence Generation

• Participating in development and implementation of the local data generation strategy.

• Supporting Non-Interventional Studies (NIS), Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), and projects using Real-World Evidence/Data (RWE/RWD).

• Collaboration with Clinical Operations (PDG) regarding strategic clinical trial site selection and engagement.

Health Technology Assessment (HTA) and Access

• Providing scientific expertise and active participation in preparation of HTA dossiers and interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Validation of scientific data integrity and ensuring clinical relevance of HTA submissions.

• Integrating medical perspectives into solutions that support patient journey and expand access to innovations.

Operational Excellence and Compliance

• Ensuring all medical activities are executed in accordance with corporate policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

• Management of Medical Information enquiries and ensuring correctness of any content generated using Artificial Intelligence.

Education/Qualification:

Education: Full higher education in the field of medicine, pharmacy, or natural sciences (MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).
Experience: Previous work experience in Medical Affairs departments, clinical research, or possession of deep clinical expertise in the relevant therapeutic area.
Languages: Fluent English (required for global cooperation).

Additional Requirements:
Strategic Thinking: Ability to act autonomously and work in complex cross-functional environments.
Digital Literacy: Skills in working with artificial intelligence tools and ability to oversee AI content.
Communication: Ability to articulate complex scientific data and maintain a direct, respectful, peer-to-peer dialogue.
Entrepreneurial Approach: Focus on creating value for patients and the healthcare system without compromising compliance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employe

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di consegna della campagna digitale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Expert in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful execution of digital campaign content projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. Supporting Global Campaign Coordinators, you manage the end-to-end coordination of campaigns across channels, ensuring standards are met. You guide Campaigns Delivery Specialists on complex projects, improve processes, and incorporate stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement. Additionally, you oversee team operations, monitor project statuses, forecast demand, identify risks, and support issue resolution. You also assist the global brand engagement manager with strategic planning to align digital campaign content delivery with future needs.

Who you are
You are an experienced digital marketing project manager, ideally in pharma or life sciences, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills to manage multiple projects, mitigate risks, and meet deadlines. Skilled at building stakeholder relationships and mentoring team members, you foster a collaborative, high-performing environment. With a strategic mindset, you support Global Campaign Coordinators in executing successful campaigns and ensuring operational excellence. In this position you will be focusing on

• Oversee Operational Activities: Coordinate content delivery operations to ensure smooth and efficient processes.

• Initiative Management: Pilot new initiatives and expand organizational services within your expertise.

• Project Monitoring: Lead calls to track project status, identify risks, and connect with global brand teams, engagement managers, and production teams.

• Mentorship: Guide Campaigns delivery specialists, resolve operational issues, mentor junior team members, and assist with onboarding.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead retrospective sessions to foster learning and improvement across therapeutic areas.

• Strategic Support: Assist global brand managers with content creation strategies aligned to organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback, adapt content requests, and facilitate alignment while supporting brand engagement managers in client relations.

​For this position, you bring the following qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• 5+ years of project management experience, ideally in digital marketing or content creation.

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing, campaign management, problem-solving, multitasking, and proficiency in project management tools and content management systems.

• Exceptional interpersonal skills with experience collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders and mentoring team members.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical industry standards, including global and local compliance and regulatory concepts (preferred).

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty

titleByLocale.it: Direttore del gruppo senior, sviluppo e processi di sicurezza
titleByLocale.en: Senior Group Director, Safety Development & Processes
titleByLocale.de: Senior Group Direktor, Safety Development & Processes
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur du groupe principal, Développement de la sécurité et processus

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, our Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) department aims to enhance healthcare for patients by elucidating and communicating the safety profile of Roche medicines to optimise their benefit-risk profile.

The Opportunity

The Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) provides strategic leadership, expertise and oversight for a global team in the design, development, implementation and coordination of activities relating to safety development, innovation, process design and continuous improvement, on behalf of PDS.

As a member of the PVSD Leadership Team, the Senior Group Director leads the global SDP function across 4 global product development sites (Basel in Switzerland, South San Francisco in the USA, Welwyn in the UK, and Mississauga in Canada). The role ensures that safety-critical processes are designed, developed, ‘owned’ and supported in line with business requirements and continuous improvement goals. They ensure that pilots, projects and major programs, intended to improve scientific safety approaches, are delivered or coordinated in line with agreed plans. They are also responsible for ensuring that PDS ‘ways of working’ adapt to changing customer requirements, and that the wider PDS community have access to expert advice in support of their efforts to deliver value to drug development and patient risk management.

The Senior Group Director is responsible for ensuring the SDP team fosters innovation, anticipates and acts on significant new developments or improvements required to PDS ways of working, and provides effective input to future enablement strategies in PDS.

The Senior Group Director leverages the strengths of a diverse global team and creates an inspiring environment where the SDP team members feel empowered to take ownership of deliverables, build knowledge and deploy resources effectively, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, il nostro dipartimento Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) ha lo scopo di migliorare la salute per i pazienti, valutando e comunicando il profilo di sicurezza dei medicinali Roche per ottimizzare il loro profilo di rischio. L'opportunità Il Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) fornisce leadership strategica, competenza e supervisione per un team globale nella progettazione, sviluppo, implementazione e coordinamento delle attività relative allo sviluppo della sicurezza, innovazione, progettazione dei processi e miglioramento continuo, a nome del PDS. Come membro del PVSD Leadership Team, il Senior Group Director guida la funzione SDP globale in 4 siti di sviluppo di prodotti globali (Basel in Svizzera, South San Francisco negli Stati Uniti, Welwyn nel Regno Unito, e Mississauga in Canada). Il ruolo assicura che i processi critici per la sicurezza siano progettati, sviluppati, “di proprietà” e supportati in linea con i requisiti aziendali e con i continui obiettivi di miglioramento. Essi assicurano che i piloti, i progetti e i programmi principali, destinati a migliorare gli approcci di sicurezza scientifica, siano consegnati o coordinati in linea con i piani concordati. Essi sono anche responsabili di garantire che PDS “sempre di lavoro” adattarsi alle mutevoli esigenze del cliente, e che la più ampia comunità PDS ha accesso a consigli esperti a sostegno dei loro sforzi per fornire valore allo sviluppo della droga e alla gestione del rischio paziente. Il Direttore del Gruppo Senior è responsabile di garantire che il team SDP adotti l'innovazione, anticipa e agisce su nuovi sviluppi significativi o miglioramenti necessari ai modi di lavoro PDS e fornisce un contributo efficace alle future strategie di abilitazione in PDS. Il Senior Group Director sfrutta i punti di forza di una squadra globale diversificata e crea un ambiente stimolante in cui i membri del team SDP si sentono in grado di prendere la proprietà dei responsabili, costruire conoscenze e distribuire le risorse in modo efficace, sempre sforzandosi per il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione. Essi sono responsabili per l'implementazione e il funzionamento di processi globali e/o funzionali definiti, compresi i collegamenti con sistemi/strumenti associati di progettazione/sviluppo, attraverso le vaste aree di sicurezza legate all'impegno del team. • Progettazione, sviluppo, manutenzione, supervisione e miglioramento continuo dei processi di sicurezza in conformità ai domini GVP, GCP e Medical Device.
• Sostenere la capacità dell’organizzazione di eseguire i processi di sicurezza attraverso la fornitura di competenze tecniche e scientifiche.
• La progettazione, lo sviluppo, l’implementazione e il coordinamento delle attività di miglioramento strategico e continuo che progrediscono gli obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine del PDS.
• Facilitazione e coordinamento dell'innovazione di sicurezza nella coesione con le esigenze dei processi di sicurezza.
• Fornitura di competenze scientifiche di nicchia che beneficiano potenzialmente delle esigenze del portafoglio. Responsabilità e responsabilità primarie:
• Leadership: Fornisce la linea-leadership per la sotto-funzione SDP globale; i membri degli allenatori per massimizzare il potenziale e il benessere mentre sostengono un clima di scopo e urgenza
• Direzione Strategica: Responsabile per la definizione e l'articolazione della visione e della strategia per SDP, in allineamento con PVSD, PDS e strategie aziendali overarching
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con varie funzioni di Pharma in base alla necessità business-critical emergente.

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche zielt unser Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) darauf ab, die Gesundheitsversorgung für Patienten zu verbessern, indem es das Sicherheitsprofil von Roche-Medikamenten zur Optimierung ihres Nutzen-Risikoprofils erläutert und kommuniziert. Die Chance Der Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) bietet strategische Führung, Kompetenz und Aufsicht für ein globales Team in der Gestaltung, Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Koordination von Aktivitäten in Bezug auf Sicherheitsentwicklung, Innovation, Prozessgestaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung im Auftrag von PDS. Als Mitglied des PVSD Leadership Teams leitet der Senior Group Director die globale SDP-Funktion über 4 globale Produktentwicklungsstandorte (Basel in Switzerland, South San Francisco in den USA, Welwyn in Großbritannien und Mississauga in Kanada). Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass sicherheitskritische Prozesse im Einklang mit den Geschäftsanforderungen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungszielen entwickelt, entwickelt, „besitzen“ und unterstützt werden. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Piloten, Projekte und wichtige Programme, die wissenschaftliche Sicherheitsansätze verbessern sollen, im Einklang mit vereinbarten Plänen geliefert oder koordiniert werden. Sie sind auch dafür verantwortlich, dass sich PDS „Arbeitswege“ an sich ändernde Kundenanforderungen anpassen und dass die breitere PDS-Gemeinschaft Zugang zu Expertenberatungen zur Unterstützung ihrer Bemühungen zur Bereitstellung von Werten für die Drogenentwicklung und das Patientenrisikomanagement hat. Der Senior Group Director ist dafür verantwortlich, dass das SDP-Team Innovationen fördert, Innovationen erwartet und auf bedeutende neue Entwicklungen oder Verbesserungen reagiert, die für PDS-Arbeitsmethoden erforderlich sind, und einen effektiven Beitrag zu zukünftigen Aktivierungsstrategien in PDS bietet. Der Senior Group Director nutzt die Stärken eines vielfältigen globalen Teams und schafft ein inspirierendes Umfeld, in dem sich die SDP-Teammitglieder als befähigt fühlen, sich an Auslieferungen zu beteiligen, Wissen aufzubauen und Ressourcen effektiv einzusetzen, immer bemüht sich um kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Innovation. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Umsetzung und Funktionsweise definierter globaler und/oder funktionaler Prozesse, einschließlich der Verbindungen mit zugehörigen Systemen/Werkzeugen-Design/Entwicklung, über die breiten sicherheitsrelevanten Bereiche des Teams. Die Aufgaben des SDP-Teams umfassen folgende Hauptbereiche:
• Design, Entwicklung, Wartung, Aufsicht und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Sicherheitsprozesse in Übereinstimmung mit GVP-, GCP- und Medical Device-Domains.
• Die Fähigkeit der Organisation, Sicherheitsprozesse durch technische und wissenschaftliche Expertise durchzuführen.
• Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Koordinierung der strategischen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten, die die kurz- und langfristigen Ziele der PDS vorantreiben.
• Erleichterung und Koordinierung der Sicherheitsinnovation im Zusammenhalt mit den Erfordernissen der Sicherheitsprozesse.
• Bereitstellung von Nischen wissenschaftlichen Know-how, die potenziell den Bedürfnissen des Portfolios zugute kommen. Primäre Verantwortung und Rechenschaftspflichten:
• Leadership: Bietet Linienführung für die globale SDP-Unterfunktion; Coaches-Mitglieder, um Potenzial und Wohlbefinden zu maximieren und gleichzeitig ein Klima von Zweck und Dringlichkeit zu erhalten
• Strategische Richtung: Verantwortlich für die Definition und Artikulation von Vision und Strategie für SDP, in Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten PVSD, PDS und breiteren Unternehmensstrategien
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Funktionen in Pharma auf der Grundlage des aufstrebenden geschäftskritischen Bedarfs.
• Rechenschaftspflicht für die SDP kann verbesserte/konsistente wissenschaftliche „Arbeitswege“ erwarten, entwickeln und unterstützen,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, notre département Développement de produits mondiaux Sécurité et gestion des risques (PDS) vise à améliorer les soins de santé pour les patients en déterminant et en communiquant le profil de sécurité des médicaments Roche afin d'optimiser leur profil bénéfice-risque. L'opportunité Le Directeur principal du développement et des processus de sécurité (SDP) assure le leadership stratégique, l'expertise et la supervision d'une équipe mondiale dans la conception, l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et la coordination des activités liées au développement, à l'innovation, à la conception des processus et à l'amélioration continue, au nom de PDS. En tant que membre de l'équipe de direction du PVSD, le directeur principal du groupe dirige la fonction de SDP mondial sur quatre sites mondiaux de développement de produits (Base en Suisse, South San Francisco aux États-Unis, Welwyn au Royaume-Uni et Mississauga au Canada). Ce rôle garantit que les processus critiques en matière de sécurité sont conçus, développés, « possédés » et soutenus conformément aux exigences opérationnelles et aux objectifs d'amélioration continue. Ils veillent à ce que les projets pilotes, les projets et les grands programmes, destinés à améliorer les approches scientifiques en matière de sécurité, soient exécutés ou coordonnés conformément aux plans convenus. Ils sont également chargés de veiller à ce que les PDS s'adaptent aux besoins changeants des clients et à ce que la communauté des PDS ait accès à des conseils d'experts à l'appui de leurs efforts visant à valoriser le développement des médicaments et la gestion des risques pour les patients. Le directeur du groupe principal est chargé de s'assurer que l'équipe du PDD favorise l'innovation, anticipe et agit sur les nouveaux développements importants ou les améliorations nécessaires aux méthodes de travail du PDS et apporte une contribution efficace aux stratégies de facilitation futures du PDS. Le directeur principal du groupe tire parti des forces d'une équipe mondiale diversifiée et crée un environnement inspirant où les membres de l'équipe du SDP se sentent habilités à prendre en charge les produits livrables, à acquérir des connaissances et à déployer des ressources efficacement, en s'efforçant toujours d'améliorer et d'innover continuellement. Ils sont responsables de la mise en œuvre et du fonctionnement de processus mondiaux et/ou fonctionnels définis, y compris les liens avec les systèmes/conception/développement d'outils connexes, dans les grands domaines de compétence liés à la sécurité de l'équipe. Le mandat de l'équipe SDP couvre les domaines principaux suivants :
• La conception, le développement, la maintenance, la surveillance et l'amélioration continue des processus de sécurité conformément aux domaines GVP, GCP et Medical Device.
• Maintenir la capacité de l'organisation à exécuter les processus de sécurité en fournissant une expertise technique et scientifique.
• La conception, l'élaboration, la mise en œuvre et la coordination d'activités d'amélioration à la fois stratégiques et continues qui favorisent la réalisation des objectifs à court et à long terme du PDS.
• Facilitation et coordination de l'innovation en matière de sécurité, en cohérence avec les besoins des processus de sécurité.
• Fourniture d'une expertise scientifique de niche susceptible de profiter aux besoins du portefeuille. Responsabilités principales et responsabilités :
• Leadership: assure la direction de la sous-fonction SDP mondiale; entraîne les membres pour maximiser le potentiel et le bien-être tout en maintenant un climat d'urgence et d'objectif
• Orientation stratégique: Responsable de la définition et de l'articulation de la vision et de la stratégie en matière de PDD, conformément à la stratégie globale de PVSD, de PDS et de stratégies d'entreprise plus larges
• S'associer étroitement à diverses fonctions en Pharma en fonction de nouveaux besoins critiques pour les entreprises.
• Responsable de veiller à ce que le PDD puisse anticiper, développer et soutenir des « voies de travail scientifiques améliorées/consistantes » ,

jobs.title: Estagiário de engenharia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário de Engenharia na área de Customer Experience, você terá a oportunidade única de aplicar seus conhecimentos acadêmicos e técnicos na prática, desenvolvendo-se profissionalmente ao lado de uma equipe de especialistas de campo.

A Oportunidade

• Você realiza o cadastro de peças e consolida informações essenciais em planilhas de Excel.

• Você controla e afere instrumentos e ferramentas, gerenciando também modificações e ações preventivas.

• Você presta suporte diário ao time de especialistas e interage ativamente com a equipe de campo.

• Você monitora casos de preparação de local (site preparation), instalação e desinstalação de equipamentos.

• Você fornece suporte on-site aos clientes de sua base, bem como assistência às ferramentas ASA, Online Support e Cobas Link.

Quem é você

• Você possui uma base de conhecimento técnico/científico na área de engenharia e domina, no mínimo, o nível intermediário do Pacote Office.

• Você se destaca pelo raciocínio analítico, lógico e focado, e não se importa em lidar com rotinas operacionais de forma atenta e cuidadosa.

• Você é proativo, tem grande interesse em aprender e busca sempre seu desenvolvimento contínuo.

• Você cultiva um bom relacionamento interpessoal com todas as áreas e valoriza o trabalho em equipe.

Desejável

• Você possui conhecimentos de inglês em nível intermediário.

*Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Objective
As a Product Environmental Lead, you will be a key member of our team in China, responsible for ensuring compliance with product environmental regulations to support successful market launch of Roche Diagnostics products. This role requires a blend of product stewardship, an understanding of regulatory affairs, solid experience in EH&S Data Management and strong project management skills. You will navigate the complexities of product localization, new product development, and importation for the Chinese market. This position is a unique opportunity for a professional who is fluent in Chinese and English and has a deep understanding of the local culture and business landscape to make a significant impact on our operations in China.
Key Responsibilities

• Product Stewardship:

•
• Independently manage product stewardship activities within existing guidelines.

• Contribute to project teams, taking ownership of ongoing activities and goals.

• Conduct comprehensive product stewardship assessments and support data collection efforts in collaboration with other functions.

• Support local sourcing inquiries

• Support R&D with setting of environmental product requirements

• Environmental Regulatory Compliance/ Implementation:

•
• Apply your in-depth knowledge of environmental regulations affecting Roche Diagnostics products to ensure the compliance of all assigned products in the Chinese market.

• Stay informed about changes and updates to local regulations.

• Process Application and Development & mQMS:

•
• Work with and improve upon existing processes tied to the mQMS and the direct organization.

• Lead process improvements for product stewardship by applying your experience and innovative ideas.

• EH&S Data and Insights Management

•
• Validate EH&S and product-related data in alignment with global data standards and local regulatory requirements (e.g. China REACH, GHS, chemical inventory management) to support operations compliance and trade compliance

• Support execution of EH&S data management processes according to global governance and procedures.

• Generate and analyze data reports to support compliance monitoring, performance tracking, and management decisions.

• Support internal and external communication on product compliance and sustainability data.

• General Duties:

•
• Develop and conduct training sessions for internal stakeholders.

• Contribute to team meetings and participate in relevant discussions.

• Act as a key member of the business team, providing insights and support for our operations in China.

Scenario-Specific Responsibilities

• For Already Launched & Localized Products:

•
• Oversee the re-assembly process in Suzhou, ensuring compliance for products made in China.

• Manage labeling requirements, including China-specific information, and coordinate with the responsible department.

• Explore and manage local component sourcing options.

• Support the transfer of reagents and assays

• For Product Updates:

•
• Lead change management processes for product environmental regulations..

• Coordinate with established PCQTs in Europe/US, ensuring they also cover localized products.

• Handle notifications and support all re-labeling activities.

• For New Product Developments:

•
• Support the transfer of new products to China during the D&D process.

• Contribute to sourcing plans for components, including local sourcing options.

• Provide support as needed for necessary notifications, registrations, and imp

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the PDG Country Study Start-Up Team, your primary focus is to drive and facilitate efficient study start-up processes to contribute to the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will enable innovative clinical trial delivery, address study start up needs across various therapeutic areas, and ensure seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff. Collaboration with local internal and external country teams, global study teams, and CROs is essential to this role.

Key
• Responsibilities
This role focuses on the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials by developing and implementing effective start-up strategies, overseeing start-up operations, and driving process improvements at the country and site level while maintaining regulatory compliance.
Key responsibilities include:
● Leading the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.
● Overseeing start-up operations and ensuring timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.
● Ensuring alignment with global strategies and timelines.
● Managing amendments throughout the study lifecycle.
● Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardization, and innovation.
● Collaborating with regional and global counterparts to harmonize systems and improve
timelines.
● Participating in external industry collaborations to influence country start-up
environments.
● Engaging with government and institutional bodies to align on clinical trial policies and
practices (e.g., with Ethics Boards, Health Authorities).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
