• Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the full portfolio of products offered by Roche Diagnostics, Tissue Division.

• Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail

• Meet with customers to discuss their evolving needs and to assess the quality of our company’s relationship with them

• Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources (specialists), in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.

• Proactively leads a joint company-strategic account planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.

• Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.

• Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.

• Closely coordinates company executive involvement and Customer Service Representatives to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution.

• Customer focused selling skills is a must to drive consistent results & partnerships.

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Capital sales experience

• Pathology/Digital Pathology sales experience

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

• Proven leadership abilities

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Hands on experience with CRM software and MS Office (particularly MS Excel)

• Strong negotiation skills with a problem-solving attitude

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esecutivo del Conto Strategico - Laboratorio di Patologia L'opportunità: Questo ruolo supporta il franchising Tissue Diagnostics e sarà responsabile per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati in territori specificati. Responsabile dell'incontro e del superamento degli obiettivi di vendita (strumenti di capitale e reagenti) in laboratori di patologia anatomica mirati all'interno della Regione Mid Atlantic. La geografia si concentra sui clienti più grandi della regione, grandi scenari strategici, massicci consolidamenti e/o maggiori opportunità competitive. Deve mantenere e crescere i conti esistenti & sviluppare nuovi conti nella geografia assegnata. Sviluppare partenariati con tutti i livelli di Influenza di acquisto per includere: C-Suite, Direttori di laboratorio, Direttori di laboratorio, Histotechnologist, Agenti di sicurezza, Gestione dei materiali, ecc. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo. Il territorio comprende: zona di Boston e parti di CT. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono previste per questo ruolo. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia di confine del territorio. Fatti di lavoro:
• Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita del portafoglio completo di prodotti offerti da Roche Diagnostics, divisione Tissue.
• Prova capacità di affrontare più progetti di gestione account alla volta, mantenendo la massima attenzione ai dettagli
• Incontro con i clienti per discutere le loro esigenze in evoluzione e per valutare la qualità del rapporto della nostra azienda con loro
• Coordina il coinvolgimento del personale aziendale, compreso il supporto, il servizio e le risorse di gestione (specialisti), al fine di soddisfare gli obiettivi di performance del cliente e le aspettative dei clienti.
• Proattivamente conduce un processo di pianificazione del conto aziendale-strategico congiunto che sviluppa obiettivi di performance reciproche, obiettivi finanziari e pietre miliari critici per un periodo di uno e tre anni.
• Comunicare chiaramente il progresso delle iniziative mensili / trimestrali a stakeholder interni ed esterni
• Proattivamente valuta, chiarisce e convalida le esigenze del cliente su base continuativa.
• Ottieni quota di vendita assegnata in conti strategici designati.
• Coordina strettamente il coinvolgimento esecutivo dell'azienda e i rappresentanti del Servizio Clienti per garantire la soddisfazione del cliente e la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Le competenze di vendita focalizzate sul cliente sono un must per guidare risultati e partnership coerenti. Chi sei (titoli minimi):
• Hai una laurea o un'esperienza equivalente
• Ha 5 anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente Preferiti:
• Esperienza di vendita di capitale
• Esperienza di patologia / patologia digitale
• Pianificazione strategica e competenze organizzative

jobs.title: Head of MSAT Technology Transfer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is seeking a highly skilled and top-tier talent—a leader who demands excellence and possesses the competency and experience in both greenfield engineering projects and routine operations. This position will spearhead end-to-end technology transfer and operational readiness efforts at our state-of-the-art greenfield biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Shanghai. This strategic role entails driving complex technical transfers, developing advanced processes, and ensuring the successful design, qualification, and start-up of the site, culminating in ramp-up and sustained operational excellence.

The MSAT Tech Transfer (TT) Manager is a pivotal technical and leadership role responsible for driving end-to-end technical transfer projects in a cGMP environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional leadership, capable of guiding a high-performing team to deliver critical projects in a tightly regulated and complex biopharmaceutical setting. This role emphasizes seamless collaboration across internal and external stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and Roche’s global network to ensure alignment, best practice implementation, and operational excellence. A strong focus on precious tech transfer, continuous technological innovation, robust process establishment, and strict compliance with GMP/SHE standards will be essential to achieving successful production, strategic project milestones, and long-term organizational success.
Technology Transfer & Operations:

• Lead Tech Transfer, PPM introduction, and compliance to ensure successful manufacturing readiness.

• The role plays a critical part in strategic project realization including qualification, manufacturing readiness and start up.

• Oversee all operations tied to technology transfer, including process design and troubleshooting, adherence to strict cGMP standards, and maintaining compliance with all Roche quality policies and international regulatory requirements.

• Drive technical innovation by identifying, evaluating, and implementing advanced technologies and methodologies to enhance process control, automation capabilities, and product quality consistency.
Strategic Leadership & Global Interaction:

• Enable and empower your team to deliver our vision through demonstrating VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) leadership behaviors and focusing on strategic project development in China.

• The role is key interface with the MFG, QA, ENG to ensure successful process alignment, production readiness, and drive collaboration across cross-functional teams.
Facilitate robust interaction and collaboration with global team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring seamless execution of internal and external technology transfers. Provide timely updates, promote effective knowledge sharing, and establish efficient coordination mechanisms to drive alignment on key initiatives and project milestones.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Leadership & People Management

• Exhibit exceptional leadership aligned with the VACC model, demonstrating a capacity to craft and execute forward-thinking strategies. Cultivate a high-impact environment by systematically eliminating barriers, advancing both people and technical capabilities, and enabling individuals to perform at their peak potential.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, with a strong emphasis on people development, fostering individual growth, and enhancing collective skillsets to meet evolvin

jobs.title: Associate Manager - MSAT Process Engineering
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The MSAT PE Lead/Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a pivotal technical role, designed for talented individuals who bring unparalleled expertise in developing and integrating advanced biomanufacturing processes. The ideal candidate will be an influential collaborator within the team, demonstrating significant technical depth capable of addressing complex challenges and advancing Roche’s process engineering strategy. By contributing at a strategic level, the PE SME
will drive end-to-end process engineering projects across greenfield projects and routine operations, reducing time-to-market, improving efficiency, and ensuring excellence throughout the product lifecycle. Additionally, this role also encompasses responsibilities in single-use technology (SUT) implementation, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, and ensuring that all technical documentation and knowledge transfer activities meet the highest
standards. With strong collaboration across cross-functional teams and internal and external stakeholders, this role will keep providing comprehensive operational support, driving technical innovation, and optimizing manufacturing efficiency across the board.

Engineering Project Support & Operations:
● Serve as a technical authority and strategic advisor for process engineering within the MSAT organization, driving excellence in manufacturing processes, validation, and key performance monitoring to ensure compliance with cGMP/SHE standards and Roche’s quality policies.
• ● Lead strategic project realization including facility design, qualification and operational efficiency improvements.
• ● Provide deep technical expertise in end-to-end process monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization to maintain consistent product quality, enhance efficiency, and mitigate operational risks.
• ● Champion process innovation and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize critical parameters, enhance automation capabilities, and improve product yield and reliability.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Performance of microbiological testing including Microbial limit test, Endotoxin and sterility test of product stream samples (excipients, bulk, packaging materials and finished products) to meet product release timelines.

• 执行产品流样品（辅料、半成品、包材和成品）的微生物测试包括微生物限度、细菌内毒素以及无菌检查以满足产品放行计划。

• Performance of environmental and critical utility testing in accordance with Chinese GMP, EU GMP and cGMP regulations and Roche/Genentech standards.

• 根据中国GMP，欧盟GMP，美国cGMP法规和罗氏/基因泰克的标准进行环境监控和关键设施的测试。

• Performance of microbiological testing of stability samples to meet stability program requirements.

• 执行稳定性样品的微生物测试以满足稳定性研究计划的要求。

• Supporting manufacturing operations by timely completion of direct material sampling and ID testing.

• 及时完成直接物料的取样及鉴别测试以支持生产运营。

• Qualification and validation of microbiological test methods.

• 微生物测试方法的确认与验证。

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• 完成指定仪器的校准与维护，确保其处于良好状态，以随时满足分析需求。

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies

• 保持实验室清洁并维护微生物耗材库存

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

• 支持实验室运营、测试方法执行、文件更新和设备验证等方面的精益项目

• Supporting investigations of microbial contamination in production processes, classified environments, and critical utility systems.
支持在生产工艺、洁净环境和关键设施系统中发生的微生物污染的调查。

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• Bachelor’s Degree((biology, microbiology, biochemistry, chemistry or other relevant discipline is preferred)

• 学士学位 ( 生物，微生物，生物化学，化学及相关学科优先)

• Graduate or higher-level Degree is preferred

• 更高学历优先

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需能力

• 6 or more years of QC experience, with a focus on microbiology

• 拥有6年或以上的质量控制（QC）经验，侧重于微生物领域。

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in microbiological testing.

• 熟悉质量控制程序和法规标准，并具备微生物检测的经验。

• Expert knowledge of cGMP relevant to the pharmaceutical industry

• 制药行业相关的cGMP知识

• Expert Knowledge in Pharmaceutical Microbiology

• 优异的制药微生物知识

• Fluent communications skills in English

• 流利的英语沟通能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Associate Manager - Scheduler
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Support manager to design and implement planning workflows, including MRP, production scheduling, and capacity planning, aligned with SAP, MPS systems

• Collaborate with IT and project teams to ensure seamless integration and alignment of SAP, and MPS systems with production and supply chain workflows

• Perform the creation, validation, and maintenance of master data to enable efficient planning in SAP and MPS systems.

• Work closely with key stakeholders, including production, quality, and engineering, to establish robust planning practices that support qualification and start-up milestones.

• Assist manager to set up a team and people hiring schedule to build a competitive team that meets the project and operation ramp up plan.

Routine Operation:

• Optimize site capacity and resource planning during budget cycles based on various factors including sales demand, working days impacted by projects, period costs, inventory strategy, etc.

• Settle down the Master Production Schedule (MPS) on a monthly basis, influence key local/global stakeholders to maintain production constancy and stability in terms of site benefits, period costs, capacity utilization, etc.

• Single point of contact with global PTS teams for DS/DP/SEMP supply of local products and related LCC initiation, implementation, follow up and coordination.

• Work out Material Requirement Plan (MRP) based on master production plan. Communicate changes of MRP with production planner and other impacted cross functional teams.

• Trace the whole process of material purchasing, delivering, testing and releasing. Ensure the inventory of packaging materials and excipients can fully support site production requirements with safety stock prepared per agreement.

• Responsible for Safety Stock strategy per business requirement and agreement with procurement to mitigate supply shortage risk.

• Host weekly Production Planning meeting, lead cross functional teams to integrate all necessary site activities and projects.

• Draft out Weekly/Daily Production Schedule based on Master Production Schedule and revise according to realistic production circumstances, make sure FG supplies are consistently produced and released timely to meet business requirements.

• Run shift model simulations for production team analysis and decision making as a reliable consultant. Consolidate data & info to re-assess site capacity planning and propose shift model adjustments whenever necessary based on business needs.

Qualification and Experience
E ducation/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Biotechnology, Manufacturing field and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 10 or more years of experience in operation experience in the GMP production environments, with proven expertise in production planning, supply chain planning, MNC preferred.

• Experienced in new planning system startup readiness and ramp up.

• Strong knowledge of MRP concepts, production scheduling methodologies, and capacity planning strategies.

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and execution skills, with the ability to effectively drive project progress and solve complex issues.

• Able to think strategically and translate strategies into actionable plans

• Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members and stakeholders

jobs.title: (Senior) Specialist - Warehouse
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse.
Routine Operation:
Technical & Operational
● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify
quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping
documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods
● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy.
● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible.
● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation.
● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions.
● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues.
● Other tasks assigned by AM.
Compliance & Safety
● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products.
● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area.
● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager.
● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications
● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred)
● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment.
● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment.
● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports)
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry
● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is seeking a highly skilled and top-tier talent—a professional who demands excellence and possesses the competency and experience in both greenfield engineering projects and routine operations. This position will spearhead visual inspection (VI) and local packaging development (LPD) at our state-of-the-art greenfield biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Shanghai. This role focuses on driving excellence in visual inspection systems and local packaging operations, ensuring cutting-edge technologies and processes are seamlessly integrated into Roche’s manufacturing model,while maintaining compliance with cGMP/SHE and Roche’s quality standards. In addition, the critical position emphasizes the successful execution of technical transfers and the operational readiness of VI and LPD workflows, ultimately achieving ramp-up and sustained operational excellence.

The MSAT VI&LPD Lead/Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a pivotal technical role, designed for exceptional professionals who bring unparalleled expertise and innovative solutions in visual inspection systems and local packaging development, both of which play a critical role in ensuring product quality and compliance in biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The ideal candidate will be a key technical contributor within the team, demonstrating profound knowledge and problem-solving capabilities to address complex challenges while advancing Roche’s global quality and operational standards. Furthermore, the VI&LPD SME will actively contribute to risk management, equipment qualification, and seamless technical transfers while fostering collaboration across cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment with strategic manufacturing goals. By contributing at a strategic and operational level, the VI&LPD SME will drive the successful implementation of advanced inspection technologies, optimized packaging solutions, and regulatory compliance practices. This role demands a strong focus on global and local regulatory alignment, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing to enhance the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Roche's visual inspection and packaging operations.

Visual inspection (VI) and local packaging development (LPD) Strategy & Execution:

• Serve as a technical authority and strategic advisor for visual inspection systems and local packaging development, ensuring the implementation of state-of-the-art processes that align with cGMP/SHE standards and Roche’s quality policies.

• Provide comprehensive technical oversight of visual inspection and packaging workflows, integrating innovative approaches for automated and manual inspection systems, defect detection accuracy, ensuring uncompromised product quality and compliance with global standards..

• Develop, validate, and standardize packaging processes, including container selection, sealing integrity, and compatibility testing, to deliver robust packaging performance across all product lifecycle stages.

• Serve as an expert in the validation and optimization of LPD and VI systems, enabling seamless production readiness and long-term operational excellence within Roche’s global biopharmaceutical manufacturing framework.

• Champion the introduction of advanced visual inspection technologies and innovative packaging methodologies, such as real-time quality monitoring systems, automated defect classification, and sustainable packaging materials, to enhance accuracy and operational flexibility.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai, and we are looking for a Packaging Engineer, with strong execution skills and hand-on experiences in packaging operation and techniques, who has mastery of core packaging processes and the capability to operate and maintain packaging equipment to ensure production continuity and reliability. Additionally, who will collaborate closely with the project team to execute this strategic initiative—including facility design, qualification, manufacturing readiness and start-up activities.

The Packaging Engineer is responsible for achieving manufacturing goals within the process step i.e. Needle cutting,labeling and Packaging. Ensuring products are executed safely and timely in full compliance and consistency with GMP/ SHE requirements and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

• Be responsible for the operation and cleaning of related process equipment on the packaging line including needle cutting, labeling, cartoning, T&T, shipping case machine and palletizing machine.

• Be responsible for packaging materials handling including the needles inspection on the packaging line.

• Support to perform equipment qualification and process validation on the packaging line.

• Support Associate Manager to complete equipment operation training and procedure training on the packaging line.

• Be responsible for documentation revision and deviation/CAPA/Planned Event writing.

2. Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• Support the initial development and optimization of packaging processes.

• Draft equipment operation procedures and logbook according to operation readiness plan.

• Train and qualify operators on equipment operation and packaging techniques and CCS implementation in packaging., e.g Needle Cutting and Visual Check, Labelling and Packaging.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.

• Performing the following tasks: Needle Cutting and Visual Check, labelling and packaging.

• Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.

• Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.

• Execute regular validation activities.

• Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.

3. Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.

• Experienced in strategic project of packaging facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in biological industry.

• Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Marketing Communication Expert - Molecular Lab

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en communication marketing - Molecular Lab

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Be responsible for organizing and implementing exhibition, event, congress, digital marketing campaigns or assisting marketing promotion activities in Molecular Lab, and executing and tracking promotional material and managing vendor.

The Opportunity:

• Plan, organize and implement events like seminar, exhibition and congress etc. Create and publish internal Newsletter & external Customer Newsletter.

• Build, Launch and report on all digital marketing campaigns (internal and external) aligned with local business strategy and tactics; Improve customer experience and brand awareness by optimizing multiple paid, owned and earned marketing channels management (e.g. WeChat, Webinar platform and other 3rd party media and etc..)

• Coordinate or design marketing promotion tools like gift, brochure or souvenir which should be ensured in accordance with Roche CI policy.

• Plan, monitor, and track budget estimation plan on a monthly basis. Plan yearly budget for exhibition, event or congress. Liaise with external vendors and agencies to ensure to meet the requirements and budget.

• Improve the efficiency of event management procedure by leveraging the knowledge and experience of process control, resources allocation, documentation, etc. Create SOP and templates to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of Event planning.

Who you are:

• At least Bachelor Degree in Marketing, Business Management or other Appropriate discipline

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Good command of MS office software application

• Product & marketing expertise

• 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la gestion des projets

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities :
China Strategy Formulation

• Strategic Framework Design: Formulate and continuously iterate a comprehensive, end-to-end strategic framework for Pharma China across the entire value chain, establishing the foundational roadmap for the organization's long-term vision.

• Data-Driven Narrative Architecture ("The China Story"): Architect and evolve a compelling, data-driven strategic narrative that clearly communicates local market realities, structural shifts, and future growth opportunities to global stakeholders.

• Connecting the Dots & Insight Generation: Effectively connect distinct business elements and generate high-value strategic insights.

• Executive Synthesis & Global Communication: Translate complex local market, clinical, and regulatory nuances into clear business contexts, gathering and preparing critical information to craft high-impact briefings, executive presentations, and strategic speeches/slides for the General Manager and global leadership.

Corporate Project Management

• Project Governance Framework: Design, standardize, and govern the PMO framework for various company projects, embedding a robust "closed-loop" management approach to monitor execution and maintain full visibility across the portfolio.

• Outcome-Driven Delivery: Maintain a strong focus on project outcomes, implementing tracking mechanisms that ensure high-quality, seamless coordination, and timely delivery across all value chains.

• Leadership Dialogue Facilitation: Organize and manage the operational structure for regular leadership review meetings, CNET activities, and strategic dialogues to facilitate quick, data-backed business decisions.

• Resource & Risk Management: Proactively identify project delivery risks, dependencies, and resource bottlenecks, optimizing resource mobilization across competing enterprise initiatives to keep core priorities on track.

Cross-Functional Project Leadership & Delivery

• Lead High-Complexity Initiatives: Manage cross-functional projects, organizing agile project squads to solve complex operational challenges.

• Process Optimization: Diagnose systemic operational friction points across the organization and establish optimized project management workflows to increase delivery speed and efficiency.

• Matrix Stakeholder Management: Master stakeholder management by influencing and aligning diverse, cross-functional teams toward shared corporate goals

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education & Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or above. An MBA or background in a top-tier strategy consulting firm is highly preferred.

• Professional Expertise: Recognized expert in corporate strategy, marketing, or access within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional verbal and written communication in Mandarin and English. Ability to craft compelling narratives and high-impact speeches for executive audiences.

• Strategic Agility: Proven track record of handling high levels of complexity and ambiguity. Ability to see the "big picture" while maintaining extreme sensitivity to critical tactical details.

• Leadership Track Record: Demonstrated ability to lead large, or cross-functional teams and influence senior management to adopt new perspectives or strategic shifts.

Leadership Mindset and Attributes

• VACC Leader: A role model for Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach leadership styles.

• Courageous Authenticity: Willin

jobs.title: International Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently.

In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Quality Strategies: Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP), using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.

• Lead Global Audits: Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.

• Partner with Stakeholders: Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.

• Support Inspections: Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.

• Advance PDQ Processes: Participate actively in assigned departmental goals and initiatives, contributing directly to the continuous improvement of PDQ processes.

• Maintain GxP Expertise: Maintain deep awareness and expertise in global regulations (such as FDA, EU, and ICH guidance) across GCP, GVP, or Medical Device frameworks.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.

• Industry Experience: Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.

• GxP Knowledge: Strong exposure to and understanding of global GxP regulations and quality roles, specifically within GCP, GVP, or IVD/MD frameworks.

• Data & Digital Literacy: Excellent digital capabilities, with a good understanding of audit management and analytical reporting tools to drive data-led solutions.

• Critical Thinking: Proven problem-so

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione a Roche, promuoviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), ci sforziamo di fiducia nell'integrità dei nostri dati e processi, agilità e trasparenza senza rivali con le autorità sanitarie, i pazienti e la società. L'opportunità Sei pronto a plasmare il futuro della gestione della qualità nel settore sanitario? Come leader di qualità all'interno della nostra divisione di qualità di sviluppo di Pharma, supporterai l'organizzazione Roche/Genentech sviluppando e fornendo robuste strategie di assicurazione della qualità, audit e conclusioni tra le molecole in sviluppo, prodotti post-approvazione e processi globali. Potrai agire come partner affidabile, assicurando che le nostre operazioni mantengano i più elevati standard di conformità, influenzando direttamente come portiamo terapie innovative ai pazienti in modo sicuro ed efficiente. In questo ruolo dinamico, si applicherà un approccio basato sul rischio alla Quality Assurance utilizzando il nostro framework Critical to Quality (CtQ). Generando dati e approfondimenti attuabili attraverso gli audit, collaborerai a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder internazionali e svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella preparazione e nel supporto delle ispezioni delle autorità di regolamentazione. Questa è un'opportunità eccezionale per utilizzare la vostra esperienza in un ambiente di matrice agile veramente globale in cui le vostre intuizioni guidano il miglioramento continuo. Responsabilità chiave:
• Strategie di qualità dell'azionamento: Supporta l'esecuzione delle strategie e delle conclusioni di assicurazione della qualità basate sul rischio in prevalenza buona prassi di farmacovigilanza (GVP) e buona pratica clinica (GCP), utilizzando il framework Critical to Quality (CtQ).
• Lead Global Audits: Pianificare, eseguire e condurre audit, raggruppare i singoli problemi in tendenze sistematiche per fornire preziosi dati di qualità che soddisfano i requisiti normativi.
• Partner con Stakeholders: Stabilire e mantenere forti partnership con gli stakeholder aziendali, presentare osservazioni di audit e rischi di conformità associati in modo chiaro.
• Ispezioni di supporto: svolgere un ruolo chiave nella preparazione e nella gestione dell'ispezione dell'autorità di regolamentazione.
• Processi PDQ avanzati: Partecipa attivamente a obiettivi e iniziative dipartimentali assegnati, contribuendo direttamente al continuo miglioramento dei processi PDQ.
• Mantenere GxP Expertise: Mantenere la consapevolezza profonda e la competenza nelle normative globali (come FDA, UE e ICH) attraverso GCP, GVP, o Medical Device framework. Chi sei tu sei un professionista di qualità proattivo e analitico che prospera nella trasformazione di dati complessi in soluzioni chiare e attuabili. Sei un eccellente comunicatore, altamente qualificato a collaborare tra culture e influenzare le parti interessate a vari livelli con o senza autorità formale. Cerchi opportunità per sviluppare le tue competenze all'interno di un team internazionale e sei appassionato di crescita continua. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Istruzione: laurea o equivalente in un campo scientifico o di qualità, o equivalente esperienza combinata.
• Esperienza nell'industria: esperienza provata nell'industria farmaceutica, biotecnologia o di dispositivi medici, con solida conoscenza dell'operatività end-to-end del prodotto.
• Conoscenza GxP: forte esposizione e comprensione delle normative globali GxP e dei ruoli di qualità, specificamente all'interno di framework GCP, GVP o IVD/MD.
• Data & Digital Literacy: eccellenti capacità digitali, con una buona comprensione della gestione dell'audit e strumenti di reporting analitico per guidare soluzioni guidate dai dati.
• Critical Thinking: Prove problem-so

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position bei Roche bringt die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Bei Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) streben wir nach Vertrauen in die Integrität unserer Daten und Prozesse, Agilität und konkurrenzlose Transparenz gegenüber Gesundheitsbehörden, Patienten und der Gesellschaft. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Zukunft des Qualitätsmanagements im Gesundheitswesen zu gestalten? Als Quality Lead in unserer Pharma Development Quality Division unterstützen Sie die Roche/Genentech Organisation durch die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung robuster Qualitätssicherungsstrategien, Audits und Schlussfolgerungen für Moleküle in der Entwicklung, bei Produkten nach der Zulassung und bei globalen Prozessen. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner agieren und sicherstellen, dass unsere Operationen die höchsten Compliance-Standards einhalten und direkt beeinflussen, wie wir innovative Therapien für Patienten sicher und effizient anbieten. In dieser dynamischen Rolle wenden Sie einen risikobasierten Ansatz für die Qualitätssicherung an, der unser Critical to Quality (CtQ) Framework verwendet. Durch die Generierung umsetzbarer Daten und Erkenntnisse durch Audits arbeiten Sie eng mit internationalen Interessengruppen zusammen und spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Vorbereitung und Unterstützung von Inspektionen der Regulierungsbehörden. Dies ist eine außergewöhnliche Gelegenheit, Ihr Fachwissen in einer wirklich globalen, agilen Matrixumgebung einzusetzen, in der Ihre Erkenntnisse zu kontinuierlicher Verbesserung führen. Wichtige Aufgaben: Qualitätsstrategien vorantreiben: Unterstützung der Umsetzung risikobasierter Qualitätssicherungsstrategien und Schlussfolgerungen in der überwiegend guten Pharmakovigilanzpraxis (GVP) sowie der guten klinischen Praxis (GCP) unter Verwendung des Critical to Quality (CtQ) -Rahmens. Lead Global Audits: Planen, führen und leiten Sie Audits, indem Sie einzelne Themen in systematische Trends gruppieren, um wertvolle Qualitätsdaten zu liefern, die die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.
• Partnerschaft mit Stakeholdern: Etablieren und pflegen Sie starke Partnerschaften mit geschäftlichen Stakeholdern, die Audit-Beobachtungen und die damit verbundenen Compliance-Risiken klar darstellen.
• Unterstützungsinspektionen: Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Vorbereitung und dem Management von Inspektionen durch die Regulierungsbehörden.
• PDQ-Prozesse voranbringen: Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an zugewiesenen Abteilungszielen und Initiativen und tragen Sie direkt zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der PDQ-Prozesse bei.
• Pflegen Sie GxP-Expertise: Behalten Sie ein tiefes Bewusstsein und Fachwissen in globalen Vorschriften (wie FDA, EU und ICH-Leitlinien) in GCP-, GVP- oder Medical Device-Frameworks bei. Wer Sie sind Sie sind ein proaktiver, analytischer Qualitätsprofi, der es schafft, komplexe Daten in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu verwandeln. Sie sind ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator, hochqualifiziert in der Zusammenarbeit über Kulturen hinweg und beeinflussen Stakeholder auf verschiedenen Ebenen mit oder ohne formale Autorität. Sie suchen nach Möglichkeiten, Ihre Fähigkeiten in einem internationalen Team zu entwickeln und sind leidenschaftlich für kontinuierliches Wachstum. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Ausbildung: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in einem wissenschaftlichen oder qualitätsbezogenen Bereich oder gleichwertige kombinierte Erfahrung.
• Branchenerfahrung: Bewährte Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Biotech- oder Medizintechnikindustrie mit fundierten Kenntnissen der End-to-End-Produktoperationalisierung.
• GxP-Wissen: Starkes Verständnis für globale GxP-Vorschriften und Qualitätsrollen, insbesondere innerhalb von GCP-, GVP- oder IVD / MD-Frameworks.
• Data & Digital Literacy: Hervorragende digitale Fähigkeiten mit einem guten Verständnis des Auditmanagements und analytischer Reporting-Tools, um datengesteuerte Lösungen voranzutreiben.
• Kritisches Denken: Nachgewiesenes Problem-so
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à la transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir de la gestion de la qualité dans les soins de santé? En tant que responsable de la qualité au sein de notre division Développement Pharma Qualité, vous soutiendrez l'organisation Roche/Genentech en élaborant et en fournissant des stratégies d'assurance qualité robustes, des audits et des conclusions entre molécules dans le développement, les produits post-approbation et les processus mondiaux. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance, vous assurant que nos opérations respectent les normes de conformité les plus élevées tout en influençant directement la façon dont nous apportons des thérapies innovantes aux patients en toute sécurité et efficacement. Dans ce rôle dynamique, vous appliquerez une approche fondée sur le risque à l'assurance de la qualité en utilisant notre cadre de référence Critical to Quality (CtQ). En générant des données et des renseignements exploitables au moyen d'audits, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les intervenants internationaux et jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la préparation et le soutien des inspections des autorités de réglementation. C'est une occasion exceptionnelle d'utiliser votre expertise dans un environnement matriciel vraiment global et agile où vos idées conduisent à une amélioration continue. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger les stratégies de qualité : Appuyer l'exécution de stratégies et de conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur le risque dans le cadre principalement de bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance (BVP) et de bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP), en utilisant le cadre de CtQ.
• Diriger les audits mondiaux : planifier, effectuer et diriger les audits, regrouper les questions individuelles en tendances systématiques afin de fournir des données de qualité précieuses qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires.
• Partenariat avec les parties prenantes: Établir et maintenir des partenariats solides avec les parties prenantes, en présentant clairement les observations d'audit et les risques de conformité associés.
• Soutien aux inspections : jouer un rôle clé dans la préparation et la gestion des inspections par les autorités de réglementation.
• Avancer les processus de PDQ : Participer activement aux objectifs et initiatives ministériels assignés, contribuant directement à l'amélioration continue des processus de PDQ.
• Tenir à jour l'expertise GxP : maintenir une connaissance et une expertise approfondies des réglementations mondiales (telles que la FDA, l'UE et les conseils de l'ICH) dans les cadres GCP, GVP ou de dispositifs médicaux. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et de qualité analytique qui prospère en transformant des données complexes en solutions claires et réalisables. Vous êtes un excellent communicateur, hautement qualifié pour collaborer à travers les cultures et influencer les intervenants à différents niveaux avec ou sans autorité formelle. Vous recherchez des occasions de développer vos compétences au sein d'une équipe internationale et êtes passionné par la croissance continue. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez:
• Éducation: Un baccalauréat ou équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité, ou équivalent expérience combinée.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are

• You hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• You bring hands-on experience applying data analytics to pharmaceutical development, CMC, formulation, stability or process development datasets, including scripting in Python, R or similar tools.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come scienziato nello sviluppo farmaceutico, fai parte del Dipartimento “Sviluppo farmaceutico” di Pharma Technical Development (PTD) di Basilea, Svizzera. Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il lancio del mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo ai siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto commerciale del prodotto e lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea. L'opportunità
• Sviluppo leader: sviluppo farmaceutico delle formulazioni parenterali per lo sviluppo e il mercato clinico (comprese le estensioni di linea). Comprendere il comportamento della stabilità (ad esempio biofisica, degradazione chimica)
• Gestione dei dati: garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutto il dipartimento.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilizzare tecniche di statistica e machine learning avanzate per eseguire l'estrazione di dati in profondità. Identificare le tendenze e le correlazioni associate ai dati scientifici.
• Competenze funzionali come project management: Rappresentanza dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico come responsabile del progetto farmaceutico nei team CMC globali, rappresentante funzionale in team interfunzionali e comitati globali all'interno di Roche.
• Inserimenti normativi: autorizzare sezioni di prodotti farmaceutici per IND/IMPDs clinici e MAAs. Chi sei Come candidato di successo si possiede un dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati O si possiede un master in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale (industria) in un'azienda farmaceutica.
• Provata esperienza di stabilire e gestire grandi set di dati, compresa l'esposizione a script associati all'analisi dei dati.
• Profonda comprensione della modellazione statistica, tra cui regressione lineare/logistica, analisi dei cluster, previsione delle serie temporali, analisi dei dati di studio longitudinale e test multivariato.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti associati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi per diverse fasi cliniche e commerciali di sviluppo.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comportamenti collaborativi, con il pensiero end-to-end e globale, nonché eccellenti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Führende Entwicklung: Pharmazeutische Entwicklung von parenteralen Formulierungen für die klinische Entwicklung und den Markt (einschließlich Linienerweiterungen). Verstehen von Stabilitätsverhalten (z.B. Biophysik, chemischer Abbau)

• Funktionskompetenz als Projektmanagement: Vertretung der Pharma-Entwicklung als Pharma-Projektleiter in globalen CMC-Teams, funktioneller Vertreter in funktionsübergreifenden Teams und globalen Gremien in Roche.

• Erprobte Erfahrungen bei der Erstellung und Verwaltung großer Datensätze, einschließlich der Exposition gegenüber Skripten, die mit der Datenanalyse verbunden sind.
• Vertieftes Verständnis der statistischen Modellierung einschließlich linearer/logistischer Regression, Clusteranalyse, Zeitreihenprognose, Longitudationsdatenanalyse und multivariate Tests.
• Kenntnis der pharmazeutischen Produktentwicklung und der damit verbundenen Anforderungen.
• Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen für verschiedene klinische und kommerzielle Entwicklungsstufen.

Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que Scientifique en Développement Pharmaceutique, vous faites partie du département Développement Pharmaceutique (PTD) à Bâle, Suisse. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. Qui vous êtes En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes. Ou vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans une entreprise pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une réflexion de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global MSAT DS Senior Process Steward

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Pharma Technical Technology (PTT) within Pharma Technical Operations (PT) enhances industrialization and product management by integrating SHE, maintenance, performance optimization, and scalable processes for improved robustness, efficiency, and reliability.

Roche’s global Manufacturing Science and Technology (gMSAT) manages commercial products, new technologies, standardization, and risk mitigation, organized into Large and Small Molecule (DS & DP) teams.

The Process Steward Large Molecule DS connects global MSAT with manufacturing sites, supporting process industrialization, driving improvements, managing second-source transfers, and providing second-level support for product issues. They represent network technological needs in governance forums and stakeholder interactions.

The Opportunity

• Support Product Technical Leads and Product Stewards in ensuring process industrialization, coordinate and execute process gap assessments, integrate identified risks into the risk log, and develop mitigation strategies.

• Drive systematic process and continuous technical product health and supply improvements based on insights, including second source and change strategies

• Execute validated state support activities and respond to evolving conditions to ensure compliance (e.g., VICs, RCAs)

• Provide technical expertise for technical and engineering runs and hands-on second-level support for investigations, CAPAs, and troubleshooting in partnership with the internal and external manufacturing network. Lead non-product specific RCAs and investigations

• Leverage the pilot plant team for real-life and scaled experimentation to support process-related projects, including validation studies and process transfer to manufacturing sites

• Ensure the implementation of network initiatives that are aligned and prioritized with manufacturing site plans, and incorporate portfolio-wide impacting aspects like direct material changes and Health Authority requirements

• Collaborate closely with global and site functions, leadership, and other gMSAT and PTT teams. Serve as a digital enabler, translating business needs to digital strategy and digital product development teams and driving technical sustainability improvements for product, process, and technology

Who you are

• B.S. or M.S. degree in Chemical, Biochemical Engineering, or related discipline with 7+ years of relevant industrial experience in process development, process engineering, or manufacturing operations. A PhD is advantageous

• Experience in collaborative, matrix team leadership and decision-making

• Demonstrated experience in process engineering, technical process development, process validation, or technology transfer (E. coli & CHO processes). Familiarity with pharmaceutical quality systems, industry guidelines, regulatory submission, health authority requirements, and platform-specific technology, processes, and equipment

• Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to define and articulate team deliverables effectively, including towards senior leadership

• Willingness to travel less than 10% as required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data Architect

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Data Architect, you will shape future-ready data architectures that directly impact our mission to improve global healthcare. Operating within a collaborative data ecosystem, you will translate complex product requirements into scalable, enterprise-standard solutions.

You will contribute to this vision by:

• Designing innovative solutions that meet business priorities, technical standards, and critical non-functional requirements across the data product life cycle.

• Maintaining the strategic architectural roadmap, vision, and current landscape for our data solutions to ensure scalability and long-term viability.

• Solving complex data challenges with a fresh perspective, evaluating multiple sources of information to drive sound architectural choices.

• Defining reference architectures and patterns, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are rigorously documented and maintained.

• Partnering with delivery teams to provide architectural oversight, consult on design patterns, proactively manage technical debt, and optimize existing data systems.

• Evaluating emerging data technologies and piloting cutting-edge solutions to continuously enhance data governance and business value.

• Fostering consensus across diverse stakeholder groups by communicating complex technical information with clarity, openness, and empathy.

Who You Are

You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning data complexity into clarity. You are passionate about data governance and eager to collaborate with cross-functional teams to build sustainable, high-impact systems.

To find success in this role, you bring:

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready data architectures across single or multiple data domains.

• Deep technical knowledge in core data technology areas, including a strong understanding of Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies.

• Proven capability in establishing reference architectures, defining fitness functions, tracking industry trends, and assessing vendor technology feasibility.

• Exceptional communication skills with a natural ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and build collaborative consensus.

• A proactive, growth-oriented mindset focused on minimizing technical debt, identifying value-add opportunities, and mentoring peers within the broader data community.

What you get

• Salary range 14.000 - 26.000 PLN gross based on the
