A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Architetto Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità In qualità di Data Architect, formerai architetture di dati pronte per il futuro che colpiranno direttamente la nostra missione per migliorare la salute globale. Operando all'interno di un ecosistema di dati collaborativo, tradurrai requisiti di prodotto complessi in soluzioni scalabili e standard aziendali. Contribuirai a questa visione da:
• Progettazione di soluzioni innovative che soddisfano le priorità aziendali, gli standard tecnici e i requisiti critici non funzionali nel ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Mantenere la roadmap architettonica strategica, la visione e il paesaggio attuale per le nostre soluzioni di dati per garantire scalabilità e affidabilità a lungo termine.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di dati con una prospettiva nuova, valutare più fonti di informazioni per guidare scelte architettoniche sonore.
• Definire architetture e modelli di riferimento, assicurando che i registri delle decisioni di architettura (ADR) siano rigorosamente documentati e mantenuti.
• Collaborare con i team di consegna per fornire supervisione architettonica, consultare i modelli di progettazione, gestire in modo proattivo il debito tecnico e ottimizzare i sistemi di dati esistenti.
• Valutare le tecnologie dei dati emergenti e pilotare soluzioni all'avanguardia per migliorare continuamente la governance dei dati e il valore aziendale.
• Promuovere il consenso tra diversi gruppi di stakeholder comunicando informazioni tecniche complesse con chiarezza, apertura ed empatia. Chi sei Sei un leader tecnico avanzato che prospera a trasformare la complessità dei dati in chiarezza. Siete appassionati di governance dei dati e desiderosi di collaborare con team interfunzionali per costruire sistemi sostenibili e ad alto impatto. Per trovare successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza dimostrata che progetta architetture di dati gestite da aziende, basate su standard e pronte per il futuro in domini di dati singoli o multipli.
• Una profonda conoscenza tecnica nelle aree principali della tecnologia dei dati, tra cui una forte comprensione dei modelli di dati concettuali e logici, delle tassonomie e delle Ontologie.
• Prova capacità di stabilire architetture di riferimento, definire le funzioni di fitness, monitorare le tendenze del settore e valutare la fattibilità della tecnologia dei fornitori.
• Capacità di comunicazione eccezionale con una capacità naturale di spiegare concetti tecnici complessi agli stakeholder non tecnici e creare un consenso collaborativo.
• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla crescita focalizzata sulla minimizzazione del debito tecnico, l'identificazione delle opportunità di valore aggiunto e la mentoring peers all'interno della più ampia comunità di dati. Che cosa si ottiene
• Intervallo salato 14.000 - 26.000 PLN lordo basato sul

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. Beim Position Data Architect Roche Digital Technology (RDT) trifft Innovation auf Zweck. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche vorantreibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Chance Als Data Architect gestalten Sie zukunftsfähige Datenarchitekturen, die sich direkt auf unsere Mission zur Verbesserung des globalen Gesundheitswesens auswirken. In einem kollaborativen Daten-Ökosystem werden komplexe Produktanforderungen in skalierbare, unternehmensspezifische Lösungen umgesetzt. Sie tragen zu dieser Vision bei, indem Sie innovative Lösungen entwickeln, die Geschäftsprioritäten, technische Standards und kritische nicht-funktionale Anforderungen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Datenprodukten erfüllen.
• Beibehaltung der strategischen architektonischen Roadmap, Vision und aktuellen Landschaft für unsere Datenlösungen, um Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Rentabilität zu gewährleisten.
• Lösung komplexer Datenherausforderungen mit einer neuen Perspektive, Bewertung mehrerer Informationsquellen, um fundierte architektonische Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Definieren von Referenzarchitekturen und Mustern, um sicherzustellen, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) streng dokumentiert und gepflegt werden.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferteams, um die Architekturaufsicht zu gewährleisten, Designmuster zu konsultieren, technische Schulden proaktiv zu verwalten und bestehende Datensysteme zu optimieren.
• Bewertung neuer Datentechnologien und Pilotierung innovativer Lösungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Data Governance und Business Value.
• Förderung des Konsenses zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen durch die Kommunikation komplexer technischer Informationen mit Klarheit, Offenheit und Empathie. Sie sind ein zukunftsorientierter technischer Führer, der es schafft, Datenkomplexität in Klarheit zu verwandeln. Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Data Governance und sind bestrebt, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um nachhaltige, wirkungsvolle Systeme aufzubauen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie folgendes mit:
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Entwerfen unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter, zukunftsfähiger Datenarchitekturen über einzelne oder mehrere Datendomänen hinweg.
• Tiefes technisches Wissen in Kerndatentechnologiebereichen, einschließlich eines fundierten Verständnisses von konzeptionellen und logischen Datenmodellen, Taxonomien und Ontologien.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen zu erstellen, Fitnessfunktionen zu definieren, Branchentrends zu verfolgen und die Machbarkeit der Anbietertechnologie zu bewerten.
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der natürlichen Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zu erklären und einen kollaborativen Konsens aufzubauen.
• Eine proaktive, wachstumsorientierte Denkweise, die sich auf die Minimierung technischer Schulden, die Identifizierung von Mehrwertmöglichkeiten und die Betreuung von Peers innerhalb der breiteren Datengemeinschaft konzentriert. Was Sie erhalten

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'opportunité En tant qu'architecte de données, vous façonnerez des architectures de données prêtes à l'avenir qui influent directement sur notre mission d'améliorer les soins de santé mondiaux. En travaillant au sein d'un écosystème collaboratif de données, vous transformerez les exigences complexes du produit en solutions évolutives et standard pour l'entreprise. Vous contribuerez à cette vision en :
• Concevoir des solutions innovantes qui répondent aux priorités des entreprises, aux normes techniques et aux exigences critiques non fonctionnelles tout au long du cycle de vie des produits de données.

• Favoriser le consensus entre les divers groupes d'intervenants en communiquant des informations techniques complexes avec clarté, ouverture et empathie. Vous êtes passionné par la gouvernance des données et désireux de collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour construire des systèmes durables et à impact élevé. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience démontrée en matière de conception d'architectures de données axées sur les entreprises, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans des domaines de données uniques ou multiples.
• Connaissances techniques approfondies dans les domaines fondamentaux de la technologie des données, y compris une bonne compréhension des modèles conceptuels et logiques de données, des taxonomies et des ontologies.
• Capacité éprouvée d'établir des architectures de référence, de définir les fonctions de conditionnement physique, de suivre les tendances de l'industrie et d'évaluer la faisabilité technologique des fournisseurs.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec une capacité naturelle d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes aux acteurs non techniques et d'établir un consensus collaboratif.
• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la croissance, axé sur la réduction de la dette technique, l'identification des possibilités d'ajout de valeur et le mentorat des pairs au sein de la communauté des données. Ce que vous obtenez

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Senior Production Technician you will be able to set up and operate equipment and processes in accordance with standard operating procedures and pilot

• Provide support to an area, person, or program. Interfaces with internal customers.

• Function as a subject matter expert in the area of knowledge.

• Participate in the development and/or delivery of training for other employees on equipment and/or procedures.

• You have specialized training or certification in particular area, system or equipment

• You have experience in team oriented work environment

• You have experience in regulated work environment

• You have thorough understanding of appropriate safety, health, and environmental procedures

• ERP and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) experience

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation. Manage and resolve internal queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process.

• Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch. Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely. Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement policies.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Key skills and Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English. Additional Chinese/Mandarin in speaking and writing is required.

• 3-5 years’ experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.en: Manager/Senior Manager - Channel Data 渠道数据团队负责人
titleByLocale.de: Manager/Senior Manager - Channel Data 渠道数据团队负责人
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire/Directeur principal - Données sur les canaux

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
全面统筹罗氏中国MCE渠道数据的治理与渠道折扣的体系化运作。在确保渠道数据（DDI）、与折扣管理的绝对准确、完整、及时与合规的基础上，以前瞻性的行业视野，引入自动化、智能化（AI）等先进的数据管理工具与系统，驱动业务流程的精益化重塑。引领渠道数据团队进行精益化、数智化的转型，实现团队效能的降本增效。同时通过精准的数据洞察赋能商业决策，打造行业领先的渠道数据管理生态标杆。

您将有机会：
1. 渠道数据治理

• 全面统筹渠道数据（包含但不限于 DDI 直连数据、流向数据、进销存数据、主数据等）的日常直连、收集、清洗、校验等工作。

• 建立并优化数据管理体系，确保数据的准确性、完整性与及时性，满足公司对业务决策与追踪、财务审计及合规风控的要求。

• 协同内外部资源，探索并建立药品追溯码数据管理机制等，作为 DDI 数据以外的前瞻性战略补充。
2. 渠道折扣管理

• 负责渠道折扣管理标准流程与运作机制的设计与维护，确保其严格符合内外部法律法规与合规审计要求。

• 主导折扣名单、协议、计算、核对、发放、对账等全链路流程管理，确保折扣执行结果的严谨准确以及公司资金安全。

• 联合策略、财务与业务部门，定期监控与分析折扣兑付情况，为商业政策与折扣政策的迭代提供数据支撑。
3. 数智化转型与效能跃升

• 敏锐识别现有数据处理与折扣执行流程中的痛点，主导并落地 RPA、AI 工具、管理系统与平台等项目，为团队增优提效。
4. 业务赋能与跨部门协同

• 从海量数据中提炼业务洞察，搭建直观的数据看板与报告，为业务管理与决策提供数据支持。

• 与跨职能团队组成敏捷工作矩阵，协同实现渠道生态体系多元化业务价值的效能支撑。

• 助力渠道运营“集中化”建设，推动运营团队内部跨职能轮岗，实现运营团队跨职能深度融合与打通。
5. 团队领导与人才孵化

• 建立梯队化的人才培养机制，鼓励团队成员多元化发展，激发团队创新思维，打造一支具备“敏捷迭代”能力与自驱基因的复合型高绩效团队。

期待您：
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• 本科及以上学历，信息/计算机科学、财务、数据分析或商业管理类专业优先。

• 大学英语六级及以上，具备优秀的中英文书面与口头商务沟通能力。

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• 行业经验：具有 8 年以上医药企业工作经验，其中至少 3 年以上渠道数据管理（DDI）、SFE、财务或商业运营管理经验。

• 专业技能：精通医药行业渠道数据管理与折扣管理模式。具备较强的数据敏感度与逻辑分析能力，熟悉 BI 工具（如 Tableau, PowerBI）、ERP 系统及主数据管理逻辑。有主导过 RPA、AI 工具引入或数据自动化系统落地经验者优先。

• 业务敏锐度：具备出色的商业敏锐度与全局观。能够穿透数据表面，深刻理解渠道策略、渠道运营、合规管控之间的内在联系，具备将海量复杂底层数据转化为高价值业务洞察并反哺业务决策与管理的能力。

• 领导力特质：具备“破局”意识，能够积极拥抱环境变化，敢于在不确定性中重塑和精益化现有流程，同时底线思维清晰，确保在变革过程中业务结果的绝对准确可靠。

jobs.title: （高级）渠道风控经理
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
全面统筹罗氏中国 MCE多渠道生态体系的合规治理与风险管控。在不断演进的行业环境下，敏锐洞察政策变化，构建从前置防御、过程监管到事后审计的风险管理闭环。协同内外部多方资源，确保渠道分销业务的高标准合规，并为渠道增值业务构建安全护城河。在坚守合规底线的同时，赋能渠道业务的高质量、可持续发展。

您将有机会：
1. 渠道生态风控体系建设与政策洞察

• 与法务合规部门积极配合，密切关注并精准解读国家及行业的合规政策与监管动态，客观评估其对渠道生态的潜在影响。

• 搭建完善的渠道风控体系，制定前瞻性的渠道风险管控预案。
2. 商业尽调、专项审计与数据核查

• 统筹并联合外部供应商，对所有各层级商业伙伴（经销商、药店等）开展尽职调查与年度常规审计。

• 聚焦 DTP 药店等关键合作方，主导针对渠道数据的专项审计与“飞检”工作。严格核验 DDI 数据与实际销量的匹配度，以及处方医院流转认定情况的真实性与准确性；在全过程中，坚决落实合规脱敏要求，严守患者隐私保护底线。
3. 公司内控合规项目协同与落地

• 作为MCE部门代表，配合公司相关团队，协调、执行和确保EC&S（出口管制与制裁）相关管理要求在MCE和渠道端的合规。

• 协同法务合规部门，深入践行BPM（商业伙伴管理）指导原则，确保MCE各项业务严格遵守公司BPM管理要求，保障渠道合作的合规。

• 协同公司行政团队，推进 BCM（业务连续性管理）的规划、践行与演练，保障渠道供应链的抗风险韧性。

• 牵头配合各类内外部合规审查与监管审计，主导沟通并推进优化措施的有效落地。
4. 合规文化宣教与运营内控先锋

• 针对不同层级的商业合作伙伴，量身定制并定期开展合规与风控专项培训，及时发现潜在隐患并完善管理规则。

• 担任 MCE 运营团队的“合规先锋”，负责团队内部员工合规管理标准的传达与教育（涵盖差旅报销、日常行为规范等内控要求），将合规意识融入团队全员日常工作中。

我们期待您：
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• 本科及以上学历，法律、审计、财务、风险管理或商业管理类专业优先。

• 大学英语六级及以上，具备优秀的中英文书面与口头商务沟通能力，能无障碍应对跨国企业的全英文风控与合规工作环境。

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• 行业经验： 具有 5 年以上大型跨国医药企业工作经验，3年以上医药行业合规、审计、渠道管理或法务相关工作经验。有律所、审计/咨询公司经验者优先。

• 专业技能： 深刻理解中国医药市场流通格局、经销商网络及 DTP 药店运作模式；精通医药行业反商业贿赂、数据隐私保护及商业尽职调查流程。

• 坚韧与原则性： 在面对内外部业务压力时，能够坚定捍卫公司的合规红线与底线。

• 业务敏锐度： 具备“既懂合规，又懂业务”的复合型视角。能够在防范风险的同时，为业务团队提供合法合规的建设性解决方案，为业务保驾护航。

• 卓越协同： 具备极强的影响力与跨部门沟通谈判能力，善于将复杂的风控条款与审计要求转化为内外合作伙伴能够理解并执行的业务语言。

• 闭环思维： 擅长从日常的审计与核查中发现问题，并自驱完善底层管理机制。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

jobs.title: Associate Manager - GMP/ GMP副经理
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement GMP-related systems, processes, and workflows for the production department.
● Develop and implement GMP training programs tailored to production staff, aligned with corporate quality policies and regulatory requirements.
● Establish the deviation management and CAPA processes in manufacturing for handling non- conformances effectively and ensuring timely resolutions.
● Implement a robust change control process, ensuring GMP compliance and proper documentation of changes in the production environment.
● Participate in the preparation for facility qualification audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all systems and practices meet GMP standards.
● Lead consumable materials/service introduction and track the status to ensure to meet the manufacturing requirement.
● Support the development of GMP documentation including SOPs, validation protocols, and project-specific documentation for compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Serve as the primary interface between the production department and QA/Compliance teams for GMP-related matters.
● Manage ongoing GMP training programs, ensuring production personnel are regularly updated on GMP and compliance requirements.
● Oversee the timely identification, investigation, and resolution of deviations, ensuring proper execution of CAPAs to avoid recurrence.
● Evaluate and coordinate changes within the production department, ensuring proper implementation and documentation in line with regulatory requirements.
● Act as the production department’s primary liaison during internal and external audits, ensuring inspection readiness and addressing observations.
● Monitor GMP compliance in daily operations, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions.
● Proactively identify areas for improvement in GMP operations, driving initiatives to enhance quality and productivity while maintaining compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in GMP compliance roles in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Hands-on experience in deviation handling, CAPA management, change control, and audit preparation is required.
● Familiarity with compliance tools and systems for managing training, deviations, and CAPAs.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
According to RDSL business and people strategies, partner with business stakeholders, perform comprehensive analysis of business knowledge and capabilities gaps. Provide the commercial training consultancy, design and develop an effective and consistent commercial training system and content, implement the learning plan effectively to ensure the good learning experience. Continue to evolve the commercial training system to ensure fit-for-future organizational needs.

Main Tasks &
• Responsibilities
1. Develop and implement annual training plan of entire business to facilitate meeting organizational goals and individual professional needs.
2. Collect, evaluate, and identify training requirements of entire business with internal and external resources including global partners to develop, review and improve training programs, including customized programs, design and implement training strategies and solutions
3. Develop and organize training materials including manuals, slides, and other materials， deploy the online and offline trainings in bilingual language (English and Mandarin)
4. Develop measurement mechanism， evaluate and follow up of training effectiveness, report the feedbacks to the business.
5. Support training program effective communication plan to enhance the business engagement
6. Create and manage training budget to maximum return on investment
7. Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

Education&
• Qualifications:
1. Bachelor Degree in Clinical Laboratory, Medical or business related major
2. Ability in facilitation and consultation, training organization and strong in communication skills
3. Good command of MS office software application
4. Training expertise is desired, healthcare industry background is a plus

Experience:
1. At least 5 years similar experience in the relevant function
2. Experience in project management with strong business acumen
3. Experience in cross function collaboration and result driven for business impact.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Sr.) Analyst, Analytical Lab, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Routine Operation :

Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness :

Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Praktikum an der Schnittstelle von Qualitätskontrolle und Lean in der Mikrobiologie (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.it: Praktikum an der Schnittstelle von Qualitätskontrolle e Lean in der Mikrobiologie (m/w/d)
titleByLocale.en: Internship at the interface of quality control and lean in microbiology (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.de: Praktikum an der Schnittstelle von Qualitätskontrolle und Lean in der Mikrobiologie (m/w/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Stage à l ' interface du contrôle de la qualité et de la microbiologie (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unsere QC Mikrobiologie, bestehend aus 7 Mitarbeitenden, ist ein wichtiger Pfeiler in der Freigabe unserer diagnostischen Einsatzstoffe. Wir freuen uns auf ein hilfsbereites und flexibles neues Teammitglied, das Spaß an der täglichen Arbeit hat und eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre unterstützt.
Wir möchten dir als Praktikant:in einen umfassenden Einblick in das „Daily Business“ der Qualitätskontrolle geben und dir zusätzlich die Möglichkeit bieten, dich aktiv in der Optimierung unserer Arbeitsabläufe einzubringen. Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in ein GMP-reguliertes Umfeld und lernst, wie man Qualität und Effizienz vereint.

Deine Aufgaben
Das Praktikum bietet dir eine spannende Mischung aus mikrobiologischer Analytik und der Mitarbeit an zukunftsgerichteten Projekten im Bereich Operational Excellence (OpEx):

1. Qualitätskontrolle & strategische Laborprojekte

• Routine & GMP: Du unterstützt bei der mikrobiologischen Analytik (z. B. Keimzahl- oder Endotoxinbestimmung) für die Freigabe diagnostischer Einsatzstoffe und sammelst wertvolle Praxis-Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld.

• Nachhaltigkeit & Portfolio-Pflege: Du begleitest uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Methoden-Portfolios. Dabei unterstützt du beispielsweise bei der Evaluierung nachhaltiger Alternativen oder bei der Vorbereitung auf neue digitale Labor-Systeme.

2. Operational Excellence (OpEx)

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du hilfst uns dabei, etablierte Laborabläufe weiter zu optimieren und datenbasierte Potenziale für eine noch effizientere Arbeitsweise zu identifizieren.

• Lean-Kultur & Kommunikation: Du unterstützt dabei, Prozessdaten in anschauliche Erfolgsgeschichten zu übersetzen. Durch die kreative Gestaltung von internen News-Formaten (z. B. Interviews, digitale Beiträge) trägst du aktiv zu unserer Lean-Kultur bei.

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium immatrikuliert (B.Sc. / M.Sc. Biologie, Mikrobiologie, Biochemie o.ä.) oder befindest dich in deinem Gap-Year.

• Du bringst bereits allgemeine praktische Laborerfahrung mit. Spezifische Grundkenntnisse in der Mikrobiologie sind dabei ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.

• Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Denkweise mit und hast Freude daran, Prozesse stetig zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern.

• Eine Affinität zu digitaler Kommunikation und die Kompetenz, Inhalte kreativ und ansprechend aufzubereiten, runden dein Profil ab.

• Erste Berührungspunkte mit Lean Management oder Operational Excellence sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss – am wichtigsten sind uns deine Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Motivation!

• Du bist fließend in Deutsch (Wort und Schrift) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Du lernst Roche Diagnostics Operations (Penzberg) kennen, einen der weltweit größten Hersteller von diagnostischen Einsatzstoffen

Deine Bewerbung

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann , auf welcher Universität/Hochs

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in oncology and hematology therapeutic areas as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of oncology/hematology

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD in oncology/hematology, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice in oncology/hematology

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience in oncology/hematology

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research You have a very good understanding of oncology/hematology global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 b

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Nel Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) China Early Development (ED) di Roche, svolgiamo un ruolo fondamentale nell'accelerare lo sviluppo precoce globale di farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti, al fine di affrontare alcune delle esigenze sanitarie insoddisfatte più difficili del mondo. Siamo un partner strategico dei team globali di sviluppo iniziale di Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) e pharma Product Development (PD) per integrare la Cina nei programmi globali di sviluppo iniziale. Insieme, portiamo avanti in tempi rapidi innovazioni straordinarie che cambiano la vita. Questa posizione si trova nella funzione di scienza clinica di Roche Product Development China, sede del China ED CoE. Questa posizione è dedicata alla guida e alla guida di programmi di sviluppo iniziale nelle aree terapeutiche di oncologia ed ematologia come responsabile clinico. L'opportunità Questo ruolo avrà l'opportunità di definire la strategia globale di sviluppo precoce e il CDP, di guidare la progettazione innovativa di sperimentazioni di sviluppo precoce, di avere un impatto significativo sull'efficienza e il successo dei nostri programmi di sviluppo precoce in oncologia/ematologia e di contribuire all'ecosistema di innovazione dello sviluppo di farmaci in Cina. Nel tuo ruolo:
• Contribuirai e influenzerai la strategia asset globale e il CDP di sviluppo iniziale come membro dei team asset globali
• Identificherai in modo proattivo opportunità di accelerazione e ottimizzazione del CDP globale per ED sfruttando competenza, esperienza, velocità e scala in Cina
• Guidarai il team interfunzionale cinese per valutare le opportunità della Cina di aderire ai programmi globali per ED o ai primi studi clinici in Cina da prospettive strategiche, scientifiche, normative e operative
• Guidare la progettazione di studi innovativi e la conduzione di studi in stretta collaborazione con esperti funzionali globali di sviluppo iniziale sui primi studi clinici in Cina
• Essere il Medical Monitor per gli studi clinici ED in Cina
• Coinvolgere scientificamente i TAE cinesi e le parti interessate interne ed esterne di Roche
• Servire come punto di contatto scientifico per i team globali di sviluppo iniziale di oncologia/ematologia
• Fare da mentore ai direttori medici junior per sviluppare ulteriormente le capacità e le capacità del CoE ED Chi sei
• Possiedi un MD in oncologia/ematologia o una laurea/master in Medicina Clinica con almeno 3 anni di pratica clinica post-laurea in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel settore biofarmaceutico e una vasta esperienza di sviluppo iniziale in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di CDP di sviluppo iniziale, progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici di sviluppo iniziale, interazione con le autorità sanitarie, collaborazione con ricercatori e ricerca clinica Hai un'ottima conoscenza delle linee guida e dei regolamenti di sviluppo globale di oncologia/ematologia, inclusi CDE, FDA ed EMEA
• Sei un comunicatore efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese scritto e verbale, con la capacità di presentare concetti complessi a team interfunzionali globali, comitati di governance e le principali parti interessate in modo logico e conciso
• Sei un grande giocatore di squadra; altamente collaborativo, buone capacità interpersonali e di influenza, può influenzare senza autorità Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si dedicano al progresso della scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi si traducono in oltre 26 milioni di persone curate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 b

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Position Im China Early Development (ED) Centre of Excellence (CoE) von Roche spielen wir eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der globalen Frühentwicklung transformativer Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der dringendsten ungedeckten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Welt zu bewältigen. Gemeinsam bringen wir außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen schnell voran. Diese Position ist in der klinischen Wissenschaftsfunktion von Roche Product Development China angesiedelt, der Heimat des China ED CoE. Diese Position ist der Leitung und Förderung früher Entwicklungsprogramme in den Therapiebereichen Onkologie und Hämatologie als klinischer Leiter gewidmet. • Wissenschaftliche Einbeziehung chinesischer TAEs sowie interner und externer Roche-Stakeholder

• Nachwuchsmedizinische Direktoren betreuen, um Fähigkeiten und Kapazitäten von ED CoE weiter auszubauen Wer Sie sind
• Sie haben einen MD in Onkologie/Hämatologie oder einen Bachelor/Master in klinischer Medizin mit mindestens 3 Jahren klinischer Praxis nach dem Abschluss in Onkologie/Hämatologie
• Sie haben Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der biopharmazeutischen Industrie und umfassende Erfahrung in der frühen Entwicklung in der Onkologie/Hämatologie.

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le poste Au sein du Centre d'excellence (CoE) de développement précoce (ED) de Roche en Chine, nous jouons un rôle essentiel dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial de médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé non satisfaits les plus difficiles au monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) et de pharma Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous mettons rapidement en avant des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Ce poste est situé au sein de la fonction science clinique de Roche Product Development China, siège du China ED CoE. Ce poste est dédié à la direction et à la conduite de programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'oncologie et de l'hématologie en tant que responsable clinique. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'opportunité de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le CDP, de piloter la conception innovante d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir un impact significatif sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation de développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous devrez :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale des actifs et le développement précoce du CDP en tant que membre des équipes mondiales des actifs.
• Identifier de manière proactive les opportunités d'accélération et d'optimisation du CDP ED mondial en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la rapidité et de l'échelle en Chine.
• Être le moniteur médical des essais cliniques sur l'ED en Chine
• Engager scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les parties prenantes internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique pour les équipes mondiales de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Encadrer les directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer davantage les capacités et les capacités du CoE ED Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en oncologie/hématologie ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique post-diplôme en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une vaste expérience de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans le développement de CDP de développement précoce, la conception et la conduite d'essais cliniques de développement précoce, l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, la collaboration avec les enquêteurs et la recherche clinique. Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des directives et réglementations mondiales de développement en oncologie/hématologie, notamment CDE, FDA et EMEA. comités et intervenants clés de manière logique et succincte.
• Vous êtes un excellent joueur d'équipe; hautement collaboratif, bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et d'influence, peut influencer sans autorité Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Security and Cybersecurity Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and independent leader who drives the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems
By bridging deep business and technical understanding, you will manage end-to-end security analysis tasks across multiple products within a domain
You will shape stakeholder perspectives, champion accountability by taking on security incident lead or project owner roles, and foster continuous improvement in security operations and best practices

Description of the area
The Identity Management Support Team manages and operates the solutions and components used to provide customers with Directory and Identity Management Services using SailPoint. We are part of a global Roche Digital Technology group (RDT).

Job Responsibilities
In this role, you are mainly responsible for the multi-cloud Identity Management environment, focusing specifically on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while maintaining consistency with AWS. This includes the design of new solutions, consultancy, maintenance, performance, tactical lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies.

Scope

• Strong background in IAM concepts at design level and evolution in Cloud environments, Azure and/or GCP.

• Contributes to the design of new solutions based on SailPoint and PingFederate, AD, Privilege Access Management.

• Design and implement Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) based on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) principles.

• Access Governance and Controls: Enforce strong security controls across cloud environments, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Identity Protection. Implement Least Privilege policies, often involving custom roles and organizational-level controls. Implement IAM Deny Policies to strictly block high-risk actions, ensuring separation of duties

• Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Drive the core value of "Automate as much as possible". Design and implement IAM infrastructure using IaC, leveraging Terraform. For Azure, this mandates IaC using Terraform and Azure Verified Modules (AVM) with CI/CD pipelines in GitLab

• Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and support Just-in-Time (JIT) Access mechanisms, ensuring no standing privileges for administrators, using tools like Cyberark for Just-in-Time access

• Operational Excellence: Act as an expert in the release management activities, providing 2nd and 3rd level support for the Identity Management Infrastructure. Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

Stakeholder Management

• Consultancy and Collaboration: Act as a mentor and reference, working closely with stakeholders to provide the right level of consultancy. Ensure regular interactions with the Managed Service Provider

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team pro

titleByLocale.it: Testa di accesso - Roche Pharma Arg

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El equipo de Enabling Team de Roche Farma Argentina busca incorporar un Access Head para liderar las estrategias comerciales y de acceso en la filial. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de guiar a un equipo multidisciplinario hacia modelos de salud innovadores, asegurando que nuestras soluciones lleguen a más pacientes de manera rápida y sostenible. Formarás parte de un entorno colaborativo y de alta confianza, actuando como un asesor clave enfocado en la acceso y el impacto a largo plazo.
Nuestras ambiciones para los pacientes a los que servimos son altas, trabajamos en base a resultados esperados y nos impulsamos en modelos de pago y/o reembolso innovadores, competitivos y basados en el valor.

La Oportunidad:

Estrategia de acceso: Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de acceso (precios, reembolso, HTA, acuerdos innovadores), alineada con los objetivos del negocio y las prioridades de salud pública.
Proporciona liderazgo al equipo comercial, así como a los procesos y estrategias en los mercados público y privado, integrando a todos los interesados internos y externos involucrados. Todo esto con una visión sistémica y analítica del negocio, evolucionando la política comercial siempre que sea necesario.
Liderazgo de equipo: Guiar, desarrollar y empoderar al equipo, asegurando una cultura de alto desempeño, colaboración transversal, cocreacion con actores externos e innovación constante.
Valor y evidencia: Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Medical y Estrategia para identificar las brechas de una estrategia conjunta y generen evidencia de vida real local necesarias y relevantes para el acceso (real world evidence, PROs, análisis farmacoeconómicos)
Liderar e impulsar el trabajo colaborativo con otras áreas de la compañía para asegurar que las estrategias de acceso incluyan la visión integral de todos los stakeholders necesarios.
Catalizar el desarrollo continuo de capacidades de acceso líderes en la industria y preparadas para el futuro en su área, con un mayor enfoque en el aprovechamiento de la analítica, la tecnología, la IA.
Permitir la priorización efectiva y la asignación de recursos en toda la organización al servicio de nuestros resultados a largo plazo.
Actuar como un asesor clave de confianza para el Enabling Team (ET) de Roche Argentina y brindar liderazgo y consulta en su área respectiva de experiencia.
Ser un líder de servicio para toda la filial y la red, actuando con coraje e integridad. Modelar el liderazgo VACC, creativo y un mindset de red, apoyando la transparencia en toda la organización.

Tu Perfil:

• Cuentas con un título universitario en Ciencias de la Salud, Ingenierías, Economía o carreras afines. Deseable Maestría en Salud Pública, Economía de la Salud, Políticas Públicas o MBA.

• Aportas experiencia de +5 años liderando estrategias de acceso al mercado o políticas sanitarias dentro de la industria farmacéutica o el sector salud .

• Demuestras trayectoria de 3 a 5 años en posiciones direcciones/regionales/globales

• Conocimientos específicos: HTA, economía de la salud, políticas públicas, pricing & reimbursement, manejo de stakeholders y regulaciones del sector salud.

• Posees un nivel de inglés bilingüe y fluido para interactuar eficazmente en entornos globales.

• Destacas por tu capacidad analítica y una mentalidad orientada a la creación de valor y al trabajo colaborativo transversal .

• Capacidad para movilizar equipos construyendo relaciones efectivas para promover el trabajo en equipo, la colaboración y el int

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen.

Dein neues Team:
Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten.
Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Deine strategische Rolle

• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.

• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.

• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.

• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.

• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.

• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.

• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.

• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.

• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner

• Du kommunizierst stark und klar auf Deutsch und

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche's Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) Department as a Senior SHE Specialist and make a meaningful impact on workplace safety and environmental stewardship. In this pivotal role, you'll identify and evaluate risks to employee safety and the environment while establishing robust controls to mitigate those hazards. Working collaboratively across the R&D department and throughout the business, you'll leverage detailed analysis, expert problem-solving skills, and extensive SHE expertise to protect our employees, our environment, and Roche's right to operate. Through strategic risk identification, comprehensive incident investigation and management, accident prevention, compliance management, and innovative program development, you'll help build and maintain a safe, compliant, and resilient workplace culture.

The Opportunity

As an expert leader with strong business acumen and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, you'll demonstrate mastery in executing and evaluating SHE risk assessments—including job hazard assessments, equipment safety evaluations, PPE assessments, and ergonomic risk assessments. Your proficiency in interpreting regulatory and technical documents, combined with your extensive knowledge of industrial environmental management and emergency response procedures, will be instrumental in driving compliance and protecting our workforce. With a background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology, along with your demonstrated expertise in biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, and chemical hygiene, you'll bring the technical depth needed to excel in our science-driven medical device R&D environment.

• Provide SHE business partner support for the R&D department of a dynamic medical diagnostic device company

• Lead or facilitate investigation of SHE incidents to identify root causes and implement corrective and preventative actions to reduce risk of recurrence

• Develop, review, and revise SHE programs through technical writing to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations

• Manage action plans to ensure incident follow-up is complete, effective, and timely

• Prepare, coordinate, and conduct regular SHE-related meetings, inspections, and training sessions

• Maintain comprehensive SHE documentation, incident databases, injury and illness records, and required permits in accordance with compliance standards

• Develop metrics, summaries, and communications to provide accurate and timely reporting of SHE-related data and trend analysis

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in occupational health and safety, engineering, or related technical field with minimum 8 years of dedicated professional SHE experience

• Extensive experience in highly regulated and science-driven industries (e.g., medical device, clinical diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or R&D environments) with demonstrated expertise in executing SHE risk assessments and emergency response procedures

• Demonstrated expertise in medical device R&D environments, including biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, chemical hygiene, and preferred background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology

• Proven ability to autonomously manage complex SHE projects, lead incident response and management, interpret regulatory and technical documents, and develop business-wide SHE programs in matrixed organizations

• Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with expert ability to manage complex workloads, deliver high-quality work with meticulous

A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al Dipartimento Sicurezza, Salute e Ambientale di Roche (SHE) come Senior SHE Specialist e avere un impatto significativo sulla sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e sulla gestione ambientale. In questo ruolo fondamentale, identificherai e valuterai i rischi per la sicurezza dei dipendenti e per l'ambiente, stabilendo controlli robusti per mitigare tali rischi. Lavorando in collaborazione attraverso il reparto R&D e in tutto il mondo del business, potrete sfruttare analisi dettagliate, competenze di problem solving esperti e una vasta esperienza SHE per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, il nostro ambiente e il diritto di Roche di operare. Attraverso l'identificazione strategica del rischio, l'indagine completa degli incidenti e la gestione, la prevenzione degli incidenti, la gestione della conformità e lo sviluppo di programmi innovativi, vi aiuterà a costruire e mantenere una cultura di lavoro sicura, conforme e resiliente. L'opportunità In qualità di leader esperto con un forte acume aziendale e una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni, dimostrerai la padronanza nell'esecuzione e nella valutazione delle valutazioni dei rischi SHE, comprese le valutazioni dei rischi di lavoro, le valutazioni sulla sicurezza delle attrezzature, le valutazioni dei PPE e le valutazioni ergonomiche del rischio. La vostra competenza nell'interpretare documenti normativi e tecnici, unitamente alla vostra vasta conoscenza delle procedure di gestione ambientale industriale e di risposta alle emergenze, sarà determinante per la conformità alla guida e la protezione della nostra forza lavoro. Con uno sfondo in chimica, elettrochimica, o microbiologia, insieme con la vostra esperienza dimostrata in biosicurezza, patogeni e igiene chimica, porterete la profondità tecnica necessaria per eccellere nel nostro ambiente R&D dispositivo medico guidato dalla scienza.
• Fornire il supporto del partner commerciale SHE per il reparto R&D di una società di dispositivi diagnostici dinamici
• condurre o facilitare l'indagine di incidenti SHE per identificare le cause di root e implementare azioni correttive e preventive per ridurre il rischio di ricorrenza
• Sviluppare, rivedere e rivedere i programmi SHE relativi attraverso la scrittura tecnica per garantire la conformità dei dati federali, di stato e di regolamentazioni locali applicabili
• Gestire i piani di azione per garantire il follow-up degli incidenti è completo, efficace e comportamento tempestivo
•
• Una vasta esperienza in settori altamente regolamentati e orientati alla scienza (ad esempio, dispositivi medici, diagnostica clinica, prodotti farmaceutici o ambienti R&D) con una comprovata competenza nell'esecure le valutazioni del rischio SHE e le procedure di risposta di emergenza
• Competenze dimostrate negli ambienti R&D del dispositivo medico, comprese le procedure di analisi del rischio SHE e di risposta di emergenza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Treten Sie als Senior SHE Specialist der Roche-Abteilung für Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SHE) bei und leisten Sie einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf die Sicherheit am Arbeitsplatz und die Umweltverantwortung. In dieser zentralen Rolle identifizieren und bewerten Sie Risiken für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeiter und die Umwelt, während Sie robuste Kontrollen einrichten, um diese Gefahren zu mindern. In Zusammenarbeit mit der gesamten F & E-Abteilung und im gesamten Unternehmen nutzen Sie detaillierte Analysen, kompetente Problemlösungskompetenzen und umfangreiches SHE-Know-how, um unsere Mitarbeiter, unsere Umwelt und das Recht von Roche zu schützen. Durch strategische Risikoidentifizierung, umfassende Untersuchung und Management von Vorfällen, Unfallverhütung, Compliance-Management und innovative Programmentwicklung helfen Sie beim Aufbau und der Aufrechterhaltung einer sicheren, konformen und widerstandsfähigen Arbeitsplatzkultur. Die Chance Als erfahrene Führungskraft mit starkem Geschäftssinn und einer proaktiven, lösungsorientierten Denkweise beweisen Sie, dass Sie SHE-Risikobewertungen - einschließlich Arbeitsplatzrisikobewertungen, Sicherheitsbewertungen von Geräten, PPE-Bewertungen und ergonomische Risikobewertungen - beherrschen. Ihre Kenntnisse in der Interpretation von regulatorischen und technischen Dokumenten, kombiniert mit Ihrem umfassenden Wissen über industrielles Umweltmanagement und Notfallmaßnahmen, werden dazu beitragen, die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu fördern und unsere Mitarbeiter zu schützen. Mit einem Hintergrund in Chemie, Elektrochemie oder Mikrobiologie, zusammen mit Ihrer nachgewiesenen Expertise in Biosicherheit, durch Blut übertragenen Krankheitserregern und chemischer Hygiene, bringen Sie die technische Tiefe, die erforderlich ist, um in unserer wissenschaftsgetriebenen F & E-Umgebung für medizinische Geräte zu übertreffen.
• Unterstützung von SHE-Geschäftspartnern für die F&E-Abteilung eines dynamischen Unternehmens für medizinische Diagnosegeräte Führen oder erleichtern Sie die Untersuchung von SHE-Vorfällen, um die Ursachen zu identifizieren und korrigierende und präventive Maßnahmen zu ergreifen, um das Wiederholungsrisiko zu verringern
• Entwicklung, Überprüfung und Überarbeitung von SHE-Programmen durch technisches Schreiben, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Bundes-, Landes- und lokalen Vorschriften sicherzustellen
• Verwalten von Aktionsplänen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Nachverfolgung von Vorfällen vollständig, effektiv und zeitnah ist
• Vorbereitung, Koordination und Durchführung regelmäßiger SHE-bezogener Treffen, Inspektionen und Schulungen
• Pflegen Sie umfassende SHE-Dokumentationen, Vorfalldatenbanken, Verletzungs- und Krankheitsaufzeichnungen und erforderliche Genehmigungen in Übereinstimmung mit Compliance-Standards
• Entwicklung von Metriken, Zusammenfassungen und Kommunikationen, um eine genaue und zeitnahe Berichterstattung über SHE-bezogene Daten und Trendanalysen zu ermöglichen Wer du bist
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Arbeitssicherheit, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten technischen Bereich mit mindestens 8 Jahren dedizierter Berufserfahrung Umfangreiche Erfahrung in stark regulierten und wissenschaftsgetriebenen Branchen (z.
