jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
• Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
• That’s what makes us Roche.

Position summary

As a team member of RSS, you execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level requirements, in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process.
It is also key to follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination.
You are responsible for managing incoming and outgoing phone calls based on the predefined SLAs and processes and incoming Service Now tickets. With your dedicated work, you contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche.

Responsibilities

● Service Delivery
o Your key responsibilities will be providing support on 1st level questions, system related questions, role management, consultancy services on existing procurement functionalities of the system/platform for end users
• o Providing support primarily by phone and ticketing tool for above mentioned system related queries coming from Indirect Procurement End Users
• o Creating/maintaining and following up cases/tickets in the adequate quality and in timely manner – within 24 hours if possible- in order to achieve the best response and end-to-end resolution time
• o Proceed with role ownership tickets in timely manner according to the guidelines
• o Responsible for first level issue resolution and being able to make decision on further actions for completing and resolving the upcoming requests and issues
• o Being a bridge between other resolver groups and the business, by reviewing feedback related incidents and sharing the knowledge and instructions with the Requestor on the adequate level
• o Work on scheduled and ad-hoc reporting activities, pro-actively practice the available and required tool sets
• o Work on the regular and ad-hoc monitoring activity and apply fixes as needed.
• o Being responsible and contribute to a proper availability planning within the Team by discussing planned holiday/training schedule in advance

● Cross-Functional Collaboration
o Contribute continuously to the implementation of new tasks and responsibilities coming to the RSS

● Outputs & Deliverables
o Maintaining SOPs, Annexes and training materials for 1st level support. Prepare and share knowledge base documents in timely manner or for the requested deadline

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

Your skills:

• ● You bring the following skills and competencies:
• o Experience in supplier relationship management
• o Basic understanding of procurement support
• o Familiar with ticketing tools
• o Good numerical and analytical skills
• o React to problems in an appropriate manner
• o Able to work in a fast paced environment
• o Good at time management
• o Open to working in afternoon schedule until 6:00 pm
• o Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills
• o Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills
• o Highly accountable, agile, and results oriented.
• o Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and written
• o Excellent organiz

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
I. Sales Target Setting and Management
• Support the preparation of annual and quarterly sales target-setting by providing historical data, market trends, and performance insights.

• Maintain and update sales performance against targets daily/weekly/monthly, identifying variances and provide data summaries to Sales Leadership for follow-up actions.

• Ensure targets are equitably distributed and clearly communicated across the sales force.

• Manage the sales performance relevant process(contract fillment, sales rebate, allowance)
II. Territory Design and Management
• Partner with sales leaders to develop and optimize sales territory structures to ensure fair opportunity distribution, minimize channel conflict, and maximize market coverage and penetration.

• Develop and maintain territory assignment rules and policies, performing regular audits and re-alignments based on business changes, market potential, and sales force size.

• Provide analysis and recommendations on optimal sales resource deployment and headcount planning.
III. Sales Performance Management and Market intelligence Analytics
• Develop, maintain, and disseminate key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into the health of the sales pipeline and overall performance.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on sales trends, productivity metrics, and funnel conversion rates to identify bottlenecks and areas for process improvement.

• Support regular business review preparation and follow-up, including identifying performance gaps and tracking improvement actions.
IV. Tender coordination
• Partner with sales leaders to build the systematic approach to monitor and capture tender opportunities and follow up with the sales team.

• Filter the tender by portfolio and dispatch to the respective territory sales team

• Support sales team to prepare tender documentation and compilation .

V. Process Improvement and Enablement
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize core sales processes (e.g., forecasting, pipeline management, account planning).

• Partner with Sales Enablement to translate best practices and process improvements into effective training content and tools.
Compliance & Additional Tasks

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

• Perform other tasks as assigned by the line manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Affairs Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

The opportunity
Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated, managed, and communicated to the global medical community.

• End-to-End Workstream Management: Independently drive and manage comprehensive business analysis workstreams, navigating ambiguous problem spaces and adapting standard frameworks to deliver clear, structured outcomes.

• Problem Solving & Requirements Accountability: Lead domain research and root cause analysis to define comprehensive requirements, contribute heavily to technical solution selection, and propose creative process improvements.

• Technical Landscape & Product Strategy Alignment: Maintain a holistic view of how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy, formulating technical strategies that align directly with broader organizational objectives.

• Application & Data Domain Mastery: Serve as the authoritative Subject Matter Expert (SME) by bridging the gap between business processes and technical execution, maintaining expert knowledge of the end-to-end information lifecycle and data transformations.

• Cross-Functional & Site-Level Collaboration: Operate at the product or site level to directly influence technical decisions, leading cross-functional teams to resolve complex business or systems issues.

• Knowledge Sharing & Community Engagement: Act as a technical mentor to junior team members, actively present at internal tech events (e.g., Tech Talks, DevOps Days), and engage in initiatives outside the regular project scope to drive engineering innovation.

Who you are

• Professional Experience: Bring 5+ years of Business Analysis or consultancy experience, including at least 3+ years within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Workstream & Requirement Management: Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams, navigate ambiguous requirements, and translate them into strategic implementation plans.

• Technical BA Proficiency: Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, documentation, traceability, and change management, with the ability to apply standard process and usability analysis tools.

• Data Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, data visualization techniques, relational databases, and non-relational data structures.

• Stakeholder & Problem Solving Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to prioritize effectively, maintain a big-picture strategic view, and propose process improvements .

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate.
To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

We create chemistry! Based on modern analytical methods and synthesis procedures we design and develop a great variety of chemical assay components for Dia and Pharma. With our domain knowledge and our wide spectrum of methods, we also accompany the whole lifecycle of active diagnostics ingredients.

We provide in “Chemistry Technologies” a full spectrum of chemical technologies from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We design tailor-made molecules and develop lab scale procedures to provide a competitive advantage for our products.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Development of synthesis strategies within projects that require particularly complex nucleic acid chemical and organic syntheses

• Conducting these syntheses in the laboratory

• Observing the field of nucleic acid chemistry and modern preparative organic chemistry through literature and patent studies, and attending conferences

• Building and maintaining a network through contacts with external and internal experts

• Collaborating with cooperating partners, e.g., in the USA

• Ensuring the required technology through the generation of own IP

• Adhering to internal and external regulations regarding occupational safety and environmental protection, quality management, labor law, confidentiality, etc.

• Representing the team leadership at project meetings and assisting in the professional supervision of employees

Who you are

• You have completed a university degree in chemistry and additionally a PhD in the field of organic chemistry

• You are an expert in oligonucleotide synthesis and preparative organic synthesis as well as in the purification of synthesis products. You gained this special knowledge by working in the pharmaceutical industry for at least 3 -5 years.

• Ideally, you have experience with non-standard oligo building blocks and ultra high purity reagents for the synthesis of highly pure oligonucleotides and experience with large scale, high quality oligonucleotide synthesis

• At the same time, you bring good knowledge in nucleic acids, excellent chemical knowledge, and basic knowledge in biochemistry

• You are strong in communication, both in German and English

• To build a network, you know how to use and maintain your contacts to establish a good relationship of trust

• You also place a high value on good teamwork to find the best solutions and to assist in the professional supervision of employees

• Projektmanagement in an industrial setting is even so well known to you

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only your updated CV and your latest certificates.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mil

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Str

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore senior Roche India – Servizi e Soluzioni Roche Chennai o Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Senior Analyst, collaborerai a stretto contatto con il team Strategic Analytics & Insights con sede negli Stati Uniti, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads e il team GATE più ampio. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di fornire analisi avanzate e approfondimenti attuabili che supportano le priorità strategiche, in ultima analisi, mirando al massimo impatto con clienti e pazienti. La tua opportunità
• Progetti complessi di piombo e iniziative nelle operazioni commerciali di farmaci, concentrandosi sul monitoraggio delle prestazioni di marca, Panoramica del mercato delle malattie, Viaggi dei pazienti (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Previsione, Supporto e valutazione del lancio del prodotto, Aderenza paziente, Targeting del medico / Account, Payer Mix, Impatto di marketing e ROIs
• Collaborare con Therapy area manager, Ecosystem insights conduce e altri stakeholder aziendali per comprendere dinamiche di mercato e comportamenti dei clienti, sfruttando questa conoscenza per supportare le strategie basate sui dati
• Comprehend requisiti delle parti interessate, priorità dei compiti e gestire efficacemente le responsabilità quotidiane, tra cui liaising e il coordinamento con il team interno GATE per la consegna
• Guidare le discussioni di team e stakeholder, agire come partner di pensiero e fornire loro soluzioni e raccomandazioni di analisi di alta qualità
• Creare presentazioni efficaci per trasmettere informazioni e raccomandazioni cruciali agli stakeholder in modo efficace
• Partecipare alle riunioni con i team in diversi fusi orari per garantire una consegna regolare delle richieste analitiche e operative relative ai partner commerciali
• Prendere una mentalità aziendale, collegare le responsabilità individuali con un'organizzazione più ampia, concentrarsi sui risultati che forniscono la maggior parte del valore aziendale e paziente
• Sii flessibile per partecipare all'incontro durante le ore di lavoro sovrapposte IST/PST
• Fornire mentorship e formazione ai membri del team junior e agli stagisti sui principi di analisi e sul dominio Pharma, promuovendo lo sviluppo di set di competenze e capacità Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Tecnologia o una disciplina rilevante, con una preferenza per Computer Science, Software, Statistica, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering e campi correlati e 4-8 anni di analisi / consulenza esperienza, con 2-5 anni specificamente nei progetti di analisi Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. Preferibilmente, Master’s Degree o qualsiasi certificazione su analytics o data science sarebbe un vantaggio aggiuntivo.
• Deve dimostrare esperienza nelle operazioni commerciali di farmacia degli Stati Uniti e possedere un forte background in analisi delle vendite, analisi dei reclami, analisi dei prodotti, analisi dei pazienti, previsione e analisi ROI
• Esperienza con una serie di set di dati secondari, compresi i dati di vendita IQVIA, 867 dati, reclami LAAD, affiliazioni, interazioni sul campo, Veeva, dati medici, e altro ancora, è un vantaggio significativo
• L'esposizione a aree terapeutiche come oncologia, neurologia, immunologia, ecc., insieme a una conoscenza di lavoro di Salesforce o Veeva, è una valida qualifica aggiuntiva

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Angemeldet Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions Chennai oder Hyderabad Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Roche hat das Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) gegründet, um analytische und technologiegetriebene Lösungen durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Roche-Partnern weltweit zu betreiben. Als Senior Analyst arbeiten Sie eng mit dem in den USA, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads und dem breiteren GATE Team zusammen. Ihre primäre Verantwortung wird es sein, fortschrittliche Analysen und handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse zu liefern, die strategische Prioritäten unterstützen und letztendlich den größten Einfluss von Kunden und Patienten anstreben. Ihre Chance
• Führen Sie komplexe Projekte und Initiativen im Pharma-Geschäft, die sich auf Brand Performance Tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patientenreisen (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Prognosen, Produkt-Start-Unterstützung und -Bewertung, Patientenhaftung, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact und ROIs konzentrieren
• Zusammenarbeit mit Therapy Area Managern, Ecosystem-Einsichten führt und andere Unternehmen Stakeholder, um Marktdynamik und Kundenverhalten zu verstehen und dieses Wissen zu nutzen, um datengesteuerte Strategien zu unterstützen
• Erfüllung der Stakeholder-Anforderungen, Priorisierung von Aufgaben und effektive Verwaltung von Tages-zu-Tage-Verantwortungen, einschließlich der Kommunikation und Koordinierung mit dem GATE-internen Team zur Lieferung
• Führen Sie die Team- und Stakeholder-Diskussionen, fungieren als Gedankenpartner und bieten ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Analyselösungen und Empfehlungen
• Erstellen Sie effektvolle Präsentationen, um entscheidende Einblicke und Empfehlungen für Stakeholder effektiv zu vermitteln
• Besuchen Sie Treffen mit Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen, um eine reibungslose Lieferung von analytischen und operativen Anfragen an die Geschäftspartner zu gewährleisten
• Nehmen Sie einen Unternehmensvorteil, die Verbindung einzelner Verantwortlichkeiten mit breiterer Organisation, konzentrieren Sie sich auf Ergebnisse, die die meisten Geschäfts- und Patientenwert bieten
• Seien Sie flexibel, um während der IST/PST überlappenden Arbeitszeit zu treffen
• Vermittlung von Mentorschaft und Ausbildung an Junior-Team-Mitglieder und Praktikanten zu analytischen Prinzipien und der Pharma-Domain, Förderung der Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Technologie oder eine relevante Disziplin, mit einer Vorliebe für Informatik, Software, Statistik, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering und verwandten Bereichen und 4-8 Jahre Analytik / Beratungserfahrung, mit 2-5 Jahren speziell in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare Analytics Projekten. Vorzugsweise wäre der Master-Abschluss oder jede Zertifizierung auf Analytik oder Datenwissenschaft ein weiterer Vorteil.
• Muss Know-how in US Pharma Commercial Operations demonstrieren und einen starken Hintergrund in der Vertriebsanalytik, Claim-Analyse, Produktanalyse, Patientenanalyse, Prognose und ROI-Analyse besitzen
• Erfahrung mit einer Reihe von sekundären Datensätzen, einschließlich IQVIA-Vertriebsdaten, 867 Daten, LAAD-Anforderungen, Zugehörigkeiten, Feldinteraktionen, Veeva, medizinische Daten und mehr, ist ein wesentlicher Vorteil
• Exposition gegenüber therapeutischen Bereichen wie Onkologie, Neurologie, Immunologie usw., zusammen mit einem Arbeitswissen von Salesforce oder Veeva, ist eine wertvolle zusätzliche Qualifikation

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste d'analyste principal Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions Chennai ou Hyderabad Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Roche a créé le Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) pour piloter des solutions d'analyse et de technologie en partenariat avec ses filiales dans le monde entier. En tant qu'analyste principal, vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'équipe de Strategic Analytics & Insights basée aux États-Unis, les directeurs de Therapy Areas Insights, Ecosystem Insights Leads et l'équipe plus large de GATE. Votre responsabilité principale sera de fournir des analyses avancées et des informations pratiques qui soutiennent les priorités stratégiques, en fin de compte en vue d'obtenir le plus grand impact auprès des clients et des patients. Votre opportunité
• Diriger des projets et des initiatives complexes dans le domaine des opérations commerciales pharmaceutiques, en mettant l'accent sur le suivi de la performance de la marque, l'aperçu du marché des maladies, les voyages des patients (traitement et traitement des médicaments), la prévision, le soutien et l'évaluation du lancement des produits, l'adhésion des patients, le ciblage des médecins et des comptes, le mélange des payeurs, l'impact sur le marché et les RI
• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de secteur de la thérapie, les chefs de file en matière d'écosystème et d'autres intervenants commerciaux pour comprendre la dynamique du marché et le comportement des clients, exploiter ces connaissances pour appuyer les stratégies axées sur les données
• Compréhension des besoins des intervenants, hiérarchiser les tâches et gérer efficacement les responsabilités quotidiennes, y compris la liaison et la coordination avec l'équipe interne du GATE pour la prestation des services
• Diriger les discussions entre l'équipe et les intervenants, agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion et leur fournir des solutions et des recommandations d'analyse de haute qualité
• Créer des présentations efficaces pour transmettre aux intervenants des idées et des recommandations cruciales
• Assister à des réunions d'équipes dans différents fuseaux Prendre une attitude d'entreprise, relier les responsabilités individuelles à une organisation plus large, se concentrer sur les résultats qui fournissent la plus grande valeur aux entreprises et aux patients
• Être flexible pour assister à des réunions pendant les heures de travail recoupant IST/PST
• Offrir un mentorat et une formation aux membres de l'équipe junior et aux stagiaires sur les principes d'analyse et le domaine Pharma, favorisant le développement des compétences et des capacités Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en technologie ou d'une discipline pertinente, avec une préférence pour l'informatique, les logiciels, les statistiques, la science des données, l'IA, l'apprentissage automatique, le génie des données et les domaines connexes et 4-8 ans d'expérience en analyse / conseil, avec 2-5 ans spécifiquement dans les projets d'analyse Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare. De préférence, le diplôme de maîtrise ou toute certification en analyse ou en science des données serait un avantage supplémentaire.
• Doit faire preuve d'expertise dans les opérations commerciales de Pharma US et posséder une solide expérience dans l'analyse des ventes, l'analyse des revendications, l'analyse des produits, l'analyse des patients, la prévision et l'analyse du ROI
• Expérience avec une gamme de données secondaires, y compris les données de vente IQVIA, 867 données, les revendications LAAD, les affiliations, les interactions sur le terrain, Veeva, les données médicales, et plus encore, est un avantage significatif
• L'exposition à des domaines thérapeutiques comme l'oncologie, la neurologie, l'immunologie, etc., ainsi qu'une connaissance pratique de Salesforce ou Veeva, est une qualification supplémentaire précieuse

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ BC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions.

• Minimum 3 year of experience in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS).

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• Products for the respective area of responsibility shall obtain Regulatory approvals in defined markets in close cooperation with other functions.

• The documents/deliverables for submissions are coordinated and compiled in a timely manner to support planned product registration timelines.

• The obtained Regulatory approvals/licenses products are maintained throughout the life cycle of the product by applying successful Regulatory change controls.

• The efficiency and the success of the Regulatory activities and strategies are maintained by clear agreements with other functions, stakeholders and external partners (authorities, companies, NBs etc).

• The regulatory requirements and strategic aspects are understood, communicated and implemented, kept up to date and are transparent within the organization.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory document and submission compilation:

• Oversees the development of submission/product registration dossiers of more complex products/programs. Develops and manages at least parts of comprehensive global regulatory submissions and registration plans. May act as mentor for more junior team members in this area.

2. External interface management:

• Understands the structure, key roles and responsibilities of external customers/stakeholders. Understands and communicates timely and effectively the needs of external customers/stakeholders. Builds effective and enduring external relationships and applies effective stakeholder management practices. Actively contributes to audits by supporting preparation, execution and follow up.

3. Regulatory knowledge and strategy:

• Leads the organization to adapt to evolving regulatory environment and requirements.

• Experience in solving complex, critical health authority issues or equivalent.

• Understanding of external environmental changes, precedents, to navigate complex situations and influence strategies and decision making.

• Ability to interpret and apply understanding of the regulators' thinking to projects and apply strategies to the different needs of different regions without significant guidance.

• Proactively creates unique/innovative regulatory strategies and influencing approaches to avoid regulatory obstacles and accelerate worldwide approvals.

4. Stakeholder management and influencing:

• Effectively partners with stakeholders to understand and provide best solutions. Takes initiative to address problems or opportunities and involves stakeholders for best solutions. Develops relationships that significantly influence the current and future direction for Roche and our products. Understands what motivates other people to perform at their best. Is skilled at managing and influencing peers. Fosters an exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to be able to shift perspectives to reach a common agreeable outcome. Negotiates with stakeholders and creates win-win compromises.

5. Decision making: :

• Has courage to make decisions even outside of scope/comfort zone.

• Proactively Initiates activities independently and initiates interactions across departments as applicable. Embrace the good decision making principles. Pushes decision making to the lowest appropriate level. Commits to decisions that have been made. Shows good judgment in decision making. Makes good decisions without necessarily having all the information in a timely manner.

6. Innovation and problem solving: :

• Drives innovation across the organization/sites. Advocates for and

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks.

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).

• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.

• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​

2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory

• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.

• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.

• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams.

​
3. Proactive Defense & Automation

• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.

• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape.

​

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Educational Bac

A Field Services Engineer is responsible for performing the field service activities for Professional Diagnostics by provision and co-ordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modification’s, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.
This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Support

• Take accountability for cases being resolved by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support

• Coordinate the resolution of escalated technical cases by identifying issues that require escalation, referring to appropriate escalation processes, providing feedback to customers, internal sales and line manager, following up until resolved and closing cases within customer expectations.

• Proactively provide technical support to customers by receiving ad-hoc customer support requests while on site, after hours etc., by receiving request for support from customers, logging case on system, providing technical support and closing case or distributing case correctly immediately.

• Provide expert technical support by receiving escalated cases, evaluating and resolving or escalating according to escalation policy and providing feedback to customers until resolved.
Modifications

• Conduct modifications by receiving notification of modification/enhancements, upskilling on technical requirements, contacting customers to schedule modifications and conducting as per specifications and standards and within deadlines. • Initiate project installations / de-installations by being appointed as project installation lead, engaging with Project Manager, agreeing installation requirements and specifications, conducting site inspection, understanding customer expectations and Customer Service and Support

• Maintain a customer centric approach with all customer engagements by aligning with the Roche values, maintaining professionalism, providing quality technical support and advice and delivering according to their expectations and SLA at all times.

• Proactively resolve customer issues by conducting courtesy visits, identifying potential issues and resolving and taking preventative action at all times.

• Qualifications: Diploma in Electrical Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Biomedical Technology or equivalent.

• Experience working with chemistry / core lab instruments.

• Willingness to be on-call during evenings, weekends, and holidays (team rotation basis).

• Experience in technical support services– advantage

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst den digitalen Wandel im Gesundheitsmarkt als Führungspersönlichkeit von morgen aktiv mitgestalten und die Diagnostik durch patientenzentrierte Innovationen revolutionieren? Starte als Leadership StartUp Trainee (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH in eine unbefristete Karriere mit echter Verantwortung. Wir bieten dir Raum für deinen individuellen Führungspfad, agile Projekte und die strategische Prägung der Gesundheitsversorgung. Werde die treibende Innovationskraft!

Wer wir sind
Als Partner für innovative Diagnostik- und datenbasierte Entscheidungsunterstützung tragen wir dazu bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen gemeinsam zu gestalten. Dabei setzen wir auf digitale Vernetzung, intelligente Technologien und enge Zusammenarbeit.

Diese Vision verfolgen wir als Vertrieb Deutschland tagtäglich mit unserem vollen Einsatz - immer im Sinne der Patient:innen.

Willst Du auch Teil davon sein?

Was bieten wir dir
Während Deines 24-monatigen Programms wirst Du vom ersten Tag an:

• Deine Leistungs- und Entwicklungsziele definieren und diesen durch intensives Training on und off the job jeden Tag einen Schritt näher kommen.

• Verantwortung für Projekte (Product Owner, Projektleitung) übernehmen, in klassischen Projekten und agilen Settings (lokal oder international) mitarbeiten und diese den entsprechenden Stakeholdern präsentieren.

• Seminare und Workshops besuchen, sowie eine:n erfahrene:n Senior Manager:in für Deine Progamm- und Karriereplanung an Deiner Seite als Mentor:in haben.

• Dein persönliches internationales Netzwerk mit aktuellen und ehemaligen Trainees sowie mit Kollegen:innen in anderen Funktionen und Bereichen aufbauen und so sehr viele Erfahrungen und Erkenntnisse in einem sich derzeit stark verändernden Umfeld sammeln.

• Die Möglichkeit haben, an einem unserer anderen Standorte im Ausland zu arbeiten und dort ein Projekt zu übernehmen.

Wer du bist
Du bist jemand, der seine eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Du liebst das Experimentieren und Vorangehen in unbekannten Gebieten. Du bist die treibende Kraft, agierst innovativ und hinterfragst Bestehendes. Du willst rasch Verantwortung übernehmen und bist bereit, die Extrameile zu gehen. Darüber hinaus hast Du ein hohes Interesse an unserem Gesundheitsmarkt, denkst unternehmerisch und willst die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Qualifikationen

• Hervorragend abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (wirtschafts- oder naturwissenschaftlicher Studiengang)

• Relevante Praxiserfahrung durch Praktika oder bis zu 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens dreimonatige Auslandserfahrung (außerhalb DACH-Region)

• Affinität für Digitalisierung und den medizinischen Wert der Diagnostik

• Verhandlungssicheres Englisch sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, soziale Kompetenz, Zielstrebigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Nachweisbares Engagement über das Studium hinaus (Ehrenamt, Sport etc.)

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser!

• Lerne von den Besten: Profitiere von maßgeschneiderten Trainings und exklusiven Coachingangeboten, die wir speziell für unsere Trainee-Community entwickelt haben.

• Networking auf Augenhöhe: Werde Teil unseres lebendigen Trainee-Netzwerks. Bei uns gibt es kein „Einzelkämpfer-Dasein“ – regelmäßige Events und Networking-Sessions gehören fest dazu.

• Rundum abgesichert & fit: Vielfältige Sport- und Vorsorgeangebote oder smarte Lösungen für deine Altersvorsorge – wir investieren in deine Gesundheit und deine finanzielle Zukunft.

Neugierig auf

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Descrizione A Roche puoi mostrarti come be, assegnato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi essere, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come vogliono prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare che tutti hanno accesso tutti cura oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa ti aspetta: La diagnostica laboratoristica è il cuore del nostro sistema sanitario e di fondamentale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Stime approssimative che il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basano su test di diagnostica in vitro. La assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi la condizione base per diagnostica sicurezza e scelte mediche. Per il nostro programma di tirocinio stiamo cercando studenti motivati, tecnologicamente care e curiosi, che siano in grado di supportare concretamente il nostro team di servizio e di costruire con noi le basi per una di successo a Roche. Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione di servizio! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo portando avanti la diagnostica laboratoristica in Germania e stiamo attivamente plasmare il futuro del sistema sanitario. A Roche puoi portare ogni giorno le do idee e il tuo sapere teorico e pratico per risolvere questioni complesse nel team. Come tirocinante (m/w/d) seguirai i nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, immergerai profondamente la connessione IT dei nostri sistemi. Durante le do missioni quotidiane in diversi ospedali e laboratori privati, la tua iniziativa personale, la tua orientamento al cliente e le do abilità tecniche saranno richieste. Il tuo perfetto inizio: all'inizio del tuo tirocinio riceve un'addestramento fondato sulle nostre immunologia cobas®-systeme e sarai seguito da un mentore fermo o una mentore durante tutto il tuo impiego esterno. Sarai impiegato nella regione di Niedersachsen, Amburgo, Brema e potrai godere della libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residenza all'interno di questo territorio (ideale che sia nella regione di Amburgo, Hannover, Brema). I seguenti punti saranno al centro del tuo tirocinio nel servizio esterno:
• Formazione professionale: assolverai un addestramento di manutenzione specializzata a due moduli di immuno (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801) nel mese di settembre (28.09. - 02.10.2026).
• Pratica tecnica: dimostraerai le do abilità manuali e tecniche direttamente durante le installazioni di apparecchiature e le manutenzioni pregiudizi.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: ricevere una profonda comprensione dell'analisi e della risoluzione di complesse questioni tecniche e applicative e supporterai attivamente il nostro team nella ricerca delle cause.
• Cambio di prospettiva: ti concentrerai sui settori di chimica clinica e immunologia, ma avrai sempre la possibilità di conoscere altri settori interessantii dell'azienda attraverso le visite di ospitalità.
• Tema di futuro IT: i reti di rete IT e la sicurezza IT ti eccitano - durante l'installazione di firewall imparerai direttamente dagli esperti IT.
• Autonomia personale: porterai le do abilità organizzative e assumerai compiti di lavoro autonomi definiti (ad esempio, l'addestramento professionale dei nostri clienti nella utilizzazione della nostra piattaforma online Navify).
• Abilità di comunicazione: affinerai le do abilità di comunicazione nel dialogo diretto con i nostri clienti e nella discussione collettiva nel team.
• Flessibilità: compilauterai piccoli progetti autonomiamente a casa, ma la maggior parte del tempo sarai là dove si trovano le nostre apparecchiature: direttamente presso i nostri clienti.
• Campo di crescita: offriamo un ambiente di crescita e rispettoso, dove puoi sviluppare le do abilità e realizzare i tuoi obiettivi. jobs.title: Solution Architect, Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

jobs.title: Marketing Support (Working Student)

titleByLocale.fr: Soutien à la commercialisation (étudiant en cours d'emploi)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. In this part-time role, you will support our team across various marketing initiatives, from administrative tasks to digital media campaigns and creative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic diagnostics environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Conseil Juridique Principal, Confidentialité aux États-Unis

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We believe in the potential of science, data and insights to improve the standard of care for humankind. We also believe the right to privacy is a fundamental human right. We process personal data with due care. Team members of the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team contribute their talents with a strong focus on collaboration and teamwork to support Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, North America affiliates and Group colleagues on privacy and digital legal matters.

As Senior Counsel, US Privacy, you would join our North America Digital & Privacy team to play a key role in providing legal advice on a wide range of matters related to data protection, digital initiatives, US privacy laws and regulations, and data governance.

The Opportunity

○ Provide guidance to key stakeholders including, other Legal and Compliance colleagues, the business and the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team in order to support the organizations’ compliance with US state and federal privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, TCPA), and other applicable data protection and privacy laws and regulations. Such guidance may include:
• ○ Review privacy impact assessments for new projects and technologies and advise on risk mitigation strategies.
• ○ Support the Diagnostics US Privacy Office in developing and maintaining policies, procedure and communications.
• ○ Develop and conduct training programs for our Legal and Compliance colleagues and other workforce members on compliance with data privacy laws and best practices for data governance.
• ○ Review and negotiate contracts with third parties, ensuring that data protection and privacy clauses align with Roche’s policies and positions.
• ○ Advise and support during the response to a suspected Breach or other data privacy incidents, including internal investigations and advising on notification and reporting obligations.
• ○ Stay updated on applicable cybersecurity requirements, new digital technologies like blockchain, AI, and the Internet of Things and advise on their legal implications.
○ Develop and maintain networks by working closely with other Legal and Compliance colleagues, IT security, People & Culture, Finance, Support Services, and other business teams to ensure a cohesive approach to US data protection and digital operations.

Who You Are

You are someone who has:

● A Doctor of Jurisprudence from an ABA-accredited law school, licensed to practice law in one or more of the 50 states in good standing.
● At least eight (8) years’ experience practicing law at a large- to medium-sized law firm or experience within a privacy, compliance, legal or contracting department in a Life Sciences company (i.e., Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech).
● Knowledge of, and working experience advising on data privacy and digital matters, federal, state, and international information security and privacy laws, rules, regulations, and industry standards (such as HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR).
● Experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating; experience with information security and privacy provisions in agreements, Business Associate Agreements and data transfer or processing agreements is preferred.
● A demonstrated ability to establish and maintain open, candid, collaborative, and trusting work relationships.
● An ability to exercise independent judgment and deliver a consistent message in the face of pressure or adversity, and to work with and mai
