jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Key Account Manager (KAM) , serás responsable de liderar la ejecución de la estrategia integral de Roche en las cuentas estratégicas asignadas y dentro de tu squad de trabajo en Paraguay, bajo el modelo operativo ágil ReImagine Latam . Tu propósito será orquestar planes de cuenta estratégicos que integren innovación, gestión de relaciones de alto nivel (C-Suite) y planificación de ventas, actuando como un socio consultor experto que conecte la visión de la organización con las necesidades del cliente para maximizar la rentabilidad y acelerar el acceso de la innovación a los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Liderar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, el forecast comercial y la gestión eficiente de los presupuestos en el territorio asignado.

• Diseñar y orquestar los Account Plans integrando objetivos estratégicos, planificación de la base instalada (IP) e innovación para maximizar la cuota de mercado.

• Trabajar proactivamente dentro del modelo operativo de Squad , colaborando de forma transversal con áreas como Finanzas, Servicio Técnico, Supply, Médica y Marketing.

• Liderar con autonomía la renovación de contratos y la gestión integral del ciclo de vida de la cuenta para mitigar riesgos de pérdida de negocio.

• Identificar y desarrollar activamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling para expandir el portafolio de soluciones en cada cuenta.

• Diseñar soluciones de negocio a medida y Business Cases de alto impacto que demuestren el retorno de inversión (ROI) ante perfiles directivos y tomadores de decisión.

• Mantener actualizado de forma impecable el pipeline de ventas, los contactos clave y los planes estratégicos por cuenta dentro de la plataforma CRM.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en áreas de la Salud, Gestión Empresarial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

• Trayectoria comprobable de más de 5 años en la industria de la salud, con una fuerte preferencia dentro del sector de Diagnóstico (IVD).

• Experiencia sólida gestionando cuentas complejas de alto desempeño y mapeando roles de decisión clave a nivel directivo (C-Level).

• Habilidades avanzadas en venta consultiva, competencias de comunicación estratégica, disciplina operativa y fuerte orientación a resultados.

• Capacidad probada para trabajar de manera autónoma, colaborativa (Framework VACC) y con alta resiliencia en entornos de volatilidad y complejidad.

• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para radicarte en Asunción y realizar viajes de negocio tanto al interior como al exterior del país según las necesidades comerciales.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer - Roche Cloud Platform Azure

titleByLocale.it: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingegnere - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.en: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.de: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingenieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.fr: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingénieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer is a highly skilled, technology-agnostic expert responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. In this role, you will leverage your deep knowledge of IT infrastructure's impact on Roche's business to make critical technical decisions with considerable independence. As a leader, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor global teams, and ensure that all technical designs and deliveries align with long-term organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Acts as a multi-disciplinary, technology-agnostic solution architect, designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated and resilient solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. Demonstrates a broad view of how different solutions work together and adapt to business demands, taking accountability for ultimate decision-making in technical design and delivery with considerable independent judgment.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Utilizes outstanding problem-solving skills to develop innovative technological ideas and guide them into final products. Follows industry advancements closely to evaluate promising technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) across technology domains. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions, maintains related component standards, and provides internal escalation support to resolve major incidents proactively.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex information and potential solutions across the organization, including to the most senior levels of the business, in non-technical terms. Leads as a consultant to senior managers on technology strategy, policies, and objectives, while managing relationships with line-of-business stakeholders. Influences technology vendors and collaborates extensively with IT partners, such as Enterprise Architects and Solution Owners, to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes strategic decisions that significantly affect departmental goals and leads large to enterprise-level project teams to ensure successful implementation. Ensures that all solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF). Plays a pivotal role in project planning by estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Drives success across multiple product lines within a domain by collaborating effectively with diverse, virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, acting as a recognized expert with proven depth and breadth across many areas. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of multiple Roche business areas beyond IT infrastructure, understanding exactly how infrastructure impacts business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting and implementing Azure cloud network solutions , in depth knowledge of advanced Azure networking architectures and interconnectivity options

• General network engineering experience

• Infrastructure as code software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

La posizione Descrizione del lavoro L'Ingegnere di rete per infrastrutture IT di Azure Cloud è un esperto altamente qualificato e diagnostico della tecnologia responsabile della soluzione di problemi aziendali insolitamente complessi con soluzioni innovative in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. In questo ruolo, potrete sfruttare la vostra profonda conoscenza dell'impatto dell'infrastruttura IT sul business di Roche per prendere decisioni tecniche critiche con notevole indipendenza. In qualità di leader, influenzerai proattivamente la strategia tecnologica, tutor team globali, e ti assicurerai che tutti i progetti tecnici e le consegne si allineino agli obiettivi organizzativi a lungo termine e agli standard normativi. • Scope / (Content Leadership): agisce come architetto di soluzioni multidisciplinari e diagnostiche, progettando, costruendo, testando e implementando soluzioni integrate e resilienti in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. Dimostra un ampio punto di vista sul modo in cui le diverse soluzioni lavorano insieme e si adattano alle esigenze aziendali, tenendo conto della responsabilità del processo decisionale definitivo nella progettazione tecnica e nella consegna con un giudizio indipendente considerevole.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): consente di ottenere il successo su più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio collaborando efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: si basa su principi tecnici avanzati, teorie e concetti, che agiscono come esperto riconosciuto con profondità e larghezza comprovate in molte aree. Dimostra la conoscenza approfondita di più aree aziendali Roche oltre l'infrastruttura IT, capire esattamente come l'infrastruttura influisce sui processi aziendali. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Dimostrata esperienza nell'architettura e nell'implementazione di soluzioni di rete cloud Azure, conoscenza approfondita delle architetture avanzate di rete Azure e delle opzioni di interconnessione

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer is a highly skilled, technology-agnostic expert responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. In this role, you will leverage your deep knowledge of IT infrastructure's impact on Roche's business to make critical technical decisions with considerable independence. As a leader, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor global teams, and ensure that all technical designs and deliveries align with long-term organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Acts as a multi-disciplinary, technology-agnostic solution architect, designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated and resilient solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. Demonstrates a broad view of how different solutions work together and adapt to business demands, taking accountability for ultimate decision-making in technical design and delivery with considerable independent judgment.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Utilizes outstanding problem-solving skills to develop innovative technological ideas and guide them into final products. Follows industry advancements closely to evaluate promising technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) across technology domains. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions, maintains related component standards, and provides internal escalation support to resolve major incidents proactively.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex information and potential solutions across the organization, including to the most senior levels of the business, in non-technical terms. Leads as a consultant to senior managers on technology strategy, policies, and objectives, while managing relationships with line-of-business stakeholders. Influences technology vendors and collaborates extensively with IT partners, such as Enterprise Architects and Solution Owners, to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes strategic decisions that significantly affect departmental goals and leads large to enterprise-level project teams to ensure successful implementation. Ensures that all solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF). Plays a pivotal role in project planning by estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Drives success across multiple product lines within a domain by collaborating effectively with diverse, virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, acting as a recognized expert with proven depth and breadth across many areas. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of multiple Roche business areas beyond IT infrastructure, understanding exactly how infrastructure impacts business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting and implementing Azure cloud network solutions , in depth knowledge of advanced Azure networking architectures and interconnectivity options

• General network engineering experience

• Infrastructure as code software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

• Impact/Stratégie: prend des décisions stratégiques qui ont une incidence importante sur les objectifs du Ministère et mène de vastes équipes de projet à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour assurer une mise en oeuvre réussie. S'assure que toutes les solutions sont conformes aux normes de qualité et de réglementation et respectent le cadre d'architecture technique (CTA) de l'organisation. Joue un rôle central dans la planification des projets en estimant les ressources, les dépendances, les risques et les échéanciers d'ingénierie.

Dirige les équipes géo-distribuées par l'influence et le mentorat, fournissant des conseils spécialisés pour optimiser la performance et l'innovation.
• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Applique des principes techniques, des théories et des concepts avancés, agissant en tant qu'expert reconnu avec la profondeur et l'étendue prouvées dans de nombreux domaines. Démontrer une connaissance approfondie de multiples secteurs d'activité de Roche au-delà de l'infrastructure de TI, comprendre exactement comment l'infrastructure influe sur les processus opérationnels. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• L'architecture et la mise en œuvre de solutions de réseau en nuage Azure, en profondeur, des architectures avancées de réseau Azure et des options d'interconnexion
• Expérience générale en ingénierie de réseau
• Infrastructure comme logiciel de code: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - Pharmacometrician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities :
Accountable for the scientific and technical quality and the timeliness of the pharmacometric (i.e. Modeling and Simulation - M&S) support provided for development projects within one or several Disease Translational Areas (DTA) by integration of scientific knowledge from literature and pre-clinical and clinical studies into mathematical models, in order to support optimal decision making in drug development from exploratory phase to confirmatory phase. Additionally, the position offers professional latitude to allocate dedicated time toward methodological innovation, evaluation of new modeling techniques, and standard process optimization to expand functional modeling excellence. For candidates with strong background or interest in clinical pharmacology, a dual-role framework can be customized.

• Develops and maintains timely, scientifically sound, innovative and business-oriented M&S strategy for the projects within or across DTA in accordance with the overall DTA Clinical Pharmacology strategy defined by the DTA Clinical Pharmacologist and the DTA disease Modeling Leader
• Develops and executes appropriate (population) pharmacokinetic and (population) pharmacodynamic models for the project and applies, if available for the project, empirical and/or mechanistically-based drug disease models
• Conducts simulations to illustrate the impact of development decisions such as dosage regimen selection and other trial design features as well as reporting of the respective outcome for internal decision making or NDA documents or peer reviewed journals
• Interacts on a scientific level with the Clinical Pharmacologist with regards to all aspects of the integration of M&S to ensure efficient and appropriate M&S strategy and activities for the project
• Prepares information and strategy for presentation at pRED and PD project team meetings in order to ensure consistency of M&S activities/objectives with overall project goals and with current Roche standards
• Ensures that members of the project team and management have a sufficient understanding of the M&S methods and results applied to the project
• Ensures that M&S strategy and results are integrated into internal and external project documents (e.g. Clinical Development Plan, Investigator Brochure)
• Manages consultants and outside collaborators that provide M&S expertise for individual tasks or entire projects.
• Ensures that M&S activities performed within the project are executed in a timely manner and to the required high statistical, pharmacological and other reporting standards
• Develops and maintains specific scientific expertise in new and emerging areas of Pharmacometrics. Establishes and manages external contacts and alliances in this field and ensures that knowledge for the assigned areas is shared effectively throughout the department.
• Provides mentorship and scientific and professional leadership to other members of the Clinical Pharmacology department.
• For candidates with strong background or interest in clinical pharmacology for local and global, a dual-role framework can be customized.

Qualifications:
Medical degree or PharmD or PhD in natural science with relevant related experience in the planning and conduct of M&S projects for pre-clinical or clinical study data (preferably in a pharmaceutical industry setting)

Experience and/or Competencies Required :
• Experience in planning and conduct of M&S projects for pre-clinical and clinical study data.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Responsabilità e responsabilità principali: Contabile per la qualità scientifica e tecnica e la tempestività del supporto farmacometrico (cioè Modeling and Simulation - M&S) fornito per progetti di sviluppo all'interno di uno o più Aree Traduzionali Malattie (DTA) mediante l'integrazione delle conoscenze scientifiche dalla letteratura e studi preclinici e clinici in modelli matematici, al fine di sostenere il processo decisionale ottimale nello sviluppo della droga dalla fase esplorativa alla fase di confermatoria. Inoltre, la posizione offre latitudine professionale per assegnare il tempo dedicato all'innovazione metodologica, alla valutazione di nuove tecniche di modellazione e all'ottimizzazione dei processi standard per espandere l'eccellenza della modellazione funzionale. Per i candidati con un forte background o interesse nella farmacologia clinica, un quadro a due rulli può essere personalizzato.
• Sviluppa e mantiene la strategia M&S tempestiva, scientificamente sana, innovativa e orientata al business per i progetti all'interno o attraverso DTA in conformità con la strategia globale di DTA Clinical Pharmacology definita dal DTA Clinical Pharmacologist e dalla DTA Disease Modeling Leader
• Sviluppa ed esegue i modelli farmacocinetici e farmacodinamici appropriati (popolazione) per il progetto e si applica, se disponibili per il progetto, modelli empirici e/o meccanizzati di malattia della droga
• Conduce simulazioni per illustrare l'impatto delle decisioni di sviluppo, come la selezione del regime di dosaggio e altre caratteristiche di progettazione di prova, nonché la segnalazione del rispettivo risultato per il processo decisionale interno o documenti NDA o riviste peer-review
• Interagisce a livello scientifico con il Farmacologo Clinico per quanto riguarda tutti gli aspetti dell'integrazione di M&S per garantire una strategia e attività M&S efficienti e appropriate per il progetto
• Prepara le informazioni e la strategia per la presentazione alle riunioni del team di progetto pRED e PD al fine di garantire la coerenza delle attività/oggettive M&S con obiettivi di progetto globali e con gli attuali standard Roche
• Assicura che i membri del team di progetto e della gestione abbiano una sufficiente comprensione dei metodi e dei risultati M&S applicati al progetto
• Assicura che la strategia e i risultati M&S siano integrati in documenti di progetto interni ed esterni (ad esempio Piano di Sviluppo Clinico, Brochure Investigator)
• Gestisce consulenti e collaboratori esterni che forniscono competenze M&S per singoli compiti o interi progetti.
• Assicura che le attività M&S svolte all'interno del progetto siano eseguite in modo tempestivo e agli elevati standard statistici, farmacologici e di segnalazione richiesti
• Sviluppa e mantiene specifiche competenze scientifiche nelle aree nuove ed emergenti della Farmacometrica. Stabilisce e gestisce contatti e alleanze esterne in questo campo e assicura che la conoscenza delle aree assegnate sia condivisa efficacemente in tutto il dipartimento.
• Fornisce mentorship e leadership scientifica e professionale ad altri membri del dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica.
• Per i candidati con forte background o interesse nella farmacologia clinica per il locale e globale, è possibile personalizzare un quadro a due rulli. Qualifiche: Grado medico o PharmD o PhD in scienze naturali con relativa esperienza nella pianificazione e nella conduzione di progetti M&S per dati di studio preclinici o clinici (preferibilmente in un ambiente di industria farmaceutica) Esperienza e/o competenze necessarie:
• Esperienza nella pianificazione e nella conduzione di progetti M&S per i dati di studio preclinici e clinici.

• Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung einer zeitnahen, wissenschaftlich fundierten, innovativen und geschäftsorientierten M&S-Strategie für die Projekte innerhalb oder innerhalb des DTA gemäß der vom DTA Clinical Pharmacology und dem DTA Disease Modeling Leader definierten Gesamtstrategie für klinische Pharmakologie

B. die Auswahl des Dosierungsschemas und andere Merkmale des Studiendesigns sowie die Berichterstattung über das jeweilige Ergebnis für interne Entscheidungsfindungen oder NDA-Dokumente oder Peer-Review-Zeitschriften

De plus, le poste offre une latitude professionnelle pour consacrer du temps à l'innovation méthodologique, à l'évaluation des nouvelles techniques de modélisation et à l'optimisation standard des processus afin d'accroître l'excellence de la modélisation fonctionnelle. Pour les candidats ayant de solides antécédents ou qui s'intéressent à la pharmacologie clinique, un cadre à double rôle peut être personnalisé.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Principal Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.This is a hands-on role focused on solving the fluidic and consumable challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. We are looking for someone who exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to our automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

• Contribute to architecture, design, research and early development of specialized consumables and mating mechanisms.

• Contribute to the layout, prototyping, and characterization of new fluidic circuits and architectures.

• Create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and material specifications with a focus on chemical compatibility and robustness.

• Conduct cross-functional design reviews. Present progress, data, and engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Principal Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.This is a hands-on role focused on solving the fluidic and consumable challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. We are looking for someone who exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to our automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Core Responsibilities:

• Contribute to architecture, design, research and early development of specialized consumables and mating mechanisms.

• Contribute to the layout, prototyping, and characterization of new fluidic circuits and architectures.

• Design, build, and assemble custom test fixtures to support testing of fluidic subsystems and novel consumables.

• Translate high-level system and assay requirements into fluidic schematics, system architectures and concepts to evaluate, compare, and downselect design paths.

• Create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and material specifications with a focus on chemical compatibility and robustness.

• Conduct cross-functional design reviews. Present progress, data, and engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA. (This is not a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are
(Required)

• You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant years of industry experience (7+ years for a Bachelor's, 5+ years for a Master's, or 3+ years for a PhD).

• You have demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex fluidic manifolds, consumable interfaces, or moving mechanisms, preferably for life science or diagnostic instrumentation.

• You have a high level of proficiency with Python for device control, automated test bench execution, and data acquisition/analysis.

• You have a strong background in experimental design for fluidic characterization.

• You have a high level of proficiency with machine shop tools, measurement equipment, and rapid prototyping technologies.

• You have demonstrated expertise in SolidWorks for detailed assembly design and the creation of manufacturing drawings.

• You have demonstrated troubleshooting skills, with a solid understanding of physics, chemistry and engineering fundamentals.

Preferred:

• You have experience with plastic bonding techniques and injection molding principles.

• You have experience utilizing CFD or FEA tools to guide fluidic and thermal design decisions.

• You have experience developing DNA sequencing, DNA synthesizers and other complex fluidic automation instrumentation.

Molecular Account Executive - Clinical MD

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory is Utah, Northern Arizona. You must live within 50 miles of the territory.

Travel expectation: 50% Overnight

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Bioinformatics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is working to improve DNA sequencing data analysis. Roche is innovating new approaches that fundamentally change when and where DNA sequencing gets processed. Our goal is to analyze data as it's generated, where it’s generated.

We are seeking a visionary and deeply technical leader to champion the customer-facing bioinformatics and software strategy for our revolutionary Axelios sequencing platform. As we launch XOOS —our cutting-edge ecosystem of bioinformatics tools—you will be the bridge between our pioneering new customers and our internal development teams.

This is not a traditional role. You will lead an elite team of bioinformatics scientists and software engineers to create bespoke, high-impact solutions, resolve sophisticated technical roadblocks, and even engage in collaborative research with early adopters. Because the Axelios platform operates on a completely different paradigm than traditional Sequencing-by-Synthesis (SBS), you will be instrumental in educating the market, ensuring seamless migration to our tools, and translating complex customer feedback into actionable development pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Customer Advocacy & Technical Enablement: Serve as the primary executive-level technical contact for new customers, driving deep adoption of the XOOS bioinformatics ecosystem across major clinical and research applications.

• Team Leadership: Build, inspire, and manage a high-performing team of customer-facing bioinformatics scientists and solutions architects.

• Bespoke Solution Engineering: Lead the creation of customized workflows, data analysis pipelines, and software integrations to solve unique customer pain points and accelerate Axelios platform adoption.

• Collaborative Research: Partner with strategic early-adopter customers on collaborative research projects, co-authoring whitepapers, and demonstrating the unique capabilities of Axelios non-SBS data.

• Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Act as a critical strategic partner to internal Bioinformatics and Software R&D teams, synthesizing market requirements, feature requests, and technical friction points into the product roadmap.

• Commercial & Technical Strategy: Collaborate with Sales and Product Management to support high-value customer engagements, technical evaluations, and complex contract closures.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA or San Diego, CA. (This is a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D.in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 4+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 6+ years of industry experience.

• You have 8+ years of progressive experience in next-generation sequencing (NGS) bioinformatics, with a demonstrated track record of leadership in an industry setting.

• You have a significant level of expertise and comprehensive knowledge of the NGS landscape, clinical genomics space, and secondary/tertiary data analysis pipelines.

• You demonstrated leadership experience.

• You have a high level of proficiency with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern software development practices, pipeline frameworks (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake), and scripting languages (Python, R).

• You have demonstrated experience in product commercialization, go-to-market execution, or technical c

• Hai 8+ anni di esperienza progressiva nella sequenziamento di prossima generazione (NGS) bioinformatica, con una traccia dimostrata di leadership in un ambiente industriale.
• Hai un livello significativo di competenze e una conoscenza completa del paesaggio NGS, dello spazio di genomica clinica e delle condotte di analisi dati secondarie/terziarie.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza di leadership.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con le architetture cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), le moderne pratiche di sviluppo del software, i framework pipeline (ad esempio, Nextflow, Snakemake), e le lingue di scripting (Python, R).
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella commercializzazione dei prodotti, nell'esecuzione del go-to-market, o c tecnico

Roche entwickelt neue Ansätze, die grundlegend verändern, wann und wo DNA-Sequenzierung verarbeitet wird. Unser Ziel ist es, Daten zu analysieren, wie sie generiert werden, wo sie generiert werden. Mit der Einführung von XOOS – unserem innovativen Ökosystem von Bioinformatik-Tools – werden Sie die Brücke zwischen unseren bahnbrechenden neuen Kunden und unseren internen Entwicklungsteams sein. Dies ist keine traditionelle Rolle. Sie werden ein Elite-Team von Bioinformatik-Wissenschaftlern und Software-Ingenieuren führen, um maßgeschneiderte, wirkungsvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln, anspruchsvolle technische Hindernisse zu lösen und sogar gemeinsame Forschung mit Early Adopters zu betreiben. Da die Axelios-Plattform nach einem völlig anderen Paradigma als herkömmliche SBS (Sequencing-by-Synthesis) arbeitet, sind Sie maßgeblich an der Aufklärung des Marktes, der nahtlosen Migration zu unseren Tools und der Umsetzung komplexer Kundenfeedbacks in umsetzbare Entwicklungspipelines beteiligt. Die Chance
• Customer Advocacy & Technical Enablement: Dienen Sie als primärer technischer Ansprechpartner auf Führungsebene für neue Kunden und fördern Sie die umfassende Einführung des XOOS-Bioinformatik-Ökosystems in wichtigen klinischen und Forschungsanwendungen.
• Teamführung: Aufbauen, inspirieren und verwalten Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Bioinformatikern und Lösungsarchitekten mit Kundenkontakt.
• Maßgeschneidertes Solution Engineering: Führen Sie die Erstellung maßgeschneiderter Workflows, Datenanalyse-Pipelines und Softwareintegrationen, um einzigartige Kundenprobleme zu lösen und die Einführung der Axelios-Plattform zu beschleunigen. Collaborative Research: Partnerschaft mit strategischen Early-Adopter-Kunden bei Verbundforschungsprojekten, Co-Authoring-Whitepapers und Demonstration der einzigartigen Fähigkeiten von Axelios-Nicht-SBS-Daten.

• Kommerzielle und technische Strategie: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebs- und Produktmanagement, um hochwertige Kundenbindungen, technische Bewertungen und komplexe Vertragsabschlüsse zu unterstützen. Diese Position basiert vor Ort in Santa Clara, CA oder San Diego, CA. (Dies ist eine hybride Position.) Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Rolle nicht angeboten. Wer Du bist: (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Ph.D.in Bioinformatik, Computational Biology, Informatik oder ein verwandtes quantitatives Feld mit 4+ Jahren Branchenerfahrung; oder einen Master-Abschluss in Bioinformatik, Computational Biology, Informatik oder ein verwandtes quantitatives Feld mit 6+ Jahren Branchenerfahrung.
• Sie verfügen über mehr als 8 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Bioinformatik der nächsten Generation für Sequenzierung (NGS), mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz in einer Branche.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Fachwissen und umfassende Kenntnisse der NGS-Landschaft, des klinischen Genomikraums und der sekundären / tertiären Datenanalyse-Pipelines.
• Sie haben Führungserfahrung gezeigt.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen in Cloud-Architekturen (AWS, Azure oder GCP), modernen Softwareentwicklungspraktiken, Pipeline-Frameworks (z. B. Nextflow, Snakemake) und Skriptsprachen (Python, R).
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Produktvermarktung, Go-to-Market-Ausführung oder technischen c gezeigt

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies.

The Opportunity
As the Subchapter Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, you will stand at the intersection of cutting-edge science and people leadership. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Wir bieten einzigartige Möglichkeiten für Pathologen, die daran interessiert sind, eine Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Assays zu spielen, die entscheidend für unser Ziel sind, Patienten mehr Zugang zu innovativen neuen Therapien zu bieten. Die Chance Als Unterkapitel Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, stehen Sie an der Schnittstelle von Spitzenwissenschaft und People Leadership. Mit Sitz in unserem Campus in Tucson, AZ, leiten Sie ein erstklassiges Team von Pathologen, das sich der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Diagnostik und gezielter Krebstherapien widmet. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die strategische und wissenschaftliche Führung bei der Überwachung von Pathologieoperationen, die jährlich mehr als 100 neue und bestehende Produktentwicklungsinitiativen und -verbesserungen in Primärantikörpern, Spezialbereichen, digitaler Pathologie, Begleitdiagnostik und Instrumenten unterstützen. Ihr Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Ermöglichung innovativer Diagnostik, die Präzisionsmedizin und gezielte Krebstherapien weltweit unterstützt. In dieser Rolle managen Sie nicht nur – Sie betreuen, inspirieren und arbeiten praxisnah mit Spitzentechnologien, um die Patientenversorgung weltweit zu verändern.
• People Leadership & Development: Direkt, Mentor und fördern das professionelle Wachstum von Instrua hochspezialisierten Team von Pathologen und 6-7 Teamleiter. Fördern Sie eine Kultur der Innovation, der Zusammenarbeit und des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Medizinische Aufsicht für tägliche Path Lab-Aktivitäten.

Fortgeschrittene Assay-Entwicklung: Führen Sie das Team bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung komplexer Assays unter Verwendung erstklassiger Technologien, darunter:
• Immunhistochemie (IHC) und In-situ-Hybridisierung (ISH) Immunfluoreszenz (IF) und Multiplex-Assays
• Digitale Pathologie und KI-gesteuerte Bildanalyse
• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Life-Science-Unternehmen, klinischen Studienteams, Regulierungsbehörden und internen F & E-Stakeholdern Innovation Champion: Bleiben Sie Branchentrends und aufkommenden Pathologietechnologien voraus, um Roches Position als Marktführer für Begleitdiagnostik und Onkologie zu behaupten Wer Du bist: Sie sind eine visionäre Führungskraft, die tiefe klinische Expertise mit einer Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen in Einklang bringt. Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen und sind motiviert durch die konkreten Auswirkungen Ihrer Arbeit auf Krebspatienten weltweit.

• Sie haben mehr als 10 Jahre Management und Führung in einer pharmazeutischen, diagnostischen oder großen akademischen oder medizinischen Umgebung.

Nous offrons des possibilités uniques aux pathologistes intéressés à jouer un rôle dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux tests essentiels à notre objectif d'offrir plus de patients accès à de nouvelles thérapies innovantes. L'opportunité En tant que sous-chapitre responsable du développement clinique, Chef de la pathologie, vous serez à l'intersection de la science de pointe et du leadership humain. Basé sur notre campus Tucson, AZ, vous dirigerez une équipe de pathologistes de classe mondiale dédiée à façonner l'avenir des diagnostics et des thérapies ciblées contre le cancer. Dans ce rôle, vous fournissez un leadership stratégique et scientifique tout en surveillant les opérations de pathologie qui soutiennent plus de 100 initiatives de développement de produits nouveaux et existants et des améliorations annuelles à travers les anticorps primaires, les stains spéciaux, la pathologie numérique, les diagnostics et les instruments de compagnon. Votre équipe joue un rôle crucial en permettant des diagnostics innovants qui soutiennent la médecine de précision et des thérapies contre le cancer ciblées dans le monde entier. Dans ce rôle, vous ne vous contentez pas de gérer — vous êtes mentor, inspirant et travaillant main-d'oeuvre avec des technologies de pointe pour transformer les soins aux patients à l'échelle mondiale.
• People Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, et favoriser le développement professionnel d'Instrua équipe hautement spécialisée de pathologistes et 6-7 chefs d'équipe. Favoriser une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'apprentissage continu. Surveillance médicale des activités quotidiennes du laboratoire Path.
• Stratégie scientifique et clinique: servir d'expert en pathologie au sein de l'unité de diagnostic et oncologie Companion, assurant la rigueur scientifique et la pertinence clinique dans tous les programmes de développement de tests.
• Développement avancé de l'essai : guidez l'équipe dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre d'essais complexes utilisant des technologies de pointe, notamment :
• Immunohistochimie (IHC) et hybridation in situ (ISH)
• Essais d'immunofluorescence (IF) et de multiplex
• Pathologie numérique et analyse d'images par l'IA
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: partenariat étroit avec des entreprises de sciences de la vie, des équipes d'essais cliniques, des organismes de réglementation et des intervenants internes en R-D
• Champion de l'innovation : restez en avance sur les tendances de l'industrie et les nouvelles technologies de pathologie pour maintenir Roches comme leader du marché en diagnostic et oncologie Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui équilibre une expertise clinique profonde avec une passion pour le développement des gens. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements collaboratifs et rapides et êtes motivé par l'impact tangible que votre travail a sur les patients atteints de cancer dans le monde entier.
• Vous êtes un MD avec la certification US Board en pathologie anatomique
• Vous avez plus de 10 ans de gestion des personnes et de leadership au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, de diagnostic ou de centre universitaire ou médical majeur.
• Vous avez une expertise approfondie en pathologie oncologique et une expérience pratique des biomarqueurs à base de tissus (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Vous connaissez bien les processus de développement, y compris les flux de travail de pathologie numérique, les outils d'analyse d'image, le cas clinique et le CAP/CLIA

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Backend (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a Senior Software Engineer Backend, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Software Engineer Backend who will work closely with their backend colleagues, and who ideally has built digital products and platforms. As a code-magician, you will support our efforts to improve the digital health ecosystem. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!
You will be part of the Platform Engineering chapter working on our navify platform.

Essentials skills for your mission:

• At least 5 years of experience working as a software engineer including 2 years as a backend engineer.

• You are familiar with the following backend technologies: Java 21+ and frameworks like Spring Boot 3+

• SQL and relational databases (e.g.PostgreSQL) are second nature to you

• You have experience with OpenID Connect standard and Keycloak or other open source software product that allows single sign-on with identity and access management

• You have experience building AI/LLM-powered backend services and tools

• You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable, and performant backend code, serving our beautiful applications

• You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code, and future-proof architectures

• You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud providers

• You enjoy guiding and sharing your knowledge with other engineers

• Great written and verbal communication in English

Bonus skills:

• Experienced in automated testing with Selenium or Selenide

• Knowledge of Infra as Code, Terraform and Github Actions

• Understanding of medical, security, and privacy regulations

• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)

• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation

• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world!

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the spec

jobs.title: Account Value Partner (Sales - Upper South)

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la valeur du compte

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner (Sales - Upper South), 1 year contract
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS

titleByLocale.it: Standard clinici di dati e Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.en: Clinical Data Standards and Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.de: Clinical Data Standards und Master Data Digital Solution Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Normes relatives aux données cliniques et solution numérique de base

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Il ruolo di un architetto dell'informazione è comprendere i processi aziendali e gli oggetti informativi e lavorare con i membri del team informatico e aziendale per identificare e progettare flussi di informazioni e standard informativi che soddisfino le esigenze aziendali. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lavora per garantire la coerenza all'interno e tra i gruppi e promuove il riutilizzo e la semplicità degli oggetti informativi. L'architetto dell'informazione lo farà identificando, classificando, standardizzando gli oggetti informativi e creando flussi di informazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate aziendali, gli architetti di soluzioni, gli architetti di software, i partner commerciali IT e gli analisti aziendali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e mantenere il panorama informativo completo e semplificare i flussi di informazioni in entrata e in uscita per MRHub.
• Stabilire e applicare standard critici e governance per gli oggetti informativi in ​​stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'ingegneria dei dati.
• Promuovere la garanzia della qualità eseguendo revisioni periodiche sulla conformità e l'integrità di tutti gli oggetti informativi e dei flussi architettonici.
• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team operativi e di progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare requisiti di informazioni e oggetti complessi per MRHub per garantire tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e facile accesso.
• Supportare la correzione dei flussi di dati non ottimali all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni complessive del sistema.
• Garantire l'accuratezza dell'architettura mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattino alle strategie IT/aziendali.
• Collaborare con team Agile e Solution Architect per documentare gli standard di governance, conformità e dati master all'interno dell'architettura della soluzione. Chi sei:
• Vasta esperienza nella guida di progetti complessi di data science e architettura dell'informazione dall'inizio alla fine con una spinta verso un impatto aziendale significativo. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .
Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions and data frameworks .

• Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks, information lifecycles, and governance best practices .

• Deep technical proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, coupled with the ability to architect and maintain complex version control workflows using Git.

• Comprehensive expertise in cloud-native database manageme
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten besteht darin, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt strebt die Konsistenz innerhalb und zwischen Gruppen an und fördert die Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt und dabei eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Lösungsarchitekten, Softwarearchitekten, IT-Geschäftspartnern und Geschäftsanalysten zusammenarbeitet. Die Chance:
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl den eingehenden als auch den ausgehenden Informationsfluss für MRHub.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Engineering Lead kritische Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte etablieren und durchsetzen.
• Fördern Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Konformität und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und Architekturabläufe.
• Bereitstellung strategischer Führung bei der Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf globale Informatikziele.
• Identifizieren und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und -objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einen einfachen Zugriff sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Behebung suboptimaler Datenflüsse innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Effizienz und Leistung des Gesamtsystems zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, um strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnisse in der Gestaltung und Implementierung unternehmensweiter Data-Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Best Practices für die Governance.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Versionskontroll-Workflows mit Git zu entwerfen und zu verwalten.
• Umfassende Expertise im Cloud-nativen Datenbankmanagement
