jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) for People & Culture (P&C) acts as the "Capability Factory" for Roche. We are a team of business-minded technologists who play "offense"—moving beyond supporting systems to architecting a high-performance digital chassis. We aim to amplify human potential by creating a zero-effort, intelligent ecosystem where technology simplifies complexity and empowers every Roche employee to do their best work.

The Opportunity

The Delivery Service Manager (DSM) for Financial & Mobility technology ensures that the "what" and "why" of the product vision are actually realized through a disciplined "how". While other roles may focus on long-term strategy or technical design, the DSM ensures that the delivery ecosystem works together effectively to provide a stable, supportable, and high-value service.

• Backlog Ownership: Manage and prioritize the product backlog by balancing business value, risks, and technical dependencies.

• Requirement Translation: Convert stakeholder needs into clear, "ready" user stories equipped with specific acceptance criteria for the development team.

• Release Planning: Lead operational readiness and impact assessments to ensure feature deployments are successfully integrated into daily operations.

• Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the bridge between business leaders and developers to manage expectations and refine the product roadmap.

• End-to-End Execution: Oversee daily operations and track progress to ensure the stable and reliable delivery of services.

• Vendor Management: Serve as the primary contact for external partners, ensuring they meet quality, scope, and compliance standards in collaboration with the Transformation Lead.

• Quality & Health Monitoring: Monitor system health and maintain performance dashboards to ensure high service availability.

• Risk & Compliance: Maintain audit readiness and internal controls to ensure all delivery activities align with security and regulatory policies.

Who you are

• Domain & Methodological Expertise: Possesses deep technical knowledge in specified systems alongside a strong understanding of IT Service Management and SCRUM methodologies.

• Stakeholder & Communication Mastery: Demonstrates excellent English communication skills and the ability to represent user groups, influencing and managing expectations across all levels of the organization.

• Strategic Prioritization: Combines analytical thinking with a "good enough instead of perfection" philosophy to manage high input volumes and meet objectives effectively.

• Independent & Virtual Collaboration: Proven ability to work with minimal supervision and plan personal workloads while remaining a highly effective contributor to virtual teams.

• Problem-Solving & Growth Mindset: Driven by a passion for continuous learning and sharing knowledge, utilizing a hands-on, customer-service-oriented approach to resolve issues.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.title: Commercial Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Commercial Support Specialist

The Opportunity

As our Commercial Application Support Specialist, you will play an essential role in maintaining the integrity and seamless operation of Roche’s commercial contract management ecosystem. You will serve as a vital link between our business operations and IT systems, ensuring data accuracy and resolving critical inquiries that empower our teams to deliver excellence worldwide.

In this role, you will:

• Drive platform stability by operationally maintaining and supporting Contract Management Lifecycle Deal Solutions systems and their integrations.

• Empower global business users by diagnosing and resolving systems inquiries, tool-handling issues, and data consistency challenges with a strong customer-centric focus.

• Collaborate across ecosystems with diverse stakeholders from local, regional, and global Business and IT teams to implement system releases smoothly.

• Champion data excellence by proactively monitoring data quality, performing root-cause analysis, and leading data cleansing initiatives to support strategic business results.

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert in cross-functional stakeholder meetings, advising on technical limitations, platform logic, and process implications.

• Foster continuous improvement by translating complex technical data into concise, actionable solutions that streamline sales and pricing processes.

Who You Are

You are an upbeat, dynamic professional who is passionate about commercial technologies and digital ecosystems. A natural problem-solver, you look at the big picture to design sustainable, scalable solutions while keeping user experience at the center of everything you do.

To thrive in this role, you bring:

• An Academic Foundation: A BSc/MSc degree in Business Administration, Finance, IT, Economics, or a related field.

• Commercial Systems Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in contract management, commercial operations, or project coordination—ideally within a global or cross-functional environment.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Owner

titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de produits de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a passionate and experienced Data Product Owner ready to drive business value through innovative data solutions? Join Roche's PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) organization as a Senior Data Product Owner!

At Roche, our 10-year Pharma vision is centered on delivering new data analytics solutions to scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). PTE is catalyzing PT's digital transformation, activating data citizenship, and building a FAIR data ecosystem. In this role, you will be pivotal in building, maintaining, and sustaining data products that drive operational excellence and enable impactful decision-making for our patients' benefit.

In this role, you will:

• Define & Communicate Product Vision: Lead the vision and roadmap for data products, aligning with organizational goals and stakeholder needs.

• Lead Data Product Development: Manage the full lifecycle of data products, from ideation to deployment, leveraging Roche’s IT/OT ecosystems for stable, automated solutions.

• Drive Value Delivery & Prioritization: Develop prioritized product backlogs, guiding teams to deliver scalable, reusable data products that achieve measurable business outcomes.

• Ensure Governance & Compliance: Guarantee data products adhere to Roche’s data quality standards, governance policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, GxP).

• Champion Collaboration & Mentorship: Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, fostering harmonization and mentoring other Data Product Owners.
Who You Are:

• 7+ years of agile experience designing and delivering complex data solutions, including 4+ years as a Product Owner or Data Analyst, preferably in the pharma or healthcare industry.

• Proven track record of data management on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake)

• Strong understanding of data architectures, data modeling, data integration (e.g., data mesh, data warehousing), and SDLC/CSV.

• Excellent ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and lead teams in an agile setting.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics

Responsiblities:
Digital

• Provide IT insights and proposals for digital projects, and support customer presentations.

• Solutions design for offering the digital solutions functions and products

• Digital products troubleshoot and provide support for networking devices and virtual machine infrastructure.

• Perform application support and configuration of digital/automation products

Workflow

• Conduct simulation analysis - TAT estimation and support proposals, presentations

• Tender reviews for LAS projects

• Perform layout drawing to visualize ideal layout and workflow to customers

Quality & Process Control

• Manage quality and service issues (QN/SBN) for licensed IT & Automation products, standardize technical documents (implementation, process), and support case escalation to regional/global teams.

Marketing

• Facilitate marketing events related to digital and automation solutions.

• Collaborate with the sales team to strategically promote digital and automation solutions.

• Conduct customer site visits to analyze and document specific requirements.

Training

• Conduct internal trainings/workshops on IT/automation

• Provide support for external customer events and workshops.

• Deliver customer training for automation instruments and various digital solutions

Education

• Bachelor’s Degree in Science/Healthcare/Information Technology or related disciplines
Experience

• At least 3 years experience in marketing / application /product support in IVD or related field
Skills

• Good presentation skill

• Good negotiation and influencing skill

• Team player with good communication and interpersonal skill

• High computer literacy and technical ability

Language

• Fluent speak of Cantonese, Mandarin and English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del Subcapitolo delle Campagne Digitali

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaigns Subchapter Lead at Roche, you'll have the opportunity to develop groundbreaking digital skills while fostering the growth of colleagues across the organization. This role offers an unparalleled chance to advance your leadership and functional expertise.

The Opportunity:

• You will coordinate subchapter operations, onboard and mentor team members, and ensure the team's proficiency in executing high-impact digital campaigns.

• You'll provide strategic vision and direction, optimize processes, manage escalations, and ensure seamless coordination among teams to achieve organizational goals.

• Continuously monitoring and optimizing resource utilization, you will ensure customer satisfaction and the effective delivery of objectives.

• By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, you will encourage team members to grow and develop their digital capabilities.

• You will build strong relationships with other Subchapter Leads to align on strategic priorities, accelerate decision-making, and support each other.

• Additionally, you will gather and share best practices, creating a community of learning and synergy.

• Establishing and maintaining process governance principles, you will ensure proper documentation and adherence to best practices within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• As an experienced professional, you have a minimum of 8 years in digital operations with a proven track record in omnichannel marketing and content delivery.

• You have at least 3 years in coaching, leadership, and people development.

• You are an excellent communicator in English (additional languages are a plus).

• You are skilled in navigating complex, multicultural environments with strong project and change management capabilities.

• As an innovative problem-solver, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and efficient in time management.

• You are able to work under pressure and manage complex issues independently.

• You are also a tech enthusiast, passionate about technology, a quick learner, and proficient with different tools.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a far parte di Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany Roche Digital Technology (STD) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a modellare domani.s futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati, e innovazioni tecnologiche di scalable.Svolto da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutta Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano e guidare scoperte che veramente contano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione personale. Per ora, chiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni a settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, municipi, riunioni di gruppo, e altri eventi collaborativi. L'ERP Solution Consultant conduce in modo indipendente la fornitura di soluzioni ERP, risolve proattivamente i problemi dei prodotti e contribuisce all'architettura. In questo ruolo, guiderai i team di prodotti, la responsabilità dei campioni e comunicherai efficacemente con le parti interessate. Risolverai problemi complessi, prenderai decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornirai una supervisione tecnica e riferirai a livello di prodotto o linea di prodotto. Portando a conoscenza ERP avanzate, competenze approfondite in settori chiave e forti competenze analitiche, contribuirai attivamente al miglioramento continuo e allo sviluppo di team. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Gestione Backlog: Definizione, ordinazione e raffinazione di articoli Backlog prodotto per allinearsi agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Strategia del prodotto: Evaluare i processi SD esistenti per individuare opportunità di ottimizzazione, in particolare nei settori dell'elaborazione automatizzata degli ordini e dell'analisi in tempo reale.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: il trattamento con gli stakeholder di Supply Chain per raccogliere feedback, gestire le aspettative e comunicare gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti.
• Sviluppo: il lavoro con i team Scrum per definire, costruire e convalidare le funzionalità del prodotto durante gli sprint.
• Solution Design & Con 209tion: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features in S/4HANA.
• Personalizzazione manuale del nucleo: eseguire una configurazione e personalizzazione standard SAP, pratiche e indipendenti all'interno del modulo S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) e Material Management (MM).
• Specificazione e progettazione WRICEF: Tradurre requisiti aziendali complessi in specifiche funzionali dettagliate per sviluppi personalizzati, progettare e fornire attivamente articoli WRICEF (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversioni, Miglioramenti e Forme) dall'ideazione all'iper cura.
• Integrazione logistica: agire come il lead funzionale per i touchpoint di integrazione SD con EWM decentralizzato (Extended Warehouse Management) e Embedded TM (Transportation Management) per garantire il flusso senza soluzione di continuità dall'ordine di vendita all'integrazione TM Qualificazioni tecniche e professionali
• S/4HANA SD: minimo 3 esperienze in SAP SD, idealmente con implementazioni S/4HANA a ciclo pieno.
• Fa.
• Scienze della vita / Esperienza Farmaceutica: Fa 1 91% con modelli di business farmaceutico
• Mente analitica: Capacità di tradurre comp

In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

jobs.title: Business Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de l'analyse commerciale (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

As the Business Analytics Lead , you will be the strategic architect of the data roadmap shaping the Patient Insights portfolio and strategy at Roche Information Solutions (RIS). You will serve as the single source of truth for the RIS Patient Insights portfolio metrics and act as the orchestrator of Patient Insights-wide business analytics. You will create effective strategies to collect data, analyze information, conduct research and implement analytics. You will bring a keen strategic focus and ability to translate data into actionable insights, championing data-driven decision making and the journey at RIS Patient Insights to become the leading chronic disease management company.

We are looking for a proven business leader. You demonstrate energy, passion, courage, vision and the drive to be part of an organization at the forefront of the industry, delivering benefits for patients, our people, and our business. Moreover, you bring:

The Business Analytics Lead will report to the Head of Business Analytics & Competitive Intelligence and be a member of the wider Strategy & Growth team. The Position is based in Vienna, Austria. This is a global role and up to 30% travel (largely international) is required.

Your upcoming mission:
Within this role, your responsibilities will fall into these main areas:

Business Analytics & KPI Strategy & Orchestration

• You explore, develop, implement and evaluation innovative business analytic solutions to meet customer needs (internal and external)

• You act as a bridge between traditionally siloed data sets (e.g. Finance, Portfolio, CX, Sales) in order to inform RIS Patient Insights business decisions and promote alignment with RIS Patient Insights Strategy

• You lead key strategic initiatives related to RIS Patient Insights-wide data analytics (e.g. executive dashboard creation; transversal governance data requirement / definition) – developing and coordinating project plans with stakeholders to deliver to expectations

• You collaborate with other business intelligence functions (incl. Finance, Commercial) to harmonize and simply the KPI identification, gathering, collection and visualization processes

• You work with technical colleagues in R&D and IT, identifying business requirements related to data analytics and supporting development of solutions that meet customer requirements (internal and external)

• Customer Solution Business Analytics & KPIs

• You serve as the single source of truth for RIS Patient Insights customer portfolio metrics

• You collaborate with product, service and solution development and pipeline key stakeholders to define key performance metrics for all RIS Patient Insights solutions – tracking product development, commercialization and use

• You serve as the accountable business owner of key reporting solutions (e.g. Tableau), serving as a ‘super user’ able to interrogate data and translate it into actionable insight

• You provide expertise with respect to portfolio analytics and key strategic recommendations that facilitate trade-off discussions

• Leadership & Growth Mindset

• You serve as a coach and mentor, building competencies in business analytics via training, education of methods, tools and frameworks

• You promote insights-backed development and data-driven decision making, developing content and delivering presentations (internal and extern

jobs.title: Contract Records Processor - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:
As a Contract Records Processor, you are responsible for establishing governance for contract records management, implementing modern archiving methodology, screening, summarizing, and entering legal contract data to provide complete, accurate profiles of contracts in Contract Lifecycle Management System (CLM) and ensuring adherence to document retention policies across Roche affiliates.

• Utilizing ticketing system for incoming requests and issues

• Support end users and requesters on system related questions, trainings, providing consultancy services on existing functionalities of the system

• Utilizing multiple data sources to confirm and update contract data in contract data migration collection sheet

• Reviewing data in database to check for completeness and accuracy

• Managing multiple data cleanup for different Groups simultaneously

• Work with team members within Global Procurement to achieve project uniformity and provide feedback of project tasks

• Coordinate project duties with other team members

Who you are:

• Have a passion for accuracy and organizational skills, which are applied to database correction and standardization

• Are skilled in writing and interpersonal communications, ample business/functional knowledge to understand complex data and detailed instructions

• Have the ability to follow directions and work independently and have good time management skills to ensure projects are completed in an accurate and timely manner

• Have strong command of keyboard shortcuts and computer navigation and you are able to learn & use multiple complex programs.

• Experience with contract management systems, Google applications

• Information management or Database Administration background strongly desirable

• Experience with Business research, and Database research. Any combination of education or experience demonstrating aptitude, responsibility, and professionalism. Bachelors Degree Strongly preferred

• Proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unser 14-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der molekularbiologischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen.

Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ im Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Umfeld geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren.

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care

• Analytik von molekularbiologischen und biochemischen und Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen diesen beiden

• Kenntnisse in der molekularbiologische / biochemische Analytik (insbesondere qPCR & Nukleinsäureaufreinigung, wie auch Zellkultur )

• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Dich und Deine Ideen einbringen

• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für Deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte beachte, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium.

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir ausschließlich Deinen vollständigen Lebenslauf.

Zeitraum: Flexibel im Zeitraum August bis Oktober für die Gesamtdauer des Praktikums von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il tuo dipartimento Il nostro team di 14 membri, composto da analisti, project manager e leader di gruppo nel campo dell'analisi della biologia molecolare, è impaziente di sostenere attivamente un nuovo membro del team disponibile e flessibile. Si dovrebbe godere di nuove sfide e adattarsi alla nostra atmosfera di lavoro positiva. In qualità di tirocinante, vorremmo darvi una panoramica dell’ambiente di Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT). Avrete anche la possibilità di affrontare in modo indipendente il lavoro di progetto per ottimizzare i processi esistenti. I tuoi compiti
• Supporto del nostro lavoro di progetto nell'area di Design Transfer & Product Care
• Analisi dei materiali molecolari biologici e biochimici e di input nell'ambiente diagnostico Il tuo profilo
• Sei attualmente iscritto a una laurea in scienze (Bachelor o Master in Biochimica / Biologia molecolare / Chimica alimentare / Scienza della vita) o sei Nel vostro periodo di tempo tra questi due
• Conoscenza dell'analisi molecolare biologica / biochimica (in particolare la purificazione dell'acido qPCR & nucleico, così come la cultura cellulare)
• Sei motivato, curioso e vuoi contribuire te stesso e le tue idee
• solida conoscenza del tedesco è richiesto I vantaggi
• Divisione tempo flessibile
• 2268 € compensazione al mese per uno stage a tempo pieno > 3 mesi
• Opportunità di rete per la tua ulteriore pianificazione della carriera
• Prezzi ridotti nella nostra mensa dei dipendenti
• Accesso al nostro centro fitness nel campus Roche
• Possibilità di alloggio presso la Roche Boarding House durante lo stage La tua domanda Si prega di notare che questo tirocinio è rivolto agli studenti (m/f/d) con registrazione continua o in alternativa alle persone nell'anno tra Bachelor e Master. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV completo. Periodo: Flessibile tra agosto e ottobre per la durata totale dello stage di 6 mesi Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Si prega di notare che le raccomandazioni per tutte le attività degli studenti (ad esempio stage, tesi finali, ecc.) sono escluse. Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. The Position

As Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

This role serves as the engagement lead for end-to-end customer engagement within the Pharma International region, encompassing the strategic oversight of CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), and field integration. As a specialized ecosystem, the CRM space is designed to streamline relationships with healthcare professionals and patients while ensuring strict regulatory compliance across global markets. The system centralizes stakeholder data to enable personalized, omnichannel engagement across digital and in-person channels, supported by automated processes such as strategic account planning and sample management. By integrating VoC insights directly into these workflows, the platform ensures that field teams can refine their account strategies based on real-time customer feedback and preferences. Beyond execution, the CRM acts as a strategic hub for data-based insights, utilizing dashboards to monitor how effectively the organization is delivering on its customer-centricity goals while maintaining audit-ready documentation for legal requirements. Ultimately, this environment breaks down departmental silos to foster seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and medical teams through a unified source of truth.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

​

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.

• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.

• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.

• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Principal Scientist to support the development of advanced molecular diagnostics technologies. This role requires expertise in both preparative chromatography and analytical techniques, spanning the entire product development lifecycle—from early-stage research through on-market support.

As part of the Chemistry Team, you will have access to cutting-edge technologies and state-of-the-art instrumentation, enabling you to contribute meaningfully to advancements in molecular diagnostics. Your work will directly impact global health, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the field of diagnostics.

The Opportunity

• Advanced Research & Development:
You will synthesize, purify, characterize complex nucleotides, phosphoramidites, oligonucleotides, their analogs, and related small molecule reagents. You will drive process optimization to enable efficient scale-up and successful product launches.

• Analytical Method Support:
You will support and utilize analytical methods for characterizing reagents, reactions, and assay performance, with applications spanning R&D and Operations.

• Problem Solving:
You will design and execute advanced troubleshooting experiments independently and in collaboration with cross-functional teams. You will develop assays that push the limits of system understanding and error detection to ensure robust designs.

• Data & Documentation Transfer:
You might manage knowledge handoffs of prototype methods and assist in transferring comprehensive documentation from research stages to development and manufacturing teams.

• Expert Collaboration:
You will act as a subject matter expert to provide technical depth across R&D departments and operations.

This position is based on-site in Pleasanton, CA.
Relocation benefits are not offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Medical Chemistry (or a related field) and have at least 2+ years of relevant industry experience, OR you hold a Master’s Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Medical Chemistry (or a related field) with 5+ years of industry experience

• You have demonstrated experience and problem-solving skills in UPLC/HPLC, ion pair chromatography, ion exchange, advanced mass spectrometry, absorption spectroscopy, and fluorescence spectroscopy.

• You have a high level of knowledge of synthetic methods for nucleotides, phosphoramidites, oligonucleotides (including post-synthetic modification) and considerable understanding of PCR methodologies.

• You have demonstrated in-depth knowledge of DNA, RNA, modified oligonucleotides (including dye- and non-natural modifications), and small molecule reagents. You also have a strong level of expertise in purifying and characterizing oligonucleotides and small molecules.

• You have proven skills in experimental design, particularly in developing and optimizing sophisticated analytical assays applied to oligonucleotides and PCR..

Preferred:

• Your attention to detail and technical writing skills enable you to prepare clear, detailed documentation, including analytical reports.

• You exhibit a proactive approach to problem-solving, a growth mindset, and a passion for contributing to a collaborative workplace culture.

• You have demonstrated Interpersonal skills: Strong verbal communication and influencing skills; can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationsh

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo cercando uno scienziato principale altamente motivato e qualificato per sostenere lo sviluppo di tecnologie diagnostiche molecolari avanzate. Questo ruolo richiede competenze sia nella cromatografia preparatoria che nelle tecniche analitiche, che coprono l'intero ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, dalla ricerca del primo stadio attraverso il supporto sul mercato. Nell'ambito del team di chimica, avrai accesso a tecnologie all'avanguardia e alla strumentazione all'avanguardia, consentendoti di contribuire in modo significativo ai progressi nella diagnostica molecolare. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente la salute globale, spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile nel campo della diagnostica. L'opportunità
• Ricerca avanzata e sviluppo: Potrai sintetizzare, purificare, caratterizzare nucleotidi complessi, fosforramidite, oligonucleotidi, loro analoghi, e relativi piccoli reagenti molecolari. Aziona l'ottimizzazione del processo per consentire la scalabilità efficiente e lanci di successo del prodotto.
• Supporto metodo analitico: Potrai supportare e utilizzare metodi analitici per la caratterizzazione di reagenti, reazioni e prestazioni di analisi, con applicazioni che spaziano dalla R&D e dalle Operazioni.
• Risoluzione dei problemi: Progettare ed eseguire esperimenti di risoluzione dei problemi avanzati in modo indipendente e in collaborazione con team interfunzionali. Si svilupperà saggi che spingono i limiti della comprensione del sistema e del rilevamento degli errori per garantire disegni robusti.
• Trasferimento dati e documentazione: Potreste gestire la conoscenza dei metodi di prototipo e aiutare a trasferire la documentazione completa dalle fasi di ricerca ai team di sviluppo e produzione.
• Collaborazione degli esperti: Si agirà come esperto di materia tematica per fornire profondità tecnica nei reparti e nelle operazioni R&D. Questa posizione si basa sul sito in Pleasanton, CA. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo. Chi sei? (richiesto)
• Hai Ph.D. in Chimica, Biochimica, Biologia chimica, Chimica Chimica (o un campo correlato) e hanno almeno 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore rilevante, O hai un Master in Chimica, Biochimica, Chimica Biologia, Chimica Chimica (o un campo correlato) con 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore
• Hai dimostrato esperienza e capacità di problem solving in UPLC/HPLC, cromatografia a coppia ionica, scambio ionico, spettrometria di massa avanzata, spettroscopia di assorbimento e spettroscopia di fluorescenza.
• Hai un alto livello di conoscenza dei metodi sintetici per nucleotidi, fosforramidite, oligonucleotidi (compresa la modifica post-sintetica) e una notevole comprensione delle metodologie PCR.
• Hai dimostrato una conoscenza approfondita del DNA, del RNA, degli oligonucleotidi modificati (comprese le modifiche coloranti e non naturali) e dei piccoli reagenti molecolari. Hai anche un forte livello di competenza nel purificare e caratterizzare oligonucleotidi e piccole molecole.
• Hai dimostrato competenze nel design sperimentale, in particolare nello sviluppo e nell'ottimizzazione di sofisticate analisi analitiche applicate a oligonucleotidi e PCR. Preferito:
• La vostra attenzione ai dettagli e alle capacità di scrittura tecnica vi permettono di preparare una documentazione chiara e dettagliata, compresi i rapporti analitici.
• Esprimi un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi, una mentalità di crescita e una passione per contribuire a una cultura di lavoro collaborativa.
• Hai dimostrato competenze interpersonali: forte comunicazione verbale e capacità di influenzare; può influenzare senza autorità e ha dimostrato esperienza di costruire e coltivare relazioni

Diese Rolle erfordert Fachwissen sowohl in der präparativen Chromatographie als auch in analytischen Techniken, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Produktentwicklung abdecken - von der Frühphase der Forschung bis zur Unterstützung auf dem Markt. Als Teil des Chemie-Teams haben Sie Zugang zu modernsten Technologien und modernsten Instrumenten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, sinnvoll zu Fortschritten in der molekularen Diagnostik beizutragen. Ihre Arbeit wird sich direkt auf die globale Gesundheit auswirken und die Grenzen dessen überschreiten, was im Bereich der Diagnostik möglich ist. Die Chance
• Fortgeschrittene Forschung & Entwicklung: Sie werden komplexe Nukleotide, Phosphoramidite, Oligonukleotide, ihre Analoga und verwandte niedermolekulare Reagenzien synthetisieren, reinigen und charakterisieren. Sie werden die Prozessoptimierung vorantreiben, um eine effiziente Skalierung und erfolgreiche Produkteinführungen zu ermöglichen.

Sie werden Assays entwickeln, die die Grenzen des Systemverständnisses und der Fehlererkennung erweitern, um robuste Designs zu gewährleisten.

• Sie haben Erfahrungen und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten in UPLC / HPLC, Ionenpaarchromatographie, Ionenaustausch, fortgeschrittener Massenspektrometrie, Absorptionsspektroskopie und Fluoreszenzspektroskopie gezeigt.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Wissen über synthetische Methoden für Nukleotide, Phosphoramidite, Oligonukleotide (einschließlich postsynthetischer Modifikation) und ein beträchtliches Verständnis der PCR-Methoden.
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über DNA, RNA, modifizierte Oligonukleotide (einschließlich Farbstoff- und nicht-natürliche Modifikationen) und niedermolekulare Reagenzien nachgewiesen. Sie haben auch ein hohes Maß an Fachwissen in der Reinigung und Charakterisierung von Oligonukleotiden und kleinen Molekülen.
• Sie verfügen über nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten im experimentellen Design, insbesondere bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung anspruchsvoller analytischer Assays für Oligonukleotide und PCR. Bevorzugt:
• Ihre Aufmerksamkeit für Details und technische Schreibfähigkeiten ermöglichen es Ihnen, klare, detaillierte Dokumentationen zu erstellen, einschließlich analytischer Berichte.
• Sie zeigen einen proaktiven Ansatz zur Problemlösung, eine Wachstumsmentalität und eine Leidenschaft für einen Beitrag zu einer kollaborativen Arbeitsplatzkultur.
• Sie haben zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten demonstriert: Starke verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten; kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen und hat nachgewiesene Erfahrung beim Aufbau und der Pflege von Beziehungen

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Invoice & Payment Processing – Handle receipt, verification, and processing of PO/non-PO invoices, prepayments, and intercompany transactions while ensuring timely and accurate payments.

• Reconciliation & Closing – Perform supplier and balance sheet reconciliations, clear aged items, and execute month-end closing activities including accruals and reporting.

• Query & Issue Resolution – Manage internal and external queries, investigate payment issues, and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve system or process-related problems.

• Compliance & Audit Support – Ensure adherence to company policies, ICFR, and statutory requirements; support internal and external audits as needed.

• Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing – Drive process improvement initiatives, participate in system testing and integration, and provide training or mentorship to team members.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Customer Support Partner (Engineer)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
As the Customer Support Partner (Engineer), you will be responsible for performing instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventive maintenance, and other instrument after-sales service issues to the satisfaction of the customer base and organization's procedures and policies.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will

• Maintain and perform necessary support at customer site, such as troubleshooting, corrective and preventive maintenance, and installation hardware and software modification.

• Provide service training to the customer and peers.

• Conduct workshop activities as required.

• Handles trouble shooting for customers and carry out root cause analysis, and liaises with GCS to manage technical issues when required.

• Well documented all customers’ touchpoints in the CRM system correctly in a timely manner.

• Monitor spare part movement in individual storage location and ensure part used is written off via the CRM system in a timely manner.

• Responsible to ensure (together with Regulatory and Product team) that customer is informed of safety / quality issues and technical updates via Customer Notification timely.

• Cooperate with the cross-functional support team to help customers solve the problem effectively.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their needs and identifying shared purpose in order to create fruitful partnerships.

• Represent Roche in engagement opportunities, collect and compiling insights, positions and feedback to inform our access and policies strategies.

• Regularly check the intranet/emails and all available channels to keep up-to-date service information including instrument operation and application related information.

• Meet customer service KPI and participate in continuous improvements.

• Actively promote and provide digital service, proactive and remote support through Remote CareGiver.

• May act as a coach for colleagues with less experience and provide guidance. Proactively identify opportunities to improve and enhance the target audience experience. Work autonomously; complete work with minimal supervision or guidance but maintain communication with supervisor regarding progress.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong troubleshooting and multi-tasking skills.

• Efficient, organized, details oriented and result driven.

• Customer-oriented individual and an outstanding problem-solver.

• Able to efficiently prioritise tasks in a fast-changing environment.

• Team players demonstrated by the ability to receive and provide feedback professionally thrive and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.

• Detail oriented, meticulous, responsive to deadlines.

• Ongoing interest in digital services, industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies.

Qualification and Experience

• Minimum Diploma in Biomedical, Electronic, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a reputable University

• Preferably, at least 1 year of related experience in a similar industry

• IT experience will be an added advantage

• Marketing and busines
