jobs.title: Warehouse Operator Despatch
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Warehouse Operator Despatch plays a vital role in our supply chain operations. This role is responsible for the physical and administrative tasks involved in the shipping, receiving, storing and distributing of materials, parts, supplies and equipment.

• Permanent Full-Time position with overtime

• Pemulwuy Warehouse based role, onsite parking available

• Collaborative and supportive team environment

As a Warehouse Operator Despatch, you will be responsible for:

• Picking orders in temperature-controlled environments (Ambient and Cold Storage) using RF gun

• Operating counterbalance and high-reach forklifts

• Handling Post Goods Issue operations using SAP

• Handling and shipping Dangerous Goods

• Booking shipments via contracted carriers.

• Always ensure compliance of safety guidelines

Who You Are

You have:

• Forklift license (LF)

• Dangerous goods license (Desirable, training provided)

• Sound knowledge of WH&S principles

• Attention to detail & ability to work independently, within a team environment and meet key performance indicators

• Ability for Heavy lifting (up to 20 Kg)

• Good numeric skills

• Basic understanding of Microsoft Office and Google Platforms

• SAP knowledge (Desirable, training provided)

• Customer service focus

Roche Diagnostics Australia Pemulwuy Warehouse is a temperature controlled facility with ample on-site parking.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is required as no visa/relocation support is available for this on-site based role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for excellence and extraordinary results and take a genuine interest in our people and their well-being, and our patients.

Take pride in knowing you can make a difference to millions of patients worldwide in developing diagnostics and treatments for oncology, neuroscience, inflammation, immunology, ophthalmology, rare diseases, respiratory disease and diabetes.

We are committed to providing an inclusive, safe, secure and healthy workplace, and to minimise any such impacts to our employees, customers and the community. We welcome applications from all people and encourage you to advise of any individual circumstances that may require consideration.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing h

jobs.title: Technical Customer Experience Manager, Sequencing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities.
We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

Roche Sequencing & Life Sciences is seeking a Technical Customer Experience Manager, Sequencing to join its Support & Applications Team in Wilmington, MA . This highly-experienced individual will leverage a blend of technical expertise, customer-centricity, and program management skills to drive impactful customer engagements on behalf of the Sequencing Support organization. This individual will help shape and facilitate customer visits to the Wilmington site for product demonstrations, showcasing the product portfolio, including KAPA DNA and RNA Library Prep chemistries and Roche’s groundbreaking Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology on the AXELIOS 1 System.

The successful candidate will coordinate feasibility studies and proof-of-concept experiments while serving as a vital conduit for customer feedback between local and global stakeholders. In addition, the Customer Experience Manager will play a critical role in orchestrating efforts for customer implementations, HyperCare activities, internal and external training events, ultimately liaising with Support functions and local and global business teams to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and team readiness. As the program grows, this individual will continue to enable and influence other Support Leaders, while simultaneously building a team to support these efforts.

The Opportunity:

This on-site position is located in Wilmington, MA . The successful candidate will report to the Director of Support & Applications and have responsibilities that include, but are not limited to:

• Strategic Customer Experience Leadership: Define and strategically lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance the end-to-end customer experience, ensuring alignment between customer interests and business objectives.

• Implementation and Feedback Conduit: Act as the primary liaison between technical teams (Support & Applications) and internal stakeholders (Sales, Digital Solutions, Commercial Project Management Office) to support successful customer implementations and capture critical service experience feedback for local and global teams.

• Escalation Management: Efficiently manage and maintain visibility for key stakeholders regarding all customer implementation-related escalations.

• Stakeholder Advocacy: Ensure customer perspectives are clearly articulated and addressed by business leaders to drive continuous improvement in product and service delivery.

• Wilmington Site Program Management: Serve as the central point of contact for Sales and Marketing concerning all customer visits to the Wilmington, MA site, managing all logistics for post-sales training, pro

Cette personne aidera à façonner et à faciliter les visites des clients sur le site de Wilmington pour des démonstrations de produits, en mettant en valeur le portefeuille de produits, y compris les produits KAPA DNA et RNA Library Prep chimistries et Roches, séquençage révolutionnaire par expansion (SBX) sur le système AXELIOS 1. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Join a highly collaborative team within our global shared services hub, where your dedication directly impacts our operational efficiency. As a Procurement Customer Support Specialist, you will be the first line of professional contact for system users, resolving inquiries, managing platform access, and ensuring a seamless end-to-end procurement experience that supports our broader mission in global healthcare.

In this engaging role, you will:

• Deliver Exceptional Support: Provide first-level operational and system-related support via phone and ticketing tools for global indirect procurement end-users.

• Manage Ticket Lifecycles: Create, maintain, and track support cases efficiently, striving for first-contact resolution within 24 hours to achieve optimal response targets.

• Bridge Knowledge Gaps: Act as a vital connector between system users and advanced technical resolver groups, translating complex technical feedback into clear, actionable instructions for the business.

• Optimize Platform Roles: Manage system access and platform role ownership requests accurately, ensuring security and compliance protocols are met.

• Build Hub Intelligence: Contribute to the creation and maintenance of standard operating documentation, knowledge base articles, and reference materials to support team performance.

• Champion Safety and Compliance: Perform daily duties in strict alignment with environmental, health, technical safety guidelines, and corporate compliance standards.

Who You Are
You are a customer-oriented, analytical problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You possess excellent organizational skills, take extreme accountability for your work, and communicate effortlessly with diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a University or College Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Economics, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: You bring 1 to 3 years of experience in procurement operations, customer service centers, or shared services support functions.

• System Familiarity: You possess a solid foundational understanding of procurement systems and enterprise planning tools (such as SAP), alongside familiarity with modern digital ticketing platforms.

• Language Excellence: You are completely fluent in both written and spoken English and Mandarin to effectively support our regional business clusters.

• Operational Agility: You possess sharp troubleshooting skills, manage your time effectively, and are comfortable working an afternoon schedule (until 6:00 PM).

Let’s grow together by accessing opportunities that set you up for success.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Treten Sie einem hochgradig kooperativen Team in unserem globalen Shared Services Hub bei, wo sich Ihr Engagement direkt auf unsere betriebliche Effizienz auswirkt. Als Procurement Customer Support Specialist sind Sie die erste professionelle Kontaktlinie für Systembenutzer, die Anfragen lösen, den Plattformzugriff verwalten und eine nahtlose End-to-End-Beschaffungserfahrung sicherstellen, die unsere breitere Mission im globalen Gesundheitswesen unterstützt. In dieser engagierten Rolle werden Sie:
• Außergewöhnlicher Support: Bereitstellung von First-Level-Betriebs- und System-Support über Telefon- und Ticketing-Tools für globale indirekte Beschaffungs-Endbenutzer.
• Verwalten Sie Ticket-Lebenszyklen: Erstellen, pflegen und verfolgen Sie Supportfälle effizient und streben Sie eine Erstkontaktlösung innerhalb von 24 Stunden an, um optimale Reaktionsziele zu erreichen.
• Bridge Knowledge Gaps: Handeln Sie als wichtige Verbindung zwischen Systembenutzern und fortschrittlichen technischen Resolver-Gruppen und übersetzen Sie komplexes technisches Feedback in klare, umsetzbare Anweisungen für das Unternehmen.
• Plattformrollen optimieren: Verwalten Sie Systemzugriffs- und Rollenbesitzanforderungen genau und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Sicherheits- und Compliance-Protokolle eingehalten werden.
• Build Hub Intelligence: Tragen Sie zur Erstellung und Pflege von Standardbetriebsdokumentationen, Knowledge Base-Artikeln und Referenzmaterialien bei, um die Teamleistung zu unterstützen.
• Champion Safety and Compliance: Führen Sie tägliche Aufgaben in strikter Übereinstimmung mit Umwelt-, Gesundheits-, technischen Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Compliance-Standards durch. Wer du bist Sie sind ein kundenorientierter, analytischer Problemlöser, der in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung lebt. Sie verfügen über hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, übernehmen extreme Verantwortlichkeit für Ihre Arbeit und kommunizieren mühelos mit verschiedenen technischen und nicht-technischen Zielgruppen. Ihre Qualifikationen:
• Bildungshintergrund: Sie haben einen Universitäts- oder Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Informatik, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Berufserfahrung: Sie bringen 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Beschaffungsbetrieben, Kundendienstzentren oder Supportfunktionen für Shared Services mit.
• Systemvertrautheit: Sie verfügen über ein solides grundlegendes Verständnis von Beschaffungssystemen und Unternehmensplanungstools (wie SAP) sowie über die Vertrautheit mit modernen digitalen Ticketing-Plattformen.
• Language Excellence: Sie sprechen vollständig geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch und Mandarin, um unsere regionalen Geschäftscluster effektiv zu unterstützen.
• Betriebliche Agilität: Sie besitzen scharfe Fähigkeiten zur Fehlerbehebung, verwalten Ihre Zeit effektiv und arbeiten gerne einen Nachmittagsplan (bis 18:00 Uhr). Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam wachsen, indem Sie auf Möglichkeiten zugreifen, die Sie auf Erfolg vorbereiten. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Rejoignez une équipe hautement collaborative au sein de notre pôle mondial de services partagés, où votre dévouement affecte directement notre efficacité opérationnelle. En tant que spécialiste du soutien à la clientèle en matière d'approvisionnement, vous serez la première ligne de contact professionnel pour les utilisateurs du système, en résolvant les demandes de renseignements, en gérant l'accès à la plate-forme et en assurant une expérience d'approvisionnement de bout en bout transparente qui soutient notre mission plus vaste dans le domaine des soins de santé mondiaux. Dans ce rôle stimulant, vous :
• Fournir un soutien exceptionnel: Fournir un soutien opérationnel de premier niveau et lié au système par le biais d'outils de téléphonie et de billetterie pour les utilisateurs finaux d'achats indirects mondiaux.
• Gérer les cycles de vie des billets : Créer, maintenir et suivre efficacement les cas de soutien, en s'efforçant d'obtenir une résolution de premier contact dans les 24 heures pour atteindre des objectifs de réponse optimaux.
• Rapprocher les lacunes en matière de connaissances : agir comme un connecteur essentiel entre les utilisateurs du système et les groupes de résolveur technique avancés, transformant les commentaires techniques complexes en instructions claires et exploitables pour l'entreprise.
• Optimiser les rôles de la plate-forme : gérer avec précision les demandes d'accès au système et de propriété des rôles de la plate-forme, en veillant à ce que les protocoles de sécurité et de conformité soient respectés.
• Construisez l'intelligence centrale : contribuez à la création et à la maintenance de documents d'exploitation standard, d'articles de base de connaissances et de matériaux de référence pour soutenir la performance de l'équipe.
• Champion de la sécurité et de la conformité : Effectuez des tâches quotidiennes en stricte conformité avec les lignes directrices en matière d'environnement, de santé, de sécurité technique et les normes de conformité de l'entreprise. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un résolveur de problèmes analytique orienté client qui prospère dans un environnement rapide. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles, prenez une responsabilité extrême pour votre travail et communiquez sans effort avec divers publics techniques et non techniques. Vos qualifications :
• Contexte éducatif : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire ou collégial en finance, administration des affaires, informatique, économie ou un domaine connexe.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans les opérations d'approvisionnement, les centres de service à la clientèle, ou les fonctions de soutien de services partagés.
• Familiarité du système: Vous possédez une solide compréhension fondamentale des systèmes d'approvisionnement et des outils de planification d'entreprise (comme SAP), ainsi que la connaissance des plateformes de billetterie numériques modernes.
• Excellence linguistique : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l'anglais écrit et parlé et le mandarin pour soutenir efficacement nos grappes d'affaires régionales.
• Agilité opérationnelle: Vous possédez des compétences de dépannage précises, gérez votre temps efficacement et êtes à l'aise de travailler un horaire de l'après-midi (jusqu'à 18 h). Laissez grandir ensemble en accédant aux opportunités qui vous mettent en place pour le succès. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Small Molecule Drug Design. You will develop and apply ML methods and models to accelerate small-molecule drug design with a focus on structure-driven approaches, working hand in hand with world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

The Opportunity

• Design, build, and apply cutting-edge ML models for small-molecule drug design, focused on protein–ligand interactions, binding affinity and key molecular properties.

• Train and fine-tune foundation models for structure prediction, using internally developed and open-source models on internal datasets.

• Validate and refine ML-generated hypotheses alongside world-class computational and medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and conference talks.

• Collaborate widely with computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and hands-on experience designing & implementing machine learning approaches such as graph neural networks, sequence models, and reinforcement learning.

• You have structure-driven modelling experience with co-folding methods, binding-affinity prediction, and structural-biology datasets.

• You are fluent in Python and cheminformatics with toolkits such as RDKit and OpenEye, and modern ML frameworks like PyTorchor JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab)..

Preferred:

• Hands-on experience building structure-prediction foundation models.

• Experience collaborating directly with medicinal chemists and structural biologists.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Basel, Switzerland (preferred) or Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If using AI to design the medicines patients need next inspires you, apply now and help accelerate small-molecule discovery at Roche.

Svilupperai e applicherai metodi e modelli ML per accelerare la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola con un focus sugli approcci struttura-driven, lavorando mano in mano con chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare, costruire e applicare modelli ML all'avanguardia per la progettazione di farmaci di piccola molecola, focalizzati sulle interazioni proteina-ligand, l'affinità vincolante e le proprietà molecolari chiave.
• Modelli di fondazione per la predizione della struttura, con modelli interni sviluppati e open source su dataset interni.
• convalidare e affinare le ipotesi generate da ML insieme a chimici computazionali e medicinali di livello mondiale e biologi strutturali.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e conferenze.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e l'esperienza hands-on progettazione e applicazione di approcci di machine learning come reti neurali grafici, modelli di sequenza e apprendimento di rinforzo.
• Hai esperienza di modellazione struttura-driven con metodi di co-folding, predizione di binding-affinity e dataset di biologia strutturale.
• Sei fluente in Python e cheminformatics con strumenti come RDKit e OpenEye, e moderni framework ML come PyTorchor JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Hands-on esperienza costruzione modelli di fondazione struttura-predizione.
• Esperienza di collaborazione direttamente con chimici medicinali e biologi strutturali. Se si utilizza l'IA per progettare i farmaci che i pazienti bisogno dopo ti ispira, applicare ora e aiutare ad accelerare la scoperta di piccole molecole a Roche. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Collaborate widely with world-class computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong theoretical foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and you build models from first principles.

• You have hands-on quantum chemistry experience and fluency in toolkits such as Psi4, PySCF and ORCA, as well as semi-empirical methods like xTB.

• You are fluent in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).

Preferred

• Experience in scientific software development, scaling ML training, and applying models to drug discovery.

• Experience generating large-scale synthetic datasets.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom (preferred) or Basel, Switzerland. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If building physics-grounded machine learning models that bring better medicines to patients faster is your calling, apply now and help shape the future of small-molecule drug discovery.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Impact

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently.

Purpose
The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context.

Key Activities and Deliverables

• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.

• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.

• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.

• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.

• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.

• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

Job Skills Required

• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.

• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Qualifications and Experience Required

• 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.

• Demonstrated hands-on experie

We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently.

Purpose
The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context.

Key Activities and Deliverables

• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.

• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.

• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.

• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.

• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.

• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

Job Skills Required

• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.

• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Qualifications and Experience Required

• 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.

• Recenser proactivement les lacunes dans les contrôles d'accès et proposer des améliorations avec un état d'esprit autonome et orienté vers la solution.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires interfonctionnels, dont des équipes de réseau, d'identité et de cloud, pour offrir des capacités d'accès sécurisées intégrées.

• Collaboration et communication: travailler confortablement entre les équipes réparties et interfonctionnelles.

• Forte capacité de communication écrite et verbale en anglais. Qualifications et expérience requises

jobs.title: Central Operations Specialist (PV, Pharmacovigilance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming how patient safety data is delivered globally?

As our Central Operations Specialist within Patient Safety Operations , you will be at the heart of our mission to ensure the efficient, high-quality, and compliant delivery of safety data outputs. You will process and report Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and device safety reports, via the utilisation of current/future safety systems, and use of vendor services, and co-develop innovative approaches for the transformation and reporting of wider types of safety-relevant data, beyond ICSRs.

In this dynamic role, you will collaborate closely with global vendors, business process owners, and cross-functional teams to maintain our inspection readiness and drive continuous improvements. You will have the unique opportunity to support change initiatives, explore cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence in pharmacovigilance, and guide our operations to meet both current and future regulatory requirements.

• Oversee Safety Data Quality: Monitor workload, compliance, and quality across the global ICSR footprint to ensure internal and external performance standards are consistently met.

• Manage Vendor & Process Collaboration: Support the oversight, coordination, and inspection readiness of ICSR and medical device safety activities in collaboration with external vendors and internal alliance managers.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Develop, maintain, and review metrics and KPIs to identify and execute process enhancements within safety reporting sub-processes.

• Lead AI & Innovation Initiatives: Support the implementation of AI-augmented activities and human-in-the-loop interventions to optimize operational safety report delivery.

• Provide Governance & Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a key point of contact for queries and issue escalations, supporting Case Processing Governance across Patient Safety Operations sites.

• Support Regulatory Reporting Projects: Execute and coordinate regulatory reporting projects for Roche products by preparing documentation and ensuring adherence to established quality standards.

Who You Are

• Industry Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with an emphasis on pharmacovigilance.

• PV Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of global Pharmacovigilance regulatory obligations and compliance standards.

• Project & Conflict Management: Proven ability to support or lead projects to a successful conclusion while demonstrating strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

• Agile Mindset: Comfort working in a matrix environment, actively participating in or leading agile squads and sprints to deliver on business strategies.

• Educational Background: A minimum of a degree-level qualification in a scientific or relevant field.

This position is based in Budapest, Hungary. Relocation Assistance is not available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
The Position

At Roche, we are building a scalable and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized, data-driven interactions across channels.
As an IT Business Analyst within Omnichannel Orchestration, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, affiliate teams, and technology delivery teams. You will play a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, supporting onboarding and adoption of omnichannel capabilities, and ensuring successful delivery of customer engagement use cases across markets.
A major focus of this role will be supporting the rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of omnichannel engagement capabilities across Pharma International affiliates.
This role will work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Business Stakeholders, you will help shape requirements, improve processes, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity
Business Analysis & Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for omnichannel engagement, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation use cases.

• Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement gathering activities with global and affiliate stakeholders.

• Support backlog refinement and prioritization activities with Product Owners and delivery teams.

Affiliate Engagement & Omnichannel Adoption

• Act as a key point of contact for affiliate teams adopting omnichannel capabilities.

• Understand affiliate business processes, pain points, and market-specific requirements.

• Support onboarding activities, capability demonstrations, training sessions, and business readiness efforts.

• Identify opportunities to improve adoption, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Vendors to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented.

• Support testing, validation, and user acceptance activities.

• Help manage dependencies across business, process, data, and technology workstreams.

Continuous Improvement

• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and standardization.

• Contribute to documentation, governance practices, templates, and best practices.

• Support reporting, insights, and measurement activities to evaluate business outcomes and adoption.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement, or Digital Transformation domains.

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into scalable technology solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs.

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel engagement, campaign execution, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation workflows.

Ce rôle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de produits, les architectes de solutions, les ingénieurs, les équipes de données et les intervenants d'affaires, vous aiderez à définir les exigences, à améliorer les processus et à garantir que les solutions offrent une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. L'opportunité Analyse opérationnelle et gestion des besoins
• Recueillir, analyser et documenter les exigences opérationnelles pour l'engagement omnicanal, les déplacements des clients, la segmentation du public et les cas d'utilisation d'activation.
• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en histoires d'utilisateurs, flux de processus, exigences fonctionnelles et critères d'acceptation.
• Faciliter les ateliers, les séances de découverte et les activités de collecte d'exigences avec les intervenants mondiaux et affiliés.
• Appuyer les activités de perfectionnement et de hiérarchisation des arriérés auprès des propriétaires de produits et des équipes de livraison. Engagement d'affiliation & Adoption Omnicanal
• Agir comme point de contact clé pour les équipes affiliées qui adoptent des capacités omnicanales.
• Comprendre les processus d'affaires d'affiliation, les points de douleur et les exigences spécifiques au marché.
• Appuyer les activités à bord, les démonstrations de capacités, les séances de formation et les efforts de préparation aux affaires.
• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer l'adoption, l'efficacité opérationnelle et l'expérience des utilisateurs. Collaboration interfonctionnelle
• Partenaire avec les propriétaires de produits, les architectes de solutions, les ingénieurs, les équipes de données et les fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les exigences opérationnelles sont bien comprises et mises en œuvre.
• Soutenir les activités de test, de validation et d'acceptation des utilisateurs.
• Aider à gérer les dépendances dans les secteurs des affaires, des processus, des données et de la technologie. Amélioration continue
• Analyser les processus d'affaires et identifier les possibilités d'optimisation et de normalisation.
• Contribuer à la documentation, aux pratiques de gouvernance, aux modèles et aux pratiques exemplaires.
• Appuyer les activités de rapport, d'information et de mesure pour évaluer les résultats opérationnels et l'adoption. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef de file axé sur la prestation et la collaboration qui est à l'aise dans les domaines des affaires et de la technologie au sein de programmes de transformation d'entreprise à grande échelle. Expérience
• 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse d'affaires, conseil, livraison de produits, CRM, technologie de marketing, engagement Omnichannel, ou domaines de transformation numérique.
• Expérimenter la collecte, l'analyse et la documentation des exigences opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions technologiques évolutives.
• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants avec de l'expérience dans la transformation d'entreprise à grande échelle ou des programmes d'engagement numérique.
• Expérience dans les environnements de livraison Agile et collaboration entre les équipes de produits, d'ingénierie et d'affaires.
• Forte compréhension de l'engagement omnicanal, de l'exécution de la campagne, des parcours clients, de la segmentation du public et des flux de travail d'activation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

• Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.

• Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus.

• Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions.

•

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Workforce Enablement (WE) è la casa per i dipendenti che affrontano prodotti, servizi e esperienze all'interno di RDT. Forniamo strumenti digitali, adottiamo e forniamo il supporto necessario per consentire l'intera forza lavoro, ovunque si trovino, ogni singolo giorno. L'organizzazione Insite Enablement è il battito cardiaco della nostra presenza fisica. Siamo il ponte tra la strategia digitale e l'esecuzione locale, assicurando che ogni sito, dai laboratori R&D ai hub aziendali, funzioni con servizi tecnologici all'avanguardia. Nell'ambito di questo team, supervisionerai un team di singoli collaboratori che sono i principali punti di responsabilità per l'eccellenza dei servizi in loco, la stabilità delle infrastrutture e l'esperienza degli utenti all'interno dei rispettivi siti. La nostra missione è quella di fornire un luogo di lavoro "a frizione" in cui la tecnologia consente al nostro popolo di concentrarsi su ciò che conta di più: migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Questo leader RDT è responsabile per le persone, budget e servizi necessari per fornire un'offerta di alta qualità per i dipendenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione.
• Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili.
• Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team
• Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra.
• Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.
• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
• Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale.
• Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità.
• Imposta la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap del prodotto.
• Rimuove attivamente gli impedimenti e i blocchi stradali per progredire, aumentando quando necessario per proteggere l'attenzione del team.
• Gestisce e allinea le aspettative e le esigenze degli stakeholder, fornendo aggiornamenti regolari sui progressi e sui rischi.
• Crea efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile tra team e funzioni. •

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Entwicklung der Fähigkeiten Ihrer Teammitglieder, die mit der Vision der Funktion übereinstimmen. Sie werden Ihr Team ermutigen, seine Karrierereise selbst zu definieren und nach Möglichkeiten zu suchen, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung der Reise zu ermöglichen. Sie werden sie dabei unterstützen, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement zu konzentrieren. Sie stellen sicher, dass Sie Ihr Team mit den richtigen Fähigkeiten, einer gesunden Dynamik und einem nachhaltigen Tempo entwickeln. Sie unterstützen die Software- und/oder Servicebereitstellung als Führungskraft, indem Sie Hindernisse beseitigen, Stakeholder verwalten und wo immer möglich Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit schaffen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Workforce Enablement (WE) ist das Zuhause für Mitarbeiter, die mit Produkten, Dienstleistungen und Erfahrungen innerhalb von RDT konfrontiert sind. Wir liefern digitale Tools, fördern die Akzeptanz und bieten die notwendige Unterstützung, um die gesamte Belegschaft, wo auch immer sie sind, jeden Tag zu ermöglichen. Die Onsite Enablement Organisation ist der Herzschlag unserer physischen Präsenz. Wir sind die Brücke zwischen digitaler Strategie und lokaler Umsetzung und stellen sicher, dass jeder Standort - von F & E-Labors bis hin zu Unternehmenszentren - mit nahtlosen, innovativen Technologiediensten arbeitet. Als Teil dieses Teams betreuen Sie ein Team von einzelnen Mitwirkenden, die die Hauptverantwortungspunkte für Vor-Ort-Service-Exzellenz, Infrastrukturstabilität und Benutzererfahrung in ihren jeweiligen Standorten sind. Unsere Mission ist es, einen "friktionslosen" Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem Technologie unsere Mitarbeiter befähigt, sich auf das zu konzentrieren, was am wichtigsten ist: das Leben der Patienten zu verbessern. Dieser RDT-Leiter ist für die Mitarbeiter, das Budget und die Dienstleistungen verantwortlich, die erforderlich sind, um ein qualitativ hochwertiges Angebot für die Mitarbeiter zu liefern. Verantwortlichkeiten
• Team Member Capability und Karriereentwicklung
• Konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten des Engineering-Teams, die mit den unmittelbaren Projektanforderungen und -zielen und der Gesamtvision der Funktion übereinstimmen.
• Ermutigt die Teammitglieder, ihre Karriere selbst zu definieren und ermöglicht aktiv Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die mit ihr übereinstimmen.
• Behebt Hindernisse und setzt klare, erreichbare Leistungsziele.
• Stellt sicher, dass das Team die richtigen Fähigkeiten und eine gesunde interne Dynamik entwickelt, um aktuelle und zukünftige Herausforderungen zu meistern.
• Team Gesundheit und Nachhaltigkeit
• Behält ein nachhaltiges Arbeitstempo für das Team bei und balanciert Lieferziele mit dem Wohlbefinden des Teams.
• Pfleget eine gesunde Teamdynamik und Zusammenarbeit, sorgt für psychologische Sicherheit und offene Kommunikation.
• Entfernt Hindernisse, die den Fluss oder die Moral behindern und als Eskalationspunkt für das Team fungieren.
• Stellt sicher, dass die Teammitglieder mit den notwendigen, relevanten Fähigkeiten ausgestattet sind und dass die Rollen klar definiert sind.
• Produkt- und Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️
• Verantwortlich für die gemeinsame Erstellung der Produkt- / Service-Roadmap aus technischer Sicht und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem insgesamt verantwortlichen Produktmanager.
• Verantwortlich für die End-to-End-Bereitstellung der Funktionen des Teams im Rahmen der Produktentwicklung, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Produkt-Roadmap und den Qualitätsstandards sicherzustellen.
• Legt klare Schwerpunkte und Prioritäten für die Lieferarbeit des Teams fest und stellt die Abstimmung mit Produkt-Roadmaps sicher.
• Entfernt aktiv Hindernisse und Hindernisse für den Fortschritt und eskaliert, wenn es notwendig ist, um den Fokus des Teams zu schützen.
• Verwaltet und richtet die Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder aus und bietet regelmäßige Updates zu Fortschritt und Risiken.
• Schafft Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit, wo immer möglich, über Teams und Funktionen hinweg. •
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que gestionnaire de la prestation des services, RDT Onsite Europe West (gestionnaire d'ingénierie), vous vous concentrerez sur le développement des capacités des membres de votre équipe qui s'alignent sur la vision de la fonction. Vous encouragerez votre équipe à définir elle-même leur parcours de carrière et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les aiderez à supprimer les barrages routiers et en mettant l'accent sur leur gestion du rendement. Vous assurez-vous de développer votre équipe avec les bonnes compétences, dynamique saine et un rythme durable. Vous soutenez le logiciel et/ou la prestation de services en tant que chef de file, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration dans la mesure du possible. Description de la zone Activement de la main-d'oeuvre (WE) est la maison pour les employés faisant face aux produits, services et expériences au sein du RDT. Nous livrons des outils numériques, conduisons l'adoption et fournissons le soutien nécessaire pour permettre à l'ensemble de la main-d'oeuvre, où qu'elle soit, chaque jour. L'organisation d'activation sur place est le battement de cœur de notre présence physique. Nous sommes le pont entre la stratégie numérique et l'exécution locale, en veillant à ce que chaque site — des laboratoires de R-D aux centres d'entreprises — fonctionne avec des services technologiques de pointe sans faille. Dans le cadre de cette équipe, vous superviserez une équipe de contributeurs individuels qui sont les principaux responsables de l'excellence des services sur place, de la stabilité de l'infrastructure et de l'expérience utilisateur dans leurs sites respectifs. Notre mission est de fournir un lieu de travail « sans friction » où la technologie permet à nos employés de se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus : améliorer la vie des patients. Ce chef de file est responsable des personnes, du budget et des services nécessaires pour offrir une offre de haute qualité aux employés. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Capacité des membres de l'équipe et perfectionnement professionnel
• Se concentre sur le développement des capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie qui correspondent aux besoins et aux objectifs immédiats du projet et à la vision globale de la fonction.
• Encourage les membres de l'équipe à définir eux-mêmes leur parcours de carrière et permet activement des possibilités de développement qui s'harmonisent avec elle.
• Enlever les barrages routiers et fixer des objectifs de rendement clairs et réalisables.
• S'assure que l'équipe développe les bonnes compétences et une dynamique interne saine pour relever les défis actuels et futurs.
• Équipe Santé et durabilité
• Maintenir un rythme de travail durable pour l'équipe, en conciliant les objectifs de prestation et le bien-être de l'équipe.
• Cultiver une saine dynamique d'équipe et la collaboration, en assurant la sécurité psychologique et la communication ouverte.
• Supprime les obstacles qui entravent l'écoulement ou le moral, agissant comme un point d'escalade pour l'équipe.
• S'assure que les membres de l'équipe sont dotés des compétences nécessaires et pertinentes et que les rôles sont clairement définis.
• Leadership de la prestation des produits et des services
• Responsable de la co-création de la feuille de route produit / service d'un point de vue technique, en partenariat avec le gestionnaire de produit qui est globalement responsable.
• Responsable de la livraison de bout en bout des caractéristiques de l'équipe dans le cadre du développement du produit, assurant l'alignement sur la feuille de route du produit et les normes de qualité.
• Établir des priorités et des priorités claires pour le travail d'exécution de l'équipe, en assurant l'alignement sur les feuilles de route des produits.
• Supprime activement les obstacles et les obstacles au progrès, et augmente au besoin pour protéger l'orientation de l'équipe.
• Gérer et harmoniser les attentes et les besoins des intervenants, en fournissant des mises à jour régulières sur les progrès et les risques.
• Créer des gains d'efficacité en collaboration lorsque cela est possible entre les équipes et les fonctions. •

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 60% overnight travel. Ideal candidate to live within the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Colorado is $71,100 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who Are You

• Diploma in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or equivalent holders. Minimum 3 years of related working experience for diploma equivalent holders with combination of education and relative work experience.

• Related working experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment is preferred.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

Preferred

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link . Company Shuttle Bus is provided at the MRT Stations.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

jobs.title: Administrative & Finance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

The Administrative & Finance Specialist provides critical operational support across multiple departments. This role is responsible for streamlining travel logistics, managing expense compliance, coordinating large-scale corporate events, and supporting the integrity of the company’s financial cycle through diligent Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) management.

Key Duties and Responsibilities;

1. General Administrative Support

• Travel & Entertainment (T&E): Coordination of business travels. This includes booking airfare, hotel accommodations and ground transfers, ensuring arrangements align with company travel policies.

• Expense Management (Concur): Ensure all claims include valid supporting documents (Official Receipts, invoices) and comply with internal audit standards.

• Corporate Credit Card Management: Oversee card issuance, limit monitoring and support usage compliance.

• Operational Monitoring: Track and maintain "Events Forms" and other administrative logs to ensure departmental requests are processed and filed systematically.

• Corporate Events Management: Support the logistics of companywide events such as National Conventions, Mid-Year Conferences and Holiday Celebrations to name a few. Manage relationships with external vendors (catering, audiovisual, venues) and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.

2. Grants, Sponsorships & Donations (GSD) Support

• Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the administrative processing of GSD requests, ensuring all contributions are documented, approved, and tracked.

3. Finance Operations
A. Accounts Receivable (AR) Management

• Customer Reconciliation: Perform regular audits of customer accounts to identify discrepancies and support resolution of payment issues.

• Credit & Collection Support: Assist the finance team in monitoring aging reports and following up on overdue accounts to maintain healthy cash flow.

• KPI Achievement: Actively contribute to meeting departmental AR goals, such as reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
B. Accounts Payable (AP) Management

• Stakeholder & Vendor Relations: Act as a bridge between internal departments and external vendors to reconcile outstanding invoices and resolve billing disputes.

• Procurement Cleanup: Regularly audit Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PR) to close out aged items and ensure the accuracy of the general ledger.

Who you are;

• Experience: 3+ years in a dual Admin/Finance role or as an Operations Coordinator.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP/Concur and advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).

• Competencies: High attention to detail, strong negotiation skills for vendor management, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Technical Proficiencies & Software Skills

• ERP & Expense Management:
• Proficiency in SAP for auditing and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems specifically for AR/AP modules and PO management.

• Data Analysis & Reporting:
• Advanced MS Excel Skills: Must be comfortable with VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and Data Validation to reconcile large financial datasets.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Ph

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Marketing Events & Administrative Coordinator serves as a dual-impact specialist, ensuring the seamless execution of high-profile corporate events while maintaining the operational integrity of the company’s administrative and financial processes.

Key Duties and Responsibilities;
