titleByLocale.fr: Stage - Projet de transformation du PGI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship - ERP Transformation Project
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented ERP Transformation Project Intern to join our global transformation team. In this role, you will sit at the heart of our SAP S/4HANA & EWM deployment, gaining hands-on exposure to a large-scale digital + business transformation. You will directly support the Project Management Office (PMO) and work cross-functionally across critical workstreams - including system integration, system testing master data, user training, organizational change management, and technical/business go live.
This is an exceptional opportunity to learn how a multi-million dollar technology implementation operates from the ground up and build highly marketable enterprise project management skills.
Key Responsibilities
1. PMO & Governance Support

• Track Project Milestones: Support PMO in maintaining and updating the master deployment project plan, tracking deliverables across various workstreams.

• Meeting Coordination: Organize, document, and distribute action items/minutes for critical workstream syncs and steering committee updates.

• RAID Log Management: Assist in maintaining the Risk, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAID) log, ensuring owners update their mitigation plans weekly.
2. Integration & Partner System Readiness

• Interface Tracking: Maintain the master integration matrix, tracking the development, testing, and sign-off status of all inbound and outbound interfaces connecting to S/4HANA & EWM.

• Partner Coordination: Act as a liaison with external third-party partners, vendors, and business users to coordinate connectivity setup and end-to-end interface testing schedules.

• Cutover Planning for Systems: Support the Integration Lead in mapping out the precise transition activities for all partner system’s interfaces.
2. Master Data Readiness

• Data Readiness Tracking: Assist Data Lead and business data owners in tracking the progress of data collection and verification cycles across all data objects.

• Data Dictionary & Governance Documentation : Assist in documenting data definitions, field-level requirements, data loading and verification strategy in a Data Input Plan to support future data governance processes.

• Data Reconciliation Support: Help document pre- and post-load data reconciliation reports, ensuring loaded SAP data perfectly matches approved source files.
4. Testing Coordination

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Stage - Projet de transformation du PGI Aperçu du rôle Nous recherchons un stagiaire de projet de transformation ERP hautement motivé et axé sur les détails pour rejoindre notre équipe de transformation mondiale. Dans ce rôle, vous vous retrouverez au cœur de notre déploiement SAP S/4HANA & EWM, en profitant de l'exposition pratique à une transformation digitale et commerciale à grande échelle. Vous soutiendrez directement le Bureau de gestion de projet (BGP) et travaillerez de manière interfonctionnelle dans tous les secteurs de travail critiques - y compris l'intégration du système, les données de base d'essai du système, la formation des utilisateurs, la gestion du changement organisationnel et la mise en oeuvre des techniques et des activités. C'est une occasion exceptionnelle d'apprendre comment une mise en oeuvre technologique de plusieurs millions de dollars fonctionne depuis le début et d'acquérir des compétences hautement commercialisables en gestion de projets d'entreprise. Principales responsabilités 1. PMO & Soutien à la gouvernance
• Suivre les jalons du projet : aider le BGP à maintenir et à mettre à jour le plan directeur du projet de déploiement, à suivre les produits livrables dans divers secteurs de travail.
• Coordination de la réunion : Organiser, documenter et distribuer les points/minutes d'action pour les synchronisations essentielles du cycle de travail et les mises à jour du comité directeur.
• Gestion des registres RAID : Aider à maintenir le registre des risques, des hypothèses, des problèmes et des dépendances (RAID), en veillant à ce que les propriétaires mettent à jour leurs plans d'atténuation chaque semaine. 2. Intégration et préparation du système partenaire
• Suivi de l'interface: Maintenez la matrice d'intégration principale, suivi du développement, des tests et de l'état de signature de toutes les interfaces entrantes et sortantes se connectant à S/4HANA & EWM.
• Coordination des partenaires : agir en tant que liaison avec les partenaires externes, les fournisseurs et les utilisateurs commerciaux pour coordonner la configuration de la connectivité et les calendriers de tests d'interface de bout en bout.
• Cutover Planning for Systems: Supportez le responsable de l'intégration dans la cartographie des activités de transition précises pour toutes les interfaces du système partenaire. 2. Maîtrise de la préparation aux données
• Suivi de l'état de préparation des données : Aider les propriétaires de données de direction et de données d'entreprise à suivre l'avancement des cycles de collecte et de vérification des données dans tous les objets de données.
• Documentation sur le dictionnaire de données et la gouvernance : aider à documenter les définitions des données, les exigences au niveau du champ, le chargement des données et la stratégie de vérification dans un plan d'entrée des données pour soutenir les processus de gouvernance des données futurs.
• Support de rapprochement des données : aide à documenter les rapports de rapprochement des données avant et après le chargement, garantissant que les données SAP chargées correspondent parfaitement aux fichiers sources approuvés. 4. Coordination des essais
• Suivi de l'état et des défauts : Surveiller les paramètres de l'état et des défauts lors des tests d'acceptation par l'utilisateur (UAT) et des tests d'acceptation par le système (SAT) en utilisant des outils comme Solman, .
• Support du testeur : aidez à coordonner les calendriers de test, en veillant à ce que les testeurs professionnels aient le bon accès, les scripts de test et les variantes de données requises.
• Test Logistics & Environment Ready: Coordonner la logistique des cycles de test, y compris la réservation de salles de test, le suivi de la fréquentation quotidienne des testeurs, et confirmer que les données de test nécessaires et la connectivité de l'environnement sont prêtes avant l'exécution. 5. Formation, autorisations et gestion du changement organisationnel
• Logistique de la formation : Coordonner la planification des séances de formation des utilisateurs finals, suivre les taux d'achèvement dans différentes unités opérationnelles.
• Cartographie des rôles : Aider l'équipe de sécurité à cartographier les utilisateurs professionnels en fonction de rôles et d'autorisations spécifiques en matière de sécurité du SAP, selon la conception organisationnelle.
• Engagement et coordination des événements : Planifier, organiser et faciliter les activités de gestion du changement - y compris les mairies, les défilés, les ateliers d'alignement des dirigeants,

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

The Head of Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management will lead RDT’s strategic technology vendor governance and Software Asset Management practice across a complex global technology landscape.

The role covers vendors across software, SaaS, cloud, platforms, on-premise infrastructure, infrastructure services and managed services. It is accountable for creating a transparent, stable, commercially disciplined and risk-managed vendor ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a large-scale technology vendor portfolio representing several hundred million CHF in spend and a team of around a dozen professionals.
The role combines vendor governance, SAM, licensing compliance, vendor risk management, service performance, operational stability, commercial oversight and senior stakeholder engagement.

Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management ensures that RDT’s critical technology vendors operate within clear standards, controls and performance expectations.

It partners with RDT functions, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Operations to ensure technology vendor relationships are compliant, stable, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise priorities.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the microbiological testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely data to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• CCS Support: Support the establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) for the aseptic production line.

• Environmental Monitoring (EM): Support EMPQ execution according to the project timeline.

• Microbiology Method Validation: Support the microbiology methods transfer, including supporting the confirmation of cleaning and disinfection processes, and the efficacy of disinfectants.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies
● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on microbiology and aseptic processes. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and microbiological testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab per completare GMP Self-Inspection e la relativa CAPAs per mantenere il livello globale di conformità GMP.

• Mantenere la pulizia del laboratorio e l'inventario delle forniture di microbiologia
• Supporta iniziative magre nel campo delle operazioni di laboratorio, esecuzione dei metodi di prova, aggiornamento della documentazione e qualificazione delle attrezzature Supporto del progetto di ingegneria e la disponibilità di funzionamento:
• Supporto CCS: Supporta la creazione della strategia di controllo delle contaminazioni (CCS) per la linea di produzione asetica.
• Monitoraggio ambientale (EM): Supporta l'esecuzione EMPQ in base alla timeline del progetto.
• Metodo di Microbiologia Validazione: Supporta il trasferimento dei metodi di microbiologia, incluso il supporto alla conferma dei processi di pulizia e disinfezione, e l'efficacia dei disinfettanti.
• Supporto per l'attrezzatura: Sostenere le qualifiche di prestazione (PQ) delle attrezzature di laboratorio e garantire il funzionamento di routine. Qualificazione e esperienza Istruzione/Qualifiche ● Corso di laurea (scienze di vita, microbiologia, o scienze analitiche è preferito) e sopra Competenze richieste ● 2 o più anni di esperienza QC, esperienza QC, con un focus sulla microbiologia e processi asettici. L'esperienza MNC Biopharma è preferita ● Conoscenza sonora delle procedure di controllo della qualità e degli standard legali, con esperienza nella garanzia asettica e test microbiologici. ● Esperienza in QC nuova disponibilità di avvio della struttura e la rampa di funzionamento è preferito. ● Capacità di comunicazione fluida in inglese ● Le competenze di gestione del progetto sono preferite. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance - Hazard Communication
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Regulatory SME (Subject Matter Expert) within the Center of Excellence, you act as the vital link between regulatory requirements and technical implementation. You will lead the organization in interpreting GHS/CLP and Dangerous Goods regulations, ensuring that Roche Diagnostics products are classified correctly and compliant globally. You don’t just follow rules; you define what compliance looks like for our specific product portfolio, now and in the future.

Key Responsibilities

• Detailed Regulatory Assessment: Lead the technical evaluation of new and changing regulations (primarily GHS/CLP). Translate complex legal text into a "Regulatory Opinion" that provides a clear, auditable rationale for Roche Diagnostics.

• Product Impact Analysis: Apply your scientific background to assess how chemical compositions and product designs are impacted by hazard communication standards.

• Strategic Compliance Roadmap: Identify upcoming regulatory trends and define the long-term compliance strategy to "future-proof" the Roche portfolio.

• Cross-Functional Implementation: Support implementation projects at all levels, ensuring that operational teams (OETs) understand how to apply regulatory opinions to compliance outputs (e.g. SDS).

• Internal Point of Contact: Serve as the primary technical expert for internal queries, prioritizing work based on risk and business impact.

Who You Are

• The Scientist-turned-Regulator: You hold a University degree in a Natural Science (Chemistry, Biology, or related) and have successfully transitioned into a Regulatory Affairs career. Other university background will be also valued.

• The GHS/CLP Expert: You have a deep understanding of Hazard Communication (80% focus) and a solid grasp of Dangerous Goods frameworks (20% focus).

• The Analytical Thinker: You enjoy dissecting complex legal texts and applying them to technical product data.

• The Effective Communicator: You can explain the "why" behind a regulation to both a lab scientist and a business executive.

The Collaborative Partner: You thrive in a global "Center of Excellence" environment, working closely with Monitoring squads and Operational teams.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Partner (Oncology & Ophthalmology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join a leading global healthcare organization as our Medical Partner to drive the medical agenda for Ophthalmology and Oncology therapeutic areas, where your expertise will directly influence patient care and shape the future of medicine. You will serve as the medical strategic leader, responsible for overseeing local medical activities, supporting product launches, driving scientific engagement, and ensuring compliance with both local and international regulations.

This is your chance to play a critical role in a company that values innovation, integrity, and impact. As part of a collaborative, cross-functional team, you will contribute to bringing innovative therapies to patients, supporting clinical excellence, and partnering with key stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem.
The Medical Partner is a therapeutic/disease area expert who supports teams in relevant areas, ensuring medical decisions remain independent from promotional objectives. They fluidly join therapeutic area teams as needed.
The Medical Partner works within teams to understand patient needs and ecosystem requirements, deriving insights to inform strategy. They enable national-level activities that benefit the medical community and improve clinical practice.
The Medical Partner develops expertise across multiple molecules or indications, driving evidence generation and scientific exchange. They enhance collaboration within the network, locally and internationally, focusing on high-value activities that impact the patient journey.

Key Areas of Responsibility

• Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a scientifically sound and differentiated value story across key disease areas

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific and clinical practice insights (including patient perspectives) into strategic actionable and differentiating recommendations for the local teams

• Provide medical expertise and customer insights to the local teams, shape medical practice and drive the adoption of medical innovations

• Provide expert opinion on scientific medical information to execute our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOPs and local/international regulations.

• Identify and develop scientific relationships with external experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice.

• Proactive customer engagement; build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, and academic institutions.

• Plan and execute relevant scientific expert meetings and advisory boards.

• Provide medical expertise in development of reimbursement dossiers.

• Implement compassionate use programs according to local situations.

• Manage of Medical Information enquiries

• Oversee medical training and education initiatives.

Who You Are

• Medical Degree (MD) or advanced degree in life sciences (PharmD, life science PhD,) with strong clinical/scientific background.

• Professional experience in medical affairs or clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Understanding of clinical trial design, interpretation and biostatistics. Established knowledge base / skill set in data generation (clinical trials, IIS, RWE programs).

• Customer focus - prioritizes the needs of patients and customers (HCPs/TAEs), ensuring all actions drive value and satisfaction.

• Excellent ability to articulate complex medical and scientific context, inform medical guidelines by contextualizing

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti a una principale organizzazione sanitaria globale come nostro Partner Medico per guidare l'agenda medica per le aree terapeutiche di Oftalmologia e Oncologia, dove la tua esperienza influenzerà direttamente la cura del paziente e plasmare il futuro della medicina. Servirete come leader strategico medico, responsabile della supervisione delle attività mediche locali, del supporto ai lanci dei prodotti, della guida dell'impegno scientifico e della conformità alle normative locali e internazionali. Questa è la tua occasione per svolgere un ruolo critico in un'azienda che valorizza innovazione, integrità e impatto. Nell'ambito di un team collaborativo e interfunzionale, contribuirai a portare terapie innovative ai pazienti, supportando l'eccellenza clinica e collaborando con i principali stakeholder dell'ecosistema sanitario. Il Medical Partner è un esperto di area terapeutica/disease che supporta i team in settori rilevanti, garantendo che le decisioni mediche rimangano indipendenti dagli obiettivi promozionali. Si uniscono fluidamente alle squadre di area terapeutica come necessario. Il Medical Partner lavora all'interno dei team per comprendere le esigenze dei pazienti e i requisiti dell'ecosistema, derivanti da approfondimenti per informare la strategia. Essi consentono attività a livello nazionale che beneficiano della comunità medica e migliorano la pratica clinica. Il Medical Partner sviluppa competenze in molteplici molecole o indicazioni, guidando la generazione delle prove e lo scambio scientifico. Migliorano la collaborazione all'interno della rete, a livello locale e internazionale, concentrandosi su attività di alto valore che influiscono sul viaggio del paziente. Aree chiave di responsabilità
• Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore scientificamente sana e differenziata in aree chiave della malattia
• Raccogliere, analizzare e tradurre intuizioni di pratica scientifica e clinica esterna (comprese le prospettive del paziente) in raccomandazioni strategiche attuabili e differenzianti per i team locali
• Fornire competenze mediche e conoscenze dei clienti ai team locali, modellare la pratica medica e guidare l'adozione di innovazioni mediche
• Fornire un parere esperto sulle informazioni mediche scientifiche per eseguire le nostre strategie di prodotto, mantenendo elevati standard etici, conformità alle Roche SOP e normative locali/internazionali.
• Identificare e sviluppare relazioni scientifiche con esperti esterni che sono fonti qualificate di comprensione e consulenza.
• Impegno proattivo del cliente; costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i leader di opinione chiave, professionisti sanitari e istituzioni accademiche.
• Pianificare ed eseguire le riunioni di esperti scientifici pertinenti e consigli di consulenza.
• Fornire competenze mediche nello sviluppo di dossier di rimborso.
• Implementare programmi di uso compassionevole secondo le situazioni locali.
• Gestione delle richieste di informazioni mediche
• Sorvegliare le iniziative di formazione medica e di istruzione. Chi sei
• Laurea medica (MD) o grado avanzato nelle scienze della vita (PharmD, Life Science PhD,) con un forte background clinico/scientifico.
• Esperienza professionale negli affari medici o nello sviluppo clinico all'interno del settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico.
• Comprensione della progettazione clinica, interpretazione e biostatistica. Base di conoscenza/abilità stabilita nella generazione dei dati (prove cliniche, programmi IIS, RWE).
• L'attenzione del cliente - privilegia le esigenze dei pazienti e dei clienti (HCP/TAEs), assicurando tutte le azioni guidare valore e soddisfazione.
• Ottima capacità di articolare il complesso contesto medico e scientifico, informare le linee guida mediche contestualizzare

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Main Responsibilities

• Acting as an Enterprise Partner along the entire patient disease journey to drive better outcomes for patients faster, functioning as a catalyst in the newly customer-oriented implementation model.

• Guiding the business squads/teams as a strategic partner to drive patient and customer centric ambitions, driving outcome-based planning with end-to-end perspective , including fit-for-purpose planning, next level of business analytics and insightful decision-making with focus on short, mid and long-term.

• Drive P&L management to ensure rigorous execution and fast responses to the business needs and adjusted priorities.

• Effective resource allocation on sustainable investment , facilitating constructive discussions about difficult trade-off decisions with business partners within and across business areas and recognizing potential for new growth opportunities.

• Performing core financial management tasks , including Event Driven Planning and financial modeling seeking for continuous learning and improvement.

• Continuously examining and interpreting data , such as financial statements, price developments, market dynamics, productivity measures, investment opportunities to inform decision making.

• Collaborating with other key players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services) , ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g., eCoE, and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

Expected Skills and Capabilities

• Successful candidate must be CA/CPA qualified and CFA qualified is a plus.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in Finance roles (e.g., FP&A, Planning & Controlling, etc)

• Business Acumen & Entrepreneurial Spirit in challenging the status quo and suggesting new solutions to complex issues.

• Strong Business Partner Skills, ‘seating at the table’ with the internal and external customers.

• Capacity to swarm strategically and operationally across the business.

• Leadership experience in working with self-aligned teams seeking for fast implementation of solutions in uncertain environments.

• Negotiation skills and ability to build strong partnerships, internally and externally.

• Enterprise mindset, connecting the dots and seeking for synergies that can concrete a bigger impact.

• Influence and communication skills that aim to share and absorb learnings and best practices across borders for the benefit of the enti

The Position
The Senior IT Data Scientist is responsible for leading, developing, and implementing data-driven AI and GenAI solutions to complex business problems. This role involves independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration and analysis, and building, testing, and deploying predictive models using various machine learning techniques. You will own projects from inception to deployment, leveraging strong programming, statistical modeling, and data visualization skills, while clearly communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Description of the area
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Data & Analytics area is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes. We’re looking for a hands-on Full-Stack AI Developer (Generalist) to join a small, fast-moving team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building end-to-end products, thrives in ambiguity, and is excited about applying AI in practical, user-facing applications.
This role seeks a broad skillset, strong foundational knowledge, and tech stack flexibility over deep specialization. You will support Roche's Data & AI strategies by working with global platforms.
This position involves collaboration with key stakeholders, including Global Procurement, Diagnostics Direct Procurement, and RSS Operations.

Job Responsibilities

• Design, build, and ship AI-powered applications from concept to production

• Develop backend services and APIs using Python

• Build responsive frontend interfaces using JavaScript / TypeScript

• Integrate LLMs into products for real-world use cases

• Build and improve RAG pipelines, prompt workflows, and agentic AI systems

• Work with modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and delivery

• Collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

• Take ownership of features across architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred

• Equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable

• Demonstrated experience in independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration, and owning projects from inception to deployment.

• Proven track record of driving medium-sized projects that influence business decisions and align with strategic objectives.

• A strong portfolio / GitHub profile with personal projects is highly valued

Technical Skills

• Strong experience in Python backend development

• Solid experience with JavaScript / TypeScript frontend development

• Comfortable working across the full stack and shipping complete features

• Snowflake CORTEX AI or Dataiku (Optional)

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior IT Data Scientist is responsible for leading, developing, and implementing data-driven AI and GenAI solutions to complex business problems. This role involves independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration and analysis, and building, testing, and deploying predictive models using various machine learning techniques. You will own projects from inception to deployment, leveraging strong programming, statistical modeling, and data visualization skills, while clearly communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Description of the area
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Data & Analytics area is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes. We’re looking for a hands-on Full-Stack AI Developer (Generalist) to join a small, fast-moving team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building end-to-end products, thrives in ambiguity, and is excited about applying AI in practical, user-facing applications.
This role seeks a broad skillset, strong foundational knowledge, and tech stack flexibility over deep specialization. You will support Roche's Data & AI strategies by working with global platforms.
This position involves collaboration with key stakeholders, including Global Procurement, Diagnostics Direct Procurement, and RSS Operations.

Job Responsibilities

• Design, build, and ship AI-powered applications from concept to production

• Develop backend services and APIs using Python

• Build responsive frontend interfaces using JavaScript / TypeScript

• Integrate LLMs into products for real-world use cases

• Build and improve RAG pipelines, prompt workflows, and agentic AI systems

• Work with modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and delivery

• Collaborate closely with product and business stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

• Take ownership of features across architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred

• Equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable

• Demonstrated experience in independently identifying analytical opportunities, conducting in-depth data exploration, and owning projects from inception to deployment.

• Proven track record of driving medium-sized projects that influence business decisions and align with strategic objectives.

• A strong portfolio / GitHub profile with personal projects is highly valued

Technical Skills

• Strong experience in Python backend development

• Solid experience with JavaScript / TypeScript frontend development

• Comfortable working across the full stack and shipping complete features

AI / GenAI Experience

• Prompt engineering

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The IT Infrastructure Engineer will be primarily responsible for the configuration, implementation, operation and optimization of supported IT Networks technologies. While your core focus is on ensuring a reliable and stable environment, you will also work with business stakeholders, IT partners, and vendors to design and build IT solutions that are robust, flexible, resilient, and supportable. By applying software engineering principles, you will help modernize our infrastructure, optimizing service reliability and eliminating manual work through automation.

Your Responsibilities

• Ensure the infrastructure is running properly to achieve agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Objectives (SLOs) in compliance with quality requirements. Manage internal infrastructure updates and patch implementations to maintain a reliable and stable environment.

• Work closely with stakeholders, internal and externals, to design , build and maintain IT solutions that meet business requirements for performance, availability, security, and compatibility.

• Apply software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products across their lifecycle. Support to abstract away infrastructure complexity by providing self-service tools

• Manage ITSM processes and track the resolution for reporting and resolving incidents, problems, changes, requests, and releases. Serve as technical support to all technologies managed by the team.

• Build relationships with customers, developers, and support teams to deliver outstanding support that meets or exceeds expectations. May lead assigned projects to influence and achieve defined goals and dates.

• Ensure external vendors and service providers meet our high standards.

• Maintain an in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies within your infrastructure area of responsibility (such as data center, wireless, Local Area Networks, Wide Area Networks and automation) to support the team and tackle complex, interdisciplinary issues.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or equivalent work experience

• You bring over 3 years of experience as a Network Engineer. Cisco CCNP certification is preferred

• You have supported, troubleshooted, and implemented large and complex data networks (LAN, DCLAN, WAN, Wireless)

• You have worked with external vendors and service providers, particularly telecom carriers

• You are experienced with infrastructure automation, including automated provisioning of network devices

• Experience applying infrastructure automation tools, infrastructure as code (IaC), scripting languages, logging, monitoring, and observability tools

• You can work flexible hours, handle occasional overtime, and participate in on-call duties

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

Applicando i principi di ingegneria del software, aiuterà a modernizzare la nostra infrastruttura, ottimizzare l'affidabilità del servizio e eliminare il lavoro manuale attraverso l'automazione. Le tue responsabilità
• Assicurarsi che l'infrastruttura sia in esecuzione correttamente per ottenere accordi di livello di servizio concordati (SLA), accordi di livello operativo (OLAs), indicatori di livello di servizio (SLIs), e obiettivi (SLOs) nel rispetto dei requisiti di qualità. Gestisci gli aggiornamenti delle infrastrutture interne e le implementazioni di patch per mantenere un ambiente affidabile e stabile.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con stakeholder, interni ed esterni, per progettare, costruire e mantenere soluzioni IT che soddisfano i requisiti aziendali per prestazioni, disponibilità, sicurezza e compatibilità.
• Applicare i principi di ingegneria del software per costruire e gestire i prodotti di infrastruttura IT su larga scala nel loro ciclo di vita. Supporto per astratta complessità delle infrastrutture fornendo strumenti self-service
• Gestire i processi ITSM e monitorare la risoluzione per segnalare e risolvere incidenti, problemi, modifiche, richieste e comunicati. Servire come supporto tecnico a tutte le tecnologie gestite dal team.
• Costruire relazioni con clienti, sviluppatori e team di supporto per fornire un supporto eccezionale che soddisfa o supera le aspettative. Può portare progetti assegnati per influenzare e raggiungere obiettivi e date definiti.
• Assicurare fornitori esterni e fornitori di servizi soddisfare i nostri elevati standard.
• Mantenere una conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie attuali ed emergenti all'interno della vostra area di responsabilità infrastrutturale (come data center, wireless, reti di area locale, reti di ampia area e automazione) per supportare il team e affrontare questioni complesse e interdisciplinari. Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, ingegneria informatica, o esperienza lavorativa equivalente
• Porti oltre 3 anni di esperienza come ingegnere di rete. La certificazione Cisco CCNP è preferita
• Hai supportato, risolto i problemi e implementato reti di dati grandi e complesse (LAN, DCLAN, WAN, Wireless)
• Hai lavorato con fornitori esterni e fornitori di servizi, in particolare vettori di telecomunicazioni
• L'utente è esperto nell'automazione delle infrastrutture, inclusa la fornitura automatizzata di dispositivi di rete
• Esperienza nell'applicazione di strumenti di automazione delle infrastrutture, infrastrutture come codice (IaC), linguaggi di script, logging, monitoraggio e strumenti di osservabilità
• È possibile lavorare ore flessibili, gestire straordinario occasionale, e partecipare a compiti on-call
• Sei fluente in inglese, sia scritto che parlato #RDT2026 Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The IT Infrastructure Engineer will be primarily responsible for the configuration, implementation, operation and optimization of supported IT Networks technologies. While your core focus is on ensuring a reliable and stable environment, you will also work with business stakeholders, IT partners, and vendors to design and build IT solutions that are robust, flexible, resilient, and supportable. By applying software engineering principles, you will help modernize our infrastructure, optimizing service reliability and eliminating manual work through automation.

Your Responsibilities

• Ensure the infrastructure is running properly to achieve agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Objectives (SLOs) in compliance with quality requirements. Manage internal infrastructure updates and patch implementations to maintain a reliable and stable environment.

• Work closely with stakeholders, internal and externals, to design , build and maintain IT solutions that meet business requirements for performance, availability, security, and compatibility.

• Apply software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products across their lifecycle. Support to abstract away infrastructure complexity by providing self-service tools

• Manage ITSM processes and track the resolution for reporting and resolving incidents, problems, changes, requests, and releases. Serve as technical support to all technologies managed by the team.

• Build relationships with customers, developers, and support teams to deliver outstanding support that meets or exceeds expectations. May lead assigned projects to influence and achieve defined goals and dates.

• Ensure external vendors and service providers meet our high standards.

• Maintain an in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies within your infrastructure area of responsibility (such as data center, wireless, Local Area Networks, Wide Area Networks and automation) to support the team and tackle complex, interdisciplinary issues.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or equivalent work experience

• You bring over 3 years of experience as a Network Engineer. Cisco CCNP certification is preferred

• You have supported, troubleshooted, and implemented large and complex data networks (LAN, DCLAN, WAN, Wireless)

• You have worked with external vendors and service providers, particularly telecom carriers

• You are experienced with infrastructure automation, including automated provisioning of network devices

• Experience applying infrastructure automation tools, infrastructure as code (IaC), scripting languages, logging, monitoring, and observability tools

• You can work flexible hours, handle occasional overtime, and participate in on-call duties

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

#RDT2026

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur de l'infrastructure informatique sera principalement responsable de la configuration, de la mise en œuvre, de l'exploitation et de l'optimisation des technologies des réseaux informatiques. Bien que votre objectif principal soit d'assurer un environnement fiable et stable, vous travaillerez également avec les intervenants commerciaux, les partenaires informatiques et les fournisseurs pour concevoir et construire des solutions informatiques robustes, flexibles, résilientes et supportables. En appliquant des principes d'ingénierie logicielle, vous contribuerez à moderniser notre infrastructure, à optimiser la fiabilité du service et à éliminer le travail manuel grâce à l'automatisation. Vos responsabilités
• S'assurer que l'infrastructure fonctionne correctement pour atteindre les ententes sur les niveaux de service (ALS), les ententes sur les niveaux opérationnels (ALS), les indicateurs de niveau de service (ALS) et les objectifs (ALS) en conformité avec les exigences de qualité. Gérer les mises à jour internes de l'infrastructure et les implémentations patch pour maintenir un environnement fiable et stable.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, internes et externes, pour concevoir, construire et maintenir des solutions informatiques qui répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de performance, de disponibilité, de sécurité et de compatibilité.
• Appliquer les principes d'ingénierie logicielle pour construire et gérer des produits d'infrastructure informatique à grande échelle tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Soutien à la complexité de l'infrastructure par la fourniture d'outils en libre-service
• Gérer les processus de la GTI et suivre la résolution des incidents, des problèmes, des changements, des demandes et des rejets. Servir de support technique à toutes les technologies gérées par l'équipe.
• Établir des relations avec les clients, les développeurs et les équipes de soutien pour offrir un soutien exceptionnel qui répond ou dépasse les attentes. Peut diriger des projets assignés pour influencer et atteindre des objectifs et des dates définis.
• Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs externes et les fournisseurs de services répondent à nos normes élevées.
• Maintenez une connaissance approfondie des technologies actuelles et émergentes dans votre domaine de responsabilité (comme le centre de données, les réseaux locaux sans fil, les réseaux étendus et l'automatisation) afin de soutenir l'équipe et d'aborder des questions interdisciplinaires complexes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en informatique, en génie informatique ou une expérience de travail équivalente
• Vous apportez plus de 3 ans d'expérience en tant qu'ingénieur réseau. La certification Cisco CCNP est préférée
• Vous avez pris en charge, dépanné et mis en place de grands réseaux de données complexes (LAN, DCLAN, WAN, Wireless)
• Vous avez travaillé avec des fournisseurs et des fournisseurs de services externes, en particulier des entreprises de télécommunications
• Vous avez l'expérience de l'automatisation de l'infrastructure, y compris la fourniture automatisée d'appareils réseau
• Expérience de l'application des outils d'automatisation de l'infrastructure, de l'infrastructure comme code (IaC), des langages de script, de l'enregistrement, du suivi et des outils d'observation
• Vous pouvez travailler des heures flexibles, faire des heures supplémentaires occasionnelles et participer à des tâches de garde
• Vous parlez couramment l'anglais, écrit et parlé #RDT2026 Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.description:

The Position
Eintrittsdatum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Standort: Roche Pharma (Schweiz) AG, Grenzacherstrasse 124, Basel
Anstellungsart: Vollzeit [Teilzeit 80% nach Rücksprache möglich]

IHRE AUFGABEN
In dieser vielseitigen Position verantworten Sie sämtliche Pricing- und Market-Access-Aspekte für Ihr zugeteiltes Produktportfolio und agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle.

• Schnittstellenfunktion: Sie agieren als kompetente Schaltstelle zu globalen Pricing-Funktionen und sind in unserer Matrix-Organisation für die zugeteilten Therapiegebiete die Ansprechperson für Fragestellungen zum Gesundheitssystem sowie der Preisbildung. Zudem unterstützen Sie unser Policy-Team bei diversen gesundheitspolitischen und regulatorischen Themen.

IHR PROFIL – Das bringen Sie mit
Sie sind eine analytische Persönlichkeit, die gerne strategisch arbeitet, aber auch in der Umsetzung glänzt. Sie verstehen es, den Wert medizinischer Innovationen überzeugend zu argumentieren.

• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie, Medizin, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, kombiniert mit mindestens 2 Jahren fundierter Berufserfahrung im Market Access & Pricing in der Schweizer Healthcare-Industrie.

• Einflussnahme & Verhandlungsgeschick: Sie besitzen die Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf Augenhöhe zu überzeugen und Verhandlungen partnerschaftlich, aber zielorientiert zum Erfolg zu führen.

• Projektmanagement & Analytik: Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten gepaart mit einem strukturierten Projektmanagement, um komplexe Dossiers und Timelines im Griff zu behalten.

• Kreativität & Teamgeist: Sie bringen Kreativität und Innovationskraft in die Lösungsfindung ein und zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Zusammenarbeit und Teamfähigkeit aus.

• Sprachen: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (Niveau Muttersprache) und Englisch. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an Information Security Governance Expert, you drive the integrity and resilience of Roche's Information Security Management System (ISMS). You are responsible for ensuring the organization maintains its yearly security certifications and remains compliant with evolving global regulations such as the US DOJ, NIS2 and RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11. You combine deep information security experience with sound regulatory knowledge and project management skills, to lead external audits & inspections and strategic security initiatives across the group. Your goal is to ensure that the security framework is not only compliant but also scalable and effective in protecting Roche's critical assets in a highly regulated environment. You have a proven track record of turning information security governance into a business enabler.

The Information Security & Privacy Governance team provides the framework for Roche to identify, assess, and mitigate information risks. The area is organized around three pillars:

• Governance & ISMS: Maintaining Roche Global ISMS framework and certification (ISO/IEC 27001).

• Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring adherence of Roche global ISMS to US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 and global healthcare/medical device regulations.

• Audit & Assurance: Support Roche affiliates during external inspections, demonstrating their commitment to compliance.

Job Responsibilities
ISMS Strategy & Framework Management

• Global ISMS Ownership : Own and maintain the Roche ISMS framework, ensuring full alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and integration with other quality management systems.

• Continual Improvement: Drive the ISMS "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) cycle to ensure the framework evolves with the threat landscape and business needs, maintaining successful yearly certification continuity.

• Policy Governance: Define and maintain enterprise-level security policies, standards, directives and procedures, ensuring they are fit-for-purpose, actionable and measurable.

• Risk Monitoring: Monitor the global risk landscape to identify adaptations required to the governance framework.

Regulatory & Compliance Orchestration

• Regulatory Translation: Integrate complex global requirements (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) into Roche Global ISMS.

• Product & Services: Collaborate with product teams to ensure "Security by Design" integration into their culture, skillset, processes and projects.

• Control Mapping: Maintain a unified control framework that maps internal Roche controls to multiple external regulatory requirements to validate coverage of the Roche Global ISMS.

• Consulting: Act as a consultant to Roche affiliates, guiding them toward compliance with regional or functional security directives.

Audit & Inspection Support

• External Audit & Inspection Support: Support legal entities of the Roche Group & functions during external audits and regulatory inspections.

• Risks Treatment Oversight: Coordinate remediation plans for audit and inspection findings and track progress to closure.

• Third-Party Governance: Oversee the security governance framework for critical supply chain partners and Cloud Service Providers.

Stakeholder & Change Management

• Strategic Advisory: Serve as a bridge between senior leadership, legal, privacy and quality to communicate information security risks and maturity milestones.

• Culture & Awareness: Support the Information Security networks by providing high-level governance guidance and strategic direction.

Qualification

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come esperto di gestione della sicurezza delle informazioni, si guida l'integrità e la resilienza del sistema di gestione della sicurezza delle informazioni di Roche (ISMS). Lei è responsabile di garantire che l'organizzazione mantiene le sue certificazioni annuali di sicurezza e rimane conforme alle normative globali in evoluzione come la US DOJ, NIS2 e RCE/CER, GMP Allegato 11. Unisci profonda esperienza di sicurezza delle informazioni con solide conoscenze normative e competenze di gestione dei progetti, per condurre audit esterni e ispezioni e iniziative di sicurezza strategica in tutto il gruppo. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di garantire che il quadro di sicurezza non è solo conforme, ma anche scalabile ed efficace nella protezione dei beni critici di Roche in un ambiente altamente regolamentato. Hai una comprovata traccia di trasformare la governance della sicurezza delle informazioni in un attivatore aziendale. Il team di Information Security & Privacy Governance fornisce il quadro per Roche per identificare, valutare e mitigare i rischi di informazione. L'area è organizzata intorno a tre pilastri:
• Governance & ISMS: Mantenere Roche Global ISMS framework e certificazione (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Compliance regolamentare: garantire l'adesione di Roche ISMS globale a US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Allegato 11 e le normative sanitarie/medicali globali.
• Audit & Assurance: Support Roche affiliati durante le ispezioni esterne, dimostrando il loro impegno per la conformità. Responsabilità del lavoro Strategia ISMS e Gestione Quadro
• Proprietà ISMS Globale: Possedere e mantenere il framework Roche ISMS, garantendo il pieno allineamento con ISO/IEC 27001:2022 e l'integrazione con altri sistemi di gestione della qualità.
• Miglioramento continuo: Guidare l'ISMS "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) ciclo per garantire che il framework si evolva con il paesaggio minaccia e le esigenze aziendali, mantenendo la continuità di certificazione annuale di successo.
• Governance della politica: Definire e mantenere le politiche di sicurezza a livello aziendale, gli standard, le direttive e le procedure, assicurando che siano adeguate, attuabili e misurabili.
• Monitoraggio del rischio: Monitorare il panorama del rischio globale per identificare gli adattamenti necessari al quadro di governance. Orchestrazione di regolamentazione e conformità
• Traduzione normativa: Integra i complessi requisiti globali (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) in Roche Global ISMS.
• Product & Services: Collabora con i team di prodotti per garantire l'integrazione "Security by Design" nella loro cultura, competenza, processi e progetti.
• Mapping di controllo: Mantenere un quadro di controllo unificato che mappa i controlli interni Roche a più requisiti normativi esterni per convalidare la copertura del Roche Global ISMS.
• Consulenza: agire come consulente per gli affiliati Roche, guidandoli verso il rispetto delle direttive di sicurezza regionali o funzionali. Supporto di controllo e ispezione
• Supporto per la verifica e l'ispezione esterna: Supporta le entità giuridiche del Gruppo Roche e le funzioni durante i controlli esterni e le ispezioni normative.
• Supervisione del trattamento dei rischi: Coordinate piani di bonifica per i risultati dell'audit e dell'ispezione e tracciate i progressi verso la chiusura.
• Governance di terze parti: supervisionare il quadro di governance della sicurezza per i partner critici della supply chain e i provider di servizi cloud. Stakeholder & Change Management
• Strategic Advisory: Servire come ponte tra leadership senior, legale, privacy e qualità per comunicare i rischi di sicurezza delle informazioni e le pietre miliari di maturità.
• Cultura & Awareness: Sostenere le reti di sicurezza dell'informazione fornendo una guida di governance di alto livello e una direzione strategica. Qualificazione

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Information Security Governance Expert treiben Sie die Integrität und Belastbarkeit des Roche Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) voran. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass das Unternehmen seine jährlichen Sicherheitszertifizierungen beibehält und die sich ändernden globalen Vorschriften wie das US-amerikanische DOJ, NIS2 und RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 erfüllt. Sie kombinieren fundierte Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit mit fundierten regulatorischen Kenntnissen und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten, um externe Audits und Inspektionen sowie strategische Sicherheitsinitiativen in der gesamten Gruppe zu leiten. Ihr Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass das Sicherheits-Framework nicht nur konform, sondern auch skalierbar und effektiv ist, um die kritischen Assets von Roche in einem stark regulierten Umfeld zu schützen. Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umwandlung von Information Security Governance in ein Business Enabler. Das Team Information Security & Privacy Governance bietet Roche den Rahmen, um Informationsrisiken zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und zu mindern. Der Bereich ist um drei Säulen organisiert:
• Governance & ISMS: Pflege des Roche Global ISMS Frameworks und der Zertifizierung (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung des globalen IMS von Roche nach US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 und globalen Vorschriften für das Gesundheitswesen/Medizinprodukte.
• Audit & Assurance: Unterstützen Sie Roche-Tochtergesellschaften bei externen Inspektionen und zeigen Sie ihre Verpflichtung zur Einhaltung. Aufgabenbereich ISMS Strategie & Framework Management
• Globales ISMS-Eigentum : Besitzen und pflegen Sie das Roche ISMS-Framework, um eine vollständige Übereinstimmung mit ISO / IEC 27001: 2022 und die Integration mit anderen Qualitätsmanagementsystemen zu gewährleisten.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Fahren Sie den ISMS-Zyklus "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA), um sicherzustellen, dass sich das Framework mit der Bedrohungslandschaft und den Geschäftsanforderungen entwickelt und die erfolgreiche jährliche Zertifizierungskontinuität gewahrt bleibt.
• Policy Governance: Definieren und pflegen Sie Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Standards, Richtlinien und Verfahren auf Unternehmensebene, um sicherzustellen, dass sie zweckdienlich, umsetzbar und messbar sind.
• Risikoüberwachung: Überwachen Sie die globale Risikolandschaft, um Anpassungen zu identifizieren, die an den Governance-Rahmen erforderlich sind. Regulatory & Compliance Orchestrierung
• Regulatory Translation: Integration komplexer globaler Anforderungen (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) in Roche Global ISMS.
• Produkt & Services: Arbeiten Sie mit Produktteams zusammen, um die Integration von "Security by Design" in ihre Kultur, Fähigkeiten, Prozesse und Projekte sicherzustellen.
• Control Mapping: Pflegen Sie ein einheitliches Kontroll-Framework, das interne Roche-Steuerungen mehreren externen regulatorischen Anforderungen zuordnet, um die Abdeckung des Roche Global ISMS zu validieren.
• Beratung: Handeln Sie als Berater für Roche-Tochtergesellschaften und führen Sie sie zur Einhaltung regionaler oder funktionaler Sicherheitsrichtlinien. Audit & Inspection Support
• Externe Audit- und Inspektionsunterstützung: Unterstützung von Rechtspersonen der Roche-Gruppe und Funktionen bei externen Audits und behördlichen Inspektionen.
• Risikobehandlungsaufsicht: Koordinieren Sie Sanierungspläne für Audit- und Inspektionsergebnisse und verfolgen Sie den Fortschritt bis zur Schließung.
• Third-Party Governance: Überwachen Sie das Security Governance Framework für kritische Supply Chain Partner und Cloud Service Provider. Stakeholder & Change Management
• Strategische Beratung: Dienen Sie als Brücke zwischen Führungskräften, Recht, Datenschutz und Qualität, um Informationssicherheitsrisiken und Meilensteine zu kommunizieren.
• Kultur & Bewusstsein: Unterstützen Sie die Informationssicherheitsnetzwerke durch eine hochrangige Governance-Anleitung und strategische Ausrichtung. Qualifikation

La position En tant qu'expert en gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information, vous dirigez l'intégrité et la résilience du Système de gestion de la sécurité de l'information (SGI) de Roche. Vous êtes responsable de veiller à ce que l'organisation conserve ses certifications de sécurité annuelles et demeure conforme à l'évolution de la réglementation mondiale telle que le DOJ, NIS2 et RCE/CER, GMP Annexe 11. Vous combinez une expérience approfondie en matière de sécurité de l'information avec de solides connaissances réglementaires et des compétences en gestion de projet, pour diriger des audits et inspections externes et des initiatives stratégiques en matière de sécurité dans tout le groupe. Votre objectif est de veiller à ce que le cadre de sécurité soit non seulement conforme, mais aussi évolutif et efficace pour protéger les actifs essentiels de Roche dans un environnement hautement réglementé. Vous avez prouvé que la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information est devenue un moteur d'affaires. L'équipe de la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information et de la protection des renseignements personnels fournit le cadre permettant à Roche de cerner, d'évaluer et d'atténuer les risques liés à l'information. La zone est organisée autour de trois piliers :
• Gouvernance et SIGS : Maintenir le cadre et la certification du SIGS mondial de Roche (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Conformité à la réglementation : Assurer le respect de Roche ISMS mondial au DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER des États-Unis, à l'annexe 11 des BPF et aux règlements mondiaux en matière de soins de santé et de dispositifs médicaux.
• Audit & Assurance: Soutenez les affiliés de Roche lors d'inspections externes, démontrant leur engagement envers la conformité. Responsabilités professionnelles Stratégie et cadre de gestion du SGIS
• Global ISMS Ownership : Possédez et maintenez le cadre de l'ISMS Roche, assurant un alignement complet avec ISO/IEC 27001:2022 et l'intégration avec d'autres systèmes de gestion de la qualité.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger le cycle de « Plan-Do-Check-Act » (PDCA) du SGSI afin de s'assurer que le cadre évolue en fonction du paysage de la menace et des besoins opérationnels, tout en maintenant une continuité de certification annuelle réussie.
• Gouvernance des politiques : Définir et maintenir des politiques, des normes, des directives et des procédures de sécurité au niveau de l'entreprise, en veillant à ce qu'elles soient adaptées à l'usage, réalisables et mesurables.
• Surveillance des risques : Surveiller le paysage mondial des risques afin de déterminer les adaptations nécessaires au cadre de gouvernance. Réglementaire & Conformité Orchestration
• Translation réglementaire: Intégrer des exigences mondiales complexes (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) dans Roche Global ISMS.
• Produits et services : Collaborez avec les équipes de produits pour assurer l'intégration de la sécurité par le design dans leur culture, leurs compétences, leurs processus et leurs projets.

• Soutien à l'audit externe et à l'inspection : Soutenir les entités juridiques du Groupe Roche et les fonctions lors des audits externes et des inspections réglementaires.

• Avis stratégique : Servir de passerelle entre les cadres supérieurs, le droit, la protection des renseignements personnels et la qualité pour communiquer les risques liés à la sécurité de l'information et les étapes de maturité.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms. We make medicines at 16 plants and 12 sites around the world. If you would like to get more information about Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT).

Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) focuses on business insights delivery and innovation within the PT financial results through consistent set of processes, reports and analytic tools which enables Business Partners decisions making.

In this role as Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) you are expected to unlock business value working with PT Global Functions, in particular partnering with Global Quality. You will operate in networks and according to agile standards. You will engage and influence decision making with the business and will have the opportunity to engage in relevant work packages with impact on both, company priorities and personal development. You bring expertise and experience which proves track records of solid performance and seniority.

You will bring strong technical expertise (relative to your experience) together with the ability to work in a self-aligning team with minimal hierarchy. You will be a catalyst for the Finance transformation and work effectively as an influencer, leaning in as a coach and catalyst to the Finance network as needed. You have a passion for piloting new approaches and constructively challenging the status quo. You know what great FP&A looks like and can identify improvement areas and also make it happen through effective stakeholder management. You can tolerate ambiguity.

Your main focus area will be Global Quality.

The Opportunity:

• Strengthen Quality Partnership: Act as the primary financial business partner to the Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ) leadership, providing strategic financial guidance on quality system investments, compliance-related projects, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) resource allocation.

• Focus on Systemic Insights: Collaborate with Quality stakeholders to translate performance metrics, such as deviations and inspection findings, into actionable financial insights, supporting long-term strategic shifts from reactive to proactive quality management.

• Governance & Decision Support: Support business cases for quality-driven initiatives, ensuring financial rigor in decisions impacting manufacturing network harmonization, risk mitigation, and the "Quality Unites Us" strategic agenda.

In this role, you are expected to connect the information received through various channels analyze the impacts in PT Financials and beyond, and communicate such to the PT Finance head and other stakeholders where necessary. The enterprise view looking beyond the PT will be a significant success factor for this role.

Who you are

• At least 5-10 years of experience in a multinational financial consolidation environment

• Strong knowledge of manufacturing finance especially in consolidation related to COGS and Inventory and strong knowledge of IFRS, ACCA, or CPA preferred

• Experience with internal controls and external audits is preferred

• Strong stakeholder management skills with various levels and groups of stakeholders. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Entrepreneurial spirit and curiosity that is inspirational to others

• Proven technica

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione PT è coinvolta nella produzione di ogni medicina Roche. dal processo di sviluppo attraverso sperimentazioni cliniche e continuando a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. Produciamo medicinali in 16 piante e 12 siti in tutto il mondo. Se volete ottenere maggiori informazioni su Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT). Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) si concentra sulla fornitura di informazioni aziendali e sull'innovazione all'interno dei risultati finanziari del PT attraverso una serie coerente di processi, report e strumenti analitici che consentono di prendere decisioni dei Business Partner. In questo ruolo come Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) ci si aspetta di sbloccare il valore aziendale lavorando con PT Global Functions, in particolare collaborando con Global Quality. Intraprenderai e influenzerai il processo decisionale con il business e avrai l'opportunità di impegnarsi in pacchetti di lavoro pertinenti con impatto su entrambe le priorità aziendali e sviluppo personale. Porterai competenze ed esperienza che dimostra record di prestazioni solide e anzianità. Porterai una forte esperienza tecnica (relativa alla tua esperienza) insieme alla capacità di lavorare in un team di auto-allineamento con una gerarchia minima. Sarai un catalizzatore per la trasformazione della finanza e lavorerai efficacemente come influencer, appoggiandoti come allenatore e catalizzatore alla rete finanziaria, se necessario. Hai la passione per pilotare nuovi approcci e sfidare costruttivamente lo status quo. Sai come appare grande FP&A e può identificare aree di miglioramento e farlo accadere anche attraverso una gestione efficace delle parti interessate. Puoi tollerare l'ambiguità. La tua area di messa a fuoco principale sarà la Qualità Globale. Opportunità:
• Rafforzare il partenariato qualità: agire come partner primario del business finanziario per la leadership Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ), fornendo orientamenti finanziari strategici sugli investimenti di sistema di qualità, progetti connessi alla conformità, e l'assegnazione delle risorse CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action).
• Focus su Insight sistemici: ditta di partnership con gli stakeholder di qualità per tradurre le metriche delle prestazioni, come deviazioni e risultati delle ispezioni, in in approfondimenti finanziari attuabili, supportando spostamenti strategici a lungo termine da una gestione della qualità reattiva a una proattiva.
• Governance e supporto decisionale: sostenere i casi aziendali per iniziative basate sulla qualità, garantire un rigor finanziario nelle decisioni che incidono sull'armonizzazione delle reti di produzione, sulla mitigazione dei rischi e sull'agenda strategica "Quality Unites Us." In questo ruolo, ci si aspetta che le informazioni ricevute attraverso vari canali analizzino gli impatti in PT Financials e non solo, e comunichino tali effetti alla testa di PT Finance e ad altri stakeholder, ove necessario. La visione dell'impresa che guarda oltre il PT sarà un fattore di successo significativo per questo ruolo. Chi sei
• Almeno 5-10 anni di esperienza in un contesto di consolidamento finanziario multinazionale
• Forte conoscenza del finanziamento manifatturiero soprattutto nel consolidamento legato ai COGS e all'inventario e forte conoscenza degli IFRS, ACCA, o CPA preferita
• Esperienza con controlli interni e audit esterni è preferibile
• Forte competenze di gestione delle parti interessate con vari livelli e gruppi di stakeholder. Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente e parte di un team. Spirito imprenditoriale e curiosità che è ispirazione per gli altri
• Proven technica

Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können.
