Wir stellen Medikamente an 16 Standorten und 12 Standorten weltweit her. Wenn Sie mehr über Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) erfahren möchten. Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) konzentriert sich auf die Bereitstellung und Innovation von Geschäftseinblicken innerhalb der PT-Finanzergebnisse durch konsistente Prozesse, Berichte und Analysewerkzeuge, die es den Geschäftspartnern ermöglichen, Entscheidungen zu treffen. In dieser Funktion als Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) wird erwartet, dass Sie die Geschäftswerte der Arbeit mit PT Global Functions, insbesondere der Partnerschaft mit Global Quality, freisetzen. Sie arbeiten in Netzwerken und nach agilen Standards. Sie werden die Entscheidungsfindung mit dem Unternehmen involvieren und beeinflussen und haben die Möglichkeit, relevante Arbeitspakete mit Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmensschwerpunkte und die persönliche Entwicklung zu betreiben. Sie bringen Expertise und Erfahrung, die Erfolge von solider Leistung und Seniorität beweist. Sie bringen starke technische Expertise (bezogen auf Ihre Erfahrung) zusammen mit der Fähigkeit, in einem selbstjustierenden Team mit minimaler Hierarchie zu arbeiten. Sie werden ein Katalysator für die Finanztransformation sein und effektiv als Influencer arbeiten, sich als Coach und Katalysator für das Finanznetzwerk bei Bedarf einverleiben. Sie haben die Leidenschaft, neue Ansätze zu steuern und konstruktiv den Status Quo herauszufordern. Sie wissen, wie groß FP&A aussieht und können Verbesserungsbereiche identifizieren und es auch durch effektives Stakeholder-Management geschehen lassen. Sie können Mehrdeutigkeit tolerieren. Ihr Schwerpunktbereich wird globale Qualität sein. Die Chance:
• Qualitätspartnerschaft stärken: Als primärer Finanzpartner der Führung der Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ) fungieren, strategische Finanzleitlinien für Investitionen in Qualitätssicherungssysteme, Compliance-bezogene Projekte und die Ressourcenzuweisung von CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) liefern.
• Fokus auf Systemische Erkenntnisse: Zusammenarbeit mit Qualitätsakteuren, um Leistungskennzahlen wie Abweichungen und Inspektionsergebnisse in umsetzbare finanzielle Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen, die langfristige strategische Verschiebungen von reaktivem zu proaktivem Qualitätsmanagement unterstützen.
• Governance & Decision Support: Unterstützung von Geschäftsfällen für qualitätsorientierte Initiativen, Gewährleistung finanzieller Strenge bei Entscheidungen, die die Harmonisierung des Fertigungsnetzes, Risikominderung und die strategische Agenda „Quality Unites Us" beeinflussen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie erwartet, dass Sie die Informationen, die über verschiedene Kanäle erhalten werden, analysieren und diese an den PT Finance-Chef und andere Stakeholder, wenn nötig, kommunizieren. Wer Sie sind
• Mindestens 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in einem multinationalen Finanzkonsolidierungsumfeld
• Starke Kenntnisse der Fertigungsfinanzierung vor allem in der Konsolidierung im Zusammenhang mit COGS und Inventar und starke Kenntnisse der IFRS, ACCA oder CPA bevorzugt
• Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollen und externen Audits bevorzugt
• Starke Stakeholder Management-Fähigkeiten mit verschiedenen Ebenen und Gruppen von Stakeholdern. Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten sowie Teil eines Teams. Unternehmergeist und Neugier, die andere inspirierend ist

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Nous fabriquons des médicaments à 16 usines et 12 sites dans le monde. Si vous souhaitez obtenir plus d'informations sur Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT), nous vous invitons à utiliser des médicaments pour la fabrication de médicaments. Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) se concentre sur la diffusion de perspectives d'affaires et l'innovation dans les résultats financiers PT grâce à un ensemble cohérent de processus, rapports et outils d'analyse qui permet aux partenaires d'affaires de prendre des décisions. Dans ce rôle en tant que partenaire d'entreprise PT (Pharma Technical) vous êtes censés débloquer la valeur commerciale de travailler avec PT Global Functions, en particulier en partenariat avec Global Quality. Vous aurez la possibilité de participer à des programmes de travail pertinents qui auront une incidence sur les priorités de l'entreprise et sur le développement personnel. Vous apporterez une expertise et une expérience qui prouvent des antécédents de performance et d'ancienneté solides. Vous apporterez une expertise technique solide (relative à votre expérience) ainsi que la capacité de travailler dans une équipe auto-alignement avec une hiérarchie minimale. Vous serez un catalyseur de la transformation des Finances et travaillerez efficacement comme une intrusion, en vous penchant comme un entraîneur et un catalyseur du réseau des Finances au besoin. Vous avez une passion pour piloter de nouvelles approches et contester de façon constructive le statu quo. Vous savez à quoi ressemble la FP&A et pouvez identifier les domaines d'amélioration et aussi faire en sorte que cela se produise par une gestion efficace des intervenants. L'opportunité :
• Renforcer le partenariat qualité : agir en tant que principal partenaire financier du leadership mondial de la qualité des opérations techniques (PTQ), en fournissant des orientations financières stratégiques sur les investissements des systèmes qualité, les projets liés à la conformité et l'allocation des ressources de l'ACAP (Actions correctives et préventives).
• Se concentrer sur les points forts : collaborer avec les intervenants de la qualité pour traduire les mesures de rendement, comme les écarts et les constatations d'inspection, en points forts, en points forts, en appui aux changements stratégiques à long terme, passant d'une gestion de la qualité réactive à une gestion proactive.
• Gouvernance et soutien à la décision : soutien aux analyses de rentabilisation pour des initiatives axées sur la qualité, en assurant la rigueur financière dans les décisions ayant une incidence sur l'harmonisation des réseaux de fabrication, l'atténuation des risques et le programme stratégique « Qualité Nous unit ». Dans ce rôle, vous devez relier les informations reçues par divers canaux analyser les impacts dans PT Financials et au-delà, et communiquer ces informations au responsable PT Finance et aux autres parties prenantes, si nécessaire. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 5-10 ans d'expérience dans un environnement de consolidation financière multinational
• Une solide connaissance du financement manufacturier, notamment dans la consolidation liée aux COGS et aux stocks et une solide connaissance des IFRS, ACCA ou CPA préférées
• Une expérience des contrôles internes et des audits externes est privilégiée
• Des compétences fortes en gestion des parties prenantes avec différents niveaux et groupes d'intervenants.

jobs.title: Process Engineer Upstream Manufacturing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Process Engineer Upstream Manufacturing lieferst Du Lösungen in der Bau 91 Manufacturing Unit SUT (Single-use Technology) bei Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing für eine sichere und qualitativ hochwertige Antikörper Produktion. Du dienst sowohl unseren Patienten als auch unseren Mitarbeitern, indem Du Prozessverbesserungen entwickelst und implementierst und den Dialog und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen lokalen und globalen Funktionen in den Bereichen Entwicklung, Innovation und Regulatory förderst. Innerhalb unseres RePeng-Teams (Recipe and Process Engineering) suchen wir Dich als Process Engineer zur Optimierung unserer Upstream-Prozesse.

Die Möglichkeit:

Deine Hauptaufgabe ist die technische und wissenschaftliche Unterstützung für robuste und effiziente Herstellungsprozesse im GMP-Umfeld, einschließlich Bereitschaftsdienst. Des Weiteren:

• Technische und wissenschaftliche Unterstützung der Schichten zur Sicherstellung robuster und effizienter Herstellungsprozesse im GMP-Umfeld, sowie Bereitschaftsdienst (On-Call)

• Umgang mit geplanten und ungeplanten Ereignissen nach GMP-Richtlinien

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung elektronischer Chargenprotokolle für kommerzielle und klinische Produkte

• Leitung oder Unterstützung von Optimierungsprojekten und Einführung neuer Technologien oder Produkte

• Erstellung und Präsentation von Konzepten, Dokumenten und Assessments bei GMP-Audits und Behördeninspektionen

Wer Du bist:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Bioprozesstechnik bevorzugt). Des Weiteren:

• Umfassende Kenntnisse im Upstream Processing biotechnologisch hergestellter Produkte

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in biopharmazeutischer Herstellung oder Entwicklung

• Erfahrung im Arbeiten in einer GMP-Umgebung sowie bei technischen Transfers und im Qualitätsrisikomanagement (QRM) von Vorteil

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Team und an Schnittstellen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Diabetes Care

titleByLocale.it: Principal IT Support Ingegnere - Diabetes Care
titleByLocale.fr: Principal IT Support Ingénieur - Diabetes Care

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Principal Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s cloud and mobile-based Digital Diabetes Care solutions , among others, handling complaints related to HCP Platforms and patient-facing apps (e.g., mySugr, Accu-Chek SmartGuide) , continuous glucose monitoring data, and accompanying algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, focusing primarily on cloud-based medical software for patients , giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages.

Your core mission will be to act as the most experienced deep-dive investigator and internal-facing team organizer, as well as the main representative for the closer stakeholders (e.g., Local teams, Development…): You will analyze complex cases, system logs, coordinate investigations with internal partners, and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue, particularly those involving remote patient monitoring , patient-generated data (e.g., blood glucose levels) , and predictive insights . While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for patient-facing cloud and mobile applications within the Diabetes Care portfolio.

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle at global level, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.

• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.

• You are the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT -related field

• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions, showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and developing agile processes

• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.

• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a distributed team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.

• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forward

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UN

jobs.title: Country Medical Manager (BC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro) Il Country Medical Manager (CMM) è un partner affidabile, esternamente focalizzato, scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro modello di customer engagement. Con la costruzione e il mantenimento di connessioni profonde e affidabili con i clienti di alto livello chiave in un periodo di tempo significativo, il CMM genererà l'impatto anticipando e ottimizzando proattivamente la pratica medica, e assicurarsi che Roche è un partner preferito nelle nostre aree di malattia chiave. La funzione medica funge da motore critico di competitività per garantire che le nostre innovazioni raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per i pazienti con una prospettiva finale. Il ruolo del CMM è progettato per massimizzare le attività mediche e scientifiche locali e di fondo per accelerare la consegna della nostra pipeline, differenziare il nostro portafoglio in base ai dati, guidare l'advocacy strategica, l'impegno della comunità, l'adozione della pratica medica, e l'accesso al nostro portafoglio mediante la capitalizzazione proattiva su "Momenti che Matter" attraverso il ciclo di vita degli asset. Principio ruoli e responsabilità / responsabilità 1. Contribuire con Medical Expertise (core & common):
• Competenza medica: responsabile per contribuire attivamente a una forte competenza scientifica, medica e terapeutica nell'ambito delle pertinenti malattie che informano la differenziazione della nostra pipeline e del nostro portafoglio. Agire come esperto medico per la pipeline e il portafoglio durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Strategia di forma: Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore, scientificamente sana e differenziata localmente e comunicare i contributi di Roche in aree chiave di malattia, riflettendo una prospettiva aziendale end-to-end che tira attraverso la strategia con impatto. 2. Impegno e opinioni dei clienti attivi (core & common):
• Impegno medico mirato attivo: come funzione medica la nostra ambizione è quella di trascorrere la maggior parte del nostro tempo attivamente coinvolgendo con i clienti esterni come partner nella strategia di coinvolgimento del cliente integrata. Il CMM funge da esperto scientifico e medico, attivando proattivamente TAE di alto livello e altri principali stakeholder in pieno allineamento strategico e operativo con altri ruoli in campo. Nella fase pre-lancio è la priorità di guidare strategie E2E proattive che offrono un'esperienza superiore, anticipare il futuro e modellare la pratica medica di conseguenza. Nella fase post-launch l'impegno continua a garantire che i pazienti giusti siano trattati al momento giusto e la portata di fidanzamento si espande sulle popolazioni dei pazienti non servite. Il coinvolgimento in campo serve come componente fondamentale di questa strategia di overarching per il coinvolgimento scientifico mirato. • Partenariato medico & Istruzione: Stabilire e mantenere efficaci relazioni tra pari e genitori con gli stakeholder esterni e identificare / sviluppare collaborazioni scientifiche conTAEs. Fornire corrente, di alta qualità, piano di educazione medica integrata e differenziare le informazioni scientifiche ai clienti esterni, sostenere la formazione scientifica dei team interni e garantire la formazione continua sulle conoscenze mediche per i ruoli PPoC. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi) Le Country Medical Manager (CMM) est un partenaire fiable, axé sur l'extérieur, scientifiquement basé dans notre modèle d'engagement client. En établissant et en maintenant des liens profonds et fiables avec des clients clés de premier plan sur une période de temps significative, le MMC générera de l'impact en anticipant et en optimisant de façon proactive la pratique médicale, et en veillant à ce que Roche soit un partenaire privilégié dans nos domaines de maladies clés. La fonction médicale est un moteur essentiel de la compétitivité pour assurer que nos innovations atteignent leur plein potentiel pour les patients dans une perspective de bout en bout. Le rôle du MMC est conçu pour maximiser les activités médicales et scientifiques locales et internationales afin d'accélérer la mise en oeuvre de notre pipeline, de différencier notre portefeuille en fonction des données, de stimuler la sensibilisation stratégique, l'engagement communautaire, l'adoption de pratiques médicales et l'accès à notre portefeuille en capitalisant proactivement sur les « Mouvements qui comptent » tout au long du cycle de vie des actifs. Rôles, responsabilités et responsabilités 1. Contribution à l'expertise médicale (essentielle et courante) :
• Expertise médicale : responsable de la contribution proactive d'une expertise scientifique, médicale et thérapeutique solide au sein des maladies pertinentes pour la différenciation de notre pipeline et de notre portefeuille. Agir comme expert médical pour le pipeline et le portefeuille tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Stratégie de forme : Diriger la partie médicale de la stratégie intégrée, façonner localement une histoire de valeur prospective, scientifiquement solide et différenciée et communiquer les contributions de Roches dans les domaines clés de la maladie, reflétant une perspective commerciale de bout en bout qui tire à travers la stratégie avec impact. 2. Engagement et points de vue proactifs des clients (de base et communs):
• Engagement médical ciblé proactif: En tant que fonction médicale, notre ambition est de passer la majorité de notre temps à s'engager proactivement avec des clients externes en tant que partenaires dans la stratégie intégrée d'engagement client. Le CGM est l'expert scientifique et médical, en faisant participer de façon proactive les TAE de haut niveau et d'autres intervenants clés à l'harmonisation stratégique et opérationnelle complète avec d'autres rôles sur le terrain. Dans la phase de pré-lancement, il est prioritaire de conduire des stratégies proactives d'E2E qui fournissent une expérience supérieure, anticipent l'avenir et façonnent la pratique médicale en conséquence. Au cours de la phase postérieure au lancement, l'engagement continue de garantir que les bons patients sont traités au bon moment et que la portée de l'engagement s'étend aux populations de patients non desservis. L'engagement sur le terrain constitue une composante essentielle de cette stratégie globale d'engagement scientifique ciblé. Il est entendu qu'en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, le MMC peut servir de point de contact principal pour certains clients ayant l'ambition de provoquer les changements requis du système de santé et, si possible, d'adopter plus tôt et plus largement notre portefeuille de transformation.
• Partenariat médical et éducation: Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces entre les pairs et les intervenants externes et identifier et développer des collaborations fondées sur la science avec les EAT. Fournir un plan d'éducation médicale intégré et de haute qualité et différencier l'information scientifique aux clients externes, appuyer la formation scientifique des équipes internes et assurer une formation continue sur les connaissances médicales pour les rôles du PPOC. Mener des échanges scientifiques internationaux/nationaux de haute qualité et non promotionnels afin de diffuser les données pertinentes, de favoriser la confiance des médecins et de favoriser l'approbation clinique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position

People Support Operations Specialist

At Roche, we believe that every employee’s journey matters. As a People Support Specialist within our People Support Solutions team, you will be the face of People & Culture (P&C), serving as the primary point of contact for employees and managers through our People Portal.

You won't just be answering questions; you will be a strategist of the employee experience, managing the Employee Lifecycle and ensuring that our P&C services are delivered with the highest quality and impact.

The opportunity:

• Provide insight and support on P&C policies and HR systems, specifically Workday.

• Deliver consistent service across multiple channels, including chat, ticketing, and phone.

• Maintain system data and execute administrative tasks related to core HR processes.

• Resolve P&C inquiries and manage employee requests efficiently.

• Gather process feedback and identify knowledge gaps to enhance service delivery.

• Maintain up-to-date documentation by staying current on internal processes and best practices.

• Participate in strategic projects as required by the business.

• Embed customer care principles into all daily interactions and activities.

• Ensure strict compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security standards.

• Drive process improvements to ensure high-quality service and operational excellence.

Who you are:

• Experience in a Shared Service Center (SSC) or a dedicated HR services environment.

• Broad HR Generalist knowledge with a proven track record of succeeding in a matrix organization and strong knowledge of the Polish Labour Law.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, dynamic setting.

• Cross-border experience, showing comfort and competence in a multicultural environment.

• Technically proficient in navigating complex HR data structures and IT applications.

• Strong customer service orientation with a focus on proactive problem-solving and continuous improvement.

• Tech-savvy, with proficiency in Google Suite and a solid understanding of Workday HR processes.

• Fluent in English and Polish, both written and spoken.

What you get:

• Contract of employment (Umowa o pracę).

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Hybrid work model (2 days per week in our Warsaw office).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM).

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Interested? Apply!

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Edge Defense
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area
The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats.
The core stack of this team includes:

• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation

• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services

• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP

​
Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").

• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.

• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).

• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes.

Who You Are

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset

• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset

• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams

​
Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience

• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM)

​
Technical Skills

• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions

• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus

• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies

• Automation

Descrizione della zona Il team Edge Defense appartiene all'organizzazione Network Security, una pietra angolare della sicurezza dell'informazione. Forniamo le tecnologie e i servizi che proteggono l'intera rete da incidenti IT Security e minacce digitali. Lo stack principale di questa squadra include:
• Difesa perimetrale: Network Firewalls e DDoS Mitigation
• Architettura moderna: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) servizi
• Sicurezza della rete cloud in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Responsabilità del lavoro
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Definire la roadmap digitale per la difesa dei perimetri (Firewalls, DDoS) e l'architettura moderna (Zero Trust) attraverso i segmenti di rete più esterni, sia in ambienti multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Cloud-Native Security: Guida la strategia di sicurezza per la complessa impronta multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), concentrandosi sulla sicurezza del perimetro e del bordo di rete nel cloud.

• Business Translation: Collegare le prestazioni di sicurezza tecnica della rete esterna ai risultati aziendali più ampi, assicurando che la sicurezza sia un acceleratore per R&D e altri ambienti non produttivi.
• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Profondamente capire cliente e business ha bisogno di modellare la direzione strategica e la roadmap digitale per il prodotto Edge Defense, concentrandosi sulla fornitura di risultati di alto valore. Chi sei Esperienza
• 5+ anni di esperienza in Information Security è un bene
• 3+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata è un bene
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership delle persone, nella gestione del prodotto/servizio, nella gestione del programma o in un ruolo simile, con una comprovata esperienza nella costruzione di team ad alte prestazioni ​ Istruzione
• Laurea o laurea in Scienze informatiche, sicurezza informatica, tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo di ingegneria correlato o esperienza equivalente
• Le certificazioni professionali di sicurezza sono un plus (ad esempio CISSP, CISM) ​ Competenze tecniche
• Sfondo collaudato e solida fondazione in Information Security specificamente in Network Firewalls (ad esempio, Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (ad esempio, Cisco ISE) e soluzioni ZTNA
• L'esperienza in ambienti multi-cloud è un plus
• Eccellenza Operativa: Forte comprensione dei framework ITIL (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) e metodologie di miglioramento continuo
• Automazione

Die Position Als Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Entwicklung der Fähigkeiten Ihrer Teammitglieder, die mit der Vision der Funktion übereinstimmen. Sie werden Ihr Team ermutigen, seine Karrierereise selbst zu definieren und nach Möglichkeiten zu suchen, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung der Reise zu ermöglichen. Sie werden sie dabei unterstützen, Hindernisse zu beseitigen und sich auf ihr Leistungsmanagement zu konzentrieren. Sie stellen sicher, dass Sie Ihr Team mit den richtigen Fähigkeiten, einer gesunden Dynamik und einem nachhaltigen Tempo entwickeln. Sie unterstützen die Software- und/oder Servicebereitstellung als Führungskraft, indem Sie Hindernisse beseitigen, Stakeholder verwalten und wo immer möglich Effizienz in der Zusammenarbeit schaffen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Das Edge Defense Team gehört zur Network Security Organisation, einem Eckpfeiler der Informationssicherheit. Wir bieten die Technologien und Services, die das gesamte Netzwerk vor IT-Sicherheitsvorfällen und digitalen Bedrohungen schützen. Der Kernstapel dieses Teams umfasst:
• Perimeter Defense: Netzwerk-Firewalls und DDoS-Abwehr
• Moderne Architektur: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Dienste
• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Aufgabenbereich
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Definieren Sie die digitale Roadmap für Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) und Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) in den externsten Netzwerksegmenten, sowohl lokal als auch in Multi-Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Operational Excellence & Automation: Führen Sie eine "Automation First" -Mentalität für externe Netzwerksicherheit, indem Sie APIs und Skripte nutzen, um manuelle Arbeit durch skalierbaren Sicherheitscode zu ersetzen ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Führen Sie die Sicherheitsstrategie für den komplexen Multi-Cloud-Fußabdruck (AWS, Azure, GCP) und konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Sicherung des Perimeters und des Netzwerkrandes in der Cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Eigentümer des End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklus für Edge Defense-Technologien, von der Entdeckung bis hin zum globalen Maßstab, um die Einhaltung der relevanten Vorschriften (z. B. DSGVO, mit Ausnahme von GxP für den Nicht-Fertigungsfokus) sicherzustellen.

• Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit: Umfassendes Verständnis der Bedürfnisse von Kunden und Unternehmen, um die strategische Ausrichtung und die digitale Roadmap für das Edge Defense-Produkt zu gestalten und sich auf die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Ergebnisse zu konzentrieren. Wer du bist Erfahrung
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit ist ein Asset
• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder regulierten Gesundheitstechnologiebranche sind ein Gewinn
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Personalführung, Produkt- / Servicemanagement, Programmmanagement oder einer ähnlichen Rolle, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams ​ Bildung
• Bachelor oder Advanced Degree in Informatik, Cyber Security, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Engineering-Bereich oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Professionelle Informationssicherheitszertifizierungen sind ein Plus (z.B. CISSP, CISM) ​ Technische Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung in Multi-Cloud-Umgebungen ist ein Plus

• Automatisierung

Vous encouragerez votre équipe à définir elle-même leur parcours de carrière et à chercher des moyens de permettre des opportunités de développement dans la direction du parcours. Vous les aiderez à supprimer les barrages routiers et en mettant l'accent sur leur gestion du rendement. Vous assurez-vous de développer votre équipe avec les bonnes compétences, dynamique saine et un rythme durable. Vous soutenez le logiciel et/ou la prestation de services en tant que chef de file, en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les intervenants et en créant des gains d'efficacité en collaboration dans la mesure du possible. Description de la zone L'équipe d'Edge Defense appartient à l'organisation de sécurité du réseau, une pierre angulaire de la sécurité de l'information. Nous fournissons les technologies et les services qui protègent l'ensemble du réseau contre les incidents de sécurité informatique et les menaces numériques. Le noyau de cette équipe comprend:
• Défense périmétrique: Pare-feu réseau et atténuation du DDoS
• Architecture moderne : services Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)

• 3+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou les technologies de santé réglementées est un atout
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans le leadership des personnes, la gestion de produits/services, la gestion de programmes ou un rôle semblable, avec une expérience éprouvée de la constitution d'équipes performantes ​ Éducation

PTE catalyzes the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Manufacturing Specialist – Cyber Security to join our PTE organization. In this role, you will serve as the key liaison between the global TechOps cyber security function and our local manufacturing sites across the globe.
Your mission will be to ensure compliance, secure operations, elevate Operational Technology (OT) security awareness, and achieve seamless integration of enterprise-level initiatives with site-specific needs. • PT Representation at Site: Act as the primary liaison and strategic bridge between manufacturing site operations and the PTE cyber security / digital teams.

• Awareness & Culture: Elevate OT (Operational Technology) security awareness among site staff, fostering a culture of cyber-vigilance.

Who You Are
You are someone who shares our passion for science, technology, and people. You bring structure, collaboration, and a secure-by-design mindset to manufacturing environments.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Chez Roche, nous nous épanouissons pour offrir plus de bienfaits à nos patients dans le cadre de notre vision de 10 ans de Pharma. Une partie intégrante de la réalisation de cette vision est de fournir des solutions d'analyse de données nouvelles et novatrices à nos scientifiques dans le cadre des Opérations techniques Pharma (PT). Pour ce faire, nous avons formé une nouvelle organisation appelée PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) avec l'aspiration à construire des opérations numériques et maigres leader dans l'industrie à travers les fonctions et toute notre empreinte de fabrication. PTE catalyse le développement et l'exécution de la stratégie d'excellence numérique et opérationnelle de PT. Nous construisons une communauté forte, interfonctionnelle et inclusive, mettons le pouvoir des données entre les mains de notre personnel et développons nos solutions d'analyse numérique et avancée, au profit de nos collègues et patients. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un spécialiste de la fabrication – Cybersécurité pour rejoindre notre organisation PTE. Dans ce rôle, vous serez la principale liaison entre la fonction globale de cybersécurité TechOps et nos sites de fabrication locaux à travers le monde. Votre mission sera d'assurer la conformité, de sécuriser les opérations, d'accroître la sensibilisation à la sécurité de la technologie opérationnelle (OT) et de parvenir à une intégration transparente des initiatives au niveau de l'entreprise avec les besoins propres au site. • Représentation PT au site : agir comme premier pont stratégique et de liaison entre les activités du site de fabrication et les équipes de cybersécurité / numérique du PTE.
• Conformité au site : Assurer la conformité au niveau du site aux normes, aux politiques et aux exigences réglementaires de cybersécurité de l'entreprise.
• Intégration de la sécurité : Diriger le déploiement sans heurt des initiatives de sécurité des entreprises mondiales, les adapter efficacement aux besoins de fabrication locaux sans perturber les opérations.
• Sensibilisation et culture : Sensibiliser davantage le personnel du site à la sécurité de l'OT (Technologie opérationnelle), en favorisant une culture de cybervigilance. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes quelqu'un qui partage notre passion pour la science, la technologie et les gens. Vous apportez structure, collaboration, et un état d'esprit sécurisé par conception dans les environnements de fabrication. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez apporter:
• Une expérience éprouvée ou une solide expérience dans les opérations de fabrication combinée à une bonne connaissance de la cybersécurité/OT Security.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité de combler l'écart entre les stratégies mondiales et l'exécution locale du site.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Synthetic Molecules Technical Development" (PTDC) bringt eine breite Palette von Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP) und Analytical Sciences mit und arbeitet eng mit wichtigen Partnern in den Bereichen Forschung und frühe Entwicklung zusammen (pRED / gRED), kommerzielle Herstellung kleinmolekularer Wirkstoffe (PTC) und globale technische Entwicklung (PTD). PTDC ist verantwortlich für die späte technische Entwicklung unserer Pipeline für kleine Moleküle und die Herstellung von DS und DP für klinische Studien.

In PTDC transformieren die Small Molecules Teams synthetische Moleküle in Medikamente. Wir entwickeln robuste, kosteneffiziente Herstellungsprozesse, liefern klinische Ware und schaffen Wissen durch Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in einem kollaborativen Umfeld.
Innerhalb der Abteilung Chemische Verfahrensentwicklung tragen die Pilotierungs- und Produktionsbetriebe von Scale-up & Supply (PTDC-S) wesentlich dazu bei, dass die Verfahren zur Herstellung neuer Pharmawirkstoffe für grosstechnische Anwendungen robust und optimal entwickelt werden, um so die benötigten Mengen Wirksubstanz in der geforderten Qualität termingerecht für die klinischen und toxischen Studien herzustellen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung von chemischen Reaktionen und physikalischen Einheitsoperationen auf Mehrzweckproduktionsanlagen im Tagesdienst

• Vorbereitung und Reinigung der Mehrzweckanlagen

• Mithilfe bei Umbauten und Reparaturen der Anlagen

• Dokumentation der Arbeiten und Einhalten der guten Herstellpraxis (GMP-Richtlinien)

• Umsetzen und vollständiges Einhalten der relevanten Roche Policies, Verfahren und Standards in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umweltschutz

• Flexibles und selbstständiges Arbeiten

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Chemie und Pharmatechnologen

• Selbstständige und exakte Arbeitsweise und gute GMP-Kenntnisse

• Interesse an neuen Technologien und Erfahrung in der Bedienung von modernen Anlagen mit speicherprogrammierbarer Steuerung

• Gute MS Office Kenntnisse

• Dynamischer und initiativer Arbeitsstil und Teamgeist

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblem Arbeitseinsatz

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ist von Vorteil

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) offre una vasta gamma di esperienze in Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP) e scienze analitiche, lavorando a stretto contatto con i partner chiave nella ricerca e sviluppo precoce (pRED/gRED), produzione commerciale di piccoli agenti molecolari (PTC), e ingegneria globale (PTD). PTDC è responsabile dello sviluppo tecnico tardivo della nostra piccola molecola pipeline e della produzione di DS e DP per gli studi clinici. In PTDC, i team di Small Molecules trasformano le molecole sintetiche in farmaci. Sviluppiamo processi produttivi robusti ed efficienti, forniamo prodotti clinici e creiamo conoscenze attraverso l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo in un ambiente collaborativo. All'interno del reparto Sviluppo Processo Chimico, le società di pilotaggio e produzione di Scale-up & Supply (PTDC-S) contribuiscono in modo significativo allo sviluppo robusto e ottimale dei processi per la produzione di nuovi principi attivi farmaceutici per applicazioni industriali su larga scala al fine di produrre le quantità richieste di ingrediente attivo nella qualità richiesta in tempo per gli studi clinici e tossici. La possibilità
• Esegui le reazioni chimiche e le operazioni di unità fisica negli impianti di produzione multiuso diurni
• Preparazione e pulizia di impianti multiuso
• Assistenza nella conversione e riparazione di attrezzature
• Documentazione del lavoro e conformità alla buona prassi manifatturiera (linea GMP)
• Implementare e rispettare pienamente le pertinenti politiche, procedure e norme Roche nei settori della sicurezza, della salute e della tutela ambientale
• Lavoro flessibile e indipendente Chi sei
• Formazione completa in chimica e farmacologi
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti ed esatti e buone conoscenze GMP
• Interessi nelle nuove tecnologie e nell'esperienza nel funzionamento di sistemi moderni con controllo logica programmabile
• Buona conoscenza dell'ufficio di MS
• Stile di lavoro dinamico e dinamico e spirito di squadra
• Prontezza per un lavoro flessibile
• Conoscenza fluente del tedesco, l'inglese è un vantaggio Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert/Lead is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Strategy Partner works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.

医疗网络专家/经理是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医学网络专家/经理与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Basic Requirements of the Job基本任职资格:
Education & Qualifications教育背景与专业资格:
MD, PhD or PharmD and working experience in relevant disease areas
医学、科学或药学博士及相关疾病领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医学或制药行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力
Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则
• Equip with the core skill sets as required by this role

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a User Enablement Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing the deployment, optimization, and day-to-day operation of user-facing software, application frameworks, and research environments across our High-Performance Computing (HPC) and AI Factory platforms. Your mission is to maximize the productivity of Roche’s scientific community by providing frictionless access to cutting-edge computational tools.
With the introduction of our industry-leading NVIDIA AI Factory infrastructure, you will play a pivotal role in productizing and supporting advanced software suites like NVIDIA AI Enterprise. By ensuring that complex AI/ML frameworks, large language model (LLM) tools, and specialized simulation environments are perfectly tuned for our clusters, you will directly accelerate the time-to-value for researchers training complex AI models and executing large-scale computational science workloads.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

User-Facing Platform & Environment Management

• Deploy, support, and optimize user-facing environment portals and platforms, including Roche ROCs and SCOOP environments for HPC.

• Own the lifecycle and availability of standard software stacks, modules, and containerized application environments.

• Collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers to ensure user-facing portals interface seamlessly with core scheduling and data transfer layers.

AI Factory & Software Stack Productization

• Architect and manage the deployment of the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software suite, ensuring proper integration and license optimization.

• Provide and support cutting-edge AI pipelines and development platforms, including NVIDIA NeMo for generative AI/LLMs and NVIDIA Omniverse for advanced industrial simulations and digital twins.

• Build, benchmark, and maintain highly optimized container builds for standard AI/ML Frameworks (such as PyTorch and TensorFlow), incorporating deep learning inference servers like Dynamo-Triton to maximize GPU utilization.

Scientific Consultation & Technical Enablement

• In partnership with the Value Engineering and Outcomes team, act as the technical entry point and consultant for research teams, assisting them in porting their code, algorithms, and models onto the ACE platforms.

• Develop, curate, and maintain developer documentation, example code repositories, and user guides to enable self-service onboarding.

• Diagnose and resolve complex software-layer bottlenecks, dependency conflicts, and compilation issues spanning scientific software packages, Python virtual environments, and

La vostra missione è quella di massimizzare la produttività della comunità scientifica di Roche fornendo l’accesso senza attrito agli strumenti computazionali all’avanguardia. Con l'introduzione della nostra infrastruttura NVIDIA AI Factory leader del settore, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella produzione e nel supporto di software avanzate come NVIDIA AI Enterprise. jobs.title: Procurement Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

About the job

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Manager in Commercial, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

As a Procurement Manager in Commercial, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Marketing & Sales (Creative and Digital, Medical and Scientific Activities, Market Access and Sales) conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a related discipline.

• You have solid procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant commodity experience.

• Proficiency in procurement systems, processes, and general contracting.

• You possess knowledge and experience in the Strategic Procurement , while specific expertise in Marketing & Sales commodity area.

• You are a proactive, curious, and motivate

Il gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui ricerca e sviluppo, servizi commerciali e aziendali, tecnologia digitale e servizi. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. Come Procurement Manager in Commercial, si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione, e concentrarsi sull'area di approvvigionamento di approvvigionamento e capacità di consegna. È inoltre possibile svolgere il ruolo del proprietario di strategia di categoria incaricato di guidare, coordinare e firmare la strategia di categoria. • Sei un professionista della consegna degli appalti che fornisce ed esegue le strategie di approvvigionamento sfruttando il know-how di spesa, il know-how di categoria, il sourcing robusto, la negoziazione, la contrazione, le metodologie di gestione dei fornitori e i quadri e le competenze di gestione del progetto.
• Si sviluppano contenuti e automazione, traducendo risultati e opportunità di approvvigionamento in contenuti e canali di acquisto automatizzati che migliorano l'adozione aziendale, la soddisfazione e l'efficienza complessiva. Chi sei:
• Lei ha una laurea, preferibilmente in affari o una disciplina relativa.
• Hai una solida esperienza di approvvigionamento nell'approvvigionamento strategico, nella costruzione di strategie di categoria e nell'esecuzione di progetti strategici con la comprensione e la competenza contrattuale generale o l'esperienza delle materie prime rilevanti.
• Competenza nei sistemi di approvvigionamento, nei processi e nei contratti generali.
• Possiedi conoscenza ed esperienza nel Procurement Strategico , mentre competenze specifiche nell'area Marketing & Sales commodity.
• Sei un proattivo, curioso e motivato

Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihrer fundierten Expertise in einer bestimmten Kategorie oder Ausgabenbereichen und der gesamten Beschaffung werden Sie proaktiv Strategien und Ansätze für die Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ausgabenanforderungen Dritter identifizieren und vorantreiben.
