• Rollentyp: Als BCL vertreten Sie die Geschäftsinteressen von DOP weltweit in relevanten Foren und sind für die Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Procure-to-Pay-Strategie von DOP verantwortlich.
• Auswirkungen: Sie fördern die globale Betriebseffizienz, die Compliance von Prozessen und die groß angelegte digitale Einführung. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prozessdesign & Strategie: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung der DOP-Roadmap für myBuy in Abstimmung mit funktionalen Partnern wie DIA Global Supply Chain und RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: Proaktive Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten für Prozessautomatisierung und Digitalisierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management und RSS Demand to Pay.
• KMU-Analyse und -Governance: Als tiefer Fachexperte fungieren, um Optionen zu analysieren, auszuarbeiten und Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Prozess-, System-, Leistungsindikator- oder Datenprobleme lösen und gleichzeitig Daten- und Regeldefinitionen unterstützen.
• Transformationsprojektdelegation: Als verantwortlicher Delegierter bei wichtigen Unternehmensinitiativen (wie dem ASPIRE-Programm, unserem übergreifenden Prozess und der digitalen Transformation) zur Unterstützung der globalen Vorlageneinführung und zur Bewertung der Auswirkungen lokalisierter Veränderungen.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Leitung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen, Verwaltung der globalen Anforderungsausrichtung und Partnerschaft mit anderen BCLs und Business Capability Ownern (BCOs), um die durchgängige funktionsübergreifende Leistung zu optimieren.
• Community & ARTS Representation: Leitung der Business Capability Community von KMU und Vertretung von DOP in Communities und Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
• Wissensmanagement: Steuerung der Entwicklung, strukturellen Wartung und Lieferung von globalen Systemprozess Doc

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

• Strategic Sourcing: Support selected high-value strategic sourcing initiatives and complex RFx activities to convert pipeline targets into realized business value.

• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborating with data analytics experts to generate Category-specific insights, generating monthly spend/savings metrics, and conducting data validation to safeguard governance.

• Implementation Support: Converting strategic outcomes into clear category guidance documents and support materials to ensure category strategies can be effectively implemented across the organization.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'opportunità Siete pronti a modellare le strategie di lungo termine dei fornitori e le condotte di progetto che forniscono innovazione medica ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Come nostro Associate Categoria Manager (ACM) a Sant Cugat, Spagna, supporterai lo sviluppo, la convalida e l'esecuzione delle strategie di categoria globali e delle iniziative strategiche annuali. In questo ruolo, si leverà rigorosa analisi degli appalti per trasformare l'intelligenza di mercato in una guida di categoria attuabile, garantendo la resilienza globale dell'offerta e il valore del portafoglio. Stiamo cercando di soddisfare una posizione Associate Categoria Manager per team. I candidati di successo saranno allineati per sostenere una delle seguenti categorie di appalti dedicati: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Meccanica, Logistica.

• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale a sostegno della Categoria assegnata, focalizzato su abilitazione strategica, intelligenza dei dati di mercato e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Impatto: Guida la conformità della categoria, l'integrità dei dati e l'esecuzione strategica nella rete operativa globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Supporto Strategy & Pipeline: Collazione dei dati di fornitori, di mercato e di business interni per contribuire a formulare la strategia di categoria a lungo termine e costruire una pipeline proattiva di future iniziative.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the respective Category Lead within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Collaborates closely with Category Managers, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal, and external market intelligence providers. Participates in a global ACM Community of Practice (CoP) coordinated by the Category Integration & Excellence Lead to ensure consistency of methodologies, reporting standards, strategic planning processes, and cross-category collaboration.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role in support of the allocated Category, focused on strategic enablement, market data intelligence, and stakeholder management.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

• Strategic Sourcing: Support selected high-value strategic sourcing initiatives and complex RFx activities to convert pipeline targets into realized business value.

• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborating with data analytics experts to generate Category-specific insights, generating monthly spend/savings metrics, and conducting data validation to safeguard governance.

• Implementation Support: Converting strategic outcomes into clear category guidance documents and support materials to ensure category strategies can be effectively implemented across the organization.

• Strategische Beschaffung: Unterstützung ausgewählter hochwertiger strategischer Beschaffungsinitiativen und komplexer RFx-Aktivitäten, um Pipeline-Ziele in realisierten Geschäftswert umzuwandeln.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à façonner les stratégies à long terme des fournisseurs et les pipelines de projets qui fournissent l'innovation médicale aux patients du monde entier? En tant que responsable de catégorie associé (ACM) à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous soutiendrez le développement, la validation et l'exécution de stratégies de catégorie globale et d'initiatives stratégiques annuelles. Dans ce rôle, vous tirerez parti de l'analyse rigoureuse des approvisionnements pour transformer l'intelligence du marché en guide de catégorie actionnable, assurant ainsi la résilience de l'offre mondiale et la valeur du portefeuille. Nous cherchons à remplir un poste de gestionnaire de catégorie associé par équipe. Les candidats retenus seront alignés pour soutenir l'une des catégories d'approvisionnement dédiées suivantes : Biologiques et chimiques, Plastiques et emballage, Électronique et systèmes, Mécanique, Logistique.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Rendre compte directement au responsable de la catégorie concerné au sein de l'organisation de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Collabore étroitement avec les gestionnaires de catégorie, les gestionnaires d'approvisionnement, les gestionnaires de prestation, les fournisseurs de renseignements financiers, juridiques et externes. Participer à une communauté de pratique mondiale de la GCA, coordonnée par le responsable de l'intégration et de l'excellence des catégories, afin d'assurer l'uniformité des méthodes, des normes de rapport, des processus de planification stratégique et de la collaboration entre les catégories.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel à l'appui de la catégorie attribuée, axé sur l'habilitation stratégique, l'information sur le marché et la gestion des intervenants.
• Impact: Vous conduisez la conformité de catégorie, l'intégrité des données, et l'exécution stratégique dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial d'opérations. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Soutien à la stratégie et au pipeline : Collation de données sur les fournisseurs, les marchés et les entreprises internes afin d'aider à formuler la stratégie de catégorie à long terme et de créer un pipeline proactif d'initiatives futures.
• Déploiement de l'initiative stratégique : Aider les gestionnaires de catégorie, l'exécution des projets, la prestation et l'approvisionnement à exécuter et à déployer des projets complexes en stricte conformité avec les normes et procédures mondiales.
• Négociation et préparation des marchés : Appuyer la rédaction des contrats et les négociations des fournisseurs pour les fournisseurs stratégiques, clés ou en difficulté en fournissant des analyses complètes, des bases de données et des repères du marché.
• Sourcing stratégique : Appuyer certaines initiatives d'approvisionnement stratégique de grande valeur et des activités complexes de RFx pour convertir les cibles de pipeline en valeur opérationnelle réalisée.
• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborer avec des experts en analyse de données pour générer des informations spécifiques aux catégories, générer des mesures mensuelles de dépenses/économies et effectuer la validation des données pour préserver la gouvernance.
• Appui à la mise en oeuvre : Conversion des résultats stratégiques en documents d'orientation et documents d'appui clairs pour s'assurer que les stratégies de catégorie peuvent être mises en oeuvre efficacement dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. • Executive & Administrative Support: Providing high-level support by proactively managing complex calendars and mailboxes, coordinating end-to-end business travel logistics and expenses, and acting as an active deputy within the administrative support team.

• Meeting & Event Coordination: Independently coordinating CoE Leadership Team meetings, workshops, and global CoE Huddles. You will facilitate meeting flows, manage timelines, and organize large internal and external events or team-building activities.

• Digital Workplace & Tools Master: Acting as a "Super User" for collaboration tools like Monday.com to design optimized boards, track action items, and automate workflows. You will also own the department's internal G-Site, ensuring templates and SOPs are organized and up to date.

• Onboarding & HR Administration: Managing the full onboarding lifecycle for new Direct Procurement employees, including hardware/software provisioning and training matrix implementation. You will also handle time management support for the Sant Cugat team and HR administration for external consultants.

jobs.title: Digital & Process Management Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la gestion numérique et des processus

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to lead digital innovation and process excellence for DOP? As our Digital & Process Management Lead based in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will have an instrumental global impact on the deployment and continuous improvement of our processes, systems, and underlying data. This newly created role combines elements of previous teams to significantly increase organizational scale and impact within the Diagnostics Global Operations transformation (“FOM”).

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Interacts frequently with ASPIRE Program Leadership, the Diagnostics Procurement Leadership Team (DPLT), Category Management, Delivery, and RSS Demand to Pay. You will also represent DOP as the “Business Owner” in the strategic D2P Business Owner Community.

• Role Type: A senior leadership role, balancing strategic and tactical responsibilities, directing a global team of up to 15 professionals (including Digital Enablement Managers, Business Process Experts, and ASPIRE Deployment resources).

• Impact: You will drive a high-performance culture, transform challenges into opportunities, and unlock the potential of your team. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digitalization & Innovation: Identifying, planning, and executing digitalization initiatives (e.g., process automation, tool deployment). You will orchestrate relevant stakeholders, develop business cases, drive user adoption, and benchmark digital procurement capabilities.

• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Representing DOP in the Roche-wide ASPIRE transformation program (D2P stream). You are accountable for delivering project milestones, leading end-to-end process design, and transitioning successfully into the sustain organization.

• Business Process Management: Managing the D2P process landscape within DOP. You will collaborate with the Global Business Process Owner to develop specificities, ensure compliant execution, and collect feedback for continuous improvement.

• Financial Scope: Maintaining oversight and working within the GRP budgets provided for various multi-year initiatives (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).

• Talent Leadership: Coaching and developing a global team, ensuring cultural awareness, and fostering an environment of psychological safety to achieve ambitious divisional goals.

Who you are

We look for an authentic, courageous, and transformational leader who is a true "systems thinker"—someone who can navigate complexity, manage competing priorities, and craft integrated solutions that drive efficiency.

• Education: A University degree is required, with a focus on business or life sciences highly preferable. A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) and professional purchasing certifications (e.g., CIPS) are prefer

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto a guidare l'innovazione digitale e l'eccellenza di processo per DOP? Con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, il nostro Digital & Process Management Lead avrà un impatto globale strumentale sull'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi, sistemi e dati sottostanti. Questo ruolo appena creato combina elementi di precedenti team per aumentare significativamente la scala organizzativa e l'impatto all'interno della trasformazione Diagnostics Global Operations (“FOM”).
• Linea di segnalazione: Rapporti direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza e fa parte del più ampio Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Il team e le parti interessate del Wider: Interagisce frequentemente con ASPIRE Program Leadership, il team di Leadership dei contratti diagnostici (DPLT), la gestione della categoria, la consegna e la domanda di RSS da pagare. Lei rappresenterà anche il DOP come “proprietario di affari” nella strategica D2P Business Owner Community.
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di leadership senior, bilanciando le responsabilità strategiche e tattiche, dirigendo un team globale di fino a 15 professionisti (tra cui Digital Enablement Managers, Business Process Experts, e ASPIRE Deployment Risorse).
• Impatto: Potrai guidare una cultura ad alte prestazioni, trasformare le sfide in opportunità e sbloccare il potenziale del tuo team. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Digitalizzazione & Innovazione: Identificare, pianificare ed eseguire iniziative di digitalizzazione (ad esempio, automazione dei processi, distribuzione degli strumenti). Potrai orchestrare le parti interessate rilevanti, sviluppare i casi aziendali, guidare l'adozione degli utenti e le capacità di approvvigionamento digitale di riferimento.
• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Rappresentare il DOP nel programma di trasformazione ASPIRE (D2P stream). Sei responsabile per la fornitura di pietre miliari di progetto, progettazione di processo end-to-end leader, e transizione con successo nell'organizzazione di supporto.
• Business Process Management: Gestione del paesaggio di processo D2P all'interno del DOP. Collaborerai con il Global Business Process Owner per sviluppare specificità, garantire l'esecuzione conforme e raccogliere feedback per il miglioramento continuo.
• Ambito finanziario: Mantenere la supervisione e il lavoro all'interno dei bilanci GRP previsti per varie iniziative pluriennali (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).
• Talent Leadership: coaching e sviluppo di un team globale, garantire la consapevolezza culturale e promuovere un ambiente di sicurezza psicologica per raggiungere obiettivi di divisione ambiziosi. Chi sei Cerchiamo un leader autentico, coraggioso e trasformazionale, che è un vero "sistemi pensatore"—qualcuno che può navigare nella complessità, gestire le priorità concorrenti e creare soluzioni integrate che favoriscano l'efficienza.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria è richiesto, con un focus sulle scienze aziendali o vita altamente preferibile. Le certificazioni di acquisto professionali (MBA o equivalente) e di master (ad esempio, CIPS) sono preferibili

Vous orchestrerez les parties prenantes concernées, développerez des analyses de rentabilisation, favoriserez l'adoption des utilisateurs et évaluerez les capacités d'approvisionnement numérique.
• Initiatives mondiales (ASPIRE et iCollab) : Représentation du DOP dans le programme de transformation ASPIRE à l'échelle de Roche (stream D2P). Vous êtes responsable de la réalisation des jalons du projet, de la conception des processus de bout en bout et de la transition réussie vers l'organisation durable.

• Talent Leadership : Coaching et développement d'une équipe mondiale, sensibilisation culturelle et promotion d'un environnement de sécurité psychologique pour atteindre des objectifs de division ambitieux. Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons un leader authentique, courageux et transformationnel qui est un véritable « penseur de systèmes », quelqu'un qui peut naviguer dans la complexité, gérer des priorités concurrentes et concevoir des solutions intégrées qui stimulent l'efficacité.
• Éducation : Un diplôme universitaire est requis, l'accent étant mis sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie. Une maîtrise (MBA ou équivalent) et des certificats d'achat professionnels (p. ex. CIPS) sont préférables

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance & Accounting Intern (Supply Chain) based in Sunway Pinnacle , you will support manufacturing and commercial sites by ensuring financial compliance, executing month-end close activities, and delivering standard cost and inventory-related activities. You will play a vital role in our finance operations, collaborating globally to continuously improve processes, systems, and standards across the network.

The Opportunity

• Execute month-end close activities, including the preparation of Manual Journal Entries as requested by the global team.

• Manage standard costing execution, ensuring the timely delivery of results while maintaining strict data quality.

• Investigate relevant accounts (such as inventory, variances, and allowances) and recommend actionable solutions to management.

• Ensure system and procedure compliance with company policies, acceptable accounting practices, and applicable financial regulations.

• Collaborate globally across the Roche network to improve financial operations and standardize processes

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing a Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline at a Malaysian university or professional body (e.g., ACCA, CPA).

• You possess a solid foundation in finance and accounting principles and are eager to apply them practically.

• You have strong proficiency in computerized applications, especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, and G-Suite (experience with financial databases is a distinct advantage).

• You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to effectively collaborate with international stakeholders.

• Pinnacle Management InsightsYou are available for a full-time internship and are comfortable working in an agile, structured corporate environment.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des perspectives de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent, ce qui vous préparera à franchir la prochaine étape de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que nos employés sont les artisans de notre succès et nous les apprécions à leur juste valeur. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où se sentir valorisé·e, respecté·e et responsabilisé·e est une expérience quotidienne.

L'Opportunité

En tant que représentant·e du soutien à l'implantation sur le terrain, vous faites partie d'une équipe d'experts qui jouent un rôle crucial dans le soutien aux principaux hôpitaux et laboratoires pour l'installation et le bon fonctionnement de leurs solutions de chimie clinique, d'immunoanalyse, de biologie moléculaire, de pathologie, d'analyse d'urine et d'automatisation.

Vous êtes une personne efficace pour résoudre les problèmes, passionnée par le milieu de la santé, et vous comprenez l'importance de nos solutions sur l'expérience client et les soins aux patients. Votre passion pour la résolution de problèmes et la satisfaction de la clientèle s'appuie sur vos connaissances techniques pour offrir une expérience client hors pair. Vous fournirez un soutien rapide, précis et constant à nos clients afin de minimiser l'interruption de leur prestation de services de diagnostic.

• Gestion de la relation client : Bâtir des liens solides avec les gestionnaires de laboratoire et utiliser l'écoute active pour diagnostiquer et résoudre rapidement leurs problèmes techniques.

• Déploiement et installation : Collaborer à la planification, coordonner le matériel/logiciel (hardware/software) et diriger l'équipe de déploiement pour garantir le succès des installations et des mises à niveau.

• Maintenance et soutien technique : Effectuer les maintenances préventives, résoudre les bulletins techniques et appuyer les équipes régionales pour minimiser l'interruption des services de diagnostic.

• Intégration des systèmes IT : Travailler avec les spécialistes locaux (RIS et équipes techniques) pour installer, configurer et soutenir l'infrastructure logicielle et informatique.

• Collaboration et administration : Participer aux réunions (service, ventes, clients) et assurer la gestion administrative quotidienne, incluant la clôture des dossiers après chaque visite de site.

Qui vous êtes

• Formation et expertise technique : Détenir un diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC) en technologie de l'électronique (ou formation connexe) et posséder des connaissances solides en systèmes informatiques et infrastructures réseau.

• Expérience terrain et laboratoire : Cumuler plus de 5 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le service sur le terrain, idéalement acquise en milieu de laboratoire (un atout majeur).

• Soutien et orientation client : Posséder une expérience éprouvée en soutien à la clientèle, axée sur la centralité client (Customer Centricity), ainsi qu'un bilinguisme français/anglais (oral et écrit) pour interagir partout au Canada.

Die Chance Als Vertreter der Feldimplementierung sind Sie Teil eines Expertenteams, das eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Unterstützung der wichtigsten Krankenhäuser und Labore für die Installation und das ordnungsgemäße Funktionieren ihrer klinischen Chemie, Immunanalyse, Molekularbiologie, Pathologie, Urinanalyse und Automatisierungslösungen spielt. Sie sind eine effektive Person, um Probleme zu lösen, leidenschaftlich für die Gesundheitsgemeinschaft, und Sie verstehen die Bedeutung unserer Lösungen für die Kundenerfahrung und Patientenversorgung. Ihre Leidenschaft für Problemlösung und Kundenzufriedenheit hängt von Ihrem technischen Wissen ab, um ein hervorragendes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten. Sie werden unsere Kunden rechtzeitig, genau und konsistent unterstützen, um die Unterbrechung ihrer Diagnosedienste zu minimieren.

• Bereitstellung und Installation: Kooperieren Sie bei der Planung, koordinieren Sie Hardware / Software und leiten Sie das Bereitstellungsteam, um den Erfolg von Installationen und Upgrades sicherzustellen.
• Wartung und technischer Support: Führen Sie vorbeugende Wartung durch, lösen Sie technische Bulletins und unterstützen Sie regionale Teams, um die Unterbrechung der Diagnosedienste zu minimieren.
• Integration von IT-Systemen: Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Spezialisten (RIS und technische Teams) zur Installation, Konfiguration und Unterstützung von Software und IT-Infrastruktur.
• Zusammenarbeit und Verwaltung: Nehmen Sie an Besprechungen teil (Service, Verkauf, Kunden) und sorgen Sie für die tägliche Verwaltung, einschließlich des Schließens von Dateien nach jedem Besuch vor Ort. Wer du bist
• Ausbildung und technisches Fachwissen: Halten Sie einen Hochschulabschluss (DEC) in Elektroniktechnik (oder verwandte Ausbildung) und verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in Computersystemen und Netzwerkinfrastruktur.
• Feld- und Laborerfahrung: Fassen Sie mehr als 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Außendienst zusammen, idealerweise erworben im Laborumfeld (ein wichtiges Asset).
• Kundenbetreuung und Orientierung: Haben Sie nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, konzentrieren sich auf Kundenzentralität (Customer Centricity) sowie Englisch / Französisch Zweisprachigkeit (mündlich und schriftlich), um in ganz Kanada zu interagieren.

Typically studying in a field related to the assigned function. May be assigned a variety of tasks relevant to the assigned function and/or special projects for the assigned function. The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organisation, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance. Assignments vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modelling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc. Length of internship will vary according to business needs and legal requirements in the market where the internship is occurring.

Key Competencies required

• Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese

• Proactive at work and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Strong analytical skills and great attention to details

• Able to challenge the status quo with skepticism and is passionate about process validation/ improvement

• Possess strong communication skills and a good record of extra-curricular activities.

• Good interpersonal skills, able to work in a team effectively, deliver on commitment.

Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee reimbursement activities as well as associated healthcare compliance reviews in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e assessment results) activities in concur

• during claim processing

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - Polish speaking (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 2 years.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Sarete responsabili della prenotazione di fatture complesse in conformità con Roche e gli standard locali in modo che il fornitore riceve i fondi in tempo per le merci fornite e i servizi resi. • Gestire gli account dei fornitori
• Audit, report e supporto AP fattura risoluzione
• Le domande di fattura interna della filiale di maniglia
• Agire come punto di contatto, promuovere forti relazioni di collaborazione tra i team finanziari della filiale e tutti gli altri team SSC interni
• Partecipare al miglioramento dei processi e ai progetti in corso, opportunità di partecipare al trasferimento di conoscenze Chi sei:
• Laurea in finanza o esperienza professionale rilevante
• Comprensione generale dei processi finanziari e degli standard. Ampia esperienza nei processi di pagamento dei conti (o relativi campi) e l'utilizzo di SAP è un vantaggio
• Forte comunicazione e competenze di consulenza e si è in grado di affrontare problemi complessi
• centricità del cliente attraverso le interazioni quotidiane
• Responsabilità end-to-end, capacità di problem solving, crescita e mentalità agile in situazioni ambigue
• accettazione multiculturale, capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e mutevole
• Proficienza in inglese e polacco In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo i vostri dati personali relativi al processo di reclutamento. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un rôle à durée déterminée pour 2 ans. La possibilité : En tant que comptable comptable, vous êtes responsable des services de haute qualité offerts aux fournisseurs et partenaires internes de Roche. Vous serez responsable de la réservation des factures complexes selon Roche et les normes locales afin que le fournisseur reçoive les fonds à temps pour les marchandises fournies et les services rendus. Vous aurez la possibilité d'avoir l'entière responsabilité du processus d'AP de bout en bout et de traiter les demandes internes et les demandes de fournisseurs reçues par téléphone ou par courrier dans la langue locale.
• Traiter et valider les factures directes et les demandes de paiement, gérer et exécuter les paiements
• Gérer les comptes fournisseurs
• Vérification, rapport et appui Résolution de la facture AP
• Poignez les requêtes internes de facture d'affiliation
• Agir comme point de contact, promouvoir de solides relations de collaboration entre les équipes financières affiliées et toutes les autres équipes internes de SSC
• Participer à l'amélioration des processus et aux projets en cours, occasion de participer au transfert des connaissances Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme universitaire en finance ou expérience professionnelle pertinente
• Compréhension générale des processus et des normes financiers. Une vaste expérience des processus de comptes créditeurs (ou du domaine connexe) et de l'utilisation du SAP est un avantage
• Fortes compétences en communication et en conseil et vous êtes en mesure de traiter des questions complexes
• La concentration des clients dans vos interactions quotidiennes
• Responsabilité de bout en bout, compétences en résolution de problèmes, croissance et état d'esprit agile dans des situations ambiguës
• Acceptation multiculturelle, capacité de travailler dans un environnement en évolution rapide
• Compétence en anglais et en polonais En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des opportunités de développement constantes, des cours et des formations linguistiques gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la chance de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.
• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion. Veuillez lire l'Avis de confidentialité des données pour plus d'informations sur la façon dont nous traitons vos données personnelles liées au processus de recrutement. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Am Standort Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing der F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG bekommst du einen einzigartigen Einblick in die Produktion von chemischen und biologischen aktiven pharmazeutischen Wirkstoffen für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung.

Der Standort Basel Drug Substance ist ein wichtiger Teil der Versorgung von Patient:innen weltweit. Er besteht aus zwei Haupt-Produktionseinheiten (sogenannten Manufacturing Units): der MU MAB und der MU SUT/ADC. Zusammen mit fünf unterstützenden Einheiten (Units) fokussieren sich rund 600 Mitarbeitende darauf, Patient:innen mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen. Die Produktionseinheiten werden von der Qualitätssicherung (QA) sowie den weiteren Units umfassend unterstützt.

Innerhalb der Qualitätssicherung spielt das Chapter Compliance, Systems & Training eine zentrale Rolle. Es besteht aus drei Teams, deren gemeinsames Ziel es ist, die Einhaltung höchster Standards in den Bereichen Compliance, Systemmanagement und Schulung am gesamten Standort zu gewährleisten.

Für das QA Systems Team und das QA Training Team suchen wir für beide Teams ab sofort motivierte Praktikant:innen. Wir bieten euch spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem dynamischen Produktionsumfeld.

Die Möglichkeit

Während deines Praktikums übernimmst du vielfältige und praxisnahe Tätigkeiten, unter anderem:

• Mitarbeit in den Team-internen Fachbereichen wie z. B. Event Management (Deviation Management), Records Management, Change Management oder Quality Risk Management – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichs Teams

• Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen Chapter-internen Praktikant:innen, um sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen und gemeinsam teamübergreifende Aufgaben zu bearbeiten

• Planung und Durchführung eigener kleiner Projekte im Bereich Systems und / oder Training

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs)

• Archivierung und Verwaltung von qualitätsrelevanten Dokumenten

• Kommunikation und enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen

• Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen

• Mitwirkung bei der Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Nachbereitung von Behördeninspektionen und Audits

Wer du bist

• Du absolvierst gerade dein Masterstudium im naturwissenschaftlichen oder technischen Bereich oder hast es vor maximal 12 Monaten vor dem Startdatum erfolgreich abgeschlossen (z. B. in Pharmazie, Biotechnologie, Chemie, Molekularbiologie oder Pädagogik).

• Du kommunizierst absolut sicher und fließend in Wort und Schrift – sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch.

• Hohe Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und proaktive Haltung.

• Sehr gute Arbeitsplanung und Priorisierung – Überblick über vielfältige Aufgaben behalten.

• Strukturierte und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise nach Vorgaben ​

• Du bist flexibel, offen und hast echte Freude an der engen und dynamischen Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.

• Der Umgang mit MS Office und den gängigen Google-Anwendungen geht dir leicht von der Hand.

Zusätzliche Informationen

• Wir bieten dir Einblick in ein internationales Pharmaumfeld und die Herstellung von Wirkstoffen, eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben im Bereich QA Systems mit direkter Praxisrelevanz. Zudem erhältst du Mitarbeit in einem engagierten, interdisziplinären Team, das Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung lebt, sowie vielfältige Einblicke in die unterschiedlichen Fachbereiche des Teams, wodurch du die Qualitätssysteme und Prozesse umfassend kennenlernst

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Presso il sito di Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing di F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, avrai una visione unica della produzione di ingredienti farmaceutici attivi chimici e biologici per la cura commerciale e clinica. Il sito di Basel Drug Substance è una parte importante della cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo. Si compone di due unità di produzione principali: la MU MAB e la MU SUT/ADC. Insieme a cinque unità di supporto, circa 600 dipendenti si concentrano sulla fornitura di pazienti con farmaci vitali. Le unità di produzione sono ampiamente supportate dalla garanzia della qualità (QA) e dalle altre unità. Nell'ambito della garanzia della qualità, il capitolo Compliance, Systems & Training svolge un ruolo centrale. Si compone di tre squadre il cui obiettivo comune è quello di garantire i più elevati standard di conformità, gestione dei sistemi e formazione in tutto il sito. Per il QA Systems Team e il QA Training Team, siamo alla ricerca di stagisti motivati per entrambe le squadre da ora in poi. Vi offriamo attività emozionanti e varie in un ambiente di produzione dinamico. La possibilità Durante il vostro tirocinio, avrete una varietà di attività pratiche, tra cui:
• Collaborazione nei dipartimenti di team interni come Event Management (Deviation Management), Gestione record, Gestione dei cambiamenti o Gestione dei rischi di qualità – in stretta collaborazione con i rispettivi dipartimenti di team
• Coordinamento e cooperazione con gli altri tirocinanti del capitolo interno: sostenere l'un l'altro e lavorare insieme sui compiti del team
• Pianificazione e realizzazione di propri piccoli progetti nel settore dei sistemi e/o della formazione
• Preparazione e revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP)
• Archiviazione e gestione di documenti rilevanti per la qualità
• Comunicazione e stretta collaborazione con le interfacce interne
• Sostegno all'organizzazione e all'attuazione della formazione
• Partecipazione alla preparazione, al monitoraggio e al follow-up delle ispezioni e degli audit ufficiali Chi sei
• Attualmente stai completando il tuo master in scienza o tecnologia o hai completato con successo un massimo di 12 mesi prima della data di inizio (ad esempio in farmacia, biotecnologia, chimica, biologia molecolare o pedagogia).
• Si comunica assolutamente in modo sicuro e fluente nella parola e nella scrittura – sia in tedesco che in inglese.
• Elevata disponibilità a imparare, iniziativa e attitudine proattiva.
• Pianificazione e priorità di lavoro molto buone – mantenere una panoramica di una vasta gamma di compiti.
• Metodo di lavoro strutturato e di qualità consapevole secondo le specifiche
• Sei flessibile, aperto e divertiti a lavorare da vicino e dinamicamente con gli altri.
• Fare affari con MS Office e le applicazioni comuni di Google è facile per voi. Ulteriori informazioni
• Vi offriamo informazioni su un ambiente farmaceutico internazionale e la produzione di principi attivi, attività auto-responsabili nel campo dei sistemi QA con rilevanza pratica diretta. Inoltre, sarete parte di un team interdisciplinare dedicato che lavora insieme e si supporta l'un l'altro, così come una vasta gamma di approfondimenti nei diversi dipartimenti del team, consentendo di conoscere i sistemi di qualità e processi in modo completo.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing site of F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, you will get a unique insight into the production of chemical and biological active pharmaceutical ingredients for commercial and clinical care. The Basel Drug Substance site is an important part of the care of patients worldwide. It consists of two main production units: the MU MAB and the MU SUT/ADC. Together with five support units, around 600 employees focus on providing patients with vital medicines. The production units are comprehensively supported by quality assurance (QA) and the other units. Within quality assurance, the chapter Compliance, Systems & Training plays a central role. It consists of three teams whose common goal is to ensure the highest standards of compliance, systems management and training throughout the site. For the QA Systems Team and the QA Training Team, we are looking for motivated interns for both teams from now on. We offer you exciting and varied tasks in a dynamic production environment. The possibility During your internship, you will take on a variety of practical activities, including:
• Collaboration in the internal team departments such as Event Management (Deviation Management), Records Management, Change Management or Quality Risk Management – in close cooperation with the respective team departments
• Coordination and cooperation with the other internal chapter trainees: to support each other and work together on cross-team tasks
• Planning and implementation of own small projects in the area of systems and / or training
• Preparation and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs)
• Archiving and management of quality-relevant documents
• Communication and close cooperation with internal interfaces
• Support for the organisation and implementation of training
• Participation in the preparation, monitoring and follow-up of official inspections and audits Who you are
• You are currently completing your master’s degree in science or technology or have successfully completed it a maximum of 12 months before the start date (e.g. in pharmacy, biotechnology, chemistry, molecular biology or pedagogy).
• You communicate absolutely safely and fluently in word and writing – both in German and English.
• High willingness to learn, initiative and proactive attitude.
• Very good work planning and prioritization – keep an overview of a wide range of tasks.
• Structured and quality-conscious working method according to specifications
• You are flexible, open and enjoy working closely and dynamically with others.
• Dealing with MS Office and the common Google applications is easy for you. Additional information
• We offer you insight into an international pharmaceutical environment and the production of active ingredients, self-responsible tasks in the field of QA systems with direct practical relevance. In addition, you will be part of a dedicated, interdisciplinary team that works together and supports each other, as well as a wide range of insights into the different departments of the team, enabling you to get to know the quality systems and processes comprehensively.

Hoffmann-La Roche AG, vous aurez un aperçu unique de la production d'ingrédients pharmaceutiques actifs chimiques et biologiques pour des soins commerciaux et cliniques. • Communication et coopération étroite avec les interfaces internes

• Vous terminez actuellement votre maîtrise en sciences ou en technologie ou vous l'avez terminée avec succès au maximum 12 mois avant la date de début (p. ex. en pharmacie, en biotechnologie, en chimie, en biologie moléculaire ou en pédagogie).
• Vous communiquez en toute sécurité et couramment en paroles et en écriture, en allemand et en anglais.
• Une grande volonté d'apprendre, d'initiative et d'attitude proactive.
• Très bonne planification du travail et hiérarchisation – garder un aperçu d'un large éventail de tâches.

• Vous êtes flexible, ouvert et aimez travailler en étroite collaboration et dynamique avec les autres.

• Nous vous offrons un aperçu d'un environnement pharmaceutique international et de la production d'ingrédients actifs, des tâches auto-responsables dans le domaine des systèmes d'AQ avec une pertinence pratique directe. The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Project Management Partner based in Lucknow and working to serve the UP Cluster and Punjab Cluster (remotely) regions, you will play a crucial role in driving cluster initiatives, streamlining operations, and championing digital transformation. You will ensure our teams execute their strategies effectively through agile processes, robust compliance, and seamless operational support, helping us deliver exceptional impact to the healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity

• Drive project execution and agility: You track the status of key cluster projects, coordinate execution, and maintain project documentation and business planning. You implement agile ways of working and leverage PMP tools to improve processes and bring system efficiencies.

• Manage local operations and vendors: You support marketing campaign rollouts, patient awareness programs, and event logistics. You are responsible for local vendor management, purchasing, administrative support to the Cluster Head, and general office administration matters.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Project Management Partner based in Lucknow and working to serve the UP Cluster and Punjab Cluster (remotely) regions, you will play a crucial role in driving cluster initiatives, streamlining operations, and championing digital transformation. You will ensure our teams execute their strategies effectively through agile processes, robust compliance, and seamless operational support, helping us deliver exceptional impact to the healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity

• Drive project execution and agility: You track the status of key cluster projects, coordinate execution, and maintain project documentation and business planning. You implement agile ways of working and leverage PMP tools to improve processes and bring system efficiencies.

• Lead strategic planning: You assess plan execution through key metrics and lead Outcome-Based Planning within the cluster, driving implementation conceptually and through digital means.

• Manage local operations and vendors: You support marketing campaign rollouts, patient awareness programs, and event logistics. You are responsible for local vendor management, purchasing, administrative support to the Cluster Head, and general office administration matters.

• Act as the Local Compliance Champion: You ensure the state office is SHE compliant and champion audit preparedness, COREMAP, and other critical compliance practices, carrying out due diligence for medico-marketing and access sponsorships.

• Digital Champion: You own cluster responsibilities for digital tools (including CRM and G Suite), driving user adoption and resolving queries. You also serve as the primary Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for SAP.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: You work closely with PJP (Patient Journey Partners) and other internal and external stakeholders to deliver solutions, manage brand collateral, and ensure commercial success.

Who You Are

• You hold a strong academic background with a university degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, or Life Sciences. An MBA (or equivalent) is highly preferred.

• You have proven experience in client handling and external stakeholder engagement, preferably in service industries. An understanding of the pharma environment and terminologies is highly desirable.

• You possess a strong grasp of technology and digital tools from both a user and admin standpoint. You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and have a high grasp of new tech applications.

• You have excellent oral and written communication skills, enabling you to build relationships and present information clearly to leadership and cross-functional teams.

• You exhibit strong logical reasoning and a positive, "can-do" attitude that thrives in dynamic environments.

• You act with a deep sense of ownership, responsibility, and empathy, ensuring you always keep patient and customer impact in mind.

• You are comfortable and capable of working effectively, managing and serving the UP and Punjab (remote) clusters.

Who we are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to pioneer the sourcing strategies that deliver critical, near-patient diagnostic technologies to the world? As our Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will spearhead global sourcing operations for our Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) portfolios. Balancing strategic alignment with tactical excellence, you will lead a highly capable team, drive digital procurement transformation, and collaborate directly with executive leadership to shape the future of our supply network.

- Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
- Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a local team of up to 16 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. In addition, you will be part of the CoE Leadership Team (LT) and manage critical relationships with executive leadership, including the Direct Procurement LT.
- Role Type: A leadership position combining an even balance of strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution.
- Impact: Your impact is defined by driving measurable financial value, robust governance, and process optimization across the NPC, Sensors & Cartridges and EM globally. Specifically, you are accountable for: ​

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times) while managing your team’s OPEX budget.

• Sourcing & Contracts: Executing compliant global sourcing, market research, and NPI benchmarking. In addition, you will oversee a critical portfolio of low-to-high complexity contracts (e.g., CDAs, SOWs or MSAs).

• Digital Leadership: Governing and improving Roche`s iCollab platform to advance supplier integration alongside Planning, Global Supply Chain, and the Roche Shared Services (RSS).

• SLA Governance: Defining KPIs to guarantee on-time and in-full (OTIF) service delivery across your assigned portfolio.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving high-stakes matrix priority conflicts, representing Roche to external providers, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

• Process & Technology: Together with our Digital & Process experts, you foster and role model the development, deployment, and usage of novel AI / Digital solutions and continuously identify and implement process improvements.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can lead high-performance cultures, embrace collaboration, and remove operational friction.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences) is required; a Master's (MBA) and CIPS certification are highly preferred.

• Experience: 7 to 10 years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industries) with 3 to 5 years specifically in a Shared Service or Co

descriptionByLocale.it: A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a pionieri le strategie di approvvigionamento che forniscono tecnologie diagnostiche critiche e quasi pazienti al mondo? Come il nostro Sourcing Lead a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si lanciano operazioni di approvvigionamento globale per i nostri portafogli di assistenza ai pazienti vicini (NPC), sensori e cartucce, e produzione esterna (EM). Bilanciando l'allineamento strategico con l'eccellenza tattica, guiderai un team altamente capace, guiderai la trasformazione degli appalti digitali e collaborerai direttamente con la leadership esecutiva per plasmare il futuro della nostra rete di approvvigionamento. ● Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza di Procurement (CoE). ● team e stakeholder Wider: sei responsabile per leader, coaching, e lo sviluppo di un team locale di fino a 16 Sourcing Manager e un Leader per la Capability Business. Inoltre, sarete parte del CoE Leadership Team (LT) e gestire relazioni critiche con la leadership esecutiva, tra cui il Direct Procurement LT. ● Tipo di ruolo: Una posizione di leadership che combina un equilibrio uniforme di allineamento di categoria strategica e esecuzione di sourcing tattico. ● Impatto: il tuo impatto è definito guidando il valore finanziario misurabile, la governance robusta e l'ottimizzazione dei processi attraverso il NPC, sensori e cartucce ed EM a livello globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per: ○ Performance & Savings: Guidare metriche chiave (PPV, quota di fornitore preferita, tempi di ciclo) mentre gestisci il budget OPEX del tuo team. Sourcing & Contracts: Esecuzione di sourcing globale, ricerca di mercato e benchmarking NPI. Inoltre, si supervisionerà un portafoglio critico di contratti di scarsa complessità (ad esempio, CDAs, SOWs o MSAs). ○ Leadership digitale: Governare e migliorare la piattaforma iCollab di Roche per far avanzare l'integrazione dei fornitori insieme a Planning, Global Supply Chain, e Roche Shared Services (RSS). ○ Governance SLA: Definire i KPI per garantire la consegna dei servizi on-time e in-full (OTIF) attraverso il portafoglio assegnato. ○ Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere conflitti prioritari di matrice ad alto consumo, rappresentando Roche a fornitori esterni, e fornendo aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza alla leadership esecutiva (CoE, Categoria, Consegna e DPLT). ○ Process & Technology: Insieme ai nostri esperti di Digital & Process, tu adotti e modella lo sviluppo, la distribuzione e l'utilizzo di nuove soluzioni AI / Digital e identifichi continuamente e implementa i miglioramenti del processo. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono condurre culture ad alte prestazioni, abbracciare la collaborazione e rimuovere l'attrito operativo. ● Istruzione: è richiesto un diploma universitario (Business o Life Sciences); una certificazione Master (MBA) e CIPS sono molto preferiti. ● Esperienza: da 7 a 10 anni in Procurement diretto (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industry) con 3 a 5 anni specificamente in un Servi condiviso

Wer du bist Wir bemühen uns, unsere Standards hoch zu halten und suchen nach Kandidaten, die Hochleistungskulturen führen, die Zusammenarbeit fördern und Reibungen beseitigen können. ● Ausbildung: Ein Universitätsabschluss (Business oder Life Sciences) ist erforderlich; eine Master- (MBA) und CIPS-Zertifizierung sind sehr bevorzugt. ● Erfahrung: 7 bis 10 Jahre in der Direktbeschaffung (Medtech-, Automobil-, Elektronik-, Pharma- oder Chemieindustrie) mit 3 bis 5 Jahren speziell in einem Shared Servi
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Nous, chez Diagnostics Direct Approvisionnement (DOP), sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à être le pionnier des stratégies d'approvisionnement qui fournissent des technologies diagnostiques critiques et proches des patients au monde? En tant que leader d'approvisionnement à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous dirigerez les opérations d'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale pour nos portefeuilles Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges et External Manufacturing (EM). Équilibrant l'alignement stratégique avec l'excellence tactique, vous dirigerez une équipe hautement compétente, piloterez la transformation des achats numériques et collaborerez directement avec les dirigeants pour façonner l'avenir de notre réseau d'approvisionnement. ● Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement. ● Équipe élargie et parties prenantes: Vous êtes responsable de la direction, de l'encadrement et du développement d'une équipe locale pouvant compter jusqu'à 16 gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et un responsable des capacités d'affaires. De plus, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de leadership du Conseil de l'Europe (EL) et gérerez des relations critiques avec les cadres supérieurs, y compris le LT d'approvisionnement direct. ● Type de rôle : Un poste de leadership combinant un équilibre uniforme entre l'alignement stratégique et l'exécution tactique de l'approvisionnement. ● Impact: Votre impact est défini par une valeur financière mesurable, une gouvernance robuste et l'optimisation des processus à travers le NPC, Sensors & Cartridges et EM à l'échelle mondiale. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable : Performances et économies : Diriger les mesures clés (PPV, part de fournisseur préférée, temps de cycle) tout en gérant le budget OPEX de votre équipe.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Exécuter un approvisionnement mondial conforme, des études de marché et des analyses comparatives NPI. De plus, vous superviserez un portefeuille essentiel de contrats de faible à grande complexité (p. ex., ACD, ASU ou ASM). Leadership numérique : diriger et améliorer la plateforme iCollab de Roche pour favoriser l'intégration des fournisseurs aux côtés de la planification, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et des services partagés de Roche (RSS). Gouvernance de l'ALS : Définir les ICR pour garantir la prestation des services à temps et en totalité (OTIF) dans l'ensemble de votre portefeuille. Conflit et exposition : résoudre les conflits prioritaires de la matrice des prises élevées, représentant Roche auprès des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à la direction (CoE, Catégorie, Exécution et DPLT). Processus et technologie : avec nos experts en processus numériques, vous encouragez et modélisez le développement, le déploiement et l'utilisation de solutions numériques et d'IA nouvelles et identifiez et implémentez en permanence les améliorations de processus. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de chercher des candidats qui peuvent diriger des cultures de haute performance, embrasser la collaboration et éliminer les frictions opérationnelles. ● Éducation: Un diplôme universitaire (affaires ou sciences de la vie) est requis; une maîtrise (MBA) et une certification CIPS sont hautement préférés. ● Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans dans l'approvisionnement direct (industries de la métallurgie, de l'automobile, de l'électronique, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des produits chimiques) et de 3 à 5 ans dans un service partagé
