jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Patient Journey Partner - Okulistyka

Dołącz do Roche jako Patient Journey Partner!

Chcesz pracować tam, gdzie Twoje działania naprawdę zmieniają sposób leczenia pacjentów ? Gdzie współtworzysz rozwiązania, zamiast realizować schematy? Jeśli tak - mamy coś dla Ciebie.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy 2 osób . Zapraszamy kandydatki i kandydatów z następujących lokalizacji:

• Szczecin (praca na terenie woj. zachodniopomorskiego i lubuskiego)

• Łódź - (praca na terenie woj. łódzkiego)

Jako Patient Journey Partner stajesz się kluczowym partnerem dla ośrodków medycznych i środowiska okulistycznego. Wspólnie projektujecie lepszy dostęp do nowoczesnych terapii, a Twoje działania przekładają się na to, jak szybko i skutecznie pacjent trafia do właściwej opieki.

To wyjątkowa rola, w której:

• łączysz perspektywę lekarzy, pacjentów i systemu ochrony zdrowia,

• budujesz partnerstwa zamiast relacji transakcyjnych,

• tworzysz realne usprawnienia na ścieżce pacjenta w okulistyce.

Twoje zadania:

• Budowanie i rozwijanie relacji z lekarzami i ośrodkami medycznymi,

• Identyfikowanie realnych wyzwań pacjentów i przekuwanie ich w konkretne rozwiązania,

• Dzielenie się ekspercką wiedzą o terapiach Roche,

• Organizacja spotkań, szkoleń i wydarzeń edukacyjnych,

• Współpraca z lokalnymi i globalnymi zespołami Roche.

Szukamy osoby, która:

• Ma doświadczenie w pracy terenowej i kontaktach z lekarzami (okulistyka będzie dużym atutem),

• Ma doświadczenie w programach lekowych

• Działa samodzielnie, proaktywnie i z naturalną otwartością,

• Świetnie komunikuje się z różnymi partnerami - zarówno w środowisku medycznym, jak i wewnątrz organizacji,

• Potrafi współpracować cross-funkcyjnie, angażując zespoły medyczne, marketingowe, market access i operacyjne,

• Lubi pracować zespołowo i czuje się dobrze w dynamicznym środowisku, gdzie wspólne rozwiązywanie wyzwań jest codziennością,

• Kieruje się empatią i misją realnej poprawy doświadczenia pacjentów,

• Zna język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.

Mile widziane:

• Wykształcenie medyczne/biologiczne,

• Znajomość środowiska okulistycznego.

Co oferujemy?

• Umowę o pracę, atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i premię roczną,

• Prywatną opiekę medyczną, ubezpieczenie na życie, karta Multisport,

• Szkolenia, rozwój i lekcje językowe,

• Dwa dodatkowe wolne piątki kwartalnie („Recharge Fridays”),

• Dofinansowanie wakacji, program akcji pracowniczych i emerytalnych,

• Realny wpływ, zaufanie i przestrzeń do działania.

W Roche czekamy na ludzi, którzy chcą działać z misją.

Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie? Aplikuj!

Jeżeli znasz kogoś, kto idealnie tu pasuje - przekaż dalej.

Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Polska Sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warszawa. Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Przysługuje Ci prawo dostępu do treści swoich danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: ochrona.danych@roche.com . Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche Twoich danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/pl/content/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-pl.html

jobs.title: Solution Integration & Testing Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us: A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Within Core Lab Development (CLD) , a division of Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , we focus on developing cutting-edge test solutions spanning clinical and immunochemistry, coagulation, mass spectrometry, and advanced laboratory automation. As part of our Solution Automation Integration and Testing group, you will operate within the cobas ultra omni Solution Layer . Here, a "Solution" represents a massive, complex System of Systems (SoS) where physical medical devices, robotic transport automation, and digital edge-to-cloud workflow software interact seamlessly, combining hardware and software products.

Important Context for Applicants: This is a Product R&D engineering role focused on physical product orchestration and embedded/cloud systems, not an enterprise IT infrastructure position.

Your Role
As a Solution Integration & Testing Architect, you will lead the technical orchestration of our R&D validation campaigns, interfacing across multiple Product Development System Teams and strategic external partners.
You will work in close, hand-in-hand partnership with the Solution Integration Manager. You own the architectural definition of the Solution Integration & Testing Strategy and design the physical, hybrid, and virtual lab topologies needed for complex testing. Your primary challenge is ensuring that hardware products (with long, physical development lifecycles) and software products (with rapid, continuous release lifecycles) are designed and architected to work seamlessly together to enable End-to-End (E2E) clinical workflows. Partnering closely with Solution Definition and Systems Test Architects, as well as your managerial counterpart, you ensure that both functional and non-functional requirements (performance, reliability, scale) are verifiably testable at the E2E solution level.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overarching Integration Strategy: Architect the master Solution Integration Strategy. Define the integration levels, quality gates between those levels, and the Continuous Integration (CI) roadmap. Establish governance for global implementation environments and automated verification pipelines across the divergent development teams of system products.

• Lab & Emulator Topology Strategy: Define the virtual, hybrid, and physical lab setup strategy. Lead the conceptual design and architecture of the digital twin landscapes, and hardware/software emulator topologies required to accurately mirror different systems that compose the solution.

• Design for Testability: Act as the final technical gatekeeper by reviewing system use cases, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and high-level requirements to guarantee verifiable testability at the solution level. Identify and prioritize critical architectural risks for E2E solution workflows.

• Cross-Functional Product Boundaries: Establish and enforce clear cross-functional test and technical responsibilities across the product delivery nodes (e.g., hardware instruments, embedded control units, navify workflow software edge & cloud).

• Technical Guidance & Automation Vision: Provide dedicated technical leadership, automation strategy, and coaching to embedded integration engineers, test automation developers, and analysts across the Solution Train. Facilitate bidirectional feedback with delivery streams to ensu

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub team has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Group Communications by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management and Digital Publishing Services.

As a Digital Campaign Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.

In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

The Opportunity:

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders.

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

• Empower affiliates to achieve their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision.

• Support affiliates with content demand planning topics and integrate local demand forecast inputs into Roche's global demand planning methodology to ensure strategic alignment and readiness.

• Report and advise: Collect insights on localisation progress. Engage with the global brand team to communicate key insights and recommendations.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field and 3 + years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English with experience in facilitating collaboration between global and local teams.

• You own experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• Proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems are needed.

• Familiarity with the Life Science industry, including key local compliance and regulatory concepts is an advantage.

​
In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportu

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il team Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali delle Comunicazioni di Gruppo sostenendo iniziative centrali con Social Media Management e Digital Publishing Services. In qualità di Digital Campaign Specialist nel Digital Campaigns Chapter nel Global Digital Hub, si gioca un ruolo cruciale nel guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della distribuzione dei contenuti della campagna in tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Garantisci un coordinamento senza interruzioni tra team globali e locali e ottieni messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Contribuisci alla fornitura di contenuti globali e locali, promuovi l'adozione di contenuti globali e la templatizzazione. In questo ruolo, si agisce come coordinatore della produzione di contenuti, così come un consulente per sostenere gli affiliati nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche. Costruisci e mantieni forti relazioni con gli stakeholder della rete di affiliazione, servendo come primo punto di contatto per domande, idee e sfide. L'opportunità:
• Gestione della produzione dei contenuti: guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della campagna e la distribuzione dei contenuti, attraverso tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Assicurare gli standard di consegna sono soddisfatti e catturare feedback rilevanti da parte degli stakeholder.
• Contenuti facilitatore di rete: avviare conversazioni tra team globali e locali per riflettere le esigenze, le intuizioni e gli insegnamenti e ottenere messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Collabora con il team di brand engagement globale sui piani e il riutilizzo dei contenuti globali/locali.
• Stakeholder Communication: incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder, rivedere le richieste di contenuti della campagna digitale e garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con le parti interessate rilevanti nella rete di affiliazione, rimanendo aggiornati con le tendenze digitali, le innovazioni del settore e la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra le affiliate.
• Incoraggiare gli affiliati a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche.
• Sostenere gli affiliati con argomenti di pianificazione della domanda di contenuti e integrare gli input di previsione della domanda locale nella metodologia di pianificazione globale della domanda di Roche per garantire l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità.
• Segnala e consiglia: Raccogli informazioni sui progressi della localizzazione. Impegnarsi con il team di brand globale per comunicare idee e raccomandazioni chiave. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business, o un campo correlato e 3 + anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale in più canali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione della campagna.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata traccia di gestione simultanea di più progetti.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub team has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Group Communications by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management and Digital Publishing Services.

As a Digital Campaign Specialist in the Digital Campaigns Chapter in the Global Digital Hub, you play a crucial role in driving the end-to-end orchestration of campaign content delivery across all channels and request types. You ensure seamless coordination between global and local teams, and achieve consistent messaging throughout the organization. You contribute to global and local content delivery, promote the adoption of global content and templatization.

In this role, you act as a content production coordinator, as well as an advisor to support affiliates in achieving their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision. You build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders in the affiliate network, serving as the first point of contact for questions, ideas, and challenges.

The Opportunity:

• Content production management: Drive the end-to-end orchestration of campaign and content delivery, across all channels and request types. Ensure delivery standards are met, and capture relevant feedback from stakeholders.

• Content network facilitator: Initiate conversations between global and local teams to reflect needs, insights and learnings and achieve consistent messaging across the organization. Collaborate with the global brand engagement team on global/local content plans and reuse.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback from stakeholders, revise digital campaign content requests accordingly, and ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with the relevant stakeholders in the affiliate network by staying up-to-date with digital trends, industry innovations, and sharing best practices across affiliates.

• Empower affiliates to achieve their content goals while aligning with Roche’s digital vision.

• Support affiliates with content demand planning topics and integrate local demand forecast inputs into Roche's global demand planning methodology to ensure strategic alignment and readiness.

• Report and advise: Collect insights on localisation progress. Engage with the global brand team to communicate key insights and recommendations.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field and 3 + years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English with experience in facilitating collaboration between global and local teams.

• You own experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• Proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems are needed.

• Familiarity with the Life Science industry, including key local compliance and regulatory concepts is an advantage.

​
In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportu

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'équipe Global Digital Hub a été créée au sein du Roche Services & Solutions Center de Budapest. Notre objectif principal est de renforcer les capacités numériques de Group Communications en soutenant des initiatives centrales avec Social Media Management et Digital Publishing Services. En tant que spécialiste de la campagne numérique au chapitre des campagnes numériques du Global Digital Hub, vous jouez un rôle crucial dans l'orchestration de bout en bout de la livraison de contenu de campagne sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Vous assurez une coordination harmonieuse entre les équipes mondiales et locales et réalisez des messages cohérents dans toute l'organisation. Vous contribuez à la livraison de contenu mondial et local, promouvoir l'adoption de contenu mondial et la templatisation. Dans ce rôle, vous faites office de coordonnateur de la production de contenu, ainsi que de conseiller pour aider les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs en matière de contenu tout en s'harmonisant avec la vision numérique de Roche. Vous établissez et maintenez des relations solides avec les intervenants du réseau d'affiliation, servant de premier point de contact pour les questions, les idées et les défis. La possibilité :
• Gestion de la production de contenu : Diriger l'orchestration de bout en bout de la campagne et de la diffusion de contenu, sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Veiller à ce que les normes de prestation soient respectées et recueillir les commentaires pertinents des intervenants.
• Animateur de réseau de contenu : Entreprendre des conversations entre les équipes mondiales et locales afin de refléter les besoins, les idées et les apprentissages et d'obtenir des messages cohérents dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'engagement de la marque mondiale sur les plans de contenu mondial/local et la réutilisation.
• Communication avec les parties intéressées : Intégrer les commentaires des parties intéressées, réviser les demandes de contenu de campagne numérique en conséquence et assurer l'alignement sur leurs attentes.
• Établir et maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les intervenants pertinents du réseau des filiales en se tenant au courant des tendances numériques, des innovations de l'industrie et du partage des pratiques exemplaires entre les filiales.
• Autoriser les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs de contenu tout en s'aligneant sur la vision numérique de Roche.
• Soutenir les affiliés avec des sujets de planification de la demande de contenu et intégrer les données de prévision de la demande locale dans la méthodologie de planification de la demande mondiale de Roche pour assurer l'alignement stratégique et la préparation.
• Rapport et conseils: Recueillir des informations sur les progrès de la localisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe mondiale de la marque pour communiquer les principales idées et recommandations. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires ou un domaine connexe et 3 + ans d'expérience en production de contenu, gestion de projet, ou gestion de campagne numérique, avec un accent sur la coordination des initiatives de marketing numérique sur plusieurs canaux.
• Vous avez une bonne compréhension des principes du marketing numérique, de la création de contenu et de la gestion de campagne.
• Vous possédez de solides capacités organisationnelles et multitâches, avec une expérience éprouvée de gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets.
• Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles en anglais avec l'expérience de faciliter la collaboration entre les équipes mondiales et locales.
• Vous possédez une expérience dans la gestion des intervenants et l'intégration de la rétroaction dans les stratégies de contenu.
• La maîtrise des outils et des logiciels de gestion de projet, qui sont prêts à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes, est nécessaire.
• La connaissance de l'industrie des sciences de la vie, y compris les concepts clés de conformité locale et de réglementation, est un avantage. ​ En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist nel Digital Campaigns Chapter nel Global Digital Hub, si gioca un ruolo cruciale nel guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della distribuzione dei contenuti della campagna in tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Garantisci un coordinamento senza interruzioni tra team globali e locali e ottieni messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Contribuisci alla fornitura di contenuti globali e locali, promuovi l'adozione di contenuti globali e la templatizzazione. In questo ruolo, si agisce come coordinatore della produzione di contenuti, così come un consulente per sostenere gli affiliati nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche. Costruisci e mantieni forti relazioni con gli stakeholder della rete di affiliazione, servendo come primo punto di contatto per domande, idee e sfide. L'opportunità:
• Gestione della produzione dei contenuti: guidare l'orchestrazione end-to-end della campagna e la distribuzione dei contenuti, attraverso tutti i canali e tipi di richiesta. Assicurare gli standard di consegna sono soddisfatti e catturare feedback rilevanti da parte degli stakeholder.
• Contenuti facilitatore di rete: avviare conversazioni tra team globali e locali per riflettere le esigenze, le intuizioni e gli insegnamenti e ottenere messaggi costanti in tutta l'organizzazione. Collabora con il team di brand engagement globale sui piani e il riutilizzo dei contenuti globali/locali.
• Stakeholder Communication: incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder, rivedere le richieste di contenuti della campagna digitale e garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro efficaci con le parti interessate rilevanti nella rete di affiliazione, rimanendo aggiornati con le tendenze digitali, le innovazioni del settore e la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra le affiliate.
• Incoraggiare gli affiliati a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di contenuto, allineando con la visione digitale di Roche.
• Sostenere gli affiliati con argomenti di pianificazione della domanda di contenuti e integrare gli input di previsione della domanda locale nella metodologia di pianificazione globale della domanda di Roche per garantire l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità.
• Segnala e consiglia: Raccogli informazioni sui progressi della localizzazione. Impegnarsi con il team di brand globale per comunicare idee e raccomandazioni chiave. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business o un campo correlato; sei altamente creativo, innovativo, avanzato marketing di pensiero con la capacità di dimostrare la consapevolezza delle tendenze digitali.
• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 1-3 anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali in lingua inglese, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Global Digital Hub a été créé au sein du Roche Services & Solutions Center à Budapest. Notre objectif principal est de renforcer les capacités numériques de Roche dans le monde entier en soutenant des initiatives centrales avec Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting et Creative Design. En tant que spécialiste de la livraison de campagnes numériques au chapitre des campagnes numériques du Global Digital Hub, vous jouez un rôle crucial dans l'orchestration de bout en bout de la livraison de contenu de campagne sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Vous assurez une coordination harmonieuse entre les équipes mondiales et locales et réalisez des messages cohérents dans toute l'organisation. Vous contribuez à la livraison de contenu mondial et local, promouvoir l'adoption de contenu mondial et la templatisation. Dans ce rôle, vous faites office de coordonnateur de la production de contenu, ainsi que de conseiller pour aider les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs en matière de contenu tout en s'harmonisant avec la vision numérique de Roche. Vous établissez et maintenez des relations solides avec les intervenants du réseau d'affiliation, servant de premier point de contact pour les questions, les idées et les défis. La possibilité :
• Gestion de la production de contenu : Diriger l'orchestration de bout en bout de la campagne et de la diffusion de contenu, sur tous les canaux et types de demandes. Veiller à ce que les normes de prestation soient respectées et recueillir les commentaires pertinents des intervenants.
• Animateur de réseau de contenu : Entreprendre des conversations entre les équipes mondiales et locales afin de refléter les besoins, les idées et les apprentissages et d'obtenir des messages cohérents dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'engagement de la marque mondiale sur les plans de contenu mondial/local et la réutilisation.
• Communication avec les parties intéressées : Intégrer les commentaires des parties intéressées, réviser les demandes de contenu de campagne numérique en conséquence et assurer l'alignement sur leurs attentes.
• Établir et maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les intervenants pertinents du réseau des filiales en se tenant au courant des tendances numériques, des innovations de l'industrie et du partage des pratiques exemplaires entre les filiales.
• Autoriser les affiliés à atteindre leurs objectifs de contenu tout en s'aligneant sur la vision numérique de Roche.
• Soutenir les affiliés avec des sujets de planification de la demande de contenu et intégrer les données de prévision de la demande locale dans la méthodologie de planification de la demande mondiale de Roche pour assurer l'alignement stratégique et la préparation.
• Rapport et conseils: Recueillir des informations sur les progrès de la localisation. Collaborer avec l'équipe mondiale de la marque pour communiquer les principales idées et recommandations. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous avez un baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, ou un domaine connexe; vous êtes très créatif, innovateur, de la pensée avant marché avec la capacité de démontrer la sensibilisation aux tendances numériques.
• Vous avez une solide compréhension des principes du marketing numérique, de la création de contenu et de la gestion de campagne et de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans la production de contenu, la gestion de projet ou la gestion de campagne numérique, l'accent étant mis sur la coordination des initiatives de marketing numérique sur plusieurs canaux.
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles en anglais, et vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion des intervenants et l'intégration de la rétroaction dans les stratégies de contenu.
• Vous avez un comportement axé sur le client dans tout ce que vous faites et la capacité de créer et de maintenir des relations efficaces avec les intervenants internes et d'autres fournisseurs de tiers.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils et les logiciels de gestion de projet, et vous êtes prêt à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes au besoin.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Responsable Commercial Territorial Multi-gammes (Sud Ests), rattaché(e) au Service Excellence Commercial, vous êtes la voix de nos clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers pour l’ensemble de nos gammes.

Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous identifiez parfaitement les interlocuteurs clés, les processus de décision, l'environnement et les enjeux de vos clients. Vous définissez et assumez la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes territoriaux (existants ou futurs), tout en participant activement à celle des comptes nationaux.

Localisation idéale: Montpellier & alentours

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Garantir la couverture terrain et assurer le rôle d’interlocuteur privilégié : Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les structures clientes, comprendre leurs processus décisionnels, identifier leurs besoins, coordonner les actions et piloter rigoureusement les informations dans le CRM.

• Assurer la conquête, la fidélisation et le développement des comptes : Élaborer et piloter les account plans, gérer le pipeline d'opportunités de vente, négocier les contrats, construire les offres commerciales, veiller au respect des engagements et résoudre les éventuels litiges.

• Garantir la transversalité et la synergie interne : Développer les échanges et la communication entre les différents services de l'entreprise, assurer la complétude des dossiers contractuels et mettre votre expertise terrain au service de la satisfaction client globale.

• Maintenir et développer vos compétences métier : Suivre activement les formations internes, intégrer les nouveautés du marché et maîtriser les outils mis à disposition afin d'apporter un conseil à forte valeur ajoutée aux clients.

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous excellez dans les techniques de négociation commerciale et la gestion de projet. Une solide culture scientifique et la connaissance du marché de la biologie médicale sont des atouts majeurs pour réussir dans ce rôle.

• Vous établissez des relations interpersonnelles solides et possédez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse, ainsi qu'une maîtrise de la gestion des données.

• Votre sens des affaires vous permet d'analyser et de comprendre les enjeux stratégiques et commerciaux de l'industrie du DIV (Diagnostic In Vitro) et du secteur de la santé au sens large.

• Vos compétences en conseil se manifestent par une écoute attentive, la capacité de traduire les demandes en besoins, l'alignement des parties prenantes autour d'une vision commune, le conseil expert et la contractualisation efficace.

• Vous faites preuve d'un leadership inspirant, capable d'engager et d'influencer, tout en collaborant et en coopérant de manière transversale.

• Votre niveau d'anglais courant vous permet de communiquer aisément dans un environnement international.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Physical Compute - IT Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The position

The Physical Compute team delivers intelligent, fit-for-purpose bare-metal infrastructure integrated seamlessly into the Roche ecosystem. The product centralizes and simplifies the delivery of Physical compute infrastructure across our global data centers, computer rooms, and small sites. We provide end-to-end lifecycle management—from provisioning and hardware preparation to maintenance and automated decommissioning—ensuring reliability, scalability, and compliance for workloads that demand the highest standards. We manage thousands of servers across global data centers for both, enterprise and scientific workloads.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual for the position of Physical Compute Engineer. In this role, you will technically lead challenging activities, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains.

Key responsibilities:

• Oversee the entire compute hardware lifecycle—including sizing consultancy, quotation creation, purchasing, backlog tracking, and physical installation up to system connectivity ensuring processes are efficient and optimized.

• Drive physical compute engineering standards and automation to minimize manual intervention across all physical compute assets. Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of integrated, resilient physical compute solutions across various compute flavors.

• Cross-Functional Coordination with Value streams, Network, OS, and Automation teams, as well as Datacenter staff and vendors on delivery and strategic planning

• Stakeholder management: act as a key technical advisor, translating complex customer needs into standard solutions. Communicates and presents complex information, issues and potential solutions on a regular basis on projects, to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Provides guidance to senior internal/external stakeholders on relevant technical matters.

• Demonstrated skills, experience and depth of knowledge to be able to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and recommendations for improvements. Lead vendor governance with key hardware partners (such as HPE and Lenovo), managing operational reviews, SLAs, KPIs, and the lifecycle of physical compute maintenance contracts (renewals, support tiers, and compliance).

• Evaluate emerging technologies in the physical compute scope via PoCs, while ensuring all infrastructure aligns with Roche's Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) and Quality/Regulatory standards.

• Estimate engineering resources, risks, and timelines for complex initiatives, while providing high-level escalation support to resolve major operational incidents.

Qualifications:
Education:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, systems analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

• 5-7 years of relevant experience in hardware Engineering&Operations, data center infrastructure, or systems administration.

• Hands-on experience in the following areas/technologies:

• Physical infrastructure Management&Integration experience working with the physical offering from major Enterprise Data Center Compute vendors such as HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..

• Experience with Enterprise HW management tools, specifically HPE OneView and Lenovo XClarity.

• Knowledge and experience with Compute offering for hyperconverge, High performance computing (HPC), AICompute HW (NVIDIA solutions). E.g.: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This intermediate IT Infrastructure Engineer independently solves a range of technical business problems and contributes to challenging projects requiring deep knowledge in their area. You will design, build, test, and implement resilient solutions, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to technical documentation and standards for Linux technology.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and consulting internal or external stakeholders.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Skilled in solving a wide range of business problems with technology in creative and effective ways. Independently applies a complete understanding of theories and concepts from one’s technical discipline to address difficult problems. Contributes to delivery in challenging projects and designs, builds, tests, and implements (first-time deployments) integrated, resilient, and reliable solutions.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques to solve a variety of problems of larger scope and complexity. Evaluates promising technologies across two or more areas via proofs of concept (PoCs) to assess feasibility for business needs. Stays aware of operational challenges, works with product teams to provide internal escalation support for resolving incidents, and produces/maintains documentation for end-to-end designs and component standards. Responsible for the completion of milestones associated with specific projects.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information, issues, and potential solutions on assigned projects and to cross-functional teams. Networks with senior internal and external personnel within their area of expertise. Represents the organization on assigned projects and serves as a consultant to internal/external stakeholders on technical matters.

• Impact/Strategy: Plays a lead role responsible for key deliverables on projects and influences the decisions and direction of the project. May lead small project teams and mentor/lead individuals in the workgroup. Ensures that solutions and components comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that technology designs adhere to the organization’s architectural strategy, policies, and direction.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse team members and virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds to achieve project or product goals.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a wide application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in the technology area, with knowledge that is particularly deep in one area (e.g., network management, Platform Compute and Storage). Understands the business needs of assigned projects and maintains a general knowledge of other related disciplines.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience independently addressing a broad range of difficult technical problems and contributing to challenging projects.

• Experience in designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated, reliable IT infrastructure solutions.

• Experience representing workgroups on project teams, managing milestones, and potentially leading small project teams or mentoring individuals.

Technical / Business Skills

• Background in Linux/Unix Server technologies (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Satellite)

• In-depth knowledge in a specific I

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Sie entwerfen, bauen, testen und implementieren belastbare Lösungen, bewerten neue Technologien und tragen zur technischen Dokumentation und zu Standards für Linux-Technologie bei. Starke Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind unerlässlich, um effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und interne oder externe Stakeholder zu konsultieren. • Umfang / (Content Leadership): Geschickt in der Lösung einer Vielzahl von Geschäftsproblemen mit Technologie auf kreative und effektive Weise. Wendet unabhängig ein vollständiges Verständnis von Theorien und Konzepten aus der eigenen technischen Disziplin an, um schwierige Probleme anzugehen. Trägt zur Lieferung in anspruchsvollen Projekten und Designs bei, baut, testet und implementiert (Ersteinsatz) integrierte, belastbare und zuverlässige Lösungen.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: übt Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken aus, um eine Vielzahl von Problemen von größerem Umfang und Komplexität zu lösen. Bewertet vielversprechende Technologien in zwei oder mehr Bereichen über Proofs of Concept (PoCs), um die Machbarkeit für die Geschäftsanforderungen zu bewerten. Bleibt sich der betrieblichen Herausforderungen bewusst, arbeitet mit Produktteams zusammen, um interne Eskalationsunterstützung bei der Behebung von Vorfällen zu bieten, und erstellt / pflegt Dokumentation für End-to-End-Designs und Komponentenstandards. Verantwortlich für den Abschluss von Meilensteinen im Zusammenhang mit bestimmten Projekten.
• Stakeholder Management: Kommuniziert und präsentiert komplexe Informationen, Probleme und mögliche Lösungen für zugewiesene Projekte und für funktionsübergreifende Teams. Netzwerke mit leitenden internen und externen Mitarbeitern in ihrem Fachgebiet. Repräsentiert die Organisation bei zugewiesenen Projekten und berät interne / externe Stakeholder in technischen Fragen.
• Impact/Strategie: Spielt eine führende Rolle für wichtige Ergebnisse in Projekten und beeinflusst die Entscheidungen und die Ausrichtung des Projekts. Kann kleine Projektteams und Mentoren/Leiter in der Arbeitsgruppe leiten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Lösungen und Komponenten den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards entsprechen und dass Technologiedesigns der Architekturstrategie, den Richtlinien und der Ausrichtung des Unternehmens entsprechen.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Zeigt die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, effektiv mit verschiedenen Teammitgliedern und virtuellen Teams von verschiedenen Standorten und kulturellen Hintergründen zusammenzuarbeiten, um Projekt- oder Produktziele zu erreichen.
• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Demonstriert eine breite Anwendung von technischen Prinzipien, Theorien und Konzepten im Technologiebereich, mit Kenntnissen, die besonders tief in einem Bereich liegen (z. B. Netzwerkmanagement, Platform Compute und Storage). Versteht die Geschäftsanforderungen von zugewiesenen Projekten und pflegt ein allgemeines Wissen über andere verwandte Disziplinen. Qualifikationen Bildung / Erfahrung
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung, die unabhängig eine breite Palette schwieriger technischer Probleme anspricht und zu herausfordernden Projekten beiträgt.
• Erfahrung im Entwerfen, Erstellen, Testen und Implementieren integrierter, zuverlässiger IT-Infrastrukturlösungen.
• Erfahrung in der Vertretung von Arbeitsgruppen in Projektteams, der Verwaltung von Meilensteinen und der potenziellen Leitung kleiner Projektteams oder der Betreuung von Einzelpersonen. Technische / Business Skills

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer - Windows
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This intermediate IT Infrastructure Engineer independently solves a range of technical business problems and contributes to challenging projects requiring deep knowledge in their area. You will design, build, test, and implement resilient solutions, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to technical documentation and standards. Strong problem-solving and communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and consulting internal or external stakeholders.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Skilled in solving a wide range of business problems with technology in creative and effective ways. Independently applies a complete understanding of theories and concepts from one’s technical discipline to address difficult problems. Contributes to delivery in challenging projects and designs, builds, tests, and implements (first-time deployments) integrated, resilient, and reliable solutions.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques to solve a variety of problems of larger scope and complexity. Evaluates promising technologies across two or more areas via proofs of concept (PoCs) to assess feasibility for business needs. Stays aware of operational challenges, works with product teams to provide internal escalation support for resolving incidents, and produces/maintains documentation for end-to-end designs and component standards. Responsible for the completion of milestones associated with specific projects.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information, issues, and potential solutions on assigned projects and to cross-functional teams. Networks with senior internal and external personnel within their area of expertise. Represents the organization on assigned projects and serves as a consultant to internal/external stakeholders on technical matters.

• Impact/Strategy: Plays a lead role responsible for key deliverables on projects and influences the decisions and direction of the project. May lead small project teams and mentor/lead individuals in the workgroup. Ensures that solutions and components comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that technology designs adhere to the organization’s architectural strategy, policies, and direction.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse team members and virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds to achieve project or product goals.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a wide application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in the technology area, with knowledge that is particularly deep in one area (e.g., network management, Platform Compute and Storage). Understands the business needs of assigned projects and maintains a general knowledge of other related disciplines.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience independently addressing a broad range of difficult technical problems and contributing to challenging projects.

• Experience in designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated, reliable IT infrastructure solutions.

• Experience representing workgroups on project teams, managing milestones, and potentially leading small project teams or mentoring individuals.

Technical / Business Skills

• In-depth knowledge in a specific IT infrastructure technology area (such as Platform, Compute and Storage, Network Management, ERP Technolo

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo intermedio IT Infrastructure Engineer risolve in modo indipendente una gamma di problemi di business tecnici e contribuisce a progetti impegnativi che richiedono una profonda conoscenza nella loro area. Progettare, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni resilienti, valutare nuove tecnologie e contribuire alla documentazione tecnica e agli standard. Le forti capacità di problem solving e di comunicazione sono essenziali per collaborare efficacemente con i team interfunzionali e consultare gli stakeholder interni o esterni. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Abilitato nel risolvere una vasta gamma di problemi di business con la tecnologia in modi creativi ed efficaci. Indipendentemente applica una comprensione completa delle teorie e dei concetti della propria disciplina tecnica per affrontare problemi difficili. Contribuisce alla consegna in progetti e progetti impegnativi, costruisce, testa e implementa soluzioni integrate, resilienti e affidabili.
• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: Esercizi di giudizio nella selezione di metodi e tecniche per risolvere una varietà di problemi di portata e complessità più grandi. Valuta le tecnologie promettenti in due o più settori attraverso le prove del concetto (PoC) per valutare la fattibilità per le esigenze aziendali. Resta a conoscenza delle sfide operative, lavora con i team di prodotti per fornire supporto di escalation interno per risolvere gli incidenti, e produce / mantiene la documentazione per i progetti end-to-end e gli standard dei componenti. Responsabile del completamento delle pietre miliari associate a progetti specifici.
• Stakeholder Management: Comunica e presenta informazioni complesse, problemi e potenziali soluzioni su progetti assegnati e team interfunzionali. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior all'interno della loro area di competenza. Rappresenta l'organizzazione di progetti assegnati e funge da consulente per gli stakeholder interni/esterni in materia tecnica.
• Impact/Strategy: gioca un ruolo di primo piano responsabile dei principali responsabili dei progetti e influenza le decisioni e la direzione del progetto. Può condurre piccoli team di progetto e tutor / persone guidate nel gruppo di lavoro. Assicura che le soluzioni e i componenti siano conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione e che i progetti tecnologici aderiscano alla strategia architettonica, alle politiche e alla direzione dell’organizzazione.
• Complessità / (Product Size): dimostra la comprovata capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi membri del team e team virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali per raggiungere obiettivi di progetto o di prodotto.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: dimostra un'ampia applicazione di principi tecnici, teorie e concetti nell'area tecnologica, con conoscenze particolarmente profonde in un'area (ad esempio, gestione della rete, Compute della piattaforma e Storage). Comprende le esigenze aziendali di progetti assegnati e mantiene una conoscenza generale di altre discipline correlate. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Esperienza dimostrata indipendentemente affrontando una vasta gamma di problemi tecnici difficili e contribuendo a progetti impegnativi.
• Esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione, collaudo e realizzazione di soluzioni integrate e affidabili per l'infrastruttura IT.
• Esperienza che rappresenta gruppi di lavoro sui team di progetto, gestione delle pietre miliari, e potenzialmente leader di piccoli team di progetto o persone di mentoring. Competenze tecniche / aziendali
• Conoscenza approfondita in una specifica area tecnologica dell'infrastruttura IT (come Piattaforma, Compute e Storage, Network Management, ERP Technolo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Dieser intermediäre IT-Infrastruktur-Ingenieur löst unabhängig eine Reihe von technischen Geschäftsproblemen und trägt zu anspruchsvollen Projekten bei, die fundierte Kenntnisse in ihrem Bereich erfordern. Sie entwerfen, bauen, testen und implementieren belastbare Lösungen, bewerten neue Technologien und tragen zur technischen Dokumentation und zu Standards bei. Starke Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind unerlässlich, um effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und interne oder externe Stakeholder zu konsultieren. Beschreibung des Gebiets Aufgabenbereich
• Umfang / (Content Leadership): Geschickt in der Lösung einer Vielzahl von Geschäftsproblemen mit Technologie auf kreative und effektive Weise. Wendet unabhängig ein vollständiges Verständnis von Theorien und Konzepten aus der eigenen technischen Disziplin an, um schwierige Probleme anzugehen. Trägt zur Lieferung in anspruchsvollen Projekten und Designs bei, baut, testet und implementiert (Ersteinsatz) integrierte, belastbare und zuverlässige Lösungen.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: übt Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken aus, um eine Vielzahl von Problemen von größerem Umfang und Komplexität zu lösen. Bewertet vielversprechende Technologien in zwei oder mehr Bereichen über Proofs of Concept (PoCs), um die Machbarkeit für die Geschäftsanforderungen zu bewerten. Bleibt sich der betrieblichen Herausforderungen bewusst, arbeitet mit Produktteams zusammen, um interne Eskalationsunterstützung bei der Behebung von Vorfällen zu bieten, und erstellt / pflegt Dokumentation für End-to-End-Designs und Komponentenstandards. jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Engineer - Physical Compute
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The position

The Physical Compute team delivers intelligent, fit-for-purpose bare-metal infrastructure integrated seamlessly into the Roche ecosystem. The product centralizes and simplifies the delivery of Physical compute infrastructure across our global data centers, computer rooms, and small sites. We provide end-to-end lifecycle management—from provisioning and hardware preparation to maintenance and automated decommissioning—ensuring reliability, scalability, and compliance for workloads that demand the highest standards. We manage thousands of servers across global data centers for both, enterprise and scientific workloads.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual for the position of Physical Compute Engineer. In this role, you will technically lead challenging activities, make critical technical decisions, and architect resilient solutions across multiple domains.

Key responsibilities:

• Oversee the entire compute hardware lifecycle—including sizing consultancy, quotation creation, purchasing, backlog tracking, and physical installation up to system connectivity ensuring processes are efficient and optimized.

• Drive physical compute engineering standards and automation to minimize manual intervention across all physical compute assets. Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of integrated, resilient physical compute solutions across various compute flavors.

• Cross-Functional Coordination with Value streams, Network, OS, and Automation teams, as well as Datacenter staff and vendors on delivery and strategic planning

• Stakeholder management: act as a key technical advisor, translating complex customer needs into standard solutions. Communicates and presents complex information, issues and potential solutions on a regular basis on projects, to cross-functional teams and the business in non-technical terms. Provides guidance to senior internal/external stakeholders on relevant technical matters.

• Demonstrated skills, experience and depth of knowledge to be able to influence IT Infrastructure vendor product evaluations and recommendations for improvements. Lead vendor governance with key hardware partners (such as HPE and Lenovo), managing operational reviews, SLAs, KPIs, and the lifecycle of physical compute maintenance contracts (renewals, support tiers, and compliance).

• Evaluate emerging technologies in the physical compute scope via PoCs, while ensuring all infrastructure aligns with Roche's Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) and Quality/Regulatory standards.

• Estimate engineering resources, risks, and timelines for complex initiatives, while providing high-level escalation support to resolve major operational incidents.

Qualifications:
Education:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, systems analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in hardware Engineering&Operations, data center infrastructure, or systems administration.

• Hands-on experience in the following areas/technologies:

• Physical infrastructure Management&Integration experience working with the physical offering from major Enterprise Data Center Compute vendors such as HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..

• Experience with Enterprise HW management tools, specifically HPE OneView and Lenovo XClarity.

• Knowledge and experience with Compute offering for hyperconverge, High performance computing (HPC), AICompute HW (NVIDIA solutions). E.g.: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Il team Physical Compute offre un'infrastruttura intelligente e fit-for-purpose bare-metal integrata perfettamente nell'ecosistema Roche. Il prodotto centralizza e semplifica la consegna dell'infrastruttura di elaborazione fisica attraverso i nostri data center globali, sale computer e piccoli siti. Forniamo la gestione end-to-end del ciclo di vita, dal provisioning e dalla preparazione hardware alla manutenzione e al decommissioning automatizzato, garantendo affidabilità, scalabilità e conformità ai carichi di lavoro che richiedono i più elevati standard. Gestiamo migliaia di server in centri di dati globali sia per i carichi di lavoro aziendali che scientifici. Stiamo cercando un individuo altamente motivato per la posizione di Physical Compute Engineer. In questo ruolo, sarete tecnicamente condurre attività impegnative, prendere decisioni tecniche critiche, e architetto soluzioni resilient in più domini. Responsabilità chiave:
• Superare l'intero ciclo di vita dell'hardware di elaborazione, tra cui consulenza di dimensionamento, creazione di quote, acquisto, monitoraggio del backlog e installazione fisica fino alla connettività del sistema assicurando processi efficienti e ottimizzati.
• Guidare gli standard di ingegneria della computazione fisica e l'automazione per minimizzare l'intervento manuale in tutti i beni di calcolo fisico. Condurre il design end-to-end, la costruzione e l'implementazione di soluzioni di elaborazione fisica integrata e resiliente attraverso vari gusti di calcolo.
• Cross-Functional Coordination con flussi di valore, team di rete, OS e Automation, nonché personale e fornitori Datacenter sulla consegna e pianificazione strategica
• Gestione degli stakeholder: fungere da consulente tecnico chiave, traducendo complesse esigenze dei clienti in soluzioni standard. Comunica e presenta informazioni complesse, questioni e soluzioni potenziali su base regolare su progetti, a team interfunzionali e il business in termini non tecnici. Fornisce una guida agli stakeholder interni/esterni senior su questioni tecniche rilevanti.
• Competenze dimostrate, esperienza e profondità di conoscenza per poter influenzare le valutazioni dei prodotti e le raccomandazioni dei fornitori di infrastrutture IT per i miglioramenti. Lead vendor governance con i principali partner hardware (come HPE e Lenovo), gestione delle recensioni operative, SLA, KPI, e il ciclo di vita dei contratti di manutenzione della computazione fisica (renewals, supporto e conformità).
• Valutare le tecnologie emergenti nel campo della computazione fisica tramite PoCs, assicurando al contempo tutte le infrastrutture si allineano con Roche's Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) e Quality/Regulatory standards.
• Valutare le risorse ingegneristiche, i rischi e le tempistiche per le iniziative complesse, fornendo al tempo stesso un supporto di escalation di alto livello per risolvere importanti incidenti operativi. Qualifiche: Istruzione:
• Laurea in informatica, analisi dei sistemi o uno studio relativo, o esperienza equivalente. Esperienza:
• 7-10 anni di esperienza rilevante in ingegneria dell'hardware e operazioni, infrastruttura del data center o amministrazione dei sistemi.
• Esperienza pratica nelle seguenti aree/tecnologie:
• Esperienza di gestione e integrazione delle infrastrutture fisiche con l'offerta fisica dei principali fornitori Enterprise Data Center Compute come HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA.
• Esperienza con gli strumenti di gestione HW Enterprise, in particolare HPE OneView e Lenovo XClarity.
• Conoscenza ed esperienza con l'offerta Compute per iperconverge, High Performance computing (HPC), AICompute HW (soluzioni VIDIA). Ad esempio: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

Die Position Die Position Das Physical Compute-Team liefert eine intelligente, passgenaue Bare-Metal-Infrastruktur, die nahtlos in das Roche-Ökosystem integriert ist. Das Produkt zentralisiert und vereinfacht die Bereitstellung der physischen Recheninfrastruktur in unseren globalen Rechenzentren, Computerräumen und kleinen Standorten. Wir bieten ein End-to-End-Lifecycle-Management – von der Bereitstellung und Hardwarevorbereitung bis hin zur Wartung und automatisierten Stilllegung – und gewährleisten Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Compliance für Workloads, die höchste Standards erfordern. Wir verwalten Tausende von Servern in globalen Rechenzentren sowohl für Unternehmens- als auch für wissenschaftliche Workloads. Wir suchen eine hoch motivierte Person für die Position des Physical Compute Engineers. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie technisch anspruchsvolle Aktivitäten, treffen kritische technische Entscheidungen und erstellen belastbare Lösungen in verschiedenen Bereichen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Überwachen Sie den gesamten Compute-Hardware-Lebenszyklus - einschließlich Dimensionierungsberatung, Angebotserstellung, Einkauf, Backlog-Tracking und physische Installation bis hin zur Systemkonnektivität, um sicherzustellen, dass Prozesse effizient und optimiert sind.
• Führen Sie physische Computer-Engineering-Standards und Automatisierung voran, um manuelle Eingriffe in alle physischen Computer-Assets zu minimieren. Führen Sie das End-to-End-Design, den Build und die Implementierung integrierter, belastbarer physikalischer Compute-Lösungen in verschiedenen Compute-Aromen.
• Funktionale Koordination mit Value-Streams, Netzwerk-, Betriebssystem- und Automatisierungsteams sowie Datacenter-Mitarbeitern und -Anbietern in Bezug auf Lieferung und strategische Planung
• Stakeholder-Management: Handeln Sie als wichtiger technischer Berater und übersetzen Sie komplexe Kundenbedürfnisse in Standardlösungen. Kommuniziert und präsentiert regelmäßig komplexe Informationen, Probleme und mögliche Lösungen zu Projekten, funktionsübergreifenden Teams und dem Unternehmen in nicht-technischer Hinsicht. Bietet Anleitungen für hochrangige interne/externe Stakeholder zu relevanten technischen Fragen.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Tiefe des Wissens, um die Produktbewertungen von IT-Infrastrukturanbietern und Empfehlungen für Verbesserungen beeinflussen zu können. Führen Sie die Vendor-Governance mit wichtigen Hardware-Partnern (wie HPE und Lenovo), verwalten Sie operative Reviews, SLAs, KPIs und den Lebenszyklus von physischen Computerwartungsverträgen (Erneuerungen, Support-Stufen und Compliance).
• Bewerten Sie neue Technologien im physischen Rechenbereich über PoCs und stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Infrastruktur mit dem Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) von Roche und den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards übereinstimmt.
• Schätzen Sie Engineering-Ressourcen, -Risiken und -Zeitpläne für komplexe Initiativen ab und bieten Sie gleichzeitig Unterstützung bei der Eskalation auf hoher Ebene, um wichtige operative Vorfälle zu lösen. Qualifikationen: Bildung:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Systemanalyse oder einer verwandten Studie oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. Erfahrung:
• 7-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in Hardware Engineering & Operations, Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur oder Systemadministration.
• Praxiserfahrung in folgenden Bereichen/Technologien:
• Physische Infrastrukturmanagement- und Integrationserfahrung in der Arbeit mit dem physischen Angebot von großen Enterprise Data Center Compute-Anbietern wie HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA.
• Erfahrung mit Enterprise HW Management Tools, speziell HPE OneView und Lenovo XClarity.
• Wissen und Erfahrung mit dem Compute-Angebot für Hyperconverge, High Performance Computing (HPC), AICompute HW (NVIDIA-Lösungen). HPE Synergy Frame Management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position L'équipe Physical Compute fournit une infrastructure de métaux nus intelligente et adaptée à l'usage intégré de façon transparente dans l'écosystème de Roche. Le produit centralise et simplifie la livraison de l'infrastructure de calcul physique dans nos centres de données mondiaux, salles d'ordinateurs et petits sites. Nous offrons une gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout – de la fourniture et de la préparation du matériel à la maintenance et au déclassement automatisé – afin d'assurer la fiabilité, l'évolutivité et la conformité des charges de travail qui exigent les normes les plus élevées. Nous gérons des milliers de serveurs à travers les centres de données mondiaux pour les charges de travail tant d'entreprise que scientifique. Nous recherchons une personne très motivée pour le poste d'ingénieur en calcul physique. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez techniquement des activités difficiles, prendrez des décisions techniques critiques et créerez des solutions résilientes dans plusieurs domaines. Principales responsabilités :
• Surveiller l'ensemble du cycle de vie du matériel informatique, y compris les services de conseil en taille, la création de devis, les achats, le suivi des retards et l'installation physique jusqu'à la connectivité du système, en veillant à ce que les processus soient efficaces et optimisés.
• Conduire les normes de calcul physique et l'automatisation pour minimiser l'intervention manuelle sur tous les actifs de calcul physique. Dirigez la conception, la construction et la mise en œuvre de solutions de calcul physique intégrées et résilientes dans différentes saveurs de calcul.
• Coordination interfonctionnelle avec les flux de valeur, les équipes Réseau, OS et Automation, ainsi que le personnel de Datacenter et les fournisseurs sur la livraison et la planification stratégique
• Gestion des intervenants : agir comme conseiller technique clé, traduire les besoins complexes des clients en solutions standard. Communiquer et présenter régulièrement des informations complexes, des questions et des solutions potentielles sur les projets, aux équipes interfonctionnelles et à l'entreprise en termes non techniques. Fournir des conseils aux principaux intervenants internes et externes sur les questions techniques pertinentes.
• Compétences démontrées, expérience et profondeur des connaissances pour pouvoir influencer les évaluations des produits des fournisseurs d'infrastructure de TI et les recommandations d'amélioration. Diriger la gouvernance des fournisseurs avec les principaux partenaires du matériel (comme HPE et Lenovo), gérer les examens opérationnels, les SLA, les KPI et le cycle de vie des contrats de maintenance de calcul physique (renouvellements, niveaux de soutien et conformité).
• Évaluer les technologies émergentes dans le domaine du calcul physique par l'intermédiaire des PdC, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les infrastructures s'harmonisent avec le cadre d'architecture technique de Roche et les normes de qualité/réglementation.
• Estimer les ressources techniques, les risques et les délais pour les initiatives complexes, tout en fournissant un appui d'escalade de haut niveau pour résoudre les principaux incidents opérationnels. Qualifications Éducation:
• Baccalauréat en informatique, analyse de systèmes ou une étude connexe, ou expérience équivalente. Expérience :
• 7-10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le domaine de l'ingénierie matérielle et des opérations, de l'infrastructure des centres de données ou de l'administration des systèmes.
• Expérience pratique dans les domaines/technologies suivants:
• Gestion physique de l'infrastructure et expérience d'intégration travaillant avec l'offre physique des principaux fournisseurs de données d'entreprise Compute tels que HPE, Lenovo, NVIDIA..
• Expérience avec les outils de gestion d'entreprise HW, en particulier HPE OneView et Lenovo XClarity.
• Connaissance et expérience avec l'offre de calcul pour hyperconverge, calcul haute performance (HPC), AICompute HW (solutions NVIDIA). Par exemple: HPE Synergy Frame management, HPE ProLiant Compute, GB 300

• Kontaktieren Sie neue und bestehende Kunden, um die Verkaufsziele in gezielten (Krankenhaus- und Referenzlabor) Konten zu erreichen und zu übertreffen, indem Sie neues Geschäft entwickeln, bestehendes Geschäft ausbauen, Kundenbeziehungen pflegen und Kundenprobleme beheben. • Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche

• Implementiert strategische Initiativen und Pläne, um den Verkaufsprozess und die Produktivität zu erleichtern.
• Arbeitet mit anderen zusammen, wenn nötig oder erforderlich, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten vorzubereiten (Reagens und Investitionsausrüstung). Präsentiert alle Vertragsvorschläge an Kunden, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was einige Verhandlungen erfordern kann.
• Leitet und organisiert notwendige Gebietsplanung und Routing für Effizienz.
