jobs.title: Accounting Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office day/week on average).
We are conducting web-based interviews.

What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office day/week on average).
We are conducting web-based interviews.

What we do:
The Record to Report Department, often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Finance and Accounting (General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting) and Supply Chain Finance. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounting Intern you will execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level.
As a qualified expert, you:

• Process General Ledger bookings (and any other local request)

• Clear customer and GL accounts

• Contribute to month-end closing tasks

• Provide help of other team members in need of assistance due to workload

• Assist in investigating account discrepancies involving inventory, variances, and allowances

• Gain practical, real-world exposure to enterprise-level financial systems within a shared services environment

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Ongoing university studies in the field of Economics - specialized in Accounting

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Available for 25-30 hours per week

• Customer focused mindset

• Proactive mindset

• Proficiency in English

• A solid academic foundation in accounting and finance principles (GAAP or IFRS)

• Proficient with spreadsheet applications and standard office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, G-Suite)

• Bonus Points: Prior exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP modules like FI, CO/PA, MM, PP) or financial close software

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Act as the IT Expert and Consultant for the SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template team, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Global Template. In this role, you will be accountable for defining and governing Material Master data standards, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy across the organization. You will drive and enforce data governance policies, support data stewardship programs, and collaborate closely with business and technical stakeholders to align data definitions, resolve data issues, and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. By combining deep SAP S/4HANA & MDG expertise with strong data management and governance capabilities, you will play a key role in building a trusted, scalable, and well-managed Material Master data environment that enables high-quality decision-making and operational excellence.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Act as the IT Expert and Consultant for the SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template team, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Global Template.

• Leads, develops, and enforces data governance policies. Works independently on specific governance projects to ensure organizational alignment and data integrity.

• Responsible for process design, configuration, testing assistance, requirements gathering, and establishing a fully functional MDG environment.

• Execute hands-on functional responsibilities, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, system configuration, and testing.

• Partner closely with Business Product, Process, and Content owners to plan and execute strategic enhancements to the Global Template solution.

• Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects, and Product Owners to create detailed technical architecture patterns for master data initiatives.

• Distribute and coordinate deliverables across cross-functional IT teams (such as Build and Test factories), ensuring on-time delivery and adherence to quality standards.

• Conduct feasibility studies and process design reviews specifically for the SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master Data solution.

• Coordinate all SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master Data dependencies—including data migration, harmonization, and IT integration—while ensuring strict alignment with global template principles.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Addresses big data governance issues. Implements and maintains robust governance standards and practices to proactively resolve compliance challenges.

• Partner with business stakeholders to develop innovative solutions addressing business challenges and opportunities.

• Collaborates extensively with various departments to ensure compliance.

• Communicates effectively and clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build trust and alignment.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Atto come esperto e consulente IT per il team SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template, leader nella progettazione, implementazione e miglioramento continuo del Global Template. In questo ruolo, sarai responsabile per la definizione e la regolamentazione degli standard di dati di Material Master, garantendo la qualità dei dati, lignaggio e l'accuratezza dei metadati in tutta l'organizzazione. Potrai guidare e far rispettare le politiche di governance dei dati, supportare i programmi di gestione dei dati e collaborare strettamente con gli stakeholder aziendali e tecnici per allineare le definizioni dei dati, risolvere i problemi dei dati e garantire la conformità ai requisiti interni ed esterni. Combinando competenze SAP S/4HANA & MDG con forti capacità di gestione dei dati e di governance, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella costruzione di un ambiente di dati affidabile, scalabile e ben gestito Material Master che consente un processo decisionale di alta qualità e l'eccellenza operativa. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Ambito / (Content Leadership):
• Atto come esperto e consulente IT per il team SAP S/4HANA & MDG – Material Master Data Global Template, leader nella progettazione, implementazione e miglioramento continuo del Global Template.
• Guida, sviluppa e applica le politiche di governance dei dati. Funziona indipendentemente su specifici progetti di governance per garantire l'allineamento organizzativo e l'integrità dei dati.
• Responsabile per la progettazione, la configurazione, l'assistenza di prova, la raccolta dei requisiti e la creazione di un ambiente MDG completamente funzionale.
• Eseguire le responsabilità funzionali, inclusi i requisiti di raccolta, analisi fit-gap, progettazione delle soluzioni, configurazione del sistema e test.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, processi e contenuti aziendali per pianificare ed eseguire miglioramenti strategici alla soluzione Global Template.
• Collabora con Enterprise Architects, Solution Architects e Product Owners per creare modelli di architettura tecnica dettagliati per le iniziative di master data.
• Distribuire e coordinare i prodotti tra i team IT multifunzionali (come le fabbriche Build e Test), assicurando la consegna in tempo reale e l'adesione agli standard di qualità.
• Condurre studi di fattibilità e recensioni di progettazione di processo specificamente per la soluzione SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master Data.
• Coordinate tutte le dipendenze dei dati SAP S/4HANA / MDG – Material Master – tra cui la migrazione dei dati, l'armonizzazione e l'integrazione IT – assicurando un rigoroso allineamento con i principi del modello globale.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: affronta grandi problemi di governance dei dati. Implementa e mantiene robusti standard di governance e pratiche per risolvere proattivamente le sfide di conformità.
• Gestione degli stakeholder:
• Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per sviluppare soluzioni innovative per affrontare sfide e opportunità di business.
• Collabora ampiamente con vari dipartimenti per garantire la conformità.
• Comunica efficacemente e chiaramente con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici per costruire fiducia e allineamento.
• Impact/Strategy: gestisce i progetti di gestione dei dati di grandi dimensioni. Sviluppa ed esegue strategie che migliorano in modo significativo la qualità dei dati e la conformità organizzativa globale.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): supervisiona più complessi sistemi di governance dei dati. Garantisce l'integrità e la sicurezza dei dati critici su più unità aziendali.
• Business / Capacità tecnica: si basa su un'elevata competenza negli strumenti e nelle pratiche di gestione dei dati. Dimostra e sfrutta una solida e completa conoscenza delle leggi e delle normative sulla privacy dei dati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Core Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. Works to build and maintain a network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of the clinical laboratory. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. Responsible for maintaining existing business and work in ways that will ensure sales goals, achievements and growth.

This is a field-based role covering the Greater Boston area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory.

Job Facts

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted (hospital and reference laboratory) accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche (chemistry, immunoassay and automation) products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to (laboratory diagnostics) customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate (capital equipment) sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare (reagent and capital equipment) proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency.

• Communicates competitive (chemistry, immunoassay, middleware, and lab automatio

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Account Executive - Core Lab Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Responsabile per la riunione e il superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati su territori specificati. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. Contatti/visita clienti esistenti e potenziali. Minimo di 10 a 15 in persona chiamate di vendita a settimana richiesto in territorio assegnato, sia esistente e prospettive. In grado di fare notti come necessario. Lavora per costruire e mantenere una rete di colleghi, partner e clienti per condividere informazioni e ottenere prospettive. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita della linea di prodotto e avere una conoscenza più approfondita di altri prodotti o servizi. Un professionista esperto e esperto con una piena comprensione della zona del laboratorio clinico. Risolve una vasta gamma di problemi in modi creativi. Questo lavoro è una posizione completamente qualificata, orientata alla carriera. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e servizi aziendali. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo che copre la zona di Greater Boston. I candidati devono risiedere entro 50 miglia del territorio. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• Minimo di 10 a 15 persone chiamate di vendita a settimana
• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).
• Implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare (attrezzatura di capitale) il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• Lavora con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare (attrezzatura di credito e capitale) proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Conduce e organizza la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessari per l'efficienza.
• Comunica competitivo (chimica, immunoassay, middleware e laboratorio automatio

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Account Executive - Core Lab Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Verantwortlich für die Erfüllung und Überschreitung der Verkaufsziele in Zielkonten in bestimmten Gebieten. In der Regel verantwortlich für mittlere bis große Konten oder haben eine mittlere bis große Quote / Gebiet. Muss Kundenperspektiven entwickeln und Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern aufbauen und pflegen. Kontakte / Besuche bestehende und potenzielle Kunden. Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche in zugewiesenem Gebiet erforderlich, sowohl bestehende als auch potenzielle. Kann Übernachtungen nach Bedarf machen. Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Kollegen, Partnern und Kunden, um Informationen auszutauschen und Interessenten zu gewinnen. Darüber hinaus erfordert die Position Wertquantifizierungspräsentationen für potenzielle Kunden. Ein erfahrener, erfahrener Fachmann mit einem vollständigen Verständnis des Bereichs des klinischen Labors. Löst eine breite Palette von Problemen auf kreative Weise. Dieser Job ist eine voll qualifizierte, karriereorientierte Position. Hat eine vollständige Kenntnis der Produkte und Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens. Arbeitet an Problemen unterschiedlichen Umfangs, bei denen die Analyse von Daten eine Bewertung identifizierbarer Faktoren erfordert. Zeigt gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken, um Lösungen zu erhalten. Netzwerke mit leitenden internen und externen Mitarbeitern in ihrem eigenen Fachgebiet. Normalerweise erhält er wenig Anweisungen zur täglichen Arbeit, allgemeine Anweisungen zu neuen Aufgaben. Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung des bestehenden Geschäfts und die Arbeit auf eine Weise, die Verkaufsziele, Erfolge und Wachstum sicherstellt. • Kontaktieren Sie neue und bestehende Kunden, um die Verkaufsziele in gezielten (Krankenhaus- und Referenzlabor) Konten zu erreichen und zu übertreffen, indem Sie neues Geschäft entwickeln, bestehendes Geschäft ausbauen, Kundenbeziehungen pflegen und Kundenprobleme beheben. • Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche
• Generiert Nachfrage und maximiert das Produktbewusstsein durch die Zusammenarbeit und Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Informationen für (Labordiagnostik-) Kunden.
• Implementiert strategische Initiativen und Pläne, um den Verkaufsprozess und die Produktivität zu erleichtern.
• Arbeitet mit anderen zusammen, wenn nötig oder erforderlich, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten vorzubereiten (Reagens und Investitionsausrüstung). Präsentiert alle Vertragsvorschläge an Kunden, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was einige Verhandlungen erfordern kann.
• Leitet und organisiert notwendige Gebietsplanung und Routing für Effizienz.
• Kommuniziert wettbewerbsfähig (Chemie, Immunoassay, Middleware und Laborautomatio)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The team supports the following countries: Italy, Israel, Greece, Croatia, Slovenia, Norway, Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

The Opportunity:
As a People Support Team Lead, you will lead a high-performing HR operations team, ensuring efficient, customer-focused service delivery. Your role involves team leadership, workload management, coaching, and performance optimization , while continuously driving process improvements, compliance, and operational excellence.
As a qualified Leader, you are:

• Building, leading and managing a strong and collaborative team

• Building a culture of customer service within the team

• Creating a safe and positive team environment and ensuring that the team demonstrates the right mindset and attitude

• Being a role model, and facilitating people processes

• Building an engaging culture to both attract and retain top talent, coaching team members regarding their individual development and career plan

• Through frequent check-ins, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions; and developing the team members’ knowledge, skills, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff

• Ensuring maintenance, ongoing development and improvements to Tier 2 platforms, ways of working, process flow, driving employee’s self-service efficiency and enabling end user behavior change

• ​ Developing and managing strong partnerships with key internal organizations and stakeholders and partnering across the business to ensure an ongoing evolution of trust, co-creation and fulfillment of their needs

• Driving continuous improvements to increase productivity, quality and service locally and globally.

​
Who you are:
We’re looking for someone who is passionate about leading with impact, driving innovation, and creating exceptional employee experiences .

• Fluency in English is essential.

• Proven Leadership – 5+ years of experience within a multinational environment, including 2+ years managing a team.

• Broad experience in a shared service center, with a proven track record of leading regional or global service delivery teams, preferably in an HR services environment (2-7 years)

• HR & Tech Savvy – Strong knowledge of Workday HR processes and CRM/Request Management Software is a plus.

• Process & Performance Mindset – Experience in streamlining operations, eliminating inefficiencies, and implementing data-driven decision-making.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in wo

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il dipartimento People Support Solutions (PSS) ha lo scopo di dare vita ai nostri colleghi in tutto il mondo con soluzioni HR integrate su misura per le loro esigenze. Siamo un team che lavora molto attentamente insieme per garantire buone relazioni con i dipendenti, anticipare le esigenze future dei nostri clienti e sviluppare proattivamente soluzioni. Il team sostiene i seguenti paesi: Italia, Israele, Grecia, Croazia, Slovenia, Norvegia, Finlandia, Danimarca e Svezia. L'opportunità: In qualità di People Support Team Lead, guiderai un team di operazioni HR altamente performante, garantendo una consegna efficiente e orientata al cliente. Il vostro ruolo coinvolge la leadership del team, la gestione del carico di lavoro, l'allenatore e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, mentre guida continuamente miglioramenti del processo, la conformità e l'eccellenza operativa. Come Leader qualificato, siete:
• Costruire, guidare e gestire un team forte e collaborativo
• Costruire una cultura del servizio clienti all'interno del team
• Creare un ambiente di team sicuro e positivo e garantire che il team dimostri la giusta mentalità e atteggiamento
• Essere un modello di ruolo e facilitare i processi delle persone
• Costruire una cultura coinvolgente per attrarre e mantenere il talento superiore, allenare i membri del team per quanto riguarda il loro sviluppo individuale e il piano di carriera
• Attraverso controlli frequenti, assicurando che il dialogo continuo si verifichi sui temi di Carriera, Capacità, Connessioni e Contributi; e sviluppando le conoscenze, competenze, competenze dei membri del team, ecc al fine di mantenere e sviluppare personale di talento
• Garantire la manutenzione, lo sviluppo continuo e miglioramenti alle piattaforme Tier 2, i modi di lavorare, il flusso di processo, la guida dell'efficienza self-service del dipendente e l'attivazione del cambiamento di comportamento dell'utente finale
• Sviluppare e gestire partnership forti con le principali organizzazioni interne e stakeholder e collaborare in tutto il business per garantire una continua evoluzione della fiducia, co-creazione e soddisfazione delle loro esigenze
• Miglioramento continuo per aumentare la produttività, la qualità e il servizio a livello locale e globale. ​ Chi sei: Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è appassionato di leader con impatto, guida innovazione, e la creazione di esperienze di dipendenti eccezionali.
• La fluidità in inglese è essenziale.
• Leadership provata – 5+ anni di esperienza in un ambiente multinazionale, tra cui 2+ anni di gestione di un team.
• Ampia esperienza in un centro di assistenza condiviso, con un comprovato record di importanti team regionali o globali di assistenza, preferibilmente in un ambiente di servizi HR (2-7 anni)
• HR & Tech Savvy – Forte conoscenza dei processi HR di Workday e CRM/Request Management Software è un plus.
• Process & Performance Mindset – Esperienza nella semplificazione delle operazioni, eliminando inefficienze e implementando processi decisionali basati sui dati. In Exchange vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Noi creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà nel wo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Abteilung People Support Solutions (PSS) erweckt ihren Zweck zum Leben, indem sie unseren Kollegen weltweit integrierte HR-Lösungen zur Verfügung stellt, die auf ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind. Wir sind ein Team, das sehr eng zusammenarbeitet, um gute Mitarbeiterbeziehungen zu gewährleisten, die zukünftigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu antizipieren und proaktiv Lösungen zu entwickeln. Das Team unterstützt die folgenden Länder: Italien, Israel, Griechenland, Kroatien, Slowenien, Norwegen, Finnland, Dänemark und Schweden. Die Gelegenheit: Als People Support Team Lead leiten Sie ein leistungsstarkes HR Operations Team, das eine effiziente, kundenorientierte Servicebereitstellung gewährleistet. Ihre Rolle umfasst Teamführung, Workload-Management, Coaching und Leistungsoptimierung, während Sie kontinuierlich Prozessverbesserungen, Compliance und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben. Als qualifizierter Leader sind Sie:
• Aufbau, Führung und Verwaltung eines starken und kooperativen Teams
• Aufbau einer Kultur des Kundenservice innerhalb des Teams
• Schaffung einer sicheren und positiven Teamumgebung und Sicherstellung, dass das Team die richtige Einstellung und Einstellung zeigt
• Vorbild sein und Menschenprozesse erleichtern
• Aufbau einer engagierten Kultur, um Top-Talente zu gewinnen und zu halten, Coaching-Teammitglieder in Bezug auf ihren individuellen Entwicklungs- und Karriereplan
• Durch häufige Check-ins, um sicherzustellen, dass ein fortlaufender Dialog zu den Themen Karriere, Fähigkeiten, Verbindungen und Beiträge stattfindet; und das Wissen, die Fähigkeiten, die Kompetenz der Teammitglieder usw. zu entwickeln, um talentierte Mitarbeiter zu halten und zu entwickeln
• Gewährleistung von Wartung, fortlaufender Entwicklung und Verbesserungen an Tier-2-Plattformen, Arbeitsweisen, Prozessfluss, Steigerung der Self-Service-Effizienz der Mitarbeiter und Ermöglichung von Veränderungen des Endbenutzerverhaltens
• Entwicklung und Verwaltung starker Partnerschaften mit wichtigen internen Organisationen und Stakeholdern sowie Partnerschaften im gesamten Unternehmen, um eine kontinuierliche Entwicklung des Vertrauens, der Mitgestaltung und Erfüllung ihrer Bedürfnisse sicherzustellen
• Laufende Verbesserungen zur Steigerung von Produktivität, Qualität und Service auf lokaler und globaler Ebene. ​ Wer du bist: Wir suchen jemanden, der leidenschaftlich daran interessiert ist, mit Wirkung zu führen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererfahrungen zu schaffen.
• Englisch fließend ist wichtig.
• Bewährte Führung - 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem multinationalen Umfeld, darunter 2+ Jahre Management eines Teams.
• Breite Erfahrung in einem Shared Service Center mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz führender regionaler oder globaler Servicebereitstellungsteams, vorzugsweise in einer HR-Serviceumgebung (2-7 Jahre)
• HR & Tech Savvy – Starkes Wissen über Workday HR-Prozesse und CRM/Request Management Software ist ein Plus.
• Process & Performance Mindset – Erfahrung in der Optimierung von Abläufen, der Beseitigung von Ineffizienzen und der Implementierung datengesteuerter Entscheidungen. Im Austausch bieten wir Ihnen:
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.
• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.
• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage / Woche im Durchschnitt). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit der Freiheit in wo
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le département Solutions de soutien aux personnes (PSS) donne vie à son objectif en fournissant à nos collègues du monde entier des solutions RH intégrées adaptées à leurs besoins. Nous sommes une équipe qui travaille en étroite collaboration pour assurer de bonnes relations avec les employés, anticiper les besoins futurs de nos clients et développer des solutions proactives. L'équipe soutient les pays suivants : Italie, Israël, Grèce, Croatie, Slovénie, Norvège, Finlande, Danemark et Suède. La possibilité : En tant que chef d'équipe de soutien aux personnes, vous dirigerez une équipe d'opérations RH hautement performante, assurant une prestation de services efficace et axée sur la clientèle. Votre rôle implique le leadership d'équipe, la gestion de la charge de travail, le coaching et l'optimisation des performances, tout en conduisant en permanence les améliorations des processus, la conformité et l'excellence opérationnelle. En tant que leader qualifié, vous êtes :
• Construire, diriger et gérer une équipe forte et collaborative
• Bâtir une culture du service à la clientèle au sein de l'équipe
• Créer un environnement d'équipe sûr et positif et veiller à ce que l'équipe démontre la bonne mentalité et l'attitude
• Être un modèle et faciliter les processus humains
• Bâtir une culture engageante pour attirer et retenir les meilleurs talents, coacher les membres de l'équipe en ce qui concerne leur perfectionnement individuel et leur plan de carrière
• Au moyen d'enregistrements fréquents, s'assurer que le dialogue se poursuit sur les sujets de la carrière, des capacités, des liens et des contributions; et développer les connaissances, les compétences, les compétences, etc. des membres de l'équipe afin de conserver et de développer du personnel talentueux
• Assurer la maintenance, le développement continu et l'amélioration des plates-formes de niveau 2, les façons de travailler, le déroulement des processus, l'efficacité du libre-service des employés et le changement de comportement des utilisateurs finaux
• Développer et gérer de solides partenariats avec les principales organisations internes et les intervenants et partenariats dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise afin d'assurer une évolution continue de la confiance, de la co-création et de la satisfaction de leurs besoins
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue de la productivité, de la qualité et des services aux niveaux local et mondial. ​ Qui vous êtes : Nous recherchons une personne passionnée par l'impact, l'innovation et la création d'expériences d'employés exceptionnelles.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle.
• Leadership éprouvé – 5+ ans d'expérience dans un environnement multinational, dont 2+ ans de gestion d'équipe.
• Grande expérience dans un centre de services partagés, avec une expérience éprouvée des principales équipes régionales ou mondiales de prestation de services, de préférence dans un environnement de services RH (2-7 ans)
• HR & Tech Savvy – Forte connaissance des processus RH de la journée de travail et CRM / Logiciel de gestion des demandes est un plus.
• Processus et performance Mindset – Expérience dans la rationalisation des opérations, l'élimination des inefficacités et la mise en œuvre de la prise de décision axée sur les données. En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'opportunité de la liberté en wo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join us and make a difference for patients.

As part of Pharma International’s Commercialization Operating Model Effectiveness Team (COMET), this role will drive operational and commercial excellence by shaping and evolving Roche’s operating model to meet future challenges and opportunities. The Strategic Operating Model Partner will serve as a seasoned expert, blending deep industry knowledge with advanced consulting skills to deliver measurable business outcomes and accelerate progress in delivering medical solutions to patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Business Acumen

• Industry Expertise: Apply an expert-level understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, including growth drivers, priority assets, regulatory landscapes, and competitive dynamics.

• Trusted Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing nuanced insights and strategic perspectives that align with Roche’s commercial priorities.
Customer Engagement Continuous Improvement

• Model Optimization: Evaluate and optimize existing customer engagement models to maximize operational efficiency and customer impact.

• Pragmatic Innovation: Foster an environment of continuous learning and innovation by scaling proven commercial tactics, facilitating cross-border learning, and accelerating future omnichannel capabilities across the ecosystem.
Operating Model Mastery & Systemic Design

• Strategic Change Execution: Architect strategies to optimize operating model effectiveness and execute complex organizational changes, balancing long-term vision with immediate business needs.

• Systemic Connectivity: Act as a systemic thinker to identify patterns and interdependencies across global teams, markets, and regions, ensuring strategic initiatives scale to deliver measurable, agile business outcomes.

• Global-to-Local Bridge: Serve as a pragmatic bridge between global strategy and frontline implementation, ensuring operating model adjustments reduce local operational friction and leverage existing regional successes.
Executive Influence & Leadership Engagement

• Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as a respected thought partner and coach to senior leaders, bringing rigor to strategic discussions and constructively challenging decisions with evidence-based recommendations.

• High-Stakes Facilitation: Facilitate critical discussions with precision and impact, seamlessly navigating diverse perspectives to foster alignment and enhance commercial effectiveness.
Consulting Excellence & Stakeholder Governance

• Problem Solving & Execution: Apply advanced consulting methodologies and project management capabilities to structure and solve complex, multi-faceted problems with rigor and precision.

• Framework & Alignment Design: Design robust decision-making frameworks and build trusted relationships across diverse stakeholders to streamline governance and sustain momentum for change.

• Impactful Communication: Craft compelling narratives and deliver high-impact communication frameworks tailored to influence senior decision-makers.

• Operational Rhythm Stewardship: Establish, steward, and maintain critical operational rhythms and meeting protocols for leadership forums, ensuring teams remain focused on out

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare Solutions Lead - South (based in Lisbon district)
Roche Diagnostics, Portugal

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
As an Healthcare Solutions Lead (HSL) you will be integrated into the Commercial Chapter, developing your activity in close collaboration with other chapters. With the main purpose to develop the business and position Roche as a strategic partner of choice, co-creating and contributing actively to market development, you will act as a first point of contact of the C-suite (decision makers, budget holders), service directors, procurement and laboratory management of public hospitals and private groups and other strategic stakeholders. Your main responsibilities are, but not limited to:

• Establish strategic partnerships with the above referred stakeholders in public and private customers, by promoting relationships of trust, understanding clients' needs and articulating Roche's solutions in a co-creation perspective, including the adoption of digital solutions, contributing to create new business opportunities.

• Drive innovative projects by building a strong network with a broad set of stakeholders, maintaining deep knowledge of our portfolio, deep understanding of customer needs, vision and positioning, and of the market dynamics and trends.

• Actively contribute to strengthening Roche´s position in established strategic accounts, collaborating with other commercial team members and with other relevant internal stakeholders to pursue the full potential of the accounts, new business opportunities and transforming them into strategic initiatives.

• Partner with DSEs (Diagnostic Solutions Experts) to create the strategic account plans and be accountable for results achievements (P&L) in the assigned accounts, and to keep information updated in CRM and other management tools.

• Develop and lead complex negotiation processes in the assigned strategic accounts ensuring sustainable profitability

Who you are:
To be successful as a Healthcare Solutions Lead, the following qualifications and capabilities are required:

• You have a Master’s degree in Management, Marketing, Economics, Life Sciences or Engineering. An additional business management degree will be considered a plus.

• You are experienced in the healthcare business or related sectors, with business development and/or other commercial responsibilities.

• You have developed throughout your professional journey a strong network with relevant stakeholders within the healthcare sector, demonstrating ability to develop long term, trustworthy relationships.

• Sei esperto nel settore sanitario o nei settori correlati, con lo sviluppo aziendale e/o altre responsabilità commerciali.
• Hai sviluppato in tutto il tuo percorso professionale una forte rete con le parti interessate rilevanti nel settore sanitario, dimostrando la capacità di sviluppare relazioni a lungo termine e affidabili.
• Comprendi le specificità del settore sanitario (preferienziale IVD, ma non obbligatorio) e come i soggetti interessati si connettono l'uno all'altro: dal rimborso, al finanziamento del settore pubblico e privato, appalti pubblici, catena del valore, ecc.
• Con una mentalità aziendale, dimostri competenze di consulenza strategica e capacità di padroneggiare un portafoglio complesso in un mercato altamente competitivo e regolamentato, in particolare in settori di innovazione dirompente (come il flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, soluzioni digitali e prodotti ad alto valore medico).
• Con la capacità di sviluppare, guidare e coordinare la gestione di progetti complessi, siete aperti all'innovazione e siete desiderosi di sfidare

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This position is based in the Enterprise Operations division within the Commercialization Operating Model (COM) team.

The Operating Model Enabler position is accountable for enabling the organizational operating model tools, processes, learning operations, continuous improvement, AI/automation, and organizational rhythms that support effective planning, coordination, and execution across the business to accelerate commercialization excellence.

The Opportunity:

Operating Model Enablement

• Lead administration, deployment, training, and user support for operating model tools and platforms

• Lead AI/Automation, and Knowledge Management initiatives in partnership with Roche Digital Technology and other local/global functions.

• Lead the EverydayAI Champion network and coordinate associated AI adoption, enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

• Monitor adoption and utilization of operating model tools and identify opportunities to improve user experience, efficiency, and effectiveness.

• Support reporting, KPI monitoring and continuous improvement of operating model processes, standards, and ways of working.

Planning & Execution Excellence

• Provide project management, coordination, and logistical support for Affiliate Outcome Planning, enterprise Work Packages (WPs), Commercialization Capability Learning Programs and other key COM initiatives.

• Maintain and enable adoption of key tools for planning, prioritization, visibility, and execution across the organization.

• Design and facilitate enterprise process improvement and workflow optimization workshops to strengthen operating model effectiveness, align ways of working and remove barriers to execution.

• Support the development and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and organizational updates connected to operating model priorities.

Learning & Capability Operations

• Assign mandatory Legal/Compliance, SHE and Functional training to Canada Pharma commercial functions and other relevant training to the Mississauga site.

• Partner with Global Learning Services (GLS) Learning Experts to manage requests to re-version learning objects, and upload or remove outdated learning assets from the Learning Management System (LMS).

• Main point of contact for technical issues and troubleshooting questions.

• Leverage e-learning authoring tools to create interactive online class modules and Product Monograph Assessments.

• Proactively identify and implement opportunities to streamline processes, automate routine activities, and leverage GLS to improve local operational efficiency and optimize resource utilization.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Learning & Development, or a related field.

• You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business operations, operating model enablement, project management, or learning operations initiatives.

• You possess strong planning, analytical, continuous improvement, stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• You have experience administering and deploying enterprise tools, platforms, collaboration tools, and reportin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment

Who you are

• Associate degree in relevant field or 5+ years in information security and fluent English.

• Programming experience (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) and ability to write custom detection logic, scripts, and templates

• Demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate vulnerabilities; experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development in large global environments

• Focus on web application, network, and computer security; cloud security experience; familiarity with attack surface management and AI-assisted development tools

• Strong communication skills explaining complex risks to non-technical audiences; comfort balancing operational tasks with research; passion for security

• Industry certifications in offensive security (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); open-source security project contributions

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment

Who you are

• Associate degree in relevant field or 5+ years in information security and fluent English.

• Programming experience (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) and ability to write custom detection logic, scripts, and templates

• Demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate vulnerabilities; experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development in large global environments

• Focus on web application, network, and computer security; cloud security experience; familiarity with attack surface management and AI-assisted development tools

• Strong communication skills explaining complex risks to non-technical audiences; comfort balancing operational tasks with research; passion for security

• Industry certifications in offensive security (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); open-source security project contributions

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 50% overnight travel.
Our ideal candidate would reside in Omaha, Nebraska or Des Moines, Iowa.
Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering

• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Nebraska is $71,100- $132,000 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to heal

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Strategic Account Executive

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives (capital instruments & reagents) in targeted Anatomic Pathology labs within the assigned geography. This role is focused on the region’s largest customers, large strategic scenarios, reference labs and competitive opportunities. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

• You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• You will create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• You will generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• You will select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a molecular biology problem with clever engineering.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineering, chemistry, molecular biology and sequencing fundamentals.

• You have demonstrated experience with advanced microfabrication techniques (lithography, thin-film deposition, wet/dry etching, and thermal fusion bonding processes).

• You have demonstrated success porting complex biochemical assays or workflows onto novel fluidic systems and optimizing performance using a systematic approach.

• You have a solid publication record, including at least one first-authored and peer-reviewed publication in a top-tier journal.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

• You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• You will create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• You will generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• You will select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a molecular biology problem with clever engineering.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineering, chemistry, molecular biology and sequencing fundamentals.

• You have demonstrated experience with advanced microfabrication techniques (lithography, thin-film deposition, wet/dry etching, and thermal fusion bonding processes).

• You have demonstrated success porting complex biochemical assays or workflows onto novel fluidic systems and optimizing performance using a systematic approach.

• You have a solid publication record, including at least one first-authored and peer-reviewed publication in a top-tier journal.

• You have demonstrated experience with Python scripting for instru

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von Sequenziersystemen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir auch den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Hindernisse für die Annahme. Von robusten Werkzeugen zur Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für Sequenzierungs-Workflows der nächsten Generation. Wir suchen einen talentierten und hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung neuartiger Technologien für biologische Anwendungen. Bei unserer Systems Technology Group werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der Forschung und frühen Entwicklung neuer Technologien, Geräte und Instrumente spielen, die mit unseren DNA-Sequenzierungs- und Molekulardiagnostikplattformen der nächsten Generation verbunden sind. Herzstück dieser Instrumente sind hochintegrierte mikrofluidische Systeme, die komplizierte Arbeitsabläufe automatisieren und komplexe Biochemie handhaben können. Um sich auf diese ehrgeizigen Ziele vorzubereiten, wird Ihr kurzfristiger Fokus eine tiefe, praktische Schulung mit unseren grundlegenden Bemühungen beinhalten. Sie unterstützen bei aktuellen Projekten, um unsere Chemie, Materialien und Methoden zu beherrschen, indem Sie kritisches Fachwissen darüber erwerben, wie wir komplexe Systeme und Prozesse entwerfen, herstellen, verbinden, simulieren, betreiben, charakterisieren und beheben. Dies ist eine praktische, interdisziplinäre Rolle, die die Lücke zwischen biochemischen Anwendungen und modernster Instrumentierung schließen soll. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem kleinen, agilen Team und der breiteren Organisation lösen Sie anspruchsvolle Probleme, erfinden neue Technologien und bringen letztendlich den neuesten Stand der Technik in DNA-Sequenzierungssystemen voran. • Sie entwerfen, fertigen und montieren benutzerdefinierte Geräte, Armaturen und Brotbretter mit verschiedenen Rapid Prototyping-Tools, einschließlich benutzerdefinierter Geräte.
