jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who we are

At Roche, 80,000 people across 150 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity, and on seeing each other’s differences as an advantage. To innovate healthcare, Roche has ambitious plans to keep learning and growing – and is seeking people who have the same goals for themselves.

The headquarters in Basel is one of Roche’s largest sites. It is home to the Corporate Executive Committee, the Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics Divisions and the global business functions. Roche Basel also covers the entire business chain from research, development and production through to marketing. Over 8,000 people from more than 60 countries work at the site.

The Position

IT Business Analyst - Business Analysis For Master Data Management - RDT Pharma R&D Informatics you will be responsible for making decisions with impact at the process, organization, or program as well as at an operational level.

Your will help drive successful completion of major projects/programs across portfolios as analytical or design lead. Your impact may be within or across multiple portfolios and you will champion accountability by example.

The IT BA is an active role in the product’s lifecycle management. The primary role is to drive the application of strategies and concepts and determine the best course of action in PharmaCoviligence Master Data technology solutions. You serve as primary consultant to senior business Leads and internal/external subject matter experts for the organization on significant matters pertaining to strategic business and technology solutions.

Some of your regular activities also include scoping, planning and supporting the successful implementation of solutions. In addition you will be required to work closely with Business Users, Product Owners, Product Managers, IT Business Partners and IT Architects to develop a conceptual architecture for the solutions.

What you’ll be expected to work on:

• Contribute to and influence the structure and completion of major programs. Develop advanced technological ideas and guide their development into a final solution. Establish new principles and concepts to independently address strategic business problems with technology solutions that are novel in their innovation and drive organizational change in the business to adopt new approaches to strategy and delivery.

• Communicates strategic information, issues and solution options across the enterprise or multiple large business portfolios. Enable great participation by all individuals on the team by creating a safe environment that empowers participants and challenges them at the same time. Foster healthy disagreements and discussions and ensure convergence and agreement.

• Lead large enterprise or multi portfolio initiatives. Able to influence inter-departmental decisions. Viewed as an area expert beyond our group . Act as team lead of a functional group. Able to represent managers at meetings and make basic decisions. Can influence decisions within an area. GI area expert

• May provide guidance and manage work of others for specific programs or objectives. Leads prioritization and planning for large strategic initiatives.

• High quality Master Data is a part of a strong AI foundation, and this role will contribute to developing and maintaining the data foundations for Safety AI enablement. Apply advanced

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, 80.000 persone in 150 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della salute. Lavorando insieme, siamo diventati uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca al mondo. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità, e sul vedere le differenze tra loro come un vantaggio. Per innovare la salute, Roche ha progetti ambiziosi per continuare a imparare e crescere – e sta cercando persone che hanno gli stessi obiettivi per se stessi. La sede di Basilea è uno dei più grandi siti di Roche. È sede del Comitato Esecutivo Aziendale, delle Divisioni Farmaceutiche e Diagnostiche e delle funzioni aziendali globali. Roche Basel copre anche l'intera catena aziendale dalla ricerca, sviluppo e produzione fino al marketing. Oltre 8.000 persone provenienti da più di 60 paesi lavorano sul sito. La posizione IT Business Analyst - Analisi aziendale per la gestione dei dati master - RDT Pharma R&D Informatica sarete responsabili di prendere decisioni con impatto al processo, organizzazione, o programma, così come a livello operativo. Il vostro aiuterà a guidare il completamento di grandi progetti / programmi su portafogli come piombo analitico o di progettazione. Il vostro impatto può essere all'interno o attraverso più portafogli e sarete campione di responsabilità per esempio. La IT BA è un ruolo attivo nella gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto. Il ruolo principale è quello di guidare l'applicazione di strategie e concetti e determinare il miglior corso di azione nelle soluzioni di tecnologia PharmaCoviligence Master Data. Sei consulente primario per aziende senior Leads e esperti di materia interna / esterna per l'organizzazione su questioni significative relative a soluzioni strategiche di business e tecnologia. Alcune delle vostre attività regolari includono anche scoping, pianificazione e supporto alla riuscita implementazione di soluzioni. Inoltre sarà necessario lavorare a stretto contatto con gli utenti aziendali, i proprietari di prodotti, i responsabili dei prodotti, i partner IT e gli architetti IT per sviluppare un'architettura concettuale per le soluzioni. Su cosa ti aspettavi di lavorare:
• Contribuire e influenzare la struttura e il completamento dei programmi principali. Sviluppare idee tecnologiche avanzate e guidare il loro sviluppo in una soluzione finale. Stabilire nuovi principi e concetti per affrontare in modo indipendente problemi di business strategici con soluzioni tecnologiche che sono nuovi nella loro innovazione e guidare il cambiamento organizzativo nel business per adottare nuovi approcci alla strategia e alla consegna.
• Comunica informazioni strategiche, problemi e opzioni di soluzione in tutta l'impresa o più grandi portafogli aziendali. Abilita grande partecipazione di tutti gli individui del team creando un ambiente sicuro che consente ai partecipanti e li sfida allo stesso tempo. Promuovere disaccordi e discussioni sane e garantire la convergenza e l'accordo.
• Condurre grandi iniziative aziendali o multi portafoglio. In grado di influenzare le decisioni interdipartimentali. Visto come un esperto di area oltre il nostro gruppo. Agire come team lead di un gruppo funzionale. In grado di rappresentare i manager nelle riunioni e prendere decisioni di base. Può influenzare le decisioni all'interno di un'area. Esperto di area GI
• Può fornire guida e gestire il lavoro di altri per programmi o obiettivi specifici. Conduce priorità e pianificazione per grandi iniziative strategiche.
• Master Data di alta qualità è una parte di una forte fondazione AI, e questo ruolo contribuirà a sviluppare e mantenere le basi di dati per l'attivazione AI di sicurezza. Applicare avanzato

Pflegen Sie gesunde Meinungsverschiedenheiten und Diskussionen und sorgen Sie für Konvergenz und Übereinstimmung.
• Führen Sie große Unternehmen oder Multi-Portfolio-Initiativen. Kann abteilungsübergreifende Entscheidungen beeinflussen. Gesehen als Experte außerhalb unserer Gruppe. Handeln Sie als Teamleiter einer funktionalen Gruppe. Kann Manager bei Meetings vertreten und grundlegende Entscheidungen treffen. Kann Entscheidungen innerhalb eines Bereichs beeinflussen. Experte für geografische Angaben
• Kann Anleitung geben und die Arbeit anderer für bestimmte Programme oder Ziele verwalten. Leitet die Priorisierung und Planung großer strategischer Initiativen.
• Hochwertige Stammdaten sind Teil einer starken KI-Grundlage, und diese Rolle wird zur Entwicklung und Pflege der Datengrundlagen für Safety AI Enablement beitragen. Anwendbar fortgeschritten

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei interessato a sviluppare nuovi reagenti e flussi di lavoro per il sequenziamento di prossima generazione? Stiamo cercando un compagno postdoctoral altamente talentuoso e motivato (m/f/d) per unirsi alla nostra squadra questa missione. Il dipartimento di Chemistry Technologies fornisce la gamma completa di reagenti diagnostici chimici, che vanno da piccole molecole a biooligomeri e polimeri. Sfruttando moderni metodi sintetici e analitici progettiamo e sviluppiamo molecole su misura per trovare le soluzioni giuste per le domande diagnostiche e oltre. Lavoriamo come team, siamo guidati dalla passione per la scienza e dall'impegno per l'apprendimento continuo a rimanere in prima linea nella ricerca. La nostra cultura è definita dalla fiducia, dalla trasparenza e da un forte spirito collaborativo. Stiamo cercando un collega proattivo che bilancia il pensiero critico indipendente con lo spirito di squadra e la flessibilità di collaborare tra diversi dipartimenti e team interdisciplinari. I tuoi compiti
• Progettazione e sintetizzazione di oligonucleotide-congiunti complessi da tecniche di bioconiugazione contemporanee e piccole entità molecolari per sintesi chimica
• Stabilire le reazioni di prossimità modellate dal DNA per il test iniziale delle nuove classi di reagente
• Collaborare proattivamente con i partner di progetto di biologia, analisi e i team di sviluppo del test di sequenziamento per acquisire una profonda conoscenza del rapporto tra progettazione strutturale e performance di analisi
• Pianificare in modo indipendente, eseguire e analizzare gli esperimenti per avanzare efficacemente i progetti
• L'attuale progresso scientifico attraverso incontri interni e visite a conferenze scientifiche per garantire la conoscenza all'avanguardia nel campo della sintesi bioorganica, della biologia chimica e della chimica superficiale
• Partecipa a un team altamente motivato e interfunzionale Il tuo profilo
• Si tiene un dottorato nel campo della chimica organica (bio), biologia chimica o scienza della vita.
• Possiedi profonda conoscenza nella sintesi di oligonucleotide-congiurati, preferibilmente in contesto di biomolecole (proteine, peptidi, acidi nucleici)
• Siete ben sperimentati nella sintesi organica
• Esperienza pratica nel campo delle reazioni di DNA-templati, reazioni di prossimità e rilevazione di acido nucleico completa il tuo profilo.
• La tua qualifica dovrebbe essere chiaramente dimostrata da almeno un primo autore pubblicato o accettato in una rivista ad alto impatto.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali sono la vostra forza. Sei sensibile alle questioni interculturali e interdisciplinari - lavorare in un team diventa naturale per te.
• Sei un individuo proattivo con passione e impegno a innovare la salute attraverso il nostro Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.
• Sono richieste eccellenti competenze in inglese, il tedesco non è obbligatorio. Quando inizia? Questa posizione sarà riempita con effetto settembre 2026 ed è limitata a 2 anni. Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? # Se siamo convinti, un'intervista virtuale avrà luogo # Se riuscite anche a convincerci qui, l'ultimo passo è un'intervista e una presentazione nel Penzberg area La tua richiesta Invia la tua richiesta inviando un CV aggiornato (incluso l'elenco delle pubblicazioni e riferimenti) insieme ai tuoi ultimi certificati. Per inviare la domanda, si prega di notare che non si possono aggiungere ulteriori documenti in seguito. Siamo lieti della vostra applicazione! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo Un futuro più sano guida u

jobs.description:

The Position

Das Employee Counseling Team der F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG engagiert sich leidenschaftlich für das Wohlbefinden und die Gesundheit unserer Mitarbeitenden am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst. In dieser verantwortungsvollen Rolle als Employee Counselor / Case Manager (60-80%) (d/f/m) unterstützen Sie aktiv die Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Teams in einem von Vertrauen geprägten Umfeld. Werden Sie Teil unseres selbstorganisierten Care Teams und gestalten Sie ein gesundes, inklusives Arbeitsklima aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

• Beraten und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende vertraulich und einfühlsam in komplexen beruflichen sowie privaten Lebenssituationen.

• Unterstützen Sie Linienvorgesetzte sowie People & Culture-Fachkräfte (HR) lösungsorientiert bei anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen.

• Steuern Sie aktiv den gesamten Case Management-Prozess zur erfolgreichen Wiedereingliederung nach längeren Abwesenheiten.

• Übernehmen Sie die eigenständige Administration und vernetzen Sie alle internen sowie externen Beteiligten effizient.

• Pflegen Sie einen aktiven und professionellen Austausch mit den relevanten Schweizer Sozialversicherungen.

• Arbeiten Sie proaktiv und auf Augenhöhe in einem modernen, selbstorganisierten Teamumfeld mit.

• Bringen Sie sich aktiv in standortspezifische Care-Team-Einsätze und interne Projekte ein.

Wer du bist

• Ausbildung & Weiterbildung: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Psychologie oder Sozialer Arbeit sowie eine Weiterbildung in lösungsorientierter Beratung oder Case Management.

• Berufserfahrung: Sie bringen mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung im Beratungs- oder Case Management-Bereich mit, idealerweise im Schweizer Kontext.

• Sprachkompetenz: Sie kommunizieren stilsicher auf Deutsch (Niveau Muttersprache) und besitzen exzellente Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Persönlichkeit: Sie zeichnen sich durch hohe Flexibilität, eine reflektierte Feedbackkultur sowie Verhandlungsgeschick im Umgang mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen aus.

• Arbeitsweise: Sie schätzen administrative Genauigkeit (Google Suite/MS Office) und bringen eine gesunde Portion Humor sowie Freude an Teamarbeit mit.

Diese Stelle ist auf 9 Monate befristet.

Wir freuen uns über deine Unterlagen inklusive Motivationsschreiben.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Aufgabe zu entdecken!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Als Learning-Abteilung verantworten wir die Einarbeitung und das Training neuer und bestehender Mitarbeitender in unserem Pharma-Bereich mit über 2000 Beschäftigten (Produktion, Quality, Entwicklung, Cell & Gene). Damit Lernen ein echtes Erlebnis wird und den Teilnehmenden sowie Trainern noch mehr Spaß macht, suchen wir Dich für 6 Monate in Vollzeit (37,5 h/Woche) als Unterstützung in unserem Team!

Unser Ziel

Wir möchten weg von „Read and Understood“ hin zu kompetenzbasierten, praxisorientierten Trainingsformaten (On-the-Job) – idealerweise gestützt von modernen digitalen und automatisierten Lösungen. Auf dieser Reise unterstützt du uns und leistest deinen Beitrag zu unserer Vision: „Jeder findet, was er sucht, versteht, was er findet, und lernt, was er braucht. “

Deine Aufgaben

Innerhalb der folgenden Tätigkeiten können sich deine Aufgaben und Einsatzmöglichkeiten bei uns wiederfinden:

• Didaktische Konzeption: Du unterstützt unsere Learning Partner bei der Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Trainings-Konzepten basierend auf unserer Strategie sowie dem Feedback aus der Organisation.

• State-of-the-Art Erwachsenenbildung: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten entwickelst du Trainings nach modernen Ansätzen der Bildungswissenschaft und Psychologie weiter. Du unterstützt bei der Methodenauswahl, der didaktischen Strukturierung sowie der konzeptionellen und visuellen Gestaltung.

• Digitale Innovation & Automatisierung: Du treibst die Digitalisierung unserer Lerninhalte voran. Dazu gehört die eigenständige Entwicklung von Softwareanwendungen, Apps oder Tools auf Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. UiPath) sowie die Arbeit mit Content-Lifecycle-Management-Systemen.

• Prozessanalyse & Visualisierung: Gemeinsam im Team identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale, führst Datenanalysen durch und visualisierst Prozesse in entsprechenden Tools, um die Stabilität und Effizienz im Learning-Bereich zu erhöhen.

• Workshop- und Content-Erstellung: Du bereitest interaktive Workshops und Präsentationsunterlagen vor, führst diese mit durch und breitest die Ergebnisse professionell auf.

Wer du bist

• Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte:r Student:in der Fachrichtungen Pädagogik, Bildungswissenschaften, Sozialpädagogik, Psychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik (oder vergleichbar) bzw. befindest dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Didaktisches Fundament: Du bringst theoretisches Wissen oder erste praktische Erfahrungen aus der Didaktik, Lernpsychologie oder Erwachsenenbildung mit und weißt, wie man Wissen nachhaltig und inspirierend vermittelt.

• Digitale Affinität: Du besitzt eine hohe IT- und Tech-Affinität. Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office/Google Workspace sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit E-Learning- und Kollaborations-Tools (Articulate, Synthesia, Miro, Trello, Lucid, Tableau) oder Low-Code-Plattformen (UiPath) zeichnen dich aus.

• Sprachkompetenz: Da wir in einem internationalen Pharma-Umfeld agieren, fließen dir gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift leicht von der Hand; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

• Persönlichkeit: Du bist kommunikativ, organisierst gerne und liebst es, im Team zu arbeiten und andere für deine kreativen Ideen zu begeistern.

• Präsenz: Es ist dir möglich, rund 80 % deiner Arbeitszeit vor Ort im Büro am Standort Penzberg zu verbringen.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• attraktive Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-

titleByLocale.it: Specialista (m/w/d) Application Prozessleitsystem Manufacturing AUF 2 JAHRE BEFRISTET
titleByLocale.en: Specialist (m/f/d) Application Process Control System Manufacturing LIMITED ON 2 YEARS
titleByLocale.de: Spezialist (m/w/d) Application Prozessleitsystem Manufacturing AUF 2 JAHRE BEFRISTET
titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste (m/w/d) Application Prozessleitsystem Manufacturing AUF 2 JAHRE BEFRISTET

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Specialist (m/w/d) Application Prozessleitsystem Manufacturing AUF 2 JAHRE BEFRISTET

Die Rolle / Dein Team

Als Specialist PLS hältst du die automatisierten Produktionsprozesse am Laufen und leistest damit einen direkten Beitrag dazu, dass unsere diagnostischen und pharmazeutischen Produkte sicher und pünktlich bei den Patient:innen ankommen. Du bist das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen komplexer Automatisierung und der Produktion, sodass wir unseren Zweck, Patient:innen ein besseres Leben zu ermöglichen , Tag für Tag erfüllen können.

Du bist Teil der Organisation MMNLGC (MSAT-PA) und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das Technologie und Verfahrenstechnik zusammenbringt. In dieser Schlüsselrolle agierst du als Schnittstelle zwischen MSAT Process Automation und den Produktionsbetrieben. Hier zählt nicht nur technisches Know-how, sondern auch Teamgeist und eine lösungsorientierte Haltung. Dein Team freut sich auf eine kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, bei der ihr euch gegenseitig unterstützt und die Herausforderung annimmt, komplexe Systeme zu beherrschen und zu optimieren.

Das erwartet Dich

Als Specialist PLS (m/w/d) bist du das technische Rückgrat der Produktion. Deine Hauptaufgaben sind vielfältig und erfordern ein tiefes Verständnis für die eingesetzten Steuerungssysteme:

• Du bist der Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden in Manufacturing (MFG) vor Ort in den Betrieben und via Hotline für alle produktiven "MSAT-Systeme".

• Du bist die zentrale, fachliche Schnittstelle (Support) und stellst den reibungslosen Betriebsablauf sicher.

• Du konfigurierst die Automationssysteme (z.B. PCS7, Step7, WinCC, Simatic Batch).

• Du programmierst PLS-Phasen und unterstützt bei deren Implementierung in Produktionsrezepten. Dabei hältst du als PLS-Programmierer:in Dein Wissen aktuell.

• Du begleitest Transferaktivitäten und Produktwechsel.

• Als technischer Fachexperte (SME) bist du bei Problemlösungen und Optimierungsmaßnahmen sowie bei Audits und Inspektionen gefragt.

• Du wirkst bei der Qualifizierung und Validierung von computerisierten Systemen mit und nimmst an Systemtestungen teil.

• Du beachtest stets die hohen Auflagen für die Arbeit im GMP-Umfeld und übernimmst Verantwortung bei der Durchführung und Koordination von GMP-Prozessen, z.B. im Change- oder Deviation-Management.

Das bringst Du mit

Deine Expertise ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle. Du bist eine lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die sowohl tiefes Fachwissen als auch die Bereitschaft zur kollegialen Unterstützung mitbringt:

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Techniker:in (Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Chemie, Biotechnologie, o.ä.) oder ein FH-Studium (Automatisierungstechnik, Biotechnologie, Verfahrenstechnik, Informatik o.ä.) abgeschlossen. Idealerweise bringst Du mindestens 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im IT-/Automatisierungsbereich der Industrie mit.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape how safety data enters our organisation and drive strategic relationships that directly impact patient safety? As the Group Head for Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering (DA&P), you will lead a high-performing team focused on establishing strategic collaborations, ensuring compliance, and governing the vital "Front-End" pillar of Patient Safety Operations.

In this pivotal role, you will merge the oversight of external asset integrations and contractual safety arrangements with the advanced management of our upstream safety data supply chain. Championing agile working principles, you will collaborate with internal and external partners across all data sources and all therapeutic modalities to deliver fit-for-purpose data solutions and influence the adoption of next-generation automation and AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Operational Strategy: Develop and deliver clear operational strategies that align with global safety goals and broader ambitions.

• Lead & Inspire: Cultivate an agile team environment that fosters self-organisation, innovation, experimentation, and autonomous decision-making.

• Manage Safety Agreements: Drive the development, negotiation, and implementation of fit-for-purpose safety agreements while facilitating the efficient integration and sharing of external data.

• Support Due Diligence: Partner with internal and external customers during company and molecule acquisitions to pre-emptively address and assess contractual requirements.

• Provide Strategic Guidance: Deliver expert knowledge on safety agreement strategies across diverse setups, including licensing agreements, clinical trial collaborations, and PV service providers.

• Innovate Data Acquisition: Partner globally to influence how technologies like artificial intelligence, cognitive computing, and automation can enhance safety data acquisition.

• Govern the Data Supply Chain: Collaborate across Affiliates, Pharma, and Diagnostics to secure timely, high-quality safety data while ensuring strict compliance with global regulations.

• Ensure Quality & Compliance: Maintain full oversight of Quality Management System (QMS) processes to ensure constant inspection readiness across operations.

• Ensure Maintenance of the deep process expertise within the team, particularly among Business Process Owners (BPOs), ensuring this critical knowledge is connected and consistently applied across the organisation

Who You Are

You are a visionary, systems-thinking leader who thrives on connecting people, ideas, and technologies across complex matrix environments. You bring a collaborative, growth-oriented mindset and are passionate about mentoring diverse teams to unlock their full potential.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Industry Experience: Significant experience within pharmacovigilance systems, operations, and global PV regulatory obligations.

• Contractual Expertise: Proven track record in safety contract management and negotiating agreements across diverse stakeholder setups.

• Agile Leadership: Demonstrated success in leading, coaching, and empowering high-performing teams in multicultural environments using agile methodologies.

• Technological Fluency: A strong awareness of digital health systems and technical advancements, particularly in how AI and cognitive computing apply to data workflows.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Art und Weise zu gestalten, wie Sicherheitsdaten in unser Unternehmen gelangen, und strategische Beziehungen voranzutreiben, die sich direkt auf die Patientensicherheit auswirken? Als Gruppenleiter für Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering (DA&P) leiten Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team, das sich auf die Etablierung strategischer Kooperationen, die Sicherstellung der Compliance und die Steuerung der wichtigen "Front-End"-Säule der Patientensicherheit konzentriert. In dieser zentralen Rolle verschmelzen Sie die Aufsicht über externe Asset-Integrationen und vertragliche Sicherheitsvereinbarungen mit dem fortgeschrittenen Management unserer vorgelagerten Sicherheitsdaten-Lieferkette. Mit agilen Arbeitsprinzipien arbeiten Sie mit internen und externen Partnern aus allen Datenquellen und allen therapeutischen Modalitäten zusammen, um passende Datenlösungen zu liefern und die Einführung von Automatisierungs- und KI-Technologien der nächsten Generation zu beeinflussen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Betriebsstrategie vorantreiben: Entwickeln und liefern Sie klare Betriebsstrategien, die mit globalen Sicherheitszielen und breiteren Ambitionen übereinstimmen.
• Lead & Inspire: Pflegen Sie eine agile Teamumgebung, die Selbstorganisation, Innovation, Experimente und autonome Entscheidungsfindung fördert.
• Verwalten von Sicherheitsvereinbarungen: Die Entwicklung, Verhandlung und Umsetzung von zweckgerechten Sicherheitsvereinbarungen vorantreiben und gleichzeitig die effiziente Integration und den Austausch externer Daten erleichtern.
• Support Due Diligence: Partnerschaft mit internen und externen Kunden bei Unternehmens- und Molekülakquisitionen, um vorbeugende Vertragsanforderungen zu erfüllen und zu bewerten.
• Strategische Anleitung: Bereitstellung von Expertenwissen über Strategien für Sicherheitsvereinbarungen in verschiedenen Setups, einschließlich Lizenzvereinbarungen, Kooperationen bei klinischen Studien und PV-Dienstleistern.
• Innovative Datenerfassung: Partner weltweit, um Einfluss darauf zu nehmen, wie Technologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, kognitives Computing und Automatisierung die Erfassung von Sicherheitsdaten verbessern können.
• Steuerung der Datenlieferkette: Zusammenarbeit zwischen verbundenen Unternehmen, Pharmaunternehmen und Diagnostikern, um zeitnahe, qualitativ hochwertige Sicherheitsdaten zu sichern und gleichzeitig die strikte Einhaltung globaler Vorschriften sicherzustellen.
• Sicherstellen von Qualität und Compliance: Behalten Sie die volle Aufsicht über die Prozesse des Qualitätsmanagementsystems (QMS), um eine ständige Inspektionsbereitschaft über den gesamten Betrieb hinweg zu gewährleisten.
• Gewährleistung der Aufrechterhaltung der umfassenden Prozesskompetenz innerhalb des Teams, insbesondere bei Business Process Ownern (BPOs), um sicherzustellen, dass dieses kritische Wissen in der gesamten Organisation verbunden und konsistent angewendet wird Wer du bist Sie sind ein visionärer, systemorientierter Leader, der es schafft, Menschen, Ideen und Technologien in komplexen Matrixumgebungen zu verbinden. Sie bringen eine kollaborative, wachstumsorientierte Denkweise mit und sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, verschiedene Teams zu betreuen, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Umfangreiche Branchenerfahrung: Bedeutende Erfahrung in Pharmakovigilanzsystemen, Betriebsabläufen und globalen PV-Aufsichtspflichten.
• Vertragsexpertise: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Sicherheitsvertragsmanagement und bei der Verhandlung von Vereinbarungen über verschiedene Stakeholder-Setups hinweg.
• Agile Führung: Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Führung, dem Coaching und der Stärkung leistungsstarker Teams in multikulturellen Umgebungen mit agilen Methoden.
• Technologisch fließend: Ein starkes Bewusstsein für digitale Gesundheitssysteme und technische Fortschritte, insbesondere in Bezug auf die Anwendung von KI und kognitivem Computing auf Daten-Workflows.
• Strategische Einflussfähigkeiten: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, sen zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à façonner la façon dont les données de sécurité entrent dans notre organisation et à stimuler des relations stratégiques qui ont une incidence directe sur la sécurité des patients? En tant que chef de groupe pour l'acquisition de données et le partenariat en matière de sécurité (AD&P), vous dirigerez une équipe hautement performante axée sur l'établissement de collaborations stratégiques, l'assurance de la conformité et la gestion du pilier vital « Fin de carrière » des opérations de sécurité des patients. Dans ce rôle central, vous fusionnerez la surveillance des intégrations d'actifs externes et des arrangements contractuels de sécurité avec la gestion avancée de notre chaîne d'approvisionnement en données de sécurité en amont. Championnant des principes de travail agiles, vous collaborerez avec des partenaires internes et externes à travers toutes les sources de données et toutes les modalités thérapeutiques pour fournir des solutions de données adaptées à l'usage et influencer l'adoption de technologies d'automatisation et d'IA de prochaine génération. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger la stratégie opérationnelle : Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies opérationnelles claires qui cadrent avec les objectifs de sécurité mondiaux et les ambitions plus larges.
• Lead & Inspire: Cultiver un environnement d'équipe agile qui favorise l'auto-organisation, l'innovation, l'expérimentation et la prise de décision autonome.
• Gérer les accords de sécurité : Favoriser l'élaboration, la négociation et la mise en oeuvre d'accords de sécurité adaptés à l'usage, tout en facilitant l'intégration et le partage efficaces des données externes.
• Soutenir la diligence raisonnable: Partenaire avec les clients internes et externes lors des acquisitions d'entreprises et de molécules pour traiter et évaluer de façon préventive les exigences contractuelles.
• Fournir une orientation stratégique : Fournir des connaissances spécialisées sur les stratégies d'ententes de sécurité dans divers établissements, y compris les accords de licence, les collaborations d'essais cliniques et les fournisseurs de services de VP.
• Innover l'acquisition de données : S'associer à l'échelle mondiale pour influencer la façon dont les technologies comme l'intelligence artificielle, l'informatique cognitive et l'automatisation peuvent améliorer l'acquisition de données de sécurité.
• Gouvernance de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de données : Collaborer avec les affiliés, les pharmaciens et les Diagnostics pour obtenir en temps opportun des données de sécurité de haute qualité tout en assurant le strict respect des règlements mondiaux.
• Assurer la qualité et la conformité : Maintenir une surveillance complète des processus du Système de gestion de la qualité (SGQ) afin d'assurer une préparation constante à l'inspection dans toutes les opérations.
• Assurer le maintien de l'expertise approfondie des processus au sein de l'équipe, en particulier parmi les propriétaires de processus d'affaires (OPA), en veillant à ce que ces connaissances critiques soient connectées et appliquées de façon cohérente dans l'ensemble de l'organisation Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire, qui réfléchit aux systèmes et qui se développe dans la connexion des gens, des idées et des technologies à travers des environnements matriciels complexes. Vous apportez un esprit collaboratif et axé sur la croissance et êtes passionné par le mentorat de diverses équipes pour libérer leur plein potentiel. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience étendue de l'industrie : Expérience importante au sein des systèmes de pharmacovigilance, des opérations et des obligations réglementaires mondiales en matière de VP.
• Expertise contractuelle : Expérience éprouvée en gestion des contrats de sécurité et en négociation d'ententes entre divers intervenants.
• Leadership Agile: Succès démontré dans la direction, le coaching et l'autonomisation des équipes à haut rendement dans des environnements multiculturels utilisant des méthodologies agiles.
• Fluidité technologique : Une forte sensibilisation aux systèmes de santé numériques et aux progrès techniques, en particulier dans la façon dont l'IA et l'informatique cognitive s'appliquent aux flux de données.
• Compétences d'influence stratégique : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec la capacité d'influencer sen

The Position
You will complete your internship/Master's thesis in the Near Patient Care Research & Early Development chapter. The chapter's mission is the pre-development of near patient care systems for subsequent product development.
Your task will consist of developing a novel flow-through biosensor and characterizing its performance. To accomplish this, you will:

• Build up a fluidic test setup for whole blood processing

• Develop new sensor layouts and methods for layer construction, employing state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques

• Integrate functional sensor components into the fluidic test setup.

• Synthesize/assemble and characterize different functional sensor components, including thick-film sensors

• Evaluate measurement data using newly developed algorithms and advanced analytical methods

• Work independently on assigned work packages: plan and execute experiments, document results, and prepare detailed technical analyses

Who You Are

We are looking for a highly motivated student with the following educational background:

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, with a B.Sc. degree in Biomedical Engineering, Microsystems Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Physics, Electrochemistry, or a related field (very good grades required)

• You are experienced in instrument control programming and fluidics control engineering

• Ideally, you have knowledge of micromachining processes

• Ideally, you possess not only basic knowledge of statistics, but also experience with methods for filtering and fitting measurement data

• Willingness to work with human material, e.g., whole blood samples, plasma, serum, and interstitial fluid is required

• High technical interest, especially in interdisciplinary work

• Enthusiasm and passion for microfluidics and biosensor development

• Independence, strong commitment, and goal-oriented mindset

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills; approachability and sociability

• Advanced level of English and at least an Upper-Intermediate level of German

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will complete your internship/Master's thesis in the Near Patient Care Research & Early Development chapter. The chapter's mission is the pre-development of near patient care systems for subsequent product development.
Your task will consist of developing a novel flow-through biosensor and characterizing its performance. To accomplish this, you will:

• Build up a fluidic test setup for whole blood processing

• Develop new sensor layouts and methods for layer construction, employing state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques

• Integrate functional sensor components into the fluidic test setup.

• Synthesize/assemble and characterize different functional sensor components, including thick-film sensors

• Evaluate measurement data using newly developed algorithms and advanced analytical methods

• Work independently on assigned work packages: plan and execute experiments, document results, and prepare detailed technical analyses

Who You Are

We are looking for a highly motivated student with the following educational background:

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, with a B.Sc. degree in Biomedical Engineering, Microsystems Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Physics, Electrochemistry, or a related field (very good grades required)

Technical Experience & Knowledge:

• Ideally, you bring knowledge and experience in prototyping of microfluidic devices and manufacturing or characterization of (bio)sensors

• You are experienced in instrument control programming and fluidics control engineering

• You are familiar with the fundamentals of optical, spectroscopic and electrochemical measurement techniques

• Ideally, you have knowledge of micromachining processes

• Ideally, you possess not only basic knowledge of statistics, but also experience with methods for filtering and fitting measurement data

• Familiarity with various analytical and characterization methods is advantageous

• Willingness to work with human material, e.g., whole blood samples, plasma, serum, and interstitial fluid is required

Personal Qualities:

• High technical interest, especially in interdisciplinary work

• Enthusiasm and passion for microfluidics and biosensor development

• Independence, strong commitment, and goal-oriented mindset

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills; approachability and sociability

• Advanced level of English and at least an Upper-Intermediate level of German

• Eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Sport Center on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

Please upload your resume and motivation letter.

Please remember that this opportunity is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled in a master's program and will maintain their student status for the entire period of the internship.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

Period: from November 2026 for a period of 6+6 months.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - Jabalpur , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Mahakoushal Area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

Who You Are

• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.

• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .

• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.

• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.

• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate.
To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Make a difference – as an intern for Established Data Solutions. We are looking for Knowledge Management (KM) and Computer Science (CS) enthusiasts with a keen interest in delivering and supporting advanced solutions at the interface of the Computer- and Life Sciences. In this role, you will specifically contribute to our Virtual Product Home (VPH) —a mission-critical, standard internal document management solution that supports over 5,000 active users and manages data for 800+ Roche products across our global manufacturing network.

KM increases the productivity and efficiency of every one of our company’s employees. We deliver services, processes and solutions that help an organization of several thousand researchers to manage and analyze their information. During the last years we have, for example, developed state-of-the-art solutions for semantic and numerical integration, automated processes for large-scale document management, and AI based information retrieval and classification tools. All our project teams follow the agile method within a very large IT organization, but embedded in a research & development function. Our interns are part of the team – which means you share all the fun & all the pain.

The opportunity:

• Be a part of a global team that delivers technical solutions to knowledge management problems

• Coordinate with colleagues and customers in the US and Europe to deliver complex technical solutions and drive change into the organization

• Manage projects independently, participate in Scrum ceremonies, and present results to the team

• Work with operational and service professionals to support content migrations, application development, content analysis and AI/ML driven decision support

• Be part of an award-winning team (4 awards in 4 years) and learn about professional software development and support across a global organization (Java, Angular, Python, Vibe Coding)

• Learn what it takes to be part of an outstanding support organization for in-house and commercial content systems, such as SharePoint, Discourse, Google Suite

• Develop a high level of understanding of global business and IT processes

Who you are:

• You are an enrolled student in a University program with focus on Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Pharma, IT or related fields or graduated within 12 months prior to the start date. You like to think creatively and tackle problems

• You’re someone who wants to influence your own development and looking for a company where you receive the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Working in a multicultural environment motivates you

• You have ability to present ideas in a clear, comprehensive manner and independent working style, yet also in a very high performing team

• You possess organizational and administrative skills

• Experience in software development and programming is a plus

• Fluent in English, knowledge in German is a plus

Application process:

• Please clearly indicate your preferred starting date and duration of the internship on your motivation letter.

• Applications need to include a CV and a motivation letter both merged in one document.

• Optionally you could also send a proof of comple

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Fai la differenza – come tirocinante per le Soluzioni Dati Stabilite. Stiamo cercando appassionati di Gestione della Conoscenza (KM) e Scienza Informatica (CS) con un forte interesse a fornire e sostenere soluzioni avanzate all'interfaccia del Computer- e Scienze della Vita. In questo ruolo, contribuirai specificamente alla nostra Virtual Product Home (VPH) —una soluzione di gestione dei documenti interni mission-critical e standard che supporta oltre 5.000 utenti attivi e gestisce i dati per 800+ Prodotti Roche nella nostra rete di produzione globale. KM aumenta la produttività e l'efficienza di ogni dipendente della nostra azienda. Forniamo servizi, processi e soluzioni che aiutano un'organizzazione di diverse migliaia di ricercatori a gestire e analizzare le loro informazioni. Negli ultimi anni, ad esempio, abbiamo sviluppato soluzioni all'avanguardia per l'integrazione semantica e numerica, processi automatizzati per la gestione di documenti su larga scala e strumenti di recupero e classificazione basati su AI. Tutti i nostri team di progetto seguono il metodo agile all'interno di una grande organizzazione IT, ma incorporato in una funzione di ricerca e sviluppo. I nostri tirocinanti fanno parte della squadra, il che significa che condividi tutto il divertimento e tutto il dolore. L'opportunità:
• Partecipa a un team globale che offre soluzioni tecniche ai problemi di gestione della conoscenza
• Coordinate con colleghi e clienti negli Stati Uniti e in Europa per fornire soluzioni tecniche complesse e guidare il cambiamento nell'organizzazione
• Gestire i progetti indipendentemente, partecipare a cerimonie Scrum, e risultati presenti al team
• Lavorare con professionisti operativi e di servizio per supportare le migrazioni dei contenuti, lo sviluppo delle applicazioni, l'analisi dei contenuti e il supporto decisionale guidato da AI/ML
• Partecipa a un team premiato (4 premi in 4 anni) e scopri lo sviluppo e il supporto del software professionale in un'organizzazione globale (Java, Angular, Python, Vibe Coding)
• Scopri cosa serve per far parte di un'organizzazione di supporto eccezionale per sistemi di contenuti interni e commerciali, come SharePoint, Discourse, Google Suite
• Sviluppare un alto livello di comprensione dei processi aziendali e IT globali Chi sei:
• Sei uno studente iscritto in un programma universitario con focus su Informatica, Bioinformatica, Farmacia, IT o campi correlati o laureato entro 12 mesi prima della data di inizio. Ti piace pensare creativamente e affrontare i problemi
• Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il proprio sviluppo e alla ricerca di una società in cui si riceve l'opportunità di perseguire i vostri interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. Lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale ti motiva
• Hai la capacità di presentare idee in modo chiaro, completo e stile di lavoro indipendente, ma anche in un team molto performante
• Possiedi competenze organizzative e amministrative
• L'esperienza nello sviluppo e nella programmazione del software è un plus
• Fluente in inglese, la conoscenza in tedesco è un plus Processo di applicazione:
• Si prega di indicare chiaramente la data di partenza preferita e la durata dello stage sulla vostra lettera di motivazione.
• Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione entrambi uniti in un documento.
• Opzionalmente si potrebbe anche inviare una prova di conformità

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Fai la differenza – come stagista per Gestione delle informazioni e delle conoscenze a Roche. Stiamo cercando appassionati di Gestione della Conoscenza (KM) e Scienza Informatica (CS) con un forte interesse a fornire e sostenere soluzioni avanzate all'interfaccia del Computer- e Scienze della Vita. KM aumenta la produttività e l'efficienza di ogni dipendente della nostra azienda. Forniamo servizi, processi e soluzioni che aiutano un'organizzazione di diverse migliaia di ricercatori a gestire e analizzare le loro informazioni. Negli ultimi anni, ad esempio, abbiamo sviluppato soluzioni all'avanguardia per l'integrazione semantica e numerica, processi automatizzati per la gestione di documenti su larga scala e strumenti di recupero e classificazione basati su AI. Tutti i nostri team di progetto seguono il metodo agile all'interno di una grande organizzazione IT, ma incorporato in una funzione di ricerca e sviluppo. I nostri tirocinanti fanno parte della squadra, il che significa che condividi tutto il divertimento e tutto il dolore. L'opportunità:
• Sostenere un team di gestione dei cambiamenti per aiutare a fornire soluzioni di gestione della conoscenza
• Coordinate con colleghi e clienti negli Stati Uniti e in Europa per fornire soluzioni tecniche complesse e guidare il cambiamento nell'organizzazione
• Gestire i progetti in modo indipendente e presentare i risultati al vostro team
• Lavorare con professionisti operativi e di servizio per supportare le migrazioni dei contenuti, lo sviluppo delle applicazioni, l'analisi dei contenuti e il supporto decisionale guidato da AI/ML
• Partecipa a un team premiato (4 premi in 4 anni) e scopri lo sviluppo e il supporto del software professionale in un'organizzazione globale (Java, Angular, Hadoop su HPC)
• Imparare a gestire un'organizzazione di supporto per sistemi di contenuti interni e commerciali, come SharePoint, SolR, Discourse, Google Suite, HBase
• Sviluppare un alto livello di comprensione dei processi aziendali e IT globali
• Produzione di materiale didattico e marketing per workshop e sessioni di formazione Chi sei:
• Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo.
• Stai cercando una società in cui ricevi l'opportunità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie.
• Lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale vi motiva.
• Come studente veloce, si guida attivamente la qualità dei requisiti.
• Inoltre, sei uno studente iscritto in un programma dell'Università (o finito i tuoi studi entro 12 mesi dalla data di inizio) con focus su Informatica, Scienza della Vita, Farmacia, IT, Neuroscienza o campi correlati, e ti piace pensare creativamente e affrontare i problemi. Cosa ti serve nella tua casella di strumenti:
• Capacità di presentare idee in modo chiaro e completo – sì, è necessario convincere i colleghi
• Stile di lavoro indipendente, ma anche in un team molto performante
• Possiedi competenze organizzative e amministrative
• Esperienza in Java e linguaggio di programmazione sarebbe un plus
• Fluente in inglese e almeno conoscenza di base in tedesco Processo di applicazione:
• Si prega di indicare chiaramente la data di partenza preferita e la durata dello stage sulla vostra lettera di motivazione.
• Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione entrambi uniti in un documento.
• Opzionalmente si potrebbe anche inviare una prova di progetti software completati (link a screencast, pagina web o manuale). Informazioni aggiuntive:
• A causa di regolamenti cittadini non UE/EFTA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che afferma che uno stage è obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di richiesta.
• La prima possibile data di inizio 1 settembre 2026.
• Tempo parziale

descriptionByLocale.de:

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Machen Sie einen Unterschied – als Praktikant für Information & Knowledge Management bei Roche. Wir suchen nach Knowledge Management (KM) und Computer Science (CS) Enthusiasten, die ein großes Interesse daran haben, fortschrittliche Lösungen an der Schnittstelle der Computer- und Life Sciences zu liefern und zu unterstützen. KM erhöht die Produktivität und Effizienz aller Mitarbeiter unseres Unternehmens. Wir liefern Dienstleistungen, Prozesse und Lösungen, die einer Organisation von mehreren tausend Forschern helfen, ihre Informationen zu verwalten und zu analysieren. In den letzten Jahren haben wir beispielsweise modernste Lösungen für die semantische und numerische Integration, automatisierte Prozesse für das Dokumentenmanagement im großen Maßstab und KI-basierte Informationsabruf- und Klassifizierungstools entwickelt. Alle unsere Projektteams folgen der agilen Methode innerhalb einer sehr großen IT-Organisation, aber eingebettet in eine Forschungs- & Entwicklungsfunktion. Unsere Praktikanten sind Teil des Teams - was bedeutet, dass Sie den ganzen Spaß und den ganzen Schmerz teilen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Unterstützung eines Change-Management-Teams bei der Bereitstellung von Wissensmanagement-Lösungen
• Koordination mit Kollegen und Kunden in den USA und Europa, um komplexe technische Lösungen zu liefern und den Wandel in der Organisation voranzutreiben
• Verwalten Sie Projekte unabhängig und präsentieren Sie Ihrem Team Ergebnisse
• Arbeiten Sie mit Betriebs- und Serviceexperten zusammen, um Inhaltsmigrationen, Anwendungsentwicklung, Inhaltsanalyse und AI / ML-gesteuerte Entscheidungsunterstützung zu unterstützen
• Werden Sie Teil eines preisgekrönten Teams (4 Auszeichnungen in 4 Jahren) und erfahren Sie mehr über professionelle Softwareentwicklung und -support in einer globalen Organisation (Java, Angular, Hadoop auf HPC)
• Lernen Sie eine Support-Organisation für interne und kommerzielle Content-Systeme wie SharePoint, SolR, Discourse, Google Suite, HBase
• Entwicklung eines hohen Verständnisses globaler Geschäfts- und IT-Prozesse
• Herstellung von Marketing- und Schulungsmaterial für Workshops und Schulungen Wer du bist:

• Sie suchen ein Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit erhalten, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu verfolgen.
• Arbeiten in einem multikulturellen Umfeld motiviert Sie.
• Als schneller Lernender treiben Sie die Qualität der Anforderungen aktiv voran.
• Darüber hinaus sind Sie ein eingeschriebener Student in einem Universitätsprogramm (oder haben Ihr Studium innerhalb von 12 Monaten ab dem Startdatum abgeschlossen) mit Schwerpunkt Informatik, Life Science, Pharma, IT, Neurowissenschaften oder verwandten Bereichen, und Sie denken gerne kreativ und gehen Probleme an. • Fähigkeit, Ideen klar und umfassend zu präsentieren – ja, Sie müssen Kollegen überzeugen

• Sie besitzen organisatorische und administrative Fähigkeiten
• Erfahrung in Java und Programmiersprache wäre ein Plus
• Fließend in Englisch und mindestens Grundkenntnisse in Deutsch Bewerbungsverfahren:

• Bewerbungen müssen einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten, die beide in einem Dokument zusammengefasst sind.

The Position
Support & Training Specialist
For our Global Customer Support (GCS) department, we are seeking a Support & Training Specialist for our Molecular Diagnostics family of products with a focus on Hardware and Software expertise. GCS is responsible for technical services in the Roche Diagnostics Division. Our team of over 500 co-workers globally provides support, training, and information to local and regional service & support representatives.

Join our team in Sant Cugat del Valles in Barcelona as a GCS Molecular Lab Specialist. In this very versatile position in GCS, you join a team responsible to provide advanced troubleshooting and support, as well as training, and documentation to regional centers and to our affiliates worldwide. You consistently work with cross-functional teams, and participate in feature and design reviews. You help to create a bridge between the needs of our customers and affiliates, and our global stakeholders. In this versatile position, you will be responsible for the following main tasks:

• Maintain and update a product-specific knowledge pool

• Offer 2nd level support for affiliates and regions to minimize system downtime

• Write support documentation, service relevant information, and maintain maintenance procedures

• Define and adhere to training and support concepts

• Execute and support training for end customers, first-level support, regional trainers, and global staff

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of training methodologies

• Assist in on-site support for local and regional service activities, including complex repairs, applications, modifications, and first installations

• Contribute to the resolution of customer problems with quick fixes and workarounds

• Facilitate knowledge transfer from manufacturer or R&D to provide comprehensive system knowledge

• Responsible for sub-processes such as digital learning and training documentation

Additional tasks include:

• Contribute to the certification of global and regional trainers

• Support initiatives and maintain strong cooperation with regional representatives

• Assist in the professional coaching of certified global and regional trainers

• Create relevant launch information for new products and support pre-launch and post-launch monitoring programs

• Create, review, and maintain training content and documentation for job-oriented trainings and dedicated systems

• Work closely within the team on some applications topics such workflow and test panels.

• Evaluate the need for Affiliate Notifications and write, publish, and maintain Notifications

• Contribute to the creation of preliminary documentation and FAQs for launch preparation

Who you are:
You thrive in an environment that allows you to interact with people internationally and across functions. You are customer-focused, service-oriented, and possess the following qualifications:

• University degree (FH, University) in engineering or equivalent professional education or experience

• Strong analytical skills and be able to be customer focused and work in an international environment

• Intercultural, good communication, and didactical skills

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, including a customer-focused approach, and highly effective teamwork and collaboration skills

• Ability to approach issues from a workflow/holistic perspective

• Interdisciplinary orientation with the ability to work on applications, workflows and hardware/software topics

• Ability to quickly

Support & Training Specialist
For our Global Customer Support (GCS) department, we are seeking a Support & Training Specialist for our Molecular Diagnostics family of products with a focus on Hardware and Software expertise. GCS is responsible for technical services in the Roche Diagnostics Division. Our team of over 500 co-workers globally provides support, training, and information to local and regional service & support representatives.

Join our team in Sant Cugat del Valles in Barcelona as a GCS Molecular Lab Specialist. In this very versatile position in GCS, you join a team responsible to provide advanced troubleshooting and support, as well as training, and documentation to regional centers and to our affiliates worldwide. You consistently work with cross-functional teams, and participate in feature and design reviews. You help to create a bridge between the needs of our customers and affiliates, and our global stakeholders. In this versatile position, you will be responsible for the following main tasks:

• Maintain and update a product-specific knowledge pool

• Offer 2nd level support for affiliates and regions to minimize system downtime

• Write support documentation, service relevant information, and maintain maintenance procedures

• Define and adhere to training and support concepts

• Execute and support training for end customers, first-level support, regional trainers, and global staff

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of training methodologies

• Assist in on-site support for local and regional service activities, including complex repairs, applications, modifications, and first installations

• Contribute to the resolution of customer problems with quick fixes and workarounds

• Facilitate knowledge transfer from manufacturer or R&D to provide comprehensive system knowledge

• Responsible for sub-processes such as digital learning and training documentation

Additional tasks include:

• Contribute to the certification of global and regional trainers

• Support initiatives and maintain strong cooperation with regional representatives

• Assist in the professional coaching of certified global and regional trainers

• Create relevant launch information for new products and support pre-launch and post-launch monitoring programs

• Create, review, and maintain training content and documentation for job-oriented trainings and dedicated systems

• Work closely within the team on some applications topics such workflow and test panels.

• Evaluate the need for Affiliate Notifications and write, publish, and maintain Notifications

• Contribute to the creation of preliminary documentation and FAQs for launch preparation

• University degree (FH, University) in engineering or equivalent professional education or experience

• Intercultural, good communication, and didactical skills

• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, including a customer-focused approach, and highly effective teamwork and collaboration skills

• Ability to approach issues from a workflow/holistic perspective

• Interdisciplinary orientation with the ability to work on applications, workflows and hardware/software topics

Does a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech business, excite you?

Roche Diagnostics has a superb opportunity for you to grow your skills whilst directly supporting our customers in the South East region, surrounding areas and being part of the field based Engineering team in Ireland.
The successful candidate will provide frontline support covering electro-mechanical hardware routine proactive/reactive work, technical training, upskilling of customers and ensuring all administration and regulatory documentation is maintained. As the first responder for technical, application and IT related issues , you will be expected to build your system understanding around the entire customer solution to include information solutions and applications of the Roche diagnostic products.

You should be resilient, and tenacious. You strive under pressure, working effectively as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines. With strong analytical skills, you are at ease working with technical, scientific and numeric information.
