jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) is a global organisation of app. 3,000 colleagues across six Innovation Centres covering multiple disease areas, with the aim of translating science into transformative medicines for patients. Within this exciting and dynamic environment, pRED Communications operates as a high-impact team of strategic business partners.

We are seeking a dynamic Senior Communications Business Partner who embodies a strategic and collaborative mindset. In this role, you will lead on a diverse portfolio of communication responsibilities across the pRED landscape. You will serve as a core member of at least one pRED Leadership Team, deploying your strategic expertise where it is most needed to drive business outcomes and organisational alignment.

​The opportunity

• Strategic advisory: Act as a core communications strategic adviser and valued Leadership Team member for a designated portfolio within pRED. You will translate business strategy into high-impact communication blueprints that resonate from the lab benches to the leadership community and beyond. You will provide strategic counsel to senior leaders and ensure communications are integrated into the business decision-making process.

• Cross-functional impact: Identify the need for, lead and execute both internal and external communication strategies to continue to position pRED and Roche at the forefront of science in healthcare. You will work as part of a Business Partnering team to align across a global network to deliver a unified communications approach.

• Culture and change catalyst: pRED is a highly dynamic and innovative part of our Roche Pharma business that requires communications to match its needs. You will lead communications initiatives around organisational transformation and development, as well as behavioral and culture evolution across different parts of the pRED network.

• Collaborative partnership: Work in partnership with colleagues from across Roche Group Communications (GC), bringing in additional expertise from distinct ‘’Centres of Excellence’’, for example in media relations, social media or employee engagement, as well as collaborating with colleagues from the wider Pharma Communications team, to co-create world class communications.

Who you are
The ideal candidate is more than a communications specialist - they are also a business leader and someone who is deeply energised by how we develop and deliver medicines. A profound curiosity and passion for science and its role in improving healthcare is key to success in this role.

• Experience: 8+ years in scientific, technical, or corporate communications within the Pharma/Biotech or related highly regulated industries; direct experience in a science or healthcare communications environment is strongly preferred.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required (Journalism, Communications, Science, or Business); Master’s degree desirable.

• Executive influence: Proven track record of navigating matrixed environments and advising c-Suite, with the ability to challenge status quo thinking constructively.

• Operational passion: You have a genuine interest in the "how" of pharma—the science, the manufacturing, and the complexity of end-to-end processes that serve our patients.

• Architect and catalyst mindset: You don’t just deliver messages; you design communication strategies that facilitate change, make impact and foster rigorous professional debate, both inside and outside of

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) è un'organizzazione globale di app. 3.000 colleghi in sei Centri di innovazione che coprono più aree di malattia, con l'obiettivo di tradurre la scienza in farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti. All'interno di questo ambiente emozionante e dinamico, pRED Communications opera come un team ad alto impatto di partner commerciali strategici. Siamo alla ricerca di un dinamico Senior Communications Business Partner che incarna una mentalità strategica e collaborativa. In questo ruolo, si porterà su un portafoglio diversificato di responsabilità di comunicazione attraverso il paesaggio pRED. Potrai servire come membro principale di almeno un team di Leadership pRED, implementando la tua esperienza strategica in cui è più necessario guidare i risultati aziendali e l'allineamento organizzativo. L'opportunità
• Consulenza strategica: agire come consulente strategico per le comunicazioni di base e valutare il membro del Team Leadership per un portafoglio designato all'interno di pRED. Tradurrai la strategia aziendale in progetti di comunicazione ad alto impatto che risonano dalle panche di laboratorio alla comunità di leadership e oltre. Potrai fornire consulenza strategica ai leader senior e garantire che le comunicazioni siano integrate nel processo decisionale aziendale.
• Impatto cross-funzionale: Identificare la necessità, guidare ed eseguire strategie di comunicazione interne ed esterne per continuare a posizionare pRED e Roche all'avanguardia della scienza nel settore sanitario. Potrai lavorare come parte di un team di Business Partnering per allinearsi in una rete globale per fornire un approccio di comunicazione unificato.
• Cultura e cambiamento catalizzatore: pRED è una parte altamente dinamica e innovativa del nostro business Roche Pharma che richiede comunicazioni per soddisfare le sue esigenze. Condurrai iniziative di comunicazione intorno alla trasformazione e allo sviluppo organizzativo, nonché all'evoluzione comportamentale e culturale in diverse parti della rete pRED.
• Partenariato collaborativo: Lavorare in collaborazione con colleghi di tutta la Roche Group Communications (GC), apportare ulteriori competenze da distinti “centri di eccellenza”, ad esempio nelle relazioni con i media, nei social media o nell’impegno dei dipendenti, oltre a collaborare con colleghi del più ampio team di Pharma Communications, per creare comunicazioni di livello mondiale. Chi sei Il candidato ideale è più di uno specialista di comunicazione - sono anche un leader di affari e qualcuno che è profondamente eccitato da come sviluppiamo e forniamo farmaci. Una profonda curiosità e passione per la scienza e il suo ruolo nel miglioramento della salute è fondamentale per il successo in questo ruolo.
• Esperienza: 8+ anni di comunicazione scientifica, tecnica o aziendale all'interno delle industrie Pharma/Biotech o connesse altamente regolamentate; l'esperienza diretta in un ambiente di comunicazione scientifica o sanitaria è fortemente preferita.
• Istruzione: Corso di laurea o equivalente richiesto (Journalism, Comunicazioni, Scienza, o Business); laurea auspicabile.
• Influenza esecutiva: comprovata traccia di navigazione degli ambienti matrici e consulenza c-Suite, con la capacità di sfidare lo status quo pensando costruttivamente.
• Passione operativa: Hai un vero interesse per il "come" del farmaco, la scienza, la produzione e la complessità dei processi end-to-end che servono i nostri pazienti.
• Architetto e catalizzatore mindset: non basta consegnare messaggi; progetta strategie di comunicazione che facilitano il cambiamento, l'impatto e favoriscono un rigoroso dibattito professionale, sia all'interno che all'esterno

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) ist eine globale Organisation der App. 3.000 Kollegen in sechs Innovationszentren, die mehrere Krankheitsbereiche abdecken, mit dem Ziel, Wissenschaft in transformative Medikamente für Patienten zu übersetzen. In diesem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld agiert pRED Communications als einflussreiches Team strategischer Geschäftspartner. Wir suchen einen dynamischen Senior Communications Business Partner, der eine strategische und kollaborative Denkweise verkörpert. In dieser Rolle führen Sie ein vielfältiges Portfolio an Kommunikationsverantwortlichkeiten in der gesamten pRED-Landschaft. Sie werden als Kernmitglied von mindestens einem pRED-Führungsteam tätig sein und Ihre strategische Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie am dringendsten benötigt wird, um Geschäftsergebnisse und organisatorische Ausrichtung voranzutreiben. Die Chance
• Strategische Beratung: Handeln Sie als strategischer Berater der Kernkommunikation und geschätztes Mitglied des Führungsteams für ein bestimmtes Portfolio innerhalb von pRED. Sie werden Geschäftsstrategie in wirkungsvolle Kommunikationsblaupausen übersetzen, die von den Laborbänken bis zur Führungsgemeinschaft und darüber hinaus ankommen. Sie bieten leitenden Führungskräften strategische Beratung und stellen sicher, dass die Kommunikation in den Geschäftsentscheidungsprozess integriert wird.
• Funktionsübergreifende Auswirkungen: Identifizieren Sie die Notwendigkeit, führen Sie und führen Sie sowohl interne als auch externe Kommunikationsstrategien durch, um pRED und Roche weiterhin an der Spitze der Wissenschaft im Gesundheitswesen zu positionieren. Sie arbeiten als Teil eines Business-Partnering-Teams, um sich in einem globalen Netzwerk auszurichten und einen einheitlichen Kommunikationsansatz zu liefern.
• Kultur- und Change-Katalysator: pRED ist ein hochdynamischer und innovativer Teil unseres Roche Pharma-Geschäfts, der eine Kommunikation erfordert, die seinen Bedürfnissen entspricht. Sie werden Kommunikationsinitiativen rund um organisatorische Transformation und Entwicklung sowie Verhaltens- und Kulturentwicklung in verschiedenen Teilen des pRED-Netzwerks leiten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus allen Bereichen der Roche Group Communications (GC), indem zusätzliches Fachwissen aus verschiedenen „Centres of Excellence, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Medienarbeit, Social Media oder Mitarbeiterengagement, sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus dem breiteren Pharma Communications-Team eingebracht wird, um eine erstklassige Kommunikation zu schaffen. Wer du bist Der ideale Kandidat ist mehr als ein Kommunikationsspezialist - er ist auch ein Wirtschaftsführer und jemand, der durch die Art und Weise, wie wir Medikamente entwickeln und liefern, stark motiviert ist. Eine tiefe Neugier und Leidenschaft für die Wissenschaft und ihre Rolle bei der Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle.
• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre in der wissenschaftlichen, technischen oder Unternehmenskommunikation in der Pharma / Biotech oder verwandten stark regulierten Industrien; direkte Erfahrung in einer Wissenschafts- oder Gesundheitskommunikationsumgebung wird stark bevorzugt.
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig erforderlich (Journalismus, Kommunikation, Wissenschaft oder Wirtschaft); Master-Abschluss wünschenswert.
• Exekutiver Einfluss: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Navigation in matrixisierten Umgebungen und der Beratung von c-Suite mit der Fähigkeit, das konstruktive Denken des Status Quo in Frage zu stellen.
• Operationelle Leidenschaft: Sie haben ein echtes Interesse am "Wie" der Pharmaindustrie - der Wissenschaft, der Herstellung und der Komplexität von End-to-End-Prozessen, die unseren Patienten dienen.
• Architekten- und Katalysator-Mentalität: Sie liefern nicht nur Botschaften; Sie entwerfen Kommunikationsstrategien, die Veränderungen ermöglichen, Auswirkungen haben und eine strenge professionelle Debatte innerhalb und außerhalb fördern

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des relations avec les investisseurs (Finances)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development.

As an Investor Relations Officer, your core responsibilities will be to analyze financial community expectations and market sentiment, provide vital internal performance updates, and ensure a continuous information flow to shareholders and bondholders. By doing so, you will strengthen their understanding and appreciation of Roche’s business while gaining extensive experience in internal and external communications directed at senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Manage the preparation of quarterly results presentations for the management team with a strong focus on finance, specifically supporting the CFO, and actively participate in the preparation of the Finance Report.

• Investor & Analyst Relations: Act as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all finance and sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests, while building and maintaining an internal network of subject matter experts.

• Fixed-Income Management: Lead all fixed-income related activities, which includes handling requests from bondholders, supporting the issuance of new debt, and supporting annual reviews with rating agencies in close collaboration with Group Treasury.

• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitor sell-side reports, contextualize consensus estimates, and maintain an internal company valuation model in close collaboration with Group Planning.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Group Finance, Legal, BD, and Communications on a variety of strategic topics, such as business development, the implementation of regulatory changes, and the ad-hoc release process.

• Capital Market Events: Participate in the preparation of capital market days (e.g., Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) by developing compelling storylines and building slide decks for individual speakers.

• IR Infrastructure: Oversee and run the day-to-day operations of the Investor Relations (IR) website and its associated digital tools.

Who You Are

• Experience & Industry Background: You bring a strong finance, accounting, or business background with at least five years of working experience at the group level of a global Pharma/Biotech company, including hands-on involvement in the quarterly and annual results review process.

• Capital Markets Expertise: You possess a deep interest in capital markets, a validated understanding of company valuations (especially within the healthcare sector), and a solid foundational understanding of accounting policies.

• Technical Skillset: You have strong proficiency in standard business tools such as Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in specialized analytical tools like Bloomberg is considered a distinct asset.

• Communication & Articulation: You are fluent in English (both written and spoken), with German language skills being a clear advantage. You back this up with excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, enabling you to clearly explain financial value drivers and complex business concepts.

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Gestire la preparazione di presentazioni trimestrali di risultati per il team di gestione con un forte focus sulla finanza, specificamente sostenere il CFO, e partecipare attivamente alla preparazione del Finance Report.

• Competenza sui mercati dei capitali: Lei possiede un profondo interesse nei mercati dei capitali, una valida comprensione delle valutazioni aziendali (soprattutto nel settore sanitario) e una solida comprensione fondamentale delle politiche contabili.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.

• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.

• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.

• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers .

​
Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

​
Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

​
Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle

​
Technical Skills

• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.

• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).

• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.

• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.

• Familiarity with PowerShell o

Dabei berücksichtigst du stets den Gesamtterminplan, das Budget, den Scope und die Qualitätsanforderungen.

• Anforderungssicherung und Change Management: Du stellst die Einhaltung und Umsetzung der User Requirements (URB/URS) sicher und bewertest mögliche Änderungen im Projektverlauf (Change Management) hinsichtlich ihrer Auswirkungen auf Kosten und Termine.

Notre discipline d'ingénierie des procédés y contribue de façon significative en mettant en œuvre des projets d'investissement tels que des installations de production d'utilitaires propres et de BPF pour la production d'ingrédients actifs jusqu'à concurrence de trois millions de chiffres. Le travail d'équipe, le soutien mutuel et les degrés de liberté dans l'élaboration de projets sont bien sûr une question pour nous. Chapitre Ingénierie RDG est responsable de la planification et de la réalisation de tous les grands projets d'investissement sur les sites de Mannheim et Penzberg. • Échange de connaissances et maintenance du réseau : Vous échangez des idées dans la communauté de l'ingénierie et créez activement un réseau d'experts. Qualités C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous
• Qualification : Vous avez réussi des études universitaires (p. ex. biotechnologie, génie chimique, génie mécanique, etc.)

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team within our global shared services hub, where your financial acumen supports our broader purpose in global healthcare. As a Record to Report PEC Analyst, you will ensure the precision, compliance, and efficiency of our end-to-end financial operations. Working within a dynamic regional ecosystem, you will take ownership of general ledger accounting, financial analysis, and continuous process improvements.

In this impactful role, you will:

• Drive Financial Accuracy: Coordinate and execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, making sure account closures match standard financial instructions.

• Manage Transaction Lifecycles: Perform and analyze core accounting transactions, oversee fixed assets calculations, justify accruals, and clear open ledger items accurately.

• Ensure Reporting Excellence: Prepare detailed monthly balance sheet reconciliations, resolve anomalies promptly, and deliver accurate reporting packages within defined timelines.

• Support Audit and Tax Management: Serve as a trusted point of contact for internal and external audits, as well as tax consultations, by preparing clear schedules and supporting documentation.

• Champion Internal Controls: Maintain up-to-date process documentation that complies strictly with international financial reporting controls, corporate policies, and local statutory laws.

• Advance Process Innovation: Collaboratively identify, recommend, and implement solutions for operational efficiency, supporting continuous improvement and best-practice sharing across the team.

Who You Are
You are an analytical, detail-oriented finance professional with an agile mindset and a strong customer service orientation. You possess excellent problem-solving abilities, enjoy working collaboratively in a team spirit, and show the self-discipline needed to manage shifting priorities.
Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a Degree, Diploma, or equivalent professional qualification in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: You bring 3 years of experience in corporate finance, financial accounting, or general ledger processes. Experience in a global shared services center (SSC) or business process outsourcing (BPO) environment is highly preferred.

• Systems & Digital Literacy: You have practical working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting systems (such as SAP) alongside advanced proficiency in standard spreadsheets and business tools.

• Language Excellence: You possess exceptional communication skills with professional fluency in English. Absolute proficiency in Mandarin is required to effectively support our partner network in Mandarin-speaking countries.

• Adaptability: You carry a collaborative mindset, willing to participate in job rotations across functional teams to build your skills and support collective goals.

Let’s grow together by accessing opportunities that set you up for success.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing health

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team within our global shared services hub, where your financial acumen supports our broader purpose in global healthcare. As a Record to Report PEC Analyst, you will ensure the precision, compliance, and efficiency of our end-to-end financial operations. Working within a dynamic regional ecosystem, you will take ownership of general ledger accounting, financial analysis, and continuous process improvements.

In this impactful role, you will:

• Drive Financial Accuracy: Coordinate and execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, making sure account closures match standard financial instructions.

• Manage Transaction Lifecycles: Perform and analyze core accounting transactions, oversee fixed assets calculations, justify accruals, and clear open ledger items accurately.

• Ensure Reporting Excellence: Prepare detailed monthly balance sheet reconciliations, resolve anomalies promptly, and deliver accurate reporting packages within defined timelines.

• Support Audit and Tax Management: Serve as a trusted point of contact for internal and external audits, as well as tax consultations, by preparing clear schedules and supporting documentation.

• Champion Internal Controls: Maintain up-to-date process documentation that complies strictly with international financial reporting controls, corporate policies, and local statutory laws.

• Advance Process Innovation: Collaboratively identify, recommend, and implement solutions for operational efficiency, supporting continuous improvement and best-practice sharing across the team.

Who You Are
You are an analytical, detail-oriented finance professional with an agile mindset and a strong customer service orientation. You possess excellent problem-solving abilities, enjoy working collaboratively in a team spirit, and show the self-discipline needed to manage shifting priorities.
Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a Degree, Diploma, or equivalent professional qualification in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: You bring 3 years of experience in corporate finance, financial accounting, or general ledger processes. Experience in a global shared services center (SSC) or business process outsourcing (BPO) environment is highly preferred.

• Systems & Digital Literacy: You have practical working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting systems (such as SAP) alongside advanced proficiency in standard spreadsheets and business tools.

• Language Excellence: You possess exceptional communication skills with professional fluency in English. Absolute proficiency in Mandarin is required to effectively support our partner network in Mandarin-speaking countries.

• Adaptability: You carry a collaborative mindset, willing to participate in job rotations across functional teams to build your skills and support collective goals.

Let’s grow together by accessing opportunities that set you up for success.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing health

Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes, aimez travailler en collaboration dans un esprit d'équipe et montrez l'autodiscipline nécessaire pour gérer les priorités changeantes. Vos qualifications :
• Études : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme, d'un diplôme ou d'une qualification professionnelle équivalente en finance, en comptabilité, en commerce ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez 3 ans d'expérience dans les processus de finance d'entreprise, de comptabilité financière ou de grand livre. L'expérience d'un centre mondial de services partagés (SSC) ou d'un environnement d'externalisation de processus d'affaires (BPO) est hautement préférée.
• Systèmes et littératie numérique : Vous avez une connaissance pratique des systèmes comptables de planification des ressources (PGI) (comme SAP) ainsi qu'une connaissance approfondie des feuilles de calcul standard et des outils d'affaires.
• Excellence linguistique : Vous possédez des compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec compétence professionnelle en anglais. Une maîtrise absolue du mandarin est nécessaire pour soutenir efficacement notre réseau de partenaires dans les pays parlant le mandarin.
• Adaptabilité : Vous portez un esprit collaboratif, prêt à participer à des rotations d'emplois entre les équipes fonctionnelles pour développer vos compétences et soutenir des objectifs collectifs. Laissez grandir ensemble en accédant aux opportunités qui vous mettent en place pour le succès. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin que nous puissions offrir une santé qui change la vie

Die Chance Als Account Executive für unsere Point of Care (POC)-Franchise sind Sie für die gesamte Kontoverwaltung und den Verkauf des gesamten Roche Point of Care-Portfolios verantwortlich. Diese Rolle erfordert die Positionierung differenzierter molekularer POC-Technologie und IT-Konnektivitätslösungen im gesamten IHN-Kontinuum der Pflege, das sowohl stationäre als auch ambulante Umgebungen umfasst. Sie werden das Geschäftswachstum vorantreiben, indem Sie wirkungsvolle Präsentationen und Workflow-Analysen durchführen, die unsere Lösungen an den einzigartigen Kundenbedürfnissen und sich verändernden Gesundheitstrends ausrichten.

• Feldbasierte Rolle in Raleigh, NC
• Für diese Buchung sind keine Umzugsvorteile verfügbar Die erwartete Gehaltsspanne für diese Position basierend auf dem primären Standort von NC beträgt 86.700.00 $ - 160.900.00 $. Ein diskretionärer Jahresbonus kann auf der Grundlage der Leistung des Einzelnen und des Unternehmens verfügbar sein. Diese Position qualifiziert sich auch für die unter dem unten angegebenen Link aufgeführten Vorteile. Vorteile Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Pourquoi Roche Nous sommes passionnés par la réalisation de Notre promesse d'améliorer la vie des patients et de créer des communautés plus saines pour tous. Nous favorisons une culture d'inclusivité, d'intégrité et de créativité tout en cherchant courageusement à répondre aux défis les plus complexes en matière de santé et en transformant la société. L'opportunité En tant que dirigeant de compte pour notre franchise Point of Care (POC), vous serez responsable de la gestion totale du compte et de la vente du portefeuille Roche Point of Care. Ce rôle exige le positionnement de solutions de connectivité moléculaires et informatiques différenciées dans le continuum de soins du Réseau intégré de santé (RSI), qui englobe à la fois les soins hospitaliers et les soins ambulatoires. Vous stimulerez la croissance des entreprises en effectuant des présentations à impact élevé et des analyses de flux de travail qui harmonisent nos solutions avec les besoins uniques des clients et les tendances changeantes en matière de soins de santé.
• Générer une nouvelle demande de clients au sein du segment IHN dans l'ensemble du portefeuille des produits Point of Care.
• Pénétrez des comptes IHN complexes et importants pour avoir accès aux principaux décideurs et intervenants et établir des faveurs.
• Traduire le flux de travail client et les besoins cliniques en actions internes tout en conciliant les grandes priorités commerciales et les objectifs financiers.
• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies propres à chaque territoire pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente.
• Utiliser les résultats des analyses de flux de travail, des examens de processus et des études d'impact pour assurer une différenciation concurrentielle.
• Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec des collègues internes afin de partager les pratiques exemplaires et de maintenir une participation active aux organisations de l'industrie. Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
• 3 ans ou plus d'expérience commerciale pertinente.
• La participation à un programme de perfectionnement, de bourses ou de rotation accéléré approuvé peut être envisagée au lieu de l'expérience. Préféré
• Expérience documentée au sein de l'espace de diagnostic de point de soins et de réseau intégré de santé.
• Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de naviguer dans des processus d'achat complexes et multipartites.
• Expérience de vente de solutions informatiques ou d'instruments de soins de santé connectés. Lieu
• Rôle sur le terrain situé à Raleigh, NC
• Aucune indemnité de réinstallation n'est disponible pour cette affectation L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal de NC est de 86 700,00 $ - 160 900,00 $. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. Une prime annuelle discrétionnaire peut être offerte en fonction des performances individuelles et de l'entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible aux avantages décrits au lien ci-dessous. Avantages Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales. C'est notre politique et notre pratique d'employer, de promouvoir et de traiter d'une autre manière tous les employés et tous les demandeurs sur la base du mérite.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Why Roche
​​​​​​​We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive for our Point of Care (POC) franchise, you will be responsible for total account management and selling the full Roche Point of Care portfolio. This role requires positioning differentiated Molecular POC technology and IT connectivity solutions across the Integrated Health Network (IHN) continuum of care, encompassing both inpatient and outpatient environments. You will drive business growth by conducting high-impact presentations and workflow analyses that align our solutions with unique customer needs and shifting healthcare trends.

• Generate new customer demand within the IHN segment across the full portfolio of Point of Care products.

• Penetrate complex and large IHN accounts to gain access to and establish favor with key decision-makers and stakeholders.

• Translate customer workflow and clinical needs into internal actions while balancing key business priorities and financial goals.

• Develop and execute territory-specific strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Utilize outcomes from workflow analyses, process reviews, and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with internal colleagues to share best practices and maintain active involvement in industry organizations.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of relevant sales or equivalent commercial experience.

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship, or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred

• Documented experience working within the Point of Care diagnostic and Integrated Health Network (IHN) space.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

• Experience selling medical device IT solutions or connected healthcare instruments.

Location

• This role is a field based role in Washington, DC

Relocation is not available for this role

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Washington DC is $86,700.00 - $160,900.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. [Benefits]

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Esperienza documentata che opera all'interno dello spazio Point of Care diagnostica e Integrated Health Network (IHN).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Regulatory Innovation & Sustainment Professional within Pharma Development Regulatory's (PDR) Quality & Compliance capability, you will be accountable for creating and maintaining PDR’s Quality Management System (QMS) framework. This includes fostering innovation, identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities and developing risk-based quality strategies.

The Opportunity

• Act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, leading or supporting cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.

• Collaborate with global teams to mature and sustain PDR’s Quality & Compliance capabilities.

• Monitor external trends and regulatory changes to ensure ongoing readiness.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and drive strategic change initiatives.

• Lead internal/external audits, Health Authority inspections, and risk assessments.

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory standards including Good Clinical Practice / Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GCP/GVP) and Medical Device related requirements, where applicable.

• Optimize processes to enable operational excellence and maintain our license to operate.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred).

• You have a minimum of 7 years of experience in Quality & Compliance, Regulatory Affairs or Drug and/or Device Development, with a strong understanding of regulated environments, industry frameworks, data and digital systems.

• You’re a strategic thinker and problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, driven by purpose, excited by innovation, and confident in influencing change across a complex organization.

• You are skilled at analyzing complex quality data and translating these insights into clear, actionable executive reporting and strategic messages.

• You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across global/local matrixed teams and senior leadership.

• You possess a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to solving challenges, with the ability to assess end-to-end processes, identify inconsistencies, and improve process effectiveness and efficiency.

• You can influence best practice adoption.

Preferred

• Experience with audits or inspections is a plus, but not essential.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. The Strategic Quality Partner acts as a single point of contact within project teams (New product development / Product Change) for a portfolio of products assigned to them. The SQP leads and drives for decisions for strategic topics from a compliance and product quality perspective. The SQP partners with internal and external stakeholders across the value chain to accelerate the development process and incorporate learnings. Stakeholders include, but are not limited to Development Leads, Project Leaders, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Global Customer Support, and Post-Market Quality.

The Opportunity

• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)

• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements

• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions

• Support internal and external audits

• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings

• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions

• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)

• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.

• 8+ years of experience in the diagnostics industry or a related field in business related Functions

• Strong scientific and technical background with sound product knowledge, ideally with assay/reagents/system/hardware/software development experience for IVD Products.

• Strong business and financial acumen with an enterprise mindset

• Knowledge of Regulations pertaining to the environment (i.e. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GDP, GMP, others)

• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Strong agile knowledge and capabilities demonstrating new ways of working

• Pragmatic decision making and ability to move forward without a perfect solution

• Demonstrated thorough E2E understanding for lifecycle management

• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in leading cross-functional teams (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) and driving change.

Locations
You are located in Tucson, Arizona. This is a primarily onsite role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future drives us to innovate, continuously advance science, and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. We want to build a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe it is critically important to ensure our employees have the necessary knowledge and ability to confidently navigate their continuous learning pathways, supporting our priority brands and disease areas.

As a Commercialization Capability Partner, you will use your knowledge of innovative learning solutions and adult learning principles to understand needs of the business, determine and design the appropriate learning solutions and ensure they are delivered in an effective manner so that Roche employees are consistently meeting their objectives.

In your role, you will coach team members, manage complex projects, challenge the status quo, and drive efficiencies. With strong influencing and communication skills, you will develop and implement strategy, leveraging cultural differences as assets, while maintaining integrity and compliance. Also, you will oversee the Product and Disease Knowledge (PDK) framework, ensuring employees receive necessary training, and act as a point of contact for capability development across various functions.

Join Roche and play a crucial role in fostering continuous learning pathways for our employees and shaping a healthier future for everyone.

The Opportunity:

• Ensure the learning journey maps and performance solutions continue to meet identified gaps and challenges.

• Partner with Squad Leads, Chapter Leads and other key stakeholders to proactively identify, design, and implement capability building solutions aligned to business priorities.

• Coordinate product/disease area training sessions with onboarding and other functional capability building sessions to support employees' skill development.

• Track the completion of training sessions and assessments in the Learning Management System, and ensure training evaluations and feedback are used to monitor the effectiveness of learning solutions through measurement and analytics.

• Collaborate with Marketing Partners, Medical Affairs Partners, and other required roles to curate learning content for the PDK framework and new product launches.

• Remain at the forefront of innovative learning solutions and bring new concepts, approaches, and ideas to fruition within Roche Canada, such as leveraging automation via AI to enhance training effectiveness and efficiency.

• Act as the local point of contact to the Global Commercialization Centre of Excellence to translate local needs/priorities to the Global team and understand what Global programs/solutions are available

• Develop and/or apply Cornerstone expertise to load learning objects, organize curriculums, automate assignments and work with Global learning services and other learning experts.

Who You Are:

• You hold a bachelor's degree (preferably in business, social science, or HR/Leadership) and possess 7+ years of experience in learning programs, with at least 5+ years in a healthcare commercial training role, ideally in Sales, Marketing, or Sales Training.

• You demonstrate proficiency in designing programs based on adult learning principles, leading large-scale learning initiatives, and quickly adapting to environmental changes with minimal disruption.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The opportunity
As a Technical Support Partner for Lab-IT, you are responsible for carrying out field service functions for Roche Diagnostics Digital Products. Your primary duties include digital product troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, and performing preventive maintenance procedures. Reporting to the Technical Support Lead for Lab-IT, you will respond promptly to all service calls and handle various after-sales service issues to ensure customer satisfaction and optimal instrument performance.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, proactive, service-minded with strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
You will be responsible for

• Perform digital product installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for all Roche Diagnostics digital Products.

• Respond promptly and effectively to all service calls from customers.

• Conduct preventive maintenance according to the established schedule to ensure instrument & digital product reliability.

• Manage and resolve other issues related to digital solution after-sales service to maintain high levels of customer support.

Who you are
Experience and Competencies:

• Strong in analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Able to drive and travel in upcountry areas and be flexible to work outside of normal working hours.

• Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Good command of spoken and written English.

• Good communication skills.

• Demonstrates a desire to influence your own development and pursue interests across functions.

• Industry Experience:

• Bachelors or Masters in IT or related fields.

• Minimum of 1 year of work experience as a IT Specialist in the healthcare business is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Marketing Partner- IVD
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Partner

Role Purpose
As the Marketing Partner, you will be required to have deep understanding and
experience with In-Vitro Diagnostics Solutions and technology trends in the Healthcare industry. Heavily focused on strategic products marketing and identifying qualified opportunities for Roche Diagnostics product lines. Work closely with sales, healthcare consultants and technical product specialists to identify market opportunities, drive sales, and maintain relationships in key accounts.
You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.
In this role, you will
Laboratory Marketing

• Analyses the evolving market environment, develops the strategy such as customer segmentations, positioning, branding, messaging, PR/communications, pricing strategy and ensures effective rollout of strategy to the marketplace.

• Assist in the development of a yearly Marketing Plan which outlines marketing

• strategies and initiatives for the products responsible.

• Laboratory KOL management and development.

• Strategic partnership with 3rd party vendors and medical associations.

Product Management

• Portfolio Management including inventory and product lifecycle management of instrument and reagents.

• Support in product quality issues and implementation.

• Support in the planning and execution of marketing activities

- Product campaigns/promotions
- Exhibition booth
- Digital marketing initiatives

• Product Training and development of selling aids and value stories.

• Provide 2nd line technical/application support e.g. evaluations, projects, troubleshooting.

• Support field force with Customer presentation/CMEs, Market intelligence, Formulation of sales arguments, Product information updates

Market Access

• Assist in the development and implementation of business strategies to achieve profitable relationships and identify potential opportunities with major accounts across the Business Area.

• Cross BA selling as One Roche approach.

Market Intelligence and Trends

• Continuously collect and analyse relevant market and competitor information and trends to assess market position and long term opportunities, translate into actionable information and shape the market.

• Feedback market trends and needs to the relevant internal stakeholders.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.
Who you are
You are someone who are/have:

• Strong organizational, communication and interpersonal skills

• Good analytical, problem solving, creative thinking and time management skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and strong business acumen together with the ability to manage ambiguity and drive for results

• Ability to perform under pressure while juggling multiple tasks

• An independent and a team player, has positive attitude and a willingness to learn

• Ability to adhere to deadlines and work in a team

• Resourceful, detail-oriented, proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast paced environment

Qualification and Experience

• More than 4 years of experience designing and delivering healthcare solutions

• Passion for the healthcare industry –good understanding of how the healthcare industry operates and the unique characteristics of the industry ecosyst

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG)
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
We are looking for a Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) who will specialize in IND (Investigational New Drug) applications and overall regulatory strategy to lead our clinical trials into action.

The Role
As an SSUL specializing in IND and Regulatory submission, you will be the architect of our country-level start-up strategy. You won't just follow processes—you will optimize them. Your primary focus will be ensuring the efficient and compliant start up of Roche-sponsored trials by mastering the bridge between global strategy and local regulatory requirements.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the Korean regulatory landscape. You excel in a cross-functional environment and are passionate about driving innovation in clinical trials.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Proven experience(5-10 years) in IND/Regulatory submissions within the pharmaceutical industry or a leading CRO.

• In-depth knowledge of local regulatory requirements (MFDS, GCP, etc.) and experience interacting with HA or Ethics Committees.

• A "Solution-Oriented" mindset: Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively drive process improvements.

• Strong communication skills in both Korean and English to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders.

• Leadership through influence: Ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Clinical Fellowship in Product Development Oncology/Haematology (PDOH)
Summary

This Roche Clinical Fellowship is aimed at medically qualified individuals with a specific interest in haematology or oncology, either before or immediately post specialist training.
Established in 2013, the program was designed to diversify and broaden clinical training through exposure to clinical research methodology from the pharmaceutical medicine perspective. The fellowship will be 1 year in duration, primarily based at Roche Products Ltd in Welwyn Garden City, UK. The position is within the Clinical Development Group, which is responsible for the strategy, design and execution of late phase clinical trials in oncology, haemato-oncology and non-malignant haematology disease areas. Every attempt will be made to accommodate your specific areas of interest and expertise, but available projects will likely need to be determined by the development timelines of each disease area programme There will be the opportunity for direct interaction across Roche/Genentech. There may be opportunities to attend scientific conferences, depending on the project and programme. Your supervisor will be an experienced member of the Clinical Development Group working in Welwyn. In addition, you will be assigned a mentor who is a UK accredited Physician. If successful, you need to be available to start the role before the end of this year.

There is 1 MD Fellow position in:-

• Oncology/Haematology (PDOH), which incorporates the following areas of specialty:
• Oncology

• Haemato-oncology (lymphoid and myeloid)

• Non-malignant haematology (haemophilia and allied bleeding disorders, gene therapy, thrombosis)

As a Fellow in the Global Clinical Development Group you may:

• Be involved in the design, execution, data review, analysis and interpretation of data from clinical studies for molecules in development as well as marketed compounds.

• Interact with globally recognised academic experts and clinical investigators

• Participate in key clinical strategy, implementation and molecule management meetings in order to gain a deeper understanding of the complexities and challenges of the development of medicines

• Provide clinical expertise in the disease area for cross functional pharmaceutical development teams

• Contribute to the generation of abstracts and oral presentations for key external conferences and other specialty meetings as well as publication opportunities.

• Be involved in discussions and initiatives around Personalised Health Care (PHC) and patient selection for different therapeutic interventions

Who is the Roche Clinical Research Fellowship suitable for?
Essential Criteria:

• GMC Registration: Must hold active registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) at the time of application.

• Clinical Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of direct clinical experience post-qualification.

• Specialty Experience: Proven experience working within haematology or oncology settings.

• An individual looking to diversify their training. While some previous clinical research experience is preferred, it is not essential.

• An individual interested in further understanding and influencing the development and approval of medicines for patients within the specific disease area. Note: this is not intended to be a basic science fellowship leading to a post graduate degree, although the clinical research could supplement or inform existing basic research if appropriate.

Il vostro supervisore sarà un membro esperto del gruppo di sviluppo clinico che lavora a Welwyn. Inoltre, vi verrà assegnato un mentore che è un medico accreditato nel Regno Unito. • Oncologia

• Ematologia non maligna (emofilia e disturbi sanguinanti alleati, terapia genica, trombosi) Come Fellow nel Global Clinical Development Group puoi:
• Essere coinvolti nella progettazione, esecuzione, recensione dei dati, analisi e interpretazione dei dati da studi clinici per molecole in sviluppo e composti commercializzati.
• Interagire con esperti accademici riconosciuti a livello globale e ricercatori clinici
• Partecipa a importanti incontri di strategia clinica, implementazione e gestione delle molecole al fine di ottenere una comprensione più approfondita delle complessità e delle sfide dello sviluppo dei farmaci
• Fornire competenze cliniche nell'area della malattia per i team di sviluppo farmaceutico funzionale
• Contribuire alla generazione di astratti e presentazioni orali per conferenze esterne chiave e altre riunioni di specialità e opportunità di pubblicazione.
• Essere coinvolti in discussioni e iniziative inerenti la Personalised Health Care (PHC) e la selezione dei pazienti per diversi interventi terapeutici Chi è il Roche Clinical Research Fellowship adatto per? Criteri essenziali:
• GMC Registrazione: deve tenere la registrazione attiva con il Consiglio medico generale (GMC) al momento della domanda.

• Esperienza di specializzazione: Esperienza comprovata che lavora all'interno delle impostazioni di ematologia o oncologia.
• Un individuo che cerca di diversificare la propria formazione. Mentre alcune precedenti esperienze di ricerca clinica è preferito, non è essenziale.
• Un individuo interessato a comprendere e influenzare ulteriormente lo sviluppo e l'approvazione dei farmaci per i pazienti all'interno dell'area malattia specifica. Nota: questo non è destinato ad essere una borsa di studio di base che porta a un diploma post-laurea, anche se la ricerca clinica potrebbe integrare o informare la ricerca di base esistente se necessario.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Bourse de recherche clinique en oncologie/hématologie (PDOH) Résumé Cette bourse clinique Roche s'adresse aux personnes médicalement qualifiées qui s'intéressent particulièrement à l'hématologie ou à l'oncologie, avant ou immédiatement après une formation spécialisée. Créé en 2013, le programme a été conçu pour diversifier et élargir la formation clinique par l'exposition aux méthodes de recherche clinique du point de vue de la médecine pharmaceutique. La bourse durera un an, principalement chez Roche Products Ltd, à Welwyn Garden City, au Royaume-Uni. Le poste fait partie du Groupe de développement clinique, qui est responsable de la stratégie, de la conception et de l'exécution des essais cliniques en phase tardive en oncologie, en hémato-oncologie et dans les zones de maladies hématologiques non malignes. Tout sera fait pour répondre à vos besoins et à vos compétences, mais les projets disponibles devront probablement être déterminés en fonction des délais d'élaboration de chaque programme. Il y aura la possibilité d'une interaction directe entre Roche et Genentech. Il peut y avoir des occasions d'assister à des conférences scientifiques, selon le projet et le programme. Votre superviseur sera un membre expérimenté du Groupe de développement clinique travaillant à Welwyn. De plus, un mentor accrédité au Royaume-Uni vous sera assigné. Si vous réussissez, vous devez être disponible pour commencer le rôle avant la fin de cette année. Il y a 1 MD Fellow en :-
• Oncologie/hématologie (PDOH), qui comprend les domaines de spécialité suivants:
• Oncologie
• Hémato-oncologie (lymphoïde et myéloïde)
• Hématologie non maligne (hémophilie et troubles hémorragiques connexes, thérapie génique, thrombose) En tant que Fellow du Groupe mondial de développement clinique, vous pouvez :
• Participer à la conception, à l'exécution, à l'examen, à l'analyse et à l'interprétation des données issues des études cliniques sur les molécules en développement et les composés commercialisés.
• Interagir avec des experts universitaires et des chercheurs cliniques mondialement reconnus
• Participer à des réunions clés sur la stratégie clinique, la mise en oeuvre et la gestion des molécules afin de mieux comprendre la complexité et les défis du développement des médicaments
• Fournir une expertise clinique dans le domaine de la maladie aux équipes de développement pharmaceutique interfonctionnel
• Contribuer à la production de résumés et de présentations orales pour des conférences externes clés et d'autres réunions spécialisées ainsi que des occasions de publication.
• Participer aux discussions et aux initiatives concernant les soins de santé personnalisés (SSP) et la sélection des patients pour différentes interventions thérapeutiques Pour qui la bourse de recherche clinique Roche convient-elle? Critères essentiels :
• Enregistrement GMC : Doit être inscrit activement auprès du Conseil médical général (CGM) au moment de la demande.
• Expérience clinique : Un minimum de 3 ans et plus d'expérience clinique directe après la qualification.
• Expérience de spécialité: Expérience éprouvée de travail dans des contextes d'hématologie ou d'oncologie.
• Une personne cherchant à diversifier sa formation. Bien que certaines expériences cliniques antérieures soient préférées, elles ne sont pas essentielles.
• Une personne intéressée à mieux comprendre et influencer le développement et l'approbation de médicaments pour les patients dans la zone de maladie spécifique. Remarque : il ne s'agit pas d'une bourse de sciences fondamentales menant à un diplôme d'études supérieures, bien que la recherche clinique puisse compléter ou informer la recherche fondamentale existante, le cas échéant.
• Les candidats doivent présenter une demande d'admission.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Intern in Roche Pharma Malaysia, you may be assigned to a variety of tasks and/or projects relevant for the assigned team/function.

The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organization, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance.

Assignments will vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modeling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc.

For assignments in Digital Marketing, key responsibilities of an intern may include but not limited to the following (with appropriate guidance from experienced colleagues):

• Collaborating closely with field-facing and office-based colleagues to understand customer/patient/healthcare ecosystem needs as well as Roche strategies and products in the assigned disease area

• Adapting materials/assets/content from global or other countries to local context and needs

• Creating new materials/assets/content

• Support planning, project management and implementation for (digital) marketing campaigns,

• Support development of content/channel strategies and tactics​

Education & Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in a Medical, Scientific, or Biotechnology-related field (e.g., Science, Medical, Biotechnology).

• Familiar with Canva and demonstrates the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new digital tools.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Creazione di nuovi materiali/asset/content

• Attualmente persegue una laurea in campo medico, scientifico o biotecnologico (ad esempio, scienza, medicina, biotecnologia).

Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Praktikant bei Roche Pharma Malaysia können Sie einer Vielzahl von Aufgaben und / oder Projekten zugewiesen werden, die für das zugewiesene Team / die zugewiesene Funktion relevant sind. Das Ziel der Aufgaben ist es, dass der Praktikant akademische oder berufliche Studien / Lernen in einer Roche-Einstellung praktisch anwendet und mehr über die Roche-Organisation erfährt, da eine zukünftige Beschäftigung bei Roche eine Möglichkeit sein kann, abhängig von der Verfügbarkeit von Arbeitsplätzen, der Kandidatenqualifikation und früheren Leistungen. Die Zuweisungen variieren, dienen jedoch in der Regel der Unterstützung der Aktivitäten regulärer Mitarbeiter, wie z. B. • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen im Außendienst und im Büro, um die Bedürfnisse des Kunden-/Patienten-/Gesundheitswesen-Ökosystems sowie die Strategien und Produkte von Roche im zugewiesenen Krankheitsbereich zu verstehen

• Erstellen neuer Materialien / Vermögenswerte / Inhalte

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Content/Channel Strategien und Taktiken Ausbildung & Qualifikationen:
• Derzeit verfolgt einen Abschluss in einem medizinischen, wissenschaftlichen oder Biotechnologie-bezogenen Bereich (z. B. Wissenschaft, Medizin, Biotechnologie).
• Vertraut mit Canva und demonstriert die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und sich an neue digitale Tools anzupassen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Weiterentwicklung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Wer Du bist:

• Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen und im Aufbau von langfristigen Kund:innenbeziehungen

• Idealerweise Erfahrung im Aufbau, Update und Entstörung von Medizinprodukten im Bereich der Blutanalysesysteme sowie Prä-, und Postanalytik

• FH/HTL in Fachrichtung Mechatronik, Telekommunikation, Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertiges Studium bzw. abgeschlossene Lehre mit Praxiserfahrung

• Führerschein Gruppe B & Reisebereitschaft

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
