• Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen kommerzielle Auswirkungen, indem Sie Kosten verankern und eine Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten entwickeln, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Strategie & Jahrespipeline: Zusammenstellung von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategoriestrategie und Initiativespipeline zu formulieren, die an Führungskräften im gesamten Unternehmen ausgerichtet ist.
• Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führen von hochwertigen kommerziellen und vertraglichen Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie.
• Lieferanten-Ökosysteme: Management wichtiger globaler Lieferanten, Einrichtung von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.
• Anleitung & Inhalt: Entwicklung und Pflege von Category Guidance-Dokumenten, um die Strategie in klare, ausführbare Inhalte für Beschaffungskollegen und Geschäftsanwender zu übersetzen.
• Business Partnering: Aufbau tiefer Beziehungen zu leitenden Stakeholdern, herausfordernde Nachfrage / Spezifikationen zur Wertmaximierung und Management von Risiko- / CSR-Bewertungen.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching von Beschaffungskollegen, Bereitstellung professioneller Entwicklung, Verwaltung eines gemeinsamen Associate Category Managers innerhalb des Teams und Verfolgung von Budgetausgaben. Wer du bist Wir suchen nach strategischen Beschaffungs-Champions mit umfangreichen Kenntnissen der globalen IT-Hardware- und Standard-Software-Liefermärkte und den Matrix-Führungskompetenzen, die erforderlich sind, um komplexe organisatorische Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Ausbildung: Universitätsabschluss erforderlich (Business oder Life Sciences Schwerpunkt bevorzugt); eine Post-Graduate Business-bezogene Qualifikation wird bevorzugt.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Head of IFU Management US Core Lab , you will lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of approximately 10 Technical Writers at the Indianapolis site. Our Product Information teams ensure that customers worldwide receive precise, timely, and compliant documentation. Your mission is to guarantee that the Instructions for Use (IFU) for our US portfolio are delivered with top-notch quality, on time, and within budget—optimally supporting both business-critical product launches and key product lifecycle changes. You will actively help shape the next generation of product information by driving digital innovations (such as AI) and process optimizations.

Responsibilities | What to Expect

• Shaping the Future of Content: As a key member of the Product Information Leadership Team, you align operational processes in Indianapolis with our global strategic goals and digital transformation roadmap.

• Driving Global Collaboration: You establish a cross-site culture, break down silos, and actively leverage synergies between our international locations to boost innovation and operational efficiency.

• Leading Through Innovation: You are a driving force for continuous improvement, establishing data-driven decision-making and integrating cutting-edge technologies into local workflows.

• Team Empowerment: You create an inclusive environment where exceptional results are the standard. You take full disciplinary and functional leadership of your team (including performance management and development) and foster a culture of psychological safety.

• Excellence and Compliance: You ensure that all product documentation strictly complies with legal guidelines and regulations while meeting the evolving needs of our US customers. Additionally, you are responsible for the budget planning and compliance of your unit.

Qualifications | What You Bring

• Education: A successfully completed degree in Technical Communication, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.

• Leadership Experience: 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams (preferably 10+ people). You have a proven track record of fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous growth.

• Industry Expertise: Sound experience in technical writing, content management, or IFU management, ideally within the medical device, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical industry.

• Pioneer Mindset: A "pioneer" mindset with experience leading teams through digital transformations. You comfortably navigate ambiguity and actively drive new ways of working.

• Project Management: Strong project management skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making to balance "quality on time" with long-term process optimization.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to operate successfully across cultures and time zones. Fluency in English is a given for this role.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indiana Base Pay Range $103,100 - $191,500 Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance, as well as participation in a long-term incentive program. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Benefits
Location: This position is based in Indianapoli

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Head of IFU Management US Core Lab , you will lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of approximately 10 Technical Writers at the Indianapolis site. Our Product Information teams ensure that customers worldwide receive precise, timely, and compliant documentation. Your mission is to guarantee that the Instructions for Use (IFU) for our US portfolio are delivered with top-notch quality, on time, and within budget—optimally supporting both business-critical product launches and key product lifecycle changes. You will actively help shape the next generation of product information by driving digital innovations (such as AI) and process optimizations.

Responsibilities | What to Expect

• Shaping the Future of Content: As a key member of the Product Information Leadership Team, you align operational processes in Indianapolis with our global strategic goals and digital transformation roadmap.

• Driving Global Collaboration: You establish a cross-site culture, break down silos, and actively leverage synergies between our international locations to boost innovation and operational efficiency.

• Leading Through Innovation: You are a driving force for continuous improvement, establishing data-driven decision-making and integrating cutting-edge technologies into local workflows.

• Team Empowerment: You create an inclusive environment where exceptional results are the standard. You take full disciplinary and functional leadership of your team (including performance management and development) and foster a culture of psychological safety.

• Excellence and Compliance: You ensure that all product documentation strictly complies with legal guidelines and regulations while meeting the evolving needs of our US customers. Additionally, you are responsible for the budget planning and compliance of your unit.

Qualifications | What You Bring

• Education: A successfully completed degree in Technical Communication, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.

• Leadership Experience: 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams (preferably 10+ people). You have a proven track record of fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous growth.

• Industry Expertise: Sound experience in technical writing, content management, or IFU management, ideally within the medical device, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical industry.

• Pioneer Mindset: A "pioneer" mindset with experience leading teams through digital transformations. You comfortably navigate ambiguity and actively drive new ways of working.

• Project Management: Strong project management skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making to balance "quality on time" with long-term process optimization.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to operate successfully across cultures and time zones. Fluency in English is a given for this role.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indiana Base Pay Range $103,100 - $191,500 Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance, as well as participation in a long-term incentive program. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Benefits
Location: This position is based in Indianapoli

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in our Market Access group within the UK and leads the Health Economics team to ensure we can gain reimbursement for our medicines.

As the Head of Health Economics and Outcomes , you are a visionary leader dedicated to ensuring UK patients have the best access to medicines in Europe. You will challenge and shape the UK reimbursement system, ensuring our value is demonstrated through innovative, high-standard health economics. You will demonstrate exceptional leadership and strategic thinking - be passionate about gaining access for all patients, but also plays a significant role in the UK and Globally to ensure healthcare systems are fit for purpose.

Your Impact

• You act as a Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach to inspire chapter members and foster a culture of growth and accountability.

• Collaborative Excellence: You remove silos and duplication across the organization to support our common "North Star".

• Strategic Leadership: You sign off on reimbursement dossiers and lead strategies that engage key stakeholders and pan-industry relationships.

• System Transformation: You play a significant role both in the UK and globally to ensure healthcare systems are fit for purpose.

• Resource Advocacy: You lead strategic planning to ensure your chapter is fully resourced and capable of meeting both current and future demands.

Who you are

• You have a strong track record in HE&OR is essential, as well as significant knowledge of the UK health system, and the ability to collaborate both locally and globally

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Health Economics

• Inspiring Coach who provides leadership of the Chapter Members within their Chapter, with a Creative Leadership mindset and the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) roles, and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organisation

• Fostering collaboration and expertise-sharing across the organisation to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill-sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the North Star

• Accountable for fostering a culture where every individual is able to bring their whole self & passion to work.

• Acting as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the centre of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.

• Lead strategic resource planning to ensure the chapter is fully resourced to meet demands of the organisation, and any resource constraints are constructively flagged, with a collaborative approach to find solutions

• Develop the long term strategy to ensure Chapter capabilities are fit for purpose now and in the future to meet internal and external demands

• Where applicable, ensuring "Foundational work" is completed, with continual review of HOW it's done to drive efficiency and minimise resource required to do it (without compromising on necessary standards)

• Ensuring ruthless prioritisation to avoid Chapter "work-creep" outside of Foundational work, Squad-prioritised work and Personal Develop

• Promuovere la collaborazione e la condivisione di competenze in tutta l'organizzazione per rimuovere silos e duplicazione, garantire un uso efficiente di simili set di abilità, e per sostenere in ultima analisi la ricerca comune della North Star
• Contabile per promuovere una cultura in cui ogni individuo è in grado di portare tutta la propria auto e passione a lavorare.
• Agire come tutore per elevati standard di conformità, etica e sicurezza; mettere i pazienti al centro di tutte le azioni da un comportamento aziendale coerente che rispetta le leggi applicabili, i codici del settore e il Codice di condotta di Roche.
• Guidare la pianificazione strategica delle risorse per garantire che il capitolo sia pienamente risorse per soddisfare le esigenze dell'organizzazione, e tutti i vincoli delle risorse sono improntati costruttivamente, con un approccio collaborativo per trovare soluzioni
• Sviluppare la strategia a lungo termine per garantire che le capacità del capitolo siano adatte a fini ora e in futuro per soddisfare le esigenze interne ed esterne
• Se applicabile, garantire il "lavoro fruttuoso" è completato, con la revisione continua di HOW è fatto per guidare l'efficienza e ridurre al minimo le risorse necessarie per farlo (senza compromettere le norme necessarie)
• Garantire priorità arrugginite per evitare il capitolo "lavoro-creep" al di fuori del lavoro della Fondazione, il lavoro-prioritizzato e lo sviluppo personale

• Führen Sie die strategische Ressourcenplanung, um sicherzustellen, dass das Kapitel vollständig mit Ressourcen ausgestattet ist, um die Anforderungen der Organisation zu erfüllen, und alle Ressourcenbeschränkungen konstruktiv markiert werden, mit einem kollaborativen Ansatz, um Lösungen zu finden
• Entwicklung einer langfristigen Strategie, um sicherzustellen, dass die Fähigkeiten von Chapter jetzt und in Zukunft für interne und externe Anforderungen geeignet sind
• Gegebenenfalls wird sichergestellt, dass "Grundlagenarbeiten" abgeschlossen sind, wobei ständig überprüft wird, WIE sie durchgeführt werden, um die Effizienz zu steigern und die dafür erforderlichen Ressourcen zu minimieren (ohne Kompromisse bei den erforderlichen Standards einzugehen).

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Ce rôle est au sein de notre groupe d'accès au marché au Royaume-Uni et dirige l'équipe d'économie de la santé pour s'assurer que nous pouvons obtenir le remboursement de nos médicaments. Vous allez défier et façonner le système de remboursement du Royaume-Uni, en vous assurant que notre valeur est démontrée par une économie de la santé innovante et de haut niveau. Vous ferez preuve d'un leadership exceptionnel et d'une réflexion stratégique - soyez passionnés par l'accès pour tous les patients, mais joue également un rôle important au Royaume-Uni et à l'échelle mondiale pour s'assurer que les systèmes de santé sont adaptés à l'objectif. • Vous avez une solide expérience en HE&OR est essentielle, ainsi qu'une connaissance importante du système de santé du Royaume-Uni, et la capacité de collaborer à l'échelle locale et mondiale

• Inspirant entraîneur qui assure le leadership des membres du Chapitre dans leur Chapitre, avec un esprit de leadership créatif et les rôles VACC (Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyst, Coach) et plus largement au besoin, pour s'assurer que les individus et les équipes se développent et se développent en fonction de leur passion et des besoins de l'Organisation
• Favoriser la collaboration et le partage d'expertise dans l'ensemble de l'organisation afin d'éliminer les cloisonnements et les doubles emplois, d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ensembles de compétences similaires et, en fin de compte, de soutenir la poursuite commune du North Star
• Responsable de la promotion d'une culture où chaque individu est capable d'apporter tout son soi et sa passion au travail.

• Diriger la planification stratégique des ressources pour s'assurer que le chapitre est entièrement doté de ressources pour répondre aux demandes de l'organisation, et que toutes les contraintes en matière de ressources sont identifiées de manière constructive, avec une approche collaborative pour trouver des solutions
• Élaborer une stratégie à long terme pour s'assurer que les capacités du chapitre sont aptes à répondre aux besoins internes et externes.
• S'il y a lieu, en veillant à ce que le «travail de base» soit terminé, avec un examen continu de la façon dont il a été fait pour stimuler l'efficacité et réduire au minimum les ressources nécessaires (sans compromettre les normes nécessaires)

jobs.title: Internship Robotics - 12 months
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In a global, cross-functional environment the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

The Opportunity

As our Intern you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on automating and tooling in the context of development and product care of complex diagnostics systems, consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaboration of (Cobots-) Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment, to support our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operation and workflows.

• Programming, testing and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams with the installation of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment.

• Plan, coordinate and execute small work packages within your area of responsibility including reporting and escalation of topics or issues to the management.

• Be able to work as an individual as well as part of a team.

Who You Are

You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry and bring the following qualifications:

• You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor- / Master student or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months), preferably in computer science with specific knowledge in e.g. robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is an advantage).

• You are able to communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• Knowledge of one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW etc.)

• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking.

• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university as part of the application documents, stating that an internship is mandatory.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Sei attualmente iscritto come studente di laurea / Master o si è recentemente laureato (nel corso degli ultimi 12 mesi), preferibilmente in informatica con conoscenze specifiche in robotica e/o visione, ingegneria elettrica o ingegneria dei sistemi o equivalente.

• Siete in grado di comunicare in modo appropriato con diversi gruppi target.
• Conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW ecc.)
• Siete motivati a costruire, gestire e promuovere relazioni e reti all'interno del dipartimento e dei progetti correlati.
• Rapida comprensione e comprensione di problemi complessi, pensiero concettuale e creativo.

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Regulatory AI & Automation Specialist , you will be responsible for acting as the strategic bridge between regulatory science and technology, driving digital transformation within the PDR organization. In this role, you will design, develop, and implement intelligent automation and generative AI solutions, eliminating repetitive tasks and optimizing operational processes to bring efficiency and agility to a global community of over 500 regulatory professionals.

The Opportunity

• Design, develop, and deploy scalable automation solutions (such as RPA, Python scripts, UiPath workflows, or No-Code/Low-Code tools) to optimize global regulatory processes.

• Research, experiment with, and implement applications based on Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and natural language processing (NLP) tailored to regulatory document management.

• Partner closely with business analysts, regulatory subject matter experts, and global leaders to map current operational processes and identify critical automation opportunities.

• Provide ongoing technical support, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting for automation and AI solutions already deployed in production.

• Author and maintain rigorous technical documentation, including solution architecture, source code, user guides, and testing methodologies.

• Design and deliver internal training programs to empower regulatory teams in the adoption and effective use of AI and automation technologies.

• Present performance metrics, project updates, and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and organizational leadership (with a scope of influence aligned to the experience level).

Who you are

• University degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Health Sciences with a strong technological focus, or a related field.

• Proven experience in designing and developing process automation (RPA) solutions, workflows, and implementing AI tools (minimum 2–3 years for a Junior profile; 4+ years for a Senior profile).

• Solid technical and programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL, and automation environments (UiPath, Power Automate, or Cloud platforms), along with familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile).

• Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks and industry registration procedures is highly valued.

• Fluent and advanced English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively interact, influence, and present findings to global teams across multiple time zones.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, a system-thinking mindset, resilience, and a strong passion for innovation focused on radically simplifying business processes.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

• Proven experience in designing and developing process automation (RPA) solutions, workflows, and implementing AI tools (minimum 2–3 years for a Junior profile; 4+ years for a Senior profile).

• Solid technical and programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL, and automation environments (UiPath, Power Automate, or Cloud platforms), along with familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile).

• Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks and industry registration procedures is highly valued.

• Fluent and advanced English language skills (both written and spoken) to effectively interact, influence, and present findings to global teams across multiple time zones.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, a system-thinking mindset, resilience, and a strong passion for innovation focused on radically simplifying business processes.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - GenMark, you will:

• be responsible for promoting GenMark’s products and services.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory includes New Jersey, Philadelphia, and Baltimore.

Travel expectation: Up to 25% Overnight travel expected

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

jobs.title: Outcomes & Capability Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Outcomes & Capability Lead, you will work with the affiliate’s Enabling Team to provide strategic guidance. Your primary role consists of driving business effectiveness and catalyzing innovation to deliver our Pharma Vision by embedding new skills and innovation frameworks to support team effectiveness and performance, as well as developing the overarching operations framework and fostering collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Secondly, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the strategy for capability development (mindset, knowledge, and skills) across the organization based on customer needs.

Your Opportunity

The responsibilities for this role include:

• Vision Realization: Drive the realization of our organization’s vision and defined outcomes of the Colombia Enabling Team (CET) while ensuring operational effectiveness of the leadership team.

• Strategic Partnering: Partner closely with the General Manager and Chapter Leads to enable the achievement of Colombia Outcomes.

• Ambition Management: Plan, track, and provide project management support to monitor progress and delivery of short-term and long-term ambitions, priorities, and outcomes of the affiliate.

• International Connectivity: Partner with other Pharma International Functions to foster agility and augment end-to-end value delivery to the business.

• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coach, train, and educate teams for high performance, guiding them in finding their own journey to self-organization, self-sufficiency, and adopting new ways of working and business principles.

• Mindset Transformation: Leverage a range of tools and practices to enable sustainable change of mindsets and behaviors as required on best practice and be a champion of connecting dots and activating the learning loop across the organization.

• Team Empowerment: Work in a self-managed, fully empowered team to shape what and how you deliver for the organization and your internal customers, collaborating with other chapters to shape the organizational culture.

• Commercialization Capability Plan: Design the Integrated Capability Development Plan for commercialization roles, ensuring the integration of technical capabilities and skills through self-management, according to customer needs and filial outcomes.

• Learning Ecosystem: Catalyze the development and reuse of models, materials, and tools from the global network to support ecosystem teams and individual colleagues in learning and development activities.

• Training Effectiveness: Facilitate, coordinate, and track training activities according to regional and filial priorities, ensuring continuous improvement and effectiveness of tools through evaluation methods and data analytics.

Who you are

The person in this role is a Lean-Agile Leader with a Lean-Agile Mindset, driving innovation, adaptation to change, and encouraging teams to be curious and question the status quo. Possess s trong expert knowledge about and experience with working by outcomes, with a clear goal orientation and commitment to create value in line with corporate objectives.
Thrives on collaboration, with the ability to bring people together and mobilize teams by building effective relationships to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries, promoting diversity. Is a ble to motivate, challenge, and coach senior leaders in the organization while fostering an environment of feedback, along with the ability to negotiate agreements and persuade

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come il risultato & Capability Lead, lavorerai con il team di abilitazione della filiale per fornire una guida strategica. Il vostro ruolo principale consiste nel guidare l'efficacia del business e catalizzare l'innovazione per fornire la nostra visione di Pharma incorporando nuove competenze e nuovi framework di innovazione per supportare l'efficacia e le prestazioni del team, oltre a sviluppare il quadro operativo di overarching e promuovere la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. In secondo luogo, sarete responsabili per la definizione e l'attuazione della strategia per lo sviluppo delle capacità (mindset, conoscenze e competenze) in tutta l'organizzazione basata sulle esigenze del cliente. La tua opportunità Le responsabilità di questo ruolo includono:
• Realizzazione Visione: Guidare la realizzazione della visione della nostra organizzazione e dei risultati definiti del Team Colombia Eattiva (CET) garantendo al contempo l’efficacia operativa del team di leadership.
• Partner Strategico: Partner a stretto contatto con il Direttore Generale e il Capitolo porta a consentire il raggiungimento dei risultati della Colombia.
• Gestione dell'ambizione: Piano, traccia e fornire supporto alla gestione del progetto per monitorare il progresso e la consegna di ambizioni, priorità e risultati a breve termine e a lungo termine della filiale.
• Connettività internazionale: Partner con altre Funzioni internazionali di Pharma per promuovere l'agilità e aumentare la distribuzione end-to-end del valore al business.
• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coach, treno e educare i team per alte prestazioni, guidandoli a trovare il proprio viaggio per l'auto-organizzazione, l'autosufficienza, e l'adozione di nuovi modi di lavoro e principi aziendali.
• Mindset Transformation: Leva una gamma di strumenti e pratiche per consentire un cambiamento sostenibile di mentalità e comportamenti come richiesto nella migliore pratica e essere un campione di punti di connessione e di attivazione del loop di apprendimento attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Team Empowerment: Lavorare in un team autogestito e pienamente abilitato per modellare cosa e come consegnare per l'organizzazione e i vostri clienti interni, collaborando con altri capitoli per modellare la cultura organizzativa.
• Piano di Capacità di Commercializzazione: Progettare il Piano di Sviluppo Capability Integrato per ruoli di commercializzazione, garantendo l'integrazione di capacità tecniche e competenze attraverso l'autogestione, in base alle esigenze del cliente e risultati filiale.
• Ecosistema di apprendimento: catalizzare lo sviluppo e il riutilizzo di modelli, materiali e strumenti della rete globale per supportare team di ecosistemi e singoli colleghi nelle attività di apprendimento e sviluppo.
• Efficacia della formazione: Facilitare, coordinare e monitorare le attività di formazione secondo le priorità regionali e filiali, garantendo un miglioramento continuo e un'efficacia degli strumenti attraverso metodi di valutazione e analisi dei dati. Chi sei La persona in questo ruolo è un Leader Lean-Agile con un Mindset Lean-Agile, guidando l'innovazione, l'adattamento al cambiamento, e incoraggiando i team a essere curiosi e mettere in discussione lo status quo. Possess s trong know-how esperto e l'esperienza con il lavoro da risultati, con un orientamento obiettivo chiaro e l'impegno a creare valore in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali. Thrives sulla collaborazione, con la capacità di riunire le persone e mobilitare i team costruendo relazioni efficaci per lavorare verso lo stesso scopo attraverso i confini organizzativi, promuovendo la diversità. È in grado di motivare, sfidare e coach senior leader nell'organizzazione, mentre promuovere un ambiente di feedback, insieme alla capacità di negoziare accordi e convincere

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Outcomes & Capability Lead arbeiten Sie mit dem Enabling Team des Affiliates zusammen, um strategische Beratung zu bieten. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Geschäftseffektivität zu steigern und Innovationen zu katalysieren, um unsere Pharma Vision zu erfüllen, indem Sie neue Fähigkeiten und Innovationsrahmen zur Unterstützung der Teameffektivität und -leistung einbinden sowie den übergreifenden Betriebsrahmen entwickeln und die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern fördern. Zweitens sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die Strategie für die Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten (Mindset, Wissen und Fähigkeiten) im gesamten Unternehmen basierend auf den Kundenbedürfnissen zu definieren und umzusetzen. Ihre Chance Die Verantwortlichkeiten für diese Rolle umfassen:
• Vision Realisation: Die Verwirklichung der Vision unserer Organisation und der definierten Ergebnisse des Colombia Enabling Teams (CET) vorantreiben und gleichzeitig die operative Effektivität des Führungsteams sicherstellen.
• Strategische Partnerschaft: Enge Partnerschaft mit dem General Manager und den Chapter Leads, um die Erreichung der Ergebnisse von Kolumbien zu ermöglichen.
• Ambition Management: Planen, verfolgen und unterstützen Sie das Projektmanagement, um den Fortschritt und die Umsetzung der kurz- und langfristigen Ambitionen, Prioritäten und Ergebnisse des Affiliates zu überwachen.
• International Connectivity: Partnerschaft mit anderen internationalen Pharma-Funktionen, um die Agilität zu fördern und die Wertschöpfung für das Unternehmen zu erhöhen.
• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coachen, trainieren und bilden Teams für hohe Leistung, führen sie bei der Suche nach ihrer eigenen Reise zur Selbstorganisation, Selbstversorgung und Annahme neuer Arbeitsweisen und Geschäftsprinzipien.
• Mindset Transformation: Nutzen Sie eine Reihe von Tools und Praktiken, um eine nachhaltige Veränderung von Denkweisen und Verhaltensweisen zu ermöglichen, wie es für Best Practices erforderlich ist, und seien Sie ein Champion der Verknüpfung von Punkten und der Aktivierung der Lernschleife in der gesamten Organisation.
• Team Empowerment: Arbeiten Sie in einem selbstverwalteten, voll ausgestatteten Team, um zu gestalten, was und wie Sie für das Unternehmen und Ihre internen Kunden liefern, und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Kapiteln zusammen, um die Organisationskultur zu gestalten.
• Kommerzialisierungsfähigkeitsplan: Entwerfen Sie den integrierten Fähigkeitsentwicklungsplan für Kommerzialisierungsrollen und stellen Sie die Integration technischer Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten durch Selbstmanagement sicher, entsprechend den Kundenbedürfnissen und den kindlichen Ergebnissen.
• Lernendes Ökosystem: Katalysieren Sie die Entwicklung und Wiederverwendung von Modellen, Materialien und Werkzeugen aus dem globalen Netzwerk, um Ökosystemteams und einzelne Kollegen bei Lern- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.
• Trainingseffektivität: Erleichterung, Koordination und Verfolgung von Schulungsaktivitäten nach regionalen und kindlichen Prioritäten, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Wirksamkeit der Tools durch Bewertungsmethoden und Datenanalysen zu gewährleisten. Wer du bist Die Person in dieser Rolle ist eine Lean-Agile-Führungskraft mit einer Lean-Agile-Mentalität, die Innovation, Anpassung an Veränderungen vorantreibt und Teams ermutigt, neugierig zu sein und den Status quo in Frage zu stellen. Besitzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen und Ihre Erfahrung mit der Arbeit nach Ergebnissen, mit einer klaren Zielorientierung und der Verpflichtung, Werte im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen zu schaffen. Gedeiht von der Zusammenarbeit, mit der Fähigkeit, Menschen zusammenzubringen und Teams zu mobilisieren, indem effektive Beziehungen aufgebaut werden, um über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg auf den gleichen Zweck hinzuarbeiten und Vielfalt zu fördern. Ist eine Fähigkeit, leitende Führungskräfte in der Organisation zu motivieren, herauszufordern und zu coachen, während ein Umfeld von Feedback gefördert wird, zusammen mit der Fähigkeit, Vereinbarungen auszuhandeln und zu überzeugen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que responsable des résultats et des capacités, vous travaillerez avec l'équipe habilitante affiliée pour fournir des orientations stratégiques. Votre rôle principal consiste à stimuler l'efficacité de l'entreprise et à catalyser l'innovation afin d'offrir notre Vision Pharma en intégrant de nouvelles compétences et de nouveaux cadres d'innovation pour soutenir l'efficacité et le rendement de l'équipe, ainsi qu'en élaborant le cadre d'opérations global et en favorisant la collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes. Deuxièmement, vous serez responsable de la définition et de la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie de développement des capacités (esprits, connaissances et compétences) dans l'ensemble de l'organisation en fonction des besoins des clients. Votre opportunité Les responsabilités pour ce rôle comprennent :
• Réalisation de la vision : Conduire la réalisation de la vision de notre organisation et les résultats définis de l'équipe d'habilitation de Colombie (EEC) tout en assurant l'efficacité opérationnelle de l'équipe de leadership.
• Partenariat stratégique : Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur général et les chefs de chapitre pour permettre la réalisation des résultats de la Colombie.
• Gestion des ambitions : Planifier, suivre et fournir un soutien à la gestion de projet pour surveiller les progrès et la réalisation des ambitions, des priorités et des résultats à court et à long terme de la filiale.
• Connectivité internationale: Partenaire avec d'autres fonctions Pharma International pour favoriser l'agilité et augmenter la livraison de valeur de bout en bout à l'entreprise.
• Coaching & Ways of Working: Coach, train, and education teams for high performance, les guidant à trouver leur propre chemin vers l'auto-organisation, l'autosuffisance, et l'adoption de nouvelles façons de travailler et de principes d'affaires.
• Transformation des mentalités : Tirer parti d'une gamme d'outils et de pratiques pour permettre un changement durable des mentalités et des comportements selon les meilleures pratiques et être un champion des points de connexion et activer la boucle d'apprentissage dans toute l'organisation.
• Autonomisation de l'équipe : Travaillez dans une équipe autogérée et pleinement habilitée à façonner ce que vous offrez à l'organisation et à vos clients internes, en collaborant avec d'autres chapitres pour façonner la culture organisationnelle.
• Plan de capacité de commercialisation : Concevoir le plan de développement intégré des capacités pour les rôles de commercialisation, en assurant l'intégration des capacités et des compétences techniques par l'autogestion, en fonction des besoins des clients et des résultats filiaux.
• Écosystèmes d'apprentissage : catalysez le développement et la réutilisation de modèles, de matériaux et d'outils provenant du réseau mondial afin d'appuyer les équipes écosystémiques et les collègues individuels dans les activités d'apprentissage et de développement.
• Efficacité de la formation : Faciliter, coordonner et suivre les activités de formation selon les priorités régionales et filiales, en assurant l'amélioration et l'efficacité continues des outils grâce aux méthodes d'évaluation et à l'analyse des données. Qui vous êtes La personne dans ce rôle est un Leader Lean-Agile avec un Mindset Lean-Agile, moteur de l'innovation, l'adaptation au changement, et encourager les équipes à être curieux et questionner le statu quo. Posséder des connaissances et de l'expérience spécialisées sur le travail par résultats, avec une orientation claire des objectifs et un engagement à créer de la valeur conformément aux objectifs de l'organisation. S'appuie sur la collaboration, avec la capacité de réunir les gens et de mobiliser les équipes en établissant des relations efficaces pour travailler dans le même but au-delà des frontières organisationnelles, en favorisant la diversité. Est capable de motiver, de défier et d'entraîner les cadres supérieurs de l'organisation tout en favorisant un environnement de rétroaction, ainsi que la capacité de négocier des ententes et de persuader

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
***24 month contract position**

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. As a global healthcare leader operating in over 100 countries, we combine the strengths of our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions to drive the future of personalized healthcare. We thrive on innovation, scientific excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering sustainable, high-quality medical solutions.

As part of our ambitious 10-year Pharma vision, we are dedicated to delivering more benefits to patients by integrating innovative technology and systems into our lifecycle management processes. By joining Roche, you will be part of a dynamic, diverse, and inspiring environment where your work has a direct, meaningful impact on patients worldwide.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a proactive and pragmatic Business Capability Specialist to join our Pharma Technical Quality (PTQ) ASPIRE Sustainment team. In this role, you will serve as the primary tactical driver owning the lifecycle of Deviations, CAPAs, and Planned Events, bridging the gap between intricate quality challenges and compliant technical solutions within our ERP and Quality Systems (SAP S/4HANA, BRH).

Your core responsibilities will include:

• Serving as the Technical Subject Matter Expert: Act as the hands-on expert for SAP S/4HANA and BRH systems, serving as the primary author for system-related deviations, leading technical investigations, and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

• Managing System Lifecycle and CAPAs: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), tracking milestone completion and verifying the effectiveness of implemented solutions to prevent recurrence.

• Coordinating Planned Events: Lead the documentation and coordination of planned system enhancements, maintenance, and upgrades, ensuring all quality impact assessments are robust and pre-approved.

• Executing Tactical Change Management: Support the Strategy Lead by executing the tactical steps of IT Change Requests while ensuring all Computer Systems Validation (CSV) documentation is audit-ready and compliant with GMP Annex 11.

• Ensuring System Health and Sustained Operations: Monitor daily system health in SAP and BRH to proactively identify process pain points and resolve technical bottleneck red flags before they escalate into critical incidents.

• Driving Data Integrity and Governance: Harvest high-quality data from QMS and ERP systems to populate strategic KPIs and dashboards, acting as a steward for record data integrity.

• Leading Audit Readiness and Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain a constant state of audit readiness, serving as the primary SME for record walkthroughs during inspections, while collaborating with IT and Business Process Owners to unblock stalled records.

Who you are
You are a collaborative, open-minded professional who values continuous learning, thrives in dynamic environments, and balances a strict compliance mindset with a focus on impactful execution.To be successful in this role, you bring the following qualifications and skills:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent technical/vocational qualification.

• You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience working within a heavily regulated GxP environment (Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech).

• You possess deep, expert-level navigation experience within SAP (preferably S/4HANA) and Quality Systems (such as Veeva Vault Quality / B

• Hai una laurea in Scienze della vita, Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo correlato, o una qualifica tecnica / professionale equivalente.
• Porti 5 anni di esperienza pratica lavorando in un ambiente GxP fortemente regolamentato (Pharma, Biotech, o MedTech).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
***24 month contract position**

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. As a global healthcare leader operating in over 100 countries, we combine the strengths of our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions to drive the future of personalized healthcare. We thrive on innovation, scientific excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering sustainable, high-quality medical solutions.

As part of our ambitious 10-year Pharma vision, we are dedicated to delivering more benefits to patients by integrating innovative technology and systems into our lifecycle management processes. By joining Roche, you will be part of a dynamic, diverse, and inspiring environment where your work has a direct, meaningful impact on patients worldwide.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a proactive and pragmatic Business Capability Specialist to join our Pharma Technical Quality (PTQ) ASPIRE Sustainment team. In this role, you will serve as the primary tactical driver owning the lifecycle of Deviations, CAPAs, and Planned Events, bridging the gap between intricate quality challenges and compliant technical solutions within our ERP and Quality Systems (SAP S/4HANA, BRH).

Your core responsibilities will include:

• Serving as the Technical Subject Matter Expert: Act as the hands-on expert for SAP S/4HANA and BRH systems, serving as the primary author for system-related deviations, leading technical investigations, and performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

• Managing System Lifecycle and CAPAs: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), tracking milestone completion and verifying the effectiveness of implemented solutions to prevent recurrence.

• Coordinating Planned Events: Lead the documentation and coordination of planned system enhancements, maintenance, and upgrades, ensuring all quality impact assessments are robust and pre-approved.

• Executing Tactical Change Management: Support the Strategy Lead by executing the tactical steps of IT Change Requests while ensuring all Computer Systems Validation (CSV) documentation is audit-ready and compliant with GMP Annex 11.

• Ensuring System Health and Sustained Operations: Monitor daily system health in SAP and BRH to proactively identify process pain points and resolve technical bottleneck red flags before they escalate into critical incidents.

• Driving Data Integrity and Governance: Harvest high-quality data from QMS and ERP systems to populate strategic KPIs and dashboards, acting as a steward for record data integrity.

• Leading Audit Readiness and Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain a constant state of audit readiness, serving as the primary SME for record walkthroughs during inspections, while collaborating with IT and Business Process Owners to unblock stalled records.

Who you are
You are a collaborative, open-minded professional who values continuous learning, thrives in dynamic environments, and balances a strict compliance mindset with a focus on impactful execution.To be successful in this role, you bring the following qualifications and skills:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent technical/vocational qualification.

• You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience working within a heavily regulated GxP environment (Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech).

• You possess deep, expert-level navigation experience within SAP (preferably S/4HANA) and Quality Systems (such as Veeva Vault Quality / B

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. We serve our patients through external partnerships because access to quality products is every patient’s right. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Technology Product Owner Specialist (PO) or Sub-Product Owner in Roche PT's Network Quality QA/QC Operational Systems team plays a pivotal role in standardizing and optimizing the systems and technology that power Quality operations and data insights. The PO is responsible for defining and implementing the overall Technology strategy for PT Quality, acting as the Global Product Owner for applicable PT technologies. A core function of the role is translating complex business use cases and requirements into standardized, compliant technology solutions, requiring a blend of technical expertise and business acumen. The PO collaborates with cross-functional teams, including Business, IT, and Validation, to ensure that high-quality, innovative solutions are defined, developed, and implemented. The role also involves managing the global master data entity and assisting the organization with expertise during regulatory inspections and the resolution of deviations.

This position requires a collaborative and open-minded individual who is capable of maintaining and transforming integral technologies while valuing continuous learning. The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

The Opportunity:

• Drive System Strategy: Serve as a global Technology PT Product Owner for QMS technologies (specifically Quality Vault QMS but can include Veeva Quality Docs ), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Direct the entire system lifecycle—including upgrades, system replacements, and retirements—while strictly adhering to established change management processes.

• Shape Product Roadmaps: Partner closely with key Business Stakeholders and IT to define the product vision, align roadmaps, manage feature backlogs, and prioritize system enhancements.

• Ensure Compliance & Data Stewardship: Act as the dedicated Business Data Steward, ensuring unwavering GxP compliance, strict data governance, and adherence to global quality policies.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilize and lead high-performing, cross-functional teams spanning global Learning departments, business stakeholders, IT partners, and validation functions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• Govern the Veeva QMS System : Manage the integration and structural nuances of the Veeva QMS and or Quality Docs ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow, reporting, and interface connectivity across global manufacturing and commercial sites.

​
Who You are:

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Veeva Quality Vault

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, prosperiamo per fornire più benefici ai nostri pazienti come parte della nostra visione Pharma di 10 anni. Serviamo i nostri pazienti attraverso partnership esterne perché l’accesso ai prodotti di qualità è diritto di ogni paziente. Ci avvaliamo di partner esterni per offrire flessibilità alla nostra capacità interna al giusto costo e qualità. Permettiamo ai nostri partner esterni di fornire in modo affidabile prodotti conformi e di qualità ai nostri clienti della supply chain, in modo che possiamo consegnare ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Lo facciamo attraverso collaborazioni interfunzionali che garantiscono eccellenza del processo di qualità e miglioramento continuo. Il team di sistemi operativi QA/QC di qualità di rete di Roche PT svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella standardizzazione e nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi e della tecnologia che alimentano operazioni di qualità e informazioni sui dati. Il PO è responsabile per la definizione e l'attuazione della strategia tecnologica globale per la qualità PT, che funge da Global Product Owner per le tecnologie PT applicabili. Una funzione fondamentale del ruolo sta traducendo complessi casi di uso aziendale e requisiti in soluzioni tecnologiche standardizzate e conformi, che richiedono una miscela di competenze tecniche e di business acum. Il PO collabora con team interfunzionali, tra cui Business, IT e Validation, per garantire che le soluzioni innovative di alta qualità siano definite, sviluppate e implementate. Il ruolo è anche quello di gestire l'entità globale dei dati master e assistere l'organizzazione con competenza durante le ispezioni normative e la risoluzione delle deviazioni. Questa posizione richiede un individuo collaborativo e aperto che è in grado di mantenere e trasformare le tecnologie integrali, valutando l'apprendimento continuo. Il candidato di successo deve essere qualcuno che presumibilmente sfida idee, privilegia il lavoro d'impatto, e può essere invocata per operare nel miglior interesse del team, prosperando in un ambiente di lavoro dinamico. L'opportunità:
• Strategia del sistema di trasmissione: Servire come un Global Technology PT Product Owner per le tecnologie QMS (in particolare Quality Vault QMS, ma può includere Veeva Quality Docs ), traducendo efficacemente i requisiti aziendali complessi in soluzioni tecniche standardizzate.
• Gestisci Lifecycle & Governance: Dirigere l'intero ciclo di vita del sistema, compresi gli aggiornamenti, i sostituti del sistema e i pensionati, mentre aderiscono rigorosamente ai processi di gestione dei cambiamenti stabiliti.
• Roadmap del prodotto: Partner a stretto contatto con i principali stakeholder aziendali e IT per definire la visione del prodotto, allineare le roadmap, gestire backlog delle funzionalità e priorità miglioramenti del sistema.
• Assicurare Compliance & Data Stewardship: agire come il Business Data Steward dedicato, assicurando la conformità GxP in continuo, la governance dei dati rigorosa e l'adesione alle politiche di qualità globali.
• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilitare e condurre team altamente performanti e interfunzionali che spaziano dai dipartimenti di apprendimento globali, dagli stakeholder aziendali, dai partner IT e dalle funzioni di validazione.
• Ottimizzare Processi e Sistemi: Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestire deviazioni e CAPAs, e supervisionare la convalida dei dati master all'interno di sistemi di qualità convalidati.
• Governare il sistema QMS di Veeva: gestire l'integrazione e le sfumature strutturali dell'ecosistema Veeva QMS e o Quality Docs, assicurando flussi di dati senza soluzione di continuità, reportistica e connettività di interfaccia tra i siti produttivi e commerciali globali. ​ Chi sei:
• Possiedi una profonda competenza tecnica: porti 7+ anni di esperienza in Veeva Quality Vault

Der PO arbeitet mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams wie Business, IT und Validation zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass hochwertige, innovative Lösungen definiert, entwickelt und umgesetzt werden. Die Aufgabe besteht auch darin, die globale Stammdateneinheit zu verwalten und die Organisation bei regulatorischen Inspektionen und der Lösung von Abweichungen mit Fachwissen zu unterstützen. Diese Position erfordert eine kollaborative und aufgeschlossene Person, die in der Lage ist, integrale Technologien beizubehalten und zu transformieren und gleichzeitig kontinuierliches Lernen zu schätzen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat muss jemand sein, der Ideen nachdenklich herausfordert, wirkungsvolle Arbeit priorisiert und sich darauf verlassen kann, im besten Interesse des Teams zu arbeiten und in einer dynamischen Arbeitsumgebung zu gedeihen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Drive System Strategy: Dienen Sie als globaler Technology PT Product Owner für QMS-Technologien (insbesondere Quality Vault QMS, kann aber Veeva Quality Docs enthalten) und übersetzen Sie komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen effektiv in standardisierte technische Lösungen.
• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Lenken Sie den gesamten Systemlebenszyklus – einschließlich Upgrades, Systemersatz und Pensionierungen – unter strikter Einhaltung der festgelegten Change-Management-Prozesse.
• Produkt-Roadmaps gestalten: Enge Partnerschaft mit wichtigen Business-Stakeholdern und IT, um die Produktvision zu definieren, Roadmaps auszurichten, Feature-Backlogs zu verwalten und Systemverbesserungen zu priorisieren.
• Sicherstellen von Compliance & Data Stewardship: Handeln Sie als dedizierter Business Data Steward und gewährleisten Sie die unerschütterliche GxP-Compliance, strenge Data Governance und die Einhaltung globaler Qualitätsrichtlinien.
• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams: Mobilisieren und leiten Sie leistungsstarke, funktionsübergreifende Teams aus globalen Lernabteilungen, Geschäftsbeteiligten, IT-Partnern und Validierungsfunktionen.

• Verwalten Sie das Veeva QMS-System: Verwalten Sie die Integration und die strukturellen Nuancen des Veeva QMS- und oder Quality Docs-Ökosystems und gewährleisten Sie einen nahtlosen Datenfluss, Reporting und Schnittstellenkonnektivität an globalen Fertigungs- und Handelsstandorten. ​ Wer Du bist:
• Sie verfügen über fundierte technische Expertise: Sie bringen 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in Veeva Quality Vault

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous nous épanouissons pour offrir plus de bienfaits à nos patients dans le cadre de notre vision de 10 ans de Pharma. Nous servons nos patients grâce à des partenariats externes parce que l'accès à des produits de qualité est le droit de chaque patient. Nous mobilisons des partenaires externes pour offrir une flexibilité à notre capacité interne au bon coût et à la bonne qualité. Nous permettons à nos partenaires externes de livrer de manière fiable des produits conformes et de qualité à nos clients de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, afin que nous puissions livrer aux patients du monde entier. Nous le faisons grâce à des collaborations interfonctionnelles assurant l'excellence des processus de qualité et l'amélioration continue. Le spécialiste du propriétaire de produits technologiques (PO) ou le propriétaire de sous-produits de l'équipe de systèmes opérationnels QA/QC de qualité réseau de Roche PT joue un rôle central dans la normalisation et l'optimisation des systèmes et de la technologie qui alimentent les opérations et les données de qualité. Le PO est responsable de la définition et de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie technologique globale pour la qualité des PT, en tant que propriétaire mondial de produits pour les technologies de PT applicables. Une fonction essentielle du rôle consiste à traduire les cas et les exigences complexes en solutions technologiques normalisées et conformes, ce qui exige un mélange d'expertise technique et de sens des affaires. Le BP collabore avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, dont Business, IT et Validation, pour s'assurer que des solutions innovantes de haute qualité sont définies, développées et mises en œuvre. Le rôle consiste également à gérer l'entité mondiale de données maîtresses et à aider l'organisation à posséder des compétences lors des inspections réglementaires et de la résolution des écarts. Cette position exige une personne collaborative et ouverte d'esprit qui est capable de maintenir et de transformer des technologies intégrales tout en valorisant l'apprentissage continu. Le candidat retenu doit être quelqu'un qui remet en question les idées de façon réfléchie, accorde la priorité au travail qui a un impact, et on peut compter sur lui pour fonctionner dans le meilleur intérêt de l'équipe, dans un milieu de travail dynamique. La possibilité :
• Drive System Strategy: Servez-vous d'une technologie mondiale PT Product Owner pour les technologies QMS (en particulier Quality Vault QMS mais peut inclure Veeva Quality Docs ), traduisant efficacement les exigences opérationnelles complexes en solutions techniques normalisées.
• Gérer le cycle de vie et la gouvernance : Diriger l'ensemble du cycle de vie du système, y compris les mises à niveau, les remplacements et les retraites, tout en respectant strictement les processus de gestion du changement établis.
• Former des feuilles de route pour les produits : S'associer étroitement avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux et les TI pour définir la vision du produit, aligner les feuilles de route, gérer les arriérés de fonctionnalités et prioriser les améliorations du système.
• Assurer la conformité et la gérance des données : agir en tant que délégué aux données commerciales, assurer la conformité sans faille à la GxP, la stricte gouvernance des données et le respect des politiques de qualité mondiales.
• Équipes interfonctionnelles de premier plan : Mobilisez et dirigez des équipes interfonctionnelles hautement performantes couvrant les départements de l'apprentissage mondial, les partenaires commerciaux, les partenaires informatiques et les fonctions de validation.
• Optimiser les processus et les systèmes : Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer les écarts et les APC, et superviser la validation des données de base dans les systèmes de qualité validés.
• Gouvernance du système QMS de Veeva : Gérer l'intégration et les nuances structurelles de l'écosystème QMS de Veeva et ou Quality Docs, en assurant un flux de données sans faille, des rapports et une connectivité d'interface entre les sites mondiaux de fabrication et commerciaux. ​ Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez une expertise technique approfondie : vous apportez 7 ans d'expérience dans Veeva Quality Vault

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the mechanical design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on solving the mechanical challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for concepting, designing, building, and testing novel electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, and fluidic solutions that ensure the ultimate performance, reliability, and longevity of our systems.

The Senior Mechanical Engineer will play a vital role in driving innovation for our next-generation instrumentation. We are looking for someone that exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to novel DNA Sequencing and automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

The Opportunity

• You will design and develop sub-systems, including electro-mechanical, pneumatic, fluidic, thermal, and consumable components.

• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (including electrical, consumables, and materials engineers) to define and manage critical technical interfaces for your module.

• You will have ownership of your sub-systems during verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with Systems Integration engineers.

• You will conduct cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs between mechanical design, materials, and assay requirements.

• You will drive technical execution for sub-systems, manage design deliverable timelines, and contribute to the overall project plan.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed CAD models, drawings, and specifications.

• You will present technical progress, data, and design trade-offs to the project team and stakeholders, clearly articulating the impact of engineering decisions.

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. E' questo che ci rende Roche. A Roche, stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di prossima generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per la sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con un risultato di campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro. Il nostro System Technology Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sulla creazione e l'avanzamento di tecnologie per migliorare in modo significativo i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento del DNA. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere meccanico senior per contribuire alla progettazione meccanica, sviluppo, caratterizzazione e integrazione di sistemi di sequenziamento all'avanguardia. Questo è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide meccaniche al centro delle nostre piattaforme di prossima generazione. Sarete responsabili di concettualizzare, progettare, costruire e testare nuove soluzioni elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche e fluidiche che garantiscono la massima performance, affidabilità e longevità dei nostri sistemi. L'Ingegnere Meccanico Senior svolgerà un ruolo vitale nella guida dell'innovazione per la nostra strumentazione di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni per nuove sfide di DNA Sequencing e automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo.
