Sosterrete l'automazione di algoritmi di patologia, flussi di lavoro e piattaforme, rimanendo responsabili per la consegna scientifica dei dati di patologia per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi.
• Patologia Tossicologica Core Portfolio: Fornire un supporto di patologia esperto nello sviluppo preclinico, allineare i progetti di studio tossicologico con le attuali linee guida scientifiche e regolamentari. Condurre valutazioni qualitative e quantitative (sito)patologiche per la scoperta e lo sviluppo di studi tossicologici, compresi gli studi conformi al GLP. Peer-review dati e interpretazioni istopatologiche dai patologi interni o CRO per i SOP consolidati. Integra i dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, chimica clinica) con i risultati di istopatologia per un'interpretazione olistica e meccanistica della tossicità. Fornire chiare e concise interpretazioni dei risultati dei test e sezioni di patologia dell'autore per i Rapporti di ricerca, i documenti normativi (ad esempio, IND/CTA) e le presentazioni di governance.
• Deployment: Proporre, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni e algoritmi di analisi delle immagini personalizzate per automatizzare la quantificazione delle celle e dei biomarcatori sui tessuti scansionati. Controllare l'integrazione di software ML e non-ML per rilevare, segmentare e segnare morfologie di tessuto complesse. Estrarre caratteristiche spaziali altamente dimensionali e metriche quantitative da multisala o standard IHC e ISH diapositive. Trasformazione comp
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp

IND / CTA) und Governance-Präsentationen.

The Position
About the team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will be a key part of our global sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects within our diagnostic portfolios, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.
To support our rapid growth, we are hiring a cohort of Senior Sourcing Managers who will be aligned to one of two specialized technology teams: Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) or Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing & contracting excellence, financial value, and compliance across the network footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics—including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times—to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and New Product Introductions (NPI) managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto per orchestrare le reti di approvvigionamento che rendono possibile la diagnostica salvavita? Come nostro Senior Sourcing Manager a Sant Cugat, Spagna, sarete una parte fondamentale delle nostre operazioni di approvvigionamento globale. Potrai condurre progetti di sourcing end-to-end all'interno dei nostri portafogli di assistenza ai pazienti vicini (NPC), sensori e cartucce, e di fabbricazione esterna (EM), mentore un team crescente di Sourcing Managers, e servire come consulente chiave per la leadership esecutiva. Se si prospera sulla complessità e si desidera sentire un impatto diretto sulla consegna di diagnostica salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo, questo è dove si appartiene.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Piombo Sourcing – NPC, sensori e cartucce, e la fabbricazione esterna (EM) e fa parte del Centro di Eccellenza di Procurement (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholders: Faremo parte di un team regionale di Senior Sourcing Managers e Sourcing Managers, gestire i rapporti con altri stakeholder DOP (Category, Delivery) e fornitori esterni e produttori di contratti.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un singolo contributor con responsabilità per i membri della squadra junior.
• Impatto: Lei guida il sourcing globale e contrae l'eccellenza, il valore finanziario e la conformità attraverso l'impronta della rete. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Prestazioni & Risparmio: Guidare metriche chiave - tra cui il risparmio PPV, la quota di fornitore preferita e i tempi di ciclo ridotti - per fornire valore di linea inferiore durante il monitoraggio della soddisfazione degli stakeholder.
• Sourcing & Analysis: Esecuzione di attività di approvvigionamento globale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e benchmarking NPI in stretta collaborazione con i manager di Categoria e Nuove Introduzioni prodotto (NPI).
• Gestione dei contratti e dei documenti: Impostazione e revisione dei contratti di alta complessità (ad esempio, MSAs) e documentazione di acquisto, mentre gestiscono con precisione i loro repository e rinnovi del ciclo di vita.
• Eccellenza Operativa & PMI Leadership: Agire come Soggetto esperto di materia (SME) per semplificare i flussi di lavoro, analizzare i requisiti degli utenti del sito per i metodi di migliore valore e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche globali.
• Risoluzione & CSR del collo di bottiglia: Partner con funzioni di supporto come Accounts Payable (AP) per sgomberare i colli di bottiglia amministrativi relativi ai fornitori, pur sostenendo le iniziative di base di fornitura CSR (diversità, sostenibilità, pratiche etiche).
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestione di conflitti di alto livello per quanto riguarda le priorità dei progetti concorrenti o le selezioni dei fornitori, e fornire aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza al CoE LT e al DPLT. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono fornire direzione e colleghi mentore in diverse posizioni.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della Vita preferita) è necessaria; un MBA o certificazioni equivalenti e professionali (ad esempio, CIPS, ISM) sono desiderabili.
• Esperienza: 5-7 anni di esperienza

• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnerschaft mit Support-Funktionen wie Accounts Payable (AP), um lieferantenbezogene administrative Engpässe zu beseitigen und sich für CSR-Initiativen (Vielfalt, Nachhaltigkeit, ethische Praktiken) einzusetzen.
• Konflikt & Exposure: Bewältigung von Konflikten mit hohen Einsätzen in Bezug auf konkurrierende Projektprioritäten oder Lieferantenauswahlen und Bereitstellung von hochfrequenten monatlichen / vierteljährlichen Updates für die CoE LT und DPLT. Wer du bist Wir bemühen uns, unsere Standards hoch zu halten und suchen nach Kandidaten, die Regie und Mentor Kollegen an verschiedenen Standorten bieten können.
• Ausbildung: Ein Universitätsabschluss (Business oder Life Sciences bevorzugt) ist erforderlich; ein MBA oder gleichwertige und professionelle Zertifizierungen (z. B. CIPS, ISM) sind wünschenswert.
• Erfahrung: 5-7+ Jahre Erfahrung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we combine science and digital innovation to deliver life-changing medicines and diagnostics globally. Behind our success is the global Roche content and digital services Lab, a cutting-edge unit driving scalable, high-quality content production across the enterprise.

We are seeking a structured, visionary Service Delivery Lead (SDL) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within our global Medical Writing and core content ecosystem. You will oversee operational governance across both internal teams and external vendors, ensuring our communications remain scientifically accurate, regulatory-compliant, and impactful.

The Role: What You Will Do
As an SDL, you will be the operational engine and accountable owner for day-to-day service delivery performance within your scope. You will bridge the gap between creative storytelling, medical writing expertise, and rigorous operational governance.
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Lead Medical Writing Services: Oversee Medical Writing services, ensuring that content production perfectly aligns with therapeutic guidelines, business needs, and strict regulatory standards.

• Harmonize Workflows: Manage and streamline cross-pillar content processes and workflows between medical writing and other core digital content functions.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with Compliance and Medical Affairs to maintain a perfect balance between creative brand storytelling and regulatory requirements.

• Operational Governance: Implement, monitor, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), delivery frameworks, KPIs, and SLAs to guarantee consistent and measurable service execution.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Serve as the central coordination point between internal Business Leads, GDH Leads, and external delivery partners to ensure structured, transparent operations.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze service performance data, monitor metrics, identify inefficiencies, and execute structured improvement initiatives using defined governance frameworks.

• Future-Ready Innovation: Ensure cost-conscious, scalable delivery models while actively driving the adoption of modern technologies—including GenAI where applicable—to maximize efficiency.

• Capacity & Incident Management: Coordinate operational capacity planning for workload balance, and manage service incidents or escalations with rigorous root-cause follow-up.

• Collaboration with business partners in Switzerland, this position is based in Malaysia will need to work flexible hours . Occasionally—though not regularly—need to work during Malaysian evening hours.

Who You Are
You thrive within structured governance environments and are highly comfortable balancing operational oversight with executive stakeholder alignment. You are an expert at anticipating risks, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and championing a culture of continuous service improvement. Process integrity, performance transparency, and service consistency are at the core of how you operate.

Your Experience & Background

• 7–10 years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency setting).

• A strong, demonstrated background in the delivery of medical writing services , with personal experience as a medical writer consider

In dieser zentralen Rolle sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, eine effektive, skalierbare und qualitativ hochwertige operative Servicebereitstellung in unserem globalen Medical Writing- und Kerninhalts-Ökosystem sicherzustellen. Sie überwachen die operative Governance sowohl in internen Teams als auch bei externen Anbietern und stellen sicher, dass unsere Kommunikation wissenschaftlich korrekt, behördlich und wirksam bleibt. Die Rolle: Was Sie tun werden Als SDL sind Sie der operative Motor und verantwortlicher Eigentümer für die tägliche Servicebereitstellung in Ihrem Bereich. Sie werden die Lücke zwischen kreativem Storytelling, medizinischem Schreiben und strenger operativer Governance schließen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Führen Sie Medical Writing Services: Überwachen Sie Medical Writing Services, um sicherzustellen, dass die Inhaltsproduktion perfekt mit therapeutischen Richtlinien, Geschäftsanforderungen und strengen regulatorischen Standards übereinstimmt.
• Workflows harmonisieren: Verwalten und optimieren Sie säulenübergreifende Content-Prozesse und Workflows zwischen medizinischem Schreiben und anderen zentralen Funktionen für digitale Inhalte.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Compliance und Medical Affairs zusammen, um eine perfekte Balance zwischen kreativem Brand Storytelling und regulatorischen Anforderungen zu gewährleisten.
• Operational Governance: Implementieren, überwachen und pflegen Sie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Delivery Frameworks, KPIs und SLAs, um eine konsistente und messbare Serviceausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Dienen Sie als zentrale Koordinationsstelle zwischen internen Business Leads, GDH Leads und externen Lieferpartnern, um strukturierte, transparente Abläufe zu gewährleisten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftspartnern in der Schweiz, diese Position hat ihren Sitz in Malaysia muss flexible Arbeitszeiten arbeiten. Gelegentlich - wenn auch nicht regelmäßig - müssen sie während der malaysischen abendstunden arbeiten. Wer du bist Sie gedeihen in strukturierten Governance-Umgebungen und sind sehr komfortabel, die operative Aufsicht mit der Ausrichtung von Stakeholdern in Einklang zu bringen. Sie sind Experte darin, Risiken zu antizipieren, Lieferherausforderungen proaktiv anzugehen und sich für eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Serviceverbesserung einzusetzen. • 7-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in Service Delivery Management, operativer Governance oder strukturierten digitalen / Content-Betriebsumgebungen (Unternehmens- oder Agenturumgebungen).
• Ein starker, demonstrierter Hintergrund in der Bereitstellung von medizinischen Schreibdiensten , mit persönlicher Erfahrung als medizinischer Schriftsteller betrachten

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an Investigative Toxicology Associate , you play a pivotal role in the development, validation, implementation, and execution of nonclinical in vitro cell culture-based assays for translational safety assessment. In this hands-on laboratory role, you leverage modern scientific tools to maximize insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline within a highly collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Deliver high-quality scientific data for modern regulated and non-regulated toxicology in vitro assays to inform risk assessment across discovery and development projects.

• Support the development, implementation, and data analysis of novel predictive in vitro safety models.

• Conduct precise data analysis, manage internal reporting within the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), and present key findings to internal stakeholders.

• Optimize laboratory processes continuously to increase quality, efficiency, and safety standards.

• Engage proactively with cross-functional matrix teams within Pharmaceutical Sciences to align on project milestones and prioritize laboratory schedules.

• Establish and maintain professional relationships with external vendors and technology providers to assess and onboard next-generation laboratory technologies.

Who You Are

You are a curious, collaborative, and detail-oriented laboratory professional passionate about advancing healthcare through cutting-edge science. You bring a strong foundational knowledge of cell biology and thrive in dynamic, matrix-organized environments.

Qualifications & Competencies:

• An apprenticeship as a biology laboratory technician, or a B.Sc. / M.Sc. degree in cell biology, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, pharmacology, toxicology, or a related scientific discipline.

• A minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience operating within a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL2) cell culture laboratory with handling of primary cells and/or iPSCs.

• Demonstrated expertise in mammalian cell culture techniques, including experience with complex in vitro models, organoids or organs-on-a-chip systems.

• Proficiency with state-of-the-art imaging technologies, such as high-content imaging or confocal imaging, alongside familiarity with im

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. L'opportunità Come Investigative Toxicology Associate , si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo, nella validazione, nell'implementazione e nell'esecuzione di saggi non clinici basati sulla cultura delle cellule vitro per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. In questo ruolo pratico di laboratorio, si sfruttano moderni strumenti scientifici per massimizzare le intuizioni, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica all'interno di un ambiente altamente collaborativo. Responsabilità chiave:
• Fornire dati scientifici di alta qualità per la tossicologia moderna regolamentata e non regolamentata in test vitro per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso i progetti di scoperta e sviluppo.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e l'analisi dei dati di nuovi modelli di sicurezza in vitro.
• Condurre analisi precise dei dati, gestire la reportistica interna all'interno del sistema di gestione delle informazioni del laboratorio (LIMS), e presentare i risultati chiave per gli stakeholder interni.
• Ottimizzare i processi di laboratorio continuamente per aumentare la qualità, l'efficienza e gli standard di sicurezza.
• Impegnarsi proattivamente con i team di matrice interfunzionali all'interno delle Scienze Farmaceutiche per allineare sulle pietre miliari del progetto e priorizzare gli orari di laboratorio.
• Stabilire e mantenere relazioni professionali con fornitori esterni e fornitori di tecnologia per valutare e a bordo tecnologie di laboratorio di nuova generazione. Chi sei Sei un curioso, collaborativo e professionale di laboratorio orientato al dettaglio appassionato di promuovere la salute attraverso la scienza all'avanguardia. Porti una forte conoscenza fondamentale della biologia cellulare e prosperi in ambienti dinamici e matrice-organizzati. Qualifiche e competenze:
• Un apprendistato come tecnico di laboratorio di biologia, o una laurea in biologia cellulare, biotecnologia, ingegneria biomedica, farmacologia, tossicologia, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.
• Un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza pratica operante all'interno di un laboratorio di cultura cellulare Biosafety Level 2 (BSL2) con gestione delle cellule primarie e/o iPSC.
• Competenza dimostrata nelle tecniche di coltura cellulare mammifero, compresa l'esperienza con modelli complessi in vitro, organoidi o sistemi organi-on-a-chip.
• Proficienza con tecnologie di imaging all'avanguardia, come immagini ad alto contenuto o immagini confocali, insieme alla familiarità con l'im

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Die Chance Als Investigative Toxicology Associate spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Validierung, Implementierung und Durchführung von nichtklinischen in vitro-Zellkultur-basierten Assays für die translationale Sicherheitsbewertung. In dieser praktischen Laborfunktion nutzen Sie moderne wissenschaftliche Werkzeuge, um Einblicke zu maximieren, Innovationen voranzutreiben und unsere therapeutische Pipeline in einem hochgradig kooperativen Umfeld voranzutreiben. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Bereitstellung hochwertiger wissenschaftlicher Daten für moderne regulierte und nicht regulierte toxikologische In-vitro-Assays, um die Risikobewertung in Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten zu unterstützen.
• Unterstützung der Entwicklung, Implementierung und Datenanalyse neuartiger prädiktiver In-vitro-Sicherheitsmodelle.
• Führen Sie eine präzise Datenanalyse durch, verwalten Sie die interne Berichterstattung innerhalb des Laborinformationsmanagementsystems (LIMS) und präsentieren Sie den internen Stakeholdern die wichtigsten Ergebnisse.
• Laborprozesse kontinuierlich optimieren, um Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheitsstandards zu erhöhen.
• Engagieren Sie sich proaktiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Matrixteams innerhalb von Pharmaceutical Sciences, um die Meilensteine des Projekts zu erreichen und die Laborzeitpläne zu priorisieren.
• Etablieren und pflegen Sie professionelle Beziehungen zu externen Anbietern und Technologieanbietern, um Labortechnologien der nächsten Generation zu bewerten und an Bord zu bringen. Wer du bist Sie sind ein neugieriger, kooperativer und detailorientierter Laborfachmann, der sich leidenschaftlich für die Förderung der Gesundheitsversorgung durch innovative Wissenschaft einsetzt. Sie bringen ein starkes grundlegendes Wissen über Zellbiologie mit und gedeihen in dynamischen, matrixorganisierten Umgebungen. Qualifikationen & Kompetenzen:
• Eine Lehre als Biologielabortechniker oder ein B.Sc. / M.Sc.-Abschluss in Zellbiologie, Biotechnologie, Biomedizintechnik, Pharmakologie, Toxikologie oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin.
• Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in einem Zellkulturlabor der Biosicherheitsstufe 2 (BSL2) mit dem Umgang mit Primärzellen und/oder iPSC.
• Nachgewiesene Expertise in Säugetierzellkulturtechniken, einschließlich Erfahrung mit komplexen In-vitro-Modellen, Organoiden oder Organ-on-a-Chip-Systemen.
• Kompetenz mit state-of-the-art-imaging-technologien, wie high-content-imaging oder konfokale bildgebung, neben der vertrautheit mit im.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. L'opportunité En tant qu'associé en toxicologie d'investigation, vous jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration, la validation, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution d'essais non cliniques de culture cellulaire in vitro pour l'évaluation de l'innocuité translationnelle. Dans ce rôle pratique de laboratoire, vous exploitez des outils scientifiques modernes pour maximiser les connaissances, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique dans un environnement hautement collaboratif. Principales responsabilités :
• Fournir des données scientifiques de haute qualité pour les essais de toxicologie in vitro réglementés et non réglementés modernes afin d'éclairer l'évaluation des risques dans l'ensemble des projets de découverte et de développement.
• Appuyer l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'analyse de données de nouveaux modèles prédictifs de sécurité in vitro.
• Effectuer une analyse précise des données, gérer les rapports internes au sein du Système de gestion de l'information de laboratoire (SGGI) et présenter les principales constatations aux intervenants internes.
• Optimiser les processus de laboratoire en continu pour améliorer la qualité, l'efficacité et les normes de sécurité.
• S'engager de façon proactive auprès d'équipes de matrices interfonctionnelles des sciences pharmaceutiques afin de s'aligner sur les jalons du projet et de hiérarchiser les calendriers des laboratoires.
• Établir et entretenir des relations professionnelles avec des fournisseurs externes et des fournisseurs de technologie pour évaluer et intégrer les technologies de laboratoire de prochaine génération. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel de laboratoire curieux, collaboratif et axé sur les détails passionné par l'avancement des soins de santé par la science de pointe. Vous apportez une solide connaissance fondamentale de la biologie cellulaire et vous prospèrez dans des environnements dynamiques et organisés en matrice. Qualifications et compétences :
• Un apprentissage comme technicien de laboratoire de biologie, ou un baccalauréat en biologie cellulaire, en biotechnologie, en génie biomédical, en pharmacologie, en toxicologie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.
• Un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience pratique dans un laboratoire de culture cellulaire de niveau de biosécurité 2 (BSL2) avec manipulation de cellules primaires et/ou iPSC.
• Expertise démontrée dans les techniques de culture cellulaire des mammifères, y compris l'expérience de modèles in vitro complexes, d'organoïdes ou de systèmes d'organes sur puce.
• Connaissance des technologies d'imagerie de pointe, telles que l'imagerie à haut contenu ou l'imagerie confocale, ainsi que de la familiarité avec l'imagerie

titleByLocale.it: Piombo di Farmacologia Clinica - Principale Scienziato
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la pharmacologie clinique - Chercheur principal

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si porterà l'avanzamento scientifico dei programmi clinici servendo come il nucleo quantitativo e farmacologia clinica piombo all'interno di team di progetto interfunzionali. Potrai guidare tutti gli aspetti della Farmacologia Clinica (CP) in tutte le fasi di sviluppo e applicare strategicamente Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approcci per ottimizzare i progetti di prova, giustificare le selezioni di dose, informare le decisioni di sviluppo e mitigare i rischi sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio di sviluppo. Il vostro scopo sarà la modalità-agnostica, dando la supervisione che abbraccia piccole molecole, grandi molecole, e nuove piattaforme.
• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: contribuisce attivamente allo sviluppo di strategie di sviluppo clinico, tra cui la progettazione di studi clinici e condurre lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e l'esecuzione delle strategie di Farmacologia Clinica e MIDD per le attività assegnate in tutte le fasi di sviluppo. Traduci i principi clinici di Farmacologia in modelli predittivi che guidano la selezione di dosi / regimi, interazioni farmaco-droga (DDI), strategie di popolazione speciali, estrapolazioni pediatrico e ponteggio geografico / etnico.
• Modellazione & Simulazione Mastery: Applicare metodologie farmacometriche (come la popolazione PK/PD, PBPK o QSP) per eseguire simulazioni di prova clinica, caratterizzare le relazioni di esposizione-risposta e definire criteri quantitativi per le decisioni di go/no-go iniziali e data-driven. Porti la competenza nel software farmacometrico (ad esempio, NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Regolazione & Asset Maximization: Guidare le sezioni CP dei principali documenti normativi (compresi IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Assicurare documenti di presentazione fit-for-purpose di alta qualità utilizzando iniziative Roche come l'autore magra dello sviluppo e l'eccellenza della presentazione digitale. Rappresentare l'azienda come esperto di materia in interazioni dell'autorità sanitaria.
• Sviluppo aziendale: fornire analisi farmacologiche cliniche e quantitative

At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les populations de patients appropriées et d'accélérer le développement des traitements sûrs et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément intégré dans les équipes de projets multi-fonctionnels et peut soutenir plusieurs domaines de maladies de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neurosciences, oncologie et ophtalmologie). o Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (MDDM) pour optimiser les modèles d'essai, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. Votre champ d'application sera agnostique-de modalité, vous donnant une surveillance qui couvre les petites molécules, les grandes molécules et les nouvelles plateformes. - Exécution du plan stratégique et quantitatif : Contribuer activement au développement de stratégies de développement clinique, y compris la conception d'essais cliniques et diriger le développement, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des stratégies de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les actifs assignés à toutes les phases de développement. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo è in Analytical Data Science, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni efficaci. PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Identifichiamo, influenziamo e adottiamo soluzioni digitali e di automazione leader del settore, sviluppiamo approcci analitici per sostenere le analisi esplorative e allineiamo le pratiche di programmazione statistica sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio dello sviluppo clinico. L'opportunità: Il programmatore Analytical Data Science è un contributore chiave al team di studio clinico, responsabile della trasformazione dei piani di analisi statistica in materiali di programmazione tracciabili di alta qualità. Questo include uscite sia statiche che dinamiche, come tabelle, elenchi, figure, e visualizzazioni interattive dei dati o dashboard. Il ruolo riguarda la creazione e la convalida di set di dati in conformità con gli standard del Modello di Scheda di Studio e del Modello di Dati di Analisi, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e degli standard Roche. Oltre a sostenere le presentazioni regolamentari, il programmatore ADS svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella generazione di informazioni sui dati attraverso piattaforme come il Insight Engine, consentendo l'esplorazione in tempo reale e l'interpretazione di diversi dati clinici ed esplorativi. Questo ruolo contribuisce a un ambiente di sviluppo moderno, orientato all'intuizione, facilitando l'analisi robusta, tempestiva e decisionale attraverso i programmi clinici.
• L'utente sviluppa, convalida e mantiene in modo indipendente set di dati e output statistici per gli studi clinici, inclusi i dataset del Modello di Tabulazione dei Dati di Studio (SDTM), i dataset del Modello di analisi (ADaM) e le tabelle, gli elenchi e le cifre (TLF), garantendo precisione di programmazione, tracciabilità e conformità ai processi interni e alle aspettative normative
• Sviluppi e supporti gli output di programmazione in una vasta gamma di tipi di dati, compresi i dati di biomarcatori esplorativi e i dati del mondo reale, per supportare obiettivi sia normativi che scientifici
• Collabori su analisi esplorative che abbracciano aree di malattia e aree terapeutiche, consentendo una generazione di informazioni per informare le strategie di sviluppo della droga
• Supporti la creazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti interattivi e applicazioni analitiche (ad esempio, dashboard o piattaforme di dati visivi) che consentono l'esplorazione dinamica di dataset integrati da parte di team scientifici e clinici
• Fornite la leadership di programmazione per gli studi assegnati, coordinando i deliverable tra i partner di programmazione interni ed esterni per soddisfare le tempistiche e i requisiti di studio
• Lei interpreta i piani di analisi statistica e li traduce in specifiche di programmazione eseguibili per garantire rigore scientifico nelle uscite
• La risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione delle sfide di programmazione tecnica con una supervisione limitata, l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi e l'implementazione di soluzioni efficaci durante la riunione dei termini
• Contribuisci alla progettazione e manutenzione di standard

• Vous collaborez à des analyses exploratoires qui couvrent les domaines de la maladie et des domaines thérapeutiques, ce qui permet de générer des connaissances pour éclairer les stratégies de développement des médicaments.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position sits within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department in pRED / Pharmaceutical Sciences, but maintains a company-wide footprint. The scope of influence transcends individual teams, regularly partnering across major organisational boundaries and cross-entities (e.g., pRED, gRED, PDR) to shape institutional knowledge.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a senior enterprise leader and expert in Clinical Pharmacology, including Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Medicine, solving high-risk development challenges and embedding advanced computational capabilities to accelerate the R&D pipeline. Operating on a senior strategic and scientific track, you will hold high accountability for shaping long-term scientific and development strategies and capital allocation for entire disease areas or global functions. Additionally, you will drive high-stakes corporate due diligence for licensing opportunities, lead complex global health authority negotiations, and act as a strategic mentor across the wider organisation.

• High-Impact Strategic and Scientific Leadership : Formulate and evolve overarching Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for high-profile molecules or portfolio segments (e.g. Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology), ensuring alignment with end-to-end development goals.

• Pioneering Technical Innovation : Identify, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art computational methodologies into workflows, stimulating the broader scientific community to experiment and challenge development paradigms.

• Complex Submissions & Regulatory Defence : Provide authoritative guidance on highly complex or unprecedented submission strategies (e.g., pediatric extrapolations, novel modalities) and serve as a primary counter-partner to health authorities and KOLs.

• Strategic Business Development : Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling evaluations and actively contribute to the development of Clinical Development Plans for high-stakes due diligence, in-licensing, and out-licensing opportunities to assess the path to value as well as the technical viability and risks of external

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova all'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa in Scienze pRED / Farmaceutiche, ma mantiene un'impronta aziendale. La portata dell'influenza trascende i singoli team, collaborando regolarmente tra i principali confini organizzativi e le intersezioni (ad esempio, pRED, gRED, PDR) per plasmare le conoscenze istituzionali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si servirà come leader di impresa senior e esperto in Farmacologia Clinica, tra cui Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) e Quantitative Medicine, risolvendo sfide di sviluppo ad alto rischio e incorporando capacità computazionali avanzate per accelerare la pipeline R&D. Operando su una traccia strategica e scientifica senior, si terrà alta responsabilitÃ per la definizione di strategie scientifiche e di sviluppo a lungo termine e allocazione di capitale per intere aree di malattia o funzioni globali. Inoltre, guiderai le due diligence aziendali ad alto livello per le opportunità di licenza, guiderai negoziazioni di autorità sanitarie globali complesse e agirai come mentore strategico in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Leadership strategica e scientifica di alto impatto: formulare ed evolvere le strategie cliniche di farmacologia e MIDD per le molecole di alto profilo o segmenti di portafoglio (ad esempio Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) delle aree di malattia di punta di Roche (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology e Ophthalmology), garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Identificare, sviluppare e integrare metodologie computazionali all'avanguardia nei flussi di lavoro, stimolando la più ampia comunità scientifica a sperimentare e sfidare i paradigmi dello sviluppo.
• Submissions & Regulatory Defence: Fornire una guida autorevole su strategie di presentazione altamente complesse o senza precedenti (ad esempio, estrapolazioni pediatriche, nuove modalità) e servire come contro-partner primario alle autorità sanitarie e KOL.
• Sviluppo Strategico delle Imprese: Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling assessments e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di Piani di Sviluppo Clinico per un elevato fabbisogno di diligenza, in-licenziamento e opportunità per la valutazione del percorso di valore, nonché la fattibilità tecnica e i rischi di esterna

Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position liegt in der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie in pRED / Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften, unterhält aber einen unternehmensweiten Fußabdruck. Der Einflussbereich geht über einzelne Teams hinaus und arbeitet regelmäßig über große organisatorische Grenzen und übergreifende Einheiten (z. B. pRED, gRED, PDR) hinweg zusammen, um institutionelles Wissen zu gestalten. Die Chance In dieser Rolle werden Sie als leitender Unternehmensleiter und Experte für klinische Pharmakologie tätig sein, einschließlich Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) und Quantitative Medicine, um risikoreiche Entwicklungsherausforderungen zu lösen und fortschrittliche Rechenfunktionen einzubetten, um die F & E-Pipeline zu beschleunigen. Mit einem hochrangigen strategischen und wissenschaftlichen Kurs haben Sie eine hohe Verantwortung für die Gestaltung langfristiger wissenschaftlicher und Entwicklungsstrategien und die Kapitalzuweisung für ganze Krankheitsbereiche oder globale Funktionen. Darüber hinaus werden Sie die Corporate Due Diligence mit hohem Einsatz für Lizenzierungsmöglichkeiten vorantreiben, komplexe globale Verhandlungen der Gesundheitsbehörden leiten und als strategischer Mentor in der gesamten Organisation fungieren.
• Strategische und wissenschaftliche Führungsrolle mit hohem Einfluss: Formulierung und Entwicklung übergreifender klinischer Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für hochkarätige Moleküle oder Portfoliosegmente (z. B. Antikörper-Wirkstoff-Konjugate) der Roche-Fokus-Krankheitsbereiche (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie), um die Ausrichtung auf die End-to-End-Entwicklungsziele sicherzustellen.
• Pionierhafte technische Innovation: Identifizieren, entwickeln und integrieren Sie modernste Computermethoden in Workflows, um die breitere wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft zu ermutigen, Entwicklungsparadigmen zu experimentieren und herauszufordern.
• Komplexe Einreichungen und regulatorische Verteidigung: Geben Sie maßgebliche Leitlinien für hochkomplexe oder beispiellose Einreichungsstrategien (z. B. pädiatrische Extrapolationen, neuartige Modalitäten) und dienen Sie als primärer Gegenpartner für Gesundheitsbehörden und KOLs.
• Strategische Geschäftsentwicklung: Führen Sie klinische Pharmakologie- und Modellbewertungen und tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungspläne für High-Stakes-Due-Diligence-, In-Licensing- und Out-Licensing-Möglichkeiten bei, um den Weg zum Wert sowie die technische Lebensfähigkeit und die Risiken externer Unternehmen zu bewerten

titleByLocale.it: Head, Ophthalmology Precision Medicine, Medical Direttore (MD)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within Pharma Research & Early Development (pRED), our Ophthalmology teams are redefining how precision medicine can transform the detection and treatment of complex retinal diseases. This is a rare opportunity to build a new function from the ground up — establishing an Ophthalmology Precision Medicine group at our Welwyn site that brings together biomarker science, advanced imaging, clinical expertise, and artificial intelligence. You will have the platform, pipeline, and resources to shape something truly new in one of the most dynamic areas of ophthalmic research.
The Opportunity

• Build a new Ophthalmology Precision Medicine function from the ground up — defining the vision, structure, and scientific direction for a group that integrates biomarkers, advanced imaging, clinical science, and AI across the pRED Ophthalmology portfolio.

• Lead a cross-functional expert team spanning translational medicine, imaging, clinical development, data science, and biomarker disciplines — ensuring precision medicine is at the heart of our Ophthalmology strategy.

• Bridge laboratory science and clinical practice by steering the generation of robust fluid- and imaging biomarker strategies that enable project and disease area decisions.

• Advance innovation in imaging science by directing cutting-edge ophthalmic imaging approaches including OCT, OCT-A, and FA to inform future clinical practice and therapeutic development.

• Enable translational insights through AI and data by integrating preclinical and clinical datasets using classical and next-generation analytical approaches.

• Influence portfolio strategy across multiple retinal diseases including neovascular AMD, diabetic macular edema, geographic atrophy, and intermediate AMD — driving the direction and future of clinical development and research.

• Represent Roche externally through strong partnerships with scientific experts, investigators, and the broader ophthalmology community — remaining at the forefront of innovation.

Who you are

• You are a board-certified ophthalmologist (MD or MD/PhD) with deep expertise in ophthalmology, translational medicine, or biomedical sciences.

• You are a recognised expert in the retina space, with a strong scientific publication record and standing as a key opinion leader in your field.

• You have deep knowledge of ophthalmic imaging technologies (OCT, OCT-A, FA) and experience with imaging analysis or Reading Centre environments.

• You are experienced in integrating preclinical and clinical data to support proof of biology, efficacy, and safety strategies, with some exposure to clinical trials.

• You are a collaborative scientific leader who thrives in matrix environments, energised by innovation and the opportunity to build something new.

Preferred

• Experience applying AI or machine learning to ophthalmic imaging analysis or clinical data interpretation.

• Prior experience in pharmaceutical drug development programmes for retinal diseases.

• Flexible working arrangements may be available for exceptional candidates who wish to maintain some clinical activity alongside this role.

If building a world-class precision medicine function and shaping the future of ophthalmic therapy development is the kind of challenge that excites you — apply now and help us bring transformative medicines to patients faster.
