• Strategische Risikoarchitektur und -vision: Definieren und gestalten Sie das globale IT Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT) und richten Sie die langfristige digitale Strategie an Roches Risikobereitschaft aus, um "Compliance by Design" in komplexen, miteinander verbundenen globalen Portfolios sicherzustellen.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von hochkomplexen Geschäfts- und Risikoherausforderungen mit erheblichen organisatorischen Auswirkungen und identifiziert proaktiv potenzielle strategische Probleme in Ihrem Einflussbereich. Entwickelt umfassende Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Richtlinien, setzt proaktive Maßnahmen um, um wiederholte Probleme zu vermeiden, und leitet Initiativen, um zukünftige Risiken zu antizipieren und zu mindern. Trägt zur Gestaltung strategischer Fragen bei und erleichtert die strategische Entscheidungsfindung auf Führungsebene.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifiziert und bindet wichtige Stakeholder auf Führungsebene und externe Partner ein und analysiert unternehmensweite Stakeholderlandschaften. Leitet unternehmensweite Risiko-, Audit- und Compliance-Initiativen und präsentiert sie der Führungsspitze, um Unterstützung und strategische Ausrichtung für risikobezogene Investitionen zu sichern. Navigiert durch hochkomplexe und politisch sensible Landschaften, agiert als organisatorischer Trust Builder und bietet kompetente Beratung bei kritischen strategischen Entscheidungen.
• E2E Audit & Compliance Leadership: Führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus komplexer IT-Audits und kontinuierlicher Überwachungsprogramme in Infrastruktur und Anwendungen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen die globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllt und proaktiv systemische Probleme identifiziert, um Wiederholungen zu verhindern.
• Inspection Command & Control: Dienen Sie als primäre IT-Verbindung bei komplexen Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörde (FDA, EMA usw.), leiten Sie "Front-Room / Back-Room" -Operationen, coachen Sie KMU in regulatorischen Interviewtechniken und stellen Sie die schnelle Bereitstellung hochwertiger, validierter Beweise sicher.
• Datenintegrität & ALCOA+ Systematisch überprüfen und erzwingen Sie den "Digital Thread", um sicherzustellen, dass alle gesundheitsregulierten Daten zuordenbar, lesbar, zeitgenössisch, originell und genau bleiben und die Integrität lebensrettender digitaler Gesundheitslösungen erhalten bleibt.
• Global Stakeholder & Transformation Management: Navigieren Sie durch sensible Landschaften, um unternehmensweite Risikoinitiativen zu leiten, arbeiten Sie mit IT-Besitzern zusammen, um robuste Sanierungs-CAPAs zu entwickeln und innovative Risikomanagementansätze zu entwickeln, um nachhaltige, transformative Auswirkungen auf die gesamte globale Organisation zu erzielen

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque patient mérite une solution de santé personnalisée. En tant que gestionnaire stratégique des risques et de la vérification de la TI, vous jouerez un rôle central pour faire en sorte que notre évolution numérique, de la découverte de médicaments à l'IA aux applications de soins de santé personnalisées, repose sur la confiance et la résilience. Vous agirez comme partenaire stratégique des leaders de la technologie numérique, en veillant à ce que les risques soient gérés de manière proactive plutôt que réactive. Ce rôle va au-delà de l'audit tactique de la « case à cocher » pour se concentrer sur la prospective stratégique – en anticipant les changements dans le paysage de menace, l'environnement réglementaire et les technologies émergentes (comme l'IA et l'architecture Cloud) Responsabilités professionnelles Portée / ( Leadership en matière de contenu) : définit la vision stratégique du risque, de la vérification et de la conformité en matière de TI, et dirige les initiatives stratégiques pour la réussite à long terme de la gestion des risques. Lance et dirige de grands projets complexes ayant un impact important sur l'organisation. Dirige l'élaboration de politiques de gestion des risques et de conformité à l'échelle de l'entreprise et donne des conseils sur les nouvelles tendances et les meilleures pratiques.
• Architecture et vision des risques stratégiques : Définir et concevoir le cadre mondial de gestion des risques de l'entreprise informatique (ERM) (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), aligner la stratégie numérique à long terme sur l'appétit pour les risques de Roches pour assurer la « conformité par la conception » dans des portefeuilles mondiaux complexes et interconnectés.
• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des défis opérationnels et des risques très complexes ayant un impact organisationnel important, en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes stratégiques potentiels dans votre sphère d'influence. Élaborer des politiques globales de gestion des risques et de conformité, mettre en oeuvre des mesures proactives pour éviter les problèmes répétés et diriger des initiatives pour anticiper et atténuer les risques futurs. Contribue à la formulation de questions stratégiques et facilite la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des cadres.
• Gestion des intervenants : Identifier et mobiliser les intervenants clés au niveau de la direction et des partenaires externes, en analysant les paysages des intervenants à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Diriger les initiatives de gestion des risques, de vérification et de conformité à l'échelle de l'organisation, les présenter aux dirigeants pour obtenir un soutien et un alignement stratégique pour les investissements liés aux risques. Navigue dans des paysages très complexes et politiquement sensibles, agit comme un bâtisseur de confiance organisationnel et fournit des conseils spécialisés sur les décisions stratégiques critiques.
• Leadership de la vérification et de la conformité E2E : Diriger le cycle de vie complet des vérifications complexes de la TI et des programmes de surveillance continue dans l'ensemble de l'infrastructure et des applications, en veillant à ce que l'organisation respecte les exigences réglementaires mondiales tout en identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes systémiques afin d'éviter qu'ils ne se reproduisent.
• Commande et contrôle de l'inspection : servir de principale liaison informatique pendant les inspections complexes de l'Autorité de la santé (AFD, EMA, etc.), diriger les opérations « Salle avant/salle arrière », entraîner les PME dans les techniques d'entrevue réglementaires et assurer la livraison rapide de preuves validées de haute qualité.
• Intégrité des données & ALCOA+ Vérification systématique et application du « fil numérique » pour s'assurer que toutes les données réglementées en matière de santé demeurent Attribuables, lisibles, contemporaines, originales et exactes, en maintenant l'intégrité des solutions de santé numériques qui sauvent la vie.
• Gestion globale des intervenants et de la transformation : Naviguer dans des paysages sensibles pour diriger des initiatives de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise, établir des partenariats avec les propriétaires de TI afin de mettre au point des APC robustes en matière d'assainissement et d'innover des approches de gestion des risques pour générer des impacts transformatifs durables à l'échelle mondiale

jobs.title: Nurse Liaison Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein Team
Als Nurse Liaison Manager:in (NLM) wirst Du Teil unserer Disease Area Neuroimmunologie. In Deiner Rolle als Expert:in im Außendienst gestaltest Du die Zusammenarbeit mit der Nurses-Community sowie unseren Teams in Vertrieb, Medical und Marketing aktiv mit. Wir verstehen uns als verlässliche Partner für Behandelnde, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Versorgung von Patient:innen mit Multipler Sklerose zu fördern.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Beratung & Schulung: Du informierst und schulst Nurses und Ärzte zur Anwendung von B-Zell- und IL6-Therapien, inkl. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Organisationsberatung: Du berätst Praxen und Kliniken bei der Optimierung von Ablauforganisationen rund um unsere Neuroimmunologie-Produkte.

• Digitale Lösungen: Du begleitest die Implementierung unserer CE-zertifizierten Medizinprodukte (z.B. Brisa) zur Therapieunterstützung.

• Eventmanagement: Du planst und gestaltest aktiv lokale Anwendertreffen, Best-Practice-Sharing-Konzepte und moderierst Workshops.

• Netzwerkarbeit: Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse vor Ort und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aktiv in das Disease Area Squad ein.

• Crossfunktionale Kooperation: Du arbeitest eng mit allen Vertretern der Customer Pacing Functions, Medical, Marketing und Patient Partnership Bereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Account Plänen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger:in, Medizinische Fachangestellte oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 4 Jahre), idealerweise in der Neurologie.

• Erfahrung in der Therapie der Multiplen Sklerose (MS),insbesondere im Umgang mit MS-Patienten und Erfahrung im Management von Praxisabläufen und der Anleitung von Pflegekräften (Praxisanleiter:in)

• Medizinische Praxis: Sicherer Umgang mit Venenverweilkanülen, Durchführung von Infusionstherapien und Komplikationsmanagement.

• Zusatzqualifikation: Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement (QSM) und Ausbildung zum Medizinprodukteberater sind von Vorteil.

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace/MS Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis.

Deine Bewerbung

A healthier future drives us to innovate. • Consulenza e formazione: informare e formare infermieri e medici sull'uso delle terapie B-cell e IL6, compresa la preparazione, l'implementazione e la gestione delle complicazioni.
• Consulenza organizzativa: Lei consiglia pratiche e cliniche sull'ottimizzazione delle organizzazioni di flusso di lavoro intorno ai nostri prodotti di neuroimmunologia.
• Soluzioni digitali: accompagni l'implementazione dei nostri prodotti medici certificati CE (ad esempio Brisa) per il supporto terapeutico.
• Gestione degli eventi: pianificare attivamente e progettare riunioni degli utenti locali, i migliori concetti di condivisione delle pratiche e workshop moderati.
• Networking: Identifichi le esigenze dei clienti locali e contribuisci attivamente alle tue intuizioni alla Squadra delle Malattie.
• Cooperazione interfunzionale: Lei lavora a stretto contatto con tutti i rappresentanti delle Funzioni del Patto del Cliente, delle aree di Partenariato Medico, Marketing e Paziente e supporta la creazione di piani di conto. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Formazione completa come salute e infermiera: in, specialista medico o qualifica comparabile, nonché diversi anni di esperienza professionale (minimo 4 anni), idealmente in neurologia.
• Esperienza nel trattamento della sclerosi multipla (MS), in particolare nel trattare con i pazienti MS e l'esperienza nella gestione delle procedure pratiche e la guida delle infermiere (pratico manager:in)
• Pratiche mediche: gestione sicura dei cannule indwelling della vena, conduzione di terapie di infusione e gestione delle complicazioni.
• Ulteriori qualifiche: La conoscenza della gestione della qualità (QSM) e la formazione come consulente di dispositivi medici sono vantaggiosi.
• Alta competenza sociale, metodi di lavoro orientati alla soluzione, iniziativa e spirito di squadra.
• Gestione sicura di Google Workspace/MS Office e buona conoscenza dell'inglese e una patente di guida valida. La tua domanda Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti: CV corrente. Attualmente non sono necessari ulteriori documenti. Prima di presentare la domanda, si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti in seguito. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients.
The Opportunity

• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.

• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.

• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.

• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.

• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.

• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.

• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.

• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.

• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.

• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. The Position
We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Strategic Talent Acquisition Intern colleague for our Corporate People & Culture Team. As a Talent Acquisition Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partner and the People & Culture Business Partners in the recruitment process for open roles.
Throughout the course of your internship here at Roche Services and Solutions (RSS), you will be able to gain suitable experience and skills in order to lead the recruitment process of certain positions end-to-end. In this position you will focus on:

• Using social media platforms (such as Linkedin Recruiter), professional networking sites/platforms/databases (like Profession.hu, Phenom People) to source and identify potential candidates

• Conducting phone screenings , checking the candidates' professional background, motivation and language knowledge via telephone interview

• Organizing and partaking in online and face-to-face interviews

• Supporting the candidates' hiring journey comprehensively from start to finish

• Ensuring accurate administration of the whole recruitment process

• Creating compelling and accurate job advertisements that will play a pivotal role in attracting top talent

jobs.title: Tax Accounting & Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
All’interno della direzione Finance, siamo alla ricerca di un Tax Accounting Specialist da inserire nel nostro ufficio fiscale con spiccate competenze tecnico-contabili. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione autonoma del ciclo di compliance fiscale e della reportistica per le società italiane del Gruppo Roche. Il ruolo richiede una solida capacità di coniugare gli adempimenti tributari con le registrazioni contabili.

Principali Responsabilità

• Tax Compliance & Operations: Gestione integrale degli adempimenti periodici relativi a IVA (LIPE, dichiarazione annuale), imposte dirette (IRES/IRAP) e ritenute d’acconto, garantendo il rispetto rigoroso delle scadenze di legge.
• Accounting & Tax Reporting: Calcolo accurato delle imposte correnti, differite e anticipate per le fasi di actual e forecast.
• Predisposizione Bilancio: Supporto tecnico nella redazione delle poste fiscali del bilancio civilistico e consolidato, assicurando la corretta applicazione dei principi contabili.
• Reporting di Gruppo: Preparazione della reportistica fiscale periodica in conformità alle linee guida della casa madre e ai requisiti locali.
• Monitoraggio Normativo: Analisi degli impatti delle novità fiscali sui processi contabili aziendali e implementazione delle procedure necessarie per garantire la conformità.

Requisiti Richiesti

• Laurea magistrale in Economia (preferibilmente con diploma di Ragioneria) ; l'abilitazione alla professione di Commercialista è considerata un requisito preferenziale.
• Almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale maturata presso società di consulenza (Big4), studi specializzati o all'interno di dipartimenti fiscali di contesti multinazionali strutturati.
• Profonda conoscenza della normativa fiscale italiana e padronanza dei principi contabili nazionali (OIC) e internazionali (IFRS).
• Utilizzo avanzato del sistema ERP SAP e di Excel.
• Madrelingua italiano e buona padronanza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata).
• Completano il profilo: eccellenti capacità analitiche, attitudine al problem solving, precisione e orientamento al lavoro di squadra in un ambiente dinamico.

Sede di lavoro: Monza
Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo determinato
Data di inizio: 1° settembre 2026

La fascia salariale prevista per questa posizione è di euro 38.290–71.096 euro. Roche Italia offre una retribuzione su 14 mensilità. La retribuzione finale sarà determinata da una serie di fattori, tra cui le competenze, l'esperienza e le qualifiche.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

• Master's degree in Economics (preferably with diploma of Reason) ; the qualification to the profession of Commercialist is considered a preferential requirement.
• At least 2-3 years of professional experience at consulting companies (Big4), specialized studies or within tax departments of structured multinational contexts.
• Deep knowledge of Italian tax law and mastery of national accounting (OIC) and international (IFRS).
• Advanced use of the SAP and Excel ERP system.
• Italian mother tongue and good mastery of the English language (written and spoken).

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten zitieren, stoppen und pflegen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Innerhalb des Finanzmanagements suchen wir einen Steuerbuchhalter, der in unser Finanzamt mit starken technischen Buchhaltungskenntnissen aufgenommen wird. Die Ressource wird für die autonome Verwaltung des fiskalischen Compliance-Zyklus und die Berichterstattung für italienische Unternehmen der Roche-Gruppe verantwortlich sein. Die Rolle erfordert eine solide Fähigkeit, Steuerkonformität mit Buchhaltungsunterlagen zu kombinieren. Hauptverantwortung
• Tax Compliance & Operations: Vollständige Verwaltung der periodischen Mehrwertsteuerpflichten (LIPE, Jahreserklärung), direkte Steuern (IRES/IRAP) und als vereinbar angesehen, um die strikte Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Fristen zu gewährleisten.
• Buchhaltung & Steuerberichterstattung: Genaue Berechnung der aktuellen Steuern, aufgeschoben und für die tatsächliche und prognostizierte Phase erwartet.
• Vorbereitung des Haushaltsplans: Technische Unterstützung bei der Erstellung der Steuerposten des Zivil- und Konzernabschlusses, um die korrekte Anwendung der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze zu gewährleisten.
• Gruppenberichterstattung: Erstellung der periodischen Steuerberichterstattung gemäß den Richtlinien der Muttergesellschaft und den lokalen Anforderungen.
• Regulation Monitoring: Analyse der Auswirkungen von Steuerinnovationen auf die Geschäftsbuchhaltungsprozesse und Umsetzung der erforderlichen Verfahren zur Sicherstellung der Compliance. Angeforderte Anforderungen
• Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften (vorzugsweise mit Diplom der Vernunft) ; die Qualifikation zum Beruf des Kommerzialisten gilt als bevorzugte Voraussetzung.
• Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Beratungsunternehmen (Big4), Fachstudien oder in Steuerabteilungen strukturierter multinationaler Kontexte.
• Tiefe Kenntnisse des italienischen Steuerrechts und Beherrschung der Volkswirtschaftlichen Gesamtrechnung (OIC) und internationalen (IFRS).
• Fortgeschrittene Nutzung des ERP-Systems SAP und Excel.
• Italienische Muttersprache und gute Beherrschung der englischen Sprache (geschrieben und gesprochen).
• Sie vervollständigen das Profil: hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeit zur Problemlösung, Präzision und Anleitung zur Teamarbeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung. Arbeitsplatz: Monza Art des Vertrags: Festgelegte Zeit Startdatum: 1. September 2026 Die Lohnspanne für diese Position beträgt EUR 38,290–71,096. Roche Italy bietet eine Bezahlung von 14 Monaten an. Der endgültige Lohn wird durch eine Reihe von Faktoren bestimmt, darunter Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Qualifikationen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, haben heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung. Unser Ergebnis sind mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt wurden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt wurden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner- Oncology
Location: Mumbai

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are

• You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Patient Services or similar preferred

• You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

• Min 4 years of Oncology sales and Key account management experience within MH/Mumbai

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责：

• 结合公司产品特点，制定区域市场策略与执行
深度解读国家及各省市政策动态、市场竞争格局，结合产品特性与医院终端需求，制定拓展目标医院业务整体策略，搭建医院端业务运作体系。

• 项目管理与经销商协作
结合总部策略和区域实践提升产品医院覆盖广度与深度。
与区域合作伙伴构建良好的合作关系；整合经销商资源建立与合作伙伴的协同机制，确保产品在医院终端的供应保障以及业务目标达成。 联动市场部制定市场方案，赋能经销商聚焦产品临床价值传递。赋能合作伙伴的业务活动，定期向业务部门/职能部门负责人提供反馈

• 目标达成与模式探索
向经销商商议制定负责区域内经销商年度/季度/月度商业目标，监督经销商建立关键绩效指标跟踪体系，监控业务数据，定期汇报目标达成情况、策略执行效果及市场动态。 针对目标达成偏差，敦促经销商快速制定优化策略与资源配置，确保产品医院端业务稳健发展。
制定区域市场策略和区域准入跟进机制，制定项目计划，建立区域项目管理回顾机制，确保区域项目合规落地及实现区域项目高效费用管理。积极探索创新模式并试点推广。

• 跨部门协同与资源整合
积极协同公司内外部资源，联动公司各个跨部门团队，协调资源支持推动解决业务推进中的跨部门协作问题。推进渠道资源的整合，保障目标达成。

• 其他
严格遵守中国法律法规及罗氏内部的合规政策，确保所有市场活动合法合规。监控业务流程中的潜在风险及时处理以保障业务健康运行。完成上级主管指派的其他临时性项目工作。

能力要求：

• 医学/药学/本科及以上

• 5年及以上医药行业经验，其中至少3年销售管理或项目管理经验

• 医院/成熟产品渠道策略制定或运营经验者优先

• 具备深度业务洞察能力，具有预见风险能力，并能提供长远发展建议和创新方案

• 具 备客户管理能力，能够分析区域信息，制定区域业务目标和工作计划能力，并能带领团队推动计划执行

• 具备项目管理能力，具有多项目和复杂项目的管理知识，能够资源优化配置，有序推动项目计划

• 具备系统思考能力和区域管理能力，能进行区域策略制定，流程优化和团队管理能力 良好的跨部门合作、沟通能力 成长型思维

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is leading the industry with respect to the investment in R&D. We drive one of the largest and most promising pipelines.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) engages with all R&D engines within the Roche group and supports more than 100 development projects with CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) activities.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing processes (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing.
We are striving for a caring and sensing network organization, which lives a culture of trust and collaboration. Our smart people drive innovation through their expertise, passion and "getting it done" mentality. The benefit for the patient is in the center of our thoughts and efforts. To achieve this goal we have embraced new ways of working and thinking.
The department of Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products from Phase 1 up to Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support, line extension development, and drug product supplies for pre-clinical studies.

As an Associate Scientist within Pharmaceutical Development, you are responsible for laboratory studies related to drug product formulation and process development for parenteral dosage forms, including large biological molecules, small synthetic molecules, and gene therapy.

The Opportunity

• Plan and coordinate lab work packages with support from the Pharmaceutical Project Leader (PPL) and peers

• Write study protocols and reports

• Execute hands-on laboratory studies related to parenteral drug product formulation and process development (Ph0 to Ph3), identify support needs, prioritize tasks, and consider flexibility in execution

• Independently analyze, interpret and present results

• Plan timing, instrument use, analytical methods, materials, and sample logistics for studies, ensuring robust and timely sample flow and storage.

• High quality standard from study planning, execution and data handling, ensuring proper documentation, data integrity, and adherence to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate +) and FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable) data principles.

• The position is limited to 1 year. Extension might be possible.

Who You Are

• Completed apprenticeship as a chemical/biological laboratory technician; Chemical-Technical Assistant (CTA), or Biological-Technical Assistant (BTA) or related fields

• Proven knowledge and hands-on experience in laboratory

• A high degree of self-motivation, curiosity and high aspiration in terms of quality is required

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a deep commitment to working in a delivery oriented environment

• Strong team player attitude

• Strong interest to embrace new ways of working and to act as change agent

• Fluent in English (written and spoken) is a must. German language skills are a plus.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche è leader del settore rispetto all'investimento in R&D. Noi guidiamo una delle tubazioni più grandi e più promettenti. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) si impegna con tutti i motori R&D all'interno del gruppo Roche e supporta oltre 100 progetti di sviluppo con attività CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls). Pharma Technical Development (PTD) porta terapie che cambiano gioco dalla fase clinica I nel mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per i processi produttivi (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Ci sforziamo di un'organizzazione di rete attenta e sensibile, che vive una cultura di fiducia e collaborazione. Le nostre persone intelligenti guidano l'innovazione attraverso la loro competenza, passione e mentalità "getting it done". Il beneficio per il paziente è al centro dei nostri pensieri e sforzi. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo abbiamo abbracciato nuovi modi di lavorare e di pensare. Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali dalla fase 1 fino al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo a siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto del prodotto commerciale, lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea e l'approvvigionamento di prodotti farmaceutici per studi preclinici. Come scienziato associato all'interno dello sviluppo farmaceutico, siete responsabili di studi di laboratorio relativi alla formulazione del prodotto di droga e allo sviluppo di processo per le forme di dosaggio parenterale, tra cui grandi molecole biologiche, piccole molecole sintetiche e terapia genica. L'opportunità
• Pianificare e coordinare i pacchetti di lavoro di laboratorio con il supporto del Leader del Progetto Farmaceutico (PPL) e dei coetanei
• Scrivere protocolli e report di studio
• Esegui gli studi pratici di laboratorio relativi alla formulazione e allo sviluppo dei processi dei prodotti farmaceutici (Ph0 a Ph3), identifica le esigenze di supporto, privilegia le attività e considera la flessibilità nell'esecuzione
• Analisi indipendente, interpretazione e risultati attuali
• Pianificare la tempistica, l'uso degli strumenti, i metodi analitici, i materiali e la logistica dei campioni per gli studi, garantendo un flusso e un deposito robusti e tempestivi.
• Standard di alta qualità dalla pianificazione dello studio, esecuzione e gestione dei dati, garantendo la corretta documentazione, integrità dei dati e l'adesione ad ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate +) e FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable) principi di dati.
• La posizione è limitata a 1 anno. L'estensione potrebbe essere possibile. Chi sei
• Apprendistato completo come tecnico di laboratorio chimico/biologica; Assistente chimico-tecnico (CTA) o Assistente Biologica-tecnico (BTA) o settori correlati
• Conoscenza e esperienza pratica in laboratorio
• È richiesto un alto grado di auto-motivazione, curiosità e alta aspirazione in termini di qualità
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione con un profondo impegno a lavorare in un ambiente orientato alla consegna
• Forte atteggiamento da giocatore di squadra
• Forte interesse ad abbracciare nuovi modi di lavorare e di agire come agente di cambiamento
• Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato) è un must. Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) arbeitet mit allen F&E-Motoren innerhalb der Roche-Gruppe zusammen und unterstützt mehr als 100 Entwicklungsprojekte mit CMC-Aktivitäten (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls). Pharma Technical Development (PTD) bringt bahnbrechende Therapien aus der klinischen Phase I auf den Markt, um jeden Patienten jeden Tag zu bedienen. Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Entwicklung sicherer, innovativer und wirksamer Medikamente unter Verwendung modernster Technologien für Herstellungsprozesse (Drug Substance and Drug Product), klinische Versorgung, Formulierung, Gerät, Verpackung und analytische Entwicklung. Unsere tägliche Arbeit umfasst auch die Erstellung von regulatorischen Dokumenten und die Übertragung von Entwicklungsprojekten auf die kommerzielle Fertigung. Wir streben eine fürsorgliche und wahrnehmende Netzwerkorganisation an, die eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der Zusammenarbeit lebt. Der Nutzen für den Patienten steht im Mittelpunkt unserer Gedanken und Bemühungen. Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, haben wir neue Wege des Arbeitens und Denkens angenommen. Die Abteilung Pharmazeutische Entwicklung ist für die Entwicklung parenteraler Arzneimittelprodukte von Phase 1 bis Launch verantwortlich. Die Aktivitäten umfassen die Entwicklung von Formulierungs- und Herstellungsprozessen für parenterale Arzneimittel für alle klinischen Stadien und den Markt, die Übertragung von Produkt und Prozess an kommerzielle Fertigungsstätten, kommerzielle Produktunterstützung, Entwicklung von Linienerweiterungen und Arzneimittellieferungen für vorklinische Studien. Als Associate Scientist bei Pharmaceutical Development sind Sie für Laborstudien im Zusammenhang mit der Formulierung von Arzneimitteln und der Prozessentwicklung für parenterale Darreichungsformen verantwortlich, einschließlich großer biologischer Moleküle, kleiner synthetischer Moleküle und Gentherapie. Die Chance
• Planen und koordinieren Sie Laborarbeitspakete mit Unterstützung des Pharmaceutical Project Leader (PPL) und Kollegen
• Schreiben Sie Studienprotokolle und Berichte
• Führen Sie praktische Laborstudien im Zusammenhang mit der Formulierung von parenteralen Arzneimitteln und der Prozessentwicklung (Ph0 bis Ph3) durch, identifizieren Sie den Unterstützungsbedarf, priorisieren Sie Aufgaben und berücksichtigen Sie Flexibilität bei der Ausführung
• Unabhängig analysieren, interpretieren und präsentieren Ergebnisse

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche dirige l'industrie en ce qui concerne l'investissement dans la R-D. Nous conduisons un des pipelines les plus importants et les plus prometteurs. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) collabore avec tous les moteurs de R-D du groupe Roche et soutient plus de 100 projets de développement dans le cadre des activités de CMC (Chimie, fabrication et contrôles). Pharma Technical Development (PTD) apporte des thérapies de changement de jeu de la phase clinique I dans le marché pour servir chaque patient, tous les jours. Notre activité principale consiste à mettre au point des médicaments sûrs, innovateurs et efficaces à l'aide de technologies de pointe pour les procédés de fabrication (substance médicamenteuse et produit pharmaceutique), l'approvisionnement clinique, la formulation, l'appareillage, l'emballage et le développement analytique. Notre travail quotidien comprend également la compilation de documents réglementaires et le transfert de projets de développement à la fabrication commerciale. Nous nous efforçons de créer un réseau de soins et de détection, qui vit une culture de confiance et de collaboration. Nos personnes intelligentes stimulent l'innovation grâce à leur expertise, leur passion et leur mentalité. Le bénéfice pour le patient est au centre de nos pensées et de nos efforts. Pour atteindre cet objectif, nous avons adopté de nouvelles façons de travailler et de penser. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de médicaments parentéraux de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux à toutes les étapes cliniques et sur le marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés aux sites de fabrication commerciaux, le soutien des produits commerciaux, le développement d'extensions de gamme et l'approvisionnement en produits pharmaceutiques pour les études précliniques. En tant que scientifique associé au sein de Développement pharmaceutique, vous êtes responsable des études de laboratoire liées à la formulation de produits pharmaceutiques et à l'élaboration de procédés pour les formes posologiques parentérales, y compris les grandes molécules biologiques, les petites molécules synthétiques et la thérapie génique. • Planifier et coordonner les trousses de travail en laboratoire avec le soutien du chef de projet pharmaceutique et des pairs
• Écrire des protocoles d'étude et des rapports
• Exécuter des études pratiques en laboratoire liées à la formulation de produits médicamenteux parentéraux et à l'élaboration de procédés (Ph0 à Ph3), déterminer les besoins de soutien, prioriser les tâches et envisager la souplesse dans l'exécution
• Analyser, interpréter et présenter les résultats de façon indépendante
• Planifier le calendrier, l'utilisation des instruments, les méthodes d'analyse, les matériaux et la logistique des échantillons pour les études, en assurant un débit et un stockage des échantillons robustes et opportuns.
• Norme de haute qualité de planification, d'exécution et de traitement des données des études, assurant une documentation adéquate, l'intégrité des données et le respect de l'ALCOA+ (Attributable, lisible, contemporain, original, précis +) et FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable et Réutilisable).
• Le poste est limité à 1 an. Une extension pourrait être possible. Qui vous êtes
• Apprentissage complété en tant que technicien de laboratoire chimique/biologique; assistant technique chimique (CTA) ou assistant technique biologique (BTA) ou domaines connexes
• Connaissances éprouvées et expérience pratique en laboratoire
• Un haut degré de motivation, de curiosité et d'aspiration en termes de qualité est nécessaire
• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration avec un engagement profond à travailler dans un environnement orienté vers la prestation
• Forte attitude des joueurs de l'équipe
• Intérêt marqué d'adopter de nouvelles façons de travailler et d'agir comme agent de changement
• L'anglais (écrit et parlé) est un must. Les compétences linguistiques en allemand sont un plus.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers - we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

• In Vivo - in vitro Immunosafety Integration & Mechanistic Strategy: Formulate, implement, and champion integrated immunosafety strategies for portfolio projects, ensuring the scientific validation and execution of predictive immunological biomarkers. Interrogate and decode in vivo immunosafety findings (e.g., changes in lymphoid architecture, immunogenicity readouts, cytokine profiles, or systemic hypersensitivities) and connect them back to mechanistic context using investigative in vitro tools. Translate complex immunological findings into unified safety position documentation, presenting definitive impact summaries for target validation, compound profiling, and IND/CTA-enabling packages.

• Advancing In Vitro Cellular Models via Immunological Elements: Proactively apply human immunology elements (e.g., primary immune cells, immune-epithelial co-cultures, inflammatory stimulus circuits) to upgrade the physiological accuracy of predictive in vitro cell models. Pioneer the optimisation, validation, and scale of 2D, 3D, and fluidic microphysiological safety systems, ensuring that models capture intricate human-specific responses like cytokine release syndromes, immune-mediated organ toxicities, or structural hypersensitivities. Drive proficiency in state-of-the-art analytical platforms such as high-content screening, flow cytometry, multiplexed fluid assays, and spatial or transcriptomic single-cell readouts.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - French speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English and French , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Developer - Banco de Sangre
¿Te apasiona generar un impacto directo en la salud de las personas a través de la innovación comercial? Como Business Developer - Banco de Sangre , te unirás a un equipo dinámico enfocado en expandir el negocio de diagnóstico y construir relaciones sólidas con nuestros clientes . Esta es una oportunidad única para liderar estrategias comerciales que maximicen la rentabilidad y aseguren los más altos niveles de satisfacción en el sector sanitario .

La Oportunidad

Implementarás las acciones de los planes estratégicos en las cuentas, siendo un experto comercial en la línea de negocio asignada, con el objetivo de promocionar técnicamente los productos, así como expandir el negocio de diagnóstico logrando así la más alta satisfacción del cliente construyendo relaciones efectivas, maximizar la participación de mercado y la rentabilidad en los productos a cargo.

• Conocerás y verificarás las necesidades de las cuentas asignadas.

• Contribuirás a la construcción, mantenimiento y ejecución de un “Plan Estratégico por Cuenta”.

• Serás el experto interlocutor interno de las necesidades de sus stakeholder a cargo.

• Asegurarás el nivel de visitas de asesoramiento y seguimiento con la adecuada actualización de la información técnica y de negocio en clientes y prospectos.

• Serás responsable de realizar ofertas y propuestas comerciales de acuerdo a las necesidades relevadas en sus clientes.

Quién eres

• Posees formación universitaria concluida en las carreras de Administración, Ingeniería o áreas afines, y cuentas con tu cédula profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con experiencia en desarrollo de negocios, ventas consultivas o roles comerciales dentro del sector de la salud o diagnóstico médico .

• Tienes una mentalidad estratégica y la habilidad de ejecutar planes comerciales orientados a resultados y a la satisfacción del cliente .

• Destacas por tus excelentes habilidades interpersonales, comunicando con fluidez y construyendo relaciones efectivas con diversos perfiles de clientes .

• Te caracteriza tu proactividad, autonomía y un estilo de trabajo altamente colaborativo .

Esta posición no incluye beneficios de relocación.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - Italian & Spanish speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English, plus Italian and Spanish , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility

jobs.title: DMPK-PD Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategy & Design: Define and lead drug design and optimisation strategies and compound profiling integrating cutting-edge Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) principles, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 5-10 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related role

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. L'opportunità Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Strategia & Design: Definire e condurre strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione della droga e profilazione dei composti che integrano i principi di Metabolismo e Farmacokinetics (DMPK) all'avanguardia, con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia e di traduzione PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).
• Esperienza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.
• Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per i progetti che spaziano dall'Optimizzazione di piombo (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce e di fine stadio (EIH, Ph 2/3).
• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le recensioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assicurando la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.
• Attuazione: Implement biomarker e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire sia la sicurezza del paziente che il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion trasparente, data-driven decision-making, agendo come consulente affidabile e coltivando relazioni professionali di alta fiducia in team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne. Chi sei
• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 5-10 anni di esperienza nel settore in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica
• Possiedi competenze profonde e complete in tutta la scoperta

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Die Chance Als erfahrener DMPK-PD-Projektleiter innerhalb der Translationalen DMPK-PD-Gruppe sind Sie von entscheidender Bedeutung, um sicherzustellen, dass das richtige Medikament in der richtigen Dosis sicher und wirksam an Patienten abgegeben wird. Sie werden nichtklinische und translationale Strategien leiten und in therapeutischen Bereichen zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche Hypothesen in bahnbrechende klinische Kandidaten umzuwandeln. Ihre Auswirkungen und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Strategie & Design: Definieren und führen Sie Arzneimitteldesign- und -optimierungsstrategien und Compound-Profiling-Integration modernster Arzneimittelmetabolismus und Pharmakokinetik (DMPK) Prinzipien, mit einem starken Fokus auf Zielbiologie-Validierung und translationalen PK / Pharmakodynamik (PD) Konzepte.
• Translationale Expertise: Dienen Sie als Fachexperte und leiten Sie frühe Entdeckungsteams bei der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller translationaler Strategien für die klinische Bewertung der Zielmodulation und nutzen Sie tiefe biochemische und pharmakologische Kenntnisse.
• Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Führen Sie grundlegende M&S-Aktivitäten durch, einschließlich PKPD, Physiologisch-Basierte Pharmakokinetik (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI) und Vorhersage der menschlichen Dosis/Therapie, um eine wesentliche Unterstützung für Projekte zu bieten, die von der Lead-Optimierung (LO) bis zur frühen und späten klinischen Entwicklung reichen (EIH, Ph 2/3).
• Regulatory Mastery: Autor und Präsentiert endgültige, qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Daten für kritische interne Programmüberprüfungen und alle wichtigen externen regulatorischen Einreichungen (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), um die globale Compliance und beschleunigte Zeitpläne zu gewährleisten.
• Umsetzung: Umsetzung von Biomarker- und bioanalytischen Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Partnern, um sowohl die Patientensicherheit als auch die Erzielung eines sinnvollen therapeutischen Nutzens zu gewährleisten.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparente, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, als vertrauenswürdiger Berater fungieren und vertrauensvolle professionelle Beziehungen zwischen globalen Projektteams, Governance-Gremien und externen Partnerschaften pflegen. Wer du bist
• Sie haben eine PharmD oder PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering oder ähnlich, gepaart mit über 5-10 Jahren Branchenerfahrung in einer pharmakokinetischen Rolle
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes, umfassendes Fachwissen über die gesamte Entdeckung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. L'opportunité En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de DMPK-PD au sein du Groupe DMPK-PD, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, de façon sûre et efficace, aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Stratégie et conception : Définir et diriger les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et établir le profil des composés en intégrant les principes de pointe du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments, en mettant fortement l'accent sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts translationnels de PK/Pharmacodynamique (PD).
• Expertise translationnelle : servir d'expert en la matière, guider les équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.
• Modélisation et simulation (M&S) : Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets qui vont de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) jusqu'au développement clinique en début et en fin de développement (EIH, Ph 2/3).
• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives et de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et des délais accélérés.
• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer la sécurité des patients et d'obtenir des avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.
• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décision transparente et axée sur les données, agissant comme conseiller de confiance et cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organismes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 5-10 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie dans un rôle lié à la pharmacocinétique
• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète dans toute la découverte
