Ce rôle de chef de file en matière de programmes et de solutions - le numérique et la technologie (approvisionnement) fait partie du chapitre Stratégie et solutions, où notre mission consiste à orchestrer les priorités stratégiques, à catalyser la valeur de l'entreprise et à amplifier l'excellence en matière d'approvisionnement. Nous ne nous contentons pas de gérer les processus; nous conduisons une amélioration continue pour renforcer l'impact des achats mondiaux sur toute l'organisation Roche. En tant que responsable des programmes et des solutions, vous guiderez une équipe agile et performante axée sur le numérique et la technologie. Votre mandat est de diriger la responsabilité de mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes et d'accélérer l'impact des achats. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'équipe à livrer contre un portefeuille à impact élevé comprenant:
• Innovation axée sur le marché et les fournisseurs : Co-création de solutions de premier marché pour résoudre des défis complexes. On s'attend à ce que vous mettiez en doute le statu quo et redéfinissiez les méthodes de travail, en regardant au-delà de la chaîne de valeur traditionnelle pour obtenir un impact au-delà des mesures d'approvisionnement standard.
• Programmes et projets stratégiques complexes : Accélération et amplification des résultats pour les initiatives d'approvisionnement à fort rendement, comme les programmes à grande échelle (p. ex. transformation des coûts) et les projets essentiels (p. ex. négociations et approvisionnement complexes). Ces initiatives sont choisies pour leur poids stratégique, leur impact et leur faisabilité. Vous dirigerez une équipe qui s'attend à établir la norme d'or pour la qualité et le rythme, exigeant un « développement continu » pour rester en avance sur les tendances du marché. C'est une chance d'obtenir un impact mesurable tout en façonnant une culture d'équipe qui reflète l'engagement de Roche pour les personnes et les patients. Au-delà de l'exécution du projet, vous serez un bâtisseur communautaire, favorisant une culture de curiosité, de sécurité psychologique et de collaboration radicale où les gens se sentent capables d'expérimenter et de grandir. Vous entraînerez une équipe moyenne à grande, guiderez l'affectation des ressources au travail d'impact le plus élevé et la planification pour transformer les objectifs de haut niveau en réalité. La possibilité :
• Leadership de portefeuille et de programme : Dirigez votre équipe dans un environnement mondial rapide pour gérer un portefeuille diversifié de solutions et de programmes (y compris les transformations des coûts et les négociations critiques) qui offrent une valeur considérable aux intervenants du numérique et de la technologie.
• Culture et développement communautaire : Culturer un environnement de confiance et d'inclusion. Vous serez un moteur clé dans la construction d'une communauté où les membres de l'équipe se sentent en sécurité pour partager les échecs comme apprentissages, célébrer les succès ensemble et collaborer au-delà des frontières pour susciter de nouvelles idées.
• Resource Orchestration: équilibre dynamiquement les ressources pour maximiser l'impact; vous travaillerez à travers les réseaux et les équipes pour s'assurer que le bon talent est au bon endroit au bon moment.
• Innovation stratégique et résolution des problèmes : Diagnostiquer les besoins complexes des entreprises dans l'espace numérique et technique, en choisissant la bonne approche (p. ex. Solution versus programme) en cherchant des pistes pour accélérer la réalisation de valeur
• Excellence du cadre : Diriger la conception et le perfectionnement des outils et des cadres du projet pour les deux « au-delà de l'approvisionnement et du 3 »

jobs.title: Principal Software/Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Innovation Accelerator (IA) team, the innovation engine and connective tissue for Design, Data and Data Science innovation strategy within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). We translate our long-term PDD vision into actionable strategy, shaping and prioritizing innovative cross-functional use cases that span PDD, PD, and Pharma. As both integrators and incubators, we explore, prototype, and help productize solutions to deliver impact in close partnership with internal Roche teams and external collaborators. With a mindset rooted in openness, value creation, and adaptability, we navigate the innovation ecosystem to drive transformative impact and future readiness across the organization.

The Opportunity

• You design and implement robust, secure, and scalable software architectures that support data- and ML-driven products

• You build front-end interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue) to enable intuitive user interactions with complex data outputs

• You develop and maintain back-end APIs and data pipelines that integrate models and data into production-grade environments

• You write simple, elegant, well-structured, and well-tested applications, software, and/or code that drive new features and improvements across all our products and services in adherence with regulatory compliance

• You collaborate with UX designers, data scientists, and product managers to align on user needs and translate them into technical solutions

• You monitor and optimize the performance, reliability, and maintainability of deployed software systems

• You enable reproducibility and development efficiency by implementing standardized logging, version control, and configuration management, while contributing to internal knowledge sharing and reusable code libraries

• You partner with IT teams to manage CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and security protocols

• You participate in agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to backlog refinement and prioritization

• You apply a product-thinking mindset to balance technical trade-offs with user impact and business value

• You develop tools and dashboards for monitoring data flows, system health, and model performance

• You keep up to date with emerging technologies in software, cloud, and data engineering to continuously improve practices

• You support early pilots, MVPs, and scaled implementations across therapeutic areas by ensuring smooth deployment of experiments and applications in cloud and custom PaaS environments

• You embrace a collaborative culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and feedback

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field

• You have a minimum of 8 years of experience in software engineering, including leading architecture or infrastructure efforts for data-centric or ML-powered applications; or an advanced degree with 6 years of equivalent work experience

• You have 4+ years of experience with relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)

• You have 4+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines using tools such as DVC, Pandas, Airflow

• You have strong proficiency in front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) and back-end API development

• You have hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terra

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sul team di Innovation Accelerator (IA), sul motore di innovazione e sul tessuto connettivo per la strategia di innovazione di Design, Data e Data Science nell'ambito delle Scienze dei Dati di Sviluppo del Prodotto (PDD). Traduciamo la nostra visione PDD a lungo termine in strategia attuabile, modellando e dando priorità a innovativi casi di uso interfunzionale che abbracciano PDD, PD e Pharma. • Progetta e implementa architetture software robuste, sicure e scalabili che supportano i prodotti data- e ML-driven
• Costruisci interfacce front-end utilizzando framework moderni (ad esempio React, Vue) per consentire interazioni utente intuitive con uscite di dati complesse
• Sviluppi e mantieni API e datadotti di back-end che integrano modelli e dati in ambienti di produzione
• Scrivete applicazioni, software e/o codici semplici, eleganti, ben strutturati e ben testati che guidano nuove funzionalità e miglioramenti in tutti i nostri prodotti e servizi in conformità alle normative

• Monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni, l'affidabilità e la manutenbilità dei sistemi software distribuiti
• È possibile abilitare la riproducibilità e l'efficienza dello sviluppo implementando logging standardizzato, il controllo delle versioni e la gestione della configurazione, contribuendo al contempo alla condivisione delle conoscenze interne e alle librerie di codice riutilizzabili
• Collaborate con i team IT per gestire i protocolli CI/CD, infrastruttura cloud e sicurezza
• Partecipate a cerimonie agili (ad esempio, pianificazione sprint, recensioni, retrospettive) e contribuiscono alla raffinatezza e alla priorità del backlog
• Si applica una mentalità di prodotto per bilanciare i trade-off tecnici con impatto utente e valore aziendale
• Sviluppi strumenti e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei flussi di dati, la salute del sistema e le prestazioni del modello
• Si mantiene aggiornato con le tecnologie emergenti in software, cloud e ingegneria dei dati per migliorare continuamente le pratiche
• Supporti i primi piloti, i MVP e le implementazioni scalate in aree terapeutiche, assicurando una distribuzione fluida di esperimenti e applicazioni in ambienti cloud e PaaS personalizzati
• Abbracci una cultura collaborativa di apprendimento continuo, sperimentazione e feedback Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea o master in Informatica, Ingegneria, Scienza dei dati, o un campo tecnico correlato
• Hai un minimo di 8 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, tra cui i principali sforzi di architettura o infrastruttura per applicazioni data-centric o ML-powered; o un grado avanzato con 6 anni di esperienza lavorativa equivalente
• Hai 4+ anni di esperienza con sistemi di database relazionali e non relazionali (ad esempio, PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)
• Hai 4 anni di esperienza nella costruzione e nell'ottimizzazione dei datadotti utilizzando strumenti come DVC, Pandas, Airflow
• Hai una forte competenza nei framework front-end (ad esempio React, Angular) e back-end API sviluppo
• Hai esperienza pratica con i servizi cloud (AWS, GCP o Azure) e le infrastrutture come codice (ad esempio, Terra

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Wir setzen unsere langfristige PDD-Vision in eine umsetzbare Strategie um und gestalten und priorisieren innovative funktionsübergreifende Anwendungsfälle, die PDD, PD und Pharma umfassen. • Sie entwerfen und implementieren robuste, sichere und skalierbare Softwarearchitekturen, die daten- und ML-gesteuerte Produkte unterstützen
• Sie erstellen Front-End-Schnittstellen mit modernen Frameworks (z. B. React, Vue), um intuitive Benutzerinteraktionen mit komplexen Datenausgaben zu ermöglichen
• Sie entwickeln und pflegen Backend-APIs und Datenpipelines, die Modelle und Daten in Produktionsumgebungen integrieren

• Sie arbeiten mit IT-Teams zusammen, um CI/CD-Pipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Sicherheitsprotokolle zu verwalten

• Sie wenden eine produktorientierte Denkweise an, um technische Kompromisse mit Benutzerwirkung und Geschäftswert auszugleichen
• Sie entwickeln Tools und Dashboards zur Überwachung von Datenflüssen, Systemzustand und Modellleistung
• Sie halten sich mit neuen Technologien in den Bereichen Software, Cloud und Data Engineering auf dem Laufenden, um die Praktiken kontinuierlich zu verbessern
• Sie unterstützen frühe Piloten, MVPs und skalierte Implementierungen in therapeutischen Bereichen, indem Sie einen reibungslosen Einsatz von Experimenten und Anwendungen in Cloud- und benutzerdefinierten PaaS-Umgebungen sicherstellen
• Sie umarmen eine kollaborative Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, Experimentierens und Feedbacks Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich
• Sie haben mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, einschließlich führender Architektur- oder Infrastrukturbemühungen für datenzentrierte oder ML-basierte Anwendungen; oder einen höheren Abschluss mit 6 Jahren gleichwertiger Berufserfahrung
• Sie haben über 4 Jahre Erfahrung mit relationalen und nicht-relationalen Datenbanksystemen (z.B. PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)
• Sie haben mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Optimieren von Datenpipelines mit Tools wie DVC, Pandas, Airflow
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in Front-End-Frameworks (z. B. React, Angular) und Back-End-API-Entwicklung
• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Services (AWS, GCP oder Azure) und Infrastruktur als Code (z.B. Terra)

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Nous transformons notre vision à long terme de la DDP en stratégie concrète, en concevant et en priorisant des cas d'utilisation transfonctionnels innovateurs qui couvrent la DDP, la DPP et la pharmacie. En tant qu'intégrateurs et incubateurs, nous explorons, prototypes et aidons à produire des solutions pour produire de l'impact en partenariat étroit avec des équipes internes Roche et des collaborateurs externes. Avec une mentalité ancrée dans l'ouverture, la création de valeur et l'adaptabilité, nous naviguons dans l'écosystème de l'innovation pour stimuler l'impact transformateur et la préparation future dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. • Vous développez des outils et des tableaux de bord pour surveiller les flux de données, la santé du système et les performances des modèles
• Vous vous tenez au courant des nouvelles technologies dans le domaine des logiciels, du cloud et de l'ingénierie des données pour améliorer continuellement les pratiques
• Vous aidez les premiers pilotes, les MVP et les implémentations à grande échelle dans les zones thérapeutiques en assurant le déploiement en douceur des expériences et des applications dans les environnements cloud et PaaS personnalisés
• Vous adoptez une culture collaborative d'apprentissage continu, d'expérimentation et de rétroaction Qui vous êtes :

jobs.title: Strategic Quality Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to an inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing inclusion and belonging enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

We are seeking a highly motivated Strategic Quality Partner (SQP) to join our Product Development Quality organization, reporting to the Subchapter lead Product Development Quality. As the Strategic Quality Partner, you will be responsible for ensuring effective partnerships with Development Project Teams in the Molecular Lab - Sequencing Solutions portfolio, thriving for project acceleration and ensuring no delay in milestones and project execution. You drive consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs). You ensure the deployment and implementation of the Design & Development Process and drive awareness and adoption of Risk based decision making across all functions. You are an example of living collective success by working, trusting and empowering each other.

The Opportunity

• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)

• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements

• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions

• Support internal and external audits

• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings

• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions

• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)

• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.

• 8+ years of experience in the diagnostics industry or a related field in business related Functions

• Strong scientific and technical background preferable in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) with sound product knowledge, ideally with assay/reagents/system/hardware/software development experience for IVD Products.

• Strong business and financial acumen with an enterprise mindset

• Knowledge of Regulations pertaining to the environment (i.e. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GDP, GMP, others)

• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Strong agile knowledge and capabilities demonstrating new ways of working

• Pragmatic decision making and ability to move forward without a perfect solution

• Demonstrated thorough E2E understanding for lifecycle management

• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in leading cross-functional teams (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) and driving change.

Locations
You are located in Santa Clara, California. This is a primarily onsite role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to an inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing inclusion and belonging enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

We are seeking a highly motivated Strategic Quality Partner (SQP) to join our Product Development Quality organization, reporting to the Subchapter lead Product Development Quality. As the Strategic Quality Partner, you will be responsible for ensuring effective partnerships with Development Project Teams in the Molecular Lab - Sequencing Solutions portfolio, thriving for project acceleration and ensuring no delay in milestones and project execution. You drive consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs). You ensure the deployment and implementation of the Design & Development Process and drive awareness and adoption of Risk based decision making across all functions. You are an example of living collective success by working, trusting and empowering each other.

The Opportunity

• Ensure consistent interpretation & implementation of global requirements across Customer Areas (CAs)

• Incorporate lessons learned from all areas of quality across Customer Areas (CA) into project support and ensure PostMarket Quality feedback is built into the requirements

• Ensure development project plans contain the right deliverables according to the Design & Development module to deliver safe and compliant solutions

• Support internal and external audits

• Lead and facilitate constructive discussions e.g. at project team meetings

• Drive awareness and adoption of the Risk Enabler inside and outside of Global Quality & Regulatory decision making; prepare and enable risk-based decisions

• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)

• Ensure effective feedback loops and information flow for milestone review.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business administration or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is considered an advantage.

• 8+ years of experience in the diagnostics industry or a related field in business related Functions

• Strong scientific and technical background preferable in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) with sound product knowledge, ideally with assay/reagents/system/hardware/software development experience for IVD Products.

• Strong business and financial acumen with an enterprise mindset

• Knowledge of Regulations pertaining to the environment (i.e. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GDP, GMP, others)

• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

• Strong agile knowledge and capabilities demonstrating new ways of working

• Pragmatic decision making and ability to move forward without a perfect solution

• Demonstrated thorough E2E understanding for lifecycle management

• Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in leading cross-functional teams (Squad Lead, Matrix Lead) and driving change.

Locations
You are located in Santa Clara, California. This is a primarily onsite role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The position manages a key account in Berkeley, CA. Candidates should live within 50 miles of Berkeley, CA.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $81,700 and $151,700 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As the R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates.
Your key responsibilities will include:

• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.

• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.

• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.

• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow.

Who you are:
You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines.
Requirements and Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.

• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.

• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .

• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.

• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish .

• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.

• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, toget

jobs.title: Estagiário de Engenharia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário de Engenharia - Customer Experience, você integrará a equipe de atendimento ao cliente, oferecendo suporte vital às operações diárias. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar seus conhecimentos técnicos e causar um impacto positivo na experiência dos nossos clientes.

A Oportunidade:

• Você realiza o cadastro de peças e a consolidação de informações em planilhas de Excel.

• Você fornece suporte essencial ao time de especialistas de campo e interage constantemente com a equipe.

• Você controla e afere instrumentos e ferramentas utilizadas nas operações.

• Você atua no controle de modificações e gerencia as manutenções preventivas.

• Você monitora os casos de preparação do local ( site preparation ), bem como os processos de instalação e desinstalação.

• Você oferece suporte na utilização das ferramentas ASA, Online Support e cobas link.

• Você presta suporte presencial ( on site ) de forma proativa aos clientes da sua base.

Quem você é:

• Você tem previsão de conclusão de curso acadêmico a partir de 2028 e manterá vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias.

• Você possui conhecimento técnico/científico na área e demonstra um raciocínio analítico, lógico e focado.

• Você tem conhecimento, no mínimo intermediário, do pacote Windows Office.

• Você é proativo, demonstra grande interesse em aprender e mantém uma postura atenta e cuidadosa em suas atividades.

• Você constrói um bom relacionamento com todas as áreas e valoriza fortemente o trabalho em equipe.

• Você não se importa em lidar com demandas de rotina operacional e se adapta bem a elas.

Desejável:

• Você possui conhecimento de inglês em nível intermediário.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every person deserves a healthy future — and that starts with ensuring the right medicines reach the right patients. We're looking for a strategic leader to shape how Indonesia's healthcare system values and accesses innovative therapies, working at the intersection of public policy, communications, and patient impact.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences who share our commitment to improving lives through science.

Your Opportunity
As Chapter Lead, you will sit on Indonesia's Leadership Team and play a central role in shaping the country's medicines access strategy — ensuring eligible patients can reach Roche's innovative therapies. You'll build and lead a high-performing team while driving relationships across government, health authorities, and patient organizations.
In this role, you will:

• Build productive relationships with government bodies, the Ministry of Health, and patient groups to strengthen treatment access and delivery nationally

• Lead the development of public policy strategies that create a favorable environment for healthcare investment and innovative treatment access

• Oversee the process for securing formulary listings and drive proposals that expand or extend access to Roche therapies

• Shape communications strategy and campaigns that reflect the business's long-term vision and key brand priorities

• Represent Roche in industry trade groups and collaborate with regional and global teams to share learnings across markets

• Lead early strategic analysis of local market potential for new therapies entering the pipeline

• Coach, mentor, and develop your team, embedding a culture of collaboration, integrity, and continuous growth

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in a relevant field such as life sciences, political science, health economics, public health, or business; an MBA is a plus

• You bring at least 10 years of experience in specialty therapeutic areas, ideally within pharmaceuticals, health economics, or private payer industries

• You have a track record of engaging senior stakeholders across complex, matrixed organizations

• You're a strong communicator with excellent analytical and business presentation skills

• You bring proven people leadership experience, with a genuine passion for developing others

• You act with integrity, courage, and a strategic mindset, and you're energized by driving impact at a national level

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, crediamo che ogni persona meriti un futuro sano — e che inizia con garantire i farmaci giusti raggiungere i pazienti giusti. Stiamo cercando un leader strategico per modellare i valori del sistema sanitario indonesiano e accedere a terapie innovative, lavorando all'intersezione della politica pubblica, delle comunicazioni e dell'impatto del paziente. Accogliamo con favore i candidati provenienti da tutti i background e le esperienze che condividono il nostro impegno a migliorare la vita attraverso la scienza. La tua opportunità Come Capo Piombo, si siederà sul team di Leadership in Indonesia e svolgere un ruolo centrale nella definizione della strategia di accesso ai farmaci del paese - assicurando che i pazienti idonei possano raggiungere le terapie innovative di Roche. Costruirai e guiderai un team di alto livello durante la guida di relazioni tra governo, autorità sanitarie e organizzazioni dei pazienti. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Costruire relazioni produttive con gli enti governativi, il Ministero della Salute e i gruppi di pazienti per rafforzare l'accesso al trattamento e la consegna a livello nazionale
• Condurre lo sviluppo di strategie di politica pubblica che creano un ambiente favorevole per gli investimenti sanitari e l'accesso al trattamento innovativo
• Superare il processo per garantire elenchi formulari e proposte di azionamento che espandono o estendono l'accesso alle terapie Roche
• Forma strategia di comunicazione e campagne che riflettono la visione a lungo termine del business e le priorità chiave del marchio
• Rappresentare Roche nei gruppi di commercio del settore e collaborare con i team regionali e globali per condividere gli insegnamenti sui mercati
• Analisi strategica precoce del potenziale di mercato locale per nuove terapie che entrano nel gasdotto
• Allenatore, mentore e sviluppare il vostro team, incorporando una cultura di collaborazione, integrità e crescita continua Chi sei
• Lei ha una laurea in un campo rilevante come le scienze della vita, la scienza politica, l'economia della salute, la salute pubblica, o il commercio; un MBA è un plus
• Porti almeno 10 anni di esperienza in aree terapeutiche speciali, idealmente all'interno di farmaceutici, economia sanitaria, o industrie di payer private
• Hai un track record di coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior in organizzazioni complesse e matrici
• Sei un comunicatore forte con eccellenti capacità di presentazione analitica e aziendale
• Porti delle persone provate esperienza di leadership, con una vera passione per lo sviluppo di altri
• Agite con integrità, coraggio e mentalità strategica, e siete eccitati dalla guida di impatto a livello nazionale Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats.

As a CyberSecurity Analyst -Monitoring & Incident Response , you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

Note: As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare sol

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

• Highly efficient and results-driven, demonstrating strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

• Commercial awareness and product knowledge, plus the ability to be a team player who thrives and collaborates in a cross-functional, fast-changing environment.

• Required education is a Bachelor or Master Degree in Health/Science/Medical disciplines (Tertiary qualification in Science and Business focus is desired), preferably with at least one year of related industry experience.

• High technical ability and computer literacy are required, along with a valid Malaysian driver’s license and the ability to travel interstate; IT, people management, marketing, and business development experience are beneficial.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster

Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Innovation Manager, you will be responsible for developing and delivering the strategy for AI & Digital innovative healthcare solutions while implementing digital solutions aligned with the specific disease’s or Access team’s business objectives. Improve patient outcomes and transform disease management practice by demonstrating and communicating the medical value of AI & Digital innovative solutions. This role involves close collaboration with medical affairs, CE (Customer Engagement) and Access teams to ensure strategic alignment and successful implementation of digital healthcare initiatives.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategy and Digital Solution Implementation

• Develop and deliver the disease area (or function)-based strategy for AI & Digital innovative healthcare solutions.

• Implement digital solutions to align with specific customer facing team’s business objectives.

2. Clinical Value Demonstration and Communication

• Improve patient outcomes and transform disease management practice by demonstrating and communicating the clinical/business value of AI & Digital Innovations.

3. Innovative Technology and Therapy Access

• Broaden the availability of innovative technologies (e.g., digital tools, AI, ML, DL) and therapies tailored to individual patients’ specific disease profiles or the healthcare system’s unmet needs.

4. External Scientific Leadership

• Reinforce Roche’s external position as an innovation leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.

5. Compliance and Governance

• Ensure strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP, and local regulations for all initiatives.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications
1. Master degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. ＞3 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Required Competencies
1. The capability to address complex challenges through critical thinking and effective decision-making.
2. Understanding of business operations, financial analysis, and the ability to assess the viability and potential impact of new AI & Digital products.
3. Domain knowledge of AI and digital business in China healthcare industry.
4. In-depth understanding of the healthcare industry, including regulatory, technological, and market-specific nuances.
5. Demonstrated understanding of principles and techniques of integrated healthcare solution, algorithm methodology, IT technical related knowledge.
6. Demonstrated strong work ethic, and proven track record of delivering high quality within timelines
7. Demonstrated ability to think strategically and align with wide range of stakeholders
8. Strong influential communication and negotiation skills

Travel Frequency
>50%

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Product Manager, you will lead the strategic development and implementation guidance of AI & Digital empowered solutions, ensuring strict alignment with business objectives. You will drive the delivery of key initiatives including DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation, and Research Solutions. Success in this position requires partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE), and Access teams to foster strategic synergy and ensure the seamless execution of these digital innovations.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Develop and execute a long-term strategic plan for the assigned AI & Digital empowered solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, or Research Solutions) that aligns with the organization’s overall business goals.
a) Market Intelligence: Conduct regular analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats within the data-driven product management and marketing landscape.
b) Roadmap & Implementation: Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on the deployment of digital solutions; develop and maintain a phased roadmap to ensure structured execution and scalability.
c) Partnership Management: Establish and nurture relationships with external partners—including data providers, technology vendors, and industry experts—to leverage external capabilities and accelerate innovation.
d) Continuous Improvement: Create a systematic mechanism for the ongoing review and optimization of strategies, processes, and product performance across the solution lifecycle.

2. Scientific Leadership & Ecosystem Engagement Reinforce Roche’s position as a scientific leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.
a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage internal expertise while fostering collaborations with key players in the external AI & Digital Innovation ecosystem to demonstrate scientific value and address stakeholder needs.
b) Value Communication: Ensure the medical and scientific value of the digital solutions is effectively communicated and recognized by the healthcare system, leveraging existing medical team expertise and stakeholder networks.

3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies, SOPs, and local regulations across all initiatives.
a) Medical Governance: Uphold high standards of scientific and medical compliance, ensuring a balanced framework for risk/benefit management specifically tailored to digital health innovations.
b) Regulatory Adherence: Guarantee that all initiatives strictly comply with Roche’s SOPs, codes of conduct, and local regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. >2 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Req

Agilità strategica 2. Competenze tecniche e aziendali 3. Ispirare e influenzare 4. Lavoro di squadra e collaborazione 5. Esperienza di pensiero strategico e capacità di pianificazione. 6. Capacità dimostrata nella leadership interfunzionale, cross-industry e nella leadership dell'ecosistema Lavoro richiesto

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Morocco, Côte d'Ivoire, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, or South Africa.

Travel Requirement: The initial pilots for this initiative will be conducted in various African countries. Candidates must be prepared for extensive travel, particularly during the project's go-live and hypercare periods . Estimated travel: 50%

The Opportunity: Commercial Execution and Scale a High-Impact
Healthcare Model

At Roche, we are driven to do "Now What Patients Need Next". This is a unique opportunity to lead the on-the-ground execution of a transformative healthcare solution in Africa. We are seeking an entrepreneurial leader to spearhead the first-ever implementation of a new IVD- Access enabling business model.

The innovative model employs a Hub-and-Spoke approach to connect small and medium-sized IVD laboratories to a state-of-the-art central reference laboratory, dedicated to improving access to high-quality In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) in Africa and other low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The model seeks to catalyze the development of Lab Medicine practices in the selected countries by driving increased investment in capacity and capability development.

As the Business Development Lead, you will own the end-to-end success (strategic, operational, and commercial) of the initial pilot and the development of related models in Africa. Your primary mission is to drive the successful launch of the defined and validated business model, ensuring the business is commercially sustainable and scalable. This is an execution-focused role, responsible for bringing this innovative business model’s vision to life.

Your Mission: A Phased Approach to Impact
Your role will evolve through three distinct phases:
1. Execute the Blueprint: Lead the inaugural pilot implementation to establish a successful, sustainable operational foundation. This includes commercial accountability for the pilot and its expansion.
2. Codify & Deploy the Playbook: Ensure the systematic capture of insights and learnings from the first pilot to create a replicable, scalable playbook for future deployments.
3. Drive Replication: Leverage your practical expertise to support the scaling of other new business models across Subregion Africa, ensuring lessons from the pilot are integrated into future launches. This includes commercial accountability for future deployments.

Key
• Responsibilities
Phase 1: Pilot Leadership
● Lead the on-the-ground implementation and operational scaling of the innovative model in the first pilot market.
● Drive all commercial and contracting processes with laboratory network leaders to ensure sustainable deployment and financial viability.
● Engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and lab stakeholders to co-build the network, shape governance frameworks, and refine business models.
● Collaborate with internal experts (e.g., legal, finance, procurement) and external partners to ensure a compliant and sustainable deployment of the model.

Phase 2 & 3: Playbook Development & Replication Support
● Systematically translate pilot execution into a practical, replicable success model for other regions.
● Develop and empower regional and local teams through on-field coaching and guidance, building implementation expertise across the organization.
● Serve as the subject matter expert on the Model’s implementation, supporting the rollout of similar business models across public and private sectors in the sub-region.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, translating complex technical concepts into successful solutions addressing problems across R&D laboratories. Your responsibilities will span the entire solution lifecycle, from design to implementation, ensuring solutions meet high-performance standards and security requirements. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of enterprise IT landscapes, driving digital transformation and operational efficiency for organizations across various industries.

The Opportunity

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Solution Design: Architect scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions tailored to business needs.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Understand technical opportunities to improve business value. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value.

Who you are
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

• Hands on experience in creating PoCs

• Previous experience collaborating with R&D users preferred

Technical Skills

• Modern architecture practices, including effective use of non functional requirements

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

La Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzioni. In questo ruolo, collaborerai con team interfunzionali, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in soluzioni di successo che affrontano problemi nei laboratori R&D. Le tue responsabilità si estenderanno all'intero ciclo di vita della soluzione, dalla progettazione all'implementazione, garantendo soluzioni conformi agli standard e ai requisiti di sicurezza ad alte prestazioni. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per modellare il futuro dei paesaggi IT aziendali, guidare la trasformazione digitale e l'efficienza operativa per le organizzazioni di vari settori.

L'opportunità

• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico Context Solution. Gestisce i requisiti non operativi (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance.

• Solution Design: soluzioni scalabili, sicure e convenienti su misura per le esigenze aziendali.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves problemi complessi assumendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e sulle dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e ontologie per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, e assicura che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) sono adeguatamente registrati.

• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni difficili o sensibili in modo chiaro e attivo lavora per costruire il consenso tra le parti interessate. Guida la condivisione e lo scambio di informazioni sulla soluzione.

• Impatto/Strategia: comprendere le opportunità tecniche per migliorare il valore aziendale. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore.

Chi sei
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard, future-ready all'interno di un contesto di soluzione specifico.

• Provate a mantenere la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale per le soluzioni tecniche e valutando gli impatti delle iniziative sui paesaggi di rischio e di applicazione.

• Mani sull'esperienza nella creazione di PoC

• Precedente esperienza di collaborazione con gli utenti R&D preferiti

Competenze tecniche

• Pratiche di architettura moderna, compreso l'uso efficace dei requisiti non funzionali
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch innovative digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche vorantreibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Der Lösungsarchitekt konzentriert sich auf die Gestaltung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Funktion arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen und übersetzen komplexe technische Konzepte in erfolgreiche Lösungen, die Probleme in allen F & E-Labors lösen. Ihre Aufgaben erstrecken sich über den gesamten Lösungslebenszyklus, vom Design bis zur Implementierung, und stellen sicher, dass die Lösungen die hohen Leistungsstandards und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft von IT-Landschaften für Unternehmen zu gestalten und die digitale Transformation und operative Effizienz für Unternehmen in verschiedenen Branchen voranzutreiben.

Die Chance

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Entwirft Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einem bestimmten Solution Context erfüllen. Verwaltet nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen. Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an der Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance aus.

• Solution Design: Architekten skalierbare, sichere und kostengünstige Lösungen, die auf die Geschäftsanforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

• Rechenschaftspflicht / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Probleme, indem Sie eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen einnehmen und ein Urteil auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen fällen. Behält die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung bei. Beurteilt und berät über die Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und steuert Referenzarchitekturen, Muster und stellt sicher, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) angemessen aufgezeichnet werden.

• Stakeholder Management: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und arbeitet aktiv daran, einen Konsens zwischen den Stakeholdern zu schaffen. Fördert den Informationsaustausch und Austausch über die Lösung.

• Impact/Strategie: Verstehen Sie technische Möglichkeiten, um den Geschäftswert zu verbessern. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Anleitung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Wertsteigerung.

Wer du bist
Bildung / Erfahrung

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von unternehmensorientierten, standardbasierten, zukunftsfähigen Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext.

• Erleben Sie, wie Sie die Vision, den Fahrplan und die aktuelle Landschaft für technische Lösungen beibehalten und die Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiko- und Anwendungslandschaften bewerten.

• Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von PoCs

• Frühere Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit R&D-Anwendern bevorzugt

Technische Fähigkeiten

• Moderne Architekturpraktiken, einschließlich der effektiven Nutzung nicht funktionaler Anforderungen
