jobs.title: Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about strengthening healthcare partnerships to accelerate clinical innovation? As the Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL), you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic site engagement, optimizing clinical trial operations, and delivering an exceptional, streamlined experience for clinical trial sites.
In this role, you will champion a "One Roche" approach, acting as the primary point of contact for strategic sites and bringing together internal medical and operational teams to anticipate and support site needs. By establishing a collaborative local community and managing key relationships with Contract Research Organizations (CROs), you will ensure the successful, high-quality delivery of our portfolio from early to late-stage clinical development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Strategic Site Engagement: Develop and execute tailored country-level site engagement strategies across disease areas, fostering trust, operational excellence, and accelerated trial progression.

• Optimize Early Landscaping & Feasibility: Engage strategically with investigators during early trial setup, landscaping, and protocol review phases to identify the most suitable sites and optimize recruitment speed.

• Lead Relationship Management & Collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact for strategic clinical sites, building deep connections with investigators, pharmacists, and clinic administrations to align cross-study priorities and capture feedback trends.

• Coordinate Internal Communities: Convene and lead a local site engagement community (integrating Local Medical Affairs, field medical teams, and clinical operations) to streamline communications and enhance the site experience.

• Provide Global & Local Study Oversight: Oversee the planning, risk mitigation, and compliance of assigned clinical studies, tracking monitoring performance, risk-based monitoring plans, and trial master file completeness.

• Manage Partner Relationships: Collaborate closely with CRO partners throughout the clinical trial lifecycle to ensure unified delivery goals, high site satisfaction, and swift resolution of operational challenges.

• Ensure Inspection Readiness: Lead local quality reviews, internal audits, and regulatory inspections for allocated studies, ensuring absolute compliance with global quality standards and regulatory guidelines.

Who You Are
You are a strategic, relationship-driven clinical operations professional who excels in dynamic environments, leads cross-functional alignment through ambiguity, and holds a strong commitment to customer-centric delivery.
Qualifications & Skills:

• Education: Degree (MD, PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s) in life sciences or an equivalent discipline.

• Experience: Significant experience in the pharmaceutical or clinical research industry, with essential expertise in end-to-end product development and clinical trial processes.

• Relationship Management: A proven track record of managing site relationships, overseeing complex clinical trials, and effectively collaborating with CROs.

• Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities, proactively identify operational challenges, and develop effective, data-backed compliance and mitigation strategies.

• Communication & Influencing: Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to bridge communication gaps between global teams and local external stakeholders.

• Languages: Mandatory fluency

• Coordinate Comunità Interne: Convene e guida una comunità locale di coinvolgimento del sito (integrando gli Affari Locali, le squadre mediche di campo e le operazioni cliniche) per semplificare le comunicazioni e migliorare l'esperienza del sito.
• Fornire la supervisione di studi globali e locali: supervisionare la pianificazione, la mitigazione del rischio e la conformità di studi clinici assegnati, monitorare le prestazioni, i piani di monitoraggio basati sui rischi e la completezza dei file master di prova.
• Gestisci i Rapporti Partner: Collabora a stretto contatto con i partner CRO in tutto il ciclo di vita di prova clinica per garantire obiettivi di consegna unificati, alta soddisfazione del sito e rapida risoluzione delle sfide operative.
• Assicurare la prontezza di ispezione: condurre recensioni di qualità locale, audit interni e controlli normativi per gli studi assegnati, assicurando l'assoluta conformità con gli standard di qualità globali e le linee guida regolamentari. Chi sei Sei un professionista di operazioni cliniche strategiche e relazionali che eccelle in ambienti dinamici, conduce l'allineamento interfunzionale attraverso l'ambiguità, e detiene un forte impegno per la consegna concentrica del cliente. Qualifiche e competenze:
• Istruzione: Laurea (MD, PhD, Master o Bachelor) in scienze della vita o una disciplina equivalente.
• Esperienza: Esperienza significativa nel settore della ricerca farmaceutica o clinica, con competenze essenziali nello sviluppo del prodotto end-to-end e nei processi di sperimentazione clinica.
• Relationship Management: una comprovata traccia di gestione delle relazioni del sito, supervisione di studi clinici complessi e collaborazione efficace con CRO.
• Mindset strategico e analitico: capacità dimostrata di gestire più priorità, identificare proattivamente le sfide operative e sviluppare strategie di compliance e mitigazione efficaci e supportate dai dati.
• Comunicazione & Influencing: presentazione eccezionale, competenze interpersonali e di negoziazione, con la capacità di colmare le lacune di comunicazione tra team globali e stakeholder esterni locali.
• Lingue: Fluenza obbligatoria
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about strengthening healthcare partnerships to accelerate clinical innovation? As the Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL), you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic site engagement, optimizing clinical trial operations, and delivering an exceptional, streamlined experience for clinical trial sites.
In this role, you will champion a "One Roche" approach, acting as the primary point of contact for strategic sites and bringing together internal medical and operational teams to anticipate and support site needs. By establishing a collaborative local community and managing key relationships with Contract Research Organizations (CROs), you will ensure the successful, high-quality delivery of our portfolio from early to late-stage clinical development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Strategic Site Engagement: Develop and execute tailored country-level site engagement strategies across disease areas, fostering trust, operational excellence, and accelerated trial progression.

• Optimize Early Landscaping & Feasibility: Engage strategically with investigators during early trial setup, landscaping, and protocol review phases to identify the most suitable sites and optimize recruitment speed.

• Lead Relationship Management & Collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact for strategic clinical sites, building deep connections with investigators, pharmacists, and clinic administrations to align cross-study priorities and capture feedback trends.

• Coordinate Internal Communities: Convene and lead a local site engagement community (integrating Local Medical Affairs, field medical teams, and clinical operations) to streamline communications and enhance the site experience.

• Provide Global & Local Study Oversight: Oversee the planning, risk mitigation, and compliance of assigned clinical studies, tracking monitoring performance, risk-based monitoring plans, and trial master file completeness.

• Manage Partner Relationships: Collaborate closely with CRO partners throughout the clinical trial lifecycle to ensure unified delivery goals, high site satisfaction, and swift resolution of operational challenges.

• Ensure Inspection Readiness: Lead local quality reviews, internal audits, and regulatory inspections for allocated studies, ensuring absolute compliance with global quality standards and regulatory guidelines.

Who You Are
You are a strategic, relationship-driven clinical operations professional who excels in dynamic environments, leads cross-functional alignment through ambiguity, and holds a strong commitment to customer-centric delivery.
Qualifications & Skills:

• Education: Degree (MD, PhD, Master’s, or Bachelor’s) in life sciences or an equivalent discipline.

• Experience: Significant experience in the pharmaceutical or clinical research industry, with essential expertise in end-to-end product development and clinical trial processes.

• Relationship Management: A proven track record of managing site relationships, overseeing complex clinical trials, and effectively collaborating with CROs.

• Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities, proactively identify operational challenges, and develop effective, data-backed compliance and mitigation strategies.

• Communication & Influencing: Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to bridge communication gaps between global teams and local external stakeholders.

• Languages: Mandatory fluency

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Gesundheitspartnerschaften zu stärken, um klinische Innovationen zu beschleunigen? Als Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung des strategischen Engagements vor Ort, der Optimierung des klinischen Studienbetriebs und der Bereitstellung einer außergewöhnlichen, optimierten Erfahrung für klinische Studienstandorte. In dieser Rolle werden Sie sich für einen "One Roche" -Ansatz einsetzen, der als primärer Ansprechpartner für strategische Standorte fungiert und interne medizinische und operative Teams zusammenführt, um den Bedarf vor Ort zu antizipieren und zu unterstützen. Durch den Aufbau einer kollaborativen lokalen Gemeinschaft und die Verwaltung wichtiger Beziehungen zu Contract Research Organizations (CROs) stellen Sie die erfolgreiche, qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung unseres Portfolios von der frühen bis späten klinischen Entwicklung sicher. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Strategisches Standortengagement vorantreiben: Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter Strategien für das Engagement auf Länderebene in Krankheitsgebieten, Förderung von Vertrauen, operativer Exzellenz und beschleunigter Studienfortschritt.
• Optimieren Sie Early Landscaping & Machbarkeit: Engagieren Sie sich strategisch mit den Ermittlern während der frühen Testphase, der Landschaftsgestaltung und der Protokollüberprüfung, um die am besten geeigneten Standorte zu identifizieren und die Rekrutierungsgeschwindigkeit zu optimieren.

• Koordinieren Sie interne Gemeinschaften: Vereinbaren und leiten Sie eine lokale Site-Engagement-Community (integrieren Sie lokale medizinische Angelegenheiten, medizinische Außendienstteams und klinische Operationen), um die Kommunikation zu optimieren und die Erfahrung vor Ort zu verbessern.
• Global & Local Study Oversight: Überwachen Sie die Planung, Risikominderung und Compliance der zugewiesenen klinischen Studien, die Verfolgung der Überwachungsleistung, risikobasierte Überwachungspläne und die Vollständigkeit der Studienstammdatei.
• Partnerbeziehungen verwalten: Arbeiten Sie während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der klinischen Studie eng mit CRO-Partnern zusammen, um einheitliche Lieferziele, eine hohe Zufriedenheit vor Ort und eine schnelle Lösung operativer Herausforderungen zu gewährleisten.
• Sicherstellung der Inspektionsbereitschaft: Führen Sie lokale Qualitätsüberprüfungen, interne Audits und behördliche Inspektionen für zugewiesene Studien durch, um die absolute Einhaltung globaler Qualitätsstandards und regulatorischer Richtlinien sicherzustellen. Wer du bist Sie sind ein strategischer, beziehungsorientierter Experte für klinische Operationen, der sich in dynamischen Umgebungen auszeichnet, eine funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung durch Mehrdeutigkeit führt und sich stark für eine kundenorientierte Lieferung einsetzt. Qualifikationen & Fähigkeiten:
• Ausbildung: Abschluss (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in Life Sciences oder einer gleichwertigen Disziplin.
• Erfahrung: Bedeutende Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder klinischen Forschungsbranche mit wesentlicher Expertise in der End-to-End-Produktentwicklung und klinischen Versuchsprozessen.

• Strategisches & analytisches Mindset: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu bewältigen, proaktiv operative Herausforderungen zu identifizieren und effektive, datengestützte Compliance- und Minderungsstrategien zu entwickeln.
• Kommunikation & Einflussnahme: Außergewöhnliches Präsentations-, zwischenmenschliches und Verhandlungsgeschick mit der Fähigkeit, Kommunikationslücken zwischen globalen Teams und lokalen externen Stakeholdern zu schließen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous passionné par le renforcement des partenariats en santé pour accélérer l'innovation clinique? En tant que responsable de la participation à la recherche clinique (CREL), vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'engagement stratégique du site, l'optimisation des opérations d'essais cliniques et la prestation d'une expérience exceptionnelle et simplifiée pour les sites d'essais cliniques. Dans ce rôle, vous défendrez une approche « One Roche », agissant comme point de contact principal pour les sites stratégiques et réunissant des équipes médicales et opérationnelles internes pour anticiper et soutenir les besoins des sites. En établissant une communauté locale collaborative et en gérant des relations clés avec des organismes de recherche contractuels (ORC), vous assurerez la prestation réussie et de haute qualité de notre portefeuille, du début à la fin du développement clinique. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger l'engagement stratégique sur le site : Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies d'engagement sur mesure à l'échelle du pays dans les domaines de la maladie, en favorisant la confiance, l'excellence opérationnelle et la progression accélérée des essais.
• Optimiser l'aménagement paysager et la faisabilité : S'engager stratégiquement auprès des chercheurs pendant les phases de mise en place, d'aménagement paysager et d'examen des protocoles pour identifier les sites les plus appropriés et optimiser la vitesse de recrutement.
• Gestion et collaboration des relations avec les responsables : agir comme principal point de contact pour les sites cliniques stratégiques, établir des liens étroits avec les chercheurs, les pharmaciens et les administrations des cliniques pour harmoniser les priorités des études croisées et saisir les tendances en matière de rétroaction.
• Coordonner les communautés internes : Convoquer et diriger une communauté d'engagement locale (intégration des affaires médicales locales, des équipes médicales de terrain et des opérations cliniques) pour rationaliser les communications et améliorer l'expérience du site.
• Superviser la planification, l'atténuation des risques et la conformité des études cliniques, le suivi du rendement de la surveillance, les plans de surveillance axés sur les risques et l'exhaustivité du dossier principal d'essai.
• Gérer les relations avec les partenaires : Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires du CRO tout au long du cycle de vie des essais cliniques afin d'assurer l'uniformisation des objectifs d'exécution, la satisfaction élevée du site et la résolution rapide des défis opérationnels.
• Assurer la préparation à l'inspection : Diriger les examens locaux de la qualité, les vérifications internes et les inspections réglementaires pour les études attribuées, en assurant la conformité absolue aux normes de qualité mondiales et aux lignes directrices réglementaires. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel des opérations cliniques stratégique et axé sur les relations qui excelle dans des environnements dynamiques, mène l'alignement interfonctionnel par l'ambiguïté et tient un engagement ferme à la livraison centrée sur le client. Qualifications et compétences :
• Études : Diplôme (MD, doctorat, maîtrise ou baccalauréat) en sciences de la vie ou dans une discipline équivalente.
• Expérience : Expérience importante dans l'industrie de la recherche pharmaceutique ou clinique, avec une expertise essentielle dans le développement de produits de bout en bout et les processus d'essais cliniques.
• Gestion des relations : Une expérience éprouvée de la gestion des relations sur place, de la supervision des essais cliniques complexes et de la collaboration efficace avec les ORC.
• Mindset stratégique et analytique : Capacité démontrée de gérer plusieurs priorités, d'identifier de façon proactive les défis opérationnels et d'élaborer des stratégies efficaces de conformité et d'atténuation appuyées par des données.
• Communication et influence : Compétences exceptionnelles en présentation, en relations interpersonnelles et en négociation, avec la capacité de combler les écarts de communication entre les équipes mondiales et les parties prenantes externes locales.
• Langues: maîtrise obligatoire

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).

• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.

• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen

Positioned at the unique intersection of R&D, Commercial, and Manufacturing, GPS acts as the steward for Pharma, Portfolio, and Product strategies. Our mission is to catalyze the Roche ecosystem by leading end-to-end lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and competitive fitness.

We are a future-focused organization committed to delivering on Roche’s Pharma Ambition — to launch 20 transformative medicines by 2030. jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Finance Enterprise Partner to join our team at Roche Diagnostics Austria.

As an FEP (Finance Enterprise Partner) you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As an FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.

Main Responsibilities

• Strategic Partnership: Serve as a key business partner, co-leading customer journey touchpoints with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Financial Advisory: Balance resource allocation across competing priorities and advise on the financial impact of business initiatives.

• Commercial Strategy: Collaborate on developing affiliate strategies, business planning, and creative revenue-generation models.

• Knowledge Sharing: Engage with FEP communities to adopt and implement global best practices locally.

• P&L Optimization: Drive profitability by identifying upsell opportunities, reducing risks, and improving operational efficiency.

• Executive Communication: Translate complex financial data into compelling "storyboard" presentations for executive decision-making.

• Culture & Collaboration: Lead and facilitate cross-functional workshops and events to strengthen team engagement.

• Process Innovation: Apply end-to-end thinking to radically simplify workflows, from deal calculation to contract monitoring.

Competencies

• Commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.

• Understanding of Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.

• Understanding of data modeling to guide decision-making, solve problems, provide analytical insight and business judgment to support strategic and tactical initiatives across the affiliate.

• Strategic thinking and ability to translate business goals into financial plans.

• High level of social competence and ability to accurately record and efficiently communicate in English. (German is a plus but not a must)

• You have 2-5 years of experience in finance (ideally in a sales-focused or commercial role) and are familiar with SAP or equivalent ERP systems

We offer a gross salary starting at € 56.000 per year and attractive benefits. Flexible working hours, workplace health promotion and various sports programs, just to name a few. Depending on your qualifications and experience, overpayment is possible.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un partner finanziario Enterprise per unirsi al nostro team di Roche Diagnostics Austria. Come FEP (Finance Enterprise Partner) sfrutta la tua comprensione aziendale approfondita unitamente alle competenze finanziarie in iniziative di guida in avanti che sono fondamentali per fornire la nostra strategia commerciale. La FEP costruisce reti in tutta l'organizzazione per condividere le migliori pratiche e creare soluzioni che generano valore per la filiale, l'impresa e il cliente. Come FEP, sei un partner di fiducia per gli stakeholder aziendali e hai stretto contatto con i clienti, dove ti garantirai un'efficiente allocazione delle risorse e un impatto massimo lungo il percorso del cliente. Principali responsabilità
• Partenariato Strategico: Servire come partner di business chiave, co-leader touchpoint di viaggio del cliente con una mentalità a livello aziendale.
• Consulente finanziario: allocazione delle risorse di bilancio sulle priorità concorrenti e consulenza sull'impatto finanziario delle iniziative aziendali.
• Strategia commerciale: collaborare allo sviluppo di strategie di affiliazione, pianificazione aziendale e modelli di generazione di ricavi creativi.
• Condivisione della conoscenza: Impegnarsi con le comunità FEP per adottare e implementare le migliori pratiche globali localmente.
• Ottimizzazione P&L: Aumentare la redditività individuando opportunità di upsell, ridurre i rischi e migliorare l'efficienza operativa.
• Comunicazione Esecutivo: Traduci dati finanziari complessi in convincenti presentazioni "storyboard" per il processo decisionale esecutivo.
• Cultura & collaborazione: portare e facilitare workshop e eventi interfunzionali per rafforzare il coinvolgimento del team.
• Process Innovation: Applica il pensiero end-to-end per semplificare radicalmente i flussi di lavoro, dal calcolo degli accordi al monitoraggio dei contratti. Competenze
• Mindset centrico commerciale e cliente con la capacità di mettere tutte le informazioni finanziarie e operative disponibili in un quadro olistico.
• Comprensione di Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.
• Comprensione della modellazione dei dati per guidare il processo decisionale, risolvere i problemi, fornire analisi e giudizio aziendale per sostenere iniziative strategiche e tattiche in tutta la filiale.
• Il pensiero strategico e la capacità di tradurre gli obiettivi aziendali in piani finanziari.
• Alto livello di competenza sociale e capacità di registrare con precisione e comunicare in modo efficiente in inglese. (Il tedesco è un plus ma non un must)
• Hai 2-5 anni di esperienza nel settore finanziario (probabilmente in un ruolo commerciale o commerciale) e conosci i sistemi SAP o ERP equivalenti Offriamo uno stipendio lordo a partire da € 56.000 all'anno e benefici interessanti. Ore lavorative flessibili, promozione della salute sul posto di lavoro e vari programmi sportivi, solo per citarne alcuni. A seconda delle vostre qualifiche e esperienza, il pagamento eccessivo è possibile. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Le FEP crée des réseaux à travers l'organisation pour partager les meilleures pratiques et co-créer des solutions qui génèrent de la valeur pour l'affilié, l'entreprise et le client. Principales responsabilités
• Partenariat stratégique : Servez-vous d'un partenaire d'affaires clé, codirigeant les points de contact du parcours client avec un état d'esprit à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we combine diagnostics, medicines, and digital technology to tackle the toughest health challenges . As a Senior Software Test Engineer at Roche, you will be a key driver in ensuring the quality and reliability of our medical software systems. You will work independently on the test design and verification of complex software functions and features, ensuring they meet rigorous regulatory and safety standards. In this role, you will define the software test environment, lead verification activities, and mentor other team members to foster technical excellence within the software testing chapter.

Key Responsibilities

• Software V&V Planning & Strategy: Conduct independent reviews of software requirements and user stories to ensure clarity and testability. You will define software acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders to establish a solid base for verification results.

• Advanced Software Test Design : Independently create, maintain, and review complex test cases for software components across all lifecycle phases—from early feasibility to product care. This includes collaborating closely with software developers on test case elaboration and issue resolution.

• Test Automation & Environment: Take responsibility for identifying and specifying the required software test equipment and environments. You will independently implement testing tools and automation frameworks in accordance with the test strategy and regulatory requirements.

• Execution & Defect Management: Execute complex software test sets, analyze results, and independently track issues through to verification of the fix. You will report findings directly to project teams and propose strategic further actions.

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to less experienced team members in software testing methodologies. You will also drive the implementation of new software testing technologies and tools within the organization.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a software verification representative in project meetings and committees, collaborating with disciplines such as Systems Engineering, HW Development, and Operations.

Who you are

• Education: Successfully completed studies (M.Sc. level or higher) in Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (e.g., Mechatronics, Electronics).

• Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in software verification or a similar position.

• Certification : ISTQB Certified Tester - Advanced Level (Test Analyst or Technical Test Analyst) or equivalent qualification.

• Technical Expertise :

• Profound knowledge of V&V processes and methods specifically for complex software systems.

• Advanced Programming Skills: Expert knowledge in test automation using languages such as Python, C/C++, Bash Script, or Gherkin .

• Tools: Advanced proficiency with test management tools like JAMA or codebeamer .

• Specialized Testing : Experience in load testing, reliability testing, and usability testing is highly desirable.

• Soft Skills :

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and navigate conflicting situations under pressure.

• Strong communication skills to articulate complex software concepts and provide constructive feedback.

• Innovative mindset with the ability to foresee potential technical risks and proactively address them.

• Languages : Expert English language skills (B2/C1 level or better). ​

In questo ruolo, definirete l'ambiente di test del software, le attività di verifica del piombo e il mentore altri membri del team per promuovere l'eccellenza tecnica all'interno del capitolo test del software. • Progettazione avanzata di test software: creare, mantenere e rivedere in modo indipendente casi di test complessi per i componenti del software in tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita - dalla fattibilità precoce alla cura del prodotto. Questo include collaborare strettamente con gli sviluppatori di software per l'elaborazione dei casi di test e la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Test Automation & Environment: assumersi la responsabilità di identificare e specificare le attrezzature e gli ambienti di prova del software richiesti. • Collaborazione interdisciplinare: agire come rappresentante di verifica del software in riunioni di progetto e comitati, collaborando con discipline come Ingegneria dei sistemi, Sviluppo HW e Operazioni. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Studi completati con successo (livello M.Sc. o superiore) in Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, o un campo tecnico correlato (ad esempio, Meccatronica, Elettronica).
• Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella verifica del software o in una posizione simile.
• Certificazione: Tester certificato ISTQB - livello avanzato (analista di test di prova o analista tecnico) o qualifica equivalente.

• Conoscenza comprovata dei processi e dei metodi V&V specificatamente per sistemi software complessi.

• Testing specializzato: L'esperienza nel test di carico, test di affidabilità e test di usabilità è altamente auspicabile.

titleByLocale.fr: Associé de la politique réglementaire de l'AEEM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Regulatory Policy Associate. In this dynamic role, you will play a critical part in enhancing our regulatory intelligence and policy advocacy across the EEMEA region.

Main Responsibilities
- Conducting comprehensive intelligence digests and analyses to create insightful dashboards, slides, and summaries, capturing key regulatory updates within the EEMEA region internally and externally.
- Assisting in the empowerment program ( capability building program) by converting global strategies into effective training materials for local affiliates, and developing cross-country comparison insights that leverage your understanding of diverse local landscapes.
- Facilitating the operation of the EEMEA Regulatory Policy Community of Practice, including organizing meetings, agenda creation, documenting minutes, coordinating with members, and managing project-based teams ("topic-based squads").
- Enhancing the communication of regulatory policy value through the creation of supportive visual materials for the leadership team, maintaining the EEMEA regulatory policy Community of Practice web page, crafting success story visuals and summaries, and assisting with various external and internal events.
- Contributing to research efforts and connecting with internal stakeholders for the development of regional and local position papers on a variety of topics, ensuring that our regulatory stances are well-informed and robust.
- Supporting the Regradar regulatory monitoring tool by ensuring that regulatory cases are thoroughly evaluated and assessed within specified timelines, maintaining high standards of compliance and awareness.

Who you are
Required experience and competencies
- A minimum of 3 years of experience in regulatory - within medtech industry is a plus
- Experience in project management and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Familiarity with regulatory policy frameworks and a keen interest in staying updated with global regulatory trends is a plus
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex regulatory information.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in creating clear and compelling presentations.

NOTE: This role is a contractor, the employment agreement will be signed through a third party agency

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Hauptzuständigkeiten - Durchführung umfassender Intelligence Digests und Analysen, um aufschlussreiche Dashboards, Folien und Zusammenfassungen zu erstellen und wichtige regulatorische Updates innerhalb der EEMEA-Region intern und extern zu erfassen. - Unterstützung beim Empowerment-Programm (Fähigkeitsaufbauprogramm), indem globale Strategien in effektive Schulungsmaterialien für lokale Tochtergesellschaften umgewandelt werden und länderübergreifende Vergleichserkenntnisse entwickelt werden, die Ihr Verständnis verschiedener lokaler Landschaften nutzen. - Erleichterung des Betriebs der EEMEA Regulatory Policy Community of Practice, einschließlich der Organisation von Meetings, der Erstellung von Tagesordnungen, der Dokumentation von Protokollen, der Koordinierung mit Mitgliedern und der Verwaltung von projektbasierten Teams ("thematische Teams"). - Verbesserung der Kommunikation der regulatorischen Politik durch die Erstellung von unterstützenden visuellen Materialien für das Führungsteam, die Aufrechterhaltung der EEMEA Community of Practice-Webseite, die Erstellung von Erfolgsgeschichten und Zusammenfassungen und die Unterstützung bei verschiedenen externen und internen Veranstaltungen. - Beitrag zu Forschungsanstrengungen und Verbindung mit internen Stakeholdern für die Entwicklung regionaler und lokaler Positionspapiere zu einer Vielzahl von Themen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere regulatorischen Haltungen gut informiert und robust sind. - Unterstützung des Regradar-Instruments zur regulatorischen Überwachung, indem sichergestellt wird, dass regulatorische Fälle innerhalb festgelegter Fristen gründlich bewertet und bewertet werden, wobei hohe Standards für Compliance und Sensibilisierung gewahrt bleiben. Wer du bist Erforderliche Erfahrung und Kompetenzen - Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Regulierung - in der Medtech-Industrie ist ein Plus - Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten. - Vertrautheit mit regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und ein großes Interesse daran, mit globalen regulatorischen Trends auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben, ist ein Plus - Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Informationen zu interpretieren. - Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal, mit Kenntnissen in der Erstellung klarer und überzeugender Präsentationen. ANMERKUNG: Diese Rolle ist ein Auftragnehmer, der Beschäftigungsvertrag wird über eine Drittagentur unterzeichnet Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department

Your internship will take place in the "Antibody Development" subchapter, which is part of our organization "Reagent Research and Design”. This subchapter focuses on the development of antibodies for various Roche Diagnostics platforms. During your internship, you will work in the "Recombinant Antibody Formats" group, responsible for cloning and expressing antibodies.
From the very beginning, you will be warmly welcomed into the team and gain exciting insights into various areas. The focus is to ensure a constant learning effect, to support and challenge you, and to offer you the opportunity to contribute your own ideas.

Your Tasks

• You will work on cloning and expressing antibodies in different cells

• You will support our team in optimizing transient transfection protocols through cell line engineering

• You will be responsible for sequencing of hybridoma cell lines.

• You will be involved in expression analyses of cells using various methods

• You will independently perform quality controls of expressed antibodies

• You will have the opportunity to plan and present your experiments independently

Your Profile

• You are enrolled in a master's degree program in biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a comparable field

• You have knowledge of fundamental immunological and molecular biological techniques (cloning, cell culture)

• You enjoy working in a team

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Your Benefits

• Flexible working hours

• €2268 gross monthly compensation for a full-time internship > 3 months

• Discounted meal prices (-50%) in our employee cafeteria

• Fitness center on campus

• Networking with other students

• Possibility of accommodation in the Roche Boarding House or convenient transport links to Munich with the Roche Shuttle

Your Application

Please upload only your resume.

Please remember that this internship is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled for the entire period of the internship or, alternatively, at people in a gap year of a maximum of one year (between Bachelor's and Master's studies), where it can be proven in writing at which university/college and exactly when (month/year) within a year the studies will be continued.

Duration : Starting October 1st, 2026 for 6 months.

We do not offer the opportunity to write a Master's Thesis.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

We look forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Das sind wir

Das Chapter Engineering RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte im dreistelligen Millionenbereich, wie z.B. Labor-/ Produktionsgebäuden oder Produktionsanlagen, verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patient:innen mit innovativen Produkten und die Weiterentwicklung der Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg.
Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit.
Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung der Kollegen und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Als Werkstudent:in Business Operations (m/w/d) unterstützt Du unser Team bei der Optimierung interner Abläufe.ű

Das erwartet Dich

• Projektmanagement: Eigenständige Unterstützung bei der Aktualisierung und Harmonisierung von Prozessen (Tools, Ablagestruktur, Wissenstransfer) inklusive Stakeholdermanagement .

• Prozessverbesserung: Erarbeitung von Optimierungsvorschlägen für vielseitige Anwendungsgebiete .

• Kommunikation & Dokumentation: Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation systemischer Änderungen sowie Nachhalten von Aktionen und Protokollen .

• Datenpflege: Aktualisierung von Datenbanken, Masterdateien und Pflege personalrelevanter Daten in SAP.

Das bringst Du mit

• Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Master-oder Bachelorstudiengang an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert .

• IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace (gSuite), Smartsheet sowie MS Office Produkten (z. B. Visio, Lucidchart) und mit SAP .

• Projekt-Know-how: Grundwissen im Projektmanagement und idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit .

• Sprachen: Gute englische Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift .

• Soft Skills: Du zeichnest Dich durch Kommunikationsstärke, Organisationsvermögen und eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit aus .

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Buyer Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Senior Buyer Specialist , serás responsable de liderar y estructurar la nueva área de compras directas dentro de la afiliada de Chile Diagnóstica, sirviendo como una pieza fundamental del plan de acción estratégico GARA. Tu objetivo central será desarrollar e implementar buenas prácticas de abastecimiento estratégico, optimizando el gasto con proveedores, liderando licitaciones complejas bajo entornos de alta presión y mitigando los riesgos del proceso para alcanzar las metas de ahorros, flujo de caja, cumplimiento y rentabilidad del negocio.

The Opportunity

• Desarrollar y ejecutar el plan anual de abastecimiento estratégico y licitaciones para las principales categorías de compras directas en alineación con los objetivos de la afiliada.

• Liderar de punta a punta los procesos de licitación, negociación y análisis comparativo de propuestas comerciales con proveedores locales y regionales.

• Actuar como un socio estratégico del negocio ( Business Partner ), involucrándote tempranamente con las diversas áreas internas para atender y planificar de forma óptima sus requerimientos en proyectos críticos y soluciones digitales tipo LIS.

• Garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de los requerimientos de Compliance , debida diligencia ( Due Diligence ) y códigos de conducta en todo el ciclo de requisición a pago (RSS).

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar los riesgos de suministro mediante análisis integrales de SRM ( Supplier Relationship Management ) para diseñar planes de contingencia que aseguren la continuidad del negocio.

• Liderar la clasificación, evaluación y gestión del desempeño de proveedores bajo Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) e indicadores clave (KPIs) bien definidos.

• Configurar, administrar y brindar entrenamiento al equipo y usuarios internos en el uso de plataformas y herramientas de compras corporativas (como SAP, Monday, etc.).

• Velar por el desarrollo de capacidades técnicas y la correcta asignación de códigos de categorías de compra (JCCs) desde que nace la necesidad del negocio hasta la emisión de órdenes de compra.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines al área de Abastecimiento y Operaciones.

• Experiencia sólida y demostrable de entre 5 y 10 años en áreas de compras, Procurement o abastecimiento estratégico, con una destacada trayectoria liderando licitaciones complejas en la industria o sectores corporativos.

• Alta resiliencia y capacidad comprobada para gestionar la presión del entorno y alinear con éxito las expectativas de múltiples stakeholders y directivos internos.

• Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de gasto, principios de Category Management y aplicativos de gestión de compras (SAP avanzado, Monday o similares).

• Enfoque analítico y ágil con orientación a resultados (ahorros, capital de trabajo, eficiencia operativa) y excelente capacidad de negociación persuasiva.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Asset Administration Shell (AAS) is a fundamental concept in the digitalization of industrial systems, aligning with the vision of Industry 4.0. It represents a standardized digital twin for physical assets, allowing a seamless interface between physical systems and the digital world. The AAS encapsulates all relevant information about an asset, including its state, behavior, and lifecycle data, creating an interoperable and machine-readable profile of the asset. Implementing the AAS concept in a synthetic molecules production facility enables improved data integration, analytics, and automation across processes. This digital twin-like structure enhances operational transparency, supports predictive maintenance, and improves production efficiency by ensuring real-time access to asset information across various systems and stakeholders. The AAS also fosters interoperability, ensuring that different components, equipment, and IT systems can easily exchange and process asset-related data.
Are you passionate about leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies to revolutionise the pharmaceutical industry? Do you have a keen interest in digitalization, Industry 4.0, and the optimization of production processes? If so, we invite you to join our Digital Value Delivery Team at our location in Basel/Kaiseraugst! As a working student, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with our dynamic team to develop and implement digital solutions in the space of Asset Administration Shell (AAS) that enhance production processes and drive digital transformation. Our team is dedicated to advancing digitization across all areas of our organisation, with a particular focus on the pharmaceutical sector. We are committed to exploring and creating new opportunities for digital twin models based on the AAS concept.

The Opportunity:

• You play an integral role in the ongoing development of our digital AAS initiative and the expansion of our digital and engineering capabilities.

• Close collaboration with internal stakeholders like engineers and operators, as well as external partners such as universities, enables you to develop innovative AAS solutions that streamline our production processes.

• Your participation allows you to gain in-depth knowledge of digitalization and Industry 4.0 topics like the AAS, specifically within the pharmaceutical industry.

• You actively engage in building a technical community around AAS within the global network and with relevant stakeholders.

• Through this role you strengthen your technical skills while enhancing your ability to build lasting relationships and professional networks.

• Organizing and participating in workshops and events gives you the opportunity to apply practical AAS methods and tools in a hands-on environment.

Who you are:

• You are currently enrolled in a Master's degree program, preferably in study areas connected to digitalization, engineering, or related fields.

• As an ambassador for our ethos of "innovation and excellence," you are a proactive, self-motivated individual with strong engineering and digital skills.

• Thriving in a dynamic environment enables you to provide both professional and personal support while fostering trust within the team through transparency and an open culture.

• You excel in networking and organizational skills, showing a keen interest in people along with familiarity with agile methods and tools.

• Your background allows you to structure and deliver conceptual work

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La Asset Administration Shell (AAS) è un concetto fondamentale nella digitalizzazione dei sistemi industriali, allineando con la visione dell'Industria 4.0. Rappresenta un gemello digitale standardizzato per i beni fisici, consentendo un'interfaccia senza interruzioni tra i sistemi fisici e il mondo digitale. L'AAS incapsula tutte le informazioni pertinenti su un asset, inclusi i dati dello stato, del comportamento e del ciclo di vita, creando un profilo interoperabile e leggibile dalla macchina del bene. L'implementazione del concetto AAS in un impianto di produzione di molecole sintetiche consente una migliore integrazione dei dati, analisi e automazione nei processi. Questa struttura digitale a due gemelli migliora la trasparenza operativa, supporta la manutenzione predittiva e migliora l'efficienza produttiva garantendo l'accesso in tempo reale alle informazioni sugli asset in diversi sistemi e stakeholder. L'AS promuove anche l'interoperabilità, assicurando che diversi componenti, attrezzature e sistemi IT possano facilmente scambiare e elaborare dati relativi alle attività. Sei appassionato di sfruttare tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia per rivoluzionare l'industria farmaceutica? Hai un forte interesse per la digitalizzazione, l'Industria 4.0 e l'ottimizzazione dei processi produttivi? Se è così, vi invitiamo a partecipare al nostro team di consegna del valore digitale nella nostra posizione a Basilea/Kaiseraugst! Come studente di lavoro, avrete l'opportunità unica di collaborare con il nostro team dinamico per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni digitali nello spazio di Asset Administration Shell (AAS) che migliorano i processi produttivi e spingono la trasformazione digitale. Il nostro team è dedicato a promuovere la digitalizzazione in tutte le aree della nostra organizzazione, con particolare attenzione al settore farmaceutico. Ci impegniamo a esplorare e creare nuove opportunità per i modelli gemelli digitali basati sul concetto AAS. L'opportunità:
• Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo continuo della nostra iniziativa AAS digitale e nell'espansione delle nostre capacità digitali e ingegneristiche.
• Una stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate interne come ingegneri e operatori, nonché con partner esterni come le università, consente di sviluppare soluzioni AAS innovative che razionalizzano i nostri processi produttivi.
• La tua partecipazione ti consente di acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di argomenti di digitalizzazione e Industria 4.0 come l'AS, in particolare nell'industria farmaceutica.
• Si impegna attivamente nella costruzione di una comunità tecnica intorno AAS all'interno della rete globale e con le parti interessate rilevanti.
• Attraverso questo ruolo rafforzate le vostre competenze tecniche, migliorando la vostra capacità di costruire relazioni durature e reti professionali.
• Organizzare e partecipare a workshop ed eventi ti dà l'opportunità di applicare metodi e strumenti pratici AAS in un ambiente pratico. Chi sei:
• Sei attualmente iscritto a un corso di laurea magistrale, preferibilmente in aree di studio collegate a digitalizzazione, ingegneria o campi correlati.
• Come ambasciatore per la nostra ethos di "innovazione e eccellenza", sei un individuo proattivo e auto-motivato con forti competenze ingegneristiche e digitali.
• La crescita in un ambiente dinamico consente di fornire supporto sia professionale che personale, promuovendo la fiducia all'interno del team attraverso la trasparenza e una cultura aperta.
• Si eccelle in rete e capacità organizzative, mostrando un interesse acuto per le persone insieme con familiarità con metodi e strumenti agili.
• Il tuo background ti permette di strutturare e di fornire un lavoro concettuale

Die Position Die Asset Administration Shell (AAS) ist ein grundlegendes Konzept in der Digitalisierung industrieller Systeme, ausgerichtet auf die Vision von Industrie 4.0. Es stellt einen standardisierten digitalen Zwilling für physische Assets dar, der eine nahtlose Schnittstelle zwischen physischen Systemen und der digitalen Welt ermöglicht. Die AAS kapselt alle relevanten Informationen über einen Vermögenswert, einschließlich seines Zustands, Verhaltens und Lebenszyklusdaten, und erstellt ein interoperables und maschinenlesbares Profil des Vermögenswerts. Die Implementierung des AAS-Konzepts in einer Produktionsanlage für synthetische Moleküle ermöglicht eine verbesserte Datenintegration, Analyse und Automatisierung über Prozesse hinweg. Diese digitale Zwillingsstruktur erhöht die betriebliche Transparenz, unterstützt die vorausschauende Wartung und verbessert die Produktionseffizienz, indem sie Echtzeit-Zugriff auf Asset-Informationen über verschiedene Systeme und Interessengruppen hinweg gewährleistet. Die AAS fördert auch die Interoperabilität und stellt sicher, dass verschiedene Komponenten, Geräte und IT-Systeme anlagenbezogene Daten problemlos austauschen und verarbeiten können. Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, innovative digitale Technologien zu nutzen, um die Pharmaindustrie zu revolutionieren? Haben Sie ein großes Interesse an Digitalisierung, Industrie 4.0 und der Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen? Wenn ja, laden wir Sie ein, sich unserem Digital Value Delivery Team an unserem Standort in Basel/Kaiseraugst anzuschließen! Als Werkstudent haben Sie die einmalige Gelegenheit, mit unserem dynamischen Team zusammenzuarbeiten, um digitale Lösungen im Bereich der Asset Administration Shell (AAS) zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die Produktionsprozesse verbessern und die digitale Transformation vorantreiben. Unser Team setzt sich dafür ein, die Digitalisierung in allen Bereichen unserer Organisation voranzutreiben, mit besonderem Fokus auf den Pharmasektor. Wir sind bestrebt, neue Möglichkeiten für digitale Zwillingsmodelle basierend auf dem AAS-Konzept zu erkunden und zu schaffen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen AAS-Initiative und dem Ausbau unserer digitalen und technischen Fähigkeiten.
• Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern wie Ingenieuren und Betreibern sowie externen Partnern wie Universitäten ermöglicht es Ihnen, innovative AAS-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Produktionsprozesse rationalisieren.
• Ihre Teilnahme ermöglicht es Ihnen, fundierte Kenntnisse über Digitalisierung und Industrie 4.0-Themen wie die AAS zu erwerben, insbesondere in der Pharmaindustrie.
• Sie beteiligen sich aktiv am Aufbau einer technischen Community rund um AAS innerhalb des globalen Netzwerks und mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
• Durch diese Rolle stärken Sie Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten und verbessern gleichzeitig Ihre Fähigkeit, dauerhafte Beziehungen und professionelle Netzwerke aufzubauen.
• Die Organisation und Teilnahme an Workshops und Veranstaltungen bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, praktische AAS-Methoden und -Tools in einer praktischen Umgebung anzuwenden. Wer du bist:
• Sie sind derzeit in einem Master-Studiengang eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Studienbereichen, die mit Digitalisierung, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Bereichen verbunden sind.
• Als Botschafter für unser Ethos "Innovation und Exzellenz" sind Sie eine proaktive, selbstmotivierte Person mit starken technischen und digitalen Fähigkeiten.
• Das Gedeihen in einem dynamischen Umfeld ermöglicht es Ihnen, sowohl professionelle als auch persönliche Unterstützung zu bieten und gleichzeitig das Vertrauen innerhalb des Teams durch Transparenz und eine offene Kultur zu fördern.
• Sie zeichnen sich durch Netzwerk- und Organisationsfähigkeit aus und zeigen ein großes Interesse an Menschen sowie die Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden und Tools.
• Ihr Hintergrund ermöglicht es Ihnen, konzeptionelle Arbeit zu strukturieren und zu liefern

L'AAS encapsule toutes les informations pertinentes sur un actif, y compris son état, son comportement et ses données sur le cycle de vie, créant ainsi un profil interopérable et lisible par machine de l'actif. La mise en œuvre du concept AAS dans une installation de production de molécules synthétiques permet d'améliorer l'intégration des données, l'analyse et l'automatisation des processus. Cette structure numérique jumelée améliore la transparence opérationnelle, soutient la maintenance prédictive et améliore l'efficacité de la production en assurant l'accès en temps réel à l'information sur les actifs dans divers systèmes et intervenants. L'AAS favorise également l'interopérabilité, en veillant à ce que différents composants, équipements et systèmes informatiques puissent facilement échanger et traiter des données relatives aux biens. Êtes-vous passionné par l'utilisation de technologies numériques de pointe pour révolutionner l'industrie pharmaceutique? Avez-vous un vif intérêt pour la numérisation, l'Industrie 4.0 et l'optimisation des processus de production? Si oui, nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe de livraison de valeur numérique à notre emplacement à Bâle/Kaiseraugst! En tant qu'étudiant travailleur, vous aurez l'occasion unique de collaborer avec notre équipe dynamique pour développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions numériques dans l'espace de Asset Administration Shell (AAS) qui améliorent les processus de production et conduisent la transformation numérique. Notre équipe est dédiée à faire progresser la numérisation dans tous les domaines de notre organisation, avec un accent particulier sur le secteur pharmaceutique. Nous nous engageons à explorer et à créer de nouvelles opportunités pour les modèles numériques jumeaux basés sur le concept AAS. La possibilité :
• Vous jouez un rôle intégral dans le développement continu de notre initiative AAS numérique et l'expansion de nos capacités numériques et d'ingénierie.
• Une collaboration étroite avec des intervenants internes comme les ingénieurs et les opérateurs, ainsi qu'avec des partenaires externes comme les universités, vous permet de développer des solutions AAS innovantes qui simplifient nos processus de production.
• Votre participation vous permet d'acquérir des connaissances approfondies sur les sujets de la numérisation et de l'industrie 4.0 comme le SAA, en particulier au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• Vous vous engagez activement à bâtir une communauté technique autour de l'AAS au sein du réseau mondial et avec les parties prenantes concernées.
• Grâce à ce rôle, vous renforcez vos compétences techniques tout en améliorant votre capacité à construire des relations durables et des réseaux professionnels.
• L'organisation et la participation à des ateliers et à des événements vous donnent l'occasion d'appliquer des méthodes et des outils pratiques du SAA dans un environnement pratique. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à un programme de maîtrise, de préférence dans des domaines d'études liés à la numérisation, l'ingénierie ou des domaines connexes.
• En tant qu'ambassadeur pour notre éthique de l'innovation et de l'excellence, vous êtes une personne proactive, automotivée et dotée de solides compétences en ingénierie et en numérique.
• Dans un environnement dynamique, vous pouvez apporter un soutien professionnel et personnel tout en favorisant la confiance au sein de l'équipe par la transparence et une culture ouverte.
• Vous excellez dans le réseautage et les compétences organisationnelles, montrant un vif intérêt pour les gens ainsi que la connaissance des méthodes et des outils agiles.
• Votre arrière-plan vous permet de structurer et de fournir un travail conceptuel

jobs.title: Operations & Audit Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Overview
We are seeking a proactive, confident, and highly organized Operations & Audit Compliance Intern . In this role, you will act as a key connector between internal team members and external vendors. You will play a crucial part in ensuring our department remains compliant with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and fully prepared for upcoming audits.
If you are someone who loves interacting with people, possesses excellent communication skills, and has an eye for detail, this internship is the perfect launchpad for your career.
Key Responsibilities

• Vendor Relations & Procurement Support: Contact current and potential vendors to request, negotiate, and consolidate quotes for materials or services.

• SOP Documentation & Evidence Gathering: Collect, verify, and organize mandatory compliance evidence as outlined in company SOPs (e.g., calibration certificates, test results, training logs).

• Internal Training Follow-up: Track team progress on mandatory courses and actively follow up with staff members to ensure timely completion and submission of completion certificates.

• Data Management & Consolidation: Maintain, update, and organize central repositories or shared file systems to ensure all audit-related evidence is easily accessible.

• Audit Readiness Support: Assist the team in basic audit preparation processes, ensuring all documentation aligns with compliance checklists.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Quality Management, International Business, or a related field.

• Languages: Spanish and Intermediate to advanced level English . Fluent verbal and written communication in both languages.

• Communication Skills: Extroverted, confident, and comfortable speaking in public or reaching out to new people (both internally and externally).

• Attitude: Proactive, positive, and results-oriented with strong diplomatic skills to follow up on pending tasks with colleagues.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Teams) or Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive).

• Knowledge of Preference in: Basic understanding of audit concepts, compliance, or quality control processes is a strong plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As part of our visionary team, you will step into a high-impact environment where complex challenges inspire sustainable business transformations. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, applying advanced systems thinking to shape long-term strategic roadmaps across interconnected enterprise networks. Joining us means driving innovation at scale, mentoring the next generation of analysts, and directly influencing the digital future of global healthcare.

The opportunity:

• Driving Content Leadership: Overseeing complex initiatives and streams with full autonomy, defining analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, and managing the overall quality of deliverables.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Leading root-cause analysis of cross-organizational business problems, proactively managing scope creep, and ensuring full alignment with global strategic objectives.

• Senior Stakeholder Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, navigating complex organizational frameworks, resolving conflicts, and empowering teams to build strong stakeholder relationships.

• Impacting Strategy & Roadmaps: Evaluating strategic solution options through advanced value and risk assessments to shape long-term business and technology roadmaps.

• Managing Product Complexity: Operating effectively at a product or product line level while navigating evolving requirements and analyzing both macro and micro implications.

• Leveraging Technical & Business Ability: Applying in-depth domain knowledge and tools across cross-functional initiatives to anticipate challenges and integrate analysis into holistic solution designs.

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week .
