jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint.

PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation Board and Portfolio Lead is accountable for the overall effectiveness and governance of the Digital Innovation Board. This role ensures that the digital portfolio is strategically aligned with PT’s organizational objectives, driving transformation through structured prioritization, decision-making and proactive risk mitigation. The DIB Lead acts as the central orchestrator, bridging strategic vision with operational execution.

Your Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Portfolio Vision

• Portfolio Oversight: Lead the Digital Innovation Board, ensuring the digital portfolio aligns with the PT strategic vision and transformative initiatives

• Performance Management: Own the digital portfolio and establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the board's practices and use case delivery

• Executive Reporting: Provide executive leadership with advanced portfolio reporting that focuses amongst others on highlighting portfolio health, value realization, financial exposure and asks strategic questions.

Governance & Process Management

• Process Governance: Oversee the submission review, change control, and continuous improvement of the DIB process to ensure efficiency and compliance.

• Compliance Stewardship: Ensure that regulatory and compliance requirements are strictly maintained and adhered to within the digital governance framework.

• Risk Mitigation: Serve as a key focal point for mitigating risks related to digital governance and the overall Risk Strategy.

• DIB Framework: Continuously improve the DIB Framework and evolve the project delivery thorough standardized project execution protocols on a global scale

• Resource & Capacity Management: Optimize resource allocation across the digital portfolio, ensuring budget, talent, and technology are strategically deployed to maximize the value impact from Digital Innovation

Operational Enablement

• Capability Development: Ensure the availability and accessibility of training programs on digital governance for employees.

• Facilitation: Drive the effectiveness of the board by managing the lifecycle of digital initiatives, from intake and review to deployment and sustainment.

• Agentification: Transform governance by embedding AI agents directly into the workflow lifecycle acting as intelligent co-pilots

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. A Roche, prosperiamo per fornire più benefici ai nostri pazienti come parte della nostra visione Pharma di 10 anni. Una parte fondamentale per raggiungere questa visione è fornire nuove e innovative soluzioni di analisi dei dati ai nostri scienziati attraverso Pharma Technical Operations (PT). Per farlo, abbiamo formato una nuova organizzazione chiamata PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) con l'aspirazione di costruire operazioni digitali e magre leader del settore attraverso funzioni e l'intera impronta produttiva. PTE è l'organizzazione che catalizza lo sviluppo globale e l'esecuzione della strategia di PT Digital and Operational Excellence per consentire a PT di realizzare le nostre promesse di performance. Costruiamo una forte comunità interfunzionale e inclusiva, mettiamo il potere dei dati nelle mani della nostra gente, sviluppiamo ulteriormente le competenze Lean e Digital in PT, e ridimensioniamo le nostre soluzioni Digital e Advanced Analytics, a beneficio dei nostri colleghi e pazienti. L'opportunità Il Digital Innovation Board e Portfolio Lead sono responsabili dell'efficacia e della governance complessiva del Digital Innovation Board. Questo ruolo assicura che il portafoglio digitale sia strategicamente allineato agli obiettivi organizzativi di PT, guidando la trasformazione attraverso priorità strutturata, processi decisionali e mitigazione del rischio proattivo. Il DIB Lead funge da orchestratore centrale, corrodendo la visione strategica con l'esecuzione operativa. Le tue responsabilità chiave Leadership strategica & Portfolio Vision
• Portfolio Oversight: Guida il Digital Innovation Board, assicurando che il portafoglio digitale si allinei con la visione strategica PT e le iniziative trasformative
• Gestione delle prestazioni: Possedere il portafoglio digitale e stabilire indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) per misurare l'efficacia delle pratiche e l'utilizzo dei casi di consegna
• Executive Reporting: Fornire leadership esecutiva con report avanzato del portafoglio che si concentra tra gli altri su evidenziare la salute del portafoglio, la realizzazione del valore, l'esposizione finanziaria e pone domande strategiche. Governance e gestione dei processi
• Governance dei processi: supervisionare la revisione di presentazione, il controllo dei cambiamenti e il miglioramento continuo del processo DIB per garantire efficienza e conformità.
• Compliance Stewardship: Assicurarsi che i requisiti normativi e di conformità siano rigorosamente mantenuti e rispettati nell'ambito della governance digitale.
• Risk Mitigation: Serve come punto focale chiave per mitigare i rischi legati alla governance digitale e alla strategia generale di rischio.
• DIB Framework: migliorare costantemente il quadro DIB ed evolvere i protocolli di esecuzione del progetto standardizzati su scala globale
• Gestione risorse e capacità: Ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse attraverso il portafoglio digitale, assicurando budget, talento e tecnologia sono strategicamente implementati per massimizzare l'impatto del valore da Digital Innovation Attivazione operativa
• Capability Development: Assicurare la disponibilità e l'accessibilità dei programmi di formazione sulla governance digitale per i dipendenti.
• Facilitazione: guidare l'efficacia del consiglio di amministrazione gestendo il ciclo di vita delle iniziative digitali, dall'assunzione e dalla revisione alla distribuzione e al sostentamento.
• Agenti: Trasformare la governance incorporando gli agenti AI direttamente nel ciclo di vita del flusso di lavoro che agisce come co-piloti intelligenti Chi sei Porti diversi anni di esperienza nelle principali trasformazioni digitali, preferibilmente nel settore farmaceutico, e stai cercando

jobs.title: Travel & Expense Specialist - Turkish Speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist as part of the Demand to Pay department maintains and supports the daily activities of the Travel and Expense and Company Card expenses associated with the Roche Global Credit card programs. This role is expected to offer a high level of customer service as this is the first point of contact for our internal customers.

• Customer Support: Act as the primary point of contact for internal customers, providing high-quality support and guidance for corporate credit cards and Concur expense management via calls and tickets.

• Ticket & Case Management: Own, track, and resolve Help Desk tickets efficiently—aiming for same-day resolution—while making decisions on first-level issues and further actions.

• System Administration: Handle day-to-day administrative duties within the Concur system to keep the platform running smoothly.

• SLA & KPI Compliance: Ensure all services are delivered with high quality and accuracy, strictly adhering to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), KPIs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Documentation & Training: Build and maintain up-to-date documentation for business systems and processes, and deliver process training to end-users as requested.

• Reporting & Monitoring: Manage scheduled and ad-hoc reporting and monitoring activities, proactively applying system fixes and communicating resolutions clearly.

• Team Collaboration & Growth: Participate in team availability planning (holidays/training) and contribute to the onboarding and implementation of new tasks arriving at the Roche-Budapest site.

Who you are

• Self-motivated and passionate about the job, understanding the importance of providing high-quality service.

• Open-minded, dedicated to making a difference, and open to constant development.

• Experience in a shared service environment, preferably in the customer service area.

• Experience with corporate credit card programs is an advantage.

• Fluency in English and Turkish Speaking .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla sanità oggi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Platform Engineer - ERP Data Platform

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architect, you will lead the technical strategy and operational framework for our B DC ecosystem, driving the modernization of legacy SAP BW/4HANA environments to SAP Datasphere . In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between foundational platform engineering, regulatory compliance, and business domain-driven data productization. You will join a forward-thinking team dedicated to building scalable, inclusive, and cutting-edge data solutions that empower global healthcare discovery.

The Opportunity

• Lead and define the Business Data Cloud (BDC) Solution Architecture, ensuring seamless technical alignment with global "Cloud First" and data mesh strategies.

• Design and implement critical "Architectural Guardrails" alongside deep-dive assessments of S/4HANA backend readiness—focusing on Core Data Services (CDS) view compatibility—to maintain a highly compliant, scalable, and audit-ready environment.

• Oversee the technical lifecycle of Datasphere Spaces, governing everything from automated provisioning and resource allocation to decommissioning standards.

• Maintain the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) blueprint for the Data Model Lifecycle, facilitating automated promotion across our 4-tier landscape (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) while optimizing the Flexible Capacity Unit (CU) model.

• Architect complex, bi-directional data sharing (Zero-Copy) between SAP Datasphere and external ecosystems like Snowflake, ensuring high-performance integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and existing DataOne architecture.

• Embed essential compliance and governance directly into the platform setup, integrating Good Practice (GxP) and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) qualification evidence while managing automated platform vulnerability patching.

• Collaborate closely with Data Teams to enforce metadata management and tagging strategies required for marketplace publication and seamless Collibra synchronization.

• Architect robust security access designs , including Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies, data privacy/masking layers (ensuring GDPR/CCPA compliance), and global data modeling design standards.

Who you are

• Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Years of Experience: You bring 5+ years of

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Platform Engineer - ERP Data Platform

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architect, you will lead the technical strategy and operational framework for our B DC ecosystem, driving the modernization of legacy SAP BW/4HANA environments to SAP Datasphere . In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between foundational platform engineering, regulatory compliance, and business domain-driven data productization. You will join a forward-thinking team dedicated to building scalable, inclusive, and cutting-edge data solutions that empower global healthcare discovery.

The Opportunity

• Lead and define the Business Data Cloud (BDC) Solution Architecture, ensuring seamless technical alignment with global "Cloud First" and data mesh strategies.

• Design and implement critical "Architectural Guardrails" alongside deep-dive assessments of S/4HANA backend readiness—focusing on Core Data Services (CDS) view compatibility—to maintain a highly compliant, scalable, and audit-ready environment.

• Oversee the technical lifecycle of Datasphere Spaces, governing everything from automated provisioning and resource allocation to decommissioning standards.

• Maintain the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) blueprint for the Data Model Lifecycle, facilitating automated promotion across our 4-tier landscape (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) while optimizing the Flexible Capacity Unit (CU) model.

• Architect complex, bi-directional data sharing (Zero-Copy) between SAP Datasphere and external ecosystems like Snowflake, ensuring high-performance integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and existing DataOne architecture.

• Embed essential compliance and governance directly into the platform setup, integrating Good Practice (GxP) and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) qualification evidence while managing automated platform vulnerability patching.

• Collaborate closely with Data Teams to enforce metadata management and tagging strategies required for marketplace publication and seamless Collibra synchronization.

• Architect robust security access designs , including Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies, data privacy/masking layers (ensuring GDPR/CCPA compliance), and global data modeling design standards.

Who you are

• Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Years of Experience: You bring 5+ years of

In qualità di esperto riconosciuto, implementerai e manterrai standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per i sistemi e i prodotti di dati della piattaforma SAP ERP, fornendo leadership sia sugli ecosistemi della piattaforma SAP Data on-premise che sul cloud. L'opportunità
• Sicurezza della piattaforma: implementare e mantenere standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per le piattaforme SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA e SAP Datasphere). Sviluppare e maturare funzionalità nella conformità e nella sicurezza del cloud, in particolare all'interno di SAP Datasphere.
• Allineamento normativo e gestione quadro: monitorare costantemente le normative pertinenti (ad esempio, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) e gli standard del settore (ad esempio, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) per garantire che la piattaforma resti davanti ai requisiti di conformità globali.
• Politica di sviluppo e governance dei dati: guidare la creazione e la raffinatezza delle politiche interne e dei quadri di governance dei dati per mantenere elevati standard di integrità, sicurezza e gestione dei dati strutturati.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Vice and Control Owner , tenendo conto della responsabilità del ciclo di vita ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting), dei controlli GxP e di altre normative pertinenti.
• Monitoraggio e riparazione: Condurre il monitoraggio settimanale e mensile dei conflitti SoD (Segregation of Duties) tramite cruscotti GRC, lavorare con SoD Champions per mitigare i rischi e affrontare gli elementi non conformi contrassegnati nella documentazione di SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Integrità di sistema: supervisionare le recensioni degli errori delle applicazioni (ad esempio, lavori falliti) e firmare il monitoraggio dei risultati in strumenti come ICAt per fornire prove per i controlli di controllo.
• Access Governance: Eseguire recensioni trimestrali di accesso critico , GRC FireFighter ruoli (Controllers, Owners, Admins), e HANA DB utenti, avviando rimozioni tempestive per mantenere un ambiente "meno privilegio".
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR Il supporto dell'audit IT definendo le attività di controllo, approvando la documentazione dell'auditor e fungendo da punto di contatto primario per gli auditor durante i cicli di picco (Sep/Oct).
• Direzione strategica: Impostare le direzioni di sviluppo tecnologico analizzando e implementando nuove soluzioni, strumenti e standard IT, con un focus sulla governance dei dati, la convalida e l'automazione.
• Valutazione del rischio: rivedere e aggiornare annualmente la valutazione del rischio di sistema (SRA) e la classificazione dei dati per garantire l'allineamento con la Baseline di sicurezza minima.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: condurre attivamente progetti di innovazione per ottimizzare i processi, introdurre nuove soluzioni e aumentare l'efficienza attraverso l'automazione dei prodotti Data.
• Collaborazione: Partner con i team di sistema e le parti interessate per garantire la proprietà delle attività, colmare le lacune di consapevolezza della privacy e formare nuovi membri del team sulle attività di controllo ICFR. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea in Informatica, IT o Ingegneria con un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza post-secondaria in SAP Security e una profonda comprensione della conformità.

• Access Governance: Führen Sie vierteljährliche Bewertungen von Critical Access, GRC FireFighter Rollen (Controller, Eigentümer, Admins) und HANA DB-Nutzer aus, die rechtzeitige Entfernungen zur Aufrechterhaltung einer "Least Privileg"-Umgebung einleiten.
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT-Audit-Unterstützung durch Definition von Kontrolltätigkeiten, Genehmigung der Auditor-Dokumentation und als primärer Ansprechpartner für Auditoren während der Spitzenzyklen (Sep/Oct).
• Strategische Richtung: Setzen Sie technologische Entwicklungsrichtungen durch Analyse und Implementierung neuer Lösungen, Tools und IT-Standards, mit einem Fokus auf Daten-Governance, Validierung und Automatisierung.
• Risikobewertung: Jährliche Überprüfung und Aktualisierung der System-Risikobewertung (SRA) und der Datenklassifizierung, um die Anpassung an die Mindestsicherheit Baseline sicherzustellen.
• Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Durchführung von Innovationsprojekten zur Optimierung von Prozessen, Einführung neuer Lösungen und Steigerung der Effizienz durch Automatisierung in Datenprodukten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit Systemteams und Stakeholdern, um Aufgabeneigentum zu gewährleisten, Datensicherheitslücken zu überbrücken und neue Teammitglieder auf ICFR-Kontrolltätigkeiten zu trainieren. Wer bist du?
• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, IT oder Engineering mit mindestens 5 Jahren postsekundärer Erfahrung in SAP Security und einem tiefen Verständnis der Compliance.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Expert en sécurité et conformité, ERP Data Platform Êtes-vous passionné par la sécurité et la conformité de l'information, en particulier dans les environnements ERP, en mettant l'accent sur l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données? Rejoignez une équipe mondiale où vous dirigerez le changement en tant qu'expert en sécurité et conformité dans l'optimisation des processus par l'expérience et l'automatisation. La Mission Votre mission principale est de s'assurer que le paysage technologique, les pratiques en matière de données et les mesures de sécurité de l'organisation n'exposent pas l'entreprise à des pénalités légales, à des pertes financières ou à des dommages à sa réputation. En tant qu'expert reconnu, vous appliquerez et maintiendrez des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les systèmes et les produits de données SAP ERP, assurant ainsi un leadership à la fois sur site et dans les écosystèmes de la plateforme SAP Data Cloud. L'opportunité
• Sécurité des plateformes: Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les plateformes SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA et SAP Datasphere). Développer et développer des capacités en matière de conformité et de sécurité cloud, en particulier dans SAP Datasphère.
• Alignement de la réglementation et gestion du cadre: surveiller en permanence les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, RGPD, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) et les normes de l'industrie (par exemple, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) afin de s'assurer que la plateforme reste en avance sur les exigences mondiales de conformité.
• Développement des politiques et gouvernance des données: Favoriser la création et le perfectionnement de politiques internes et de cadres de gouvernance des données pour maintenir des normes élevées d'intégrité, de sécurité et de traitement structuré des données.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Agir en tant que propriétaire de système adjoint et propriétaire de contrôle, en prenant la responsabilité du cycle de vie de bout en bout ICFR (contrôle interne des rapports financiers), des contrôles GxP et d'autres règlements pertinents.
• Surveillance et réparation: Diriger la surveillance hebdomadaire et mensuelle des conflits de SoD (ségrégation des fonctions) via les tableaux de bord du GRC, travailler avec les champions de SoD pour atténuer les risques et traiter les éléments non conformes signalés dans la documentation SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Intégrité du système: Surveiller les examens d'erreurs d'application (par exemple, les emplois échoués) et signer le suivi des résultats dans des outils comme ICAt pour fournir des preuves pour les contrôles.
• Gouvernance de l'accès : Effectuer des examens trimestriels de l'accès critique, des rôles de FireFighter du GRC (Contrôleurs, Propriétaires, Administrateurs) et des utilisateurs de HANA DB, en initiant des suppressions en temps opportun pour maintenir un environnement « le moins privilégié ».
• Leadership de l'audit : chef de file du CIRF Soutien à la vérification de la TI en définissant les activités de contrôle, en approuvant la documentation de l'auditeur et en agissant comme principal point de contact pour les vérificateurs pendant les cycles de pointe (sept/oct).
• Orientation stratégique: Définir des orientations de développement technologique en analysant et en mettant en œuvre de nouvelles solutions, outils et normes informatiques, en mettant l'accent sur la gouvernance des données, la validation et l'automatisation.
• Évaluation des risques : Revoir et mettre à jour chaque année l'évaluation des risques du système et la classification des données afin d'assurer l'alignement sur la base minimale de sécurité.
• Optimisation des processus : Mener activement des projets d'innovation pour optimiser les processus, introduire de nouvelles solutions et accroître l'efficacité grâce à l'automatisation des produits Data.
• Collaboration: partenariat avec les équipes du système et les parties prenantes pour assurer l'appropriation des tâches, combler les lacunes en matière de sensibilisation à la protection des données et former de nouveaux membres d'équipes aux activités de contrôle du CIRF. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou en génie avec un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience postsecondaire en sécurité SAP et une compréhension profonde de la conformité.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Diagnostics Operations by maintaining the best performance of our electro-mechanical equipment used in the Facilities/Utilities organization.

The Opportunity:

• You're performing electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electromechanical equipment, HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, and chilled water systems used in Facilities/Utilities. Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• You're using test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild facilities/utilities equipment as required and perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by manufacturing engineers

• You're using maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies and apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

• You're responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• You're completing preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules. You will provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off- hours and weekends. Maintains accurate records of all activities

Who you are:

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years related operations or manufacturing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates Degree or equivalent military training or documented 3 years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: HVAC, Ammonia refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic in an operations or manufacturing setting

• Proficient in Google Office Suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Email, Calendar

• Knowledge of screw and reciprocal compressors, electrical and controls troubleshooting

• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices)

• Experience with HVAC systems (rooftop units, air handling units, VAVs, fan coil units, electric and gas heaters); chilled water systems (ammonia screw chillers, ammonia and pumps); boilers and hot water systems (gas and electric boilers); refrigeration (stand-alone refrigerator/freezers, walk in coolers and freezers, CO2 refrigeration, and ammonia refrigeration)

• Experience with Building Automation systems

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected s

jobs.title: Becario Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:

Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

La oportunidad
Estamos buscando un Becario de Administración y Marketing Médico para unirse a nuestro capítulo de Medical Affairs. Esta es una excelente oportunidad para estudiantes universitarios proactivos que deseen involucrarse en la gestión estratégica del sector farmacéutico. El candidato seleccionado brindará soporte operativo clave en la administración de contratos de profesionales de la salud (HCP), control de bases de datos, gestión de plataformas de compras internas y coordinación de actividades médico-científicas

Requisitos del Perfil

• Educación: Estudiante activo de 5to o 6to semestre de carreras universitarias en Ciencias Biomédicas, Química, Administración, Mercadotecnia o afines.

• Idiomas: Inglés básico.

• Herramientas Informáticas: Manejo básico de Paquetería Office y dominio operativo de Google Suite (Google Sheets automatizados, Drive, Forms).

Funciones y Responsabilidades Principales

• Gestión de Contratos y Cumplimiento Legal (SAC)

• Gestión de Proveedores y Plataformas Internas

• Control Administrativo, Compliance y Soporte al Capítulo Médico

• Gestión de eventos y actividades médico científicas &actividades digitales

Quien eres:
Competencias Deseadas

• Atención al detalle y rigurosidad en el manejo de documentos oficiales.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y servicio interno para interactuar con gerentes médicos, el equipo legal y proveedores externos .

• Autonomía y proactividad para dar seguimiento a procesos que dependen de múltiples áreas de aprobación .

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Idiomas: Inglés básico.

• Herramientas Informáticas: Manejo básico de Paquetería Office y dominio operativo de Google Suite (Google Sheets automatizados, Drive, Forms).

• Gestión de Contratos y Cumplimiento Legal (SAC)

• Gestión de Proveedores y Plataformas Internas

Quien eres:
Competencias Deseadas

• Atención al detalle y rigurosidad en el manejo de documentos oficiales.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y servicio interno para interactuar con gerentes médicos, el equipo legal y proveedores externos .

• Autonomía y proactividad para dar seguimiento a procesos que dependen de múltiples áreas de aprobación .

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
CZ verze:
Hledáme Customer Service Representative
Do našeho logistického týmu hledáme nového kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Customer Service Representative , který/á nám pomůže s administrativou a podporou při zpracování objednávek a komunikaci s klienty.
Co bude Vaší náplní práce?

• Zpracování objednávek našich klientů v systému SAP

• Vytváření prodejních objednávek, faktur a dobropisů (Credit Notes)

• Řešení operativních požadavků a dotazů od klientů

• Komunikace s kolegy z logistiky, financí, salesu a kvality (reklamační proces)

• Předávání informací klientům a spolupráce na hladkém průběhu objednávek

• Postupné zapojení do dalších oblastí logistiky

Koho hledáme?

• Máte rád/a administrativu, jste pečlivý/á, zodpovědný/á a umíte si zorganizovat práci

• Máte příjemné a profesionální vystupování při komunikaci se zákazníky

• Ovládáte angličtinu na komunikativní úrovni (psanou i mluvenou), čeština/slovenština na úrovni rodilého mluvčího

• Zkušenost se SAP (objednávkový systém) je velkou výhodou

• Zvládáte práci s e-mailem a platformami Google

• Vzdělání v oblasti Business Administration, Logistiky nebo Ekonomie výhodou

• Máte zkušenosti v zákaznické podpoře, sales support nebo jiné customer-focused roli

• Jste samostatný/á, proaktivní a dokážete zvládat více priorit současně

Co nabízíme?

• Práci v menším přátelském týmu, kde se všichni podporují a pomáhají si

• Možnost pracovat částečně z domova (home office)

• Zaučení do procesů a další rozvoj v oblasti logistiky

• Stabilní pracovní prostředí s možností dlouhodobé spolupráce

EN verze:
We are looking for Customer Service Representative
We are seeking a new colleague to join our logistics team as a Customer Service Representative , to provide administrative and operational support for order processing and customer communication.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Processing customer orders in SAP system

• Creating sales orders, invoices and credit notes

• Communication with customers to resolve operational requests or questions

• Cooperation with colleagues from logistics, finance, sales and quality (complaint handling)

• Providing timely information to clients and ensuring smooth order flow

• Gradually learning and supporting other logistics-related tasks

Who we are looking for:

• You enjoy administrative tasks, are detail-oriented, responsible and well-organized

• You have professional and customer-friendly communication skills

• Fluent in local language (Czech/Slovak native level) and good command of English (spoken and written)

• Experience with SAP (order management) is a strong advantage

• Comfortable using email and Google platforms

• University degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Economics or related field is an advantage

• Proven experience in a customer-focused role (sales support, application support, customer service, training)

• Self-starter, proactive, with ability to handle conflicting priorities independently

• Motivated to develop long-term relationships with clients

What we offer:

• Work in a smaller, friendly team where colleagues support each other

• Possibility to work partly from home (home office)

• Full training and opportunities to grow within logistics

• Stable role with long-term career prospects

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to ensure that life-saving medicines successfully make it from the lab to patients worldwide? As a Legal Counsel - Global Pharma Technical Operations & Facilities, you will join a highly collaborative, global team of experts providing proactive legal support to our manufacturing and supply backbone. In this role, you will be trusted to advise on high-stakes, strategic matters that directly support our company’s global ambition to prevent, stop, and cure diseases.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will serve as an individual contributor providing business-focused legal support and strategic counseling. You can expect to:

• Provide strategic legal advice and business-focused counseling to the Pharma Technical Operations (PT) and Direct Procurement organizations.

• Draft and negotiate complex agreements , including manufacturing, supply, and development contracts key to our global operations.

• Act as the primary legal point of contact for technical operations and facility matters during large, high-stakes transactions.

• Develop and implement legal strategies for the global business by collaborating closely with other lawyers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership.

• Advise on regulatory and compliance matters under Swiss and EU legislation, with a focus on current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and quality systems.

• Manage outside counsel retained to support specific global legal matters.

• Thrive in a dynamic, cross-cultural team environment where your agility, influence, and solution-oriented mindset drive meaningful global impact

Who you are
You are a proactive, confident professional who views change as an opportunity and is committed to driving continuous improvement. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Legal Excellence: A passed Bar Exam and a minimum of 3 years of professional experience within an international law firm or the legal department of a multinational group.

• Industry Expertise: Prior legal experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech sectors, with a strong understanding of drug manufacturing processes, cGMP regulations, and technical compliance.

• Strong Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, a high level of cross-cultural sensitivity, and a dedicated team-player attitude.

• Business & Negotiation Acumen: Excellent analytical and negotiation skills, paired with a results-oriented approach to resolving complex technical and legal issues.

• Language Skills: Fluency in business-level English is required; knowledge of German or other languages is considered a distinct asset.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

In qualità di consulente legale - Global Pharma Technical Operations & Facilities, vi unirete ad un team di esperti altamente collaborativo e globale che fornisce un supporto legale proattivo alla nostra dorsale di produzione e fornitura. In questo ruolo, sarete fidati di consigliare su alti-stakes, questioni strategiche che supportano direttamente l'ambizione globale della nostra azienda per prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie. • Sviluppare e implementare strategie legali per il business globale collaborando a stretto contatto con altri avvocati, team interfunzionali e leadership senior.
• Consultare le questioni regolamentari e di conformità ai sensi della legislazione svizzera e dell'UE, con un focus sulle attuali Buone pratiche manifatturiere (cGMP) e sui sistemi di qualità.
• Gestire il consulente esterno mantenuto per sostenere specifiche questioni legali globali.
• La spinta in un ambiente di team dinamico e interculturale in cui la vostra agilità, influenza e mentalità orientata alla soluzione portano un impatto globale significativo Chi sei Sei un professionista proattivo e fiducioso che vede cambiare come un'opportunità e si impegna a guidare il miglioramento continuo. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Eccellenza Legale: Un esame di Bar passato e un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale all'interno di uno studio legale internazionale o il dipartimento legale di un gruppo multinazionale.
• Competenza del settore: Priore esperienza legale nei settori farmaceutico o biotecnologico, con una forte comprensione dei processi di produzione di droga, delle normative cGMP e della conformità tecnica.
• Forte comunicazione & collaborazione: Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, un alto livello di sensibilità interculturale, e un atteggiamento di team-player dedicato.
• Business & Negotiation Acumen: eccellenti competenze analitiche e di negoziazione, abbinate ad un approccio orientato ai risultati per risolvere complesse questioni tecniche e legali.
• Competenze linguistiche: È richiesta una fluidità nell'inglese di livello aziendale; la conoscenza delle lingue tedesche o di altre lingue è considerata un bene distinto. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to ensure that life-saving medicines successfully make it from the lab to patients worldwide by navigating the evolving digital landscape? As a Legal Counsel - Global Pharma Technical Operations & Facilities (Data & Digital) , you will join a highly collaborative, global team providing proactive legal support to our manufacturing and supply backbone. In this role, you will be trusted to advise on high-stakes, data-driven matters that directly support our company’s global ambition to prevent, stop, and cure diseases.

The Opportunity
In this individual contributor role, you will focus on business-focused legal support, contract negotiation, and strategic data counseling. You can expect to:

• Provide strategic legal advice and business-focused counseling to the Pharma Technical Operations and Direct Procurement organizations.

• Draft and negotiate complex agreements , including manufacturing, supply, and development contracts key to our global operations.

• Act as the primary legal point of contact for technical operations and facility matters during large, high-stakes transactions.

• Develop and implement legal strategies for the global business by collaborating closely with other lawyers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership.

• Advise on complex data and digital matters arising under Swiss and EU legislation, guiding any legal questions in the field of technical operations.

• Manage outside counsel retained to support specific global legal or digital matters.

• Thrive in a dynamic, cross-cultural team environment where your agility, influence, and solution-oriented mindset drive meaningful global impact.

Who you are
You are a proactive, confident professional who views change as an opportunity and is committed to driving continuous improvement. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Qualified Legal Professional: You hold a passed Bar Exam and bring at least 3 years of professional experience within an international law firm or the legal department of a multinational group.

• Digital & Pharma Expertise: You have prior experience providing legal support in the pharmaceutical or biotech industries, with a strong focus on data and digital-related matters alongside manufacturing agreements.

• Technical Savvy: You possess a strong affinity for healthcare and biotechnology, allowing you to understand highly complex technical and digital issues relating to pharmaceutical drug manufacturing.

• Strategic Communicator & Collaborator: You combine excellent analytical and negotiation skills with high cross-cultural sensitivity and a dedicated team-player attitude.

• Language Skills: You are fluent in business-level English (written and verbal); knowledge of German or other languages is an asset.

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Qualified Legal Professional: Vous possédez un Bar Exam passé et apportez au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein d'un cabinet d'avocats internationaux ou du département juridique d'un groupe multinational.
• Expertise numérique & Pharma: Vous avez une expérience préalable en matière de soutien juridique dans les industries pharmaceutiques ou biotechnologiques, en mettant l'accent sur les données et les questions liées au numérique aux côtés des accords de fabrication.
• Technical Savvy: Vous possédez une forte affinité pour les soins de santé et la biotechnologie, vous permettant de comprendre des questions techniques et numériques très complexes liées à la fabrication de médicaments pharmaceutiques.
• Communicateur et collaborateur stratégique : Vous combinez d'excellentes compétences analytiques et de négociation avec une grande sensibilité interculturelle et une attitude d'équipe dévouée.

• Durchführung und Organisation der notwendigen Gebietsplanung und -routing für die Effizienz. Führt Business-Analyse und Planung durch.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager Core Lab (d/f/m)
Roche Diagnostics, Lisbon, Portugal

Are you a highly competitive, commercially savvy individual ready to be the expert advisor for our Core Lab automation, Core assays and tender strategy? Join our Business Strategy Chapter in Lisbon. You will be instrumental in leveraging our Core Lab solutions portfolio to significantly strengthen our market position and drive substantial business impact within the Portuguese healthcare system.

The Opportunity

As the Product Manager for Core Lab Automation and Core Reagents, you will be a key expert in this area as well as a consultant for our strategic Core Lab solutions. Your main focus will be to apply your strategic and product management expertise to support our strategy, commercial activities and our tender wins within the Core Lab area.

Your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Automation Expertise: Serve as the solid technical expert for the Core Lab automation portfolio, leveraging both healthcare consulting and product management experience.

• Commercial Strategy Support: Apply strong commercial acumen to shape the positioning of our automation solutions in a market striving for Healthcare efficiency. Transfer your know-how into valuable customer interactions.

• Tender Consultancy: Act as the expert advisor to proactively guide and support the Core Lab Tender process with tender experience to strengthen all commercial activity and proactively support the sales team with technical expertise to win opportunities in the Core Lab customer area.

• Market Insight & Engagement: Maintain close contact with local and global relevant stakeholders to gather crucial market insights, shape our future solutions and support strategic projects.

• Product Management: Take over the active product management of a wider part of our broad CoreLab portfolio.

Who You Are

We seek a highly motivated individual contributor with a winning, competitive mindset and a strong, positive attitude who is ready to take ownership of the Core Lab Automation and Core reagents business in Portugal while embracing the beauty of strong collaboration between sales, marketing and global teams:

• Education & Experience: University degree in Life Sciences or Healthcare in a relevant field, with product management and/or sales experience, preferably within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) or Medical Device industry.

• Mindset & Behaviour: A winning, competitive mindset, a positive challenger with excellent composure, and a strong, positive attitude.

• Expertise: Deep expertise in the IVD business and a solid technical understanding of Core Lab Automation as well as a proven commercial acumen with strong tender experience within the IVD or healthcare sector.

• Collaboration & Communication: A strong collaborator with excellent communication skills, capable of establishing trusting, long-term relationships. Able to work effectively both autonomously and collaboratively with local and international stakeholders across the internal local and global Roche network.

• Language Fluency: Fluent in both Portuguese and English for effective formal presentation and face-to-face interactions.

• Location: While we embrace a hybrid work model, proximity to the Roche office in Lisbon, Amadora, is required to ensure you can comfortably commute.

Ready to make a significant impact? Don't miss this unique opportunity to shape the future of Core Lab in Portugal and apply by July 17, 2026 .

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager Core Lab (d/f/m)
Roche Diagnostics, Lisbon, Portugal

Are you a highly competitive, commercially savvy individual ready to be the expert advisor for our Core Lab automation, Core assays and tender strategy? Join our Business Strategy Chapter in Lisbon. You will be instrumental in leveraging our Core Lab solutions portfolio to significantly strengthen our market position and drive substantial business impact within the Portuguese healthcare system.

The Opportunity

As the Product Manager for Core Lab Automation and Core Reagents, you will be a key expert in this area as well as a consultant for our strategic Core Lab solutions. Your main focus will be to apply your strategic and product management expertise to support our strategy, commercial activities and our tender wins within the Core Lab area.

Your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Automation Expertise: Serve as the solid technical expert for the Core Lab automation portfolio, leveraging both healthcare consulting and product management experience.

• Commercial Strategy Support: Apply strong commercial acumen to shape the positioning of our automation solutions in a market striving for Healthcare efficiency. Transfer your know-how into valuable customer interactions.

• Tender Consultancy: Act as the expert advisor to proactively guide and support the Core Lab Tender process with tender experience to strengthen all commercial activity and proactively support the sales team with technical expertise to win opportunities in the Core Lab customer area.

• Market Insight & Engagement: Maintain close contact with local and global relevant stakeholders to gather crucial market insights, shape our future solutions and support strategic projects.

• Product Management: Take over the active product management of a wider part of our broad CoreLab portfolio.

Who You Are

We seek a highly motivated individual contributor with a winning, competitive mindset and a strong, positive attitude who is ready to take ownership of the Core Lab Automation and Core reagents business in Portugal while embracing the beauty of strong collaboration between sales, marketing and global teams:

• Education & Experience: University degree in Life Sciences or Healthcare in a relevant field, with product management and/or sales experience, preferably within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) or Medical Device industry.

• Mindset & Behaviour: A winning, competitive mindset, a positive challenger with excellent composure, and a strong, positive attitude.

• Expertise: Deep expertise in the IVD business and a solid technical understanding of Core Lab Automation as well as a proven commercial acumen with strong tender experience within the IVD or healthcare sector.

• Collaboration & Communication: A strong collaborator with excellent communication skills, capable of establishing trusting, long-term relationships. Able to work effectively both autonomously and collaboratively with local and international stakeholders across the internal local and global Roche network.

• Language Fluency: Fluent in both Portuguese and English for effective formal presentation and face-to-face interactions.

• Location: While we embrace a hybrid work model, proximity to the Roche office in Lisbon, Amadora, is required to ensure you can comfortably commute.

Ready to make a significant impact? Don't miss this unique opportunity to shape the future of Core Lab in Portugal and apply by July 17, 2026 .

Who we are
A healthier futur

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.
Como um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Serviços , você será responsável por realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar os clientes na adequação do local onde serão instalados os equipamentos Roche. Você conduzirá manutenções preventivas e corretivas, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento anual e assegurando o menor impacto possível na rotina laboratorial do cliente. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a excelência técnica e a disponibilidade das soluções Roche no campo.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

• Realizar visitas de Site Preparation para orientar clientes na adequação técnica de infraestrutura para instalação de equipamentos.

• Conduzir manutenções preventivas técnicas, desde o agendamento e conferência de kits até o registro detalhado em sistema CRM.

• Executar manutenções corretivas de forma eficaz e eficiente para minimizar o downtime e manter a rotina operacional do cliente.

• Efetuar upgrades de hardware e software nos equipamentos instalados conforme orientações dos Especialistas Técnicos.

• Identificar situações críticas em clientes e reportá-las ao Coordenador Regional de Serviços, propondo respostas rápidas e resolutivas.

• Apoiar as equipes de Assessoria Científica na resolução de problemas de operação e aplicações, sempre que necessário.

• Colaborar com o Repair Shop nas revisões de equipamentos seguindo rigorosamente os procedimentos técnicos existentes.

• Garantir o fluxo de informações estratégicas do campo para a equipe de Vendas e dar suporte ao desenvolvimento técnico do time.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa.

• Experiência comprovada em assistência técnica, manutenções e serviços relacionados a equipamentos de análises clínicas ou informática.

• Conhecimento intermediário de Inglês (leitura técnica e comunicação básica).

• Habilidade em organização e autogestão para cumprimento de cronogramas de manutenção e chamados técnicos.

• Facilidade em estabelecer bom relacionamento interpessoal e atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Perfil proativo com foco na resolução de problemas e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

• Capacidade de comunicação clara para orientar clientes, reportar situações críticas internamente, bem como apresentar habilidades de liderança e suporte técnico para auxiliar no desenvolvimento de colegas e parceiros.

• Ter base de residência em Brasília.

• Disponibilidade de trabalho em turnos deslocados e escala de plantão.

• Disponibilidade para viagens em território nacional.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Custom Software Developer - Salesforce Center of Excellence
Description of the Area The Customer Engagement Platforms and Services function acts as Salesforce Center of Excellence (CoE) within Roche Digital Technology . These platforms and services are consumed by others to create business facing platforms, products and services . The goal is to empower product teams to develop business capabilities efficiently and compliantly, while reducing their cognitive load and allowing them to focus on value generation . Although development and operations remain decentralized, the Salesforce CoE can offer additional services, especially to smaller organizations that may lack certain specialized skills . The team is mandated to significantly reduce unintended customization and technical diversity by partnering with the business functions using the systems and driving re-use, simplification and standardization .
The Opportunity:

• Support Salesforce Engineering: Support the design, crafting, configuration, deployment, and sustaining of Salesforce software solutions (including LWC, Apex, and Flow) tailored to business requirements and objectives .

• Contribute to Global Projects: Serve as an active project contributor within global product teams, operating primarily at the project level within an internationally distributed team .

• Implement Delivery Processes: Implement the entire software delivery process, managing transitions from sandbox development to production deployment using CI/CD tools and SFDX .

• Optimize Software Quality: Improve existing software quality management and metrics through robust execution of Apex Unit Testing and detailed code reviews .

• Manage Stakeholder Communications: Identify and communicate with stakeholders in a straightforward manner, maintaining a clear view of how components fit into larger systems .

• Assess Technical Feasibility: Support product decisions by providing reliable technical feasibility assessments and actively contributing to the refinement of requirements .

• Support Cross-Platform Integration: Apply basic knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) to support seamless cross-platform integrations when necessary .

• Engage in Knowledge Sharing: Participate actively in organizational knowledge-sharing initiatives, including tech universities, conferences, and Communities of Practice (CoPs) .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical domain .

• Experienced Salesforce Developer: You bring 3+ years of progressive work experience as an active project contributor in software engineering, focusing on configuration and deployment within the Salesforce ecosystem .

• Full-Stack Technical Expert: You possess proven expertise using a combination of frontend, backend, and full-stack development tools, specifically LWC, Apex, and SOQL .

• Architectural Knowledge: You have a solid understanding of Salesforce architecture (including sharing models and security settings) and know how Sales, Service, and Community Clouds interact .

• Collaborative Problem Solver: You are highly adept at providing and seeking constructive feedback, communicating technical risks, and evaluating alternative ways to solve problems .

• Growth-Oriented Learner: You independently execute personal development plans, stay updated on current technological trends, and actively participate in professional communities .

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sviluppatore di software personalizzato - Salesforce Center of Excellence Descrizione dell'Area La funzione Piattaforme e Servizi di Customer Engagement agisce come Salesforce Center of Excellence (CoE) all'interno di Roche Digital Technology . Queste piattaforme e servizi sono consumati da altri per creare piattaforme, prodotti e servizi di business. L'obiettivo è quello di consentire ai team del prodotto di sviluppare le capacità aziendali in modo efficiente e conforme, riducendo al contempo il loro carico cognitivo e permettendo loro di concentrarsi sulla generazione del valore. Anche se lo sviluppo e le operazioni rimangono decentralizzate, il Salesforce CoE può offrire servizi aggiuntivi, in particolare alle organizzazioni più piccole che possono mancare determinate competenze specialistiche. Il team è incaricato di ridurre significativamente la personalizzazione indesiderata e la diversità tecnica, collaborando con le funzioni aziendali utilizzando i sistemi e la guida di riutilizzo, semplificazione e standardizzazione. L'opportunità:
• Supporto Salesforce Engineering: Supporta la progettazione, l'artigianato, la configurazione, l'implementazione e il supporto di soluzioni software Salesforce (tra cui LWC, Apex e Flow) su misura per esigenze e obiettivi aziendali.
• Contribuisci a Global Projects: Serve come contributore attivo di progetto all'interno di team di prodotti globali, operante principalmente a livello di progetto all'interno di un team distribuito a livello internazionale.
• Processi di consegna dell'esecuzione: implementare l'intero processo di consegna del software, gestire le transizioni dallo sviluppo della sandbox alla distribuzione di produzione utilizzando strumenti CI/CD e SFDX .
• Ottimizzare la qualità del software: migliorare la gestione della qualità del software esistente e metriche attraverso l'esecuzione robusta di Apex Unit Testing e le recensioni dettagliate del codice.
• Gestisci le comunicazioni degli stakeholder: Identificare e comunicare con gli stakeholder in modo semplice, mantenendo una chiara visione di come i componenti si adattano a sistemi più grandi .
• Valutare la fattibilità tecnica: sostenere le decisioni dei prodotti fornendo valutazioni di fattibilità tecniche affidabili e contribuire attivamente alla raffinatezza dei requisiti.
• Support Cross-Platform Integration: Applicare le conoscenze di base delle piattaforme cloud (come AWS, Azure o GCP) per supportare le integrazioni senza soluzione di continuità cross-platform quando necessario.
• Engage in Knowledge Sharing: Partecipa attivamente in iniziative di condivisione della conoscenza organizzativa, tra cui università tecnologiche, conferenze e Comunità di Pratica (CoPs) . Chi sei:
• Professionista Educato: Lei ha una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, Tecnologia dell'Informazione, o un relativo dominio tecnico.
• Sviluppatore Salesforce esperto: Porti 3+ anni di esperienza di lavoro progressiva come contributore attivo del progetto nell'ingegneria del software, concentrandosi sulla configurazione e distribuzione all'interno dell'ecosistema Salesforce .
• Esperto Tecnico Full-Stack: Possiedi competenze comprovate utilizzando una combinazione di strumenti di sviluppo frontend, backend e full-stack, in particolare LWC, Apex e SOQL .
• Conoscenza architettonica: Hai una solida comprensione dell'architettura Salesforce (tra cui la condivisione di modelli e impostazioni di sicurezza) e sai come le vendite, i servizi e le cloud della Comunità interagiscono.
• Problem Solver collaborativo: Lei è molto abile nel fornire e cercare feedback costruttivi, comunicare rischi tecnici, e valutare modi alternativi per risolvere i problemi.
• Imparante orientato alla crescita: Lei esegue autonomamente piani di sviluppo personale, rimanere aggiornato sulle attuali tendenze tecnologiche, e partecipare attivamente alle comunità professionali.

Die Position Custom Software Developer - Salesforce Center of Excellence Die Funktion Customer Engagement Platforms and Services fungiert als Salesforce Center of Excellence (CoE) innerhalb von Roche Digital Technology. Diese Plattformen und Dienste werden von anderen genutzt, um geschäftsorientierte Plattformen, Produkte und Dienstleistungen zu schaffen. Ziel ist es, Produktteams zu befähigen, Geschäftsfähigkeiten effizient und konform zu entwickeln, während sie gleichzeitig ihre kognitive Belastung reduzieren und sich auf die Wertschöpfung konzentrieren können. Obwohl Entwicklung und Betrieb weiterhin dezentralisiert sind, kann das Salesforce CoE zusätzliche Dienstleistungen anbieten, insbesondere für kleinere Organisationen, denen möglicherweise bestimmte Fachkenntnisse fehlen. Das Team ist beauftragt, unbeabsichtigte Anpassung und technische Vielfalt durch die Partnerschaft mit den Geschäftsfunktionen mit den Systemen und die Förderung der Wiederverwendung, Vereinfachung und Standardisierung deutlich zu reduzieren. Die Gelegenheit:
• Support Salesforce Engineering: Unterstützen Sie das Design, die Erstellung, Konfiguration, Bereitstellung und Wartung von Salesforce-Softwarelösungen (einschließlich LWC, Apex und Flow), die auf Geschäftsanforderungen und -ziele zugeschnitten sind.
• Beitrag zu globalen Projekten: Als aktiver Projektmitwirkender in globalen Produktteams tätig, hauptsächlich auf Projektebene in einem international verteilten Team.
• Implementieren von Bereitstellungsprozessen: Implementieren Sie den gesamten Softwarebereitstellungsprozess und verwalten Sie Übergänge von der Sandbox-Entwicklung bis zur Produktionsbereitstellung mit CI/CD-Tools und SFDX.
• Optimieren Sie die Softwarequalität: Verbessern Sie das bestehende Softwarequalitätsmanagement und die vorhandenen Metriken durch robuste Ausführung von Apex Unit Testing und detaillierten Code-Reviews.
• Verwalten Sie Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Identifizieren und kommunizieren Sie mit Stakeholdern auf einfache Weise und behalten Sie einen klaren Überblick darüber, wie Komponenten in größere Systeme passen.

• Unterstützung der plattformübergreifenden Integration: Wenden Sie grundlegende Kenntnisse von Cloud-Plattformen (wie AWS, Azure oder GCP) an, um bei Bedarf nahtlose plattformübergreifende Integrationen zu unterstützen.
• Engage in Knowledge Sharing: Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an organisatorischen Wissensaustauschinitiativen, einschließlich Tech-Universitäten, Konferenzen und Communities of Practice (CoPs). Wer du bist:
• Educated Professional: Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering, Informationstechnologie oder einer verwandten technischen Domäne.
