jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Lead Engineer will lead the end-to-end algorithm lifecycle—from development through validation and regulatory-ready deployment—ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, and Imaging Governance frameworks. Acting as the single point of accountability across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS, the role will deliver scalable analytical platform capabilities, promote automation, and ensure quality, documentation, and compliance standards are consistently applied.

This position drives the vision, strategy, and execution of the imaging algorithm ecosystem, enabling faster, reproducible, and compliant development and deployment across research and clinical domains. You will be responsible for defining tasks for others and driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service and multi-modal solutions. With expertise in AI/ML models architecture and interoperability, advanced analysis application frameworks and cloud features, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.

This Senior Lead Engineer role requires daily engagement with scientific, regulatory, clinical, and informatics partners to align on strategy, prioritization, and execution to strengthen collaboration and visibility across global teams, providing a direct bridge between Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development, and Platform Operations.

The Opportunity:

• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for multi-modal (including Radiology and Digital Pathology) Imaging Data & Insights within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP).

• Prioritize and deliver initiatives that enhance data quality, accessibility, and reusability for R&D, translational research, and clinical development.

• Act as the primary product owner for the imaging modalities analysis applications, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable and compliant technical solutions.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and external collaborations to ensure interoperability, compliance, and strategic alignment.

• Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-modal imaging data analysis applications, visualization, and analytics.

• Ensure timely delivery of product enhancements, standardized workflows, and integration of AI/ML-enabled tools.

• Collaborate with engineering, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure adherence to GxP, FAIR, and data-governance standards.

• Drive alignment across R&D, Diagnostics, and Data Science functions to enable shared data and analysis pipelines and unified processes.

• Manage dependencies, risks, and milestones for all digital pathology deliverables and communicate progress through KPIs and performance reports.

• Identify and implement opportunities to increase scalability, automation, and efficiency across analysis workflows.

• Monitor industry and technology trends in digital pathology, AI/ML, and digital health to guide ongoing product innovation .

• Identify and introduce the common format for deployment, reducing conversion costs and enhancing inference speed across har

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior porterà il ciclo di vita dell'algoritmo end-to-end - dallo sviluppo attraverso la validazione e l'implementazione di norma-ready - garantendo l'allineamento con GxP, SaMD e Imaging Governance framework. Essendo l'unico punto di responsabilità tra gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS, il ruolo fornirà funzionalità scalabili di piattaforma analitica, promuovere l'automazione e garantire la qualità, la documentazione e gli standard di conformità sono costantemente applicati. Questa posizione guida la visione, la strategia e l'esecuzione dell'ecosistema dell'algoritmo di imaging, consentendo uno sviluppo e una distribuzione più rapidi, riproducibili e conformi tra ricerca e ambiti clinici. Sarete responsabili della definizione dei compiti per gli altri e della guida di iniziative su larga scala su un prodotto. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica, ispirerai l'innovazione e guiderai la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio e multi-modali complesse. Grazie all'esperienza nell'architettura e nell'interoperabilità dei modelli AI/ML, ai framework applicativi avanzati di analisi e alle caratteristiche cloud, promuoverai la consistenza architettonica, guiderai la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti e gli ingegneri senior del mentore per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo di Senior Lead Engineer richiede l'impegno quotidiano con partner scientifici, normativi, clinici e informatici per allineare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione per rafforzare la collaborazione e la visibilità tra i team globali, fornendo un ponte diretto tra Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development e Platform Operations. L'opportunità:
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap per multi-modali (tra cui Radiologia e Patologia Digitale) Imaging Data & Insights all'interno della Global Imaging Platform (GIP).
• Priorizzare e fornire iniziative che migliorano la qualità dei dati, l'accessibilità e la riutilizzabilità per R&D, la ricerca traduttiva e lo sviluppo clinico.
• Agire come il principale proprietario del prodotto per le applicazioni di analisi delle modalità di imaging, coordinando attraverso gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS.
• Partner scientifico, clinico e tecnico porta a tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e conformi.
• Gestisci le relazioni degli stakeholder e le collaborazioni esterne per garantire l'interoperabilità, la conformità e l'allineamento strategico.
• Controllare il ciclo di vita end-to-end di applicazioni di analisi dei dati di imaging multi-modale, visualizzazione e analisi.
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei miglioramenti del prodotto, flussi di lavoro standardizzati e l'integrazione di strumenti abilitati AI/ML.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, qualità e regolamentazione per garantire l'adesione a standard GxP, FAIR e data-governance.
• Allineamento dell'unità attraverso le funzioni R&D, Diagnostics e Data Science per abilitare le pipeline di dati e analisi condivise e processi unificati.
• Gestire dipendenze, rischi e pietre miliari per tutti i materiali di patologia digitale e comunicare i progressi attraverso KPI e report sulle prestazioni.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per aumentare la scalabilità, l'automazione e l'efficienza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di analisi.
• Monitorare le tendenze dell'industria e della tecnologia nella patologia digitale, AI/ML e la salute digitale per guidare l'innovazione dei prodotti in corso.
• Identificare e introdurre il formato comune per la distribuzione, ridurre i costi di conversione e migliorare la velocità di inferenza attraverso l'arr

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Senior Lead Engineer wird den End-to-End-Algorithmus-Lebenszyklus – von der Entwicklung über die Validierung bis hin zur regulatorischen Bereitstellung – leiten und die Abstimmung mit GxP-, SaMD- und Imaging-Governance-Frameworks sicherstellen. Als einziger Verantwortlichkeitspunkt für gRED, pRED, PD, RDT und RIS wird die Rolle skalierbare analytische Plattformfähigkeiten liefern, die Automatisierung fördern und sicherstellen, dass Qualität, Dokumentation und Compliance-Standards konsequent angewendet werden. Diese Position treibt die Vision, Strategie und Ausführung des bildgebenden Algorithmus-Ökosystems voran und ermöglicht eine schnellere, reproduzierbare und konforme Entwicklung und Bereitstellung in Forschung und klinischen Bereichen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, Aufgaben für andere zu definieren und mittlere bis große Initiativen in einem Produkt voranzutreiben. In dieser strategischen Rolle coachen und leiten Sie andere Ingenieure, zeichnen sich durch Stakeholder-Verhandlungen aus und geben Orientierung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele. Sie tragen aktiv zum technischen Wissen bei, inspirieren zu Innovationen und leiten das Design komplexer Multi-Service- und Multi-Modal-Lösungen. Mit Expertise in der Architektur und Interoperabilität von AI / ML-Modellen, fortschrittlichen Analyseanwendungs-Frameworks und Cloud-Features fördern Sie die architektonische Konsistenz, fördern die technische Strategie für wichtige Komponenten und betreuen leitende Ingenieure, um die höchsten Standards der technischen Qualität im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten. Diese Rolle als Senior Lead Engineer erfordert die tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen, regulatorischen, klinischen und IT-Partnern, um die Strategie, Priorisierung und Ausführung auszurichten, um die Zusammenarbeit und Sichtbarkeit in globalen Teams zu stärken und eine direkte Brücke zwischen Imaging Governance, Algorithmusentwicklung und Plattformbetrieb zu bilden. Die Gelegenheit:
• Definieren und implementieren Sie die Produktstrategie und Roadmap für multimodale (einschließlich Radiologie und digitale Pathologie) Imaging-Daten und -Insights innerhalb der Global Imaging Platform (GIP).
• Priorisieren und liefern Sie Initiativen, die die Datenqualität, Zugänglichkeit und Wiederverwendbarkeit für Forschung und Entwicklung, translationale Forschung und klinische Entwicklung verbessern.
• Handeln Sie als primärer Produkteigentümer für die Anwendungen zur Analyse der Bildgebungsmodalitäten und koordinieren Sie über gRED, pRED, PD, RDT und RIS hinweg.
• Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen, klinischen und technischen Leitern, um Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare und konforme technische Lösungen umzusetzen.
• Verwalten Sie Stakeholder-Beziehungen und externe Kooperationen, um Interoperabilität, Compliance und strategische Ausrichtung sicherzustellen.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie den End-to-End-Lebenszyklus von multimodalen Imaging-Datenanalyseanwendungen, Visualisierung und Analyse.
• Gewährleistung der zeitnahen Bereitstellung von Produktverbesserungen, standardisierten Workflows und der Integration von AI/ML-fähigen Tools.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Engineering-, Qualitäts- und Regulierungsteams zusammen, um die Einhaltung der GxP-, FAIR- und Datenverwaltungsstandards sicherzustellen.
• Förderung der Ausrichtung über F&E-, Diagnose- und Data Science-Funktionen hinweg, um gemeinsame Daten- und Analysepipelines und einheitliche Prozesse zu ermöglichen.
• Verwalten Sie Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Meilensteine für alle digitalen Pathologieergebnisse und kommunizieren Sie den Fortschritt durch KPIs und Leistungsberichte.
• Identifizieren und implementieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Erhöhung der Skalierbarkeit, Automatisierung und Effizienz in Analyse-Workflows.
• Überwachen Sie Industrie- und Technologietrends in der digitalen Pathologie, AI / ML und digitalen Gesundheit, um die laufende Produktinnovation zu leiten.
• Identifizieren und Einführung eines gemeinsamen Formats für die Bereitstellung, Verringerung der Konversionskosten und Verbesserung der Inferenzgeschwindigkeit über Har
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur principal dirigera le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'algorithme, depuis le développement jusqu'à la validation jusqu'au déploiement réglementaire, pour assurer l'alignement avec les cadres de gouvernance GxP, SaMD et Imaging. Agissant en tant que point unique de responsabilisation pour gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS, le rôle fournira des capacités de plate-forme analytique évolutives, favorisera l'automatisation et assurera l'application uniforme des normes de qualité, de documentation et de conformité. Cette position stimule la vision, la stratégie et l'exécution de l'écosystème de l'algorithme d'imagerie, permettant un développement et un déploiement plus rapides, reproductibles et conformes dans les domaines de la recherche et de la clinique. Vous serez responsable de la définition des tâches pour les autres et de la conduite d'initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle à travers un produit. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices et multimodales complexes. Avec une expertise en architecture et en interopérabilité des modèles AI/ML, des cadres d'applications d'analyse avancés et des fonctionnalités cloud, vous favoriserez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants, et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle d'ingénieur principal exige un engagement quotidien avec les partenaires scientifiques, réglementaires, cliniques et informatiques afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution afin de renforcer la collaboration et la visibilité entre les équipes mondiales, fournissant un pont direct entre la gouvernance de l'imagerie, le développement de l'algorithme et les opérations de la plateforme. La possibilité :
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits multimodaux (y compris la radiologie et la pathologie numérique) Imager des données et des informations au sein de la plateforme mondiale d'imagerie (GIP).
• Privilégier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la qualité des données, leur accessibilité et leur réutilisabilité pour la R-D, la recherche translationnelle et le développement clinique.
• Agir en tant que principal propriétaire du produit pour les applications d'analyse des modalités d'imagerie, en coordonnant les applications gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS.
• Partenaire avec des pistes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques pour traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques évolutives et conformes.
• Gérer les relations avec les intervenants et les collaborations externes pour assurer l'interopérabilité, la conformité et l'alignement stratégique.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie de bout en bout des applications d'analyse de données d'imagerie multimodale, de visualisation et d'analyse.
• Assurer la prestation en temps opportun des améliorations apportées aux produits, des flux de travail normalisés et l'intégration d'outils compatibles avec l'IA/ML.
• Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité et de réglementation pour assurer le respect des normes GxP, FAIR et de gouvernance des données.
• Conduire l'alignement entre les fonctions R-D, Diagnostics et Data Science pour permettre le partage des données et des pipelines d'analyse et des processus unifiés.
• Gérer les dépendances, les risques et les jalons pour tous les produits de pathologie numérique et communiquer les progrès au moyen des ICR et des rapports de rendement.
• Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des occasions d'accroître l'évolutivité, l'automatisation et l'efficacité des processus d'analyse.
• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et de la technologie en matière de pathologie numérique, d'IA/ML et de santé numérique pour guider l'innovation continue des produits.
• Identifier et introduire le format commun pour le déploiement, réduire les coûts de conversion et améliorer la vitesse d'inférence dans tous les secteurs

The Position
Du suchst ein Praktikum, in dem Du Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? Dann bist Du bei uns richtig.

Die Abteilung Manufacturing Reagents Compounding PZ am Standort Penzberg sieht sich in der Verantwortung, dass Patienten präzise medizinisch-diagnostische Resultate erhalten. Unser Beitrag dazu ist die Herstellung von Reagenzien, Kalibratoren und Kontrollen für Immunologische Tests.
Wir stehen für Zuverlässigkeit, Qualität und Wachstum. Mit unserer zupackenden, optimistischen Einstellung gestalten wir unsere Zukunft zum Wohle der Patienten, unserer Mitarbeitenden, für uns als Organisation, Global Operations und für Roche.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse mit

• Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein eigenes Projekt zum Thema Materialfluss in der Diagnostik Produktion zu planen und umzusetzen

• Deine Energie bringst Du dort ein, wo Du mit deinen Talenten den größten Impact generieren kannst

Dein Profil

Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) der Logistik, (Wirtschafts-) Ingenieurwesens, BWL/Management und vergleichbarer Masterstudiengänge oder befindest dich im Gap Year. Mit deiner Perspektive möchtest Du die Effizienz in der Produktion aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Stärken

• Du hast Spaß daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam mit einem Team Konzepte zu erarbeiten

• Du bist offen für Neues ist Kommunikation ist eine Stärke von Dir

• Deine Kombinationsgabe ermöglicht es Dir, verschiedene Ziele und Wünsche zu vereinen und geeignete Lösungen zu finden

• Du bist fit im Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs/Slides)

• Du setzt AI zielführend ein

• Du bist kreativ und setzt Deine Ideen gerne in die Tat um

• Du kannst Dich eigenständig organisieren und Dir Deinen Arbeitsalltag strukturieren

• Du hast Interesse daran in einem operativen Umfeld zu arbeiten und Dich in interdisziplinäre Inhalte einzuarbeiten

• Du hast bereits einige Erfahrungen in der Umsetzung von Projekten erworben

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

The Position
As a Medical Affairs Partner, you will act as a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded collaborator within our customer engagement ecosystem. Based in the affiliate team, you will drive the local medical strategy, build deep peer-to-peer connections with scientific communities, and ensure our diagnostic and therapeutic innovations reach their full potential to transform patient lives.

In this role, you will:

• Drive Scientific & Medical Strategy: Lead the medical component of the integrated therapeutic strategy, translating complex clinical data into a clear, differentiated value story across key disease areas.

• Cultivate Trusted Partnerships: Proactively engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), external scientific experts, and healthcare stakeholders to foster meaningful, science-driven collaborations.

• Advance Evidence Generation: Develop and implement local integrated evidence plans, identifying data gaps and supporting Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies, non-interventional studies, and investigator-initiated research.

• Accelerate Patient Market Access: Contribute scientific expertise to local Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, articulating the real-world value of our innovations to secure faster patient access.

• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Systematically gather external clinical insights, utilizing emerging digital tools and AI insights responsibly to anticipate and optimize local medical practice adoption.

• Ensure Absolute Excellence & Compliance: Oversee medical information requests and collaborate with Regulatory and Clinical Operations teams, maintaining strict adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

Who You Are
You are an entrepreneurial, solution-oriented professional who thrives in cross-functional team environments. You balance deep scientific expertise with the strategic acumen required to navigate ambiguity and communicate complex insights with clarity and impact.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Excellence: You hold an advanced degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

• Professional Experience: You bring proven experience in Medical Affairs or equivalent clinical/scientific expertise within relevant therapeutic areas preferably in Retinal Diseases & Ophthalmology

• Strategic Communication: You possess exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead peer-to-peer scientific dialogue at an executive level in English.

• Digital Literacy: You maintain a growth mindset toward digital tools, demonstrating basic AI literacy and the ability to ensure robust human-in-the-loop oversight of digital content.

• Compliance & Collaborative Mindset: You demonstrate strong personal accountability, a collaborative approach to cross-functional "squad" environments, and an unwavering commitment to ethical compliance.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Product Development Regulatory Affairs (PDR), a flexible, bold, and distinctive regulatory organization where we make strategic decisions quickly, innovate boldly, and deliver insights that shape our portfolio development. We are seeking a talented professional to help build, mature, and sustain our regulatory business capabilities while fostering a culture of continuous learning and meaningful impact for patients.

The Opportunity:

• Support complex and higher exposure quality and compliance activities , providing guidance and risk assessment to PDR staff on GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR compliance issues, and serving as advisor and subject matter expert for Quality and Compliance-related processes

• Lead deviation management and process management activities, updating and maintaining regulatory documents while sustaining Quality and Compliance operational activities required for maintaining Roche's license to operate and Quality Management System (QMS)

• Oversee training management , scheduling training sessions and ensuring completion across PDR to support our commitment to regulatory compliance and continuous learning

• Prepare and manage compliance reports , monitoring trends in the external compliance environment

• Partner across the enterprise with stakeholders within and beyond PDR (including affiliates, PD quality organizations, and the broader Roche group) to unlock company-wide benefits and ensure regulatory compliance

• Lead increasingly complex deliverables while collaborating cross-functionally with key stakeholders, generating insights, and mentoring peers to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

• Monitor and respond to trends in innovation and the external compliance environment, anticipating changes in the regulatory landscape and assessing future business needs

• Contribute to initiatives that shape our technical, business, and healthcare environments , bringing new ideas into the business and leading them with entrepreneurial mindset

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of relevant regulatory affairs, quality, or compliance experience in the Pharma or Medical Device space, with a proven ability to independently deliver and lead increasingly complex projects and initiatives

• Experience working with health authorities , understanding the global regulatory environment

• Strategic and systems thinker with strong data management, content management, and knowledge management capabilities; experienced in change leadership and operating effectively in matrix environments

• Cross-functional collaboration expert with demonstrated experience in building trusted partnerships across internal and external stakeholders, including health authorities

• Compliance-focused professional with a deep understanding of the global regulatory environment, GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR requirements, and a commitment to maintaining license to operate and integrity

• Continuous learner with a growth mindset, strong communication skills, and ability to seek and act on feedback

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring

• Imparente continuo con una mentalità di crescita, forti capacità di comunicazione, e la capacità di cercare e agire sul feedback In cambio vi forniamo:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics
At Roche Diagnostics, we are committed not only to advancing diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make critical decisions for their patients, but also to improving how these essential tools are integrated into healthcare systems worldwide - delivering strong outcomes more efficiently and at a lower cost.
In more than 100 countries, we offer one of the industry's most comprehensive portfolios of in vitro diagnostic tests, combined with clinical decision support, consulting, digital diagnostics, disease management, laboratory automation, and software solutions. Together, these capabilities help us deliver integrated solutions for laboratories, clinicians, and healthcare systems.
What is your mission?
As a Business Process Partner/ Administrative Pool Assistant, you will be part of a business support team working closely with the leadership team. Your mission will be to improve business agility and operational efficiency, helping free up valuable time for strategic teams as well as field-based commercial and service teams.
This role combines high-quality executive and administrative support with a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement. You will help optimize processes, introduce practical management tools, including project management and AI-based solutions, and ensure compliance with internal policies at a national level.
If you are motivated by efficiency, technology, collaboration, and the opportunity to make a real business impact, this role offers a great opportunity to contribute.

Your Key Responsibilities:
Executive and leadership support
Coordinate and manage leadership agendas, including meetings, travel planning, and other priority activities that support business focus and organizational effectiveness.
Internal and external coordination
Support interactions with key internal and external stakeholders to help move strategic initiatives, cross-functional projects, and commercial priorities forward. You will also contribute to improving day-to-day ways of working, making processes clearer, simpler, and more efficient.
Commercial Strategic Support : Provide direct support to key account teams, including preparing client briefings, managing data in the CRM system, and administrative follow-up on executive actions as a key member of the administrative pool
Process improvement and automation
Identify repetitive or manual tasks across different areas and help design and implement practical solutions to simplify, improve, and automate them, including through the use of AI and digital tools.
Compliance and governance
Help ensure that administrative and operational processes are carried out in line with internal policies and standards across Finance, Human Resources, Communications & Events, and Business Integrity.
Cross-functional collaboration
Work closely with colleagues across the support team to coordinate priorities, provide back-up when needed, and help ensure continuity and balanced workload across the organization.

What We Look for in You:
At least 5 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Project management from planning through execution

• Executive support

• Team coordination

• Administrative or operational management in large corporate environments, ideally within matrix or network organizations

• Residence in Barcelona

Languages
Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish are essential.
Digital mindset and technology skills
Strong experience using cloud-based

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Diagnostica Roche A Roche Diagnostics, ci impegniamo non solo ad avanzare soluzioni diagnostiche che aiutano i professionisti del settore sanitario a prendere decisioni critiche per i loro pazienti, ma anche a migliorare il modo in cui questi strumenti essenziali sono integrati in sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo - fornendo risultati forti in modo più efficiente e ad un costo più basso. In più di 100 paesi, offriamo uno dei portafogli più completi del settore di test diagnostici in vitro, combinato con il supporto decisionale clinico, la consulenza, la diagnostica digitale, la gestione delle malattie, l'automazione di laboratorio e le soluzioni software. Insieme, queste capacità ci aiutano a fornire soluzioni integrate per laboratori, medici e sistemi sanitari. Qual è la tua missione? In qualità di Business Process Partner/Administrative Pool Assistant, sarai parte di un team di supporto aziendale che lavora a stretto contatto con il team di leadership. La vostra missione sarà di migliorare l'agilità aziendale e l'efficienza operativa, aiutando a liberare tempo prezioso per le squadre strategiche, così come i team commerciali e di servizio basati sul campo. Questo ruolo combina un supporto esecutivo e amministrativo di alta qualità con una forte attenzione all'innovazione e al miglioramento continuo. Aiuterai a ottimizzare i processi, a introdurre strumenti di gestione pratici, tra cui la gestione dei progetti e soluzioni basate su AI, e a garantire il rispetto delle politiche interne a livello nazionale. Se siete motivati da efficienza, tecnologia, collaborazione e l'opportunità di fare un impatto reale sul business, questo ruolo offre una grande opportunità di contribuire. Le tue responsabilità chiave: Supporto esecutivo e leadership Coordinare e gestire gli ordini del giorno della leadership, compresi gli incontri, la pianificazione dei viaggi e altre attività prioritarie che supportano l'attenzione aziendale e l'efficacia organizzativa. Coordinamento interno ed esterno Supporta le interazioni con i principali stakeholder interni ed esterni per aiutare a spostare iniziative strategiche, progetti interfunzionali e priorità commerciali in avanti. Contribuirai anche a migliorare i modi quotidiani di lavorare, rendendo i processi più chiari, più semplici e più efficienti. Supporto commerciale Fornire supporto diretto ai team di account chiave preparando i briefing dei clienti, mantenendo i dati CRM accurati e seguendo le azioni amministrative e operative nell'ambito del team di supporto aziendale più ampio. Miglioramento del processo e automazione Identificare attività ripetitive o manuali in diverse aree e aiutare a progettare e implementare soluzioni pratiche per semplificare, migliorare e automatizzarle, anche attraverso l'uso di AI e strumenti digitali. Compliance e governance Aiuta a garantire che i processi amministrativi e operativi siano realizzati in linea con le politiche e gli standard interni in materia di finanza, risorse umane, comunicazioni e eventi e business Integrity. Collaborazione interfunzionale Lavorare a stretto contatto con i colleghi di tutto il team di supporto per coordinare le priorità, fornire il backup quando necessario, e contribuire a garantire continuità e carico di lavoro equilibrato in tutta l'organizzazione. Cosa cerchiamo in te: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante in uno o più dei seguenti settori:
• Gestione del progetto dalla pianificazione all'esecuzione
• Supporto esecutivo
• Coordinamento del team
• Gestione amministrativa o operativa in grandi ambienti aziendali, idealmente all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice o di rete
• Residence a Barcellona Lingue Fluente scritto e parlato inglese e spagnolo sono essenziali. Digital mindset e competenze tecnologiche Forte esperienza con prodotti basati su cloud

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Diagnostik Bei Roche Diagnostics setzen wir uns nicht nur dafür ein, diagnostische Lösungen zu entwickeln, die medizinische Fachkräfte dabei unterstützen, kritische Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten zu treffen, sondern auch, um zu verbessern, wie diese wichtigen Werkzeuge in Gesundheitssysteme weltweit integriert werden - und damit bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die effizienter und kostengünstiger sind. In mehr als 100 Ländern bieten wir eines der branchenweit umfassendsten Portfolios an In-vitro-Diagnostiktests, kombiniert mit klinischer Entscheidungsunterstützung, Beratung, digitaler Diagnostik, Krankheitsmanagement, Laborautomation und Softwarelösungen. Gemeinsam helfen uns diese Fähigkeiten, integrierte Lösungen für Labore, Kliniker und Gesundheitssysteme zu liefern. Was ist Ihre Mission? Als Business Process Partner / Administrative Pool Assistant sind Sie Teil eines Business Support Teams, das eng mit dem Führungsteam zusammenarbeitet. Ihre Mission ist es, die geschäftliche Agilität und operative Effizienz zu verbessern und so wertvolle Zeit für strategische Teams sowie feldbasierte Geschäfts- und Serviceteams freizusetzen. Diese Rolle verbindet eine qualitativ hochwertige exekutive und administrative Unterstützung mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Sie helfen, Prozesse zu optimieren, praktische Management-Tools, einschließlich Projektmanagement und KI-basierte Lösungen, einzuführen und die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien auf nationaler Ebene sicherzustellen. Wenn Sie durch Effizienz, Technologie, Zusammenarbeit und die Möglichkeit motiviert sind, eine echte Geschäftswirkung zu erzielen, bietet diese Rolle eine großartige Gelegenheit, einen Beitrag zu leisten. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben: Unterstützung von Führungskräften Koordinieren und verwalten Sie Führungspläne, einschließlich Meetings, Reiseplanung und andere vorrangige Aktivitäten, die den Geschäftsfokus und die organisatorische Effektivität unterstützen. Interne und externe Koordinierung Unterstützung der Interaktion mit wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern, um strategische Initiativen, funktionsübergreifende Projekte und kommerzielle Prioritäten voranzubringen. Sie tragen auch dazu bei, die tägliche Arbeitsweise zu verbessern und Prozesse klarer, einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten. Kommerzielle Unterstützung Direkte Unterstützung für Key-Account-Teams durch die Vorbereitung von Kundenbriefings, die Pflege genauer CRM-Daten und die Nachverfolgung administrativer und operativer Maßnahmen als Teil des breiteren Business-Support-Teams. Prozessverbesserung und Automatisierung Identifizieren Sie sich wiederholende oder manuelle Aufgaben in verschiedenen Bereichen und helfen Sie bei der Gestaltung und Implementierung praktischer Lösungen, um sie zu vereinfachen, zu verbessern und zu automatisieren, einschließlich durch den Einsatz von KI und digitalen Tools. Compliance und Governance Stellen Sie sicher, dass administrative und operative Prozesse im Einklang mit internen Richtlinien und Standards in den Bereichen Finanzen, Personalwesen, Kommunikation & Veranstaltungen und Geschäftsintegrität durchgeführt werden. Funktionale Zusammenarbeit Arbeiten Sie eng mit Kollegen im gesamten Supportteam zusammen, um Prioritäten zu koordinieren, bei Bedarf ein Backup bereitzustellen und die Kontinuität und ausgewogene Arbeitsbelastung im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten. Was wir in dir suchen: Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:
• Projektmanagement von der Planung bis zur Ausführung
• Exekutive Unterstützung
• Teamkoordinierung
• Administratives oder operatives Management in großen Unternehmensumgebungen, idealerweise in Matrix- oder Netzwerkorganisationen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Diagnostic Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous nous engageons non seulement à faire progresser les solutions diagnostiques qui aident les professionnels de la santé à prendre des décisions critiques pour leurs patients, mais aussi à améliorer la façon dont ces outils essentiels sont intégrés dans les systèmes de soins de santé dans le monde entier - en obtenant de bons résultats plus efficacement et à moindre coût. Dans plus de 100 pays, nous offrons l'un des portefeuilles de tests de diagnostic in vitro les plus complets de l'industrie, combinés à un soutien à la décision clinique, conseil, diagnostic numérique, gestion des maladies, automatisation de laboratoire et solutions logicielles. Ensemble, ces capacités nous aident à fournir des solutions intégrées pour les laboratoires, les cliniciens et les systèmes de santé. Quelle est votre mission ? En tant que partenaire des processus opérationnels et adjoint au groupe administratif, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de soutien aux entreprises qui travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de direction. Votre mission sera d'améliorer l'agilité des affaires et l'efficacité opérationnelle, en aidant à libérer du temps précieux pour les équipes stratégiques ainsi que les équipes commerciales et de services sur le terrain. Ce rôle combine un soutien administratif et exécutif de haute qualité avec un accent marqué sur l'innovation et l'amélioration continue. Vous aiderez à optimiser les processus, à introduire des outils de gestion pratiques, y compris la gestion de projet et les solutions basées sur l'IA, et à assurer le respect des politiques internes au niveau national. Si vous êtes motivé par l'efficacité, la technologie, la collaboration et la possibilité d'avoir un impact commercial réel, ce rôle offre une excellente occasion de contribuer. Vos responsabilités clés : Appui à la direction Coordonner et gérer les programmes de leadership, y compris les réunions, la planification des voyages et d'autres activités prioritaires qui appuient l'orientation opérationnelle et l'efficacité organisationnelle. Coordination interne et externe Appuyer les interactions avec les principaux intervenants internes et externes afin d'aider à faire avancer les initiatives stratégiques, les projets interfonctionnels et les priorités commerciales. Vous contribuerez également à améliorer les méthodes de travail quotidiennes, en rendant les processus plus clairs, plus simples et plus efficaces. Soutien commercial Fournir un soutien direct aux principales équipes de comptabilité en préparant des séances d'information sur les clients, en tenant à jour des données exactes sur la CRM et en assurant le suivi des actions administratives et opérationnelles dans le cadre de l'équipe élargie de soutien aux entreprises. Amélioration et automatisation des processus Identifier les tâches répétitives ou manuelles dans différents domaines et aider à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions pratiques pour les simplifier, les améliorer et les automatiser, y compris grâce à l'utilisation d'IA et d'outils numériques. Respect et gouvernance Aider à s'assurer que les processus administratifs et opérationnels sont menés conformément aux politiques et aux normes internes des Finances, des Ressources humaines, des Communications et événements et de l'intégrité opérationnelle. Collaboration interfonctionnelle Collaborer étroitement avec les collègues de l'équipe de soutien pour coordonner les priorités, fournir des renforts au besoin et aider à assurer la continuité et l'équilibre de la charge de travail dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce que nous cherchons en vous: Au moins 5 années d'expérience pertinente dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants:
• Gestion de projet depuis la planification jusqu ' à l ' exécution
• Appui administratif
• Coordination des équipes
• Gestion administrative ou opérationnelle dans de grands environnements organisationnels, idéalement au sein d'organisations matricielles ou de réseaux
• Résidence à Barcelone Langues L'anglais et l'espagnol écrits et parlés sont essentiels. L'état d'esprit numérique et les compétences technologiques Forte expérience en utilisant des produits basés sur le cloud

jobs.title: Clinical Selling Specialist - Toledo
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Clinician Selling Specialist , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en impulsar la adopción de nuestros biomarcadores y soluciones innovadoras dentro de las comunidades clínicas. Construirás relaciones sólidas con líderes de opinión clave (KOLs), investigadores y proveedores de atención médica para avanzar en nuestra misión de mejorar los resultados de los pacientes a través de la medicina personalizada y una mejor gestión de enfermedades crónicas.

En este rol, serás la persona de referencia para aspectos clínicos y técnicos en el área de Castilla-La Mancha . Serás responsable de promover nuestras soluciones con un enfoque técnico-científico, adaptando las estrategias globales a la realidad local de la Atención Primaria y los centros especializados, asegurando que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a los pacientes adecuados en el momento adecuado.

Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ventas Estratégicas y Promoción Técnica: Promover productos y servicios con mensajes científicos diferenciadores. Negociarás con centros de salud y hospitales, proporcionando explicaciones técnicas de alto nivel centradas en el tratamiento y la gestión del paciente.

• Enfoque en Atención Primaria y Diabetes: Serás un socio clave para los proveedores de Atención Primaria, especialmente en el contexto de la Diabetes , promoviendo las ventas con un enfoque orientado al tratamiento e identificando nuevas oportunidades de negocio dentro de las cuentas existentes.

• Participación de las Partes Interesadas: Identificar y cultivar una red de defensores (KOLs, Líderes Clínicos, Directores Médicos). Adaptarás los planes de ventas para satisfacer sus necesidades y comunicarás las implicaciones de las licitaciones públicas al Gerente de Zona.

• Formación Clínica: Educar al personal de enfermería y a los profesionales de la salud tanto en hospitales como en centros de Atención Primaria sobre el uso del producto, coordinando la participación de las enfermeras en los protocolos de atención al paciente.

• Experiencia Científica: Actuar como el experto local, presentando las soluciones de Roche en foros regionales y simposios. Te mantendrás actualizado sobre las regulaciones IVDR y los algoritmos de gestión de pacientes.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Recopilar y compartir información sobre tendencias del mercado y competencia. Implementarás campañas de marketing y colaborarás con los Gerentes de Producto en actividades promocionales locales (congresos, talleres, etc.).

• Inversión y ROI: Proponer e implementar inversiones en tu territorio basadas en un retorno (ROI) definido y asegurar que se cumplan todos los compromisos con el cliente.

• Movilidad: Este puesto requiere una alta presencia en campo, con viajes esperados dentro del área designada (Castilla-La Mancha) 70+% del tiempo.

Quién Eres
Buscamos un perfil científico con una fuerte enfoque comercial y experiencia en el ecosistema sanitario local.

• Educación: Se necesita Licenciatura. Se valorará altamente la Licenciatura en Ciencias.

• Experiencia: 3 a 5 años de experiencia en la industria de ciencias de la vida. Es esencial una experiencia probada en Atención Primaria.

• Experiencia en la Materia: Se valora profundamente el conocimiento o la experiencia en Diabetes.

• Construcción de Relaciones: Gran capacidad para construir y mantener relaciones con profesionales de la salud a todos los niveles.

• Idiomas: Se valora mucho la fluidez en español ; un dominio sólido del inglés es obligatorio para la colaboración global.

• Ubicación: D

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Zur Verstärkung unseres Chapters MSAT Pilot Plant am Standort Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Person mit einem guten Prozessverständnis der biotechnologischen Drug Substance Herstellung und Fokus auf Downstream Processing. Als Team unterstützen wir die DS-Produktion und die Prozessentwicklung durch den Betrieb unserer Labor- und Pilotanlagen (USP & DSP) sowie die Durchführung von Scale-up- und Tech-Transfer-Projekten. In dieser Rolle unterstützen wir nicht nur die DS-Produktion durch unsere Labor- und Pilotläufe, sondern treiben auch aktiv Innovations- und Transferprojekten voran.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Mitarbeiter:in MSAT Pilot Plant der biotechnologische DS Herstellung mit Fokus DSP/ADC umfasst dein Tätigkeitsgebiet folgende Aufgaben:

• Puffer- und Medienherstellung: Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Berechnung und präzise Herstellung von Puffern und Medienansätzen für Upstream- (USP) und Downstream- (DSP) Prozesse.

• Operativer Projekt-Support: Aktive und selbständige Mitarbeit und Unterstützung bei Tech Transfers, Scale-up/down Aktivitäten, sowie Testläufen im Labor.

• Technical Writing & Dokumentation: Qualitätskonforme Dokumentation der Herstellungsschritte (Protokolle, Logbücher) sowie Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von einfachen Berichten und Arbeitsanweisungen (SOPs).

• Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen: Enge Abstimmung mit Schnittstellen innerhalb und außerhalb der Organisation (z. B. Entwicklung und Produktion) zur optimalen Koordination von Pufferbedarfen und Projektzeitplänen.

• Anlagen- und Gerätesupport: Vorbereitung, Bedienung, Reinigung und Qualifizierungs-Unterstützung von Labor- und Pilotanlagen (z. B. Filtrations- und Chromatographieanlagen) sowie deren Unterhalt.

• Sicherheit und Ordnung: Sicherstellung von Ordnung, Sauberkeit (5S-Standard) und Arbeitssicherheit im Bereich der Pufferherstellung sowie Überwachung der Rohstoffbestände.

• Arbeiten mit HAS : Umgang mit hochaktiven Stoffen, sauberes, präzieses Arbeiten und verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit diesen Stoffen unter Einhaltung der arbeitshygienischen Vorgaben.

Wer Du Bist
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant:in (Biologie/Chemie), Pharmatechnolog:in oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit erster Berufserfahrung in einem pharmazeutischen/biotechnologischen Produktions- oder Entwicklungsumfeld

• Grundlegendes Prozessverständnis von biotechnologischer DS-Herstellung (USP & DSP) sowie Freude am exakten, praktischen Arbeiten nach Rezepturen.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit gängigen Labormessgeräten (z. B. pH-Meter, Leitfähigkeitsmessung, Waagen) von Vorteil.

• Du bewegst dich souverän und zielgerichtet sowohl im streng regulierten GMP-Umfeld als auch im agilen non-GMP-Bereich und wendest die jeweiligen Standards korrekt an.

• Teamorientierte, strukturierte und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, Aufgaben exakt und selbstständig voranzutreiben.

• Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend (erforderlich), Englisch von Vorteil.

• Versierter Umgang mit MS-Office und Google Applications.

• Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, praktisch wochentags und ggf. an Wochenenden zu arbeiten oder Bereitschaftsdienst zu leisten (Pikettdienst).

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the gl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Per rafforzare il nostro capitolo di MSAT Pilot Plant nel sito di Basilea, stiamo cercando una persona dedicata con una buona comprensione del processo di produzione di sostanze stupefacenti biotecnologiche e un focus sulla lavorazione a valle. In qualità di team, supportiamo la produzione e lo sviluppo di processi DS attraverso il funzionamento dei nostri impianti di laboratorio e pilota (USP & DSP) e l'implementazione di progetti di scale-up e trasferimento tecnologico. In questo ruolo, non solo supportiamo la produzione DS attraverso le nostre piste di laboratorio e pilota, ma anche promuovere attivamente progetti di innovazione e trasferimento. La possibilità Come dipendente: in MSAT Pilot Plant la produzione di DS biotecnologica con focus su DSP/ADC il vostro campo di attività include i seguenti compiti:
• Produzione di buffer e media: pianificazione indipendente, calcolo e produzione precisa di buffer e approcci multimediali per i processi upstream (USP) e downstream (DSP).
• Supporto del progetto operativo: cooperazione attiva e indipendente e supporto nei trasferimenti tecnologici, attività di scale-up/down e test di laboratorio.
• Scrittura Tecnica & Documentazione: Documentazione conforme alla qualità delle fasi di produzione (protocolli, logbook) e supporto per la creazione di semplici report e istruzioni di lavoro (SOP).
• Cooperazione con le interfacce: Coordinamento stretto con le interfacce all'interno e all'esterno dell'organizzazione (ad esempio sviluppo e produzione) per un coordinamento ottimale dei requisiti di buffer e dei programmi di progetto.
• Supporto impianti e attrezzature: preparazione, funzionamento, pulizia e qualificazione di impianti di laboratorio e pilota (ad esempio impianti di filtrazione e cromatografia) e loro manutenzione.
• Sicurezza e ordine: garantire l'ordine, la pulizia (5S standard) e la sicurezza sul lavoro nel settore della produzione e del monitoraggio dei materiali grezzi.
• Lavorare con HAS: trattare sostanze altamente attive, lavorare in modo pulito, preciso e responsabile di queste sostanze nel rispetto dei requisiti di igiene professionale. Chi sei Per avere successo in questo ruolo emozionante, è idealmente portare i seguenti:
• Formazione completa come tecnico di laboratorio: in (biologia/chimica), farmacotecnologia: in o comparabile formazione tecnica con esperienza professionale iniziale in un ambiente di produzione o sviluppo farmaceutico/biotecnologico
• Comprensione di processo di base della produzione di DS biotecnologica (USP & DSP) e il godimento del lavoro esatto e pratico secondo le ricette.
• L'esperienza nell'utilizzo di dispositivi di misura di laboratorio comuni (ad esempio pHmetri, misurazione della conducibilità, bilancia) è vantaggiosa.
• Ti muovi con fiducia e mira sia nell'ambiente GMP strettamente regolamentato che nell'area non GMP agile e applica correttamente i rispettivi standard.
• Personalità orientata al team, strutturata e comunicativa con la capacità di avanzare compiti in modo preciso e indipendente.
• Competenze linguistiche: fluente tedesco (richiesto), inglese benefico.
• Gestione esperta di MS-Office e Google Applications.
• Flessibilità e la volontà di lavorare praticamente nei giorni feriali e possibilmente nei fine settimana o di fornire il servizio on-call (servizio epiquet). Applicare ora con il tuo CV attuale e le recenti testimonianze e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti attraverso il gl

The possibility As an employee: in MSAT Pilot Plant the biotechnological DS production with focus on DSP/ADC your field of activity includes the following tasks:
• Buffer and media production: Independent planning, calculation and precise production of buffers and media approaches for upstream (USP) and downstream (DSP) processes.
• Operational project support: Active and independent cooperation and support in tech transfers, scale-up/down activities, and laboratory test runs.
• Technical Writing & Documentation: Quality-compliant documentation of the production steps (protocols, logbooks) as well as support for the creation of simple reports and work instructions (SOPs).
• Cooperation with interfaces: Close coordination with interfaces within and outside the organisation (e.g. development and production) for optimal coordination of buffer requirements and project schedules.
• Plant and equipment support: preparation, operation, cleaning and qualification support of laboratory and pilot plants (e.g. filtration and chromatography plants) and their maintenance.
• Safety and order: ensuring order, cleanliness (5S standard) and occupational safety in the area of buffer production and monitoring of raw material stocks.
• Working with HAS : handling highly active substances, clean, precise working and responsible handling of these substances in compliance with occupational hygiene requirements. Who you are In order to succeed in this exciting role, you ideally bring the following:
• Completed training as a laboratory technician:in (biology/chemistry), pharmatechnolog:in or comparable technical training with initial professional experience in a pharmaceutical/biotechnological production or development environment
• Basic process understanding of biotechnological DS production (USP & DSP) as well as enjoyment of exact, practical work according to recipes.
• Experience in using common laboratory measuring devices (e.g. pH meters, conductivity measurement, balances) is advantageous.
• You move confidently and purposefully both in the strictly regulated GMP environment and in the agile non-GMP area and apply the respective standards correctly.
• Team-oriented, structured and communication-strong personality with the ability to advance tasks accurately and independently.
• Language skills: German fluent (required), English beneficial.
• Experienced handling of MS-Office and Google Applications.
• Flexibility and the willingness to work practically on weekdays and possibly on weekends or to provide on-call service (picquet service). Apply now with your current CV and recent testimonials and become part of our team to shape the future together! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Pour renforcer notre chapitre sur l'usine pilote MSAT sur le site de Bâle, nous recherchons une personne dévouée qui comprend bien le processus de production de substances pharmaceutiques biotechnologiques et qui met l'accent sur la transformation en aval. En tant qu'équipe, nous soutenons la production et le développement de processus DS par l'exploitation de nos laboratoires et de nos installations pilotes (USP & DSP) ainsi que la mise en œuvre de projets de mise à niveau et de transfert de technologie. Dans ce rôle, nous soutenons non seulement la production de DS par l'intermédiaire de nos laboratoires et de nos projets pilotes, mais aussi activement la promotion de projets d'innovation et de transfert. La possibilité En tant qu'employé : dans l'usine pilote MSAT, la production de DS biotechnologique en mettant l'accent sur DSP/ADC, votre domaine d'activité comprend les tâches suivantes :
• Production de tampons et de médias : planification, calcul et production précise de tampons et d'approches médiatiques pour les processus en amont (USP) et en aval (DSP).
• Appui opérationnel aux projets: coopération active et indépendante et soutien aux transferts de technologie, aux activités de mise à niveau et de réduction et aux essais en laboratoire.
• Rédaction technique et documentation: documentation conforme à la qualité des étapes de production (protocoles, journaux de bord) ainsi que support pour la création de rapports simples et instructions de travail (SOP).
• Coopération avec les interfaces: coordination étroite avec les interfaces à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation (par exemple, développement et production) pour une coordination optimale des exigences de tampon et des calendriers de projet.
• Soutien des installations et de l'équipement: soutien à la préparation, à l'exploitation, au nettoyage et à la qualification des installations de laboratoire et des installations pilotes (par exemple les installations de filtration et de chromatographie) et leur entretien.
• Sécurité et ordre: assurer l'ordre, la propreté (5S) et la sécurité au travail dans le domaine de la production tampon et du contrôle des stocks de matières premières.
• Travail avec AAS : manipulation de substances hautement actives, travail propre, précis et manipulation responsable de ces substances conformément aux exigences d'hygiène du travail. Qui vous êtes Afin de réussir dans ce rôle passionnant, vous apportez idéalement ce qui suit:
• Formation complétée en tant que technicien de laboratoire: en (biologie/chimie), en pharmacotechnolog:en ou formation technique comparable avec expérience professionnelle initiale dans un environnement de production ou de développement pharmaceutique/biotechnologique
• Compréhension des processus de base de la production biotechnologique DS (USP & DSP) ainsi que la jouissance du travail exact et pratique selon les recettes.
• L'expérience acquise dans l'utilisation de dispositifs de mesure communs en laboratoire (p. ex. pHmètres, mesure de la conductivité, bilans) est avantageuse.
• Vous vous déplacez avec confiance et avec détermination dans l'environnement BPF strictement réglementé et dans la zone agile non BPF et appliquez correctement les normes respectives.
• Personnalité forte, structurée et axée sur l'équipe, capable d'avancer les tâches avec précision et indépendance.
• Compétences linguistiques: Allemand couramment (requis), Anglais bénéfique.
• Gestion expérimentée des applications MS-Office et Google.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part of achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspir ation to digitally transform and become a lean organization.

PTE catalyzes the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further de velop Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.

As we establish a PT-wide Data Governance framework to orchestrate sustainable solutions, we are looking for a Data Security & Privacy Lead . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security, privacy, and compliance of PT data. You will collaborate widely with PT regulatory functions, IT, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and monitor policies in line with industry standards. This role is critical in our ongoing dedication to ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance, requiring a strong understanding of data privacy and security needs in a life sciences organization.

The Opportunity
As our Data Security & Privacy Lead, your main responsibilities will be divided into four core pillars:
1. Security & Privacy Policy Definition and Implementation

• Work closely with relevant Roche IT, legal, and regulatory functions to define policies for data acquisition, storage, usage, and deletion to ensure security and privacy across the data lifecycle.

• Partner with System Owners, Data Owners, and IT to ensure security and privacy policies are relevant and applied adequately to existing systems across PT.

• Conduct impact assessments and define implementation strategies for new and updated policies, working closely with business partners to effectively and consistently implement policy.

2. Security & Privacy Compliance

• Collaborate with business domains to effectively monitor privacy and security compliance across multiple systems and platforms.

• Support business domains to appropriately respond to data subject requests and regulatory requirements in a compliant and timely manner.

• Ensure PT data adheres to regulatory requirements and global data protection laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPA).

• Coordinate architectural design decisions affecting security and privacy by design principles throughout the solution development lifecycle.

3. Advisory & Advocacy

• Act as the primary point of contact and provide expertise for staff regarding data privacy and protection obligations, including information governance activities and information security.

• Continuously train, upskill, and raise awareness for privacy and security maturity in PT. Lead policy-specific awareness activities, working with the Data Culture Lead where relevant to ensure PT-wide understanding and effective adoption.

4. Risk Monitoring & Escalation

• Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits, scoping and suggesting mitigations to ensure data security and privacy practices are adhered to, and the risk of future incidents is reduced.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security, privacy, and compliance of PT data. You will collaborate widely with PT regulatory functions, IT, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and monitor policies in line with industry standards. This role is critical in our ongoing dedication to ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance, requiring a strong understanding of data privacy and security needs in a life sciences organization.

The Opportunity
As our Data Security & Privacy Lead, your main responsibilities will be divided into four core pillars:
1. Security & Privacy Policy Definition and Implementation

• Work closely with relevant Roche IT, legal, and regulatory functions to define policies for data acquisition, storage, usage, and deletion to ensure security and privacy across the data lifecycle.

• Partner with System Owners, Data Owners, and IT to ensure security and privacy policies are relevant and applied adequately to existing systems across PT.

• Conduct impact assessments and define implementation strategies for new and updated policies, working closely with business partners to effectively and consistently implement policy.

2. Security & Privacy Compliance

• Collaborate with business domains to effectively monitor privacy and security compliance across multiple systems and platforms.

• Support business domains to appropriately respond to data subject requests and regulatory requirements in a compliant and timely manner.

• Ensure PT data adheres to regulatory requirements and global data protection laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPA).

• Coordinate architectural design decisions affecting security and privacy by design principles throughout the solution development lifecycle.

3. Advisory & Advocacy

• Act as the primary point of contact and provide expertise for staff regarding data privacy and protection obligations, including information governance activities and information security.

• Continuously train, upskill, and raise awareness for privacy and security maturity in PT. Lead policy-specific awareness activities, working with the Data Culture Lead where relevant to ensure PT-wide understanding and effective adoption.

4. Risk Monitoring & Escalation

• Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits, scoping and suggesting mitigations to ensure data security and privacy practices are adhered to, and the risk of future incidents is reduced.

• Leverage comprehensive knowledge of Roche escalation pathways and risk mit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Product Owner, Data, Analytics & AI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcar e. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business need s, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative even ts.

The opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic Product Owner to lead the evolution of our Data, Analytics & AI ecosystem. You will own the roadmap for D&I initiatives, ensuring we deliver seamless, automated customer service experiences while navigating complex stakeholder environments and critical technical migrations. It requires a strong understanding of our specific data ecosystems, integration patterns (e.g., between Genesys, Salesforce, and Snowflake), and AI capabilities to guide decisions and shape direction. Working across organizational boundaries, your focus is on aligning business priorities with technology, driving ownership, and orchestrating execution in a complex matrix rather than mere process coordination.

• Product Vision & Strategy: Own the end-to-end roadmap for Analytics & AI solutions. Define the "what" and "why" to drive adoption, balancing the need for global standardization with the agility required for local market success.

• Stakeholder & Change Management: Act as the primary interface for key market affiliates. Proactively manage the "Global vs. Local" dynamic, building business cases that demonstrate the value of Data, Analytics & AI to markets that may have established legacy solutions or strong operational preferences.

• Lean Team Execution: Operates in a lean, cross-functional environment with shared resources. Influence outcomes and align workstreams without direct line management authority.

Who you are:

• Deep expertise in delivering Data/AI/ML-driven solutions within highly regulated industries (Pharma, Life Sciences, or MedTech).

• Conversational AI Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing, iterating, and optimizing complex, multi-turn conversational flows, including managing persona, tone, "barge-in" scenarios, and error handling to ensure natural interactions.

• Voice-Specific UX (VUI): Proven track record in defining interaction design patterns that minimize latency and manage turn-taking, maintaining customer trust through robust fallback mechanisms.

• Technical Migration Strategy: Experience leading products through telephony platform transitions (e.g., Cisco to Genesys) or modernization efforts, with a strong grasp of the operational impact on customer-facing teams.

• Influencing Without Authority: Proven ability to drive product adoption in decentralized organizations, negotiating with resistant stakeholders by pivoting strategies to solve local pain points rather than forcin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Titolare del prodotto Voce AI paziente e cliente Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda dei bisogni aziendali s, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di squadra e altri ts collaborativi. L'opportunità: Questo ruolo è basato nella nostra divisione ecosistemi Voice AI, che è dedicata a trasformare le esperienze di servizio clienti attraverso l'automazione cloud-native e l'intelligenza di conversazione. Operiamo con un approccio strategico e orientato al valore, corrodendo la visione globale dei prodotti con la realtà del mercato locale durante le migrazioni della piattaforma critica. L'opportunità di lavorare attraverso i confini organizzativi e orchestrare schemi di integrazione complessi offre uno spazio eccezionale per la leadership e l'innovazione.
• Avrete la roadmap end-to-end per le nostre iniziative Voice AI e Voicebot, definendo la strategia per guidare l'adozione, bilanciando gli standard globali con le esigenze del mercato locale.
• Potrai agire come l'interfaccia principale per i principali affiliati di mercato, gestire proattivamente le relazioni degli stakeholder e creare casi di business per dimostrare il valore di Voice AI.
• Potrai guidare il lato del prodotto delle migrazioni della piattaforma (come ad esempio passare dai sistemi legacy a Genesys), assicurando la parità delle caratteristiche, sfruttando nuove capacità di ecosistema.
• Si arrugginirà a priori il backlog basato su dati reali e metriche di performance, tenendo piena responsabilità per le prestazioni del bot, la fiducia NLU e la soddisfazione del cliente.
• Potrai guidare le decisioni tecniche e la direzione della forma sfruttando la tua comprensione di ecosistemi di dati complessi e modelli di integrazione tra Genesys, Salesforce e Snowflake.
• Potrai influenzare i risultati e allineare i flussi di lavoro all'interno di un ambiente matrice magra e trasversale senza bisogno di autorità di gestione diretta della linea. Chi sei:
• Esperienza: Dimostrata esperienza di progettazione, iterazione e ottimizzazione dei flussi di conversazione complessi e multi-turn, compresi i modelli di design UX (VUI) Voice-Specific (richiesto).
• Modernizzazione tecnica: Regime tracciato di prodotti leader attraverso transizioni piattaforma di telefonia o migrazioni, con una forte comprensione dei modelli di integrazione (richiesto).
• Gestione delle prestazioni: comprensione profonda delle metriche specifiche della voce (ad esempio, il tasso di contenimento, la confidenza NLU, l'accettazione Falsa) per guidare miglioramenti del prodotto attuabili (richiesto).
• Stakeholder Influence: comprovata capacità di guidare l'adozione dei prodotti nelle organizzazioni decentrate e negoziare efficacemente con le parti interessate multifunzionali (richiesto).
• Competenze tecniche: competenza con piattaforme AI dialogali (ad esempio, Cognigy, Genesys, Dialogflow) e una solida comprensione di come formare modelli di linguaggio naturale (richiesto). •
