jobs.title: Business Analyst - ERP Operations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
The ERP team at Roche manages the enterprise’s unified digital backbone, supporting over 100,000 users across more than 100 countries . Our mission is to operate, protect, scale, and innovate the ERP/SAP systems that ensure the reliable delivery of medicines and diagnostics globally . This includes driving the ASPIRE program—one of the healthcare industry’s largest digital transformations, migrating our global footprint to SAP S/4HANA .
The ERP Business Operations team runs the operational engine behind this massive unit . We turn complex workforce, financial, and delivery data into the high-impact insights and strategic decisions that keep our global ecosystem moving forward .

The Role: What You Will Do
We are looking for an independent, tech-savvy, and genuinely curious Business Analyst to own key operational domains end-to-end . You won't just compile spreadsheets; you will instinctively leverage data tooling, automation, and AI to make operations faster, cleaner, and more reliable .
Your core responsibilities will include:

• Workforce & Resource Analytics: Own and maintain the unit's comprehensive global workforce data baseline (internal FTEs, external partners, location strategies, and capacity scaling models) while ensuring absolute data consistency .

• Financial Planning & Budget Tracking: Support budget planning, forecasting, and planned-vs-actual cost tracking . You will reconcile data across sustainment and program lines, investigate variances, and prepare reports that withstand executive scrutiny .

• Leadership Reporting: Prepare and quality-assure recurring status reports, KPI dashboards, and critical decision-support materials for the ERP Leadership Team and governance bodies .

• Process Optimization & AI Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone processes and pragmatically redesign them using advanced spreadsheets, BI dashboards, and emerging AI productivity tools .

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as a dependable contact point across Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), chasing inputs, managing deadlines, and navigating stakeholder pushback constructively .

• Initiative & Content Leadership: Independently structure and drive complex analysis topics sponsored by the Head of ERP, defining problem spaces, performing root-cause analyses, and bringing clear recommendations to a decision .

Who You Are
Experience & Background

• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, business operations, PMO, or financial analysis within a digital technology or large-scale transformation environment .

• A proven track record of independently owning ambiguous analysis topics from a vague question down to a structured, leadership-ready presentation .

• Experience working within global matrix organizations, massive ERP/SAP environments, or regulated fields (Pharma/Biotech) is a major plus .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Data Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel (complex modeling, large datasets, data hygiene) and hands-on experience with BI tools like Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau .

• Tech-Savvy & AI-Curious: A distinct passion for experimenting with and adopting new technologies, automation, or scripting (SQL, Python, Apps Script) to optimize workflows .

• Financial Acumen: Comfort working with complex cost structures, resource models, and forecasts, with a sharp eye for tracing financial inconsistencies to their root cause .

• Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply sys

La nostra missione è di operare, proteggere, scalare e innovare i sistemi ERP/SAP che garantiscono la consegna affidabile di farmaci e diagnostica a livello globale. Questo include la guida del programma ASPIRE – una delle più grandi trasformazioni digitali del settore sanitario, migrando la nostra impronta globale a SAP S/4HANA . Il team ERP Business Operations gestisce il motore operativo dietro questa enorme unità . Trasformiamo la forza lavoro complessa, i dati finanziari e di consegna nelle intuizioni ad alto impatto e nelle decisioni strategiche che mantengono il nostro ecosistema globale in avanti. Il ruolo: cosa farai Stiamo cercando un indipendente, tech-savvy, e autenticamente curioso Business Analyst di possedere domini operativi chiave end-to-end . Non si compilano solo fogli di calcolo; si leverà istintivamente strumenti di dati, automazione e AI per rendere le operazioni più veloci, più pulite e più affidabili. Le tue responsabilità principali includono:
• Analisi delle forze di lavoro e delle risorse: Possedere e mantenere la linea di base globale dei dati della forza lavoro dell'unità (FTE interne, partner esterni, strategie di localizzazione e modelli di scalabilità) garantendo al contempo una coerenza dei dati assoluta.
• Pianificazione finanziaria & Budget Tracking: Pianificazione del bilancio di sostegno, previsione e pianificazione-vs-effettivo monitoraggio dei costi . Potrai conciliare i dati attraverso linee di supporto e programma, indagare variazioni, e preparare rapporti che resistere esame esecutivo .
• Leadership Reporting: Preparare e garantire la qualità rapporti di stato ricorrenti, cruscotti KPI e materiali critici di supporto decisionale per il team di Leadership ERP e gli organismi di governance .
• Ottimizzazione dei processi & AI Automation: Identificare processi manuali, ripetitivi o di errore e ridisegnarli pragmaticamente utilizzando fogli di calcolo avanzati, dashboard BI e strumenti di produttività AI emergenti .
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Agire come punto di contatto affidabile attraverso Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), inseguire gli input, gestire le scadenze e navigare stakeholder pushback costruttivamente.
• Iniziativa & Content Leadership: struttura indipendente e guidare argomenti di analisi complessi sponsorizzati dal capo dell'ERP, definendo spazi di problema, eseguendo analisi di root-cause, e portando raccomandazioni chiare a una decisione. Chi sei Esperienza e sfondo
• 5+ anni di esperienza nell'analisi aziendale, operazioni aziendali, PMO, o analisi finanziaria all'interno di una tecnologia digitale o ambiente di trasformazione su larga scala.
• Un collaudato track record di possedere indipendentemente argomenti di analisi ambigue da una vaga domanda fino a una presentazione strutturata e pronta alla leadership.
• L'esperienza di lavoro all'interno di organizzazioni di matrice globali, ambienti ERP/SAP massicci, o settori regolamentati (Pharma/Biotech) è un vantaggio importante. Competenze tecniche & Artigianato
• Mastery dati: competenza avanzata in Google Sheets/Excel (modellazione complessa, grandi dataset, igiene dei dati) e esperienza pratica con strumenti BI come Looker Studio, Power BI, o Tableau .
• Tech-Savvy & AI-Curious: Una passione distinto per sperimentare e adottare nuove tecnologie, automazione o scripting (SQL, Python, Apps Script) per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro.
• Acume finanziario: Comfort lavorando con strutture complesse di costo, modelli di risorse e previsioni, con un occhio affilato per tracciare incongruenze finanziarie alla loro causa principale .
• Problem Solving strutturato: Capacità di applicare sis

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer wir sind Das ERP-Team von Roche verwaltet das einheitliche digitale Backbone des Unternehmens und unterstützt über 100.000 Benutzer in mehr als 100 Ländern. Unsere Mission ist es, die ERP/SAP-Systeme zu betreiben, zu schützen, zu skalieren und zu erneuern, die die zuverlässige Lieferung von Medikamenten und Diagnosen weltweit gewährleisten. Dazu gehört auch die Förderung des ASPIRE-Programms – einer der größten digitalen Transformationen der Gesundheitsbranche – und die Migration unserer globalen Präsenz auf SAP S/4HANA. Das ERP Business Operations Team führt den operativen Motor hinter dieser massiven Einheit. Wir verwandeln komplexe Personal-, Finanz- und Lieferdaten in wichtige Erkenntnisse und strategische Entscheidungen, die unser globales Ökosystem voranbringen. Die Rolle: Was Sie tun werden Wir suchen einen unabhängigen, technisch versierten und wirklich neugierigen Business Analysten, um wichtige operative Domänen Ende-zu-Ende zu besitzen. Sie werden nicht nur Tabellenkalkulationen kompilieren; Sie werden instinktiv Datenwerkzeuge, Automatisierung und KI nutzen, um Operationen schneller, sauberer und zuverlässiger zu machen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Workforce & Resource Analytics: Besitzen und pflegen Sie die umfassende globale Workforce-Datenbasis (interne FTEs, externe Partner, Standortstrategien und Kapazitätsskalierungsmodelle) und gewährleisten Sie gleichzeitig absolute Datenkonsistenz.
• Finanzplanung & Budget-Tracking: Unterstützung der Budgetplanung, Prognose und Plan-vs-Ist-Kosten-Tracking. Sie werden Daten über Sustainment- und Programmlinien abgleichen, Varianzen untersuchen und Berichte erstellen, die der Kontrolle durch die Exekutive standhalten.
• Leadership Reporting: Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung wiederkehrender Statusberichte, KPI-Dashboards und kritische Entscheidungsunterstützungsmaterialien für das ERP-Führungsteam und die Führungsgremien.
• Prozessoptimierung & KI-Automatisierung: Identifizieren Sie manuelle, sich wiederholende oder fehleranfällige Prozesse und gestalten Sie sie pragmatisch mithilfe von erweiterten Tabellenkalkulationen, BI-Dashboards und neuen KI-Produktivitätstools neu.
• Funktionale Koordination: Handeln Sie als zuverlässiger Ansprechpartner über Value Streams (Digital Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing), jagen Sie Inputs, verwalten Sie Termine und navigieren Sie konstruktiv durch Stakeholder-Pushback.
• Initiative & Content Leadership: Komplexe Analysethemen, die vom Leiter ERP gesponsert werden, selbstständig strukturieren und vorantreiben, Problemräume definieren, Ursachenanalysen durchführen und klare Entscheidungsempfehlungen geben. Wer du bist Erfahrung & Hintergrund
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Geschäftsanalyse, Geschäftsbetrieb, PMO oder Finanzanalyse in einer digitalen Technologie oder einer groß angelegten Transformationsumgebung.
• Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz der unabhängigen Besitz mehrdeutige Analysethemen von einer vagen Frage bis hin zu einer strukturierten, Führung bereit Präsentation.

• Data Mastery: Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Google Sheets / Excel (komplexe Modellierung, große Datensätze, Datenhygiene) und praktische Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Looker Studio, Power BI oder Tableau .

• Finanzieller Scharfsinn: Komfort beim Arbeiten mit komplexen Kostenstrukturen, Ressourcenmodellen und Prognosen, mit einem scharfen Auge für die Rückverfolgung finanzieller Inkonsistenzen bis zu ihrer Ursache.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes L'équipe ERP de Roche gère l'épine dorsale numérique unifiée de l'entreprise, soutenant plus de 100 000 utilisateurs dans plus de 100 pays. Notre mission est d'opérer, de protéger, d'étendre et d'innover les systèmes ERP/SAP qui assurent la livraison fiable de médicaments et de diagnostics à l'échelle mondiale. Cela inclut la conduite du programme ASPIRE – l'une des plus grandes transformations numériques de l'industrie de la santé, migrer notre empreinte mondiale vers SAP S/4HANA . L'équipe ERP Business Operations gère le moteur opérationnel derrière cette unité massive. Nous transformons les données complexes sur la main-d'oeuvre, les finances et la prestation de services en données à impact élevé et en décisions stratégiques qui font avancer notre écosystème mondial. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste d'affaires indépendant, technologique et vraiment curieux pour posséder des domaines opérationnels clés de bout en bout. Vous ne vous contenterez pas de compiler des feuilles de calcul ; vous utiliserez instinctivement l'outillage de données, l'automatisation et l'IA pour rendre les opérations plus rapides, plus propres et plus fiables. Vos principales responsabilités comprendront :
• Workforce & Resource Analytics: possède et maintient la base de données globale de base globale de l'unité (ETP internes, partenaires externes, stratégies de localisation et modèles d'échelle des capacités) tout en assurant une cohérence absolue des données.
• Planification financière et suivi budgétaire : Appuyer la planification budgétaire, les prévisions et le suivi des coûts prévus et réels. Vous rapprocherez les données entre les lignes de soutien et de programme, étudierez les écarts et préparerez des rapports qui résistent à l'examen des cadres supérieurs.
• Rapports sur le leadership : Préparer et assurer la qualité des rapports de situation récurrents, des tableaux de bord de l'ICP et des documents essentiels d'appui à la décision à l'intention de l'équipe de leadership du PGI et des organes de gouvernance.
• Optimisation des processus et automatisation de l'IA : Identifier les processus manuels, répétitifs ou sujets à erreur et les remanier de façon pragmatique à l'aide de tableurs avancés, de tableaux de bord BI et d'outils émergents de productivité de l'IA.
• Coordination interfonctionnelle : Agir en tant que point de contact fiable entre les flux de valeur (finance numérique, chaîne d'approvisionnement, fabrication), poursuivre les intrants, gérer les échéances et naviguer de manière constructive avec les intervenants.
• Leadership de l'initiative et du contenu : structurer et piloter de façon indépendante des sujets d'analyse complexes parrainés par le chef de l'ERP, définir des espaces de problèmes, effectuer des analyses de causes profondes et présenter des recommandations claires à une décision. • 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse d'affaires, opérations d'affaires, PMO, ou analyse financière dans une technologie numérique ou un environnement de transformation à grande échelle .
• Une expérience éprouvée de posséder indépendamment des sujets d'analyse ambigus d'une question vague jusqu'à une présentation structurée et prête à diriger.
• Expérience de travail au sein d'organisations matricielles mondiales, d'environnements ERP/SAP massifs, ou de champs réglementés (Pharma/Biotech) est un plus majeur . Compétences techniques et artisanat
• Maîtrise des données : Compétences avancées en Google Sheets/Excel (modélisation complexe, gros ensembles de données, hygiène des données) et expérience pratique avec des outils BI comme Looker Studio, Power BI ou Tableau .

• Accumen financier: Confort de travailler avec des structures de coûts complexes, des modèles de ressources et des prévisions, avec un oeil aigu pour tracer les incohérences financières à leur cause fondamentale .

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to execute critical purchasing activities and deliver the operational excellence that supports our global diagnostic innovations? As our Procurement Specialist in Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for the execution of foundational purchasing support activities. In this role, you will navigate enterprise tools and the purchase-to-pay process to meet business and project objectives in a fully compliant manner.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with business partners and internal stakeholders in DOP across a multicultural, virtual setting.

• Role Type: An operational role focused on executing end-to-end purchasing activities and supporting continuous improvement.

• Impact: By efficiently supporting the procurement process and providing high levels of internal customer service, you ensure that stakeholder expectations are satisfied. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Operational Execution: Supporting the effective procurement of critical products and services in a timely and efficient manner.

• Data & Documentation: Maintaining master data for materials and suppliers, executing workflows, and ensuring all relevant documentation (e.g., Supplier Due Diligence, Price Lists) is complete and available in SAP or respective systems.

• Issue Resolution: Working with team members and business partners to mitigate any procurement or business issues and help achieve agreed business goals.

• Policy & Compliance: Executing operational procurement activities in line with a responsible Procurement approach, utilizing tools, processes, and policy settings aligned with DOP business processes.

• Performance Metrics: Contributing to the delivery of established customer service targets and metrics, tracking and monitoring these metrics where required, and escalating issues as they arise.

• Continuous Improvement: Supporting the optimization of processes to consistently increase quality and efficiency standards.

Who you are

We look for self-driven professionals with a continuous improvement mindset who can develop innovative ideas and foster collaborative networks.

• Education: A relevant university business degree is required.

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in operational/tactical Procurement processes. Experience working in a multicultural, virtual setting is required. Direct procurement experience is highly desirable.

• Systems Expertise: Solid experience navigating SAP enterprise systems and procure-to-pay tools.

• Industry Knowledge: Life science industry experience is highly desirable.

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regarding the digital transformation of operations (Digital 2.0 / Industry 4.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to execute critical purchasing activities and deliver the operational excellence that supports our global diagnostic innovations? As our Procurement Specialist in Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for the execution of foundational purchasing support activities. In this role, you will navigate enterprise tools and the purchase-to-pay process to meet business and project objectives in a fully compliant manner.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with business partners and internal stakeholders in DOP across a multicultural, virtual setting.

• Role Type: An operational role focused on executing end-to-end purchasing activities and supporting continuous improvement.

• Impact: By efficiently supporting the procurement process and providing high levels of internal customer service, you ensure that stakeholder expectations are satisfied. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Operational Execution: Supporting the effective procurement of critical products and services in a timely and efficient manner.

• Data & Documentation: Maintaining master data for materials and suppliers, executing workflows, and ensuring all relevant documentation (e.g., Supplier Due Diligence, Price Lists) is complete and available in SAP or respective systems.

• Issue Resolution: Working with team members and business partners to mitigate any procurement or business issues and help achieve agreed business goals.

• Policy & Compliance: Executing operational procurement activities in line with a responsible Procurement approach, utilizing tools, processes, and policy settings aligned with DOP business processes.

• Performance Metrics: Contributing to the delivery of established customer service targets and metrics, tracking and monitoring these metrics where required, and escalating issues as they arise.

• Continuous Improvement: Supporting the optimization of processes to consistently increase quality and efficiency standards.

Who you are

We look for self-driven professionals with a continuous improvement mindset who can develop innovative ideas and foster collaborative networks.

• Education: A relevant university business degree is required.

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in operational/tactical Procurement processes. Experience working in a multicultural, virtual setting is required. Direct procurement experience is highly desirable.

• Systems Expertise: Solid experience navigating SAP enterprise systems and procure-to-pay tools.

• Industry Knowledge: Life science industry experience is highly desirable.

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regarding the digital transformation of operations (Digital 2.0 / Industry 4.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Identifizierung neuer Möglichkeiten und Unterstützung der Optimierung von Prozessen zur Steigerung der allgemeinen Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards.

jobs.title: Master Data Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to architect the data foundation that drives digital excellence and unlocks actionable insights for our global procurement operations? As our Master Data Manager based in Mumbai, India , you will be a core member of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE). In this critical role, you will define, govern, and optimize the data assets that power the digital evolution of DOP.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with the colleagues in Analytics and Performance Insights, data consumers, and multifunctional teams globally to ensure data is fit for purpose.

• Role Type: A senior individual contributor role focused on data architecture, governance, and master data management. May involve project-based direct or indirect supervision.

• Impact: You assure quality and trust in our data, establishing the governance framework for the organization. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Data Strategy & Governance: Defining data assets within the DOP domain, creating standard guidelines, and establishing internal policies and data controls to monitor adherence.

• Quality Assurance: Maintaining data quality using customer feedback, developing reporting metrics, evaluating issues, and coordinating regular corrections.

• Continuous Improvement: Optimizing workflows and continuously driving the quality and availability of data in alignment with other business units and functions.

• Alignment & Projects: Supporting organizational and system alignment, data standardization, and Master Data ERP projects.

• Knowledge Management & Training: Developing and executing data trainings, capturing relevant documentation, and ensuring process-specific training content is accessible to DOP communities.

Who you are

We look for a self-directed professional with a sense of urgency who can drive data excellence in a complex, matrixed environment.

• Education: A relevant Bachelor’s degree is required; a Master’s degree is highly desirable.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience leading a data architecture or engineering

Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a progettare la base di dati che guida l'eccellenza digitale e sblocca le intuizioni attuabili per le nostre operazioni di approvvigionamento globale? Come nostro Master Data Manager con sede a Pune/Mumbai, India, sarai un membro fondamentale del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE). In questo ruolo critico, definirete, governate e ottimizzare i dati che alimentano l'evoluzione digitale del DOP.
• Reporting Line: La posizione riporta direttamente al Lead Operazioni di Appalti e fa parte del più ampio Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Il team Wider e le parti interessate: lavora a stretto contatto con i colleghi di Analytics e Performance Insights, i consumatori di dati e le squadre multifunzionali a livello globale per garantire che i dati siano adatti allo scopo.
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di contribuente individuale senior focalizzato sull'architettura dei dati, la governance e la gestione dei dati master. Può coinvolgere la supervisione diretta o indiretta del progetto.
• Impatto: Garantisci qualità e fiducia nei nostri dati, stabilendo il quadro di governance per l'organizzazione. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia e governance dei dati: Definire le attività dei dati all'interno del dominio DOP, creare linee guida standard e stabilire politiche interne e controlli dei dati per monitorare l'adesione.
• Garanzia di qualità: Mantenere la qualità dei dati utilizzando il feedback dei clienti, sviluppare metriche di reportistica, valutare i problemi e coordinare le correzioni regolari.
• Miglioramento continuo: ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro e guidare continuamente la qualità e la disponibilità dei dati in allineamento con altre unità aziendali e funzioni.
• Alignment & Projects: Sostenere l'allineamento organizzativo e di sistema, la standardizzazione dei dati e i progetti Master Data ERP.
• Gestione delle conoscenze e formazione: lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di corsi di formazione dei dati, la cattura di documentazione rilevante e la garanzia di contenuti formativi specifici del processo è accessibile alle comunità DOP. Chi sei Cerchiamo un professionista autodiretto con un senso di urgenza che può guidare l'eccellenza dei dati in un ambiente complesso e matrice.
• Istruzione: È richiesto un diploma di laurea rilevante; un master è altamente auspicabile.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di esperienza leader di un'architettura dati o ingegneria

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to drive the strategic architecture and tactical enablement of our Demand-to-Pay processes, unlocking continuous improvement and seamless digital adoption? As our Business Capability Lead for SAP based in Mumbai , India, you will play a critical role in designing, managing, and governing our system processes. Operating at the intersection of strategic design and tactical execution, you will champion continuous improvement and drive the strategy for our key SAP solution.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with the DOP Leadership Team, DOP Delivery, Category teams, RSS Demand-to-Pay, Global Procurement, and external providers. You will also lead the Business Capability Community formed by SMEs and represent DOP in Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Role Type: A senior strategic and tactical individual contributor role focused on global process ownership, governance, and change management.

• Impact: You have a key, measurable impact on departmental efficiency and compliance (e.g., cycle times). Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Management: Acting as a deep Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business processes and systems, elaborating design options to resolve system, perfo mance, and data concerns while shaping the overall vision and strategy.

• System Strategy & Projects: Developing and deploying the DOP strategy for assigned solutions SAP and acting as a responsible delegate on global projects (e.g., Aspire), ensuring successful template adoption and managing change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement & Change Management: Proactively identifying and driving automation and digitalization opportunities. Acting as a change agent to escalate improvement areas, driving global requirements alignment, and partnering across functions to implement optimized End-to-End solutions.

• Governance & Analytics: Supporting delegated data and rules definition for global data. Serving as the primary enterprise reporting SME to advise senior leadership on maximizing ERP and SAP S/4HANA analytics to solve complex problems.

• Knowledge Management: Developing and maintaining global system process documentation and comprehensive training materials.

Who you are

jobs.title: Performance & Insights Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to be a key driver in transforming our procurement function into a data-driven organization? As our Performance & Insight Manager, based in Mumbai you will leverage complex data to generate actionable insights that optimize strategies, improve supplier performance, mitigate risks, and enhance overall procurement efficiency.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (DOP).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely and cross-culturally with procurement team members, category managers, finance, IT, and other global stakeholders.

• Role Type: A highly analytical and strategic role focused on data integration, insights generation, and the continuous enhancement of procurement intelligence solutions.

• Impact: You will translate complex data into clear, impactful recommendations. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Insights Generation & Analysis: Proactively identifying areas where data can optimize decision-making. Conducting in-depth analysis to spot trends and opportunities, and performing scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for different procurement strategies.

• Reporting & Visualization: Designing and developing insightful dashboards, reports, and visualizations to track key procurement metrics (e.g., spend analysis, savings, supplier performance, risk, and compliance).

• Data Integration: Identifying, collecting, cleansing, and integrating relevant data from various internal and external sources, including ERP systems and market intelligence platforms.

• Program & Rollout Support: Supporting the deployment of procurement tools and processes by defining reporting requirements, developing tracking mechanisms, and ensuring data integrity during implementation.

• Technology Evaluation: Evaluating, recommending, and driving the implementation of appropriate data analytics tools and platforms in close collaboration with IT.

• Stakeholder Communication: Preparing and presenting findings effectively, translating complex data insights into clear, understandable formats for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

Who you are

We look for professionals with a strong analytical mindset, a can-do mentality, and a high willingness to take personal responsibility to drive our data evolution.

• Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline is required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in data analysis and insights generation, specifically focused on procurement or supply chain. Experience working cross-culturally in a global position is essential.

• Procurement Knowledge: A deep understanding of procurement processes, methodologies, and best practices.

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQ

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As an Associate Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines, and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory.

• Are responsible for ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products. Promotes effective, positive, and productive communication among teams to ensure and maximize the satisfaction of customer base. Manages customer accounts at a level that promotes goodwill, confidence, and credibility in order to exceed customer expectations in terms of product, service, and support quality.

• Follows standard practices and procedures to install, maintain and repair Roche Diagnostics’ equipment. Identifies and analyzes current problems and repairs where possible or escalates to higher levels when repairs are not possible. Schedules and performs preventative maintenance per department policy. Monitors customer equipment performance and is able to respond to and resolve most routine issues. Refers complex problems and issues to higher levels.

• Identifies revenue-generating and cost-saving opportunities implements the Roche Diagnostics service agreement policy and seek out opportunities to market service contracts to existing customers.

• Provides routine technical support to existing customers, including operator troubleshooting training when needed.

• Completes and documents all service and customer account-related reports, updates, and emails in a timely and professional manner, compliant with all quality procedures.

• Maintains expenses within departmental guidelines and controls inventory and all company property

This field-based role requires up to 25% overnight travel. This person will support Montgomery, AL.

Who you are

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience.

• You have 2 years of experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless
networking or equivalent level of competency attained through appropriate training curriculum.

Preferred Requirements

• You hold 4 year Engineering Degree in Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical or related.

• Basic knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems and information technology.

• Knowledge of basic chemistry.

• Ability to develop in-depth technically related troubleshooting skills.

• Good written/

jobs.title: AI Solution Catalyst (Science)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Solution Catalyst, you act as the vital bridge between the AI Innovation Teams (Product & BP) and the wider ecosystem. Your mission is to amplify the value of developed AI solutions by driving their adoption, commercialization, and integration across internal business units and external markets.
You will "catalyze" success by translating complex technical innovations into compelling value propositions, ensuring that the solutions built by the Innovation Leads (Science or Healthcare) achieve maximum impact and visibility.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Value Amplification & Adoption
a) Go-to-Market Strategy: Partner with AI Innovation Leads and Product Managers to design and execute deployment strategies, key objectives for key solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, or Research Tools).
b) Adoption Drive: Act as the primary champion for assigned digital solutions, overcoming barriers to entry and driving usage rates among internal users (e.g., Medical teams) or external customers (e.g., Patients, HCPs).
c) Success Storytelling: Identify and package "wins" and case studies. Transform data and usage metrics into compelling narratives that demonstrate ROI and scientific/business value to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
2. Stakeholder Connection & Synergy
a) Bridge Building: Serve as the connector between the AI Innovation Lab/Teams and the broader commercial/medical organization.
b) Feedback Loop: Gather real-world feedback from the field and market, channeling insights back to the Product Managers to inform future iterations and feature enhancements.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Business, Administration, or related fields
2. 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, or general marketing.
3. Experience working in a cross-functional environment, supporting technical or product teams.
Job Required Competencies
1. Exceptional ability to translate technical features (AI/Tech) into business benefits and human-centric value propositions. You are a "translator" between tech and business.
2. Strong interpersonal skills to build networks across a matrix organization. Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
3. Ability to pivot quickly between strategic planning (how to position a product) and tactical execution (organizing a launch event or creating sales aids).
4. Passionate about finding new ways to apply and scale existing innovations.
5. Focused on tangible outcomes (e.g., adoption rates, customer satisfaction, brand equity lift) rather than just process.
Travel Frequency
<25%

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro) Come l'AI Solution Catalyst, si agisce come il ponte vitale tra i team di innovazione AI (Product & BP) e l'ecosistema più ampio. La vostra missione è di amplificare il valore delle soluzioni AI sviluppate guidando la loro adozione, la commercializzazione e l'integrazione in unità di business interne e mercati esterni. Si "catalizzerà" il successo traducendo complesse innovazioni tecniche in proposizioni di valore convincenti, assicurando che le soluzioni realizzate dai Leads Innovation (Science o Healthcare) raggiungano il massimo impatto e visibilità. Principio Roles &
• Responsabilità / responsabilità 1. Amplificazione del valore e adozione a) Strategia di Go-to-Market: Partner con AI Innovation Leads e Product Manager per progettare ed eseguire strategie di distribuzione, obiettivi chiave per soluzioni chiave (ad esempio, DPMM, PLM, o Strumenti di ricerca). b) Adoption Drive: Agite come campione primario per le soluzioni digitali assegnate, superando le barriere ai tassi di utilizzo di entrata e di guida tra gli utenti interni (ad esempio, team medici) o clienti esterni (ad esempio, pazienti, HCP). c) Storytelling di successo: Identificare e pacchetto "wins" e studi di caso. Trasforma i dati e le metriche di utilizzo in narrazioni convincenti che dimostrano ROI e valore scientifico/commerciale alla leadership senior e agli stakeholder esterni. 2. Stakeholder Connection & Synergy a) Bridge Building: Servire come connettore tra AI Innovation Lab/Teams e l'organizzazione commerciale/medical più ampia. b) Feedback Loop: Raccogli il feedback del mondo reale dal campo e dal mercato, incanalando approfondimenti ai Product Manager per informare le future iterazioni e miglioramenti delle funzionalità. Qualificazione ed esperienza Formazione
• Qualifiche 1. Laurea in Medicina, Business, Amministrazione o settori correlati 2. 3-5 anni di esperienza nel coordinamento del progetto, supporto amministrativo, o marketing generale. 3. Prova a lavorare in un ambiente interfunzionale, supportando team tecnici o di prodotto. Competenze richieste 1. Eccezionale capacità di tradurre caratteristiche tecniche (AI/Tech) in vantaggi aziendali e proposte di valore umano-centrico. Sei un "traduttore" tra tecnologia e business. 2. Forte capacità interpersonali per costruire reti attraverso un'organizzazione di matrice. Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senza autorità diretta. 3. Capacità di ruotare rapidamente tra pianificazione strategica (come posizionare un prodotto) e esecuzione tattica (organizzazione di un evento di lancio o la creazione di aiuti di vendita). 4. Appassionato a trovare nuovi modi per applicare e scalare le innovazioni esistenti. 5. Concentrati su risultati tangibili (ad esempio, tassi di adozione, soddisfazione del cliente, brand equity lift) piuttosto che solo processo. Frequenza di viaggio <25% Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
The Roche Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late stage development (Phase 2-3) clinical strategies and plans to deliver medically differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Medical Director participates in development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and helps ensure effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
The Medical Director is an entry-level PD Clinical Director position and, as such, Medical Directors are developing their knowledge of clinical studies and the pharma/biotech industry.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position ALLGEMEINE ZUSAMMENFASSUNG UND ZWECK: Die Roche Clinical Development Organisation ist nach therapeutischen Bereichen gegliedert und ist für die Entwicklung und Durchführung klinischer Strategien im Spätstadium (Phase 2-3) und Pläne zur Bereitstellung medizinisch differenzierter Therapien verantwortlich, die den Patienten sinnvolle Verbesserungen bieten. Der medizinische Direktor beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung der Strategie und des Plans für klinische Entwicklung (CD) und trägt dazu bei, die effektive und effiziente Durchführung der zugewiesenen Moleküle / Indikationen sicherzustellen. Der Medical Director ist eine Einstiegsposition als PD Clinical Director und als solche entwickeln Medical Directors ihr Wissen über klinische Studien und die Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie. ERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATIONEN:
• Akademisch/wissenschaftlich/klinisch:
• M.D. erforderlich
• Relevante klinische, wissenschaftliche oder klinische Prüfung/Entwicklungserfahrung im gleichen/ähnlichen therapeutischen Bereich erforderlich
• Akademischer / Lehrhintergrund ist ein Plus
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinischen Relevanz
• Erfahrungen mit der Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einer Peer-Review-Zeitschrift werden bevorzugt
• Regulatory: Kenntnisse der medizinischen Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA und anderen relevanten Richtlinien und Vorschriften werden bevorzugt
• Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre postgraduale akademische oder klinische Erfahrung
• Bis zu 30% globale Reisen Schlüsselkompetenzen und -verhalten
• Ethik: Hat eine tadellose Ethik. Nachweis oder Nachweisfähigkeit von Roche Values
• Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail: Hervorragende Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail
• Business Acumen: Hat Kenntnisse in der Pharma- / Biotech-Industrie, den verschiedenen Funktionen und Rollen, die an der Arzneimittelentwicklung beteiligt sind. Führt regelmäßig die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen
• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele rechtzeitig, zielgenau und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren
• Zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen
• Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Gute Geschäftspräsentationsfähigkeiten; ist komfortabel und effektiv, wenn sie sich intern oder extern anderen präsentieren. Selbstsicher und kompetent, wenn man intern und extern mit anderen interagiert: bleibt konzentriert und punktgenau, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen produktiv und reif zu stellen
• Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: Gute Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: weiß, wie man Ergebnisse durch effektive interne und externe Zusammenarbeit mit anderen erledigt
• Entscheidungsfindung: Wissen, wie man Kompromissentscheidungen trifft, während man Ethik und Wirksamkeit in Einklang bringt
• Teamwork: Starke Orientierung an Teamwork BESONDERE ZÖLLE UND ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN: CDP Strategie und Planung
• Beteiligt sich an der Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugeordnete Moleküle/Indikationen
• Sammelt und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die für die Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
• Arbeitet mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Subteams zusammen, um CD-Plankomponenten zu entwickeln (z. B. Analyse- / Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)
• Arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Input für Budget- / Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die für die Implementierung und Ausführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
• Bleibt auf dem Laufenden über interne und externe Entwicklungen, Trends und andere Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit von CD relevant sind, um jederzeit eine vollständig aktuelle Ansicht und Pe zu erhalten

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, over 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing with its 600 employees produces Large Molecule APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) for commercial and clinical supply.

As Chapter Lead Calibration you enable and empower your team to deliver our vision through embedding new ways of working, demonstrating VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) leadership behaviors. You and your team are maintaining the site’s right to operate and enable excellence in manufacturing by providing technical support to Manufacturing Units in Basel DS resulting in safe, high quality, and continuously improving production as well as technical transfers.

You serve both, our patients and our employees in the Units on site by developing and implementing process improvements, foster the dialogue and collaboration between global functions in development, innovation and regulatory and align across other Roche manufacturing sites. You will be part of the Facilities Management & SHE Leadership Team and report to the Unit Head Facilities Management & SHE.

The Opportunity:

You create an environment of strong team spirit, timely and effective communications, sense of urgency, high motivation and inspire teams to achieve goals in the immediate and longer term. Furthermore:

• Strategic Leadership & Vision: Establish strategic goals for the Calibration Chapter, aligning resources to remove impediments, empower self-organizing teams, and drive a continuous improvement mindset using PT lean principles

• Network & Site Collaboration: Serve as an active change agent on the FM&SHE leadership team, driving cross-functional planning, decision-making, and collaboration both within the site and across the broader network

• Financial Accountability: Maintain full responsibility for the Chapter budget, ensuring strategic allocation of resources and a positive impact on the overall financial performance of the FM&SHE Unit

• Safety & Compliance Culture: Proactively promote a positive Safety Culture and strictly adhere to cGMP operating principles, as well as regulatory compliance requirements from the FDA, OSHA, EPA, and SHE regulations

• Data Ownership & Confidentiality: Act as the designated Dataset Owner for the Calibration Management System (CCMS), ensuring absolute confidentiality of all process-related data

• Operational Excellence & Execution: Ensure the timely execution of calibration work orders and 1st-level support, guaranteeing all tools and equipment remain within calibration for service and maintenance activities

• Quality Assurance & Problem Solving: Oversee Discrepancy Management (per SOP), sponsor structured problem-solving for deviations (OOT), and manage quality approvals including Maintenance Programs, like-for-like assessments, Calibration Ranges, Tolerances, and Units of Measure

• Continuous Optimization & Collaboration: Work closely with internal colleagues, contractors, and service engineers to resolve issues efficiently while constantly providing innovative ideas to optimize calibration and troubleshooting practices

Who You Are:

You have a Graduate Degree (Engineering, Biological Sciences, or Metrology) or higher-level Degree is preferred. Furthermore:

• 10 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry, i

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Pharma Sweden, we’re looking for a Marketing Manager to drive seamless customer experience, optimize therapeutic marketing and omnichannel strategies aligned with the broader local disease area strategy.

Purpose of the role, including overall expectations on impact:

The marketing manager will partner with a number of internal and external stakeholders to enable a fit-for-purpose marketing strategy to provide a seamless customer experience meeting our brand ambition and our customer needs.

This role will also be a member of the Pharma International network to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross border, cross functional work package teams.

Key responsibilities and accountabilities :

• Partner with key cross-functional disease area team members to define the long-, mid-, and short-term outcomes, focusing on customer experience and marketing activities

• Be responsible for the marketing and omnichannel strategy and plan supporting customer experience and brand management outcomes

• Together with a cross-functional team, lead the implementation of the marketing and omnichannel plans in different disease areas

• Regularly review and optimize the plans and strategies based on insights, customer feedback and PPOC input to ensure that activities to optimize the customer experience while continuously ladder up to the outcomes

• Together with the cross-functional teams create and customize compelling content (including marketing messaging and campaigns)

• Align marketing objectives with regional and global direction, leverage the networked ways of working to identify synergies cross-countries and maximize impact

Capabilities and competences:

• Strategic and tactical experience and skills in marketing and omnichannel customer engagement

• Insight generation, market research and trends - about customer needs, preferences and competitors to make informed decisions

• Expert in different channels, both traditional and digital, and using analytics to measure impact on omnichannel customer engagement

• Experience within healthcare and understanding of relevant disease areas including oncology and rare conditions

• Ability to work well and collaborate with cross-functional teams

• Self-driven, good listener and communication skills to understand customer as well as system needs in order to be able to provide high quality omnichannel engagement

• Interest in keeping up to date with healthcare business environment trends, as well as trying to predict future trends

• Pharma business acumen, brand/product and/or solution marketing experience

• Strong verbal and written communication skills (Swedish and English)

• Driver and passion for results

• +7 years experience in similar roles within healthcare

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Driver e passione per i risultati

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The International Product Manager acts as the ultimate owner of their specific product area, holding accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes beyond feature outputs. This role leads continuous product discovery and validation to ensure solutions are valuable to customers, viable for the business, and technically feasible. By providing strategic context and driving cross-functional collaboration, the International Product Manager aligns engineering efforts with broader business goals while serving as the deep subject matter expert on the product domain.

The Opportunity
Main tasks:

• Product Outcome Accountability: Holds overall accountability for the product's outcomes, responsible for delivering measurable business results rather than just feature outputs.

• Continuous Discovery & Validation: Leads continuous product discovery to ensure solutions are valuable to customers, viable for the business, usable by users, and technically feasible to build.

• Strategic Context & Alignment: Provides strategic context to the team, ensuring that stable core teams are focused on work that is genuinely worth building and delivers necessary results.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Drives cross-functional collaboration, balancing the needs of customers, the business, and technical feasibility.

• Customer & Domain Expertise: Maintains comprehensive and well informed knowledge of customers/users (qualitative and quantitative), product data, and the broader market and industry.

• Risk Ownership: Owns the customer value and viability risk, ensuring the product meets business needs while solving customer problems.

Additional tasks:

• Data-Driven Learning: Constantly learns from customers and data to inform product decisions.

• Business Acumen: Applies deep business knowledge, including finance, sales, and legal aspects, to product decision-making.

• Owner's Mindset: Maintains an owner's mindset for the specific product or problem area, acting as the critical element for the success of the empowered product team.

• Customer Advocacy: Acts as the expert on the users and customers to ensure their needs are central to the product's development.

• Results-Driven Development: Ensures that all development work is results-driven and aligned with the established outcome goals.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Science or related field; Master’s preferred

• Scientific or marketing background, business acumen, and 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or diagnostics industry, sales and/or marketing are desired

• Strong understanding of diagnostics industry, country and global product management, and commercial operations.

• Demonstrated enterprise mindset, commercial capabilities, and value creation focus.

• Ability to inspire, develop, and empower colleagues to deliver impact and achieve results.

• Proven track record in leading strategic initiatives, managing change, and navigating ambiguity.

• Exceptional interpersonal, influencing, negotiation, and conflict resolution abilities with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

• Customer-focused, business-driven, innovative, and able to think and act across borders.

• Commitment to learning, fostering partnerships, and embracing Agile ways of working to break down silos.

• Expérience scientifique ou commerciale, acuité des affaires et 5+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou diagnostique, les ventes et/ou la commercialisation sont souhaitées
• Connaissance approfondie de l'industrie du diagnostic, de la gestion des produits nationaux et mondiaux et des opérations commerciales.
• L'esprit d'entreprise, les capacités commerciales et la création de valeur.
• Capacité d'inspirer, de développer et de donner aux collègues les moyens de produire des effets et d'obtenir des résultats.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite d'initiatives stratégiques, la gestion du changement et la navigation de l'ambiguïté.
• Capacités interpersonnelles exceptionnelles, d'influence, de négociation et de résolution de conflits avec les intervenants et les équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Ce sont les clients, les entreprises, les innovateurs et les personnes capables de penser et d'agir au-delà des frontières.
• Engagement à l'égard de l'apprentissage, de la promotion des partenariats et de l'adoption de façons Agiles de travailler pour briser les silos. jobs.title: External Workforce Product & Insights Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Workforce Optimization (WFO) provides expertise at global level with the ambition of elevating the way leaders shape Roche’s workforce. In partnership with P&C and cross-functional experts, they further evolve a framework on how to partner with the external workforce, provide insights regarding total workforce (workforce including external partners), and data-driven, skill-based workforce solutions. These frameworks/solutions enable us to partner with the business in defining integrated workforce strategies and to unlock the strategic potential of our total workforce (TW). Shaping new practices/products to navigate the evolving business landscape and to proactively shape Roche’s workforce to be future ready, working with new technologies and cross-functional partners offers great learning opportunities.

The Opportunity:
As an External Workforce (EW) Product & Insights Analyst, you support Roche’s cross-functional EW Framework with regards to efficient & compliant processes, and enable TW insights by data quality, data analysis and regular reporting at a global level.

• Contribute to the data accuracy of EW data e.g. by supporting month-end closing procedures, by regular operational data audits, as well as driving data enhancement processes

• Prepare workforce reports reconciling data from our Finance & P&C systems in order to provide transparency of our EW across Roche and gather relevant insights

• Support regular reporting on EW for Senior Leadership and/or global audit data requests

• Support initiatives - in the field of TW Insights - to enrich EW across Roche, drive automation and efficient WFO operations and support EW data and insights requests

• Partner closely with EW Framework & Enablement team as well as Product & Insights Partners to ensure a good understanding of the data (& processes) requirements and translate them into EW data products

• Support the regular communications to PSS regarding EW initiatives/updates of relevance to Roche Responsible Persons (=RRPs, persons responsible for managing external partners) - in close collaboration with the EW team

• Keep track on feedback, challenges and requests of RRPs (via PSS) regarding data entry process & beyond, and loop this back into EW related product evolution

• Support the design and offering of training for RRPs, regarding their responsibilities, the external partner lifecycle and usage of EW infrastructure

Who you are:

• 3-4 years of work experience in matrixed, global and data related settings, preferably within People & Culture

• Communication skills, incl. know how to communicate data and how to use technology, ideally experience in designing learning journeys

• Fluency in English

• Data-driven mind with expertise in data analysis, analytics and interpretation, with strong skills in Excel/Google Sheets; and know how to apply AI, algorithms/libraries

• Analytical & technical skills, leveraging data & translating them into action and can address complex problems via data-driven solutions

• Flexibility to adapt to different needs and navigate ambiguity in complex environments

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Emp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Workforce Optimization (WFO) fornisce competenze a livello globale con l'ambizione di elevare il modo in cui i leader plasmano la forza lavoro di Roche. In collaborazione con gli esperti P&C e cross-functional, essi evolvono ulteriormente un quadro su come collaborare con la forza lavoro esterna, fornire informazioni riguardanti la forza lavoro totale (forza di lavoro, compresi i partner esterni), e soluzioni di forza lavoro basate su competenze basate sui dati. Questi quadri/soluzioni ci permettono di collaborare con il business nella definizione di strategie integrate di forza lavoro e di sbloccare il potenziale strategico della nostra forza lavoro totale (TW). La formazione di nuove pratiche/prodotti per navigare nel panorama aziendale in evoluzione e per modellare proattivamente la forza lavoro di Roche per essere pronta futura, lavorare con nuove tecnologie e partner interfunzionali offre grandi opportunità di apprendimento. L'opportunità: In qualità di analista di prodotti e informazioni per la forza lavoro esterna (EW) supporta il framework EW cross-funzionale di Roche per quanto riguarda i processi efficienti e conformi, e consente agli insight TW di qualità dei dati, analisi dei dati e report periodici a livello globale.
• Contribuire alla precisione dei dati di EW ad esempio supportando le procedure di chiusura di fine mese, tramite controlli regolari dei dati operativi, nonché i processi di miglioramento dei dati di guida
• Preparare i report della forza lavoro che riconciliano i dati dei nostri sistemi Finance & P&C al fine di fornire trasparenza del nostro EW attraverso Roche e raccogliere informazioni pertinenti
• Supporta la segnalazione regolare su EW per le richieste di dati di Senior Leadership e/o audit globale
• Iniziative di supporto - nel campo di TW Insights - per arricchire EW attraverso Roche, l'automazione del drive e le operazioni WFO efficienti e sostenere le richieste di dati e approfondimenti EW
• Collabora a stretto contatto con il team EW Framework & Enablement e con Product & Insights Partners per garantire una buona comprensione dei requisiti dei dati (processi e processi) e tradurli in prodotti di dati EW
• Sostenere le comunicazioni regolari a PSS per quanto riguarda le iniziative EW/aggiornamento di rilevanza a Roche Responsible Persons (=RRP, persone responsabili della gestione di partner esterni) - in stretta collaborazione con il team EW
• Tenere traccia di feedback, sfide e richieste di RRP (via PSS) per quanto riguarda il processo di entrata dei dati e oltre, e loop questo di nuovo in EW relativa evoluzione del prodotto
• Sostenere la progettazione e l'offerta di formazione per RRP, per quanto riguarda le loro responsabilità, il ciclo di vita dei partner esterni e l'utilizzo dell'infrastruttura EW Chi sei:
• 3-4 anni di esperienza lavorativa nelle impostazioni matrici, globali e relative ai dati, preferibilmente all'interno di People & Culture
• Capacità di comunicazione, incl. sapere come comunicare i dati e come utilizzare la tecnologia, idealmente l'esperienza nella progettazione dei viaggi di apprendimento
• Fluency in inglese
• Mente data-driven con esperienza nell'analisi dei dati, analisi e interpretazione, con forti competenze in Excel/Google Sheets; e sapere come applicare AI, algoritmi/librari
• Competenze analitiche e tecniche, sfruttando i dati e traducendoli in azione e possono affrontare problemi complessi tramite soluzioni data-driven
• Flessibilità per adattarsi alle diverse esigenze e navigare in ambienti complessi In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: Competitivo stipendio e pacchetto caffetteria, bonus annuale, Servizi medici privati, Emp
