jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As an Infrastructure Provisioning and Management Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing and advancing our core infrastructure management and provisioning tech stack. This role has a strong focus on driving configuration-as-code, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and modern automated provisioning best practices across our high-performance compute (HPC) and industry-leading AI Factory.
You will own the lifecycle, deployment, and optimization of bare-metal and virtualized compute environments that power Roche's advanced computing initiatives. By treating infrastructure strictly as code and eliminating manual configurations, you will ensure our advanced clusters are highly reproducible, securely patched, and rapidly scalable to meet the evolving demands of computational science and large-scale AI workloads.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Automated Provisioning & Cluster Orchestration

• Design, deploy, and manage large-scale automated provisioning systems for multi-node HPC and AI Factory environments.

• Own and maintain the infrastructure management and provisioning tech stack underpinning the orchestration, monitoring, and provisioning of complex GPU and CPU workloads.

• Streamline bare-metal provisioning and node imaging pipelines to ensure minimal downtime and rapid expansion capabilities.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) & Configuration Governance

• Enforce a strict configuration-as-code and infrastructure-as-code mindset, replacing manual interventions with repeatable automation scripts.

• Author, review, and maintain complex Ansible playbooks and roles for configuration management, patch deployment, and compliance drift remediation.

• Establish robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to test, validate, and deploy infrastructure changes safely across development, staging, and production clusters.

Operating System Engineering & Lifecycle Management

• In partnership with Enterprise OS teams, standardize and manage operating system builds, with dual proficiency across HPC and AI Factory platforms.

• Utilize solutions such as Red Hat Image Builder and NVIDIA Base Command Manager to create optimized, compliant, and secure custom golden images tailored for AI and high-performance computing workloads.

• Manage OS lifecycles, including kernel tuning, automated package updates, and vulnerability management, ensuring alignment with global security standards.

Platform Reliability & Collaboration

• Implement proactive monitoring and alerting for infrastructure provisioning health, node availability, and configurat

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro In qualità di Infrastructure Provisioning and Management Engineer all'interno del team Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE), sarai responsabile della supervisione e dell'avanzamento della nostra gestione delle infrastrutture principali e del provisioning dello stack tecnico. Questo ruolo ha un forte focus sulla guida configurazione-as-code, infrastruttura-as-code (IaC), e moderne pratiche automatizzate di provisioning attraverso la nostra elaborazione ad alte prestazioni (HPC) e AI Factory leader del settore. Avrete il ciclo di vita, la distribuzione e l'ottimizzazione di ambienti di calcolo bare-metal e virtualizzati che alimentano le iniziative di calcolo avanzate di Roche. Trattando l'infrastruttura rigorosamente come codice ed eliminando le configurazioni manuali, garantirai che i nostri cluster avanzati siano altamente riproducibili, patchati in modo sicuro e rapidamente scalabili per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione della scienza computazionale e dei carichi di lavoro AI su larga scala. Descrizione della zona Hosting e Infrastructure (HI) fornisce infrastrutture on-premise mission-critical, cloud hosting, connettività e prodotti tecnologici che consentono a tutte le funzioni di ogni sito Roche di sviluppare, innovare, collegare e fornire prodotti digitali conformi in tutta la Roche Enterprise. Il team Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) è focalizzato sulla guida del successo del cliente e del successo della piattaforma, agendo come centro di eccellenza e consegna per l'High Performance Compute e l'AI Infrastructure supportando casi di utilizzo AI e HPC in Roche. Questo team facilita l'installazione e l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità per i clienti verticali aziendali che necessitano di una elaborazione accelerata, aiutando i consumatori di infrastrutture con esigenze ottimizzate per l'elevata disponibilità, il trasferimento dei dati senza soluzione di continuità, la flessibilità, la velocità e le esigenze in rapida evoluzione dell'IA, aiutando a raggiungere tempi rapidi per il valore. Responsabilità del lavoro Progettazione automatizzata & Cluster Orchestration
• Progettazione, distribuzione e gestione di sistemi di provisioning automatizzati su larga scala per ambienti HPC e AI Factory multi-nodo.
• Possedere e mantenere la gestione delle infrastrutture e il provisioning dello stack tecnico che sottopone l'orchestrazione, il monitoraggio e la fornitura di complessi carichi di lavoro GPU e CPU.
• Ottimizzare le pipeline di provisioning bare-metal e di imaging nodo per garantire un minimo di downtime e capacità di espansione rapida. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) & Configuration Governance
• Fornire una stretta mentalità di configurazione-as-code e infrastruttura-as-code, sostituendo interventi manuali con script di automazione ripetibili.
• Autore, revisione, e mantenere complessi playbooks Ansible e ruoli per la gestione della configurazione, l'implementazione di patch e la correzione della deriva di conformità.
• Stabilire robuste tubazioni CI/CD utilizzando GitLab per testare, convalidare e distribuire i cambiamenti di infrastruttura in modo sicuro attraverso lo sviluppo, la stadiazione e cluster di produzione. Ingegneria del sistema operativo e gestione del ciclo di vita
• In collaborazione con i team Enterprise OS, standardizzare e gestire le build del sistema operativo, con doppia competenza sulle piattaforme HPC e AI Factory.
• Utilizzare soluzioni come Red Hat Image Builder e NVIDIA Base Command Manager per creare immagini d'oro personalizzate ottimizzate, conformi e sicure su misura per i carichi di lavoro di elaborazione AI e ad alte prestazioni.
• Gestisci i cicli di vita del sistema operativo, tra cui il tuning del kernel, gli aggiornamenti automatizzati dei pacchetti e la gestione delle vulnerabilità, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza globali. Affidabilità e collaborazione della piattaforma
• Implementare il monitoraggio proattivo e l'avviso per la salute di approvvigionamento delle infrastrutture, la disponibilità dei nodi e la configurazione

Essendo un ponte tra i team di dominio aziendale, i team RDT AI (ad esempio Applied AI), l'ingegneria della piattaforma e l'infrastruttura, il team VEO garantisce che la domanda di entrare nella AI Factory sia strutturata, governata e allineata alle capacità della piattaforma, consentendo un efficace imbarco, esecuzione e risultati misurabili. Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Als Mitglied des ACE Value Engineering & Outcomes (VEO)-Teams werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle dabei spielen, sicherzustellen, dass Anwendungsfälle für KI und High Performance Computing (HPC) erfolgreich übersetzt, bereitgestellt und in der gesamten KI-Fabrik und HPC-Infrastruktur von Roche ausgeführt werden. Wenn Sie an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsdomänen, RDT AI-Teams (wie Applied AI) und Platform Engineering arbeiten, tragen Sie dazu bei, den End-to-End-Flow von der Anwendungsfallabsicht bis hin zu realen, laufenden Workloads zu besitzen. Sie stellen sicher, dass Workloads technisch ausführbar, skalierbar und auf die Plattformfähigkeiten abgestimmt sind, was eine schnelle Time-to-Value- und nachhaltige Einführung ermöglicht und die Abstimmung zwischen Geschäftsabsicht und Plattformausführung gewährleistet. Sie werden auch dazu beitragen, zu definieren und kontinuierlich zu verbessern, wie sich Anwendungsfälle vom Konzept zur Ausführung im gesamten KI-Fabrik- und HPC-Ökosystem bewegen, und helfen, wiederholbare und skalierbare Wege für die Ausführung von Workloads zu etablieren. Beschreibung des Gebiets Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) bietet unternehmenskritische On-Premise-Infrastruktur-, Cloud-Hosting-, Konnektivitäts- und Technologieprodukte, die es allen Funktionen an jedem Roche-Standort ermöglichen, konforme digitale Produkte im gesamten Roche Enterprise zu entwickeln, zu innovieren, zu verbinden und zu liefern. Das Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team konzentriert sich darauf, sowohl den Kundenerfolg als auch den Plattformerfolg zu fördern, indem es als Kompetenzzentrum und Bereitstellung für die High Performance Compute und AI-Infrastruktur fungiert, die KI- und HPC-Anwendungsfälle in ganz Roche unterstützt. Dieses Team erleichtert das nahtlose Onboarding und die Übernahme für vertikale Geschäftskunden, die eine beschleunigte Berechnung benötigen, um den Infrastrukturverbrauchern mit Anforderungen zu helfen, die auf Hochverfügbarkeit, nahtlose Datenübertragung, Flexibilität, Geschwindigkeit und die sich schnell ändernden Anforderungen der KI optimiert sind. Innerhalb von Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) spielt das Value Engineering & Outcomes (VEO)-Team eine entscheidende Rolle im KI-Fabrik-Ökosystem, indem es sicherstellt, dass KI- und HPC-Anwendungsfälle in ausführbare Workloads übersetzt und erfolgreich auf der Plattforminfrastruktur realisiert werden. Als Brücke zwischen Business-Domain-Teams, RDT AI-Teams (wie Applied AI), Plattform-Engineering und Infrastruktur stellt das VEO-Team sicher, dass die Nachfrage, die in die KI-Fabrik gelangt, strukturiert, geregelt und auf die Plattformfähigkeiten ausgerichtet ist, was ein effektives Onboarding, eine effektive Ausführung und messbare Ergebnisse ermöglicht. Aufgabenbereich Use Case Strukturierung, Herausforderung & Bereitschaft
• Partnerschaft mit Business-Domain-Teams und RDT AI-Teams (wie Applied AI), um KI- und HPC-Anwendungsfälle zu klären, zu strukturieren und konstruktiv zu hinterfragen
• Beurteilen Sie Bereitschaft, Abhängigkeiten und Machbarkeit über Daten-, Infrastruktur- und Plattformbeschränkungen hinweg
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Anwendungsfälle vor der Ausführung technisch tragfähig und an den Plattformfähigkeiten ausgerichtet sind
• Lücken frühzeitig erkennen und Teams zu ausführbaren Pfaden führen Workload-Übersetzung, Architektur und Plattform-Routing
• Übersetzen von Anwendungsfällen in ausführbare Workload-Designs, einschließlich Compute-, Storage-, Orchestrierungs- und Datenanforderungen
• Definieren Sie, wie Workloads in AI Factory, HPC und Hybridumgebungen bereitgestellt werden
• Nutzen Sie die Erfahrung mit containerisierten und verteilten Systemen (z. B. Kubernetes, HPC-Scheduler), um sicherzustellen, dass die Workloads produktionsbereit sind
• Entwicklung wiederverwendbarer Muster zur Standardisierung der Workload-Bereitstellung und -Skalierung Plattform Onboarding & Ausführung
• Fahren Sie das Onboarding von Workloads in Plattformumgebungen, um alle technischen Aspekte zu gewährleisten

jobs.title: Workload Orchestration Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Workload Orchestration Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing and advancing our workload orchestration tech stack across both our High-Performance Computing (HPC) and industry-leading AI Factory platforms. With the rapid expansion of our compute infrastructure, efficiently scheduling, managing, and maximizing the utilization of our CPU and GPU environments is paramount.
You will own the deployment, configuration, and fine-tuning of orchestration platforms that schedule massive, parallel computational workloads. By implementing robust scheduling policies for traditional scientific workflows and modern containerized AI workloads, you will bridge the gap between heavy compute capacity and efficient execution. Your work will directly ensure that Roche’s researchers, data scientists, and engineers can seamlessly run large-scale AI model training and computational science simulations at scale.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Orchestration Stack Deployment & Governance

• Design, implement, and maintain the SLURM Workload Manager ecosystem across our HPC cluster architectures, ensuring high availability and optimal resource distribution.

• Deploy and manage Run:ai as the core orchestration and virtualization layer for the AI Factory, enabling fractional GPU allocation and dynamic resource allocation.

• Evaluate, architect, and implement SLURM Slinky integrations where required to seamlessly bridge Kubernetes-based AI orchestration with traditional HPC cluster resources.

Containerization & Workload Optimization

• Define best practices and frameworks for containerized scientific execution, utilizing Singularity/Apptainer and/or Enroot to provide secure, reproducible performance environments for HPC.

• Translate user and workload requirements into optimized scheduling parameters (e.g., topology-aware scheduling, multi-node scaling).

• Actively profile and tune scheduling queues, quality-of-service (QoS) parameters, and fair-share policies to maximize multi-tenant efficiency.

Platform Reliability & Telemetry

• Partner with Observability Engineers to implement continuous monitoring, telemetry, and reporting dashboards to track scheduler efficiency, queue wait times, and hardware utilization rates.

• Troubleshoot complex workload failures, including distributed training synchronization issues, MPI communication bottlenecks, and driver incompatibilities.

• Maintain configuration-as-code models for the scheduling tier, leveraging automation to deploy cluster policies uniformly.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Workload Orchestration Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for overseeing and advancing our workload orchestration tech stack across both our High-Performance Computing (HPC) and industry-leading AI Factory platforms. With the rapid expansion of our compute infrastructure, efficiently scheduling, managing, and maximizing the utilization of our CPU and GPU environments is paramount.
You will own the deployment, configuration, and fine-tuning of orchestration platforms that schedule massive, parallel computational workloads. By implementing robust scheduling policies for traditional scientific workflows and modern containerized AI workloads, you will bridge the gap between heavy compute capacity and efficient execution. Your work will directly ensure that Roche’s researchers, data scientists, and engineers can seamlessly run large-scale AI model training and computational science simulations at scale.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Orchestration Stack Deployment & Governance

• Design, implement, and maintain the SLURM Workload Manager ecosystem across our HPC cluster architectures, ensuring high availability and optimal resource distribution.

• Deploy and manage Run:ai as the core orchestration and virtualization layer for the AI Factory, enabling fractional GPU allocation and dynamic resource allocation.

• Evaluate, architect, and implement SLURM Slinky integrations where required to seamlessly bridge Kubernetes-based AI orchestration with traditional HPC cluster resources.

Containerization & Workload Optimization

• Define best practices and frameworks for containerized scientific execution, utilizing Singularity/Apptainer and/or Enroot to provide secure, reproducible performance environments for HPC.

• Translate user and workload requirements into optimized scheduling parameters (e.g., topology-aware scheduling, multi-node scaling).

• Actively profile and tune scheduling queues, quality-of-service (QoS) parameters, and fair-share policies to maximize multi-tenant efficiency.

Platform Reliability & Telemetry

• Partner with Observability Engineers to implement continuous monitoring, telemetry, and reporting dashboards to track scheduler efficiency, queue wait times, and hardware utilization rates.

• Troubleshoot complex workload failures, including distributed training synchronization issues, MPI communication bottlenecks, and driver incompatibilities.

• Maintain configuration-as-code models for the scheduling tier, leveraging automation to deploy cluster policies uniformly.

Qualifications

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As a Sales Executive you will manage Account and Ensure Sales Achievement in Assigned Territory & Product lines, assist District Sales Manager in relieving their duties whenever necessary

• Develop new accounts with proper and close follow-up of sales opportunity

• Develop and maintains good customer relationships with important and relevant personnel

• Proactive and creative solve problems in managing customers’ complaint by proper investigation and close follow-up in resolving issues (eg: product deliveries/application troubleshooting)

• Coordinate with Distribution partner /Third Party to better serve customers

• Work closely with the Professional Service team to deliver the post-sales service for the maximum customers’ satisfaction.

Who you are

• Have Bachelor in Health/Science

• Have 3 year multinational companies experience in Pharmaceutical/ Diagnostic/ Healthcare industrial sales

• Have effective communication and interpersonal skill

• Have creative problem solving and negotiation skill

• Have customer complaint handling skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im R&D-Team "Functional Assays" suchen wir für den Zeitraum Mitte August 2026 bis Ende Januar 2027 eine/einen Praktikantin/Praktikanten zur Mitarbeit im Tätigkeitsfeld Protein-Analytik.

Praktikums-Inhalte

• Mitarbeit bei Standard-Protein-Analytik der protein-basierten, diagnostischen Reagentien.

• Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung neuer Methoden zur Reagentien-Charakterisierung

• Mitarbeit bei DSP-Prozessen

Qualifikationen

Für eine Beschäftigung als Praktikant (m/w/d) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Master-Studiengang der Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie o.ä ,
Bachelor-Abschluss wird vorausgesetzt!

• Immunologische Vorkenntnisse über Antikörper, Antigene, Proteinbiochemie

• Interesse an verschiedensten Methoden zur Charakterisierung protein-basierter Reagentien

• Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Eigenständigkeit, Engagement und Teamfähigkeit

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade dein Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum: ab dem 17. August 2026 – 31. Januar 2027 für die Dauer von 5 ½ Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Farmacie Roche La missione
• L'assistenza sanitaria sta cambiando: innovazione radicale, maggiore apertura al cambiamento, crescente empowerment dei pazienti, molteplici fonti di informazioni mediche e pressione sulla spesa pubblica. Come risultato di tutto questo, i bisogni dei nostri stakeholder continuano ad evolversi.
• Il Partner del Viaggio Paziente (PJP) è al centro dell'organizzazione Roche, ponendo in risalto il ruolo che giochiamo nella società - dall'offrire per lo più medicinali di livello mondiale verso una maggiore collaborazione, innovazione e interruzione generativa. In questo modo il PJP sarà direttamente responsabile per fornire risultati migliori per i pazienti, la loro comunità, l'ecosistema e l'organizzazione, più velocemente.
• Il PJP è un leader potenziato e il volto locale di Roche Hong Kong e Macau. Collabora a stretto contatto con tutte le parti interessate, toccando direttamente il percorso del paziente (in una data area terapeutica o malattia), acquisendo una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze per collegare le capacità di Roche per creare soluzioni significative.
• Il PJP fornirà risultati migliori per i pazienti, migliore valore comunitario e migliori risultati commerciali, quest'ultimo è la conseguenza dei primi due. Commettere a migliorare i risultati di cura migliori per i pazienti è un buon affare.
• Questo ruolo è localmente incorporato nell'ecosistema di Hong Kong, è un ruolo integrato, punto di contatto primario, funzionalemente agnostico, (cioè non si inserisce nei concetti tradizionali di Affari Commerciali/Sales o Medico)
• Non ha redditivitÃ, obiettivi di vendita o incentivi
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche Hong Kong & Macau devono guidare per esempio, nel modo di lavorare in rete. Questo è dove le soluzioni sono fonte dalla rete interna ed esterna prima, per evitare duplicazioni, e per ottenere risultati migliori paziente più velocemente.
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche Hong Kong & Macau devono guidare per esempio nell'accelerare la maturità digitale di Roche internamente e nell'ambiente sanitario esterno, allineati con la visione Roche a lungo termine di Personalized Health Care. Principali passività
• Tutti i dipendenti di Roche dovrebbero contribuire efficacemente alla collaborazione e al coordinamento interfunzionali e rispettare tutte le leggi, regolamenti, politiche e procedure che governano il nostro business.
• Questo profilo di posizione serve solo a dare un ampio profilo dei doveri richiesti e sarà rinnovato e modificato a intervalli periodici nella consultazione con l'ente.
• Il PJP è un ruolo di alto livello all'interno dell'affiliato, che ha l'autorità decisionale di richiedere risorse di Roche (sia all'interno della rete affiliata e più ampia) al fine di avere migliorato l'impatto sul viaggio del paziente
• Per quanto riguarda gli ecosistemi di Hong Kong e Macao, il PJP continuerà ad evolvere la collaborazione all'interno dell'ecosistema dei cluster HA, dei partenariati pubblici e privati e dei cambiamenti del sistema sanitario in cui gli HSP saranno modellati. Dettagli:
• Il PJP si concentra sull'importanza di portare l'esterno dentro, lavorando con i partner di Hong Kong e Macau per scoprire tutte le potenziali opportunità di trasformare i risultati per i pazienti, più velocemente. Portano anche l'interno fuori, per portare Roche competenze, scienza e conoscenza all'ecosistema.
• Agisce come partner affidabile ed è il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra gli stakeholder e Roche; il PJP condivide il paziente e la comunità degli stakeholder ha bisogno internamente, prioritizza e protegge le risorse, e guida soluzioni che forniscono risultati più velocemente.
• Partner con paziente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Pharmaceuticals Die Mission
• Die Gesundheitsfürsorge verändert sich: Radikale Innovation, erhöhte Offenheit für Veränderungen, zunehmende Stärkung der Patientenkompetenz, vielfältige medizinische Informationsquellen und Druck auf die öffentlichen Ausgaben. Als Ergebnis all dessen entwickeln sich die Bedürfnisse unserer Stakeholder weiter.
• Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und stellt die Rolle, die wir in der Gesellschaft spielen, auf den Kopf - von der Bereitstellung von Weltklasse-Medikamenten hin zu viel mehr Partnerschaften, Innovationen und führenden generativen Störungen. Auf diese Weise wird die PJP direkt rechenschaftspflichtig sein, um Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern.
• Die PJP ist ein mächtiger Führer und das lokale Gesicht von Roche Hong Kong und Macau. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln.
• Die PJP wird bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten, einen besseren Gemeinschaftswert und bessere kommerzielle Ergebnisse liefern, wobei letzteres die Folge der ersten beiden ist. Die Verpflichtung zur Verbesserung besserer Pflegeergebnisse für Patienten ist ein gutes Geschäft.
• Diese Rolle ist lokal in das Ökosystem von Hongkong eingebettet, es ist eine integrierte Rolle, primärer Ansprechpartner, funktional agnostisch, (d. H. Es passt nicht in die traditionellen Konzepte von Commercial / Sales oder Medical Affairs)
• Es hat keine Rentabilität, Verkaufsziele oder Anreize
• Alle Roche Hong Kong & Macau Mitarbeiter sollen mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen, in der Netzwerk-Arbeitsweise. Hier werden zuerst Lösungen aus dem internen und externen Netzwerk bezogen, um Doppelungen zu vermeiden und schneller bessere Patientenergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Alle Mitarbeiter von Roche Hong Kong & Macau werden mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen, um die digitale Reife von Roche intern und im externen Gesundheitsumfeld zu beschleunigen, im Einklang mit der langfristigen Roche-Vision von Personalized Health Care. Hauptbuchhaltung
• Von allen Roche-Mitarbeitern wird erwartet, dass sie effektiv zur funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und Koordination beitragen und alle Gesetze, Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Verfahren einhalten, die unser Geschäft regeln.
• Dieses Positionsprofil dient nur dazu, einen groben Überblick über die erforderlichen Aufgaben zu geben und wird in regelmäßigen Abständen in der Konsultation des etablierten Unternehmens erneuert und geändert.
• Der PJP ist eine Führungsposition innerhalb des Affiliates, der die Entscheidungsbefugnis hat, Ressourcen von Roche (sowohl innerhalb des Affiliates als auch im weiteren Netzwerk) anzufordern, um die Patientenreise zu verbessern.
• In Bezug auf die Ökosysteme von Hongkong und Macau wird die PJP die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Ökosystems von HA-Clustern, öffentlichen und privaten Partnerschaften und die reibungslose Einführung von Veränderungen des Gesundheitssystems, in denen die HSPs gestaltet werden, weiter ausbauen. Einzelheiten:
• Die pjp konzentriert sich auf die wichtigkeit, die außenseite nach innen zu bringen, indem sie sowohl mit hongkong als auch mit macau-partnern zusammenarbeitet, um alle möglichen möglichkeiten aufzudecken, die ergebnisse für patienten schneller zu verändern. Sie bringen auch das Innere nach außen, um Roche Know-how, Wissenschaft und Wissen in das Ökosystem zu bringen.
• Tritt als vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf und ist der primäre (aber nicht exklusive) Ansprechpartner zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche; die PJP teilt die Bedürfnisse der Patienten- und Stakeholder-Community intern, priorisiert und sichert Ressourcen und treibt Lösungen voran, die schneller Ergebnisse liefern.
• Partner mit dem Patienten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutiques La Mission
• Les soins de santé changent : innovation radicale, ouverture accrue au changement, renforcement de l'autonomisation des patients, sources multiples d'information médicale et pression sur les dépenses publiques. Par conséquent, les besoins de nos intervenants continuent d'évoluer.
• Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) est au centre de l'organisation Roche, renversant le rôle que nous jouons dans la société - de l'offre principalement de médicaments de classe mondiale à beaucoup plus de partenariat, d'innovation et de rupture de génération. Ce faisant, le PJP sera directement responsable d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, leur communauté, l'écosystème et l'organisation, plus rapidement.
• Le PJP est un leader habilité et le visage local de Roche Hong Kong et Macao. Elle s'associe étroitement avec toutes les parties prenantes touchant directement le parcours du patient (dans un domaine thérapeutique ou de maladie donné), en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives.
• Le PJP produira de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, une meilleure valeur communautaire et de meilleurs résultats commerciaux, ce dernier étant la conséquence des deux premiers. S'engager à améliorer les résultats des soins pour les patients est une bonne affaire.
• Ce rôle est intégré localement dans l'écosystème de Hong Kong, c'est un rôle intégré, principal point de contact, fonctionnellement agnostique, (c'est-à-dire qu'il ne s'inscrit pas dans les concepts traditionnels de commerce/ventes ou affaires médicales)
• Elle n'a ni objectifs de rentabilité, ni incitations en matière de ventes.
• Tous les employés de Roche Hong Kong & Macao doivent montrer l'exemple, dans la manière de travailler en réseau. C'est là que les solutions proviennent d'abord du réseau interne et externe, afin d'éviter les doubles emplois et d'obtenir plus rapidement de meilleurs résultats pour les patients.
• Tous les employés de Roche Hong Kong & Macao doivent montrer l'exemple en accélérant la maturité numérique de Roche en interne et dans l'environnement de santé externe, aligné sur la vision à long terme de Roche des soins de santé personnalisés. Principales responsabilités
• Tous les employés de Roche doivent contribuer efficacement à la collaboration et à la coordination interfonctionnelles et se conformer à toutes les lois, règlements, politiques et procédures qui régissent notre entreprise.
• Ce profil de poste sert seulement à donner un aperçu général des fonctions requises et sera renouvelé et modifié à intervalles réguliers en consultation avec le titulaire.
• Le PJP est un rôle de niveau supérieur au sein de l'affilié, qui a le pouvoir décisionnel de demander des ressources de Roche (à la fois au sein de l'affilié et de l'ensemble du réseau) afin d'avoir une incidence améliorée sur le cheminement du patient
• En ce qui concerne les écosystèmes de Hong Kong et de Macao, le PJP continuera à développer la collaboration au sein de l'écosystème des grappes d'HA, des partenariats publics et privés et le bon déroulement des changements du système de santé dans lesquels les PSH seront façonnés. Détails:
• Le PJP met l'accent sur l'importance d'amener l'extérieur, en collaboration avec les partenaires de Hong Kong et de Macao, à découvrir toutes les possibilités potentielles de transformer les résultats pour les patients, plus rapidement. Ils apportent aussi l'intérieur, pour apporter l'expertise, la science et le savoir Roche à l'écosystème.
• Agit en tant que partenaire de confiance et est le principal point de contact (mais non exclusif) entre les intervenants et Roche; le PJP partage les besoins des patients et des intervenants à l'interne, priorise et sécurise les ressources et stimule les solutions qui produisent les résultats plus rapidement.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel (12-month FTC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This is 12-month Fixed-Term Contract.

The Opportunity

As Legal Counsel you will have responsibility for supporting the General Counsel as a key member of the
legal team and working with various stakeholders throughout the business, providing sound legal advice across the relevant matters affecting the business.
You will identify and manage commercial and legal risk in and work for the creation of sound commercial proposals that meet business areas goals and metrics and protect the Company’s risk levels, reputation and financial interests.

Key Responsibilities:

• Data Protection Operations: Serve as the primary responsible person for operational data privacy matters across the affiliate. This includes managing and resolving Data Subject Requests (DSRs) and investigating privacy incidents, while maintaining a direct reporting line to the Data Protection Officer (DPO) for escalation and strategic alignment.

• Comprehensive Legal Support: Act as a core business partner by advising on UK commercial pharmaceutical laws. Provide comprehensive legal support in the UK and Ireland with a view to ensuring Roche achieves its goals and appropriately manages legal risk (to take into account laws and regulations relating (but not limited) to, competition law, commercial, data protection, marketing and advertising, anti-bribery law, litigation and disputes).

• Ethical & Compliance Leadership: Ensuring that the company, employees and agencies operate ethically and in compliance with the Roche Group Code of Conduct.

• R&D and Clinical Trial Support: Provide proactive legal counsel to global and local R&D teams. This includes advising on clinical trial regulations, reviewing and negotiating clinical trial agreements (CTAs).

• Project & Commercial Execution: Supporting the business to ensure activities are both commercially sound and legally compliant.

• Horizon Scanning & Risk Mitigation: Identify risks and opportunities derived from changes in legislation and ensure that the key legal aspects are taken into account in both planning and decision processes.

• Business Alignment: Ensure alignment and adherence across the relevant business areas in all legal matters.

• Operational Excellence: Ensuring the legal tools, template documents and agreements are maintained and reflect any changes in business practice and relevant laws and regulations.

Who You Are:

• Qualifications: You are a qualified lawyer in England and Wales.

• Core Expertise: You possess a strong, practical knowledge of UK data protection laws (UK GDPR) and UK commercial pharmaceutical law. You are comfortable reviewing and negotiating agreements and providing daily support to diverse business units.

• Industry Experience (required qualifications): Prior experience within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry, featuring a comprehensive understanding of UK and Irish legal frameworks, UK GDPR, and relevant healthcare compliance standards (e.g., ABPI Code guidelines).

• Desirable Competencies: Familiarity or experience with medical device regulations and digital health laws (such as UK Medical Devices Regulations, CE/UKCA marking frameworks, or software-as-a-medical-device guidance) is not mandatory but would be a plus.

• Inclusive Collaboration: Fosters a diverse, high-performing culture by bridging geographical and functional boundaries, resolving conflicts, and driving cross-team unity.

• Impactful Communication & Influence: Simplifies complex legal concepts clearly while inspiring the organi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è 12 mesi Fixed-Term Contract. L'opportunità In qualità di consigliere legale avrete la responsabilità di sostenere il Consiglio Generale come membro chiave del team legale e lavorare con vari stakeholder in tutto il business, fornendo una solida consulenza legale in materia di business. Identificherai e gestirai il rischio commerciale e legale e lavorerai per la creazione di proposte commerciali solide che soddisfano gli obiettivi e le metriche delle aree commerciali e proteggono i livelli di rischio, la reputazione e gli interessi finanziari della Società. Responsabilità chiave:
• Operazioni per la protezione dei dati: Servire come persona responsabile principale per la privacy dei dati operativi in tutta la filiale. Ciò include la gestione e la risoluzione delle richieste degli interessati (DSRs) e l'analisi degli incidenti sulla privacy, pur mantenendo una linea di reporting diretta al Data Protection Officer (DPO) per l'escalation e l'allineamento strategico.
• Supporto Legale Comprehensive: Agire come partner di core business consigliando sulle leggi farmaceutiche commerciali del Regno Unito. Fornire un supporto legale completo nel Regno Unito e in Irlanda al fine di garantire che Roche raggiunga i suoi obiettivi e gestisca adeguatamente il rischio legale (per tener conto delle leggi e delle normative relative (ma non limitate) a, diritto di concorrenza, commerciale, protezione dei dati, marketing e pubblicità, diritto anti-bribery, contenzioso e controversie).
• Leadership Etica & Compliance: Assicurarsi che l'azienda, i dipendenti e le agenzie gestiscano eticamente e nel rispetto del Codice di condotta del Gruppo Roche.
• R&D e Clinical Trial Support: fornire consulenza legale proattiva alle squadre R&D globali e locali. Ciò include la consulenza sulle normative cliniche di prova, la revisione e la negoziazione degli accordi di sperimentazione clinica (CTA).
• Project & Commercial Execution: Sostenere il business per garantire che le attività siano sia commercialmente solide che legalmente conformi.
• Horizon Scanning & Risk Mitigation: Identificare i rischi e le opportunità derivanti dai cambiamenti legislativi e garantire che gli aspetti legali chiave siano presi in considerazione sia nei processi di pianificazione che nelle decisioni.
• Allineamento aziendale: Assicurare l'allineamento e l'adesione in tutte le questioni legali.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Garantire gli strumenti legali, i documenti dei modelli e gli accordi sono mantenuti e riflettono eventuali cambiamenti nella pratica aziendale e nelle leggi e regolamenti pertinenti. Chi sei?
• Qualifiche: Lei è un avvocato qualificato in Inghilterra e Galles.
• Competenza di base: Lei possiede una forte e pratica conoscenza delle leggi di protezione dei dati del Regno Unito (Regno Unito GDPR) e del diritto farmaceutico commerciale del Regno Unito. Sei comodo rivedere e negoziare accordi e fornire supporto giornaliero a diverse unità aziendali.
• Esperienza nel settore (requisiti richiesti): Esperienza prioritaria all'interno delle scienze della vita o dell'industria farmaceutica, con una comprensione completa dei quadri giuridici del Regno Unito e dell'Irlanda, del GDPR del Regno Unito e dei relativi standard di conformità sanitaria (ad esempio, linee guida del codice ABPI).
• Competenze discrezionali: familiarità o esperienza con le normative sui dispositivi medici e le leggi sulla salute digitale (come i regolamenti sui dispositivi medici del Regno Unito, i quadri di marcatura CE/UKCA, o la guida software-as-a-medical-dispositivo) non è obbligatoria ma sarebbe un vantaggio.
• Collaborazione Inclusiva: promuove una cultura diversificata e ad alto rendimento, corrodendo i confini geografici e funzionali, risolvendo i conflitti e guidando l'unità trasversale.
• Comunicazione e influenza d'impatto: semplificare con chiarezza i concetti legali complessi e ispirare l'organizzazione

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Dies ist ein 12-Monats-Festvertrag. Die Chance Als Rechtsberater haben Sie die Verantwortung, den General Counsel als wichtiges Mitglied der Rechtsteam und die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen, die Bereitstellung einer fundierten Rechtsberatung in den relevanten Angelegenheiten, die das Unternehmen betreffen. Sie identifizieren und verwalten kommerzielle und rechtliche Risiken und arbeiten an der Erstellung solider kommerzieller Vorschläge, die die Ziele und Metriken der Geschäftsbereiche erfüllen und das Risikoniveau, den Ruf und die finanziellen Interessen des Unternehmens schützen. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Datenschutz: Dienen Sie als primäre verantwortliche Person für operative Datenschutzangelegenheiten im gesamten Affiliate. Dies umfasst die Verwaltung und Lösung von Datensubjektanfragen (DSRs) und die Untersuchung von Datenschutzvorfällen, während eine direkte Berichtslinie an den Datenschutzbeauftragten (DPO) zur Eskalation und strategischen Ausrichtung beibehalten wird.
• Umfassende rechtliche Unterstützung: Handeln Sie als Kerngeschäftspartner durch Beratung zu kommerziellen pharmazeutischen Gesetzen in Großbritannien. Gewährleistung einer umfassenden rechtlichen Unterstützung in Großbritannien und Irland, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche seine Ziele erreicht und die rechtlichen Risiken angemessen steuert (um Gesetze und Vorschriften in Bezug auf (aber nicht beschränkt) Wettbewerbsrecht, Handelsrecht, Datenschutz, Marketing und Werbung, Anti-Bestechungsrecht, Rechtsstreitigkeiten und Streitigkeiten zu berücksichtigen).
• Ethical & Compliance Leadership: Sicherstellen, dass das Unternehmen, die Mitarbeiter und Agenturen ethisch und in Übereinstimmung mit dem Verhaltenskodex der Roche Group handeln.
• F&E und Clinical Trial Support: Proaktive Rechtsberatung für globale und lokale F&E-Teams. Dazu gehören die Beratung zu klinischen Studienvorschriften, die Überprüfung und Verhandlung von klinischen Studienvereinbarungen (CTAs).
• Project & Commercial Execution: Unterstützung des Unternehmens, um sicherzustellen, dass die Aktivitäten sowohl kommerziell als auch rechtlich konform sind.
• Horizon Scanning & Risk Mitigation: Identifizieren Sie Risiken und Chancen, die sich aus Gesetzesänderungen ergeben, und stellen Sie sicher, dass die wichtigsten rechtlichen Aspekte sowohl in Planungs- als auch Entscheidungsprozessen berücksichtigt werden.
• Business Alignment: Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung und Einhaltung in allen relevanten Geschäftsbereichen in allen rechtlichen Angelegenheiten.
• Operational Excellence: Sicherstellen, dass die rechtlichen Werkzeuge, Vorlagendokumente und Vereinbarungen beibehalten werden und alle Änderungen in der Geschäftspraxis und den relevanten Gesetzen und Vorschriften widerspiegeln. Wer Du bist:
• Qualifikationen: Sie sind ein qualifizierter Anwalt in England und Wales.
• Kernkompetenz: Sie verfügen über fundierte, praktische Kenntnisse der britischen Datenschutzgesetze (GB DSGVO) und des britischen Handelspharmarechts. Sie fühlen sich wohl dabei, Vereinbarungen zu überprüfen und auszuhandeln und bieten täglich Unterstützung für verschiedene Geschäftseinheiten.
• Branchenerfahrung (erforderliche Qualifikationen): Vorkenntnisse in den Biowissenschaften oder der pharmazeutischen Industrie, die ein umfassendes Verständnis der britischen und irischen gesetzlichen Rahmenbedingungen, der britischen DSGVO und relevanter Compliance-Standards im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. ABPI-Code-Richtlinien) bieten.
• Wünschenswerte Kompetenzen: Vertrautheit oder Erfahrung mit Medizinproduktevorschriften und digitalen Gesundheitsgesetzen (wie z. B. UK Medical Devices Regulations, CE/UKCA-Kennzeichnungsrahmen oder Software-as-a-medical-device Guidance) ist nicht obligatorisch, wäre aber ein Plus.
• Inklusive Zusammenarbeit: Fördert eine vielfältige, leistungsstarke Kultur, indem sie geografische und funktionale Grenzen überbrückt, Konflikte löst und die Einheit zwischen den Teams fördert.
• Wirkungsvolle Kommunikation & Einfluss: Vereinfacht komplexe Rechtskonzepte deutlich und inspiriert die Organisationen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est un contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois. L'opportunité En tant que conseiller juridique, vous aurez la responsabilité d'appuyer l'avocat général en tant que membre clé de la l'équipe juridique et la collaboration avec divers intervenants dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en fournissant des conseils juridiques judicieux sur les questions pertinentes touchant l'entreprise. Vous identifierez et gérerez les risques commerciaux et juridiques et travaillerez à la création de propositions commerciales saines qui répondent aux objectifs et aux paramètres des secteurs d'activité et qui protègent les niveaux de risque, la réputation et les intérêts financiers de l'entreprise. Principales responsabilités :
• Opérations de protection des données: Servir de principale personne responsable des questions de confidentialité des données opérationnelles dans l'ensemble de la filiale. Il s'agit notamment de gérer et de résoudre les demandes de renseignements personnels (DSR) et d'enquêter sur les incidents liés à la protection de la vie privée, tout en maintenant une ligne de déclaration directe à l'agent de protection des données (DPO) pour l'escalade et l'alignement stratégique.
• Soutien juridique global: agir en tant que partenaire principal en conseillant sur la législation pharmaceutique commerciale du Royaume-Uni. Fournir un soutien juridique global au Royaume-Uni et en Irlande en vue d'assurer que Roche atteigne ses objectifs et gère correctement les risques juridiques (pour tenir compte des lois et règlements relatifs (mais non limités) au droit de la concurrence, au droit commercial, à la protection des données, au marketing et à la publicité, à la législation anti-corruption, aux litiges et aux litiges).
• Leadership en matière d'éthique et de conformité : Veiller à ce que l'entreprise, ses employés et ses organismes fonctionnent de façon éthique et conforme au Code de conduite du Groupe Roche.
• Soutien à la R-D et aux essais cliniques : Fournir des conseils juridiques proactifs aux équipes de R-D mondiales et locales. Cela comprend des conseils sur la réglementation des essais cliniques, l'examen et la négociation d'accords d'essais cliniques.
• Projet et exécution commerciale: Soutenir l'entreprise pour s'assurer que les activités sont à la fois commercialement saines et conformes à la loi.
• Analyse de l'horizon et atténuation des risques : Identifier les risques et les possibilités découlant des changements législatifs et veiller à ce que les principaux aspects juridiques soient pris en compte dans les processus de planification et de décision.
• Harmonisation des activités : Assurer l'harmonisation et l'adhésion dans tous les domaines d'activité pertinents pour toutes les questions juridiques.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Veiller à ce que les outils juridiques, les modèles de documents et les ententes soient maintenus et refléter tout changement dans les pratiques commerciales et les lois et règlements pertinents. Qui vous êtes :
• Qualifications: Vous êtes un avocat qualifié en Angleterre et au Pays de Galles.
• Expertise fondamentale: Vous possédez une solide connaissance pratique des lois britanniques sur la protection des données (RGPD) et du droit pharmaceutique commercial britannique. Vous êtes à l'aise d'examiner et de négocier des ententes et de fournir un soutien quotidien à diverses unités commerciales.
• Expérience de l'industrie (qualifications requises): Expérience antérieure dans le domaine des sciences de la vie ou de l'industrie pharmaceutique, avec une compréhension complète des cadres juridiques britanniques et irlandais, du RGPD britannique et des normes pertinentes de conformité en matière de soins de santé (par exemple, lignes directrices du Code ABPI).
• Compétences souhaitables : La connaissance ou l'expérience des règlements sur les instruments médicaux et des lois sur la santé numérique (comme les règlements sur les instruments médicaux du Royaume-Uni, les cadres de marquage CE/UKCA ou les directives sur les logiciels en tant que dispositifs médicaux) n'est pas obligatoire, mais serait un plus.
• Collaboration inclusive : Favoriser une culture diversifiée et performante en comblant les frontières géographiques et fonctionnelles, en résolvant les conflits et en favorisant l'unité des équipes.
• Communication et influence impactées: Simplifie clairement les concepts juridiques complexes tout en inspirant l'organisation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Enterprise Architect Il Principal Enterprise Architect fornisce una supervisione architettonica essenziale, una leadership visionaria e una guida strategica in un ampio contesto Cross-Domain. In questo ruolo altamente impattante, si prenderanno i temi più complessi e interfunzionali che abbracciano più aree di business e tecnologia. Un focus significativo del vostro mandato sarà l'architettura "RDT as a Business" (Informatics Domain), il trattamento della nostra organizzazione interna Roche Digital Technology come linea di business critica. Il vostro scopo comprenderà anche altre iniziative di impresa che vanno oltre RDT. Potrai guidare gli altri nella risoluzione di problemi e problemi altamente complessi che hanno implicazioni diffuse sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi interfunzionali. Descrizione della zona La funzione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Enterprise Architecture forma, allinea ed esegue la strategia tecnologica collegando l'ambizione aziendale agli investimenti, all'architettura e alla consegna. Per questo ruolo specifico, un dominio primario è Informatics (soggetto RDT), insieme ad altri complessi domini cross-enterprise. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i leader operativi, l'Ufficio Trasformazione, l'Eccellenza RDT e la Gestione Portfolio per stabilire un modello operativo moderno e integrato. Questo settore assicura che le operazioni siano costruite sulla generazione delle informazioni e aderiscano agli standard del settore (ad esempio IT4IT, ITIL), stabilendo un robusto supporto architettonico per iniziative strategiche interne e interfunzionali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Architettare la North Star per "RDT as a Business": Definire architetture e modelli di funzionalità target-state per le operazioni interne di RDT. Prendere la proprietà di definire ed evolvere l'applicazione RDT e il paesaggio tecnologico e il modello di dati, garantendo un solido supporto di architettura per iniziative interne strategiche.
• Ottimizzazione del Modello Operativo: supporta attivamente l'evoluzione del Modello Operativo e integra i suoi elementi (ad esempio Strategia, Portfolio, Consegna, Operazioni). Spostare l'organizzazione verso Data-Driven Portfolio Management e Agile, AI abilitato Consegna e Operazioni, garantendo il collegamento ai nostri asset di paesaggio IT esistenti e fornendo tracciabilità.
• Architettura Governance & Standards ("Enable & Govern"): Guidare la governance dell'architettura per il dominio Informatics e guidare l'allineamento cross-domain attraverso Information, Technology, Business e Application Architecture. Fornire chiarezza, "strada asfaltata", e guardrails che consentono velocità ed efficacia nella consegna piuttosto che creare attrito burocratico.
• Tackling Complex Cross-Functional Topics: Guide squadra a matrice nel risolvere i problemi interfunzionali più complessi con ampie implicazioni sui processi e sui risultati organizzativi. Agire come il piombo architettonico per le principali iniziative cross-domain che vanno oltre una singola funzione, garantendo architetture coessive target in tutta l'impresa.
• Cross-Domain Coherence & Technical Debt Management: condurre rigorose valutazioni di impatto architettonico per iniziative cross-domain. Gestione attiva del debito tecnico e supporto Future State Architecture semplificando sistematicamente il paesaggio delle applicazioni, disattivando i sistemi ridondanti e stabilendo la governance per prevenire la complessità futura.
• Trasparenza Data-Driven: Promuovere la filosofia che il valore dell'architettura è misurato da decisioni migliori e risultati di consegna. Sfrutta la nostra catena di strumenti di architettura integrata (ArchiMEDES) per fornire i critici architettonici

Pour ce rôle spécifique, un domaine principal est l'informatique (champ d'application du RDT), ainsi que d'autres domaines interentreprises complexes. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les chefs de file opérationnels, le Bureau de la transformation, l'excellence en RDT et la gestion de portefeuille pour établir un modèle opérationnel moderne et intégré. Ce domaine garantit que les opérations sont fondées sur la production de renseignements et qu'elles respectent les normes de l'industrie (p. ex. IT4IT, ITIL), en établissant un solide soutien à l'architecture pour les initiatives stratégiques internes et interfonctionnelles. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Architecting the North Star for "RDT as a Business": Définir les architectures d'état cible et les modèles de capacité pour les opérations internes de RDT. S'approprier la définition et l'évolution du modèle d'application et de technologie RDT Paysage et données, en assurant un solide soutien en architecture pour les initiatives internes stratégiques.

Déplacer l'organisation vers la gestion de portefeuille axée sur les données et Agile, l'IA a permis la livraison et les opérations, assurant la connexion à nos actifs informatiques existants et assurant la traçabilité.
• Gouvernance et normes de l'architecture (« Enable & Govern ») : Diriger la gouvernance de l'architecture dans le domaine de l'informatique et favoriser l'alignement interdomaines dans l'architecture de l'information, de la technologie, des affaires et des applications. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are a high-performing cybersecurity team tasked with protecting the organization’s computing environments. While our historical stronghold has been managing enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure, we are now expanding our focus to secure our dynamic, cloud-native environments.
We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer specializing in Cloud Workload Protection. You will be responsible for securing IaaS, PaaS, containers, and serverless architectures. Working alongside your senior endpoint security colleagues, you will bridge the gap between traditional endpoint defense and modern cloud infrastructure, ensuring our threat detection and application governance standards are seamlessly extended to the cloud.

Job Responsibilities

• Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP): Architect, deploy, and manage Cloud Workload Protection Platforms ( e.g., Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Wiz, or Aqua) across our multi-cloud environment ( AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).

• Container & Kubernetes Security: Implement runtime defense, vulnerability scanning, and configuration hardening for containerized applications and orchestration platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE).

• Extending Core Services to the Cloud: Adapt our existing strategies for EDR and Application Control to function effectively in ephemeral, cloud-native workloads without degrading performance.

• DevSecOps Integration: Embed security controls directly into CI/CD pipelines (Shift-Left), ensuring images, registries, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates are scanned and secured before deployment.

• Automated Remediation: Develop automated response playbooks for cloud misconfigurations and workload alerts using serverless functions and native cloud APIs.

Qualifications
Education / Experience / Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of dedicated experience securing public cloud workloads, with a strong understanding of the shared responsibility model.

• Deep technical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. You should know how to secure a pod, restrict container privileges, and manage network policies.

• Proven, hands-on experience deploying and tuning commercial or open-source cloud security platforms (CWPP / CNAPP).

• Strong grasp of cloud-native networking (VPCs, Security Groups) and Identity and Access Management (least-privilege roles, service accounts).

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Additional Qualifications

• Bridge Builder: Ability to collaborate closely with DevOps and Cloud Engineering teams, acting as an enabler rather than a roadblock.

• Strategic Thinker: Capacity to look at our existing on-premise security policies and intelligently adapt them for ephemeral cloud environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a highly dynamic cybersecurity environment where priorities can shift based on emerging needs.

• Team Player: Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external team mates and stakeholders.

• Mentorship: Willingness to cross-train our existing senior endpoint engineers on cloud-native security concepts, while learning from their deep endpoint telemetry expertise.

• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Sicherung von Public Cloud-Workloads mit einem starken Verständnis des Shared Responsibility-Modells.

• Bewährte praktische Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung und Abstimmung kommerzieller oder Open-Source-Cloud-Sicherheitsplattformen (CWPP / CNAPP).
• Starkes Verständnis von Cloud-nativen Netzwerken (VPCs, Sicherheitsgruppen) und Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement (Least-Privilege-Rollen, Service-Accounts).
• Kenntnisse in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch (C1 oder höher). Zusätzliche Qualifikationen
• Bridge Builder: Die Fähigkeit, eng mit DevOps- und Cloud-Engineering-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und nicht als Hindernis, sondern als Enabler zu fungieren.
• Strategischer Denker: Fähigkeit, unsere bestehenden On-Premise-Sicherheitsrichtlinien zu betrachten und sie intelligent an ephemere Cloud-Umgebungen anzupassen.
• Anpassbar: Komfortables Arbeiten in einer hochdynamischen Cybersicherheitsumgebung, in der sich die Prioritäten je nach Bedarf ändern können.
• Teamplayer: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit internen und externen Teamkollegen und Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:
This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.
In this role, you will engage in cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance, Device MSAT, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmaceutical Development, Clinical, and Commercial teams.

• Serve as the Technical Project Lead or Subject Matter Expert to drive the robust development of combination products and medical devices, ensuring a seamless advancement into clinical phases and commercial market applications.

• Apply deep engineering expertise and strategic insights, establish robust technical product requirements and develop drug-device combination product design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products while ensuring high performance, design robustness and fostering innovation.

• Lead internal and external technical investigations to swiftly resolve complex, design-related issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Author and manage comprehensive design control documentation - including Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications (URS), Design Inputs/Outputs, Verification/Validation Plans, conformity assessments, and risk management files.

• Navigate the global regulatory landscape to ensure all product designs and processes comply with industry standards, specifically ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR Part 820 (with an emphasis on 820.30 Design Controls).

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 10+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Strong background in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery.

• Proven technical leadership and advanced problem-solving capabilities in cross-functional team environments.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:
This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.

• Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products while ensuring high performance, design robustness and fostering innovation.

• Lead internal and external technical investigations to swiftly resolve complex, design-related issues using structured problem-solving methodologies.

• Author and manage comprehensive design control documentation - including Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications (URS), Design Inputs/Outputs, Verification/Validation Plans, conformity assessments, and risk management files.

• Navigate the global regulatory landscape to ensure all product designs and processes comply with industry standards, specifically ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR Part 820 (with an emphasis on 820.30 Design Controls).

Who you are:

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 10+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Hands-on expertise in pen injector and autoinjector development throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Strong background in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery.

• Proven technical leadership and advanced problem-solving capabilities in cross-functional team environments.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

• Deep knowledge of regulations, industry sta

• Universitätsabschluss (BSc oder MSc) in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin von einer akkreditierten Institution.
• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Maschinenbau und in der Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln in pharmazeutischen oder stark regulierten Umgebungen (cGxP, QSR).
