A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, crediamo che ogni paziente meriti un viaggio di cura personalizzato. Roche Information Solutions (RIS) è all'avanguardia nel campo della salute digitale, sviluppando soluzioni software all'avanguardia che trasformano la cura dei pazienti trasformando i dati complessi in insight medici attuabili. Stiamo cercando un visionario Clinician Centered Disease Management Lifecycle Leader per unire il nostro team. In questo ruolo, si sarà campione di un portafoglio critico di strumenti clinici che consentono ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria di fornire medicina di precisione e prendere decisioni salvavita ogni giorno. La posizione Come Leader del ciclo di vita, detenerai l'accountability commerciale end-to-end e la piena proprietà P&L per il nostro portafoglio di prodotti digitali a livello clinico. Potrai colmare il divario tra la visione strategica a lungo termine e l'esecuzione quotidiana, modellando la roadmap del prodotto e portando un team altamente performante di Product Manager per fornire risultati significativi per i sistemi sanitari e pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il vostro portafoglio comprende soluzioni di punta come navify Clinical Hub (nCH) , navify Mutation Profiler (nMP) , e navify Cervical Cancer Screening (nCCS) . Potrai agire come collaboratore chiave in tutta l'organizzazione, collaborando a stretto contatto con RIS Go-to-Market (GTM), Foundation Medicine (FMI), e i team molecolari RDS per scalare il nostro impatto e integrare senza soluzione di continuità software con la nostra diagnostica molecolare e sequenziamento hardware. • Guidare la strategia commerciale di overarching e le prestazioni finanziarie, tenendo la responsabilità completa per il portafoglio P&L e risultati aziendali.
• Formulare e implementare proposte di valore congiunte e strategie di ingresso commerciale per il mercato statunitense e i territori globali.
• Traduci obiettivi strategici complessi in obiettivi chiari e attuabili per i team di prodotto, favorendo un ambiente autonomo focalizzato sulla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Campione la visione e i principi del prodotto centrale stabiliti dalla leadership, comunicando attivamente il "perché" al vostro team e l'organizzazione più ampia. Eccellenza del prodotto e collaborazione
• Guidare il ciclo di vita degli strumenti clinici, garantendo una gestione del mercato di successo, con un focus specifico sul supporto e l'espansione dell'APAC e dei mercati globali.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con il team molecolare RDS per promuovere opportunità di integrazione commerciale e tecnologica che coinvolgono il portafoglio Avenio e il sequencer Axelios.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con Foundation Medicine sulle offerte e la collaborazione di Precision Oncology potenziate
• Monitorare e segnalare le metriche principali delle prestazioni del prodotto, la ricezione del mercato e il feedback globale della filiale direttamente alla leadership executive.
• Ottimizzare costantemente i processi organizzativi per elevare standard di qualità ed efficienza nel vostro ciclo di vita. Persone & Lifecycle Coaching
• Agire come un leader-coach dedicato, priorizzare il reclutamento, la mentorship e il continuo upskilling del vostro team Product Management.
• I team di guida nelle pratiche avanzate di scoperta dei prodotti, aiutandoli a effettuare trade-off strategici e focalizzati sui clienti in ambienti clinici altamente complessi.
• Struttura flussi di lavoro interfunzionali e ottimizzare la topologia del team per ridurre drasticamente le dipendenze organizzative e muoversi più velocemente.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer wir sind Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Patient eine personalisierte Pflegereise verdient. Roche Information Solutions (RIS) steht an der Spitze des digitalen Gesundheitswesens und entwickelt innovative Softwarelösungen, die die Patientenversorgung durch die Umwandlung komplexer Daten in umsetzbare medizinische Erkenntnisse transformieren. Wir suchen einen visionären Clinician Centered Disease Management Lifecycle Leader, der unserem Team beitritt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie sich für ein kritisches Portfolio von klinikorientierten Tools einsetzen, die Gesundheitsdienstleister in die Lage versetzen, Präzisionsmedizin zu liefern und jeden Tag lebensrettende Entscheidungen zu treffen. Die Position Als Lifecycle-Leader haben Sie eine durchgängige kommerzielle Verantwortung und volles P&L-Eigentum für unser klinikorientiertes digitales Produktportfolio. Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen langfristiger strategischer Vision und täglicher Umsetzung, gestalten die Produkt-Roadmap und führen ein leistungsstarkes Team von Produktmanagern, um aussagekräftige Ergebnisse für Gesundheitssysteme und Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Ihr Portfolio umfasst Flaggschiff-Lösungen wie navify Clinical Hub (nCH), navify Mutation Profiler (nMP) und navify Cervical Cancer Screening (nCCS). Sie werden als wichtiger Mitarbeiter im gesamten Unternehmen tätig sein und eng mit RIS Go-to-Market (GTM), Foundation Medicine (FMI) und den RDS Molecular-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um unsere Auswirkungen zu skalieren und Software nahtlos in unsere Hardware für molekulare Diagnostik und Sequenzierung zu integrieren. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben Strategische Führung & P&L Ownership
• Führen Sie die übergreifende Geschäftsstrategie und die finanzielle Performance voran und halten Sie die vollständige Rechenschaftspflicht für Portfolio-P & L und Geschäftsergebnisse.
• Formulieren und implementieren Sie gemeinsame Wertversprechen und kommerzielle Einstiegsstrategien für den US-Markt und globale Territorien.
• Übersetzen Sie komplexe strategische Ziele in klare, umsetzbare Ziele für Produktteams und fördern Sie eine autonome Umgebung, die sich auf die Problemlösung konzentriert.
• Verfechten Sie die zentrale Produktvision und die von der Führung festgelegten Prinzipien und kommunizieren Sie Ihrem Team und der gesamten Organisation aktiv das "Warum". Product Excellence & Zusammenarbeit
• Führen Sie den Lebenszyklus von klinikorientierten Tools, um ein erfolgreiches On-Market-Management zu gewährleisten, mit besonderem Fokus auf der Unterstützung und dem Ausbau der APAC- und globalen Märkte.
• Enge Partnerschaft mit dem RDS Molecular-Team, um kommerzielle und technologische Integrationsmöglichkeiten mit dem Avenio-Portfolio und dem Axelios-Sequenzierer voranzutreiben.

jobs.title: Senior Safety Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)

• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.

• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.

• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).

• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.

• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).

• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data.

Who you are:

• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;

• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.

• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence, with and without authority, in a global matrix envir

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La nostra organizzazione di sicurezza clinica è dedicata a fornire miglioramenti significativi ai pazienti attraverso terapie medicalmente differenziate. In questo ruolo, forniremo un supporto essenziale per la scienza della sicurezza e la farmacovigilanza alle molecole in tutto il portafoglio Roche, garantendo i più elevati standard di sicurezza dei partecipanti e affidabilità dei dati. In qualità di Senior Safety Director di Roche, sarai un leader esperto e strategico riconosciuto nella sicurezza della droga, guidando la strategia di sicurezza per le nostre molecole più complesse, costruendo la capacità organizzativa nell'organizzazione di sicurezza clinica. Potrai fornire un mentore esperto ai colleghi, condurre presentazioni di alto livello di regolamentazione, e rappresentare le competenze di sicurezza di Roche alle autorità di regolamentazione, comitati di governance e leadership senior. Questo ruolo combina competenze tecniche profonde con l'influenza strategica. • Conduce lo sviluppo della strategia di sicurezza fornendo input in programmi di sviluppo clinico, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), scheda di valutazione della tecnologia sanitaria (HTA) e strategie di lancio.
• Fornisce input di sicurezza critico per informare il processo decisionale sui piani di sviluppo clinico e sui progetti di studio individuali. Fornisce inoltre una supervisione necessaria e una revisione esperta per i componenti di sicurezza delle sottomissioni delle autorità di regolamentazione (ad esempio, IND, NDA, MAA).
• Influenza principali stakeholder (ad esempio, team di sviluppo triade o cross-funzionale, leader normativo, questioni mediche). Chi sei:
• Professionista sanitario qualificato o laureato in Scienze della Vita e un minimo di 10+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo della droga in industria farmaceutica o relativa, tra cui almeno 5 anni in sicurezza della droga; comprensione a livello di esperti degli aspetti scientifici di sicurezza, farmacovigilanza, e la gestione del rischio clinico / paziente con la conoscenza dimostrabile dei requisiti GVP, GCP e CTR;
• 10+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo di farmaci clinici nell'industria biofarmaceutica o in un settore relativo (ad esempio accademia; CRO; ecc); preferibilmente compreso almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo relativo alla sicurezza della droga clinica.
• Dimostrare la comprensione esperta degli aspetti scientifici della sicurezza, della gestione del rischio fotovoltaico e clinico/paziente (ad esempio attraverso la conoscenza dimostrabile dell'applicazione dei requisiti GVP, GCP & CTR) è essenziale.
• Capacità dimostrata di condurre e influenzare, con e senza autorità, in una matrice globale invir

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche bringen wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unsere Organisation für klinische Sicherheit widmet sich der Bereitstellung sinnvoller Verbesserungen für Patienten durch medizinisch differenzierte Therapien. In dieser Funktion unterstützen Sie die Moleküle in der Sicherheitswissenschaft und Pharmakovigilanz im gesamten Roche-Portfolio und gewährleisten die höchsten Standards für die Sicherheit und Datenzuverlässigkeit der Teilnehmer. Als Senior Safety Director bei Roche sind Sie ein anerkannter Experte und strategischer Marktführer für Arzneimittelsicherheit, der die Sicherheitsstrategie für unsere komplexesten Moleküle vorantreibt und gleichzeitig organisatorische Fähigkeiten in der gesamten Organisation für klinische Sicherheit aufbaut. Sie bieten Kollegen eine fachkundige Betreuung, leiten hochkarätige regulatorische Einreichungen und vertreten die Sicherheitsexpertise von Roche gegenüber Regulierungsbehörden, Governance-Ausschüssen und Führungskräften. Diese Rolle verbindet tiefes technisches Know-how mit strategischem Einfluss. Dies ist die perfekte Gelegenheit für einen Sicherheitsführer, der bereit ist, die Zukunft der Arzneimittelentwicklung zu gestalten und organisatorische Exzellenz voranzutreiben. Die Gelegenheit:
• Übernimmt die Führung bei der Definition, dem Besitz, dem Fortschritt und der Führung der definierten Sicherheitsstrategie für ihre Programme
• Verantwortlich für die Etablierung und Aufrechterhaltung der Unternehmensposition zum Sicherheitsprofil und die Gestaltung der proaktiven Patientenrisikokommunikation und Risikomanagementstrategie.
• Muss eine objektive und neutrale Position als Sicherheitsexperte bieten, auch wenn es um widersprüchliche Geschäftsprioritäten oder Standpunkte geht.
• Ist der fachkundige Inhaltsüberprüfer für Sicherheitsaspekte und muss für die Entscheidungsfindung im Sicherheitsprofil während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus konsultiert werden (z. B. Aktualisierungen der Prüferbroschüre (IB) / Sicherheitskennzeichnung, Integrierter Sicherheitsmanagementplan / Risikomanagementplan (RMP)).
• Führt die Entwicklung der Sicherheitsstrategie durch Eingabe in klinische Entwicklungsprogramme, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Dossier und Startstrategien.
• Bietet kritische Sicherheitsinformationen, um die Entscheidungsfindung über klinische Entwicklungspläne und individuelle Studiendesigns zu informieren. Bietet auch die erforderliche Aufsicht und Expertenüberprüfung für Sicherheitskomponenten von Zulassungsanträgen (z. B. IND, NDA, MAA).
• Beeinflusst wichtige Stakeholder (z. B. Triaden- oder funktionsübergreifende Entwicklungsteams, Regulatory Leader, Medical Affairs). Arbeitet eng mit PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) zusammen, um die Ergebnisse der klinischen Sicherheit zu erfüllen und die medizinische und wissenschaftliche Interpretation neuer klinischer und nichtklinischer Sicherheitsdaten bereitzustellen. Wer du bist:
• Qualifiziertes medizinisches Fachpersonal oder Absolvent der Biowissenschaften und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Arzneimittelentwicklung in der pharmazeutischen oder verwandten Industrie, davon mindestens 5 Jahre in der Arzneimittelsicherheit; Expertenwissen über wissenschaftliche Aspekte der Sicherheit, Pharmakovigilanz und klinisches / Patientenrisikomanagement mit nachweisbaren Kenntnissen der GVP-, GCP- und CTR-Anforderungen;
• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung klinischer Arzneimittel in der biopharmazeutischen Industrie oder einem verwandten Sektor (z. B. Wissenschaft, CRO usw.); vorzugsweise mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Funktion im Zusammenhang mit der Sicherheit klinischer Arzneimittel.
• Ein fachkundiges Verständnis der wissenschaftlichen Aspekte des Sicherheits-, PV- und klinischen / Patientenrisikomanagements (z. B. durch nachweisbare Kenntnisse der Anwendung von GVP-, GCP- und CTR-Anforderungen) ist unerlässlich.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, mit und ohne Autorität in einer globalen Matrixumgebung zu führen und zu beeinflussen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre organisation de sécurité clinique se consacre à apporter des améliorations significatives aux patients grâce à des thérapies médicales différenciées. Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez aux molécules du portefeuille Roche un soutien essentiel en matière de sécurité et de pharmacovigilance, assurant ainsi les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité des participants et de fiabilité des données. En tant que directeur principal de la sécurité chez Roche, vous serez un expert reconnu et un chef de file stratégique dans le domaine de la sécurité des médicaments. Vous offrirez un mentorat d'expert à vos collègues, dirigerez des présentations réglementaires à haut niveau et représenterez l'expertise de Roche en matière de sécurité auprès des organismes de réglementation, des comités de gouvernance et des cadres supérieurs. Ce rôle combine une expertise technique approfondie avec une influence stratégique. C'est l'occasion idéale pour un leader de la sécurité prêt à façonner l'avenir du développement des médicaments et à stimuler l'excellence organisationnelle. La possibilité :
• Prend l'initiative de définir, de posséder, de progresser et d'orienter la stratégie de sécurité définie pour leurs programmes
• Responsable de l'établissement et du maintien de la position de l'entreprise sur le profil de sécurité et de l'élaboration de la stratégie proactive de communication et de gestion des risques pour les patients.
• Doit fournir une position objective et neutre en tant que professionnel de la sécurité, même lorsqu'il fait face à des priorités ou des points de vue commerciaux contradictoires.
• Est l'examinateur expert du contenu pour les aspects de sécurité et doit être consulté pour la prise de décision sur le profil de sécurité tout au long du cycle de vie du produit (p. ex. mises à jour de la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB)/étiquette de sécurité, Plan de gestion de la sécurité intégrée/Plan de gestion des risques (PGR)).
• Dirige l'élaboration de la stratégie de sécurité en fournissant une contribution aux programmes de développement clinique, aux profils de produits cibles (PPT), aux plans de données probantes intégrées (PEI), au dossier d'évaluation des technologies de la santé (AST) et aux stratégies de lancement.
• Fournit des données essentielles sur l'innocuité pour éclairer la prise de décisions sur les plans de développement clinique et les plans d'études individuels. Fournit également la surveillance et l'examen d'experts nécessaires pour les composantes de sécurité des présentations d'autorités réglementaires (p. ex., IND, NDA, AAM).
• Influence sur les intervenants clés (p. ex., équipes de développement triade ou interfonctionnelle, chef de la réglementation, affaires médicales). Collabore étroitement avec le SCP (Portfolio Clinical Safety) afin de répondre aux attentes en matière d'innocuité clinique et de fournir une interprétation médicale et scientifique des nouvelles données cliniques et non cliniques sur l'innocuité. Qui vous êtes :
• un professionnel de la santé qualifié ou un diplômé en sciences de la vie et un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience en développement de médicaments dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou l'industrie connexe, y compris au moins 5 ans en sécurité des médicaments; une compréhension par des experts des aspects scientifiques de l'innocuité, de la pharmacovigilance et de la gestion des risques cliniques/patients avec une connaissance démontrable des exigences en matière de VPH, de PCG et de RCT;
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en développement de médicaments cliniques dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique ou dans un secteur connexe (p. ex. les universités, les ORC, etc.); de préférence, inclure au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle lié à l'innocuité des médicaments cliniques.
• Il est essentiel de démontrer que les experts comprennent les aspects scientifiques de la sécurité, du VP et de la gestion des risques cliniques/patients (p. ex., par une connaissance démontrable de l'application des exigences en matière de VPG, de PCG et de RTC).
• Capacité démontrée de diriger et d'influencer, avec et sans autorité, dans une matrice globale environnementale

Notre organisation de sécurité clinique se consacre à apporter des améliorations significatives aux patients grâce à des thérapies médicales différenciées. En tant que directeur médical principal en matière de sécurité chez Roche, vous serez un expert reconnu et un chef de file stratégique en matière de sécurité des médicaments, conduisant une stratégie de sécurité pour nos molécules les plus complexes tout en renforçant la capacité organisationnelle de l'organisation en matière de sécurité clinique. Vous offrirez un mentorat d'expert à vos collègues, dirigerez des présentations réglementaires à haut niveau et représenterez l'expertise de Roche en matière de sécurité auprès des organismes de réglementation, des comités de gouvernance et des cadres supérieurs. Ce rôle combine une expertise technique approfondie avec une influence stratégique. C'est l'occasion idéale pour un leader de la sécurité prêt à façonner l'avenir du développement des médicaments et à stimuler l'excellence organisationnelle. La possibilité :
• Prend l'initiative de définir, de posséder, de progresser et d'orienter la stratégie de sécurité définie pour leurs programmes
• Responsable de l'établissement et du maintien de la position de l'entreprise sur le profil de sécurité et de l'élaboration de la stratégie proactive de communication et de gestion des risques pour les patients.
• Doit fournir une position objective et neutre en tant que professionnel de la sécurité, même lorsqu'il fait face à des priorités ou des points de vue commerciaux contradictoires.
• Est l'examinateur expert du contenu pour les aspects de sécurité et doit être consulté pour la prise de décision sur le profil de sécurité tout au long du cycle de vie du produit (p. ex. mises à jour de la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB)/étiquette de sécurité, Plan de gestion de la sécurité intégrée/Plan de gestion des risques (PGR)).
• Dirige l'élaboration de la stratégie de sécurité en fournissant une contribution aux programmes de développement clinique, aux profils de produits cibles (PPT), aux plans de données probantes intégrées (PEI), au dossier d'évaluation des technologies de la santé (AST) et aux stratégies de lancement.
• Fournit des données essentielles sur l'innocuité pour éclairer la prise de décisions sur les plans de développement clinique et les plans d'études individuels. Fournit également la surveillance et l'examen d'experts nécessaires pour les composantes de sécurité des présentations d'autorités réglementaires (p. ex., IND, NDA, AAM).
• Influence sur les intervenants clés (p. ex., équipes de développement triade ou interfonctionnelle, chef de la réglementation, affaires médicales). Collabore étroitement avec le SCP (Portfolio Clinical Safety) afin de répondre aux attentes en matière d'innocuité clinique et de fournir une interprétation médicale et scientifique des nouvelles données cliniques et non cliniques sur l'innocuité. Responsabilités liées aux qualifications médicales :
• Interpréter les nouvelles données d'innocuité dans le contexte de l'expérience clinique en médecine et définir les questions/questions d'innocuité nécessitant des évaluations spécifiques de l'innocuité clinique médicale.
• Effectuer des évaluations de l'impact de la pratique médicale sur la qualité des produits.
• Déterminer l'impact clinique potentiel des résultats non cliniques sur l'innocuité et interpréter les risques associés au produit.
• Conseiller et interpréter la façon dont les risques peuvent influer sur l'équilibre entre les risques et les avantages cliniques, compte tenu de la pratique clinique réelle.
• Faire des évaluations médicales officielles de l'entreprise concernant la relation causale entre les événements signalés et le traitement (p. ex., pour les rapports individuels sur la sécurité des cas).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Project Leader , serás responsable de generar una experiencia de cliente superior desde tu experiencia en gestión de proyectos, logrando implementar soluciones integrales que garanticen la máxima satisfacción, fidelización del cliente y la rentabilidad de nuestro negocio. En este rol dentro de la división de Diagnóstica (DIA), actuarás como el orquestador técnico y operativo que planifica, ejecuta y asegura la puesta en marcha de proyectos de mayor envergadura y complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Orquestar la implementación: Planificar, coordinar y ejecutar la instalación de sistemas de diagnóstico de mediana y gran envergadura.

• Co-diseñar la estrategia: Validar las propuestas técnicas y económicas junto a los equipos de Comercial, Estrategia y Servicio Técnico.

• Optimizar recursos: Gestionar tiempos, costos y presupuestos en conjunto con los KAMs de Servicio y Líderes de línea.

• Asegurar la cadena de suministro: Monitorear el abastecimiento de instrumentos, reactivos y repuestos junto al área de Importaciones.

• Mitigar riesgos: Diseñar y ejecutar planes de contingencia eficaces ante desvíos en el cronograma.

• Comunicación y Control: Controlar el avance del proyecto, reportar los estados a los clientes (internos/externos) y mantener los KPIs actualizados.

Who you are

• Formación: Profesional titulado en áreas de la Salud (Tecnología Médica, Bioquímica, Biomédica o carreras afines) o Ingeniería (Civil, Electrónica, Industrial o carreras afines).

• Experiencia (Excluyente): Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en laboratorios clínicos, gestión de clientes e implementación de proyectos en el sector salud.

• Project Management: Experiencia demostrable en gestión de proyectos complejos, idealmente bajo metodología del PMI o metodologías ágiles.

• Herramientas: Dominio de Microsoft Project, Microsoft Excel, Monday.com o plataformas afines de análisis de datos y gestión de proyectos.

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (lectura técnica y comunicación operativa).

• Habilidades blandas: Orientación al cliente, autonomía, negociación y adaptabilidad al modelo de liderazgo VACC (Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach y Catalizador).

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Local Quality Responsible
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As the Local Quality Responsible, you will lead and shape the strategic and operational performance of our Local Quality Management System (QMS). In this role, you will champion a robust quality culture, ensuring our clinical and pharmacovigilance activities consistently align with global standards and local regulatory requirements. You will serve as a strategic partner to leadership, driving continuous improvement and proactive risk management to deliver safe, high-quality solutions for patients.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the Affiliate Quality Management System (QMS): Direct the operational execution of our Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) quality standards, ensuring compliance with local regulations.

• Champion a Culture of Quality: Partner closely with local and international leadership teams to promote compliance, manage institutional risks, and drive regular Management Review processes.

• Oversee Audit & Inspection Readiness: Act as the primary point of contact for clinical and pharmacovigilance audits and Health Authority inspections, leading local coordination and response strategies.

• Drive Continuous Improvement & CAPA: Facilitate root-cause analyses, manage the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process, and address process deviations swiftly and effectively.

• Manage Strategic Service Providers: Oversee external GCP/GVP vendors by establishing robust monitoring plans, regular risk assessments, and performance evaluations.

• Empower Through Training: Establish and maintain local training frameworks to ensure all relevant personnel are fully equipped and compliant with core global standards.

Who You Are
You are a highly motivated quality professional who thrives on collaboration, strategic thinking, and continuous improvement. You possess excellent listening and decision-making skills, with a proven ability to influence teams, build consensus, and navigate challenging compliance landscapes seamlessly.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, or a related field (Advanced degree or specialized quality certification is preferred).

• Experience: 5+ years of professional experience within the biopharmaceutical industry or an equivalent regulated environment.

• Regulatory Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on knowledge of GCP and GVP regulatory requirements, along with experience navigating Health Authority inspections or audits.

• Quality & Risk Systems: Solid understanding of Quality Principles (such as ISO 9001 standards) and proactive Risk Management frameworks.

• Global Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with a track record of effectively managing stakeholders across a matrixed or international organization.

Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Note that a full job description is available at request.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Come Responsabile della Qualità Locale, guiderai e formerai le prestazioni strategiche e operative del nostro Sistema di Gestione della Qualità Locale (QMS). In questo ruolo, sarete campione di una solida cultura della qualità, assicurando le nostre attività cliniche e farmacovigilanza costantemente allineate agli standard globali e ai requisiti normativi locali. Servirete come partner strategico per la leadership, il miglioramento continuo e la gestione del rischio proattivo per fornire soluzioni sicure e di alta qualità per i pazienti. Responsabilità chiave:
• Guidare il sistema di gestione della qualità dell'affiliato (QMS): Dirigere l'esecuzione operativa dei nostri standard di qualità Good Clinical Practice (GCP) e Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), garantendo il rispetto delle normative locali.
• Campione di una Cultura di Qualità: Partner a stretto contatto con i team di leadership locali e internazionali per promuovere la conformità, gestire i rischi istituzionali e guidare i processi regolari di Management Review.
• Superare Audit & Inspection Readiness: Agire come punto di contatto primario per le verifiche cliniche e farmacovigilanza e le ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria, leader strategie di coordinamento e risposta locali.
• Guidare il miglioramento continuo & CAPA: Facilitate analisi causa radice, gestire il processo di azione correttiva e preventiva (CAPA) e affrontare le deviazioni di processo rapidamente ed efficacemente.
• Gestisci i provider di servizi strategici: supervisiona i fornitori esterni di GCP/GVP stabilendo piani di monitoraggio robusti, regolari valutazioni dei rischi e valutazioni delle prestazioni.
• Formazione: Stabilire e mantenere i quadri di formazione locali per garantire che tutto il personale competente sia completamente attrezzato e conforme agli standard globali fondamentali. Chi sei Sei un professionista di qualità altamente motivato che prospera su collaborazione, pensiero strategico e miglioramento continuo. Possiedi eccellenti capacità di ascolto e decision-making, con una comprovata capacità di influenzare i team, costruire il consenso e navigare in contesti di conformità senza soluzione di continuità. Qualificazioni & Esperienza:
• Istruzione: laurea in scienza, biologia, o un campo correlato (La laurea avanzata o certificazione di qualità specializzata è preferito).
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di esperienza professionale nell'industria biofarmaceutica o in un ambiente regolamentato equivalente.
• Competenza normativa: Conoscenze dimostrate a mano sui requisiti normativi GCP e GVP, insieme all'esperienza di navigazione ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria o audit.
• Sistemi di qualità e rischio: solida comprensione dei principi di qualità (come gli standard ISO 9001) e dei sistemi di gestione dei rischi proattivi.
• Global Collaboration: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta in inglese, con un track record di gestione efficace degli stakeholder attraverso un'organizzazione matrice o internazionale. Facciamo prosperare insieme in una cultura costruita sulla fiducia, la collaborazione, il rispetto e le alte prestazioni. Si noti che una descrizione completa del lavoro è disponibile su richiesta. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of the Quality Assurance team, you will be a trusted partner for customers to ensure and improve the overall quality of IT systems throughout their lifecycle. You are a customer-focused, highly collaborative individual who will work with delivery units across both Business and Informatics to advance existing and emerging business-critical technology according to Roche’s needs.

The Opportunity
You will ensure that Roche’s regulated/critical systems and services adhere to regulatory standards (e.g., CSV, GMP, GCP) and regulatory risks are managed adequately to protect Roche's business. By providing automated control insights and streamlined monitoring capabilities, an effective and consistent tracking of Information on Quality Oversight is enabled. Governance and processes are provided to comply with GxP, Data privacy laws, and regulations when processing and hosting Roche data.

• Participate in the development of new standards and the revision of existing standards related to Computer Systems Validation (CSV).

• Assemble global feedback on proposed or existing standards and tools and provide recommendations for new guidance/standards or revisions to existing guidance/standards.

• Provide independent Quality Assurance oversight/support for IT4IT systems (and some business domains) with regard to Computer Systems Validation and other regulatory systems, including merger and acquisition activities.

• Escalate non-compliance against quality standards to the appropriate governance bodies and Risk Management functions for resolution.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT AND PARTNERING:

• Connect and understand the regulatory and compliance needs in the context of the stakeholders and closely partner with them to develop the strategic direction of the product. Shape the Digitalized Compliance roadmap and portfolio to deliver high value outcomes for the customers of the product.

• Define and deliver the product roadmap and manage the end-to-end product lifecycle (including continuously facilitating product discovery), ensuring it delivers tangible and meaningful value aligned with customer needs and expected business outcomes.

IMPACT AND COMPLEXITY

• Define and manage product service levels, governance and operational support model aligned with stakeholder needs.

• Lead or coordinate quality and compliance discussions for pragmatic solutions assuring a quality is everyone’s responsibility mindset.

Who you are:

• You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

• You have a minimum of 5 + years of experience in information technology, data science, quality, or related professional competence.

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset and excels at Product Management practices.

• Takes 'progressive risk'--not thrill-seeking, but risk that leads to opportunity.

• Has a keen Quality & Regulatory Expertise: You are passionate about major technology trends and continuously learning new capabilities (e.g. AI, Cloud, Data Meshes).

• Demonstrates an executive presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manages complexity.

• Understanding of health regulatory frameworks (FDA, EMEA, ISO9001, ISO13485, PIC/s).

• Understanding of risk and control frameworks and quality standards including government guidelines and laws (NIST, HIPAA, GDPR, EU AI Act).

Relocation benefits are available for this job posting.
Must be willing to work onsite in our Indianapolis, Roche location

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients' lives and are bold in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. This is why we come to work each day, committed to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and ensuring access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are seeking a Principal Scientist I to join our Molecular Lab, Research and Early Development Team, Oncology and Genetics. Within the Roche Diagnostics organization, our Research and Early Development teams are committed to making a tangible impact on the future of healthcare. The Principal Scientist I brings technical depth and breadth, curiosity, and the creativity to be an important contributor in developing novel molecular diagnostic assays. The goal will be to build sequencing assays on our revolutionary Axelios Sequencing platform and translating the immense potential of our Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology into real-world assays that can benefit patients. This is a hands-on, lab-based role where scientific excellence and a proactive, results-oriented mindset are paramount. You will spearhead innovative projects and key collaborations, driving the science from the initial idea to a fully realized solution.

This is an opportunity for a visionary scientist to not only pioneer new workflows but to help shape the next generation of medical innovation.

The Opportunity

• You will join a diverse local team of dedicated and curious scientists where you will role-model leadership qualities, mentor junior scientists, and champion a culture of scientific rigor and innovation.

• You will prototype and optimize different sequencing assay workflows by aligning pharma project needs, designing and implementing rigorous experiments, and applying established and innovative procedures to enable end-to-end solutions; You will proactively highlight issues, troubleshoot assays, and resolve technical challenges by applying broad knowledge of molecular biology techniques and accumulated experience

• You will work closely with the commercial team, external pharma partners, and internal bioinformatics colleagues to implement and analyze novel workflows to further pharma collaborations. You'll translate complex data into meaningful interpretations for internal and external stakeholders.

• You will support the adoption of Axelios sequencing technology and the growth of the pharma service business by executing pilot collaboration projects, creating technical documentations including standard operating protocols, and supporting assay transfer to the CLIA laboratory.

• You will identify and champion new technological opportunities, contributing to the strategic direction of the R&D organization.

This position is based on-site (4+ days) in Pleasanton, CA.
There is no relocation support.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD in Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, (or a related field) with 5+ years of relevant industry experience

• You have a deep understanding of molecular biology in NGS workflows beyond routine preparation of sequencing libraries.

• You have demonstrated experience designing and optimizing novel NGS workflows.

• You have demonstrated the ability to critically examine assay workflows and troubleshoot unknown and unfamiliar issues.

• You have experience with diagnostic assay development, including a high level understanding of the regulatory framework for RUO, LDT, or IVD ass

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients' lives and are bold in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. This is why we come to work each day, committed to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and ensuring access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

We are seeking a Principal Scientist I to join our Molecular Lab, Research and Early Development Team, Oncology and Genetics. Within the Roche Diagnostics organization, our Research and Early Development teams are committed to making a tangible impact on the future of healthcare. The Principal Scientist I brings technical depth and breadth, curiosity, and the creativity to be an important contributor in developing novel molecular diagnostic assays. The goal will be to build sequencing assays on our revolutionary Axelios Sequencing platform and translating the immense potential of our Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology into real-world assays that can benefit patients. This is a hands-on, lab-based role where scientific excellence and a proactive, results-oriented mindset are paramount. You will spearhead innovative projects and key collaborations, driving the science from the initial idea to a fully realized solution.

This is an opportunity for a visionary scientist to not only pioneer new workflows but to help shape the next generation of medical innovation.

The Opportunity

• You will join a diverse local team of dedicated and curious scientists where you will role-model leadership qualities, mentor junior scientists, and champion a culture of scientific rigor and innovation.

• You will prototype and optimize different sequencing assay workflows by aligning pharma project needs, designing and implementing rigorous experiments, and applying established and innovative procedures to enable end-to-end solutions; You will proactively highlight issues, troubleshoot assays, and resolve technical challenges by applying broad knowledge of molecular biology techniques and accumulated experience

• You will work closely with the commercial team, external pharma partners, and internal bioinformatics colleagues to implement and analyze novel workflows to further pharma collaborations. You'll translate complex data into meaningful interpretations for internal and external stakeholders.

• You will support the adoption of Axelios sequencing technology and the growth of the pharma service business by executing pilot collaboration projects, creating technical documentations including standard operating protocols, and supporting assay transfer to the CLIA laboratory.

• You will identify and champion new technological opportunities, contributing to the strategic direction of the R&D organization.

This position is based on-site (4+ days) in Pleasanton, CA.
There is no relocation support.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD in Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, (or a related field) with 5+ years of relevant industry experience

• You have a deep understanding of molecular biology in NGS workflows beyond routine preparation of sequencing libraries.

• You have demonstrated experience designing and optimizing novel NGS workflows.

• You have demonstrated the ability to critically examine assay workflows and troubleshoot unknown and unfamiliar issues.

• You have experience with diagnostic assay development, including a high level understanding of the regulatory framework for RUO, LDT, or IVD ass

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a role with a fixed term contract 12 months initially with the possibility to prolong. The employment contract will be concluded via our vendor providing employee lease service.

Are you looking for an opportunity where your work makes a real impact on a healthier future? Join our sales team at Roche d.o.o. as an Account Manager / Product Specialist for Pathology and take on a key role in managing customer relations, sales processes, and professional application support within pathology laboratories.

Travel within Croatia expected: 70 %

The Opportunity

As part of our dynamic sales team, you will be responsible for:

• Key Account Management: Developing long-term relationships with assigned key institutions and driving sales activities in line with the marketing strategy.

• Achieving Sales Targets: Participating in the creation and successful implementation of the annual sales plan for the pathology portfolio.

• Deployment Project Management: Managing the introduction of new analyzers, from gathering data for offers and contracts to coordinating technical installations and tracking customer satisfaction.

• Professional & Application Support: Providing expert support and conducting user training for pathology analyzers to ensure seamless operations for our customers.

• Public Tender Management: Tracking, preparing data, and processing requests for participation in public tenders in cooperation with the Sales Lead and Tender Specialists.

• Collaboration & Administration: Working closely with the Marketing department to execute strategies and maintaining up-to-date activity records in the CRM tool.

Who You Are

You are innovative, driven, and eager to grow with us. You are the ideal candidate if you possess:

• University Degree in Natural Sciences (such as Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Laboratory Biomedicine, Veterinary Medicine, Biology, Microbiology, or related fields)

• Proven (2+ years) working hands-on laboratory experience using molecular biology techniques (e.g. cell isolation or quantitative PCR) OR experience in the marketing and sales of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) medical devices

• Proficient knowledge of the MS Office suite

• Fluency in English (both written and spoken) and the local language at the native level

• Strong agility, a passion for advancing healthcare, a collaborative team spirit, and a high level of integrity and communication skills

• A valid category B driver's license

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Starke Agilität, eine Leidenschaft für die Förderung des Gesundheitswesens, ein kooperativer Teamgeist und ein hohes Maß an Integrität und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
• A gültiger Führerschein der Kategorie B Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. • Connaissance approfondie de la suite MS Office
• Connaissance de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) et de la langue locale au niveau natif

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Global Study Lead is responsible for ensuring that all studies are designed, planned, executed, monitored, closed out and documented in an appropriate manner within the planned timeframe and cost; ensuring that the sponsor responsibilities are fulfilled, while assuring compliance to all applicable regulatory requirements. Responsible for the timeline and budget planning and execution of studies. Assigns and ensures delivery of specific tasks to/from other members of the study team. Provides oversight to outside support including CROs, consultants and/or medical advisors

The Opportunity:

The key accountabilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

• Leads the global study team with full accountability for the study deliverables with respect to quality, budget and timelines, in collaboration with the Study Team and ensures the development of high quality study designs for sponsored studies in collaboration with internal and external experts

• In collaboration with Program Leadership, prepares different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g. study, real-world evidence) in cross-functional collaboration (e.g. with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) to support global strategies and planning of timeline and costs

• Develops key study documents (i.e., Design Validation Plan, protocol, study training materials, study forms and templates, study report)

• Oversees planning and operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by Pharma partners

• Accountable for study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Adherence to regulations, guidelines and standard operating procedures, and ensures audit/inspection readiness.

• Execution of sponsored studies for assigned areas of focus for registrational and/or non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up. conduct and close-out). Oversees study activities outsourced to a service provider (i.e., CRO).

• Ensure that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• Oversees projects to ensure completion on-time, within scope and budget; and tracks project performance to analyze the completion of short and long term goals.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, including CROs, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence.

Who you are:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or related field

• You have 8+ years of experience managing the full lifecycle of sponsored studies, ensuring projects meet performance goals within scope, quality, budget, and timeline.

• You have extensive experience in ensuring that study results are published in collaboration with the Publication Team.

• You have in-depth knowledge and experience in the role of Clinical Operations in product development; are aware of Roche’s place in the market and our value proposition to patients and customers.

• You have experience with PHCS and Companion Diagnostic trials, specifically within pathology and core lab indications

• You have experience managing complex projects by using analytical judgment and innovative thinking to assess risks and so

• osservanza di regolamenti, linee guida e procedure operative standard, e assicura la prontezza di audit/ispezione.
• Esecuzione di studi sponsorizzati per aree di messa a fuoco assegnate per scopi immatricolati e/o non registrativi attraverso tutte le fasi di studio (pianificazione, start-up, condotta e close-out). Supera le attività di studio in outsourced a un fornitore di servizi (cioè, CRO).

• Hai una laurea in Scienze della Vita o campo correlato
• Hai 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita completo degli studi sponsorizzati, assicurando che i progetti soddisfino gli obiettivi di performance entro portata, qualità, budget e timeline.
• Hai una vasta esperienza nel garantire che i risultati dello studio siano pubblicati in collaborazione con il team di pubblicazione.
• Avete una conoscenza approfondita e un’esperienza nel ruolo delle Operazioni Cliniche nello sviluppo dei prodotti; siete consapevoli del posto di Roche nel mercato e della nostra proposta di valore per i pazienti e i clienti.
• Hai esperienza con i test diagnostici PHCS e Companion, specificamente all'interno delle indicazioni di laboratorio di patologia e core
• Hai esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi utilizzando giudizio analitico e pensiero innovativo per valutare i rischi e così

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Der Global Study Lead ist dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass alle Studien in angemessener Weise innerhalb des geplanten Zeitrahmens und der geplanten Kosten entworfen, geplant, durchgeführt, überwacht, abgeschlossen und dokumentiert werden; sicherzustellen, dass die Verantwortlichkeiten des Sponsors erfüllt werden und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung aller geltenden regulatorischen Anforderungen sichergestellt wird. Verantwortlich für die Planung des Zeitplans und des Budgets sowie die Durchführung von Studien. Zuweist und sichert die Lieferung spezifischer Aufgaben an / von anderen Mitgliedern des Studienteams. Bietet Aufsicht für externe Unterstützung, einschließlich CROs, Berater und / oder medizinische Berater Die Gelegenheit: Die wichtigsten Rechenschaftspflichten für diese Position umfassen, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf:
• Leitet das globale Studienteam mit voller Rechenschaftspflicht für die Studienergebnisse in Bezug auf Qualität, Budget und Zeitpläne in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Studienteam und sorgt für die Entwicklung von qualitativ hochwertigen Studiendesigns für gesponserte Studien in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Experten
• In Zusammenarbeit mit Program Leadership werden verschiedene Szenarien für die Evidenzgenerierung (z. B. Studie, Evidenz aus der realen Welt) in funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit (z. B. mit Regulatory Affairs, R&D, CDMA Project Teams) vorbereitet, um globale Strategien und die Planung von Zeitplänen und Kosten zu unterstützen.
• Entwickelt wichtige Studiendokumente (z. B. Entwurfsvalidierungsplan, Protokoll, Studienschulungsmaterialien, Studienformulare und Vorlagen, Studienbericht)
• Beaufsichtigt Planung und operative Aspekte von Begleitdiagnostikstudien, die von Pharma-Partnern gesponsert werden
• Verantwortlich für das Budget der zugewiesenen Studien auf Studienebene.
• Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Standardarbeitsanweisungen und Gewährleistung der Audit- / Inspektionsbereitschaft.
• Durchführung von gesponserten Studien für zugeordnete Schwerpunkte zu Registrierungs- und/oder Nichtregistrierungszwecken durch alle Studienphasen (Planung, Start-up, Durchführung und Close-Out). Überwacht Studienaktivitäten, die an einen Dienstleister (d. H. CRO) ausgelagert werden.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden.
• Überwacht Projekte, um sicherzustellen, dass die Fertigstellung pünktlich, innerhalb des Umfangs und des Budgets erfolgt; und verfolgt die Projektleistung, um die Erreichung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele zu analysieren.
• Aufbau und Pflege starker, kooperativer Beziehungen mit funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften, wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern und anderen Allianzpartnern, einschließlich CROs, bei der Erreichung der Geschäftsziele und der Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz. Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences oder verwandten Bereichen
• Sie haben mehr als 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Lebenszyklus von gesponserten Studien, um sicherzustellen, dass Projekte Leistungsziele in Umfang, Qualität, Budget und Zeitplan erfüllen.
• Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrung darin, sicherzustellen, dass die Studienergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Publikationsteam veröffentlicht werden.
• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Rolle von Clinical Operations in der Produktentwicklung; sind sich des Platzes von Roche auf dem Markt und unseres Wertversprechens für Patienten und Kunden bewusst.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit PHCS und Companion Diagnostic Studien, insbesondere in der Pathologie und Kernlabor Indikationen
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer Projekte durch analytisches Urteilsvermögen und innovatives Denken, um Risiken zu bewerten.

• Desenvolver estratégias com base no diagnóstico de políticas de saúde, ambiente regulatório e tendências de mercado que influenciam o acesso à inovação;

• Liderar a estratégia de acesso ao mercado com foco em valor, incluindo o desenvolvimento de propostas de valor e engajamento de stakeholders;

• Planejar, gerar e disseminar evidências que sustentem as estratégias de acesso e processos de incorporação;

• Colaborar e garantir o alinhamento com diferentes áreas internas e coordenar a implementação das estratégias de precificação, acesso e comunicação de evidências de valor;

• Desenvolver dossiês informativos de preço para submissão à CMED e de ATS para submissões no mercado público (Conitec e SES) e privado (ANS);

• Antecipar e minimizar gargalos nos processos de precificação e incorporação para garantir resultados de sucesso;

• Representar a perspectiva da afiliada em discussões sobre cenário de preço e acesso em fóruns globais.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Farmácia, Engenharia, Biomedicina ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e execução de estratégias de acesso público e privado no Brasil e domínio do ecossistema de saúde e regulação de acesso (ANS, Conitec, CMED); Domínio da legislação de preços CMED, Diretrizes Metodológicas Conitec, Resoluções Normativas referentes à incorporação de medicamentos na ANS; Conhecimento sólido em Economia da Saúde e Medicina Baseada em Evidências

• Colaboração, Habilidades de influência, Planejamento orientado em resultados

• Inglês avançado

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Global Supply Chain organization by maintaining the reliability and performance of the equipment utilized within the Hub Operations Americas group located in Indianapolis.

Your Opportunity

Position’s most important individual tasks:

• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.

• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.

• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.

• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers

• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

Who you are:

Minimum qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years of related experience in maintenance experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates degree, journeyman’s card or equivalent military training related to maintenance of equipment in an industrial setting.

• At least 5 years of experience in technical support and maintenance roles.

• Preferred credentials: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, etc

• Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems. Preferred experience: familiar with conveyor systems and other equipment used within warehouse operations.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, using diagnostic tools, and interpreting equipment manuals and schematics.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, spare parts management, and relevant safety regulations.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing circumstances.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Specialista di Manutenzione, sarete in grado di contribuire a modellare il futuro dell'organizzazione Roche Global Supply Chain mantenendo l'affidabilità e le prestazioni dell'apparecchiatura utilizzata all'interno del gruppo Hub Operations Americas situato a Indianapolis. La tua opportunità Le attività individuali più importanti della posizione:
• Completi compiti di manutenzione preventiva secondo procedure e orari dettagliati.
• Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi elettrici o meccanici per determinare i problemi in attrezzature non funzionanti, utilizzati all'interno di aree di stoccaggio.
• Smantellare, regolare, riparare e assemblare le attrezzature in base ai piani di layout, progetti, manuali operativi o di riparazione, schizzi grezzi, o disegni.
• Utilizzare apparecchiature di prova e diagnostica per eseguire controlli e ricostruire le attrezzature come richiesto.
• Eseguire le modifiche dell'attrezzatura, tra cui l'installazione, il supporto di validazione e l'avvio di nuove attrezzature, così come le attività di decommissioning come diretto da ingegneri
• Utilizzare tecnologie e tecniche di manutenzione predittiva per migliorare le efficienze operative.
• Applicare conoscenze e competenze avanzate per completare incarichi che richiedono giudizio e iniziativa. Capirete le implicazioni del lavoro e fare raccomandazioni per le soluzioni. Riceverai poche istruzioni sulle assegnazioni quotidiane e potrai determinare metodi e procedure su nuovi incarichi. Chi sei: Titolo minimo:
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalenza
• 2+ anni di esperienza relativa nell'esperienza di manutenzione. Preferiti:
• Grado associato, carta del viaggiatore o formazione militare equivalente relativo alla manutenzione di attrezzature in un ambiente industriale.
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nei ruoli di supporto tecnico e manutenzione.
• Preferite credenziali: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, ecc
• Forte conoscenza tecnica e esperienza pratica con sistemi elettrici, meccanici e pneumatici. Esperienza preferita: familiarità con i sistemi di trasporto e altre attrezzature utilizzate nelle operazioni di magazzino.
• La competenza nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella diagnosi di problemi tecnici, utilizzando strumenti diagnostici, e interpretando manuali e schemi.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente tra team interfunzionali e comunicare concetti tecnici agli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Familiarità con programmi di manutenzione preventiva, gestione dei pezzi di ricambio e normative di sicurezza rilevanti.
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente accelerato e orientato alla scadenza, gestione di più priorità e adattamento alle circostanze mutevoli. I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro. Trasparenza salariale L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria di Tucson è 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante. Vantaggi Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo a vicenda per esplorare nuove possibilità

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes interfonctionnelles et de communiquer des concepts techniques aux intervenants non techniques.
• Connaissance des programmes d'entretien préventif, de la gestion des pièces de rechange et des règlements de sécurité pertinents.

jobs.title: Customer Service Support Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
Serás el facilitador clave para garantizar la continuidad operativa y la efi ciencia administrativa de nuestra área de Customer Support. Tu objetivo será gestionar de manera integral el ciclo de vida de los casos, órdenes y activos utilizando las plataformas centrales de la c ompañía (CRM y ERP). Actuarás como el puente entre las necesidades del cliente, el equipo técnico en campo y las áreas de soporte interno, asegurando siempre que los flujos de servicio cumplan con los plazos comerciales y los estrictos estándares regulatorios del sector salud.

Responsabilidades:
Administración del Ciclo de Vida del Servicio (CRM)

• Gestión Integral de Casos: Realizar la apertura, tipificación, asignación, actualización y cierre formal de incidentes, reclamos técnicos, y solicitudes de mantenimiento/reparación.

• Soporte Operativo en Campo: Asignar órdenes de trabajo (WO) al personal técnico y mantener actualizada la disponibilidad del equipo para asegurar la cobertura.

• Actualizaciones de Instrumentos: Registrar y actualizar remotamente datos operativos en los sistemas corporativos (parámetros, perfiles de usuario, actualizaciones de software/firmware).

Control del Flujo de Instalaciones y Logística Inversa (ERP & CRM)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
（高级）治疗领域专员负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
