jobs.title: Data Engineer Intern-CET
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data Engineer Intern Position Overview

• Location: Shanghai, China (Onsite)

• Duration: 3–6 months (Minimum 3 days per week)

• Team: Roche China Data Management and Integration Platforms Product
We are looking for a passionate, tech-savvy Data Engineer Intern to join our team. In this role, you will be working alongside senior data engineers to build modern data pipelines, optimize data platforms or solutions, and handle real-world healthcare data at scale.
Key Responsibilities

• Pipeline Development: Assist in designing, building, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and transform data from diverse sources into our data lake/data warehouse.

• Data Integration: Support the integration of internal platforms and third-party systems using APIs and messaging queues.

• Data Quality & Governance: Adopt Data governance framework to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security across platforms.

• Optimization: Use advanced AI tools to help monitor and optimize data processing jobs for better performance and cost-efficiency.

• Collaboration: Partner with Product Managers, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver clean, structured data products .
What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related engineering or economics field.

• Programming Skills: Solid foundational skills in Python or Java/Scala, with a strong command of SQL.

• Data Knowledge: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), or NoSQL databases.

• The "Nice-to-Haves" (Pluses):
• Experience with data warehouse technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks) or workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud).

• Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and Git.

• Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, curiosity to learn new technologies quickly, and good communication skills (English and Mandarin).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Instrument Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of instrument operations within the Indianapolis Distribution Center. This role focuses on operational investigations, systems troubleshooting, inventory accuracy, and process optimization to ensure efficient instrument movement and order fulfillment.
This position will serve as a key operational resource for resolving complex issues, improving workflows, and supporting cross-functional initiatives that impact instrument distribution and warehouse execution. The role will work closely with warehouse operations, transportation, supply chain planning, and quality teams to ensure operational stability and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
Operational Execution & Issue Resolution

• Investigate and resolve operational issues related to order fulfillment, inventory discrepancies, and system transactions.

• Troubleshoot SAP and warehouse management system transactions to identify root causes of operational disruptions.

• Support accurate execution of transfer orders, shipments, and instrument movements.

• Monitor operational workflows and escalate issues as needed to maintain service levels.

Systems & Process Expertise

• Serve as an operational resource for SAP and warehouse management processes related to instrument operations.

• Identify recurring issues or process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen operational efficiency.

• Support development and maintenance of work instructions, process documentation, and operational standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Supply Chain, Transportation, Quality, and Warehouse teams to resolve operational issues and improve workflow coordination.

• Support communication between operational teams and system stakeholders when troubleshooting issues or implementing process changes.

Continuous Improvement

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow optimization, operational efficiency, and inventory accuracy.

• Support implementation and sustainment of CI tools such as 5S, root cause analysis, and standard work documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce operational friction, and strengthen process reliability.

Operational Reporting & Analysis

• Track and review operational performance indicators related to inventory integrity and order execution.

• Support analysis of operational data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field OR equivalent combination of education and relevant operations experience

• 3+ years of experience in supply chain, warehouse operations, distribution, or logistics

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP or warehouse management systems (WMS)

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to investigate operational issues and identify root causes

• Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain or distribution center operations

• Experience troubleshooting SAP transactions or warehouse management system processes

• Experience supporting operational investigations, inventory management, or order execution workflows

• Experience with continuous improvement tools such as Lean, root cause analysis, or 5S

• Strong organizational, documentat

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The Opportunity:

• Own the search, gathering, drafting, analysis, review, and maintenance of Genentech’s Managed Care Contracts, including digital record and metadata management in the contract lifecycle management (CLM) system and ensuring accurate entry of contract data.

• Work closely with Contract Managers and internal partners to review contract needs and requirements in line with Genentech’s contracting strategies, business objectives, and compliance, drafting amendments/notices and initial drafts of amended and restated contracts.

• Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills by synthesizing complex content into clear, concise, actionable communications and contract language and effectively explaining contract terms to stakeholders.

• Operate with a continuous improvement and agile mindset: thrive in ambiguity and change, prioritize effectively, work independently after direction, build trusting relationships across stakeholders, and respond to ad hoc requests.

• Bring or develop working knowledge of the U.S. healthcare system and managed care segments (wholesalers, specialty distributors/pharmacies, GPOs, payers, providers, HTC, hospitals, and health systems) and of Genentech’s contract types, products, and related systems, as well as CLM or comparable technologies and advanced data architecture.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of relevant/transferable work experience and prior contract drafting experience.

• Demonstrated knowledge of, or strong aptitude to learn, policies and guidelines affecting contracts, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding objectives and goals.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across a variety of settings and stakeholders.

• Preferred: experience with CLM systems, managed care, and/or experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or related industry.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes au cœur du programme ASPIRE, l'une de nos transformations numériques les plus importantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise, simplifiant les processus mondiaux et transformant notre empreinte mondiale en un environnement ERP moderne. Une transformation de cette échelle ne réussit que lorsqu'elle est construite sur une base de haute fidélité, de données de confiance. L'équipe ASPIRE Data Migration orchestre le parcours de notre empreinte de données globale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste hautement qualifié en gestion de données et gouvernance pour exécuter notre stratégie de migration de données de bout en bout, en assurant une transition transparente, précise et sécurisée de systèmes existants complexes à notre colonne vertébrale numérique future. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Dans cette position au niveau de l'entreprise, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et les objectifs commerciaux stratégiques. Vous naviguerez dans des structures complexes de données existantes, gérerez des plates-formes de gouvernance de données à grande échelle et vous assurerez que les données migrées prennent parfaitement en charge les opérations mondiales. Vos responsabilités principales comprendront :
• Exécution de la stratégie de migration : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de cadres, de politiques et de processus complets de migration des données pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des données héritées dans le nouvel environnement ERP.
• Gouvernance et conformité avancées : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des cadres avancés de gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise qui s'étendent à l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurant des pratiques de conformité des données solides.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Tâcher des anomalies et des anomalies de migration des données très complexes, effectuer une analyse racine-cause pour protéger l'intégrité des données de l'entreprise.
• Profil et qualité des données: Établir des mesures rigoureuses de qualité des données, des normes de validation, des routines de nettoyage et des méthodologies de profilage pour assurer une migration à haute fidélité.
• Cible de cartographie des données : Analyser les architectures de données existantes, très fragmentées, et les cartographier proprement aux modèles de données ERP cibles futurs.

• Expérience approfondie: Une expérience éprouvée de projets de migration de données à cycle complet pour les grandes plates-formes ERP et l'amélioration continue des cadres de migration complexes.

• Expertise en matière d'outillage : Maîtrise technique reconnue dans les outils de migration de données standard et ETL.
• Nettoyage et profilage des données: Capacités avancées en profilage des données, validation structurelle et nettoyage des données complexes pour atteindre l'hygiène absolue des données.
• Modélisation des données: Capacité exceptionnelle de déconstruire les systèmes existants et de les traduire en configurations cibles propres et structurées. Leadership et communication

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur juridique et de la conformité

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that when brilliant minds come together with a shared purpose, we can achieve the extraordinary for patients. As our Senior Legal & Compliance Manager for Roche Indonesia, you will sit at the intersection of business enablement and ethical leadership — providing strategic legal counsel that accelerates commercial decisions while safeguarding the highest standards of compliance and integrity across the organization.

Your Opportunity

• Provide pragmatic, strategically sound legal counsel to business partners, translating complex legal issues into clear, business-enabling recommendations.

• Manage end-to-end contract review, drafting, and negotiation with speed and accuracy, while maintaining an organized, up-to-date repository of corporate documents, contract templates, and tender data.

• Ensure all commercial activities and interactions with healthcare professionals and healthcare organizations adhere to applicable regulations, industry codes, company policies, and ethical standards.

• Drive the local implementation of global compliance initiatives and privacy standards, fostering a strong culture of ethics and integrity across the organization.

• Own and continuously improve the legal function's knowledge infrastructure — standard operating procedures, shared documentation, and workflows that ensure a single source of truth and clear audit trails.

• Act as the subject matter expert on Indonesian healthcare laws, industry codes of practice, and corporate governance, supporting the Head of Legal in aligning local strategies with regional and global legal networks.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor of Laws (S.H.) degree and a valid advocate license; a Master of Laws (LL.M.) is an advantage.

• You bring a minimum of 6 years of legal and compliance experience, with proven exposure to a multinational company environment — experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is strongly preferred.

• You have strong knowledge of Indonesian corporate law, healthcare regulations, and public/tender processes in the healthcare environment.

• You are fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia, with excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills.

• You are digitally savvy — proficient in everyday productivity tools and genuinely curious about using AI to work smarter, while applying critical thinking and professional judgment to validate and oversee AI-generated outputs.

• You are detail-oriented and self-driven, delivering accurate, well-structured work at pace with minimal supervision, and you communicate confidently with local stakeholders and global networks alike.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Hai una forte conoscenza del diritto societario indonesiano, dei regolamenti sanitari e dei processi pubblici/tender nell'ambiente sanitario.
• Sei fluente sia in inglese che in Bahasa Indonesia, con eccellenti capacità di redazione legale e di negoziazione.
• Sei digitalmente esperto — competente negli strumenti di produttività di tutti i giorni e sinceramente curioso di usare l'IA per lavorare più intelligente, durante l'applicazione di pensiero critico e giudizio professionale per convalidare e supervisionare le uscite generate dall'IA.
• Siete orientati al dettaglio e auto-driven, fornendo un lavoro accurato e ben strutturato al passo con una supervisione minima, e si comunica con fiducia con gli stakeholder locali e le reti globali allo stesso modo. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Agir en tant qu'expert en matière de droit indonésien de la santé, de codes de pratique et de gouvernance d'entreprise, en aidant le chef de la direction juridique à aligner les stratégies locales sur les réseaux juridiques régionaux et mondiaux. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en droit (S.H.) et d'une licence d'avocat PERADI valide; une maîtrise en droit (LL.M.) est un avantage.

• Vous avez une solide connaissance du droit des entreprises indonésiennes, de la réglementation en matière de soins de santé et des processus d'appel d'offres dans l'environnement des soins de santé.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Every role at Roche contributes uniquely to delivering greater value to healthcare systems. In this role, you will be the critical link ensuring our diagnostic solutions perform seamlessly where they matter most. You will join a highly collaborative, cross-functional network dedicated to providing elite-level technical resolve, focusing significantly on our molecular testing environments, and ensuring a premium customer experience.

As a Application Specialist supporting our Molecular portfolio, you will:

• Manage Advanced Inquiries: Process, track, and resolve moderate-to-high complexity customer inquiries, complaints, and system application anomalies with high technical accuracy.

• Troubleshoot Complex Systems: Evaluate application behaviors, review testing parameters, and recommend prompt corrective actions to optimize laboratory workflows.

• Formulate Action Plans: Partner closely with regional field service networks to identify persistent technical challenges and design structured plans that restore optimal operational performance.

• Drive Escalation & Reporting: Proactively identify product quality trends, logging detailed technical errors inside our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform to fuel global product improvement.

• Enable Knowledge Sharing: Foster a culture of learning by providing basic customer training sessions at our Scientific Center or collaborating on-site to mentor local service partners.

• Empower Sales Teams: Support commercial excellence by contributing technical and laboratory layout insights during high-value customer workshops and vendor proposals.

Who You Are
You are a analytical problem-solver who thrives on unlocking solutions to complex technical challenges. You enjoy connecting with people, collaborating across diverse teams, and translating complicated data into clear, actionable advice.

To excel in this role, you bring:

• Education: A University degree or diploma in a relevant biomedical discipline, medical laboratory sciences, or engineering.

• Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience within a clinical hospital laboratory, research setting, or professional customer support environment.

• Specialized Expertise: Proven hands-on experience or deep theoretical knowledge working with molecular diagnostics applications, methodologies, or workflows .

• Technical Aptitude: Proven experience diagnosing and resolving analytical system errors or troubleshooting complex laboratory workflows.

• Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal skills with professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 level or higher) to collaborate effectively with local and international stakeholders.

• Mindset: A highly organized approach to work, with the ability to prioritize tasks independently while thriving inside a multicultural team ecosystem.

• Mobility: Willingness and flexibility to travel locally and internationally to support on-site installations or attend global training programs.

Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Chi sei Sei un problem-solver analitico che prospera su soluzioni di sblocco a complesse sfide tecniche. • Istruzione: laurea o diploma universitario in una disciplina biomedica rilevante, scienze di laboratorio medico, o ingegneria.
• Esperienza: 3-5 anni di esperienza pratica all'interno di un laboratorio ospedaliero clinico, impostazione di ricerca, o ambiente di assistenza clienti professionale.
• Aptitude tecnica: comprovata esperienza diagnosticando e risolvendo errori di sistema analitico o guasti di lavoro complessi di laboratorio.
• Competenze di comunicazione: Forte competenze interpersonali con competenza professionale in inglese (livello B1/B2 o superiore) per collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder locali e internazionali.
• Mindset: Un approccio altamente organizzato al lavoro, con la capacità di dare priorità ai compiti indipendentemente mentre prospera all'interno di un ecosistema di team multiculturale.
• Mobilità: Volontà e flessibilità per viaggiare a livello locale e internazionale per supportare le installazioni in loco o partecipare a programmi di formazione globale. Facciamo prosperare insieme in una cultura costruita sulla fiducia, la collaborazione, il rispetto e le alte prestazioni. Si noti che una descrizione completa del lavoro è disponibile su richiesta. Si noti che i benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questo ruolo. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un f più sano

• Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in einem klinischen Krankenhauslabor, einer Forschungsumgebung oder einer professionellen Kundenbetreuungsumgebung.
• Technische Eignung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Diagnose und Behebung von Fehlern im analytischen System oder bei der Fehlerbehebung komplexer Laborworkflows.
• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit professionellen Englischkenntnissen (B1/B2-Niveau oder höher), um effektiv mit lokalen und internationalen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten.

The Position
The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. In this critical role based at our Cape Town site, you will serve as a vital technical advisor and legislative interpreter to protect our most valuable human, reputational, and operational resources. You will balance field-based hazard control with high-level knowledge transformation, synthesizing complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance to advance employee well-being, safety, and long-term organizational stability.

Your Impact

- Conduct routine safety audits, facility assessments, and vendor inspections to ensure strict compliance with local occupational health and safety legislation and global directives.
- Facilitate daily operational risk assessments and document standardized Workplace Health Risk Assessments (WHRA) across active production floors and laboratory zones.
- Monitor and analyze safety metrics, tracking leading and lagging indicators to proactively predict risk and design continuous mitigation strategies.
- Deliver engaging safety orientations, inductions, and e-courses, effectively translating technical regulatory compliance content into accessible learning for all personnel.
- Support the implementation of Injury, Illness and Prevention Programs (IIPPs), emergency action setups, and specialized site first-responder protocols.
- Partner closely with site management and People & Culture during root-cause incident investigations, managing data tracking, claim documentation, and return-to-work initiatives.
- Maintain mandatory compliance logs, ensure safety data sheets remain current, and design highly visual safety dashboards that convey hazard levels at a glance.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, collaborative, and forward-thinking safety professional who uses excellent judgment to resolve complex technical challenges. You bring a natural diplomat with superior communication skills, able to navigate sensitive inquiries with tact and build trusted relationships across all organizational levels.

To set yourself up for success, you bring:

- Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, or a related scientific discipline. A postgraduate qualification is considered an advantage.
- Experience: 3 to 7 years of safety experience gained within a production or manufacturing environment. Direct exposure to pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environments is highly advantageous.
- Regulatory Expertise: Explicit knowledge of national health and safety legislation (such as the OSHAct), risk assessment methodologies, and safety data protocols.
- Specialized Safety Knowledge: A foundational understanding of Biosafety Levels (BSL-1 through BSL-3), industrial hygiene principles (air monitoring, fume hoods, noise levels), and chemical hygiene practices.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. In this critical role based at our Cape Town site, you will serve as a vital technical advisor and legislative interpreter to protect our most valuable human, reputational, and operational resources. You will balance field-based hazard control with high-level knowledge transformation, synthesizing complex regulatory requirements into actionable guidance to advance employee well-being, safety, and long-term organizational stability.

Your Impact

- Conduct routine safety audits, facility assessments, and vendor inspections to ensure strict compliance with local occupational health and safety legislation and global directives.
- Facilitate daily operational risk assessments and document standardized Workplace Health Risk Assessments (WHRA) across active production floors and laboratory zones.
- Monitor and analyze safety metrics, tracking leading and lagging indicators to proactively predict risk and design continuous mitigation strategies.
- Deliver engaging safety orientations, inductions, and e-courses, effectively translating technical regulatory compliance content into accessible learning for all personnel.
- Support the implementation of Injury, Illness and Prevention Programs (IIPPs), emergency action setups, and specialized site first-responder protocols.
- Partner closely with site management and People & Culture during root-cause incident investigations, managing data tracking, claim documentation, and return-to-work initiatives.
- Maintain mandatory compliance logs, ensure safety data sheets remain current, and design highly visual safety dashboards that convey hazard levels at a glance.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, collaborative, and forward-thinking safety professional who uses excellent judgment to resolve complex technical challenges. You bring a natural diplomat with superior communication skills, able to navigate sensitive inquiries with tact and build trusted relationships across all organizational levels.

To set yourself up for success, you bring:

- Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, or a related scientific discipline. A postgraduate qualification is considered an advantage.
- Experience: 3 to 7 years of safety experience gained within a production or manufacturing environment. Direct exposure to pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environments is highly advantageous.
- Regulatory Expertise: Explicit knowledge of national health and safety legislation (such as the OSHAct), risk assessment methodologies, and safety data protocols.
- Specialized Safety Knowledge: A foundational understanding of Biosafety Levels (BSL-1 through BSL-3), industrial hygiene principles (air monitoring, fume hoods, noise levels), and chemical hygiene practices.
- Operational Agility: Strong digital literacy (Microsoft Office and safety databases). You are physically comfortable navigating a large campus, wearing required protective equipment, and working around specialized environments like cold rooms or laboratories.

Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

jobs.title: Betriebsingenieur für Gebäudetechnik (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur opérationnel pour la technologie du bâtiment (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.

Das sind wir

Wir sind ein offenes und mutig agierendes Team, das den operativen Betrieb des Standortes Penzberg aktiv gestaltet. Mit der Betriebstechnik verantworten wir alle Gebäude von Forschung, Diagnostik-Produktion und Site am Standort. Mit den BusinessX-Einheiten gestalten und betreiben wir Prozesse, Systeme und die Unternehmerpflichten im Betrieb.
Unseren internen Partnern bieten wir innovative Lösungen und Services in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Technikeinheiten am Standort. Gemeinsam stellen wir eine effiziente Produktion und Anlagenbetrieb sicher und tragen mit den Technical Business Partnern die Verantwortung für ein nachhaltiges Asset-Management.

Du hast Lust, in unser Team zu kommen? Dann bewirb dich gleich jetzt!

Das erwartet Dich

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Betreibern und Standortfunktionen zusammen

• Du verantwortest vor Ort den technischen Betrieb der Gebäude- und Prozesstechnischen Nebenanlagen und stehst der Produktion als technischer Berater zur Verfügung.

• Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung anlagenspezifischer Ingenieurleistung und die Übernahme von (Teil-) Projektleitungsverantwortung bei Investitionsmaßnahmen

• Kostenplanung und Kontrolle technischer Leistungen

• Fehlermonitoring und Ursachenanalysen, Energiemonitoring der gebäudetechnischen Anlagen und Erarbeitung von Optimierungskonzepten

• Technische Bewertung von Anlagen zur Life-Cycle-Planung

• Einhaltung der Complianceanforderungen bzgl. Anlagensicherheit, Umweltschutz, Arbeitssicherheit und Qualitätssicherheit

• Sicherstellung einer aktuellen Dokumentation für Anlagen und Gebäude

• Du stellst im Rahmen deiner delegierten Verantwortung sicher, dass die technischen Anlagen dem Stand der Technik entsprechen und Risiken durch Analysen und Maßnahmen (technische Prüfungen z.B. ATEX, SIL, etc.) minimiert und die Anlagenqualität optimiert werden.

Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast dein Studium im Ingenieurwesen (Master, Bachelor) mit einer technischen Fachrichtung (Gebäudetechnik, Facility Management, Anlagentechnik, Verfahrenstechnik oder vergleichbar) erfolgreich abgeschlossen, alternativ verfügst Du über eine technische Weiterbildung als Techniker/Meister (m/w/d) in den oben genannten Fachgebieten.

• Du hast bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im technischen Umfeld gesammelt und bringst erste Erfahrung mit Explosionsschutz mit.

• Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Bau, in der Instandhaltung und dem Betrieb von Gebäudetechnischen Anlagen und Prozesstechnischen Nebenanlagen im Industrieumfeld, bevorzugt in der pharmazeutischen und chemischen Produktion.

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse zu Instandhaltungsstrategien, GxP und Projektmanagementtools

• Du verstehst komplexe Sachverhalte und weist strukturiert zu einem lösungsorientierten Ergebnis zu kommen

• Du zeichnest dich durch eine selbständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, einem hohen Maß an Einsatzbereitschaft sowie der Bereitschaft zu berufsbegleitenden Fortbildungsmaßnahmen aus

• In der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichsten Ansprechpartnern auf verschiedensten Hierarchieebenen setzt du deine sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und dein sicheres Auftreten ein

• Du legst viel Wert auf das Arbeiten im Team

• Im Umgang mit MS Office- und SAP-Anwendungen fühlst du dich sicher

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients in person, via phone or Email

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.
Wi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo avanzando la scienza in modo che tutti possiamo trascorrere più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Noi siamo Siamo un team aperto e coraggioso che forma attivamente il funzionamento operativo del sito Penzberg. Con la tecnologia operativa siamo responsabili per tutti gli edifici di ricerca, produzione diagnostica e sito sul sito. Con le unità BusinessX, progettiamo e gestiamo processi, sistemi e gli obblighi imprenditoriali in azienda. Offriamo ai nostri partner interni soluzioni e servizi innovativi in stretta collaborazione con le unità tecniche del sito. Insieme garantiamo una produzione efficiente e un funzionamento degli impianti e insieme ai nostri partner tecnici siamo responsabili della gestione sostenibile degli asset. Vuoi unirti alla nostra squadra? Quindi applicare ora! Questo è ciò che vi aspetta
• Lavorate a stretto contatto con gli operatori e le funzioni di localizzazione
• Sarà responsabile del funzionamento tecnico dei sistemi di costruzione e di processo ausiliari in loco e sarà disponibile alla produzione come consulente tecnico.
• Realizzazione autonoma dei servizi di ingegneria specifici per impianti e assunzione di responsabilità (partiale) di gestione dei progetti per misure di investimento
• Pianificazione dei costi e controllo dei servizi tecnici
• Monitoraggio degli errori e analisi delle cause, monitoraggio energetico degli impianti di costruzione tecnica e sviluppo di concetti di ottimizzazione
• Valutazione tecnica delle strutture di pianificazione del ciclo di vita
• Rispetto dei requisiti di conformità Sicurezza delle piante, protezione dell'ambiente, sicurezza del lavoro e sicurezza della qualità
• Garantire una documentazione aggiornata per strutture ed edifici
• Nell'ambito della vostra responsabilità delegata, assicuratevi che gli impianti tecnici rispettino lo stato dell'arte e che i rischi siano minimizzati da analisi e misure (test tecnici, ad esempio ATEX, SIL, ecc.) e la qualità dell'impianto è ottimizzata. Lo porti con te.
• Hai completato con successo i tuoi studi in ingegneria (Master, Bachelor) con una disciplina tecnica (ingegneria di costruzione, gestione delle strutture, ingegneria degli impianti, ingegneria dei processi o simili), in alternativa riceverai formazione tecnica come tecnico/master (m/f/d) nelle aree di competenza sopra menzionate.
• Hai già maturato diversi anni di esperienza professionale nell'ambiente tecnico e portare la tua prima esperienza con protezione contro le esplosioni.
• Hai esperienza nella costruzione, manutenzione e funzionamento di impianti di ingegneria edilizio e impianti ausiliari di ingegneria di processo nell'ambiente industriale, preferibilmente nella produzione farmaceutica e chimica.
• Hai una buona conoscenza delle strategie di manutenzione, GxP e strumenti di gestione del progetto
• Capisci problemi complessi e hai un approccio strutturato a un risultato orientato alla soluzione
• Sei caratterizzato da un metodo di lavoro indipendente e proattivo, un alto grado di impegno e la volontà di prendere misure di formazione part-time
• In collaborazione con diversi contatti a diversi livelli gerarchici, si utilizzano le vostre capacità di comunicazione molto buone e il vostro aspetto sicuro
• Si attribuisce grande importanza al lavoro in un team
• Quando si tratta di applicazioni MS Office e SAP, ti senti sicuro
• Sei esperto in inglese e non hai paura di parlare con clienti internazionali di persona, via telefono o e-mail Finora tanto bene? Possiamo fare di meglio. Wid

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

Who You Are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data Scientist Intern Position Overview
Location: Shanghai/Beijing, China (Onsite)
Duration: 6 months (Minimum 3 days per week)
Team: CET-China AI platform & adoption

We are looking for a passionate, innovative Data Scientist Intern to join our team. In this role, you will be working alongside senior AI scientists and engineers to research AI products, explore data-driven AI use cases, and develop advanced algorithms and models to solve real-world healthcare challenges.

Key Responsibilities

• Algorithm & Model Research: Assist in researching, designing, and evaluating machine learning, deep learning, or Generative AI models tailored to specific product use cases.

• Data Exploration & Analysis: Dive into large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, extract meaningful features, and identify opportunities for AI-driven products.

• Prototyping & PoC (Proof of Concept): Build and test prototypes to validate new AI algorithms and evaluate the feasibility of cutting-edge algorithms within China AI platform & adoption ecosystem.

• Model Optimization: Support the evaluation, fine-tuning, and optimization of existing AI models to improve their accuracy, performance, and robustness.

What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

• Education: Currently pursuing a Master’s (exceptional Bachelor’s candidates will also be considered) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related highly quantitative field.

• Programming Skills: Solid coding skills in Python, with a strong command of standard AI/ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas).

• AI Knowledge: A strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning architectures, statistical modeling, and data evaluation metrics.

• Research Capability: Demonstrated ability to conduct independent literature reviews, read and synthesize cutting-edge AI research papers, and extract actionable insights for practical use cases.

• Theoretical Foundations: A deep mathematical understanding of machine learning and deep learning principles, including optimization algorithms, loss functions, linear algebra, and probability theory. You should know how models work under the hood, not just how to call their APIs.

• Prototyping & Frameworks: Hands-on experience with research-centric AI frameworks etc. Ability to rapidly translate academic algorithms into working prototypes or Proof of Concepts (PoCs).

• Experimental Design: Strong skills in designing rigorous AI experiments, selecting appropriate baseline models, establishing robust evaluation metrics, and performing comprehensive benchmark analysis.

• GenAI / LLM Research Experience: Deep interest or hands-on research experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), including Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT like LoRA), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) evaluation, or Agentic workflows.

• Paper Replication: A strong GitHub portfolio showcasing your ability to replicate algorithms from recent research papers from scratch.

• Languages: Full professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken). Reading and comprehending complex English technical papers is a daily requirement.

• Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, data scientists and necessary stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into actionable AI research topics and technical solutions.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more t

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Aperçu du poste de stagiaire en sciences des données Lieu: Shanghai/Beijing, Chine (sur place) Durée: 6 mois (minimum 3 jours par semaine) Équipe: plateforme AI CET-Chine & adoption Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire de Data Scientist passionné et innovant pour rejoindre notre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez aux côtés de scientifiques et d'ingénieurs chevronnés de l'IA à la recherche de produits de l'IA, à l'exploration de cas d'utilisation de l'IA axés sur les données et à la mise au point d'algorithmes et de modèles avancés pour résoudre les problèmes de santé réels. Principales responsabilités
• Recherche sur l'algorithme et les modèles : aidez à la recherche, à la conception et à l'évaluation de modèles d'apprentissage automatique, d'apprentissage profond ou d'IA génériques adaptés à des cas spécifiques d'utilisation de produits.
• Exploration et analyse des données : Plonger dans des ensembles de données à grande échelle pour découvrir les modèles, extraire des caractéristiques significatives et identifier les possibilités pour les produits axés sur l'IA.
• Prototypage & PoC (Proof of Concept) : Construisez et testez des prototypes pour valider de nouveaux algorithmes d'IA et évaluer la faisabilité d'algorithmes de pointe au sein de la plateforme d'IA chinoise et de l'écosystème d'adoption.
• Optimisation des modèles : Soutenir l'évaluation, le réglage fin et l'optimisation des modèles d'IA existants pour améliorer leur précision, leurs performances et leur robustesse. Ce que nous cherchons (Qualifications)
• Éducation: Actuellement poursuivre une maîtrise (exceptionnels candidats Bachelor, seront également considérés) en informatique, intelligence artificielle, science des données, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, ou un domaine connexe hautement quantitatif.
• Compétences de programmation : Compétences de codage solides en Python, avec une forte maîtrise des bibliothèques et des cadres standards en AI/ML (p. ex. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
• Connaissance de l'IA : Une solide compréhension fondamentale des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique, des architectures d'apprentissage profond, de la modélisation statistique et des paramètres d'évaluation des données.
• Capacité de recherche : Capacité démontrée d'effectuer des examens de littérature indépendants, de lire et de synthétiser des documents de recherche de pointe sur l'IA, et d'extraire des renseignements concrets pour des cas d'utilisation pratique.
• Fondations théoriques : Une compréhension mathématique profonde de l'apprentissage automatique et des principes d'apprentissage profond, y compris les algorithmes d'optimisation, les fonctions de perte, l'algèbre linéaire et la théorie des probabilités. Vous devriez savoir comment les modèles fonctionnent sous le capot, pas seulement comment appeler leurs API.
• Prototypage & Cadres: Expérience pratique avec des cadres d'IA centrés sur la recherche, etc. Capacité de traduire rapidement les algorithmes académiques en prototypes de travail ou de Proof of Concepts (PoCs).
• Conception expérimentale : Fortes compétences dans la conception d'expériences rigoureuses d'IA, la sélection de modèles de référence appropriés, l'établissement de mesures d'évaluation robustes et la réalisation d'analyses comparatives exhaustives.
• GenAI / LLM Expérience de recherche: Intérêt profond ou expérience de recherche pratique dans les modèles de grande langue (LLM), y compris Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT comme LoRA), Rétrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) évaluation, ou Workflows Agentic.
• Paper Replication: Un portefeuille solide GitHub montrant votre capacité à reproduire des algorithmes à partir de récents articles de recherche de zéro.
• Langues: Compétence professionnelle complète en mandarin et en anglais (écrit et parlé). Lire et comprendre des documents techniques anglais complexes est une exigence quotidienne.
• Collaboration : Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les data savants et les intervenants nécessaires pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles complexes en sujets de recherche sur l'IA réalisables et en solutions techniques. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus

titleByLocale.it: Procurement Solutions Manager (AI Agents & Workflow Automation)
titleByLocale.en: Procurement Solutions Manager (AI Agents & Workflow Automation)
titleByLocale.de: Procurement Solutions Manager (AI Agents & Workflow Automation)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des solutions d'approvisionnement (agents d'AI et automatisation des flux de travail)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is based in the Global Procurement function, which supports Roche’s goal of bringing innovative solutions to patients through business and supplier partnerships. We act as the bridge between Roche business functions and our suppliers, delivering value through productivity, speed, risk management, sustainability, innovative solutions, and streamlined buying experiences.

As the Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will be part of Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Our purpose is to advance value delivery through digital solutions & excellence, with Digital & AI augmenting and amplifying our capacity and capability to magnify outcomes, eventually delivering greater impact per person and a better procurement experience.
Reporting to the Procurement AI Solutions Lead, your primary responsibility is to design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows that transform procurement processes. Leveraging your specialized knowledge and expertise, you will work hands-on with Generative AI, workflow orchestration platforms, MCPs, enterprise systems, and internal data sources to deliver production-ready AI solutions. You will proactively help Global Procurement improve productivity, speed, user experience, quality, and decision-making across the procurement ecosystem.
You will work closely with Procurement SMEs, internal AI solution engineers, Digital peers, IT, Analytics & Insights, and external partners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing into robust solution concepts, pilots, and scalable implementations. You will bridge strategic AI priorities and the practical realities of building reliable, enterprise-ready solutions in a complex global procurement environment.

Your Key Responsabilities:

As a Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will play a pivotal role according to your experience, knowledge, and strategic business/team requirements, including but not limited to:

• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner with procurement teams to identify, structure, and validate high-impact automation and AI use cases. Translate business needs, process complexity, policy requirements, data realities, and user experience considerations into clear solution designs.

• Workflow & Agent Design: Design and build intelligent workflow logic for procurement use cases, combining AI capabilities, business rules, MCP and API integrations, data checks, human-in-the-loop steps, and measurable quality controls. Independently build, configure and embed AI agents into existing procurement systems and processes to automate end-to-end tasks.

• Rapid Prototyping: Build and test initial proofs-of-concept (PoCs) using workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier) and internal data sources to validate value quickly before full-scale engineering. Translate learnings into actionable specifications for internal teams, external partners, and solution engineers.

• Solution Evaluation & Observability: Utilize enterprise LLM observability and evaluation tools to monitor agent behavior, track accuracy, analyze failure modes, and systematically iterate on prompts and workflow logic to ensure production-grade reliability.

• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Act as product/solution owner from discovery to scalable rollout. Manage scope, timelines, dependencies, value hypotheses, success metrics, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex matrix environment.

• Enterprise-Ready Solution Thinking: Collaborate with Digital Governance & Management, IT, Compl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sulla funzione Global Procurement, che supporta l’obiettivo di Roche di portare soluzioni innovative ai pazienti attraverso partnership di business e fornitori. Agiamo come ponte tra le funzioni aziendali Roche e i nostri fornitori, offrendo valore attraverso produttività, velocità, gestione dei rischi, sostenibilità, soluzioni innovative e esperienze di acquisto semplificate. In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), farai parte di Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Il nostro scopo è quello di promuovere la consegna del valore attraverso soluzioni digitali e eccellenza, con Digital & AI che aumenta e amplifica la nostra capacità e capacità di magnificare i risultati, alla fine di fornire un maggiore impatto per persona e una migliore esperienza di approvvigionamento. Segnalandosi al Leader delle soluzioni AI di appalti, la vostra responsabilità primaria è quella di progettare, costruire, testare e distribuire agenti AI e flussi di lavoro agentici che trasformano i processi di approvvigionamento. Sfruttando le tue conoscenze e competenze specialistiche, lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'IA Generativa, piattaforme di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro, MCP, sistemi aziendali e fonti di dati interne per fornire soluzioni AI pronte alla produzione. Aiuterai proattivamente il Global Procurement a migliorare la produttività, la velocità, l'esperienza utente, la qualità e il processo decisionale in tutto l'ecosistema di approvvigionamento. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le PMI di approvvigionamento, gli ingegneri della soluzione AI interna, i coetanei digitali, l'IT, l'analisi e le insights e i partner esterni per spostare idee ad alto valore dall'opportunità di inquadrare in concetti di soluzione robusta, piloti e implementazioni scalabili. Avrete a ponte le priorità strategiche dell'IA e le realtà pratiche di costruire soluzioni affidabili e pronte all'impresa in un complesso ambiente di approvvigionamento globale. Le tue responsabilità chiave: In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale in base alle tue esigenze di esperienza, conoscenza e business/team strategici, inclusi ma non limitati a:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner con i team di approvvigionamento per identificare, strutturare e convalidare i casi di automazione ad alto impatto e utilizzo di AI. Traduci le esigenze aziendali, la complessità del processo, i requisiti politici, le realtà dei dati e le considerazioni sull'esperienza degli utenti in progetti di soluzione chiari.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Progettare e costruire logica di flusso di lavoro intelligente per l'approvvigionamento di casi di utilizzo, combinando capacità di AI, regole aziendali, integrazioni MCP e API, controlli di dati, passi umani-in-the-loop e controlli di qualità misurabili. Creare, configurare e incorporare agenti AI in sistemi e processi di approvvigionamento esistenti per automatizzare le attività end-to-end.
• Prototipazione rapida: costruire e testare le prove iniziali-di-concetto (PoCs) utilizzando strumenti di automazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, n8n, Zapier) e fonti di dati interne per convalidare il valore rapidamente prima dell'ingegneria su larga scala. Traduci gli insegnamenti in specifiche attuabili per team interni, partner esterni e ingegneri di soluzioni.
• Valutazione & Osservabilità della soluzione: Utilizzare strumenti di osservazione e valutazione LLM aziendali per monitorare il comportamento dell'agente, tracciare la precisione, analizzare i modi di guasto, e iterare sistematicamente su richieste e logica del flusso di lavoro per garantire l'affidabilità di livello di produzione.
• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Agite come proprietario del prodotto/soluzione dalla scoperta al rollout scalabile. Gestisci portata, tempestività, dipendenze, ipotesi di valore, metriche di successo, rischi e aspettative degli stakeholder in un ambiente di matrice complesso.
• Soluzione Enterprise-Ready Pensare: Collaborare con Digital Governance & Management, IT, Compl

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Diese Rolle basiert auf der Funktion Global Procurement, die Roches Ziel unterstützt, Patienten durch Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften innovative Lösungen zu bieten. Wir fungieren als Brücke zwischen den Geschäftsfunktionen von Roche und unseren Lieferanten und liefern Wert durch Produktivität, Geschwindigkeit, Risikomanagement, Nachhaltigkeit, innovative Lösungen und optimierte Einkaufserlebnisse. Als Procurement Solutions Manager (AI) werden Sie Teil von Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Unser Ziel ist es, die Wertschöpfung durch digitale Lösungen und Exzellenz zu verbessern, indem Digital & AI unsere Fähigkeit und Fähigkeit zur Ergebnisvergrößerung erweitert und verstärkt, was letztendlich zu einer größeren Wirkung pro Person und einer besseren Beschaffungserfahrung führt. Berichterstattung an den Procurement AI Solutions Lead, Ihre primäre Verantwortung besteht darin, KI-Agenten und Agenten-Workflows zu entwerfen, zu erstellen, zu testen und einzusetzen, die Beschaffungsprozesse verändern. Durch die Nutzung Ihres Fachwissens und Ihrer Expertise arbeiten Sie praktisch mit Generative AI, Workflow-Orchestrierungsplattformen, MCPs, Unternehmenssystemen und internen Datenquellen zusammen, um produktionsfähige KI-Lösungen zu liefern. Sie werden Global Procurement proaktiv dabei unterstützen, Produktivität, Geschwindigkeit, Benutzererfahrung, Qualität und Entscheidungsfindung im gesamten Beschaffungsökosystem zu verbessern. Sie arbeiten eng mit Beschaffungs-KMU, internen KI-Lösungsingenieuren, Digital Peers, IT, Analytics & Insights und externen Partnern zusammen, um hochwertige Ideen vom Opportunity Framing in robuste Lösungskonzepte, Piloten und skalierbare Implementierungen zu übertragen. Sie werden strategische KI-Prioritäten und die praktischen Realitäten des Aufbaus zuverlässiger, unternehmensfähiger Lösungen in einem komplexen globalen Beschaffungsumfeld überbrücken. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben: Als Procurement Solutions Manager (AI) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrem Wissen und Ihren strategischen Geschäfts- / Teamanforderungen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partnerschaft mit Beschaffungsteams zur Identifizierung, Strukturierung und Validierung von hochwirksamen Automatisierungs- und KI-Anwendungsfällen. Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen, Prozesskomplexität, Richtlinienanforderungen, Datenrealitäten und Überlegungen zur Benutzererfahrung in klare Lösungsdesigns.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Entwerfen und erstellen Sie intelligente Workflow-Logik für Beschaffungs-Anwendungsfälle, die KI-Fähigkeiten, Geschäftsregeln, MCP- und API-Integrationen, Datenprüfungen, Human-in-the-Loop-Schritte und messbare Qualitätskontrollen kombiniert. Bauen, konfigurieren und integrieren Sie KI-Agenten unabhängig in bestehende Beschaffungssysteme und -prozesse, um End-to-End-Aufgaben zu automatisieren.
• Rapid Prototyping: Erstellen und Testen Sie erste Proofs-of-Concepts (PoCs) mithilfe von Workflow-Automatisierungstools (z. B. n8n, Zapier) und internen Datenquellen, um den Wert schnell vor dem vollständigen Engineering zu validieren. Übersetzen Sie das Lernen in umsetzbare Spezifikationen für interne Teams, externe Partner und Lösungstechniker.
• Lösungsbewertung & Beobachtbarkeit: Verwenden Sie Enterprise LLM-Beobachtbarkeits- und Bewertungstools, um das Verhalten von Agenten zu überwachen, die Genauigkeit zu verfolgen, Fehlermodi zu analysieren und systematisch auf Aufforderungen und Workflow-Logik zu iterieren, um eine Zuverlässigkeit in der Produktion zu gewährleisten.
• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Handeln Sie als Produkt- / Lösungsbesitzer von der Entdeckung bis zum skalierbaren Rollout. Verwalten Sie Umfang, Zeitpläne, Abhängigkeiten, Werthypothesen, Erfolgsmetriken, Risiken und Stakeholder-Erwartungen in einer komplexen Matrixumgebung.

jobs.title: Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL)

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de l'équipe de démarrage de l'étude de pays (CSTL)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a UK Country Study Start-Up Team Leader, you will drive the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials. You will play a key role in delivering clinical trials to patients by enabling innovative trial execution and ensuring a seamless experience for investigators and clinical site staff in the UK

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for leading the country's study start-up strategy, focusing on efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external partners. Your work will have a direct impact on the speed and quality of our clinical trials. This role is internally known as the Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL).

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Overseeing start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.

• Serve as a key member of the Country Leadership Team, contributing actionable insights and leadership influence to advance clinical study start-up environments.

• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with regional and global counterparts to standardise systems, improve study timelines, and implement innovations across study processes.

• Leading the development and oversight of clinical trial submissions and amendments, managing packages, and ensuring document maintenance.

• Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardisation, and innovation at the country and site level.

• Providing strategic oversight for all aspects of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and negotiating contracts.

• Engaging with government and institutional bodies, such as Ethics Boards and Health Authorities, to align on and influence evolving clinical trial policies and practices.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Job description
The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation.
Description of the area

Key Responsibilities:

• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.

• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.

• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.

• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.

• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery.

Technical Requirements & Expertise:

• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.

• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.

• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.

• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.

• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.

• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential.
