jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
JD - China Enterprise Technology Intern
Company: Roche
Organization: China Enterprise Technology (CET)
Location: Shanghai, China
Duration: 3–6 months

Position Summary
Roche is seeking a versatile and highly motivated Enterprise Technology Intern to join our China Enterprise Technology (CET) team. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between technical project management, DevOps engineering, and operations research.
You will be instrumental in driving our infrastructure modernization by coordinating the large-scale migration of over 100 GitLab projects. Simultaneously, you will dive deep into scientific computing by designing a Linear Programming model to optimize GPU resource allocation for our complex, data-heavy scientific workloads (such as bioinformatics and computational chemistry).

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Coordination & Governance

• Act as the project coordinator for cross-functional IT, DevOps, and scientific computing teams within CET.

• Facilitate project meetings, track milestones, and manage timelines using Agile methodologies.

• Maintain clear documentation, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and present progress reports to technical leads and stakeholders.

• Identify project bottlenecks and collaborate with team members to resolve blockers efficiently.
2. Large-Scale GitLab Projects Migration

• Plan and execute the seamless migration of 100+ GitLab projects into a unified, secure enterprise environment.

• Ensure the integrity of source code, commit histories, access controls, and environment variables during the transition.

• Update and validate CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous integration remains uninterrupted post-migration.

• Create automated scripts and clear user guides to assist development teams in adapting to the new repository structures.
3. Computing Resource Optimization for Scientific Workloads

• Formulate a Linear Programming (LP) model to optimize the scheduling and allocation of Computing resources for intensive scientific workloads (e.g., genomics, drug discovery simulations, and AI/ML modeling).

• Analyze compute constraints, job priorities, memory requirements, and runtime patterns to maximize cluster throughput and minimize idle time.

• Implement optimization solutions using Python libraries

• Deliver data-driven insights and a proof-of-concept scheduling algorithm to improve the cost-efficiency of Roche’s scientific computing infrastructure.
Key Qualifications

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Bioinformatics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• DevOps & IT Skills: Experience with version control systems (Git) and an understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

• Programming & Math: Strong proficiency in Python and a solid foundational knowledge of mathematical optimization and Linear Programming.

• Project Management: Familiarity with Agile frameworks and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or Monday.

• Domain Interest: A strong interest in scientific computing, healthcare technology, or bioinformatics infrastructure.

• Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and the capacity to work independently in a dynamic environment.

• Languages: Fluent in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken).
What We Offer

• Meaningful, hands-on experience at the intersection of enterprise IT, DevOps, and life sciences.

• Direct mentorship from experienced architects, DevOps engineers,

Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la modernisation de notre infrastructure en coordonnant la migration à grande échelle de plus de 100 projets GitLab. Simultanément, vous plongerez profondément dans l'informatique scientifique en concevant un modèle de programmation linéaire pour optimiser l'allocation des ressources GPU pour nos charges de travail scientifiques complexes et abondantes en matière de données (comme la bioinformatique et la chimie informatique). Principales responsabilités 1. Coordination et gouvernance du projet
• Agir en tant que coordonnateur de projet pour les équipes interfonctionnelles de TI, DevOps et de calcul scientifique au sein du CET.
• Faciliter les réunions de projet, suivre les étapes et gérer les échéanciers à l'aide de méthodologies agiles.
• Tenir une documentation claire, suivre les principaux indicateurs de rendement et présenter des rapports d'étape aux responsables techniques et aux intervenants.
• Identifier les goulets d'étranglement du projet et collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe pour résoudre efficacement les obstacles. 2. Projets GitLab à grande échelle Migration
• Planifiez et exécutez la migration transparente de plus de 100 projets GitLab vers un environnement d'entreprise unifié et sécurisé.
• Assurer l'intégrité du code source, des historiques de commit, des contrôles d'accès et des variables d'environnement pendant la transition.
• Mettre à jour et valider les pipelines CI/CD pour s'assurer que l'intégration continue d'être ininterrompue après la migration.
• Créer des scripts automatisés et des guides d'utilisation clairs pour aider les équipes de développement à s'adapter aux nouvelles structures de dépôt. 3. Optimisation des ressources informatiques pour les charges de travail scientifiques
• Formuler un modèle de programmation linéaire afin d'optimiser le calendrier et l'affectation des ressources informatiques pour des charges de travail scientifiques intensives (p. ex. génomique, simulations de découverte de médicaments et modélisation de l'IA/ML).
• Analyser les contraintes de calcul, les priorités de travail, les besoins en mémoire et les modèles d'exécution afin de maximiser le débit des grappes et de minimiser le temps de repos.
• Implémenter des solutions d'optimisation à l'aide de bibliothèques Python
• Fournir des informations basées sur les données et un algorithme de planification de validation de concept pour améliorer le rapport coût-efficacité de l'infrastructure de calcul scientifique Roche. Qualifications clés
• Éducation: Actuellement poursuivre un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en informatique, mathématiques, bioinformatique, sciences des données, ou un domaine quantitatif connexe.
• DevOps & IT Skills: Expérience des systèmes de contrôle des versions (Git) et compréhension des pipelines CI/CD.
• Programmation & Mathématiques : Une solide compétence en Python et une solide connaissance fondamentale de l'optimisation mathématique et de la programmation linéaire.
• Gestion de projet : Familialité avec les cadres agiles et les outils de gestion de projet comme Jira, Confluence ou lundi.
• Intérêt du domaine : Un fort intérêt pour l'informatique scientifique, la technologie de la santé ou l'infrastructure bioinformatique.
• Compétences souples : Excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes, de communication et de travail indépendant dans un environnement dynamique.
• Langues: Mandarin et anglais (écrit et parlé). Ce que nous offrons
• Une expérience utile et pratique à l'intersection de l'informatique d'entreprise, des DevOps et des sciences de la vie.
• Des architectes expérimentés, des ingénieurs DevOps,

jobs.title: IT Project Management Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT 项目管理实习生 (IT Project Management Intern)

职位概览 (Job Summary)
我们正在寻找一位自驱、细心且沟通能力强的 IT 项目管理实习生加入我们的团队。
在这一角色中，你将作为 Senior 项目经理的得力助手，深度参与到 IT 项目的实际交付过程中。你将有机会接触到真实、完整的 IT 项目生命周期，在资深导师的带教下，学习如何进行跨部门沟通、系统化需求管理及项目风险控制，为你的职业生涯打下坚实的基础。

岗位职责 (Key Responsibilities)
作为一个助手的角色，你的日常工作将主要围绕以下几个方面展开：

• 项目日常跟进（PM Assistant）：协助 Senior PM 使用 Monday.com 跟踪项目各节点的进度，提醒团队成员及时更新任务状态，确保项目信息同步透明。

• 需求与运营支持（Demand Management Support）：协助维护 ServiceNow 系统中的需求池，处理基础的日常系统提单、审批流跟进以及平台数据的维护工作。

• 会议组织与文档管理：负责项目例会、需求讨论会的组织与协调；负责会议纪要（Meeting Minutes）的记录、待办事项（Action Items）的整理及后续的日常推进。

• 日常行政支持与团队协作：协助收集、整理各业务部门的基础需求，辅助 PM 进行项目周报、流程图及操作手册等文档的编写与归档，支持团队日常的高效运转。

任职要求 (Qualifications)
既然是实习生，我们更看重你的学习敏锐度与做事态度：

• 教育背景：本科或研究生在读（2027年或之后毕业优先），计算机、信息管理、工业工程、商业分析或管理类相关专业优先（优秀的跨专业同学亦可）。

• 核心软实力（最看重）：

• 极强的执行力与细心度：交代的每项日常支持工作都能有始有终、细致地完成，有强烈的责任心。

• 良好的沟通与协调能力：不怯场，能清晰、礼貌且有条理地与不同部门的同学沟通。

• 自驱与快速学习能力：愿意主动提问、快速吸收新的业务知识与 IT 工具。

• 技能加分项：

• 熟练使用 Office 办公软件（Word, Excel, PPT），如果熟悉 Monday.com 或 ServiceNow 等系统者将是极大的加分项。

• 具备良好的英文读写能力（能处理日常英文邮件、撰写英文会议纪要或文档）。

• 实习时间：每周能保证出勤 3-4 天及以上，能够持续实习 3-6 个月者优先。

你将获得 (What You Will Gain)

• 1对1资深带教：由 Senior PM 亲自带教，让你明白每一项支持性工作背后的职场逻辑和项目全局观。

• 前沿工具实战经验：熟练掌握业界主流的 Monday.com 项目管理软件与 ServiceNow 数字化工作流平台，极大提升个人简历竞争力。

• 良好的团队氛围：Nice 的团队、开放包容的沟通环境。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Payroll, Time & Benefits Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - Payroll, Time & Benefits Analyst
Location - Mumbai

Your Opportunity

You will focus on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for executing HR system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner, in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, and several local and global benefits. etc. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the P&C People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other P&C functions within and outside of P&C People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding across local HR processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on employee lifecycle management, finance, procurement, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.

Responsibilities

1) Service Delivery

• Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, several local and global benefits administration, etc. (details refer to the country service catalog)

• Provide customer service on pay, time and benefits related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.

• Understand and have working knowledge of local time/absence policies. ○ Correspondence with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time/absence entry.

• Manage, process and reconcile mass upload files for all pay frequencies. ○ Monitor data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy

• Ensure integrations are processed timely and resolve any errors ensuring accurately processed

• Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.

• Supports P&C Chapters in system maintenance activities.

• Provide guidance and advisory to first level P&C support teams.

• Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (KA, SWIs).

• Participating in project activities as required

• Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced.

• Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution

Wir sind das Sustainability Netzwerk am Roche Standort Ludwigsburg und treiben mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft die Themen rund um Nachhaltigkeit voran. Während dem Praktikum kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und operative Aufgaben und Projekte im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit mitgestalten. • Implementierung technischer Lösungen & KI: Eigenständige Identifikation, Evaluierung und Einführung von neuen Software- oder KI-Lösungen zur Optimierung und Automatisierung von Nachhaltigkeitsprozessen (z. B. KI-gestützte Datenanalysen, automatisierte Workflows oder digitale Tools zur Verbrauchsüberwachung).

• Energie- und Umweltmanagement: Datengestützte Unterstützung bei Projekten zum Energie- und Umweltmanagement (z. B. Ermittlung und Durchführung von Energie- und Abfalleinsparprojekten).

• Operative Unterstützung: Mithilfe bei Risk Assessments und Durchführung von Unfallanalysen sowie Unterstützung bei Compliance- und Governance-Themen.

• Kennzahlen & Analytics: Unterstützung bei der Erfassung, Berechnung und modernen, ggf. automatisierten Darstellung von Kennzahlen und KPIs.

• Schulungen & Training: Mithilfe bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen und Unterweisungen.

• Kommunikation & Awareness: Mitgestaltung und Optimierung des Intranet-Auftritts und der standortweiten Kommunikation von Nachhaltigkeitsthemen zur Erhöhung des Bewusstseins der Mitarbeitenden.

Schwerpunkttätigkeiten des Praktikums werden im Zusammenhang mit Projektaufkommen und Interessen des/der Kandidaten/in festgelegt.

Dein Profil

• Ausbildung: Laufendes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eines Studienganges im Bereich Umweltinformatik , Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines Ingenieurstudienganges (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Umweltingenieurwesen etc.) mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Datenanalyse oder Prozessautomatisierung und Interesse an Sustainability Themen.

• Tech-Skills: Erste praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Wissen im Bereich Datenanalyse (z. B. Python, SQL), Prozessautomatisierung (z. B. Low-Code-Plattformen) oder dem Einsatz von KI-Lösungen.

• Arbeitsweise: Selbständige und methodisch strukturierte Arbeitsweise geprägt von Proaktivität, Eigeninitiative und dem Willen zur technologischen Gestaltung.

• Mindset : Innovatives Denken und die Fähigkeit, Bestehendes kritisch zu hinterfragen und neu zu denken.

• Soft Skills: Ausgeprägtes Kommunikationsvermögen mit Empathie, Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie eine echte Begeisterung für Nachhaltigkeitsthemen.

• Sprachen : Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Verfügbarkeit: Zeit für ein 5-6 monatiges Praktikum - ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan is looking for a Product Manager, internally titled as Manager Business Innovation Molecular. Reporting to the Team Lead- Business Innovation, this position will see you developing specific marketing plans for products within the organization, interprets and translate scientific clinical data into commercial implications. You will analyze data and make strategic recommendations while providing marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches.

• This is a permanent and individual contributor position based in Karachi, within our Diagnostics business.

Your Opportunity

• Conceptualize, lead, execute and/or coordinate all activities related to product launches, product promotions, scientific training and for the Sales team, Customer & market analyses, co-creation and implementation of marketing plans and management of allocated A& P budget.

• Co-create with Medical, Sales teams, Clinical Value Marketing promotional, educational, access and partnership initiatives or business model solutions, which support faster adoption of Diagnostics solutions according to clinical guidelines and protocols

• Partner with relevant internal and external stakeholders to develop and communicate unique value propositions for our Diagnostics portfolio

• Identify strategic partners (public or private organizations) which can facilitate improved Patient Access – e.g. MoH, telehealth/teleconsultation system providers, insurance and financial institutions, patient coaching providers, NGOs, Hospitals etc.

• Co-develop the marketing plan based on robust market insights and analytics and informed by regular key Customer visits with Medical & Sales

• Source & analyze (including the development of business cases) market insight for new product launch potential, competitor intelligence, hospital procurement policies, pricing, etc.

• Leverage globally developed campaigns and brand assets to deploy locally translated promotional/educational materials for new and existing products, including brochures, leaflets, detailing materials, presentations, Lead HCP and Institutional marketing efforts for product promotion. including disease education

• Maintain strong disease and product knowledge; support internal and external customer education programs and product training

• Lead KOL engagement and speaker programs

• Leverage Medical and Scientific studies to create content for patients, HCPs and Institutions

• Drive shift in engaging HCPs on digital marketing platforms

• Conduct double visits with the Sales team to shape actionable content and format for the product training and promotional campaigns

• Coordinate with Medical to establish relevant presence and engagement for strategic events (symposia, conferences, etc.)

• Collaborate seamlessly with the rest of the Sales, Medical and other functions to deliver on the company’s objectives

• Ensure full compliance with Roche policies, coordinate with Quality & Regulatory functions, and secure timely and proper approval & documentation of activities and assets according to SOPs including the local customization process

• Contribute to actionable training & progress of the Sales Team by feedback & feed forward and sharing Customer Insight

• Implement Globally developed/validated tools and assets, customized for local use as applicable

• Track and consolidate relevant analytics and ROI KPIs

• Adopt

• Fonte & analizzare (compreso lo sviluppo di casi di business) intuizione di mercato per il nuovo potenziale di lancio del prodotto, intelligenza concorrente, politiche di approvvigionamento ospedaliero, prezzi, ecc.

• Mantenere la forte malattia e la conoscenza del prodotto; sostenere i programmi di formazione interna ed esterna del cliente e formazione del prodotto
• Lead KOL programmi di fidanzamento e altoparlanti
• Studi medici e scientifici per creare contenuti per pazienti, HCP e istituzioni
• Spostamento dell'azionamento in HCP coinvolgente sulle piattaforme di marketing digitale
• Condurre le doppie visite con il team Vendite per modellare contenuti e formati attuabili per la formazione dei prodotti e le campagne promozionali
• Coordinate con Medico per stabilire presenza e impegno rilevanti per eventi strategici (simposia, conferenze, ecc.)
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con il resto delle funzioni Vendite, Mediche e altre da fornire sugli obiettivi dell’azienda
• Assicurare la piena conformità alle politiche Roche, coordinare le funzioni di Quality & Regulatory e garantire tempestiva e corretta approvazione e documentazione delle attività e dei beni secondo le SOP, incluso il processo di personalizzazione locale
• Contribuisci alla formazione attiva e al progresso del Team Vendite tramite feedback e feed forward e condivisione della Customer Insight
• Strumenti e attività globalmente sviluppati/validati, personalizzati per uso locale come applicabile
• Tracciare e consolidare le analisi pertinenti e i KPI ROI
• Adozione

• Co-créer avec des équipes médicales, commerciales, marketing de valeur clinique des initiatives promotionnelles, éducatives, d'accès et de partenariat ou des solutions de modèles d'affaires, qui soutiennent l'adoption plus rapide de solutions diagnostiques selon les lignes directrices et protocoles cliniques
• Partenaire avec les intervenants internes et externes concernés pour élaborer et communiquer des propositions de valeur uniques pour notre portefeuille de diagnostics
• Identifier les partenaires stratégiques (organismes publics ou privés) qui peuvent faciliter l'amélioration de l'accès des patients (p. ex., le ministère de la Santé, les fournisseurs de systèmes de télésanté et de téléconsultation, les institutions financières et d'assurance, les fournisseurs d'encadrement des patients, les ONG, les hôpitaux, etc.).
• Co-développer le plan marketing basé sur de solides perspectives de marché et d'analyse et éclairé par des visites régulières de clients clés avec Medical & Sales
• Source et analyse (y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation) aperçu du marché pour le nouveau potentiel de lancement de produits, renseignements sur les concurrents, politiques d'approvisionnement des hôpitaux, prix, etc.
• Tirer parti des campagnes et des atouts de la marque au niveau mondial pour déployer du matériel promotionnel/éducatif traduit localement pour les produits nouveaux et existants, y compris des brochures, des dépliants, des documents détaillés, des présentations, des efforts de promotion des produits par le plomb HCP et des institutions. y compris l'éducation aux maladies
• Maintenir une solide connaissance des maladies et des produits; appuyer les programmes internes et externes de sensibilisation des clients et la formation des produits
• Engagement des chefs de file et programmes de conférenciers
• Tirer parti des études médicales et scientifiques pour créer du contenu pour les patients, les HCP et les institutions
• Intensification de la participation des PCH aux plateformes de marketing numérique
• Effectuer des visites doubles avec l'équipe des ventes pour façonner le contenu actionnable et le format des campagnes de formation et promotion des produits
• Coordonner avec Medical pour établir la présence et l'engagement pertinents pour les événements stratégiques (symposia, conférences, etc.)
• Collaborer en douceur avec le reste des ventes, des fonctions médicales et autres pour réaliser les objectifs de la société.
• Assurer le plein respect des politiques de Roche, la coordination avec les fonctions de qualité et de réglementation, et assurer l'approbation et la documentation opportunes et appropriées des activités et des biens conformément aux SOP, y compris le processus local de personnalisation
• Contribuer à la formation pratique et à l'avancement de l'équipe des ventes en faisant part de vos commentaires et de vos commentaires et en partageant le point de vue des clients
• Mettre en œuvre des outils et des actifs développés ou validés à l'échelle mondiale, adaptés à l'usage local, selon le cas

jobs.title: Territory Manager – Foundation Medicine
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

​ Accelerate Your Career in Precision Medicine If you are looking to transition from traditional medical sales into the frontier of genomic innovation, this permanent role offers the perfect platform for your professional evolution. As part of the Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) team within Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, this role is based in Lahore and will cover the Central and North regions. Reporting directly to the Business Manager for FMI, you won't just be managing a territory—you will be building a market, expanding your strategic business acumen, and establishing yourself as a leading expert in comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP).

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche : Own your territory and build high-level partnerships by serving as the trusted, expert face of Foundation Medicine (FMI) for prominent Oncologists, Pathologists, and multidisciplinary tumor boards across the Central and North regions.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs : Champion the scientific adoption of FMI's cutting-edge genomic testing portfolio, directly influencing personalized healthcare pathways.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge : Sharpen your scientific expertise by mastering complex molecular oncology, precision diagnostics, and genomic data to consult confidently with top-tier medical experts.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use : Step up to the challenge of managing regional commercial targets, honing your data-driven territory planning and execution skills.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions: Grow into a strategic leader by collaborating directly with the FMI Business Manager to co-create regional business blueprints, analyze market dynamics, and map long-term institutional accounts.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community : Develop sophisticated problem-solving skills as you work across complex hospital ecosystems to streamline genomic testing workflows from sample to report.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis : Position yourself as a thought leader by educating clinicians on the paradigm-shifting value of comprehensive genomic profiling over traditional testing.

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products) : Expand your professional presentation and leadership skills by driving scientific roundtables, medical meetings, and clinical case reviews.

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others : Gain valuable experience in healthcare market access by exploring and leveraging institutional funding and patient support avenues.

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP : Drive impactful patient-centric solutions by ensuring healthcare providers are fully aware of programs designed to maximize testing accessibility.

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem: Develop high-level "systems thinking" capabilities by embedding FMI testing into standard hospital clinical protocols.

• Responsible to repor

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Accelera la tua carriera in medicina di precisione Se stai cercando di passare dalle vendite mediche tradizionali alla frontiera dell'innovazione genomica, questo ruolo permanente offre la piattaforma perfetta per la tua evoluzione professionale. Nell'ambito del team Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, questo ruolo è basato in Lahore e coprirà le regioni centrali e nord. Segnalando direttamente al Business Manager per FMI, non solo gestirai un territorio – costruirai un mercato, espanderai il tuo acume strategico aziendale e ti stabilirai come un esperto leader nella profilazione genomica completa (CGP).
• Il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra le parti interessate e Roche: Possedere il proprio territorio e costruire partnership di alto livello servendo come il volto di fiducia, esperto di medicina della Fondazione (FMI) per oncologi di spicco, patologi, e schede tumorali multidisciplinari in tutte le regioni del Centro e del Nord.
• Responsabile per i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e supporta il loro uso appropriato, che include la condivisione dei loro meriti con HCP: Campione dell'adozione scientifica del portafoglio di test genomici all'avanguardia di FMI, influenzando direttamente percorsi sanitari personalizzati.
• Conoscenza del paesaggio delle malattie e dei prodotti: Affilare le tue competenze scientifiche masterizzando oncologia molecolare complessa, diagnostica di precisione e dati genomici per consultare con fiducia esperti medici di alto livello.
• Responsabilità dei prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il suo uso appropriato: salire alla sfida di gestire gli obiettivi commerciali regionali, affinare le vostre capacità di pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio.
• Ampia comprensione della sua area terapeutica e della sua rispettiva futura pipeline, tale da poter lavorare su soluzioni future: Crescere in un leader strategico collaborando direttamente con FMI Business Manager per co-creare progetti di business regionali, analizzare le dinamiche di mercato e mappare conti istituzionali a lungo termine.
• Partner con stakeholder di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità per fornire valore per i pazienti e la comunità: Sviluppare sofisticate capacità di problem solving mentre lavori in ecosistemi ospedalieri complessi per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di test genomici dal campione al report.
• Consapevolezza della malattia Diagnosi: Posizionati come leader di pensiero educando i medici sul valore di cambiamento del paradigma della profilazione genomica completa sul test tradizionale.
• Istruzione HCP (prodotti pre-approvati e post-approvati) : Espandi le tue capacità professionali di presentazione e leadership guidando tavole rotonde scientifiche, riunioni mediche e recensioni di casi clinici.
• I pazienti’ Accesso ai fondi disponibili, ad esempio PBM/SSP & altri: Ottieni una preziosa esperienza nell'accesso al mercato sanitario esplorando e sfruttando i finanziamenti istituzionali e i viali di supporto dei pazienti.
• Comunicazione proattiva con HCP su PSP: Soluzioni impattanti per il paziente-centric assicurando ai fornitori di servizi sanitari la piena consapevolezza dei programmi progettati per massimizzare l'accessibilità ai test.
• PJP agisce come un pensatore di sistema con la capacità di identificare lo scopo condiviso tra le parti interessate e lo sfrutta per co-creare soluzioni con le parti interessate nell'ecosistema: Sviluppare capacità di "sistemi di pensiero" di alto livello incorporando i test FMI nei protocolli clinici ospedalieri standard.
• Responsabile del repo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Ihre Chance Beschleunigen Sie Ihre Karriere in der Präzisionsmedizin Wenn Sie den Übergang vom traditionellen medizinischen Verkauf zur Grenze der genomischen Innovation anstreben, bietet diese ständige Rolle die perfekte Plattform für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung. Als Teil des Teams von Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics Pakistan hat diese Rolle ihren Sitz in Lahore und wird die zentralen und nördlichen Regionen abdecken. Wenn Sie direkt an den Business Manager für FMI berichten, verwalten Sie nicht nur ein Gebiet - Sie bauen einen Markt auf, erweitern Ihren strategischen Geschäftssinn und etablieren sich als führender Experte für umfassendes genomisches Profiling (CGP).
• Der primäre (aber nicht-exklusive) Kontaktpunkt zwischen Stakeholdern und Roche: Besitzen Sie Ihr Territorium und bauen Sie hochrangige Partnerschaften auf, indem Sie als vertrauenswürdiges, fachkundiges Gesicht der Foundation Medicine (FMI) für prominente Onkologen, Pathologen und multidisziplinäre Tumorboards in den Regionen Zentral und Nord dienen.
• Verantwortlich für die Produkte von Roche während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus und unterstützt deren angemessene Verwendung, einschließlich des Teilens ihrer Vorzüge mit HCPs : Verfechten Sie die wissenschaftliche Übernahme des hochmodernen Portfolios von FMI für Genomtests, die direkt personalisierte Gesundheitswege beeinflussen.
• Verständnis von Krankheitslandschaften und Produktwissen: Schärfen Sie Ihre wissenschaftliche Expertise, indem Sie komplexe molekulare Onkologie, Präzisionsdiagnostik und Genomdaten beherrschen, um sich mit erstklassigen medizinischen Experten vertraut zu machen.
• Verantwortung der Roche-Produkte während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus und Unterstützung ihrer angemessenen Nutzung: Stellen Sie sich der Herausforderung, regionale Geschäftsziele zu verwalten und Ihre datengesteuerten Fähigkeiten im Bereich Planung und Ausführung zu verbessern.
• Breites Verständnis seines/ihres therapeutischen Bereichs und seiner jeweiligen zukünftigen Pipeline, so dass sie an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen arbeiten können: Werden Sie zu einem strategischen Marktführer, indem Sie direkt mit dem FMI Business Manager zusammenarbeiten, um regionale Geschäftspläne zu erstellen, Marktdynamiken zu analysieren und langfristige institutionelle Konten abzubilden.
• Partnerschaften mit Interessengruppen der Patientenreise, um Hindernisse zu beseitigen und Möglichkeiten freizuschalten, um einen Mehrwert für Patienten und die Gemeinschaft zu schaffen: Entwickeln Sie anspruchsvolle Problemlösungskompetenzen, während Sie in komplexen Krankenhausökosystemen arbeiten, um genomische Testworkflows von der Probe bis zum Bericht zu optimieren.
• Bewusstsein für Krankheitsdiagnose: Positionieren Sie sich als Vordenker, indem Sie Kliniker über den Paradigmenwechselwert eines umfassenden genomischen Profilings gegenüber traditionellen Tests aufklären.
• HCP-Ausbildung (vorab genehmigte und nachab genehmigte Produkte): Erweitern Sie Ihre professionellen Präsentations- und Führungsfähigkeiten, indem Sie wissenschaftliche Roundtables, medizinische Meetings und klinische Fallprüfungen durchführen.
• Patienten Zugang zu verfügbaren Mitteln, z. B. PBM/SSP und andere: Gewinnen Sie wertvolle Erfahrungen im Bereich des Zugangs zum Gesundheitsmarkt, indem Sie Möglichkeiten zur institutionellen Finanzierung und Patientenunterstützung erkunden und nutzen.
• Proaktive Kommunikation mit HCPs auf PSP: Führen Sie wirkungsvolle patientenzentrierte Lösungen durch, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Gesundheitsdienstleister sich der Programme bewusst sind, die die Zugänglichkeit von Tests maximieren.
• PJP agiert als Systemdenker mit der Fähigkeit, einen gemeinsamen Zweck unter den Interessengruppen zu identifizieren und nutzt dies, um gemeinsam mit Interessengruppen im Ökosystem Lösungen zu entwickeln: Entwickeln Sie hochrangige "Systemdenken" -Fähigkeiten, indem Sie FMI-Tests in klinische Standardprotokolle für Krankenhäuser integrieren.
• Verantwortlich für repor

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Votre opportunité Accélérez votre carrière en médecine de précision Si vous cherchez à passer de la vente médicale traditionnelle à la frontière de l'innovation génomique, ce rôle permanent offre la plateforme parfaite pour votre évolution professionnelle. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Fondation Médecine Inc. (FMI) au sein de Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, ce rôle est basé à Lahore et couvrira les régions du Centre et du Nord. Sous l'autorité directe du chef d'entreprise de l'IMF, vous ne gérerez pas seulement un territoire : vous créerez un marché, élargirez votre sens stratégique des affaires et vous établirez comme un expert de premier plan en profilage génomique complet (CGP).
• Point de contact principal (mais non exclusif) entre les parties prenantes et Roche : Possédez votre territoire et établissez des partenariats de haut niveau en servant de visage expert de la Fondation Médecine (FMI) pour les Oncologues, les pathologistes et les conseils tumoraux multidisciplinaires de toutes les régions du Centre et du Nord.
• Responsable des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutient leur utilisation appropriée, qui inclut le partage de leurs mérites avec les HCP : Championne de l'adoption scientifique du portefeuille de tests génomiques de pointe du FMI, influençant directement les parcours de soins personnalisés.
• Connaissance du paysage des maladies et des produits : Approfondissez votre expertise scientifique en maîtrisant l'oncologie moléculaire complexe, les diagnostics de précision et les données génomiques pour consulter en toute confiance des experts médicaux de haut niveau.
• Responsabilité des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutien de son utilisation appropriée : Déploiez le défi de la gestion des objectifs commerciaux régionaux, perfectionnez vos compétences de planification et d'exécution de territoire axées sur les données.
• Compréhension étendue de son domaine thérapeutique et de son avenir, de sorte qu'ils puissent travailler sur des solutions basées sur l'avenir: Devenez un chef de file stratégique en collaborant directement avec le gestionnaire d'entreprise de l'IMF pour créer des plans d'affaires régionaux, analyser la dynamique du marché et cartographier les comptes institutionnels à long terme.
• Partenaires avec les intervenants du cheminement des patients pour supprimer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités de fournir de la valeur pour les patients et la communauté : Développer des compétences sophistiquées de résolution de problèmes lorsque vous travaillez à travers des écosystèmes hospitaliers complexes pour rationaliser les processus de test génomique de l'échantillon à rapport.
• Sensibilisation à la maladie Diagnostic : Positionnez-vous comme un leader de la pensée en éduquant les cliniciens sur la valeur changeante du profil génomique global par rapport aux tests traditionnels.
• Formation HCP (produits pré-approuvés et post-approuvés) : Élargissez votre présentation professionnelle et vos compétences en leadership en conduisant des tables rondes scientifiques, des réunions médicales et des examens de cas cliniques.
• Patients Accès aux fonds disponibles, p. ex. PBM/SSP et autres : acquérir une expérience précieuse en matière d'accès au marché des soins de santé en explorant et en tirant parti du financement institutionnel et des possibilités de soutien aux patients.
• Communication proactive avec les PSC sur les PSP : Conduire des solutions axées sur le patient en veillant à ce que les fournisseurs de soins de santé soient pleinement conscients des programmes conçus pour maximiser l'accessibilité aux tests.
• Le PJP agit comme un penseur système capable d'identifier des objectifs communs entre les intervenants et d'en tirer parti pour créer des solutions avec les intervenants de l'écosystème : Développer des capacités de « réflexion système » de haut niveau en intégrant les tests de l'IMF dans des protocoles cliniques hospitaliers standard.
• Responsable de la représentation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Functional expertise – Primary Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Play the role of “strategic product champion” to lead the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy and drive/coordinate branding development or evolution process

• Ensure the development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Design and deliver delightful end-to-end customer experiences through networked way of working

• Maintain up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area

• Use appropriate data analytics: analyze and assesses the data to extrapolate meaning and opportunities that drives the product’s overall market strength and positioning

• Enable a wide range of tactical activities to support a seamless, well integrated brand message and overall position across multiple marketing platforms. These activities may span several customer types (e.g. payers, HCPs) and will require working knowledge across different types of marketing

• Monitor competitor activity and recommend action

• Cultivate and develop Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers Ensure that all products are actively forecasted; manage the introduction/withdrawal of products; and that product changes/updates are communicated

• Provide input into public relations and access strategy Respect the compliance with all relevant Roche guidelines and policies

Mindset & Behaviors

• Enterprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others

• Accelerate learning: I push to learn new things even if difficult, and openly share my successes and failures

• Simplify radically: I eliminate complexity, reuse with pride, and accomplish more with less

• Make impact now: I take accountability to do what's right, deliver value fast, and don't wait for certainty

• Think long term: I choose actions today that benefit future generations

Skills and Experience :

• You have at least 8 years of experience in sales, marketing (at least 1 years of marketing relevant experience/projects including work packages and gigs), digital engagement and/or commercial operations (including leadership), with demonstrable evidence of successfully partnering with customers and achieving shared goals and outcomes.

• Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology , Business, Marketing or other related fields preferred

• You have a proven track record of

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Functional expertise – Primary Responsibilities & Accountabilities

• Play the role of “strategic product champion” to lead the development of the local (or above affiliate) marketing strategy and drive/coordinate branding development or evolution process

• Ensure the development of the marketing strategies and their execution with a strong focus of patient value and connected with all the strategies and solutions generated by different functions and teams

• Design and deliver delightful end-to-end customer experiences through networked way of working

• Maintain up to date knowledge of the global market for the therapy area

• Use appropriate data analytics: analyze and assesses the data to extrapolate meaning and opportunities that drives the product’s overall market strength and positioning

• Enable a wide range of tactical activities to support a seamless, well integrated brand message and overall position across multiple marketing platforms. These activities may span several customer types (e.g. payers, HCPs) and will require working knowledge across different types of marketing

• Monitor competitor activity and recommend action

• Cultivate and develop Key Opinion Leaders, product advocates and speakers Ensure that all products are actively forecasted; manage the introduction/withdrawal of products; and that product changes/updates are communicated

• Provide input into public relations and access strategy Respect the compliance with all relevant Roche guidelines and policies

Mindset & Behaviors

• Enterprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse perspectives, invite opposing views, and challenge myself and others

• Accelerate learning: I push to learn new things even if difficult, and openly share my successes and failures

• Simplify radically: I eliminate complexity, reuse with pride, and accomplish more with less

• Make impact now: I take accountability to do what's right, deliver value fast, and don't wait for certainty

• Think long term: I choose actions today that benefit future generations

Skills and Experience :

• You have at least 8 years of experience in sales, marketing (at least 1 years of marketing relevant experience/projects including work packages and gigs), digital engagement and/or commercial operations (including leadership), with demonstrable evidence of successfully partnering with customers and achieving shared goals and outcomes.

• Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology , Business, Marketing or other related fields preferred

• You have a proven track record of

jobs.title: Tender Analyst (Technical bachground)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
The Tender Analyst will analyze tender reporting requirements using data from internal and external sources to provide insights to decision-makers. He/she will demonstrate a high level of responsibility and collaboration with relevant stakeholders to understand the needs and deliver the requirement, timely and with high accuracy and reliability. He/she will identify data sources and interpret trends and patterns in datasets, will construct creative data / trends visualization based on business data and market knowledge. He/she will create specifications for reports and analysis based on data elements required or available. He/she could directly produce data sets and reports for analysis using system reporting tools as required.

• Dashboard Architecture & Data Modeling : Architect the underlying data models, schemas, and calculated fields required to power advanced Tableau and BI dashboards. Ensure that data structures are optimized for rapid query performance and scalable reporting.

• Database Structure & Pipeline Engineering : Build and maintain robust database structures (DB) and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines. Integrate disparate data streams—including distributor spreadsheets, SimplyBid master data, and external bidding news—into a single source of truth.

• Technical Governance & Systems Integration: Establish data governance protocols to ensure data integrity, security, and compliance. Collaborate with regional IT teams, system administrators, and automation engineers (including IT Interns) to align database infrastructure with broader corporate IT frameworks.

• Build strong collaborative relationships with peers that includes timely feedback and communication to gain alignment

• Perform any other duties that may be assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in a business, scientific or related field such as finance, marketing, MIS, IT, engineering, etc. from a reputable university (local/overseas)

• Professional Experience, Core Competencies, Mindset, and Behavioral Traits

• Minimum 3 years of experience in analytics and consulting

• Experience working in cross-functional projects

• Experience in the Healthcare Industry and MNCs will be an added advantage ●

• SAP and BI reporting tools (ie. Tableau) experience is a Must

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità L'Analista di Tender analizzerà i requisiti di reporting tenero utilizzando i dati provenienti da fonti interne ed esterne per fornire informazioni ai decisori. Egli dimostrerà un alto livello di responsabilità e collaborazione con le parti interessate rilevanti per comprendere le esigenze e fornire il requisito, tempestivo e con alta precisione e affidabilità. Identificherà fonti di dati e interpreterà tendenze e modelli in dataset, costruirà dati creativi / tendenze di visualizzazione basati su dati aziendali e conoscenze di mercato. Egli creerà specifiche per report e analisi basate su elementi di dati richiesti o disponibili. Potrebbe produrre direttamente set di dati e report per l'analisi utilizzando strumenti di reporting di sistema come richiesto.
• Dashboard Architecture & Data Modeling: Architetto i modelli di dati sottostanti, gli schemi e i campi calcolati necessari per alimentare le dashboard di Tableau e BI avanzate. Assicurarsi che le strutture dei dati siano ottimizzate per le prestazioni rapide di query e la reportistica scalabile.
• Database Structure & Pipeline Engineering: costruire e mantenere robuste strutture di database (DB) e ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline. Integrare flussi di dati disparati, inclusi fogli di calcolo del distributore, dati master di SimplyBid e notizie di offerte esterne, in un'unica fonte di verità.
• Technical Governance & Systems Integration: Stabilire protocolli di governance dei dati per garantire l'integrità dei dati, la sicurezza e la conformità. Collabora con team IT regionali, amministratori di sistema e ingegneri di automazione (compresi IT Interns) per allineare l'infrastruttura di database con più ampi framework IT aziendali.
• Costruire forti relazioni collaborative con i pari che includono feedback tempestivi e comunicazione per ottenere allineamento
• Eseguire qualsiasi altro dovere che può essere assegnato di volta in volta come richiesto dal business. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea in un campo commerciale, scientifico o relativo, come finanza, marketing, MIS, IT, ingegneria, ecc da un'università rispettabile (locale/oltremare)
• Esperienza professionale, competenze di base, Mindset e tratti comportamentali
• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nell'analisi e nella consulenza
• Esperienza di lavoro in progetti interfunzionali
• L'esperienza nel settore sanitario e MNCs sarà un vantaggio aggiunto ●
• L'esperienza di SAP e BI (cioè Tableau) è un must Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Quality and Regulatory Trainee
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This internship program offers students an opportunity to learn and develop within our Quality and Regulatory Subchapter. In this program, you'll gain insights into the diagnostics industry while upskilling and contributing to impactful projects for our patients.

We are looking for 1 intern who wants to be part of our Business Integrity team within the Quality and Regulatory department.

Your main responsibilities:

• Support continuous updates of quality management system documentation by interacting with other areas of the company.

• Support technical quality control activities for MD / IVD products.

• Participate in a project to ensure vigilance contact availability for main hospital accounts.

• Provide regulatory documentation translation support for tenders.

• Participate in projects regarding Quality and Regulatory activities.

Who are we looking for?

As an ideal candidate, you will have the following experience, education, and knowledge:

• Bachelors/Masters degree student in Health Sciences.

• Languages: Spanish and English (advanced C1 level).

• The applicant must be currently enrolled in a university to be eligible for a university internship contract.

As an ideal candidate, you will have the following skills:

• Eager to learn, self-managed & directed, bold, and able to prioritize.

• Attention to detail.

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must.

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools.

• Ability to deeply listen, question & understand, and communicate smoothly.

What will you get out of this program?

• Comprehensive professional experience that will allow you to acquire solid technical and practical knowledge in the diagnostics industry.

• Soft skill training to manage projects and provide sustainable value to patients in a VUCA (volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity) environment.

• You will have a mentor who will support your development throughout the program.

Additional Responsibilities and Compliance

The Trainee (Intern) must comply with all applicable legislation, internal procedures, and regulations regarding Safety, Health, and Environment, especially those procedures related to waste segregation, application of preventive measures, and use of work equipment and personal protective equipment.

Furthermore, the Trainee (Intern) must be familiar with and act in full compliance with the Company's policies, including the Code of Conduct and applicable Ethical Codes.

Regarding Information Security, the Trainee (Intern) must:

• Be aware of and comply with established quality and information security standards, and in any case, act according to instructions received.

• Comply with and enforce applicable procedures.

• Strive for the preservation of information security.

• Provide suggestions and participate in the continuous improvement of developed activities.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employe

• Impaziente di imparare, autogestito e diretto, audace, e in grado di dare priorità.
• Attenzione ai dettagli.
• La capacità di lavorare con le squadre interfunzionali è un must.
• Capacità di comprendere e sfruttare i mezzi e gli strumenti digitali.
• Capacità di ascoltare profondamente, domandare & capire e comunicare senza intoppi. Cosa uscirai da questo programma?
• Esperienza professionale completa che vi permetterà di acquisire solide conoscenze tecniche e pratiche nel settore della diagnostica.
• Addestramento a competenze morbide per gestire i progetti e fornire valore sostenibile ai pazienti in un ambiente VUCA (volatilità, incertezza, complessità e ambiguità).
• Avrete un mentore che supporterà il vostro sviluppo durante il programma. Ulteriori responsabilità e conformità Il Trainee (Intern) deve rispettare tutte le leggi, le procedure interne e i regolamenti applicabili in materia di sicurezza, salute e ambiente, in particolare quelle procedure relative alla segregazione dei rifiuti, all'applicazione di misure preventive, all'uso di attrezzature di lavoro e di attrezzature di protezione personale. Inoltre, il Trainee (Intern) deve avere familiarità e agire nel pieno rispetto delle politiche della Società, tra cui il Codice di condotta e i Codici Etici applicabili. Per quanto riguarda la sicurezza delle informazioni, il Trainee (Intern) deve:
• Essere consapevoli e conformi agli standard di qualità e sicurezza delle informazioni stabiliti, e in ogni caso, agire secondo le istruzioni ricevute.
• Completare e applicare le procedure applicabili.
• Impegnarsi per la conservazione della sicurezza dell'informazione.
• Fornire suggerimenti e partecipare al continuo miglioramento delle attività sviluppate. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un dipendente di pari opportunità

• Conduci "deep-dives" tecnico e studi di fattibilità sulle tecnologie di laboratorio emergenti (ad esempio, tecnologie analitiche in evoluzione, AR/VR per la formazione di laboratorio, analisi dei risultati AI-driven) per determinare la loro vestibilità nel paesaggio aziendale Roche.
• Identificare e risolvere proattivamente i colli di bottiglia architettonici negli strumenti di laboratorio legacy, assicurando che le soluzioni di connettività non diventino "piccola" o difficili da mantenere.
• Creare ed evolvere i modelli di dati concettuali e logici specificatamente per gli strumenti di laboratorio, garantendo l'allineamento con i principi di dati FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable).
• Architetti e mantieni lo strato di comunicazione che facilita lo scambio di dati senza soluzione di continuità attraverso l'ecosistema TechOps Quality.
• Progetti soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Senior Solution Architect konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem komplexen, multiplen Lösungs- oder Produktkontext. In dieser Rolle entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die den Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen und gleichzeitig nicht funktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen verwalten. Sie führen andere dazu, komplexe Probleme zu lösen, die Vision und den Fahrplan für mehrere Lösungen beizubehalten, den Produktteams technische Aufsicht zu bieten und neue Technologien zu bewerten, um bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten. • Sie besitzen die Dokumentation für kritische architektonische Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Instrumentenkommunikation, Datenerfassung und Datenintegrität (Architecture Decision Records: ADR).

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS) , we believe that every line of code can improve a patient’s life. Within our Patient Software Insights group, we build a diverse portfolio of digital solutions—from web apps to desktop tools—that help healthcare providers and patients stay one step ahead of disease.
We don't just "deploy"; we deliver trust.
As a Senior DevOps Automation Engineer , you will be the guardian of our delivery lifecycle, ensuring that our life-saving software reaches those who need it with the highest quality and security.

The Opportunity: Where Engineering meets Purpose
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is life-changing. You will join a cross-functional squad of brilliant engineers, designers, and product owners to:

• Master the Pipeline: Architect and oversee complex CI/CD ecosystems for Backend, Web, API, and Desktop environments (Windows/MacOS).

• Define the Standard: Establish best-in-class code branching and review processes that empower our dev teams.

• Automation at Scale: Use your Python mastery to eliminate manual bottlenecks and create self-healing deployment flows.

• Security & Resilience: Integrate cutting-edge SAST/DAST tools (SonarQube, Mayhem) to ensure our medical software is impenetrable.

• Lead by Example: Mentor fellow engineers and act as a technical lighthouse within the organization.

Who You Are: The Architect of Flow
You are a seasoned engineer who sees the "big picture." You are passionate about clean code, robust infrastructure, and, above all, the people you work with.
Your technical footprint:

• Proven Track Record: 7+ years of hands-on experience in high-level CI/CD automation across diverse platforms (Web, API, Lambdas, Desktop).

• The CI/CD Trio: Deep expertise in GitHub Actions , Jenkins, or GitLab CI.

• Containerization & Repos: Master of Docker/Containerd and artifact management (Nexus/Artifactory).

• The Language of Automation: Proficiency in Python (or a similar high-level language).

• Security-Minded: Experience weaving security tools (Trivy, SonarQube) into the fabric of the development process.

• Soft Skills: A collaborative spirit, a desire to mentor, and excellent English communication skills.

You’ll stand out if you bring: Familiarity with AWS, experience with testing frameworks (Appium, Selenium, JUnit), or a background in SaaS/E-commerce.

What’s in it for you? (The Roche Experience)

• Work with Purpose: Direct contact with our users to understand how your work helps people living with diabetes and other conditions.

• Innovation Culture: We welcome "technical evangelists." If you want to speak at a conference or write a blog, we’ll support you 100%.

• State-of-the-Art Tech: From native development to Infrastructure-as-Code in the cloud.

• Premium Benefits: Brand new Apple hardware, professional training budget, fitness and lunch benefits, public transport support, and language classes.

• A Hub of Talent: Join a diverse, agile environment in Sant Cugat where knowledge sharing is part of our DNA.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity,

For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life . The Opportunity: Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk! You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers. Who you are: We seek an experienced, motivated Senior DevOps Software Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:
• At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).
• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.
• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.
• Deep experience in:
• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).
• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).
• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).
• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.
• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. The following skills significantly strengthen your application:
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.
• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),
• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.
• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries. Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...) You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits. You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers. • At least 7 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines (for example, Backend, Web, API, Lambdas, and Desktop (Windows, MacOS)).
• Proven ability to establish code branching and review processes.
• Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language.
• Deep experience in:
• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).
• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).
• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).
• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.
• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. The following skills significantly strengthen your application:
• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.
• Experience in building and testing applications (e.g., JMeter, Appium, xCUITest, JUnit, Selenium),
• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.
• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries. Here's what you can expect from us:

You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you!

jobs.title: Praktikum Biosensorik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Wir sind das „Bio-Interaction-Analysis-Team in der R&D der Diagnostik Division der Roche Diagnostics GmbH. Wir sind ein junges Team mit 6 Mitarbeitenden, spezialisiert im Bereich der Biosensorik.
Wir suchen wir für den Zeitraum September bis Mitte Februar eine/einen Praktikantin/Praktikanten zur Mitarbeit an unserem R&D-Projekten.

Was dich erwartet/Deine Aufgaben

• Bewertung monoklonaler Antikörper für die Forschung und Entwicklung immunologischer Einsatzstoffe im Bereich kinetisches Screening

• Erhebung kinetischer Daten mittels Surface Plasmon Resonance Technologie (Biacore)

• Bestimmung von Antikörper-Antigen Wechselwirkungen, Quantifizierung von ka, kd, KD, Epitopbinning, Antikörper Spezifitätsanalytik, Auswertung und Interpretation der Daten

• Du bist eingebunden in unser sehr agiles Team, die Interpreatation Diskussion deiner erhobenen ist Teil deiner Aufgabe

Wer du bist

Für das Praktikum im Bereich der Biosensorik bringst du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Master-Studiengang der Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie oder verwandte Studiengänge, Bachelor-Abschluss wird vorausgesetzt!

• Du verfügst über Vorkenntnisse in der Immunologie, insbesondere Antikörper, Proteinbiochemie und hast bereits immunologische Assays durchgeführt ELISA o.ä.

• Interesse an Real Time Biosensorik, Biophysik

• Du bist kommunikativ und kannst in englischer Sprache präsentieren

• Du bist hoch motiviert, teamfähig

• Du kannst eigenständig arbeiten

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
