jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Digital Pathology Sales Enablement is accountable for developing and growing the Digital Pathology business, including image management systems and clinical algorithms, in Key Accounts across EMEA/LATAM. This role provides visionary leadership to accelerate the adoption of digital pathology solutions, aligning global go-to-market priorities with regional execution to transform pathology workflows and strengthen long-term partnerships with top-tier healthcare customers.

The role holds shared responsibility for the P&L of the Digital Pathology business and serves as the primary strategic lead for pathology-specific digital transformation projects. Working closely with key account management and clinical specialists, the role acts as a catalyst for integrating digital pathology into routine diagnostic practice across Europe and LATAM.
As a senior cross-functional leader, the incumbent influences how RIS delivers value through digital solutions, champions customer-centric innovation, and ensures seamless collaboration between global and regional teams. Acting as a strategic bridge between the market and the enterprise, this role will translate customer insights and emerging trends into actionable imperatives that shape the future direction of RIS’s digital ecosystem and product strategy.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the digital business strategy for Digital Pathology Adoption through key customer projects, driving the implementation of digital workflows, commercial growth, and clinical value across Tier-1 accounts in Europe and LATAM. Define pathology-specific acceleration plans in close collaboration with regional stakeholders.

• Provide visionary leadership to the GTM organization, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Build team capabilities in digital acumen, strategic account management, and customer partnership excellence.

• Define and execute the Go-To-Market strategy for Digital Pathology, ensuring global product objectives for image management and AI-based diagnostics are successfully adapted to regional market needs. Translate pathology workflow insights into actionable strategic initiatives.

• Strengthen Tier-1 account relationships and expand digital solution adoption through customer-centric engagement, value-based selling, and commercial excellence. Ensure shared P&L objectives are met by driving sustainable business performance, pipeline growth, and account prioritization.

• Oversee the implementation of large-scale digital pathology installations, including scanner integration and data management platforms, across complex pathology networks. Lead cross-functional teams to ensure high adoption rates and measurable clinical impact.

• Serve as a trusted advisor by leveraging deep expertise in pathology workflows, tissue diagnostics, and the clinical value of digital imaging. Connect digital capabilities with diagnostic outcomes to maximize relevance for pathologists and lab directors.

• Collaborate with global Product Management to translate field insights into product roadmap priorities, guiding lifecycle decisions and co-creation initiatives with strategic customers. Advocate for innovation opportunities that enhance scalability, usability, and ROI.

• Hold shared P&L responsibility for Digital Pathology performance, expertly defining and executing digital acceleration strategies and bespoke account plans in collaboration with the EMEA/LATAM team.

Essendo un ponte strategico tra il mercato e l’impresa, questo ruolo tradurrà le intuizioni dei clienti e le tendenze emergenti in imperativi attuabili che modellano la direzione futura dell’ecosistema digitale RIS e della strategia di prodotto. Definire piani di accelerazione specifici per la patologia in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder regionali.

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia Go-To-Market per la patologia digitale, assicurando obiettivi globali di prodotto per la gestione delle immagini e la diagnostica basata su AI sono adattati con successo alle esigenze del mercato regionale. Tradurre patologia workflow approfondimenti in iniziative strategiche attuabili.
• Rafforzare le relazioni di account Tier-1 e espandere l'adozione di soluzioni digitali attraverso il coinvolgimento incentrato sul cliente, la vendita basata sul valore e l'eccellenza commerciale. Garantire gli obiettivi P&L condivisi sono soddisfatti guidando prestazioni aziendali sostenibili, crescita delle tubazioni e priorità dei conti.
• Superare l'implementazione di installazioni di patologia digitale su larga scala, tra cui l'integrazione dello scanner e piattaforme di gestione dei dati, attraverso reti di patologia complesse. Condurre team interfunzionali per garantire elevati tassi di adozione e un impatto clinico misurabile.
• Servire come consulente affidabile sfruttando le competenze profonde nei flussi di lavoro patologico, diagnostica dei tessuti e il valore clinico dell'imaging digitale. Collegare le capacità digitali con i risultati diagnostici per massimizzare la rilevanza per i patologi e i direttori di laboratorio.
• Collabora con la gestione globale dei prodotti per tradurre intuizioni sul campo le priorità della roadmap del prodotto, guidando le decisioni del ciclo di vita e le iniziative di co-creazione con i clienti strategici. Avvocato per opportunità di innovazione che valorizzano scalabilità, usabilità e ROI.

Ce rôle fournit un leadership visionnaire pour accélérer l'adoption de solutions de pathologie numérique, en alignant les priorités mondiales de mise en marché avec l'exécution régionale pour transformer les flux de travail de pathologie et renforcer les partenariats à long terme avec les clients de soins de santé de premier ordre. Ce rôle assume la responsabilité partagée de la P et L du secteur de la pathologie numérique et est le principal responsable stratégique des projets de transformation numérique propres à la pathologie. En étroite collaboration avec des spécialistes clés de la gestion des comptes et des cliniques, le rôle joue un rôle de catalyseur pour l'intégration de la pathologie numérique dans les pratiques de diagnostic de routine en Europe et au LATAM. En tant que leader interfonctionnel senior, le titulaire influence la façon dont RIS offre de la valeur grâce à des solutions numériques, défend l'innovation centrée sur le client et assure une collaboration transparente entre les équipes mondiales et régionales. Agissant comme un pont stratégique entre le marché et l'entreprise, ce rôle permettra de traduire les connaissances des clients et les tendances émergentes en impératifs réalisables qui façonnent l'orientation future de l'écosystème numérique et de la stratégie des produits RIS. La possibilité :
• Diriger la stratégie d'entreprise numérique pour la pathologie numérique Adoption à travers des projets clients clés, moteur la mise en œuvre de flux de travail numériques, la croissance commerciale et la valeur clinique dans les comptes Tier-1 en Europe et LATAM. Définir des plans d'accélération spécifiques à la pathologie en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants régionaux.
• Fournir un leadership visionnaire à l'organisation GTM, favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration et d'amélioration continue. Développer les capacités de l'équipe en matière d'acuité numérique, de gestion stratégique des comptes et d'excellence du partenariat client.
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie Go-To-Market pour la pathologie numérique, en veillant à ce que les objectifs de produits mondiaux pour la gestion de l'image et les diagnostics basés sur l'IA soient adaptés avec succès aux besoins du marché régional. Traduire les informations sur les flux de travail en initiatives stratégiques réalisables.
• Renforcer les relations de compte Tier-1 et élargir l'adoption de solutions numériques par l'engagement axé sur le client, la vente fondée sur la valeur et l'excellence commerciale. Veiller à ce que les objectifs communs en matière de P et L soient atteints en favorisant la performance opérationnelle durable, la croissance des pipelines et la hiérarchisation des comptes.
• Superviser la mise en place d'installations de pathologie numérique à grande échelle, y compris de plates-formes d'intégration des scanners et de gestion des données, sur des réseaux de pathologie complexes. Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer des taux d'adoption élevés et des répercussions cliniques mesurables.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Opportunity: Sales & Applications Specialist – Roche Tissue Diagnostics (Ireland)

Are you ready to make a tangible difference in patient lives?

At Roche, we are dedicated to "Doing now what patients need next." As the world’s largest investor in R&D in healthcare and a global leader in in vitro diagnostics, Roche Tissue Diagnostics is at the forefront of transforming cancer diagnosis. We are seeking a passionate and driven professional to join our team in Ireland to help us deliver these life-changing solutions.

The Role

This is a pivotal Sales and Applications role focused on driving the adoption of our diagnostic solutions. You will be the primary link between our advanced technology and the laboratories that use them, ensuring that pathologists and scientists have the support they need to provide the best possible outcomes for their patients.

Who You Are

You are a technical expert who is ready to combine your scientific background with a commercial mindset. We are looking for individuals who embody courage, passion, and integrity .

• Qualifications: You hold a degree in Biomedical Science (or equivalent).

• Experience: You have direct experience working within a histopathology laboratory.

• Location: You are based in the Republic of Ireland, with a preference for candidates located in the Cork-Dublin or Galway-Dublin corridors to facilitate effective territory management.

• Sales Mindset: While previous sales experience is highly valued, it is not essential. We are looking for the right attitude—a desire to learn, grow, and apply your technical expertise in a commercial setting.

Core Commercial Traits We Look For:

• Precision & Impact: A target-focused professional who balances high-quality outputs with a patient-centric mindset.

• Proactive Mindset: You are self-motivated, identifying opportunities and making informed decisions to drive business outcomes.

• Commercially Astute: You understand the value of market data and how it contributes to sustainable growth.

• Collaborative Influence: You build strong interpersonal relationships and networks across all levels to drive collective success.

• Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in a fast-paced commercial environment and remain resilient in the face of challenges.

Why Roche?
Joining Roche means becoming part of a global team that is defined by its commitment to healthcare transformation. We offer a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and the opportunity to work with industry-leading diagnostic solutions that directly improve patient care.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Opportunity: Sales & Applications Specialist – Roche Tissue Diagnostics (Ireland)

Are you ready to make a tangible difference in patient lives?

At Roche, we are dedicated to "Doing now what patients need next." As the world’s largest investor in R&D in healthcare and a global leader in in vitro diagnostics, Roche Tissue Diagnostics is at the forefront of transforming cancer diagnosis. We are seeking a passionate and driven professional to join our team in Ireland to help us deliver these life-changing solutions.

The Role

This is a pivotal Sales and Applications role focused on driving the adoption of our diagnostic solutions. You will be the primary link between our advanced technology and the laboratories that use them, ensuring that pathologists and scientists have the support they need to provide the best possible outcomes for their patients.

Who You Are

You are a technical expert who is ready to combine your scientific background with a commercial mindset. We are looking for individuals who embody courage, passion, and integrity .

• Qualifications: You hold a degree in Biomedical Science (or equivalent).

• Experience: You have direct experience working within a histopathology laboratory.

• Location: You are based in the Republic of Ireland, with a preference for candidates located in the Cork-Dublin or Galway-Dublin corridors to facilitate effective territory management.

• Sales Mindset: While previous sales experience is highly valued, it is not essential. We are looking for the right attitude—a desire to learn, grow, and apply your technical expertise in a commercial setting.

Core Commercial Traits We Look For:

• Precision & Impact: A target-focused professional who balances high-quality outputs with a patient-centric mindset.

• Proactive Mindset: You are self-motivated, identifying opportunities and making informed decisions to drive business outcomes.

• Commercially Astute: You understand the value of market data and how it contributes to sustainable growth.

• Collaborative Influence: You build strong interpersonal relationships and networks across all levels to drive collective success.

• Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in a fast-paced commercial environment and remain resilient in the face of challenges.

Why Roche?
Joining Roche means becoming part of a global team that is defined by its commitment to healthcare transformation. We offer a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and the opportunity to work with industry-leading diagnostic solutions that directly improve patient care.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Team Lead (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a 2 year fixed-term position.

The opportunity:

• Building, leading, coaching and managing a strong and collaborative Accounts Payable team covering end-to-end AP support

• Creating a safe and positive team environment and ensuring that the team demonstrates the right mindset and attitude

• Setting up clear, right, challenging expectations and goals, with desired behaviors for team members and role modelling these

• Through frequent check-ins, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions; and developing the team members’ knowledge, skills, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff as well as building a team talent pipeline

• Setting and monitoring team working plan and resource allocations

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships, working with peers to develop future service portfolio in the area of P2P Services & Solutions

• Ensuring high quality knowledge transfers and smooth transitions in case of transferring work to own area. Liaising with other Service teams for cross-functional end-to-end service delivery and process improvement

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience. Experience in working with SAP.

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. 2-5 years of experience in a shared service center, with a proven track record of leading regional or global service delivery teams

• Proficiency in English ( French is an advantage)

• A growth & continuous improvement mindset, coupled with strong business acumen and an understanding of servicing impact

• Customer centricity & accountability as well as excellent communication & problem-solving skills

• Strong leadership competencies and demonstrated success in cross-cultural collaboration, change & stakeholder management

• You bring a creative leadership style and a coaching mindset (empowering, facilitating accountability, collaboration, experimentation & continuous learning)

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Engineer, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Engineer, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s buil

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Finance Business Analyst

The Opportunity

As a member of the RSS Performance Management, Finance Expert Team, as our Finance Business Analyst, you will be the bridge between core finance operations and modern data analytics. You won’t just be crunching numbers; you will be challenging the status quo, automating legacy processes, and shaping how our global business functions make decisions. Embracing an agile mindset, you will directly influence the efficiency of our global Finance teams.

• Drive Innovation & Automation: Lead continuous improvement initiatives to automate reporting, streamline workflows, and eliminate manual efficiencies across global sites.

• Own the Data Narrative: Develop, maintain, and elevate our financial reporting systems and platforms to deliver high-quality, actionable standard and management reporting.

• Ensure Data Integrity: Manage and oversee consistent master data and robust financial controls to ensure the absolute reliability of our financial statements.

• Collaborate Globally: Partner closely with local and global Finance teams to provide rapid, high-impact support for urgent business needs and month-end processes.

Who You Are

• The Experience: 3–5 years of experience in a global finance, accounting, or financial systems environment.

• System & Tools: High proficiency in SAP environments. You are a power-user of Excel, capable of leveraging advanced formulas and data modeling to drive operational efficiency. You have a proven track record—or a strong aptitude—for developing and optimizing sustainable reporting platforms.

• The Mindset: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a passion for problem-solving and process optimization. You don't just find errors; you build the system that prevents them.

• Education & Languages: Fluent English is essential. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, or a related field is required.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Finanzgeschäft Analyst Die Chance Als Mitglied des RSS Performance Management, Finance Expert Team, sind Sie als unser Finance Business Analyst die Brücke zwischen Kernfinanzbetrieb und moderner Datenanalyse. Sie werden nicht nur Zahlen knacken; Sie werden den Status Quo herausfordern, Legacy-Prozesse automatisieren und gestalten, wie unsere globalen Geschäftsfunktionen Entscheidungen treffen. Mit einer agilen Denkweise beeinflussen Sie direkt die Effizienz unserer globalen Finanzteams.
• Förderung von Innovation und Automatisierung: Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen, um das Reporting zu automatisieren, Workflows zu optimieren und manuelle Effizienz an globalen Standorten zu eliminieren.
• Own the Data Narrative: Entwickeln, pflegen und verbessern Sie unsere Finanzberichterstattungssysteme und -plattformen, um qualitativ hochwertige, umsetzbare Standard- und Managementberichterstattung zu liefern.
• Datenintegrität sicherstellen: Verwalten und überwachen Sie konsistente Stammdaten und robuste Finanzkontrollen, um die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Abschlüsse zu gewährleisten.
• Global zusammenarbeiten: Enge Partnerschaft mit lokalen und globalen Finanzteams, um schnelle, wirkungsvolle Unterstützung für dringende Geschäftsanforderungen und Monatsendprozesse zu bieten. Wer du bist
• Die Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer globalen Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Finanzsystemumgebung.
• System & Tools: Hohe Kenntnisse in SAP-Umgebungen. Sie sind ein Power-User von Excel, der in der Lage ist, fortschrittliche Formeln und Datenmodellierung zu nutzen, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu steigern. Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz – oder eine starke Eignung – für die Entwicklung und Optimierung nachhaltiger Berichtsplattformen.
• Das Mindset: Starke analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten mit einer Leidenschaft für Problemlösung und Prozessoptimierung. Sie finden nicht nur Fehler; Sie bauen das System, das sie verhindert.
• Bildung & Sprachen: fließendes Englisch ist unerlässlich. Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Business Analytics oder einem verwandten Bereich ist erforderlich. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.
• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty.
• Flexibilität: Wir unterstützen auch Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden. Home Office ist allgemein verfügbar (in der Regel 2 Bürotage). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.
• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen. Bitte lesen Sie die Datenschutzerklärung für weitere Informationen darüber, wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten im Zusammenhang mit dem Rekrutierungsprozess umgehen: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unserer Diagnose durchgeführt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste des affaires financières L'opportunité En tant que membre de l'équipe d'experts en gestion du rendement RSS, en tant qu'analyste des affaires financières, vous serez le pont entre les opérations financières de base et l'analyse moderne des données. Vous n'avez gagné que des chiffres de plus en plus grands; vous allez défier le statu quo, automatiser les processus hérités et façonner le fonctionnement de notre entreprise mondiale prendre des décisions. En prenant en compte un état d'esprit agile, vous influencerez directement l'efficacité de nos équipes financières mondiales.
• Piloter l'innovation et l'automatisation : Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour automatiser les rapports, rationaliser les flux de travail et éliminer les gains d'efficacité manuels sur les sites mondiaux.
• Posséder la narration des données : Développer, maintenir et élever nos systèmes et plateformes d'information financière afin d'offrir des rapports de qualité et de gestion.
• Assurer l'intégrité des données : Gérer et superviser des données de base cohérentes et des contrôles financiers robustes pour assurer la fiabilité absolue de nos états financiers.
• Collaborer en étroite collaboration avec les équipes financières locales et mondiales afin de fournir un soutien rapide et à fort impact pour les besoins urgents des entreprises et les processus de fin de mois. Qui vous êtes
• L'expérience : de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement mondial de finances, de comptabilité ou de systèmes financiers.
• Système & Outils: Haute compétence dans les environnements SAP. Vous êtes un utilisateur de puissance d'Excel, capable de tirer parti de formules avancées et de modélisation de données pour conduire l'efficacité opérationnelle. Vous avez des antécédents avérés – ou une forte aptitude – pour développer et optimiser des plateformes de reporting durables.
• The Mindset: Fortes compétences analytiques et quantitatives avec une passion pour la résolution de problèmes et l'optimisation des processus. Vous ne trouvez pas seulement des erreurs ; vous construisez le système qui les empêche.
• Éducation et langues: L'anglais fluide est essentiel. Un baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, analyse des affaires ou un domaine connexe est requis. En échange, nous vous fournissons
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours de bureau). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.
• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion. Veuillez lire l'Avis de confidentialité des données pour plus d'informations sur la façon dont nous traitons vos données personnelles liées au processus de recrutement: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidats Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec nos diagnostics

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como Especialista de Dados em Supply Chain, você terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em inteligência estratégica para otimizar a Cadeia Logística da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil. Seu foco está em elevar a experiência do cliente e maximizar a rentabilidade através de decisões fundamentadas. Você será responsável por promover a cultura de dados utilizando desde soluções analíticas clássicas até Advanced Analytics, atuando como um facilitador para parceiros de negócios na identificação de casos de uso de alto impacto.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos e das informações geradas através deles;

• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio;

• Transformar a tomada de decisão de Supply Chain para uma cultura de Data Driven Organization, alinhando as necessidades do negócio com ações tomadas internamente;

• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.

• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.

• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos, trazendo foco na melhoria contínua e redução de custos;

• Desafiar os dashboards gerados atualmente, trazendo sinergia de relatórios e minimizando as vulnerabilidades de informações entre eles;

• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.

• Experiência relevante em Engenharia de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos

• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain

• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação

• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares

• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares

• Inglês avançado

• Forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes

• Resiliência e grande habilidade de articulação cross- supply

• Perfil proativo voltado para a resolução de problemas

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório obrigatório)

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The IT Technical Analyst for ServiceNow IRM focuses on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under the guidance of more experienced analysts. In this entry-level role, you will operate within well-defined, routine tasks, focusing on continuous learning and applying core business analysis principles. By supporting the delivery of clearly documented requirements and assisting with problem definition, you will build foundational skills while contributing to the design of specific IT solution features.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Operates within well-defined, routine tasks under close supervision, with a primary focus on continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards. Executes work within existing templates and processes, proactively seeking clarification and collaborating effectively with team members to build confidence and capability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Supports senior Analysts and Solution Architects in analyzing technical problems within a defined scope, contributing to problem definition, and identifying potential root causes under guidance. Elicits and clarifies stakeholder needs, analyzes and maps requirements, and assists in identifying and presenting basic solutions. Accountable for the timely completion and quality of assigned discrete tasks and delivering clearly documented requirements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies primary team members and internal stakeholders within a project, interacting closely with agile team members working on IT solutions. Acts as a supportive communicator and information gatherer, assisting in preparing basic project updates, capturing stakeholder feedback, and clarifying basic requirements on small, well-defined engagements.

• Impact/Strategy: Focuses on participation, observation, and learning to understand foundational objectives and their relevance. Makes foundational contributions to project objectives while learning how they align with broader goals.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a single solution level, supporting the analysis and documentation of requirements for specific features or functionalities. Demonstrates the ability to analyze individual solution components and understands the basic impacts of changes within this limited scope.

• Business / Technical ability: Exhibits a basic understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Possesses a foundational understanding of the relevant business or technical domain and supporting technologies.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Entry-level experience with a focus on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under guidance.

• Demonstrated eagerness for continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards.

• Knowledge of Risk Management and IT Security is a plus

Technical Skills

• ServiceNow Foundations: Basic understanding of ServiceNow tables, fields, and workflow relationships.

• AI Proficiency is a plus: Ability to use Claude (or similar LLMs) to assist in technical analysis, documentation drafting, and platform troubleshooting.

• Agile Methodologies: Foundational knowledge of Agile/Scrum principles, Understanding

• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Unterstützt leitende Analysten und Lösungsarchitekten bei der Analyse technischer Probleme in einem definierten Umfang, trägt zur Problemdefinition bei und identifiziert mögliche Ursachen unter Anleitung. Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige Durchführung und Qualität der zugewiesenen diskreten Aufgaben und die Bereitstellung klar dokumentierter Anforderungen.

• Wirkung / Strategie: Konzentriert sich auf Partizipation, Beobachtung und Lernen, grundlegende Ziele und ihre Relevanz zu verstehen. Er leistet grundlegende Beiträge zu den Projektzielen und lernt, wie sie mit breiteren Zielen übereinstimmen.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert typischerweise auf einer einzigen Lösungsebene und unterstützt die Analyse und Dokumentation von Anforderungen für bestimmte Funktionen oder Funktionen. Zeigt die Fähigkeit, einzelne Lösungskomponenten zu analysieren und versteht die grundlegenden Auswirkungen von Änderungen in diesem begrenzten Umfang.
• Business / Technical Fahigkeit: Zeigt ein grundlegendes Verständnis und Anwendung von Tools, Prinzipien, Konzepten und Techniken in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Usability und Prozessanalyse. The Position

As a ServiceNow IRM Solutions Engineer, you drive the successful delivery and evolution of Roche’s Information Risk Management capabilities on the ServiceNow platform.
You combine product ownership, strong ServiceNow expertise, and hands-on delivery capability to ensure scalable and compliant solutions supporting Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), and Privacy.
In this role, you translate business, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements into clear and implementable user stories, enabling engineering teams to deliver efficiently and with clarity. You own the delivery backlog and ensure alignment with the product roadmap, enterprise architecture, and strategic priorities.
Beyond backlog ownership, you actively support delivery when needed — contributing to analysis, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution validation to ensure successful and high-quality outcomes.
Your goal is to ensure that ServiceNow capabilities supporting information risk, third-party risk, and privacy management are delivered in a scalable, reliable, and compliant way, enabling Roche to manage information risks effectively across the enterprise.

• Requirements Engineering: Translate complex business, regulatory, and security requirements into clear, actionable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria .

• Transparent Delivery : Maintain visibility into progress, dependencies, and risks, while balancing team capacity and business urgency

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Bridge the gap between ITIL-based processes , cybersecurity governance, and technical implementation to ensure a cohesive risk management ecosystem.

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a ServiceNow IRM Solutions Engineer, you drive the successful delivery and evolution of Roche’s Information Risk Management capabilities on the ServiceNow platform.
You combine product ownership, strong ServiceNow expertise, and hands-on delivery capability to ensure scalable and compliant solutions supporting Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), and Privacy.
In this role, you translate business, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements into clear and implementable user stories, enabling engineering teams to deliver efficiently and with clarity. You own the delivery backlog and ensure alignment with the product roadmap, enterprise architecture, and strategic priorities.
Beyond backlog ownership, you actively support delivery when needed — contributing to analysis, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and solution validation to ensure successful and high-quality outcomes.
Your goal is to ensure that ServiceNow capabilities supporting information risk, third-party risk, and privacy management are delivered in a scalable, reliable, and compliant way, enabling Roche to manage information risks effectively across the enterprise.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Backlog Management : Own and refine the ServiceNow IRM, GRC, TPRM, and Privacy backlogs, ensuring a prioritized pipeline of work that aligns with the product roadmap and business value.

• Architectural Guidance : Interpret solution and process architectures to guide delivery, ensuring all configurations and integrations align with ServiceNow platform best practices.

• Requirements Engineering: Translate complex business, regulatory, and security requirements into clear, actionable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria .

• Transparent Delivery : Maintain visibility into progress, dependencies, and risks, while balancing team capacity and business urgency

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Bridge the gap between ITIL-based processes , cybersecurity governance, and technical implementation to ensure a cohesive risk management ecosystem.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in technical product ownership, product/service management, technical analysis, or delivery leadership.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in software delivery and ServiceNow platform implementation.

• Demonstrated experience translating complex business or regulatory requirements into implementable technical work items.

• Experience working in Agile delivery environments with backlog ownership and roadmap alignment.

• Experience working with ServiceNow IRM, GRC, Risk Management, TPRM, or Privacy Management modules.

• Experience working in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or similar) is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IRM, GRC, TPRM, and Privacy Management capabilities.

• Understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, configuration, and integration patterns.

• Familiarity with information risk management, cybersecurity governance, and privacy risk management practices.

• Understanding of ITIL-based processes in enterprise environments.

• Experience supporting regulated IT environments and system validation activities is a plus.

• Strong understanding of software delivery methodologies and backlog management practices.

• Ability to int

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur de solutions IRM de ServiceNow, vous pilotez la prestation et l'évolution réussies des capacités de gestion des risques d'information de Roches sur la plateforme ServiceNow. Vous combinez la propriété des produits, une solide expertise ServiceNow et une capacité pratique de livraison pour assurer des solutions évolutives et conformes à la gouvernance, au risque et à la conformité (GRC), à la gestion des risques de tiers (GRPT) et à la protection de la vie privée. Votre objectif est de s'assurer que les capacités de ServiceNow qui soutiennent le risque d'information, le risque de tiers et la gestion de la vie privée sont fournies de façon évolutive, fiable et conforme, ce qui permet à Roche de gérer efficacement les risques d'information dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. • Orientation architecturale : Interpréter les architectures de solutions et de processus pour guider la livraison, en veillant à ce que toutes les configurations et intégrations s'harmonisent avec les meilleures pratiques de la plateforme ServiceNow.
• Exigences Ingénierie: Traduire des exigences complexes en affaires, réglementaires et de sécurité en récits d'utilisateurs clairs et exploitables avec des critères d'acceptation bien définis.
• Prestation transparente : maintenir la visibilité dans les progrès, les dépendances et les risques, tout en équilibrant les capacités de l'équipe et l'urgence opérationnelle
• Alignement interfonctionnel : combler l'écart entre les processus basés sur l'ITIL, la gouvernance de la cybersécurité et la mise en oeuvre technique pour assurer la cohésion de l'écosystème de gestion des risques. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information, en génie, en informatique ou dans une discipline connexe.
• 5+ ans d'expérience dans la propriété technique de produits, la gestion de produits/services, l'analyse technique ou le leadership de la prestation.
• 5+ ans d'expérience pratique dans la livraison de logiciels et la mise en œuvre de la plateforme ServiceNow.
• Expérience démontrée transformant des exigences opérationnelles ou réglementaires complexes en éléments de travail technique réalisables.
• Expérience de travail dans les environnements de prestation Agile avec appropriation en retard et alignement de feuille de route.
• Expérience de travail avec les modules ServiceNow IRM, GRC, Gestion des risques, TPRM ou Gestion de la vie privée.
• L'expérience de travail dans les industries réglementées (pharmacie, biotechnologie, soins de santé, etc.) est un atout. Compétences techniques
• Forte connaissance des capacités de gestion de service, de GRC, de GRPT et de gestion de la confidentialité.
• Compréhension des modèles d'architecture, de configuration et d'intégration de la plate-forme ServiceNow.
• Connaissance des pratiques de gestion des risques liés à l'information, à la cybersécurité et à la protection des renseignements personnels.

• L'expérience à l'appui des environnements informatiques réglementés et des activités de validation du système est un atout.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

[Cross-Functional Value Creation]

• Drive cross-functional financial initiatives: partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Excellence and other groups to model the financial impa

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche in 50 Worten
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Wir brauchen DICH als Facharbeiter in der Energieversorgung (m/w/d)
Deine Abteilung

In unserer Abteilung kümmern wir uns rund um die Uhr um die Versorgung des Standorts mit Energie und Medien. Auftretende Störmeldungen aus allen Betrieben und Gebäuden werden von uns ausgewertet und an die Bereitschaften oder Ansprechpartner weitergeleitet. Die kontinuierliche Überwachung und Optimierung unserer Anlagen liegt uns ebenso am Herzen wie Wartung und Pflege.

Dein Team

Wir arbeiten im Schichtbetrieb 24/7, unsere Abteilung besteht aus 6 Schichtgruppen, die zeitversetzt in einem attraktiven, gesundheitsoptimierten Schichtmodell arbeiten. Das Team, in dem Du eingesetzt wirst, besteht aus einem Schichtleiter mit 3 Mitarbeitern.

Dein zukünftiges Tätigkeitsfeld

• Du steuerst und überwachst in einer modernen Leitwart e Anlagen und Netze, die das gesamte Werk mit Energie und Medien versorgen.

• Du übernimmst Betriebskontrollen und Routineanalysen.

• Du führs t Inspektionen und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den Anlagen der Energieversorgung durch.

• Im Team sorgst Du rund um die Uhr für die Bearbeitung von auftretenden Störmeldungen aus dem gesamten Werk.

Wer Du bist:

• Als Facharbeiter in der Energieversorgung hast Du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Anlagenmechaniker/in Fachrichtung Versorgungstechnik, Mechatroniker/in für Kältetechnik, Elektroniker/in für Betriebs- oder Automatisierungstechnik, Chemikant oder vergleichbar.

• Du bist bereits mindestens 3 Jahre in deinem erlernten Beruf tätig und konntest Erfahrungen in Überwachung, Bedienung, Wartung und Reparatur von Maschinen und Anlagen sammeln.

• Wünschenswert wäre zudem eine Zusatzausbildung als Kesselwärter (m/w/d) sowie Spezialkenntnisse im Bereich Ammoniak-Kältetechnik. Du kannst diese Kenntnisse auch in entsprechenden Lehrgängen erwerben.

• Du bist schwindelfrei un d Arbeiten auf Rohrbrücken oder Hubarbeitsbühnen stellen für Dich kein Problem dar.

• Die gängigen EDV-Systeme (z.B. Google Suite) beherrschst Du sicher und hast Spaß daran damit zu arbeiten

• Du erkennst das Potential für Optimierungsmaßnahmen am Arbeitsplatz und arbeitest aktiv an der Umsetzung von Verbesserungen mit.

• Für Deine Zuverlässigkeit, Engagement und eine exakte Arbeitsweise sowie Selbständigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Arbeit im Team wirst Du geschätzt.

• Du bringst die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem vollkontinuierlichen Schichtbetrieb mit.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Le segnalazioni di errori provenienti da tutte le aziende e gli edifici vengono valutate da noi e inoltrate alla disponibilità o alle persone di contatto. • Inoltre, sarebbe auspicabile una formazione supplementare come custode di caldaia (m/f/d) e una conoscenza speciale nel campo della tecnologia di refrigerazione dell'ammoniaca. È anche possibile acquisire questa conoscenza in corsi appropriati.
• Siete privi di vertigini e lavorare su ponti tubi o piattaforme di lavoro di sollevamento non sono problemi per voi.

jobs.title: Head of RIS Solution Selling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
RIS delivers digital healthcare solutions to drive lab efficiency and improve patient care. The role of Digital Solution Selling leads two critical mandates in order to drive global, commercial adoption:

• Enterprise Transformation: evolving Roche’s offer from individual products to an integrated, enterprise-wide solution-selling approach

• Affiliate Integration: ensuring affiliates systematically embed digital products into their commercial frameworks and buying cycles

The Opportunity
As the Digital Solution Selling Leader, you will drive global commercial adoption and shape the future of enterprise digital health sales. In this role, you will:

• Lead Digital Solution-Selling Strategy: Drive the commercial shift from product-centric marketing to highly integrated, differentiating enterprise solution-selling frameworks.

• Design Buying-Cycle Frameworks: Architect total commercial solutions that firmly embed digital value at the core of our global commercial strategy.

• Develop Scalable Approaches: Leverage and scale existing enterprise tools and global frameworks (including Global Marketing, Rexis, CSM, and consulting) to maximize commercial differentiation.

• Coach Affiliate Leadership: Partner with and coach affiliate leadership teams to shift mindsets and transition from product-focused to solution-selling commercial engines.

• Orchestrate Cross-Functional Integration: Partner deeply with Go-To-Market (GTM), Global Marketing, Consulting, and Lifecycles to seamlessly embed digital solutions into affiliate frameworks.

• Scale Global Success: Identify adoption barriers across regions and deploy strategic playbooks, value narratives, and best practices to drive measurable commercial impact.

• Lead and Develop Key Capabilities: Coach and foster a high-performing team characterized by strong ownership, clear accountability, and a continuous growth mindset.

• Influence the Product Lifecycle: Provide early commercial insights into the product lifecycle to design digital health solutions for optimal commercial adoption right from the beginning.

Who you are
You are a strategic commercial leader who thrives in complex, matrixed environments, translates customer insights into impactful strategies, and is passionate about driving transformational organizational change.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Diagnostics, Digital Health, Data Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field is required (Advanced degree preferred).

• Commercial Strategy Experience: 8+ years of experience in commercial strategy, solution selling, digital health, diagnostics, healthcare technology, product commercialization, go-to-market, or affiliate/regional commercial roles.

• Leadership Excellence: Proven track record of leading, coaching, and developing teams, either through direct management or in a strong matrix leadership capacity.

• Global & Regional Collaboration: Extensive experience successfully working with global, regional, and affiliate commercial teams within healthcare or diagnostics.

• Framework Architecture: Demonstrated experience building scalable commercial frameworks, global playbooks, enablement approaches, or enterprise solution-selling capabilities.

• Strategic Value Translation: Strong communicator who excels at simplifying complex digital topics, translating customer needs into commercial value, and influencing senior stakeholders.

• Agile & Impact Mindset: Comfort operating in ambiguity, a strong ownership mindset

• Istruzione: laurea in Business, Scienze della vita, Sanità, Diagnostica, Salute digitale, Scienza dei dati, IT, Ingegneria o un campo correlato è richiesto (Preferito di laurea avanzato).
• Esperienza di strategia commerciale: 8+ anni di esperienza nella strategia commerciale, vendita di soluzioni, salute digitale, diagnostica, tecnologia sanitaria, commercializzazione dei prodotti, go-to-market, o ruoli commerciali affiliati/regionali.
• Eccellenza di leadership: comprovato record di leader, coaching e team di sviluppo, sia attraverso la gestione diretta o in una forte capacità di leadership matrice.
• Global & Regional Collaboration: Ampia esperienza di lavoro con i team commerciali globali, regionali e affiliati all'interno della sanità o della diagnostica.
• Architettura Quadro: Esperienza dimostrata che costruisce quadri commerciali scalabili, playbook globali, approcci di attivazione, o capacità di soluzione-selling enterprise.
• Traduzione del valore strategico: comunicatore forte che eccelle nella semplificazione di argomenti digitali complessi, traducendo le esigenze del cliente in valore commerciale e influenzando gli stakeholder senior.
