C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position RIS fournit des solutions de soins de santé numériques pour stimuler l'efficacité des laboratoires et améliorer les soins aux patients. Le rôle de la vente de solutions numériques mène deux mandats critiques afin de favoriser l'adoption mondiale et commerciale :
• Transformation de l'entreprise : l'évolution de Roches offre des produits individuels à une approche intégrée de vente de solutions à l'échelle de l'entreprise
• Intégration des filiales : faire en sorte que les filiales intègrent systématiquement les produits numériques dans leurs cadres commerciaux et cycles d'achat L'opportunité En tant que leader de la vente de solutions numériques, vous stimulerez l'adoption commerciale mondiale et façonnerez l'avenir des ventes de santé numériques d'entreprise. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Stratégie de vente de solutions numériques de pointe : Diriger le passage du marketing axé sur les produits à des cadres de vente de solutions d'entreprise hautement intégrés et différenciés.
• Design Buying-Cycle Frameworks : Architecte des solutions commerciales globales qui intègrent fermement la valeur numérique au cœur de notre stratégie commerciale mondiale.
• Développer des approches évolutives : tirer parti des outils d'entreprise existants et des cadres mondiaux (y compris le marketing mondial, le Rexis, le CSM et le conseil) pour maximiser la différenciation commerciale.
• Coach Affiliate Leadership: Partenaire avec et coach des équipes de leadership d'affiliation pour changer les mentalités et la transition de produits axés vers la vente de solutions moteurs commerciaux.
• Intégration trans-fonctionnelle orchestrale : S'associer en profondeur avec Go-To-Market (GTM), Global Marketing, Consulting et Lifecycles pour intégrer de manière transparente les solutions numériques dans les cadres d'affiliation.
• Échelle Réussite mondiale : Recenser les obstacles à l'adoption entre les régions et déployer des cahiers de lecture stratégiques, des récits de valeur et des pratiques exemplaires afin d'obtenir un impact commercial mesurable.
• Diriger et développer les capacités clés : Cocher et favoriser une équipe hautement performante caractérisée par une forte appropriation, une reddition de comptes claire et un état d'esprit de croissance continue.
• Influencer le cycle de vie du produit: Fournir dès le début des perspectives commerciales sur le cycle de vie du produit pour concevoir des solutions de santé numériques pour une adoption commerciale optimale dès le début. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef de file commercial stratégique qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et matriciaux, traduit les points de vue des clients en stratégies d'impact et est passionné par le changement organisationnel transformationnel.
• Éducation: Baccalauréat en affaires, sciences de la vie, soins de santé, diagnostics, santé numérique, sciences des données, informatique, génie, ou un domaine connexe est requis (diplôme avancé préféré).
• Stratégie commerciale Expérience : 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans la stratégie commerciale, la vente de solutions, la santé numérique, le diagnostic, la technologie de la santé, la commercialisation de produits, l'accès au marché ou les rôles commerciaux affiliés/régionaux.
• Excellence en leadership : Expérience éprouvée de leadership, d'encadrement et de développement d'équipes, soit par la gestion directe, soit dans une solide capacité de leadership matricielle.
• Collaboration mondiale et régionale: Une vaste expérience de travail avec succès avec des équipes commerciales mondiales, régionales et affiliées au sein des soins de santé ou des diagnostics.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in leading a seamless industrialization and thorough technical product management through integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization and scalable manufacturing processes and technologies in support of the manufacturing network. Product and process robustness, efficiency and reliability are key performance indicators, PTT owns and drives continuous improvement.
We are looking for a technical expert who understands the realities of the manufacturing areas and can design standard operating frameworks that drive operational excellence and compliance.

The Opportunity
In this role you proactively identify and close quality systems gaps across the network and you serve as translator between shop-floor manufacturing realities and global quality standards, ensuring that compliance frameworks enable manufacturing throughput and continuous improvement.More responsibilities include:

• Support manufacturing sites and global networks in proactively identifying and close quality systems gaps, implementing standardized processes and quality standards

• Drive the delivery and sustainment of a robust and regulatory-compliant Quality Management System (QMS) process as global single point of contact and core decision-maker for the assigned global quality system process content and design

• Translate HA requirements into an implementable QMS process, collaborating closely with independent quality compliance partners, staying updated on evolving regulations, health authority expectations, and external industry benchmarks to drive continuous optimization of the Quality Management System (QMS)

• Oversees the timely execution of critical deliverables, including global policy updates, IT/digital tool enhancements (e.g., Veeva), training deployment, and performance metric tracking for the assigned global quality system process .

• Provide expert guidance and direct support for regulatory inspections and health authority audits relating to global quality system processes.

• Manage intersections with other quality system process owners to achieve seamless, end-to-end process management across cross-functional squads and technical governance forums.

Who you are
You are a specialized expert in manufacturing technologies and compliance with a strong sense of accountability and exceptional strategic decision-making capabilities. Your qualifications include:

• Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or the Life Science with 10+ years or more of relevant industrial experience in parenteral production (compounding to Visual inspection) within quality systems, quality operations, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.

• Strong Knowledge in stability management through out distribution is a plus

• Specialized knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems and industry-wide guidelines relevant to pharma process development and manufacturing, such as ICH guidelines.

• Strong digital acumen and experience supporting IT-solutions or quality management platforms, such as Veeva, is highly preferred.

• High degree of problem-solving skills and the ability to gain alignment with internal stakeholders and authorities in operationally demanding environments. You are a collaborative leader who excels in providing clear guidance to matrix teams while maintaining a focus on implementation, complianc

L'opportunità In questo ruolo si identificano e chiudono proattivamente le lacune dei sistemi di qualità in tutta la rete e si serve come traduttore tra realtà manifatturiere e standard di qualità globali, assicurando che i quadri di conformità consentono la produttività e il miglioramento continuo. Altre responsabilità includono:
• Sostenere i siti di produzione e le reti globali nell'identificazione proattiva e nelle lacune dei sistemi di qualità, implementando processi standardizzati e standard di qualità
• Guidare la consegna e il sostegno di un processo di Quality Management System (QMS) robusto e conforme alle normative come unico punto di contatto globale e decisore centrale per il contenuto e il design del processo di qualità globale assegnato del sistema
• Traduci i requisiti HA in un processo QMS implementabile, collaborando a stretto contatto con partner indipendenti di conformità della qualità, rimanendo aggiornati sulle normative in evoluzione, le aspettative dell'autorità sanitaria e i benchmark dell'industria esterna per guidare l'ottimizzazione continua del Sistema di Gestione della Qualità (QMS)
• Supera l'esecuzione tempestiva dei responsabili critici, inclusi gli aggiornamenti di policy globali, i miglioramenti IT/digital tool (ad esempio, Veeva), l'implementazione della formazione e il monitoraggio metrico delle prestazioni per il processo di sistema di qualità globale assegnato.
• Fornire una guida esperta e un supporto diretto alle ispezioni normative e agli audit dell'autorità sanitaria relativi ai processi di sistema di qualità globale.
• Gestire le intersezioni con altri proprietari di processo di sistema di qualità per raggiungere la gestione del processo senza soluzione di continuità, end-to-end attraverso le squadre interfunzionali e forum di governance tecnica. Chi sei Sei un esperto specializzato nelle tecnologie di produzione e nel rispetto di un forte senso di responsabilità e di eccezionali capacità decisionali strategiche. Le tue qualifiche includono:
• Laurea o Master in ingegneria chimica, ingegneria biochimica, o la scienza della vita con 10+ anni o più di esperienza industriale rilevante nella produzione parenterale (rispetto all'ispezione visiva) all'interno di sistemi di qualità, operazioni di qualità o produzione farmaceutica.
• La forte conoscenza nella gestione della stabilità attraverso la distribuzione esterna è un plus
• Conoscenza specializzata dei sistemi di qualità farmaceutica e delle linee guida a livello industriale rilevanti per lo sviluppo e la produzione di processi farmaceutici, come le linee guida ICH.
• Forte acume digitale e l'esperienza di supporto IT-solutions o piattaforme di gestione della qualità, come Veeva, è altamente preferito.
• Un alto grado di capacità di problem solving e la capacità di ottenere l'allineamento con gli stakeholder interni e le autorità in ambienti operativamente esigenti. Sei un leader collaborativo che eccelle nel fornire una chiara guida ai team di matrice pur mantenendo un focus sull'implementazione, compiacente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als integraler Bestandteil von Pharma Technical Operations (PT) spielt PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Führung einer nahtlosen Industrialisierung und eines gründlichen technischen Produktmanagements durch die Integration von SHE, proaktiver Wartung, Anlagenfitness, Leistungsoptimierung und skalierbaren Fertigungsprozessen und -technologien zur Unterstützung des Fertigungsnetzwerks. Produkt- und Prozessrobustheit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit sind wichtige Leistungsindikatoren, die PTT besitzt und vorantreibt. Wir suchen einen technischen Experten, der die Realitäten der Fertigungsbereiche versteht und Standard-Betriebsrahmen entwerfen kann, die operative Exzellenz und Compliance fördern. Die Chance In dieser Rolle identifizieren und schließen Sie proaktiv Lücken in Qualitätssystemen im gesamten Netzwerk und sind als Übersetzer zwischen Fertigungsrealitäten und globalen Qualitätsstandards tätig, um sicherzustellen, dass Compliance-Frameworks den Fertigungsdurchsatz und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung ermöglichen. Weitere Aufgaben umfassen:
• Unterstützung von Produktionsstätten und globalen Netzwerken bei der proaktiven Erkennung und Schließung von Qualitätssystemlücken, Implementierung standardisierter Prozesse und Qualitätsstandards
• Förderung der Bereitstellung und Aufrechterhaltung eines robusten und regulierungskonformen Qualitätsmanagementsystems (QMS) als globaler Ansprechpartner und zentraler Entscheidungsträger für den zugewiesenen globalen Prozessinhalt und das Design des Qualitätsmanagementsystems
• Übersetzen Sie HA-Anforderungen in einen umsetzbaren QMS-Prozess, arbeiten Sie eng mit unabhängigen Qualitäts-Compliance-Partnern zusammen und halten Sie sich über die sich entwickelnden Vorschriften, Erwartungen der Gesundheitsbehörden und externe Branchenbenchmarks auf dem Laufenden, um die kontinuierliche Optimierung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems (QMS) voranzutreiben.
• Überwacht die zeitnahe Ausführung kritischer Ergebnisse, einschließlich globaler Richtlinienaktualisierungen, IT/digitaler Tool-Erweiterungen (z. B. Veeva), Schulungsbereitstellung und leistungsmetrisches Tracking für den zugewiesenen globalen Qualitätssystemprozess.
• Bereitstellung von Expertenberatung und direkter Unterstützung für regulatorische Inspektionen und Audits von Gesundheitsbehörden in Bezug auf globale Qualitätssystemprozesse.
• Verwalten Sie Schnittstellen mit anderen Prozesseigentümern von Qualitätssystemen, um ein nahtloses, durchgängiges Prozessmanagement in funktionsübergreifenden Squads und technischen Governance-Foren zu erreichen. Wer du bist Sie sind ein spezialisierter Experte für Fertigungstechnologien und die Einhaltung eines starken Verantwortungsbewusstseins und außergewöhnlicher strategischer Entscheidungsfähigkeiten. Ihre Qualifikationen umfassen:
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering oder Life Science mit mehr als 10 Jahren einschlägiger industrieller Erfahrung in der parenteralen Produktion (zusammengesetzt mit visueller Inspektion) in Qualitätssystemen, Qualitätsbetrieben oder pharmazeutischer Herstellung.
• Starkes Wissen über Stabilitätsmanagement durch Out-Distribution ist ein Plus
• Spezialisiertes Wissen über pharmazeutische Qualitätssysteme und branchenweite Richtlinien, die für die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Pharmaprozessen relevant sind, wie z. B. ICH-Richtlinien.
• Starker digitaler Scharfsinn und Erfahrung bei der Unterstützung von IT-Lösungen oder Qualitätsmanagement-Plattformen wie Veeva wird sehr bevorzugt.
• Hohes Maß an Problemlösungskompetenz und die Fähigkeit, sich mit internen Stakeholdern und Behörden in betrieblich anspruchsvollen Umgebungen abzustimmen. Sie sind eine kollaborative Führungskraft, die sich durch klare Anleitungen für Matrixteams auszeichnet und sich gleichzeitig auf die Implementierung konzentriert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partie intégrante de Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) joue un rôle clé dans la direction d'une industrialisation transparente et d'une gestion technique approfondie des produits en intégrant SHE, maintenance proactive, aptitude à l'installation, optimisation des performances et procédés de fabrication évolutives et technologies à l'appui du réseau de fabrication. La robustesse, l'efficacité et la fiabilité des produits et des procédés sont des indicateurs de performance clés, PTT possède et favorise l'amélioration continue. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un expert technique qui comprend les réalités des secteurs de fabrication et peut concevoir des cadres d'exploitation normalisés qui favorisent l'excellence opérationnelle et la conformité. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous identifiez et comblez de façon proactive les lacunes des systèmes de qualité dans l'ensemble du réseau et vous servez de traducteur entre les réalités de la fabrication en atelier et les normes de qualité mondiales, assurant ainsi que les cadres de conformité permettent le débit de fabrication et l'amélioration continue. D'autres responsabilités comprennent :
• Aider les sites de fabrication et les réseaux mondiaux à identifier et à combler les lacunes des systèmes de qualité, à mettre en œuvre des processus normalisés et des normes de qualité
• Diriger la livraison et le maintien d'un système de gestion de la qualité (SGQ) robuste et conforme à la réglementation en tant que point de contact mondial et décideur principal pour le contenu et la conception du système de qualité mondial assigné
• Traduire les exigences d'AP en un processus de SGQ implémentable, en collaborant étroitement avec des partenaires indépendants en matière de conformité à la qualité, en restant au courant de l'évolution des règlements, des attentes des autorités sanitaires et des points de repère externes de l'industrie afin d'optimiser continuellement le système de gestion de la qualité (SGQ).
• Supervise l'exécution en temps opportun des produits livrables essentiels, y compris les mises à jour des politiques mondiales, les améliorations apportées aux outils informatiques et numériques (p. ex., Veeva), le déploiement de la formation et le suivi de la mesure du rendement pour le processus du système mondial de qualité assigné.
• Fournir des conseils spécialisés et un appui direct aux inspections réglementaires et aux vérifications des autorités sanitaires concernant les processus des systèmes mondiaux de qualité.
• Gérer les intersections avec d'autres propriétaires de processus de système de qualité afin d'assurer une gestion de bout en bout transparente des processus dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les forums de gouvernance technique. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un expert spécialisé dans les technologies de fabrication et la conformité avec un fort sens de responsabilité et des capacités de décision stratégique exceptionnelles. Vos qualifications comprennent:
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie chimique, en génie biochimique ou en sciences de la vie avec 10 ans ou plus d'expérience industrielle pertinente en production parentérale (composée à l'inspection visuelle) dans les systèmes de qualité, les opérations de qualité ou la fabrication pharmaceutique.
• Une bonne connaissance de la gestion de la stabilité grâce à la distribution est un atout
• Connaissances spécialisées des systèmes de qualité des produits pharmaceutiques et des lignes directrices à l'échelle de l'industrie concernant l'élaboration et la fabrication des procédés pharmaceutiques, comme les lignes directrices de l'ICH.
• Forte acuité numérique et l'expérience soutenant les solutions informatiques ou les plates-formes de gestion de la qualité, comme Veeva, est hautement préféré.
• Un niveau élevé de compétences en résolution de problèmes et la capacité d'obtenir l'alignement avec les intervenants et les autorités internes dans des environnements exigeants sur le plan opérationnel. Vous êtes un chef de file collaboratif qui excelle en fournissant des conseils clairs aux équipes matricielles tout en maintenant un accent sur la mise en œuvre,

jobs.title: Head of Engineering DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Engineering DIA R&D

As a Head of Engineering in Diagnostics (DIA) R&D, you’ll lead the teams that build the engineering foundation beneath our science, and the development of your people will be your first responsibility. You’ll help them shape their own career paths and open the opportunities that let them grow, remove the roadblocks in their way, and set the clear goals that good performance management depends on. You’ll lead software and service delivery with focus, clearing impediments, managing stakeholders well and building efficiencies into the way teams collaborate.

Description of the Area:

You’ll architect and deliver the next generation of DIA R&D engineering capabilities, leading teams that bring together advanced AI and ML, laboratory informatics infrastructure and computational science. You’ll develop engineers who can work through the unusual complexity that comes when biology, chemistry and technology meet, from LIMS and ELN systems to agentic AI and cloud-scale data platforms. And you’ll drive technical excellence and pace while holding the rigour and compliance standards that Diagnostics R&D depends on.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you’ll have the room to drive technical excellence and shape platforms built for what comes next. You’ll:

• Develop future capabilities: Build the engineering strengths the function will need next, and coach your people through the long arc of their careers, including the systemic roadblocks that hold whole teams back.

• Shape strategy and vision: Co-create the long-term technical direction and strategy for the computational science and AI/ML platform portfolio.

• Set the technical standard: Define the platform architecture for AI/ML infrastructure (model deployment, MLOps, vector databases), scientific computing (HPC and cloud compute), laboratory informatics (LIMS and ELN integration) and the data platforms beneath them.

• Own delivery: Take accountability for how the portfolio performs in production, holding the line on quality, reliability and the performance SLAs people depend on.

• Manage complex dependencies: Direct technical priorities across a portfolio that spans AI solutions, bioinformatics pipelines, laboratory systems and data infrastructure, keeping the architecture coherent and free of duplication.

• Engage senior stakeholders: Build the relationships that make engineering possible here, with research leadership, IT infrastructure, Quality and Compliance, enterprise architecture and cloud platform teams, and align priorities and resources across them.

• Sharpen engineering practice: Improve how the teams build, from CI/CD pipelines for validated systems to infrastructure-as-code, automated testing and model deployment.

• Steward budget and resources: Manage the team’s budget, including headcount, operating costs and vendor contracts, and make the trade-offs that put resources where they matter most.

Who you are:

We’re looking for a leader who pairs technical depth with regulatory discipline, and who has already built and run engineering organisations rather than stepping up to lead one for the first time. You’ll bring:

• Education: A bachelor’s or advanced degree, typically in an engineering, IT or business discipline.

• Engineering leadership: 10+ years in software and platform engineering, including 5+ years leading cross-functional technical teams, with managers as well as engineers reporting to you.

• Regulated life sciences: 5+ years in pharmaceutical R&D,

As a Head of Engineering in Diagnostics (DIA) R&D, you’ll lead the teams that build the engineering foundation beneath our science, and the development of your people will be your first responsibility. You’ll help them shape their own career paths and open the opportunities that let them grow, remove the roadblocks in their way, and set the clear goals that good performance management depends on. You’ll lead software and service delivery with focus, clearing impediments, managing stakeholders well and building efficiencies into the way teams collaborate.

Description of the Area:

You’ll architect and deliver the next generation of DIA R&D engineering capabilities, leading teams that bring together advanced AI and ML, laboratory informatics infrastructure and computational science. You’ll develop engineers who can work through the unusual complexity that comes when biology, chemistry and technology meet, from LIMS and ELN systems to agentic AI and cloud-scale data platforms. And you’ll drive technical excellence and pace while holding the rigour and compliance standards that Diagnostics R&D depends on.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you’ll have the room to drive technical excellence and shape platforms built for what comes next. You’ll:

• Develop future capabilities: Build the engineering strengths the function will need next, and coach your people through the long arc of their careers, including the systemic roadblocks that hold whole teams back.

• Shape strategy and vision: Co-create the long-term technical direction and strategy for the computational science and AI/ML platform portfolio.

• Set the technical standard: Define the platform architecture for AI/ML infrastructure (model deployment, MLOps, vector databases), scientific computing (HPC and cloud compute), laboratory informatics (LIMS and ELN integration) and the data platforms beneath them.

• Own delivery: Take accountability for how the portfolio performs in production, holding the line on quality, reliability and the performance SLAs people depend on.

• Manage complex dependencies: Direct technical priorities across a portfolio that spans AI solutions, bioinformatics pipelines, laboratory systems and data infrastructure, keeping the architecture coherent and free of duplication.

• Engage senior stakeholders: Build the relationships that make engineering possible here, with research leadership, IT infrastructure, Quality and Compliance, enterprise architecture and cloud platform teams, and align priorities and resources across them.

• Sharpen engineering practice: Improve how the teams build, from CI/CD pipelines for validated systems to infrastructure-as-code, automated testing and model deployment.

• Steward budget and resources: Manage the team’s budget, including headcount, operating costs and vendor contracts, and make the trade-offs that put resources where they matter most.

Who you are:

We’re looking for a leader who pairs technical depth with regulatory discipline, and who has already built and run engineering organisations rather than stepping up to lead one for the first time. You’ll bring:

• Education: A bachelor’s or advanced degree, typically in an engineering, IT or business discipline.

• Engineering leadership: 10+ years in software and platform engineering, including 5+ years leading cross-functional technical teams, with managers as well as engineers reporting to you.

• Regulated life sciences: 5+ years in pharmaceutical R&D,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

We are seeking an SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant to join our team supporting a highly complex, customized SAP solution. This role is ideal for a consultant who thrives in technically challenging environments and is passionate about deep-dive problem-solving and continuous learning. We are looking for a consultant who is not intimidated by complexity but energized by it. This role requires someone who views an individualized SAP solution as an intellectual challenge rather than an obstacle, and who sees continuous learning as a core part of the job.

The Opportunity

• Provide functional consulting and support for our bespoke SAP solution with extensive custom developments.

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex business processes in the supply chain and logistics space.

• Collaborate with development and technical teams to understand non-standard functionality and custom implementations.

• Drive system enhancements, testing, and deployment activities in a GxP context.

• Deal with uncertainty and make decisions at the product level.

• Provide solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Primarily interact within product teams and squads as applicable.

• Interact directly with stakeholders medium to large engagements.

• Communicate information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicate the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement.

Who you are:

• Hands-on experience with SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management).

• Hands-on experience of SAP Transportation Management (TM) concepts and integration points.

• Working knowledge of BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) and its application in custom developments.

• Familiarity with BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) functionality.

• Experience supporting complex, non-standard SAP solutions with custom code.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams.

• Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly.

Nice to have:

• German language skills (written and spoken).

• Experience with SAP ABAP or custom object development.

• Experience in the Pharmaceutical environment following GxP guidelines.

• Familiarity with change management and process improvement methodologies.

• Familiarity with agile methodologies like SAFe.

• Intermediate level of business process domain knowledge in supply chain.

What you get:

• Salary range 10,100 - 18,800 PLN gross monthly based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 12%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and man

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Consulente funzionale – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions Stiamo cercando un consulente funzionale SAP EWM/TM per unire il nostro team supportando una soluzione SAP altamente complessa e personalizzata. Questo ruolo è ideale per un consulente che prospera in ambienti tecnicamente impegnativi ed è appassionato di deep-dive problem-solving e apprendimento continuo. Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente che non è intimidito dalla complessità ma stimolato da esso. Questo ruolo richiede qualcuno che vede una soluzione SAP individualizzata come una sfida intellettuale piuttosto che un ostacolo, e che vede l'apprendimento continuo come una parte fondamentale del lavoro. L'opportunità
• Fornire consulenza e supporto funzionali per la nostra soluzione SAP su misura con ampi sviluppi personalizzati.
• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare i processi aziendali complessi nella supply chain e nello spazio logistico.
• Collabora con team di sviluppo e tecnici per comprendere funzionalità non standard e implementazioni personalizzate.
• Miglioramento del sistema di azionamento, test e attività di distribuzione in un contesto GxP.
• Affrontare l'incertezza e prendere decisioni a livello del prodotto.
• Fornire soluzioni a una vasta gamma di problemi difficili.
• Interagisci principalmente all'interno di team di prodotti e squadre come applicabile.
• Interagisci direttamente con le parti interessate da media a grandi impegni.
• Comunicare informazioni, problemi e potenziali soluzioni all'interno dei team di prodotti e comunicare chiaramente l'impatto del proprio lavoro nel contesto delle esigenze aziendali.
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, i workshop e il coinvolgimento dei clienti. Chi sei:
• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management).
• Esperienza pratica dei concetti e dei punti di integrazione di SAP Transportation Management (TM).
• Conoscenze di lavoro di BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) e la sua applicazione negli sviluppi personalizzati.
• Familiarità con funzionalità BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call).
• Esperienza di supporto soluzioni SAP complesse e non standard con codice personalizzato.
• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di navigare ambiguità.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali.
• Volontà e capacità dimostrata di imparare rapidamente nuovi concetti e tecnologie. Bello da avere:
• Competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate).
• Esperienza con SAP ABAP o sviluppo di oggetti personalizzati.
• Esperienza nell'ambiente farmaceutico seguendo le linee guida GxP.
• Familiarità con la gestione dei cambiamenti e metodi di miglioramento dei processi.
• Familiarità con metodologie agili come SAFe.
• Livello intermedio di conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale nella supply chain. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Gamma di insalata 10.100 - 18.800 PLN mensile lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 12%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e auto e uomo

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - NMR Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione NMR esperto in chimica analitica pRED-pCMC In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questo ruolo è situato all'interno del dipartimento di Chimica preclinica, Produzione e Controllo (pCMC), parte dell'organizzazione di Small Molecule Research in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). Si apre la strada per i candidati alla droga dalla ricerca precoce allo sviluppo in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo. Collaborando attivamente con i nostri partner di scoperta e sviluppo, leviamo tecnologie all'avanguardia e l'eccellenza scientifica per trasformare le molecole in future medicine. Come esperti CMC, portiamo una ricca varietà di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione formulazione, scienza materiale e chimica analitica, progressi pionieristici in piccole molecole, peptidi e medicine a base di acido nucleico. L'opportunità Stiamo offrendo un'opportunità unica per un esperto NMR pratico nel nostro gruppo di caratterizzazione molecolare analitica. Come Centro di Eccellenza per l'Analitica, forniamo metodi e servizi all'avanguardia per la determinazione delle strutture chimiche, delle purezza e delle impurità, supportando progetti di portafoglio in tutta la catena del valore. In questo ruolo si pianifica, eseguire e segnalare esperimenti NMR per l'elucidazione della struttura e studi di interazione inter- e intra-molecolare.
• Analisi innovativa: Applicando analisi all'avanguardia supporti lo sviluppo di sintesi e formulazione consentendo rapidi progressi per i progetti e l'identificazione di possibili sfide.
• Sviluppo del metodo: sviluppate e implementate nuovi esperimenti NMR e date input per gli sviluppi futuri del nostro gruppo NMR.
• Eccellenza scientifica: Migliora l'eccellenza scientifica identificando le tendenze del settore, e costruendo e mantenendo partnership accademiche.
• Visione strategica: Contribuisci approfondimenti scientifici per modellare la strategia a medio e lungo termine per NMR all'interno del portafoglio Roche. Lavorando a fianco del gruppo NMR e del Team Leadership, guidate la traduzione del vostro contributo strategico nelle strategie di squadra attuabili.
• Collaborazione e Relationship Building: Lei promuove relazioni fiduciose e una collaborazione efficace con i team di scoperta e sviluppo tecnico interni e con i partner esterni. Chi sei
• Sfondo educativo: Master con un minimo di 5 anni o PhD in chimica analitica o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore.
• Comprehensive Knowledge of NMR analytics e le sue applicazioni abbinate a una profonda comprensione della base tecnica e teorica oltre gli esperimenti standard per NMR liquido e solido. L'esperienza con altri metodi per la caratterizzazione biofisica è un plus.
• Esperienza comprovata: Le mani sulle competenze negli studi di elucidazione e interazione di NMR per oligonucleotidi sintetici e/o peptidi. Competenza dimostrata sugli studi di struttura di ordine superiore e sugli studi di aggregazione.
• Mindset: Possiedi un approccio di mentalità aperta e altamente proattivo, "just-do-it". Ti piace risolvere i problemi e sviluppare nuovi modi

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Medical Affairs Operations Lead , you will be a strategic partner in the execution of global launch preparations and clinical adoption activities for our medical solutions. You will drive operational excellence by managing timelines, resources, and budgets for high-impact medical projects. This is an invitation to join a high-performing, agile environment where your project management expertise ensures our scientific innovations successfully reach the healthcare community.

• Master Operational Delivery: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of medical affairs activities, from resource identification and scheduling to budget monitoring and delivery.

• Drive Launch Excellence: Partner with cross-functional squads to provide agile facilitation support for the development of Integrated Evidence Plans and global launch strategies.

• Elevate Medical Education: Lead the planning and execution of global medical education programs, webinars, and high-profile scientific events such as congresses and advisory boards.

• Champion Strategic Communication: Manage the content for digital platforms, newsletters, and communication channels to ensure our medical insights are effectively disseminated.

• Build Global Partnerships: Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and vendors to ensure compliant and efficient handling of all medical affairs initiatives.

• Navigate Compliance: Oversee the preparation and tracking of contracts and interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and patients, ensuring adherence to global quality and legal standards.

• Inspire Continuous Improvement: Drive efficiencies by sharing best practices within your team, fostering a culture of knowledge exchange and lifelong learning.

Who You Are
You are a proactive and self-directed project management professional who thrives in fast-paced, matrixed environments. You bring a tactical and strategic mindset to complex operational challenges and are passionate about fostering a culture of belonging and high performance.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Strong Educational Background: A degree or advanced degree (Bachelor, Master, or PhD) in Project Management, Business Administration, or Life Sciences.

• Industry Experience: 3–5+ years of related experience within the diagnostics, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sectors.

• Project Management Mastery: Proven expertise in project management and communication; a PMP certification or experience in agile methodologies is a strong advantage.

• Strategic & Matrix Leadership: A track record of leading complex, cross-functional teams and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

• Global Mindset: Excellent verbal and written English skills, with the ability to partner effectively across diverse regions, cultures, and time zones.

Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million

• Forte formation : Diplôme ou diplôme avancé (Bachelor, maîtrise ou doctorat) en gestion de projets, administration des affaires ou sciences de la vie.
• Expérience de l'industrie : 3 à 5 ans d'expérience connexe dans les secteurs du diagnostic, des produits pharmaceutiques ou de la biotechnologie.
• Maîtrise de gestion de projet : expertise éprouvée en gestion de projet et communication ; une certification PMP ou une expérience dans les méthodologies agiles est un avantage important.
• Leadership stratégique et matriciel : Une expérience d'équipes complexes et interfonctionnelles de premier plan et d'influence sur les résultats sans autorité directe.
• Global Mindset : Excellentes compétences en anglais, verbales et écrites, avec la capacité de s'associer efficacement dans diverses régions, cultures et fuseaux horaires. Laissez-les prospérer ensemble dans une culture fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration, le respect et la haute performance. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'emplacement principal est Sant Cugat del Vallès. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead, Oncology/Pathology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Clinical Development Lead, Oncology/Pathology is responsible for planning and implementation of Clinical Development activities for novel medical value diagnostic solutions in the areas of oncology and tissue-based pathology at Roche Diagnostic Solutions (RDS), with a primary focus on Companion diagnostic/Personalized Healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity:

• Designs scientifically sound clinical studies and study programs in cross-functional teams

• Makes substantial contributions to the Clinical Development strategy for the relevant therapeutic/disease area(s)

• Leads clinical study design and execution, including critical review of study results, protocol and report generation to support new product development

• Works with colleagues from Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Biometrics, Development, Quality, Business, and other functions to ensure appropriate implementation of clinical development strategies

• Leads medical/scientific input and preparation of regulatory submissions as well as responses to reviewers from regulatory agencies

• May participate in external interactions with health authorities (HAs)

• Maintains clinical, regulatory, and scientific expertise as it relates to IVD product development and regulatory documentation

• Builds and maintains close relationships with external thought leaders, supports preparation of advisory boards within the assigned indication area

• Builds and maintains strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders, key internal and external stakeholders and other alliance partners, in meeting business goals and ensuring operational excellence

• Drives competitive differentiation, innovation and early pipeline activities and develops intellectual property strategy

• Develops and manages external development partnerships (industry and academia)

• Leads comprehensive literature reviews, supervises collation of relevant clinical and scientific information from different sources, and creates new scientific content (without guidance/direction)

• Solves or leads others to solve complex outcomes; uses sophisticated analytical thought to

• exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions

• Acts as a coach for colleagues with less experience and helps them develop skills/expertise

• Permanently optimizes processes to increase quality and efficiency standards

• Drive patient and customer-centricity (mindset, behaviors and actions) by always putting the needs of patients and the customers first

• Partner across diverse regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging, inclusion and diversity

• Working across Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations communities to identify mutual value and opportunities for collaboration

• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial

• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion (culture, mindset and behaviors)

Who You Are

• You have a medical degree or advanced degree (PhD, PharmD or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Oncology, Immunology, Molecular Biology and or Anatomic Pathology

• You have 7+ years academic, diagnostics or pharma industry exp

• esercitare giudizio e identificare soluzioni innovative

• Partner in diverse regioni, culture e fusi orari per creare un ambiente di appartenenza, inclusione e diversità

• Demonstrieren Sie Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit, um in einer schnelllebigen, matrixförmigen Umgebung zu arbeiten, in der eine flüssige, teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit entscheidend ist
• Die Werte von Model Roche: Integrität, Mut und Leidenschaft (Kultur, Denkweise und Verhalten) Wer du bist

jobs.title: Project Change Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) intende "trasformare il modo in cui opera Roche". Come organizzazione globale di oltre 3.500 colleghi, possiamo consentire a Roche di operare in un ambiente di business competitivo e in continua evoluzione. Forniamo ai nostri partner servizi e soluzioni aziendali end-to-end, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Abbracciando una mentalità OneRoche, facciamo leva sulla nostra rete globale situata a Budapest (Ungheria), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), e i nostri altri siti per rimanere clienti-centric 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e co-creare soluzioni insieme. L'opportunità Come Project Change Manager sarete parte dell'organizzazione RSS Project Management. Sei un appassionato di gestione dei progetti e di gestione dei cambiamenti di progetto e vuoi fornire i migliori servizi di gestione dei progetti di classe ai partner di Roche? Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo lavorerai con l'organizzazione Marketing Technologies e i suoi team di soluzione . Sarete responsabili per il successo della consegna dei cambiamenti di progetto e la traduzione della visione tecnica nell'adozione pratica degli utenti e piani di rollout. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà, ma non sarà limitato a: Engagement Delivery
• Strategia di gestione del cambiamento: Creazione, gestione e attuazione di una strategia di gestione del cambiamento olistico - incluso impegno, disponibilità e adozione - in stretta allineamento con il rispettivo proprietario della soluzione. Guidare il cambiamento comportamentale e l'adozione della tecnologia per garantire un trasferimento di conoscenze efficace, la disponibilità degli utenti e l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità di nuove funzionalità.
• Monitoraggio dei cambiamenti: monitorare attivamente l'adozione di funzionalità tecniche in tutto l'ecosistema. Identificare costantemente le opportunità per migliorare l'usabilità del prodotto e le capacità della piattaforma collaborando direttamente con i proprietari di soluzioni, gli utenti e l'ecosistema più ampio.
• Abilitazione e prontezza: Guida l'adozione end-to-end degli utenti definendo i framework di prontezza, gestendo le strategie di coinvolgimento trasversale e fornendo materiali pratici di abilitazione che consentono agli stakeholder di eseguire autonomamente nuovi processi aziendali
• Supporto & Feedback Loop: Servire come primo contatto di adozione per le domande di usabilità. Agire come la ‘voce dell’utente’, comprendere le proprie esigenze aziendali, guidandoli su come la tecnologia risolve tali esigenze, e traducendo i punti di dolore della filiale in feedback attuabile per i proprietari della soluzione.
• Consistency: Garantire la creazione, l'accuratezza e la coerenza dei contenuti di apprendimento, allinearlo strettamente con le più ampie campagne di comunicazione e le attività di coinvolgimento globale. Fornire feedback e garantire l'adozione di materiale formativo. Capability Building Diventa membro attivo dell'Organizzazione per la gestione dei progetti RSS
• Migliorare costantemente la gestione del progetto e le capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti di progetto, le offerte di servizi e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi RSS Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nella gestione dei cambiamenti di progetto.
• Esperienza comprovata nei principi di gestione dei cambiamenti, nelle metodologie e nell'applicazione del design didattico ai portafogli di apprendimento per adulti.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Position Summary
As the Head of RIS Market Adoption, you play a senior and critical role responsible for driving the uptake of Roche Information Solutions (RIS) from 'Nail-it' to 'Scale-it' across markets and Roche affiliates. You address two key aspects of adoption: overcoming market barriers for broad adoption within and across markets, and leveraging and activating the commercial framework within our affiliates.
Working closely with the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy team and other partners across the Roche organization, you shape the GTM blueprint and identify opportunities to address barriers for broad adoption. While the GTM Strategy function is responsible for a highly commercial-ready product, your focus is ensuring broad adoption into commercial frameworks and markets around the globe.
Your key deliverables include developing strategies to comply with local data residency policies, unlocking revenue pathways for different customer and market archetypes, and demonstrating the value and return on investment (ROI) through commercial evidence generation. You also create and deliver scalable models and frameworks for clinician engagement and customer success.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Team Leadership and Development: Coach, develop, and manage the Market Adoption team, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning to ensure consistent application of capabilities across all projects and use cases. You will create a high-performing team, empower people to contribute to their full potential, actively coach, and manage succession planning.

• Revenue Strategy and Financial Modeling: Proactively analyze and connect financial flows, value pools, and emerging market dynamics to develop commercial insights and accelerate market success across all regions.

• Payer and Reimbursement Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive revenue and payer strategies at the portfolio level in collaboration with GTM Strategy teams and Lifecycles. Establish innovative payer models to ensure optimal reimbursement and maximum value capture.

• Evidence Generation and Alignment: Drive the strategic alignment and prioritization of Commercial Evidence (e.g., Health Economics and Outcomes Research/HECONs) in close collaboration with the Clinical Evidence team and relevant Lifecycles.

• Clinical Digital Transformation Leadership: Lead the team of clinical digital transformation specialists, providing strategic clinical guidance to specific projects and inspiring affiliates to successfully commercialize and scale digital solutions.

• Market Shaping and Opportunity Identification: Collaborate with regional teams to identify and actively pursue market shaping opportunities with a mid-to-long term view, utilizing an open and experimental approach to ensure the best market fit.

• Operational Readiness and Compliance: Own the assurance of IT readiness and maintain

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti, e siamo coraggiosi sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti. Posizione Sommario In qualità di responsabile dell'adozione del mercato RIS, si gioca un ruolo senior e critico responsabile per l'assunzione di Roche Information Solutions (RIS) da 'Nail-it' a 'Scale-it' su mercati e affiliati Roche. Rivolgersi a due aspetti chiave dell'adozione: superare le barriere di mercato per un'ampia adozione all'interno e all'interno dei mercati e sfruttare e attivare il quadro commerciale all'interno delle nostre affiliate. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di strategia Go-to-Market (GTM) e con altri partner dell'organizzazione Roche, modellate il modello GTM e identificate le opportunità per affrontare le barriere per un'ampia adozione. Mentre la funzione GTM Strategy è responsabile di un prodotto altamente commerciale-ready, il vostro obiettivo è garantire un'ampia adozione in quadri commerciali e mercati in tutto il mondo. I vostri principali responsabili includono lo sviluppo di strategie per rispettare le politiche locali di residenza dei dati, sbloccare percorsi di reddito per diversi archetipi di cliente e di mercato, e dimostrare il valore e il ritorno sull'investimento (ROI) attraverso la generazione di prove commerciali. È inoltre possibile creare e fornire modelli e framework scalabili per il coinvolgimento clinico e il successo del cliente. Le tue responsabilità principali
• Team Leadership and Development: Coach, sviluppare e gestire il team Market Adoption, promuovere una cultura di alte prestazioni e apprendimento continuo per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle capacità in tutti i progetti e casi di utilizzo. Si creerà un team altamente performante, che consente alle persone di contribuire al loro pieno potenziale, attivamente coach e gestire la pianificazione di successione.
• Strategia delle entrate e modellazione finanziaria: analizzare e collegare attivamente flussi finanziari, pool di valori e dinamiche di mercato emergenti per sviluppare insight commerciali e accelerare il successo del mercato in tutte le regioni.
• Payer e Reimbursement Strategy: Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie complete di ricavi e payer a livello di portafoglio in collaborazione con i team di GTM Strategy e Lifecycles. Stabilire modelli di payer innovativi per garantire il rimborso ottimale e la cattura del valore massimo.
• Generazione e allineamento delle prove: Guidare l'allineamento strategico e la priorità delle prove commerciali (ad esempio, economia sanitaria e risultati di ricerca/HECON) in stretta collaborazione con il team di Evidenze Cliniche e i relativi cicli di vita.
• Leadership clinica della trasformazione digitale: guidare il team di specialisti della trasformazione digitale clinica, fornendo una guida clinica strategica a progetti specifici e ispirando affiliati per commercializzare e scalare con successo le soluzioni digitali.
• Identificazione di Market Shaping e Opportunity: collaborare con i team regionali per identificare e perseguire attivamente opportunità di modellazione del mercato con una visione a medio-lungo termine, utilizzando un approccio aperto e sperimentale per garantire la migliore vestibilità del mercato.
• Prontezza operativa e conformità: Possa l'assicurazione della disponibilità IT e mantenere

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer wir sind Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und dem Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Roche setzt sich stark für einen vielfältigen und integrativen Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir bemühen uns, Teams aufzubauen, die eine Reihe von Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten repräsentieren. Die Vielfalt ermöglicht es uns, einen großartigen Ort für die Arbeit und Innovation für Patienten zu schaffen. Positionsübersicht Als Head of RIS Market Adoption spielen Sie eine leitende und entscheidende Rolle bei der Einführung von Roche Information Solutions (RIS) von "Nail-it" zu "Scale-it" in allen Märkten und Roche-Tochtergesellschaften. Sie befassen sich mit zwei Schlüsselaspekten der Adoption: Überwindung von Marktbarrieren für eine breite Akzeptanz innerhalb und zwischen den Märkten sowie Nutzung und Aktivierung des kommerziellen Rahmens innerhalb unserer Tochtergesellschaften. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Go-to-Market (GTM)-Strategieteam und anderen Partnern in der Roche-Organisation gestalten Sie den GTM-Plan und identifizieren Möglichkeiten, Hindernisse für eine breite Akzeptanz zu beseitigen. Während die GTM Strategy-Funktion für ein hochkommerzielles Produkt verantwortlich ist, liegt Ihr Fokus auf der Gewährleistung einer breiten Akzeptanz in kommerziellen Rahmenbedingungen und Märkten auf der ganzen Welt. Ihre wichtigsten Ergebnisse umfassen die Entwicklung von Strategien zur Einhaltung lokaler Datenresidenzrichtlinien, die Erschließung von Umsatzpfaden für verschiedene Kunden- und Marktarchetypen und die Demonstration des Werts und des Return on Investment (ROI) durch kommerzielle Evidenzgenerierung. Sie erstellen und liefern auch skalierbare Modelle und Frameworks für das Engagement von Klinikern und den Kundenerfolg. Ihre Hauptverantwortung
• Teamführung und -entwicklung: Coach, Entwicklung und Management des Market Adoption-Teams, Förderung einer Kultur der hohen Leistung und des kontinuierlichen Lernens, um eine konsistente Anwendung der Fähigkeiten in allen Projekten und Anwendungsfällen sicherzustellen. Sie erstellen ein leistungsstarkes Team, befähigen Menschen, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten, aktiv zu coachen und die Nachfolgeplanung zu verwalten.
• Umsatzstrategie und Finanzmodellierung: Analysieren und verbinden Sie proaktiv Finanzströme, Value Pools und die Dynamik der aufstrebenden Märkte, um kommerzielle Erkenntnisse zu entwickeln und den Markterfolg in allen Regionen zu beschleunigen.
• Payer and Reimbursement Strategy: Entwicklung und Umsetzung umfassender Umsatz- und Kostenstrategien auf Portfolioebene in Zusammenarbeit mit GTM Strategy Teams und Lifecycles. Etablieren Sie innovative Kostenträgermodelle, um eine optimale Erstattung und maximale Werterfassung zu gewährleisten.
• Evidenzgenerierung und -ausrichtung: Förderung der strategischen Ausrichtung und Priorisierung kommerzieller Evidenz (z. B. Gesundheitsökonomie und Ergebnisforschung / HECONs) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Clinical Evidence-Team und relevanten Lifecycles.
• Führen Sie das Team von Spezialisten für klinische digitale Transformation, bieten Sie strategische klinische Beratung für bestimmte Projekte und inspirieren Sie Partner, um digitale Lösungen erfolgreich zu vermarkten und zu skalieren.
• Market Shaping and Opportunity Identification: Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Teams, um Marktgestaltungsmöglichkeiten mittel- bis langfristig zu identifizieren und aktiv zu verfolgen, wobei ein offener und experimenteller Ansatz verwendet wird, um die beste Marktpassung zu gewährleisten.
• Operational Readiness and Compliance: Eigene Zusicherung der IT-Reife und Pflege

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que la bonne entreprise signifie un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès à des innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Roche est fermement attachée à un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous nous efforçons de constituer des équipes qui représentent un éventail de milieux, de perspectives et de compétences. Faire place à la diversité nous permet de créer un endroit idéal pour travailler et innover pour les patients. Résumé du poste En tant que responsable de l'adoption de RIS Market, vous jouez un rôle de premier plan et de premier plan pour amener l'adoption de Roche Information Solutions (RIS) de « Nail-it » à « Scale-it » à travers les marchés et les filiales de Roche. Vous abordez deux aspects clés de l'adoption : surmonter les obstacles au marché pour une large adoption à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des marchés, et exploiter et activer le cadre commercial au sein de nos filiales. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de la stratégie Go-to-Market (GTM) et d'autres partenaires de l'organisation Roche, vous façonnez le plan GTM et identifiez les possibilités de surmonter les obstacles à l'adoption générale. Alors que la fonction Stratégie GTM est responsable d'un produit hautement commercial, votre objectif est d'assurer une large adoption dans les cadres commerciaux et les marchés à travers le monde. Vos principaux produits livrables comprennent l'élaboration de stratégies pour se conformer aux politiques locales de résidence des données, le déblocage des voies de revenus pour différents archétypes de clients et de marchés, et la démonstration de la valeur et du rendement de l'investissement (ROI) par la production de preuves commerciales. Vous créez et livrez également des modèles et des cadres évolutives pour l'engagement des cliniciens et la réussite des clients. Vos principales responsabilités
• Leadership et perfectionnement de l'équipe : Coordonner, développer et gérer l'équipe d'adoption du marché, en favorisant une culture de haute performance et d'apprentissage continu pour assurer l'application uniforme des capacités dans tous les projets et les cas d'utilisation. Vous créerez une équipe hautement performante, responsabiliserez les gens à contribuer à leur plein potentiel, entraînera activement et gérera la planification de la relève.
• Stratégie en matière de revenus et modélisation financière : Analyser et relier de façon proactive les flux financiers, les réserves de valeur et la dynamique des marchés émergents afin de développer des perspectives commerciales et d'accélérer le succès du marché dans toutes les régions.
• Stratégie de paiement et de remboursement : Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies globales de revenu et de paiement au niveau du portefeuille, en collaboration avec les équipes de la Stratégie GTM et les cycles de vie. Établir des modèles de payeur innovateurs pour assurer un remboursement optimal et une saisie maximale de la valeur.
• Génération et alignement des données probantes : Diriger l'alignement stratégique et l'établissement des priorités des données probantes commerciales (p. ex., la recherche sur l'économie et les résultats en matière de santé/HECON) en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe des données probantes cliniques et les cycles de vie pertinents.
• Leadership en transformation numérique clinique : Diriger l'équipe de spécialistes en transformation numérique clinique, fournir des conseils cliniques stratégiques à des projets spécifiques et inspirer les affiliés à commercialiser et à mettre à l'échelle des solutions numériques.
• Structure du marché et identification des possibilités : Collaborer avec les équipes régionales pour identifier et exploiter activement les possibilités de façonner le marché à moyen et à long terme, en utilisant une approche ouverte et expérimentale pour assurer la meilleure adéquation du marché.
• État de préparation opérationnelle et conformité : S'assurer de l'état de préparation des TI et maintenir
