jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
Are you passionate about making a significant impact in the field of Hematology? Join the team for the position of Strategy Value Partner.

At Roche, you will have the chance to develop and adapt product strategies and tactics that align with international guidelines to introduce and expand the use of key products within the Hematology Disease Area.
As a Strategy Value Partner, you will maintain a visionary perspective that supports and aligns with various initiatives, build meaningful relationships with top Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), and generate valuable insights. By supporting and backing up Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) activities, you will drive patient journey success by defining and implementing local marketing and access plans, ensuring that PJPs are well-equipped with the necessary knowledge and tools.

Main Responsibilities
- Develop specific strategic plans for therapeutic areas
- Establish external partnerships serving the patient journey
- Lead internal alignment and resource mobilization around patient journey needs
- Enhance customer adoption for Roche products in the designated therapy area
- Collaborate closely with PJPs, Healthcare System Partners (HSPs), and Enablers to ensure prompt and equal access to Roche innovation
- Accountable for deliverables and outcomes in their therapeutic area
- Leverage and support the Pharma International Network and digital solutions to deploy effective engagement with customers and interventions towards the patient journey
- In collaboration with PJPs and HSPs, design, develop, and implement activities that enable Roche to secure optimal reimbursement and realize the maximum potential of current and future products

Who You Are
- You have a minimum of 3 years' marketing experience within the pharma industry.
- You drive scientific value, committed to advancing scientific knowledge and translating it into impactful outcomes
- You are experienced in working with cross-functional teams and agile methodologies
- You demonstrate exponential thinking and can envision innovative solutions beyond traditional boundaries
- You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, take initiative, embrace challenges, and drive projects with a sense of ownership.
- You exhibit strategic thinking and have the ability to develop and implement long-term strategies
- You maintain a growth mindset, open to learning, feedback, and continuous improvement
- You have strong influencing skills, adept at building relationships and persuading others to achieve goals
- You excel in effective decision-making, making well-informed decisions in a timely manner
- You demonstrate cross-functional leadership, leading and inspiring teams across different functions with an ability to connect beyond country borders, collaborating effectively with global teams and stakeholders
- You bring multidisciplinary experience with a diverse background in commercial, access, and medical domains
- You have consistently demonstrated Roche Values, leadership commitments, and core competencies at a high level
- You partner with internal and external entities to increase the adoption of the patient journey approach.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Kuwait. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Are you passionate about making a significant impact in the field of Hematology? Join the team for the position of Strategy Value Partner.

At Roche, you will have the chance to develop and adapt product strategies and tactics that align with international guidelines to introduce and expand the use of key products within the Hematology Disease Area.
As a Strategy Value Partner, you will maintain a visionary perspective that supports and aligns with various initiatives, build meaningful relationships with top Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), and generate valuable insights. By supporting and backing up Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) activities, you will drive patient journey success by defining and implementing local marketing and access plans, ensuring that PJPs are well-equipped with the necessary knowledge and tools.

Main Responsibilities
- Develop specific strategic plans for therapeutic areas
- Establish external partnerships serving the patient journey
- Lead internal alignment and resource mobilization around patient journey needs
- Enhance customer adoption for Roche products in the designated therapy area
- Collaborate closely with PJPs, Healthcare System Partners (HSPs), and Enablers to ensure prompt and equal access to Roche innovation
- Accountable for deliverables and outcomes in their therapeutic area
- Leverage and support the Pharma International Network and digital solutions to deploy effective engagement with customers and interventions towards the patient journey
- In collaboration with PJPs and HSPs, design, develop, and implement activities that enable Roche to secure optimal reimbursement and realize the maximum potential of current and future products

Who You Are
- You have a minimum of 3 years' marketing experience within the pharma industry.
- You drive scientific value, committed to advancing scientific knowledge and translating it into impactful outcomes
- You are experienced in working with cross-functional teams and agile methodologies
- You demonstrate exponential thinking and can envision innovative solutions beyond traditional boundaries
- You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, take initiative, embrace challenges, and drive projects with a sense of ownership.
- You exhibit strategic thinking and have the ability to develop and implement long-term strategies
- You maintain a growth mindset, open to learning, feedback, and continuous improvement
- You have strong influencing skills, adept at building relationships and persuading others to achieve goals
- You excel in effective decision-making, making well-informed decisions in a timely manner
- You demonstrate cross-functional leadership, leading and inspiring teams across different functions with an ability to connect beyond country borders, collaborating effectively with global teams and stakeholders
- You bring multidisciplinary experience with a diverse background in commercial, access, and medical domains
- You have consistently demonstrated Roche Values, leadership commitments, and core competencies at a high level
- You partner with internal and external entities to increase the adoption of the patient journey approach.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Kuwait. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Ingeniero de IT en Lima, te unirás a un Squad multidisciplinario para brindar soporte informático crítico y asegurar que nuestros clientes cuenten con las mejores soluciones de gestión de laboratorio . Esta posición te ofrece la oportunidad de impactar directamente en la eficiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología .

Oportunidad

• Liderar la implementación y el mantenimiento de soluciones informáticas para la gestión de laboratorios y conexiones de clientes .

• Brindar soporte técnico preventivo y correctivo, asegurando el cierre oportuno de actividades en el CRM según los estándares globales .

• Colaborar proactivamente con tu Squad para identificar necesidades de hardware, interfaces y viabilidad técnica de nuevas herramientas .

• Participar en la elaboración de proyectos informáticos y material de especificaciones técnicas para clientes y personal interno .

• Gestionar la instalación de servidores, redes, bases de datos y equipos periféricos (lectores, impresoras) en el entorno del cliente .

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del área de servicios.

• Realizar visitas de campo y demostraciones técnicas junto a los integrantes del equipo comercial cuando sea requerido .

• Atender el servicio de retén una vez finalizado el periodo de aprendizaje de 6 meses .

Quien eres

• Eres profesional titulado en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines, debidamente colegiado y con habilidad profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con al menos 2 años de experiencia comprobada en la gestión de proyectos de IT .

• Posees sólidos conocimientos técnicos en desarrollo de software, manejo de redes y gestión de bases de datos .

• Demuestras autonomía, liderazgo y capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente en entornos dinámicos .

• Te comunicas de manera efectiva en inglés a nivel intermedio .

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Ecosystem Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
La posición de Medical Ecosystem Partner está enfocada en posicionar nuevas moléculas e indicaciones, fortalecer la excelencia científica, la generación de evidencia y el cumplimiento normativo. Colabora con el equipo médico de las Áreas Terapéuticas para abordar necesidades no cubiertas y mejorar la presencia científica local.

Responsabilidades
1. Posicionamiento de Nuevas Moléculas y/o Indicaciones

• Entrenarse en nuevas áreas terapéuticas e investigar el manejo de la patología y el Journey del paciente.

• Mapear cuentas clave y stakeholders para construir relaciones científicas y captar insights del ecosistema.

2. Excelencia Científica

• Actuar como enlace médico local y fomentar el desarrollo de protocolos de tratamiento con stakeholders.

• Proporcionar insights científicos a los squads y apoyar la educación médica alineada con los objetivos locales y regionales.

3. Habilitador de Acceso

• Evaluar brechas de evidencia y proponer generación de datos locales para respaldar el valor clínico de las terapias.

• Coordinar el diseño y ejecución de planes de generación de datos y la implementación de herramientas digitales.

4. Cumplimiento Médico

• Mapear, incluir y segmentar HCPs y KSHs en EpiCx, además de registrar interacciones e insights conforme a los tiempos establecidos.

• Garantizar entrenamientos, cumplimiento de procesos, SOPs y estándares para asegurar el cumplimiento médico.

Quién Eres

• Profesional graduado en Medicina o carreras del área de la salud con título universitario debidamente reconocido en el país donde llevará a cabo su función. El candidato debe contar con la idoneidad y los permisos legales requeridos por la legislación local vigente de su país para ejercer funciones de visita médica, comunicación científica y relacionamiento con profesionales de la salud (HCPs).

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia, con al menos 3 años en área médica o afín (experiencia en la industria farmacéutica y/o terapéutica es un plus).

• Experiencia comprobada en la interacción profesional con stakeholders externos, incluyendo médicos, tomadores de decisión y otros actores clave del sector.

• Conocimiento del entorno y los sistemas sanitarios locales.

• Conocimientos en generación de datos: Ensayos Clínicos, Estudios Iniciados por Investigadores (IIS), Real World Evidence (RWE) y publicaciones.

• Idioma inglés/español fluido

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem-solving, this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops, and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals—from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment, and monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that offers exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest, preparing you for the next level in your career path. We know that our people are responsible for our success, and we deeply value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity:

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As an Associate Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel, demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and installation specialist for assigned Roche product lines, and provide valued service to your laboratory customers within an assigned territory.

You will be responsible for:

• Maximizing Customer Satisfaction: Ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products. Promoting effective, positive, and productive communication among teams. Managing customer accounts to promote goodwill, confidence, and credibility, consistently exceeding customer expectations for product, service, and support quality.

• Equipment Maintenance & Repair: Following standard practices and procedures to install, maintain, and repair Roche Diagnostics equipment. Identifying and analyzing current problems, performing repairs where possible, and escalating to higher levels when necessary. Scheduling and performing preventive maintenance per department policy. Monitoring equipment performance to resolve routine issues, while referring complex problems to senior team members.

• Driving Value & Revenue: Identifying revenue-generating and cost-saving opportunities. Implementing the Roche Diagnostics service agreement policy and seeking out opportunities to market service contracts to existing customers.

• Technical Support & Training: Providing routine technical support to existing customers, including conducting operator troubleshooting training when needed.

• Documentation & Compliance: Completing and documenting all service and customer account-related reports, updates, and emails in a timely, professional manner that complies with all quality procedures.

• Asset Management: Maintaining expenses within departmental guidelines and effectively controlling inventory and all company property.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem-solving, this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops, and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals—from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment, and monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that offers exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest, preparing you for the next level in your career path. We know that our people are responsible for our success, and we deeply value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity:

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As an Associate Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel, demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and installation specialist for assigned Roche product lines, and provide valued service to your laboratory customers within an assigned territory.

You will be responsible for:

• Maximizing Customer Satisfaction: Ensuring and maximizing customer satisfaction with Roche equipment and related products. Promoting effective, positive, and productive communication among teams. Managing customer accounts to promote goodwill, confidence, and credibility, consistently exceeding customer expectations for product, service, and support quality.

• Equipment Maintenance & Repair: Following standard practices and procedures to install, maintain, and repair Roche Diagnostics equipment. Identifying and analyzing current problems, performing repairs where possible, and escalating to higher levels when necessary. Scheduling and performing preventive maintenance per department policy. Monitoring equipment performance to resolve routine issues, while referring complex problems to senior team members.

• Driving Value & Revenue: Identifying revenue-generating and cost-saving opportunities. Implementing the Roche Diagnostics service agreement policy and seeking out opportunities to market service contracts to existing customers.

• Technical Support & Training: Providing routine technical support to existing customers, including conducting operator troubleshooting training when needed.

• Documentation & Compliance: Completing and documenting all service and customer account-related reports, updates, and emails in a timely, professional manner that complies with all quality procedures.

• Asset Management: Maintaining expenses within departmental guidelines and effectively controlling inventory and all company property.

This field-based role requires up to 10% overnight travel after the initial training period. The specialist will primarily support the Washington, D.C. area but should expect to travel to Baltimore, Richmond, and Norfolk as needed.

Who you are

• You hold a High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience.

• You have 2 years of experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless
networking or equivalent level of competency attained through appropriate training curriculum.

Preferred Requirements

• You hold 4 year Engineering Degree in Biomedical, Mechanical, Electri

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Second Shift: 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM

As the Histology Process Lead you will oversee the operational processes of the 2nd shift histology team to ensure workflow efficiency and support business goals. This role is responsible for delegating tasks to 2nd shift personnel while proactively collaborating with the 1st shift team and the 1st shift Process Lead. You will provide essential line support, ensure quality and training compliance, and assist the Histology Supervisor in meeting overall production schedules and customer service expectations.

The Opportunity

Quality and Safety

• Maintains Right to Operate by ensuring all processes are performed safely; addresses and escalates hazards; timely reports incidents and near misses

• Maintains the quality system and achieves quality objectives

• Ensures audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.) and represents team during internal audits/inspections

• Ensures accuracy and completeness of procedures for receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials per FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, GMP, MEE, and Roche policies

• Coordinates training completion and execution (NCRs, OJT, Operating Procedures, Work Instructions); maintains >95% training compliance

• Ensures inventory accuracy and adherence to inventory control processes (TECO, Cycle counts, etc.)

• Assists with NCR investigations, reworks, corrective actions, and document changes including writing new or updating work instructions and OPs

Production

• Monitors, balances, and delegates work to employees and contractors to achieve production goals and schedule adherence

• Provides 20-40% line support including receive, material handling, product build, formulation, material availability, SAP transactions, packet review, audits, and resource allocation

• Interfaces with complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment

• Ensures daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs are completed for proper communication between shifts and teams

• Effectively leads multiple production lines

• Coordinates maintenance and calibration of equipment in responsible areas

Continuous Improvement

• Ensures adherence to 6S, cycle times, and standard work; identifies and implements process improvements

• Facilitates and/or participates in Tier Meetings and staff meetings

• Troubleshoots problems, engages support functions, and assists in implementing preventative measures

• Collects, populates, and trends daily metrics (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery) to identify gaps and support operational excellence

Teamwork and Collaboration

• Proactively collaborates with peers across shifts and functions to achieve daily targets; provides performance feedback to leadership on employee contribution, attendance, and quality

• Ensures successful onboarding of new employees and contractors; participates in the interview process

• Performs other duties as assigned by management

Who You Are

• You have an Associate’s Degree

• You have 3 years Relevant work experience, preferably in GMP environment

• Experience leading teams or projects preferred.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement and previous experience with ERP systems and SAP

• Proficient with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc)

• High degree of initiative with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Ability to read, write and comprehend English; strong communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong organizationa

• Esperienza dimostrata con miglioramento continuo e precedente esperienza con sistemi ERP e SAP

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
You will be an expert in the hardware and software integration activities for a next generation sequencing platform. You will be a technical contributor and lead on long-term, complex and novel projects that require ingenuity, creativity and technical expertise. You are someone who does not shy away from a difficult problem, but seeks it out. You must be comfortable developing complex tools to aid in the characterization and operation of the sequencing platform using python or another rapid prototype language. You must be organized, detail oriented, and self motivated. Below are the responsibilities of this role:

• Systems Integration & Characterization: Lead the end-to-end integration of hardware and software, focusing on the characterization of component interactions and overall sequencing platform performance.

• Test Methodology Development: Design and implement comprehensive testing frameworks, including metrology tools, modular object-oriented software, and data management systems.

• Performance Analysis: Execute detailed experiments to measure and optimize system parameters such as accuracy, reliability, and repeatability, including high-speed data path troubleshooting.

• Physics-Based Problem Solving: Apply a deep understanding of system physics and assay performance to conduct root cause analysis and solve complex technical challenges.

• Strategic Leadership: Drive cross-functional projects independently, providing creative solutions and technical guidance to engineering teams under general management.

Who You Are
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

• Degree in Bio-engineering, Bio-medical Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering or a related discipline with a background in instrumentation development .

• Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of applicable industry experience, Master’s degree with 2+ years of applicable industry experience, or Ph.D. with 1+ years of applicable industry experience.

• Programming experience required , 2+ years of Python required, familiarity with C++ a plus.

• Experience with sequencing system development is a plus .

• Strong mechanical and electrical skills, electro-mechanical integration and troubleshooting skills a must.

• Analytical skills to effectively review and analyze technical problems.

• Understanding of DNA manipulation techniques and sequencing methodologies a plus.

• Meticulous attention to detail and excellent written and electronic record keeping skills.

• Strong oral and written communication skills.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this role.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. • Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to (laboratory diagnostics) customers.

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di vendita attrezzature capitale. Responsabile per la riunione e il superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati su territori specificati. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. Contatti/visita clienti esistenti e potenziali. Minimo di 10 a 15 in persona chiamate di vendita a settimana richiesto in territorio assegnato, sia esistente e prospettive. In grado di fare notti come necessario. Lavora per costruire e mantenere una rete di colleghi, partner e clienti per condividere informazioni e ottenere prospettive. Inoltre, la posizione richiede presentazioni di quantificazione del valore ai potenziali clienti. Deve dimostrare una conoscenza approfondita della linea di prodotto e avere una conoscenza più approfondita di altri prodotti o servizi. Un professionista esperto e esperto con una piena comprensione della zona del laboratorio clinico. Risolve una vasta gamma di problemi in modi creativi. Questo lavoro è una posizione completamente qualificata, orientata alla carriera. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e servizi aziendali. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno senior nella propria area di competenza. Responsabile della vendita dei prodotti o servizi dell'azienda, dello sviluppo di nuovi conti e/o dell'espansione dei conti esistenti. Normalmente riceve piccole istruzioni sul lavoro quotidiano, istruzioni generali su nuovi incarichi. Responsabile per il mantenimento di business e lavoro esistenti in modi che garantiranno obiettivi di vendita, risultati e crescita. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo, il nostro candidato ideale risiederebbe nella zona della metropolitana di New York, in particolare nella zona di Nassau e Suffolk. È necessario vivere entro 50 miglia del territorio con la capacità di viaggiare in tutto il territorio per le riunioni dei clienti. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questa posizione. Fatti di lavoro
• Contatti nuovi e già esistenti clienti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati (ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento), sviluppando nuove attività, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e la risoluzione dei problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche (chimica, immunoassay e automazione), il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere vendite.
• Minimo di 10 a 15 persone chiamate di vendita a settimana
• Genera la domanda e massimizza la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando con e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti (diagnosi di laboratorio).
• Implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare (attrezzatura di capitale) il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• Lavora con altri, come necessario o richiesto, per preparare (attrezzatura di credito e capitale) proposte per i conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• Co

Verantwortlich für die Erfüllung und Überschreitung der Verkaufsziele in Zielkonten in bestimmten Gebieten. In der Regel verantwortlich für mittlere bis große Konten oder haben eine mittlere bis große Quote / Gebiet. Muss Kundenperspektiven entwickeln und Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern aufbauen und pflegen. Kontakte / Besuche bestehende und potenzielle Kunden. Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche in zugewiesenem Gebiet erforderlich, sowohl bestehende als auch potenzielle. Kann Übernachtungen nach Bedarf machen. Aufbau und Pflege eines Netzwerks von Kollegen, Partnern und Kunden, um Informationen auszutauschen und Interessenten zu gewinnen. Darüber hinaus erfordert die Position Wertquantifizierungspräsentationen für potenzielle Kunden. Sie müssen fundierte Kenntnisse der Produktlinie nachweisen und über fundierte Kenntnisse anderer Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verfügen. Ein erfahrener, erfahrener Fachmann mit einem vollständigen Verständnis des Bereichs des klinischen Labors. Löst eine breite Palette von Problemen auf kreative Weise. Dieser Job ist eine voll qualifizierte, karriereorientierte Position. Hat eine vollständige Kenntnis der Produkte und Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens. Arbeitet an Problemen unterschiedlichen Umfangs, bei denen die Analyse von Daten eine Bewertung identifizierbarer Faktoren erfordert. Zeigt gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Auswahl von Methoden und Techniken, um Lösungen zu erhalten. Netzwerke mit leitenden internen und externen Mitarbeitern in ihrem eigenen Fachgebiet. Verantwortlich für den Verkauf der Produkte oder Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens, die Entwicklung neuer Konten und / oder die Erweiterung bestehender Konten. Normalerweise erhält er wenig Anweisungen zur täglichen Arbeit, allgemeine Anweisungen zu neuen Aufgaben. Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung des bestehenden Geschäfts und die Arbeit auf eine Weise, die Verkaufsziele, Erfolge und Wachstum sicherstellt. • Kontaktieren Sie neue und bestehende Kunden, um die Verkaufsziele in gezielten (Krankenhaus- und Referenzlabor) Konten zu erreichen und zu übertreffen, indem Sie neues Geschäft entwickeln, bestehendes Geschäft ausbauen, Kundenbeziehungen pflegen und Kundenprobleme beheben. • Mindestens 10 bis 15 persönliche Verkaufsgespräche pro Woche
• Generiert Nachfrage und maximiert das Produktbewusstsein durch die Zusammenarbeit und Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Informationen für (Labordiagnostik-) Kunden.
• Implementiert strategische Initiativen und Pläne, um den Verkaufsprozess und die Produktivität zu erleichtern.
• Arbeitet mit anderen zusammen, wenn nötig oder erforderlich, um Vorschläge für zugewiesene Konten vorzubereiten (Reagens und Investitionsausrüstung). Präsentiert alle Vertragsvorschläge an Kunden, um das Gesamtgeschäft und die Rentabilität zu maximieren, was einige Verhandlungen erfordern kann.

Responsable de l'atteinte et du dépassement des objectifs de vente dans des comptes ciblés dans des territoires déterminés. Généralement responsable des comptes moyens à grands ou ayant un quota/territoire moyen à grand. Il faut développer les perspectives client et créer et maintenir des relations avec les décideurs. Contacts/visites les clients existants et potentiels. Minimum de 10 à 15 appels de vente par semaine requis sur le territoire assigné, à la fois existants et potentiels. En outre, la position nécessite des présentations de quantification de valeur aux clients potentiels. Doit démontrer une connaissance approfondie de la gamme de produits et avoir une connaissance plus approfondie d'autres produits ou services. Un professionnel expérimenté et expérimenté qui comprend parfaitement le domaine du laboratoire clinique. Résoudre un large éventail de questions de manière créative. Ce poste est entièrement qualifié et orienté vers la carrière. A une connaissance complète des produits et services de l'entreprise. Travaille sur des problèmes de portée diverse où l'analyse des données nécessite une évaluation de facteurs identifiables. Démontrer un bon jugement dans le choix des méthodes et des techniques pour obtenir des solutions. Réseaux avec des cadres supérieurs internes et externes dans leur propre domaine d'expertise. Responsable de la vente des produits ou services de l'entreprise, du développement de nouveaux comptes et/ou de l'expansion des comptes existants. Normalement peu d'instructions sur le travail quotidien, des instructions générales sur les nouvelles affectations. Responsable du maintien des activités existantes et du travail de manière à assurer les objectifs de vente, les réalisations et la croissance. • Contacts clients nouveaux et existants pour atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente dans les comptes ciblés (hôpital et laboratoire de référence), en développant de nouvelles affaires, en développant les affaires existantes, en maintenant des relations avec les clients et en dépannant les problèmes des clients. Cela comprend l'identification et l'élaboration de plans de comptes stratégiques, l'élaboration et la diffusion d'un message de différenciation et d'une valeur économique quantifiable pour les produits et les services, la vente de la différenciation primaire des produits Roche (chimie, immunoessais et automatisation), la résolution et la gestion des objections, et la négociation pour obtenir des ventes.

• Génére la demande et maximise la sensibilisation aux produits en travaillant avec les clients (diagnostics de laboratoire) et en leur fournissant de l'éducation et de l'information.
• Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives et des plans stratégiques pour faciliter le processus de vente et la productivité du matériel (immobilisations).
• Travaille avec d'autres personnes, selon les besoins ou les besoins, pour préparer des propositions (réactifs et matériel d'équipement) pour les comptes attribués. Présente toutes les propositions de contrats aux clients afin de maximiser l'ensemble des activités et de la rentabilité, ce qui peut nécessiter des négociations.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como Parceiro do Ecossistema de Saúde Suplementar você será responsável em fortalecer o engajamento com os stakeholders desse ecossistema, promovendo áreas de interesse estratégico, como condições médicas específicas, tratamentos inovadores e soluções para ampliar o acesso às nossas inovações.
Você será responsável por introduzir e sustentar o crescimento das inovações da Roche no ambiente das operadoras de saúde e prestadores da área, demonstrando seus benefícios e contribuição para a sustentabilidade do ecossistema de saúde. Para isso, deverá considerar diferentes aspectos de impacto no acesso privado: cobertura e processos regulatórios, modelos de parcerias e iniciativas comerciais estratégicas, aspectos tributários relacionados ao mercado, modelos de remuneração e de relacionamento entre os players, diferentes incentivos e valores na definição de terapias e jornadas terapêuticas, e tendências de mercado do setor - modelos de verticalização, protocolos assistenciais e linhas de cuidado.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Gerenciar os principais indicadores de performance das terapias Roche nos ambientes dos prestadores e pagadores de forma direta - operadoras verticais - e/ou indireta - operadoras com rede credenciada, sendo responsável pela definição de planos estratégicos e táticos para as diferentes contas e jornadas atuando de forma 360° dentro de contas específicas.

• Garantir a gestão e a entrega de resultados com o suporte de outras equipes e áreas viabilizadoras, avaliando oportunidades nas áreas de acesso, promoção, médica e comercial, propondo estratégias eficazes para o desenvolvimento de relações de longo prazo no acesso às nossas inovações.

• Desenvolver e manter relações sólidas e estratégicas com stakeholders e decisores em contas chave sendo o principal ponto de contato para os clientes, assegurando respostas rápidas e eficazes a suas necessidades.

• Identificar e capitalizar oportunidades para expandir o negócio dentro das contas existentes, bem como propor inovações, soluções e serviços adaptados às necessidades dos clientes, promovendo o seu crescimento sustentável.

• Desenvolver e implementar planos estratégicos de contas para atingir metas robustas de vendas e crescimento, sincronizando esforços com equipes internas de marketing, áreas viabilizadoras e atendimento ao cliente para garantir a entrega excepcional de produtos e serviços.

• Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inovador e de alto desempenho em um modelo de “Squad”.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa (Pós-graduação/MBA desejável) e inglês avançado desejável.

• Base em São Paulo/SP com disponibilidade para viagens nacionais frequentes (média de 75%/mês).

• Domínio do ecossistema de Saúde Suplementar, seus modelos de remuneração e proposição de modelos de negócio (incluindo aspectos tributários).

• Experiência no relacionamento com Prestadores e Operadoras de Saúde em diversos níveis de governança, inclusive o executivo.

• Experiência em elaboração, gestão de planos de contas estratégicas e segmentação de clientes.

• Sólido conhecimento integrando as áreas de Acesso, Médico-científico, Experiência do Cliente e Comercial.

• Habilidade para gerenciar cenários complexos com múltip

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, Roche is fundamentally committed to improving patient lives by advancing the future of healthcare. We stand as an undisputed industry leader in diagnostics, providing the critical data that allows physicians to make precise, life-saving medical decisions.
At Roche, our culture thrives on innovation, collaboration, and genuine connection. We believe in creating a space where you can show up as your authentic self, supported by a world-class team that values your unique perspective. For an intern, Roche offers an unparalleled learning environment, combining cutting-edge medical technology with structured mentorship, all while giving you the chance to do work that directly impacts human health every single day.

The Opportunity

• Hands-on Technical Support: Shadow senior application specialists to learn how to troubleshoot diagnostic instrumentation.

• Customer Training: Shadow senior application specialists to learn training delivery methods, and customer integration with new systems or system changes.

• Diagnostic Problem-Solving: Learn to interpret technical information, software logs, and diagnostic tools for troubleshooting or customer validation support

• Administrative Accuracy: Documentation best practices in industry

Who You Are:
We are looking for analytical, collaborative thinkers who are eager to learn and passionate about technology and healthcare.

Required Education:

• Individuals currently pursuing an undergraduate degree/diploma in Medical lab Technology, Science, or a closely related technical field.

• Bilingual Proficiency : Fluent in both English and French (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts and support clients in both languages.

Preferred Skills:

• Mindset: Exceptional troubleshooting skills with a natural curiosity for how complex systems work.

• Communication: Possesses strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills, with an ability to maintain a calming presence and effectively guide clients through complex technical troubleshooting under high-pressure situations.

• Mobility: A valid Driver’s License is a plus.

What We Offer:

• Mentorship: Direct, one-on-one guidance from industry-leading technical specialists.

• Real-World Impact: Genuine exposure to the healthcare technology sector where your work helps deliver timely medical results for patients.

• Competitive Compensation: Paid internship with a supportive stipend.

• Career Pipeline: Participation and strong performance in the internship program helps cultivate the foundational skills and company-specific experience required for full-time roles or rotational development programs upon graduation.

Additional Information:

• Duration: 12 months

• Work term : Full-time (35 hours per week) and will begin in September 2026.

• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of time in the office).

• Location: Based in Montreal, Quebec

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, Roche is fundamentally committed to improving patient lives by advancing the future of healthcare. We stand as an undisputed industry leader in diagnostics, providing the critical data that allows physicians to make precise, life-saving medical decisions.
At Roche, our culture thrives on innovation, collaboration, and genuine connection. We believe in creating a space where you can show up as your authentic self, supported by a world-class team that values your unique perspective. For an intern, Roche offers an unparalleled learning environment, combining cutting-edge medical technology with structured mentorship, all while giving you the chance to do work that directly impacts human health every single day.

The Opportunity:

• Hands-on Technical Support: Shadow senior FSRs to learn how to install, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain complex diagnostic instrumentation (such as our cobas systems).

• Preventative Maintenance: Assist in performing routine preventative maintenance checks and technical service updates to minimize equipment downtime for healthcare providers.

• Diagnostic Problem-Solving: Learn to interpret technical information, software logs, and diagnostic tools to isolate root causes of equipment malfunctions.

• Administrative Accuracy: Documentation best practices in industry

Who You Are:

• We are looking for analytical, collaborative thinkers who are eager to learn and passionate about technology and healthcare.

Required Education:

• Individuals currently pursuing an undergraduate degree/diploma in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related technical field.

• Bilingual Proficiency : Fluent in both English and French (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts and support clients in both languages.

Preferred Skills:

• Mindset: Exceptional troubleshooting skills with a natural curiosity for how complex mechanical and electronic systems work.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills; a calming presence when helping clients resolve technical issues under pressure.

• Mobility: A valid Driver’s License is a plus.

What We Offer:

• Mentorship: Direct, one-on-one guidance from industry-leading technical specialists and senior field engineers.

• Real-World Impact: Genuine exposure to the healthcare technology sector where your work helps deliver timely medical results for patients.

• Competitive Compensation: Paid internship with a supportive stipend.

• Career Pipeline: Participation and strong performance in the internship program helps cultivate the foundational skills and company-specific experience required for full-time roles or rotational development programs upon graduation

Additional Information:

• Duration: 12 months

• Work term : Full-time (35 hours per week) and will begin in September 2026.

• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of time in the office).

• Location: Based in Montreal, Quebec

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, Roche is fundamentally committed to improving patient lives by advancing the future of healthcare. We stand as an undisputed industry leader in diagnostics, providing the critical data that allows physicians to make precise, life-saving medical decisions.

At Roche, our culture thrives on innovation, collaboration, and genuine connection. We believe in creating a space where you can show up as your authentic self, supported by a world-class team that values your unique perspective. For an intern, Roche offers an unparalleled learning environment, combining cutting-edge medical technology with structured mentorship, all while giving you the chance to do work that directly impacts human health every single day.

The Opportunity:

• Business Systems and Process Support: Drive process improvement and workflow optimization by documenting business requirements and leveraging data analytics, automation, and high-value AI use cases.

• Collaboration and Continuous Learning: Work closely with cross-functional teams on business improvement initiatives while staying informed on emerging AI, analytics technologies, and automation frameworks.

• Data Analytics and Reporting: Build and maintain data visualization tools, dashboards, and KPI reports using platforms like Tableau, Salesforce, or Snowflake to identify operational trends and insights.

Who You Are:

We are looking for analytical, collaborative thinkers who are eager to learn and passionate about technology and healthcare.

Required Education:

• Individuals currently pursuing an undergraduate degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.

• Bilingual Proficiency: Fluent in both English and French (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts and support clients in both languages.

Preferred Skills:

• Technical Familiarity: Basic exposure to data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Excel, SQL, Salesforce, Snowflake, or Python.

• Mindset: Exceptional troubleshooting skills with a natural curiosity for AI/ML concepts and automation platforms. .

• Communication: Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills; a calming presence when helping clients resolve technical issues under pressure.

What We Offer:

• Mentorship: Direct, one-on-one guidance from experienced data professionals and industry-leading technical specialists.

• Real-World Impact: Genuine exposure to AI and analytics initiatives in a global healthcare organization where your work improves customer and patient outcomes.

• Competitive Compensation: Paid internship with a supportive stipend.

• Career Pipeline: Participation and strong performance in the internship program helps cultivate the foundational skills and company-specific experience required for full-time roles or rotational development programs upon graduation.

Additional Information:

• Duration: 12 months

• Work term : Full-time (35 hours per week) and will begin in September 2026.

• Our team follows a hybrid work structure (majority of time in the office).

• Location: Based in Montreal, Quebec

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

•

La posizione supporta anche i team di prodotti locali fornendo informazioni finanziarie e modellazione per guidare il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Responsabilità chiave: 1. • Monitorare l'accuratezza e la tempestività delle postazioni finanziarie, comprese le voci di giornale, le accruals e le riclassificazioni.

• Coordinate con SSC e consulenti fiscali esterni per i depositi fiscali e gli audit.
• Sostenere i processi di chiusura di fine mese e fine anno, fornendo contesto locale, risolvendo discrepanze e garantendo una corretta documentazione.

• Identificare le opportunità di semplificare e automatizzare i processi di finanza e di approvvigionamento a livello locale.
• Promuovere il rispetto dei controlli interni, delle politiche finanziarie e delle pratiche di approvvigionamento etico.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

As a Process Lead for Instruments, Reagents, and Formulation, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and optimizing our manufacturing workflows to support our operational goals. You will join a dynamic production team dedicated to driving operational excellence, maximizing productivity, and cultivating an inclusive environment guided by our operating principles. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead production lines, mentor team members, and directly influence the quality of deliverables that impact patient lives worldwide.

• You manage, balance, and delegate daily tasks to production employees and contractors to achieve scheduling goals and optimize line throughput.

• You ensure all manufacturing processes are performed in a safe, healthy manner while maintaining full compliance with regulatory standards (such as FDA and OSHA).

• You provide dedicated hands-on line support, including material handling, product building, bulk solution formulation, and process auditing.

• You drive continuous improvement by implementing lean practices, establishing standard work, and troubleshooting operational issues.

• You monitor, review, and update operational procedures and work instructions to maintain exceptional quality and audit readiness.

• You collect, populate, and trend key operational metrics to identify gaps, implement preventative measures, and support excellence initiatives.

• You foster a collaborative team culture by facilitating shift handovers, guiding onboarding for new hires, and sharing best practices.

Who you are:

• You hold an Associate's Degree (or equivalent combined education and experience) and bring 3+ years of relevant manufacturing experience, preferably in a regulated environment.

• You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to deliver clear direction, collaborate across functions, and provide constructive coaching feedback.

• You demonstrate a high degree of initiative, with the capability to work independently and manage multiple tasks within a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• You are highly organized with strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and a proven track record of solving complex problems effectively.

• You are an inspiring and influential natural leader who excels at motivating team members and reinforcing positive group values.

Preferred:

• You have prior experience leading teams or managing operational projects.

• You possess demonstrated hands-on experience with Lean or Continuous Improvement methodologies.

• You have experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, ideally SAP.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, Texas is 52 400,00 - 81 000,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

• Si dimostra un alto grado di iniziativa, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire più attività all'interno di un ambiente veloce e ad alto volume.
• Sei altamente organizzato con forte pensiero critico, abilità analitiche, e un record di traccia comprovato di risolvere i problemi complessi in modo efficace.
• Sei un leader naturale ispiratore e influente che eccelle nel motivare i membri del team e rafforzare i valori di gruppo positivi. Preferito:
• Avete precedenti esperienze di team leader o gestione di progetti operativi.

jobs.title: Site IT Experience Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking for passionate student to join us as a Site IT Experience intern. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who is interested in pursuing a career in Site IT support, as they will gain hands-on experience in a global professional environment.

Your Responsibilities

• Assisting to complete the SOP documentation for the team while shadow learning from the Site IT Operations Specialist.

• New floor setup of IT equipments

• New Hire IT Onboarding tasks

• Assisting for IT Asset Management which includes stock count, migration of data to new asset management tool and asset management documentation

• Assisting as a backup for Site IT Operations Specialist for daily task on handling user issues.

​ Who we are looking for:

• Undergraduate students from reputable universities in the relevant fields of IT, Computer Science or Engineering.

• Passionate and energetic in information technology functions (IT Hardware related).

• Good communication skills with high proficiency in English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Schedule: This position is within a 24/7 call center. It is expected for this individual to have flexibility working 2nd or 3rd shifts and/or weekends, including some holidays. Your schedule will be determined on a quarterly basis.

This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you have passion for problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
This position provides technical support to customers, answering questions on function and usage of products via the Technical Support Center. This individual may also provide technical assistance to sales, marketing and other Roche departments.

• You will analyze basic problems with non functioning electro/mechanical equipment, software applications or reagents to identify problem area(s) and recommend corrective action.

• You will also serve as the primary support liaison between Roche and the customer.

• This individual will recommend solutions to customer’s application questions and maintain a database of problems so that recurring problems can be analyzed and reported.

• You will know and apply the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization.

• You will have significant on-the-job training or formalized education in a specific area. Requires some evaluation, originality or ingenuity.

• This individual will contribute independently or with a team towards a program or department goal or service.

• You will interface with internal customers and departments.

• This individual is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a remote based role.

Who You Are

• Associate’s degree or equivalent military training in medical technology, electronics or related field.

Preferred Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred, or Associates degree in medical or STEM, or equivalent field service or CSC experience.

• Phone customer service experience

• Clinical chemistry applications background

• Applications training in cobas 6000, cobas 8000, or cobas pro, cobas pure, mass spec.

• Interest/ability in working 2nd or 3rd shift.

• Interest/ability in working a Saturday or Sunday in schedule.

The expected salary range for this position based on Indianapolis, IN is $47,600.00 - $88,400.00/year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Schedule: This position is within a 24/7 call center. It is expected for this individual to have flexibility working 2nd or 3rd shifts and/or weekends, including some holidays. Your schedule will be determined on a quarterly basis.

This is an exciting time to join Roche Support Network. If you have passion for problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

The Opportunity
This position provides technical support to customers, answering questions on function and usage of products via the Technical Support Center. This individual may also provide technical assistance to sales, marketing and other Roche departments.

• You will analyze basic problems with non functioning electro/mechanical equipment, software applications or reagents to identify problem area(s) and recommend corrective action.

• You will also serve as the primary support liaison between Roche and the customer.

• This individual will recommend solutions to customer’s application questions and maintain a database of problems so that recurring problems can be analyzed and reported.

• You will know and apply the fundamental concepts, practices and procedures of the particular field of specialization.

• You will have significant on-the-job training or formalized education in a specific area. Requires some evaluation, originality or ingenuity.

• This individual will contribute independently or with a team towards a program or department goal or service.

• You will interface with internal customers and departments.

• This individual is responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a remote based role.

Who You Are

• Associate’s degree or equivalent military training in medical technology, electronics or related field.

Preferred Requirements

• Bachelor's degree preferred, or Associates degree in medical or STEM, or equivalent field service or CSC experience.

• Phone customer service experience

• Clinical chemistry applications background

• Applications training in cobas 6000, cobas 8000, or cobas pro, cobas pure, mass spec.

• Interest/ability in working 2nd or 3rd shift.

• Interest/ability in working a Saturday or Sunday in schedule.

Benefits
