titleByLocale.en: (资深)包装操作工 - 无菌制剂（正式工）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
罗氏正在上海建设全新的大分子工厂。我们开放了包装操作工的岗位，该职位要求具备出色的执行能力和丰富的包装操作经验，精通核心包装流程，并能够操作和日常维护包装设备，以确保生产的连续性和可靠性。此外，该职位还需与项目团队紧密合作，共同执行这项战略计划，包括工厂设计、验证、生产准备和启动等工作。
包装操作工负责在工艺步骤（例如针头切割、贴标和包装）中达成生产目标，确保产品安全、及时地生产，并完全符合GMP/SHE要求以及罗氏的企业原则、质量政策和标准。

• 负责包装线上相关工艺设备的操作和清洁，包括针头切割机、贴标机、装盒机、药监码系统、装箱机和码垛机。

• 负责包装物料的转运和管理，包括包装线上的针头检查。

• 协助进行包装线的设备验证和工艺验证。

•
负责高质量、高效率地执行资质认证和生产活动。

工程项目支持和运行准备阶段:

• 参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 支持包装工艺的初步开发和优化。

• 参与运行准备工作的实施，例如：起草设备操作规程和日志、现场5S 管理、根据准备计划进行现场机器清洁等。

• 接受包装设备操作和 CCS 实施方面的培训并获得相关资质。

• 完成其他分配的任务。

日常运营阶段:

• 确保日常操作符合罗氏的GMP/SHE及相关法规要求。

• 执行以下生产操作：例如，针头切割和目视检查、贴标和包装。

• 执行常规包装生产操作并填写GMP记录。

• 确保所有包装活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

• 在包装过程中实施冷链管理。

• 在维护工程师的支持下，及时诊断并解决设备故障，以最大限度地减少停机时间。

• 相关IT系统操作，例如SAP、MES。

• 执行其他分配的任务。
岗位要求：

教育背景/资质

• 大专及以上学历（药学/生物学专业优先）。

岗位所需胜任力

• 拥有3年及以上注射剂制药行业运营经验，有跨国生物制药公司经验者优先。

• 具备包装设施战略项目经验者优先，包括设计、调试和验证。

• 熟悉cGMP及制药行业相关法规，尤其是生物制药行业相关法规。

• 能够与团队成员和干系人有效沟通、协作并建立积极的互动关系。具备基本的英语沟通能力优先。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. In this critical role based at our Brackengate site in Cape Town, you will serve as a vital generalist responsible for the end-to-end coordination and administration of our youth development programs and transformation initiatives. This position acts as a primary bridge between internal departments and external partners, providing specialized administrative support to the People & Culture (P&C) function to ensure site activities remain aligned with local statutory requirements and corporate transformation goals.

As a Skills Development & Compliance Coordinator, you will:

- Serve as the primary operational liaison for youth development initiatives, aligning internal departmental resource needs with program objectives.
- Manage communications and build collaborative relationships with external partners, including universities, colleges, academic institutions, and external funding bodies.
- Maintain, compile, and update the statutory site training register to accurately track learning interventions and monitor participant progress.
- Coordinate the collection of documentation required for compliance submissions to relevant local education and training authorities, including Workplace Skills Plans.
- Partner closely with local People & Culture and Legal teams to compile compliance reports and manage employee data in alignment with local equity standards.
- Manage operational logistics for equity forums, coordinate regular site policy audits to identify workplace barriers, and maintain meeting agendas and minutes.
- Provide dedicated ad-hoc administrative support, tracking the overall effectiveness of site employee engagement and transformation initiatives.

Who You Are

You are a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive administrative professional who possesses a passion for driving human resource development and equity initiatives. You bring excellent interpersonal skills that allow you to connect naturally with people across all levels of an organization, coupled with robust project coordination capabilities.

To set yourself up for success, you bring:

- Education: A National Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
- Experience: 3 to 5 years of proven experience either within a corporate environment or relevant practice areas, focusing on legal administration, corporate social responsibility, or human resources support.
- Regulatory Knowledge: A strong foundational understanding of local statutory frameworks, including skills development levies, employment equity legislation, and broad-based economic empowerment codes.
- Digital & Collaboration Tools: High proficiency using a wide variety of electronic collaboration tools, such as Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
- Core Competencies: Strong command of written and verbal English, a high level of attention to detail, and a proven ability to balance multiple project tasks effectively.

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. In this critical role based at our Brackengate site in Cape Town, you will serve as a vital generalist responsible for the end-to-end coordination and administration of our youth development programs and transformation initiatives. This position acts as a primary bridge between internal departments and external partners, providing specialized administrative support to the People & Culture (P&C) function to ensure site activities remain aligned with local statutory requirements and corporate transformation goals.

As a Skills Development & Compliance Coordinator, you will:

- Serve as the primary operational liaison for youth development initiatives, aligning internal departmental resource needs with program objectives.
- Manage communications and build collaborative relationships with external partners, including universities, colleges, academic institutions, and external funding bodies.
- Maintain, compile, and update the statutory site training register to accurately track learning interventions and monitor participant progress.
- Coordinate the collection of documentation required for compliance submissions to relevant local education and training authorities, including Workplace Skills Plans.
- Partner closely with local People & Culture and Legal teams to compile compliance reports and manage employee data in alignment with local equity standards.
- Manage operational logistics for equity forums, coordinate regular site policy audits to identify workplace barriers, and maintain meeting agendas and minutes.
- Provide dedicated ad-hoc administrative support, tracking the overall effectiveness of site employee engagement and transformation initiatives.

Who You Are

You are a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive administrative professional who possesses a passion for driving human resource development and equity initiatives. You bring excellent interpersonal skills that allow you to connect naturally with people across all levels of an organization, coupled with robust project coordination capabilities.

To set yourself up for success, you bring:

- Education: A National Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
- Experience: 3 to 5 years of proven experience either within a corporate environment or relevant practice areas, focusing on legal administration, corporate social responsibility, or human resources support.
- Regulatory Knowledge: A strong foundational understanding of local statutory frameworks, including skills development levies, employment equity legislation, and broad-based economic empowerment codes.
- Digital & Collaboration Tools: High proficiency using a wide variety of electronic collaboration tools, such as Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
- Core Competencies: Strong command of written and verbal English, a high level of attention to detail, and a proven ability to balance multiple project tasks effectively.

Note that a full job description is available upon request.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Notez qu'une description de travail complète est disponible sur demande. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités

jobs.title: Breast Biomarker Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre el rol
Buscamos un líder científico apasionado por transformar la atención al paciente. En este rol, serás el puente estratégico entre la innovación científica, el diagnóstico avanzado y la práctica clínica. Tu misión principal es impulsar el uso de biomarcadores para personalizar tratamientos, asegurando que los pacientes adecuados reciban el tratamiento adecuado en el momento preciso.

¿Qué harás en el día a día?

• Liderar la estrategia científica: Serás el referente experto en el área de mama, definiendo cómo la ciencia y la tecnología mejoran el viaje del paciente. Trabajarás codo a codo con expertos médicos, equipos de diagnóstico y equipos globales para integrar nuevos hallazgos en la clínica real.

• Conectar el ecosistema: Actuarás como punto de enlace entre la investigación interna, los equipos de diagnóstico y la comunidad médica externa. Tu objetivo es facilitar una comunicación bidireccional que traduzca datos científicos complejos en soluciones prácticas.

• Impulsar la evidencia y la investigación: Coordinarás proyectos de investigación (desde fases tempranas hasta estudios de evidencia en el mundo real) para cerrar brechas de conocimiento médico y fortalecer nuestras propuestas terapéuticas.

• Impacto externo: Colaborarás estrechamente con sociedades médicas y líderes de opinión para construir colaboraciones que mejoren el acceso y la comprensión de los biomarcadores, asegurando que nuestras soluciones lleguen a quienes más las necesitan.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

• Formación: Grado superior en Ciencias de la Salud (Biociencias, Medicina, Farmacia, Biotecnología, etc.). Se valorará positivamente formación en investigación.

• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en roles similares (Medical Science Liaison, Medical Affairs, Market Access o gestión de cuentas de salud) en la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica.

• Conocimientos técnicos:

• Dominio del entorno de diagnóstico y monitorización clínica.

• Experiencia sólida en el ciclo de vida de ensayos clínicos (diseño, ejecución y análisis).

• Experiencia previa trabajando con líderes de opinión y sociedades científicas.

• Habilidades clave:

• Visión estratégica y analítica: Capacidad para conectar puntos, interpretar datos complejos y tomar decisiones con impacto a largo plazo.

• Trabajo en equipo: Habilidad para colaborar en entornos matriciales, influyendo y comunicando con éxito a distintos niveles.

• Innovación: Mentalidad creativa para proponer soluciones más allá de lo convencional.

• Idiomas: Inglés fluido (imprescindible).

¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?
Te ofrecemos la oportunidad de trabajar en la vanguardia de la medicina personalizada, donde tu trabajo diario impacta directamente en la calidad de vida de los pacientes. Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar altamente cualificado en un entorno que fomenta la creatividad, la autonomía y el desarrollo profesional continuo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunit

The Position
Sobre el rol
Buscamos un líder científico apasionado por transformar la atención al paciente. En este rol, serás el puente estratégico entre la innovación científica, el diagnóstico avanzado y la práctica clínica. Tu misión principal es impulsar el uso de biomarcadores para personalizar tratamientos, asegurando que los pacientes adecuados reciban el tratamiento adecuado en el momento preciso.

¿Qué harás en el día a día?

• Liderar la estrategia científica: Serás el referente experto en el área de mama, definiendo cómo la ciencia y la tecnología mejoran el viaje del paciente. Trabajarás codo a codo con expertos médicos, equipos de diagnóstico y equipos globales para integrar nuevos hallazgos en la clínica real.

• Conectar el ecosistema: Actuarás como punto de enlace entre la investigación interna, los equipos de diagnóstico y la comunidad médica externa. Tu objetivo es facilitar una comunicación bidireccional que traduzca datos científicos complejos en soluciones prácticas.

• Impulsar la evidencia y la investigación: Coordinarás proyectos de investigación (desde fases tempranas hasta estudios de evidencia en el mundo real) para cerrar brechas de conocimiento médico y fortalecer nuestras propuestas terapéuticas.

• Impacto externo: Colaborarás estrechamente con sociedades médicas y líderes de opinión para construir colaboraciones que mejoren el acceso y la comprensión de los biomarcadores, asegurando que nuestras soluciones lleguen a quienes más las necesitan.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

• Formación: Grado superior en Ciencias de la Salud (Biociencias, Medicina, Farmacia, Biotecnología, etc.). Se valorará positivamente formación en investigación.

• Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en roles similares (Medical Science Liaison, Medical Affairs, Market Access o gestión de cuentas de salud) en la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica.

• Conocimientos técnicos:

• Dominio del entorno de diagnóstico y monitorización clínica.

• Experiencia sólida en el ciclo de vida de ensayos clínicos (diseño, ejecución y análisis).

• Experiencia previa trabajando con líderes de opinión y sociedades científicas.

• Habilidades clave:

• Visión estratégica y analítica: Capacidad para conectar puntos, interpretar datos complejos y tomar decisiones con impacto a largo plazo.

• Trabajo en equipo: Habilidad para colaborar en entornos matriciales, influyendo y comunicando con éxito a distintos niveles.

• Innovación: Mentalidad creativa para proponer soluciones más allá de lo convencional.

• Idiomas: Inglés fluido (imprescindible).

¿Por qué unirte a nosotros?
Te ofrecemos la oportunidad de trabajar en la vanguardia de la medicina personalizada, donde tu trabajo diario impacta directamente en la calidad de vida de los pacientes. Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar altamente cualificado en un entorno que fomenta la creatividad, la autonomía y el desarrollo profesional continuo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner - Oncology
Location: Mumbai

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche's capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

Your Opportunity

• You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators

• You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations

• You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

• You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

Who you are ​

• Relevant graduate delivery required, post-graduation preferred

• More than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Oncology or similar preferred

• Strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

• English language knowledge, written and verbal is preferred, knowledge of local language is an advantage

• Willingness to relocate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Organisation “Standort Basel / Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort Basel & Kaiseraugst bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation.

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Unser Fokus liegt auf langfristigen Investitionen im Bereich Forschung und Entwicklung, um das Leben von Menschen zu verbessern - heute und für künftige Generationen.
Der Bereich Site Assets Project Delivery ist an den Standorten Basel & Kaiseraugst verantwortlich für die kosten-, termin- und qualitätsgerechte Durchführung von Investitionsprojekten.

Wir arbeiten in einem rollenbasierten Modell, das Tätigkeiten in unterschiedlichen Verantwortungsbereichen ermöglicht .

Deine Möglichkeit

Als erfahrener Projektleiter auf Bauherrenseite übernehme ich die professionelle Bauherrenvertretung für Roche. In dieser Rolle verantworte ich die ganzheitliche Leitung und Steuerung von anspruchsvollen Bau-, Labor-, Infrastruktur- und Engineering-Projekten im regulierten Pharma-Umfeld.

• Projektsteuerung & -initiierung: Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien (Feasibility Studies) sowie die strategische Projektinitiierung und -organisation gemäß den Anforderungen von Auftraggebern, Nutzern und Betreibern.

• Beschaffung & Vertragsmanagement: Professionelle Erstellung und Prüfung von Konzepten, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeunterlagen sowie die anschließende Beauftragung und Überwachung der Dienstleistungen.

• Projektcontrolling: Umfassendes Kosten-, Termin-, Änderungs- und Risikomanagement zur Sicherung des Projekterfolgs.

• Ressourcen- & Stakeholdermanagement: Effiziente Koordination von Architekten, Fachplanern, Ingenieuren und ausführenden Unternehmen sowie enge Abstimmung mit internen, teils globalen Teams.

• Compliance & Qualität: Konsequente Sicherstellung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben, Qualitätsrichtlinien und Standards zur Arbeitssicherheit.

• Design & Corporate Identity: Verbindliche Einhaltung und Umsetzung der spezifischen Vorgaben der Roche Corporate Architecture .

• Engineering-Expertise: Fachliche Führung von komplexen Projekten an der Schnittstelle von Bau, Labor und kritischer Infrastruktur.

Wer bist du

Du denkst positiv, handelst integer und reflektierst dich und deine Arbeit mit einem klaren Blick. Kommunikation liegt dir und du willst etwas bewegen – im Team und im Projekt als Challenger, Motivator und Macher.

Um deine Rolle als erfolgreiche/r Projektleiter:in (w/m/d) bestmöglich wahrnehmen zu können, bringst du folgende Fähigkeiten mit:

• Ausbildung & Architekturfokus: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Städtebau, Architektur und Innenarchitektur.

• Berufserfahrung im Pharma-Umfeld: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von Bauprojekten, idealerweise im regulierten Umfeld wie Pharma, Life Sciences, Chemie oder Industrie.

• Projekt- & Kostencontrolling: Fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement, im Kosten- und Terminc

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’organizzazione “Location Basel / Kaiseraugst”, parte della funzione di gruppo globale “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, fornisce l’infrastruttura e i servizi per l’intera sede di Basilea e Kaiseraugst e li sviluppa continuamente in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi si può aspettare un modello organizzativo moderno in cui è possibile contribuire i vostri talenti in un lavoro significativo. Garantiamo la libertà di progettazione e di decisione nella nostra organizzazione. Un futuro più sano. E' questo che ci guida. Il nostro focus è sugli investimenti a lungo termine nella ricerca e nello sviluppo per migliorare la vita delle persone – oggi e per le generazioni future. La divisione Site Assets Project Delivery è responsabile dell'implementazione di progetti di investimento relativi a costi, tempi e qualità nelle sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst. Lavoriamo in un modello basato sul ruolo che consente attività in diversi settori di responsabilità. La tua opportunità Come direttore di progetto esperto da parte del cliente, prendo il controllo del rappresentante cliente professionale per Roche. In questo ruolo, sono responsabile della gestione olistica e del controllo di progetti di costruzione, laboratorio, infrastruttura e ingegneria impegnativi nell'ambiente farmaceutico regolamentato.
• Project Management & Initiation: condurre studi di fattibilità, nonché l'avvio e l'organizzazione di progetti strategici secondo i requisiti dei clienti, degli utenti e degli operatori.
• Procurement & Contract Management: Preparazione professionale e esame dei concetti, delle offerte e dei documenti di approvvigionamento, nonché la successiva messa in servizio e monitoraggio dei servizi.
• Controllo del progetto: Costo globale, scadenza, cambiamento e gestione del rischio per garantire il successo del progetto.
• Resource & Stakeholder Management: Efficiente coordinamento di architetti, progettisti specializzati, ingegneri e aziende che eseguono, oltre a stretto coordinamento con team interni, in parte globali.
• Compliance & Quality: Garanzia costante di tutti i requisiti normativi, linee guida e standard di qualità per la sicurezza sul lavoro.
• Design & Corporate Identity: adempimento e implementazione dei requisiti specifici di Roche Corporate Architecture.
• Competenze ingegneristiche: Gestione professionale di progetti complessi nell'interfaccia di costruzione, laboratorio e infrastrutture critiche. Chi sei Pensi positivamente, agire con integrità e riflettere te stesso e il tuo lavoro con una visione chiara. La comunicazione è tua e vuoi fare la differenza – nel team e nel progetto come sfidante, motivatore e creatore. Al fine di essere in grado di svolgere al meglio il vostro ruolo di project manager di successo:in (f/m/d), si portano le seguenti competenze:
• Formazione e attenzione all'architettura: studi completi in architettura, ingegneria civile o una disciplina comparabile, nonché una forte comprensione del design urbano, architettura e interior design.
• Esperienza professionale nell'ambiente farmaceutico: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di costruzione, idealmente in un ambiente regolamentato come farmacia, scienze della vita, chimica o industria.
• Project & Cost Controlling: conoscenza approfondita della gestione del progetto, dei costi e della terminologia

• Resource & Stakeholder Management: Efficient coordination of architects, specialist planners, engineers and executing companies as well as close coordination with internal, partly global teams.

• Design & Corporate Identity: Binding compliance and implementation of the specific requirements of Roche Corporate Architecture.

Who are you You think positively, act with integrity and reflect yourself and your work with a clear view. Communication is yours and you want to make a difference – in the team and in the project as a challenger, motivator and maker. In order to be able to best perform your role as a successful project manager:in (f/m/d), you bring the following skills:
• Training & focus on architecture: Completed studies in architecture, civil engineering or a comparable discipline as well as a strong understanding of urban design, architecture and interior design.
• Professional experience in the pharmaceutical environment: At least 5 years of experience in managing construction projects, ideally in a regulated environment such as pharma, life sciences, chemistry or industry.
• Project & Cost Controlling: In-depth knowledge in project management, cost and terminology

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data

At Roche, we believe every individual can make a difference. We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data to join our team in a role that sits at the intersection of engineering excellence and business impact. In this position, you will lead and grow high-performing data and analytics engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and business-critical solutions that support commercial decision-making across sales, marketing, pricing, and customer engagement .

The Commercial Data, Analytics and AI area supports Service, Marketing, Sales, and Commercial Operations across Roche Diagnostics’ global organization, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational excellence at scale. The area spans global, regional, and country-level teams and covers a wide range of commercial activities, including customer engagement, sales effectiveness, service performance, pricing, installed base management, and operational optimization.

Operating in a highly regulated, global environment, the Commercial Data & Analytics function partners closely with business, IT, Digital, and central Data & AI platform teams to deliver trusted data foundations, analytics, and AI-enabled insights. Solutions are designed to be scalable, compliant, and reusable across markets, while remaining flexible enough to address local needs.

By providing reliable data products, analytics capabilities, and advanced insights, the area plays a critical role in improving commercial effectiveness, service quality, and customer experience, ultimately supporting Roche Diagnostics’ mission to deliver innovative diagnostics solutions to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and develop high-performing data and analytics engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous professional growth .

• Scale engineering capabilities to support diverse Commercial use cases across Service, Marketing, Sales, and Operations through modern data modeling and transformation .

• Drive technical standards by establishing and enforcing best practices for dbt-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, and comprehensive documentation .

• Evolve data onboarding as a service to enable efficient, standardized, and scalable ingestion of new data sources while maintaining strict security and governance .

• Design robust pipelines that power advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions, ensuring all datasets are production-grade and "AI-ready" for downstream science teams .

• Collaborate with platform teams to align commercial data solutions with enterprise architecture, ensuring the reuse of platform capabilities and avoiding tool duplication .

• Manage team delivery on a day-to-day basis, translating complex commercial requirements into reliable analytics layers and high-impact insight products .

• Champion engineering craftsmanship by reviewing technical designs and guiding your team toward maintainable, cost-efficient, and scalable architectural decisions .

Who you are:

• Experienced Leader: You possess 5+ years of experience in data engineering leadership or architecture, with a proven track record of building high-performing teams .

• Industry Expert: You bring 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry to navigate complex compliance needs .

• Formally Educated: You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science or a similar f

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Team Lead Engineering Dati commerciali A Roche, crediamo che ogni individuo possa fare la differenza. Stiamo cercando un Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data per unire il nostro team in un ruolo che siede all'incrocio di eccellenza ingegneristica e impatto aziendale. In questa posizione, guiderai e cresci team di ingegneria dati e analisi altamente performanti per fornire soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e business-critical che supportano il processo decisionale commerciale attraverso vendite, marketing, prezzi e coinvolgimento dei clienti. L’area Commercial Data, Analytics e AI supporta il Servizio, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni Commerciali attraverso l’organizzazione globale di Roche Diagnostics, consentendo il processo decisionale e l’eccellenza operativa in scala. L'area abbraccia team globali, regionali e di livello nazionale e copre una vasta gamma di attività commerciali, tra cui l'impegno del cliente, l'efficacia delle vendite, le prestazioni del servizio, i prezzi, la gestione delle basi installate e l'ottimizzazione operativa. Operando in un ambiente globale altamente regolamentato, la funzione Commercial Data & Analytics collabora a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforme aziendali, IT, Digital e Central Data & AI per fornire fondazioni di dati affidabili, analisi e informazioni AI-enabled. Le soluzioni sono progettate per essere scalabili, conformi e riutilizzabili in tutti i mercati, pur rimanendo abbastanza flessibili per soddisfare le esigenze locali. Fornendo prodotti di dati affidabili, funzionalità di analisi e approfondimenti avanzati, l'area svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l'efficacia commerciale, la qualità del servizio e l'esperienza del cliente, supportando infine la missione di Roche Diagnostics di fornire soluzioni diagnostiche innovative ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. L'opportunità:
• Guidare e sviluppare team di ingegneria di dati e analisi altamente performanti, favorendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, responsabilità e crescita professionale continua.
• Capacità di ingegneria scala per supportare diversi casi di uso commerciale in Servizi, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni attraverso la modellazione e la trasformazione dei dati moderni.
• Guidare gli standard tecnici, stabilendo e rafforzando le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo basato su dbt, CI/CD, test automatizzati e documentazione completa.
• Coinvolgere i dati a bordo come servizio per consentire un'ingestione efficiente, standardizzata e scalabile di nuove fonti di dati, mantenendo al contempo una stretta sicurezza e governance.
• Progettazione di robuste condotte che alimentano soluzioni di analisi avanzate e AI/ML, assicurando che tutti i dataset siano di qualità produttiva e "AI-ready" per i team di scienza a valle.
• Collaborare con i team di piattaforma per allineare le soluzioni di dati commerciali con l'architettura aziendale, garantendo il riutilizzo delle funzionalità della piattaforma e evitando duplicazioni degli strumenti .
• Gestire la consegna del team su base giornaliera, traducendo complessi requisiti commerciali in livelli di analisi affidabili e prodotti di analisi ad alto impatto.
• Artigianato di ingegneria campione esaminando i progetti tecnici e guidando il vostro team verso decisioni architettoniche mantenuti, convenienti e scalabili. Chi sei:
• Leader esperto: Possiedi 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership dell'ingegneria dei dati o nell'architettura, con una comprovata traccia di costruzione di team di alto livello.
• Esperto del settore: Portate 2+ anni di esperienza all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata per navigare complesse esigenze di conformità.
• Formally Educated: Hai una laurea o una laurea avanzata in Informatica o un f simile

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Team Lead Engineering Handelsdaten Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Mensch einen Unterschied machen kann. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data, das unserem Team in einer Rolle beitritt, die an der Schnittstelle von Engineering Excellence und Business Impact sitzt. In dieser Position führen und wachsen Sie leistungsstarke Daten- und Analyse-Engineering-Teams, um skalierbare, zuverlässige und geschäftskritische Lösungen zu liefern, die die kommerzielle Entscheidungsfindung über Vertrieb, Marketing, Preisgestaltung und Kundenbindung unterstützen. Der Bereich Commercial Data, Analytics und AI unterstützt Service-, Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Handelsoperationen in der globalen Organisation von Roche Diagnostics und ermöglicht datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und operative Exzellenz im Maßstab. Das Gebiet umfasst globale, regionale und landesweite Teams und umfasst eine breite Palette von kommerziellen Aktivitäten, darunter Kundenengagement, Verkaufseffizienz, Serviceleistung, Preisgestaltung, installiertes Basismanagement und operative Optimierung. Die Kommerzielle Daten & Analytics-Funktion arbeitet in einem hochregulierten, globalen Umfeld eng mit den Teams Business, IT, Digital und Central Data & AI zusammen, um vertrauenswürdige Datengrundlagen, Analysen und AI-fähige Erkenntnisse zu liefern. Lösungen sind so konzipiert, dass sie skalierbar, konform und über die Märkte wiederverwendbar sind, während sie flexibel genug bleiben, um lokale Bedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Durch die Bereitstellung von zuverlässigen Datenprodukten, Analysefähigkeiten und fortschrittlichen Erkenntnissen spielt der Bereich eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Verbesserung der kommerziellen Effektivität, der Servicequalität und der Kundenerfahrung und unterstützt letztendlich die Mission von Roche Diagnostics, innovative Diagnoselösungen für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Die Gelegenheit:
• Führen und entwickeln Sie hochperformierende Daten- und Analyse-Engineering-Teams, die eine Kultur der technischen Exzellenz, Rechenschaftspflicht und kontinuierliches professionelles Wachstum fördern.
• Scale Engineering-Funktionen, um verschiedene kommerzielle Anwendungsfälle über Service, Marketing, Vertrieb und Operationen durch moderne Datenmodellierung und Transformation zu unterstützen.
• Führen Sie technische Standards, indem Sie Best Practices für dbt-basierte Entwicklung, CI/CD, automatisierte Tests und umfassende Dokumentationen festlegen und forcieren.
• Erarbeiten Sie Daten über Bording als Service, um eine effiziente, standardisierte und skalierbare Aufnahme neuer Datenquellen zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig strenge Sicherheit und Governance zu gewährleisten.
• Entwerfen Sie robuste Pipelines, die fortschrittliche Analytik und AI/ML-Lösungen betreiben und sicherstellen, dass alle Datensätze produktionsfähig und "AI-ready" für nachgelagerte Wissenschaftsteams sind.
• Mit Plattformteams zusammenarbeiten, um kommerzielle Datenlösungen mit der Unternehmensarchitektur auszurichten, um die Wiederverwendung von Plattformfunktionen zu gewährleisten und die Werkzeugvervielfältigung zu vermeiden.
• Manage Team-Lieferung auf Tagesbasis, Übersetzen komplexer kommerzieller Anforderungen in zuverlässige Analyseschichten und hocheffiziente Einsichtsprodukte.
• Champion-Engineering-Handwerk durch Überprüfung von technischen Designs und Führung Ihres Teams auf beständige, kostengünstige und skalierbare Architekturentscheidungen . Wer du bist:
• Erfahrener Führer: Sie verfügen über 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Data Engineering-Führung oder -Architektur, mit einem nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz des Aufbaus von hochperforming Teams .
• Branchenexperte: Sie bringen 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder regulierten Gesundheitswesen-Technologieindustrie, um komplexe Compliance-Anforderungen zu navigieren.
• Förmliche Ausbildung: Sie halten einen Bachelor- oder Fortgeschrittenen Abschluss in Informatik oder ähnliches f
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chef d'équipe Ingénierie Données commerciales Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque individu peut faire la différence. Nous cherchons une équipe responsable de l'ingénierie Données commerciales pour rejoindre notre équipe dans un rôle qui se situe à l'intersection de l'excellence en génie et de l'impact commercial. Dans cette position, vous dirigerez et développerez des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement pour fournir des solutions évolutives, fiables et critiques pour les affaires qui soutiennent la prise de décision commerciale à travers les ventes, le marketing, les prix et l'engagement des clients. Le secteur des données commerciales, de l'analyse et de l'intelligence artificielle soutient l'organisation mondiale des services, du marketing, des ventes et des opérations commerciales dans l'ensemble de Roche Diagnostics. La zone s'étend aux équipes mondiales, régionales et nationales et couvre un large éventail d'activités commerciales, y compris l'engagement des clients, l'efficacité des ventes, la performance des services, les prix, la gestion de base installée et l'optimisation opérationnelle. Opérant dans un environnement mondial hautement réglementé, la fonction Commercial Data & Analytics s'associe étroitement aux équipes de plateformes commerciales, informatiques, numériques et centrales de Data & AI pour fournir des bases de données fiables, des analyses et des informations adaptées à l'IA. Les solutions sont conçues pour être évolutives, conformes et réutilisables sur tous les marchés, tout en restant suffisamment souples pour répondre aux besoins locaux. En fournissant des produits de données fiables, des capacités d'analyse et des informations avancées, la région joue un rôle essentiel dans l'amélioration de l'efficacité commerciale, de la qualité du service et de l'expérience client, soutenant finalement la mission de Roche Diagnostics pour fournir des solutions diagnostiques innovantes aux patients dans le monde entier. La possibilité :
• Diriger et développer des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement, favorisant une culture d'excellence technique, de responsabilité et de croissance professionnelle continue.
• Capacités d'ingénierie à l'échelle pour soutenir divers cas d'utilisation commerciale dans les services, le marketing, les ventes et les opérations par la modélisation et la transformation de données modernes.
• Conduire les normes techniques en établissant et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques pour le développement basé sur le DBT, le CI/CD, les tests automatisés et la documentation complète.
• Evolver les données à bord en tant que service permettant une ingestion efficace, normalisée et évolutive de nouvelles sources de données tout en maintenant une sécurité et une gouvernance strictes.
• Concevoir des pipelines robustes qui alimentent l'analyse avancée et les solutions AI/ML, en veillant à ce que tous les ensembles de données soient de qualité de production et « prêts à l'AI » pour les équipes scientifiques en aval.
• Collaborer avec les équipes de plate-forme pour aligner les solutions de données commerciales sur l'architecture d'entreprise, en assurant la réutilisation des capacités de la plate-forme et en évitant la duplication des outils.
• Gérer la prestation de l'équipe au quotidien, en traduisant des exigences commerciales complexes en couches d'analyse fiables et en produits à fort impact.
• Métier d'ingénierie champion en examinant les conceptions techniques et en guidant votre équipe vers des décisions architecturales durables, rentables et évolutives. Qui vous êtes :
• Leader expérimenté : vous possédez 5 ans d'expérience dans le leadership ou l'architecture de l'ingénierie des données, avec une expérience éprouvée de la construction d'équipes performantes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous apportez 2+ ans d'expérience au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie, ou de la technologie de santé réglementée pour naviguer les besoins de conformité complexes.
• Formellement formé: vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'un diplôme avancé en informatique ou d'un diplôme similaire f

jobs.title: Produktionsexpert:in (befristet auf 18 Monate)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Abteilung Solids DP (Solida Produktion) ist Teil der Manufacturing Unit Solids am Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst. In der Solida Produktion werden verschiedene feste Arzneiformen (Filmtabletten, Kapseln, Granulat in Glasflaschen) sowie kommerzielle als auch Entwicklungsprodukte hergestellt. Hierbei handelt es sich ausschließlich um High-Potent-Produkte mit einer Batch-Size zwischen 15 KG bis 100 KG. Das Produktionsteam besteht aus ca. 45 Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Produktionsexpert:in übernimmst du im Produktionsbereich die folgenden Aufgaben:

• Herstellung von Filmtabletten, Kapsel und deren Zwischenstufen

• Abfüllung von Granulaten in Glasflaschen

• Bedienen, Rüsten und Reinigen der zugehörigen Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten

• GMP-konforme Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten am Computersystem

• Warenbewegungen von GMP-Materialien

Wer Du Bist
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung vorzugsweise im Lebensmittelbereich oder Pharmabereich

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von festen Arzneiformen (Kapsulierung, Tablettierung, Lackierung von großem Vorteil) im GMP-Bereich

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von High-Potent-Produkten (von großem Vorteil)

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit inkl. Nacht-, Samstag- und Sonntagsarbeit (5-Schicht)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bringst Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und eine hohe Eigeninitiative mit. Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Riempimento di granuli in bottiglie di vetro

• Documentazione conforme GMP del lavoro svolto sul sistema informatico
• Movimenti di materiali GMP Chi sei Per avere successo in questo ruolo emozionante, è idealmente portare i seguenti:
• Formazione professionale completa preferibilmente nel settore alimentare o farmaceutico
• Esperienza nella produzione di forme di dosaggio solido (capsulamento, tablet, laccatura di grande vantaggio) nel settore GMP
• Buone competenze informatiche
• Esperienza nella produzione di prodotti ad alta potenza (di grande vantaggio)
• Prontezza per il lavoro a turni tra cui lavoro notturno, sabato e domenica (5 turni)

• Porti affidabilità, spirito di squadra e un alto livello di iniziativa. Ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Hierbei handelt es sich ausschließlich um High-Potent-Produkte mit einer Batch-Size zwischen 15 KG bis 100 KG. Das Produktionsteam besteht aus ca. 45 Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Produktionsexpert:in übernimmst du im Produktionsbereich die folgenden Aufgaben:

• Herstellung von Filmtabletten, Kapsel und deren Zwischenstufen

• Abfüllung von Granulaten in Glasflaschen

• Bedienen, Rüsten und Reinigen der zugehörigen Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten

• GMP-konforme Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten am Computersystem

• Warenbewegungen von GMP-Materialien

Wer Du Bist
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung vorzugsweise im Lebensmittelbereich oder Pharmabereich

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von festen Arzneiformen (Kapsulierung, Tablettierung, Lackierung von großem Vorteil) im GMP-Bereich

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von High-Potent-Produkten (von großem Vorteil)

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit inkl. Nacht-, Samstag- und Sonntagsarbeit (5-Schicht)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bringst Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und eine hohe Eigeninitiative mit. Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

The Position
This position is offered in the Clinical Development team within Medical Affairs and Clinical Development.
The Clinical Development Team explores unmet medical needs and designs clinical development strategies and studies for diagnostic solutions and personalized healthcare. In your role you support the Clinical Development Leads to develop innovative diagnostic solutions in the area of Neurology and/or Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases.

The Rotkreuz site, where a wide variety of disciplines work hand in hand, is a meeting place for over 2,700 talented employees from 70 different nations. The Opportunity
Your main tasks will include:

• Supporting the team with medical/scientific expertise to help develop novel diagnostics solutions.

• Conduct comprehensive literature reviews, collation of relevant clinical and scientific information from different sources, and create new scientific content.

• Writing a wide range of medical and scientific documents.

• Collaborate with other functions as well as external experts on development programs.

• Support the team with the generation of target product profiles, and translation into analytical and clinical product requirements.

Who You are

• You are currently enrolled as a Medical student or PhD student in a health-related scientific field (e.g. neurology, cardiology, metabolic diseases, endocrinology, immunology, etc) or have recently graduated with a PhD degree in one of the fields above (within the last 12 months)

• You are interested to transfer your scientific and/or medical knowledge and your curiosity into the development of clinical diagnostic solutions have excellent communication and strong scientific writing skills

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Si prega di notare che questa requisizione è una promozione interna e un 2 y orecchio-fisso termine opportunità. L'opportunità Il reparto Audit e Compliance fornisce servizi per gli affiliati nella regione EMEA. Le nostre aree principali sono: Compliance Finanziaria, Autorizzazione SAP, Viaggi e Spese , Compliance Healthcare. In questa posizione ti concentrerai su:

• Eseguire controlli di qualità mensili sulle attività svolte dai membri del team

• Corso di laurea (preferibilmente in Finanza / Economia)
• 2+ anni di esperienza in campo rilevante (preferibilmente in qualsiasi posizione relativa alla finanza o alla conformità)
• Fluency in lingua inglese e tedesca
• Persone forti capacità di gestione
• Forte integrità mentale
• Buona gestione dei cambiamenti In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please, note that this requisition is an internal promotion and a 2 y ear-fixed term opportunity.

The opportunity

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense , Healthcare Compliance.
In this position you will focus on:

• Coordinating complete, stringent and timely T&E related tasks which are in the department's scope

• Performing monthly quality checks over tasks performed by the team members

• Regular service quality review with main stakeholders (Group and Divisions)

• Supporting team members and Roche affiliates in ad hoc T&E compliance related tasks and questions upon requests

• Recruiting and onboarding new comers , identify individual talent and execute retain plan (by identifying career development and learning opportunities)

• Coaching and developing the team members, deliver high performing team

• Collaborating with other leaders within the RSS EMEA, representatives of supported field from other RSS Operations and with regional BPMs of the supported topic

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Bachelor's degree (preferably in Finance/ Economics)

• 2+ years of experience in relevant field (preferably in any finance or compliance related position)

• Fluency in English and German language

• Strong people managing skills

• Strong compliance mindset

• Good change management

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice ( 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: People Support Solutions Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center.

We are looking for a motivated intern to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnology company offering exceptional career paths and benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding and looking for new talent to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework.

At Roche, our entry point for all employees and managers is the People Portal, and the team enabling People & Culture (P&C) work is called the People Support Team.
The People Support members act as the first point of contact for P&C-related enquiries and services for all Roche people (employees, candidates, contingents, retirees, managers, P&C colleagues, etc.) while executing Employee Lifecycle Management activities and tasks.

What you’ll do:

• Support the People Support Operations team with inquiries and administrative tasks, ensuring accurate and timely service.

• Assist with HR system data maintenance and basic reporting.

• Contribute to process documentation (SOPs, work instructions) and knowledge updates.

• Apply customer service principles while engaging with employees and stakeholders.

• Learn to monitor service quality and support compliance with KPIs, SLAs, and data privacy rules.

• Build relationships with P&C colleagues and customers to support effective service delivery.

• Contribute to achieving global consistency and high-quality service through teamwork and collaboration.

What can you bring to our team:
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. Furthermore:

• y​ou have ongoing Hungarian university studies

• y​ou are available 25 hours per week

• y​ou have a good command of Hungarian and English, and have outstanding communication skills

• you are open to learn and develop

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Vous avez une bonne maîtrise du hongrois et de l'anglais, et avez des compétences de communication exceptionnelles

• Expérience professionnelle précieuse
• Salaire compétitif
• Temps de travail flexible selon vos études
• Soutien à la rédaction de thèses universitaires
• Possibilités de formation
• Bon emplacement accessible
• Grande culture d'entreprise axée sur les gens
• Événements sociaux et opportunités de team-building
• Possibilité de jouer un rôle à plein temps après la remise des diplômes Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: International Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently.

In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Quality Strategies: Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well Good Clinical Practice (GCP),using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.

• Lead Global Audits: Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.

• Partner with Stakeholders: Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.

• Support Inspections: Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.

• Advance PDQ Processes: Participate actively in assigned departmental goals and initiatives, contributing directly to the continuous improvement of PDQ processes.

• Maintain GxP Expertise: Maintain deep awareness and expertise in global regulations (such as FDA, EU, and ICH guidance) across GCP, GVP, or Medical Device frameworks.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.

• Industry Experience: Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.

• GxP Knowledge: Strong exposure to and understanding of global GxP regulations and quality roles, specifically within GCP, GVP, or IVD/MD frameworks.

• Data & Digital Literacy: Excellent digital capabilities, with a good understanding of audit management and analytical reporting tools to drive data-led solutions.

• Critical Thinking: Proven problem-solving, decision-making, and project management skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous information.

Location

• This position is based in Welwyn

• Relocation Assistance is not available.

• #MQRS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Für die Abteilung Operations Quality Product Partnering RDI suchen wir einen hochmotivierten und engagierten Quality Partner mit Erfahrung in der Produktpflege (Product Care/ Improvements) von Medizinprodukten / IVDs.
Als Quality Partner stellen sie mit den zuständigen Produkt- und Produktions- Verantwortlichen sicher, dass die Roche Vorgaben sowie die Gesetze, Regularien und Standards (regulatory requirements of United States Food and Drug Administration, In Vitro Diagnostics Regulation of the European Union, ISO 13485, etc.) beim Designtransfer in die Produktion, der Herstellung und bei Änderungen im Zusammenhang mit unseren Medizinprodukten / IVDs eingehalten und entsprechend dokumentiert werden.

Die Möglichkeit

• Sie prüfen und genehmigen Änderungen (Change Control) im Rahmen des Herstellprozesses und der Produktpflege

• Sie prüfen und genehmigen Projekt-, Produkt-, sowie Prozessdokumente und andere für die Herstellung relevante Vorgabe- und Nachweisdokumente (Arbeitsanweisungen, Templates, Checklisten)

• Sie prüfen und genehmigen Abweichungen (Nonconformities)

• Sie stellen sicher, dass die qualitätsbezogenen Produktfreigabeaktivitäten in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich, wie z.B. die Überprüfung und Freigabe von Produkten, compliant und rechtzeitig abgeschlossen werden.

• Sie sind für die qualitätsrelevanten Aspekte bei Design oder technischen Produkttransfer Projekten in die Produktion verantwortlich um die Produktqualität, die Einhaltung der Vorgaben und die durchgängige Dokumentation sicherzustellen

• Sie helfen unsere Prozesse zu verbessern um unsere Qualität und Effizienz zu erhöhen

• Sie unterstützen Projekte oder Initiativen im Bereich Quality Management oder unseres Operations Partner und engagieren sich als Prozessberater innerhalb unseres QMS

• Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Master Data Management

Wer sie sind
Sie sind offen für neue Ideen und hinterfragen konventionelle Denkmuster. Sie schätzen es, in einer leistungsorientierten Umgebung zu arbeiten, die von gegenseitigem Respekt, Diskussion und Zusammenarbeit getragen wird. Dann ist Roche für Sie der Ausgangspunkt für ein spannendes und internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungschancen.

• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes technisches oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder über langjährige Berufserfahrung in einem technischen Bereich.

• Sie verfügen über mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Quality Management von Medizinprodukten / IVDs und deren regulatorischen Vorgaben (ISO 13485, FDA Regulation, …).

• Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in Prozess-Risikoanalysen (pFMEAs) und der gesamtheitlichen Beurteilung von Massnahmen bei Produkt- und Prozessänderungen.

• Sie verfügen über praktische Erfahrung im Umgang und Einsatz von Problemlösungs- und Verbesserungsmethoden zur Qualitäts- und Produktivitätssteigerung.

• Sie verfügen über gute und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch und können diese in einem komplexen Umfeld einbringen um Lösungen über alle Hierarchien unserer Interessengruppen zu erzielen.

• Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der Definition, Erfassung und Analyse von statistischen Daten um die Produktqualität und Prozesse zu verbessern.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Leader - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:

The Technical Leader will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team — responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. The team manages 650+ AWS accounts and enables application teams to build and operate healthcare solutions by providing secure, standardised infrastructure while maintaining development and deployment autonomy.

You will own the technical direction and architecture decisions for SAM's cloud platform. This means designing the systems that provision, secures, and governs hundreds of AWS accounts globally — and ensuring the engineering team builds them to a high standard. Your domain is the *how*: architecture, implementation quality, technical standards, and engineering growth.

What you will do:

• Own technical architecture and design decisions for SAM — landing zone design, account vending, IAM governance, and identity management (AWS Identity Center).

• Translate the Security Architect's guardrail requirements and security standards into implementable engineering work — Terraform modules, automation pipelines, and detection/remediation patterns.

• Design for platform consumers, not just infrastructure: build reusable, self-service modules and APIs that over 200+ product teams can adopt without needing to contact SAM for every change.

• Drive automation-first engineering: replace manual, ticket-driven workflows with programmatic access, IaC-managed configuration, and self-service tooling.

• Set and enforce technical standards: code review expectations, Terraform module stru

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti.
