La posizione Leader tecnico - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il portafoglio di prodotti digitali in espansione di Roche dimostra il suo impegno a fornire professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti con soluzioni digitali e digitalmente abilitate che trasformano la cura del paziente. Il portafoglio di prodotti esistente comprende sistemi di supporto decisionale, soluzioni di gestione dei dati e soluzioni di flusso di lavoro. Al centro di questi diversi tipi di soluzioni è sempre paziente sicurezza dei dati e la privacy come la massima priorità per Roche. In questo contesto, Roche ha costruito un team globale che costruisce, protegge e gestisce piattaforme infrastrutturali (cloud e on-prem) per i suoi prodotti digitali. Questo team sta lavorando con una grande libertà di operare in una configurazione auto-organizzata ed è responsabile per affrontare le sfide della sicurezza informatica, della conformità e delle infrastrutture del settore sanitario, consentendo allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta velocità. L'opportunità: Il Leader Tecnico si unirà al team Secure Account Management (SAM), responsabile dell'infrastruttura cloud, dell'erogazione di account, della sicurezza e della governance nel portafoglio prodotti digitali di Roche. Il team gestisce 650+ account AWS e consente ai team applicativi di costruire e gestire soluzioni sanitarie fornendo infrastrutture sicure e standardizzate, mantenendo allo stesso tempo l'autonomia di sviluppo e distribuzione. Possiederai le decisioni tecniche di direzione e architettura per la piattaforma cloud di SAM. Ciò significa progettare i sistemi che forniscono, assicura e governa centinaia di conti AWS a livello globale - e garantire che il team di ingegneria li costruisce ad un alto livello. Il tuo dominio è il *how*: architettura, qualità di implementazione, standard tecnici e crescita ingegneristica. Cosa farai:
• Proprio architettura tecnica e decisioni di progettazione per SAM — progettazione zona di atterraggio, vending conto, governance IAM e gestione dell'identità (AWS Identity Center).
• Traduci i requisiti di protezione dell'architetto di sicurezza e gli standard di sicurezza in un lavoro di ingegneria attuabile — moduli Terraform, condotte di automazione e modelli di rilevamento/rimediazione.
• Progettazione per i consumatori di piattaforme, non solo infrastruttura: costruire moduli e API riutilizzabili, self-service che oltre 200 team di prodotti possono adottare senza dover contattare SAM per ogni cambiamento.
• Automazione dell'azionamento-prima ingegneria: sostituire i flussi di lavoro manuali, con accesso programmatico, configurazione gestita da IaC e tooling self-service.
• Impostare e rispettare gli standard tecnici: le aspettative di revisione del codice, Terraform modulo stru

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Endpoint
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly skilled Cybersecurity Engineer responsible for protecting our digital footprint at the endpoint level. Our team manages critical security products across the enterprise, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure.
Our team consists of deep subject matter experts in cybersecurity and we are looking for a driven, technically rigorous Security Engineer to join us. Your primary mission will be to maintain and evolve our security tools, bringing a modern, automation-first development mindset to our operational security practices to ensure optimal performance.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintenance at scale: Configure, deploy, and maintain our global Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solution across thousands of endpoints (Windows, macOS, and Linux) to ensure peak performance.

• Application Control Governance: Design, implement, and fine-tune Application Control policies (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC, or third-party equivalents) to ensure only trusted executables, scripts, and libraries run within our environment, balancing security with user productivity.

• Optimization: Continuous evaluation to minimize false positives, optimize system performance, and improve the overall signal-to-noise ratio.

• Secure Data Erasure Lifecycle: Support the maintenance and auditing of our enterprise-grade secure data wiping services.

• Automation: Leverage a development mindset to build scripts, tools, and API integrations that automate repetitive engineering tasks and deployment processes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other senior cybersecurity experts, translating their deep security requirements into scalable, automated technical solutions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing EDR solutions (e.g., Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in a large-scale enterprise environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Technical Skills

• Security Foundations: Good fundamental understanding of enterprise cybersecurity, specifically around endpoint security (EDR/XDR platforms like Cortex XDR), application whitelisting, and secure data handling.

• Application Control Expertise: Strong practical experience designing, rolling out, and maintaining Application Control/Whitelisting strategies across complex organizational structures.

• OS Internals: Strong understanding of operating system architectures, processes, memory management and filesystems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to dive into complex system logs to trace issues back to their root cause.

• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on experience with configuration management and deployment tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).

• Development Best Practices: Solid understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Additional Qualifications

• The "Builder" Mentality: You look at a manual, repetitive IT task and immediately think about how to write a script to do it better and faster.

• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complex deployment failures across varied endpoint environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a high

Il nostro team gestisce prodotti di sicurezza critici in tutta l'azienda, tra cui Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control e Secure Data Erasure. Il nostro team è composto da esperti di materia profonda in sicurezza informatica e stiamo cercando un guidato, tecnicamente rigoroso Security Engineer per unirsi a noi. La vostra missione primaria sarà quella di mantenere ed evolvere i nostri strumenti di sicurezza, portando una mentalità di sviluppo moderna e automazione-prima alle nostre pratiche di sicurezza operativa per garantire prestazioni ottimali. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Manutenzione in scala: Configurare, distribuire e mantenere la nostra soluzione globale Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) su migliaia di endpoint (Windows, macOS e Linux) per garantire prestazioni di punta.
• Governance di controllo delle applicazioni: Progettazione, implementare e perfezionare le politiche di controllo delle applicazioni (ad esempio, AppLocker, WDAC, o equivalenti di terze parti) per garantire solo eseguibili, script e librerie affidabili eseguiti all'interno del nostro ambiente, bilanciando la sicurezza con la produttività degli utenti.
• Ottimizzazione: Valutazione continua per minimizzare i falsi positivi, ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e migliorare il rapporto segnale-rumore generale.
• Il ciclo di vita sicuro per la cancellazione dei dati: Supporta la manutenzione e la verifica dei nostri servizi di pulizia sicura dei dati aziendali.
• Automazione: Leva una mentalità di sviluppo per costruire script, strumenti e integrazioni API che automatizzano i compiti di ingegneria ripetitiva e i processi di distribuzione.
• Collaborazione interattiva: Partner con altri esperti di sicurezza informatica senior, traducendo i loro requisiti di sicurezza profondi in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e automatizzate. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, sicurezza informatica, o esperienza pratica equivalente.
• 3+ anni di comprovata esperienza di gestione delle soluzioni EDR (ad esempio, Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in un ambiente aziendale su larga scala.
• Competenza in inglese scritto e parlato (C1 o sopra il livello). Competenze tecniche
• Security Foundations: Buona comprensione fondamentale della sicurezza informatica aziendale, in particolare intorno alla sicurezza endpoint (piattaforme EDR/XDR come Cortex XDR), whitelisting delle applicazioni e gestione sicura dei dati.
• Competenza di controllo delle applicazioni: Forte esperienza pratica progettazione, roll out e mantenimento delle strategie di controllo delle applicazioni / whitelisting attraverso strutture organizzative complesse.
• OS Interni: Forte comprensione delle architetture del sistema operativo, processi, gestione della memoria e filesystem (Windows, Linux, macOS).
• Mindset analitico: eccellenti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi con la capacità di immergersi in registri di sistema complessi per tracciare i problemi alla loro causa principale.
• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on esperienza con la gestione della configurazione e strumenti di distribuzione (ad esempio, Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).
• Migliori pratiche di sviluppo: comprensione solida dei cicli di vita di sviluppo del software (SDLC), controllo della versione (Git), e pipeline CI/CD (ad esempio, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Ulteriori qualifiche
• La Mentalità "Builder": si guarda a un compito IT manuale e ripetitivo e pensare immediatamente a come scrivere uno script per farlo meglio e più velocemente.
• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complessi guasti di distribuzione in diversi ambienti endpoint.
• Adattabile: Comodo lavoro in alto

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:
The Technical Product Owner will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team - responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. The team manages 650+ AWS accounts and enables application teams to build and operate healthcare solutions by providing secure, standardized infrastructure while maintaining development and deployment autonomy.
This role sits at the intersection of product thinking and cloud engineering. You will own the product roadmap and backlog for SAM's cloud and services portfolio, translating the needs of digital health product teams into a platform that is secure, self-service, and well-documented. The platform delivers compliant AWS landing zones integrated with a modern cybersecurity backbone, providing guardrails for hosted applications across AWS regions worldwide - and is evolving toward supporting external partners and third-party consumers.

What you will do:

• Own, prioritise, and communicate the product roadmap for SAM's cloud landing zone and associated services - balancing security, compliance, developer experience, and self-service.

• Act as the voice of platform customers (internal product teams and, increasingly, external partners): gather feedback, represent the platform in PI planning sessions, and maintain transparency on request lifecycle and prioritisation decisions.

• Drive platform evolution toward self-service and automation - reducing manual ticket-based workflows in favour of programmatic access, Infrastructure-as-Code, and API-first interfaces.

• Ow

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il portafoglio di prodotti digitali in espansione di Roche dimostra il suo impegno a fornire professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti con soluzioni digitali e digitalmente abilitate che trasformano la cura del paziente. Il portafoglio di prodotti esistente comprende sistemi di supporto decisionale, soluzioni di gestione dei dati e soluzioni di flusso di lavoro. Al centro di questi diversi tipi di soluzioni è sempre paziente sicurezza dei dati e la privacy come la massima priorità per Roche. In questo contesto, Roche ha costruito un team globale che costruisce, protegge e gestisce piattaforme infrastrutturali (cloud e on-prem) per i suoi prodotti digitali. Questo team sta lavorando con una grande libertà di operare in una configurazione auto-organizzata ed è responsabile per affrontare le sfide della sicurezza informatica, della conformità e delle infrastrutture del settore sanitario, consentendo allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta velocità. L'opportunità: Il Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico si unirà al team Secure Account Management (SAM) - responsabile dell'infrastruttura cloud, dell'erogazione di account, della sicurezza e della governance nel portafoglio prodotti digitali di Roche. Il team gestisce 650+ account AWS e consente ai team applicativi di costruire e gestire soluzioni sanitarie fornendo infrastrutture sicure e standardizzate mantenendo allo stesso tempo l'autonomia di sviluppo e distribuzione. Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra pensiero del prodotto e ingegneria cloud. Avrete la roadmap del prodotto e il backlog per il portafoglio cloud e servizi di SAM, traducendo le esigenze dei team di prodotti per la salute digitale in una piattaforma sicura, self-service e ben documentata. La piattaforma offre zone di atterraggio AWS conformi integrate con una moderna spina dorsale di sicurezza informatica, fornendo guardrails per le applicazioni ospitate in tutte le regioni di AWS in tutto il mondo - e si sta evolvendo verso il supporto di partner esterni e consumatori di terze parti. Cosa farai:
• Possedere, dare priorità e comunicare la roadmap del prodotto per la zona di atterraggio cloud di SAM e i servizi associati - bilanciamento della sicurezza, conformità, esperienza dello sviluppatore e self-service.
• Agire come voce dei clienti della piattaforma ( team di prodotti interni e, sempre più, partner esterni): raccogliere feedback, rappresentare la piattaforma nelle sessioni di pianificazione PI, e mantenere la trasparenza su richiesta ciclo di vita e decisioni di priorità.
• Evoluzione della piattaforma di trasmissione verso self-service e automazione - riduzione dei flussi di lavoro manuali basati sui biglietti a favore di accessi programmatici, interfacce Infrastructure-as-Code e API-first.
• Ah!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Technical Product Owner - Digitale Gesundheitsplattform, Secure Cloud Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Roches wachsendes digitales Produktportfolio zeigt sein Engagement, Gesundheitsexperten, Labors und Patienten digitale und digital nutzbare Lösungen zur Verfügung zu stellen, die die Patientenversorgung verändern. Das bestehende Produktportfolio umfasst Entscheidungshilfesysteme, Datenmanagementlösungen und Workflow-Lösungen. Im Mittelpunkt dieser vielfältigen Lösungen steht immer die Sicherheit und Privatsphäre der Patientendaten als oberste Priorität für Roche. In diesem Zusammenhang hat Roche ein globales Team aufgebaut, das Infrastrukturplattformen (Cloud und On-Prem) für seine digitalen Produkte baut, sichert und betreibt. Dieses Team arbeitet mit hoher Freiheit in einem selbstorganisierten Setup und ist verantwortlich für die Bewältigung der Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Cybersicherheit, Compliance und Infrastruktur im Gesundheitswesen und ermöglicht gleichzeitig die Entwicklung von Hochgeschwindigkeitsprodukten. Die Gelegenheit: Der Technical Product Owner wird Teil des Teams für Secure Account Management (SAM), das für Cloud-Infrastruktur, Kontobereitstellung, Sicherheit und Governance im gesamten digitalen Produktportfolio von Roche verantwortlich ist. Das Team verwaltet über 650 AWS-Konten und ermöglicht es Anwendungsteams, Gesundheitslösungen zu erstellen und zu betreiben, indem es eine sichere, standardisierte Infrastruktur bereitstellt und gleichzeitig die Entwicklungs- und Bereitstellungsautonomie beibehält. Diese Rolle liegt an der Schnittstelle von Product Thinking und Cloud Engineering. Sie besitzen die Produkt-Roadmap und den Backlog für das Cloud- und Serviceportfolio von SAM und übersetzen die Bedürfnisse von Digital-Health-Produktteams in eine Plattform, die sicher, eigenständig und gut dokumentiert ist. Die Plattform bietet konforme AWS-Landezonen, die mit einem modernen Cybersicherheits-Backbone integriert sind und Leitplanken für gehostete Anwendungen in allen AWS-Regionen weltweit bieten - und entwickelt sich zur Unterstützung externer Partner und Drittverbraucher. Was Sie tun werden:
• Besitzen, priorisieren und kommunizieren Sie die Produkt-Roadmap für die Cloud-Landezone von SAM und die damit verbundenen Dienste - Balance-Sicherheit, Compliance, Entwicklererfahrung und Self-Service.
• Handeln Sie als Stimme der Plattformkunden (interne Produktteams und zunehmend auch externe Partner): sammeln Sie Feedback, vertreten Sie die Plattform in PI-Planungssitzungen und sorgen Sie für Transparenz bei Lifecycle- und Priorisierungsentscheidungen.
• Plattformentwicklung hin zu Self-Service und Automatisierung - Reduzierung manueller ticketbasierter Workflows zugunsten von programmatischem Zugriff, Infrastructure-as-Code und API-First-Schnittstellen.
• Eule
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Propriétaire de produits techniques - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'expansion du portefeuille de produits numériques de Roches démontre son engagement à fournir aux professionnels de la santé, aux laboratoires et aux patients des solutions numériques et numériques qui transforment les soins aux patients. Le portefeuille de produits existant comprend des systèmes de soutien à la décision, des solutions de gestion des données et des solutions de workflow. Au centre de ces différents types de solutions est toujours la sécurité des données des patients et la confidentialité comme la plus haute priorité pour Roche. Dans ce contexte, Roche a construit une équipe mondiale qui construit, sécurise et exploite des plateformes d'infrastructure (cloud et on-prem) pour ses produits numériques. Cette équipe travaille avec une grande liberté pour fonctionner dans une configuration auto-organisée et est chargée de relever les défis de cybersécurité, de conformité et d'infrastructure du secteur des soins de santé tout en permettant le développement de produits à grande vitesse. L'occasion : Le propriétaire du produit technique se joindra à l'équipe de Secure Account Management (SAM) - responsable de l'infrastructure cloud, de la fourniture de compte, de la sécurité et de la gouvernance dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits numériques de Roche. L'équipe gère plus de 650 comptes AWS et permet aux équipes d'application de construire et d'exploiter des solutions de santé en fournissant une infrastructure sécurisée et normalisée tout en maintenant l'autonomie de développement et de déploiement. Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection de la pensée des produits et de l'ingénierie du cloud. Vous serez propriétaire de la feuille de route des produits et de l'arriéré du portefeuille cloud et services de SAM, traduisant les besoins des équipes de produits de santé numériques en une plateforme sécurisée, en libre-service et bien documentée. La plate-forme offre des zones d'atterrissage AWS conformes intégrées à un épine dorsale de cybersécurité moderne, fournissant des garde-corps pour les applications hébergées dans les régions AWS du monde entier - et évolue vers le soutien de partenaires externes et de consommateurs tiers. Ce que vous ferez :
• Propre, prioriser et communiquer la feuille de route du produit pour la zone d'atterrissage en nuage de SAM et les services associés - équilibrer la sécurité, la conformité, l'expérience du développeur et le libre-service.
• Agir en tant que voix des clients de la plateforme (équipes de produits internes et, de plus en plus, partenaires externes) : recueillir des commentaires, représenter la plateforme dans les sessions de planification de l'IP, et maintenir la transparence sur les décisions relatives au cycle de vie des demandes et aux priorités.
• Conduire l'évolution de la plate-forme vers le libre-service et l'automatisation - réduire les workflows manuels basés sur les tickets en faveur de l'accès programmatique, Infrastructure-as-Code, et API-first interfaces.
• Attendu

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect in Roche Digital Technologies (RDT) - Biometrics and Clinical Evidence focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the complex clinical trial and real world data acquisition domain, working across multiple systems in the end-to-end ecosystem. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the architectural vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies including the rapidly growing Agentic AI and ML technologies to accelerate innovation and maximize the impact to the business.

Your Responsibilities

• Jointly develop the IT Product roadmap together with the engineering teams and product heads and advise on technology choices

• Design solutions that meet system requirements, business priorities, and fit within the overall CRF & RWD Data Acquisition ecosystem. Accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture design.

• Ensure compliance and alignment with the Roche enterprise standards, principles and policies

• Assess functional & non-functional requirements and technical enablers together with Business Analysts and the technical team to develop architecture-runway and key design decisions

• Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle

• Work closely with the development teams to resolve technical challenges during system development and support

• Continually explore, research and pilot emerging technologies and propose adoption as appropriate

• Identify cost-savings opportunities and optimize IT investments

• Mitigate security and compliance risks from technical debt and obsolescence

• Propose and lead proof of concepts (PoC) to assess technical viability together with the Tech team

• Work with RDT adopting the use of AI and ML solutions in both developing and managing data pipelines.

• Actively participate & collaborate with solution, information, and enterprise architects within the engineering team and across products

Who You Are

• You built 7+ years of work experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Lead, of which at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry. Knowledge of Pharma Regulations (GxP, Computer Validation) experience preferred

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

• Experience in the Pharma/Biotech domain, especially Clinical Trial Data Systems, such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Non-CRF data systems, digital health technologies, and clinical data warehouses

• Experience with ETLs/ELTs, data warehouses/lake/lakehouses, enterprise data integration patterns, relational and object databases, and experience with AWS or other cloud technologies

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products

• Ability

The Position
The Solution Architect in Roche Digital Technologies (RDT) - Biometrics and Clinical Evidence focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the complex clinical trial and real world data acquisition domain, working across multiple systems in the end-to-end ecosystem. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the architectural vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies including the rapidly growing Agentic AI and ML technologies to accelerate innovation and maximize the impact to the business.

Your Responsibilities

• Jointly develop the IT Product roadmap together with the engineering teams and product heads and advise on technology choices

• Design solutions that meet system requirements, business priorities, and fit within the overall CRF & RWD Data Acquisition ecosystem. Accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture design.

• Ensure compliance and alignment with the Roche enterprise standards, principles and policies

• Assess functional & non-functional requirements and technical enablers together with Business Analysts and the technical team to develop architecture-runway and key design decisions

• Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle

• Work closely with the development teams to resolve technical challenges during system development and support

• Continually explore, research and pilot emerging technologies and propose adoption as appropriate

• Identify cost-savings opportunities and optimize IT investments

• Mitigate security and compliance risks from technical debt and obsolescence

• Propose and lead proof of concepts (PoC) to assess technical viability together with the Tech team

• Work with RDT adopting the use of AI and ML solutions in both developing and managing data pipelines.

• Actively participate & collaborate with solution, information, and enterprise architects within the engineering team and across products

Who You Are

• You built 7+ years of work experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Lead, of which at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry. Knowledge of Pharma Regulations (GxP, Computer Validation) experience preferred

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

• Experience in the Pharma/Biotech domain, especially Clinical Trial Data Systems, such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Non-CRF data systems, digital health technologies, and clinical data warehouses

• Experience with ETLs/ELTs, data warehouses/lake/lakehouses, enterprise data integration patterns, relational and object databases, and experience with AWS or other cloud technologies

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products

• Ability

jobs.title: Supply Chain Partner (18 months contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Supply Chain Partner at Roche Diagnostics, you will join our dynamic Supply Chain team, a key pillar within the Finance and Operations Chapter . In this role, you will report directly to the Supply Chain Team Lead.

You will be part of a high-performing, collaborative team of five dedicated colleagues who take immense pride in delivering world-class customer care. We operate in a modern, agile environment, leveraging cutting-edge digital solutions and a steadfast commitment to sustainability to support our internal and external partners. Our team moves seamlessly between local execution and global collaboration, maintaining a particularly close and strategic partnership with our Nordic counterparts.

The Opportunity

• Master order-to-cash execution within a complex SAP landscape, maximizing the adoption and quality of our digital ordering portfolio (Webshop, eOrder, and Inventory Ordering).

• Drive improvement initiatives and foster cross-functional collaboration , taking full accountability for end-to-end delivery.

• Deliver exceptional supply chain support by swiftly fulfilling customer needs.

• Optimize inventory management by rigorously applying FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles to minimize waste and ensure reliable product supply.

• Maintain and govern critical customer and material master data to ensure system accuracy.

• Synthesize data to prepare high-impact reports and actionable insights for both internal and external stakeholders.

• Proactively monitor system dataflows incl. IDOC handling , troubleshooting anomalies to maintain operational continuity.

• Orchestrate logistics and transportation frameworks.

Who You Are

• SAP Specialist : You bring solid experience with SAP—ideally SAP S/4HANA —coupled with a deep, functional understanding of its ecosystem.

• Industry Insider : You possess a proven track record in supply chain or logistics, preferably within the highly regulated pharmaceutical or diagnostics sectors.

• Tech-Savvy Analyst : You back up your logistics expertise with robust IT literacy, combining advanced Excel proficiency with a natural talent for data-driven, analytical thinking.

• Bilingual Communicator : You possess exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English , allowing you to collaborate seamlessly with diverse stakeholders.

• Proactive Driver : You are a self-starter by nature—characterized by a resilient, goal-oriented mindset and a passion for moving projects forward.

Your application

We make your life easier: Please upload only your current compelling CV in English.
For questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Simone Däubler-Jensen, Supply Chain Team Lead, at +45 27375452 .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Communicatore bilingue: Possiedi eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali sia in danese che in inglese, permettendoti di collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con diversi stakeholder.
• Driver attivo: sei un auto-starter per natura, caratterizzato da una mentalità resiliente e orientata agli obiettivi e da una passione per i progetti in avanti. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Test Manager is the strategic architect and operational guardian of the ASPIRE Test Methodology. You are tasked with identifying operational "white space" and engineering new processes to fill those gaps. You will ensure the testing organization is compliant with Computer System Validation (CSV) and Quality standards while driving continuous evolution. As the primary defender of processes during audits and the lead architect for system upgrades, you balance regulatory rigor with operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance for high-impact and/or complex quality assurance projects. Develops and implements Quality Engineering best practices across multiple initiatives, ensuring consistency, test traceability, and alignment with enterprise standards. Leads quality analysis efforts on significant projects, provides guidance to less experienced Quality Engineers, and contributes to strategic initiatives. Provides oversight, advisory, and quality assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring testing purpose and scope alignment, test cohesion, traceability, and ultimate product value.

• Custodianship: Own the master version of the ASPIRE Test Methodology.

• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure every process update is "pre-validated" by aligning with CSV and Quality teams before rollout.

• Content Creation: Author high-quality technical documentation, including SOPs, Work Instructions, and User Guides.

Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex and strategic software quality problems, defining the quality assurance scope and driving comprehensive root cause analysis for critical defects that may span organizational boundaries. Elicits and analyzes complex stakeholder quality needs with expertise, influencing business stakeholders to inform and make the right decisions regarding product quality and release readiness. Defines strategic testing solution scope, manages complexity, and drives consensus on quality standards and release criteria through persuasive communication. Recommends optimal quality assurance technologies and tools for business transformation, providing highly innovative solutions to unusually complex quality challenges.

• Milestone Management: Take full accountability for ensuring all test phases (e.g., SAT, UAT, RT) start on time according to the global release calendar.

• Progress Monitoring: Track real-time testing metrics, defect burn-

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. L'ERP Test Manager è l'architetto strategico e il custode operativo della metodologia di test ASPIRE. Hai il compito di identificare gli "spazi bianchi" operativi e progettare nuovi processi per colmare tali lacune. Ti assicurerai che l'organizzazione di test sia conforme agli standard di convalida del sistema informatico (CSV) e di qualità, guidando al tempo stesso l'evoluzione continua. In qualità di difensore principale dei processi durante gli audit e di architetto principale per gli aggiornamenti di sistema, riesci a bilanciare il rigore normativo con l'efficienza operativa. Ambito delle responsabilità / (Leadership dei contenuti): fornisce leadership di livello esperto e guida strategica per progetti di garanzia della qualità ad alto impatto e/o complessi. Sviluppa e implementa le migliori pratiche di ingegneria della qualità in molteplici iniziative, garantendo coerenza, tracciabilità dei test e allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Dirige le attività di analisi della qualità su progetti significativi, fornisce indicazioni agli ingegneri della qualità meno esperti e contribuisce a iniziative strategiche. Fornisce supervisione, consulenza e garanzia della qualità in tutte le iniziative strategiche, garantendo l'allineamento dello scopo e dell'ambito dei test, la coesione dei test, la tracciabilità e il valore finale del prodotto.
• Custodianship: possedere la versione master della metodologia di test ASPIRE.
• Allineamento normativo: garantire che ogni aggiornamento del processo sia "pre-convalidato" allineandosi con i team CSV e Qualità prima dell'implementazione.
• Creazione di contenuti: creazione di documentazione tecnica di alta qualità, comprese SOP, istruzioni di lavoro e guide per l'utente. Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi: guida l'analisi di problemi complessi e strategici di qualità del software, definendo l'ambito di garanzia della qualità e conducendo un'analisi completa delle cause alla radice dei difetti critici che possono oltrepassare i confini dell'organizzazione. Sollecita e analizza le complesse esigenze di qualità delle parti interessate con competenza, influenzando le parti interessate aziendali a informare e prendere le giuste decisioni in merito alla qualità del prodotto e alla disponibilità del rilascio. Definisce l'ambito della soluzione di test strategico, gestisce la complessità e guida il consenso sugli standard di qualità e sui criteri di rilascio attraverso una comunicazione persuasiva. Raccomanda tecnologie e strumenti ottimali di garanzia della qualità per la trasformazione aziendale, fornendo soluzioni altamente innovative a sfide di qualità insolitamente complesse.
• Gestione delle tappe fondamentali: assumersi la piena responsabilità di garantire che tutte le fasi di test (ad esempio SAT, UAT, RT) inizino in tempo secondo il calendario di rilascio globale.
• Monitoraggio dei progressi: traccia in tempo reale i parametri di test e l'eliminazione dei difetti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE) bei Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Der ERP-Testmanager ist der strategische Architekt und operative Hüter der ASPIRE-Testmethodik. Ihre Aufgabe ist es, betriebliche „Leerräume“ zu identifizieren und neue Prozesse zu entwickeln, um diese Lücken zu schließen. Sie stellen sicher, dass die Testorganisation den Computersystemvalidierungs- (CSV) und Qualitätsstandards entspricht und treiben gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung voran. Als Hauptverteidiger der Prozesse bei Audits und leitender Architekt für Systemaktualisierungen sorgen Sie für ein Gleichgewicht zwischen regulatorischer Strenge und betrieblicher Effizienz. Aufgabenbereich / (Content Leadership): Bietet Führung auf Expertenebene und strategische Anleitung für wirkungsvolle und/oder komplexe Qualitätssicherungsprojekte. Entwickelt und implementiert Best Practices für die Qualitätstechnik über mehrere Initiativen hinweg und stellt so Konsistenz, Testrückverfolgbarkeit und Ausrichtung an Unternehmensstandards sicher. Leitet Qualitätsanalysebemühungen bei bedeutenden Projekten, gibt weniger erfahrenen Qualitätsingenieuren Anleitung und trägt zu strategischen Initiativen bei. Bietet Aufsicht, Beratung und Qualitätssicherung bei strategischen Initiativen und stellt die Ausrichtung von Testzweck und -umfang, Testkohäsion, Rückverfolgbarkeit und den ultimativen Produktwert sicher.
• Verwahrung: Besitzen Sie die Masterversion der ASPIRE-Testmethodik.
• Regulierungsabstimmung: Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Prozessaktualisierung vorab validiert wird, indem Sie sie vor der Einführung mit den CSV- und Qualitätsteams abstimmen.
• Inhaltserstellung: Verfassen Sie hochwertige technische Dokumentation, einschließlich SOPs, Arbeitsanweisungen und Benutzerhandbücher. Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse komplexer und strategischer Softwarequalitätsprobleme, definiert den Umfang der Qualitätssicherung und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse für kritische Fehler durch, die sich über Organisationsgrenzen erstrecken können. Ermittelt und analysiert komplexe Qualitätsanforderungen von Stakeholdern mit Fachwissen und beeinflusst die Stakeholder des Unternehmens, um sie zu informieren und die richtigen Entscheidungen hinsichtlich Produktqualität und Release-Bereitschaft zu treffen. Definiert den Umfang der strategischen Testlösung, verwaltet die Komplexität und sorgt durch überzeugende Kommunikation für einen Konsens über Qualitätsstandards und Freigabekriterien. Empfiehlt optimale Qualitätssicherungstechnologien und -tools für die Geschäftstransformation und bietet hochinnovative Lösungen für ungewöhnlich komplexe Qualitätsherausforderungen.
• Meilensteinmanagement: Übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung dafür, dass alle Testphasen (z. B. SAT, UAT, RT) pünktlich gemäß dem globalen Release-Kalender beginnen.
• Fortschrittsüberwachung: Verfolgen Sie Testmetriken und Fehlerverbrennungen in Echtzeit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst or IT Quality professional looking for a creative, challenging environment? We are seeking an individual to join our team in South San Francisco to help deliver cost-effective, sustainable, and compliant business solutions.

Your Responsibilities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and UX Designers, to define scope, solutions, constraints, and project risks.

• Manage compliance documentation processes and systems, characterizing business solutions for compliance with internal and external regulations.

• Be accountable for the creation and maintenance of:

• System Risk Assessments and Data Classification Reports.

• User Requirements and Functional/Technical Specifications.

• Validation Plans, Reports, and Registries.

• Requirements Traceability Matrices, Test Plans, and Test Reports.

• Data/Process flow diagrams and training documentation.

• Configure system settings and provide consultation to customers regarding solution enhancements and new implementations.

• Facilitate UAT planning and execution.

• Serve as a trusted partner for Global Privacy, IT Security, and Business Quality teams, maintaining expert-level knowledge of governance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485).

• Drive the resolution of business or systems issues throughout the project lifecycle.

• Enhance the creation and maintenance of compliance documentation (e.g., System Risk Assessments, Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices) by leveraging AI-driven automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining compliance rigor.

• Implement AI-assisted quality control tools to automate data validation, anomaly detection, and cross-platform consistency checks, ensuring sustained data integrity and adherence to GxP/CSV standards at scale.

• Utilize AI-powered analytical tools to monitor platform performance, proactively identify process bottlenecks, and generate audit-ready compliance metrics.

• Guide the strategic deployment of AI agents within the IT Quality landscape, ensuring that AI-assisted workflows remain compliant by design and effectively support business requirements.

Who You Are

• You hold a BA/BS degree in life science, informatics, business, or equivalent (MA/MS or post-graduate coursework is a plus)

• You built 6 to 8 years of related experience in an IT business systems analyst or IT quality assurance role

• You built advanced domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, manufacturing/quality assurance processes, and computer systems validation (CSV).

• Proven understanding of application development methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), including functional requirements, process modeling, and large-scale system implementations.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

Your Opportunity to Shine:

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

At Roche, y

We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

At Roche, y

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

Als Facharbeiter (m/w/d) Abfüllung/Opt. Kontrolle - befristet 2 Jahre bist Du für die maschinelle Abfüllung, und optische Kontrolle von sterilen Lösungen in Spritzen verantwortlich. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich:

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und optischen Kontrollanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Zudem unterstützt Du sowohl bei der Bedienung der Flaschenaufgabe als auch bei Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- Wartungs- und Reparaturarbeiten

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du Dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit:
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die täglichen Herausforderungen Deiner Kolleg*innen und schaffst ein Klima der gegenseitigen Unterstützung. Du stellst Fragen, um zu verstehen, sprichst kontroverse Themen offen und ehrlich an. Darüber hinaus motivierst Du alle mit Deiner Can-Do-Einstellung. In diesem Sinne treibst Du eine neue Denkweise und Mindset voran, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in Wertströmen benötigt.

Als Facharbeiter (m/w/d) Abfüllung/Opt. Kontrolle verfügst Du über eine Ausbildung als Chemikant/Pharmakant/PTA (m/w/d) . Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion zeichnet Dich aus.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The opportunity:
As a German-speaking Template Manager (P&C Document Management Solution),​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful organization and you are responsible for supporting the document generation process within Global P&C Document Management Solution, especially for creating document templates in Workday using Kainos Extend.

Your main tasks will include (but not limited to):

• Creating and maintaining document templates in Global P&C Document Management Solution according to guidelines and guidance from Template Requesters

• Supporting the implementation of template automations in other P&C systems (e. g. ServiceNow, Workday)

• Consulting with Template Requesters regarding possible options for template creation

• Supporting the testing activities for document generation.

• Ensuring document delivery from the personal files upon request

• Providing professional customer service, developing key stakeholder relationships and advising partners on the adoption of new ways of working.

• Demonstrating process knowledge to ensure compliance by updating documentation (SWIs, SOPs, GWIs) and strictly adhering to legal and data protection regulations.

Who you are:
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Strong & precise work-ethic, good analytical skills, ability to deal with Excel tables and ability to focus on details and numbers

• A tech savvy vein, analytical thinking, strong knowledge of MS Office and G Suite applications

• Experience with Java or Visual Basic, basic knowledge of HTML (would be a plus)

• Experience in service delivery or customer care environment

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency : Provide structural project management to maintain project standards, ensuring clear, transparent, and connected tracking of the product's initiative portfolio for leadership visibility.

• Performance Reporting : Establish and drive consistent project KPI tracking and status reporting across the specific product area to ensure schedule and budget adherence across all parallel initiatives.

• Project Management capability development : Serve as a subject matter expert, providing project management delivery coaching to the product teams to embed "one way of project delivery" across the organization.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities , service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of project management experience; a background in bu

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) intende "trasformare il modo in cui opera Roche". Come organizzazione globale di oltre 3.500 colleghi, possiamo consentire a Roche di operare in un ambiente di business competitivo e in continua evoluzione.
