Abbracciando una mentalità OneRoche, facciamo leva sulla nostra rete globale situata a Budapest (Ungheria), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), e i nostri altri siti per rimanere clienti-centric 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e co-creare soluzioni insieme. L'opportunità Come Project Manager sarete parte dell'organizzazione di gestione del progetto RSS e riferire al capo Piombo per la gestione dei progetti. Sei un appassionato di project management e vuoi fornire i migliori servizi di gestione dei progetti di classe ai partner di Roche? Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per la consegna del progetto di successo utilizzando una metodologia di gestione agile o tradizionale del progetto. Potrai lavorare con i team di soluzioni per Marketing Technologies che sono incaricati di fornire una trasformazione strategica, supportando e evolvendo le operazioni di soluzione in corso. • Project Management & Coordination: Coordinare l'esecuzione giornaliera del progetto in tutta l'area della soluzione facilitando cerimonie (scrums, pianificazione sprint), mantenendo i backlog del prodotto e gestendo attivamente i registri delle azioni e delle decisioni.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Atto come punto di contatto principale del progetto per catturare, strutturare e imbuto volumi pesanti di richieste cross-program, assicurando che i team di prodotto mantengano sufficiente attenzione sugli obiettivi prioritari.
• Coordinamento cross-Program: Coordinamento con altri programmi e richieste funzionali in arrivo. Pianificare, tracciare e facilitare iniziative complesse e multi-stakeholder, garantendo un'integrazione e un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità con tempi strategici overarching.
• Gestione delle dipendenze e delle interfacce: gestione attiva e monitoraggio delle dipendenze end-to-end - sia interne che esterne - mentre raffinazione delle interfacce di handover tra i proprietari dei prodotti e altre funzioni.
• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency: Fornire la gestione dei progetti strutturali per mantenere gli standard di progetto, assicurando un monitoraggio chiaro, trasparente e connesso del portafoglio di iniziative del prodotto per la visibilità della leadership.
• Performance Reporting: Stabilire e guidare il monitoraggio costante del progetto KPI e la segnalazione dello stato attraverso l'area specifica del prodotto per garantire la pianificazione e l'aderenza del budget in tutte le iniziative parallele.
• Sviluppo delle capacità di gestione del progetto: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire la consegna di project management ai team di prodotti per incorporare "un modo di consegna del progetto" in tutta l'organizzazione. Capability Building Essere un membro attivo del Capitolo Project Management
• Migliorare costantemente le capacità di gestione del progetto, le offerte di servizio e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi del capitolo Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto; uno sfondo in bu

jobs.title: Project Change Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
主要工作目标（岗位简介）

• 引领神经科学 (NS) 大型会议及活动的卓越规划、高效执行与闭环落实

• 主导神经科学团队的财务精细化管控与预算预警，确保资源投放有效

• 落实合规运营，全面管控团队合规风险，并持续优化复杂的内部业务流程

主要职责 / 责任
主导 (Lead)

• 卓越会议统筹 ：全面主导神经科学年会 (Cycle Meeting)、年中会 (Annual Meeting)、季度业务回顾 (QBP)、团队管理会及高规格全球团队访华的端到端后勤统筹；确保关键会议的待办事项追踪闭环，推动团队战略优先事项的高效执行

• 财务精细化管控 ：全面管理 OPEX 费用预算规划；整体把控各团队的费用使用节奏，确保资源的最优分配

• 核心业务流程优化 ：深度优化并切实解决业务实操中的流程痛点

• 团队文化与文化传播 ：通过将“长期主义”和正能量文化融入日常运营细节，提升员工凝聚力与敬业度，在内部平台积极树立并传播神经科学的品牌形象

• 全面合规风控管理 ：紧跟公司合规政策，督促全员 100% 按时完成合规培训；确保所有行政与财务报销流程严格遵循罗氏行为准则，实现“零违规运营”。

支持 (Support)

• 核心人才发展支持 ：跨职能高效协同，为部门核心高潜力人才发展项目提供教务支持及行政闭环

• 高效日程管理 ：高效管理治疗领域负责人 (FH) 的日常行程与内外连接，负责日常报销及团队的其他行政事务

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
主要工作目标（岗位简介）

• 引领神经科学 (NS) 大型会议及活动的卓越规划、高效执行与闭环落实

• 主导神经科学团队的财务精细化管控与预算预警，确保资源投放有效

• 落实合规运营，全面管控团队合规风险，并持续优化复杂的内部业务流程

主要职责 / 责任
主导 (Lead)

• 卓越会议统筹 ：全面主导神经科学年会 (Cycle Meeting)、年中会 (Annual Meeting)、季度业务回顾 (QBP)、团队管理会及高规格全球团队访华的端到端后勤统筹；确保关键会议的待办事项追踪闭环，推动团队战略优先事项的高效执行

• 财务精细化管控 ：全面管理 OPEX 费用预算规划；整体把控各团队的费用使用节奏，确保资源的最优分配

• 核心业务流程优化 ：深度优化并切实解决业务实操中的流程痛点

• 团队文化与文化传播 ：通过将“长期主义”和正能量文化融入日常运营细节，提升员工凝聚力与敬业度，在内部平台积极树立并传播神经科学的品牌形象

• 全面合规风控管理 ：紧跟公司合规政策，督促全员 100% 按时完成合规培训；确保所有行政与财务报销流程严格遵循罗氏行为准则，实现“零违规运营”。

支持 (Support)

• 核心人才发展支持 ：跨职能高效协同，为部门核心高潜力人才发展项目提供教务支持及行政闭环

• 高效日程管理 ：高效管理治疗领域负责人 (FH) 的日常行程与内外连接，负责日常报销及团队的其他行政事务

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare capabilities across the Middle East? As our Commercial Capability Development Lead, you will combine strategic vision with operational excellence to establish and scale core commercialization capabilities. Initially operating as a standalone expert with the opportunity to build a team in the future, you will empower our commercial, access, regulatory, and medical teams to deliver life-changing innovations to patients.

Your Responsibilities

• Drive Capability Strategy: Conduct functional and cross-functional capability assessments to design strategic learning journeys and build regional capability heat maps.

• Lead Regional Transformation: Guide and support regional change initiatives and organizational development projects aligned with broader healthcare business goals.

• Design & Deliver Impactful Learning: Conceptualize and moderate highly engaging workshops and training programs (both in-person and virtual) covering scientific, commercial, and behavioral topics.

• Collaborate Globally & Locally: Partner closely with internal departments and external stakeholders to represent regional development needs and scale existing training across the organization.

• Build Future Teams: Identify future skill requirements, align regional budgets, and lay the foundational groundwork to recruit, onboard, and coach your future team.

Who You Are
You are an entrepreneurial thinker and a collaborative leader who excels at translating operational gaps into structured, modern learning experiences within complex environments.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Background & Domain Expertise: A degree in Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, Economics, or equivalent practical experience in operational effectiveness and adult learning.

• Learning & Development Mastery: Proven experience designing curriculums, leveraging blended learning platforms, and applying adult learning pedagogy within the pharmaceutical or healthcare sector.

• Change Management & Transformation: A successful track record of guiding strategic organizational development, managing change, and navigating classic or agile methodologies.

• Strategic Communication & Facilitation: Exceptional moderation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and resolve conflicts constructively.

• Leadership Potential: Demonstrated experience or clear potential to effectively hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high-performing team in the future.

* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

At Roche, we deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you. Apply today!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

En tant que responsable du développement des capacités commerciales, vous combinerez la vision stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle pour établir et évaluer les capacités de commercialisation de base. Initialement en tant qu'expert autonome avec l'occasion de construire une équipe à l'avenir, vous donnerez aux équipes commerciales, d'accès, de réglementation et médicales les moyens de fournir aux patients des innovations qui changent la vie. • Stratégie sur les capacités motrices : Effectuer des évaluations des capacités fonctionnelles et interfonctionnelles pour concevoir des parcours d'apprentissage stratégiques et établir des cartes de la chaleur des capacités régionales.
• Diriger la transformation régionale : Guider et appuyer les initiatives régionales de changement et les projets de développement organisationnel alignés sur les objectifs généraux du secteur de la santé.
• Conception et prestation d'un apprentissage efficace : Conceptualisez et modérez des ateliers et des programmes de formation (en personne et virtuels) qui couvrent des sujets scientifiques, commerciaux et comportementaux.

Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur entrepreneurial et un chef de file collaboratif qui excelle dans la traduction des lacunes opérationnelles en expériences d'apprentissage structurées et modernes dans des environnements complexes. • Contexte éducatif et expertise de domaine : Diplôme en administration des affaires, psychologie organisationnelle, ressources humaines, économie ou expérience pratique équivalente en efficacité opérationnelle et en apprentissage des adultes.
• Maîtrise de l'apprentissage et du développement : Expérience éprouvée en matière de conception de programmes d'études, d'utilisation de plates-formes d'apprentissage mixtes et d'application de la pédagogie de l'apprentissage des adultes dans le secteur pharmaceutique ou des soins de santé.
• Gestion et transformation du changement : Une expérience réussie de guider le développement organisationnel stratégique, de gérer le changement et de naviguer des méthodologies classiques ou agiles.

• Potentiel de leadership : Expérience démontrée ou potentiel clair d'embaucher, de monter à bord, d'entraîner et de développer une équipe hautement performante à l'avenir. * Il s'agit d'une contribution individuelle sans rapport direct. Chez Roche, nous offrons des solutions de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde, c'est l'endroit pour vous. Postulez aujourd'hui ! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled and influential Principal Data Engineer to join and provide technical leadership for the digital solution navify Cervical Screening. You will be a top-tier expert, driving architectural decisions, overseeing data integration and ensuring delivery of features and improvements. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is passionate about data, delivery and technical excellence.

As Data Lead, you will provide orchestration within cross-functional agile product teams, influencing the strategic direction and delivery of data-driven features. While hands-on contributions are expected, your primary focus as a Data Lead will be on ensuring the strategic differentiation of products through data and innovation, orchestrating DA&R capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive data integration and data fabric adoption across the domains, bringing together data, business and development domains.

• Ensure best practices and support organization-wide standards for data quality, governance, security, and observability.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert, mentoring Senior and Staff Engineers and collaborating closely with engineering leadership, data scientists, and business stakeholders.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to shape data strategy, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, and influence decision-making at both domain and enterprise levels.

• Spearhead the evaluation and integration of new technologies to continuously improve the performance and reliability of the data ecosystem.

• Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex performance and architectural challenges across the data ecosystem.

• You will be accountable for defining and ensuring timely delivery of all data-related requirements, including data integration, migration, storage, structure, legal compliance, privacy, quality, and insights generation.

• You will orchestrate DA&R engagement and delivery for digital products, activating the right DA&R capabilities. You will act as a key liaison, building and maintaining strong working relationships with cross-functional experts (other data experts, product owners, software engineers, clinicians) to jointly explore business opportunities and data assets.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience in a Data Engineering role, with significant experience operating at a Principal or Staff-level capacity .

• Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.

• Extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS Glue, Google Dataflow, Azure Data Factory) and deep expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Deep, hands-on expertise in data warehousing concepts, advanced modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, data vault), and establishing data governance frameworks.

• Proven track record of building, optimizing, and leading the deployment of massive-scale, highly concurrent data pipelines using distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Flink).

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Good command of Spanish.

• Deep experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Dagster) and managing them at scale.

• Experience with NoSQL and graph databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j).

• Expertise in

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo Stiamo cercando un Principal Data Engineer eccezionalmente qualificato e influente per unirsi e fornire la leadership tecnica per la soluzione digitale navify Cervical Screening. Sarete un esperto di alto livello, guidando decisioni architettoniche, supervisionando l'integrazione dei dati e garantendo la consegna di caratteristiche e miglioramenti. Questo è un ruolo di leadership fondamentale per qualcuno che è appassionato di dati, consegna e eccellenza tecnica. In qualità di Data Lead, fornirete l'orchestrazione all'interno di team di prodotti agili cross-funzionali, influenzando la direzione strategica e la consegna di funzionalità data-driven. Mentre i contributi pratici sono attesi, il vostro obiettivo primario come Data Lead sarà quello di garantire la differenziazione strategica dei prodotti attraverso i dati e l'innovazione, orchestrando le capacità DA&R. Principali responsabilità
• Guida l'integrazione dei dati e l'adozione del tessuto dei dati attraverso i domini, unendo i domini di dati, di business e di sviluppo.
• Assicurare le migliori pratiche e sostenere gli standard organizzativi per la qualità dei dati, la governance, la sicurezza e l'osservanza.
• Agire come esperto di materia tecnica, mentoring Senior e Staff Engineers e collaborare strettamente con la leadership di ingegneria, scienziati di dati e stakeholder aziendali.
• Partner con stakeholder interfunzionali per modellare la strategia dei dati, tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e influenzare il processo decisionale sia a livello di dominio che di impresa.
• Guida la valutazione e l'integrazione di nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le prestazioni e l'affidabilità dell'ecosistema dei dati.
• Risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione delle più complesse sfide di performance e architettura in tutto l'ecosistema dei dati.
• Sarete responsabili per la definizione e la fornitura tempestiva di tutti i requisiti relativi ai dati, tra cui l'integrazione dei dati, la migrazione, lo storage, la struttura, la conformità legale, la privacy, la qualità e la generazione di insight.
• Potrai orchestrare l'impegno e la consegna DA&R per i prodotti digitali, attivando le giuste capacità DA&R. Potrai agire come un collegamento chiave, costruire e mantenere forti rapporti di lavoro con esperti cross-funzionali (altri esperti di dati, proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri software, medici) per esplorare congiuntamente opportunità di business e beni di dati. Qualificazioni richieste
• 8+ anni di esperienza professionale in un ruolo di Data Engineering, con esperienza significativa che opera in una capacità di livello Principale o Staff .
• Competenza di esperti in SQL e Python.
• Ampia esperienza di progettazione e gestione di piattaforme di dati cloud su larga scala (ad esempio, AWS Glue, Google Dataflow, Azure Data Factory) e profonda esperienza nella containerizzazione e orchestrazione (Docker/Kubernetes).
• Profondo esperienza pratica nei concetti di data warehousing, tecniche di modellazione avanzate (ad esempio, modellazione dimensionale, data vault), e la creazione di quadri di governance dei dati.
• Provato record di costruzione, ottimizzazione, e leader la distribuzione di datadotti su larga scala, altamente concurrent utilizzando framework di elaborazione distribuiti (ad esempio, Apache Spark, Flink).
• Comunicazione eccezionale, negoziazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di presentare concetti tecnici complessi sia al pubblico tecnico che esecutivo. Qualificazioni predestinate
• Buon comando dello spagnolo.
• Esperienza profonda con strumenti di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, Apache Airflow, Dagster) e la gestione in scala.
• Esperienza con database NoSQL e grafici (ad esempio MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j).

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer wir sind Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlich qualifizierten und einflussreichen Principal Data Engineer, der sich der digitalen Lösung navify Cervical Screening anschließt und technische Führung übernimmt. Sie werden ein Top-Tier-Experte sein, der architektonische Entscheidungen trifft, die Datenintegration überwacht und die Bereitstellung von Funktionen und Verbesserungen sicherstellt. Dies ist eine wichtige Führungsrolle für jemanden, der sich für Daten, Lieferung und technische Exzellenz begeistert. Als Data Lead sorgen Sie für die Orchestrierung in funktionsübergreifenden agilen Produktteams, beeinflussen die strategische Ausrichtung und die Bereitstellung datengesteuerter Funktionen. Während praktische Beiträge erwartet werden, liegt Ihr Hauptaugenmerk als Data Lead darauf, die strategische Differenzierung von Produkten durch Daten und Innovationen zu gewährleisten und DA & R-Fähigkeiten zu orchestrieren. Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Fördern Sie die Datenintegration und Datengewebeakzeptanz in den Domänen und bringen Sie Daten-, Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsdomänen zusammen.
• Stellen Sie Best Practices sicher und unterstützen Sie organisationsweite Standards für Datenqualität, Governance, Sicherheit und Beobachtbarkeit.
• Handeln Sie als Experte für technische Themen, betreuen Sie Senior- und Personalingenieure und arbeiten Sie eng mit der technischen Führung, Datenwissenschaftlern und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen.
• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, um die Datenstrategie zu gestalten, Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen umzusetzen und die Entscheidungsfindung auf Domänen- und Unternehmensebene zu beeinflussen.
• Speerspitze bei der Bewertung und Integration neuer Technologien zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit des Datenökosystems.
• Beheben und beheben Sie die komplexesten Leistungs- und Architekturherausforderungen im gesamten Datenökosystem.
• Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, alle datenbezogenen Anforderungen, einschließlich Datenintegration, Migration, Speicherung, Struktur, Einhaltung der Rechtsvorschriften, Datenschutz, Qualität und Generierung von Erkenntnissen, rechtzeitig zu definieren und sicherzustellen.
• Sie orchestrieren das Engagement und die Lieferung von DA & R für digitale Produkte und aktivieren die richtigen DA & R-Funktionen. Sie werden als eine wichtige Verbindung fungieren und starke Arbeitsbeziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Experten (andere Datenexperten, Produktbesitzer, Softwareingenieure, Kliniker) aufbauen und pflegen, um gemeinsam Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Datenressourcen zu erkunden. Benötigte Qualifikationen
• 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Data Engineering-Rolle, mit erheblicher Erfahrung in einer Haupt- oder Personalebene.
• Expertenkenntnisse in SQL und Python.
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Architektur und Verwaltung großer Cloud-Datenplattformen (z. B. AWS Glue, Google Dataflow, Azure Data Factory) und umfassende Expertise in Containerisierung und Orchestrierung (Docker/Kubernetes).
• Tiefe, praktische Expertise in Data-Warehousing-Konzepten, fortschrittlichen Modellierungstechniken (z. B. Dimensionsmodellierung, Data-Vault) und der Einrichtung von Data-Governance-Frameworks.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau, der Optimierung und dem Einsatz von massenhaften, hochgradig gleichzeitigen Datenpipelines mit verteilten Verarbeitungs-Frameworks (z.B. Apache Spark, Flink).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.

תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.

תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:

• ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם

• זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.

• הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.

• עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות

מי את/ה:

התפקיד מתאים לאנשים בעלי רצון להתנסות במודל עבודה אחר - מודל מולטידיסיפלינרי, המאפשר מרחב פעולה רחב, אחריות גדולה ומנדט להוביל מהלכים משמעותיים בארגון ומחוצה לו.
אנשים בעלי תשוקה לעבודה עם צוותים רפואיים, המביאים איתם רקע מגוון לתפקיד שהוא "גם וגם" ומשלב בתוכו מגוון יכולות שיאפשרו לדיאלוג עם הרופאים לעשות הבדל בחיי המטופלים.

• ניסיון מוכח בניהול קשרי לקוחות מורכבים וביצירת שותפויות משמעותיות עם מובילי דעה באקוסיסטם הרפואי

• ניסיון קודם בתפקיד PS/נציג/ה רפואי בפארמה (מינימום 3 שנות ניסיון) – עדיפות לניסיון בתחום הנוירולוגיה, בדגש על טרשת נפוצה

• ניסיון בעבודה שיווקית מדעית מול צוותים רפואיים

• נכונות לעבודת שטח אינטנסיבית (אזור מרכז-ירושלים-דרום), מתוך הבנה ששם נמצאים הפתרונות האמיתיים עבור המטופלים

• תואר אקדמי במדעי החיים

• ניסיון בפיתוח והובלת פרויקטים בשיתוף עם הלקוחות

אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה שליחות ומשמעות נפגשים.
הצטרפו אלינו למסע חדשני שבו כוכב הצפון הוא טובת המטופל.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.

תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.

תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:

• ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם

• זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.

• הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.

• עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות

titleByLocale.it: Technical Capo Team – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
titleByLocale.en: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
titleByLocale.de: Technical Teamleiter – Applied & Agentic AI Systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Tech Lead Manager) who exhibits a player-coach mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions.
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing the lightweight, empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering pod.

Description of the area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building and operating high-value AI solutions and to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~6 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.

Job Responsibilities
Technical Direction & Architecture:

• Guide technical decision making and architect robust systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent workflows, and enterprise data.

• Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your engineers.

• Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt.

• Help to establish and enforce standards for code and systems development across the team.

Agentic SDLC & Code Quality:

• Act as the primary technical gatekeeper; while you are willing to step away from day-to-day code development, you are fully willing to perform effective code reviews.

• Ensure the team effectively leverages AI coding assistants daily to accelerate development while maintaining strict enterprise software engineering standards for both human-written and AI-generated code.

Team Health & Psychological Safety:

• Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work and actively remove impediments and roadblocks to progress.

• Cultivate healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Maintain a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Manage team members with different skill sets from your own , injecting stability into the team in a complex organizational environment.

Capability Development & Resource Management:

• Encourage team members to self-define their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it.

• Manage hiring, onboarding, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution.

• Manage the team's budget, including headcount, operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility.

Qualifications

• Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior.

• Possesses deep active listening and mentoring skills.

• Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity.

• Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro Stiamo cercando un Team Lead tecnico (Tech Lead Manager) che esibisce una mentalità giocatore-coach per condurre un team altamente autonomo e multidisciplinare di sviluppatori di software AI. Potrai fungere da voce ingegneristica che funge da ponte tra obiettivi aziendali ambiziosi e la realtà tecnica di costruire soluzioni AI scalabili, etiche e ad alto impatto. In questo ruolo, è necessario bilanciare con successo l'essere sul manager- e il produttore-schedule. Ti allontanerai dalla codifica delle funzionalità quotidiane per guidare l'architettura del sistema e eseguire rigorose recensioni di codici, fornendo allo stesso tempo la gestione delle persone leggere e empatiche necessarie per coltivare un pod di ingegneria ad alte prestazioni. Descrizione della zona A Roche Digital Technology, stiamo avanzando i confini di Applied AI. Il team Applied AI Engineering si concentra sull'archiviazione, la costruzione e l'utilizzo di soluzioni AI di alto valore e sulla soluzione di complesse sfide aziendali nel settore sanitario. Nel panorama tecnologico del 2026, operiamo in piccole squadre agili (ad esempio, ~6 membri) alimentate da agenti avanzati di codifica (come Claude Code) per sviluppare e spedire soluzioni più velocemente che mai (Agentic SDLC). Questo team non solo costruirà soluzioni end-to-end, ma supporterà anche progetti "buy and integration", raccogliendo feedback tecnici per supportare lo sviluppo in corso delle piattaforme AI RDT. Responsabilità del lavoro Direzione Tecnica e Architettura:
• Guidare il processo decisionale tecnico e progettare sistemi robusti che integrano i flussi di lavoro generativi AI, multi-agenti e i dati aziendali.
• Spiegare il "WHY" e fornire il contesto necessario ai vostri ingegneri.
• Identificare le aree di debito tecnico e eseguire analisi pragmatiche dei costi/benefici per risolvere questo debito.
• Aiuta a stabilire e rispettare gli standard per lo sviluppo del codice e dei sistemi in tutto il team. SDLC agente e qualità del codice:
• Agire come il portiere tecnico primario; mentre si è disposti a allontanarsi dallo sviluppo di codice di giorno per giorno, si è pienamente disposti a eseguire recensioni di codice efficaci.
• Assicurarsi che il team efficacemente leva assistenti di codifica AI ogni giorno per accelerare lo sviluppo, mantenendo rigidi standard di ingegneria del software aziendale sia per codice generato dall'uomo che dall'intelligenza artificiale. Salute di squadra & sicurezza psicologica:
• Impostare la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team e rimuovere attivamente impedimenti e blocchi stradali al progresso.
• Coltivare dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Mantenere un ritmo sostenibile di lavoro per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Gestire i membri del team con diversi set di abilità da soli, iniettando stabilità nel team in un ambiente organizzativo complesso. Gestione delle risorse e dello sviluppo di capacità:
• Incoraggiare i membri del team per autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e attivare attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Gestire l'assunzione, l'imbarco, la calibrazione del risarcimento, la pianificazione della successione, la gestione delle prestazioni e la risoluzione dei conflitti.
• Gestisci il budget del team, inclusi i costi operativi e i contratti dei fornitori, assicurando la responsabilità finanziaria. Qualifiche
• Mostra il comportamento del servo e della leadership creativa (VACC).
• Possede competenze di ascolto e mentoring molto attive.
• Dimostra una presenza di leadership, forte acume aziendale, capacità di navigare ambiguità, e gestire la complessità.
• È un leader decisivo, comodo prendere decisioni in un ritmo veloce, dinamico

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Wir suchen einen Technical Team Lead (Tech Lead Manager), der eine Spieler-Coach-Mentalität zeigt, um ein hoch autonomes, multidisziplinäres Team von KI-Softwareentwicklern zu führen. Sie fungieren als definierende Ingenieursstimme, die als Brücke zwischen ehrgeizigen Geschäftszielen und der technischen Realität des Aufbaus skalierbarer, ethischer und wirkungsvoller KI-Lösungen dient. In dieser Rolle müssen Sie erfolgreich auf dem Manager- und Maker-Zeitplan sein. Sie entfernen sich von der täglichen Feature-Codierung, um die Systemarchitektur zu leiten und strenge Code-Reviews durchzuführen, während Sie gleichzeitig das leichte, einfühlsame Personalmanagement bereitstellen, das für die Entwicklung eines leistungsstarken Engineering-Pods erforderlich ist. Beschreibung des Gebiets Bei Roche Digital Technology erweitern wir die Grenzen von Applied AI. Das Applied AI Engineering Team konzentriert sich auf die Architektur, den Bau und den Betrieb hochwertiger KI-Lösungen und auf die Lösung komplexer geschäftlicher Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen. In der Technologielandschaft von 2026 arbeiten wir in kleinen agilen Teams (z. B. ~6 Mitglieder), die von fortschrittlichen Codieragenten (wie Claude Code) unterstützt werden, um Lösungen schneller als je zuvor zu entwickeln und zu liefern (Agentic SDLC). Dieses Team wird nicht nur End-to-End-Lösungen entwickeln, sondern auch "Kaufen und Integrieren" -Projekte unterstützen und gleichzeitig technisches Feedback zur Unterstützung der laufenden Entwicklung von RDT AI-Plattformen sammeln. Aufgabenbereich Technische Leitung & Architektur:
• Führen Sie technische Entscheidungen und erstellen Sie robuste Systeme, die generative KI, Multiagenten-Workflows und Unternehmensdaten integrieren.
• Erklären Sie das "Warum" und geben Sie Ihren Ingenieuren den notwendigen Kontext.
• Identifizieren Sie Bereiche der technischen Schulden und führen Sie pragmatische Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen zur Lösung dieser Schulden durch.
• Helfen Sie, Standards für die Code- und Systementwicklung im gesamten Team festzulegen und durchzusetzen. Agentic SDLC & Code Qualität:
• Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Gatekeeper; Während Sie bereit sind, sich von der täglichen Codeentwicklung zu entfernen, sind Sie voll und ganz bereit, effektive Code-Reviews durchzuführen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Team täglich KI-Codierungsassistenten effektiv einsetzt, um die Entwicklung zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig strenge Enterprise-Software-Engineering-Standards für von Menschen geschriebenen und KI-generierten Code einzuhalten. Team Gesundheit & Psychologische Sicherheit:
• Setzen Sie klare Schwerpunkte und Prioritäten für die Bereitstellungsarbeit des Teams und entfernen Sie aktiv Hindernisse und Hindernisse für den Fortschritt.
• Pflegen Sie eine gesunde Teamdynamik und Zusammenarbeit, sorgen Sie für psychologische Sicherheit und offene Kommunikation.
• Behalten Sie ein nachhaltiges Arbeitstempo für das Team bei und balancieren Sie die Lieferziele mit dem Wohlbefinden des Teams.
• Verwalten Sie Teammitglieder mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten und bringen Sie dem Team in einer komplexen organisatorischen Umgebung Stabilität. Capability Development & Resource Management:
• Ermutigen Sie die Teammitglieder, ihre Karriere selbst zu definieren und aktiv Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu ermöglichen, die mit ihr übereinstimmen.
• Verwalten Sie Einstellung, Onboarding, Kompensationskalibrierung, Nachfolgeplanung, Umgang mit Underperformance und Konfliktlösung.
• Verwalten Sie das Budget des Teams, einschließlich Mitarbeiterzahl, Betriebskosten und Lieferantenverträge, um die finanzielle Verantwortung zu gewährleisten. Qualifikationen
• Zeigt Diener und kreative Führung (VACC) Verhalten.
• Besitzt tiefe aktive Zuhör- und Mentoring-Fähigkeiten.
• Demonstriert eine Führungspräsenz, starken Geschäftssinn, die Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren und Komplexität zu verwalten.
• Ist ein entscheidender Führer, bequem Entscheidungen in einem schnellen, dynamischen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Description du poste Nous sommes à la recherche d'une équipe technique responsable (Tech Lead Manager) qui expose une mentalité joueur-coach pour diriger une équipe multidisciplinaire hautement autonome de développeurs de logiciels d'IA. Vous agirez comme la voix de l'ingénierie servant de pont entre des objectifs commerciaux ambitieux et la réalité technique de construire des solutions d'IA évolutives, éthiques et à impact élevé. Dans ce rôle, vous devez équilibrer avec succès être sur le calendrier du gestionnaire et du fabricant. Vous vous éloignez du codage quotidien des caractéristiques pour guider l'architecture du système et effectuer des révisions rigoureuses du code, tout en fournissant la gestion légère et empathique des personnes nécessaires pour cultiver un module d'ingénierie très performant. Description de la zone Chez Roche Digital Technology, nous progressons dans les limites de l'IA appliquée. L'équipe d'ingénierie de l'IA appliquée se concentre sur l'architecture, la construction et l'exploitation de solutions d'IA de haute valeur et pour résoudre des défis complexes dans le domaine des soins de santé. Dans le paysage technologique de 2026, nous opérons dans de petites équipes agiles (p. ex. ~6 membres) alimentées par des agents de codage avancés (comme Claude Code) pour développer et expédier des solutions plus rapidement que jamais (Agentic SDLC). Cette équipe va non seulement construire des solutions de bout en bout, mais aussi soutenir des projets « d'achat et d'intégration » tout en recueillant des commentaires techniques pour soutenir le développement continu des plateformes d'IA de RDT. Responsabilités professionnelles Direction technique et architecture :
• Guidez la prise de décision technique et les systèmes d'architecte robustes qui intègrent l'IA générative, les workflows multi-agents et les données d'entreprise.
• Expliquez le «QUOI» et fournissez le contexte nécessaire à vos ingénieurs.
• Identifier les domaines de la dette technique et effectuer des analyses pragmatiques coûts/avantages pour résoudre cette dette.
• Aider à établir et à faire appliquer des normes pour l'élaboration de codes et de systèmes dans toute l'équipe. Agent SDLC et qualité du code :
• Agissez en tant que gardien technique principal; bien que vous soyez prêt à vous éloigner de l'élaboration de code au jour le jour, vous êtes tout à fait disposé à effectuer des révisions de code efficaces.
• Veiller à ce que l'équipe tire efficacement parti des assistants de codage d'IA quotidiennement pour accélérer le développement tout en maintenant des normes strictes d'ingénierie logicielle d'entreprise pour le code humain et le code généré par l'IA. Santé et sécurité psychologique de l'équipe :
• Mettre clairement l'accent et les priorités sur le travail d'exécution de l'équipe et éliminer activement les obstacles et les obstacles au progrès.
• Cultiver une saine dynamique d'équipe et la collaboration, en assurant la sécurité psychologique et la communication ouverte.
• Maintenir un rythme de travail durable pour l'équipe, en conciliant les objectifs de prestation et le bien-être de l'équipe.
• Gérer les membres de l'équipe avec différents ensembles de compétences de votre propre, injecter la stabilité dans l'équipe dans un environnement organisationnel complexe. Développement des capacités et gestion des ressources :
• Encourager les membres de l'équipe à définir eux-mêmes leur parcours de carrière et permettre activement des possibilités de développement qui s'harmonisent avec elle.
• Gérer l'embauche, l'embarquement, l'étalonnage de la rémunération, la planification de la relève, la gestion du rendement insuffisant et la résolution des conflits.
• Gérer le budget de l'équipe, y compris le compte, les coûts opérationnels et les contrats de fournisseurs, en assurant la responsabilité financière. Compétences
• Exposer le comportement du serviteur et du leadership créatif (VAC).
• Possède de profondes compétences d'écoute active et de mentorat.
• Démontrer une présence de leadership, un sens fort des affaires, la capacité de naviguer l'ambiguïté et de gérer la complexité.
• Est un leader décisif, confortable de prendre des décisions dans un rythme rapide, dynamique

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.

This is a maternity cover opportunity.

The Opportunity:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• You possess exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• You are able to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• You are skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

In qualità di coordinatore del progetto di design (DPC), sei il proprietario finale dei biglietti di design. L'utente agisce come punto centrale di contatto dall'assunzione dei biglietti alla consegna, gestione di tutta la gestione del progetto, amministrazione di Workfront, allocazione dei progetti, comunicazione degli stakeholder. La vostra missione è quella di proteggere il tempo creativo per i progettisti e garantire l'esecuzione liscia e tempestiva in tutti i tipi di progetto. Questo ruolo richiede un approccio proattivo alla gestione del progetto, tra cui la proiezione e la delegazione di compiti in arrivo, la comunicazione costante per ottimizzare la consegna del progetto e la manutenzione di un ambiente di team equilibrato e produttivo. Questa e' un'opportunita' di copertura di maternità. L'opportunità:
• Superare il ciclo di vita completo dei biglietti Workfront assegnati, dall'assunzione alla chiusura.
• Verificare i biglietti, chiarire le informazioni mancanti o non chiare con gli stakeholder.
• Assegna progettisti basati su disponibilità e competenza.
• Gestisci l'amministrazione di Workfront, inclusi metadati, timeline, passaggi di attività e documentazione.
• Agire come unico punto di contatto tra stakeholder e designer.
• Coordinate kick-off richiede progetti complessi o ad alta priorità, e route feedback ai progettisti.
• Assicurare consegne tempestive, aggiornare le parti interessate, chiudere i biglietti, bloccanti escalate e monitorare i progressi del team. Chi sei:
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del progetto o nella gestione del flusso di lavoro, preferibilmente in un'area di progettazione o in un'attività simile.
• Possiedi eccezionali capacità di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di priorità compiti in un ambiente frenetico.
• Siete in grado di organizzare e gestire il tempo in modo efficiente, priorità compiti per gestire più progetti contemporaneamente.
• Sei abile nella promozione delle relazioni con i clienti attraverso le discussioni iniziali del progetto, gli aggiornamenti in corso e l'impostazione di aspettative realistiche, assicurando una corretta esecuzione del progetto. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.
• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Scopri di cosa si tratta il Global Digital Hub. Scopri il Roche Services & Solutions Center e come lavoriamo insieme come team veramente globale! descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.

This is a maternity cover opportunity.

The Opportunity:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• You possess exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• You are able to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• You are skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

jobs.title: Internship Inclusion & Belonging International (m/f/d) / 12 months

titleByLocale.fr: Inclusion des stagiaires et appartenance internationale (m/f/d) / 12 mois

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Inclusion & Belonging International (I&B) Office sits at the heart of our People & Culture strategy. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience, influence strategy, and shape a truly inclusive environment. Based in Basel, the role offers a flexible starting date and options for hybrid work to support your work-life balance.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will not just be observing; you will be an active driver of sustainable cultural change. You will work closely with the I&B International team and network with leaders, project Project Managers, and local Impact Networks (Employee Resource Groups). You will become part of the vibrant multicultural community of The Roche Intern Network and receive mentorship from senior I&B professionals, rounded up by attractive benefits.

Key Responsibilities include:

• Country Impact Network & Community Enablement: Serve as a central point of contact for Roche's country Impact Networks (Business/Employee Resource Groups) in Switzerland. Assist them with resource allocation, cultural awareness/day preparation and communications support.

• Project Management & Operations: Assist in solving problems and key deliverables for the team; actively fuel day-to-day actions with the support of AI systems and methods

• Engagement & Communication: Support the preparation of engagement moments with networks, internal and external events; take care of follow up activities, success measurements and Social Media activities.

Who You Are
You are eager to shape your own career path and want to join a company where your title is just the starting point, not the limit. As a passionate advocate for inclusion and belonging, you bring an empathetic, curious, and open-minded approach to diverse cultures. You are ready to champion creative ideas and embrace innovative solutions, including AI, to drive meaningful change.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

• Education: Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, ideally with a proficient literacy for Inclusion & Belonging (e.g., Psychology, Business Administration, Sociology, Human Resources, Global Studies) OR you have graduated within the last 12 months.

• Analytical Capability: Comfortable handling data, identifying trends, and translating numbers into clean, digestible PowerPoint/Google Slides narratives.

• Organization: Strong structured thinking with the ability to manage multiple overlapping tasks in a fast-paced, matrixed corporate environment.

• Languages: Fluency in written and spoken English AND German is required. Additional languages are a plus.

Application Process
To be considered, please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your motivation for joining the Inclusion & Belonging International team at Roche.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ufficio Inclusion & Belonging International (I&B) si trova nel cuore della nostra strategia People & Culture. Questo stage offre un'opportunità unica per acquisire esperienza pratica, strategia di influenza e modellare un ambiente veramente inclusivo. Con sede a Basilea, il ruolo offre una data di partenza flessibile e opzioni per il lavoro ibrido per supportare il tuo equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, non solo sarete osservanti; sarete un pilota attivo di cambiamenti culturali sostenibili. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team I&B International e la rete con leader, project manager e reti locali di impatto (Employee Resource Groups). Diventate parte della vivace comunità multiculturale di The Roche Intern Network e riceverete la mentorship da professionisti I&B senior, arrotondati da benefici interessanti. Le responsabilità chiave includono:
• Country Impact Network & Community Enablement: Serve come punto di contatto centrale per le reti di impatto del paese di Roche (Gruppi di risorse per i dipendenti/impresa) in Svizzera. Aiutarli con l'allocazione delle risorse, la consapevolezza culturale / la preparazione del giorno e il supporto delle comunicazioni.
• Project Management & Operations: Assist nella risoluzione di problemi e key deliverables per il team; alimentare attivamente le azioni quotidiane con il supporto di sistemi e metodi AI
• Engagement & Communication: Sostenere la preparazione di momenti di impegno con reti, eventi interni ed esterni; prendersi cura di seguire attività, misurazioni di successo e attività dei Social Media. Chi sei Sei impaziente di modellare il tuo percorso di carriera e vuoi unire una società in cui il tuo titolo è solo il punto di partenza, non il limite. Come appassionato sostenitore di inclusione e appartenenza, si porta un approccio empatico, curioso e di mentalità aperta a culture diverse. Siete pronti a sostenere idee creative e ad abbracciare soluzioni innovative, tra cui AI, per guidare cambiamenti significativi. Qualificazioni e competenze necessarie:
• Istruzione: Attualmente iscritta al programma di un Master, idealmente con una proficua alfabetizzazione per Inclusione & Belonging (ad esempio, Psicologia, Business Administration, Sociologia, Risorse Umane, Studi Globali) O ti sei laureato negli ultimi 12 mesi.
• Capabilità analitica: dati di gestione confortevoli, l'identificazione delle tendenze e la traduzione dei numeri in narrazioni pulite e digeribili PowerPoint/Google Slides.
• Organizzazione: Forte pensiero strutturato con la capacità di gestire più attività sovrapposte in un ambiente aziendale veloce e matrice.
• Lingue: È richiesta la fluidità in inglese e tedesco scritto e parlato. Le lingue aggiuntive sono un plus. Processo di applicazione Per essere considerato, si prega di inviare il vostro CV e una breve lettera di copertura che delinea la vostra motivazione per unire il team Inclusion & Belonging International a Roche. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
The Delivery capability covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.
This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP).

As the Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will meet the challenge to bring vision, guidance, prioritization, and focus to the Procurement Delivery capability area such as team vision, capability development, performance and strategic category management (in line with functional objectives and business needs).
You will lead and guide a team of Procurement Category Experts and Procurement Category Specialists, working closely with them to develop the team vision, prioritize and focus efforts, and provide coaching and guidance to support your team’s development and growth both as individuals and as a team.

You are accountable for the best allocation of your people to ensure flexibility, excellence in execution, delivery and performance, and talent development. Your scope includes

• Portfolio Leadership: Strategic management of a diverse portfolio of Drug Substance and New Modalities manufacturing partnerships, encompassing a significant commercial and development footprint

• Global Reach: Driving procurement strategy across an international landscape, working with cross-functional teams and external partners spanning Europe, North America, and Asia.

• Strategic Complexity: Balancing the management of established commercial partnerships with the unique requirements of high-growth technology platforms and new pipeline assets.

• Value Creation: Leading the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for this critical network, from strategic outsourcing and site selection to long-term supplier relationship management

The Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, including, but not limited to, these core responsibilities:

• You utilise your in depth knowledge and expertise in External Manufacturing to act as a Delivery domain lead providing thought leadership, advice, and know-how on delivery capability topics, strategies, and best practices, and shaping and defining the Category area vision and priorities.

• You driver performance and category strategies for the Roche Pharma global spend within your category areas. You are accountable for achieving the GP Balanced Score Card targets, translating the GP strategy (including ongoing effectiveness, automation and AI utilisation) and delivering the business specific needs and targets.

• You work within the capability teams, networks, and squads/project teams to ensure prioritization and focus on delivering or supporting both project and foundational work.

• Yo
