La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità La capacità di consegna copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contrazione, definizione di strategia di contenuto ed esecuzione. Questa posizione fa parte del team di leadership di Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement che segnala nel Capitolo Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP). In qualità di Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico in cui incontrerai la sfida di portare visione, orientamento, priorità e attenzione all'area Procurement Delivery, come la visione del team, lo sviluppo delle capacità, le prestazioni e la gestione strategica delle categorie (in linea con gli obiettivi funzionali e le esigenze aziendali). Potrai guidare e guidare un team di esperti di categoria di appalti e specialisti della categoria di appalti, lavorando a stretto contatto con loro per sviluppare la visione del team, priorità e gli sforzi di messa a fuoco, e fornire coaching e guida per sostenere lo sviluppo e la crescita del tuo team sia come individui e come team. Sei responsabile della migliore allocazione della tua gente per garantire flessibilità, eccellenza nell'esecuzione, consegna e performance e sviluppo del talento. Il tuo scopo include
• Portfolio Leadership: Gestione strategica di un portafoglio diversificato di partnership per la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti e nuove modalità, che comprende una significativa impronta commerciale e di sviluppo
• Global Reach: Guidare la strategia di approvvigionamento attraverso un panorama internazionale, lavorando con team interfunzionali e partner esterni che spaziano dall'Europa, dal Nord America e dall'Asia.
• Complessità Strategica: Bilanciare la gestione di partnership commerciali consolidate con i requisiti unici delle piattaforme tecnologiche ad alta crescita e dei nuovi asset pipeline.
• Creazione del valore: Condurre il ciclo di vita di approvvigionamento end-to-end per questa rete critica, dall'outsourcing strategico e la selezione del sito alla gestione del rapporto dei fornitori a lungo termine Il Capo della Sostanza della Droga & Nuovi Modalities Procurement giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, la conoscenza e i requisiti generali di business / team, tra cui, ma non solo, queste responsabilità fondamentali:
• Utilizzi la tua profonda conoscenza e competenza nel settore manifatturiero esterno per agire come un lead di dominio di consegna fornendo leadership, consigli e know-how sui temi delle capacità di consegna, strategie e best practice, e modellando e definendo la visione e le priorità dell'area Categoria.
• Le prestazioni del conducente e le strategie di categoria per la spesa globale di Roche Pharma all'interno delle aree di categoria. Sei responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi della GP Balanced Score Card, traducendo la strategia GP (compresa l'efficacia in corso, l'automazione e l'utilizzo AI) e fornendo le esigenze e gli obiettivi specifici del business.
• Lavorate all'interno dei team di capacità, reti e team di squadra/progetto per garantire la priorità e la messa a fuoco sul fornire o sostenere sia il lavoro di progetto che quello di base.
• Ehi.

• Complexité stratégique : Équilibrer la gestion des partenariats commerciaux établis avec les exigences uniques des plateformes technologiques à forte croissance et des nouveaux actifs de pipeline.
• Création de valeur : Diriger le cycle de vie des achats de bout en bout pour ce réseau essentiel, de l'externalisation stratégique et de la sélection du site à la gestion à long terme des relations avec les fournisseurs Le responsable de l'approvisionnement en substances médicamenteuses et nouvelles modalités jouera divers rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et des exigences générales de l'entreprise ou de l'équipe, y compris, sans s'y limiter, ces responsabilités fondamentales :
• Vous utilisez vos connaissances et votre expertise en fabrication externe pour jouer le rôle de chef de file de la livraison en fournissant un leadership de réflexion, des conseils et un savoir-faire sur les sujets, les stratégies et les meilleures pratiques en matière de capacité de livraison, et en définissant la vision et les priorités de la zone de catégorie.
• Vous pilotez les performances et les stratégies de catégorie pour les dépenses mondiales Roche Pharma dans vos domaines de catégorie. Vous êtes responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs du GP Balanced Score Card, de la traduction de la stratégie du GP (y compris l'efficacité continue, l'automatisation et l'utilisation de l'IA) et de la réalisation des besoins et des objectifs spécifiques de l'entreprise.
• Vous travaillez au sein des équipes de capacités, des réseaux, des équipes ou des équipes de projet afin d'assurer l'établissement de priorités et de vous concentrer sur la réalisation ou le soutien de projets et de travaux fondamentaux.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This is 1-year fixed-term contract.

Who are we

Doing now what patients need next.

Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) :

We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.
That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

pRED Clinical Operations:

Our North Star is to increase R&D Productivity and Patient Inclusivity. This is supported by our CO Strategy to deliver value for pRED CO and our portfolio. We aspire to be a leading edge Clinical Operations organisation that drives innovative patient-inclusive approaches in study design and execution, utilises advanced analytics to drive data-driven decisions, and embeds innovative technologies into our ways of working to improve productivity delivery of programs and studies. We strive to create a workplace where team members own their own development and learning and are empowered to create and innovate.

Contract Purpose:

As a contract Study Manager you will be assigned to pRED early phase clinical studies, and as part of a cross-functional study team, you will be responsible for delivering study management and clinical operations activities under the direction and leadership of a Study Management Team Leader.

Through your direct study responsibilities you will also contribute to the management of external stakeholder relationships by helping Roche to be the preferred sponsor for sites, patients and other important healthcare providers.

What you will do / Expectations during your assignment:

During your assignment you will participate as a member of the Study Management Team contributing to the delivery and execution of early phase study protocols. You will:

• DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION by providing operational expertise into protocol design and feasibility, country selection, patient centricity and data delivery plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Ensure study quality and integrity by developing and maintaining study systems and documentation (including informed consent forms, communication plan, Trial Monitoring Plan, Trial Master File etc).

• PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT, for insourced studies, by supporting or managing feasibility assessments to ensure countries and sites are selected for participation in studies. Provide guidance to country operational representatives during studies to ensure countries start-up on time and deliver on their recruitment commitments.

• MANAGE VENDOR PERFORMANCE by providing direction and actively managing relationships. Ensure vendors and third-party suppliers deliver against contracted scope of work and performance expectations and adhere to all appropriate standards (including ICH/GCP, SOPs and other regulations).

• PLAN DEMAND AND SUPPLY by overseeing the forecasting and maintenance of supplies (including IMP) needed to ensure sites have the necessary resources to run clinical studies.

• MANAGE RISK AND COMPLIANCE by assisting the study team in the identification, management and mitigation of study-related risks and issues in your areas of responsi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer sind wir Jetzt tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Pharmaforschung und frühe Entwicklung (pRED) : Wir glauben, dass es dringend notwendig ist, medizinische Lösungen jetzt zu liefern – auch wenn wir Innovationen für die Zukunft entwickeln. Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln. Und wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Wir sind stolz darauf, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Wir sind viele, arbeiten als eins über Funktionen hinweg, über Unternehmen hinweg und auf der ganzen Welt. pRED Klinische Operationen: Unser North Star soll die R&D-Produktivität und Patienteninklusivität steigern. Dies wird durch unsere CO-Strategie unterstützt, um einen Mehrwert für pRED CO und unser Portfolio zu liefern. Wir streben danach, eine führende Organisation für klinische Operationen zu sein, die innovative patienteninklusive Ansätze in der Studiengestaltung und -durchführung vorantreibt, fortschrittliche Analysen einsetzt, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungen zu treffen, und innovative Technologien in unsere Arbeitsweise einbettet, um die Produktivität von Programmen und Studien zu verbessern. Wir bemühen uns, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem Teammitglieder ihre eigene Entwicklung und ihr eigenes Lernen besitzen und in der Lage sind, zu schaffen und zu innovieren. Vertragszweck: Als Vertragsstudienleiter werden Sie klinischen Studien in der Frühphase von pRED zugewiesen, und als Teil eines funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams sind Sie für die Durchführung von Studienmanagement- und klinischen Betriebsaktivitäten unter der Leitung und Leitung eines Studienmanagementteamleiters verantwortlich. Durch Ihre direkten Studienverantwortlichkeiten tragen Sie auch zum Management externer Stakeholder-Beziehungen bei, indem Sie Roche dabei unterstützen, der bevorzugte Sponsor für Standorte, Patienten und andere wichtige Gesundheitsdienstleister zu sein. Was Sie tun / Erwartungen während Ihres Einsatzes: Während Ihres Einsatzes nehmen Sie als Mitglied des Studienmanagementteams teil und tragen zur Bereitstellung und Durchführung von Studienprotokollen für die Frühphase bei. Sie werden
• DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION durch Bereitstellung von operativem Know-how in den Bereichen Protokolldesign und Machbarkeit, Länderauswahl, Patientenorientierung und Datenbereitstellungspläne in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern. Gewährleistung der Studienqualität und -integrität durch Entwicklung und Pflege von Studiensystemen und -dokumentation (einschließlich Einwilligungsformularen, Kommunikationsplan, Testüberwachungsplan, Trial Master File usw.).
• PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT für Insourcing-Studien durch Unterstützung oder Verwaltung von Machbarkeitsbewertungen, um sicherzustellen, dass Länder und Standorte für die Teilnahme an Studien ausgewählt werden. Bereitstellung von Leitlinien für die operativen Vertreter der Länder während der Studien, um sicherzustellen, dass die Länder rechtzeitig anlaufen und ihre Einstellungsverpflichtungen erfüllen.
• VERWANDELN VENDOR PERFORMANCE durch Direktion und aktives Management von Beziehungen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Anbieter und Drittanbieter nach vertraglich vereinbarten Arbeits- und Leistungserwartungen liefern und alle geeigneten Standards (einschließlich ICH / GCP, SOPs und anderen Vorschriften) einhalten.
• PLANEN ENTWICKLUNG UND VERSORGUNG durch Überwachung der Prognose und Wartung der Lieferungen (einschließlich IMP), die erforderlich sind, um sicherzustellen, dass die Standorte über die notwendigen Ressourcen für die Durchführung klinischer Studien verfügen.
• MANAGE RISIKO UND KOMPLIANZ durch Unterstützung des Studienteams bei der Identifizierung, dem Management und der Minderung von studienbezogenen Risiken und Problemen in Ihren Verantwortungsbereichen (einschließlich der Aufsicht über die Ris)
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui sommes-nous Faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. Recherche pharmaceutique et développement précoce (PRED) : Nous pensons qu'il est urgent de fournir des solutions médicales dès maintenant – même lorsque nous développons des innovations pour l'avenir. Nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients. Nous sommes courageux dans la décision et dans l'action. Et nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler chaque jour. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Nous sommes fiers de qui nous sommes, de ce que nous faisons et de la façon dont nous le faisons. Nous sommes nombreux, travaillant comme un à travers les fonctions, à travers les entreprises, et à travers le monde. Opérations cliniques pRED : Notre North Star vise à accroître la productivité de la R-D et l'inclusion des patients. Ceci est soutenu par notre stratégie CO pour offrir de la valeur pour le CO pRED et notre portefeuille. Nous aspirons à être une organisation d'opérations cliniques de pointe qui stimule des approches innovantes incluant le patient dans la conception et l'exécution des études, utilise des analyses avancées pour conduire des décisions fondées sur les données, et intègre des technologies innovantes dans nos façons de travailler pour améliorer la productivité des programmes et des études. Nous nous efforçons de créer un milieu de travail où les membres de l'équipe possèdent leur propre perfectionnement et apprentissage et sont habilités à créer et à innover. Objet du contrat: En tant que gestionnaire d'étude contractuel, vous serez affecté à des études cliniques de phase initiale du programme et, dans le cadre d'une équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, vous serez responsable de la gestion des études et des activités cliniques sous la direction et la direction d'un chef d'équipe de gestion des études. Grâce à vos responsabilités d'étude directes, vous contribuerez également à la gestion des relations avec les intervenants externes en aidant Roche à être le commanditaire privilégié des sites, des patients et d'autres fournisseurs de soins de santé importants. Ce que vous ferez / Attentes pendant votre mission : Pendant votre affectation, vous participerez à titre de membre de l'équipe de gestion de l'étude qui contribue à la prestation et à l'exécution des protocoles d'étude en phase initiale. Vous:
• EXÉCUTION DE L'ÉTUDE DE LIVRAISON en fournissant une expertise opérationnelle dans la conception et la faisabilité des protocoles, la sélection des pays, la centricité des patients et les plans de livraison des données en partenariat avec les intervenants interfonctionnels. Assurer la qualité et l'intégrité des études en élaborant et en tenant à jour des systèmes et des documents d'étude (y compris les formulaires de consentement éclairé, le plan de communication, le plan de surveillance des essais, le dossier principal des essais, etc.).
• PROVIDE PAYS SURVEILLANCE, pour les études sous-traitées, en appuyant ou en gérant les évaluations de faisabilité pour s'assurer que les pays et les sites sont sélectionnés pour participer aux études. Fournir des conseils aux représentants opérationnels des pays au cours des études afin de veiller à ce que les pays démarrent à temps et respectent leurs engagements en matière de recrutement.
• GESTIONNAIRE PERFORMANCE en fournissant une orientation et une gestion active des relations. Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs et les fournisseurs tiers respectent la portée contractuelle du travail et les attentes en matière de rendement et respectent toutes les normes appropriées (notamment l'ICH/GCP, les SOP et d'autres règlements).
• PLAN DE DEMANDE ET DE POUVOIR en surveillant la prévision et l'entretien des approvisionnements (y compris les PIM) nécessaires pour s'assurer que les sites disposent des ressources nécessaires pour mener des études cliniques.
• RISQUE DE GESTION ET CONFORMITÉ en aidant l'équipe d'étude à identifier, gérer et atténuer les risques et les problèmes liés à l'étude dans vos domaines de responsabilité (y compris la surveillance du ris)

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Doing now what patients need next. A pioneer in the development of blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery systems, Roche Diabetes Care is committed to helping people with diabetes live lives that are as normal and active as possible and helping healthcare professionals manage their patients' condition in an optimal way. The ACCU-CHEK® portfolio-from blood glucose monitoring through information management to insulin delivery - offers innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Maintenance Specialist , you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.

You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

The opportunity :

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Who you are:
Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies a

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Doing now what patients need next. A pioneer in the development of blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery systems, Roche Diabetes Care is committed to helping people with diabetes live lives that are as normal and active as possible and helping healthcare professionals manage their patients' condition in an optimal way. The ACCU-CHEK® portfolio-from blood glucose monitoring through information management to insulin delivery - offers innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Maintenance Specialist , you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.

You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

The opportunity :

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Who you are:
Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies a

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file du partenaire de voyage

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Patient Journey Partner Lead based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for driving the strategic deployment of the PJP network, ensuring activities generate high-impact value within the Disease Areas aligned with the affiliate's goals and ecosystem priorities. In this role, your absolute priority will be leadership and people empowerment ; you will coach, mentor, and guide a highly diverse and multidisciplinary team, managing a mixed structure spanning both specific geographic territories and key therapeutic areas.

The Opportunity

• Take direct accountability for the deployment of PJPs, ensuring their activities generate high-impact value aligned with strategic goals and ecosystem priorities.

• Diagnose individual capability needs, provide tailored field coaching, and empower PJPs to experiment boldly, remove operational roadblocks, and become self-reliant.

• Architect up-to-date competency models, design comprehensive onboarding and learning roadmaps, and foster a continuous learning culture across the network.

• Catalyze cross-functional ecosystems to form self-sufficient "pods" that share business ideas, assess impacts, and prioritize initiatives based on deep patient journey insights.

• Help teams clearly define their purpose, develop effective operational rituals (such as impact retrospectives), and leverage agile methodologies to drive organizational growth.

• Foster a culture of trust and psychological safety, supporting an environment where teams can give and receive continuous feedback to scale value across the enterprise.

Who you are

• University degree in Science, Economics, Business, or related disciplines; an advanced life science degree or an MBA is considered a strong plus.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex stakeholder engagement, with a strong priority on exceptional people leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability and resilience to lead, inspire, and manage highly diverse professional teams (including physicians, biologists, accountants, and lawyers across various ages and seniorities).

• Strong command of agile ways of working, system thinking, data-driven mindset, and a proactive approach to experimenting and learning from failures.

• Fluent in Spanish with a high proficiency in English, enabling effective collaboration and knowledge-sharing across the broader Roche global enterprise.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Partner di Viaggio Paziente con sede a Buenos Aires, sarai responsabile della guida dell'implementazione strategica della rete PJP, assicurando che le attività generino valore ad alto impatto all'interno delle aree Malattie allineate agli obiettivi e alle priorità dell'ecosistema della filiale. In questo ruolo, la vostra assoluta priorità sarà la leadership e l'empowerment delle persone; sarà coach, mentore, e guidare un team altamente diversificato e multidisciplinare, la gestione di una struttura mista che comprende sia specifici territori geografici che aree terapeutiche chiave. L'opportunità
• Prendere la responsabilità diretta per l'implementazione dei PJP, assicurando che le loro attività generino un valore ad alto impatto allineato con obiettivi strategici e priorità dell'ecosistema.
• Diagnosi delle esigenze delle capacità individuali, fornire allenamenti su misura del campo, e consentire ai PJP di sperimentare in modo audace, rimuovere i blocchi stradali operativi e diventare autosufficienti.
• Architetto modelli di competenze aggiornate, progettazione completa onboarding e roadmap di apprendimento, e promuovere una cultura di apprendimento continua in tutta la rete.
• Catalizzare gli ecosistemi interfunzionali per formare "podi" autosufficienti che condividono idee di business, valutare gli impatti e priorità iniziative basate su approfondimenti di viaggio dei pazienti.
• Aiuta i team a definire chiaramente il loro scopo, sviluppare rituali operativi efficaci (come retrospettive di impatto), e sfruttare metodologie agili per guidare la crescita organizzativa.
• Promuovere una cultura di fiducia e sicurezza psicologica, sostenendo un ambiente in cui i team possono dare e ricevere feedback continui per valorizzare l'impresa. Chi sei
• Laurea in Scienze, Economia, Business o discipline correlate; una laurea in scienze della vita avanzata o un MBA è considerato un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza comprovata leader di team interfunzionali e gestione di complessi stakeholder engagement, con una forte priorità sulle eccezionali capacità di leadership delle persone.
• Capacità dimostrata e resilienza di guidare, ispirare e gestire team professionali altamente diversi (compresi medici, biologi, contabili e avvocati di varie età e anziani).
• Forte comando di modi agili di lavoro, pensiero di sistema, data-driven mindset, e un approccio proattivo per sperimentare e imparare dai fallimenti.
• Fluente in spagnolo con un'alta competenza in inglese, consentendo una collaborazione efficace e condivisione della conoscenza attraverso l'impresa globale Roche più ampia. Non sono offerti benefici di trasferimento per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Übernahme direkter Rechenschaftspflicht für den Einsatz von PJPs, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Aktivitäten einen hohen Wert generieren, der mit strategischen Zielen und Ökosystemprioritäten in Einklang steht.

• Pflegen Sie eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der psychologischen Sicherheit und unterstützen Sie ein Umfeld, in dem Teams kontinuierliches Feedback geben und erhalten können, um den Wert im gesamten Unternehmen zu skalieren. Wer du bist
• Universitätsabschluss in Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Wirtschaft oder verwandten Disziplinen; ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss oder ein MBA gilt als starkes Plus.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partenaire de voyage de patients, basé à Buenos Aires, vous serez responsable du déploiement stratégique du réseau PJP, garantissant que les activités génèrent une valeur élevée dans les zones de maladies alignées sur les objectifs et les priorités écosystémiques de l'affilié. Dans ce rôle, votre priorité absolue sera le leadership et l'autonomisation des personnes ; vous entraînerez, mentorerez et guiderez une équipe multidisciplinaire et très diversifiée, gérant une structure mixte couvrant à la fois des territoires géographiques spécifiques et des domaines thérapeutiques clés. L'opportunité
• Rendre compte directement du déploiement des PJP, en veillant à ce que leurs activités produisent une valeur à impact élevé conforme aux objectifs stratégiques et aux priorités des écosystèmes.
• Diagnostiquer les besoins individuels en matière de capacités, fournir un encadrement sur mesure et permettre aux PJP d'expérimenter avec hardiesse, d'éliminer les obstacles opérationnels et de devenir autonomes.
• Architecter des modèles de compétences à jour, concevoir des feuilles de route complètes pour l'embarquement et l'apprentissage et favoriser une culture d'apprentissage continu dans tout le réseau.
• Catalysez les écosystèmes interfonctionnels pour former des « pods » autosuffisants qui partagent des idées d'affaires, évaluent les impacts et priorisent les initiatives en fonction de connaissances approfondies sur le cheminement des patients.
• Aider les équipes à définir clairement leur but, à élaborer des rituels opérationnels efficaces (tels que les rétrospectives d'impact) et à tirer parti des méthodologies agiles pour stimuler la croissance organisationnelle.
• Favoriser une culture de confiance et de sécurité psychologique, en soutenant un environnement où les équipes peuvent donner et recevoir une rétroaction continue à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire en sciences, économie, affaires ou disciplines connexes; un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie ou un MBA est considéré comme un plus fort.
• Expérience éprouvée de la direction d'équipes interfonctionnelles et de la gestion d'engagements complexes des intervenants, avec une forte priorité sur les compétences exceptionnelles en leadership des personnes.
• Capacité et résilience démontrées pour diriger, inspirer et gérer des équipes professionnelles très diversifiées (y compris les médecins, les biologistes, les comptables et les avocats de divers âges et anciennetés).
• Forte maîtrise des méthodes de travail agiles, de la pensée du système, de l'état d'esprit axé sur les données et d'une approche proactive de l'expérimentation et de l'apprentissage des échecs.
• En espagnol avec une haute maîtrise de l'anglais, permettant une collaboration efficace et le partage des connaissances dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise mondiale Roche. Aucune indemnité de réinstallation n'est offerte pour ce poste. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

The Position
La Oportunidad

El Analista de Inteligencia de Servicio será el encargado de asegurar el ciclo de vida operativo y la trazabilidad de los instrumentos de la compañía. Su responsabilidad abarca desde la gestión integral del Instrument Handling (instalación, documentación, capitalización y alta en plataformas internas), hasta la regularización y optimización de la base instalada. Asimismo, fungirá como el nodo central para la recepción, gestión y ejecución de notificaciones críticas de fábrica (SBN, QN, SN, MN), garantizando que los equipos en campo cuenten con las actualizaciones y modificaciones necesarias para maximizar su tiempo de actividad (uptime).

Responsabilidades:

• Coordinar y dar seguimiento al proceso completo de instalación de nuevos equipos.

• Asegurar el correcto flujo y resguardo de la documentación de instalación.

• Gestionar el proceso de capitalización de los instrumentos de acuerdo con las políticas financieras y operativas de la empresa.

• Mantener actualizada, depurada y concisa la base de datos de los equipos en campo.

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente - Oncología & Oncohematología (Neuquén)
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de voyage patient - Oncología & Oncohematología (Neuquén)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner basado en Neuquén y con cobertura en la zona Sur del país, serás responsable de generar valor a lo largo de todo el recorrido del paciente en las áreas de Oncología y Oncohematología. En este rol híbrido, navegarás de manera transversal entre las funciones Médica, de Acceso y Comercial, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con el Healthcare System Partner (HSP) de la zona para co-crear soluciones integrales, acelerar el acceso a la innovación en productos de alto costo y asegurar mejores resultados de salud para la comunidad local.

The Opportunity

• Actuar como el socio de confianza y punto primario de contacto entre los actores clave del ecosistema de salud del Sur del país y Roche para mejorar de manera integral la experiencia del paciente.

• Trabajar de forma proactiva y en sinergia con el HSP (Healthcare System Partner) local y los equipos multifuncionales de la zona para alinear estrategias en común y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos propuestos.

• Identificar barreras críticas en el diagnóstico y tratamiento de patologías oncológicas y oncohematológicas, implementando iniciativas que optimicen el viaje del paciente.

• Incorporar la perspectiva y tendencias del mercado externo del Sur para enriquecer las estrategias de acceso y comercialización de soluciones y productos de alto costo de la compañía.

• Fomentar un modelo de relacionamiento basado en la confianza mutua y la transparencia con instituciones, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión del ecosistema regional.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Ciencias Económicas, Empresariales o afines; contar con un posgrado en salud o MBA será especialmente valorado.

• Experiencia previa comprobable en roles científicos, comerciales, de acceso o de cara al cliente dentro de la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica.

• Conocimiento sólido y experiencia en las áreas terapéuticas de Oncología y/o Oncohematología, demostrando afinidad y manejo previo en carteras de productos de alto costo.

• Alta adaptabilidad para integrarse rápidamente a dinámicas de trabajo colaborativas en terreno, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia en redes.

• Manejo de metodologías de trabajo ágiles, mentalidad de crecimiento, proactividad y dominio intermedio/avanzado del idioma inglés.

• Radicación en la ciudad de Neuquén y disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente dentro de la zona Sur asignada.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Cross AT (Neuquén)

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente - Cross AT (Neuquén)
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de voyage patient - Cross AT (Neuquén)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner basado en Neuquén , serás responsable de gestionar de manera integral el recorrido de los pacientes para un portafolio diversificado que abarca Atrofia Muscular Espinal (AME), Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia. Actuando de forma transversal entre las funciones Médica, de Acceso y Comercial, tu misión será adaptarte ágilmente a los equipos de terreno, identificar oportunidades críticas en el ecosistema regional y asegurar el acceso ágil a tratamientos de alto costo y alta complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Liderar de punta a punta las iniciativas orientadas al paciente para un portafolio multiobjetivo de alta especialidad (AME, Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia) en el Sur argentino.

• Integrarse de manera fluida y veloz a los equipos de soporte y colaboradores de terreno de la zona para potenciar el alcance de los objetivos estratégicos propuestos.

• Construir relaciones de largo plazo y valor agregado con especialistas médicos, sociedades científicas regionales y financiadores clave de la salud en la zona Sur.

• Diseñar e implementar soluciones innovadoras que superen las barreras geográficas y de infraestructura locales para agilizar el diagnóstico y la entrega de productos de alto costo.

• Capturar insights valiosos del mercado y tendencias emergentes para alimentar la planificación y asignación estratégica de recursos en la subregión.

Who you are

• Profesional universitario graduado en carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas, Economía o afines.

• Experiencia sólida y comprobable gestionando carteras de medicamentos o soluciones de alta complejidad y productos de alto costo.

• Conocimiento técnico o experiencia previa en algunas de las especialidades del puesto (AME/Enfermedades Poco Frecuentes, Neurología, Oftalmología o Hemofilia).

• Excelente capacidad para adaptarse ágilmente al trabajo en equipo, autogestión y resiliencia para manejarse en entornos geográficamente dispersos.

• Pensamiento estratégico, habilidades digitales orientadas a la omnicanalidad y dominio del idioma inglés.

• Radicación efectiva en la ciudad de Neuquén y disponibilidad para viajar en la región Sur según las necesidades de la posición.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Como Patient Journey Partner para la Provincia de Buenos Aires, asumirás un rol estratégico de alto impacto destinado a reforzar el ecosistema de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito principal será actuar como un catalizador en el terreno bonaerense, fusionando las perspectivas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para preparar el mercado, acelerar la adopción de nuestra innovación diagnóstica/terapéutica y asegurar que los pacientes accedan a soluciones críticas en el menor tiempo posible.

The Opportunity

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de campo para el recorrido del paciente en el marco del próximo lanzamiento y la fase de expansión de Nefritis Lúpica en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Identificar, mapear y priorizar de manera temprana los centros de referencia, redes de derivación y stakeholders clave (nefrólogos, reumatólogos y comités de auditoría) en PBA.

• Desarrollar e implementar planes de valor que faciliten el diagnóstico temprano de la patología y agilicen los procesos de cobertura y acceso al tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos internos de Marketing, Asuntos Médicos y Acceso para asegurar la consistencia del posicionamiento de la marca durante el lanzamiento.

• Monitorear y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas desplegadas en el terreno, pivotando ágilmente las tácticas comerciales y médicas para maximizar el éxito en la expansión del portafolio.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras como Bioquímica, Medicina, Farmacia, Comercialización, Administración de Empresas o disciplinas afines al negocio de la salud.

• Experiencia sólida previa en la gestión de lanzamientos de productos biológicos, terapias especiales o soluciones de alta complejidad en la industria de la salud.

• Conocimiento del mercado e instituciones de salud públicas y privadas presentes en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Mentalidad fuertemente emprendedora ( Growth Mindset ), orientación a resultados de negocio y pasión por la innovación disruptiva enfocada en el paciente.

• Excelentes capacidades de comunicación persuasiva, habilidades de negociación estratégica y fluidez intermedia/avanzada en inglés.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner con cobertura en la región del Litoral, serás responsable de liderar y desplegar la estrategia enfocada en el recorrido del paciente para el área terapéutica de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito será navegar de forma transversal entre las áreas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para derribar las barreras del sistema de salud regional, co-diseñando soluciones innovadoras con los actores clave del ecosistema litoraleño que aceleren el acceso oportuno al tratamiento y mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Establecer un canal de comunicación directo y de confianza con nefrólogos, reumatólogos, instituciones de salud y tomadores de decisión en la región del Litoral para optimizar el recorrido del paciente con Nefritis Lúpica.

• Mapear y diagnosticar las brechas críticas del sistema de salud local en el abordaje de la patología, promoviendo el valor médico y científico del portafolio de Roche.

• Co-crear e implementar iniciativas y soluciones de acceso y comerciales que simplifiquen los procesos de derivación, diagnóstico temprano y continuidad del tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con redes transversales internas y squads regionales para integrar las perspectivas específicas del Litoral dentro de las tácticas nacionales de la filial.

• Identificar y priorizar aquellas oportunidades y ecosistemas locales que generen un impacto médico y social sostenible en el tiempo.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Ciencias Económicas, Empresariales o disciplinas afines.

• Trayectoria demostrable en posiciones de cara al cliente dentro del mercado de la salud (especialista de producto, acceso, relaciones institucionales o áreas médicas).

• Conocimiento o experiencia previa en el manejo de enfermedades autoinmunes, nefrología o reumatología será altamente considerado para este desafío.

• Sólida visión de negocios combinada con un genuino interés por la experiencia del cliente y la excelencia médica.

• Habilidades avanzadas de comunicación, pensamiento sistémico y familiaridad con metodologías ágiles de trabajo.

• Residencia en una ciudad principal de la zona del Litoral y plena disponibilidad para viajar por la región.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Quality Control Technician , you will perform routine and non-routine testing and inspection of our products, raw materials, and formulations to ensure strict compliance with quality specifications. Working under general supervision, you will maintain laboratory equipment and help continuously improve our quality systems through meticulous data review and collaborative problem-solving.

• Perform analysis of raw materials, in-process materials, finished formulations, and customer-returned products using validated software and standard operating procedures.

• Calibrate and maintain laboratory equipment and test stands to ensure proper operation and execute preventative maintenance procedures.

• Compile and review data obtained during biochemical assays, stability programs, and formulation studies to ensure absolute compliance with specifications and report abnormalities.

• Participate in investigations , summaries, and reports, while actively contributing to special projects focused on analytical problem-solving and process improvement.

• Revise and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) and potentially assist in developing new testing methods as required.

• Collaborate with peers and internal stakeholders to achieve daily quality objectives and uphold the integrity of the company's quality system.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma or equivalency required (Bachelor’s degree in a scientific field preferred).

• 1+ year of experience working in a laboratory, technical, or scientific environment, ideally within a regulated industry.

• Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

• Highly detail-oriented with the ability to perform basic mathematical calculations and exercise sound judgment within defined practices.

• Proficient computer skills , including standard software packages (Word and Excel), with exposure to SAP or Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELN) considered a plus.

• Thorough understanding of appropriate laboratory safety procedures and a commitment to maintaining quality standards.

• Exposure to process improvement methodologies is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in scientific field

• Intermediate computer knowledge, including basic understanding of Microsoft Office software, SAP, Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN)

• 1+ year experience working in laboratory environment

• 1+ year technical or scientific experience

• 1+ year experience working in a regulatory environment

• 1+ year experience with process improvement

This is an on-site position.
Relocation benefits are not approved for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is $42,700.00 - $79,300.00 . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detaile d in this link.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.
Como Gerente de Inteligência Comercial , você será o motor estratégico e preditivo do RocheON, transformando dados de mercado, cenários macroeconômicos e performance em inteligência competitiva de alto nível para suportar toda a operação comercial. Como líder, guardião e arquiteto da governança, compliance e parametrização da área, sua missão será conectar os insights de alto valor gerados pelos núcleos operacionais e de distribuição às decisões do time e da Estratégia Comercial, garantindo a viabilidade comercial de ponta a ponta.
Seu foco será orquestrar os processos de Previsão de Vendas, Comitê Comercial e a arquitetura de ferramentas preditivas, mitigando riscos corporativos e assegurando soluções sustentáveis alinhadas à aceleração das inovações da companhia, além de liderar estratégias de uso de Inteligência Artificial para impulsionar a eficiência do negócio.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Responsável por consolidar análises macroeconômicas e inputs de inteligência de mercado para criar e apresentar reportes executivos de performance direcionados ao C-Level, indicando preventivamente mudanças de rota estratégicas.

• Atuar como o elo de conexão estratégico entre as oportunidades mapeadas na ponta (Ecossistema de Saúde Suplementar e Distribuição) e a área de Estratégia Comercial, apoiando no desenho estrutural e viabilidade financeira de novas políticas para todo o portfólio.

• Liderar estratégias no Comitê Comercial, validando a estrutura conceitual, os resultados analíticos e as visões consolidadas de venda e demanda levadas ao nível diretivo.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Writer – São Paulo, Brazil
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the peop le we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Technical Writer, you will be the focal point for Roche to research, develop, write, and edit technical and informational materials for various organizational need publications (including product labels, package inserts, instrument manuals, price lists, application sheets, customer bulletins and letters, online help text, instrument calibrator and parameter diskettes, or other electronic docume ntation and miscellaneous publications for both internal and external customer usage). You will collaborate with medical subject matter experts to ensure the accuracy of the medical content, ensuring all materials meet established global and country standards as to appearance, content, and compliance with applicable government policies, procedures, and regulations, while permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards. Along with your application, please submit a technical writing sample explaining how to use public transportation in your city for foreigners visiting for the first time (you can select the starting point and destination). This sample will be used to assess your technical writing skills.

About the opportunity:

• Write and update customer-facing and service content in English for Roche instruments and software, respecting project timelines, documentation standards, guidelines, and templates.

• Gather and consolidate information for technical content creation independently, working closely with content/project managers, project teams, manufacturers, and development/GCS teams locally and globally.

• Act as a cross-functional expert with the UX department and Terminologist to create English UI text, reviewing them for translatability, terminological correctness, and style adherence.

• Contribute actively to the risk assessment process for assigned products, ensuring all relevant product risks and their mitigations are clearly described in the documentation.

• Create target language versions of deliverables after translation (all formats), managing external translation agencies and coordinating the review process with affiliates.

• Perform peer reviews on documents or topics written by other technical writers, ensuring adherence to terminology and content guidelines while providing constructive feedback.

• Create and modify multimedia content independently (photographs, screenshots, videos, 3D graphics, diagrams) using appropriate software tools, or coordinate their creation and integration.

• Handle smaller content management tasks (like organizing reviews), assist Language Operations with translation management, and contribute to updating tools, processes, and standards.

Who you are:

• A professional with a self-starting mindset, strong ownership, high efficiency, creativity, and the ability to work independently in a highly regulated, complex matrix environment.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, sharp attention to detail, compliance, and deep practical knowledge of FDA regulations, quality system guidelines, ISO, and industry standards.

• Experienced in using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools within your professional daily routine.

• Capable of acting as a terminologist: creatin

La posizione Scrittore tecnico – San Paolo, Brasile Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con la peop le che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche. Come Scrittore Tecnico, sarai il punto focale per Roche per la ricerca, lo sviluppo, la scrittura e la modifica di materiali tecnici e informativi per varie pubblicazioni organizzative (comprese le etichette dei prodotti, gli inserti dei pacchetti, i manuali degli strumenti, i listini dei prezzi, i fogli delle applicazioni, i bollettini dei clienti e le lettere, il testo di aiuto online, il calibratore degli strumenti e le dische dei parametri, o altre pubblicazioni elettroniche docume ntation e varie per l'usorie per uso del cliente). Collaborerai con esperti di materia medica per garantire l'accuratezza dei contenuti medici, assicurando che tutti i materiali soddisfino gli standard globali e nazionali stabiliti per quanto riguarda l'aspetto, il contenuto e il rispetto delle politiche, delle procedure e delle normative vigenti, ottimizzando in modo permanente i processi per aumentare la qualità e gli standard di efficienza. Insieme alla vostra domanda, si prega di presentare un campione di scrittura tecnica che spiega come utilizzare i trasporti pubblici nella vostra città per gli stranieri che visitano per la prima volta (è possibile selezionare il punto di partenza e la destinazione). Questo campione sarà utilizzato per valutare le vostre abilità di scrittura tecnica. Informazioni sull'opportunitÃ:
• Scrivere e aggiornare i contenuti dei clienti e dei servizi in inglese per strumenti e software Roche, nel rispetto dei tempi di progetto, standard di documentazione, linee guida e modelli.
• Raccogliere e consolidare le informazioni per la creazione di contenuti tecnici in modo indipendente, lavorando a stretto contatto con content/project manager, team di progetto, produttori e team di sviluppo/GCS a livello locale e globale.
• Agire come esperto interfunzionale con il dipartimento UX e Terminologist per creare testo inglese UI, rivedendoli per traslatabilità, correttezza terminologica e aderenza di stile.
• Contribuisci attivamente al processo di valutazione del rischio per i prodotti assegnati, assicurando che tutti i rischi rilevanti del prodotto e le loro mitigazioni siano chiaramente descritti nella documentazione.
• Creare versioni di lingua di destinazione dei consegnabili dopo la traduzione (tutti i formati), gestire le agenzie di traduzione esterne e coordinare il processo di revisione con le affiliate.
• Esegui recensioni peer su documenti o argomenti scritti da altri scrittori tecnici, assicurando l'adesione alla terminologia e alle linee guida dei contenuti, fornendo feedback costruttivi.
• Creare e modificare contenuti multimediali in modo indipendente (fotografi, screenshot, video, grafica 3D, diagrammi) utilizzando strumenti software appropriati, o coordinare la loro creazione e integrazione.
• Gestire le attività di gestione dei contenuti più piccole (come l'organizzazione di recensioni), assistere le operazioni linguistiche con la gestione della traduzione e contribuire ad aggiornare strumenti, processi e standard. Chi sei:
• Un professionista con un self-starting mentalità, forte proprietà, alta efficienza, creatività, e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente di matrice altamente regolamentato e complesso.
• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto, attenzione a dettagli, conformità e profonda conoscenza pratica delle normative FDA, linee guida del sistema di qualità, ISO e standard del settore.
• Esperienza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale (AI) all'interno della vostra routine quotidiana professionale.
• Capace di agire come terminologo: creatina

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through seamless, secure, and authenticated access. As a Junior Web Access Management Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage and secure our web application access controls and identity federation systems. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies, and API gateway access run without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex application security infrastructures while contributing to the automation and optimization of secure access workflows.

Job Responsibilities
Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of enterprise IAM and Web Access Control (WAC) platforms (such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, or Auth0), including basic policy management and standard troubleshooting.

• Assist in integrating applications with central Identity Providers (IdPs) using standard authentication and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).

• Support the deployment, monitoring, and validation of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) mechanisms, including TOTP, security keys (FIDO2/WebAuthn), and passwordless authentication methods.

• Participate in the automation of routine access management tasks, user provisioning policies (such as JIT or basic SCIM setups), and configuration management using Version Control systems and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot session management anomalies, token validation (JWT) issues, and secure communications across web server and API gateway environments.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine application access configuration and user lifecycle tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and runbooks for application integrations and access management lifecycles.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and validate authentication tokens, access policies, and application gateways across diverse staging and production environments.

Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting authentication and access issues, and engage to senior team members for complex IAM anomalies .

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies (such as manual provisioning friction) and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily integration requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

Business/Technical Ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain and supporting web access technologies.

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors (such as compliance, user friction, and security threats) affecting the secure web access space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic access management problems or opportunities holistically.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, junior Web Development, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on web development, infrastructure, or Identity and Access Managem

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Al centro della nostra sicurezza digitale è la fiducia che costruiamo attraverso l'accesso senza soluzione di continuità, sicuro e autenticato. In qualità di Junior Web Access Management Engineer, ti unirai al nostro team Identity and Access Management (IAM) per aiutare a gestire e proteggere i nostri controlli di accesso alle applicazioni web e i sistemi di federazione di identità. Sarete strumentali nel garantire che le nostre integrazioni Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) e accesso gateway API funzionano senza un hitch. Questo è un ruolo orientato alla crescita in cui imparerai a navigare in complesse infrastrutture di sicurezza delle applicazioni, contribuendo all'automazione e all'ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro di accesso sicuri. Responsabilità del lavoro Ambito
• Supporta l'amministrazione quotidiana delle piattaforme IAM e Web Access Control (WAC) aziendali (come Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, o Auth0), inclusa la gestione delle policy di base e la risoluzione dei problemi standard.
• Assistere nell'integrazione di applicazioni con provider di identità centrali (IdPs) utilizzando protocolli di autenticazione e autorizzazione standard, tra cui SAML, OAuth 2.0 e OpenID Connect (OIDC).
• Supporta l'implementazione, il monitoraggio e la convalida dei meccanismi di autenticazione Multi-Factor (MFA), inclusi TOTP, chiavi di sicurezza (FIDO2/WebAuthn), e metodi di autenticazione senza password.
• Partecipare all'automazione delle attività di gestione degli accessi di routine, alle politiche di provisioning degli utenti (come le configurazioni JIT o SCIM di base), e alla gestione della configurazione utilizzando i sistemi e gli script di Version Control (PowerShell, Bash, o Python).
• Collabora con gli ingegneri senior per risolvere le anomalie della gestione delle sessioni, i problemi di convalida dei token (JWT) e le comunicazioni sicure in ambienti web server e gateway API. Impatto/Strategia
• Collaborare nell'automazione della configurazione di accesso alle applicazioni di routine e delle attività del ciclo di vita degli utenti utilizzando lo scripting di base (PowerShell, Python o Bash) e mantenere gli script utilizzando i sistemi di controllo delle versioni.
• Assistere nel mantenimento di wiki interne del team, procedure operative standard (SOP), e runbook per le integrazioni delle applicazioni e i cicli di gestione degli accessi.
• Collabora con gli ingegneri senior per tracciare, distribuire e convalidare i token di autenticazione, le politiche di accesso e i gateway applicativi in diversi ambienti di allestimento e produzione. Complessità
• Si concentra principalmente sull'esecuzione di procedure definite, la risoluzione dei problemi di autenticazione e di accesso, e si impegna a membri del team senior per anomalie complesse IAM .
• Contribuisce all'agilità del team identificando inefficienze operative (come l'attrito di provisioning manuale) e proponendo miglioramenti di processo minori all'interno delle attività quotidiane immediate.
• Dimostra una crescente autonomia all'interno del dominio specifico traducendo i requisiti di integrazione quotidiana in compiti strutturati sotto la supervisione diretta. Capacità commerciale/tecnica
• Possede una conoscenza operativa del dominio Identity and Access Management (IAM) e supporta le tecnologie di accesso web.
• Comprende fonti di influenza, comprensione di fattori interni ed esterni (come la conformità, l'attrito utente e le minacce di sicurezza) che influenzano lo spazio di accesso web sicuro, ed è in grado di identificare e analizzare i problemi di gestione di accesso di base o le opportunità olistiche. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Esperienza: 1–2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, junior Web Development, o junior Security Operations (SOC). Uno stage focalizzato sullo sviluppo web, l'infrastruttura, o Identity and Access Managem

• Soutenir l'administration quotidienne des plateformes IAM et Web Access Control (WAC) d'entreprise (comme Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity ou Auth0), y compris la gestion des politiques de base et le dépannage standard.
• Aider à intégrer les applications avec les fournisseurs d'identité centraux (IDP) en utilisant des protocoles d'authentification et d'autorisation standard, y compris SAML, OAuth 2.0 et OpenID Connect (OIDC).
• Soutenir le déploiement, la surveillance et la validation des mécanismes d'authentification multi-facteurs (MFA), y compris TOTP, les clés de sécurité (FIDO2/WebAuthn), et les méthodes d'authentification sans mot de passe.
• Participez à l'automatisation des tâches de gestion d'accès de routine, des politiques de provisionnement des utilisateurs (comme les configurations JIT ou SCIM de base) et de la gestion de configuration à l'aide de systèmes de contrôle de version et de scripts (PowerShell, Bash ou Python).
• Collaborer avec les ingénieurs supérieurs pour résoudre les anomalies de gestion de session, les problèmes de validation de jeton (JWT) et sécuriser les communications entre les environnements de serveur Web et de passerelle API. Impact/stratégie
• Collaborez à l'automatisation de la configuration d'accès d'application de routine et des tâches du cycle de vie de l'utilisateur en utilisant des scripts de base (PowerShell, Python ou Bash) et maintenez des scripts en utilisant des systèmes de contrôle de version.
• Aider à maintenir les wikis internes de l'équipe, les procédures d'exploitation standard (SOP) et les runbooks pour les intégrations d'applications et les cycles de vie de gestion d'accès.
• Collaborer avec des ingénieurs chevronnés pour acheminer, distribuer et valider les jetons d'authentification, les politiques d'accès et les passerelles d'application dans divers environnements de mise en scène et de production. Complexité
• Se concentre principalement sur l'exécution de procédures définies, le dépannage des problèmes d'authentification et d'accès, et s'engage auprès des membres de l'équipe senior pour les anomalies complexes IAM .
• Contribue à l'agilité de l'équipe en identifiant les inefficacités opérationnelles (comme les frictions manuelles de fourniture) et en proposant des améliorations mineures dans le cadre des tâches quotidiennes immédiates.
• Démontre une autonomie croissante dans le domaine spécifique en traduisant les exigences quotidiennes d'intégration en tâches structurées sous supervision directe. Capacités commerciales et techniques
• Possède une connaissance pratique du domaine Identity and Access Management (IAM) et des technologies d'accès au Web.
• Comprendre les sources d'influence, comprendre les facteurs internes et externes (comme la conformité, les frictions des utilisateurs et les menaces pour la sécurité) qui affectent l'espace d'accès sécurisé sur le Web, et est capable d'identifier et d'analyser de façon holistique les problèmes ou les possibilités de gestion de l'accès de base. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• Expérience : de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans un service d'assistance informatique, l'administration des systèmes, le développement de sites Web juniors ou des opérations de sécurité juniors. Un stage axé sur le développement web, l'infrastructure ou la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès
