jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise.

The Opportunity
This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise.

Your Responsibilities

• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards

• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities

• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders

• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies

• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions

• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback

• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions

• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery

• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space

• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards

• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement

• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices

Who You Are

Technology Skills & Experience

• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired

• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices

• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs

• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired

• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus

Core Competencies & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas

• 2+ years working in a multinational environment as an Engineer or Te

• MBA o altro corso di laurea o post-laurea rilevante è preferito
• Esperienza rilevante nella strategia commerciale commerciale, nella vendita di soluzioni, nella salute digitale, nella diagnostica, nella tecnologia sanitaria, nella commercializzazione dei prodotti, nei ruoli commerciali o commerciali.
• L'esperienza nella diagnostica è preferita
• Esperienza in team leader, coaching e sviluppo, sia attraverso la gestione diretta o in una forte capacità di leadership matrice.
• Fluente inglese scritto e verbale, lo spagnolo è un plus
• Prove capacità di lavorare in un ambiente in continua evoluzione in modo agile
• Forte orientamento/attenzione del cliente
• Disponibilità per viaggiare circa il 50% del tempo

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As Head of Integrated Solutions you will be responsible for driving the integrated solution strategy for Brazil by leading the design and selling of tailor made offerings to existing and new customers. At the same time, you will be responsible for the commercial operations of digital solutions sales, leading both Roche Healthcare Consulting and Roche Information Solutions teams.

Define integrated solutions strategy across all customer areas, develop market and provide skills, tools and equip commercial teams on selling tailor made solutions to customers, ensuring that the affiliate systematically embed digital products into commercial frameworks. Defining the unique selling propositions to differentiate the solutions against other suppliers and personalized to the customer type.

You will also be responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring the marketing activities of Integrated solutions. Focus on the business development, sales and sustainability of the business for digital solutions in healthcare. As well as establish the strategic framework, design, and organizational structure for Roche Healthcare Consulting to drive execution. Focusing on accelerating project loyalty and enhancing the conversion for new business opportunities.

The Opportunity:

• Lead, manage and develop solution marketing concept cross business areas;

• Drive the commercial shift from product-centric marketing to highly integrated, differentiating enterprise solution-selling frameworks.

• Identify new opportunities that could drive business growth, including new revenue streams and business models;

• Define and implement commercial strategy for solutions;

• Define pricing models together with local finance team;

• Develop go to market strategy for digital diagnostics solutions;

• Take commercial responsibility for increasing market share and sales.

• Provide direction, develop strategies and co-create innovative consultancy services to meet our customers demands and position Roche as a true partner in Healthcare.

• People leader to the Integrated Solutions chapter, being a sparring partner and coach to enhance their skills, personal development and increase impact

• Deliver value to our clients by providing strategic consultancy advice through projects, both within and beyond the lab

• Leverage all existing/new initiatives globally to ensure best practice sharing;

• Foster collaboration to identify synergies between the areas of expertise that could upgrade the solutions proposal;

• Collaborate with global and regional teams on customer projects, commercialization models and R&D strategies.

Who you are:

• University degree in Life Science, Marketing, Business Management or Engineering

• MBA or other relevant graduate or postgraduate degree is preferred

• Relevant experience in commercial commercial strategy, solution selling, digital health, diagnostics, healthcare technology, product commercialization, go-to-market, or commercial roles.

• Experience in diagnostics is preferred

• Experience in leading, coaching, and developing teams, either through direct management or in a strong matrix leadership capacity.

• Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish is a plus

• Proven ability to work in an ever changing environment in an agile manner

• Strong customer orientation/focus

• Availability to travel about 50% of the time

• Availability to work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Who we are
A heal

Gleichzeitig sind Sie für den kommerziellen Betrieb des Vertriebs digitaler Lösungen verantwortlich und leiten sowohl die Teams von Roche Healthcare Consulting als auch von Roche Information Solutions. La position En tant que responsable des solutions intégrées, vous serez responsable de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de solutions intégrées pour le Brésil en dirigeant la conception et la vente d'offres sur mesure aux clients existants et nouveaux. En même temps, vous serez responsable des opérations commerciales des ventes de solutions numériques, dirigeant à la fois Roche Healthcare Consulting et Roche Information Solutions. Se concentrer sur le développement de l'entreprise, les ventes et la durabilité de l'entreprise pour des solutions numériques dans les soins de santé. En plus d'établir le cadre stratégique, la conception et la structure organisationnelle de Roche Healthcare Consulting pour conduire l'exécution. • Diriger, gérer et développer le concept de commercialisation des solutions entre les secteurs d'activité;
• Conduire le passage commercial du marketing axé sur les produits à des cadres de vente de solutions d'entreprise hautement intégrés et différenciés.
• Identifier de nouvelles possibilités qui pourraient stimuler la croissance des entreprises, y compris de nouvelles sources de revenus et de nouveaux modèles d'affaires;
• Définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie commerciale de solutions;
• Définir des modèles de tarification avec l'équipe financière locale;
• Élaborer une stratégie de marché pour les solutions de diagnostic numérique;
• Prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'accroître la part de marché et les ventes.
• Fournir une orientation, développer des stratégies et co-créer des services de conseil innovants pour répondre aux demandes de nos clients et positionner Roche comme un véritable partenaire dans le domaine de la santé.
• Chef de file du chapitre Solutions intégrées, partenaire et coach pour améliorer leurs compétences, leur développement personnel et leur impact
• Offrir de la valeur à nos clients en fournissant des conseils stratégiques dans le cadre de projets, tant au sein du laboratoire qu'au-delà
• tirer parti de toutes les initiatives existantes/nouvelles à l'échelle mondiale pour assurer le partage des meilleures pratiques;
• Favoriser la collaboration pour identifier les synergies entre les domaines d'expertise susceptibles d'améliorer la proposition de solutions;
• Collaborer avec les équipes mondiales et régionales sur les projets clients, les modèles de commercialisation et les stratégies de R-D. Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme universitaire en sciences de la vie, marketing, gestion d'entreprise ou en génie
• MBA ou autre diplôme de troisième ou troisième cycle pertinent est préféré
• Expérience pertinente en matière de stratégie commerciale, de vente de solutions, de santé numérique, de diagnostic, de technologie de santé, de commercialisation de produits, de mise en marché ou de rôles commerciaux.
• L'expérience du diagnostic est privilégiée
• Expérience dans la direction, le coaching et le développement d'équipes, soit par la gestion directe, soit dans une solide capacité de leadership matricielle.
• Anglais écrit et verbal, espagnol est un plus
• Capacité éprouvée de travailler dans un environnement en constante évolution de manière agile
• Une forte orientation/orientation du client
• Disponibilité pour voyager environ 50% du temps
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans un modèle hybride basé à São Paulo Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste. Qui nous sommes Une guérison

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roch e.

Como Gerente de Vendas de Distribuição , você será o elo estratégico entre a Roche e o canal de distribuição, atuando na linha de frente por meio de visitas e negociações comerciais. Sua missão será garantir a presença total do portfólio no mercado através da gestão direta de distribuidores, redes de varejo e canais de delivery.
Seu foco será assegurar que o abastecimento seja contínuo e eficiente, eliminando rupturas de estoque para que o paciente tenha acesso imediato ao tratamento, além de garantir o alinhamento e harmonia entre a expedição, o estoque e a venda.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Elaborar as previsões de vendas considerando o cenário de mercado e seus concorrentes, com base em relatórios quantitativos, por cliente, produto e acuracidade do phasing (fluxo de vendas por período).

• Acompa nhar as previsões de vendas durante o período, identificando possíveis divergências e tomando as providências imediatas.

• Realizar a negociação das vendas com os distribuidores de acordo com a política interna vigente e as condições comerciais pré-estabelecidas.

• Cumprir estritamente a estratégia elaborada pelo time do produto.

• Efetuar visitas aos clientes (distribuidores, redes de varejo e deliveries), apresentando estudos sobre demandas x estoque para identificação da necessidade de novas compras ou reposição.

• Gerenciar o processo de vendas diretas ou através de OL (Operação Logística) dentro da sua área de atuação, direcionando e acompanhando a gestão dos clientes.

• Apoiar localmente todo o fluxo do processo de compra, desde a formulação dos pedidos/contrato até o acompanhamento dos níveis de estoque.

• Monitorar os processos de recebimento em parceria direta com a área de crédito e cobrança.

Quem você é:

• Graduação superior completa em Administração de Empresas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Economia, Farmácia, Direito ou outras áreas relacionadas .

• Experiência na área comercial, incluindo conhecimento prático nas práticas comerciais vigentes para o mercado privado e mercado de distribuição.

• Experiência e conhecimento na indústria farmacêutica são mandatórios.

• Esta posição requer base em Salvador (BA) ou Recife (PE).

• Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.

Esta vaga possui um candidato preferencial pré-identificado.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Cumprir estritamente a estratégia elaborada pelo time do produto.
• Efetuar visitas aos clientes (distribuidores, redes de varejo e deliverys), apresentando estudos sobre demandas x estoque para identificação da necessidade de novas compras ou reposição.

• Apoiar localmente todo o fluxo do processo de compra, desde a formulação dos pedidos/contrato até o acompanhamento dos níveis de estoque.
• Monitorar os processos de recebimento em parceria direta com a área de crédito e cobrança. Quem você é:
• Graduação superior completa em Administração de Empresas, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Economia, Farmácia, Direito ou outras áreas relacionadas.
• Experiência na área comercial, incluindo conhecimento prático nas práticas comerciais vigentes para o mercado privado e mercado de distribuição.
• Experiência e conhecimento na indústria farmacêutica são mandatórios.
• Esta posição requer base em Salvador (BA) ou Recife (PE).

Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

jobs.title: Director of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement

titleByLocale.it: Direttore of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement
titleByLocale.en: Director of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement
titleByLocale.de: Direktor of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des services du site, stratégie et activation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a visionary leader ready to drive transformational change at a global scale? The Director of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement will serve as a strategic architect for the Indianapolis Site, translating Roche's global mission into local operational excellence while strengthening our impact on patients, customers, and employees. This highly visible, senior leadership role offers the opportunity to design and execute innovative site strategies, lead a high-performing customer-focused organization, and represent Roche as a trusted partner within the Indiana business community—all while building the operational infrastructure that accelerates progress from vision to measurable outcomes.

The Opportunity

• Develop, execute and maintain long-range strategic planning in collaboration with global standards, identifying opportunities that drive impact and experience locally, regionally, and globally while translating organizational strategy into actionable business goals for a high-performance, customer-focused site organization.

• Direct all site facility and business services in support of the annual business plan and longer-range strategic master plan, engaging senior leaders and driving operational effectiveness through improved technology, data analytics, and digital tools.

• Develop annual and rolling 5-year strategy and site experience budgets with full oversight for spending management, cost reduction identification, and optimization of the site projects portfolio.

• Build and maintain strategic relationships across local and global functions and external community resources, positioning Indianapolis as a strong corporate partner with local, state, and federal organizations while representing Roche's interests and values.

• Partner closely with campus user groups and Procurement to ensure service providers deliver optimal value, proactively negotiate superior services, and evolve service models with agility in response to customer feedback and evolving business needs.

• Select, develop, and evaluate staff to ensure efficient operations, providing coaching, training, and opportunities for skill development while fostering a culture of inclusion, agility, excellence, and transformational leadership.

• Serve as the Process Owner for Site Applications and business services, evaluating and implementing emerging technologies while developing, sharing, and adopting technical innovations, KPIs, and benchmarking information across the global sites network community.

Who You Are

• Minimum of 15+ years of related experience, including 10+ years of Site Operational management or business management experience in a diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry, with demonstrated progressive management and leadership responsibilities.

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (Master's degree in business or relevant professional field preferred).

• Proven experience creating and driving strategic initiatives with demonstrated business agility, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to identify and solve complex problems while managing departmental budgeting and resource utilization.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence and gain credibility and respect from stakeholders across all organizational levels (from employees to executives) and within regulated environments.

• Demonstrated ability to interact and collaborate effectively across all functions and levels of the glo

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei un leader visionario pronto a guidare il cambiamento trasformazionale su scala globale? Il Direttore dei Servizi del Sito, Strategy & Enablement servirà da architetto strategico per il Sito Indianapolis, traducendo la missione globale di Roche nell'eccellenza operativa locale, rafforzando il nostro impatto su pazienti, clienti e dipendenti. Questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile e senior offre l'opportunità di progettare ed eseguire strategie innovative del sito, condurre un'organizzazione focalizzata sul cliente ad alto rendimento e rappresentare Roche come partner affidabile all'interno della comunità aziendale dell'Indiana—tutti mentre la costruzione dell'infrastruttura operativa che accelera il progresso dalla visione ai risultati misurabili. L'opportunità
• Sviluppare, eseguire e mantenere una pianificazione strategica a lungo raggio in collaborazione con gli standard globali, individuando opportunità che spingono l'impatto e l'esperienza a livello locale, regionale e globale, traducendo la strategia organizzativa in obiettivi di business attuabili per un'organizzazione di siti ad alte prestazioni focalizzata sui clienti.
• Dirigere tutte le strutture del sito e i servizi aziendali a sostegno del piano aziendale annuale e del piano di master strategico a più lungo raggio, coinvolgendo i leader senior e guidando l'efficacia operativa attraverso una migliore tecnologia, analisi dei dati e strumenti digitali.
• Sviluppare budget di strategia annuale e rolling 5-year e di esperienza del sito con piena supervisione per la gestione delle spese, l'identificazione della riduzione dei costi e l'ottimizzazione del portafoglio progetti del sito.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni strategiche tra le funzioni locali e globali e le risorse della comunità esterna, posizionando Indianapolis come un forte partner aziendale con le organizzazioni locali, statali e federali, mentre rappresenta gli interessi e i valori di Roche.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gruppi di utenti del campus e Procurement per garantire ai fornitori di servizi di offrire un valore ottimale, negoziare proattivamente servizi superiori, ed evolvere modelli di servizi con agilità in risposta al feedback dei clienti e alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione.
• Selezionare, sviluppare e valutare il personale per garantire operazioni efficienti, fornire coaching, formazione e opportunità di sviluppo delle competenze, promuovendo una cultura di inclusione, agilità, eccellenza e leadership trasformazionale.
• Servire come proprietario di processo per applicazioni del sito e servizi di business, la valutazione e l'attuazione delle tecnologie emergenti, mentre lo sviluppo, la condivisione e l'adozione di innovazioni tecniche, KPI e informazioni di benchmarking in tutta la comunità di rete di siti globali. Chi sei
• Minimo di 15+ anni di esperienza relativa, tra cui 10+ anni di gestione operativa del sito o esperienza di gestione aziendale in un'industria diagnostica, farmaceutica o biotecnologia, con dimostrate responsabilità di gestione progressiva e leadership.
• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operazioni, o un campo relativo (la laurea di Master in business o campo professionale rilevante preferito).
• Prove esperienze di creazione e di guida di iniziative strategiche con agilità aziendale dimostrata, forti capacità di negoziazione, e la capacità di identificare e risolvere problemi complessi, mentre la gestione del budget dipartimentale e l'utilizzo delle risorse.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e presentazione con la capacità di influenzare e guadagnare credibilità e rispetto da parte degli stakeholder di tutti i livelli organizzativi (da dipendenti a dirigenti) e all'interno di ambienti regolamentati.
• Dimostrata capacità di interagire e collaborare efficacemente in tutte le funzioni e livelli del guanto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Sind Sie eine visionäre Führungskraft, die bereit ist, transformative Veränderungen auf globaler Ebene voranzutreiben? Der Director of Site Services, Strategy & Enablement wird als strategischer Architekt für den Standort Indianapolis tätig sein und Roches globale Mission in lokale operative Exzellenz umsetzen und gleichzeitig unsere Auswirkungen auf Patienten, Kunden und Mitarbeiter stärken. Diese sehr sichtbare Führungsrolle bietet die Möglichkeit, innovative Standortstrategien zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, eine leistungsstarke, kundenorientierte Organisation zu leiten und Roche als vertrauenswürdigen Partner innerhalb der Geschäftswelt von Indiana zu vertreten - und dies alles beim Aufbau der operativen Infrastruktur, die den Fortschritt von der Vision zu messbaren Ergebnissen beschleunigt. Die Chance
• Entwicklung, Durchführung und Aufrechterhaltung einer langfristigen strategischen Planung in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Standards, wobei Chancen identifiziert werden, die Auswirkungen und Erfahrungen lokal, regional und global fördern, während die organisatorische Strategie in umsetzbare Geschäftsziele für eine leistungsstarke, kundenorientierte Standortorganisation umgesetzt wird.
• Lenken Sie alle Standorteinrichtungen und Geschäftsdienstleistungen zur Unterstützung des jährlichen Geschäftsplans und des strategischen Masterplans mit größerer Reichweite, engagieren Sie Führungskräfte und steigern Sie die operative Effektivität durch verbesserte Technologien, Datenanalysen und digitale Tools.
• Entwickeln Sie jährliche und rollende 5-Jahres-Strategie- und Site-Experience-Budgets mit vollständiger Aufsicht über das Ausgabenmanagement, die Identifizierung von Kostensenkungen und die Optimierung des Portfolios der Site-Projekte.
• Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Beziehungen über lokale und globale Funktionen und externe Gemeinschaftsressourcen hinweg, wobei Indianapolis als starker Unternehmenspartner mit lokalen, staatlichen und föderalen Organisationen positioniert wird und gleichzeitig die Interessen und Werte von Roche vertritt.
• Enge Partnerschaft mit Campus-Benutzergruppen und Beschaffung, um sicherzustellen, dass Dienstleister einen optimalen Wert liefern, proaktiv überlegene Dienste aushandeln und Servicemodelle mit Agilität als Reaktion auf Kundenfeedback und sich ändernde Geschäftsanforderungen entwickeln.
• Wählen, entwickeln und bewerten Sie Mitarbeiter, um einen effizienten Betrieb sicherzustellen, Coaching, Schulungen und Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten anzubieten und gleichzeitig eine Kultur der Inklusion, Agilität, Exzellenz und transformativen Führung zu fördern.
• Als Process Owner für Site Applications und Business Services evaluieren und implementieren Sie neue Technologien und entwickeln, teilen und übernehmen Sie technische Innovationen, KPIs und Benchmarking-Informationen in der globalen Site-Netzwerk-Community. Wer du bist
• Mindestens 15+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung, darunter 10+ Jahre Betriebsführung oder betriebswirtschaftliche Erfahrung in einer diagnostischen, pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Industrie mit nachgewiesener fortschrittlicher Management- und Führungsverantwortung.
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Operations oder einem verwandten Bereich (Master-Abschluss in Business oder relevanten Berufsfeld bevorzugt).
• Bewährte Erfahrung bei der Erstellung und Förderung strategischer Initiativen mit nachgewiesener geschäftlicher Agilität, starkem Verhandlungsgeschick und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen, während die Abteilungsbudgetierung und Ressourcenauslastung verwaltet werden.
• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, von Stakeholdern auf allen Organisationsebenen (von Mitarbeitern bis hin zu Führungskräften) und in regulierten Umgebungen Glaubwürdigkeit und Respekt zu erlangen.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, effektiv über alle Funktionen und Ebenen hinweg zu interagieren und zusammenzuarbeiten

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous un leader visionnaire prêt à conduire le changement transformationnel à l'échelle mondiale? Le directeur des Services du site, Stratégie et Activation servira d'architecte stratégique pour le site Indianapolis, traduisant la mission globale de Roche en excellence opérationnelle locale tout en renforçant notre impact sur les patients, les clients et les employés. Ce rôle de leadership très visible et très élevé offre l'occasion de concevoir et d'exécuter des stratégies de site novatrices, de diriger une organisation axée sur la clientèle et de représenter Roche en tant que partenaire de confiance au sein du milieu des affaires de l'Indiana, tout en construisant l'infrastructure opérationnelle qui accélère les progrès de la vision à des résultats mesurables. L'opportunité
• Élaborer, exécuter et maintenir une planification stratégique à long terme en collaboration avec les normes mondiales, en identifiant les possibilités qui favorisent l'impact et l'expérience au niveau local, régional et mondial tout en transformant la stratégie organisationnelle en objectifs opérationnels réalisables pour une organisation de site à haut rendement axée sur la clientèle.
• Diriger tous les services d'installation et d'affaires du site à l'appui du plan d'activités annuel et du plan directeur stratégique à plus long terme, en faisant participer les cadres supérieurs et en stimulant l'efficacité opérationnelle grâce à une technologie améliorée, à l'analyse des données et aux outils numériques.
• Élaborer des budgets annuels de stratégie et d'expérience sur cinq ans avec une surveillance complète de la gestion des dépenses, l'identification de la réduction des coûts et l'optimisation du portefeuille de projets sur place.
• Établir et maintenir des relations stratégiques entre les fonctions locales et mondiales et les ressources communautaires externes, en faisant d'Indianapolis un partenaire d'entreprise solide avec les organisations locales, étatiques et fédérales tout en représentant les intérêts et les valeurs de Roche.

• Servir de propriétaire de processus pour les applications de sites et les services aux entreprises, évaluer et mettre en oeuvre les technologies émergentes tout en développant, en partageant et en adoptant des innovations techniques, des ICR et des données comparatives dans la communauté de réseaux de sites mondiaux. • Baccalauréat en affaires, en opérations ou dans un domaine connexe (diplôme de maîtrise en affaires ou domaine professionnel pertinent préféré).
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de création et de pilotage d'initiatives stratégiques avec une agilité opérationnelle démontrée, de solides compétences en négociation et la capacité de cerner et de résoudre des problèmes complexes tout en gérant la budgétisation ministérielle et l'utilisation des ressources.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation avec la capacité d'influencer et d'acquérir la crédibilité et le respect des intervenants de tous les niveaux organisationnels (des employés aux cadres supérieurs) et dans les environnements réglementés.
• Capacité démontrée d'interagir et de collaborer efficacement entre toutes les fonctions et tous les niveaux du Glo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Customer Support Specialist within our APAC Hub, you are the first point of professional contact for our customers. You play a vital role in ensuring that healthcare providers can continue their essential work without interruption. In this role, you will:

• Resolve critical challenges: Handle customer inquiries via phone and digital channels, providing foundational troubleshooting and technical problem-solving to ensure patient testing remains on track.

• Champion digital transformation: Actively promote and guide customers in adopting digital support tools and remote assistance technologies to improve laboratory efficiency.

• Drive quality and safety: Act as a local case handler, identifying product quality issues and escalating them to ensure the highest standards of patient safety.

• Foster continuous improvement: Contribute to the creation of new troubleshooting materials and "self-fix" content, empowering both colleagues and customers.

• Collaborate across borders: Work within an agile, intercultural team, participating in local and global projects that shape the future of service excellence in the region.

• Simulate real-world solutions: Utilize our onsite laboratory to recreate customer scenarios, ensuring our solution approaches are accurate and effective.

Who You Are
We are looking for a curious, customer-centric individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about healthcare technology.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or Information Technology.

• Professional Experience: You bring at least 1-2 years of experience in medical technology, laboratory environments, or healthcare IT support.

• Language Excellence: You are fluent in English and possess professional-level proficiency in one or more of the following: Chinese dialects, Thai, or Korean, to support our diverse APAC customer clusters.

• Technical Aptitude: You have a solid understanding of medical analysis systems, connectivity, or IT network technologies, with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Customer-First Mindset: You possess excellent communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical information clearly and concisely.

• Flexibility: You are comfortable working within a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, including public holidays, to support the critical needs of the healthcare systems we serve. Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

• 業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサービスエンジニア
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
　　　　　　　　• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　
• 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

• 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing/Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a digital marketing intern, you will support the brand in planning, implementing, monitoring campaigns and creating a social media presence. You will be required to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive the adoption of Roche’s Health Digital Solutions (HDS) & Glucose Monitoring (GM) solutions to enable the implementation of Roche’s integrated Personalized Diabetes Management (iPDM) strategy.

The Opportunity:

• Exposure to the E-commerce (Shopee & Lazada) and digital space

• Generating content for Roche’s digital platforms

• Designing digital materials for Shopee, Lazada, social media sites I.e. Telegram

• Identifying and monitoring digital market trends (i.e. reading data to track performance of digital campaigns campaigns)

• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders - you will be able to hone your relationship management skills

• Access to our diverse Roche Network

Who you are:

• You are currently studying for your Bachelor’s degree in Digital Marketing

• Familiar with E-commerce such as Shopee & Lazada as well as the digital space

• Up to date with trends on social channels (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook etc)

• Excellent digital communication skills

• Able to commit for 6 months internshi p

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Come stagista di marketing digitale, supporterai il marchio nella pianificazione, nell'implementazione, nel monitoraggio delle campagne e nella creazione di una presenza sui social media. Sarà necessario lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'adozione delle soluzioni di monitoraggio della salute di Roche (HDS) & Glucose (GM) per consentire l'implementazione della strategia di gestione integrata dei diabeti personalizzati di Roche (iPDM). L'opportunità:
• Esposizione all'E-commerce (Shopee & Lazada) e allo spazio digitale
• Generare contenuti per le piattaforme digitali di Roche
• Progettazione di materiali digitali per Shopee, Lazada, social media siti I.e. Telegram
• Identificare e monitorare le tendenze del mercato digitale (cioè leggere i dati per monitorare le prestazioni delle campagne di campagne digitali)
• Collaborando con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni - sarete in grado di affinare le vostre capacità di gestione delle relazioni
• Accesso alla nostra rete Roche Chi sei:
• Attualmente stai studiando per la tua laurea in Digital Marketing
• Familiare con E-commerce come Shopee & Lazada e lo spazio digitale
• Fino ad oggi con tendenze sui canali sociali (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook ecc)
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione digitale
• In grado di commettere per 6 mesi internshi p Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Als Praktikant für digitales Marketing unterstützen Sie die Marke bei der Planung, Umsetzung, Überwachung von Kampagnen und beim Aufbau einer Social Media Präsenz. Sie müssen eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um die Einführung der Lösungen von Roche für Health Digital Solutions (HDS) und Glucose Monitoring (GM) voranzutreiben, um die Umsetzung der integrierten Strategie von Roche für personalisiertes Diabetesmanagement (iPDM) zu ermöglichen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Exposition gegenüber dem E-Commerce (Shopee & Lazada) und dem digitalen Raum
• Generieren von Inhalten für die digitalen Plattformen von Roche
• Entwerfen von digitalen Materialien für Shopee, Lazada, Social-Media-Sites I.e. Telegram
• Identifizierung und Überwachung digitaler Markttrends (d. h. Lesen von Daten zur Verfolgung der Leistung digitaler Kampagnenkampagnen)
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern - Sie können Ihre Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsmanagement verbessern
• Zugang zu unserem vielfältigen Roche Netzwerk Wer du bist:
• Sie studieren gerade für Ihren Bachelor in Digital Marketing
• Vertraut mit E-Commerce wie Shopee & Lazada sowie dem digitalen Raum
• Aktuell mit Trends auf sozialen Kanälen (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook etc.)
• Hervorragende digitale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Kann sich für 6 Monate internshi p verpflichten Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in Business Enablement in Data, Analytics & Research (Location: Pune)

The Position
Do you want to be part of a purpose-driven environment? Are you passionate about project and process management? Are you a team player and want to work in an international environment? Do you want to work in a Data Driven environment? Are you curious to explore digital solutions for creating a profitable digital insights business and shaping the future of healthcare?

Then join our Business Enablement Team in Data, Analytics & Research - for 6-12 months, based in Pune, India.

What we offer:

• Opportunity to gain experience and insights into Business Management and the future of Data, Analytics & Research in digital healthcare

• Opportunity to work closely with senior management

• The chance to be a part of agile Project Teams, shaping our organization and products

• An international working environment to learn and grow

• A role to grow your coaching, consulting, project management and analytical skills, in particular by having an exposure to a broad scope of the business

Role Responsibilities:

• Support senior managers across Data, Analytics & Research and within the Business Enablement Team, to deliver on critical business operations activities

• As needed, support key initiatives in the planning, execution and evaluation phase. This entails, project planning, process development, organizing team setup, supporting the team in agile ways of working, delivering input to the work, performing specific deep dive reviews, and analyses for senior leaders that inform or enable high-level decision-making on operations and business change initiatives

• Direct project correspondences by preparing and reviewing project proposals, memos, meeting minutes, emails, invitations and agendas

• Work with various cross functional project teams to propose creative and efficient business solutions

• Execute project management tasks and lead specific areas in alignment with project managers and leads

• Provide transparent and timely reporting on assigned tasks as well as delegated assignments, such as monthly Data Fabric or Research Portfolio reporting collection and compilation

• Participate in agile ways of working

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Strategic Planning, Data Science or a related field.

• You are currently enrolled as a MSC student or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months) in Business Administration, Management, Strategic Planning, Data Science or a similar field of relevance

• You have an interest in interest in digital technologies and for bringing data science and business management practises together

• You have a curious and creative mind and enjoy to rethink ways of working

• You are a system-thinker and can easily connect the dots and develop pragmatic solutions for complex challenges

• You have good organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills, can prioritize and can easily coordinate events and projects

• You have the ability to execute in a virtual or remote setting

• You are a team player who is highly collaborative in a diverse team, participative, autonomous with strong sense of responsibility

• You demonstrate a high motivation with a positive can-do attitude

• You are a great communicator and can capture and simplify complex topics in a customer-orientated way

• You enjoy working in a global, diverse and dynamic environment

• Fluency in English is required

• Sta

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Internship in Business Enablement in Dati, Analytics & Research (Locazione: Pune) La posizione Vuoi fare parte di un ambiente orientato allo scopo? Sei appassionato di project and process management? Sei un giocatore di squadra e vuoi lavorare in un ambiente internazionale? Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente Data Driven? Sei curioso di esplorare le soluzioni digitali per creare un business di informazioni digitali redditizie e modellare il futuro della sanità? Quindi unisciti al nostro Business Enablement Team in Dati, Analytics & Research - per 6-12 mesi, con sede a Pune, India. Cosa offriamo:
• Opportunità di acquisire esperienze e approfondimenti nella gestione aziendale e nel futuro dei dati, analisi e ricerca nella sanità digitale
• Opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione senior
• La possibilità di far parte di agili team di progetto, modellando la nostra organizzazione e prodotti
• Un ambiente di lavoro internazionale per imparare e crescere
• Un ruolo per crescere il tuo coaching, consulenza, project management e competenze analitiche, in particolare avendo un'esposizione ad una vasta gamma di attività Responsabilità del ruolo:
• Supporta i senior manager di dati, analisi e ricerca e all'interno del Business Enablement Team, per fornire attività critiche di business
• Come necessario, sostenere iniziative chiave nella fase di pianificazione, esecuzione e valutazione. Ciò comporta, la pianificazione del progetto, lo sviluppo del processo, l'organizzazione del team, il supporto al team in modi agili di lavoro, la fornitura di input al lavoro, l'esecuzione di specifiche recensioni approfondite, e le analisi per i leader senior che informano o abilitano il processo decisionale di alto livello su operazioni e iniziative di cambiamento di business
• Corrispondenza diretta del progetto preparando e rivedendo proposte di progetto, memo, verbali di riunione, e-mail, inviti e agenda
• Lavorare con vari team di progetto funzionali cross per proporre soluzioni aziendali creative ed efficienti
• Eseguire i compiti di project management e condurre aree specifiche in allineamento con i project manager e i lead
• Fornire report trasparenti e tempestivi sulle attività assegnate e incarichi delegati, come ad esempio la raccolta e la compilazione di report mensili di Data Fabric o Research Portfolio
• Partecipare a modi agili di lavorare Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Laurea in Business Administration, gestione, pianificazione strategica, scienza dei dati o un campo correlato.
• Sei attualmente iscritto come studente di MSC o ti sei recentemente laureato (nel corso degli ultimi 12 mesi) in Business Administration, Management, Strategic Planning, Data Science o un campo di rilevanza simile
• Hai un interesse per le tecnologie digitali e per l'incontro tra scienza e gestione dei dati
• Hai una mente curiosa e creativa e divertiti a ripensare i modi di lavorare
• Tu sei un pensatore di sistema e puoi collegare facilmente i punti e sviluppare soluzioni pragmatiche per sfide complesse
• Hai buone capacità organizzative, analitiche e interpersonali, in grado di priorità e può facilmente coordinare eventi e progetti
• Hai la possibilità di eseguire in un'impostazione virtuale o remota
• Sei un giocatore di squadra che è altamente collaborativo in un team diverso, partecipativo, autonomo con forte senso di responsabilità
• Dimostra un'alta motivazione con un atteggiamento positivo
• Sei un grande comunicatore e puoi catturare e semplificare argomenti complessi in modo orientato al cliente
• Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente globale, vario e dinamico
• Fluency in inglese è richiesto
• Statua

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Praktikum in Business Enablement in Data, Analytics & Research (Standort: Pune) Die Position Möchten Sie Teil einer zielgerichteten Umgebung sein? Sie interessieren sich für Projekt- und Prozessmanagement? Sie sind Teamplayer und möchten in einem internationalen Umfeld arbeiten? Möchten Sie in einer datengesteuerten Umgebung arbeiten? Sind Sie neugierig auf digitale Lösungen, um ein profitables Digital Insights Business zu schaffen und die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens zu gestalten? Dann treten Sie unserem Business Enablement Team in Data, Analytics & Research bei - für 6-12 Monate mit Sitz in Pune, Indien. Was wir anbieten:
• Gelegenheit, Erfahrungen und Einblicke in Business Management und die Zukunft von Data, Analytics & Research im digitalen Gesundheitswesen zu sammeln
• Möglichkeit, eng mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammenzuarbeiten
• Die Chance, Teil von agilen Projektteams zu sein und unsere Organisation und Produkte zu gestalten
• Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld zum Lernen und Wachsen
• Eine Rolle, um Ihre Coaching-, Beratungs-, Projektmanagement- und Analysefähigkeiten zu erweitern, insbesondere durch ein breites Geschäftsfeld Aufgabenbereiche:
• Unterstützung von Führungskräften in den Bereichen Data, Analytics & Research und im Business Enablement-Team, um wichtige Geschäftsaktivitäten durchzuführen

jobs.title: Strategic Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

• Secure a permanent career path with the global leader in diagnostic innovation.

• Champion meaningful change to enhance outcomes for our partners and patients.

• Thrive within a high-performing, agile network that empowers visionary leadership.

At Roche Diagnostics NZ (RDNZ) , we don’t just adapt to the future of healthcare—we shape it. We have an exciting opportunity for a visionary Strategic Key Account Manager (SKAM) to join our Auckland team and champion impactful, win/win partnerships that elevate patient care across New Zealand.

In this position, you will drive commercial excellence by blending your sales instincts with a data-driven approach to deliver superior market results. Your ability to leverage advanced analytics, conduct deep market assessments, and build successful customer relationships will be the catalyst for our continued success in the field.

As a champion within our Strategic Key Account team, you are expected to operate with a strategic mindset, actively contributing to the collective growth.

If you are a strategic thinker who thrives in an agile, high-performing network and loves turning complex challenges into commercial triumphs, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities include;

As a SKAM, you will be an integral part of the team, driving our commercial success and customer satisfaction. Embracing our VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership model, you will:

• Own the relationship with your key accounts, leading contract management, conducting high-level business reviews, and effortlessly resolving commercial hurdles.

• Map out customer organizations, uncover hidden opportunities, and inject invaluable customer insights directly into RDNZ’s broader strategic vision.

• Break down silos by partnering seamlessly across Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver unmatched value to our clients.

• Ensure all documentation and operations meet Roche’s gold standard for quality, compliance, health, and safety.

Who you are;

You are a self-starter eager to architect your own professional growth. We offer an environment where you can explore diverse interests throughout our global network, viewing your role not as a static destination, but as a catalyst for your broader potential.

You are a master relationship-builder who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You bring a growth mindset, agility, and a passion for continuous improvement, and you have;

• 5+ years of proven success in sales or account management.

• A tertiary qualification in Science or Business (or the perfect blend of both) is highly desired.

• Deep knowledge of NZ laboratory networks and Roche diagnostic solutions (desirable)

• Proficiency in CRM/Data tools like Salesforce (Rexis), and the Google and Microsoft suite of products.

• Outstanding communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to mobilize teams and influence outcomes without formal authority.

• Ability to travel nationally, some international travel may be required.

A valid driver’s license is essential.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in New Zealand.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitme

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

• Campione cambiamento significativo per migliorare i risultati per i nostri partner e pazienti.
• Thrive all'interno di una rete agile ad alte prestazioni che abilita la leadership visionaria. A Roche Diagnostics NZ (RDNZ) , non ci adattiamo solo al futuro della salute - la modellamo. Abbiamo un'emozionante opportunità per un visionario Strategic Key Account Manager (SKAM) per unire il nostro team di Auckland e il campione di partnership di successo / win che elevano la cura dei pazienti in Nuova Zelanda. In questa posizione, guiderai l'eccellenza commerciale fondendo i tuoi istinti di vendita con un approccio data-driven per fornire risultati di mercato superiori. La vostra capacità di sfruttare l'analisi avanzata, condurre valutazioni di mercato profonde, e costruire relazioni con i clienti di successo sarà il catalizzatore per il nostro continuo successo nel campo. Come campione all'interno del nostro team Strategic Key Account, ci si aspetta di operare con una mentalità strategica, contribuendo attivamente alla crescita collettiva. Se sei un pensatore strategico che prospera in una rete agile e ad alto rendimento e ama trasformare sfide complesse in trionfi commerciali, vogliamo sentire da voi. Le responsabilità chiave includono; Come SKAM, sarete parte integrante del team, guidando il nostro successo commerciale e la soddisfazione del cliente. Abbracciando il nostro modello di leadership VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach), si:
• Possedere il rapporto con i vostri conti chiave, gestione del contratto leader, condurre recensioni di affari di alto livello, e senza sforzo risolvere ostacoli commerciali.
• Pianifica le organizzazioni dei clienti, scopri le opportunità nascoste e inietta informazioni inestimabili dei clienti direttamente nella visione strategica più ampia di RDNZ.
• Ripartire i silos collaborando senza soluzione di continuità attraverso la finanza, il marketing e il successo del cliente per fornire valore ineguagliabile ai nostri clienti.
• Assicurarsi che tutta la documentazione e le operazioni soddisfino lo standard oro di Roche per qualità, conformità, salute e sicurezza. Chi sei! Sei un auto-starter desideroso di architetto la tua crescita professionale. Offriamo un ambiente in cui è possibile esplorare diversi interessi in tutta la nostra rete globale, visualizzando il vostro ruolo non come destinazione statica, ma come catalizzatore per il vostro potenziale più ampio. Sei un maestro relazionale che prospera in ambienti complessi e veloci. Porti una mentalità di crescita, agilità, e una passione per il miglioramento continuo, e hai;
• 5+ anni di successo dimostrato nella gestione delle vendite o degli account.
• Una qualifica terziaria in Scienza o Business (o la miscela perfetta di entrambi) è altamente desiderato.
• Conoscenza profonda delle reti di laboratorio NZ e delle soluzioni diagnostiche Roche (desiderabili)
• La competenza negli strumenti CRM/Data come Salesforce (Rexis) e nella suite di prodotti Google e Microsoft.
• Competenze di comunicazione eccezionali, pensiero strategico, e la capacità di mobilitare le squadre e influenzare i risultati senza autorità formale.
• Capacità di viaggiare a livello nazionale, alcuni viaggi internazionali possono essere richiesti. Una patente valida è essenziale. Questo ruolo è aperto solo ai candidati che hanno piena idoneità a vivere e lavorare in Nuova Zelanda. Non accettiamo alcun curriculum non richiesto o richieste da reclutame

按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。

医学临床、医学检验或药学硕士及以上，或有相关体外诊断领域的工作经验

流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche:
A healthier future. That’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. To create a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

Opportunity:

We are looking for an Early in Career (EiC) Intern who will actively contribute to positioning Roche as the employer of choice for early-career talent. The EiC intern will work closely with EiC partners and specialists to plan and execute activities aimed at building and developing a diverse and sustainable talent pipeline that aligns with the future hiring needs of our business.

Position Summary:

The Early in Career (EiC) intern will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to manage university recruitment and talent acquisition activities. This role requires a proactive, hands-on individual passionate about young talent, growth, and innovation, with excellent organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities:

• Support the management of university recruitment teams, working closely with EiC partners and specialists.

• Handle vendor relationships for recruitment events, including merchandising, giveaways, and storage logistics.

• Coordinate meetings with vendors to clarify event requirements based on predefined specifications.

• Provide administrative support to EiC partners and specialists.

• Assist in implementing EiC activities aligned with Roche’s global frameworks and strategies.

• Collaborate with the Recruitment team to maintain and update job boards, social media channels, and registration platforms.

• Manage intake portal requests for EiC specialists in the relevant region.

• Gain a basic understanding of Roche’s clients and business areas to tailor EiC activities effectively.

• Support initiatives to attract young talent in partnership with the Talent Marketing team.

• Help prepare university recruitment teams for events and provide on-site or remote support.

• Work cross-functionally with colleagues regionally and globally to deliver consistent and effective People Support Solutions.

•

Who You Are:

• Currently an active university student graduation end of 2026.

• Fluent in English and Portuguese (both oral and written).

• Studying Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset.

• Passionate about young talent, continuous learning, and growth.

• Organized and structured in daily work.

• Strong team player with a collaborative attitude.

• Problem solver with a positive, “can-do” approach.

• Comfortable navigating multicultural and ambiguous environments.

• Experienced or passionate about tech solutions.

Additional Information:

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Helfen Sie bei der Vorbereitung von Rekrutierungsteams für Veranstaltungen und bieten Sie Unterstützung vor Ort oder aus der Ferne.

• Organisiert und strukturiert in der täglichen Arbeit.
• Starker Teamplayer mit einer kooperativen Einstellung.

Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le stagiaire EiC travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires et des spécialistes EiC pour planifier et exécuter des activités visant à créer et à développer un bassin de talents diversifié et durable qui cadre avec les besoins futurs en embauche de notre entreprise. Sommaire du poste : Le stagiaire en début de carrière collaborera avec des équipes internes et des partenaires externes pour gérer les activités de recrutement universitaire et d'acquisition de talents. Ce rôle exige une personne proactive et pratique passionnée par les jeunes talents, la croissance et l'innovation, avec d'excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de communication. Responsabilités :
• Soutenir la gestion des équipes de recrutement universitaires, en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires et les spécialistes de EiC.
• Gérer les relations des fournisseurs pour les événements de recrutement, y compris le merchandising, les cadeaux et la logistique de stockage.
• Coordonner les réunions avec les fournisseurs afin de clarifier les exigences relatives aux événements en fonction de spécifications prédéfinies.
• Fournir un soutien administratif aux partenaires et aux spécialistes du CIE.
• Aider à la mise en oeuvre des activités de la CIE alignées sur les cadres et stratégies mondiaux de Roche.
• Collaborer avec l'équipe de recrutement pour maintenir et mettre à jour les conseils d'emploi, les réseaux sociaux et les plateformes d'inscription.
• Gérer les demandes de portail d'admission pour les spécialistes de la CIE dans la région concernée.
• Acquérir une compréhension de base des clients de Roches et des secteurs d'activité pour adapter efficacement les activités EiC.
• Appuyer les initiatives visant à attirer les jeunes talents en partenariat avec l'équipe de marketing Talent.
• Aider à préparer les équipes de recrutement des universités pour les événements et fournir un soutien sur place ou à distance.
• Travailler en collaboration avec des collègues régionaux et mondiaux pour offrir des solutions de soutien aux personnes cohérentes et efficaces.

• Actuellement, les étudiants de l'université sont diplômés à la fin de 2026.
• Fluent en anglais et portugais (oral et écrit).
• Étudier le marketing, les communications, l'administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.
• Un état d'esprit proactif, pratique et axé sur la solution.
• Passionné de jeunes talents, d'apprentissage continu et de croissance.
• Organisé et structuré dans le travail quotidien.
• Fort joueur d'équipe avec une attitude collaborative.
• Résoudre les problèmes avec une approche positive, c'est faire.
• La navigation confortable des environnements multiculturels et ambigus.
• Expérience ou passion pour les solutions technologiques. Renseignements supplémentaires : Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.
