descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Role: Associate
• Location: Chennai
• Job Type: Full Time
• Years of Relevant Experience in Analytics/Pharma/Biotech Domain: 0-1 year
• Job Description:
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai and Hyderabad to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
As an Associate, you will work closely with Project leads to execute projects for stakeholders in the business teams across Roche’s global affiliates. The projects can be in the domains of Analytics, Data Science, and Technology to deliver solutions to real-world business problems. You will be required to understand business and mathematical logics and execute solutions using analytical thinking/technical skills.
In this role, you will:
• ● Build expertise on various programming languages, querying tools, data management tools, BI platforms
• ● Work in collaboration with a team to deliver projects for the Roche stakeholders
• ● Utilize and gain knowledge on industry standard tools and help process data
• ● Gain knowledge on statistical methodologies and support various Data Science projects
• ● Gain knowledge on BI tools and support report/dashboard build and maintenance
• ● Present the findings from the analyses to the stakeholders in an effective and structured fashion
• ● Develop knowledge of the rapidly changing healthcare marketplace
• ● Contribute to the internal initiatives and help grow the GATE team
• Education:
• UG: B.Tech/B.E. – (Computer Science, IT, Biotechnology and related specializations) with 9 0% or 9 /10 CGPA

Qualifications:
• ● Overall experience of 0-1 years in the analytics / consulting /technology space
• ● Strong quantitative aptitude an logical thinking ability is required
• ● Ability to read data and derive insights from the data
• ● Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
• ● Working knowledge of Python, SQL, Excel is an added advantage
• ● Highly motivated, learning oriented and quality focused individuals would be preferred

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior IT Service Delivery Manager

The Opportunity
As a Senior IT Service Delivery Manager within the Diagnostics R&D Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) organization, you will champion the management, governance, and optimization of IT Services across the entire Diagnostics R&D department.

You will put the needs of our scientific teams at the center of everything you do—ensuring the right processes, resources, and KPIs are in place to meet service commitments. Success in this role requires skillfully navigating a highly complex, matrixed organization to execute comprehensive solution visions and drive strategic vendor partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
Stakeholder & Demand Management

• Strategic Partnership: Identify, engage, and collaborate deeply with all R&D functional heads (including Labs, Computational Science & Engineering, Instrumentation, Engineering, Business Partnering, CDMA, and PPM). Understand their unique technical requirements and propose strategic solutions.

• Demand Forecasting: Maintain a forward-looking perspective of the R&D ecosystem to proactively forecast future infrastructure, platform, and service demands.

• Service Lifecycle Management: Drive the service lifecycle strategy in alignment with broader product roadmaps. Ensure services are clearly cataloged, easily discoverable, and highly consumable for R&D teams, continuously measuring success through User Experience (UX) metrics.

Operations, Governance & Process Optimization

• Metrics & Performance: Define service runs against metrics that matter to R&D teams. Establish new Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), design measurement methods, and hold accountability for delivery against targets, deadlines, and quality standards.

• Process Improvement: Spot operational insights and performance trends to continually drive process efficiencies and quality enhancements. Initiate changes to service specifications based on real-world data.

• Incident & Escalation Management: Swiftly resolve operational incidents to minimize downtime, protecting scientific velocity and business goals. Manage high-profile escalations and implement root-cause improvements to reduce recurring issues.

• Backlog Negotiation: Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and technical debt across R&D pillars. Advocate for the prioritization of operational needs directly within product team backlogs.

• Service Continuity: Develop, evaluate, and continually refine business continuity and disaster recovery plans to safeguard critical R&D operations and datasets.

Financial, Sourcing & Vendor Management

• Fiscal Accountability: Manage the team budget with full accountability for invoicing, billing controls, and compliance with local procurement, VMO, security, and legal processes.

• Vendor Performance: Monitor vendor relationships to ensure external operations meet agreed-upon SLA metrics, constantly identifying opportunities to enhance external service delivery.

• Sourcing Innovation: Lead Request for Proposal (RfP) processes, service benchmarking, and the onboarding or transition of services to new suppliers.

• Strategic Sourcing: Partner with sourcing managers to align with global sourcing strategies, exploring modern delivery models (such as co-sourcing or end-to-end sourcing) that fit the R&D landscape.

Methodology & Leadership Innovation

• Agile & DevOps Champion: Drive the implementation of Agile frameworks, DevOps maturity assessments, and automation initiatives to boost operational efficiency across int

• Incident & Escalation Management: risolvere rapidamente gli incidenti operativi per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo, proteggere la velocità scientifica e gli obiettivi aziendali. Gestire escalations di alto profilo e implementare root-cause miglioramenti per ridurre i problemi ricorrenti.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, il faut naviguer habilement dans une organisation très complexe et matricielle pour réaliser des visions globales de solutions et stimuler les partenariats stratégiques avec les fournisseurs. Principales responsabilités Gestion des intervenants et de la demande
• Partenariat stratégique : Identifier, engager et collaborer étroitement avec tous les responsables fonctionnels de la R-D (y compris les laboratoires, les sciences et l'ingénierie informatiques, l'instrumentation, l'ingénierie, le partenariat d'affaires, CDMA et PPM). Comprendre leurs exigences techniques uniques et proposer des solutions stratégiques.
• Prévisions de la demande : Maintenir une perspective prospective de l'écosystème de la R-D afin de prévoir de façon proactive les besoins futurs en matière d'infrastructure, de plate-forme et de services.
• Gestion du cycle de vie du service : Diriger la stratégie du cycle de vie du service conformément à des feuilles de route plus larges. Veiller à ce que les services soient clairement catalogués, facilement découvrables et très consommables pour les équipes de R-D, en mesurant continuellement le succès grâce aux mesures de l'expérience utilisateur (UX). Opérations, gouvernance et optimisation des processus
• Mesure et rendement : Définir le service est conforme aux mesures qui comptent pour les équipes de R-D. Établir de nouveaux indicateurs clés de rendement (ICP), concevoir des méthodes de mesure et rendre compte de l'exécution par rapport aux cibles, aux échéances et aux normes de qualité.
• Amélioration des processus : Spot des idées opérationnelles et des tendances de rendement pour stimuler continuellement l'efficacité des processus et améliorer la qualité. Initier des modifications aux spécifications de service basées sur des données du monde réel.
• Gestion de l'incident et de l'escalation : Résoudre rapidement les incidents opérationnels pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt, protéger la vitesse scientifique et les objectifs commerciaux. Gérer les escalades à forte visibilité et mettre en œuvre les améliorations de cause racine pour réduire les problèmes récurrents.
• Négociation en arrière-plan : Identifier les lacunes opérationnelles, les goulets d'étranglement et la dette technique entre les piliers de la R-D. Préconiser la hiérarchisation des besoins opérationnels directement dans les arriérés des équipes de produits.
• Continuité des services : Élaborer, évaluer et perfectionner continuellement les plans de continuité des activités et de reprise après sinistre afin de protéger les opérations et les ensembles de données essentiels en R-D. Finances, approvisionnement et gestion des fournisseurs
• Responsabilisation financière : Gérer le budget de l'équipe en rendant pleinement compte de la facturation, des contrôles de facturation et de la conformité aux procédures locales d'approvisionnement, de VMO, de sécurité et de justice.
• Rendement des fournisseurs : Surveiller les relations des fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les opérations externes respectent les paramètres convenus de l'ALS, en identifiant constamment les possibilités d'améliorer la prestation des services externes.
• Sourcing Innovation : Processus de demande de propositions (DP), analyse comparative des services et intégration ou transition des services vers de nouveaux fournisseurs.
• Sourcing stratégique : S'associer avec les gestionnaires de l'approvisionnement pour s'aligner sur les stratégies mondiales d'approvisionnement, explorer des modèles modernes de prestation (comme le co-approvisionnement ou l'approvisionnement de bout en bout) qui correspondent au paysage de la R-D. Méthodologie et leadership Innovation
• Agile & DevOps Champion: Diriger la mise en œuvre des cadres Agile, des évaluations de maturité DevOps et des initiatives d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle de l'ensemble de l'entreprise

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
An unserem Standort in Basel bieten wir eine spannende Praktikumsmöglichkeit an. Im Bereich Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing stellen wir in der hybriden Single Use (SUT) und der Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC) Produktionsanlage Wirkstoffe zur Krebstherapie her. Diese biotechnologischen Prozesse finden mit Hilfe von hochautomatisierten Anlagen unter Einhaltung von Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) statt. Als Praktikant/in in der Produktion arbeitest Du mit hoher Selbstständigkeit an Optimierungs- und Verbesserungsprojekten und lernst dabei, wie die GMP Produktion von Anfang bis Ende funktioniert.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung und Unterstützung von interdisziplinären Projekten zur Prozessoptimierung.

• Prozessabläufe analysieren und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten ausarbeiten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen, wie Qualität, Engineering, Manufacturing Science & Technology.

• Mitarbeit bei der Bearbeitung von Ursachenanalysen im Rahmen von Prozessabweichungen und bei der Implementierung der zugehörigen Massnahmen.

• Kennenlernen und Unterstützen von Routineaufgaben (z.B. Dokumentenpflege, Rohdatenauswertung, usw.).

• Mitarbeit an Compliance und SHE Themen sowie kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen (KVP) und Unterstützung Materialmanagement.

• Die GMP-gerechte Durchführung und Dokumentation ihrer Aufgaben im Bereich mit Fokus auf Qualität des Produktes und der Prozesse.

Wer Du Bist

• Du bist derzeit in einem Masterstudiengang vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Naturwissenschaften (z.B. Pharmazie, Biologie, Chemie, Life Sciences) oder im Bereich des Ingenieurwesens (z.B. Biotechnologie, Pharmatechnik, Verfahrenstechnik) eingeschrieben oder Du hast Dein Studium innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor dem Startdatum abgeschlossen.

• Proaktives Teilen von Wissen mit exzellenten Organisations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Gute Kenntnisse von MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) und von Google Applikationen (Drive, Docs, Tabellen, Präsentationen) - eine generelle IT-Affinität (z. B. Interesse an Automatisierungen mittels Google Skripten) wird vorausgesetzt.

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzliche Information​

• Deine Bewerbung muss einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.

• Bitte beachte, aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen, aus der hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum verpflichtend ist, sowie die Dauer des Pflichtpraktikums.

• Das Praktikum ist nicht geeignet für eine Masterarbeit.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nella nostra posizione a Basilea, offriamo un'emozionante opportunità di stage. Nella divisione Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing, produciamo principi attivi per la terapia del cancro nell'impianto di produzione ibrido a uso singolo (SUT) e di cojugate anticorpo (ADC). Questi processi biotecnologici hanno luogo con l'aiuto di impianti altamente automatizzati nel rispetto delle attuali buone pratiche di fabbricazione (cGMP). Come stagista nella produzione, si lavora in modo indipendente su progetti di ottimizzazione e miglioramento e imparare come la produzione GMP funziona dall'inizio alla fine. La possibilità
• Attuazione e sostegno di progetti interdisciplinari per l'ottimizzazione dei processi.
• Analizzare i flussi di processo e sviluppare opzioni di ottimizzazione.
• Collaborazione con varie interfacce, come la qualità, l'ingegneria, la scienza della produzione e la tecnologia.
• La cooperazione nel trattamento delle cause principali analizza nel quadro delle deviazioni di processo e nell'attuazione delle misure associate.
• Scopri e supporta le attività di routine (ad esempio la manutenzione dei documenti, la valutazione dei dati grezzi, ecc.).
• La cooperazione sulla conformità e gli argomenti SHE nonché i processi di miglioramento continuo (CIP) e la gestione dei materiali di supporto.
• L'implementazione e la documentazione GMP conformi ai loro compiti nell'area con particolare attenzione alla qualità del prodotto e dei processi. Chi sei
• Sei attualmente iscritto nel programma di un master, preferibilmente nei campi delle scienze naturali (ad esempio farmacia, biologia, chimica, scienze della vita) o nel campo dell'ingegneria (ad esempio biotecnologia, tecnologia farmaceutica, ingegneria dei processi) o hai completato i tuoi studi entro 12 mesi prima della data di inizio.
• Condividere attivamente le conoscenze con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di comunicazione.
• È necessaria una buona conoscenza di MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e di applicazioni di Google (Drive, Docs, Tables, Presentations) - un'affinità IT generale (ad esempio l'interesse per l'automazione con gli script di Google).
• Molto buono orale e scritto tedesco così come buone abilità inglesi. Ulteriori informazioni
• La vostra domanda deve includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione.
• Si prega di notare che, a causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EFTA sono tenuti a presentare un certificato dall'università come parte dei documenti di richiesta, affermando che uno stage è obbligatorio, così come la durata dello stage obbligatorio.
• Lo stage non è adatto per una tesi master. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position At our location in Basel, we offer an exciting internship opportunity. In the Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing division, we produce active ingredients for cancer therapy in the hybrid single use (SUT) and antibody drug conjugate (ADC) production plant. These biotechnological processes take place with the help of highly automated plants in compliance with Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). As an intern in production, you work independently on optimization and improvement projects and learn how GMP production works from start to finish. The possibility
• Implementation and support of interdisciplinary projects for process optimization.
• Analyze process flows and develop optimization options.
• Collaboration with various interfaces, such as quality, engineering, manufacturing science & technology.
• Cooperation in the processing of root cause analyses within the framework of process deviations and in the implementation of the associated measures.
• Get to know and support routine tasks (e.g. document maintenance, raw data evaluation, etc.).

• Proactively share knowledge with excellent organizational and communication skills.
• Good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and of Google applications (Drive, Docs, Tables, Presentations) - a general IT affinity (e.g. interest in automation using Google scripts) is required.

Ces processus biotechnologiques se déroulent avec l'aide d'installations hautement automatisées en conformité avec les bonnes pratiques de fabrication actuelles (BPF). jobs.title: Global SHE Compliance Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global SHE Compliance Expert

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe that operational excellence and sustainable action go hand in hand. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical requirements and organizational objectives, ensuring that our compliance systems effectively support our global license to operate. You will join a forward-thinking global team dedicated to maintaining the highest safety, health, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead System Ownership: Act as the Global Product Owner for safety, health, and environmental (SHE) compliance systems, monitoring corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and driving consistent application across global sites.

• Define Strategic Requirements: Document process features, user stories, and requirements in technical platforms to guide digital development teams effectively.

• Develop Compliance Standards: Create, revise, and update global internal compliance standards and process documents to reflect evolving regulatory landscapes.

• Drive Risk Insights: Monitor global compliance updates, identify potential gaps, and partner with regional experts to proactively mitigate operational risks.

• Optimize Data Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to transform SHE compliance data into actionable trend reports and insights for leadership reviews.

• Foster Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact across corporate governance lines, advising site-level SHE officers and compliance managers to support system adoption.

Who You Are

You bring a unique blend of technical curiosity, analytical precision, and collaborative spirit. You are passionate about translating complex regulatory requirements into structured digital processes and thriving in an environment built on ethics and transparency.
Qualifications:

• University degree in Engineering, Legal, Data/Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.

• Proven experience in a similar role (such as technical compliance, IT/digital data consultancy, or operational risk management) within a multinational matrix environment.

• Demonstrated track record in data architecture, compliance analytics, or digital system infrastructure.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in fluent English.

• Familiarity with global compliance standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001) or specific focus areas like occupational health and environmental protection is a distinct advantage.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global SHE Compliance Expert

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe that operational excellence and sustainable action go hand in hand. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical requirements and organizational objectives, ensuring that our compliance systems effectively support our global license to operate. You will join a forward-thinking global team dedicated to maintaining the highest safety, health, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead System Ownership: Act as the Global Product Owner for safety, health, and environmental (SHE) compliance systems, monitoring corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and driving consistent application across global sites.

• Define Strategic Requirements: Document process features, user stories, and requirements in technical platforms to guide digital development teams effectively.

• Develop Compliance Standards: Create, revise, and update global internal compliance standards and process documents to reflect evolving regulatory landscapes.

• Drive Risk Insights: Monitor global compliance updates, identify potential gaps, and partner with regional experts to proactively mitigate operational risks.

• Optimize Data Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to transform SHE compliance data into actionable trend reports and insights for leadership reviews.

• Foster Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact across corporate governance lines, advising site-level SHE officers and compliance managers to support system adoption.

Who You Are

You bring a unique blend of technical curiosity, analytical precision, and collaborative spirit. You are passionate about translating complex regulatory requirements into structured digital processes and thriving in an environment built on ethics and transparency.
Qualifications:

• University degree in Engineering, Legal, Data/Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.

• Proven experience in a similar role (such as technical compliance, IT/digital data consultancy, or operational risk management) within a multinational matrix environment.

• Demonstrated track record in data architecture, compliance analytics, or digital system infrastructure.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in fluent English.

• Familiarity with global compliance standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001) or specific focus areas like occupational health and environmental protection is a distinct advantage.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for furthe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description
The Senior IT Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, utilizing strong programming skills in Python or Scala, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Spark.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines. Works independently to execute specific data engineering projects from start to finish.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex data ingestion and processing problems. Optimizes data flows and actively enhances overall system performance.

• Stakeholder Management: Engages directly with broader business units and data scientists to thoroughly understand and meet their data needs. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Impact/Strategy: Handles big-sized data engineering projects. Implements robust strategies that significantly improve the organization's data infrastructure.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex, large-scale data systems. Integrates multiple diverse data sources and ensures efficient, reliable data flow across platforms.

Qualifications
Technical Skills

• AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma), and agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

• Data Architecture: Proficiency in Data Mesh concepts, decentralized data architectures, semantic data modeling, knowledge graphs, and ontologies.

• Data Quality & Observability: Ability to implement automated profiling, data lineage tracking, and anomaly detection using frameworks like Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, or dbt.

Experience & Domain Knowledge

• Clinical Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of Clinical Trial Execution (CTE) workflows and operational data systems, specifically CTMS, EDC, and Interactive Response Technology (IxRS).

• Data Product Management: Experience designing and managing the lifecycle of reusable data products, including setting SLAs, creating documentation, and ensuring compliance with GxP standards.

• Stakeholder Management: Proven track record in product-led agile teams, translating business requirements from clinical operators into technical data specifications and communicating complex AI readiness concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): conduce la progettazione, la costruzione e la manutenzione di datadotti scalabili. Funziona indipendentemente per eseguire specifici progetti di ingegneria dei dati dall'inizio alla fine.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complessi problemi di ingestione e trattamento dei dati. Ottimizza i flussi di dati e migliora attivamente le prestazioni del sistema complessivo.
• Stakeholder Management: Engages direttamente con unità aziendali più ampie e scienziati di dati per comprendere e soddisfare le loro esigenze di dati. Comunica efficacemente con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Impact/Strategy: gestisce progetti di ingegneria dei dati di grandi dimensioni. Implementa strategie robuste che migliorano significativamente l'infrastruttura dati dell'organizzazione.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): gestisce sistemi di dati complessi e su larga scala. Integra diverse fonti di dati e garantisce un flusso di dati efficiente e affidabile su piattaforme. Qualifiche Competenze tecniche
• Infrastrutture AI/LLM: Esperienza con pipeline di generazione aumentata (RAG), database vettoriali (come Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma), e framework AI agentici come LangChain, AutoGen e CrewAI.
• Architettura dei dati: competenza nei concetti di Data Mesh, architetture di dati decentrate, modellazione semantica dei dati, grafici di conoscenza e onlogie.
• Qualità dei dati e osservabilità: Capacità di implementare profili automatizzati, tracciamento della linea di dati e rilevamento di anomalia utilizzando framework come Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, o dbt. Esperienza e conoscenza del dominio
• Esperienza di dominio clinico: profonda comprensione dei flussi di lavoro di Esecuzione clinica (CTE) e dei sistemi di dati operativi, in particolare CTMS, EDC e Tecnologia di risposta interattiva (IxRS).
• Gestione dei dati: progettazione e gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati riutilizzabili, compresa l'impostazione di SLA, la creazione di documentazione e la conformità agli standard GxP.
• Stakeholder Management: Provato track record in team agili guidati dai prodotti, traducendo i requisiti aziendali da parte degli operatori clinici in specifiche tecniche dei dati e comunicando concetti complessi di prontezza AI a stakeholder non tecnici. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Sie arbeiten eng mit Datenwissenschaftlern und Analysten zusammen, um ihre spezifischen Datenanforderungen zu erfüllen, indem Sie starke Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder Scala, SQL-Expertenwissen und Kenntnisse in Big Data-Technologien wie Spark nutzen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Aufgabenbereich
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leitet das Design, den Aufbau und die Wartung skalierbarer Datenpipelines. Funktioniert unabhängig, um spezifische Data Engineering-Projekte von Anfang bis Ende auszuführen.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Datenaufnahme- und Verarbeitungsprobleme. Optimiert den Datenfluss und verbessert aktiv die Gesamtsystemleistung.
• Stakeholder Management: Engagiert sich direkt mit breiteren Geschäftseinheiten und Datenwissenschaftlern, um ihre Datenbedürfnisse gründlich zu verstehen und zu erfüllen. Kommuniziert effektiv mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern.
• Impact/Strategie: Bewältigt große Data Engineering-Projekte. Führt robuste Strategien ein, die die Dateninfrastruktur des Unternehmens erheblich verbessern.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Verwaltet komplexe, groß angelegte Datensysteme. Integriert mehrere verschiedene Datenquellen und sorgt für einen effizienten, zuverlässigen Datenfluss über Plattformen hinweg. Qualifikationen Technische Fähigkeiten
• AI/LLM-Infrastruktur: Erfahrung mit Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-Pipelines, Vektordatenbanken (z. B. Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma) und agentischen KI-Frameworks wie LangChain, AutoGen und CrewAI.

• Stakeholder Management: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in produktgeführten agilen Teams, die die Geschäftsanforderungen von klinischen Betreibern in technische Datenspezifikationen übersetzen und komplexe KI-Bereitschaftskonzepte an nicht-technische Stakeholder kommunizieren. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position

IT Business Analyst

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

This role is based in our Patient Reported Outcomes & Digital Health Technology division, which is dedicated to delivering technology solutions for capturing patient-centric data within clinical studies. Operating within a lean, fast-moving micro-team, you will act as a tactical scout to streamline our patient-facing data acquisition platforms, directly reducing the daily burden on clinical trial participants. The outstanding opportunity to use an AI-native approach for rapid prototyping offers you a unique chance to shape human-centric healthcare tech from inception to deployment.
As an integrated part of the team, your main focus will include:

• Drive Patient-Centricity: Turn qualitative trial participant feedback into actionable user experience requirements and map interface flows to minimize data-entry burdens for vulnerable patients.

• Define Product Lifecycle: Support the execution of pilot studies, gather feedback, shape product roadmaps, and act as a System Owner to a portfolio of front-end applications.

• Leverage Rapid Prototyping: Use generative AI tools as a force multiplier to rapidly build concepts, automate user experience testing for diverse user groups, and document system requirements.

• Contribute to Strategy & Vision: Map emerging clinical study needs to platform capabilities, monitor digital health trends, and proactively embed modern AI tools into daily workflows to accelerate analysis.

• Maintain Stakeholder Collaboration: Serve as an active operational bridge between the core technical team, external SaaS vendors, and business-facing clinical functions to manage technical alignment and data validation timelines.

• Consider Performance & Optimization: Use pilot data and system metrics to identify bottlenecks, streamline data acquisition pipelines, and implement agile best practices to accelerate data capture workflows.

• Envisager la performance et l'optimisation : utiliser des données pilotes et des mesures du système pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement, rationaliser les pipelines d'acquisition de données et mettre en oeuvre des pratiques exemplaires agiles pour accélérer les processus de saisie de données. • Expérience : Expérience pratique en analyse d'entreprise, conception UX/UI, analyse de systèmes, ou un rôle de gestion de produits junior, couplé avec une formation ou une solide fondation éducative dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des technologies de santé réglementées.
• Compétences techniques de l'IA-Native: Haute compétence dans la mise à profit d'outils d'IA génériques (p. ex., Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) pour rédiger des scripts, construire des maquettes frontales, automatiser les workflows,

jobs.title: Head of Engineering Applied AI
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description

The Senior Product Leader - Head of Applied AI Engineering is a senior leadership position responsible for defining and executing the engineering strategy, agentic toolkit development, and organizational scaling for the Applied AI department. You will oversee multiple engineering squads, led by Technical Team Leads, focused on building robust, scalable agentic engineering solutions and toolkits, and implementing an Agentic SDLC. You work closely with your peer in Applied AI, the Head of Applied AI Solutions, to ensure your team's delivery fits the business problem, demonstrates value (proof-of-value) and enables the realization of high-value business outcomes through AI innovation.
Your objective is to build a world-class engineering organization that delivers sustainable, secure, and compliant agentic engineering at scale, accelerating the transformation of our business through advanced automation.

Description of the area
The Applied AI Engineering function is the foundational accelerator for agentic engineering across our Software Development and AI initiatives. We focus on industrializing AI through the development of an agentic engineering practices, and the integration of AI-driven tools into the software development lifecycle. We accelerate closing the gap between proof-of-concept and production-grade services.
This leadership role focuses on the structural and strategic health of the engineering discipline, fostering a culture of excellence, high-performance, and continuous technical evolution within our multidisciplinary squads.

Job Responsibilities

• Engineering Strategy & Governance
Define the long-term technical roadmap for Applied AI engineering. Establish global engineering standards, governance frameworks, and architectural principles to ensure applicability and scalability across all AI services.

• Organizational Design & Scaling
Design and build high-performing engineering squads. Lead the recruitment and professional development of Technical Team Leads and engineers. Implement organizational structures that optimize for speed, quality, and cross-functional alignment with business consulting teams.

• Platform Development & AI SDLC
Champion the implementation of Agentic SDLC and modern AI/ML engineering practices. Oversee the development of internal AI platforms that provide reusable components, automated testing, and seamless deployment paths for AI models and applications.

• Strategic Leadership & Financial Oversight
Manage the department's engineering budget, including infrastructure costs and vendor relationships. Collaborate with senior leadership to align engineering capacity with the highest-priority business opportunities. Act as a primary technical advisor to executive stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Partnership
Work in close partnership with the Head of Applied AI Use Case Consulting and Head of Applied AI Solutions to ensure agentic capabilities are integrated into the overall functions demand management process. Ensure that proof of value and delivered solutions meet the business value requirements defined by your peers.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 10-15+ years of experience in software engineering and technical leadership, with a strong emphasis on AI/ML and platform engineering and agentic engineering.

• Tech + Pharma (5++

• Proven track record of building and scaling large-scale engineering organizations and managing multidisciplinary technical managers.

• Expert-level unde

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro The Senior Product Leader - Head of Applied AI Engineering è una posizione di leadership senior responsabile per la definizione e l'esecuzione della strategia di ingegneria, dello sviluppo dei toolkit agentici e della scalabilità organizzativa per il dipartimento di Applied AI. Potrai supervisionare più team ingegneristici, guidati da Technical Team Leads, focalizzati sulla costruzione di soluzioni e toolkit di ingegneria agentic robuste e scalabili, e l'implementazione di un SDLC Agentic. Lavorate a stretto contatto con il vostro peer in Applied AI, il capo delle soluzioni AI applicate, per garantire la consegna del vostro team si adatta al problema del business, dimostra il valore (protetto di valore) e consente la realizzazione di risultati aziendali di alto valore attraverso l'innovazione AI. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di costruire un'organizzazione di ingegneria di livello mondiale che offre un'ingegneria agentec sostenibile, sicura e conforme a scala, accelerando la trasformazione del nostro business attraverso l'automazione avanzata. Descrizione della zona La funzione Applied AI Engineering è l'acceleratore fondamentale per l'ingegneria agentica attraverso le nostre iniziative di sviluppo software e AI. Ci concentriamo sull'industrializzazione dell'IA attraverso lo sviluppo di pratiche ingegneristiche agentiche e l'integrazione di strumenti basati sull'intelligenza artificiale nel ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software. Acceleriamo la chiusura del divario tra i servizi di qualità della prova e quelli di produzione. Questo ruolo di leadership si concentra sulla salute strutturale e strategica della disciplina ingegneristica, promuovendo una cultura di eccellenza, ad alte prestazioni e continua evoluzione tecnica all'interno delle nostre squadre multidisciplinari. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Strategia di ingegneria e governance Definire la roadmap tecnica a lungo termine per l'ingegneria applicata AI. Stabilire standard di ingegneria globale, framework di governance e principi architettonici per garantire l'applicabilità e la scalabilità in tutti i servizi AI.
• Progettazione organizzativa e scala Progettare e costruire squadre di ingegneria ad alte prestazioni. Guidare il reclutamento e lo sviluppo professionale del team tecnico conduce e ingegneri. Realizzare strutture organizzative che ottimizzano per velocità, qualità e allineamento interfunzionale con i team di consulenza aziendale.
• Sviluppo della piattaforma e AI SDLC Campione l'implementazione di Agentic SDLC e moderne pratiche di ingegneria AI/ML. Superare lo sviluppo di piattaforme AI interne che forniscono componenti riutilizzabili, test automatizzati e percorsi di distribuzione senza interruzioni per modelli e applicazioni AI.
• Leadership strategica e supervisione finanziaria Gestire il bilancio di ingegneria del dipartimento, compresi i costi delle infrastrutture e le relazioni dei fornitori. Collabora con la leadership senior per allineare la capacità di ingegneria con le più alte opportunità di business priorità. Agire come consulente tecnico primario per le parti interessate esecutive.
• Partenariato interdisciplinare Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con il capo di Applied AI Use Case Consulting e il responsabile delle soluzioni AI applicate per garantire che le funzionalità agentiche siano integrate nel processo di gestione della domanda di funzioni generali. Assicurarsi che la prova di valore e le soluzioni consegnate soddisfino i requisiti di valore aziendale definiti dai vostri coetanei. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• 10-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria software e nella leadership tecnica, con una forte enfasi sull'ingegneria AI/ML e piattaforma e l'ingegneria agentica.
• Tech + Pharma (5++
• Provato record di traccia di costruzione e scalare grandi organizzazioni ingegneristiche e la gestione di manager tecnici multidisciplinari.
• Unde a livello di esperti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Der Senior Product Leader - Head of Applied AI Engineering ist eine leitende Führungsposition, die für die Definition und Durchführung der Engineering-Strategie, die Entwicklung von Agenten-Toolkits und die organisatorische Skalierung für die Applied AI-Abteilung verantwortlich ist. Sie beaufsichtigen mehrere Engineering-Teams unter der Leitung von Technical Team Leads, die sich auf die Erstellung robuster, skalierbarer Agentic Engineering-Lösungen und Toolkits und die Implementierung eines Agentic SDLC konzentrieren. Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihrem Peer in Applied AI, dem Head of Applied AI Solutions, zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferung Ihres Teams dem Geschäftsproblem entspricht, einen Wert (Proof-of-Value) aufweist und die Realisierung hochwertiger Geschäftsergebnisse durch KI-Innovation ermöglicht. Ihr Ziel ist es, ein erstklassiges Engineering-Unternehmen aufzubauen, das nachhaltiges, sicheres und konformes Agentic Engineering in großem Maßstab liefert und die Transformation unseres Geschäfts durch fortschrittliche Automatisierung beschleunigt. Beschreibung des Gebiets Die Funktion Applied AI Engineering ist der grundlegende Beschleuniger für Agentic Engineering in unseren Softwareentwicklungs- und KI-Initiativen. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Industrialisierung von KI durch die Entwicklung von Agentic Engineering-Praktiken und die Integration von KI-gesteuerten Tools in den Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus. Wir beschleunigen die Schließung der Lücke zwischen Proof-of-Concept- und Production-Grade-Services. Diese Führungsrolle konzentriert sich auf die strukturelle und strategische Gesundheit der Ingenieurdisziplin und fördert eine Kultur der Exzellenz, Hochleistung und kontinuierliche technische Entwicklung in unseren multidisziplinären Kadern. Aufgabenbereich
• Engineering Strategie & Governance Definieren Sie die langfristige technische Roadmap für Applied AI Engineering. Etablieren Sie globale Engineering-Standards, Governance-Frameworks und Architekturprinzipien, um Anwendbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit für alle KI-Services zu gewährleisten.
• Organisationsdesign & Skalierung Entwerfen und bauen Sie leistungsstarke Engineering-Kader. Führen Sie die Rekrutierung und berufliche Entwicklung von technischen Teamleitern und Ingenieuren. Implementieren Sie Organisationsstrukturen, die auf Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung mit Business-Consulting-Teams optimieren.
• Plattformentwicklung & AI SDLC Verfechten Sie die Implementierung von Agentic SDLC und modernen AI / ML-Engineering-Praktiken. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwicklung interner KI-Plattformen, die wiederverwendbare Komponenten, automatisierte Tests und nahtlose Bereitstellungspfade für KI-Modelle und -Anwendungen bereitstellen.
• Strategische Führung und finanzielle Aufsicht Verwalten Sie das Engineering-Budget der Abteilung, einschließlich Infrastrukturkosten und Lieferantenbeziehungen. Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Führungskräften, um die Engineering-Kapazitäten auf die Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit höchster Priorität auszurichten. Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Berater für Executive Stakeholder.
• Funktionsübergreifende Partnerschaft Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Head of Applied AI Use Case Consulting und dem Head of Applied AI Solutions zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass agentische Fähigkeiten in den gesamten Bedarfsmanagementprozess integriert werden. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Wertnachweis und die gelieferten Lösungen die von Ihren Kollegen festgelegten Geschäftswertanforderungen erfüllen. Qualifikationen Bildung / Erfahrung
• 10-15+ Jahre Erfahrung in Software Engineering und technischer Führung, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf AI / ML und Platform Engineering und Agentic Engineering.
• Tech + Pharma (5++)
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau und der Skalierung großer Ingenieurorganisationen und beim Management multidisziplinärer technischer Manager.
• Une auf Expertenebene

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Description du poste Le chef de produit principal - Chef de l'ingénierie de l'IA appliquée est un poste de chef de file chargé de définir et d'exécuter la stratégie d'ingénierie, l'élaboration de trousses d'agents et l'échelle organisationnelle du département de l'IA appliquée. Vous superviserez plusieurs équipes d'ingénieurs, dirigées par Technical Team Diriges, axées sur la construction de solutions et de trousses d'outils d'ingénierie d'agents robustes et évolutives, et la mise en oeuvre d'un SDLC d'agents. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec votre pair dans l'IA appliquée, le responsable des solutions d'IA appliquée, pour s'assurer que la livraison de votre équipe répond au problème d'affaires, démontre de la valeur (preuve de valeur) et permet la réalisation de résultats d'affaires de grande valeur grâce à l'innovation en AI. Votre objectif est de construire une organisation d'ingénierie de calibre mondial qui offre une ingénierie agentique durable, sécurisée et conforme à l'échelle, en accélérant la transformation de notre entreprise par l'automatisation avancée. Description de la zone La fonction Applied AI Engineering est l'accélérateur fondamental de l'ingénierie agentique dans nos initiatives de développement de logiciels et d'IA. Nous nous concentrons sur l'industrialisation de l'IA par le développement de pratiques d'ingénierie agentique et l'intégration d'outils pilotés par l'IA dans le cycle de vie du développement logiciel. Nous accélérons la réduction de l'écart entre les services de preuve de conception et de production. Ce rôle de leadership se concentre sur la santé structurelle et stratégique de la discipline d'ingénierie, favorisant une culture d'excellence, de haute performance et d'évolution technique continue au sein de nos équipes multidisciplinaires. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Stratégie d'ingénierie et gouvernance Définir la feuille de route technique à long terme pour l'ingénierie appliquée de l'IA. Établir des normes d'ingénierie mondiales, des cadres de gouvernance et des principes architecturaux pour assurer l'applicabilité et l'évolutivité de tous les services d'IA.
• Conception organisationnelle et agrandissement Concevoir et construire des équipes d'ingénieurs performantes. Diriger le recrutement et le perfectionnement professionnel des chefs d'équipe technique et des ingénieurs. Mettre en place des structures organisationnelles qui optimisent la rapidité, la qualité et l'alignement interfonctionnel avec les équipes de conseil en affaires.
• Développement de plateformes et AI SDLC Championne de la mise en œuvre de SDLC Agentique et des pratiques modernes d'ingénierie AI/ML. Superviser le développement de plateformes internes d'IA qui fournissent des composants réutilisables, des tests automatisés et des chemins de déploiement sans faille pour les modèles et les applications d'IA.
• Leadership stratégique et surveillance financière Gérer le budget d'ingénierie du Ministère, y compris les coûts d'infrastructure et les relations avec les fournisseurs. Collaborer avec les cadres supérieurs pour aligner la capacité en génie sur les occasions d'affaires les plus prioritaires. Agir à titre de conseiller technique principal auprès des intervenants exécutifs.
• Partenariat interfonctionnel Travailler en partenariat étroit avec le responsable de l'application de l'IA Conseil d'utilisation des cas et le responsable des solutions d'application de l'IA pour s'assurer que les capacités d'agents sont intégrées dans le processus global de gestion de la demande. Assurez-vous que la preuve de la valeur et les solutions livrées répondent aux exigences de valeur opérationnelle définies par vos pairs. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• 10-15 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle et en leadership technique, avec un accent particulier sur l'IA/ML et l'ingénierie des plateformes et des agents.
• Tech + Pharma (5++
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction et de la mise à niveau d'organisations d'ingénierie à grande échelle et de la gestion de gestionnaires techniques multidisciplinaires.
• Niveau expert

jobs.title: Finance Excellence Partner (Roche Diagnostics)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Finance Excellence Partner to join the Roche Diagnostics Turkiye team.

Key Responsibilities

• You will perform, coordinate and monitor Month end closing tasks. Assuring timely and accurate submission in accordance with DIS, FGAR and other associated Global guidance.

• You are local key contact for Group functions, e.g. CCA, RSS Ops to coordinate on financial reporting etc.

• You will maintain robust financial reporting systems, processes and financial controls that are geared towards continuous improvement, centralization and automation and to ensure integrity and reliability of financial statements and information.

• You prepare financial reports/presentations for the affiliate to track and analyze the actual performance against budget,forecasts and KPIs

• You coordinate and setting the process,timeline and clarity of the deliverables of annual budget processes for the finance and the organization

• You proactively provide developed, automated and enhanced standard/management reporting to support business operations, continuous improvements based on market development and needs.

• You identify and analyze inefficiencies and drive continuous improvements, through standardized processes and tasks in the area of Finance Analyst role in Subregion South East

• You work across the Subregion South East Finance Analysts Chapter to ensure that technological advances are integrated in insights generation processes.

• You monitor all finance processes to assure financial compliance. Performing ICFR controls

• You proactively support in cleaning and aligning of Master data in collaboration with master data owners (eg. Supply Chain)

Who You Are

• 3+ years working experience and solid understanding of management and financial accounting as well as affiliate finance

• Possess advanced controlling and reporting skills and expertly manage system landscape used by affiliates incl. BI tool know-how (e.g. tableau)

• Systems thinking – understands interdependencies within and above the affiliate. Establishes streamlined and harmonized financial processes and systems across the subregion

• Knowledge of SAP, EDI, Sales Force, and Microsoft Office will be preferred

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English & Turkish,month-end

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: CRM Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Principal Business Analyst acts as a senior strategic tech consultant, leveraging in-depth knowledge of the commercial sales domain and CRM architectures to provide holistic, global product ownership of CRM Sales. Operating effectively within a complex matrix organization, you will work closely with regional product ownership to navigate regional nuances, drive consensus, and manage strict backlog prioritization. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to handle the complexity of interconnected systems and integrations, overseeing both the daily operational world and next-generation AI capabilities (including Slack and Agentforce frameworks) with full autonomy. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term product roadmaps, steer global cross-functional teams, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.

Your Responsibilities

• Scope/(Content Leadership): Oversees global CRM Sales product streams with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale across our operational ecosystem. Defines and leads technical discovery efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigates complex frameworks, and delegates work while managing the quality of the product backlog and technical delivery.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business and platform problems, defining the problem space and driving comprehensive root cause analysis that spans complex integration boundaries. Proactively prevents custom-code and scope creep, manages the complexity of various scopes of change, and is ultimately accountable for product deliverables and operational stability, ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across regional and global organizational boundaries. Shapes product strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to drive unified platform alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects and programs by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with commercial business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced AI capability assessments (Agentforce, automation loops) and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term global product roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works typically on a global product or product line level, effectively managing highly ambiguous and evolving requirements in dynamic, live operational environments. Demonstrates a holistic viewpoint to analyze problems, considering potential micro and macro implications across related domains and interconnected integration layers (such as Slack collaboration hubs).

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies (Salesforce multi-cloud architecture) to inform business strategies. Leads the application of tools, principles, and techniques across complex and cross-functional initiatives, anticipating challenges and proactively integrating advanced integration patterns and AI capabilities into broader solution design.

Who You Are

• Extensive experience overseeing global product initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Product Ownership, CRM Sales ecosystems, and modern cloud concepts an

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il principale Business Analyst agisce come consulente tecnico strategico senior, sfruttando la conoscenza approfondita del dominio commerciale di vendita e le architetture CRM per fornire la proprietà globale del prodotto di CRM vendite. Operando efficacemente all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice complessa, lavorerai a stretto contatto con la proprietà dei prodotti regionali per navigare le sfumature regionali, guidare il consenso e gestire rigide priorità backlog. In questo ruolo, si applicano sistemi che pensano di gestire la complessità di sistemi e integrazioni interconnesse, supervisionando sia il mondo operativo quotidiano che le capacità AI di nuova generazione (compresi i quadri Slack e Agentforce) con piena autonomia. Facendo da consulente di fiducia per la leadership, formerai attivamente roadmap di prodotto a lungo termine, guiderai team multifunzionali globali e ti consiglio soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per la trasformazione aziendale sostenibile. Le tue responsabilità
• Scope/(Content Leadership): supervisiona i flussi globali di prodotti CRM Sales con autonomia, coordinando complessità e scala in tutto il nostro ecosistema operativo. Definisce e conduce gli sforzi di scoperta tecnica in spazi altamente ambigui, naviga strutture complesse e i delegati lavorano mentre gestiscono la qualità del backlog del prodotto e la consegna tecnica.
• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali e della piattaforma, definendo lo spazio di problema e guidando l'analisi completa delle cause che abbraccia i confini di integrazione complessi. Proattivamente impedisce il codice personalizzato e lo scopo strisciare, gestisce la complessità di vari ambiti di cambiamento, ed è in definitiva responsabile per i prodotti consegnabili e la stabilità operativa, garantendo l'allineamento con obiettivi organizzativi più ampi.
• Stakeholder Management: Identificare e coinvolgere i principali stakeholder, tra cui la gestione, attraverso i confini organizzativi regionali e globali. Forma la strategia del prodotto come consulente di fiducia per la leadership, naviga attivamente i conflitti per guidare l'allineamento della piattaforma unificata e potenzia i team nella gestione degli stakeholder.
• Impatto/Strategia: spinge un impatto significativo su progetti e programmi garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni ad alto valore che si allineano con la strategia aziendale commerciale. Conduce la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica, comprese le valutazioni avanzate delle capacità AI (Agentforce, loop di automazione) e la valutazione del rischio, e forma attivamente roadmap globali di prodotto a lungo termine.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona tipicamente a livello globale di prodotto o di linea di prodotto, gestendo efficacemente requisiti altamente ambigui ed evolutivi in ambienti operativi dinamici e dal vivo. Dimostra un punto di vista olistico per analizzare i problemi, considerando potenziali implicazioni micro e macro tra domini correlati e strati di integrazione interconnessi (come hub di collaborazione Slack).
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: Utilizza la conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale o tecnico e le tecnologie pertinenti (architettura multi-cloud di Salesforce) per informare le strategie aziendali. Conduce l'applicazione di strumenti, principi e tecniche attraverso iniziative complesse e interfunzionali, anticipando le sfide e integrando proattivamente modelli di integrazione avanzati e le capacità di AI nella progettazione di soluzioni più ampie. Chi sei
• Esperienza ampia che supervisiona le iniziative globali di prodotto con autonomia, coordinamento della complessità e della scala, e allineamento di guida in spazi altamente ambigui.
• Conoscenza avanzata dimostrata della proprietà dei prodotti, degli ecosistemi di vendita CRM e dei moderni concetti cloud

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Principal Business Analyst fungiert als Senior Strategic Tech Consultant und nutzt fundierte Kenntnisse der kommerziellen Vertriebsdomäne und CRM-Architekturen, um einen ganzheitlichen, globalen Produktbesitz von CRM Sales zu gewährleisten. Wenn Sie innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation effektiv arbeiten, arbeiten Sie eng mit dem regionalen Product Ownership zusammen, um regionale Nuancen zu navigieren, den Konsens zu fördern und eine strikte Priorisierung des Backlogs zu verwalten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Systeme anwenden, die darauf ausgelegt sind, die Komplexität miteinander verbundener Systeme und Integrationen zu bewältigen und sowohl die tägliche Betriebswelt als auch die KI-Fähigkeiten der nächsten Generation (einschließlich Slack- und Agentforce-Frameworks) mit voller Autonomie zu überwachen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte gestalten Sie aktiv langfristige Produkt-Roadmaps, steuern globale funktionsübergreifende Teams und empfehlen optimale Technologielösungen für eine nachhaltige Geschäftstransformation. Ihre Aufgaben
• Scope/(Content Leadership): Überwacht globale CRM Sales Produktströme mit Autonomie, koordiniert Komplexität und Skalierung in unserem operativen Ökosystem. Definiert und leitet technische Entdeckungsbemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Bereichen, navigiert komplexe Frameworks und die Arbeit der Delegierten bei der Verwaltung der Qualität des Produktbestands und der technischen Lieferung.
• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäfts- und Plattformproblemen, definiert den Problemraum und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse durch, die komplexe Integrationsgrenzen umfasst. Proaktiv verhindert benutzerdefiniertes Code- und Scope-Creep, verwaltet die Komplexität verschiedener Änderungsbereiche und ist letztlich für Produktergebnisse und Betriebsstabilität verantwortlich, wodurch die Ausrichtung auf breitere organisatorische Ziele sichergestellt wird.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifiziert und engagiert wichtige Stakeholder, einschließlich des Managements, über regionale und globale Organisationsgrenzen hinweg. Gestaltet die Produktstrategie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung, steuert aktiv Konflikte, um eine einheitliche Plattformausrichtung zu erreichen, und stärkt Teams im Stakeholder-Management.
• Auswirkung/Strategie: Fördert erhebliche Auswirkungen auf Projekte und Programme, indem es die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Lösungen sicherstellt, die mit der kommerziellen Geschäftsstrategie übereinstimmen. Leitet die Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen, einschließlich erweiterter KI-Fähigkeitsbewertungen (Agentforce, Automatisierungsschleifen) und Risikobewertungen, und gestaltet aktiv langfristige globale Produkt-Roadmaps.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert typischerweise auf einer globalen Produkt- oder Produktlinienebene und verwaltet effektiv sehr mehrdeutige und sich entwickelnde Anforderungen in dynamischen, live-Betriebsumgebungen. Demonstriert einen ganzheitlichen Standpunkt zur Analyse von Problemen unter Berücksichtigung möglicher Mikro- und Makroimplikationen über verwandte Domänen und miteinander verbundene Integrationsschichten (wie Slack Collaboration Hubs).
• Business / Technical Fahigkeit: Verwendet fundierte Kenntnisse des Geschäfts- oder technischen Bereichs und relevanter Technologien (Salesforce Multi-Cloud-Architektur), um Geschäftsstrategien zu informieren. Leitet die Anwendung von Tools, Prinzipien und Techniken in komplexen und funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen, antizipiert Herausforderungen und integriert proaktiv fortschrittliche Integrationsmuster und KI-Fähigkeiten in ein breiteres Lösungsdesign. Wer du bist
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Überwachung globaler Produktinitiativen mit Autonomie, der Koordination von Komplexität und Skalierung sowie der Ausrichtung auf sehr mehrdeutige Bereiche.
• Nachgewiesenes fortgeschrittenes Wissen über Product Ownership, CRM Sales Ökosysteme und moderne Cloud-Konzepte
