Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'analyste principal des affaires agit à titre de consultant principal en technologie stratégique, en tirant parti de connaissances approfondies du domaine des ventes commerciales et des architectures CRM pour assurer la propriété globale des produits de CRM Sales. Fonctionnant efficacement au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la propriété régionale des produits afin de naviguer dans les nuances régionales, de susciter un consensus et de gérer un arriéré de priorités rigoureux. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée des systèmes pour gérer la complexité des systèmes et des intégrations interconnectés, en supervisant à la fois le monde opérationnel quotidien et les capacités d'IA de prochaine génération (y compris les cadres Slack et Agentforce) avec pleine autonomie. En tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, vous élaborerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, dirigerez des équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour une transformation durable des entreprises. Vos responsabilités
• Portée/( Leadership du contenu) : Supervise les flux de produits CRM mondiaux avec autonomie, coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle dans notre écosystème opérationnel. Définit et dirige les efforts de découverte technique dans des espaces très ambigus, navigue dans des cadres complexes et délègue le travail tout en gérant la qualité de l'arriéré de produits et la prestation technique.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires et de plate-forme, définit l'espace des problèmes et dirige une analyse globale des causes profondes qui couvre les frontières d'intégration complexes. Prévient de façon proactive le changement de code et de portée sur mesure, gère la complexité des divers champs de changement et, en fin de compte, rend compte des produits livrables et de la stabilité opérationnelle, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs organisationnels plus généraux.
• Gestion des intervenants : Identifier et mobiliser les principaux intervenants, y compris la gestion, au-delà des frontières organisationnelles régionales et mondiales. Forme la stratégie de produit en tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, navigue activement les conflits pour conduire l'alignement unifié de la plate-forme, et habilite les équipes dans la gestion des intervenants.
• Impact/Stratégie : Conduit un impact important sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la prestation de solutions de grande valeur qui s'harmonisent avec la stratégie commerciale. Dirige l'évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l'évaluation avancée des capacités d'IA (force d'intervention, boucles d'automatisation) et l'évaluation des risques, et façonne activement les feuilles de route à long terme des produits mondiaux.
• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne généralement au niveau mondial ou de la gamme de produits, gérant efficacement des exigences très ambiguës et évolutives dans des environnements opérationnels dynamiques et vivants. Démontrer un point de vue holistique pour analyser les problèmes, en tenant compte des implications micro et macro potentielles dans les domaines connexes et les couches d'intégration interconnectées (comme les centres de collaboration Slack).
• Capacités d'affaires / techniques : Utilise une connaissance approfondie du domaine d'affaires ou technique et des technologies pertinentes (architecture multicloud de Salesforce) pour éclairer les stratégies d'affaires. Diriger l'application d'outils, de principes et de techniques dans le cadre d'initiatives complexes et interfonctionnelles, anticiper les défis et intégrer de façon proactive les modèles d'intégration avancés et les capacités d'IA dans la conception de solutions plus larges. Qui vous êtes
• Une vaste expérience en matière de supervision des initiatives mondiales de produits avec autonomie, coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle, et conduite de l'alignement dans des espaces très ambigus.
• Connaissance avancée démontrée de la propriété de produit, des écosystèmes CRM Sales et des concepts modernes de cloud

jobs.title: Senior Field Service Engineer (Kuwait)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Field Service Engineer is responsible for providing on-site technical support for the installation, commissioning, preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting of Roche equipment. This role involves traveling to customer sites to ensure equipment is operating at peak performance. This individual will work under general supervision, handling routine service calls independently while assisting team members on more complex issues. You will play an important role in ensuring healthcare professionals and laboratories can operate with confidence, helping support better outcomes for patients across Kuwait.

Your Responsibilities

• Deliver the planned system installations and carry out installations as per Roche standards.

• Ensure all service activities are performed and documented in a timely manner as per Roche standards.

• Ensures coverage and support in line with agreements with customers and necessary accreditation requirements are met.

• Escalate technical issues, PRI/PSI to appropriate internal stakeholder and follow up for closure.

• Timely forecast spare parts of systems for line of expertise.

• Ensure Key deliverables i.e. Uptime, customer satisfaction, Value of service to manage expectations for assigned strategic customers are met.

• Accountable for mandatory upgrades/ modifications for assigned systems and ensure that been done for all systems in the country.

• Provide expert technical opinion, identify possible solutions and recommend strategies that lead to timely and effective resolution of high priority issues. Act as mentor and lend support to FSEs to resolve complex and persistent issues.

• Accountable for assigned administrative tasks (PPM scheduling, Modifications, e services, Service Marketing, Service revenue).

• Establishes and develops a relationship with the customer that enhances the reputation and professionalism of Roche Diagnostics.

• Provides clear and appropriate customer communication, including pro-active arrangement of routine preventative and corrective maintenance visits.

• Ensures that all administration and back office tasks are completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who You Are
You are a proactive and customer-focused technical professional who enjoys solving problems and working in a dynamic field-based environment. You are able to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• You hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, Biomedical, Electronic, Mechatronics or relevant fields

• You built 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in a technical support, maintenance, or field service role. The ideal candidate built experience handling Roche IVD instruments such as Pre and Post Analytics / C6800 / Ultra plus / U6500 / Cobas PRO / Cobas Pure

• You have advanced problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with customers and colleagues

• You are able to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work under tight deadline

• You are proactive with learning-oriented mindset, and are motivated to work in a hands-on environment and support field operations

• You have deep understanding of digital technologies, Automation and their application in service operations

• You have excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills with the ability to convey strategic concepts to a diverse audience

• You are detail-oriented and able to work independently as well as collaborati

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Field Service Engineer is responsible for providing on-site technical support for the installation, commissioning, preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting of Roche equipment. This role involves traveling to customer sites to ensure equipment is operating at peak performance. This individual will work under general supervision, handling routine service calls independently while assisting team members on more complex issues. You will play an important role in ensuring healthcare professionals and laboratories can operate with confidence, helping support better outcomes for patients across Kuwait.

Your Responsibilities

• Deliver the planned system installations and carry out installations as per Roche standards.

• Ensure all service activities are performed and documented in a timely manner as per Roche standards.

• Ensures coverage and support in line with agreements with customers and necessary accreditation requirements are met.

• Escalate technical issues, PRI/PSI to appropriate internal stakeholder and follow up for closure.

• Timely forecast spare parts of systems for line of expertise.

• Ensure Key deliverables i.e. Uptime, customer satisfaction, Value of service to manage expectations for assigned strategic customers are met.

• Accountable for mandatory upgrades/ modifications for assigned systems and ensure that been done for all systems in the country.

• Provide expert technical opinion, identify possible solutions and recommend strategies that lead to timely and effective resolution of high priority issues. Act as mentor and lend support to FSEs to resolve complex and persistent issues.

• Accountable for assigned administrative tasks (PPM scheduling, Modifications, e services, Service Marketing, Service revenue).

• Establishes and develops a relationship with the customer that enhances the reputation and professionalism of Roche Diagnostics.

• Provides clear and appropriate customer communication, including pro-active arrangement of routine preventative and corrective maintenance visits.

• Ensures that all administration and back office tasks are completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who You Are
You are a proactive and customer-focused technical professional who enjoys solving problems and working in a dynamic field-based environment. You are able to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• You hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, Biomedical, Electronic, Mechatronics or relevant fields

• You built 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in a technical support, maintenance, or field service role. The ideal candidate built experience handling Roche IVD instruments such as Pre and Post Analytics / C6800 / Ultra plus / U6500 / Cobas PRO / Cobas Pure

• You have advanced problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with customers and colleagues

• You are able to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work under tight deadline

• You are proactive with learning-oriented mindset, and are motivated to work in a hands-on environment and support field operations

• You have deep understanding of digital technologies, Automation and their application in service operations

• You have excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills with the ability to convey strategic concepts to a diverse audience

• You are detail-oriented and able to work independently as well as collaborati

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche Diagnostics gestalten wir die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung. In Penzberg schlägt das Herz unserer Produktion für hochwertige Einsatzstoffe, die weltweit in der Diagnostik und Therapie entscheidende Unterschiede machen. Hier zählt Deine Expertise: Mit Leidenschaft für organische Synthese und einem scharfen Blick für Qualität trägst Du dazu bei, dass Patient:innen weltweit zuverlässige Ergebnisse erhalten. Werde Teil eines Umfelds, in dem Deine Stimme zählt und Deine Entwicklung im Fokus steht.

Dein neues Team:
Du verstärkst unsere Abteilung „Production Organic Chemistry“ im Bereich Chemistry Mid and Small Scale . Wir sind ein engagiertes Team, das chemische Reagenzien und interne Standards vom Labor- bis zum Technikumsmaßstab herstellt. Bei uns triffst Du auf eine Kultur des Miteinanders: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, meistern gemeinsam die „Extra-Meile“ und legen großen Wert auf eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance. Wir freuen uns auf Deine frischen Impulse!

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle bist Du der Motor für unsere Produktionsprozesse und stellst sicher, dass Innovation und Präzision Hand in Hand gehen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

• Du übernimmst die fachliche Leitung im Tagesgeschäft des Produktionsbereichs. Dabei begleitest Du Projekte fachlich und stellst den reibungslosen Ablauf sicher.

• Du betreust Produktionsansätze sowie Betriebsversuche und steuerst moderne Anlagen und Software zur Herstellung unserer Produkte.

• Du implementierst sicherheits- und qualitätsrelevante Prozesse, führst Batch Record Reviews durch und bewertest Produktionsabweichungen in enger Abstimmung mit den Schnittstellen.

• Du verantwortest den Transfer von neuen Methoden und Verfahren aus der Entwicklung in den Technikumsmaßstab und optimierst bestehende Einrichtungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Bereich Manufacturing Science and Technology.

• Du führst analytische Tests durch, wertest diese aus und erstellst präzise Herstellvorschriften sowie Kalkulationen gemäß den gültigen Vorgaben.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine proaktive Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und komplexe chemische Fragestellungen strukturiert löst.

• Du hast Dein Studium der Chemie (Master oder Diplom) erfolgreich mit einer Promotion in organischer Synthese-Chemie abgeschlossen.

• Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Kenntnisse in der präparativen Synthese. Du besitzt Erfahrung im regulierten Produktionsumfeld der organisch-chemischen Produktion und im Scale-up (Labor zu Technikum)

• Du hast Freude daran, Dich in neue technische Anlagen einzuarbeiten, und handelst stets verantwortungsbewusst hinsichtlich Arbeitssicherheit und Qualitätssicherung.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, der souverän mit diversen Schnittstellen interagiert und durch Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie eine gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise überzeugt.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gehst routiniert mit gängigen EDV-Anwendungen um.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche Diagnostics, stiamo plasmando il futuro della salute. A Penzberg, il cuore della nostra produzione batte per materiali di input di alta qualità che fanno una differenza decisiva nella diagnostica e nella terapia in tutto il mondo. Qui conta la tua esperienza: Con una passione per la sintesi organica e un occhio attento alla qualità Aiuta i pazienti a ottenere risultati affidabili in tutto il mondo. Diventa parte di un ambiente in cui la tua voce conta e il tuo sviluppo è l'obiettivo. La tua nuova squadra: Rafforzare il nostro reparto di chimica organica di produzione nel campo della Chimica di metà e piccola scala. Siamo un team dedicato che produce reagenti chimici e standard interni da laboratorio a scala di impianti pilota. Con noi, incontrerete una cultura di cooperazione: Ci sosteniamo a vicenda, padroneggiamo il “extra mile” insieme e attribuiamo grande importanza ad un sano equilibrio di vita lavorativa. Attendiamo con ansia i vostri impulsi freschi! Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta In questo ruolo, sei il motore per i nostri processi produttivi e assicurati che innovazione e precisione vadano di pari passo. I vostri compiti includono:
• Si prende il controllo della gestione professionale nel business giorno per giorno della zona di produzione. Accompagnate professionalmente i progetti e assicurate il flusso liscio.
• Si supervisiona gli approcci di produzione, nonché le prove operative e il controllo di sistemi e software moderni per la produzione dei nostri prodotti.
• Si implementano processi di sicurezza e di qualità rilevanti, eseguire recensioni discografiche batch e valutare deviazioni di produzione in stretto coordinamento con le interfacce.
• Sarete responsabili del trasferimento di nuovi metodi e processi, dallo sviluppo alla scala pilota e dell'ottimizzazione delle strutture esistenti in collaborazione con il settore della scienza e della tecnologia manifatturiera.
• Eseguire test analitici, eseguirli e creare precise linee guida e calcoli di produzione secondo le specifiche applicabili. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti Sei una personalità proattiva che ama assumersi la responsabilità e risolvere complessi problemi chimici in modo strutturato.
• Hai completato con successo i tuoi studi in chimica (master o diploma) con un dottorato in chimica di sintesi organica.
• Hai una profonda conoscenza pratica della sintesi preparatoria. Avete esperienza nell'ambiente di produzione regolamentato della produzione organica-chimica e nella scala-up (laboratorio a impianto pilota)
• Vi piace familiarizzare con nuove strutture tecniche e agire sempre responsabilmente per quanto riguarda la sicurezza del lavoro e l'assicurazione della qualità.
• Sei un giocatore di squadra che interagisce con fiducia con varie interfacce e convince attraverso l'assertività e un modo di lavoro coscienzioso.
• Si comunica in modo sicuro in tedesco e di routine trattare con applicazioni EDP comuni. La tua domanda Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti:
• Profilo attuale del CV o della giornata di lavoro
• I certificati e le prove ufficiali (educativi) Attualmente non sono necessari ulteriori documenti. Prima di presentare la domanda, si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti in seguito. Applicare ora – siamo felici! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo Un'hena

In Penzberg, the heart of our production beats for high-quality input materials that make a decisive difference in diagnostics and therapy worldwide. Responsibility | This is what awaits you In this role, you are the engine for our production processes and ensure that innovation and precision go hand in hand. Your tasks include:

• You supervise production approaches as well as operational tests and control modern systems and software for the production of our products.
• You implement safety- and quality-relevant processes, perform batch record reviews and evaluate production deviations in close coordination with the interfaces.
• You will be responsible for the transfer of new methods and processes from development to pilot scale and optimize existing facilities in cooperation with the field of Manufacturing Science and Technology.

The Roche Kuwait early in career Program is a 12 months rotational development program at Roche. The program is tailored for high potential individuals at an early stage of their career, and No work experience is required. The program accelerates their professional development and enables them to be key contributors to Roche's purpose and what patients need next.

Your Responsibilities

• Provide back-office support to the Professional Services team through Roche Field Service solutions, including case creation and dispatching to assigned personnel

• Collaborate with the Service Team Leader to prepare necessary documents and schedule instrument implementations with customers, manage preventive maintenance (PM) schedules, and upload PM reports for invoicing processes for public and private hospitals.

• Manage spare parts by arranging courier services, overseeing spare part inventory, ordering, and collaborating with supply chain for order follow-ups.

• Archive both hard and soft copies of service documents and maintain organized filing systems in the office and core map.

• Manage document flow between Roche, and the customers, including contracts, proposals, quotations, and repair requests.

• Control the numbering, sorting, filing, and retrieval of documents produced by the technical team or department to ensure accuracy and security.

• Support the team with petty cash management, handling departmental expenses, and processing documents efficiently.

Your Opportunity

• Participants build an extensive network within Roche and upskill themselves

• Best possible work environment is designed to foster participants' learning experience

• You are at an early stage in your career. Fresh graduates will be preferred

• You are eager to work with diverse cultures

• You are curious and have passion for learning new things, and have high degree of integrity and courage

• You have excellent communication and innovative skills

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Kuwait early in career Program is a 12 months rotational development program at Roche. The program is tailored for high potential individuals at an early stage of their career, and No work experience is required. The program accelerates their professional development and enables them to be key contributors to Roche's purpose and what patients need next.

Roche Kuwait offers Professional Service Administrator position for a period of 11 months and one month rotation with the below main responsibilities:

Your Responsibilities

• Provide back-office support to the Professional Services team through Roche Field Service solutions, including case creation and dispatching to assigned personnel

• Collaborate with the Service Team Leader to prepare necessary documents and schedule instrument implementations with customers, manage preventive maintenance (PM) schedules, and upload PM reports for invoicing processes for public and private hospitals.

• Manage spare parts by arranging courier services, overseeing spare part inventory, ordering, and collaborating with supply chain for order follow-ups.

• Liaise with various teams to prepare and send necessary documents (urgent letters, site service reports, etc.) to field engineers.

• Collaborate with business partners (e.g., water units, UPS, 3rd-party materials, lab renovation contractors) to track daily pending issues and manage reminders.

• Daily monitoring and updating of internal systems cases for field engineers; open, dispatch, and follow up on cases through to closure.

• Archive both hard and soft copies of service documents and maintain organized filing systems in the office and core map.

• Manage document flow between Roche, and the customers, including contracts, proposals, quotations, and repair requests.

• Control the numbering, sorting, filing, and retrieval of documents produced by the technical team or department to ensure accuracy and security.

• Support the team with petty cash management, handling departmental expenses, and processing documents efficiently.

Your Opportunity

• Participants build an extensive network within Roche and upskill themselves

• Best possible work environment is designed to foster participants' learning experience

• Participants will have access to senior leaders and will be assigned to a mentor to support their career journey

• Contributing to purpose driven projects and taking responsibilities from day 1

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor degree in Life Sciences, Economy, Business Administration, or any related area

• You are at an early stage in your career. Fresh graduates will be preferred

• Having a basic understanding of healthcare system is preferred

• You are eager to work with diverse cultures

• You are curious and have passion for learning new things, and have high degree of integrity and courage

• You have excellent communication and innovative skills

• You are proficient in English

Our mission
Roche is a global pioneer and leader in Personalized Healthcare. We provide breakthrough differentiated medicines and diagnostic tests using expertise in Science, Technology and Data so that people can live better lives. We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all.

We are living in truly historic times. The rapid digitalization of healthcare fuels an accelerated transformation in

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) will lead the PHCS's new business development activities for Path Labs and is accountable for Roche's Global Personalized Healthcare Solutions new incremental revenue related to the Path Lab portfolio. The successful candidate in this role will be responsible for identifying, driving and creating relationships with new and existing emerging biopharma partners. This role is primarily responsible for sourcing and onboarding new biopharma partners and developing strategic plans to create a qualifi ed pipeline of opportunities to drive sustainable revenue and growth. This role will report to the Head of the PHCS Pharma Partnering team at Roche Diagnostics Solutions and will be expected to work collaboratively across the organization to achieve results. Customers are pharmaceutical and/or therapeutic device companies that partner with Roche Diagnostics for their pharma services and companion diagnostic projects. We seek a highly motivated, collaborative individual with a strong drive to succeed who enjoys building, infl uencing, and working with a diverse team.

The Opportunity:

• Leads new business development for the Emerging Biopharma Partnering effort, contracts management activities for the Path Lab Customer Area portfolio serving global customers.

• Establishes objectives and develops business strategies needed to increase the penetration of external (i.e. non-Roche Group) emerging biopharma accounts.

• Develops, maintains and executes a strong pipeline of new business and qualifi ed leads across all different diagnostic testing modalities.

• Maintains a good understanding of the trends in the pharmaceutical industry and how they impact the companion diagnostic business. Leverages these insights to support the strategic plan of the organization.

• Conducts research on emerging business trends and economic requirements of the pharmaceutical industry and researches, screens and recommends key target companies for business alliance.

• Works with Project and CAP/CLIA Lab leadership to ensure projects can be fully supported and delivered on quality and time.

• Closely collaborates with all functions (e.g. legal, regulatory, development) to align our partnership activities with the capabilities of the organization.

• Travel: Estimated 25%

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Life Science

• You hold a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in sales, partnering, or new business development activities.

• You have a proven track record in achieving company goals through the creation of strategic partnerships, including pre-contract negotiations and post-contract alliance management.

• You possess experience with the establishment of contracts, development of pricing strategies and monitoring contract fulfi llment

• Working knowledge of worldwide pharmaceutical and in vitro diagnostic markets, including product development strategies, regulatory environment, relevant technologies and global commercialization.

• You have a high-level understanding of the different diagnostic testing modalities and ability to advise partners on the best technological options.

• You bring a strong background and knowledge

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) guiderà le nuove attività di sviluppo commerciale del PHCS per Path Labs ed è responsabile per le soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate globali di Roche nuove entrate incrementali relative al portafoglio Path Lab. Il candidato di successo in questo ruolo sarà responsabile per l'identificazione, la guida e la creazione di relazioni con nuovi e esistenti partner biofarmaci emergenti. Questo ruolo è in primo luogo responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'imbarco di nuovi partner biofarmaci e dello sviluppo di piani strategici per creare una pipeline di opportunità per guidare ricavi e crescita sostenibili. Questo ruolo si riferirà al responsabile del team PHCS Pharma Partnering di Roche Diagnostics Solutions e sarà previsto di lavorare in collaborazione attraverso l'organizzazione per raggiungere i risultati. I clienti sono aziende di dispositivi farmaceutici e/o terapeutici che collaborano con Roche Diagnostics per i loro servizi farmaceutici e i progetti diagnostici dei compagni. Cerchiamo un individuo altamente motivato e collaborativo con un forte sforzo per avere successo che gode di costruzione, infl uencing, e lavorare con un team diverso. L'opportunità:
• Conduce un nuovo sviluppo aziendale per lo sforzo di Emerging Biopharma Partnering, attività di gestione dei contratti per il portafoglio Path Lab Customer Area che serve clienti globali.
• Stabilisce obiettivi e sviluppa strategie di business necessarie per aumentare la penetrazione di conti biofarmaci emergenti esterni (cioè non-Roche Group).
• Sviluppa, mantiene ed esegue una forte conduttura di nuovi business e qualifi ed conduce attraverso tutte le diverse modalità di test diagnostici.
• Mantiene una buona comprensione delle tendenze nell'industria farmaceutica e come influiscono sul business diagnostico del compagno. Leva queste informazioni per sostenere il piano strategico dell'organizzazione.
• Conduce la ricerca sulle tendenze di business emergenti e i requisiti economici dell'industria farmaceutica e delle ricerche, schermi e raccomanda le aziende di punta chiave per l'alleanza aziendale.
• Funziona con la leadership di Project e CAP/CLIA Lab per garantire che i progetti possano essere pienamente supportati e consegnati in qualità e tempo.
• Collabora strettamente con tutte le funzioni (ad esempio legali, regolamentari, di sviluppo) per allineare le nostre attività di partnership con le capacità dell'organizzazione.
• Viaggi: stimato 25% Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Scienze della Vita
• Hai un minimo di 6-8 anni di esperienza in vendite, partner, o nuove attività di sviluppo aziendale.
• Hai una comprovata esperienza nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali attraverso la creazione di partenariati strategici, tra cui i negoziati precontrattuali e la gestione delle alleanze post-contrattuali.
• Possiedi esperienza con la creazione di contratti, lo sviluppo di strategie di prezzi e il controllo del contratto fulfi llment
• Conoscenze di lavoro dei mercati farmaceutici e diagnostici in vitro in tutto il mondo, comprese le strategie di sviluppo del prodotto, l'ambiente normativo, le tecnologie rilevanti e la commercializzazione globale.
• Hai una comprensione di alto livello delle diverse modalità di test diagnostici e la capacità di consigliare i partner sulle migliori opzioni tecnologiche.
• Porti uno sfondo forte e una conoscenza

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) dirigera les nouvelles activités de développement commercial du PHCS pour Path Labs et sera responsable des nouvelles recettes supplémentaires liées au portefeuille Path Lab de Roche. Le candidat retenu dans ce rôle sera chargé d'identifier, de diriger et d'établir des relations avec les nouveaux partenaires biopharmaceutiques et les nouveaux partenaires existants. Ce rôle est principalement responsable de l'approvisionnement et de l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires biopharmaceutiques et de l'élaboration de plans stratégiques visant à créer une réserve d'opportunités pour stimuler des revenus et une croissance durables. Ce rôle relèvera du chef de l'équipe de partenariat PHCS Pharma chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions et devrait travailler en collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour obtenir des résultats. Les clients sont des entreprises pharmaceutiques et/ou thérapeutiques qui collaborent avec Roche Diagnostics pour leurs services pharmaceutiques et leurs projets de diagnostic. Nous recherchons une personne hautement motivée et collaborative, avec une forte volonté de réussir qui aime construire, influer et travailler avec une équipe diversifiée. La possibilité :
• Dirige le développement de nouvelles activités pour l'effort de partenariat en biopharma émergent, les activités de gestion des contrats pour le portefeuille client de Path Lab au service des clients mondiaux.
• Établir des objectifs et élaborer des stratégies d'affaires nécessaires pour accroître la pénétration des comptes biopharmaceutiques émergents externes (c.-à-d. non-Groupe Roche).
• Développer, entretenir et exécuter un important portefeuille de nouvelles activités et des pistes qualifiées pour toutes les différentes modalités de tests diagnostiques.
• Maintient une bonne compréhension des tendances dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et de l'impact qu'elles ont sur les activités diagnostiques des partenaires. Tire parti de ces idées pour appuyer le plan stratégique de l'organisation.
• Mener des recherches sur les nouvelles tendances commerciales et les besoins économiques de l'industrie pharmaceutique et des recherches, filtrer et recommander des entreprises cibles clés pour les alliances commerciales.
• Travaille avec la direction du projet et du laboratoire CAP/CLIA pour s'assurer que les projets peuvent être entièrement soutenus et livrés en temps et en qualité.
• Collabore étroitement avec toutes les fonctions (p. ex., juridiques, réglementaires, de développement) afin d'harmoniser nos activités de partenariat avec les capacités de l'organisation.
• Voyages : estimation de 25 % Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie
• Vous possédez un minimum de 6-8 ans d'expérience dans les activités de vente, de partenariat ou de développement d'entreprise.
• Vous avez fait preuve d'une expérience dans la réalisation des objectifs de l'entreprise grâce à la création de partenariats stratégiques, y compris les négociations précontractuelles et la gestion des alliances postcontractuelles.
• Vous possédez de l'expérience dans l'établissement de contrats, l'élaboration de stratégies de tarification et le suivi de l'exécution des contrats
• Connaissance pratique des marchés mondiaux des produits pharmaceutiques et des diagnostics in vitro, y compris les stratégies de développement des produits, l'environnement réglementaire, les technologies pertinentes et la commercialisation mondiale.
• Vous avez une compréhension de haut niveau des différentes modalités de tests diagnostiques et la capacité de conseiller les partenaires sur les meilleures options technologiques.
• Vous apportez une solide expérience et connaissance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea (한국로슈진단)
Division: Core Lab & POC (진단검사 사업부)
Location: 서울
Position: Sales Representative (영업)

Your key responsibilities
Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Printing & Automation) (Madrid)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Platform Engineer for Onsite Technologies, you will play a key role in the design, evolution, and continuous improvement of Roche’s workplace technology platforms. You will provide technical leadership across enterprise workplace services with a particular focus on Printing, Microsoft technologies, Automation, Platform Engineering, and service integrations. Working closely with architects, engineering teams, service delivery managers, and managed service providers, you will help ensure Roche’s workplace platforms remain scalable, reliable, secure, and operationally efficient.

You will contribute to the strategic evolution of workplace platforms while supporting global engineering initiatives and driving modernization efforts across the Onsite Technology Services portfolio. This role combines technical expertise, platform ownership, solution design, automation, and operational excellence within a global enterprise environment. The role is heavily focused on engineering, platform enablement, technical governance, and continuous improvement rather than people management responsibilities.

Your Responsibilities

• Design, maintain, and continuously improve workplace technology platforms.

• Drive technical roadmaps and platform modernization initiatives aligned with business and technology objectives.

• Ensure platforms are scalable, reliable, secure, and supportable.

• Contribute to technical standards, engineering practices, and operational governance frameworks.

• Support architecture reviews and technology evaluations.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert for enterprise printing solutions and related workplace technologies for creating great Office experiences.

• Drive continuous improvements across printing services, print management platforms, and associated integrations.

• Support implementation of new workplace technologies and service capabilities.

• Collaborate with vendors and service providers to improve platform performance and service quality.

• Identify opportunities for innovation and simplification across workplace services.

• Drive adoption of Microsoft technologies and automation capabilities across workplace services.

• Design and implement automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and service quality.

• Support integration of workplace services with Microsoft platforms and collaboration technologies.

• Contribute to Infrastructure as Code, workflow automation, and self-service initiatives.

• Promote automation-first engineering practices.

• Support operational engineering teams in improving platform reliability and service maturity.

• Analyze incidents, recurring issues, and operational trends to identify improvement opportunities.

• Drive root cause analysis and technical problem resolution activities.

• Contribute to observability, monitoring, telemetry, and operational health initiatives.

• Support service continuity and operational readiness activities.

• Work closely with Service Delivery Managers, Platform Engineering teams, Architects, and Managed Service Providers.

• Support global workplace technology initiatives and transformation programs.

• Provide technical guidance to operational teams and service stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Contribute to engineering roadmaps and strategic planning activities.

• Technical ownership of assigned workplace technology platforms.

• Subject matter expertise across printing, Microsoft

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’Ingegnere di Piattaforma Senior per le Tecnologie In cantiere, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella progettazione, nell’evoluzione e nel miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme tecnologiche di Roche. Fornirai leadership tecnica nei servizi di lavoro aziendali con un particolare focus su Stampa, tecnologie Microsoft, Automazione, Platform Engineering e integrazioni di servizi. Lavorando a stretto contatto con architetti, team di ingegneria, service delivery manager e fornitori di servizi gestiti, vi aiuterà a garantire che le piattaforme di lavoro di Roche rimangano scalabili, affidabili, sicure ed efficienti in modo operativo. Contribuirai all'evoluzione strategica delle piattaforme di lavoro, supportando le iniziative di ingegneria globale e promuovendo gli sforzi di modernizzazione in tutto il portafoglio dei servizi tecnologici in loco. Questo ruolo combina competenze tecniche, proprietà della piattaforma, progettazione di soluzioni, automazione e eccellenza operativa all'interno di un ambiente aziendale globale. Il ruolo è fortemente focalizzato su ingegneria, abilitazione della piattaforma, governance tecnica e miglioramento continuo piuttosto che responsabilità di gestione delle persone. Le tue responsabilità
• Progettazione, manutenzione e miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme tecnologiche sul posto di lavoro.
• Guidare le roadmap tecniche e le iniziative di modernizzazione delle piattaforme allineate agli obiettivi aziendali e tecnologici.
• Assicurare piattaforme scalabili, affidabili, sicure e supportabili.
• Contribuire a standard tecnici, pratiche ingegneristiche e quadri di governance operativa.
• Supporta recensioni di architettura e valutazioni tecnologiche.
• Agire come esperto di materia tecnica per le soluzioni di stampa aziendale e le relative tecnologie di lavoro per la creazione di grandi esperienze di Office.
• Miglioramento continuo dei servizi di stampa, piattaforme di gestione della stampa e integrazioni associate.
• Sostenere l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie di lavoro e le capacità di servizio.
• Collabora con fornitori e fornitori di servizi per migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma e la qualità dei servizi.
• Identificare opportunità di innovazione e semplificazione nei servizi di lavoro.
• Guidare l'adozione di tecnologie Microsoft e capacità di automazione attraverso i servizi di lavoro.
• Progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni di automazione che migliorano l'efficienza operativa e la qualità dei servizi.
• Supporto integrazione dei servizi di lavoro con piattaforme Microsoft e tecnologie di collaborazione.
• Contribuire alle Infrastrutture come Codice, automazione del flusso di lavoro e iniziative self-service.
• Promuovere le pratiche di automazione-prima ingegneria.
• Sostenere i team di ingegneria operativa per migliorare l'affidabilità della piattaforma e la maturità dei servizi.
• Analizzare gli incidenti, i problemi ricorrenti e le tendenze operative per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento.
• Guidare le attività di analisi delle cause root e risoluzione dei problemi tecnici.
• Contribuire alle iniziative di osservanza, monitoraggio, telemetria e salute operativa.
• Supporto della continuità del servizio e delle attività di prontezza operativa.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Service Delivery Manager, team di Platform Engineering, architetti e fornitori di servizi gestiti.
• Sostenere le iniziative tecnologiche globali sul posto di lavoro e i programmi di trasformazione.
• Fornire assistenza tecnica ai team operativi e agli stakeholder dei servizi.
• Comunicare rischi tecnici, dipendenze e opportunità di miglioramento.
• Contribuire a roadmap di ingegneria e attività di pianificazione strategica.
• Proprietà tecnica delle piattaforme tecnologiche di lavoro assegnate.
• Competenze di materia per la stampa, Microsoft

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Diese Rolle vereint technische Expertise, Plattformbesitz, Lösungsdesign, Automatisierung und operative Exzellenz in einer globalen Unternehmensumgebung. Die Rolle konzentriert sich stark auf Engineering, Plattform-Enablement, technische Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung, anstatt Verantwortung für das Personalmanagement. Ihre Aufgaben
• Design, Wartung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Arbeitsplatztechnologieplattformen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Plattformen skalierbar, zuverlässig, sicher und unterstützt werden können.
• Beitrag zu technischen Standards, Engineering-Praktiken und Rahmenbedingungen für die operative Governance.

• Handeln Sie als technischer Fachexperte für Unternehmensdrucklösungen und verwandte Arbeitsplatztechnologien, um großartige Büroerlebnisse zu schaffen.
• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen bei Druckdiensten, Druckmanagementplattformen und zugehörigen Integrationen voran.
• Unterstützung der Implementierung neuer Arbeitsplatztechnologien und Servicefähigkeiten.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Anbietern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um die Leistung der Plattform und die Servicequalität zu verbessern.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Innovationen und Vereinfachungen bei allen Arbeitsplatzdienstleistungen.
• Förderung der Einführung von Microsoft-Technologien und Automatisierungsfunktionen für alle Arbeitsplatzdienste.
• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie Automatisierungslösungen, die die betriebliche Effizienz und Servicequalität verbessern.
• Unterstützung der Integration von Arbeitsplatzdiensten mit Microsoft-Plattformen und Collaboration-Technologien.
• Tragen Sie zu Infrastructure as Code, Workflow-Automatisierung und Self-Service-Initiativen bei.
• Förderung von Automation-First Engineering-Praktiken.
• Unterstützen Sie operative Engineering-Teams bei der Verbesserung der Plattformzuverlässigkeit und Servicereife.
• Analysieren Sie Vorfälle, wiederkehrende Probleme und operative Trends, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
• Drive Root Ursachenanalyse und technische Problemlösungsaktivitäten.
• Beitrag zur Beobachtbarkeit, Überwachung, Telemetrie und operativen Gesundheitsinitiativen.
• Unterstützung der Kontinuität des Dienstes und der Einsatzbereitschaft.

jobs.title: Principal Data Innovation Specialist (RWD)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development (PD). We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Principal Data Innovation Specialist helps identify, prototype, and scale novel methods and technologies that transform how data is used across product development. Reporting to the Data Innovation Lead, you will explore emerging capabilities such as AI, semantic integration, and knowledge graphs to unlock new use cases for clinical, real-world, and operational data. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, product teams, and external partners to design proof-of-concepts, validate innovative solutions, and assess long-term feasibility. This role requires curiosity, strong technical grounding, and a mindset oriented toward experimentation and continuous learning.

The Opportunity

• Multi-Agent & AI Development: Prototype, validate, and scale advanced AI capabilities, focusing heavily on multi-agent development and orchestration architectures to unlock complex use cases across product development.

• Core Data Engineering: Lead robust data engineering activities to design, optimize, and streamline data workflows, building scalable data pipelines that integrate unstructured, multi-modal, and unconventional data sources.

• Analytical Project Leadership: Drive innovation activities and lead complex analytical projects focused on exploring novel data types , automated agent-driven workflows, and knowledge graph integrations in a multi-modal environment.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with scientists, engineers, and product teams to pilot data innovations , integrating advanced engineering pipelines and multi-agent frameworks into broader clinical development and data science workflows.

• Platform & Tool Creation: Drive the development of low-/no-code analytics platforms to democratize multi-modal data access and establish frameworks for the scalable evaluation, productization, and reuse of experimental data approaches.

• Subject Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Serve as an innovation methodology expert , guiding peers through new data modalities while mentoring junior team members on cutting-edge techniques, data tools, and agent architectures.

• Compliance & Data Governance: Proactively identify innovation areas via research while ensuring all engineering and AI frameworks maintain absolute compliance with data privacy and security regulations like HIPAA and GDPR.

Who You Are

• Educational & Professional Foundation: You hold a Master’s or Ph

• Core Data Engineering: Leader robuste attività di ingegneria dei dati per progettare, ottimizzare e ottimizzare i flussi di dati, costruzione di datadotti scalabili che integrano fonti di dati non strutturate, multi-modali e non convenzionali.
• Leadership del progetto analitico: guidare attività di innovazione e condurre complessi progetti analitici focalizzati sull'esplorazione di nuovi tipi di dati, flussi di lavoro automatizzati di agenti e integrazioni dei grafici di conoscenza in un ambiente multi-modale.
• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con scienziati, ingegneri e team di prodotti per pilotare le innovazioni dei dati, integrando pipeline di ingegneria avanzate e quadri multi-agenti in flussi di lavoro più ampi di sviluppo clinico e di scienza dei dati.
• Platform & Tool Creation: Guidare lo sviluppo di piattaforme di analisi a basso/no-code per democratizzare l'accesso multi-modale dei dati e stabilire dei framework per la valutazione scalabile, la produzione e il riutilizzo degli approcci di dati sperimentali.
• Oggetto Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Servire come esperto di metodologia dell'innovazione, guidare i coetanei attraverso nuove modalità di dati mentre mentoring i membri del team junior su tecniche all'avanguardia, strumenti di dati e architetture di agente.
• Compliance & Data Governance: Identificare attivamente le aree di innovazione attraverso la ricerca, assicurando che tutti i framework di ingegneria e AI mantengano il rispetto assoluto della privacy dei dati e delle normative di sicurezza come HIPAA e GDPR. Chi sei

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Diese Rolle ist Teil des Teams Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS), das die Datenexzellenz und -analyse vorantreibt, um eine verbesserte Entscheidungsfindung und Evidenzgenerierung innerhalb der Roche Product Development (PD) zu ermöglichen. Wir entwickeln und implementieren Datenstrategien, die den Wert klinischer, operativer und realer Daten freisetzen, um die Generierung, Entscheidungsfindung und Innovation bei Parkinson und darüber hinaus zu beschleunigen. Durch die Einbettung von FAIR-Prinzipien, die Förderung der Data Governance und die Ermöglichung der Datenproduktisierung stellt RWCDS sicher, dass Daten nicht nur auffindbar und nutzbar sind, sondern auch ein Treiber für wissenschaftliche Strenge, Regulierungsbereitschaft und KI-gestützte Transformation. Durch intensive Partnerschaften mit internen Funktionen und externen Mitarbeitern gestalten wir ein zukunftsfähiges Daten-Ökosystem, das personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung und effiziente Arzneimittelentwicklung unterstützt. Der Principal Data Innovation Specialist hilft bei der Identifizierung, dem Prototyp und der Skalierung neuer Methoden und Technologien, die die Verwendung von Daten in der Produktentwicklung verändern. In der Berichterstattung an den Data Innovation Lead werden Sie neue Funktionen wie KI, semantische Integration und Wissensgraphen untersuchen, um neue Anwendungsfälle für klinische, reale und operative Daten freizuschalten. Sie arbeiten mit Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Produktteams und externen Partnern zusammen, um Proof-of-Concepts zu entwerfen, innovative Lösungen zu validieren und die langfristige Machbarkeit zu bewerten. Diese Rolle erfordert Neugier, starke technische Grundlagen und eine Denkweise, die auf Experimente und kontinuierliches Lernen ausgerichtet ist. Die Chance
• Multi-Agent & AI-Entwicklung: Prototyp, Validierung und Skalierung fortschrittlicher KI-Fähigkeiten, wobei der Schwerpunkt stark auf Multi-Agent-Entwicklungs- und Orchestrierungsarchitekturen liegt, um komplexe Anwendungsfälle in der Produktentwicklung freizuschalten.
• Core Data Engineering: Führen Sie robuste Data Engineering-Aktivitäten, um Datenworkflows zu entwerfen, zu optimieren und zu rationalisieren und skalierbare Datenpipelines zu erstellen, die unstrukturierte, multimodale und unkonventionelle Datenquellen integrieren.
• Analytische Projektleitung: Innovationsaktivitäten vorantreiben und komplexe analytische Projekte leiten, die sich auf die Erforschung neuartiger Datentypen, automatisierter agentengesteuerter Workflows und Wissensgraphenintegrationen in einer multimodalen Umgebung konzentrieren.
• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partnerschaft mit Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren und Produktteams, um Dateninnovationen zu pilotieren und fortschrittliche Engineering-Pipelines und Multi-Agent-Frameworks in breitere klinische Entwicklung und Data Science-Workflows zu integrieren.
• Plattform- und Tool-Erstellung: Förderung der Entwicklung von Low-/No-Code-Analyseplattformen, um den multimodalen Datenzugriff zu demokratisieren und Rahmenbedingungen für die skalierbare Auswertung, Produktivierung und Wiederverwendung experimenteller Datenansätze zu schaffen.
• Subject Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Dienen Sie als Experte für Innovationsmethodik und führen Sie Peers durch neue Datenmodalitäten, während Sie Junior-Teammitglieder zu innovativen Techniken, Datentools und Agentenarchitekturen betreuen.
• Compliance & Data Governance: Proaktive Identifizierung von Innovationsbereichen durch Forschung und gleichzeitige Sicherstellung der absoluten Einhaltung der Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorschriften wie HIPAA und DSGVO durch alle Engineering- und KI-Frameworks. Wer du bist
• Educational & Professional Foundation: Sie haben einen Master oder Ph
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Ce rôle repose sur l'équipe de la Stratégie mondiale et clinique des données (RWCDS) qui stimule l'excellence et l'analyse des données afin d'améliorer la prise de décisions et la production de données probantes au sein de Roche Product Development (PD). Nous élaborons et mettons en oeuvre des stratégies de données qui débloquent la valeur des données cliniques, opérationnelles et réelles pour accélérer la production de données probantes, la prise de décisions et l'innovation dans la DP et au-delà. En intégrant les principes FAIR, en faisant progresser la gouvernance des données et en permettant la production de données, RWCDS s'assure que les données sont non seulement exploitables et utilisables, mais aussi un moteur de rigueur scientifique, de préparation réglementaire et de transformation assistée par l'IA. Grâce à des partenariats profonds avec des fonctions internes et des collaborateurs externes, nous formons un écosystème de données prêt à l'avenir qui soutient des soins de santé personnalisés et un développement efficace des médicaments. Le spécialiste principal de l'innovation dans les données aide à identifier, à prototyper et à mettre à l'échelle de nouvelles méthodes et technologies qui transforment la façon dont les données sont utilisées dans le développement de produits. Rendre compte au responsable de l'innovation dans les données, vous explorerez les capacités émergentes telles que l'IA, l'intégration sémantique et les graphiques de connaissances pour débloquer de nouveaux cas d'utilisation pour des données cliniques, réelles et opérationnelles. Vous collaborerez avec des scientifiques, des ingénieurs, des équipes de produits et des partenaires externes pour concevoir des preuves de concepts, valider des solutions innovantes et évaluer la faisabilité à long terme. Ce rôle exige la curiosité, une solide assise technique et un état d'esprit orienté vers l'expérimentation et l'apprentissage continu. L'opportunité
• Développement multi-agents et d'IA : Prototype, validation et mise à l'échelle des capacités d'IA avancées, se concentrant fortement sur les architectures de développement multi-agents et d'orchestration pour débloquer des cas d'utilisation complexes à travers le développement de produits.
• Ingénierie des données de base : Diriger des activités robustes d'ingénierie des données pour concevoir, optimiser et rationaliser les flux de données, construire des pipelines de données évolutives qui intègrent des sources de données non structurées, multimodales et non conventionnelles.
• Leadership des projets d'analyse : Diriger les activités d'innovation et diriger des projets d'analyse complexes axés sur l'exploration de nouveaux types de données, des flux de travail automatisés axés sur les agents et l'intégration de graphiques de connaissances dans un environnement multimodal.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: Partenaire avec des scientifiques, des ingénieurs et des équipes de produits pour piloter des innovations en matière de données, intégrant des pipelines d'ingénierie avancée et des cadres multi-agents dans des flux de travail plus larges de développement clinique et de science des données.
• Création de plates-formes et d'outils : Favoriser le développement de plates-formes d'analyse à faible/sans code pour démocratiser l'accès aux données multimodales et établir des cadres pour l'évaluation évolutive, la production et la réutilisation des approches expérimentales de données.
• Objet Expertise et mentorat : servir d'expert en méthodologie d'innovation, guider les pairs à travers de nouvelles modalités de données tout en guidant les membres de l'équipe junior sur les techniques de pointe, les outils de données et les architectures d'agents.
• Conformité et gouvernance des données : identifier de manière proactive les domaines d'innovation par la recherche tout en veillant à ce que tous les cadres d'ingénierie et d'IA respectent de façon absolue les règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données telles que HIPAA et GDPR. Qui vous êtes
• Fondation Educationnelle & Professionnelle: Vous possédez un Master

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ou rselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorr ow.

The Position
As a Safety and Reporting Senior Specialist of Post Market Quality , you will be a key player within our Quality and Regulatory organization. Working with a high degree of autonomy and minimal supervision, you will ensure our products maintain the highest standards of safety and compliance after they reach the market. You will dive into complex cases, collaborate globally, and contribute to continuous improvement in a dynamic, patient-centric environment.
Your Main Responsibilities:

• Case & Report Management: Take accountability for the timely and compliant handling of safety, vigilance, and Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) cases/reports, strictly adhering to ISO Quality System requirements and country-specific regulations.

• Regulatory & Affiliate Collaboration: Interface directly with Regulatory Authorities (e.g., FDA, Notified Bodies) and Affiliate Organizations. Coordinate, prepare, and deliver precise responses by collaborating with global subject matter experts.

• Post-Market Surveillance (PMS): Maintain and facilitate the schedule of PMS reports, drive data generation, and lead the planning, completion, and evaluation of PMS activities for various product families.

• Quality System & Process Improvement: Develop advanced monitoring systems for data and PMS reports to boost efficiency. Review case quality and customer feedback to optimize our internal processes.

• Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all records meet established quality processes, and take ownership of completing thorough risk assessments for product quality issues.

• Training, Mentoring & Squad Support: Participate in developing and delivering training on vigilance/safety/PMS topics. Onboard and coach less experienced colleagues, lead or contribute to agile projects (e.g., SQUADs), and act as a proxy for the Principal Specialist when needed.

What’s in your toolbox? (Qualifications & Experience):

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Sciences and/or vocational training with equivalent related experience.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience working in a regulated environment (preferred experience in Quality Systems, Vigilance, and/or Safety).

• Languages: Fluent professional knowledge of English is required. Knowledge of German is a strong asset.

• Technical Savvy: Laboratory experience and/or strong IT skills are highly preferred.

• Global Mindset: Proven experience working successfully in virtual, cross-functional, and intercultural teams.

Leadership & Soft Skills that will make you thrive:

• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to make sound decisions even when dealing with limited or ambiguous information.

• Resilience & Confident Manner: A strong sense of quality, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to changing environments.

• Communication & Technical Writing: Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to author technical documentation tailored for regulatory authorities.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e siamo senza paura sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo a rispettare il rigore scientifico, l'etica insopportabile e l'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un tomorr migliore. La posizione Come specialista di sicurezza e reporting della qualità del mercato post, sarete un giocatore chiave nella nostra organizzazione di qualità e regolamentazione. Lavorando con un alto grado di autonomia e una minima supervisione, vi assicurerete che i nostri prodotti mantengano i più elevati standard di sicurezza e conformità dopo che raggiungono il mercato. Ti immergerai in casi complessi, collaborerai a livello globale e contribuirai a un miglioramento continuo in un ambiente dinamico e paziente-centrico. Le tue responsabilità principali:
• Case & Report Management: Tenere conto della tempestiva e conforme gestione della sicurezza, della vigilanza e dei casi/reporti di sorveglianza post-market (PMS), rispettando rigorosamente i requisiti ISO Quality System e le normative specifiche per il paese.
• Collaborazione di regolamentazione e affiliazione: interfaccia direttamente con le autorità di regolamentazione (ad esempio, FDA, Organismi notificati) e le organizzazioni di affiliazione. Coordinare, preparare e fornire risposte precise collaborando con esperti di materie globali.
• Sorveglianza post-market (PMS): Mantenere e facilitare il programma di rapporti PMS, generare dati e condurre la pianificazione, il completamento e la valutazione delle attività PMS per varie famiglie di prodotti.
• Quality System & Process Improvement: Sviluppare sistemi di monitoraggio avanzati per i report di dati e PMS per aumentare l'efficienza. Verifica la qualità dei casi e il feedback dei clienti per ottimizzare i nostri processi interni.
• Compliance & Risk Management: Assicurarsi che tutti i record soddisfino i processi di qualità stabiliti, e prendere la proprietà di completare valutazioni di rischio complete per i problemi di qualità del prodotto.
• Formazione, Mentoring & Squad Support: Partecipa allo sviluppo e alla formazione su temi di vigilanza/sicurezza/PMS. A bordo e coach colleghi meno esperti, portare o contribuire a progetti agili (ad esempio, SQUADs), e agire come proxy per il Principal Specialist quando necessario. Cosa c'è nella tua cassetta degli attrezzi? (Qualifiche & Esperienza):
• Istruzione: laurea in Scienze e/o formazione professionale con esperienza relativa equivalente.
• Esperienza: 3+ anni di esperienza che lavorano in un ambiente regolamentato (esperienza preferita in Sistemi di Qualità, vigilanza e/o sicurezza).
• Lingue: È richiesta una conoscenza professionale fluida dell'inglese. La conoscenza del tedesco è un bene forte.
• Tecnica Savvy: Esperienza di laboratorio e/o forti competenze informatiche sono altamente preferiti.
• Global Mindset: Provata esperienza di lavoro con successo in team virtuali, cross-funzionali e interculturali. Leadership & Soft Skills che vi farà prosperare:
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Capacità di prendere decisioni sonore anche quando si tratta di informazioni limitate o ambigue.
• Resilience & Confident Manner: Un forte senso di qualità, una mentalità orientata alla soluzione, e la capacità di adattarsi agli ambienti mutevoli.
• Comunicazione e scrittura tecnica: eccellenti competenze di negoziazione e la capacità di autore di documentazione tecnica su misura per le autorità di regolamentazione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla sanità oggi e per la generazione
