jobs.title: Analytical Data Science, Senior Programmer

titleByLocale.it: Scienza dei dati analitica, Programmatore senior
titleByLocale.fr: Sciences des données analytiques, programmeur principal

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is in Analytical Data Science, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. PDD Analytical Data Science teams are mobilized across the portfolio to generate data-driven insights, identify opportunities for scale, and implement impactful solutions.

PDD Analytical Data Science is recognized as a leading hub for top industry talent, operating as an agile workforce to deliver regulatory commitments across the portfolio. We identify, influence, and adopt industry-leading digital and automation solutions, develop analytical approaches to support exploratory analyses, and align statistical programming practices across both early- and late-stage clinical development.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Analytical Data Science Programmer is a key contributor to the clinical study team, responsible for transforming statistical analysis plans into high-quality, traceable programming deliverables. This includes both static and dynamic outputs, such as tables, listings, figures, and interactive data visualizations or dashboards. The role involves creating and validating datasets in accordance with Study Data Tabulation Model and Analysis Data Model standards, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Roche standards. In addition to supporting regulatory submissions, the ADS Programmer plays a critical role in generating data insights through platforms such as the Insight Engine, enabling real-time exploration and interpretation of diverse clinical and exploratory data. This role contributes to a modern, insight-driven development environment by facilitating robust, timely, and decision-enabling analytics across clinical programs.

• You independently develop, validate, and maintain datasets and statistical outputs for clinical trials, including Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), ensuring programming accuracy, traceability, and compliance with internal processes and regulatory expectations

• You develop and support programming outputs across a wide range of data types, including exploratory biomarker data and real-world data, to support both regulatory and scientific objectives

• You collaborate on exploratory analyses that span disease areas and therapeutic areas, enabling insight generation to inform drug development strategies

• You support the creation and refinement of interactive tools and analytical applications (e.g., dashboards or visual data platforms) that enable dynamic exploration of integrated datasets by scientific and clinical teams

• You provide programming leadership for assigned studies, coordinating deliverables across internal and external programming partners to meet study timelines and requirements

• You interpret statistical analysis plans and translate them into executable programming specifications to ensure scientific rigor in outputs

• You troubleshoot and resolve technical programming challenges with limited supervision, proactively identifying risks and implementing effective solutions while meeting timelines

• You contribute to the design and maintenance of standard macros and reusable components, promoting efficiency and consistency across multiple studies and projects

• You document programming workflows and maintain audit trails, ensuring study files are complete, traceable, and inspection-ready

• You work cross-functionally wit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Questo ruolo è in Analytical Data Science, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. I team di PDD Analytical Data Science sono mobilitati in tutto il portafoglio per generare informazioni basate sui dati, identificare le opportunità di scala e implementare soluzioni efficaci.

PDD Analytical Data Science è riconosciuto come un hub leader per i migliori talenti del settore, operante come una forza lavoro agile per fornire impegni normativi in tutto il portafoglio. Identifichiamo, influenziamo e adottiamo soluzioni digitali e di automazione leader del settore, sviluppiamo approcci analitici per sostenere le analisi esplorative e allineiamo le pratiche di programmazione statistica sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio dello sviluppo clinico.

L'opportunità:

Il Senior Analytical Data Science Programmer è un contributore chiave del team di studio clinico, responsabile della trasformazione dei piani di analisi statistica in materiali di programmazione tracciabili di alta qualità. Questo include uscite sia statiche che dinamiche, come tabelle, elenchi, figure e visualizzazioni interattive dei dati o dashboard. Il ruolo prevede la creazione e la convalida di set di dati in conformità con gli standard del Modello di Scheda di Studio e del Modello di Dati di Analisi, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e degli standard Roche. Oltre a sostenere le presentazioni regolamentari, il programmatore ADS svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella generazione di informazioni sui dati attraverso piattaforme come il Insight Engine, consentendo l'esplorazione in tempo reale e l'interpretazione di diversi dati clinici ed esplorativi. Questo ruolo contribuisce a un ambiente di sviluppo moderno, orientato all'intuizione, facilitando l'analisi robusta, tempestiva e decisionale nei programmi clinici.

• L'utente sviluppa, convalida e mantiene in modo indipendente set di dati e output statistici per gli studi clinici, inclusi i dataset del Modello di Tabulazione dei Dati di Studio (SDTM), i dataset del Modello di analisi (ADaM) e le tabelle, gli elenchi e le cifre (TLF), garantendo precisione di programmazione, tracciabilità e conformità ai processi interni e alle aspettative normative

• Sviluppi e supporti gli output di programmazione in una vasta gamma di tipi di dati, compresi i dati di biomarcatori esplorativi e i dati del mondo reale, per supportare obiettivi sia normativi che scientifici

• Collabori su analisi esplorative che abbracciano aree di malattia e aree terapeutiche, consentendo una generazione di informazioni per informare le strategie di sviluppo della droga

• Supporti la creazione e la raffinatezza di strumenti interattivi e applicazioni analitiche (ad esempio, dashboard o piattaforme di dati visivi) che consentono l'esplorazione dinamica di dataset integrati da parte di team scientifici e clinici

• Fornite la leadership di programmazione per gli studi assegnati, coordinando i deliverable tra i partner di programmazione interni ed esterni per soddisfare le tempistiche e i requisiti di studio

• Lei interpreta i piani di analisi statistica e li traduce in specifiche di programmazione eseguibili per garantire rigore scientifico nelle uscite

• La risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione delle sfide di programmazione tecnica con una supervisione limitata, l'identificazione proattiva dei rischi e l'implementazione di soluzioni efficaci durante la riunione dei termini

• Contribuisci alla progettazione e alla manutenzione di macro standard e componenti riutilizzabili, promuovendo efficienza e coerenza tra più studi e progetti

• Documenti i flussi di lavoro di programmazione e mantieni i percorsi di audit, assicurando che i file di studio siano completi, tracciabili e pronti all'ispezione

• Lavori in modo trasversale
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Diese Rolle ist in Analytical Data Science, einer Kernfunktion innerhalb von Product Development Data Sciences (PDD), die strategische Führung und wissenschaftliche Strenge in der Entwicklung bei Roche bietet. PDD Analytical Data Science-Teams werden im gesamten Portfolio mobilisiert, um datenbasierte Erkenntnisse zu generieren, Skalierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und wirkungsvolle Lösungen zu implementieren.

PDD Analytical Data Science ist als führendes Zentrum für Top-Industrietalente anerkannt und agiert als agile Belegschaft, um regulatorische Verpflichtungen im gesamten Portfolio zu erfüllen. Wir identifizieren, beeinflussen und übernehmen branchenführende digitale und Automatisierungslösungen, entwickeln analytische Ansätze zur Unterstützung explorativer Analysen und richten statistische Programmierpraktiken sowohl in der frühen als auch in der späten Phase der klinischen Entwicklung aus.

Die Gelegenheit:

Der Senior Analytical Data Science Programmer ist ein wichtiger Beitrag zum klinischen Studienteam, das für die Umwandlung statistischer Analysepläne in qualitativ hochwertige, rückverfolgbare Programmierergebnisse verantwortlich ist. Dies umfasst sowohl statische als auch dynamische Ausgaben wie Tabellen, Listen, Zahlen und interaktive Datenvisualisierungen oder Dashboards. Die Aufgabe besteht darin, Datensätze in Übereinstimmung mit den Standards des Study Data Tabulation Model und des Analysis Data Model zu erstellen und zu validieren, um die Einhaltung der regulatorischen Anforderungen und der Roche-Standards sicherzustellen. Neben der Unterstützung von Zulassungsanträgen spielt der ADS-Programmierer eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Generierung von Datenerkenntnissen durch Plattformen wie die Insight Engine, die die Echtzeit-Exploration und Interpretation verschiedener klinischer und explorativer Daten ermöglicht. Diese Rolle trägt zu einer modernen, erkenntnisorientierten Entwicklungsumgebung bei, indem sie robuste, zeitnahe und entscheidungsfähige Analysen in klinischen Programmen ermöglicht.

• Sie entwickeln, validieren und pflegen unabhängig Datensätze und statistische Ausgaben für klinische Studien, einschließlich Datensätze für das Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), Datensätze für das Analysis Data Model (ADaM) sowie Tabellen, Auflistungen und Zahlen (TLFs), um die Programmiergenauigkeit, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Einhaltung interner Prozesse und regulatorischer Erwartungen zu gewährleisten.

• Sie entwickeln und unterstützen Programmierergebnisse für eine Vielzahl von Datentypen, einschließlich explorativer Biomarkerdaten und realer Daten, um sowohl regulatorische als auch wissenschaftliche Ziele zu unterstützen.

• Sie arbeiten an explorativen Analysen zusammen, die Krankheitsbereiche und therapeutische Bereiche umfassen und es ermöglichen, Erkenntnisse zu generieren, um Strategien zur Arzneimittelentwicklung zu informieren

• Sie unterstützen die Erstellung und Verfeinerung von interaktiven Tools und analytischen Anwendungen (z. B. Dashboards oder visuelle Datenplattformen), die eine dynamische Erkundung integrierter Datensätze durch wissenschaftliche und klinische Teams ermöglichen.

• Sie bieten Programmierführung für zugewiesene Studien und koordinieren die Ergebnisse interner und externer Programmierpartner, um die Studienzeitpläne und -anforderungen zu erfüllen

• Sie interpretieren statistische Analysepläne und übersetzen sie in ausführbare Programmierspezifikationen, um die wissenschaftliche Strenge der Ergebnisse sicherzustellen

• Sie beheben und lösen technische Programmierherausforderungen mit begrenzter Aufsicht, erkennen proaktiv Risiken und implementieren effektive Lösungen, während Sie die Zeitvorgaben einhalten

• Sie tragen zum Design und zur Wartung von Standard-Makros und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten bei und fördern die Effizienz und Konsistenz in mehreren Studien und Projekten

• Sie dokumentieren die Programmierung von Workflows und pflegen Audit-Trails, um sicherzustellen, dass die Studiendateien vollständig, nachvollziehbar und prüfungsbereit sind

• Sie arbeiten funktionsübergreifend wit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Ce rôle est dans le domaine de l'analyse des données, une fonction essentielle au sein de l'élaboration de produits Data Sciences (PDD) qui assure le leadership stratégique et la rigueur scientifique dans l'ensemble du développement à Roche. Les équipes de la PDD Analytical Data Science sont mobilisées dans l'ensemble du portefeuille pour générer des informations fondées sur les données, identifier les possibilités d'échelle et mettre en œuvre des solutions efficaces.

La PDD Analytical Data Science est reconnue comme un pôle de premier plan pour les meilleurs talents de l'industrie, fonctionnant comme une main-d'oeuvre agile pour respecter les engagements réglementaires dans l'ensemble du portefeuille. Nous identifions, influons et adoptons des solutions numériques et d'automatisation de pointe, nous développons des approches analytiques pour appuyer les analyses exploratoires et nous alignons les pratiques de programmation statistique à la fois au début et à la fin du développement clinique.

La possibilité :

Le programmeur principal en sciences des données analytiques est l'un des principaux collaborateurs de l'équipe d'étude clinique, responsable de la transformation des plans d'analyse statistique en produits livrables de haute qualité et traçables. Cela comprend les sorties statiques et dynamiques, comme les tableaux, les listes, les figures et les visualisations interactives de données ou les tableaux de bord. Le rôle consiste à créer et à valider des ensembles de données conformément aux normes du modèle de calcul des données d'étude et du modèle de données d'analyse, en veillant au respect des exigences réglementaires et des normes Roche. En plus d'appuyer les présentations réglementaires, le programmeur ADS joue un rôle essentiel dans la production de données par le biais de plateformes telles que le moteur Insight, permettant l'exploration et l'interprétation en temps réel de diverses données cliniques et exploratoires. Ce rôle contribue à un environnement de développement moderne axé sur les connaissances en facilitant l'analyse robuste, opportune et décisionnelle dans l'ensemble des programmes cliniques.

• Vous élaborez, validez et maintenez de façon indépendante des ensembles de données et des extrants statistiques pour les essais cliniques, y compris des ensembles de données du modèle de tabulation des données d'étude (SDTM), des ensembles de données du modèle de données d'analyse (ADaM) et des tableaux, des listes et des figures (FTL), assurant l'exactitude de la programmation, la traçabilité et la conformité aux processus internes et aux attentes réglementaires.

• Vous développez et supportez des extrants de programmation pour un large éventail de types de données, y compris des données exploratoires de biomarqueurs et des données du monde réel, afin de soutenir des objectifs réglementaires et scientifiques

• Vous collaborez à des analyses exploratoires qui couvrent les domaines de la maladie et des domaines thérapeutiques, permettant de générer des connaissances pour éclairer les stratégies de développement des médicaments

• Vous soutenez la création et le perfectionnement d'outils interactifs et d'applications analytiques (p. ex. tableaux de bord ou plateformes de données visuelles) qui permettent une exploration dynamique des ensembles de données intégrés par les équipes scientifiques et cliniques

• Vous exercez un leadership en matière de programmes pour les études assignées, en coordonnant les produits livrables entre les partenaires de programmes internes et externes afin de respecter les échéances et les exigences de l'étude.

• Vous interprètez les plans d'analyse statistique et les traduisez en spécifications de programmation exécutables pour assurer la rigueur scientifique dans les extrants

• Vous dépannez et résolvez les défis de programmation technique avec une supervision limitée, identifiez proactifment les risques et mettez en œuvre des solutions efficaces tout en respectant les délais

• Vous contribuez à la conception et à la maintenance de macros standard et de composants réutilisables, favorisant l'efficacité et la cohérence entre plusieurs études et projets

• Vous documentez les workflows de programmation et maintenez des pistes d'audit, vous assurant que les dossiers d'étude sont complets, traçables et prêts à être inspectés

• Tu travailles de façon interfonctionnelle

The Position
Créée en 2019, Timkl est une structure de service destinée à accompagner les patients chroniques . Rejoignez notre équipe motivée et pionnière pour améliorer le quotidien des patients diabétiques. Vous avez le goût du challenge et souhaitez travailler aux côtés des professionnels de santé pour faciliter la prise en charge des personnes diabétiques ? Cette opportunité est pour vous.]

Présentation du poste : Afin de poursuivre son développement, Timkl recrute actuellement un infirmier coordinateur (H/F) à Reims. Ce rôle implique, dans le cadre du contrat de coopération avec l'équipe médicale du CHU de Reims, l'ajustement des plans de traitement, la fourniture de soins de premier recours, la gestion de la matériovigilance et le soutien ainsi que la formation des professionnels de santé.

Responsabilités :
L’ajustement du traitement :

• Lecture et interprétation des glycémies (à jeun, préprandiales, postprandiales, soir, coucher)

• Lecture et interprétation de l'HbA1c

• Lecture et interprétation de la cétonémie et de la cétonurie

• Lecture et interprétation de la fructosamine

• Identification de nouveaux objectifs de traitement

• Développement de nouveaux schémas insuliniques et ajustement des doses pour les activités quotidiennes (repas, activités physiques)

• Détermination de nouveaux débits de base d'insuline pour les pompes

• Traitement des hypoglycémies : resucrage des patients (soin de premier recours)

• Traitement des hyperglycémies : gestion de la cétose avec prescription d'insuline pour normaliser la glycémie (soin de premier recours)

• Prévention des incidents et accidents (hypoglycémies, hyperglycémies)

Soins de premier recours :

• Gestion du circuit de matériovigilance : Recueillir les événements auprès des patients et fournir les éléments au correspondant matériovigilance de TIMKL

• Assurer des astreintes pour le dépannage des pompes en semaine

• Dispenser des formations sur un contenu pédagogique précis auprès des professionnels de santé

• Offrir un support aux professionnels de santé dans le suivi des patients

• Coordonner le suivi des patients avec les professionnels de santé

• Participer avec le responsable de région à la promotion des services auprès des prescripteurs et des pharmaciens

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab&POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your key responsibilities
1. Define and execute clinical chemistry and related product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute product marketing plans and plan of actions

• Develop product key message and sales tools such as brochure, master presentations, advertising films and gimmicks

• Prepare new product launch and manage the product lifecycle from phase in to phase out.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottleneck

• Manage all regulatory and reimbursement tasks involved during phase in and out

• Support quality issues with S&S and QA

• Monitor and analyze sales performance monthly and yearly

• Coordinate and conduct congress, product seminars and conferences

• Update marketing activities reports regularly

2. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Conduct market survey

• Gather information about competitors' activities and price strategies to set up counter-proposals

• Visit KOLs and major customers regularly: workshop, product presentation, proposals etc.

3, Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK

• Coordinate training for sales, distributors and all relevant stakeholders

• Cooperate with sales, S&S, SCM, Q&R & MA, DMS, finance etc. regularly

• Liaise with regional and global colleague

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

4. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team

• Meet compliance for all external activities

Who you are

Bachelor Degree in Health/Science disciplines
At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab&POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your key responsibilities
1. Define and execute clinical chemistry and related product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute product marketing plans and plan of actions

• Develop product key message and sales tools such as brochure, master presentations, advertising films and gimmicks

• Prepare new product launch and manage the product lifecycle from phase in to phase out.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottleneck

• Manage all regulatory and reimbursement tasks involved during phase in and out

• Support quality issues with S&S and QA

• Monitor and analyze sales performance monthly and yearly

• Coordinate and conduct congress, product seminars and conferences

• Update marketing activities reports regularly

2. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Conduct market survey

• Gather information about competitors' activities and price strategies to set up counter-proposals

• Visit KOLs and major customers regularly: workshop, product presentation, proposals etc.

3, Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK

• Coordinate training for sales, distributors and all relevant stakeholders

• Cooperate with sales, S&S, SCM, Q&R & MA, DMS, finance etc. regularly

• Liaise with regional and global colleague

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

4. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team

• Meet compliance for all external activities

Who you are

Bachelor Degree in Health/Science disciplines
At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)

서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지

jobs.title: Medical Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Medical Specialist is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building deep and long-term connections with key customers, you will anticipate and proactively optimize medical practice, ensuring Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas. Operating with an end-to-end perspective, you will serve as a critical driver of competitiveness to accelerate our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, and maximize patient access to our life-changing innovations.

What you will be working on:
As a Medical Specialist, you will:

• Proactively contribute strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise to differentiate our portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Lead the medical component of the integrated local strategy, shaping a scientifically sound value story that reflects an end-to-end commercialisation.

• Spend a significant time in the field, proactively engaging Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders in full alignment with cross-functional roles.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies to anticipate future medical trends and shape local medical practice.

• Manage post-launch engagement to ensure the right patients are treated at the right time while expanding our scope to underserved patient populations.

• Establish effective peer-to-peer relationships, identify science-driven collaborations, and deliver high-quality, non-promotional medical education to external customers.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate clinical practice and patient insights into strategic, actionable recommendations for your squad.

• Independently manage the end-to-end execution of insight initiatives like advisory boards, ensuring strict adherence to compliance standards.

• Design and manage the local Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP), identifying evidence gaps and executing tactics like Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies.

• Provide clinical context and expertise to local Health Authority submissions to support high-quality regulatory approvals and product licenses.

Who You Are:
You have:

• Completed Medical degree along with prior experience in Medical Affairs or Clinical Research.

• A strong grasp of complex clinical data sets, including clinical trials and Real-World Evidence, with the ability to leverage digital and AI tools to shape strategy.

• A comprehensive understanding of the Bangladesh healthcare system, allowing you to seamlessly navigate the patient journey across public and private sectors.

• The capability to independently author scientific materials and conduct contextual material reviews utilizing a strong working knowledge of the Pharmaceutical Code of Marketing Practices.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to build trust and have direct, respectful scientific exchanges on a peer-to-peer level.

• A growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the comfort required to navigate ambiguity while proposing pragmatic, value-adding solutions.

• A highly collaborative nature that thrives when showing leadership, self-motivation, and accountability within a multi-skilled, cross-functional network.

This rol

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

• Medical Affairs role focused on Ophthalmology

• Sydney-based role ( 12 Months Maximum Term Contract)

• Flexible & agile work environment

The Medical Partner is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, you will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, ensuring that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.

The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end-to-end perspective. In this role, you will maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, champion community engagement, and advance patient access.

What will you be working on:
As a Medical Partner, you will:

• Act as the ultimate scientific expert for our Ophthalmology pipeline and portfolio, proactively contributing strong therapeutic area expertise.

• Lead the medical component of the local strategy.

• Proactively engage externally, including withTherapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders, as an active partner in our engagement strategy.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies and tactics that deliver superior experiences, anticipate future medical trends, and shape medical practice.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific insights and clinical practice perspectives into actionable strategic recommendations.

• Systematically identify evidence gaps and solutions to support local medical practice.

Who are you:
You are a qualified Medical Affairs professional with a completed Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences degree (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

You have:

• Demonstrated experience within Medical Affairs as a Medical Adviser or Medical Manager, ideally with deep expertise in the Ophthalmology therapeutic landscape and established relationships with Australian TAEs

• A comprehensive knowledge of the drug development process, clinical trials, R eal-World Evidence (RWE) , and the nuanced Australian medical and regulatory landscape

• A strong working knowledge of the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct , allowing you to conduct comprehensive reviews of materials and resolve compliance issues proactively.

• An entrepreneurial and growth mindset , meaning you love to seek out opportunities, experiment, navigate ambiguity, and challenge the status quo to deliver positive change

• Excellent assertive communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to articulate complex data clearly and build trusted internal and external collaborations

• AI literacy and a digital-forward learner mindset, confidently incorporating digital tools and human-in-the-loop oversight into your daily work.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is required for this Sydney-based role as visa and/or relocation support is not available for this role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitm

• AI literacy and a digital-forward learner mindset, confidently incorporating digital tools and human-in-the-loop oversight into your daily work. Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is required for this Sydney-based role as visa and/or relocation support is not available for this role. jobs.title: Senior Safety, Health and Environmental Professional I

titleByLocale.it: Professionista Senior in Sicurezza, Salute e Ambiente I
titleByLocale.en: Senior Safety, Health and Environmental Professional I
titleByLocale.de: Senior Safety, Health und Environmental Professional I
titleByLocale.fr: Professionnels de la sécurité, de la santé et de l'environnement I

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche as a Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) Business Partner and help us advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In this dynamic role, you'll be the trusted expert and strategic partner across manufacturing, facilities, R&D, supply chain, and other key business functions—developing and implementing comprehensive SHE policies, programs, and initiatives that ensure regulatory compliance while fostering a culture of safety and sustainability. You'll work with considerable independence, lead cross-functional teams on complex projects, mentor colleagues, and make a measurable impact on how we protect our people and environment at Roche.

The Opportunity

• Coordinates, develops, implements, and maintains SHE policies, procedures, and programs for regulatory compliance, company Directives, and site/Bay Area-wide initiatives—managing critical programs such as Hazardous and Medical Waste, Industrial Wastewater, Compressed Gases, TSCA/FIFRA, and Refrigerant Management.

• Serves as the subject matter expert in program implementation, leads identification of improvement opportunities, and creates and leads teams to address deficiencies.

• Conducts proactive inspections and hazard evaluations of work areas; assesses impacts from equipment, materials, processes, and facilities to identify and control hazardous conditions and regulatory non-compliance.

• Develops, implements, and conducts formal campus-wide SHE inspections and audits; assists with or leads external audits and tracks resolution of issues.

• Provides technical expertise to management and staff in resolving difficult problems, interpreting laws, regulations, and Roche standards while supporting new staff orientation and training.

• Analyzes key program areas and trends; works with vendors and business functions to identify opportunities, implement initiatives, and establish systems to track, measure, and report on assigned activities.

• Participates in emergency planning and response, and supports SHE management with cross-functional projects impacting multiple business areas and divisions

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in physical science, life science, environmental sciences, engineering, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in industries such as diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, or related sectors with demonstrated expertise in SHE programs.

• Proven ability to influence opinions and drive change across multiple business functions and units without direct authority, with strong knowledge and application of relevant laws and regulations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex scientific, technical, and regulatory information to diverse audiences and audiences.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop effective training materials while building and maintaining smooth, cooperative working relationships across multiple departments and business units

• Preferred Skills: Completion of a national certification, or ability to obtain, such as a Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM).

Relocation benefits for this position are not available.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $86,200-$160,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geog

• Analyzes key program areas and trends; works with vendors and business functions to identify opportunities, implement initiatives, and establish systems to track, measure, and report on assigned activities.

• Participates in emergency planning and response, and supports SHE management with cross-functional projects impacting multiple business areas and divisions

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in physical science, life science, environmental sciences, engineering, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in industries such as diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, or related sectors with demonstrated expertise in SHE programs.

• Proven ability to influence opinions and drive change across multiple business functions and units without direct authority, with strong knowledge and application of relevant laws and regulations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex scientific, technical, and regulatory information to diverse audiences and audiences.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop effective training materials while building and maintaining smooth, cooperative working relationships across multiple departments and business units

• Preferred Skills: Completion of a national certification, or ability to obtain, such as a Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM).

Relocation benefits for this position are not available.

• o Collaborare allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di soluzioni per i clienti, assicurandosi che soddisfino le esigenze e le aspettative dei clienti
• o Collaborare con team interfunzionali per progettare ed eseguire iniziative che migliorano l'esperienza cliente end-to-end. Ottimizzazione/innovazione dei processi

• o Implementare le migliori pratiche e standard operativi per ottimizzare i processi e massimizzare la produttività Chi siete:

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Hauptaufgabe des Service Expert Managers besteht darin, ein hervorragendes Kundenerlebnis für hochkomplexe Installationen zu bieten. Dazu müssen Sie eine starke Beziehung zur Vertriebsabteilung und anderen Supportbereichen aufbauen. Es wird von entscheidender Bedeutung sein, Ihr Team auf ein strategischeres und leistungsstärkeres Niveau zu führen und dabei das hohe technische Wissen des Teams zu nutzen, um eine detaillierte Datenanalyse zu fördern, die proaktive Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden fördert. Intern helfen Sie bei der Erstellung von Schulungsplänen für Außendienstteams und entwickeln die für das Unternehmen und neue Herausforderungen erforderlichen Fähigkeiten. Die Chance:
• Teamführung
• o Führen, motivieren und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team aus Managern und Mitarbeitern.
• o Bieten Sie Coaching, Unterstützung und Mentoring an, um den Erfolg von Einzelpersonen und Teams sicherzustellen.
• o Fördern Sie ein kollaboratives und integratives Arbeitsumfeld, das Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung fördert.
• o Fördern Sie eine kundenorientierte Kultur, die Empathie, Reaktionsfähigkeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Vordergrund stellt. Strategie
• o Erstellen Sie eine Strategie zur Unterstützung von Installationen und neuen Projekten bei unseren Schlüsselkunden.
• o Entwickeln Sie umfassende Projektpläne, in denen Aufgaben, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets dargelegt sind.
• o Definieren Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren, um die Effektivität der Projektumsetzung und das Kundenerlebnis zu messen.
• o Überwachen und analysieren Sie Servicekennzahlen, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.
• o Datenanalyse und vorgeschlagene Aktionspläne zur Steigerung der Kosten- und Serviceeffizienz.
• o Kontinuierliche Bewertung und Verbesserung von Serviceprozessen, um Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit zu steigern.
• o Lösen Sie komplexe Kundenprobleme und Eskalationen mit Professionalität und Einfühlungsvermögen.
• o Leiten Sie die Schulungsstrategie an das Mitarbeiterteam weiter. Zusammenarbeit
• o Arbeiten Sie eng mit Vertriebs-, Marketing-, Produkt- und Betriebsteams zusammen, um eine kohärente Servicebereitstellung und konsistente Nachrichtenübermittlung sicherzustellen.
• o Zusammenarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Kundenlösungen, um sicherzustellen, dass diese den Kundenbedürfnissen und -erwartungen entsprechen.
• o Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um Initiativen zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, die das End-to-End-Kundenerlebnis verbessern. Prozessoptimierung/Innovation.
• o Innovationen vorantreiben, indem neue Technologien, Tools und Methoden eingeführt werden, um das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern und die Servicefreundlichkeit zu verbessern Metriken, um den Projektfortschritt zu verfolgen und Bereiche mit Verbesserungspotenzial zu identifizieren.
• o Implementieren Sie Best Practices und betriebliche Standards, um Prozesse zu optimieren und die Produktivität zu maximieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Strategische und technische Führung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung, Betreuung und Skalierung leistungsstarker technischer Support- oder Außendienstteams, idealerweise im IVD-Bereich (In-vitro-Diagnostik).
• Komplexes Projektmanagement: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Leitung komplexer Installationen und Großprojekte vom Anfang bis zur Fertigstellung, Verwaltung von Zeitplänen, Ressourcen und Budgets.
• Datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung: Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu nutzen, klare KPIs festzulegen und Kennzahlen in proaktive, kosteneffiziente Aktionspläne umzusetzen. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Außergewöhnliche Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten mit nachweislicher Fähigkeit, starke Partnerschaften zwischen Vertrieb, Marketing, Betrieb und globalen/lokalen Teams aufzubauen. Kundenzentrierte Denkweise: Ein leidenschaftlicher Verfechter des End-to-End-Kundenerlebnisses, der über das nötige Einfühlungsvermögen und die Professionalität verfügt, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Les principales responsabilités du gestionnaire Service Expert seront de fournir une excellente expérience client pour les installations très complexes. Pour ce faire, vous devrez établir une relation solide avec le service commercial et d’autres domaines de support. Il sera essentiel de mener votre équipe à un niveau plus stratégique et plus performant, en utilisant l'équipe et ses connaissances techniques élevées pour promouvoir une analyse détaillée des données qui favorise des actions proactives pour nos clients. En interne, vous contribuerez à créer des plans de formation pour les équipes terrain et à développer les compétences nécessaires à l'entreprise et aux nouveaux défis. L'opportunité :
• Leadership d'équipe
• o Diriger, motiver et développer une équipe hautement performante de gestionnaires et d'employés.
• o Fournir du coaching, du soutien et du mentorat pour assurer la réussite des individus et des équipes.
• o Favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif et inclusif qui favorise l'innovation et l'amélioration continue.
• o Favoriser une culture centrée sur le client qui donne la priorité à l'empathie, à la réactivité et à l'amélioration continue. Stratégie
• o Construire une stratégie pour soutenir les installations et les nouveaux projets chez nos clients clés.
• o Élaborer des plans de projet complets qui décrivent les tâches, les délais, les ressources et les budgets.
• o Définir des indicateurs de performance clés pour mesurer l'efficacité de la mise en œuvre du projet et l'expérience client.
• o Surveiller et analyser les mesures de service pour favoriser l'amélioration continue.
• o Analyse des données et plans d'action proposés pour améliorer l'efficacité des coûts et des services.
• o Évaluer et améliorer continuellement les processus de service pour améliorer l'efficacité et la satisfaction des clients.
• o Résoudre les problèmes et les escalades complexes des clients avec professionnalisme et empathie.
• o Diriger la stratégie de formation auprès de l'équipe du personnel. Collaboration.
• o Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de ventes, de marketing, de produits et d'exploitation pour assurer une prestation de services cohérente et des messages cohérents.
• o Collaborer au développement et à la fourniture de solutions clients, en s'assurant qu'elles répondent aux besoins et aux attentes des clients.
• o Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour concevoir et exécuter des initiatives qui améliorent l'expérience client de bout en bout. Optimisation/innovation des processus.
• o Stimuler l'innovation en introduisant de nouvelles technologies, outils et méthodologies pour améliorer l'expérience client et améliorer la facilité de service.
• o Piloter et tester de nouvelles initiatives, recueillir des commentaires et itérer en fonction des informations pour conduire une amélioration continue. suivre l'avancement des projets et identifier les domaines à améliorer.
• o Mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques et normes opérationnelles pour optimiser les processus et maximiser la productivité. Qui vous êtes :
• Leadership stratégique et technique : expérience avérée dans la direction, l'encadrement et la mise à l'échelle d'équipes de support technique ou de service sur le terrain hautes performances, idéalement au sein du secteur IVD (In Vitro Diagnostics).
• Gestion de projets complexes : expérience démontrée dans la direction d'installations complexes et de projets à grande échelle du début à la fin, en gestion des délais, des ressources et des budgets.
• Prise de décision basée sur les données : fort esprit analytique avec la capacité d'exploiter des données complexes, d'établir des KPI clairs et de traduire les mesures en plans d'action proactifs et rentables. Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec une capacité avérée à établir des partenariats solides entre les équipes de vente, de marketing, d'exploitation et mondiales/locales. Esprit centré sur le client : Un défenseur passionné de l'expérience client de bout en bout, possédant l'empathie et le professionnalisme nécessaires pour résoudre les problèmes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​Der Produktionsstandort Kaiseraugst ist ein Eckpfeiler im weltweiten Produktions- und Logistiknetzwerk von Roche. Ca. 2000 Personen sind hier beschäftigt und der Standort beherbergt den weltweit grössten und innovativsten Verpackungsbetrieb von Roche.

Als PraktikantIn innerhalb der Training Academy für die Manufacturing Unit Assembly & Packaging bist Du am Puls des Geschehens: Du unterstützt uns dabei, neue Mitarbeitende optimal auf ihre Aufgaben vorzubereiten, Trainings weiterzuentwickeln und die hohen Qualitätsstandards zu sichern.

Die Möglichkeit
In diesem Praktikum bist Du nicht nur administrative Unterstützung, sondern ein aktiver Teil des gesamten Programms.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte:

• Du bist die treibende Kraft bei der Organisation, Koordination und Weiterentwicklung unseres produktionsspezifischen Onboarding-Programms. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen einen reibungslosen und motivierenden Start hinlegen.

• Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch ihre ersten Tage, bist Ansprechperson für Fragen und baust die Brücke zwischen der Academy und der Produktion.

• Du unterstützt uns aktiv bei der Konzeption und dem Design von modernen Trainings Modulen und erstellst zielgruppengerechte, anschauliche Trainingsmaterialien.

• Du übernimmst das eigenständige Handling von administrativen Prozessen (z. B. smarte Kalenderverwaltung, Ressourcenplanung und Materialbeschaffung für Schulungszwecke) und stimmst Dich dazu eng mit den verschiedenen Produktionslinien ab.

Wer Du Bist
Du bist immatrikuliert oder hast Dein Studium an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule, vorzugsweise im Bereich Erwachsenenbildung, Pharmazie, Medien- /Kommunikationswissenschaften oder Wirtschaft, innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate abgeschlossen und hast Interesse, Deine Kenntnisse im Rahmen eines 12-monatigen Praktikums bei einem Arbeitspensum von mindestens 80% in einer modernen Arbeitsumgebung einzusetzen, sowie die pharmazeutische Industrie kennenzulernen.

Überdies rundest Du Dein Profil mit folgenden Kompetenzen ab:

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Ein hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative sowie selbstständiger, genauer und nachvollziehbarer Arbeitsweise

• Kreativität, Ideenreichtum und Innovation

• Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Lösungsorientierung sowie kollaborative Arbeitsweise

• Eine teamorientierte Denkweise mit Blick auf stete Verbesserung der Prozesse

• Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Zusätzliche Information

• Der bevorzugte Start des Praktikums ist ab September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung.

• Bitte gib Dein präferiertes Startdatum, das Pensum und die gewünschte Praktikumsdauer in Deiner Bewerbung an.

• Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, tog

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il sito di produzione Kaiseraugst è una pietra angolare della rete globale di produzione e logistica di Roche. Circa 2000 persone sono impiegate qui e il sito ospita la più grande e innovativa azienda di imballaggio di Roche al mondo. Come tirocinante all'interno dell'Accademia di formazione per l'assemblaggio e l'imballaggio delle unità di produzione, sei sul polso degli eventi: Ci aiuta a preparare in modo ottimale nuovi dipendenti per i loro compiti, sviluppare corsi di formazione e garantire elevati standard di qualità. La possibilità In questo stage, non sei solo supporto amministrativo, ma una parte attiva dell'intero programma. I vostri compiti principali:
• Siete la forza trainante nell'organizzazione, nel coordinamento e nell'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro programma di onboarding specifico per la produzione. Assicurarsi che i nuovi colleghi facciano un inizio liscio e motivante.
• Si accompagnano i partecipanti attraverso i loro primi giorni, sono la persona di contatto per domande e costruire il ponte tra l'Accademia e la produzione.
• Ci supporti attivamente nella concezione e nella progettazione di moduli di formazione moderni e crei materiali di formazione orientati al gruppo target.
• Si prende il controllo della gestione indipendente dei processi amministrativi (ad esempio, gestione del calendario intelligente, pianificazione delle risorse e approvvigionamento dei materiali per scopi formativi) e votare Rimanere vicino alle diverse linee di produzione. Chi sei Siete matricolati o avete completato i vostri studi in un'università o università di scienze applicate, preferibilmente nel campo dell'educazione degli adulti, farmacia, media / scienze della comunicazione o economia, negli ultimi 12 mesi e sono interessati a utilizzare la vostra conoscenza in uno stage di 12 mesi con un carico di lavoro di almeno l'80% in un ambiente di lavoro moderno, così come arrivare a conoscere l'industria farmaceutica. Inoltre, si completa il tuo profilo con le seguenti competenze:
• Comprensione rapida
• Un alto grado di iniziativa e un metodo di lavoro indipendente, preciso e comprensibile
• Creatività, immaginazione e innovazione
• Alto livello di lavoro di squadra e orientamento della soluzione e metodi di lavoro collaborativi
• Una mentalità orientata al team per migliorare costantemente i processi
• La volontà di assumersi la responsabilità Ulteriori informazioni
• L'inizio preferito dello stage è da settembre 2026 o per accordo.
• Si prega di indicare la data di inizio preferita, il carico di lavoro e la durata di tirocinio desiderata nella vostra applicazione.
• I cittadini non UE/EFTA devono includere una conferma dell'università che uno stage obbligatorio fa parte dell'istruzione nei documenti di richiesta. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano,
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Kaiseraugst production site is a cornerstone of Roche’s global production and logistics network. Approximately 2000 people are employed here and the site is home to Roche’s largest and most innovative packaging company in the world. As an intern within the Training Academy for the Manufacturing Unit Assembly & Packaging, you are on the pulse of events: You help us to optimally prepare new employees for their tasks, develop training courses and ensure high quality standards. The possibility In this internship, you are not only administrative support, but an active part of the entire program. Your main tasks:
• You are the driving force in the organization, coordination and further development of our production-specific onboarding program. You ensure that new colleagues make a smooth and motivating start.
• You accompany the participants through their first days, are the contact person for questions and build the bridge between the Academy and production.
• You actively support us in the conception and design of modern training modules and create target-group-oriented, clear training materials.
• You take over the independent handling of administrative processes (e.g. smart calendar management, resource planning and material procurement for training purposes) and vote Stay close to the different production lines. Who you are You are matriculated or have Completed your studies at a university or university of applied sciences, preferably in the field of adult education, pharmacy, media / communication sciences or economics, within the last 12 months and are interested in using your knowledge in a 12-month internship with a workload of at least 80% in a modern working environment, as well as getting to know the pharmaceutical industry. In addition, you round off your profile with the following competencies:
• Quick understanding
• A high degree of initiative as well as an independent, accurate and comprehensible working method
• Creativity, imagination and innovation
• High level of teamwork and solution orientation as well as collaborative working methods
• A team-oriented mindset with a view to constantly improving processes
• Willingness to take responsibility Additional information
• The preferred start of the internship is from September 2026 or by arrangement.
• Please indicate your preferred start date, the workload and the desired internship duration in your application.
• Non-EU/EFTA citizens must include a confirmation from the university that a mandatory internship is part of the education in the application documents. Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100,000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let's build a healthier future, tog

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le site de production de Kaiseraugst est une pierre angulaire du réseau mondial de production et de logistique de Roche. Environ 2000 personnes y travaillent et le site abrite la plus grande et la plus innovante entreprise d'emballage de Roche dans le monde. En tant que stagiaire à l'Académie de formation pour l'assemblage et l'emballage des unités de fabrication, vous êtes sur le pouls des événements: Vous nous aidez à préparer au mieux les nouveaux employés à leurs tâches, à développer des cours de formation et à garantir des normes de qualité élevées. La possibilité Dans ce stage, vous êtes non seulement un soutien administratif, mais une partie active de l'ensemble du programme. Vos principales tâches:
• Vous êtes le moteur de l'organisation, de la coordination et du développement de notre programme d'embarquement spécifique à la production. Vous veillez à ce que les nouveaux collègues fassent un début doux et motivant.
• Vous accompagnez les participants pendant leurs premiers jours, êtes la personne de contact pour les questions et construire le pont entre l'Académie et la production.
• Vous nous soutenez activement dans la conception et la conception de modules de formation modernes et créez des matériels de formation clairs et orientés vers des groupes cibles.
• Vous prenez en charge la gestion indépendante des processus administratifs (p. ex., la gestion intelligente du calendrier, la planification des ressources et l'approvisionnement matériel à des fins de formation) et votez Restez à proximité des différentes lignes de production. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes diplômé ou avez terminé vos études dans une université ou une université de sciences appliquées, de préférence dans le domaine de l'éducation des adultes, de la pharmacie, des médias / sciences de la communication ou de l'économie, au cours des 12 derniers mois et êtes intéressé à utiliser vos connaissances dans un stage de 12 mois avec une charge de travail d'au moins 80% dans un environnement de travail moderne, ainsi que de connaître l'industrie pharmaceutique. En outre, vous arrondissez votre profil avec les compétences suivantes:
• Compréhension rapide
• Un degré élevé d'initiative ainsi qu'une méthode de travail indépendante, précise et compréhensible
• Créativité, imagination et innovation
• Un haut niveau de travail d'équipe et d'orientation des solutions ainsi que des méthodes de travail en collaboration
• Un état d'esprit orienté vers l'équipe en vue d'améliorer constamment les processus
• Volonté de prendre la responsabilité Informations complémentaires
• Le début préféré du stage est à partir de septembre 2026 ou par arrangement.
• Veuillez indiquer votre date de début préférée, la charge de travail et la durée de stage souhaitée dans votre candidature.
• Les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent inclure une confirmation de l'université qu'un stage obligatoire fait partie de la formation dans les documents de candidature. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Bâtissons un avenir plus sain

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect provides both visionary technical steering and empathetic people leadership. This is a high-impact, hybrid role where 75% of your accountability is dedicated to Solution Architecture and Technical Oversight for the navify® Point of Care (PoC) Program, and 25% is dedicated to engineering management and people development.

As People Leader, you will be responsible for leading a team of Senior Software Engineers, advising on individual career paths for engineers, mentor Senior/Staff-level contributors, conducting regular performance appraisals, and manage professional growth through personalized development plans.

You will be responsible for the architectural health and delivery outcomes of our Point of Care Operations; a world wide scale solution deployed in more than 50 countries in all world wide regions, connected with more that 250.000 Point of Care instruments in the field. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical implementation, ensuring our cloud-to-edge middleware solution remains scalable, secure, and performant. Point of Care and Healthcare domain knowledge becomes a critical asset to be able to thrive in such a complex environment.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for business stakeholders, product owners, and external clinical partners. And align between cross disciplines in a highly complex and cross-teams highly dependent environment, making sure Solution Architecture is in line with Enterprise Architecture and overarching E2E Solution design.

• Drive the creation of architectures consistent with project roadmaps, platform strategies, governance policies, and standards. Also, ensure the appropriate implementation of the above-mentioned items.

• Apply stakeholder management and soft skills; especially the ability to influence without formal authority, align architecture roadmaps and dependencies across multiple programs and capacity to build effective networks beyond purely technical expertise.

• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs to rapidly stream architectural designs and core team iterations. Proven experience embedding native AI capabilities into cloud and edge products. And build a deep understanding of the legal and regulatory constraints of AI in healthcare (e.g., FDA guidelines, EU AI Act). Ensures all AI models and features strictly adhere to patient privacy, security, and data integrity standards.

• Translate complex technical debt, roadmap trade-offs, and innovative opportunities into business-value-focused language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Remove blockers at the organization-team interface. Mediate between team dependencies and prioritize technical tasks in line with the architectural roadmap.

• Define and evolve a modular, high-availability architecture on AWS. Drive the adoption of modern Java frameworks that support elastic scaling and high-throughput data processing.

La posizione Il Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect fornisce sia lo sterzo tecnico visionario che la leadership empatica delle persone. Questo è un ruolo ibrido ad alto impatto, dove il 75% della tua responsabilità è dedicato a Solution Architecture e Technical Oversight per il navify® Programma Point of Care (PoC) e il 25% è dedicato alla gestione dell'ingegneria e allo sviluppo delle persone. Come People Leader, sarete responsabili di guidare un team di ingegneri di software senior, consigliando su percorsi di carriera individuali per gli ingegneri, il mentore Senior/Staff-level contributors, conducendo regolari valutazioni delle prestazioni, e gestire la crescita professionale attraverso piani di sviluppo personalizzati. Sarete responsabili per la salute architettonica e i risultati di consegna del nostro Point of Care Operations; una soluzione a scala mondiale schierata in più di 50 paesi in tutte le regioni del mondo, collegata con più di 250.000 strumenti Point of Care nel campo. Potrai colmare il divario tra strategia aziendale e implementazione tecnica, assicurando che la nostra soluzione middleware cloud-to-edge rimanga scalabile, sicura e performante. La conoscenza del dominio di Care and Healthcare diventa un bene critico per poter prosperare in un ambiente così complesso. Le tue responsabilità
• Agire come punto di contatto tecnico principale per gli stakeholder aziendali, i proprietari di prodotti e i partner clinici esterni. E allineare tra le discipline incrociate in un ambiente altamente complesso e cross-teams altamente dipendente, assicurandosi che Solution Architecture sia in linea con Enterprise Architecture e overarching E2E Solution Design.
• Guidare la creazione di architetture coerente con roadmap di progetto, strategie di piattaforma, politiche di governance e standard. Inoltre, assicurarsi l'implementazione appropriata degli articoli sopra menzionati.
• Applicare la gestione degli stakeholder e le competenze morbide; in particolare la capacità di influenzare senza autorità formale, allineare le roadmap di architettura e le dipendenze attraverso più programmi e capacità di costruire reti efficaci al di là di pura competenza tecnica.
• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs per trasmettere rapidamente progetti architettonici e core team iterations. Esperienza comprovata che incorpora le capacità AI native in prodotti cloud e edge. E costruire una profonda comprensione dei vincoli legali e normativi dell'IA nel settore sanitario (ad esempio, linee guida della FDA, EU AI Act). Garantisce che tutti i modelli e le caratteristiche AI aderiscano strettamente agli standard di privacy, sicurezza e integrità dei dati del paziente.
• Traduci il debito tecnico complesso, i trade-off roadmap e le opportunità innovative nel linguaggio focalizzato sul valore aziendale per gli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Rimuovere i bloccanti all'interfaccia di organizzazione-team. Mediate tra le dipendenze del team e priorità compiti tecnici in linea con la roadmap architettonica.
• Definire ed evolvere un'architettura modulare ad alta disponibilità su AWS. Guidare l'adozione di moderni framework Java che supportano lo scaling elastico e l'elaborazione di dati ad alto rendimento.
• Standardizzare le nostre soluzioni di bordo basate su DotNet. Scopri come ci interfacciamo con diverse flotte di strumenti (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, ecc.), assicurando resistenza durante la volatilità della rete.
• Master complesse topologie di messaggistica. Definire modelli per architetture basate su eventi, sincronizzazione di stato distribuita e distribuzione affidabile dei dati in ambienti in cui la connettività è intermittente.
• Impostare il punto di riferimento per i requisiti non operativi. Guidare la modellazione di minacce proattive, integrare la sicurezza per-design, e garantire che il nostro middleware incontra un med rigoroso

jobs.title: Medical Lead (Neurology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Lead is the key Medical Affairs role that develops broad medical & scientific expertise within given Disease/Therapeutic Areas. As a Medical Lead, you support development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies, primarily drive scientific exchange and evidence generation activities.

Key Responsibilities

• You are a strategic partner who provides medical insights and expertise to the organisation and executes all planned medical activities.

• You will be the medical responsible of the team and will be more in the field.

• You manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• You collaborate with stakeholders in identifying and prioritising relevant research ideas and developing them into research projects.

• You collaborate closely with Clinical Operations across different phases of interventional clinical trials: Gaining clarity and communicating/spreading the knowledge to communities of interest, helping to define and maintain country participation strategy, supporting development of sites selection strategy through a disease area lens by different means including participation in site feasibility activities, pre-activation site visits and other F2F and remote interactions with the sites as needed, patient recruitment & retention, protocol & patient-related issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

• You detect the medical gap/need for RWD/E generation activities by reviewing Integrated Evidence Plans, communicate, agree and document, plan & execute and/or participate in respective work in non-interventional studies and RWD/E generation activities: Definition of the research questions and study objectives, study design and protocol, study budget, feasibility, site selection, pre-activation and ad-hoc visits, patient recruitment, protocol & patient issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

Who You Are

• You have Medicine, pharmacy or dentistry degree

• Your experience in Neurology is preferred

• You have previous experience in Pharma Industry

• You are fluent in Turkish and English

• You have strategic thinking and growth mindset

• You are collaborative and experienced in stakeholder management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• L'utente rileva il gap medico/necessario per le attività di generazione RWD/E esaminando i piani di prova integrati, comunica, accetta e documenta, pianifica e giustizia e/o partecipa al rispettivo lavoro in studi non internazionali e attività di generazione RWD/E: Definizione delle domande di ricerca e obiettivi di studio, progettazione e protocollo di studio, bilancio di studio, fattibilità, selezione del sito, pre-attivazione e visite ad-hoc, reclutamento dei pazienti, protocolli e problemi dei pazienti, comunicazione scientifica dei risultati di studio, relazione di studio clinico e pubblicazioni scientifiche. • La tua esperienza in Neurologia è preferita
• Hai esperienza precedente in Industria farmaceutica
• Sei fluente in turco e inglese
• Hai pensiero strategico e mentalità di crescita
• Sei collaborativo e esperto nella gestione degli stakeholder Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Über Roche - Near Patient Care Operations
Doing now what patients need next. Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche.
