Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA.

Dein neues Team
Als Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) im Bereich NPC Operations schlagen wir die Brücke zwischen Entwicklung und Produktion. Mit rund 170 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim, Indianapolis und Rotkreuz leiten wir die Technologiestrategie, die Industrialisierung des Produktdesigns und die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg.
Als projektorientierte Organisation ermöglichen wir skalierbare Produktdesigns, die für die Massenproduktion bereit sind. Wir stellen robuste Prozesse und Anlagen für exzellente Ergebnisse und skalierbare QC-Prozesse sicher. In Partnerschaft mit externen Netzwerken sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion.
Wir engagieren uns für den Aufbau eines globalen, vielfältigen und inklusiven Teams, das verschiedene Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten zusammenbringt, um Innovationen zu fördern und ein großartiges Arbeitsumfeld für alle zu schaffen.

Deine neue Rolle
Als Senior Process Science Engineer - Lasertechnologien (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine hochspezialisierte Rolle in unserer Organisation und stellst durch ein tiefes Verständnis der kalten Ablation und extrem präziser Materialabtragsraten die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und den Transfer in die Serienfertigung von Laserstrahlmikrostrukturierungsprozesse (besonders mit UKP-Lasern, also Ultrakurzpuls) sicher. Deine Hauptaufgaben sind dabei:

• Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien und Entwicklung robuster Prozesse für das Laserabtragen, -schneiden und -bohren im Mikrometerbereich.

• Systematische Prozessfenster-Ermittlung basierend auf der Anwendung wissenschaftlicher Methoden (z. B. DoE – Design of Experiments), um stabile Prozessparameter (Pulsenergie, Repetitionsrate, Scangeschwindigkeit) zu definieren.

• Auswahl und Qualifizierung von Laserquellen - Evaluierung und Auswahl geeigneter Strahlquellen (z. B. Pikosekunden- oder Femtosekundenlaser) und optische Komponenten für spezifische Materialanforderungen.

• Analyse der Abtragsergebnisse mittels hochauflösender Messtechnik (z. B. Lichtmikroskopie, Weißlichtinterferometrie, REM), um die Qualität der Mikrostrukturierung sicherzustellen.

• Optimierung der Strahlführung und -formung - Anpassung und Justage optischer Systeme (Scanner, Objektive, Strahlaufweiter) zur Erzielung optimaler Fokusdurchmesser und Strahlprofile.

• Transfer in die Serienfertigung - Überführung der entwickelten Prozesse vom Laborstatus in die industrielle Serienreife inklusive Erstellung der notwendigen Dokumentation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni su Roche - Vicino alle operazioni di cura del paziente Fare quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'Area clienti Vicino alla cura dei pazienti (NPC) combina i portafogli di Roche’s Point of Care e Diabetes Care. Il nostro obiettivo è migliorare la gestione delle malattie consentendo risposte critiche e soluzioni personalizzate più vicine alle persone a cui ci impegniamo. Con la nostra passione, portiamo i test più vicini ai pazienti e diamo potere alle persone di monitorare meglio la propria salute. Allo stesso tempo, aiutiamo i medici a prendere decisioni più veloci e più sicure più vicine al paziente. Nell'ambito delle operazioni NPC, siamo globalmente responsabili per la produzione end-to-end di soluzioni per il monitoraggio continuo del glucosio (CGM), la misurazione dello zucchero nel sangue (BGM) e la consegna dell'insulina (IDS), così come i prodotti point-of-care (POC). I nostri impianti di produzione interna più importanti sono Mannheim in Germania e Indianapolis negli Stati Uniti. La tua nuova squadra Come Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) nel campo delle operazioni NPC, costruiamo il ponte tra sviluppo e produzione. Con circa 170 colleghi a Mannheim, Indianapolis e Rotkreuz, guidiamo la strategia tecnologica, l'industrializzazione della progettazione del prodotto e la collaborazione con partner esterni in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Come organizzazione orientata al progetto, permettiamo ai progetti di prodotti scalabili pronti per la produzione di massa. Garantiamo processi e strutture robuste per risultati eccellenti e processi QC scalabili. In collaborazione con le reti esterne, garantiamo costi di produzione competitivi e una produzione affidabile. Siamo impegnati a costruire un team globale, diversificato e inclusivo che riunisce diverse prospettive e competenze per guidare l'innovazione e creare un grande ambiente di lavoro per tutti. Il tuo nuovo ruolo Senior Process Science Engineer - Laser Technologies (m/f/d) Si gioca un ruolo altamente specializzato nella nostra organizzazione e, attraverso una profonda comprensione dei tassi di ablazione freddi e di rimozione dei materiali estremamente precisi, garantire lo sviluppo e il trasferimento di successo nella produzione di serie di processi di microstrutturazione del fascio laser (specialmente con i laser UKP, cioè il polso ultrashort). I vostri compiti principali sono:
• Condurre studi di fattibilità e sviluppare processi robusti per ablazione laser, taglio e foratura a scala micron.
• Determinazione sistematica della finestra di processo basata sull'applicazione di metodi scientifici (ad esempio DoE – Design of Experiments) per definire parametri di processo stabili (pulsare energia, tasso di ripetizione, velocità di scansione).
• Selezione e qualificazione di sorgenti laser - Valutazione e selezione di sorgenti di trave adatte (ad esempio laser picosecondo o femtosecondo) e componenti ottici per specifiche esigenze di materiale.
• Analisi dei risultati di rimozione utilizzando tecniche di misura ad alta risoluzione (ad esempio microscopia leggera, interferometria della luce bianca, REM) per garantire la qualità della microstrutturazione.
• Ottimizzazione della guida e della sagomatura del fascio - adattamento e adeguamento dei sistemi ottici (scanner, obiettivi, espansioni del fascio) per raggiungere i diametri focali ottimali e i profili del fascio.
• Trasferimento alla produzione di serie - trasferimento dei processi sviluppati dallo stato di laboratorio alla maturità della serie industriale, compresa la preparazione della documentazione necessaria
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About Roche - Near Patient Care Operations Doing now what patients need next. The Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) combines Roche’s Point of Care and Diabetes Care portfolios. Our goal is to improve disease management by enabling critical responses and personalized solutions closer to the people we are committed to. With our passion, we bring tests closer to patients and empower people to better monitor their own health. At the same time, we help medical professionals make faster and safer decisions closer to the patient. Within NPC Operations, we are globally responsible for the end-to-end production of solutions for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), blood sugar measurement (BGM) and insulin delivery (IDS), as well as point-of-care (POC) products. Our most important internal production facilities are Mannheim in Germany and Indianapolis in the USA. Your new team As Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) in the field of NPC operations, we build the bridge between development and production. With around 170 colleagues in Mannheim, Indianapolis and Rotkreuz, we lead the technology strategy, industrialization of product design and collaboration with external partners throughout the entire product lifecycle. As a project-oriented organization, we enable scalable product designs that are ready for mass production. We ensure robust processes and facilities for excellent results and scalable QC processes. In partnership with external networks, we ensure competitive manufacturing costs and reliable production. We are committed to building a global, diverse and inclusive team that brings together diverse perspectives and skills to drive innovation and create a great work environment for everyone. Your new role Senior Process Science Engineer - Laser Technologies (m/f/d) You play a highly specialized role in our organization and, through a deep understanding of cold ablation and extremely precise material removal rates, ensure the successful development and transfer into the series production of laser beam microstructuring processes (especially with UKP lasers, i.e. ultrashort pulse). Your main tasks are:
• Conduct feasibility studies and develop robust processes for laser ablation, cutting and drilling at the micron scale.
• Systematic process window determination based on the application of scientific methods (e.g. DoE – Design of Experiments) to define stable process parameters (pulse energy, repetition rate, scanning speed).
• Selection and qualification of laser sources - Evaluation and selection of suitable beam sources (e.g. picosecond or femtosecond lasers) and optical components for specific material requirements.
• Analysis of removal results using high-resolution measurement techniques (e.g. light microscopy, white light interferometry, REM) to ensure the quality of microstructuring.
• Optimisation of beam guidance and shaping - adaptation and adjustment of optical systems (scanners, objectives, beam expanders) to achieve optimum focal diameters and beam profiles.
• Transfer to series production - transfer of the developed processes from the laboratory status to industrial series maturity, including the preparation of the necessary documentation

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de Roche - Opérations de soins aux patients Faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'Espace client près des soins aux patients (PCN) regroupe les portefeuilles de Roches Point of Care et Diabetes Care. Notre objectif est d'améliorer la gestion des maladies en permettant des réponses critiques et des solutions personnalisées plus proches des personnes auxquelles nous sommes engagés. Avec notre passion, nous rapprochons les tests des patients et donnons aux gens les moyens de mieux surveiller leur propre santé. Parallèlement, nous aidons les professionnels de la santé à prendre des décisions plus rapides et plus sûres auprès du patient. Au sein des opérations NPC, nous sommes globalement responsables de la production de bout en bout de solutions pour la surveillance continue du glucose (CGM), la mesure du taux de sucre dans le sang (BGM) et l'administration d'insuline (IDS), ainsi que de produits au point de soins (POC). Nos principales installations de production interne sont Mannheim en Allemagne et Indianapolis aux États-Unis. Votre nouvelle équipe En tant que science et technologie manufacturières (SMA) dans le domaine des opérations de CNP, nous construisons le pont entre le développement et la production. Avec environ 170 collègues à Mannheim, Indianapolis et Rotkreuz, nous menons la stratégie technologique, l'industrialisation de la conception des produits et la collaboration avec des partenaires externes tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. En tant qu'organisation axée sur le projet, nous permettons des conceptions de produits évolutives prêtes à la production de masse. Nous assurons des processus et des installations robustes pour d'excellents résultats et des processus de QC évolutives. En partenariat avec des réseaux externes, nous garantissons des coûts de fabrication compétitifs et une production fiable. Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir une équipe mondiale, diversifiée et inclusive qui rassemble des perspectives et des compétences diverses pour stimuler l'innovation et créer un excellent environnement de travail pour tous. Votre nouveau rôle Ingénieur scientifique principal des procédés - Laser Technologies (m/f/d) Vous jouez un rôle hautement spécialisé dans notre organisation et, grâce à une compréhension approfondie de l'ablation à froid et des taux d'élimination des matériaux extrêmement précis, assurer le développement réussi et le transfert dans la série de procédés de microstructuration des faisceaux laser (surtout avec les lasers UKP, c'est-à-dire l'impulsion ultra courte). Vos principales tâches sont les suivantes :
• Mener des études de faisabilité et mettre au point des procédés robustes pour l'ablation laser, la découpe et le forage à l'échelle du micron.
• Détermination systématique de la fenêtre de processus basée sur l'application de méthodes scientifiques (par exemple DoE – Conception d'expériences) pour définir des paramètres de processus stables (énergie d'impulsion, taux de répétition, vitesse de balayage).
• Sélection et qualification des sources laser - Évaluation et sélection des sources de faisceau appropriées (par exemple lasers picoseconde ou femtoseconde) et des composants optiques pour des exigences spécifiques en matière de matériaux.
• Analyse des résultats d'élimination à l'aide de techniques de mesure à haute résolution (par exemple microscopie de lumière, interférométrie de lumière blanche, REM) pour assurer la qualité de la microstructuration.
• Optimisation du guidage et de la mise en forme des faisceaux - adaptation et réglage des systèmes optiques (canners, objectifs, amplificateurs de faisceau) pour obtenir des diamètres focals et des profils de faisceau optimaux.
• Transfert à la production en série - transfert des procédés développés du statut de laboratoire à la maturité des séries industrielles, y compris la préparation de la documentation nécessaire

You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. Description of the area

By aligning with Business Stakeholders (RSS and Global Procurement), you will ensure the seamless delivery of T&E technology for One T&E Strategy as well as major enterprise programs, including ASPIRE and Mergers and Acquisitions. Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. • Stakeholder Collaboration
Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manag

Vous assurerez une continuité totale en gérant et en surveillant les couches d'intergiciel et d'intégration critiques qui relient ces composants. En vous alignant avec les intervenants commerciaux (RSS et Approvisionnement mondial), vous assurerez la prestation transparente de la technologie de T-E pour une stratégie de T-E ainsi que des grands programmes d'entreprise, y compris ASPIRE et Fusions et Acquisitions. Il s'agit de traduire les programmes d'efficacité opérationnelle en réalité technique, en veillant à ce que toutes les solutions soient fournies avec la qualité et le calendrier nécessaires pour appuyer les objectifs organisationnels mondiaux. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Stratégie et vision Il est responsable d'établir l'orientation d'un produit et de s'assurer qu'il atteint des résultats et des objectifs financiers définis. Définit la stratégie, la feuille de route et les caractéristiques des produits en fonction des objectifs opérationnels, des besoins des utilisateurs et des politiques organisationnelles. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité Recueillir, comprendre et prioriser activement les besoins des utilisateurs internes. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal du problème du client et être responsable de définir et de fournir une solution qui fournit une valeur tangible. Définir et suivre les mesures clés liées à la satisfaction des utilisateurs, à l'engagement et à la livraison de valeur, et utiliser ces données pour éclairer les itérations de produits.
• Produit Cycle de vie Mgmt. Posséder le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, orienter son développement et gérer sa croissance et éventuellement son déclin en fonction de l'étude de marché, de la rétroaction des clients et des objectifs commerciaux. Gérer le produit conformément aux nouveaux règlements.

Communiquer clairement la feuille de route du produit, les échéanciers et les compromis potentiels à divers intervenants pour qu'ils manipulent

Roche Pharma is seeking a Technical Product Owner to help shape and deliver our global and regional web experience ecosystem. You will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, UX/UI specialists, regional teams, and external partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and lead day-to-day delivery execution.
This role focuses on advancing capabilities across content management, personalization, search, integrations, localization, analytics, and digital experience optimization while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.

Your Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Delivery

• Own and prioritize the backlog for web experience and analytics platforms.

• Translate business requirements into user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Lead sprint planning, refinement, testing, and release activities with development teams.

• Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

Web Platform & Experience Management

• Content publishing and localization workflows

• Search and discoverability capabilities

• Personalization and customer journey experiences

• Analytics and digital experience optimization

• Consent and identity-enabled experiences

• Ensure web capabilities are scalable, reusable, and aligned across regions and channels.

• Balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and platform standards.

Integration & Technical Coordination

• Coordinate integrations across platforms such as:

• Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and other CMS platforms

• Adobe Assets and other DAM repositories

• Personalization engines like Adobe Target

• IAM/SSO and consent management solutions

• CDP, CRM, and marketing automation platforms

• Analytics, reporting, and insight-generation tools

• Collaborate with architects and engineers on APIs, data flows, metadata, and connected services.

• Support cross-functional coordination across teams and vendors.

Quality, Compliance & Operations

• Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, accessible, and compliant with Roche standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, accessibility, security).

• Support testing, defect management, release readiness, and production validation.

• Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and operational impacts.

• Partner with support and operations teams to drive platform stability and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

• Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendors.

• Collaborate with UX/UI, content, SEO, analytics, and regional teams to ensure alignment and usability.

• Facilitate communication across global and regional stakeholders to support consistent delivery and adoption.

• Contribute to governance, roadmap planning, and prioritization activities.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Digital Product Manager,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma is seeking a Technical Product Owner to help shape and deliver our global and regional web experience ecosystem. In this role, you will drive scalable, compliant, and customer-centric digital experiences across websites, portals, and connected engagement platforms for healthcare professionals, researchers, patients, and consumers.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, UX/UI specialists, regional teams, and external partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and lead day-to-day delivery execution.
This role focuses on advancing capabilities across content management, personalization, search, integrations, localization, analytics, and digital experience optimization while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.

Your Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Delivery

• Own and prioritize the backlog for web experience and analytics platforms.

• Translate business requirements into user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Lead sprint planning, refinement, testing, and release activities with development teams.

• Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

• Coordinate day-to-day delivery across engineering teams, vendors, and partners.

Web Platform & Experience Management

• Support the delivery and continuous improvement of:

• Global, regional, and local websites and portals

• Content publishing and localization workflows

• Search and discoverability capabilities

• Personalization and customer journey experiences

• Analytics and digital experience optimization

• Consent and identity-enabled experiences

• Ensure web capabilities are scalable, reusable, and aligned across regions and channels.

• Balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and platform standards.

Integration & Technical Coordination

• Coordinate integrations across platforms such as:

• Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and other CMS platforms

• Adobe Assets and other DAM repositories

• Personalization engines like Adobe Target

• IAM/SSO and consent management solutions

• CDP, CRM, and marketing automation platforms

• Analytics, reporting, and insight-generation tools

• Collaborate with architects and engineers on APIs, data flows, metadata, and connected services.

• Support cross-functional coordination across teams and vendors.

Quality, Compliance & Operations

• Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, accessible, and compliant with Roche standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, accessibility, security).

• Support testing, defect management, release readiness, and production validation.

• Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and operational impacts.

• Partner with support and operations teams to drive platform stability and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

• Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendors.

• Collaborate with UX/UI, content, SEO, analytics, and regional teams to ensure alignment and usability.

• Facilitate communication across global and regional stakeholders to support consistent delivery and adoption.

• Contribute to governance, roadmap planning, and prioritization activities.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner, Digital Product Manager,

Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. • Conduire l'impact Agile : Intégrer les meilleures pratiques Agile et promouvoir les initiatives de changement dans les gammes de produits ou les domaines afin de favoriser une culture dynamique de l'innovation.
• Superviser la gouvernance à grande échelle : gérer des programmes complexes avec des dépendances multiples, exécuter des mesures de prestation tout en gérant les risques dans des environnements ambigus.
• Empower & Mentor Teams: Agissez en tant qu'entraîneur dévoué pour les collègues, fournissant des commentaires constructifs et favorisant la croissance dans toutes les disciplines de prestation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef de file dynamique et collaboratif qui prospère dans la complexité de navigation et rassembler diverses équipes pour atteindre des objectifs stratégiques. Vous êtes un communicateur expert capable de guider le changement organisationnel et d'établir des relations professionnelles durables. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience approfondie de la gestion de la prestation : Une expérience éprouvée en tant que gestionnaire de programme, ingénieur de formation à la libération, entraîneur agile ou archétype de prestation semblable gérant des programmes complexes à grande échelle.
• Expertise en cadre agile : Expérience pratique intégrant les meilleures pratiques agiles et menant avec succès des initiatives de gestion du changement organisationnel.
• Collaboration stratégique avec les intervenants : Succès démontré établissant de solides relations et cultivant la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants de haut niveau au-delà de diverses frontières.
• Compétences avancées en matière d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : Capacité solide d'analyser les problèmes de prestation transfrontalière, d'évaluer les options stratégiques et de mettre en oeuvre des solutions novatrices.
• Communication et coaching exceptionnels : Compétences exceptionnelles en facilitation et en négociation, combinées à une passion pour le mentorat de collègues et le renforcement des capacités de l'équipe. Laissez-les prospérer ensemble dans une culture fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration, le respect et la haute performance. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Scientific Strategy Director (Cardiometabolism & Neurology)

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur de la stratégie scientifique (Cardiométabolisme et neurologie)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Scientific Strategy Director (Cardiometabolism & Neurology)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity:
The Scientific Strategy Director holds a critical leadership position within US Medical & Scientific Affairs, driving the scientific strategy for designated disease area(s) across multiple franchise portfolios*. This role is instrumental in guiding a team of Senior Scientific Managers, transforming complex scientific information into actionable medical strategies, and ensuring the successful adoption of Roche's innovative diagnostic solutions.

This Director will be responsible for articulating a clear strategic vision, cultivating robust people leadership, and placing a high priority on external engagement and partnership management. The position demands extensive cross-functional collaboration, both with US and global stakeholders, and plays a pivotal role in the integration and delivery of Roche's comprehensive health solutions to patients. The Scientific Strategy Director will also be key in identifying emerging scientific trends, assessing competitive landscapes, and translating these insights to inform Roche's current and future diagnostic portfolios. The work of the Scientific Strategy Director is done in close collaboration with the global research and development, regulatory affairs and US commercial and access teams to ensure alignment and maximize the impact of Roche's diagnostic offerings. Furthermore, the Director will champion a culture of scientific excellence and continuous learning within their team and across the broader organization, fostering an environment where innovation and patient-centric solutions thrive.

*Assigned portfolio may contain multiple technical and disease areas and may change over time based on needs and priorities of the organization

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Coaching & Development: Provide continuous coaching, mentorship, and feedback to direct reports, driving performance, growth, and succession planning across key scientific and leadership roles.

• Resource & Capability Planning: Strategically allocate MSA scientific resources and lead targeted training initiatives to strengthen strategic, scientific, and leadership capabilities across the organization.

• Culture Leadership: Foster a culture of high performance, accountability, inclusion, and innovation within MSA and the broader Roche community.

• Strategic Prioritization: Partner with the VP of Medical & Scientific Affairs to define and align U.S. scientific priorities with global and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strategic & Tactical Execution: Lead development and execution of integrated scientific strategies, including evidence generation, education, and external engagement initiatives.

• Field Alignment: Collaborate with field leadership to ensure alignment between field medical activities and scientific strategy, incorporating field insights into planning and execution.

• External Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, professional societies, and pharma/alliance partners to inform and advance scientific strategy.

• Financial Stewardship: Manage discretionary and operational budgets responsibly, ensuring efficient resource use and strong return on scientific investment.

Who You Ar

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Roche Diagnostics in South Africa is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join our dynamic team in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal. As a Field Service Engineer you will provide the diagnostic instrumentation post-sales technical support in accordance with the manufacturers specifications and Roche Diagnostics standards.

Key Challenges

Installation/De-installations
To manage technical installation / de-installation in collaboration with the project installation and Implementation teams, engaging with Project Manager, agreeing installation requirements and specifications, conducting site inspection, understanding customer expectations and requirements and assisting in developing installation plan within deadline.

Technical / Application Support

• To provide customer support and assistance by understanding customer issues, evaluating cause, providing solutions (telephonic and on site as relevant) and resolving within deadline / SLA.

• To provide Specialist technical /product advice and guidance to sales by receiving requests from sales, understanding customer specification, providing expertise and advice and making recommendations as required.

• Support all modifications and support role out plan to meet Global modification KPI’s.

• To support technical field support for cases by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support (if possible) and coordinating resolution of cases within SLA/deadline .

• To provide Specialist technical support on site by coordinating appointment to resolve case with key contact at customer, organizing required reagents, consumables and quality control materials and providing support within deadline / SLA

• To support and resolve escalated technical cases and co-share findings with the technical support team. If required to escalate by identifying issues that require escalation, referring to appropriate escalation process, providing feedback to customers, internal sales and line manager, following up until resolved and closing case within customer expectations

The Position

About Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to helping shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

Role Summary
As the Head of the RDT Pharma R&D AI Center of Excellence (CoE) and Data Analytics , you assume a critical executive leadership role, serving as a vital AI thought leader and Strategic Partner to the RDT Pharma R&D Leadership Team and Business teams.
Rather than acting as a traditional "ivory tower" service provider, you will proactively shape the overall Pharma R&D AI and data strategy by delivering centralized core services alongside embedded, hands-on expert support. You are responsible for setting up the Hyderabad CoE, establishing the service offerings that will empower workflow teams to deliver compliant, zero-friction digital solutions and ensuring the scalable industrialization of Agentic AI capabilities Across the Pharma R&D domain.

Key Accountabilities

• CoE Strategy & Flexible Service Operationalization: Lead the establishment and operation of the R&D Agentic AI CoE. You will define and shape a flexible, hybrid operating model that balances centralized core services (such as governance, standards and infrastructure) with embedded support. You will have the flexibility to dial the capacity of this model up or down based on the specific demands of the workflow pods, ensuring your team provides both foundational guidance and active, hands-on collaboration exactly where it is needed most.

• Strategic Partnership & Capability Enablement: Act as an advisory partner to the workflow teams who retain ultimate responsibility for business process redesign, product development, business and technical requirements, KPI ownership (Cycle Time, Quality, Productivity) and value realization. Your CoE will drive technological change management and accelerate internal capability maturity through experience based pairing and knowledge transfer.

• Governance, Verification & Validation ( V&V) and Quality Standards: Standardize Verification & Validation (V&V) frameworks, define the "definition of done" and automate traceability matrices to ensure predictability across high-risk use cases. Act as the primary authority for maintaining strict GxP standards and EU AI Act traceability integrating System Risk Assessments (SRRA) and Data Classification Reports into CoE templates.

• Core Platforms & Rapid Innovation: Provide foundational architecture and managed "sandbox" environments to accelerate the "proof of science" for new AI use cases. Oversee AI DevOps to rapidly prototype and validate CoE frameworks against real world needs. Act as an advisor on PHOps (token optimization for R&D workflows) and provide essential model upgrade guidance for the Domain.

• Agent Marketplace & Asset Management: Own and develop the integrated Agentic orchestration strategy, and AI agent registry. You will be responsible for synthesizing insights from workflow teams to mainta

Avrete la flessibilità di comporre la capacità di questo modello su o giù in base alle esigenze specifiche dei pod del flusso di lavoro, assicurando il vostro team fornisce sia la guida di base che la collaborazione attiva e pratica esattamente dove è necessario più.

Il tuo CoE guiderà la gestione dei cambiamenti tecnologici e accelererà la maturità delle capacità interne attraverso l'accoppiamento basato sull'esperienza e il trasferimento delle conoscenze.

• Agent Marketplace & Asset Management: Propre et développe la stratégie d'orchestration Agentique intégrée, et le registre des agents d'IA. Vous serez responsable de la synthèse des idées des équipes de workflow à mainta

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As an Engineering Manager you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area
Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.

The Team Lead Data Foundations & Governance is part of Workforce Insights & Oversight and, together with the team, is accountable for establishing and maintaining strong, AI-ready data foundations that ensure data is trusted, secure, and fit for purpose. The role defines and operates data governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistency and control across the data lifecycle. It leads data quality management, master data practices, and metadata management to maintain integrity and reliability. The role ensures compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, and provides the structures and controls that enable sustainable and scalable data use across the organization. This role will be essential in enabling the next AI S-curve by helping build a connected data fabric and enhancing the organization’s data foundations with rich business context, interoperability, and discoverability. By ensuring data is structured, governed, and accessible in ways that support intelligent automation and decision-making, the role creates the foundation required for an increasingly agentic AI world, where AI systems and autonomous agents can reliably reason, act, and generate value at scale.

This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, technologies, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-e

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro In qualità di Engineering Manager ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Workforce Enablement (WE) è la casa per i dipendenti che affrontano prodotti, servizi e esperienze all'interno di RDT. Forniamo strumenti digitali, adottiamo e forniamo il supporto necessario per consentire l'intera forza lavoro, ovunque si trovino, ogni singolo giorno. Il Team Lead Data Foundations & Governance fa parte di Workforce Insights & Oversight e, insieme al team, è responsabile per la creazione e il mantenimento di solide basi di dati predisposte per l'IA che garantiscono che i dati siano affidabili, sicuri e adatti allo scopo. Il ruolo definisce e gestisce i quadri di governance dei dati, gli standard e le politiche per garantire coerenza e controllo nel ciclo di vita dei dati. Guida la gestione della qualità dei dati, le pratiche dei dati master e la gestione dei metadati per mantenere l'integrità e l'affidabilità. Il ruolo garantisce il rispetto dei requisiti di privacy, sicurezza e regolamentazione, e fornisce le strutture e i controlli che consentono un utilizzo sostenibile e scalabile dei dati in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo sarà essenziale per consentire al prossimo AI S-curve aiutando a costruire un tessuto di dati collegato e migliorando le basi di dati dell'organizzazione con un ricco contesto aziendale, l'interoperabilità e la scoperta. Assicurando che i dati siano strutturati, governati e accessibili in modo da supportare l'automazione intelligente e il processo decisionale, il ruolo crea le basi necessarie per un mondo AI sempre più agentico, dove i sistemi AI e gli agenti autonomi possono ragionare, agire e generare valore in scala. Questo leader RDT è responsabile per le persone, budget, tecnologie e servizi necessari per fornire un'offerta di alta qualità per i dipendenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione.
• Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili.
• Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team
• Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra.
• Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.
• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
• Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale.
• Contabile

L'équipe responsable des bases de données et de la gouvernance fait partie du programme Perspectives et surveillance de la main-d'oeuvre et, de concert avec l'équipe, elle est responsable de l'établissement et du maintien de bases de données solides et prêtes pour l'IA, qui garantissent la fiabilité, la sécurité et l'adéquation des données. Ce rôle définit et gère les cadres, les normes et les politiques de gouvernance des données afin d'assurer la cohérence et le contrôle au cours du cycle de vie des données. Il dirige la gestion de la qualité des données, les pratiques de gestion des données et la gestion des métadonnées pour maintenir l'intégrité et la fiabilité. Ce rôle assure le respect des exigences en matière de protection des renseignements personnels, de sécurité et de réglementation et fournit les structures et les contrôles qui permettent une utilisation durable et évolutive des données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle sera essentiel pour permettre la prochaine courbe de S AI en aidant à construire un tissu de données connecté et en améliorant les bases de données de l'organisation avec un riche contexte commercial, l'interopérabilité et la découverte. En s'assurant que les données sont structurées, régies et accessibles de manière à soutenir l'automatisation intelligente et la prise de décisions, le rôle crée les bases nécessaires à un monde de l'IA de plus en plus agent, où les systèmes d'IA et les agents autonomes peuvent raisonnablement raisonner, agir et générer de la valeur à l'échelle. Ce leader du RDT est responsable des personnes, du budget, des technologies et des services nécessaires pour offrir une offre de haute qualité aux employés. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Capacité des membres de l'équipe et perfectionnement professionnel
• Se concentre sur le développement des capacités de l'équipe d'ingénierie qui correspondent aux besoins et aux objectifs immédiats du projet et à la vision globale de la fonction.
• Encourage les membres de l'équipe à définir eux-mêmes leur parcours de carrière et permet activement des possibilités de développement qui s'harmonisent avec elle.
• Enlever les barrages routiers et fixer des objectifs de rendement clairs et réalisables.
• S'assure que l'équipe développe les bonnes compétences et une dynamique interne saine pour relever les défis actuels et futurs.
• Équipe Santé et durabilité
• Maintenir un rythme de travail durable pour l'équipe, en conciliant les objectifs de prestation et le bien-être de l'équipe.
• Cultiver une saine dynamique d'équipe et la collaboration, en assurant la sécurité psychologique et la communication ouverte.
• Supprime les obstacles qui entravent l'écoulement ou le moral, agissant comme un point d'escalade pour l'équipe.
• S'assure que les membres de l'équipe sont dotés des compétences nécessaires et pertinentes et que les rôles sont clairement définis.
• Leadership de la prestation des produits et des services
• Responsable de la co-création de la feuille de route produit / service d'un point de vue technique, en partenariat avec le gestionnaire de produit qui est globalement responsable.
• Comptable

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity
The Head of Product E3 Citizen Development (Rapid Application Development & Intelligent Automation) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.
Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.
Description of the area
Engineering Excellence & Experience enables engineers at Roche to explore, plan, design, code, build, test and deploy software packages in a reliable, secure, automated and consistent manner across the different business areas, including facilitated access to automated, composable, infrastructure consumable through Infra as Code & API on premise and in the public cloud.
Democratization of software development capabilities and citizen development across Roche are a key enabler and strategic priority and the Citizen Developer Team will provide the necessary capabilities and solutions for Rapid Application Development platforms, Low / No Code platforms, and Workflow Automation tools - provisioned with administration, governance, lifecycle / release / platform roadmap management, and operations enabling delivery in line with Roche SLAs and regulations.

Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision
Accountable for setting the direction for a complex product and ensuring that it achieves business outcomes and financial objectives. Monitor business, market, and technology trends to inform product strategy and proactively propose new solutions. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Establish a clear and aspirational vision for the end-to-end user experience across all touchpoints and product lines. Proactively identify emerging trends and market shifts to inform the long-term product roadmaps and maintain a competitive advantage. Define and track KPIs and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Product Lifecycle & Portfolio Mgmt.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for a complex product or products in a portfolio and influence the long-term product strategies and roadmaps of related products. Identify new opportunities for innovation and growth. Identify and capitalize on emerging market trends and technologies to shape the future of the industry and to create new opportunities for the company.

• Stakeholder Collaboration
Move beyond team collaboration to orchestrating a broader ecosystem of internal teams, external software vendors (SaaS), and academic partners through integrated platform strategies and robust API management. Influence a wider range of stakeholders, including senior leadership and key external partners

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il capo del prodotto E3 Citizen Development (Rapid Application Development & Intelligent Automation) è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, scaling e eventuale ritiro di un prodotto complesso. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di guidare team di ingegneria e servizi che costruiscono prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfano le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con gli standard del settore. Descrizione della zona Engineering Excellence & Experience consente agli ingegneri di Roche di esplorare, pianificare, progettare, codificare, costruire, testare e distribuire pacchetti software in modo affidabile, sicuro, automatizzato e coerente in tutte le diverse aree di business, tra cui l'accesso facilitato a sistemi automatizzati, composable, infrastrutture di consumo tramite Infra come Code & API on premise e nel cloud pubblico. La democratizzazione delle capacità di sviluppo software e lo sviluppo dei cittadini attraverso Roche sono un fattore chiave e una priorità strategica e il Citizen Developer Team fornirà le capacità e le soluzioni necessarie per le piattaforme Rapid Application Development, piattaforme Low / No Code e strumenti Workflow Automation - forniti con amministrazione, governance, lifecycle / rilascio / piattaforma roadmap gestione, e le operazioni che consentono la consegna in linea con Roche SLAs e regolamenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Strategia e visione Contabile per impostare la direzione di un prodotto complesso e garantire che raggiunge i risultati aziendali e gli obiettivi finanziari. Monitorare le tendenze del business, del mercato e della tecnologia per informare la strategia del prodotto e proporre proattivamente nuove soluzioni. Integrare attivamente le capacità AI rilevanti nella roadmap del prodotto. Definire, tracciare e comunicare i KPI rilevanti per il prodotto per misurarne le prestazioni e il contributo agli obiettivi e alla strategia aziendali.
• Customer-Centricity Stabilire una visione chiara e aspirazione per l'esperienza utente end-to-end in tutti i punti di contatto e le linee di prodotto. Identificare attivamente le tendenze emergenti e i cambiamenti di mercato per informare le roadmap del prodotto a lungo termine e mantenere un vantaggio competitivo. Definire e monitorare i KPI e utilizzare questi dati per informare le iterazioni dei prodotti.
• ciclo di vita del prodotto & Portfolio Mgmt. Proprio il ciclo di vita del prodotto end-to-end per un prodotto complesso o prodotti in un portafoglio e influenza le strategie di prodotto a lungo termine e roadmap di prodotti correlati. Identificare nuove opportunità di innovazione e crescita. Identificare e capitalizzare le tendenze e le tecnologie del mercato emergenti per modellare il futuro del settore e creare nuove opportunità per l'azienda.
• Collaborazione di Stakeholder Andare oltre la collaborazione di team per orchestrare un ecosistema più ampio di team interni, fornitori di software esterni (SaaS), e partner accademici attraverso strategie di piattaforma integrate e gestione API robusta. Influenza una più ampia gamma di stakeholder, tra cui leadership senior e partner esterni chiave

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Der Head of Product E3 Citizen Development (Rapid Application Development & Intelligent Automation) ist für den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus verantwortlich, von der ersten Idee und strategischen Planung bis hin zur Einführung, Skalierung und eventuellen Pensionierung eines komplexen Produkts. Diese Rolle ist entscheidend für die Umwandlung wissenschaftlicher und geschäftlicher Anforderungen in greifbare, hochwertige Technologielösungen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap zu definieren und sicherzustellen, dass sie mit den übergreifenden Zielen unserer Organisation übereinstimmt und letztendlich die Bereitstellung lebensverändernder Diagnostika und Medikamente für Patienten beschleunigt. Diese Rolle erfordert eine unverwechselbare Kombination aus wissenschaftlicher Neugier, technischen Kenntnissen und Geschäftskenntnissen, um erfolgreich durch die Landschaft zu navigieren. Ihr primäres Ziel ist es, Engineering- und Serviceteams bei der Entwicklung wünschenswerter, machbarer, tragfähiger und nachhaltiger Produkte zu unterstützen, die den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen unserer internen Benutzer gerecht werden und gleichzeitig die strikte Einhaltung der relevanten Industriestandards gewährleisten. Beschreibung des Gebiets Engineering Excellence & Experience ermöglicht es den Ingenieuren von Roche, Softwarepakete zuverlässig, sicher, automatisiert und konsistent in den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen zu erkunden, zu planen, zu entwerfen, zu kodieren, zu erstellen, zu testen und bereitzustellen, einschließlich eines erleichterten Zugriffs auf automatisierte, zusammensetzbare und verbrauchbare Infrastruktur über Infra as Code & API vor Ort und in der Public Cloud. Die Demokratisierung der Softwareentwicklungsfunktionen und der Bürgerentwicklung bei Roche ist eine wichtige Voraussetzung und strategische Priorität, und das Citizen Developer Team wird die notwendigen Funktionen und Lösungen für Rapid Application Development-Plattformen, Low / No Code-Plattformen und Workflow-Automatisierungstools bereitstellen, die mit Verwaltung, Governance, Lifecycle / Release / Platform Roadmap-Management und Operationen ausgestattet sind, die die Bereitstellung gemäß Roche SLAs und Vorschriften ermöglichen. Aufgabenbereich
• Strategie & Vision Verantwortlich dafür, die Richtung für ein komplexes Produkt festzulegen und sicherzustellen, dass es Geschäftsergebnisse und finanzielle Ziele erreicht. Überwachen Sie Geschäfts-, Markt- und Technologietrends, um die Produktstrategie zu informieren und proaktiv neue Lösungen vorzuschlagen. Proaktive Integration relevanter KI-Fähigkeiten in die Produkt-Roadmap. Definieren, verfolgen und kommunizieren Sie relevante KPIs für das Produkt, um seine Leistung und seinen Beitrag zu Geschäftszielen und -strategien zu messen.
• Kundenzentrierung Erstellen Sie eine klare und ehrgeizige Vision für die End-to-End-Benutzererfahrung über alle Touchpoints und Produktlinien hinweg. Erkennen Sie proaktiv aufkommende Trends und Marktverschiebungen, um die langfristigen Produkt-Roadmaps zu informieren und einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu wahren. Definieren und verfolgen Sie KPIs und verwenden Sie diese Daten, um Produkt-Iterationen zu informieren.
• Product Lifecycle & Portfolio Mgmt. Besitzen Sie den End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklus für ein komplexes Produkt oder Produkte in einem Portfolio und beeinflussen Sie die langfristigen Produktstrategien und Roadmaps verwandter Produkte. Identifizieren Sie neue Möglichkeiten für Innovation und Wachstum. Identifizieren und nutzen Sie neue Markttrends und Technologien, um die Zukunft der Branche zu gestalten und neue Möglichkeiten für das Unternehmen zu schaffen.
• Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit Gehen Sie über die Zusammenarbeit im Team hinaus und orchestrieren Sie ein breiteres Ökosystem von internen Teams, externen Softwareanbietern (SaaS) und akademischen Partnern durch integrierte Plattformstrategien und robustes API-Management. Einfluss auf ein breiteres Spektrum von Stakeholdern, einschließlich Führungskräften und wichtigen externen Partnern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Le chef de produit E3 Citizen Development (Rapid Application Development & Intelligent Automation) est responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vie du produit, de l'idée initiale et de la planification stratégique jusqu'au lancement, à la mise à l'échelle et éventuellement à la retraite d'un produit complexe. Ce rôle est essentiel pour transformer les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions technologiques tangibles et de grande valeur. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, de la stratégie et de la feuille de route du produit, en s'assurant qu'elle s'harmonise avec les objectifs généraux de notre organisation et, en fin de compte, accélère la prestation de diagnostics et de médicaments qui changent la vie aux patients. Ce rôle exige une combinaison distinctive d'enquête scientifique, de compétence technique et de perspicacité commerciale pour naviguer avec succès dans le paysage. Votre objectif principal est de diriger les équipes d'ingénierie et de service en construisant des produits souhaitables, réalisables, viables et durables qui répondent aux besoins changeants de nos utilisateurs internes tout en maintenant le strict respect des normes pertinentes de l'industrie. Description de la zone L'excellence et l'expérience en génie permettent aux ingénieurs de Roche d'explorer, de planifier, de concevoir, de coder, de construire, de tester et de déployer des progiciels de manière fiable, sécurisée, automatisée et cohérente dans les différents domaines d'activité, y compris l'accès facilité à l'infrastructure automatisée, composable et consommable via Infra comme code et API sur place et dans le cloud public. La démocratisation des capacités de développement logiciel et le développement des citoyens à Roche constituent une priorité clé et stratégique et l'équipe Citizen Developer fournira les capacités et les solutions nécessaires pour les plateformes de développement d'applications rapides, les plates-formes Low / No Code, et les outils Workflow Automation - fournis avec l'administration, la gouvernance, le cycle de vie / version / plate-forme gestion de feuille de route, et les opérations permettant la livraison en conformité avec Roche SLAs et les règlements. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Stratégie et vision Il est responsable d'établir l'orientation d'un produit complexe et de s'assurer qu'il atteint les résultats opérationnels et les objectifs financiers. Surveiller les tendances des affaires, du marché et de la technologie pour éclairer la stratégie des produits et proposer de nouvelles solutions de manière proactive. Intégrer de manière proactive les capacités d'IA pertinentes dans la feuille de route des produits. Définir, suivre et communiquer les ICR pertinents pour le produit afin de mesurer son rendement et sa contribution aux objectifs et à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
• Client-Centricité Établir une vision claire et aspirationnelle de l'expérience utilisateur de bout en bout dans tous les points de contact et lignes de produits. Identifier de façon proactive les tendances émergentes et les changements de marché pour éclairer les feuilles de route à long terme des produits et maintenir un avantage concurrentiel. Définir et suivre les ICR et utiliser ces données pour éclairer les itérations de produits.
• Cycle de vie des produits et portefeuille Mgmt. Posséder le cycle de vie de bout en bout d'un ou de plusieurs produits complexes dans un portefeuille et influencer les stratégies et les feuilles de route à long terme des produits connexes. Identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'innovation et de croissance. Identifier et tirer parti des tendances et des technologies émergentes du marché pour façonner l'avenir de l'industrie et créer de nouvelles possibilités pour l'entreprise.
• Collaboration avec les parties prenantes Au-delà de la collaboration d'équipe, orchestrer un écosystème plus large d'équipes internes, de fournisseurs externes de logiciels (SaaS) et de partenaires universitaires grâce à des stratégies intégrées de plate-forme et à une gestion robuste des API. Influencer un plus large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris les dirigeants et les principaux partenaires externes

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 工作职责 目标与计划管理
• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性
• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划 客户管理与区域合作
• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动
• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

jobs.title: RWD Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Strategic planning
● Shape and influence strategy for complex evidence generation deliveries and cross-functional projects
● Lead and/or support evidence generation strategy/plan setting up as critical component of local integrated evidence plan for multiple portfolio and pipeline products across therapeutic areas
● Provide epidemiological inputs with solid understanding of strategic business context in the medical planning process across therapeutic areas
Implementation
● Lead the RWD project/studies design, analyses and interpretation.
● Map / license RWD sources and build research collaborations to increase the availability of fit - for - purpose RWD.
● Implement the RWE plan and execute RWE projects timely in close collaboration with cross - functional partners.
● Identify and implement scientifically innovative RWE programs that can support to address business needs and overcome key challenges in drug development using RWD or enable to provide meaningful RWE in support of regulatory decision making (e.g. label changes, new indications), payer decision making and clinical practice.
Communication
● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance
● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders
● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs.
Development
● Act as a coach, mentor or consult to provide technical expertise on the RWE/epidemiology basics and internal/external trainings.
● Serve as franchise / division level RWE lead to ensure a broad understanding of the value of RWE to the product value demonstration both locally and globally.
● Maintain process standards across the therapeutic areas according to Roche SOPs, China CDE requirements and GPP guidelines with regard to pharmacoepidemiology

Qualification and Experience
● Education/Qualifications
- Master degree or above in the epidemiology, biostatistics, public health or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in designing, implementation and report of epidemiology/observational studies
- Working experiences as real world data scientist/epidemiologist in multinational pharmaceutical company or Clinical Research Organization, experience in oncology studies will be plus
● Leadership Competencies
Ability to work effectively in a matrix team
● Job Required Competencies
- Expert knowledge of epidemiology/observational methodologies and applications
- Previous experience as a key RWD scientist or lead epidemiologist
- Good knowledge of statistical programming skill (including SAS programming)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, as required
- Demonstrated project management skills is strongly preferred
- Business acumen
- Be able to handle technical discussion in fluent English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to health

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English, Arabic is advantage

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory

• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives

• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential

• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management

• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products

• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.

• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission

• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups

• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites

• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts

• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers

• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management

• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments

• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction
