jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。
高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。

【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。

1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）

• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築

• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む）

2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート

• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務

• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務

• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務

• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務

3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動

• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供

• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます

【応募条件（必須要件）】

• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。

• 全国転勤可であること。

• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方
臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。
診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。
学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサイエンティスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）:大宮オフィス　〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16　シーノ大宮ノースウイング　10F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置　屋内全面禁煙
募集者名　ロシュ・ダイアグノ

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm by shaping Roche’s strategic direction and ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape. As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, which is composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, these teams work together to provide unbiased, expertly curated, and technology-enabled intelligence to drive lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies. The Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) team delivers high-quality competitive intelligence and actionable recommendations that shape Roche’s decision-making across leadership and end-to-end (E2E) molecule teams.
In this role as a Competitive Intelligence Leader based in Basel, you will lead and implement competitive intelligence strategies for both early- and late-stage pipeline assets, as well as prioritized on-market products by leveraging AI-driven technologies and deep analysis of scientific, clinical, and commercial information. You will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor in guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy, focusing your efforts on specific Disease Areas (DA) within a Therapeutic Area (TA) and broader industry trends. As a catalyst for strategic collaboration, you will engage with key functions including Research and Early Development (RED), Product Development (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partnering/Business Development, US Pharma, and Pharma International to drive strategic impact.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Thought Leadership & Competitive Intelligence: Act as a strategic thought partner, providing high-quality insights and recommendations to guide decision-making at the Disease Area (DA), Therapeutic Area (TA), and enterprise levels. Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources (including primary/secondary research, real-world evidence, and AI-driven analytics) to anticipate market evolution, competitor moves, and emerging trends that impact Roche’s strategy and competitiveness.

• Competitive Pipeline Development: Shape competitive strategies by informing competitive positioning, TPP creation, and launch plans (value proposition, differentiation, messaging), while leading the assessment of standard-of-care evolution by synthesizing insights at pre-clinical and clinical stages, including emerging trends and modalities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Partner with key internal stakeholders (GPS, R&D, Product Development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams) to ensure insights are embedded in strategic planning, while fostering collaboration across the lifecycle, functions, and geographies to maximize impact.

• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Lead and execute strategic initiatives with clear objectives, ensuring timely, high-quality, and impactful deliverables. Manage relationships with external agencies and internal partners, ensuring complete alignment with business priorities and objectives.

• Innovation & AI-Enabled Insights: Champion the adoption of advanced analytics, AI-driven intelligence

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo plasmando la direzione strategica di Roche e assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, e Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, questi team lavorano insieme per fornire un'intelligenza impareggiabile, sapientemente curata e tecnologica per guidare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza di commercializzazione e il portafoglio strategie. Il team Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) fornisce un'intelligenza competitiva di alta qualità e raccomandazioni attuabili che modellano il processo decisionale di Roche tra i team di leadership e di end-to-end (E2E). In questo ruolo di Competitive Intelligence Leader con sede a Basilea, guiderai e implementerai strategie di intelligenza competitive sia per i beni delle tubazioni di primo e ultimo stadio, sia per i prodotti privilegiati sul mercato sfruttando le tecnologie AI-driven e la profonda analisi delle informazioni scientifiche, cliniche e commerciali. Potrai servire come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia nella guida di Roche prodotto, area di malattia, farmacia e strategia aziendale, concentrando i tuoi sforzi su specifiche aree di malattia (DA) all'interno di uno spazio terapeutico (TA) e tendenze del settore più ampio. Come catalizzatore per la collaborazione strategica, si impegnano con funzioni chiave tra cui ricerca e sviluppo precoce (RED), sviluppo del prodotto (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partner/Business Development, US Pharma e Pharma International per guidare l'impatto strategico. L'opportunità
• Leadership strategica del pensiero e intelligenza competitiva: agire come partner di pensiero strategico, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni di alta qualità per guidare il processo decisionale presso l'Area Malattia (DA), Area terapeutica (TA), e livelli di impresa. Analizzare e sintetizzare i dati da più fonti (compresa la ricerca primaria/secondaria, le prove del mondo reale e l'analisi guidata dall'IA) per anticipare l'evoluzione del mercato, le mosse dei concorrenti e le tendenze emergenti che influiscono sulla strategia e sulla competitività di Roche.
• Sviluppo competitivo del Pipeline: Formare strategie competitive informando il posizionamento competitivo, la creazione di TPP e i piani di lancio (proposizione del valore, differenziazione, messaggistica), mentre leader la valutazione dell'evoluzione standard-of-care sintetizzando intuizioni a fasi precliniche e cliniche, comprese le tendenze e le modalità emergenti.
• Collaborazione & Influenza trasversale: Partner con i principali stakeholder interni (GPS, R&D, Sviluppo del Prodotto, Affari Medici, Sviluppo Business e team commerciali) per garantire che gli insight siano incorporati nella pianificazione strategica, promuovendo la collaborazione tra il ciclo di vita, le funzioni e le geografie per massimizzare l'impatto.
• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Guidare ed eseguire iniziative strategiche con obiettivi chiari, garantendo consegne tempestive, di alta qualità e di impatto. Gestisci i rapporti con le agenzie esterne e con i partner interni, garantendo un allineamento completo con le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Innovazione & AI-Enabled Insights: Campione dell'adozione di analisi avanzate, intelligenza basata sull'intelligenza

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Unser Global Pharma Strategy (GPS)-Team ist der Herzschlag von Pharma, indem es den Rhythmus festlegt, indem es die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche prägt und sicherstellt, dass unser Portfolio Patienten weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen liefert. Durch die Integration wissenschaftlicher, kommerzieller und marktbezogener Erkenntnisse treibt GPS die unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Innovation von Geschäftsmodellen voran, um Roches Führungsposition in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft zu stärken. Als Teil des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights-Teams (PSI) innerhalb von GPS, das aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy besteht, arbeiten diese Teams zusammen, um unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte und technologiegestützte Intelligenz bereitzustellen, um Lifecycle-Management, Kommerzialisierungsexzellenz und Portfoliostrategien voranzutreiben. Das Team von Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) liefert qualitativ hochwertige Wettbewerbsinformationen und umsetzbare Empfehlungen, die die Entscheidungsfindung von Roche in Führungs- und End-to-End-Molekülteams (E2E) prägen. In dieser Rolle als Competitive Intelligence Leader mit Sitz in Basel leiten und implementieren Sie wettbewerbsfähige Intelligenzstrategien für Pipeline-Assets in der Früh- und Spätphase sowie priorisierte On-Market-Produkte, indem Sie KI-gesteuerte Technologien und eine umfassende Analyse wissenschaftlicher, klinischer und kommerzieller Informationen nutzen. Sie werden als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater bei der Steuerung von Roches Produkt-, Krankheits-, Pharma- und Unternehmensstrategie dienen und Ihre Bemühungen auf bestimmte Krankheitsbereiche (DA) innerhalb eines therapeutischen Bereichs (TA) und breitere Branchentrends konzentrieren. Als Katalysator für die strategische Zusammenarbeit werden Sie sich mit Schlüsselfunktionen wie Research and Early Development (RED), Product Development (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partnering / Business Development, US Pharma und Pharma International beschäftigen, um strategische Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Die Chance Strategische Thought Leadership & Competitive Intelligence: Handeln Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und bieten Sie qualitativ hochwertige Einblicke und Empfehlungen, um die Entscheidungsfindung im Disease Area (DA), Therapeutic Area (TA) und auf Unternehmensebene zu leiten. Analysieren und synthetisieren Sie Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen (einschließlich Primär-/Sekundärforschung, Evidenz aus der realen Welt und KI-gestützte Analysen), um Marktentwicklung, Wettbewerberbewegungen und neue Trends zu antizipieren, die sich auf die Strategie und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Roche auswirken.
• Wettbewerbsorientierte Pipeline-Entwicklung: Formulieren Sie Wettbewerbsstrategien, indem Sie die Wettbewerbspositionierung, die TPP-Erstellung und die Startpläne (Value Proposition, Differenzierung, Messaging) informieren und gleichzeitig die Bewertung der Standard-of-Care-Evolution leiten, indem Sie Erkenntnisse in präklinischen und klinischen Phasen synthetisieren, einschließlich neuer Trends und Modalitäten.
• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit und Einfluss: Partnerschaft mit wichtigen internen Stakeholdern (GPS, R&D, Produktentwicklung, Medical Affairs, Business Development und kaufmännische Teams), um sicherzustellen, dass die Erkenntnisse in die strategische Planung eingebettet sind, während die Zusammenarbeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, Funktionen und Regionen hinweg gefördert wird, um die Wirkung zu maximieren.
• Projekt-, Stakeholder- und Vendor-Management: Führen und führen Sie strategische Initiativen mit klaren Zielen durch, um zeitnahe, qualitativ hochwertige und wirkungsvolle Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten. Verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu externen Agenturen und internen Partnern und gewährleisten Sie eine vollständige Abstimmung mit den Geschäftsprioritäten und -zielen. Innovation & AI-Enabled Insights: Verfechten Sie die Einführung von Advanced Analytics und KI-gesteuerter Intelligenz
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, en fixant le rythme en façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roches et en veillant à ce que notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe du portefeuille, de la stratégie et des perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, qui est composée d'Avancé Analytics for Business Insights, de Competitive Intelligence, d'Ecosystem Insights, de Partenaires responsables de l'évaluation commerciale et de Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, ces équipes travaillent ensemble à fournir des renseignements impartiaux, spécialisés et axés sur la technologie afin de stimuler la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) fournit une intelligence concurrentielle de haute qualité et des recommandations pratiques qui façonnent la prise de décision de Roche dans les équipes de direction et de molécule de bout en bout (E2E). Dans le cadre de ce rôle de chef de file en matière de renseignements concurrentiels basé à Bâle, vous dirigerez et mettre en oeuvreez des stratégies de renseignement concurrentiel pour les actifs des pipelines en début et en fin de phase, ainsi que des produits prioritaires sur le marché en tirant parti des technologies axées sur l'IA et en analysant en profondeur l'information scientifique, clinique et commerciale. Vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance pour guider les produits, les maladies, les produits pharmaceutiques et la stratégie d'entreprise de Roches, en concentrant vos efforts sur des zones de maladies particulières dans un domaine thérapeutique (TA) et des tendances plus générales de l'industrie. En tant que catalyseur de la collaboration stratégique, vous participerez à des fonctions clés telles que la recherche et le développement précoce (RED), le développement de produits (PD), la PDMA, le GPS, le partenariat/développement d'entreprises, la pharmacie américaine et Pharma International pour stimuler l'impact stratégique. L'opportunité
• Leadership de la pensée stratégique et intelligence concurrentielle : agir en tant que partenaire de la pensée stratégique, fournir des idées et des recommandations de haute qualité pour guider la prise de décisions dans la région de la maladie (DA), la région thérapeutique (TA) et l'entreprise. Analyser et synthétiser les données provenant de sources multiples (y compris la recherche primaire/secondaire, les données factuelles et l'analyse de l'IA) pour anticiper l'évolution du marché, les mouvements des concurrents et les tendances émergentes qui influent sur la stratégie et la compétitivité de Roche.
• Développement concurrentiel des pipelines : façonner les stratégies concurrentielles en informant le positionnement concurrentiel, la création de PPT et les plans de lancement (proposition de valeur, différenciation, messagerie), tout en dirigeant l'évaluation de l'évolution des normes de soins en synthétisant les idées aux stades préclinique et clinique, y compris les nouvelles tendances et modalités.
• Collaboration et influence interfonctionnelles : partenariat avec les principaux intervenants internes (GPS, R-D, Développement des produits, Affaires médicales, Développement des affaires et des équipes commerciales) pour s'assurer que les idées sont intégrées dans la planification stratégique, tout en favorisant la collaboration tout au long du cycle de vie, des fonctions et des géographies afin de maximiser l'impact.
• Gestion des projets, des parties prenantes et des fournisseurs : Diriger et exécuter des initiatives stratégiques avec des objectifs clairs, en veillant à ce que les produits livrables soient fournis en temps opportun, de qualité et d'impact. Gérer les relations avec les organismes externes et les partenaires internes, en assurant l'harmonisation complète avec les priorités et les objectifs opérationnels.
• Innovation & Intelligences activées par l'IA : Championne de l'adoption d'analyses avancées, d'intelligences induites par l'IA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: System Architect / System Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Within the Near Patient Care R&D Development Network, our team of system architects supports the development of diagnostic and medical devices. We ensure that the system of hardware, software, and sensors works together seamlessly to form a robust solution. We are looking for a technically focused team player who can think holistically, understand complex systems, and act proactively to bring experts together to develop state-of-the-art diagnostic and disease management solutions.

Your Opportunity

• You will hold technical responsibility in key systems engineering disciplines for the development of systems or complex system components.

• You will be accountable for systems engineering deliverables, such as requirements, architecture, risks, concepts,, and configuration management.

• You will contribute to product development projects, including system integration.

• You will create development documentation and design artifacts according to good design practices and regulatory-relevant requirements.

• You will drive the alignment between instrument and assay development and their integration.

• You will work closely with other functions such as HW and SW Engineering, Operations, or Customer Support in cross-functional activities.

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, natural sciences, or an equivalent qualification.

• You have experience in medical device development (a focus on hardware is a plus) and have ideally worked in a regulated environment (e.g., IVDR).

• With your clear, structured, and proactive working style, you promote collaboration in interdisciplinary teams.

• You think analytically and are capable of seeing the big picture as well as the details.

• You have practical experience in system integration, working with various technology domains.

• You navigate confidently within complex systems and distributed organizations, proactively identifying system-level issues and driving them to resolution.

• You are fluent in English, with additional knowledge of German considered a plus.

What We Offer

• A meaningful role at the intersection of hardware and software development in a highly relevant field of medical technology.

• The opportunity to work on innovative and complex systems within an interdisciplinary team of experts.

• A collaborative environment that encourages proactive engagement and continuous learning.

• Individual development opportunities and the chance to apply your expertise in a global setting.

Your Application

Please upload your current CV, a motivation letter and the certificate of your highest qualification.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno del Near Patient Care R&D Development Network, il nostro team di architetti di sistema supporta lo sviluppo di dispositivi diagnostici e medici. Garantiamo che il sistema di hardware, software e sensori funzionino senza soluzione di continuità per formare una soluzione robusta. Stiamo cercando un giocatore di squadra tecnicamente focalizzato che può pensare olistico, comprendere sistemi complessi, e agire proattivamente per riunire gli esperti per sviluppare soluzioni diagnostiche e di gestione delle malattie all'avanguardia. La tua opportunità
• Avrete la responsabilità tecnica nelle discipline di ingegneria dei sistemi chiave per lo sviluppo di sistemi o componenti di sistema complessi.
• Sarete responsabili per i materiali di ingegneria dei sistemi, come requisiti, architettura, rischi, concetti e gestione della configurazione.
• Contribuirai a progetti di sviluppo del prodotto, inclusa l'integrazione del sistema.
• Si creerà documentazione di sviluppo e artefatti di progettazione secondo buone pratiche di progettazione e requisiti di regolazione-rilevanti.
• Potrai guidare l'allineamento tra lo sviluppo dello strumento e del saggio e la loro integrazione.
• Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altre funzioni come HW e SW Engineering, Operations o Customer Support in attività multifunzionali. Chi sei
• Hai una laurea o master (BSc/MSc) in Meccatronica, Ingegneria Meccanica/Elettrica, Fisica, Ingegneria Biomedica, Biotecnologia, Scienze naturali, o una qualifica equivalente.
• Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di dispositivi medici (un focus sull'hardware è un plus) e hai lavorato idealmente in un ambiente regolamentato (ad esempio, IVDR).
• Con il vostro stile di lavoro chiaro, strutturato e proattivo, promuovete la collaborazione in team interdisciplinari.
• Pensi analiticamente e sono in grado di vedere il grande quadro così come i dettagli.
• Hai esperienza pratica nell'integrazione del sistema, lavorando con vari domini tecnologici.
• Si naviga con fiducia all'interno di sistemi complessi e organizzazioni distribuite, identificare proattivamente i problemi di livello di sistema e guidarli alla risoluzione.
• Sei fluente in inglese, con conoscenza aggiuntiva del tedesco considerato un plus. Cosa offriamo
• Un ruolo significativo nell'intersezione dello sviluppo hardware e software in un campo altamente rilevante della tecnologia medica.
• L'opportunità di lavorare su sistemi innovativi e complessi all'interno di un team interdisciplinare di esperti.
• Un ambiente collaborativo che incoraggia l'impegno proattivo e l'apprendimento continuo.
• Opportunità di sviluppo individuali e la possibilità di applicare le tue competenze in un ambiente globale. La tua domanda Si prega di caricare il CV corrente, una lettera di motivazione e il certificato della vostra più alta qualifica. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss (BSc / MSc) in Mechatronik, Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik, Physik, Biomedizintechnik, Biotechnologie, Naturwissenschaften oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten (ein Fokus auf Hardware ist ein Plus) und haben idealerweise in einer regulierten Umgebung (z. B. IVDR) gearbeitet.

• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung in der Systemintegration und arbeiten mit verschiedenen Technologiedomänen.
• Sie navigieren sicher in komplexen Systemen und verteilten Organisationen, identifizieren proaktiv Probleme auf Systemebene und bringen sie zur Lösung.

• Eine bedeutende Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Hard- und Softwareentwicklung in einem hochrelevanten Bereich der Medizintechnik.
• Die Möglichkeit, in einem interdisziplinären Expertenteam an innovativen und komplexen Systemen zu arbeiten.
• Eine kollaborative Umgebung, die proaktives Engagement und kontinuierliches Lernen fördert.
• Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und die Möglichkeit, Ihre Expertise in einem globalen Umfeld einzusetzen. Nous veillons à ce que le système de matériel, de logiciels et de capteurs fonctionne de façon transparente pour former une solution robuste. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un joueur d'équipe techniquement concentré qui peut penser de façon holistique, comprendre des systèmes complexes et agir de manière proactive pour réunir des experts pour développer des solutions de diagnostic et de gestion des maladies de pointe. Votre opportunité
• Vous assumerez la responsabilité technique dans les disciplines clés de l'ingénierie de systèmes pour le développement de systèmes ou de composants de systèmes complexes.
• Vous serez responsable des produits livrables de l'ingénierie des systèmes, tels que les exigences, l'architecture, les risques, les concepts et la gestion de la configuration.
• Vous contribuerez à des projets de développement de produits, y compris l'intégration de systèmes.
• Vous créerez des documents de développement et des artefacts de conception selon les bonnes pratiques de conception et les exigences pertinentes de la réglementation.
• Vous dirigerez l'alignement entre l'instrument et le développement de l'essai et leur intégration.

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans le développement d'appareils médicaux (un accent sur le matériel est un plus) et avez idéalement travaillé dans un environnement réglementé (p. ex., IVDR).
• Avec votre style de travail clair, structuré et proactif, vous favorisez la collaboration dans des équipes interdisciplinaires.
• Vous pensez analytiquement et êtes capable de voir le grand tableau ainsi que les détails.
• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans l'intégration des systèmes, en travaillant avec différents domaines technologiques.
• Vous naviguez en toute confiance au sein de systèmes complexes et d'organisations distribuées, identifiant de façon proactive les problèmes au niveau du système et les conduisant à la résolution.
• Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais, avec une connaissance supplémentaire de l'allemand considéré comme un plus. Ce que nous offrons
• Un rôle significatif à l'intersection du développement matériel et logiciel dans un domaine très pertinent de la technologie médicale.
• L'occasion de travailler sur des systèmes innovants et complexes au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire d'experts.
• Un environnement de collaboration qui encourage l'engagement proactif et l'apprentissage continu.
• Possibilités de développement individuel et possibilité d'appliquer votre expertise dans un contexte mondial. Votre demande Veuillez télécharger votre CV actuel, une lettre de motivation et le certificat de votre qualification la plus élevée. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature! Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) organization works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Digital / Technology strategy. Our goal is to drive the delivery and scale of key data and digital solutions in support of Roche’s vision.

The Role
As a Data Analyst , you will be the critical link between complex business challenges, data consumers, and technical data solutions. In this role, you will not only profile and analyze data but will also act as the operational engine for our data product suite. You will own the visual management of data product performance, and manage the end-to-end maintenance and support lifecycle. By ensuring data products are highly visible, measurable, and reliably supported, you enable diverse consumers—including Data Scientists, BI Experts, Senior Leaders, and automated applications—to unlock maximum value from our data assets.
Working within a multidisciplinary team alongside Data Domain Leads, Data Product Owners, SMEs, and Data Engineers, you will ensure our data products remain high-performing, well-maintained, and aligned with global governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Profiling & Requirements Translation: Utilize SQL and Python to extract, profile, and analyze source data to support feature development and data cleansing initiatives. Translate complex business rules into technical analytical specifications for the engineering team.

• Integrity, Compliance & Quality: Ensure all data products meet rigorous data integrity, security, and validation standards. Collaborate with the Validation Lead and Tester to define acceptance criteria and design test layouts.

• Data Exploration & Discovery: Conduct deep-dive data exploration and review prospective data sources during data product development in close collaboration with the Data Domain Lead (DDL) to assess viability, identify data quality constraints, and uncover hidden value.

• Collaborative Data Modeling: Contribute actively to conceptual and logical data modeling efforts, partnering closely with the Data Product Owner (DPO) and the architectural team to design schemas that support diverse downstream user needs.

• Standardization, Contracts & Lifecycle Documentation: Contribute to data standardization initiatives to ensure portfolio scalability. Define, implement, and maintain formal data contracts alongside up-to-date data dictionaries and metadata layers so consumers understand exactly what data is available, its expected schema, and how to safely use it.

• Performance & Visual Management: Design, build, and maintain data product monitoring dashboards (e.g., using Tableau or PowerBI). Track and visually report on Data Quality KPIs, product adoption metrics, system latency, and user satisfaction to provide transparency to senior leadership and consumers.

• Maintenance & Support Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for data product operational support. Lead incident management efforts, conduct root-cause analysis for anomalies or pipeline failures, evaluate business impact, and coordinate with Data Engineers to deploy hotfixes and changes.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Biotechnology, or a related field.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'organizzazione PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) opera in partnership tra le principali funzioni aziendali globali, creando e implementando una strategia globale di Digital / Technology. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di guidare la consegna e la scala dei dati chiave e delle soluzioni digitali a supporto della visione di Roche. Il ruolo In qualità di Data Analyst, sarai il collegamento critico tra complesse sfide aziendali, consumatori di dati e soluzioni tecniche di dati. In questo ruolo, non solo profilare e analizzare i dati, ma fungerà anche da motore operativo per la nostra suite di dati. Avrete la gestione visiva delle prestazioni del prodotto di dati, e gestire la manutenzione end-to-end e il ciclo di vita di supporto. Assicurando che i prodotti dati siano altamente visibili, misurabili e supportati in modo affidabile, è possibile attivare diversi consumatori, tra cui Data Scientists, BI Experts, Senior Leaders e applicazioni automatizzate, per sbloccare il massimo valore dai nostri asset di dati. Lavorando all'interno di un team multidisciplinare insieme a Data Domain Leads, Data Product Owners, PMI e Data Engineers, vi assicurerete che i nostri prodotti di dati rimangano altamente performanti, ben mantenuti e allineati con gli standard di governance globali. Principali responsabilità
• Traduzione: Utilizzare SQL e Python per estrarre, profilare e analizzare i dati sorgente per supportare le iniziative di sviluppo delle funzionalità e pulizia dei dati. Traduci regole aziendali complesse in specifiche tecniche analitiche per il team di ingegneria.
• Integrità, conformità e qualità: assicurarsi che tutti i prodotti di dati soddisfino rigorosi standard di integrità, sicurezza e validazione dei dati. Collabora con il cavo di convalida e il tester per definire i criteri di accettazione e i layout dei test di progettazione.
• Esplorazione dei dati & Discovery: Condurre l'esplorazione dei dati in profondità e rivedere le potenziali fonti di dati durante lo sviluppo dei prodotti di dati in stretta collaborazione con Data Domain Lead (DDL) per valutare la fattibilità, identificare i vincoli di qualità dei dati e scoprire il valore nascosto.
• Collaborative Data Modeling: Contribuisci attivamente agli sforzi di modellazione dati concettuale e logica, collaborando a stretto contatto con il Data Product Owner (DPO) e il team architettonico per progettare schemi che supportano diverse esigenze degli utenti a valle.
• Standardizzazione, Contratti & Lifecycle Documentazione: Contribuisci alle iniziative di standardizzazione dei dati per garantire la scalabilità del portafoglio. Definire, implementare e mantenere contratti di dati formali insieme ai dizionari di dati aggiornati e ai livelli di metadati in modo che i consumatori capiscono esattamente quali dati è disponibile, il suo schema previsto e come utilizzarlo in modo sicuro.
• Performance & Visual Management: Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di dashboard di monitoraggio dei prodotti dati (ad esempio, utilizzando Tableau o PowerBI). Traccia e segnala visivamente i KPI di qualità dei dati, le metriche di adozione dei prodotti, la latenza del sistema e la soddisfazione degli utenti per fornire trasparenza alla leadership senior e ai consumatori.
• Manutenzione e gestione del supporto: servire come punto di contatto primario per il supporto operativo del prodotto di dati. Guidare gli sforzi di gestione degli incidenti, condurre analisi causa radice per anomalie o guasti delle tubazioni, valutare l'impatto aziendale e coordinare con gli ingegneri dati per distribuire hotfix e modifiche. Vous serez propriétaire de la gestion visuelle de la performance du produit de données, et gérer la maintenance de bout en bout et soutenir le cycle de vie. jobs.title: Junior Application/Technical Specialist (m/f/d) - Dutch speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Department
In our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC), we support customers from diagnostic laboratories and hospitals in several European countries with technical, application, and IT-related questions regarding Roche in-vitro diagnostic systems. In this role, your focus is at the interface of molecular diagnostics, laboratory processes, and IT systems. You will provide support particularly on topics such as LIS connection, connectivity, middleware, and digital laboratory workflows.

For our international RCSC, we are looking for a Junior Application/Technical Specialist (m/f/d) based in Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) or Vilvoorde (BE).

Your key responsibilities

• Handling application-related, technical, and system-related customer inquiries

• supporting the analysis of issues involving diagnostic systems, laboratory IT and customer workflows

• contributing to solutions for connectivity and interface topics, for example in the areas of LIS, middleware and remote connectivity

• carefully documenting cases and solutions in the CRM system

• delivering customer and employee trainings

• preparing and sharing product- and system-related information

• occasionally supporting field service colleagues during on-site visits to customer laboratories

Who you are

• You speak and write fluently in both Dutch and English. German, Turkish or Greek would be an advantage but not a must.

• You hold a university degree, ideally in molecular biology, biochemistry, medical informatics, medical technology, or medical engineering, or a comparable field of study. Alternatively, you have a scientific or medical-technical background and are looking to grow in an application-focused and IT-related environment.

• You bring initial knowledge or a strong interest in molecular biology.

• You enjoy technical topics and have a strong affinity for IT.

• Ideally, you have had first exposure to LIS, laboratory IT, middleware, connectivity or system integration.

• You enjoy working with complex systems and approach challenges in a structured and solution-oriented way.

• You are customer-focused, communicative and a strong team player.

• You live close to Mannheim, Almere, or Vilvoorde and are willing to travel regularly

• to Mannheim.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage.

Please note that once your application is submitted, you will not be able to add further documents.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.
Oportunidad:

Business & Squads Support Analyst
Como Business & Squads Support Analyst, jugarás un rol fundamental en la articulación y éxito de nuestras estrategias médicas y comerciales. T endrás la oportunidad de trabajar de manera ágil y transversal, brindando soporte directo al Squad Lead y a los Enablers Médicos y de Marketing. Serás el motor logístico, administrativo y organizativo que garantizará la correcta ejecución de nuestros eventos, lanzamientos y presupuestos, asegurando siempre el cumplimiento de nuestras normativas de compliance.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de Eventos y Congresos: Coordinar la participación en Congresos Médicos Nacionales e Internacionales, RIMEs, realización de Simposios, reuniones de Advisory Board, workshops, eventos propios locales y regionales.

• Logística Integral: Coordinar, dentro de las normas regulatorias y de compliance vigentes, la logística relacionada con los participantes y el evento (stands, materiales promocionales y no promocionales, contacto con disertantes, Profesionales Médicos, traslados, alojamiento, contratos y pago de honorarios).

• Lanzamientos: Organizar lanzamientos de productos, gestionando toda la logística de participantes y del evento.

• Gestión Presupuestaria: Dar soporte en la planificación de la alocación de inversiones. Realizar el seguimiento de presupuestos médicos y promocionales junto con el Partner de Finanzas, actualizando mensualmente al Squad Lead y Enablers, y monitoreando desvíos en el acumulado trimestral/anual.

• Control Administrativo y SAP: Realizar el control y análisis de gastos en SAP (o herramienta vigente). Enviar provisiones mensuales a Finanzas y controlar el WBS (seguimiento de gastos imputados a cada producto). Cargar requerimientos, controlar su cumplimiento, ingresar facturas/recibos y realizar el seguimiento del circuito de pago para evitar demoras.

• Materiales y Omnicanalidad: Planificar materiales promocionales/no promocionales y su distribución omnichannel a los PPoC’s.

• Soporte de Marca: Apoyar en la adaptación del branding internacional a los requisitos nacionales, slogans y frases promocionales acorde a las regulaciones locales.

• Entrenamientos: Organizar y coordinar el entrenamiento de PJPs junto con el Squad y el PJP Lead.

• Gestión de Grants & Donations (G&D): Recibir solicitudes de becas y donaciones, seguir su aprobación, evaluar presupuestos, confeccionar cartas de aceptación, cargar en el sistema GSD y controlar la ejecución del pedido.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• This role is heavily focused on strategic products marketing and identifying qualified opportunities for Roche Pathology Lab product lines.

• The primary resource for technical information regarding products and applications in the areas of expertise.

• Work closely with sales, technical product specialists and marketing staff throughout the region to identify market opportunities, drive sales, and maintain relationships in key accounts

The Opportunity:

• Understand internal and external market situation and deliver short term and long term product strategy and annual bonus policy etc.

• Frequently work closely with global marketing and product management to develop relevant materials used in China market like promotion material, training material, FAQs for internal and external use.

• Timely deliver product sales forecast and work closely with sales team to drive successful implementation of opportunity

• Develop and maintain relationships with key accounts as well as market influencers.

• Develop new product launch plan and lead the product registration, market access, product position, price and strategy through cooperation with relative departments.

• Create market promotion plan and work closely with sales, regional market team etc. to hold market promotion events to deliver medical value efficiently and drive market potential

• Timely provide product training to sales team, distributor partner etc.

Who you are:

• A Bachelor degree or above in the medical area. Completion of an advanced degree in business (MBA) or related science is strongly desired.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Good command of MS office software application

• Product & marketing expertise

• Good track record for working in a MNC company for eight or more years, with related supervisory work experience in sales, application support, customer service or training

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con le vendite, gli specialisti del prodotto tecnico e il personale di marketing in tutta la regione per identificare le opportunità di mercato, guidare le vendite e mantenere le relazioni in contabilità chiave L'opportunità:
• Comprendere la situazione del mercato interno ed esterno e fornire la strategia a breve termine e a lungo termine del prodotto e la politica di bonus annuale ecc.
• Spesso lavorare a stretto contatto con il marketing globale e la gestione dei prodotti per sviluppare materiali rilevanti utilizzati nel mercato cinese come materiale di promozione, materiale di formazione, FAQ per uso interno ed esterno.
• Consegna puntuale delle previsioni di vendita del prodotto e lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di vendita per guidare l'implementazione di successo delle opportunità
• Sviluppare e mantenere le relazioni con i conti chiave e gli influencer di mercato.

• Fornire puntuale formazione del prodotto al team di vendita, partner di distributore ecc. Chi sei:
• Una laurea o superiore nella zona medica. Il completamento di un grado avanzato nel business (MBA) o la scienza relativa è fortemente desiderato.
• Proficienza in inglese parlato e scritto
• Buon comando dell'applicazione software per ufficio MS
• Competenze di prodotto e marketing
• Buon record per lavorare in un'azienda MNC per otto o più anni, con relativa esperienza di lavoro di supervisione in vendite, supporto applicazioni, servizio clienti o formazione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.title: Strategic Workforce Planning Partner

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire stratégique de planification des effectifs

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you ready to architect the future of work at one of the world's leading healthcare innovators? Roche’s Workforce Optimization (WFO) Area of Practice is a high-impact global team dedicated to revolutionizing how we ensure the future readiness of our most valuable asset: our people. By bringing together strategic People & Culture (P&C) insights with cutting-edge data science, we create a future-ready workforce combining internal talent and external expertise. Here, your work in Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) isn't just about numbers—it's about ensuring we have the vision and the workforce that is doing now what patients need next .

As an SWP/WFO Partner , you are a catalyst for a future-ready workforce. You will collaborate directly with business leaders and cross-functional partners to translate ambitious goals into actionable workforce strategies. This isn't a back-office role; you will be at the forefront, supporting SWP projects and while supporting the enablement and scaling of our frameworks to shape the Roche of tomorrow. If you are passionate about data-driven innovation and eager to lead the charge in navigating a rapidly evolving business landscape, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

The Opportunity

• You collaborate with the business, P&C, and cross-functional experts to translate priorities into workforce needs by leading or supporting work product teams:
• Advise the business and project teams on SWP products as a strategic partner.

• Partner on the end-to-end process from diagnosis to defining recommendations.

• Enable data-driven decisions & strategy development leveraging expertise on topics including future skills/capabilities identification, workforce AI/tech impact analysis, location strategies, and external workforce optimization

• You contribute to the overall AoP vision and strategy, e.g. via AoP specific strategic initiatives, evolving WFO’s product portfolio and support to the WFO delivery

• You co-create the strategic vision and roadmap for SWP product enablement/training & scaling within Roche, ensuring alignment across the product portfolio to optimize value. This role comprises upwards of 30% capacity dedicated to these activities.

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in business administration, human resources, or a related field, with 7+ years relevant experience in global, matrixed People & Culture organizations, business embedded roles and/or consulting firms.

• A systems thinker with robust stakeholder management and influencing capabilities, you bring a track record in people strategy development/workforce planning, SWP, or total/external workforce strategies, combined with a commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience through business partnerships.

• You are experienced with/have a passion for project and change management, learning and development topics

• You have business acumen across different business and geographic environments (ideally in Pharma/Diagnostics/Healthcare-related industries)

• You possess strong consulting skills (diagnosing, analytical skills, critical thinking), strong problem solving skills, digital & data acumen

• You are fluent in English (written & verbal)

• You are adaptable, motivated, and collaborative with a growth mindset for navigating complex challenges and changing priorities.

Are you ready to architect the future of work at one of the world's leading healthcare innovators? Apply now!

• Contribuisci alla visione e alla strategia globale di AoP, ad esempio attraverso iniziative strategiche specifiche di AoP, evolvendo il portafoglio prodotti WFO e il supporto alla consegna WFO
• Co-crea la visione strategica e la roadmap per l'attivazione/formazione dei prodotti SWP all'interno di Roche, garantendo l'allineamento attraverso il portafoglio prodotti per ottimizzare il valore. Questo ruolo comprende fino al 30% di capacità dedicata a queste attività. Chi sei

• Hai acume di affari in diversi ambienti commerciali e geografici (idealmente nelle industrie di Pharma/Diagnostics/Healthcare)
• Possiedi forti competenze di consulenza (diagnosi, abilità analitiche, pensiero critico), forti capacità di problem solving, digital & data acumen

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
End-to-End Business Team Coach, Growth & Performance (G&P)
Portfolio Strategy and Delivery (PSD)

The Position
At Roche, we have a bold Pharma Strategy to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden. With this top of mind, Portfolio Strategy and Delivery’s (PSD) purpose is to translate Roche strategies into PD priorities and deliver PD’s portfolio with excellence.

As an End-to-End Business Team Coach, you will act as a strategic partner to high-priority teams (including LCTs, GDTs, GFTs, etc.) across the R&D value chain. You will be responsible for building and executing a systemic coaching strategy that enables the delivery of PD’s core business and critical priority projects. You will contribute to the overall success of PD Growth & Performance (G&P) by improving team effectiveness, equipping teams to navigate complexity and accelerate decision-making, problem-solving, and delivery.

The Opportunity

• Systemic Team Coaching: Deliver end-to-end coaching interventions for high-priority assets (with TA-Focus), LCTs, GDTs, GFTs, STs and other prioritized teams at critical junctures (start-ups, milestones, transitions, etc.). You will look beyond individual personalities to the broader system, aligning stakeholders and ensuring cross-functional accountability.

• Strategic Business Impact: You will focus on directionally improving key business value drivers by coaching teams toward excellence in problem-solving and execution. You will move beyond traditional dynamics to ensure that team efforts are measured by their success in delivery and their alignment with PD’s core priorities.

• Foster Systemic Team Health & Alignment: In partnership with Resourcing Leads (RLs) and Global Program Managers (GPMs), you will accelerate team effectiveness through clarity and alignment. Being aware of the particularities of each TA, you will be accountable for ensuring that the health of the team system acts as a high-performance engine for the drug development lifecycle.

• Operationalize the TA-Model: Deepen your business understanding of specific Therapeutic Areas (TAs) to provide targeted value and impact, ensuring coaching triggers are aligned with the new LSPC prioritization framework.

• Data & Performance Culture: Maintain a systems-thinking perspective and use data/metrics to identify cross-organization insights. You will be accountable for demonstrating the measurable impact of coaching interventions.

• Innovation & AI Integration: Stay ahead of industry trends to enhance team performance and proactively explore and visualize the use of AI, automation, and digital technologies to enhance team performance and coaching efficiency.

• Standards of Practice and Value Measurement: Contribute to and adopt Standards of Practice and Value Measurement & Reporting, ensuring consistent quality and a clear link between coaching interventions and business impact across the global organization.

Who you are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s/MBA preferred. Formal accreditation in Team Coaching (ICF, EMCC, or equivalent) is essential.

• Experience: 10+ years of experience in Pharma/Biotech or high-complexity industries. Proven track record of systemic team coaching for global, matrixed teams through large-scale change and drug development lifecycles. Experience must go beyond individual (1:1) coaching to include end-to-end work with cross-functional teams.

• Systemic Mindset: Deep understanding of systemic framework

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione End-to-End Business Team Coach, Crescita & Performance (G&P) Strategia e Consegna del portafoglio (PSD) La posizione A Roche, abbiamo una coraggiosa strategia Pharma per fornire 20 farmaci trasformativi che affrontano le malattie con il più alto peso sociale. Con questo top di mente, Portfolio Strategy and Delivery’s (PSD) lo scopo è quello di tradurre le strategie Roche in priorità PD e consegnare il portafoglio di PD con eccellenza. Come End-to-End Business Team Coach, si agirà come partner strategico per le squadre ad alta priorità (tra cui LCT, GDT, GFT, ecc) attraverso la catena del valore R&D. Sarete responsabili per la costruzione e l'esecuzione di una strategia di coaching sistemico che consente la consegna del core business di PD e progetti prioritari critici. Contribuirai al successo complessivo di PD Growth & Performance (G&P) migliorando l'efficacia del team, dotando i team per navigare nella complessità e accelerare il processo decisionale, problem solving e consegna. L'opportunità
• Team Coaching sistemico: fornire gli interventi di coaching end-to-end per le attività ad alta priorità (con TA-Focus), LCT, GDTs, GFTs, STs e altre squadre prioritarie a junctures critici (start-up, pietre miliari, transizioni, ecc). Potrai guardare oltre le personalità individuali al sistema più ampio, allineare gli stakeholder e garantire la responsabilità interfunzionale.
• Strategic Business Impact: Ti concentrerai sul miglioramento direzionale dei driver chiave del valore aziendale allenando i team verso l'eccellenza nella risoluzione dei problemi e nell'esecuzione. Si muoverà oltre le dinamiche tradizionali per garantire che gli sforzi di squadra sono misurati dal loro successo nella consegna e il loro allineamento con le priorità principali della PD.
• Foster Systemic Team Health & Alignment: In collaborazione con Resourcing Leads (RLs) e Global Program Managers (GPMs), si accelera l'efficacia del team attraverso chiarezza e allineamento. Essendo consapevoli delle particolarità di ogni TA, sarete responsabili per garantire che la salute del sistema di squadra agisce come un motore ad alte prestazioni per il ciclo di vita di sviluppo della droga.
• Operazionalizzare la TA-Model: Profonda la tua comprensione aziendale di aree terapeutiche specifiche (TA) per fornire valore e impatto mirati, assicurando che i trigger di coaching siano allineati con il nuovo framework di priorità LSPC.
• Data & Performance Culture: Mantenere una prospettiva di pensiero sistemico e utilizzare dati / metriche per identificare le intuizioni di cross-organizzazione. Sarete responsabili per dimostrare l'impatto misurabile degli interventi di coaching.
• Innovazione & AI Integrazione: Rimanete al passo con le tendenze del settore per migliorare le prestazioni del team e per esplorare e visualizzare proattivamente l'uso di AI, automazione e tecnologie digitali per migliorare le prestazioni del team e l'efficienza di coaching.
• Standard di Pratica e Misura del Valore: Contribuisci e adotti Standard di Pratica e Misurazione del Valore & Reporting, garantendo una qualità costante e un chiaro legame tra gli interventi di coaching e l'impatto aziendale in tutta l'organizzazione globale. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Corso di laurea richiesto; Master/MBA preferito. L'accreditamento formale in Team Coaching (ICF, EMCC, o equivalente) è essenziale.
• Esperienza: 10+ anni di esperienza nelle industrie farmaceutiche/biotecniche o ad alta complessità. Provato record di allenatore di squadra sistemico per team globali, matrice attraverso i cicli di cambiamento su larga scala e sviluppo della droga. L'esperienza deve andare oltre i singoli (1:1) allenando per includere il lavoro end-to-end con le squadre interfunzionali.
• Mindset sistemico: profonda comprensione del quadro sistemico

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position End-to-End Business Team Coach, Wachstum & Performance (G&P) Portfoliostrategie und -lieferung (PSD) Die Position Bei Roche haben wir eine mutige Pharma-Strategie, um 20 transformative Medikamente gegen Krankheiten mit der höchsten gesellschaftlichen Belastung zu liefern. Vor diesem Hintergrund besteht der Zweck von Portfolio Strategy and Delivery (PSD) darin, Roche-Strategien in PD-Prioritäten zu übersetzen und das Portfolio von PD hervorragend zu liefern. Als End-to-End Business Team Coach fungieren Sie als strategischer Partner für Teams mit hoher Priorität (einschließlich LCTs, GDTs, GFTs usw.) entlang der gesamten R&D-Wertschöpfungskette. Sie sind für den Aufbau und die Durchführung einer systemischen Coaching-Strategie verantwortlich, die die Bereitstellung des Kerngeschäfts und der kritischen vorrangigen Projekte von PD ermöglicht. Sie tragen zum Gesamterfolg von PD Growth & Performance (G&P) bei, indem Sie die Teameffektivität verbessern, Teams ausstatten, um Komplexität zu bewältigen und Entscheidungsfindung, Problemlösung und -bereitstellung zu beschleunigen. Die Chance
• Systemisches Team Coaching: Führen Sie End-to-End-Coaching-Interventionen für hochpriore Vermögenswerte (mit TA-Focus), LCTs, GDTs, GFTs, STs und andere priorisierte Teams zu kritischen Zeitpunkten (Start-ups, Meilensteine, Übergänge usw.) durch. Sie werden über einzelne Persönlichkeiten hinaus auf das breitere System blicken, die Interessengruppen ausrichten und eine funktionsübergreifende Rechenschaftspflicht sicherstellen.
• Strategische Geschäftsauswirkungen: Sie konzentrieren sich darauf, die wichtigsten Geschäftswerttreiber gezielt zu verbessern, indem Sie Teams in Richtung Exzellenz bei der Problemlösung und -ausführung coachen. Sie werden über die traditionelle Dynamik hinausgehen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Teambemühungen an ihrem Erfolg bei der Umsetzung und ihrer Ausrichtung auf die Kernprioritäten von PD gemessen werden.
• Pflegen Sie Systemic Team Health & Alignment: In Partnerschaft mit Resourcing Leads (RLs) und Global Program Managers (GPMs) beschleunigen Sie die Teameffektivität durch Klarheit und Ausrichtung. Wenn Sie sich der Besonderheiten jedes TA bewusst sind, sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, dass die Gesundheit des Teamsystems als Hochleistungsmotor für den Lebenszyklus der Arzneimittelentwicklung fungiert.
• Operationalisierung des TA-Modells: Vertiefen Sie Ihr Geschäftsverständnis für spezifische therapeutische Bereiche (TAs), um einen gezielten Wert und eine gezielte Wirkung zu erzielen, und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Coaching-Trigger auf das neue LSPC-Priorisierungs-Framework abgestimmt sind.
• Data & Performance Culture: Behalten Sie eine systemorientierte Perspektive bei und verwenden Sie Daten / Metriken, um organisationsübergreifende Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren. Sie werden dafür verantwortlich sein, die messbaren Auswirkungen von Coaching-Interventionen zu demonstrieren.
• Innovation & KI-Integration: Bleiben Sie den Branchentrends voraus, um die Teamleistung zu verbessern, und erkunden und visualisieren Sie proaktiv den Einsatz von KI, Automatisierung und digitalen Technologien, um die Teamleistung und die Coaching-Effizienz zu verbessern.
• Standards of Practice und Value Measurement: Tragen Sie zu Standards of Practice und Value Measurement & Reporting bei und übernehmen Sie diese, um eine konsistente Qualität und eine klare Verbindung zwischen Coaching-Interventionen und Geschäftsauswirkungen in der globalen Organisation zu gewährleisten. Wer du bist
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss erforderlich; Master / MBA bevorzugt. Die formale Akkreditierung im Team Coaching (ICF, EMCC oder gleichwertig) ist unerlässlich.
• Erfahrung: 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Pharma / Biotech oder hochkomplexen Branchen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz von systemischem Teamcoaching für globale, matrixisierte Teams durch groß angelegte Veränderungs- und Medikamentenentwicklungszyklen. Die Erfahrung muss über das individuelle (1:1) Coaching hinausgehen und die End-to-End-Arbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams umfassen.
• Systemisches Mindset: Tiefes Verständnis systemischer Rahmenbedingungen
